e.zh: 他在当地的废品场买到了汽车备件。

e.en: The old bus ended up rusting in a {scrapyard}.
e.zh: 那辆旧巴士最后在废品场里生锈烂掉了。

scratch.t:
v. 抓；挠；划伤
n. 划痕；从零开始

e.en: Don't {scratch} the mosquito bite or it will get worse.
e.zh: 别抓蚊子包，越抓越糟。

e.en: We had to start the project from {scratch} again.
e.zh: 我们只好从头开始重做这个项目。

scratchboard.t: n. 刮画板（刮画艺术用纸）

e.en: The artist created stunning illustrations on a black {scratchboard}.
e.zh: 这位艺术家在黑色刮画板上创作了惊艳的插画。

e.en: Kids love making art with a {scratchboard} and stylus.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢用刮画板和刻笔创作。

scratched.t:
v. 抓挠、划伤（scratch 的过去式）
adj. 有划痕的

e.en: The cat {scratched} the sofa to sharpen its claws.
e.zh: 猫抓沙发来磨爪子。

e.en: My phone screen got {scratched} in my pocket.
e.zh: 我的手机屏幕在口袋里被划花了。

scratcher.t: n. 抓挠用具（如挠痒棒）

e.en: I bought a back {scratcher} shaped like a tiny hand.
e.zh: 我买了个小手形状的痒痒挠。

e.en: The cat ignored the new {scratcher} we got her.
e.zh: 那只猫对我们新买的猫抓板不屑一顾。

scratches.t:
n. 划痕（复数）
v. 抓挠（scratch 的三单）

e.en: My new car already has a few {scratches} on the door.
e.zh: 我的新车门上已经有几道划痕了。

e.en: The dog {scratches} at the door when it wants out.
e.zh: 狗想出去时会抓门。

e.en: Stop {scratching} that rash before it gets infected.
e.zh: 别再抓那块疹子了，免得感染。

e.en: I could hear mice {scratching} inside the walls.
e.zh: 我能听见老鼠在墙里抓挠的声音。

scratchy.t: adj. 刺痒的；沙哑的；潦草的

e.en: This wool sweater is so {scratchy} against my skin.
e.zh: 这件羊毛衫穿在身上扎得慌。

e.en: Her voice sounded {scratchy} from yelling all night.
e.zh: 她喊了一整晚，嗓子都沙哑了。

scrawl.t:
v. 潦草地写
n. 潦草字迹

e.en: He tried to {scrawl} a note before running out the door.
e.zh: 他出门前匆忙潦草地写了张便条。

e.en: I can barely read the doctor's {scrawl} on this prescription.
e.zh: 医生处方上的鬼画符我几乎看不懂。

scrawled.t: v. 潦草地写（scrawl 的过去式）

e.en: Someone {scrawled} graffiti across the bathroom wall.
e.zh: 有人在洗手间墙上乱涂了涂鸦。

e.en: She {scrawled} her phone number on a napkin.
e.zh: 她在餐巾纸上潦草地写下电话号码。

e.en: That {scrawny} stray cat needs a good meal.
e.zh: 那只瘦巴巴的流浪猫需要吃顿好的。

e.en: He was a {scrawny} kid before he started lifting weights.
e.zh: 他练举重前是个瘦小的孩子。

scream.t:
v. 尖叫
n. 尖叫声

e.en: Don't {scream} at your little sister like that.
e.zh: 别那样冲你妹妹大吼大叫。

e.en: I heard a {scream} coming from the next apartment.
e.zh: 我听到隔壁公寓传来一声尖叫。

screamed.t: v. 尖叫（scream 的过去式）

e.en: She {screamed} when the spider crawled onto her arm.
e.zh: 蜘蛛爬到她胳膊上时，她尖叫了起来。

e.en: The fans {screamed} as the band took the stage.
e.zh: 乐队登台时粉丝们尖叫不已。

e.en: His shot was an absolute {screamer} into the top corner.
e.zh: 他那一脚劲射直挂球门死角。

e.en: The new horror movie is a real {screamer}.
e.zh: 这部新恐怖片真是吓人尖叫连连。

screaming.t:
v. 尖叫中
adj. 刺耳的；显眼的

e.en: The baby has been {screaming} for an hour straight.
e.zh: 宝宝已经连续哭叫了一个小时。

e.en: Fans were {screaming} the lyrics back at the singer.
e.zh: 歌迷们对着歌手嘶吼着合唱歌词。

screamingly.t: adv. 极度地；令人尖叫地

e.en: The new comedy is {screamingly} funny from start to finish.
e.zh: 这部新喜剧从头到尾笑得人前仰后合。

e.en: His outfit was {screamingly} obvious at the formal dinner.
e.zh: 他的着装在正式晚宴上扎眼得不行。

screams.t:
v. 尖叫（三单）
n. 尖叫声（复数）

e.en: Her bright red dress {screams} confidence and style.
e.zh: 她那件鲜红的连衣裙透着满满的自信和品味。

e.en: The {screams} from the haunted house echoed down the street.
e.zh: 鬼屋里传来的尖叫声回荡在整条街上。

e.en: Hikers slid down the loose {scree} on the mountainside.
e.zh: 徒步者在山坡松散的碎石坡上滑了下去。

e.en: Be careful crossing that field of {scree} above the cliff.
e.zh: 过悬崖上方那片碎石坡时要小心。

screech.t:
v. 发出尖啸声
n. 刺耳的尖叫

e.en: The car came to a sudden {screech} at the red light.
e.zh: 那辆车在红灯前急刹，发出刺耳的声响。

e.en: Owls {screech} loudly in the woods at night.
e.zh: 猫头鹰夜里在林中尖声鸣叫。

screeching.t:
adj. 刺耳尖叫的
v. 发出尖啸

e.en: The train pulled in with brakes {screeching} loudly.
e.zh: 火车进站时刹车发出刺耳的尖叫声。

e.en: A {screeching} parrot lives in my neighbor's apartment.
e.zh: 邻居家养了一只叫声刺耳的鹦鹉。

e.en: The old microphone made her voice sound {screechy}.
e.zh: 那个旧麦克风让她的声音变得刺耳。

e.en: That violin student is still pretty {screechy}.
e.zh: 那个学小提琴的学生拉得还很尖锐刺耳。

screed.t: n. 冗长的文章；砂浆找平层

e.en: He posted a long {screed} about modern politics online.
e.zh: 他在网上发了一篇关于当代政治的长篇大论。

e.en: Her email turned into a {screed} against the new policy.
e.zh: 她的邮件变成了针对新政策的一通声讨。

screen.t:
n. 屏幕；荧幕
v. 筛选；放映

e.en: My phone {screen} cracked when I dropped it on the floor.
e.zh: 我手机掉地上时屏幕摔裂了。

e.en: Companies {screen} job applicants before scheduling interviews.
e.zh: 公司在安排面试前会先筛选求职者。

screened.t:
v. 筛选；放映（screen 的过去式）
adj. 有屏蔽的

e.en: The film was {screened} at film festivals across Europe.
e.zh: 这部电影在欧洲各大电影节上展映。

e.en: All visitors are {screened} at the security checkpoint.
e.zh: 所有访客都要在安检处接受检查。

screener.t: n. 筛选者；样片（送审影片）

e.en: Critics received a {screener} of the movie before its release.
e.zh: 影评人在影片上映前拿到了一份试映片。

e.en: The {screener} at the door checked everyone's ID.
e.zh: 门口的安检员核查了每个人的身份证。

screening.t:
n. 筛查；放映
v. 筛选（screen 的现在分词）

e.en: There's a private {screening} of the new film tonight.
e.zh: 今晚有这部新电影的私人放映会。

e.en: Regular health {screening} can catch problems early.
e.zh: 定期体检筛查可以及早发现问题。

e.en: The festival hosts free {screenings} every weekend.
e.zh: 该电影节每周末都有免费放映场次。

e.en: Doctors recommend annual {screenings} for adults over forty.
e.zh: 医生建议四十岁以上成人每年做体检筛查。

e.en: She spent two years writing the {screenplay} for her debut film.
e.zh: 她花了两年时间写她的处女作剧本。

e.en: The {screenplay} was adapted from a bestselling novel.
e.zh: 这部剧本改编自一部畅销小说。

e.en: He has written several award-winning {screenplays} in his career.
e.zh: 他职业生涯中创作了几部获奖剧本。

e.en: Most {screenplays} follow a standard three-act structure.
e.zh: 大多数电影剧本都遵循标准的三幕结构。

screens.t:
n. 屏幕（复数）
v. 筛选；放映

e.en: Kids spend too many hours staring at {screens} these days.
e.zh: 现在的孩子盯着屏幕的时间太多了。

e.en: The theater has twelve {screens} showing different movies.
e.zh: 这家影院有十二个放映厅同时上映不同电影。

e.en: My {screensaver} is a slideshow of vacation photos.
e.zh: 我的屏保是度假照片的幻灯片。

e.en: The office computers all have the company logo as a {screensaver}.
e.zh: 办公室的电脑屏保都是公司标志。

e.en: The {screenwriter} won an Oscar for her debut film.
e.zh: 这位编剧凭处女作拿下了奥斯卡奖。

e.en: Becoming a successful {screenwriter} in Hollywood is incredibly difficult.
e.zh: 在好莱坞成为成功的编剧极其困难。

e.en: Several famous {screenwriters} are joining the writers' strike.
e.zh: 几位知名编剧加入了编剧罢工。

e.en: The studio hired two {screenwriters} to revise the script.
e.zh: 制片公司聘请了两位编剧修改剧本。

e.en: She's taking a {screenwriting} class at the local college.
e.zh: 她正在本地大学上编剧课。

e.en: Good {screenwriting} balances dialogue with strong visual storytelling.
e.zh: 好的编剧既讲究台词，也注重视觉叙事。

screw.t:
n. 螺丝钉
v. 拧紧；搞砸

e.en: I need a smaller {screw} to fix this loose hinge.
e.zh: 我需要一颗小一点的螺丝来修这个松动的合页。

e.en: Don't {screw} up your big interview tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天那场重要面试可别搞砸了。

screwball.t:
n. 怪人；曲线球
adj. 古怪的

e.en: The film is a classic {screwball} comedy from the 1930s.
e.zh: 这部电影是上世纪三十年代经典的疯癫喜剧。

e.en: My uncle is a lovable {screwball} who tells wild stories.
e.zh: 我叔叔是个可爱的怪人，总讲离奇故事。

e.en: Hand me a Phillips {screwdriver} from the toolbox.
e.zh: 把工具箱里的十字螺丝刀递给我。

e.en: He ordered a vodka {screwdriver} at the airport bar.
e.zh: 他在机场酒吧点了一杯伏特加橙汁鸡尾酒。

screwed.t: adj. 搞砸了的；完蛋了的

e.en: If we miss this deadline, we're completely {screwed}.
e.zh: 如果错过这个截止日期，我们就彻底完蛋了。

e.en: He {screwed} the shelf firmly into the wall.
e.zh: 他把架子牢牢地拧在墙上。

screwing.t: v. 拧紧；搞砸（现在分词）

e.en: He's {screwing} the new license plate onto the car.
e.zh: 他正把新车牌拧到车上。

e.en: Stop {screwing} around and finish your homework.
e.zh: 别再瞎胡闹了，把作业写完。

e.en: This flat-pack desk needs sixteen tiny {screws}.
e.zh: 这张组装书桌需要十六颗小螺丝。

e.en: He {screws} the lid on tightly to keep it fresh.
e.zh: 他把盖子拧紧以保持新鲜。

e.en: Ranchers worry about {screwworm} infestations harming their cattle.
e.zh: 牧场主担心螺旋蝇蛆危害他们的牛群。

e.en: The {screwworm} was eradicated through a sterile insect program.
e.zh: 通过不育昆虫项目，螺旋蝇蛆被根除了。

e.en: My laptop has been acting {screwy} since the update.
e.zh: 自从更新后我的笔记本电脑就一直运行得怪怪的。

e.en: That's the {screwy}-est plan I've ever heard.
e.zh: 那是我听过最离谱的计划。

e.en: The manuscript shows clear {scribal} errors in several lines.
e.zh: 这份手稿在若干行中明显存在抄写员的错误。

e.en: Ancient {scribal} traditions preserved knowledge across generations.
e.zh: 古代抄写员的传统将知识代代相传。

scribble.t:
v. 乱涂乱写
n. 潦草字迹

e.en: Let me {scribble} down the address before I forget.
e.zh: 我趁还没忘先把地址草草记下。

e.en: The toddler covered the wall with crayon {scribble}.
e.zh: 那小孩用蜡笔在墙上画满了乱涂乱画。

e.en: She {scribbled} a quick note and slipped it under the door.
e.zh: 她匆匆写了张便条塞到门下。

e.en: He {scribbled} ideas on a napkin during lunch.
e.zh: 他午餐时把想法草草写在餐巾纸上。

e.en: The novelist modestly called himself a humble {scribbler}.
e.zh: 那位小说家谦虚地自称是个不入流的写手。

e.en: Every {scribbler} dreams of writing a bestseller someday.
e.zh: 每个涂鸦写手都梦想有朝一日写出畅销书。

scribbles.t:
n. 潦草字迹
v. 乱写（第三人称）

e.en: The notebook was full of mysterious {scribbles} and doodles.
e.zh: 笔记本上满是神秘的涂鸦和潦草字迹。

e.en: She {scribbles} reminders on every available scrap of paper.
e.zh: 她把备忘随手潦草地写在任何能找到的纸片上。

scribbling.t: v. 乱涂乱写（现在分词）

e.en: The reporter was {scribbling} notes throughout the press conference.
e.zh: 记者在整个新闻发布会上都在快速记笔记。

e.en: Stop {scribbling} on the table—use paper instead.
e.zh: 别在桌子上乱涂，用纸吧。

e.en: In ancient Egypt, a {scribe} held great social status.
e.zh: 在古埃及，抄写员拥有很高的社会地位。

e.en: Hospitals now hire a medical {scribe} to document patient visits.
e.zh: 医院现在雇佣医疗记录员来记录病人就诊情况。

e.en: A black {scrim} concealed the stage crew from the audience.
e.zh: 一块黑色纱幕将后台工作人员从观众视线中遮住。

e.en: The director used a {scrim} to create a dreamlike effect.
e.zh: 导演用纱幕营造出梦幻般的效果。

e.en: The team held a light {scrimmage} before the big game.
e.zh: 球队在大赛前进行了一场轻松的练习赛。

e.en: Coach watched the players {scrimmage} on the practice field.
e.zh: 教练在训练场上看着球员们进行对抗练习。

e.en: They had to {scrimp} on groceries to pay rent.
e.zh: 他们不得不在食品上省钱来付房租。

e.en: Don't {scrimp} when buying a good pair of shoes.
e.zh: 买一双好鞋时不要太省。

scrimshaw.t: n. 贝壳或骨雕工艺品

e.en: The museum displays whalebone {scrimshaw} carved by sailors.
e.zh: 博物馆展出水手雕刻的鲸骨工艺品。

e.en: He learned {scrimshaw} from his grandfather last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他跟祖父学了骨雕手艺。

e.en: Workers were paid in company {scrip} instead of cash.
e.zh: 工人们领到的是公司代用券而不是现金。

e.en: The old mining town once issued its own {scrip}.
e.zh: 这座旧矿镇曾发行过自己的代币。

script.t:
n. 脚本；剧本
v. 编写脚本

e.en: The actor memorized the entire {script} in two days.
e.zh: 那位演员两天就背完了整个剧本。

e.en: I wrote a Python {script} to rename the files.
e.zh: 我写了个 Python 脚本来重命名这些文件。

scripted.t: adj. 照脚本的；预先写好的

e.en: Her apology sounded oddly {scripted} and insincere.
e.zh: 她的道歉听起来像照稿念的,毫无诚意。

e.en: The interview was fully {scripted} by the producers.
e.zh: 这场采访完全由制片人写好了台词。

scripting.t:
n. 脚本编写
v. 编写脚本（现在分词）

e.en: Bash {scripting} can automate boring repetitive tasks.
e.zh: 用 Bash 脚本可以自动化那些枯燥重复的工作。

e.en: She's {scripting} a short film for the festival.
e.zh: 她正在为电影节编写一部短片的剧本。

e.en: Medieval monks copied books in a quiet {scriptorium}.
e.zh: 中世纪的僧侣在安静的缮写室里抄书。

e.en: The abbey's {scriptorium} produced beautifully illuminated manuscripts.
e.zh: 修道院的缮写室出品了精美的彩饰手抄本。

e.en: All the build {scripts} live in the tools folder.
e.zh: 所有构建脚本都放在 tools 文件夹里。

e.en: She reads movie {scripts} on the train every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上在地铁上读电影剧本。

e.en: The pastor offered a {scriptural} answer to her question.
e.zh: 牧师以圣经经文回答了她的问题。

e.en: His sermon drew on several {scriptural} references.
e.zh: 他的布道引用了多处圣经经文。

scripturally.t: adv. 按照圣经；依经文地

e.en: The argument is {scripturally} sound but practically difficult.
e.zh: 这一论点在经文上站得住脚,但实践起来很难。

e.en: She defended her view {scripturally} and with conviction.
e.zh: 她引经据典且坚定地为自己的观点辩护。

e.en: He quoted {scripture} during the wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 他在婚礼上引用了一段圣经经文。

e.en: Daily reading of {scripture} brings her great comfort.
e.zh: 每天读经让她感到极大的安慰。

e.en: The {scriptwriter} won an Emmy for the pilot episode.
e.zh: 那位编剧凭试播集赢得了艾美奖。

e.en: She works as a freelance {scriptwriter} for streaming shows.
e.zh: 她是一名自由编剧,为流媒体剧集写稿。

e.en: In old novels, a {scrivener} copied legal documents by hand.
e.zh: 在旧小说里,抄写员靠手写复制法律文书。

e.en: The {scrivener} sat hunched over his desk all day.
e.zh: 那位抄写员整天弓着身子伏案工作。

e.en: Boston restaurants are famous for their broiled {scrod}.
e.zh: 波士顿的餐馆以烤小鳕鱼出名。

e.en: I ordered the {scrod} with lemon butter sauce.
e.zh: 我点了配柠檬黄油酱的小鳕鱼。

e.en: In medieval times, {scrofula} was called the king's evil.
e.zh: 中世纪时,瘰疬被称为王者之疾。

e.en: The doctor recognized the symptoms of {scrofula} immediately.
e.zh: 医生立刻认出了瘰疬的症状。

e.en: The old manuscript spelled the word as {scrol}.
e.zh: 那本古手稿把这个词拼作 scrol。

e.en: "{Scrol}" is an archaic spelling of "scroll."
e.zh: scrol 是 scroll 一词的古老拼法。

scroll.t:
v. 滚动（网页、列表）
n. 卷轴

e.en: I {scroll} through the feed before bed.
e.zh: 我睡前会刷一下信息流。

e.en: She unrolled the ancient {scroll} carefully.
e.zh: 她小心地展开那卷古卷轴。

e.en: He {scrolled} through hundreds of messages looking for hers.
e.zh: 他翻了上百条消息,只为找她那条。

e.en: She {scrolled} to the bottom of the page.
e.zh: 她滑到了页面最底部。

scrolling.t:
n. 滚动（屏幕）
v. 滚动（现在分词）

e.en: Endless {scrolling} on social media drains my evenings.
e.zh: 在社交媒体上无尽地刷屏耗掉了我的夜晚。

e.en: Stop {scrolling} and go to bed already.
e.zh: 别再刷手机了,快去睡觉。

scrolls.t:
v. 滚动（第三人称）
n. 卷轴（复数）

e.en: The Dead Sea {scrolls} were discovered by a shepherd.
e.zh: 死海古卷是被一位牧羊人发现的。

e.en: He {scrolls} through Twitter the moment he wakes up.
e.zh: 他一醒来就开始刷推特。

e.en: The iron gate features delicate {scrollwork} along the top.
e.zh: 那扇铁门顶部有精致的卷涡花饰。

e.en: Antique furniture often has hand-carved {scrollwork} on the legs.
e.zh: 古董家具的腿脚常有手工雕刻的卷形花纹。

e.en: Don't be such a {scrooge} — buy your kid a gift.
e.zh: 别这么吝啬,给你孩子买个礼物吧。

e.en: My boss is a real {scrooge} around the holidays.
e.zh: 我老板在节日期间真是个守财奴。

e.en: Even {scrooges} loosen their wallets at Christmas time.
e.zh: 就连小气鬼到了圣诞节也会松开钱包。

e.en: The office is full of {scrooges} who skip every party.
e.zh: 办公室里全是不参加任何聚会的吝啬鬼。

e.en: The doctor ordered an ultrasound to check for {scrotal} swelling.
e.zh: 医生开了超声检查以确认是否有阴囊肿胀。

e.en: He visited the clinic complaining of {scrotal} pain.
e.zh: 他去诊所就诊,主诉阴囊疼痛。

e.en: The {scrotum} regulates testicular temperature for sperm production.
e.zh: 阴囊调节睾丸温度以利于精子生成。

e.en: Any lump in the {scrotum} should be examined promptly.
e.zh: 阴囊里出现任何肿块都应尽快就医检查。

e.en: I had to {scrounge} for change to pay the toll.
e.zh: 我得四处翻找零钱才付得起过路费。

e.en: Students often {scrounge} free pizza at campus events.
e.zh: 学生们经常在校园活动上蹭免费披萨。

e.en: My roommate is a total {scrounger} who never buys snacks.
e.zh: 我室友是个十足的蹭东西鬼,从来不买零食。

e.en: He's known as the office {scrounger} for free coffee.
e.zh: 他在办公室是出了名的蹭咖啡能手。

scrub.t:
v. 用力擦洗
v. 取消（计划、任务）

e.en: You'll need to {scrub} the pan to remove burnt sauce.
e.zh: 你得用力刷这只锅,才能去掉烧焦的酱汁。

e.en: They had to {scrub} the rocket launch due to weather.
e.zh: 由于天气原因,他们不得不取消火箭发射。

scrubbed.t:
adj. 擦洗干净的
v. scrub 的过去式

e.en: She {scrubbed} the bathroom tiles until they sparkled.
e.zh: 她把浴室瓷砖刷得锃亮。

e.en: NASA {scrubbed} the mission after detecting a fuel leak.
e.zh: 美国宇航局在发现燃料泄漏后取消了此次任务。

scrubber.t: n. 洗刷工具；废气净化器

e.en: The factory installed a {scrubber} to reduce smokestack emissions.
e.zh: 工厂安装了一台洗涤器以减少烟囱排放。

e.en: This sponge has a rough {scrubber} on one side.
e.zh: 这块海绵一面带有粗糙的擦洗面。

e.en: He spent the morning {scrubbing} the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 他用了一上午擦洗厨房地板。

e.en: {Scrubbing} the video forward, I found the missing clip.
e.zh: 我快进拖动视频,找到了缺失的那段画面。

scrubby.t: adj. 长满矮树丛的；矮小的

e.en: The trail wound through dry, {scrubby} hills for miles.
e.zh: 小径在干燥而灌木丛生的山间蜿蜒数英里。

e.en: A few {scrubby} bushes grew beside the abandoned house.
e.zh: 那座废弃的房子旁长着几丛矮小的灌木。

e.en: Kangaroos roam freely across the Australian {scrubland}.
e.zh: 袋鼠在澳大利亚的灌木荒原上自由游荡。

e.en: Much of the region is dry {scrubland} unsuitable for farming.
e.zh: 该地区大多是不适合耕作的干旱灌木地。

e.en: The mother cat carried her kitten by the {scruff}.
e.zh: 母猫叼着小猫的颈背把它带走。

e.en: He grabbed the puppy gently by the {scruff} of its neck.
e.zh: 他轻轻抓住小狗的颈背。

e.en: He showed up to the meeting in {scruffy} jeans and sneakers.
e.zh: 他穿着邋遢的牛仔裤和运动鞋就来开会了。

e.en: The {scruffy} little dog wagged its tail at strangers.
e.zh: 那只毛发凌乱的小狗对着陌生人摇尾巴。

scrum.t:
n. Scrum 敏捷开发流程
n. 橄榄球争球

e.en: Our team holds a daily {scrum} every morning at nine.
e.zh: 我们团队每天早上九点开站会。

e.en: The forwards locked together for the {scrum} near the goal line.
e.zh: 前锋们在球门线附近抱在一起争球。

e.en: The referee ordered another {scrummage} after the forward pass.
e.zh: 裁判在向前传球之后又判了一次争球。

e.en: Players bound tightly together as the {scrummage} began.
e.zh: 争球开始时，球员们紧紧地抱在一起。

e.en: Grandma baked a {scrumptious} chocolate cake for my birthday.
e.zh: 奶奶为我的生日烤了一个超好吃的巧克力蛋糕。

e.en: That Thai place serves {scrumptious} green curry.
e.zh: 那家泰国餐厅的青咖喱真是美味。

e.en: We tried some local {scrumpy} at the village pub.
e.zh: 我们在村里的酒馆尝了些当地的烈苹果酒。

e.en: Farmers in Somerset still brew traditional {scrumpy} cider.
e.zh: 萨默塞特的农民仍在酿造传统的烈苹果酒。

e.en: Don't {scrunch} the paper before putting it in the printer.
e.zh: 放进打印机之前别把纸揉皱了。

e.en: She tends to {scrunch} her nose when she's confused.
e.zh: 她一困惑就会皱起鼻子。

scrunched.t: adj. 被揉皱的、缩成一团的

e.en: He {scrunched} the receipt into a tiny ball.
e.zh: 他把收据揉成了一个小纸团。

e.en: She {scrunched} up her face at the bitter taste.
e.zh: 她尝到苦味，脸都皱成了一团。

e.en: She tied her hair back with a pink {scrunchie}.
e.zh: 她用一个粉色发圈把头发扎了起来。

e.en: {Scrunchies} from the nineties are trendy again.
e.zh: 九十年代的发圈又重新流行起来了。

e.en: He had no {scruple} about lying to get the promotion.
e.zh: 他为了升职撒谎，毫无顾忌。

e.en: She wouldn't {scruple} to ask for a refund.
e.zh: 她要求退款时一点也不会犹豫。

scrupulous.t: adj. 严谨的、一丝不苟的

e.en: The accountant is {scrupulous} about every single receipt.
e.zh: 这位会计对每一张收据都一丝不苟。

e.en: Be {scrupulous} when citing sources in your research paper.
e.zh: 在研究论文中引用资料时务必严谨。

e.en: She kept her kitchen {scrupulously} clean at all times.
e.zh: 她始终把厨房打扫得一尘不染。

e.en: The judge {scrupulously} followed every rule of evidence.
e.zh: 法官严格遵守每一条证据规则。

scrutable.t: adj. 可看透的、可理解的

e.en: His motives were finally {scrutable} after the email leaked.
e.zh: 邮件泄露后，他的动机终于变得清晰可辨。

e.en: The contract's terms are barely {scrutable} without a lawyer.
e.zh: 没有律师帮忙，合同条款几乎让人看不懂。

e.en: A {scrutineer} watched as ballots were counted at the table.
e.zh: 一名监票员在旁监督桌上的选票计票。

e.en: Each party may send one {scrutineer} to the polling station.
e.zh: 每个政党可派一名监票员到投票站。

scrutinies.t: n. scrutiny 的复数；多次审查

e.en: The proposal survived multiple {scrutinies} by the audit team.
e.zh: 该提案经受住了审计团队的多轮审查。

e.en: Several {scrutinies} of the data revealed no errors.
e.zh: 对数据的多次细查均未发现错误。

scrutinise.t: v. 仔细审查（英式拼写）

e.en: Inspectors will {scrutinise} every document before approval.
e.zh: 检查员会在批准前仔细审查每一份文件。

e.en: Critics {scrutinise} the budget line by line each year.
e.zh: 评论人士每年都会逐条审视预算。

e.en: The auditor {scrutinised} the spreadsheet for hidden errors.
e.zh: 审计员仔细检查了表格中是否有隐藏的错误。

e.en: Reporters {scrutinised} the candidate's tax returns closely.
e.zh: 记者们仔细审查了这位候选人的报税记录。

scrutinises.t: v. scrutinise 的第三人称单数

e.en: The auditor {scrutinises} every receipt before approving the report.
e.zh: 审计员在批准报告前会仔细审查每张收据。

e.en: She {scrutinises} job applications for any inconsistencies.
e.zh: 她仔细审视求职申请是否有任何前后矛盾之处。

e.en: He spent hours {scrutinising} the contract for hidden clauses.
e.zh: 他花了几个小时仔细审查合同中是否有隐藏条款。

e.en: The committee is {scrutinising} the budget proposal closely.
e.zh: 委员会正在仔细审查这份预算提案。

e.en: Editors {scrutinize} every line before publishing the article.
e.zh: 编辑在文章发表前会仔细审查每一行。

e.en: You should {scrutinize} the terms before signing the lease.
e.zh: 签租约前你应该仔细审阅条款。

e.en: The lab results were {scrutinized} by three independent experts.
e.zh: 实验结果被三位独立专家仔细审查过。

e.en: She {scrutinized} his face for any sign of doubt.
e.zh: 她仔细打量他的脸，寻找任何怀疑的迹象。

scrutinizes.t: v. scrutinize 的第三人称单数

e.en: The teacher {scrutinizes} each essay for plagiarism.
e.zh: 老师会仔细检查每篇文章是否有抄袭。

e.en: He {scrutinizes} the data before drawing any conclusions.
e.zh: 他在得出任何结论前都会仔细审查数据。

e.en: Investors are {scrutinizing} the startup's financial statements.
e.zh: 投资者正在仔细审视这家初创公司的财务报表。

e.en: She kept {scrutinizing} the photo for familiar faces.
e.zh: 她不停地仔细端详照片，寻找熟悉的面孔。

e.en: The new policy is under intense public {scrutiny}.
e.zh: 新政策正受到公众的密切审视。

e.en: His expenses didn't hold up to closer {scrutiny}.
e.zh: 他的开支经不起更仔细的审查。

scrying.t: n. 借水晶球等预言占卜

e.en: The fortune teller claimed to see futures by {scrying} into a crystal ball.
e.zh: 那位算命师声称能通过水晶球占卜看到未来。

e.en: Medieval mystics practiced {scrying} using polished mirrors.
e.zh: 中世纪的神秘主义者用磨光的镜子进行水晶占卜。

scsi.t: n. 小型计算机系统接口

e.en: Old servers often relied on {SCSI} drives for storage.
e.zh: 老式服务器通常依靠 SCSI 硬盘来存储数据。

e.en: The technician replaced the failing {SCSI} controller.
e.zh: 技术员更换了出故障的 SCSI 控制器。

e.en: We took a {scuba} diving course in Thailand last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在泰国上了水肺潜水课。

e.en: He bought new {scuba} gear before the Bali trip.
e.zh: 去巴厘岛之前他买了新的水肺潜水装备。

e.en: The dive shop rents out {scubas} and wetsuits by the hour.
e.zh: 潜水店按小时出租水肺装备和潜水服。

e.en: Several {scubas} were lined up on the boat deck.
e.zh: 几套水肺装备整齐地摆在船甲板上。

e.en: Dark clouds {scud} across the sky before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨前乌云在天空中飞掠而过。

e.en: Sailboats {scud} along the bay in the strong wind.
e.zh: 帆船在大风中沿着海湾飞驰。

e.en: Clouds were {scudding} across the moon all night.
e.zh: 云整夜在月亮前面飞快地掠过。

e.en: We watched the leaves {scudding} down the empty street.
e.zh: 我们看着树叶顺着空荡的街道飞快地飘过。

scuff.t:
v. 磨蹭出痕迹
n. 擦痕

e.en: Try not to {scuff} your new shoes on the pavement.
e.zh: 尽量别在人行道上把你的新鞋蹭花了。

e.en: There's a small {scuff} on the corner of the table.
e.zh: 桌角上有一处小小的擦痕。

scuffed.t: adj. 被磨损的、有擦痕的

e.en: His {scuffed} sneakers showed years of skateboarding.
e.zh: 他那双磨损的运动鞋显示出多年滑板生涯的痕迹。

e.en: She {scuffed} her boot against the curb by accident.
e.zh: 她不小心把靴子蹭到了路缘石上。

e.en: A brief {scuffle} broke out between the two fans.
e.zh: 两名球迷之间爆发了短暂的扭打。

e.en: Police were called after a {scuffle} in the parking lot.
e.zh: 停车场发生扭打后警察被叫来了。

e.en: The kids were {scuffling} over the last slice of pizza.
e.zh: 孩子们为了最后一块披萨扭打在一起。

e.en: We heard people {scuffling} outside the bar at midnight.
e.zh: 半夜我们听到酒吧外有人在扭打。

scull.t:
v. 用单桨划船
n. 短桨

e.en: He likes to {scull} on the river early every morning.
e.zh: 他喜欢每天清晨在河上划单人赛艇。

e.en: The rower lifted the {scull} carefully out of the water.
e.zh: 那位划手小心地把单桨划艇抬出水面。

e.en: The old mansion still has a working {scullery} downstairs.
e.zh: 这栋老宅楼下还有一间能用的洗碗间。

e.en: Maids once washed dishes for hours in the {scullery}.
e.zh: 女仆们过去常常在洗碗间一洗就是几个小时。

scully.t: n. 人名（罕用普通词义）

e.en: Agent {Scully} remained the skeptical scientist throughout the series.
e.zh: 史考莉探员在整部剧中始终是位持怀疑态度的科学家。

e.en: Fans still debate whether Mulder or {Scully} was right.
e.zh: 粉丝们至今仍在争论穆德和史考莉谁才是对的。

e.en: The angler caught a small {sculpin} off the rocky shore.
e.zh: 那位钓鱼者在多岩石的岸边钓到了一条小杜父鱼。

e.en: A spiny {sculpin} darted between the tide pool rocks.
e.zh: 一条多刺的杜父鱼在潮池岩石间快速穿行。

e.en: She learned to {sculpt} clay figures at art school.
e.zh: 她在艺术学校学会了用黏土塑造人像。

e.en: Personal trainers help clients {sculpt} their bodies.
e.zh: 私人教练帮助客户雕塑自己的身材。

sculpted.t:
adj. 雕刻成型的
v. sculpt 的过去式

e.en: The artist {sculpted} a lifelike statue from marble.
e.zh: 那位艺术家用大理石雕刻出一尊栩栩如生的雕像。

e.en: He has a finely {sculpted} jawline.
e.zh: 他的下颌线条轮廓分明。

sculpting.t:
v. 雕刻；塑造
n. 雕刻艺术

e.en: She spent the weekend {sculpting} a small bronze figure.
e.zh: 她整个周末都在雕刻一个小小的青铜人像。

e.en: This workout focuses on {sculpting} core muscles.
e.zh: 这套训练专注于塑造核心肌群。

e.en: The {sculptor} unveiled her latest bronze piece yesterday.
e.zh: 那位雕塑家昨天揭幕了她最新的青铜作品。

e.en: He trained as a {sculptor} in Florence for ten years.
e.zh: 他在佛罗伦萨当了十年雕塑家学徒。

e.en: The young {sculptress} won a major prize at the biennale.
e.zh: 这位年轻的女雕塑家在双年展上荣获大奖。

e.en: A renowned {sculptress} donated the statue to the city.
e.zh: 一位著名女雕塑家将这尊雕像捐赠给了这座城市。

sculptural.t: adj. 雕塑的；有雕塑感的

e.en: The building features striking {sculptural} curves.
e.zh: 这栋建筑有着引人注目的雕塑般的曲线。

e.en: Her dress had a {sculptural} quality on the runway.
e.zh: 她的裙子在 T 台上呈现出雕塑般的质感。

sculpture.t:
n. 雕塑；雕刻作品
v. 雕刻

e.en: A bronze {sculpture} stands in the museum's main hall.
e.zh: 博物馆的大厅里立着一尊青铜雕塑。

e.en: She studies modern {sculpture} at the academy.
e.zh: 她在学院里学习现代雕塑。

sculptured.t: adj. 雕刻成的；轮廓分明的

e.en: The garden was decorated with finely {sculptured} hedges.
e.zh: 花园里装饰着修剪精美如雕塑般的树篱。

e.en: He admired her {sculptured} cheekbones in the photo.
e.zh: 他欣赏照片中她那如雕刻般的颧骨。

e.en: The gallery houses dozens of marble {sculptures}.
e.zh: 这家画廊收藏着数十件大理石雕塑。

e.en: His ice {sculptures} melted before the festival ended.
e.zh: 他的冰雕在艺术节结束前就融化了。

e.en: A layer of green {scum} covered the abandoned pond.
e.zh: 一层绿色浮渣盖满了那个废弃的池塘。

e.en: Skim the {scum} off the broth before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前把汤上的浮沫撇掉。

e.en: Don't trust him — he's a total {scumbag}.
e.zh: 别信他，他完全就是个人渣。

e.en: The {scumbag} stole money from his own grandmother.
e.zh: 那个人渣居然偷了自己外婆的钱。

scummy.t: adj. 卑鄙的；满是浮渣的

e.en: The pond water looked too {scummy} to swim in.
e.zh: 池塘的水看起来太脏了，没法游泳。

e.en: That was a really {scummy} thing to do to a friend.
e.zh: 对朋友做这种事真的太卑鄙了。

scunthorpe.t: n. 斯肯索普（英国城市）

e.en: She grew up in {Scunthorpe} before moving to London.
e.zh: 她在搬到伦敦前一直在斯肯索普长大。

e.en: The football team from {Scunthorpe} plays in a lower league.
e.zh: 来自斯肯索普的那支足球队在低级别联赛踢球。

scupper.t:
v. 使失败；破坏
n. 排水口

e.en: A leak threatened to {scupper} the entire merger deal.
e.zh: 一处泄漏可能会毁掉整个并购交易。

e.en: Bad weather could {scupper} our weekend plans.
e.zh: 坏天气可能会毁掉我们的周末计划。

e.en: Grandma made jelly from the {scuppernong} grapes every fall.
e.zh: 奶奶每年秋天都用麝香葡萄做果冻。

e.en: The vineyard specializes in sweet {scuppernong} wine.
e.zh: 这家葡萄园专门酿造甜味的麝香葡萄酒。

scurrilous.t: adj. 下流的；恶意诽谤的

e.en: The tabloid published a {scurrilous} attack on the actress.
e.zh: 那家小报刊登了对那位女演员的恶毒攻击。

e.en: He sued the blogger over the {scurrilous} accusations.
e.zh: 他就那些诽谤性的指控起诉了那位博主。

e.en: Mice {scurry} across the kitchen floor at night.
e.zh: 老鼠夜里在厨房地板上窜来窜去。

e.en: Tourists {scurry} for cover when the rain starts.
e.zh: 游客们一下雨就匆匆找地方避雨。

scurrying.t: v. 匆忙奔跑（scurry 现在分词）

e.en: Office workers were {scurrying} home through the snow.
e.zh: 上班族冒着雪匆匆忙忙地往家赶。

e.en: I saw a squirrel {scurrying} up the tree trunk.
e.zh: 我看见一只松鼠急匆匆地爬上树干。

scurvy.t:
n. 坏血病
adj. 卑鄙的

e.en: Sailors used to suffer from {scurvy} on long voyages.
e.zh: 水手们过去在长途航行中常患坏血病。

e.en: Vitamin C in citrus fruits prevents {scurvy}.
e.zh: 柑橘类水果中的维生素 C 可以预防坏血病。

e.en: Junior doctors do most of the {scut} work in the hospital.
e.zh: 住院医师在医院里干大部分跑腿杂活。

e.en: The rabbit's white {scut} flashed as it ran into the bushes.
e.zh: 兔子钻进灌木丛时，白色的短尾巴一闪而过。

e.en: Crabs {scutter} sideways across the wet sand.
e.zh: 螃蟹横着身子在湿沙上飞快爬过。

e.en: We heard mice {scutter} behind the kitchen wall.
e.zh: 我们听见老鼠在厨房墙后窸窸窣窣地跑。

e.en: The leaked report could {scuttle} the campaign.
e.zh: 泄露的报告可能会毁掉整个竞选活动。

e.en: Crabs {scuttle} sideways along the wet sand.
e.zh: 螃蟹沿着湿沙横着快速爬行。

e.en: The office {scuttlebutt} says she's getting promoted soon.
e.zh: 办公室的小道消息说她很快就要升职了。

e.en: Don't believe every piece of {scuttlebutt} you hear at work.
e.zh: 别相信你在公司听到的每一条小道消息。

scuttling.t: v. 快跑；凿沉（scuttle 现在分词）

e.en: Crabs were {scuttling} across the rocks at low tide.
e.zh: 退潮时螃蟹在岩石上飞快地爬来爬去。

e.en: The scandal risks {scuttling} his reelection bid.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻有可能毁掉他的连任竞选。

e.en: The beetle's hard {scutum} protects its wings underneath.
e.zh: 甲虫坚硬的小盾片保护着下面的翅膀。

e.en: Entomologists examined the markings on the insect's {scutum}.
e.zh: 昆虫学家观察了昆虫小盾片上的纹路。

scuzzy.t: adj. 肮脏的；令人厌恶的

e.en: We avoided that {scuzzy} bar near the bus station.
e.zh: 我们都避开汽车站旁边那家又脏又破的酒吧。

e.en: His apartment was {scuzzy} but the rent was cheap.
e.zh: 他的公寓又脏又乱，但租金便宜。

scylla.t: n. 锡拉（希腊神话中的海妖）

e.en: Sailors in legend feared the monster {Scylla} guarding the strait.
e.zh: 传说中水手们都害怕守护海峡的怪物斯库拉。

e.en: He was caught between {Scylla} and Charybdis at work.
e.zh: 他在工作中陷入了进退两难的困境。

scythe.t:
n. 长柄镰刀
v. 用镰刀割

e.en: The farmer swung his {scythe} through the tall grass.
e.zh: 农夫挥舞着大镰刀割倒高高的青草。

e.en: Death is often pictured carrying a {scythe}.
e.zh: 死神常常被描绘成手持大镰刀的形象。

e.en: Workers sharpened their {scythes} before heading to the fields.
e.zh: 工人们去田里之前先把大镰刀磨利了。

e.en: Old {scythes} hung on the wall of the barn.
e.zh: 几把旧镰刀挂在谷仓的墙上。

scythian.t:
n. 斯基泰人
adj. 斯基泰的

e.en: The museum displays gold artifacts from {Scythian} burial mounds.
e.zh: 博物馆展出斯基泰人墓葬中的黄金文物。

e.en: Ancient {Scythian} warriors were famed for their skill with bows.
e.zh: 古代斯基泰战士以精湛的弓箭技艺闻名。

sda.t: n. 串行数据线（Serial Data）；基督复临安息日会

sdi.t: n. 战略防御倡议（Strategic Defense Initiative）

sdp.t: n. 会话描述协议（Session Description Protocol）

sdr.t: n. 特别提款权；软件定义无线电

sds.t: n. 安全数据表（Safety Data Sheet）

e.en: Cables run along the {seabed} to connect the two continents.
e.zh: 电缆沿着海床连接两个大陆。

e.en: Scientists mapped the {seabed} using sonar technology.
e.zh: 科学家用声纳技术绘制海床地图。

e.en: A lone {seabird} circled above the fishing boat.
e.zh: 一只海鸟在渔船上空盘旋。

e.en: Plastic pollution threatens {seabird} populations worldwide.
e.zh: 塑料污染威胁着全球海鸟种群。

e.en: The storm hit cities along the eastern {seaboard}.
e.zh: 风暴袭击了东海岸沿线的城市。

e.en: Trade flourished across the entire Atlantic {seaboard}.
e.zh: 贸易在整个大西洋沿岸蓬勃发展。

seaborne.t: adj. 海运的；由海上运输的

e.en: Most global cargo travels via {seaborne} shipping routes.
e.zh: 全球大多数货物通过海运路线运输。

e.en: The country relies on {seaborne} oil imports.
e.zh: 该国依赖海运石油进口。

e.en: The {Seabrook} nuclear plant supplies power to New England.
e.zh: 西布鲁克核电站为新英格兰地区供电。

e.en: They spent the weekend at a cottage in {Seabrook}.
e.zh: 他们在西布鲁克的小屋度过了周末。

e.en: The {SEAC} computer was an early electronic machine built in 1950.
e.zh: SEAC计算机是1950年建造的早期电子机器。

e.en: Engineers studied the {SEAC} architecture for inspiration.
e.zh: 工程师们研究SEAC的架构以获取灵感。

e.en: We drove along the rocky {seacoast} for hours.
e.zh: 我们沿着多岩石的海岸开了几个小时车。

e.en: Many lighthouses stand on the New England {seacoast}.
e.zh: 许多灯塔矗立在新英格兰的海岸上。

e.en: The old {seafarer} told tales of distant ports.
e.zh: 老海员讲述着远方港口的故事。

e.en: Modern {seafarer} unions push for better working conditions.
e.zh: 现代海员工会争取更好的工作条件。

seafaring.t:
n. 航海
adj. 航海的

e.en: The Vikings were a famous {seafaring} people.
e.zh: 维京人是著名的航海民族。

e.en: He gave up his {seafaring} life to settle down.
e.zh: 他放弃了航海生活,选择安定下来。

e.en: Hydrothermal vents on the {seafloor} support unique ecosystems.
e.zh: 海底的热液喷口孕育着独特的生态系统。

e.en: Robots collected samples from the deep {seafloor}.
e.zh: 机器人从深海海底采集样本。

e.en: The restaurant serves the freshest {seafood} in town.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应城里最新鲜的海鲜。

e.en: I'm allergic to most types of {seafood}.
e.zh: 我对大多数海鲜过敏。

e.en: The chalk cliffs near {Seaford} attract many hikers.
e.zh: 锡福德附近的白垩崖吸引了许多徒步者。

e.en: They moved to {Seaford} for the quieter coastal life.
e.zh: 他们搬到锡福德,过上更安静的海滨生活。

e.en: We strolled along the {seafront} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后我们沿着海滨散步。

e.en: Their hotel room had a beautiful {seafront} view.
e.zh: 他们的酒店房间能看到美丽的海景。

seagoing.t: adj. 远洋的；适合航海的

e.en: The company operates a fleet of {seagoing} vessels.
e.zh: 该公司经营着一支远洋船队。

e.en: His grandfather had a long {seagoing} career.
e.zh: 他的祖父有着漫长的航海生涯。

e.en: {Seagrass} meadows store huge amounts of carbon.
e.zh: 海草草甸能储存大量的碳。

e.en: Sea turtles graze on the underwater {seagrass}.
e.zh: 海龟以水下的海草为食。

e.en: A {seagull} swooped down and stole my sandwich.
e.zh: 一只海鸥俯冲下来抢走了我的三明治。

e.en: The {seagull} cries echoed across the harbor.
e.zh: 海鸥的叫声在港口上空回荡。

e.en: {Seaham} beach is famous for its colorful sea glass.
e.zh: 锡哈姆海滩以五彩的海玻璃而闻名。

e.en: He grew up in a mining family near {Seaham}.
e.zh: 他在锡哈姆附近的矿工家庭长大。

e.en: A tiny {seahorse} clung to the coral with its tail.
e.zh: 一只小海马用尾巴紧紧抓住珊瑚。

e.en: Male {seahorse} carry the eggs until they hatch.
e.zh: 雄性海马负责孕育鱼卵直到孵化。

seal.t:
v. 密封；封口
n. 海豹；印章

e.en: Please {seal} the envelope before mailing it.
e.zh: 邮寄前请把信封封好。

e.en: A curious {seal} popped its head above the water.
e.zh: 一只好奇的海豹把头探出水面。

e.en: Store leftovers in a {sealable} plastic container.
e.zh: 把剩菜存放在可密封的塑料容器里。

e.en: The bag has a {sealable} top to keep food fresh.
e.zh: 这个袋子有可密封的封口,能保持食物新鲜。

e.en: Apply a waterproof {sealant} around the bathtub.
e.zh: 在浴缸周围涂上防水密封胶。

e.en: The roofer used {sealant} to fix the small leak.
e.zh: 屋顶工用密封胶修补了小裂缝。

e.en: The judge {sealed} the records to protect the witness.
e.zh: 法官封存了记录以保护证人。

e.en: Her fate was {sealed} the moment she signed the contract.
e.zh: 她签字的那一刻命运就已注定。

e.en: Apply a clear {sealer} to protect the wooden deck.
e.zh: 涂一层透明封闭剂来保护木甲板。

e.en: The vacuum {sealer} keeps food fresh much longer.
e.zh: 真空封口机能让食物保鲜更久。

e.en: The military arranged a {sealift} to deliver supplies overseas.
e.zh: 军方安排了海运行动向海外运送物资。

e.en: A massive {sealift} moved tanks across the ocean.
e.zh: 一次大规模海运将坦克跨海运送。

e.en: He's {sealing} the cracks before winter arrives.
e.zh: 他在冬天来临前把裂缝封好。

e.en: The {sealing} ceremony marked the end of negotiations.
e.zh: 封印仪式标志着谈判的结束。

sealink.t: n. 海联（英国渡轮公司）

e.en: The new {sealink} ferry cut travel time in half.
e.zh: 新的海上联运渡轮将旅行时间缩短了一半。

e.en: She booked a {sealink} crossing to the island.
e.zh: 她预订了海上联运船去岛上。

e.en: A group of {seals} basked on the rocks near shore.
e.zh: 一群海豹在近岸的礁石上晒太阳。

e.en: This tape {seals} cardboard boxes really securely.
e.zh: 这种胶带能把纸箱封得很牢。

e.en: The traditional Inuit boots were made from {sealskin}.
e.zh: 传统的因纽特人靴子是用海豹皮做的。

e.en: She wore a vintage {sealskin} coat to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一件复古海豹皮大衣出席晚会。

seam.t:
n. 接缝；缝合处
v. 缝合

e.en: The {seam} on my jacket split when I bent over.
e.zh: 我弯腰时夹克的缝线裂开了。

e.en: Miners discovered a rich {seam} of coal underground.
e.zh: 矿工们在地下发现了一条丰富的煤层。

e.en: His grandfather was a {seaman} during the Second World War.
e.zh: 他爷爷在二战期间是一名水手。

e.en: The young {seaman} signed up for a three-year voyage.
e.zh: 这位年轻水手报名参加了一次三年的航行。

e.en: The captain's {seamanship} saved the boat during the storm.
e.zh: 船长高超的航海技术在风暴中救了那艘船。

e.en: Good {seamanship} requires years of practical experience.
e.zh: 出色的航海技艺需要多年的实战经验。

seamed.t: adj. 有接缝的；有皱纹的

e.en: His face was {seamed} with deep wrinkles from years outdoors.
e.zh: 常年在户外，他的脸上布满了深深的皱纹。

e.en: She wore a pair of classic {seamed} stockings.
e.zh: 她穿了一双经典的后缝长袜。

e.en: Several {seamen} were rescued from the sinking ship.
e.zh: 有几名水手从沉船中被救了出来。

e.en: The port was full of {seamen} on shore leave.
e.zh: 港口里满是上岸休假的水手。

e.en: The fast {seamer} took five wickets in the match.
e.zh: 那位快速摆动球手在比赛中拿下五个三柱门。

e.en: He's the most reliable {seamer} on the cricket team.
e.zh: 他是板球队里最可靠的摆动球投手。

seamless.t: adj. 无缝的；流畅衔接的

e.en: The app offers a {seamless} experience across all your devices.
e.zh: 这款应用在所有设备上都能提供无缝体验。

e.en: Their transition to remote work was surprisingly {seamless}.
e.zh: 他们向远程办公的过渡顺畅得出人意料。

e.en: The new system integrates {seamlessly} with our existing tools.
e.zh: 新系统能与我们现有的工具无缝集成。

e.en: She switched {seamlessly} between English and Mandarin.
e.zh: 她在英语和普通话之间自如切换。

e.en: Users praised the {seamlessness} of the new checkout flow.
e.zh: 用户称赞新的结账流程衔接得天衣无缝。

e.en: The {seamlessness} of the design impressed every reviewer.
e.zh: 这个设计的流畅完整给每位评审都留下了深刻印象。

e.en: Scientists discovered a new {seamount} teeming with marine life.
e.zh: 科学家发现了一座海底山，海洋生物在那里生机勃勃。

e.en: The submarine carefully navigated around the underwater {seamount}.
e.zh: 潜艇小心地绕过这座海底山航行。

e.en: The {seamstress} altered my wedding dress in just two days.
e.zh: 那位裁缝两天就把我的婚纱改好了。

e.en: Her grandmother worked as a {seamstress} for forty years.
e.zh: 她奶奶当了四十年的女裁缝。

e.en: The documentary exposed the {seamy} side of the music industry.
e.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了音乐圈不堪的一面。

e.en: He grew up in a {seamy} neighborhood downtown.
e.zh: 他在市中心一个鱼龙混杂的街区长大。

e.en: They held a {seance} to contact her late grandmother.
e.zh: 他们举行了一场降神会，想联系她已故的奶奶。

e.en: The Victorian-era {seance} was a popular form of entertainment.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的降神会曾是流行的娱乐方式。

e.en: We took a {seaplane} from the harbor to the island.
e.zh: 我们从港口坐水上飞机去那座岛。

e.en: The {seaplane} landed gently on the calm lake surface.
e.zh: 水上飞机轻轻降落在平静的湖面上。

e.en: Rotterdam is one of the busiest {seaports} in Europe.
e.zh: 鹿特丹是欧洲最繁忙的海港之一。

e.en: The old {seaport} now hosts cruise ships and waterfront cafes.
e.zh: 这座老海港如今停靠游轮，开满了海滨咖啡馆。

seaq.t: n. 证券交易自动报价系统（缩写）

e.en: Traders watch {SEAQ} screens for London share price quotes.
e.zh: 交易员盯着SEAQ屏幕查看伦敦的股票报价。

e.en: The {SEAQ} system reports automated quotes from market makers.
e.zh: SEAQ系统发布做市商的自动报价。

e.en: {Sear} the steak quickly to lock in the juices.
e.zh: 快速煎一下牛排，把肉汁锁住。

e.en: The desert sun can {sear} your skin within minutes.
e.zh: 沙漠的阳光几分钟内就能灼伤你的皮肤。

search.t:
v. 搜索；查找
n. 搜索；搜寻

e.en: I'll {search} Google for a cheaper flight tomorrow.
e.zh: 我明天去谷歌上搜一下更便宜的机票。

e.en: The {search} for the missing hiker lasted three days.
e.zh: 对失踪登山者的搜寻持续了三天。

e.en: All chat history is fully {searchable} from the sidebar.
e.zh: 所有聊天记录都可以在侧栏完整搜索。

e.en: The archive is {searchable} by date, author, or topic.
e.zh: 该档案可按日期、作者或主题进行搜索。

e.en: I {searched} everywhere but couldn't find my keys.
e.zh: 我到处找过，但还是没找到钥匙。

e.en: Police {searched} the suspect's apartment last night.
e.zh: 警方昨晚搜查了嫌疑人的公寓。

e.en: The {searcher} typed a few keywords into the box.
e.zh: 搜索者在框里输入了几个关键词。

e.en: Volunteer {searchers} combed the forest for the lost child.
e.zh: 志愿搜寻者们在森林里搜寻那个走失的孩子。

searches.t: n./v. 搜索（复数/第三人称）

e.en: Most Google {searches} now happen on mobile phones.
e.zh: 如今大多数谷歌搜索都发生在手机上。

e.en: She {searches} her bag for her wallet every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都在包里翻找钱包。

searching.t:
v. 搜索中
adj. 锐利的；审视的

e.en: I've been {searching} for that book for weeks.
e.zh: 我已经找那本书找了好几周了。

e.en: She gave him a {searching} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子用审视的目光看了他一眼。

e.en: He looked at her {searchingly}, hoping for an honest answer.
e.zh: 他探究地看着她，希望得到一个诚实的回答。

e.en: The interviewer questioned the candidate {searchingly} about his past.
e.zh: 面试官刨根问底地询问应聘者的过去。

e.en: A {searchlight} swept across the harbor looking for the boat.
e.zh: 探照灯扫过港口寻找那艘船。

e.en: The prison's {searchlight} lit up the entire perimeter wall.
e.zh: 监狱的探照灯把整圈围墙都照亮了。

e.en: The chef {seared} the tuna for just thirty seconds.
e.zh: 厨师只把金枪鱼煎了三十秒。

e.en: That image is {seared} into my memory forever.
e.zh: 那个画面永远烙印在我的记忆里。

e.en: The {searing} heat made it hard to breathe outside.
e.zh: 灼热的高温让人在户外几乎无法呼吸。

e.en: The critic wrote a {searing} review of the new film.
e.zh: 那位影评人写了一篇尖锐的新片评论。

e.en: A hot pan quickly {sears} the meat on both sides.
e.zh: 热锅能迅速把肉的两面煎封住。

e.en: The afternoon sun {sears} the rooftops of the old town.
e.zh: 午后的阳光炙烤着老城的屋顶。

e.en: Rough {seas} delayed the ferry for several hours.
e.zh: 海上风浪大，渡轮被迫推迟了好几个小时。

e.en: Sailors used to navigate the {seas} by the stars.
e.zh: 过去水手们靠星星在大海上辨别方向。

e.en: She painted a beautiful {seascape} of the rocky coast.
e.zh: 她画了一幅美丽的礁石海岸海景画。

e.en: The hotel window framed a stunning {seascape} at sunset.
e.zh: 酒店的窗户框出了夕阳下绝美的海景。

e.en: My daughter collected a {seashell} from every beach we visited.
e.zh: 我女儿在每个去过的海滩都捡了一个贝壳。

e.en: Hold the {seashell} to your ear to hear the ocean.
e.zh: 把贝壳贴在耳边，就能听到海的声音。

e.en: We walked along the {seashore} and watched the sunset.
e.zh: 我们沿着海岸散步，看着夕阳落下。

e.en: Crabs scuttled across the rocks at the {seashore}.
e.zh: 螃蟹在海边的岩石上飞快地横行。

e.en: The {securitization} of mortgages fueled the 2008 crisis.
e.zh: 按揭贷款的证券化引发了2008年的金融危机。

e.en: Banks profit greatly from the {securitization} of loans.
e.zh: 银行从贷款证券化中获利丰厚。

security.t:
n. 安全；保障
n. 证券；担保

e.en: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of {security}.
e.zh: 双重验证增加了一层额外的安全保障。

e.en: Airport {security} confiscated his bottle of water.
e.zh: 机场安检没收了他的那瓶水。

e.en: They traded the SUV for a fuel-efficient {sedan}.
e.zh: 他们把那辆SUV换成了一辆省油的轿车。

e.en: A black {sedan} pulled up outside the hotel.
e.zh: 一辆黑色轿车停在了酒店门口。

sedate.t:
adj. 沉着的；安详的
v. 给…用镇静剂

e.en: The town has a {sedate} pace of life.
e.zh: 这座小镇生活节奏很舒缓。

e.en: Vets often {sedate} large dogs before surgery.
e.zh: 兽医常在手术前给大型犬注射镇静剂。

e.en: The patient was heavily {sedated} after the operation.
e.zh: 病人手术后被深度镇静。

e.en: The injured tiger had to be {sedated} for transport.
e.zh: 那只受伤的老虎必须被麻醉后才能运送。

e.en: The old couple danced {sedately} across the floor.
e.zh: 那对老夫妻在舞池里平静优雅地跳着舞。

e.en: She drove {sedately} through the quiet neighborhood.
e.zh: 她沉稳地开车穿过安静的小区。

sedates.t: v. sedate 的第三人称单数

e.en: The vet {sedates} nervous cats before dental cleanings.
e.zh: 兽医在为紧张的猫洗牙前会先给它们镇静。

e.en: This medication {sedates} patients within five minutes.
e.zh: 这种药能在五分钟内让病人镇静下来。

sedating.t: v. 给…用镇静剂（进行时）

e.en: Some allergy pills have a {sedating} effect.
e.zh: 有些抗过敏药有镇静作用。

e.en: The team is {sedating} the bear before relocation.
e.zh: 团队正在为这只熊麻醉以便迁移。

e.en: The dentist offered {sedation} for the long procedure.
e.zh: 牙医为这次漫长的治疗提供了镇静服务。

e.en: He remained under {sedation} throughout the night.
e.zh: 他整夜处于镇静状态。

sedative.t:
n. 镇静剂
adj. 有镇静作用的

e.en: The doctor prescribed a mild {sedative} for her insomnia.
e.zh: 医生给她开了一种温和的镇静剂治疗失眠。

e.en: Chamomile tea has a gentle {sedative} effect.
e.zh: 洋甘菊茶有温和的镇静作用。

e.en: Richard {Seddon} was a long-serving Prime Minister of New Zealand.
e.zh: 理查德·塞登是新西兰任期最长的总理之一。

e.en: The town of {Seddon} sits on New Zealand's South Island.
e.zh: 塞登镇位于新西兰南岛。

sedentary.t: adj. 久坐的；缺乏运动的

e.en: A {sedentary} lifestyle increases your risk of heart disease.
e.zh: 久坐不动的生活方式会增加患心脏病的风险。

e.en: Office workers often have very {sedentary} jobs.
e.zh: 办公室职员的工作通常都是久坐型的。

e.en: Tall {sedge} grew along the edge of the pond.
e.zh: 池塘边长着高高的莎草。

e.en: Birds nest among the {sedge} in the marsh.
e.zh: 鸟儿在沼泽的莎草丛中筑巢。

sedgwick.t: n. 塞奇威克（人名/姓氏）

e.en: Edie {Sedgwick} was a famous muse of Andy Warhol.
e.zh: 伊迪·塞奇威克是安迪·沃霍尔著名的灵感缪斯。

e.en: Kyra {Sedgwick} starred in the TV series The Closer.
e.zh: 凯拉·塞奇威克主演了电视剧《罪案终结》。

e.en: A layer of {sediment} settled at the bottom of the bottle.
e.zh: 瓶底沉积了一层沉淀物。

e.en: Rivers carry {sediment} downstream toward the ocean.
e.zh: 河流将沉积物带往下游入海。

e.en: The Grand Canyon reveals millions of years of {sedimentary} rock.
e.zh: 大峡谷展示了数百万年的沉积岩层。

e.en: Fossils are typically found in {sedimentary} layers.
e.zh: 化石通常在沉积岩层中被发现。

e.en: {Sedimentation} slowly fills the reservoir with mud.
e.zh: 沉积作用慢慢地用淤泥填满了水库。

e.en: The lab measures {sedimentation} rates in the blood.
e.zh: 实验室测量血液中的红细胞沉降率。

e.en: Old wines often have {sedimented} particles at the bottom.
e.zh: 陈年葡萄酒底部常常有沉淀颗粒。

e.en: Decades of habit had {sedimented} into the company culture.
e.zh: 几十年的习惯已沉淀为公司文化。

e.en: The team published a {sedimentological} study of the river basin.
e.zh: 团队发表了一篇关于这条流域的沉积学研究。

e.en: {Sedimentological} analysis reveals ancient climate patterns.
e.zh: 沉积学分析揭示了古代的气候模式。

e.en: The journalist was charged with {sedition} for his article.
e.zh: 这名记者因其文章被以煽动叛乱罪起诉。

e.en: Posting that pamphlet was considered an act of {sedition}.
e.zh: 散发那本小册子被视为煽动叛乱的行为。

e.en: The government banned the {seditious} pamphlets immediately.
e.zh: 政府立即查禁了那些煽动性的小册子。

e.en: He was arrested for making {seditious} speeches online.
e.zh: 他因在网上发表煽动性言论而被捕。

e.en: Sir Charles {Sedley} was a famous Restoration-era poet.
e.zh: 查尔斯·塞德利爵士是著名的复辟时代诗人。

e.en: The character {Sedley} appears in Thackeray's Vanity Fair.
e.zh: 塞德利这个角色出现在萨克雷的《名利场》中。

e.en: Glossy ads try to {seduce} customers into buying more.
e.zh: 光鲜的广告试图诱使顾客买更多东西。

e.en: Don't let easy money {seduce} you into bad choices.
e.zh: 别让轻松赚来的钱诱使你做出错误的选择。

e.en: In the novel, the {seducer} eventually faces his downfall.
e.zh: 在小说中,那个引诱者最终自食其果。

e.en: He was portrayed as a charming but ruthless {seducer}.
e.zh: 他被描绘成一个迷人却冷酷的诱惑者。

e.en: The film explores themes of {seduction} and betrayal.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了诱惑与背叛的主题。

e.en: The {seduction} of fame can ruin young actors.
e.zh: 名声的诱惑可能会毁掉年轻演员。

e.en: The aroma of fresh coffee is incredibly {seductive}.
e.zh: 新煮咖啡的香气令人难以抗拒。

e.en: Social media offers a {seductive} but shallow form of connection.
e.zh: 社交媒体提供了一种诱人但浅薄的联系方式。

e.en: She smiled {seductively} from across the crowded room.
e.zh: 她隔着拥挤的房间魅惑地笑了笑。

e.en: The dessert was {seductively} displayed in the window.
e.zh: 那款甜点被诱人地摆在橱窗里。

e.en: The {seductiveness} of quick profits often misleads new investors.
e.zh: 快速获利的诱惑常常误导新手投资者。

e.en: Her voice had a quiet {seductiveness} that captivated listeners.
e.zh: 她的嗓音带有一种悄然的魅惑,深深吸引着听众。

e.en: The film cast her as a clever {seductress}.
e.zh: 这部电影把她塑造成一个聪明的诱惑者。

e.en: In the legend, the {seductress} lures sailors to their doom.
e.zh: 在传说中,那位魅惑者引诱水手走向毁灭。

e.en: His {sedulity} in research earned him wide respect.
e.zh: 他在研究中的勤勉为他赢得了广泛的尊重。

e.en: The old craftsman approached his work with quiet {sedulity}.
e.zh: 这位老工匠以默默的勤勉投入工作。

sedulous.t: adj. 勤勉的；坚持不懈的

e.en: She is a {sedulous} student who reviews notes every night.
e.zh: 她是一位勤勉的学生,每晚都会复习笔记。

e.en: The detective made {sedulous} efforts to solve the case.
e.zh: 那位侦探勤勉努力地破解此案。

e.en: He {sedulously} avoided any mention of the incident.
e.zh: 他刻意地避免提及那起事件。

e.en: The team worked {sedulously} to meet the deadline.
e.zh: 团队勤勉努力地工作以赶上截止日期。

e.en: {Sedum} plants thrive even in dry rocky soil.
e.zh: 景天属植物即使在干燥的岩石土壤中也能茁壮生长。

e.en: She planted {sedum} along the garden path.
e.zh: 她沿着花园小径种了一些景天。

see.t:
v. 看见；明白
v. 见面；理解

seed.t:
n. 种子
v. 播种；(赛事) 设为种子选手

e.en: He planted a {seed} of doubt in her mind.
e.zh: 他在她心中埋下了怀疑的种子。

e.en: Soak the {seed} overnight before planting it.
e.zh: 播种前请将种子浸泡一晚。

e.en: The garage became the {seedbed} for many famous startups.
e.zh: 那间车库成了许多著名创业公司的发源地。

e.en: Cover the {seedbed} with mulch to retain moisture.
e.zh: 用覆盖物盖住苗床以保持湿度。

seeded.t: adj. 已播种的；(比赛) 种子选手的

e.en: She is {seeded} second in this year's tournament.
e.zh: 她在今年的锦标赛中被列为二号种子。

e.en: The farmer {seeded} the field with wheat last week.
e.zh: 那位农夫上周在田里播种了小麦。

e.en: The neighborhood's {seediness} discouraged most tourists.
e.zh: 这个街区的破败感让大多数游客望而却步。

e.en: Behind the bar's charm lay an unmistakable {seediness}.
e.zh: 那家酒吧迷人的外表下藏着难以忽视的肮脏龌龊。

seeding.t:
n. 播种；(赛事) 定种子
v. seed 的进行时

e.en: The startup is {seeding} a new round of funding.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在进行新一轮种子融资。

e.en: Spring is the best time for {seeding} the lawn.
e.zh: 春天是给草坪播种的最佳时节。

e.en: I prefer {seedless} grapes for the kids' lunchbox.
e.zh: 我更喜欢给孩子的便当装无籽葡萄。

e.en: This bakery sells {seedless} jam tarts every morning.
e.zh: 这家面包店每天早上都卖无籽果酱挞。

e.en: Water each {seedling} gently to avoid damaging the roots.
e.zh: 轻轻给每株幼苗浇水,以免伤到根部。

e.en: The tomato {seedling} grew rapidly in the greenhouse.
e.zh: 那株番茄幼苗在温室里迅速成长。

e.en: The {seedlings} need sunlight for at least six hours daily.
e.zh: 这些幼苗每天至少需要六小时的阳光。

e.en: Volunteers planted hundreds of {seedlings} on the hillside.
e.zh: 志愿者们在山坡上种下了数百株幼苗。

e.en: The dried {seedpod} rattled when I shook it.
e.zh: 我摇动那个干种荚时,它发出沙沙的响声。

e.en: Each {seedpod} contains dozens of tiny black seeds.
e.zh: 每个种荚里都装着几十粒细小的黑色种子。

e.en: Sprinkle some {seeds} on top of the salad.
e.zh: 在沙拉上撒一些种子。

e.en: His speech planted the {seeds} of a revolution.
e.zh: 他的演说播下了一场革命的种子。

e.en: The local {seedsman} sells heirloom tomato varieties every spring.
e.zh: 当地的种子商每年春天都会出售传家宝番茄品种。

e.en: Her grandfather was a respected {seedsman} in the village.
e.zh: 她的祖父是村里一位受人尊敬的种子商。

seedy.t: adj. 破旧的；肮脏邋遢的

e.en: They ended up in a {seedy} bar near the docks.
e.zh: 他们最后跑到了码头边一家肮脏破旧的酒吧。

e.en: Avoid that {seedy} part of town after dark.
e.zh: 天黑后别去镇上那个龌龊的地方。

seeing.t:
v. see 的进行时
conj. 鉴于；因为

e.en: {Seeing} the sunrise from the mountain was unforgettable.
e.zh: 在山上看日出令人难以忘怀。

e.en: I'm {seeing} my doctor tomorrow about the headaches.
e.zh: 我明天要去看医生,谈谈我的头痛问题。

e.en: Many young people {seek} jobs in the tech industry.
e.zh: 许多年轻人在科技行业寻找工作。

e.en: You should {seek} medical advice if the pain persists.
e.zh: 如果疼痛持续,你应该寻求医生的建议。

e.en: The {secondee} from London joined our team for six months.
e.zh: 那位从伦敦借调来的同事加入我们团队六个月。

e.en: As a {secondee}, she still reports to her original employer.
e.zh: 作为借调员工,她仍向原雇主汇报。

e.en: The motion needs a {seconder} before we can vote.
e.zh: 这项动议需要一位附议人才能进行表决。

e.en: Her colleague served as the {seconder} at the board meeting.
e.zh: 她的同事在董事会上担任附议人。

secondhand.t:
adj. 二手的；旧的
adv. 间接地

e.en: I picked up this jacket at a {secondhand} store downtown.
e.zh: 我在市中心的一家二手店淘到了这件夹克。

e.en: He only knows the news {secondhand} from his neighbors.
e.zh: 他只是从邻居那里间接听说了这个消息。

e.en: Firstly, the price is too high; {secondly}, the quality is poor.
e.zh: 首先价格太高,其次质量也很差。

e.en: {Secondly}, we need to address the customer feedback issues.
e.zh: 其次,我们需要处理客户反馈的问题。

e.en: He's on {secondment} to the Tokyo office for a year.
e.zh: 他被借调到东京办公室工作一年。

e.en: The {secondment} gave her valuable international experience.
e.zh: 这次借调让她获得了宝贵的国际经验。

e.en: The video loaded in just a few {seconds}.
e.zh: 视频只用了几秒钟就加载完了。

e.en: He went back for {seconds} of the chocolate cake.
e.zh: 他又去拿了一份巧克力蛋糕。

e.en: The project was developed in complete {secrecy} for two years.
e.zh: 这个项目在完全保密的状态下开发了两年。

e.en: Government {secrecy} around the deal raised public suspicion.
e.zh: 政府对这笔交易的保密引起了公众的怀疑。

secret.t:
n. 秘密
adj. 秘密的

e.en: Can you keep a {secret} between us?
e.zh: 你能在咱俩之间保守这个秘密吗?

e.en: The chef revealed the {secret} ingredient in his sauce.
e.zh: 主厨透露了他酱料中的秘密配料。

secretarial.t: adj. 秘书的；文秘工作的

e.en: She took a {secretarial} course before applying for the job.
e.zh: 她在申请这份工作前上了一门文秘课程。

e.en: The role involves mostly {secretarial} duties like scheduling.
e.zh: 这个职位主要涉及安排日程等文秘工作。

e.en: The UN {secretariat} handles all administrative operations.
e.zh: 联合国秘书处负责所有行政事务。

e.en: She works at the {secretariat} of the international committee.
e.zh: 她在国际委员会的秘书处工作。

e.en: The {secretaries} organized the entire conference flawlessly.
e.zh: 秘书们把整个会议组织得无懈可击。

e.en: Several cabinet {secretaries} attended the press briefing.
e.zh: 几位内阁部长出席了新闻发布会。

e.en: Please ask my {secretary} to schedule the meeting for Tuesday.
e.zh: 请让我的秘书把会议安排在星期二。

e.en: The {secretary} of state delivered a speech on foreign policy.
e.zh: 国务卿就外交政策发表了讲话。

e.en: She accepted the {secretaryship} of the local cycling club.
e.zh: 她接受了当地自行车俱乐部秘书的职务。

e.en: His {secretaryship} lasted for nearly a decade.
e.zh: 他担任秘书一职将近十年。

e.en: Certain glands {secrete} hormones into the bloodstream.
e.zh: 某些腺体会向血液中分泌激素。

e.en: Frogs {secrete} a slimy substance to keep their skin moist.
e.zh: 青蛙会分泌黏液来保持皮肤湿润。

e.en: The small intestine releases {secretin} when food enters it.
e.zh: 食物进入小肠时,小肠会释放促胰液素。

e.en: Doctors use {secretin} to test pancreatic function.
e.zh: 医生用促胰液素来测试胰腺功能。

e.en: Excessive {secretion} of stomach acid can cause heartburn.
e.zh: 胃酸分泌过多会引起烧心。

e.en: The plant's sticky {secretion} traps small insects.
e.zh: 这种植物的黏性分泌物能困住小昆虫。

secretive.t: adj. 隐秘的；守口如瓶的

e.en: He's very {secretive} about his weekend plans.
e.zh: 他对自己的周末计划非常保密。

e.en: The company is {secretive} about its upcoming product launch.
e.zh: 该公司对即将推出的新产品讳莫如深。

e.en: She glanced {secretively} at the message on her phone.
e.zh: 她偷偷地瞥了一眼手机上的信息。

e.en: He {secretively} slipped the note into her bag.
e.zh: 他偷偷地把纸条塞进了她的包里。

e.en: His {secretiveness} about money started to worry his wife.
e.zh: 他在金钱上的隐瞒开始让妻子担心。

e.en: The team's {secretiveness} fueled rumors about the project.
e.zh: 团队的保密态度引发了关于该项目的种种传闻。

e.en: She {secretly} hoped he would call her back.
e.zh: 她暗自希望他会给她回电话。

e.en: They got married {secretly} last weekend in Vegas.
e.zh: 他们上周末在拉斯维加斯偷偷结婚了。

e.en: The pancreas contains many {secretory} cells.
e.zh: 胰腺含有许多分泌细胞。

e.en: Researchers are studying the gland's {secretory} function.
e.zh: 研究人员正在研究这个腺体的分泌功能。

e.en: Best friends share all their {secrets} with each other.
e.zh: 最好的朋友会彼此分享所有秘密。

e.en: The book reveals the {secrets} of professional photography.
e.zh: 这本书揭示了专业摄影的秘诀。

e.en: Hold on a few {secs} while I check the file.
e.zh: 稍等几秒,我查一下文件。

e.en: The page should load in just a couple of {secs}.
e.zh: 这个页面应该几秒钟就能加载好。

e.en: The small religious {sect} lived apart from mainstream society.
e.zh: 这个小教派与主流社会分开生活。

e.en: He left the {sect} after questioning its beliefs.
e.zh: 在质疑教派的信仰后,他离开了。

sectarian.t:
adj. 宗派的
n. 宗派成员

e.en: The country has been torn apart by {sectarian} violence.
e.zh: 这个国家被宗派暴力撕裂。

e.en: Politicians warned against fueling {sectarian} tensions.
e.zh: 政客们警告不要煽动宗派紧张情绪。

e.en: Years of {sectarianism} damaged trust between communities.
e.zh: 多年的宗派主义损害了社区之间的信任。

e.en: The peace talks aimed to end religious {sectarianism}.
e.zh: 和谈旨在终结宗教宗派主义。

section.t:
n. 部分；章节；区段
v. 切开

e.en: The sports {section} of the newspaper covers local games.
e.zh: 报纸的体育版报道本地比赛。

e.en: Please read the next {section} before tomorrow's class.
e.zh: 请在明天上课前读完下一节内容。

e.en: We bought a huge {sectional} sofa for the living room.
e.zh: 我们给客厅买了一个超大的组合沙发。

e.en: The party tried to overcome {sectional} differences within it.
e.zh: 该党试图克服内部的派系分歧。

sectionalism.t: n. 地方主义；本位主义

e.en: Regional {sectionalism} weakened the country's unity in the 1800s.
e.zh: 19世纪的地方分立主义削弱了国家的团结。

e.en: Critics blamed {sectionalism} for the failed legislation.
e.zh: 批评人士将立法失败归咎于地方主义。

e.en: The orange was neatly {sectioned} into juicy segments.
e.zh: 那个橙子被整齐地分成了多瓣多汁的果肉。

e.en: The report is {sectioned} by region for easier reading.
e.zh: 该报告按地区分段,便于阅读。

e.en: The book is divided into five clear {sections}.
e.zh: 这本书清晰地分为五个部分。

e.en: Different {sections} of the city have very different vibes.
e.zh: 城市的不同区域有着截然不同的氛围。

e.en: The tech {sector} grew rapidly during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间科技行业增长迅速。

e.en: Job opportunities in the public {sector} are increasing.
e.zh: 公共部门的就业机会正在增加。

e.en: The report analyzes {sectoral} trends in renewable energy.
e.zh: 该报告分析了可再生能源的行业趋势。

e.en: Governments imposed {sectoral} sanctions on key industries.
e.zh: 各国政府对关键行业实施了部门制裁。

e.en: Both private and public {sectors} need to invest in AI.
e.zh: 私营和公共部门都需要在人工智能上投资。

e.en: Several {sectors} of the economy are still recovering.
e.zh: 经济的几个领域仍在复苏中。

e.en: France maintains a strictly {secular} education system.
e.zh: 法国坚持实行严格的世俗教育制度。

e.en: The wedding was a {secular} ceremony at the courthouse.
e.zh: 那场婚礼是在法院举行的非宗教仪式。

e.en: Many European countries have largely {secularised} over time.
e.zh: 许多欧洲国家随着时间推移已大体世俗化。

e.en: The school {secularised} its curriculum in the 1990s.
e.zh: 这所学校在90年代将课程世俗化。

e.en: {Secularism} keeps religion separate from government affairs.
e.zh: 世俗主义使宗教与政府事务相分离。

e.en: The constitution enshrines {secularism} as a core principle.
e.zh: 宪法将世俗主义奉为核心原则。

e.en: As a {secularist}, she opposes prayer in public schools.
e.zh: 作为一名世俗主义者,她反对在公立学校祈祷。

e.en: The {secularist} movement gained traction in the 19th century.
e.zh: 世俗主义运动在19世纪逐渐兴起。

e.en: The country's {secularity} is protected by the constitution.
e.zh: 该国的世俗性受到宪法保护。

e.en: Modern art often reflects the {secularity} of contemporary life.
e.zh: 现代艺术常常反映当代生活的世俗性。

e.en: The {secularization} of holidays makes them more inclusive.
e.zh: 节日的世俗化使其更具包容性。

e.en: Sociologists study the {secularization} of Western societies.
e.zh: 社会学家研究西方社会的世俗化进程。

e.en: Reformers wanted to {secularize} the public school curriculum.
e.zh: 改革者希望使公立学校课程世俗化。

e.en: Some governments {secularize} institutions previously run by churches.
e.zh: 一些政府将原由教会管理的机构世俗化。

e.en: The hospital was {secularized} after being run by nuns.
e.zh: 这家医院在由修女经营之后被世俗化了。

e.en: Christmas has become a heavily {secularized} holiday.
e.zh: 圣诞节已经变成了一个高度世俗化的节日。

e.en: The school approaches ethics {secularly}, not religiously.
e.zh: 这所学校从世俗角度而非宗教角度来教授伦理。

e.en: They chose to raise their kids {secularly}.
e.zh: 他们选择以非宗教的方式抚养孩子。

secure.t:
adj. 安全的；稳固的
v. 获得；保护

e.en: Make sure your password is strong and {secure}.
e.zh: 确保你的密码足够强且安全。

e.en: She finally landed a {secure} job at a big firm.
e.zh: 她终于在一家大公司找到了一份稳定的工作。

secured.t:
adj. 有担保的
v. 已获得

e.en: The startup just {secured} ten million in funding.
e.zh: 这家初创公司刚刚获得了一千万美元的融资。

e.en: Please make sure all the windows are {secured} before leaving.
e.zh: 离开前请确保所有窗户都已锁好。

e.en: Please store the password {securely} in a trusted manager.
e.zh: 请把密码安全地保存在可信的密码管理器里。

e.en: The bike was {securely} locked to the metal rack.
e.zh: 自行车被牢牢地锁在金属车架上。

secures.t: v. 获得；保护（第三人称单数）

e.en: This belt {secures} the cargo during long flights.
e.zh: 这条带子在长途飞行中固定货物。

e.en: The startup {secures} ten million in fresh funding.
e.zh: 这家初创公司获得了一千万的新一轮融资。

securing.t: v. 确保；固定（现在分词）

e.en: They are {securing} the building before the storm hits.
e.zh: 他们在暴风雨来临前加固这栋建筑。

e.en: She succeeded in {securing} a job at Google.
e.zh: 她成功获得了谷歌的一份工作。

securities.t: n. 证券；有价证券（复数）

e.en: He trades {securities} for a major investment bank.
e.zh: 他在一家大型投行从事证券交易。

e.en: Government {securities} are considered relatively safe investments.
e.zh: 政府债券被视为相对安全的投资。

e.en: I always get {seasick} on small fishing boats.
e.zh: 我坐小渔船总会晕船。

e.en: Half the passengers felt {seasick} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间，一半的乘客都晕船了。

e.en: Ginger candy is a popular remedy for {seasickness}.
e.zh: 姜糖是缓解晕船的常用偏方。

e.en: He suffered terrible {seasickness} on the overnight ferry.
e.zh: 他在夜班渡轮上晕船晕得厉害。

e.en: We rented a small cottage at the {seaside} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在海边租了一间小屋。

e.en: Brighton is a classic British {seaside} town.
e.zh: 布莱顿是一座典型的英国海滨小镇。

season.t:
n. 季节；赛季
v. 调味

e.en: Autumn is my favorite {season} for hiking.
e.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢徒步的季节。

e.en: Don't forget to {season} the soup with salt and pepper.
e.zh: 别忘了用盐和胡椒给汤调味。

e.en: The temperatures this week are pleasantly {seasonable}.
e.zh: 本周的气温很符合时令，让人舒服。

e.en: She offered some {seasonable} advice about holiday spending.
e.zh: 她对节日开销给出了一些应时的建议。

e.en: The cafe's menu changes with {seasonal} ingredients.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的菜单会随季节性食材而变化。

e.en: Many resorts hire {seasonal} workers during the summer.
e.zh: 许多度假村会在夏季招聘季节性员工。

e.en: Retail sales show strong {seasonality} around the holidays.
e.zh: 零售销售在节假日前后呈现明显的季节性。

e.en: Forecasters must adjust models to account for {seasonality}.
e.zh: 预测人员必须调整模型以考虑季节性因素。

e.en: This dish is only available {seasonally}, mostly in winter.
e.zh: 这道菜只在特定季节供应，主要是冬天。

e.en: Unemployment figures are reported {seasonally} adjusted each month.
e.zh: 失业数据每月以经季节调整的形式公布。

seasoned.t: adj. 经验丰富的；调过味的

e.en: He's a {seasoned} traveler who's visited eighty countries.
e.zh: 他是个经验丰富的旅行者，去过八十个国家。

e.en: Serve the {seasoned} chicken with rice and vegetables.
e.zh: 把调好味的鸡肉配米饭和蔬菜一起上桌。

e.en: Add a bit more {seasoning} if the soup tastes bland.
e.zh: 如果汤太淡，就再加点调味料。

e.en: Italian {seasoning} usually contains oregano, basil, and thyme.
e.zh: 意式调味料通常含有牛至、罗勒和百里香。

e.en: Japan is famous for its four distinct {seasons}.
e.zh: 日本以四季分明而闻名。

e.en: The show ran for six {seasons} on Netflix.
e.zh: 这部剧在Netflix上播了六季。

seat.t:
n. 座位
v. 使就座

e.en: Please take a {seat} and the doctor will be right with you.
e.zh: 请坐，医生马上就来。

e.en: I booked a window {seat} for the long flight.
e.zh: 我为这趟长途航班订了一个靠窗的座位。

e.en: Always fasten your {seatbelt} before starting the car.
e.zh: 开车之前一定要先系好安全带。

e.en: The {seatbelt} sign is still on, so please remain seated.
e.zh: 安全带指示灯还亮着，请大家继续坐好。

e.en: Please remain {seated} until the plane comes to a stop.
e.zh: 请保持坐在座位上，直到飞机完全停稳。

e.en: The restaurant {seated} us by the window with an ocean view.
e.zh: 餐厅把我们安排在能看到海景的窗边。

seater.t: n. 有…座位的交通工具（如 two-seater 双座）

e.en: We rented a seven-{seater} van for the family road trip.
e.zh: 我们租了一辆七座面包车去全家自驾游。

e.en: The new arena is a 20,000-{seater} for major concerts.
e.zh: 这座新场馆有两万个座位，专为大型演唱会设计。

seating.t: n. 座位安排；座位容量

e.en: The theater has {seating} for over a thousand people.
e.zh: 这家剧院能容纳一千多人。

e.en: Outdoor {seating} fills up quickly on sunny weekends.
e.zh: 晴朗的周末，户外座位很快就坐满了。

e.en: My {seatmate} on the flight slept the entire trip.
e.zh: 航班上我的邻座整趟旅程都在睡觉。

e.en: She chatted with her {seatmate} throughout the train ride.
e.zh: 她在整段火车旅程中都和邻座聊天。

e.en: The theater has over two thousand {seats}.
e.zh: 这家剧院有两千多个座位。

e.en: Please book three {seats} for tomorrow's show.
e.zh: 请为明天的演出预订三个座位。

e.en: It rains a lot in {Seattle} during winter.
e.zh: 西雅图冬天经常下雨。

e.en: Many tech companies have offices in {Seattle}.
e.zh: 许多科技公司在西雅图设有办公室。

e.en: Students completed their {seatwork} quietly at their desks.
e.zh: 学生们在课桌前安静地完成课堂作业。

e.en: The teacher assigned math {seatwork} after the lesson.
e.zh: 老师在课后布置了数学课堂练习。

e.en: We upgraded to a room with a {seaview} balcony.
e.zh: 我们升级到带海景阳台的房间。

e.en: The {seaview} apartment costs twice as much.
e.zh: 这间海景公寓的价格是两倍。

e.en: The town built a higher {seawall} to fight erosion.
e.zh: 小镇建了更高的海堤来抵御侵蚀。

e.en: Waves crashed against the concrete {seawall}.
e.zh: 海浪拍打着混凝土海堤。

e.en: The lighthouse beam swept {seaward} through the fog.
e.zh: 灯塔的光束穿过浓雾射向海面。

e.en: He turned his gaze {seaward} and sighed.
e.zh: 他把目光投向大海,叹了口气。

e.en: The river flows {seawards} through a wide valley.
e.zh: 河水穿过宽阔的山谷流向大海。

e.en: The boats drifted slowly {seawards} with the tide.
e.zh: 船只随着潮水缓缓向海漂去。

e.en: The plant converts {seawater} into drinkable water.
e.zh: 该工厂将海水转化为可饮用的水。

e.en: My phone broke after falling into {seawater}.
e.zh: 我的手机掉进海水后就坏了。

e.en: Warmer {seawaters} are bleaching coral reefs worldwide.
e.zh: 变暖的海水正在使全球珊瑚礁白化。

e.en: The fishing fleet operates in nearby {seawaters}.
e.zh: 渔船队在附近海域作业。

e.en: The St. Lawrence {Seaway} connects the Great Lakes to the Atlantic.
e.zh: 圣劳伦斯海道将五大湖与大西洋连通。

e.en: Heavy ice closed the {seaway} for the winter.
e.zh: 厚冰使这条海道冬季关闭。

e.en: Japanese cuisine uses {seaweed} in many dishes.
e.zh: 日本料理在许多菜肴中都用到海藻。

e.en: Strands of {seaweed} tangled around my ankles.
e.zh: 一缕缕海藻缠住了我的脚踝。

e.en: Different {seaweeds} grow at different ocean depths.
e.zh: 不同种类的海藻生长在不同的海洋深度。

e.en: Researchers study edible {seaweeds} as a sustainable food source.
e.zh: 研究人员将可食用海藻作为可持续食物来源进行研究。

e.en: Inspectors verified the ship's {seaworthiness} before departure.
e.zh: 检查员在出发前核实了船只的适航性。

e.en: Doubts about its {seaworthiness} delayed the voyage.
e.zh: 对其适航性的怀疑推迟了航行。

e.en: The old yacht is no longer {seaworthy}.
e.zh: 这艘旧游艇已经不适合出海了。

e.en: Make sure the boat is {seaworthy} before the trip.
e.zh: 出行前要确保这艘船适合航海。

sebaceous.t: adj. 皮脂的；分泌油脂的

e.en: Acne is often caused by overactive {sebaceous} glands.
e.zh: 痤疮通常是由皮脂腺过度活跃引起的。

e.en: The doctor removed a small {sebaceous} cyst from his back.
e.zh: 医生从他背上切除了一个小皮脂囊肿。

e.en: Excess {sebum} can clog pores and cause breakouts.
e.zh: 多余的皮脂会堵塞毛孔并引发痘痘。

e.en: This cleanser helps control {sebum} on oily skin.
e.zh: 这款洁面乳有助于控制油性皮肤的皮脂分泌。

sec.t:
n. 秒（second 的缩写）
adj. （葡萄酒）干型的

secateur.t: n. 修枝剪（常用复数 secateurs）

e.en: She used a sharp {secateur} to prune the rose bush.
e.zh: 她用锋利的修枝剪修剪玫瑰丛。

e.en: A good {secateur} makes garden work much easier.
e.zh: 一把好的修枝剪能让园艺工作轻松许多。

secede.t: v. 正式脱离；退出（组织、国家）

e.en: Several states threatened to {secede} from the union.
e.zh: 几个州威胁要脱离联邦。

e.en: The region voted to {secede} and form an independent country.
e.zh: 该地区投票决定独立建国。

e.en: The civil war began over the issue of {secession}.
e.zh: 内战因脱离联邦的问题而爆发。

e.en: Calls for {secession} grew louder after the election.
e.zh: 选举之后要求独立的呼声愈加高涨。

secessionist.t:
n. 分离主义者
adj. 主张脱离的

e.en: {Secessionist} movements have grown in several regions.
e.zh: 分离主义运动在多个地区不断壮大。

e.en: The leader denied being a {secessionist}.
e.zh: 这位领导人否认自己是分离主义者。

e.en: Writers often {seclude} themselves to finish a novel.
e.zh: 作家常常把自己隔离起来以完成小说。

e.en: He chose to {seclude} himself in a mountain cabin.
e.zh: 他选择躲进山中小屋隐居。

e.en: They found a {secluded} beach with no tourists.
e.zh: 他们找到了一处没有游客的僻静海滩。

e.en: The cabin sits in a {secluded} corner of the forest.
e.zh: 那间小屋坐落在森林中一个隐蔽的角落。

e.en: She moved to a cabin in {seclusion} to write her novel.
e.zh: 她搬到一间隐居的小屋去写小说。

e.en: The monks live in complete {seclusion} from the outside world.
e.zh: 僧侣们与外界完全隔绝地生活。

second.t:
adj. 第二的
n. 秒

e.en: Wait a {second}, I need to grab my keys.
e.zh: 等一下,我得拿一下钥匙。

e.en: She finished in {second} place at the marathon.
e.zh: 她在马拉松比赛中获得了第二名。

e.en: I bought a {second-hand} bike for fifty dollars.
e.zh: 我花五十美元买了一辆二手自行车。

e.en: Most of his furniture is {second-hand} but stylish.
e.zh: 他大部分家具都是二手的,但很有格调。

e.en: The app is mainly for chatting and {secondarily} for sharing photos.
e.zh: 这款应用主要用于聊天,其次是分享照片。

e.en: She works as a teacher and {secondarily} as a freelance writer.
e.zh: 她主要是老师,其次还做自由撰稿人。

e.en: Cost is {secondary} to quality in our hiring decisions.
e.zh: 在招聘决策中,成本相对于质量是次要的。

e.en: My daughter just started {secondary} school this fall.
e.zh: 我女儿今年秋天刚上中学。

e.en: Every job {seeker} should polish their resume before applying.
e.zh: 每位求职者在投简历前都该好好打磨简历。

e.en: She is a passionate {seeker} of truth and knowledge.
e.zh: 她是一位执着的真理与知识追寻者。

e.en: The retreat attracts spiritual {seekers} from around the world.
e.zh: 这处静修地吸引着来自世界各地的灵性追寻者。

e.en: Job {seekers} crowded the career fair on Saturday.
e.zh: 周六的招聘会上挤满了求职者。

seeking.t: v. 寻求；寻找（seek 的现在分词）

e.en: She is {seeking} a new role in marketing.
e.zh: 她正在寻找一份市场营销方面的新工作。

e.en: Many users are {seeking} better privacy on social platforms.
e.zh: 许多用户希望在社交平台上获得更好的隐私保护。

seeks.t: v. 寻求；寻找（第三人称单数）

e.en: The startup {seeks} engineers with cloud experience.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在招聘有云端经验的工程师。

e.en: He {seeks} advice from his mentor every month.
e.zh: 他每个月都会向导师寻求建议。

seely.t: adj. 可怜的；幸福的（古语，罕用）

e.en: The poem describes a {seely} shepherd lost in the woods.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了一位在林中迷途的可怜牧人。

e.en: Old ballads often portray {seely} villagers as innocent souls.
e.zh: 古老的歌谣常把朴实的村民描绘成天真的灵魂。

e.en: You {seem} tired after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行之后你看起来很累。

e.en: These results {seem} too good to be true.
e.zh: 这些结果好得让人难以置信。

e.en: The meeting {seemed} shorter than it really was.
e.zh: 那场会议感觉比实际时间要短。

e.en: She {seemed} surprised by the unexpected gift.
e.zh: 她对这份意外的礼物似乎感到惊讶。

seeming.t:
adj. 表面上的
n. 外表

e.en: His {seeming} calm hid a great deal of anxiety.
e.zh: 他表面的镇定掩盖着内心的极度焦虑。

e.en: Despite her {seeming} confidence, she was nervous backstage.
e.zh: 尽管她看似自信,但在后台其实很紧张。

e.en: The bug appeared {seemingly} out of nowhere last night.
e.zh: 这个 bug 昨晚看似无缘无故地冒了出来。

e.en: She handled the crisis with {seemingly} effortless grace.
e.zh: 她从容不迫地化解了那场危机。

e.en: It is not {seemly} to argue at a funeral.
e.zh: 在葬礼上争吵是不得体的。

e.en: She gave a {seemly} reply to the awkward question.
e.zh: 她对这个尴尬的问题给出了得体的回答。

seems.t: v. 似乎（第三人称单数）

e.en: It {seems} like everyone is using AI tools now.
e.zh: 现在似乎人人都在用 AI 工具。

e.en: The app {seems} to crash whenever I open settings.
e.zh: 我每次打开设置,这个应用好像就会崩溃。

seen.t: v. 看见（see 的过去分词）

e.en: I have never {seen} such a beautiful sunset.
e.zh: 我从未见过如此美丽的日落。

e.en: The film should be {seen} on the big screen.
e.zh: 这部电影应该到大银幕上去看。

e.en: Rainwater began to {seep} through the basement walls.
e.zh: 雨水开始从地下室的墙壁里渗进来。

e.en: Doubts started to {seep} into his mind.
e.zh: 疑虑开始悄悄爬上他的心头。

e.en: Engineers found water {seepage} in the tunnel walls.
e.zh: 工程师在隧道墙壁上发现了渗水现象。

e.en: The old roof showed signs of slow {seepage}.
e.zh: 那个旧屋顶出现了缓慢渗漏的迹象。

e.en: The ancient {seer} warned the king of coming danger.
e.zh: 那位古代先知警告国王即将到来的危险。

e.en: Some call her a financial {seer} for her bold predictions.
e.zh: 有人因她大胆的预测而称她为金融预言家。

e.en: He wore a light blue {seersucker} suit to the wedding.
e.zh: 他穿着一身浅蓝色泡泡纱西装去参加婚礼。

e.en: {Seersucker} fabric is perfect for hot summer days.
e.zh: 泡泡纱面料非常适合炎热的夏日。

sees.t: v. 看见（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {sees} her grandmother every Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 她每个周日下午都会去看望奶奶。

e.en: The doctor {sees} patients until six in the evening.
e.zh: 这位医生看诊到晚上六点。

seesaw.t:
n. 跷跷板
v. 上下摆动

e.en: The kids laughed as they rode the {seesaw}.
e.zh: 孩子们一边玩跷跷板一边咯咯地笑。

e.en: Stock prices {seesaw} whenever earnings reports come out.
e.zh: 每逢财报发布,股价就会上下波动。

e.en: The playground has two new {seesaws} near the slide.
e.zh: 操场上滑梯旁新装了两架跷跷板。

e.en: Her mood {seesaws} between excitement and worry.
e.zh: 她的情绪在兴奋与担忧之间起伏不定。

e.en: He began to {seethe} when his idea was dismissed.
e.zh: 他的想法被否决时,他气得火冒三丈。

e.en: Crowds {seethe} through the station at rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰时段,人群汹涌地涌过车站。

seething.t: adj. 沸腾的；怒火中烧的

e.en: She was {seething} after reading the rude email.
e.zh: 看完那封无礼的邮件后,她气得发抖。

e.en: The market square was {seething} with weekend shoppers.
e.zh: 集市广场上挤满了周末购物的人。

sefton.t: n. 塞夫顿（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: They moved to {Sefton} for its quiet coastal views.
e.zh: 他们搬到塞夫顿,看中那里宁静的海岸景色。

e.en: {Sefton} Park is a popular weekend spot in Liverpool.
e.zh: 塞夫顿公园是利物浦颇受欢迎的周末去处。

sega.t: n. 世嘉（日本游戏公司）

e.en: He still keeps his old {Sega} console in the closet.
e.zh: 他还把那台老世嘉游戏机收在柜子里。

e.en: {Sega} released many iconic games in the nineties.
e.zh: 世嘉在九十年代推出了许多经典游戏。

segment.t:
n. 部分；片段
v. 分割

e.en: The wealthy {segment} of consumers prefers luxury brands.
e.zh: 高端消费群体更偏爱奢侈品牌。

e.en: Please {segment} the audience by age and income.
e.zh: 请按年龄和收入对受众进行分群。

e.en: The bridge has a graceful {segmental} arch design.
e.zh: 这座桥采用了优美的弧形拱设计。

e.en: Linguists study {segmental} features like vowels and consonants.
e.zh: 语言学家研究元音和辅音等音段特征。

segmentary.t: adj. 分节的；由节段组成的

e.en: Anthropologists describe the tribe's {segmentary} kinship system.
e.zh: 人类学家描述了这个部落的分支型亲属制度。

e.en: The society has a {segmentary} political structure.
e.zh: 这个社会拥有分节式的政治结构。

segmentation.t: n. 分割；细分（市场、图像）

e.en: Customer {segmentation} helps marketers target the right audience.
e.zh: 客户细分帮助营销人员锁定合适的受众。

e.en: Image {segmentation} is a key task in computer vision.
e.zh: 图像分割是计算机视觉中的一项关键任务。

e.en: Insects have a clearly {segmented} body structure.
e.zh: 昆虫的身体结构明显呈分节状。

e.en: The market is {segmented} into three main groups.
e.zh: 市场被划分为三个主要群体。

segments.t:
n. 片段（复数）
v. 分割

e.en: The video is divided into five short {segments}.
e.zh: 视频被分成五个短片段。

e.en: She peeled the orange and ate the {segments}.
e.zh: 她剥了橙子,把果肉一瓣瓣吃掉。

segovia.t: n. 塞戈维亚（西班牙城市）

e.en: The Roman aqueduct in {Segovia} still stands today.
e.zh: 塞戈维亚的罗马输水道至今依然屹立。

e.en: Andrés {Segovia} revolutionized classical guitar performance.
e.zh: 安德烈斯·塞戈维亚革新了古典吉他演奏。

e.en: Schools should never {segregate} students by race.
e.zh: 学校绝不应按种族隔离学生。

e.en: Please {segregate} the recyclables from regular trash.
e.zh: 请将可回收物与普通垃圾分开放置。

segregated.t: adj. 被隔离的；种族隔离的

e.en: Many southern schools were once strictly {segregated}.
e.zh: 许多南方的学校曾经实行严格的种族隔离。

e.en: The data is stored on a {segregated} secure server.
e.zh: 数据存储在一个独立的安全服务器上。

e.en: Racial {segregation} was outlawed in the 1960s.
e.zh: 种族隔离在1960年代被宣布为非法。

e.en: The hospital practices strict {segregation} of contagious patients.
e.zh: 医院对传染病人实行严格的隔离措施。

e.en: The {segregationist} governor blocked the school's doors.
e.zh: 那位主张种族隔离的州长堵住了学校的大门。

e.en: Civil rights activists fought against {segregationist} policies.
e.zh: 民权活动家与种族隔离政策作斗争。

segue.t:
v. 无缝过渡
n. 衔接段

e.en: The host made a smooth {segue} into the next topic.
e.zh: 主持人巧妙地过渡到了下一个话题。

e.en: Let me {segue} from marketing into our sales numbers.
e.zh: 让我从市场营销过渡到我们的销售数据。

seige.t: n. 围攻（siege 的拼写错误）

e.en: Note: '{seige}' is a common misspelling of 'siege'.
e.zh: 注意:"seige"是"siege"(围攻)的常见拼写错误。

e.en: Spell-check flagged {seige} and suggested 'siege' instead.
e.zh: 拼写检查标出了seige并建议改为siege。

e.en: The local {seigneur} owned all the land in the valley.
e.zh: 当地领主拥有山谷里所有的土地。

e.en: Peasants paid heavy taxes to their {seigneur}.
e.zh: 农民向他们的领主缴纳沉重的税赋。

e.en: Quebec's {seigneurial} system lasted until the 1850s.
e.zh: 魁北克的领主制度一直延续到1850年代。

e.en: He carried himself with a quiet {seigneurial} air.
e.zh: 他举手投足间带着一种沉静的贵族气派。

seiko.t: n. 精工（日本手表品牌）

e.en: He inherited a vintage {Seiko} watch from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里继承了一只复古的精工手表。

e.en: {Seiko} introduced the world's first quartz wristwatch in 1969.
e.zh: 精工于1969年推出了世界上第一款石英腕表。

e.en: Couples kissed along the banks of the {Seine}.
e.zh: 情侣们在塞纳河畔亲吻。

e.en: Fishermen used a long {seine} to catch the herring.
e.zh: 渔民用长长的围网捕捉鲱鱼。

e.en: Japan has strict {seismic} building codes.
e.zh: 日本有严格的抗震建筑规范。

e.en: AI represents a {seismic} shift in software development.
e.zh: 人工智能代表着软件开发领域的颠覆性变革。

e.en: California's high {seismicity} keeps engineers constantly vigilant.
e.zh: 加州频繁的地震活动让工程师们始终保持警惕。

e.en: Researchers monitor {seismicity} near the volcano daily.
e.zh: 研究人员每天监测火山附近的地震活动。

e.en: The {seismograph} recorded tremors throughout the night.
e.zh: 地震仪整夜记录到了震动。

e.en: Every observatory has a sensitive {seismograph} on site.
e.zh: 每个观测站都配有一台灵敏的地震仪。

e.en: The {seismological} data suggested an aftershock was likely.
e.zh: 地震学数据显示很可能会有余震。

e.en: She works at the national {seismological} center in Beijing.
e.zh: 她在北京的国家地震中心工作。

e.en: The {seismologist} warned residents about possible aftershocks.
e.zh: 地震学家警告居民可能会有余震。

e.en: As a {seismologist}, she studies fault lines worldwide.
e.zh: 作为一名地震学家,她研究全球的断层线。

e.en: She earned her PhD in {seismology} from Stanford.
e.zh: 她在斯坦福大学获得了地震学博士学位。

e.en: Modern {seismology} uses thousands of sensors worldwide.
e.zh: 现代地震学在全球使用着成千上万个传感器。

e.en: NASA installed a {seismometer} on Mars to detect quakes.
e.zh: NASA在火星上安装了一台地震仪以探测震动。

e.en: The {seismometer} picked up a faint distant tremor.
e.zh: 那台地震仪捕捉到了一次微弱的远震。

seize.t: v. 抓住；夺取；把握（机会）

e.en: You should {seize} this rare career opportunity.
e.zh: 你应该抓住这个难得的职业机会。

e.en: Police can {seize} assets linked to criminal activity.
e.zh: 警方可以查封与犯罪活动有关的资产。

seized.t: v. 抓住；夺取（seize 的过去式）

e.en: Police {seized} a large amount of cash during the raid.
e.zh: 警方在突袭中查获了大量现金。

e.en: She {seized} the opportunity to study abroad.
e.zh: 她抓住了出国留学的机会。

seizes.t: v. 抓住；夺取（seize 第三人称单数）

e.en: The customs officer routinely {seizes} counterfeit goods at the border.
e.zh: 海关官员经常在边境查获假冒商品。

e.en: He {seizes} every chance to practice his English.
e.zh: 他抓住每一个练习英语的机会。

seizing.t: v. 抓住；夺取（seize 的现在分词）

e.en: The army is {seizing} control of the capital.
e.zh: 军队正在夺取首都的控制权。

e.en: She made the deal by {seizing} the right moment.
e.zh: 她抓住了恰当的时机促成了这笔交易。

seizure.t:
n. 夺取；查封
n. (疾病) 发作

e.en: The patient had a {seizure} and was rushed to hospital.
e.zh: 那位病人癫痫发作,被紧急送往医院。

e.en: Police announced the {seizure} of ten kilograms of drugs.
e.zh: 警方宣布查获了十公斤毒品。

sejm.t: n. 瑟姆（波兰议会下院）

e.en: The {Sejm} passed the new law after a heated debate.
e.zh: 波兰议会经过激烈辩论后通过了这项新法律。

e.en: Members of the {Sejm} voted to approve the budget.
e.zh: 波兰议会议员投票通过了预算案。

selassie.t: n. 塞拉西（埃塞俄比亚皇帝姓氏）

e.en: Haile {Selassie} ruled Ethiopia for over four decades.
e.zh: 海尔·塞拉西统治埃塞俄比亚长达四十多年。

e.en: Rastafarians revere Haile {Selassie} as a divine figure.
e.zh: 拉斯塔法里教徒将海尔·塞拉西尊为神圣人物。

selborne.t: n. 塞尔伯恩（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: Gilbert White's natural history of {Selborne} remains a classic.
e.zh: 吉尔伯特·怀特撰写的《塞尔伯恩博物志》至今仍是经典。

e.en: Tourists visit {Selborne} to see the famous old village.
e.zh: 游客们前往塞尔伯恩参观那座著名的古老村庄。

selby.t: n. 塞尔比（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: The town of {Selby} sits beside a medieval abbey.
e.zh: 塞尔比镇坐落在一座中世纪修道院旁。

e.en: Trains to {Selby} depart from York every hour.
e.zh: 开往塞尔比的火车每小时从约克发车。

e.en: He {seldom} checks his email after work hours.
e.zh: 他下班后很少查看邮件。

e.en: Such a beautiful sunset is {seldom} seen in the city.
e.zh: 在城市里很少能看到如此美丽的日落。

select.t:
v. 选择；选中
adj. 精选的

e.en: Please {select} a payment method to continue.
e.zh: 请选择一种支付方式以继续。

e.en: Only a {select} few were invited to the dinner.
e.zh: 只有少数精选嘉宾被邀请出席晚宴。

e.en: The text on this page is not {selectable} with the mouse.
e.zh: 这个页面上的文字无法用鼠标选中。

e.en: Make sure all menu items are {selectable} on mobile devices.
e.zh: 确保所有菜单项在移动设备上都可以被选中。

selected.t:
adj. 被选中的
v. 选择（过去式）

e.en: She was {selected} as team captain for the season.
e.zh: 她被选为本赛季的队长。

e.en: I {selected} a few photos to share online.
e.zh: 我挑选了几张照片分享到网上。

selectee.t: n. 被选中者；应征入伍者

e.en: Each {selectee} received a letter outlining the next steps.
e.zh: 每位入选者都收到了说明后续步骤的信函。

e.en: The army assigned each {selectee} to a training unit.
e.zh: 军方将每位入选新兵分配到一个训练单位。

e.en: I'm {selecting} a new laptop for college.
e.zh: 我正在挑选一台上大学用的新笔记本电脑。

e.en: The committee is {selecting} finalists from hundreds of entries.
e.zh: 委员会正在从数百份参赛作品中挑选决赛入围者。

e.en: This shop offers a wide {selection} of teas.
e.zh: 这家店提供种类繁多的茶叶。

e.en: The jury's {selection} of the winner surprised everyone.
e.zh: 评委会对获胜者的选择让所有人都感到意外。

e.en: The menu features {selections} from across Asia.
e.zh: 菜单上有来自亚洲各地的精选菜品。

e.en: Please confirm your {selections} before checking out.
e.zh: 请在结账前确认您的选择。

selective.t: adj. 有选择性的；挑剔的

e.en: She is very {selective} about who she follows online.
e.zh: 她对自己关注的人非常挑剔。

e.en: The school has a highly {selective} admissions process.
e.zh: 这所学校的录取过程非常严格。

e.en: The app {selectively} blocks notifications during work hours.
e.zh: 这款应用会在工作时间有选择地屏蔽通知。

e.en: He listens {selectively}, hearing only what he wants.
e.zh: 他选择性地听,只听他想听的内容。

e.en: Different catalysts show varied {selectivities} in this reaction.
e.zh: 不同的催化剂在此反应中表现出不同的选择性。

e.en: The study compared the {selectivities} of three filtering methods.
e.zh: 该研究比较了三种过滤方法的选择性。

e.en: The drug's high {selectivity} reduces side effects significantly.
e.zh: 这种药物的高选择性显著减少了副作用。

e.en: Top universities are known for their academic {selectivity}.
e.zh: 顶尖大学以其严格的学术选拔而闻名。

selectman.t: n. 民选市镇管理委员

e.en: The town {selectman} addressed concerns at the public meeting.
e.zh: 镇议员在公众会议上回应了大家的关切。

e.en: He served as a {selectman} for over a decade.
e.zh: 他担任镇议员长达十多年。

selector.t:
n. 选择器（CSS/程序）
n. 选拔者

e.en: Use the CSS {selector} to target specific elements.
e.zh: 使用 CSS 选择器来定位特定的元素。

e.en: Turn the {selector} switch to choose a wash cycle.
e.zh: 转动选择开关以选择洗涤模式。

selects.t: v. 选择（第三人称单数）

e.en: The algorithm {selects} the best ad for each user.
e.zh: 该算法为每位用户挑选最合适的广告。

e.en: She always {selects} the cheapest option on the menu.
e.zh: 她总是在菜单上选择最便宜的那一项。

e.en: Brazil nuts contain a high amount of {selenium}.
e.zh: 巴西坚果含有大量的硒。

e.en: We use {Selenium} to automate browser testing.
e.zh: 我们用 Selenium 来自动化浏览器测试。

e.en: Meditation helps her connect with her inner {self}.
e.zh: 冥想帮助她与内心的自我建立联系。

e.en: After the trip, he felt like his old {self} again.
e.zh: 那次旅行之后,他感觉自己又回到了从前的状态。

e.en: His constant {self-abasement} made colleagues uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他不停地贬低自己,让同事们感到很不自在。

e.en: The novel explores guilt and quiet {self-abasement}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了内疚和默默的自我贬低。

self-absorbed.t: adj. 只顾自己的；自我陶醉的

e.en: He is too {self-absorbed} to notice his friend's sadness.
e.zh: 他过于自我中心,根本没察觉朋友的难过。

e.en: Teenagers can sometimes seem a bit {self-absorbed}.
e.zh: 青少年有时显得有点以自我为中心。

self-aggrandisement.t: n. 自抬身价；自我扩张

e.en: His speech was full of shameless {self-aggrandisement}.
e.zh: 他的演讲充斥着毫不掩饰的自我吹嘘。

e.en: The memoir avoids the usual political {self-aggrandisement}.
e.zh: 这本回忆录避开了政客惯有的自我标榜。

e.en: His emails are filled with petty {self-aggrandisements}.
e.zh: 他的邮件里满是琐碎的自吹自擂。

e.en: Voters grew tired of the candidate's endless {self-aggrandisements}.
e.zh: 选民厌倦了那位候选人没完没了的自我吹捧。

self-aggrandizement.t: n. 自抬身价；自我扩张

e.en: The CEO's interview reeked of {self-aggrandizement}.
e.zh: 那位 CEO 的采访满是自我吹嘘的味道。

e.en: He used the charity event for blatant {self-aggrandizement}.
e.zh: 他利用这场慈善活动公然为自己脸上贴金。

e.en: Her tweets are mostly thinly veiled {self-aggrandizements}.
e.zh: 她的推文大多是不加掩饰的自我吹捧。

e.en: Readers saw through the politician's {self-aggrandizements}.
e.zh: 读者一眼看穿了那位政客的自我标榜。

self-assertion.t: n. 自信主张；自我表现

e.en: Healthy {self-assertion} helps you set clear boundaries.
e.zh: 健康的自我主张能帮你清晰地划定界限。

e.en: The workshop teaches quiet, respectful {self-assertion}.
e.zh: 这个工作坊教授温和而尊重他人的自我表达。

e.en: Public speaking really boosted her {self-confidence}.
e.zh: 公开演讲大大增强了她的自信心。

e.en: He spoke with calm {self-confidence} during the interview.
e.zh: 他在面试中表现得从容自信。

e.en: Their fragile {self-confidences} grew through small daily wins.
e.zh: 他们脆弱的自信在每天的小成就中逐渐累积起来。

e.en: The coach helped rebuild the players' shaken {self-confidences}.
e.zh: 教练帮助队员们重建动摇的自信。

e.en: She gave a {self-confident} answer to the tough question.
e.zh: 面对那个棘手的问题,她自信地作出了回答。

e.en: He looked {self-confident} as he walked onto the stage.
e.zh: 他自信满满地走上了舞台。

self-conscious.t: adj. 不自在的；害羞拘谨的

e.en: She felt {self-conscious} about her accent at first.
e.zh: 她起初对自己的口音感到很不自在。

e.en: Teens often grow {self-conscious} about their appearance.
e.zh: 青少年常会对自己的外貌感到敏感拘谨。

e.en: She enrolled in a {self-defense} class after work.
e.zh: 她下班后报了一个自我防卫课程。

e.en: He claimed the punch was thrown in {self-defense}.
e.zh: 他声称那一拳是出于自卫。

e.en: Daily writing requires real {self-discipline} and patience.
e.zh: 每日写作需要真正的自律和耐心。

e.en: His {self-discipline} helped him pass the bar exam.
e.zh: 他的自律帮他通过了律师资格考试。

self-service.t:
n. 自助服务
adj. 自助式的

e.en: The cafeteria is {self-service} during lunch hours.
e.zh: 午餐时段这家食堂是自助式的。

e.en: Most banks now offer {self-service} options online.
e.zh: 如今大多数银行都提供线上自助服务。

self-sufficient.t: adj. 自给自足的；独立的

e.en: Their farm is almost completely {self-sufficient} for food.
e.zh: 他们的农场在食物上几乎完全自给自足。

e.en: She wants to be financially {self-sufficient} by thirty.
e.zh: 她希望三十岁前能在经济上自给自足。

e.en: Therapy helped her rebuild a strong sense of {self-worth}.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮她重建了强烈的自我价值感。
