e.en: Don't tie your {self-worth} to a single test score.
e.zh: 别把你的自我价值绑在一次考试成绩上。

e.en: The book examines how social media shapes young people's {self-worths}.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了社交媒体如何塑造年轻人的自我价值感。

e.en: Her workshops aim to nurture children's fragile {self-worths}.
e.zh: 她的工作坊旨在呵护孩子们脆弱的自我价值感。

e.en: Adolescence is a critical time for forming {selfhood}.
e.zh: 青春期是形成自我认同的关键阶段。

e.en: The novel explores a young woman's search for {selfhood}.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位年轻女性寻找自我的过程。

e.en: It feels {selfish} to take a vacation right now.
e.zh: 现在去度假感觉有点自私。

e.en: Don't be {selfish}—share the snacks with everyone.
e.zh: 别自私啦,把零食分给大家一起吃。

e.en: He {selfishly} kept the last slice of cake.
e.zh: 他自私地把最后一块蛋糕留给了自己。

e.en: She acted {selfishly} during the team project.
e.zh: 在小组项目中她表现得很自私。

e.en: Her {selfishness} eventually drove her friends away.
e.zh: 她的自私最终让朋友们离她而去。

e.en: A little {selfishness} is fine when caring for yourself.
e.zh: 在照顾自己时,稍微自私一点也无可厚非。

e.en: The nurse showed {selfless} dedication during the pandemic.
e.zh: 那位护士在疫情期间表现出无私的奉献精神。

e.en: He made a {selfless} choice to give up the promotion.
e.zh: 他无私地选择放弃这次升职机会。

e.en: She volunteered {selflessly} at the shelter every weekend.
e.zh: 她每个周末都无私地在收容所做志愿者。

e.en: He {selflessly} donated his bone marrow to a stranger.
e.zh: 他无私地把骨髓捐给了一位陌生人。

sentinel.t:
n. 哨兵，守卫
n. (编程) 哨兵值

e.en: A lone {sentinel} stood guard at the castle gate all night.
e.zh: 一名孤独的哨兵整夜守卫着城堡大门。

e.en: The software acts as a {sentinel}, watching for unusual network activity.
e.zh: 该软件充当哨兵,监视异常的网络活动。

e.en: The {sentry} checked everyone's identification before allowing entry.
e.zh: 哨兵在允许任何人进入前都检查证件。

e.en: A {sentry} was posted at the main gate around the clock.
e.zh: 主门口全天候布有哨兵。

e.en: {Seoul} is the bustling capital city of South Korea.
e.zh: 首尔是韩国繁华的首都。

e.en: We spent three days exploring the markets of {Seoul} last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天我们花了三天时间逛首尔的市场。

sepal.t: n. 萼片（花的组成部分）

e.en: Each green {sepal} protects the flower bud before it opens.
e.zh: 每一片绿色的萼片在花苞开放前都对其加以保护。

e.en: The botanist examined the {sepal} under a powerful microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在高倍显微镜下检查了萼片。

e.en: The {separability} of church and state is a constitutional principle.
e.zh: 政教分离性是一项宪法原则。

e.en: Engineers tested the {separability} of the two connected components.
e.zh: 工程师测试了两个相连部件的可分离性。

separable.t: adj. 可分离的，可分开的

e.en: The keyboard is easily {separable} from the tablet for travel.
e.zh: 键盘可以轻松从平板上分离,便于出行携带。

e.en: These two issues are not really {separable} from each other.
e.zh: 这两个问题其实无法彼此分开看待。

separate.t:
v. 分开，分离
adj. 单独的，不同的

e.en: Please {separate} the recyclables from the regular trash.
e.zh: 请把可回收物与普通垃圾分开。

e.en: They booked {separate} rooms at the hotel for privacy.
e.zh: 他们为了隐私在酒店订了不同的房间。

e.en: The couple has been {separated} for nearly two years now.
e.zh: 这对夫妇已经分居将近两年了。

e.en: She {separated} the egg whites from the yolks for the recipe.
e.zh: 她按食谱把蛋白与蛋黄分开。

e.en: Each item is sold {separately} on the company's website.
e.zh: 每件商品在公司网站上单独出售。

e.en: We arrived {separately} but ended up sitting at the same table.
e.zh: 我们分开到达,最后却坐在了同一张桌子。

e.en: Children gradually develop a sense of {separateness} from their parents.
e.zh: 孩子会逐渐形成与父母分离的独立意识。

e.en: The painting expresses a deep feeling of urban {separateness} and loneliness.
e.zh: 这幅画表达了一种深沉的都市疏离感与孤独。

separates.t:
v. 分开（separate 第三人称单数）
n. 单件衣物

e.en: A tall fence {separates} our yard from the neighbor's garden.
e.zh: 一道高高的栅栏将我们的院子与邻居的花园隔开。

e.en: She bought several mix-and-match {separates} for her work wardrobe.
e.zh: 她为工作衣橱买了几件可搭配的单品。

separating.t: v. 正在分开（separate 的进行式）

e.en: The river runs through the city, {separating} the old and new districts.
e.zh: 这条河穿城而过,将新旧城区分隔开来。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {separating} laundry into colors and whites.
e.zh: 他下午花时间把洗的衣服按彩色和白色分开。

e.en: The {separation} between work and personal life can be difficult.
e.zh: 工作与私人生活之间的分隔有时很难做到。

e.en: After a long {separation}, the family was finally reunited.
e.zh: 经过长期的分离,这家人终于团聚了。

e.en: The long {separations} were hard on their young marriage.
e.zh: 长时间的分离对他们年轻的婚姻是种考验。

e.en: Chemists study the {separations} of compounds in the mixture.
e.zh: 化学家研究混合物中各化合物的分离过程。

separatism.t: n. 分离主义，独立运动

e.en: Regional {separatism} has fueled tensions for decades.
e.zh: 地区分离主义已经使紧张局势持续了几十年。

e.en: The party rejects any form of ethnic {separatism}.
e.zh: 该政党反对任何形式的民族分离主义。

separatist.t:
n. 分离主义者
adj. 分裂主义的

e.en: A {separatist} movement gained support in the north.
e.zh: 一场分离主义运动在北方获得了支持。

e.en: Police arrested several {separatist} leaders yesterday.
e.zh: 警方昨天逮捕了几名分离主义领袖。

e.en: Use a comma as the {separator} between values in the file.
e.zh: 在该文件中用逗号作为数值之间的分隔符。

e.en: The oil {separator} keeps water out of the engine.
e.zh: 这个油分离器防止水进入发动机。

sephardic.t: adj. 西班牙系犹太人的

e.en: She grew up singing traditional {Sephardic} songs at home.
e.zh: 她从小在家中唱传统的西班牙系犹太歌曲。

e.en: The museum features {Sephardic} Jewish heritage from medieval Spain.
e.zh: 博物馆展出中世纪西班牙的塞法迪犹太遗产。

sepia.t: n. 深褐色；乌贼墨色调

e.en: The old photo had a warm {sepia} tone.
e.zh: 那张老照片带着温暖的褐色调。

e.en: He applied a {sepia} filter to make the image look vintage.
e.zh: 他用了棕褐色滤镜让照片显得复古。

sepoy.t: n. (旧时) 英军中的印度士兵

e.en: The {sepoy} rebellion of 1857 reshaped colonial India.
e.zh: 1857年的印度兵起义改变了殖民地印度。

e.en: A young {sepoy} stood guard at the fort gate.
e.zh: 一名年轻的印度兵守卫在城堡门口。

e.en: Doctors warned that untreated infections can lead to {sepsis}.
e.zh: 医生警告说未治疗的感染可能导致败血症。

e.en: She was hospitalized with severe {sepsis} last week.
e.zh: 她上周因重度脓毒症住院。

e.en: Each Highland {sept} traced its lineage to a common ancestor.
e.zh: 每个苏格兰高地家族支系都追溯到一位共同祖先。

e.en: The clan was made up of several smaller {sept} groups.
e.zh: 这个氏族由几个较小的支族组成。

e.en: Thin {septa} divide the chambers of the heart.
e.zh: 薄薄的间隔膜将心脏的腔室分开。

e.en: The biologist examined the {septa} inside the fungal cells.
e.zh: 生物学家检查了真菌细胞内的隔膜。

e.en: The patient had a small {septal} defect in the heart.
e.zh: 病人心脏有一处小的间隔缺损。

e.en: Surgeons repaired the {septal} wall during the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中修复了间隔壁。

e.en: School starts in early {September} every year.
e.zh: 学校每年九月初开学。

e.en: They got married on a sunny day in {September}.
e.zh: 他们在九月一个阳光明媚的日子结婚。

e.en: Several rainy {Septembers} ruined the harvest in a row.
e.zh: 接连几个多雨的九月毁了收成。

e.en: He remembered the cool {Septembers} of his childhood.
e.zh: 他记得童年时凉爽的那些九月。

e.en: The jazz {septet} played late into the night.
e.zh: 这个爵士七重奏乐团演奏到深夜。

e.en: Beethoven composed a famous {septet} for strings and winds.
e.zh: 贝多芬创作了一首著名的弦乐管乐七重奏。

e.en: The wound turned {septic} and required antibiotics.
e.zh: 伤口感染化脓了,需要使用抗生素。

e.en: Their cabin uses a {septic} tank instead of city sewage.
e.zh: 他们的小木屋用化粪池而不是市政下水道。

e.en: He nearly died from {septicaemia} after the surgery.
e.zh: 他手术后差点死于败血症。

e.en: Early antibiotics can prevent {septicaemia} from spreading.
e.zh: 及早使用抗生素能防止败血症扩散。

e.en: The infection progressed quickly into {septicemia}.
e.zh: 这种感染迅速发展成了败血症。

e.en: Doctors treated the {septicemia} with intravenous drugs.
e.zh: 医生用静脉注射药物治疗了败血症。

e.en: The {septuagenarian} runner finished the marathon in good time.
e.zh: 这位七十多岁的跑者以不错的成绩完成了马拉松。

e.en: A cheerful {septuagenarian} taught us how to dance.
e.zh: 一位开朗的七旬老人教我们跳舞。

septum.t: n. 中隔，隔膜（如鼻中隔）

e.en: He broke his nose and damaged the {septum}.
e.zh: 他鼻子骨折,鼻中隔也受了伤。

e.en: A deviated {septum} can cause breathing problems.
e.zh: 鼻中隔偏曲可能导致呼吸困难。

e.en: The {septuplet} babies were all born healthy after a long delivery.
e.zh: 这七胞胎婴儿在漫长的分娩后都健康出生了。

e.en: The drummer played a tricky {septuplet} rhythm in the solo.
e.zh: 鼓手在独奏中演奏了一段棘手的七连音节奏。

e.en: The ancient {sepulcher} held the remains of a forgotten king.
e.zh: 这座古老的陵墓里葬着一位被遗忘的国王。

e.en: Pilgrims visited the stone {sepulcher} in silent reverence.
e.zh: 朝圣者们静静地瞻仰着这座石墓。

e.en: His {sepulchral} voice gave the ghost story extra chills.
e.zh: 他低沉如墓的嗓音让鬼故事更添寒意。

e.en: A {sepulchral} silence fell over the empty cathedral.
e.zh: 空荡荡的大教堂里笼罩着死一般的寂静。

e.en: They knelt before the marble {sepulchre} of the saint.
e.zh: 他们跪在圣人的大理石陵墓前。

e.en: The old church houses a {sepulchre} dating from the twelfth century.
e.zh: 这座古老教堂里有一座可追溯至十二世纪的陵墓。

sequacious.t: adj. 盲从的，缺乏独立思考的

e.en: His {sequacious} followers agreed with every opinion he voiced.
e.zh: 他那些盲从的追随者对他的每个观点都表示赞同。

e.en: The crowd showed a {sequacious} loyalty to the charismatic leader.
e.zh: 人群对那位魅力领袖表现出盲从的忠诚。

sequel.t:
n. 续集，续篇
n. 后果

e.en: Fans waited five years for the {sequel} to the hit movie.
e.zh: 影迷们等了五年才等到这部热门电影的续集。

e.en: The novel's {sequel} sold even better than the original.
e.zh: 这部小说的续集卖得比原作还好。

e.en: Chronic fatigue can be a long-term {sequela} of the infection.
e.zh: 慢性疲劳可能是这种感染的长期后遗症。

e.en: Doctors monitor every {sequela} that follows a severe stroke.
e.zh: 医生会监测重度中风后出现的每一种后遗症。

e.en: The studio greenlit two more {sequels} after the box office success.
e.zh: 在票房大卖后，制片厂又批准拍摄两部续集。

e.en: Most {sequels} struggle to match the magic of the original.
e.zh: 大多数续集都难以再现原作的魅力。

sequence.t:
n. 顺序，序列
v. 按顺序排列

e.en: Follow the steps in the correct {sequence} to install the app.
e.zh: 按正确顺序执行步骤即可安装这个应用。

e.en: The opening {sequence} of the film is visually stunning.
e.zh: 这部电影的开场片段视觉效果令人惊艳。

sequenced.t: v. 已排序（sequence 的过去式）

e.en: Researchers {sequenced} the virus's genome within just a few days.
e.zh: 研究人员在短短几天内就测定了该病毒的基因组序列。

e.en: The playlist is carefully {sequenced} to build emotional momentum.
e.zh: 这个歌单经过精心排序，以营造情感的递进。

e.en: He uses a vintage {sequencer} to program retro synth beats.
e.zh: 他用一台复古音序器来编排怀旧合成器节拍。

e.en: The lab's new DNA {sequencer} runs samples in under an hour.
e.zh: 实验室的新型DNA测序仪能在一小时内完成样本分析。

e.en: The film's action {sequences} were shot over three months.
e.zh: 这部电影的动作场景拍摄了三个月。

e.en: Mathematicians study {sequences} that follow predictable patterns.
e.zh: 数学家研究遵循可预测规律的数列。

sequencing.t: n. 排序；(基因) 测序

e.en: DNA {sequencing} has become much faster and cheaper recently.
e.zh: DNA测序近来变得更快也更便宜了。

e.en: Proper {sequencing} of tasks can save hours of project time.
e.zh: 合理安排任务顺序可以节省数小时的项目时间。

e.en: Each chapter introduces an idea {sequent} to the previous one.
e.zh: 每一章都引入一个紧接前文的概念。

e.en: The argument unfolds in {sequent} steps of careful logic.
e.zh: 论证以严密逻辑的连续步骤层层展开。

e.en: The tutorial uses {sequential} steps that build on each other.
e.zh: 这份教程采用层层递进的顺序步骤。

e.en: Memory works best when information is presented in {sequential} order.
e.zh: 信息按顺序呈现时记忆效果最好。

e.en: Her {selflessness} inspired everyone on the team.
e.zh: 她的无私精神鼓舞了团队里的每一个人。

e.en: True {selflessness} doesn't expect anything in return.
e.zh: 真正的无私不求任何回报。

selfridge.t: n. 塞尔福里奇（人名/英国百货品牌）

e.en: They spent the afternoon shopping at {Selfridge}'s on Oxford Street.
e.zh: 他们一下午都在牛津街的塞尔福里奇百货逛街。

e.en: Harry Gordon {Selfridge} revolutionized modern department store retail.
e.zh: 哈里·戈登·塞尔福里奇彻底革新了现代百货零售业。

selfsame.t: adj. 完全相同的；同一个

e.en: We met again at the {selfsame} café a year later.
e.zh: 一年后我们又在同一家咖啡馆重逢。

e.en: He repeated the {selfsame} excuse he used last week.
e.zh: 他又搬出了上周用过的同一套借口。

selkirk.t: n. 塞尔扣克（人名/地名）

e.en: The {Selkirk} Mountains span parts of British Columbia and Idaho.
e.zh: 塞尔扣克山脉横跨英属哥伦比亚和爱达荷州。

e.en: He adopted a fluffy {Selkirk} Rex kitten last week.
e.zh: 他上周领养了一只毛茸茸的塞尔扣克卷毛猫。

sell.t:
v. 卖；出售
v. 推销；推广（想法）

e.en: They plan to {sell} their old car online.
e.zh: 他们打算在网上卖掉旧车。

e.en: That pitch will be a hard {sell} to investors.
e.zh: 那个方案很难说服投资人。

sellable.t: adj. 可出售的；卖得出去的

e.en: The startup needs a {sellable} product, not just a prototype.
e.zh: 这家初创公司需要的是能卖的产品,不是原型。

e.en: Her artwork is beautiful but not always {sellable}.
e.zh: 她的作品很美,但不一定卖得出去。

e.en: The {seller} agreed to lower the price by ten percent.
e.zh: 卖家同意把价格降低百分之十。

e.en: Her novel became a top {seller} on Amazon.
e.zh: 她的小说成了亚马逊的畅销书。

e.en: Online {sellers} must respond to buyer messages within a day.
e.zh: 网店卖家必须在一天内回复买家消息。

e.en: Many {sellers} are offering huge discounts this weekend.
e.zh: 许多卖家这个周末都在大幅打折。

selling.t:
n. 销售
v. 卖（sell 的 -ing 形式）

e.en: She is {selling} handmade jewelry on Etsy.
e.zh: 她在 Etsy 上卖手工首饰。

e.en: Convenience is the main {selling} point of this app.
e.zh: 便利是这个应用最大的卖点。

e.en: Pass me the {sellotape} so I can wrap this gift.
e.zh: 把透明胶带递给我,我要包这份礼物。

e.en: The poster was stuck to the wall with {sellotape}.
e.zh: 海报是用透明胶带贴在墙上的。

e.en: Fans called the band's new album a total {sellout}.
e.zh: 乐迷觉得乐队的新专辑彻底向商业妥协了。

e.en: The concert was a {sellout} within ten minutes.
e.zh: 演唱会十分钟内就售罄了。

sells.t: v. 卖（sell 的第三人称单数）

e.en: This bakery {sells} the best croissants in town.
e.zh: 这家面包店卖全城最好吃的可颂。

e.en: Sex {sells}, as advertisers have long known.
e.zh: 性能卖钱,这是广告商早就明白的道理。

selly.t: n. 塞利（地名，如 Selly Oak）

e.en: Many students live in {Selly} Oak near the university.
e.zh: 许多学生住在大学附近的塞利奥克。

e.en: The bus to {Selly} Oak runs every ten minutes.
e.zh: 开往塞利奥克的公交每十分钟一班。

e.en: I prefer lime {seltzer} over sugary soda.
e.zh: 比起含糖汽水,我更喜欢青柠苏打水。

e.en: She poured a glass of cold {seltzer} after the run.
e.zh: 跑完步她倒了一杯冰苏打水。

e.en: The Amazon {selva} is home to countless undiscovered species.
e.zh: 亚马逊雨林栖息着无数未被发现的物种。

e.en: Heavy rains flooded the {selva} for weeks.
e.zh: 连日暴雨让这片雨林被淹了数周。

e.en: Online, people often present idealized versions of their {selves}.
e.zh: 在网上,人们常常展示理想化的自我。

e.en: The therapy helped them reconnect with their true {selves}.
e.zh: 那次治疗帮他们重新找回了真实的自我。

sem.t: n. 扫描电子显微镜（SEM 缩写）

e.en: The {SEMA} show in Las Vegas attracts car enthusiasts worldwide.
e.zh: 拉斯维加斯的 SEMA 车展吸引着全球车迷。

e.en: He works as a {SEMA}-certified automotive parts engineer.
e.zh: 他是一名 SEMA 认证的汽车零部件工程师。

e.en: Use proper {semantic} HTML tags for better accessibility.
e.zh: 使用语义化的 HTML 标签可以提升无障碍性。

e.en: Their argument was really just a {semantic} disagreement.
e.zh: 他们的争论其实只是字面意义上的分歧。

e.en: The two phrases differ {semantically} despite sharing some words.
e.zh: 这两句话虽然有些用词相同,但语义上不一样。

e.en: Mark up the page {semantically} so screen readers work well.
e.zh: 按语义标记页面,屏幕阅读器才能正常工作。

e.en: Don't get caught up in {semantics}; focus on the main idea.
e.zh: 别纠结字眼,关注核心观点就好。

e.en: Modern linguistics studies the {semantics} of natural language.
e.zh: 现代语言学研究自然语言的语义。

semaphore.t:
n. 信号量（编程）
n. 旗语

e.en: The mutex acts as a {semaphore} controlling thread access.
e.zh: 这个互斥锁起到信号量的作用,控制线程访问。

e.en: Sailors once communicated with {semaphore} flags between ships.
e.zh: 水手们曾用旗语在船只之间通信。

e.en: After the storm, life regained some {semblance} of normality.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,生活才稍微恢复了一点常态。

e.en: The deal had a {semblance} of fairness but wasn't.
e.zh: 这笔交易表面公平,实际并非如此。

e.en: The clinic stores donor {semen} in cryogenic tanks.
e.zh: 诊所将捐献的精液储存在低温罐中。

e.en: Researchers analyzed {semen} samples to assess male fertility.
e.zh: 研究人员分析精液样本以评估男性生育力。

e.en: She is taking five courses this {semester}.
e.zh: 她这学期选了五门课。

e.en: The fall {semester} starts in early September.
e.zh: 秋季学期九月初开学。

e.en: He spent two {semesters} studying abroad in Tokyo.
e.zh: 他在东京交换了两个学期。

e.en: The program is split into four {semesters} of coursework.
e.zh: 这个项目分为四个学期的课程。

semi.t:
adj. 半的；部分的
n. 半决赛；半挂卡车

e.en: Their team lost in the {semi} of the cup.
e.zh: 他们队在杯赛半决赛中输了。

e.en: A {semi} truck overturned on the highway this morning.
e.zh: 今早一辆半挂卡车在高速公路上翻了。

e.en: Brazil reached the World Cup {semi-final} after a tense match.
e.zh: 巴西在一场紧张的比赛后挺进世界杯半决赛。

e.en: She missed the {semi-final} due to a knee injury.
e.zh: 她因膝伤错过了半决赛。

e.en: Both teams advanced to the {semi-finals} after stunning wins.
e.zh: 两队都在惊人的胜利后晋级半决赛。

e.en: The {semi-finals} will be broadcast live on Saturday.
e.zh: 半决赛将于周六现场直播。

e.en: The bonds pay interest {semiannually} every June and December.
e.zh: 这些债券每年六月和十二月各付一次利息。

e.en: Employees receive performance reviews {semiannually}.
e.zh: 员工每半年接受一次绩效评估。

e.en: Beavers are {semiaquatic} mammals that build dams in rivers.
e.zh: 河狸是在河中筑坝的半水生哺乳动物。

e.en: Frogs lead a {semiaquatic} life on land and water.
e.zh: 青蛙过着水陆两栖的半水生生活。

e.en: This {semiarid} region rarely receives more than ten inches of rain.
e.zh: 这个半干旱地区年降雨很少超过十英寸。

e.en: Farmers in {semiarid} zones rely heavily on drip irrigation.
e.zh: 半干旱地区的农民非常依赖滴灌。

semiautomatic.t: adj. 半自动的（常指枪械）

e.en: The factory installed a {semiautomatic} packaging line last month.
e.zh: 工厂上个月安装了一条半自动包装线。

e.en: Police recovered a {semiautomatic} pistol at the scene.
e.zh: 警方在现场缴获了一把半自动手枪。

e.en: The students sat in a {semicircle} around their teacher.
e.zh: 学生们围着老师坐成半圆形。

e.en: Draw a {semicircle} above the line as a roof.
e.zh: 在线条上方画一个半圆作为屋顶。

e.en: The theater has a {semicircular} seating arrangement.
e.zh: 剧院的座位呈半圆形布置。

e.en: Damage to the {semicircular} canals can cause vertigo.
e.zh: 半规管受损可能导致眩晕。

semiclassical.t: adj. 半古典的（音乐/物理）

e.en: She enjoys {semiclassical} music from old Hindi films.
e.zh: 她喜欢老印度电影里的半古典音乐。

e.en: The composer blends jazz with {semiclassical} arrangements.
e.zh: 这位作曲家将爵士与半古典编曲融合在一起。

e.en: Forgetting a {semicolon} can break the entire JavaScript file.
e.zh: 漏掉一个分号可能让整个 JavaScript 文件出错。

e.en: Use a {semicolon} to join two closely related sentences.
e.zh: 用分号连接两个密切相关的句子。

e.en: Python avoids {semicolons} at the end of every line.
e.zh: Python 不要求每行末尾加分号。

e.en: Her essay overuses {semicolons} where commas would do.
e.zh: 她的文章在该用逗号的地方滥用了分号。

e.en: Taiwan dominates the global {semiconductor} manufacturing industry.
e.zh: 台湾主导着全球的半导体制造业。

e.en: A shortage of {semiconductor} chips delayed car production.
e.zh: 半导体芯片短缺导致汽车生产延期。

e.en: She advanced to the {semifinal} after winning three matches.
e.zh: 她连胜三场后晋级半决赛。

e.en: The {semifinal} game was decided in overtime.
e.zh: 半决赛在加时中分出胜负。

e.en: The dress code for the dinner is {semiformal}.
e.zh: 晚宴的着装要求是半正式。

e.en: He wore a blazer for the {semiformal} office party.
e.zh: 他穿了西装外套出席公司的半正式派对。

semiliterate.t: adj. 半文盲的；识字有限的

e.en: The program helps {semiliterate} adults improve their reading skills.
e.zh: 这个项目帮助半文盲成年人提升阅读能力。

e.en: His complaint email was rambling and almost {semiliterate}.
e.zh: 他的投诉邮件啰嗦得几乎像半文盲写的。

e.en: The {semimolten} rock flowed slowly down the volcano's slope.
e.zh: 半熔融的岩石顺着火山坡缓缓流下。

e.en: Engineers studied the {semimolten} metal as it cooled.
e.zh: 工程师们研究金属冷却过程中的半熔融状态。

seminal.t: adj. 开创性的；影响深远的

e.en: Her paper became a {seminal} work in machine learning.
e.zh: 她的论文成为机器学习领域的开创性著作。

e.en: The 1960s were a {seminal} decade for civil rights.
e.zh: 1960 年代是民权运动具有开创意义的十年。

sense.t:
n. 感觉；意义
v. 察觉到

e.en: Your plan makes a lot of {sense} to me.
e.zh: 你的计划在我看来很有道理。

e.en: Dogs have a much keener {sense} of smell than humans.
e.zh: 狗的嗅觉比人类灵敏得多。

sensed.t: v. 察觉到（sense 的过去式）

e.en: She {sensed} that something was wrong the moment he walked in.
e.zh: 他一进门她就感觉到出了什么事。

e.en: The robot {sensed} an obstacle and stopped immediately.
e.zh: 机器人感测到障碍物便立即停下。

senseless.t: adj. 无意义的；失去知觉的

e.en: The {senseless} violence shocked the entire neighborhood.
e.zh: 这种毫无意义的暴力震惊了整个街区。

e.en: Arguing about it now is completely {senseless}.
e.zh: 现在再争论这个完全没有意义。

senselessly.t: adv. 毫无意义地；愚蠢地

e.en: Many young soldiers died {senselessly} in that war.
e.zh: 许多年轻士兵在那场战争中毫无意义地牺牲。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {senselessly} scrolling his phone.
e.zh: 他整个下午都漫无目的地刷手机。

e.en: The {senselessness} of the attack left everyone speechless.
e.zh: 这次袭击毫无道理,让所有人无言以对。

e.en: She wrote about the {senselessness} of modern consumerism.
e.zh: 她写文章批评现代消费主义的荒谬。

senses.t:
n. 感官；理智
v. 察觉（第三人称单数）

e.en: The forest awakens all five {senses} at once.
e.zh: 森林一下子唤醒了人的五种感官。

e.en: Come to your {senses} and accept their offer.
e.zh: 清醒一下,接受他们的提议吧。

e.en: Her design has a clean, modern {sensibility}.
e.zh: 她的设计有种简洁现代的格调。

e.en: The film offends my moral {sensibility}.
e.zh: 这部电影冒犯了我的道德感受。

e.en: Wearing a helmet is the {sensible} thing to do.
e.zh: 戴头盔是明智的做法。

e.en: She gave me some very {sensible} career advice.
e.zh: 她给了我一些非常明智的职业建议。

e.en: He invested his savings {sensibly} in index funds.
e.zh: 他理智地把积蓄投入了指数基金。

e.en: Dress {sensibly} for the cold mountain weather.
e.zh: 针对山区的寒冷天气穿得明智一点。

sensing.t:
n. 传感；感测
v. 察觉（进行时）

e.en: {Sensing} her discomfort, he changed the subject.
e.zh: 察觉到她的不自在,他换了话题。

e.en: Modern phones use remote {sensing} to detect motion.
e.zh: 现代手机用远程传感来检测动作。

e.en: The campaign aims to {sensitise} the public to mental health issues.
e.zh: 该活动旨在让公众关注心理健康问题。

e.en: Repeated exposure can {sensitise} the skin to certain chemicals.
e.zh: 反复接触会使皮肤对某些化学物质过敏。

sensitised.t: adj. 已敏化的（英式拼写）

e.en: Years of training have {sensitised} him to subtle musical changes.
e.zh: 多年的训练让他对细微的音乐变化非常敏感。

e.en: Her skin became {sensitised} after using the new cream.
e.zh: 她用了那款新面霜后皮肤变得敏感了。

e.en: This is a {sensitive} topic, so please be careful.
e.zh: 这是个敏感话题,请小心一些。

e.en: My eyes are {sensitive} to bright sunlight.
e.zh: 我的眼睛对强烈的阳光很敏感。

e.en: The reporter handled the family's grief {sensitively}.
e.zh: 记者很体贴地处理了那家人的悲痛。

e.en: Teachers should respond {sensitively} to students' concerns.
e.zh: 老师应该体贴地回应学生的顾虑。

e.en: The diplomat was careful about cultural {sensitivities} during the talks.
e.zh: 外交官在会谈中很注意文化上的敏感问题。

e.en: Food {sensitivities} can cause bloating and fatigue in many adults.
e.zh: 食物敏感可能让许多成年人腹胀和疲劳。

e.en: You can adjust mouse {sensitivity} in the settings menu.
e.zh: 你可以在设置菜单里调整鼠标灵敏度。

e.en: He handled the topic with great {sensitivity} and care.
e.zh: 他非常体贴地处理了这个话题。

e.en: Repeated exposure can lead to {sensitization} of the immune system.
e.zh: 反复接触可能导致免疫系统出现致敏。

e.en: The campaign aimed at public {sensitization} about climate change.
e.zh: 该活动旨在提高公众对气候变化的敏感意识。

e.en: Workshops {sensitize} employees to issues of workplace bias.
e.zh: 研讨会让员工对职场偏见更加敏感。

e.en: Certain drugs can {sensitize} skin to sunlight quickly.
e.zh: 某些药物会让皮肤迅速对阳光变得敏感。

e.en: The training {sensitized} staff to subtle signs of burnout.
e.zh: 培训让员工对倦怠的细微迹象更加敏感。

e.en: Her skin became {sensitized} after using the new cream.
e.zh: 她用了新面霜后皮肤变得敏感。

e.en: The phone's proximity {sensor} dims the screen during calls.
e.zh: 手机的距离传感器会在通话时让屏幕变暗。

e.en: A motion {sensor} turns on the porch light automatically.
e.zh: 运动传感器会自动打开门廊的灯。

e.en: The exhibition offered a rich {sensorial} experience for visitors.
e.zh: 这场展览为参观者提供了丰富的感官体验。

e.en: Wine tasting involves complex {sensorial} judgments about flavor.
e.zh: 品酒涉及对风味复杂的感官判断。

sensorineural.t: adj. 感音神经性的（医学）

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her with mild {sensorineural} hearing loss.
e.zh: 医生诊断她为轻度感音神经性听力损失。

e.en: Loud concerts can cause permanent {sensorineural} damage over time.
e.zh: 长期听吵闹的演唱会可能造成永久性感音神经损伤。

sensorium.t: n. 感觉中枢；感觉系统

e.en: The patient's {sensorium} was clear and oriented to time.
e.zh: 病人的神志清醒,对时间也有定向力。

e.en: Virtual reality engages the entire human {sensorium} at once.
e.zh: 虚拟现实能同时调动人类全部的感官系统。

e.en: Babies learn through constant {sensory} exploration of their world.
e.zh: 婴儿通过不断的感官探索来认识世界。

e.en: The cafe creates a calm {sensory} environment for studying.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆营造出适合学习的宁静感官环境。

e.en: The novel features {sensual} descriptions of summer in Italy.
e.zh: 小说中有对意大利夏天充满感官气息的描写。

e.en: She enjoys the {sensual} pleasure of fresh silk sheets.
e.zh: 她喜欢崭新丝绸床单带来的感官享受。

sensualist.t: n. 沉溺感官享受的人

e.en: The chef is a true {sensualist} who savors every meal.
e.zh: 这位厨师是个真正的感官主义者,会细细品味每一餐。

e.en: As a {sensualist}, he chased beauty in every form.
e.zh: 作为一个感官主义者,他追逐各种形式的美。

sensuality.t: n. 性感；耽于感官享受

e.en: The painting captures the warm {sensuality} of a Mediterranean afternoon.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉到了地中海午后温暖的感官气息。

e.en: Her dance combined elegance with quiet {sensuality} on stage.
e.zh: 她的舞蹈在台上融合了优雅与含蓄的感性。

sensually.t: adv. 性感地；耽于感官地

e.en: She moved {sensually} across the dance floor to the music.
e.zh: 她伴着音乐在舞池里风情万种地舞动。

e.en: The poem describes the garden {sensually} and in vivid detail.
e.zh: 这首诗以丰富感官的笔触细腻描绘了花园。

sensuous.t: adj. 感官的；令人愉悦的

e.en: The fabric had a {sensuous} feel against her skin.
e.zh: 这种布料贴在她皮肤上,触感非常美妙。

e.en: The film is famous for its {sensuous} cinematography and color.
e.zh: 这部电影以其唯美的摄影和色彩著称。

sensuously.t: adv. 感官地；令人愉悦地

e.en: The chocolate melted {sensuously} on his tongue with each bite.
e.zh: 巧克力每咬一口都在他舌尖上美妙地融化。

e.en: She wrapped the scarf {sensuously} around her bare shoulders.
e.zh: 她将围巾柔美地绕在裸露的肩头。

e.en: The poem celebrates the {sensuousness} of ripe summer fruit.
e.zh: 这首诗赞美了夏日成熟水果带来的感官之美。

e.en: Critics praised the {sensuousness} of her oil paintings.
e.zh: 评论家盛赞她油画作品中浓郁的感官气息。

sent.t: v. 发送（send 的过去式）

e.en: I {sent} you the report just before lunch.
e.zh: 我在午饭前刚把报告发给你了。

e.en: The company {sent} flowers to every employee on Friday.
e.zh: 公司周五给每位员工都送了鲜花。

sentence.t:
n. 句子；判决
v. 判决

e.en: Try to write each {sentence} as clearly as possible.
e.zh: 尽量把每一句话写得清楚些。

e.en: The judge handed down a five-year prison {sentence}.
e.zh: 法官判处了五年监禁。

e.en: The judge {sentenced} him to five years in prison.
e.zh: 法官判处他五年监禁。

e.en: She was {sentenced} to community service for the minor offense.
e.zh: 她因轻微违法被判处社区服务。

e.en: The {sentencer} must consider both the crime and the offender's history.
e.zh: 判刑者必须同时考虑罪行和罪犯的过往记录。

e.en: Judges acting as a {sentencer} follow strict legal guidelines.
e.zh: 作为判刑者的法官需遵循严格的法律准则。

sentences.t:
n. 句子（复数）
v. 判决（第三人称单数）

e.en: Try to write shorter {sentences} for clearer communication.
e.zh: 尽量写较短的句子,以便沟通更清晰。

e.en: The court handed down harsh {sentences} for the convicted criminals.
e.zh: 法庭对被定罪的罪犯判处了严厉刑罚。

e.en: The {sentencing} hearing is scheduled for next Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 量刑听证会定于下周二上午举行。

e.en: New laws have changed the {sentencing} guidelines for drug offenses.
e.zh: 新法律改变了毒品犯罪的量刑准则。

e.en: The professor explained the {sentential} structure of the complex paragraph.
e.zh: 教授讲解了这段复杂段落的句子结构。

e.en: Logic students study {sentential} connectives like 'and' and 'or'.
e.zh: 逻辑学学生研究像“与”和“或”这样的句子连接词。

sententious.t: adj. 爱说教的；故作警句的

e.en: His {sententious} remarks at the meeting annoyed his colleagues.
e.zh: 他在会议上一本正经的说教让同事们感到厌烦。

e.en: The essay had a {sententious} tone that felt overly preachy.
e.zh: 这篇文章语气说教,显得过于训诫。

e.en: Scientists debate whether octopuses possess true {sentience}.
e.zh: 科学家们争论章鱼是否具有真正的感知能力。

e.en: Some philosophers question the {sentience} of advanced AI systems.
e.zh: 一些哲学家质疑先进人工智能系统是否具有感知力。

sentient.t: adj. 有知觉的；有意识的

e.en: Many people believe dolphins are highly {sentient} creatures.
e.zh: 许多人相信海豚是高度有感知能力的生物。

e.en: Science fiction often imagines {sentient} robots with human-like emotions.
e.zh: 科幻小说常想象具有类人情感的有感知能力的机器人。

e.en: Public {sentiment} has shifted against the new tax policy.
e.zh: 公众情绪已转为反对新的税收政策。

e.en: The app analyzes customer {sentiment} from product reviews online.
e.zh: 该应用分析在线产品评论中的客户情绪。

sentimental.t: adj. 伤感的；多愁善感的

e.en: This old photo album has great {sentimental} value to me.
e.zh: 这本旧相册对我有重要的情感价值。

e.en: She gets {sentimental} whenever that song plays on the radio.
e.zh: 每当收音机里播放那首歌,她都会变得多愁善感。

sentimentalise.t: v. 使感情化（英式拼写）

e.en: Movies often {sentimentalise} childhood memories beyond what really happened.
e.zh: 电影常常把童年回忆感伤化,超出实际情况。

e.en: Try not to {sentimentalise} the past when writing your memoir.
e.zh: 写回忆录时尽量不要把过去感伤化。

e.en: Critics accused the novel of excessive {sentimentalism} and weak plotting.
e.zh: 评论家指责这部小说过于感伤主义且情节薄弱。

e.en: Victorian poetry is often associated with romantic {sentimentalism}.
e.zh: 维多利亚诗歌常与浪漫的感伤主义联系在一起。

e.en: He's a hopeless {sentimentalist} who keeps every birthday card he receives.
e.zh: 他是个无可救药的多愁善感者,收到的每张生日卡都留着。

e.en: As a {sentimentalist}, she cried at every wedding she attended.
e.zh: 作为多愁善感的人,她参加的每场婚礼都会落泪。

e.en: The film was ruined by too much {sentimentality} in the ending.
e.zh: 这部电影因结尾过于煽情而被毁了。

e.en: He hated the {sentimentality} of greeting card slogans and clichés.
e.zh: 他讨厌贺卡标语和陈词滥调中的多愁善感。

sentimentalize.t: v. 使感情化；多愁善感地对待

e.en: Hollywood tends to {sentimentalize} stories about war and sacrifice.
e.zh: 好莱坞倾向于把关于战争与牺牲的故事感伤化。

e.en: Don't {sentimentalize} the old days; life was actually quite difficult.
e.zh: 别把旧时光理想化感伤化;生活其实相当艰难。

sentimentally.t: adv. 感伤地；多愁善感地

e.en: She spoke {sentimentally} about her grandmother's old farmhouse.
e.zh: 她深情伤感地谈起祖母那座老农舍。

e.en: He kept the ticket stub {sentimentally} for over twenty years.
e.zh: 他出于情感把那张票根珍藏了二十多年。

e.en: Many users shared similar {sentiments} in the comments section.
e.zh: 许多用户在评论区表达了相似的情感看法。

e.en: Her speech expressed the {sentiments} of the entire community.
e.zh: 她的演讲表达了整个社区的心声。

e.en: Please complete the forms {sequentially} from page one.
e.zh: 请从第一页开始按顺序填写表格。

e.en: The tasks must be done {sequentially}, not in parallel.
e.zh: 这些任务必须按顺序完成，不能并行。

e.en: Forests {sequester} large amounts of carbon from the atmosphere.
e.zh: 森林能从大气中吸收并储存大量的碳。

e.en: The judge will {sequester} the jury during the trial.
e.zh: 法官将在审判期间隔离陪审团。

sequestered.t:
adj. 隐蔽的；与世隔绝的
v. 被隔离（sequester 的过去式）

e.en: The jury was {sequestered} in a hotel for two weeks.
e.zh: 陪审团被隔离在酒店里长达两周。

e.en: She {sequestered} herself in the cabin to finish her novel.
e.zh: 她把自己关在小屋里以完成小说。

e.en: The court may {sequestrate} the assets of the bankrupt company.
e.zh: 法院可能会扣押这家破产公司的资产。

e.en: Authorities decided to {sequestrate} the disputed property pending review.
e.zh: 当局决定在审查期间扣押这处有争议的房产。

e.en: Carbon {sequestration} is essential for slowing climate change.
e.zh: 碳封存对减缓气候变化至关重要。

e.en: The {sequestration} of the witnesses kept media out completely.
e.zh: 对证人的隔离把媒体完全挡在了外面。

e.en: A single {sequin} fell from her dress onto the dance floor.
e.zh: 她裙子上的一片亮片掉到了舞池里。

e.en: She sewed a tiny {sequin} onto each corner of the costume.
e.zh: 她在戏服的每个角上缝了一片小亮片。

e.en: She wore a {sequined} dress that sparkled under the stage lights.
e.zh: 她穿着一条亮片裙，在舞台灯光下闪闪发光。

e.en: The dancers twirled in {sequined} costumes during the finale.
e.zh: 舞者们在压轴时身着亮片戏服旋转起舞。

sequinned.t: adj. 缀有亮片的（sequined 的变体）

e.en: Her {sequinned} jacket caught everyone's eye at the gala.
e.zh: 她那件亮片夹克在晚会上吸引了所有人的目光。

e.en: He bought a {sequinned} top for the costume party.
e.zh: 他买了一件亮片上衣去参加化装派对。

e.en: The giant {sequoia} towered over us like a living skyscraper.
e.zh: 这棵巨型红杉像一座活的摩天大楼般高耸入云。

e.en: We hiked through groves of ancient {sequoia} trees in California.
e.zh: 我们在加州古老的红杉林中徒步穿行。

e.en: The lab tested several {sera} for antibody responses.
e.zh: 实验室检测了几种血清的抗体反应。

e.en: Researchers stored the patient {sera} in a deep freezer.
e.zh: 研究人员将患者的血清存放在低温冷冻柜中。

seraglio.t: n. 后宫；土耳其苏丹的宫殿

e.en: The sultan kept his wives in a guarded {seraglio}.
e.zh: 苏丹把他的妻妾们安置在戒备森严的后宫里。

e.en: Tourists visited the old palace {seraglio} in Istanbul.
e.zh: 游客们参观了伊斯坦布尔那座古老宫殿的后宫。

serape.t: n. 墨西哥式彩色披肩

e.en: He wrapped a colorful {serape} around his shoulders against the cold.
e.zh: 他披上一条彩色的墨西哥披肩抵御寒意。

e.en: The market sold handwoven {serape} blankets in bright patterns.
e.zh: 市场上卖着图案鲜艳的手织墨西哥披肩。

e.en: The painting shows a glowing {seraph} hovering above the altar.
e.zh: 画中描绘了一位炽天使盘旋在祭坛上方。

e.en: Ancient texts describe the {seraph} as having six wings.
e.zh: 古籍描述炽天使长有六只翅膀。

e.en: The baby gave a {seraphic} smile as she fell asleep.
e.zh: 那女婴入睡时露出了天使般的微笑。

e.en: Her {seraphic} singing voice silenced the entire hall.
e.zh: 她那天使般的歌声让整个大厅安静下来。

serb.t:
n. 塞尔维亚人
adj. 塞尔维亚的

e.en: My neighbor is a {Serb} who moved here in 1995.
e.zh: 我的邻居是一位1995年搬来这里的塞尔维亚人。

e.en: The {Serb} tennis player won the championship again this year.
e.zh: 那位塞尔维亚网球选手今年又赢得了冠军。

e.en: {Serbia} is located in the Balkan region of Europe.
e.zh: 塞尔维亚位于欧洲巴尔干地区。

e.en: She traveled to {Serbia} last summer to visit relatives.
e.zh: 她去年夏天去塞尔维亚探望亲戚。

serbian.t:
adj. 塞尔维亚的
n. 塞尔维亚人；塞尔维亚语

e.en: He speaks fluent {Serbian} and English at work.
e.zh: 他在工作中能流利使用塞尔维亚语和英语。

e.en: The restaurant serves traditional {Serbian} grilled meat dishes.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应传统的塞尔维亚烤肉菜肴。

e.en: Many {Serbs} celebrate their Orthodox Christmas in January.
e.zh: 许多塞尔维亚人在一月庆祝东正教圣诞节。

e.en: The {Serbs} have a rich tradition of folk music.
e.zh: 塞尔维亚人有着丰富的民间音乐传统。

e.en: The hills turned {sere} and brown after the long drought.
e.zh: 长期干旱后,山丘变得干枯枯黄。

e.en: Autumn leaves grew {sere} before falling from the branches.
e.zh: 秋叶在从枝头飘落前变得干枯。

serenade.t:
n. 小夜曲
v. 对…唱小夜曲

e.en: He played a soft {serenade} on his guitar at midnight.
e.zh: 他在午夜用吉他弹奏了一首柔和的小夜曲。

e.en: Street musicians often {serenade} couples dining outside the cafe.
e.zh: 街头音乐家常为在咖啡馆外用餐的情侣弹唱。

serendipitous.t: adj. 意外惊喜的；机缘凑巧的

e.en: Their {serendipitous} meeting at the airport changed both their lives.
e.zh: 他们在机场的偶然相遇改变了两人的人生。

e.en: Finding that old letter was a truly {serendipitous} discovery.
e.zh: 发现那封旧信真是一次意外的惊喜。

serendipity.t: n. 意外发现美好事物的运气

e.en: By pure {serendipity}, she found her dream job online.
e.zh: 全凭意外的好运,她在网上找到了梦想的工作。

e.en: Many great inventions happened through {serendipity} rather than careful planning.
e.zh: 许多伟大的发明源于偶然机缘而非精心策划。

e.en: The lake looked {serene} in the early morning light.
e.zh: 清晨的阳光下,湖面显得宁静祥和。

e.en: She remained {serene} despite the chaos around her.
e.zh: 尽管周围一片混乱,她仍保持平静。

e.en: The cat slept {serenely} on the sunny windowsill.
e.zh: 猫咪在阳光照射的窗台上安详地睡着。

e.en: She smiled {serenely} as the audience applauded her speech.
e.zh: 听众为她的演讲鼓掌时,她安详地微笑着。

serengeti.t: n. 塞伦盖蒂（东非大草原）

e.en: The {Serengeti} is famous for its annual wildebeest migration.
e.zh: 塞伦盖蒂以一年一度的角马大迁徙而闻名。

e.en: We watched lions hunt across the {Serengeti} plains at dawn.
e.zh: 我们在黎明时分观看狮子在塞伦盖蒂平原上狩猎。

e.en: Meditation brings a sense of {serenity} to my busy days.
e.zh: 冥想为我忙碌的日子带来一份宁静。

e.en: The garden was a place of true {serenity} and beauty.
e.zh: 那座花园是真正宁静与美丽的所在。

e.en: In medieval Europe, a {serf} worked the lord's land.
e.zh: 在中世纪的欧洲,农奴为领主耕种土地。

e.en: The novel describes the harsh life of a Russian {serf}.
e.zh: 这部小说描述了俄国农奴的艰苦生活。

e.en: Russia officially abolished {serfdom} in 1861 under Tsar Alexander II.
e.zh: 俄国于1861年在亚历山大二世统治下正式废除农奴制。

e.en: Many peasants escaped {serfdom} by fleeing to free cities.
e.zh: 许多农民通过逃往自由城市来摆脱农奴制。

serge.t: n. 哔叽（一种斜纹布料）

e.en: His suit was made of dark blue {serge} wool.
e.zh: 他的西装由深蓝色的哔叽羊毛料制成。

e.en: School uniforms were once commonly tailored from sturdy {serge}.
e.zh: 校服过去常用结实的哔叽呢料裁制。

e.en: The {sergeant} ordered the recruits to start their morning drill.
e.zh: 中士命令新兵开始晨练操练。

e.en: She was promoted to police {sergeant} after ten years of service.
e.zh: 服役十年后,她被晋升为警察中士。

serial.t:
adj. 连续的；连载的
n. 连续剧；连载作品

e.en: Please enter the {serial} number printed on the back.
e.zh: 请输入背面印的序列号。

e.en: The streaming app released the new {serial} drama last Friday.
e.zh: 流媒体应用上周五发布了新的连续剧。

serialisation.t: n. 序列化；连载（英式拼写）

e.en: JSON {serialisation} converts objects into a string for storage.
e.zh: JSON序列化将对象转换为字符串以便存储。

e.en: The novel's {serialisation} appeared weekly in the magazine.
e.zh: 这部小说每周在杂志上连载发表。

serialise.t: v. 序列化；连载（英式拼写）

e.en: You need to {serialise} the data before sending it over the network.
e.zh: 你需要先序列化数据再通过网络发送。

e.en: The publisher decided to {serialise} the new thriller in monthly issues.
e.zh: 出版商决定将新惊悚小说按月连载发表。

serialism.t: n. 序列主义（音乐流派）

e.en: Schoenberg developed {serialism} as a new approach to musical composition.
e.zh: 勋伯格发展出序列主义作为一种新的作曲手法。

e.en: Twentieth-century {serialism} challenged traditional ideas about melody and harmony.
e.zh: 二十世纪的序列主义挑战了关于旋律与和声的传统观念。

serialization.t: n. 序列化（数据转换为可存储格式）

e.en: JSON {serialization} is widely used for web API responses.
e.zh: JSON 序列化被广泛用于网页 API 的响应。

e.en: The novel's magazine {serialization} ran for nearly two years.
e.zh: 这部小说在杂志上连载了将近两年。

e.en: You need to {serialize} the object before sending it over.
e.zh: 在发送之前你需要把这个对象序列化。

e.en: The publisher decided to {serialize} the story across six issues.
e.zh: 出版社决定把这个故事分六期连载。

serialized.t:
adj. 已序列化的
v. serialize 的过去式

e.en: The data is {serialized} as JSON before being saved.
e.zh: 数据在保存前被序列化成 JSON 格式。

e.en: His novel was first {serialized} in a weekly newspaper.
e.zh: 他的小说最初是在一份周报上连载的。

e.en: The tasks must be processed {serially}, not in parallel.
e.zh: 这些任务必须按顺序处理,不能并行。

e.en: The chapters were published {serially} over several months.
e.zh: 这些章节在数月间陆续连载发表。

serie.t: n. 系列（多为外语拼写，英语罕用）

e.en: The Italian {serie} A football league starts in August.
e.zh: 意大利甲级足球联赛在八月开赛。

e.en: Each {serie} of tests must pass before deployment.
e.zh: 每一系列测试都必须通过才能部署。

e.en: Netflix released the new {series} early this morning.
e.zh: Netflix 今天一早就上线了这部新剧集。

e.en: A {series} of small earthquakes shook the coastal town.
e.zh: 一连串小地震摇晃了这座沿海小镇。

serif.t: n. 衬线（字体笔画末端装饰）

e.en: Times New Roman is a classic {serif} font for documents.
e.zh: Times New Roman 是经典的文档衬线字体。

e.en: Designers often pair a {serif} headline with sans-serif body text.
e.zh: 设计师常常把衬线大标题和无衬线正文搭配使用。

serine.t: n. 丝氨酸（一种氨基酸）

e.en: {Serine} is a common amino acid found in many proteins.
e.zh: 丝氨酸是许多蛋白质中常见的一种氨基酸。

e.en: The enzyme uses a {serine} residue at its active site.
e.zh: 该酶在其活性位点使用了一个丝氨酸残基。

serious.t: adj. 严肃的；严重的；认真的

e.en: Are you {serious} about quitting your job next month?
e.zh: 你下个月真的打算辞职吗?

e.en: The accident caused {serious} damage to the bridge.
e.zh: 这次事故对桥梁造成了严重损坏。

seriously.t: adv. 认真地；严重地；说真的

e.en: You need to take this deadline {seriously} from now on.
e.zh: 从现在起你得认真对待这个截止日期。

e.en: {Seriously}, that movie was the best I've seen this year.
e.zh: 说真的,那部电影是我今年看过最棒的。

e.en: The doctor explained the {seriousness} of the diagnosis honestly.
e.zh: 医生坦诚地说明了诊断的严重程度。

e.en: She approaches every project with the same calm {seriousness}.
e.zh: 她对每个项目都怀着同样冷静认真的态度。

serjeant.t: n. 高级律师（旧称，等同 sergeant）

e.en: The {serjeant} at arms led the procession into the chamber.
e.zh: 纠仪官率领队伍走入议事厅。

e.en: A {serjeant} of the royal household carried the ceremonial mace.
e.zh: 皇家侍从中的一名典礼官手持仪仗权杖。

seminar.t: n. 研讨会；专题讨论课

e.en: I'm attending a {seminar} on climate policy this Friday.
e.zh: 我这周五要参加一场气候政策研讨会。

e.en: The professor leads a weekly {seminar} for graduate students.
e.zh: 这位教授每周为研究生主持一次研讨课。

e.en: The young {seminarian} studied theology for seven years.
e.zh: 这位年轻的神学院学生学了七年神学。

e.en: Each {seminarian} is assigned a mentor priest.
e.zh: 每位神学院学生都会被分配一位指导神父。

e.en: The conference offers free {seminars} on AI safety.
e.zh: 会议提供免费的人工智能安全研讨会。

e.en: Online {seminars} have replaced many in-person workshops.
e.zh: 线上研讨会已经取代了许多线下工作坊。

e.en: He spent four years at a Catholic {seminary} in Rome.
e.zh: 他在罗马的一所天主教神学院度过了四年。

e.en: The {seminary} trains future ministers and missionaries.
e.zh: 这所神学院培养未来的牧师和传教士。

e.en: Activists worked to {seminate} new ideas about sustainability.
e.zh: 活动人士致力于传播关于可持续发展的新理念。

e.en: The teacher used stories to {seminate} moral values.
e.zh: 老师用故事来传播道德观念。

e.en: She wrote a {semiological} analysis of fashion advertisements.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于时尚广告的符号学分析。

e.en: The film invites a {semiological} reading of its symbols.
e.zh: 这部电影适合从符号学角度解读其象征。

e.en: Roland Barthes is a key figure in modern {semiology}.
e.zh: 罗兰·巴特是现代符号学的关键人物。

e.en: She studies the {semiology} of street art and graffiti.
e.zh: 她研究街头艺术和涂鸦的符号学。

e.en: Brand logos carry strong {semiotic} meaning for consumers.
e.zh: 品牌标志对消费者具有强烈的符号学意义。

e.en: The course explores {semiotic} theory through film analysis.
e.zh: 这门课通过电影分析探讨符号学理论。

e.en: The {semiotician} explained how emojis function as modern signs.
e.zh: 这位符号学家解释了表情符号如何作为现代符号发挥作用。

e.en: Umberto Eco was both a novelist and a {semiotician}.
e.zh: 翁贝托·埃科既是小说家又是符号学家。

e.en: {Semiotics} examines how images, words, and gestures create meaning.
e.zh: 符号学研究图像、文字和动作如何产生意义。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on the {semiotics} of memes.
e.zh: 她的论文写的是网络梗的符号学。

semipermeable.t: adj. 半渗透的；半透性的

e.en: The cell membrane is {semipermeable}, allowing only certain molecules through.
e.zh: 细胞膜是半透性的，只让某些分子通过。

e.en: Engineers built a {semipermeable} barrier to filter the saltwater.
e.zh: 工程师建造了一道半透性屏障来过滤海水。

e.en: She collects rings made with {semiprecious} stones like amethyst.
e.zh: 她收集用紫水晶等半宝石制成的戒指。

e.en: The shop sells {semiprecious} gems at affordable prices.
e.zh: 这家店以实惠的价格出售半宝石。

semitic.t: adj. 闪米特的；闪族人的

e.en: Hebrew and Arabic both belong to the {Semitic} language family.
e.zh: 希伯来语和阿拉伯语都属于闪米特语系。

e.en: The professor studies ancient {Semitic} cultures of the Near East.
e.zh: 这位教授研究近东的古代闪米特文化。

e.en: Move the note up one {semitone} to match the key.
e.zh: 把这个音升高半音以匹配调性。

e.en: The melody shifts by a {semitone} in the second verse.
e.zh: 旋律在第二段中升高了半音。

e.en: Florida has a {semitropical} climate with mild winters.
e.zh: 佛罗里达气候属亚热带，冬天温和。

e.en: The garden grows {semitropical} fruits like mango and guava.
e.zh: 花园里种着芒果和番石榴等亚热带水果。

e.en: Traditional pasta is made from {semolina} flour and water.
e.zh: 传统意大利面是用粗粒小麦粉和水做的。

e.en: She cooked a sweet {semolina} pudding for dessert.
e.zh: 她做了一道香甜的粗麦布丁当甜点。

e.en: Police found traces of {Semtex} hidden in the abandoned warehouse.
e.zh: 警方在废弃仓库里发现了塞姆汀炸药的痕迹。

e.en: {Semtex} is a plastic explosive often used in mining.
e.zh: 塞姆汀是一种常用于采矿的塑性炸药。

sen.t: n. 分（日元等货币辅币单位）

e.en: The {Senate} voted to approve the new climate bill.
e.zh: 参议院投票通过了新的气候法案。

e.en: She hopes to run for the {Senate} next year.
e.zh: 她希望明年竞选参议员席位。

e.en: The {senator} gave a passionate speech about healthcare reform.
e.zh: 那位参议员就医疗改革发表了激昂的演讲。

e.en: A junior {senator} introduced the controversial new bill.
e.zh: 一位资历较浅的参议员提出了这项有争议的新法案。

senatorial.t: adj. 参议员的；参议院的

e.en: He has the calm, {senatorial} manner of an experienced statesman.
e.zh: 他举止从容稳重，颇有资深政治家的风范。

e.en: The {senatorial} race attracted millions in campaign donations.
e.zh: 这场参议员竞选吸引了数百万美元的捐款。

e.en: Several {senators} crossed party lines to support the bill.
e.zh: 多位参议员跨越党派界限支持该法案。

e.en: The {senators} debated the budget late into the night.
e.zh: 参议员们就预算问题辩论到深夜。

e.en: Please {send} me the report by Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 请在周五下午前把报告发给我。

e.en: I'll {send} a quick message before the meeting starts.
e.zh: 会议开始前我会快速发条消息。

e.en: The email had no subject and an unknown {sender}.
e.zh: 这封邮件没有主题，发件人也不明。

e.en: Always verify the {sender} before clicking suspicious links.
e.zh: 点击可疑链接前一定要核实发件人。

sending.t:
v. 发送中
n. 发送

e.en: She is {sending} flowers to her mother for her birthday.
e.zh: 她正在给妈妈寄生日花束。

e.en: Stop {sending} me notifications late at night.
e.zh: 别再深夜给我发通知了。

sends.t: v. 发送（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {sends} a daily reminder at eight in the morning.
e.zh: 这个应用每天早上八点发送提醒。

e.en: He {sends} his kids to school by bike every day.
e.zh: 他每天骑车送孩子上学。

seneca.t: n. 塞内卡（古罗马哲学家）；塞内卡族

e.en: The {Seneca} people lived in what is now western New York.
e.zh: 塞内卡族曾居住在今天的纽约州西部。

e.en: {Seneca} wrote influential letters on Stoic philosophy.
e.zh: 塞涅卡撰写了影响深远的斯多葛派哲学书信。

e.en: {Senegal} is famous for its vibrant music and rich culture.
e.zh: 塞内加尔以充满活力的音乐和丰富的文化闻名。

e.en: We flew to {Senegal} to visit the historic Gorée Island.
e.zh: 我们飞往塞内加尔参观历史悠久的戈雷岛。

senegalese.t:
adj. 塞内加尔的
n. 塞内加尔人

e.en: The chef prepared a delicious {Senegalese} fish stew.
e.zh: 厨师做了一道美味的塞内加尔鱼炖菜。

e.en: My neighbor is a {Senegalese} student studying engineering.
e.zh: 我邻居是一名学工程的塞内加尔学生。

e.en: Scientists study {senescence} to understand why cells age.
e.zh: 科学家研究衰老以理解细胞为何老化。

e.en: The leaves turn yellow as the plant enters {senescence}.
e.zh: 植物进入衰老期时叶子会变黄。

e.en: The {seneschal} managed the lord's estate with strict authority.
e.zh: 总管以严格的权威管理着领主的庄园。

e.en: In medieval times, the {seneschal} oversaw all household affairs.
e.zh: 中世纪时，总管负责处理一切家务事宜。

e.en: Mountain folk still hunt wild {seng} root in the Appalachians.
e.zh: 阿巴拉契亚山民至今仍在挖野生人参根。

e.en: He sold dried {seng} to traders for a good price.
e.zh: 他把晒干的人参卖给商人，价钱不错。

e.en: Her grandfather became {senile} in his late eighties.
e.zh: 她的祖父快九十岁时变得有些老糊涂了。

e.en: Don't call him {senile} just because he forgot once.
e.zh: 别因为他忘了一次就说他老糊涂。

e.en: The old man's {senility} made conversation difficult.
e.zh: 老人的痴呆症让交谈变得困难。

e.en: Doctors distinguish dementia from ordinary {senility}.
e.zh: 医生会区分痴呆和普通的老年衰退。

senior.t:
adj. 年长的；资深的
n. 前辈；高年级生

e.en: She was promoted to {senior} engineer last month.
e.zh: 她上个月被提升为高级工程师。

e.en: My {senior} year of college was the busiest.
e.zh: 我大学最后一年最忙。

e.en: Promotions here are based on merit, not just {seniority}.
e.zh: 这里的晋升看能力,不只是看资历。

e.en: He has the {seniority} to choose his own projects.
e.zh: 他资历足够,可以自己挑项目做。

seniors.t: n. 长者；高年级生（复数）

e.en: The cafe offers a discount for {seniors} on Mondays.
e.zh: 这家咖啡店周一为老年人提供折扣。

e.en: Graduating {seniors} gathered for one last photo.
e.zh: 即将毕业的高年级生聚在一起拍最后一张合影。

e.en: She drinks {senna} tea to relieve constipation.
e.zh: 她喝番泻叶茶来缓解便秘。

e.en: The pharmacy sells {senna} as a natural laxative.
e.zh: 药店把番泻叶作为天然泻药出售。

senor.t: n. 先生（西班牙语称谓）

e.en: "Good morning, {senor}," the waiter said politely.
e.zh: “早上好,先生,”服务员礼貌地说。

e.en: The hotel manager greeted each {senor} at the door.
e.zh: 酒店经理在门口迎接每一位先生。

sensate.t: adj. 有感觉的；可感知的

e.en: The novel describes a vivid, {sensate} world of taste and touch.
e.zh: 这本小说描绘了一个充满味觉和触觉的感官世界。

e.en: Buddhism warns against attachment to {sensate} pleasures.
e.zh: 佛教告诫人们不要执着于感官享乐。

sensation.t: n. 感觉；轰动；轰动一时的事件

e.en: Her debut album was an overnight {sensation}.
e.zh: 她的首张专辑一夜之间引起了轰动。

e.en: I felt a tingling {sensation} in my fingers.
e.zh: 我感到手指有一阵刺痛感。

e.en: The team made a {sensational} comeback in the final minute.
e.zh: 球队在最后一分钟完成了惊人的逆转。

e.en: Tabloids love {sensational} headlines that exaggerate the truth.
e.zh: 小报喜欢用夸大事实的耸动标题。

sensationalism.t: n. 哗众取宠；耸人听闻

e.en: News {sensationalism} drowns out serious reporting.
e.zh: 新闻的耸人听闻盖过了严肃报道。

e.en: He criticized the channel's reliance on {sensationalism}.
e.zh: 他批评该频道一味依赖煽情报道。

sensationalist.t:
n. 追求轰动效应者
adj. 哗众取宠的

e.en: The blog took a {sensationalist} approach to every story.
e.zh: 那个博客对每条新闻都采取耸人听闻的处理方式。

e.en: Avoid {sensationalist} sources when researching health topics.
e.zh: 研究健康话题时要避开哗众取宠的信息来源。

sensationalistic.t: adj. 煽情的；哗众取宠的

e.en: The documentary felt cheap and {sensationalistic}.
e.zh: 这部纪录片显得廉价又煽情。

e.en: Readers are tired of {sensationalistic} clickbait headlines.
e.zh: 读者已经厌倦了煽情的标题党。

sensationalize.t: v. 大肆渲染；耸人听闻地报道

e.en: Reporters often {sensationalize} celebrity divorces.
e.zh: 记者常常对名人离婚事件进行炒作。

e.en: Please don't {sensationalize} the accident in your article.
e.zh: 请不要在文章里把这场事故写得太耸动。

sensationalized.t:
v. 渲染（过去式）
adj. 被夸大的

e.en: The media {sensationalized} the minor scandal for weeks.
e.zh: 媒体把这个小丑闻炒作了好几个星期。

e.en: Critics said the film {sensationalized} a real tragedy.
e.zh: 评论家说这部电影把真实悲剧拍得过于煽情。

e.en: She performed {sensationally} at her first concert.
e.zh: 她在自己的首场音乐会上表现得极为出色。

e.en: The newspaper {sensationally} reported the politician's affair.
e.zh: 该报纸耸人听闻地报道了政客的婚外情。

e.en: Spicy food triggers strong {sensations} on the tongue.
e.zh: 辛辣食物会在舌头上引起强烈的感觉。

e.en: The young singers became internet {sensations} overnight.
e.zh: 那些年轻歌手一夜之间成了网红。

sermon.t:
n. 布道；说教
v. 说教

e.en: The pastor's Sunday {sermon} focused on forgiveness and patience.
e.zh: 牧师周日的讲道主要谈宽恕与耐心。

e.en: Stop giving me a {sermon} about cleaning my room.
e.zh: 别再为整理房间的事跟我说教了。

e.en: My uncle loves to {sermonize} about hard work at dinner.
e.zh: 我叔叔喜欢在饭桌上大谈勤奋的道理。

e.en: The columnist tends to {sermonize} rather than report the facts.
e.zh: 这位专栏作家更爱说教,而不是报道事实。

seroconversion.t: n. 血清转化（抗体出现）

e.en: {Seroconversion} typically occurs a few weeks after the initial infection.
e.zh: 血清转化通常在初次感染后的几周内发生。

e.en: Doctors track {seroconversion} to confirm the vaccine produced antibodies.
e.zh: 医生通过追踪血清转化来确认疫苗产生了抗体。

e.en: A {serologic} test can detect past exposure to the virus.
e.zh: 血清学检测可以查出过往是否感染过该病毒。

e.en: The clinic offers {serologic} screening for several common infections.
e.zh: 诊所提供针对多种常见感染的血清学筛查。

e.en: {Serological} surveys helped estimate how widely the virus had spread.
e.zh: 血清学调查帮助估算病毒传播的广泛程度。

e.en: The lab confirmed the diagnosis using a {serological} method.
e.zh: 实验室用血清学方法确认了诊断结果。

e.en: {Serology} studies antibodies to reveal a patient's infection history.
e.zh: 血清学通过抗体来揭示病人的感染史。

e.en: The hospital's {serology} lab runs hundreds of blood tests daily.
e.zh: 医院的血清学实验室每天进行数百次血液检测。

e.en: All household contacts tested {seronegative} for the virus this week.
e.zh: 本周所有同住者的病毒检测都呈血清阴性。

e.en: Patients who remain {seronegative} may need a booster vaccine dose.
e.zh: 血清阴性的病人可能需要打加强针。

e.en: About ten percent of the village tested {seropositive} for dengue.
e.zh: 村里大约有百分之十的人登革热血清呈阳性。

e.en: He was found {seropositive} during a routine health screening.
e.zh: 他在常规体检中被查出血清呈阳性。

e.en: Many antidepressants act on {serotonergic} pathways in the brain.
e.zh: 许多抗抑郁药作用于大脑的血清素能通路。

e.en: Researchers study how {serotonergic} neurons influence mood and sleep.
e.zh: 研究人员研究血清素能神经元如何影响情绪与睡眠。

e.en: Exercise can boost {serotonin} levels and improve your mood.
e.zh: 运动可以提高血清素水平,改善心情。

e.en: Low {serotonin} has been linked to depression in some studies.
e.zh: 在一些研究中,血清素偏低与抑郁有关。

e.en: There are four distinct {serotype} variants of the dengue virus.
e.zh: 登革病毒有四种不同的血清型。

e.en: Scientists identified a new {serotype} circulating in the region.
e.zh: 科学家在该地区发现了一种新的血清型。

e.en: The wound produced a clear {serous} fluid as it healed.
e.zh: 伤口在愈合时渗出清亮的浆液。

e.en: The lungs are surrounded by a thin {serous} membrane.
e.zh: 肺部外面包裹着一层薄薄的浆膜。

e.en: A long green {serpent} slithered across the jungle path.
e.zh: 一条长长的绿蛇从丛林小路上滑过。

e.en: The myth describes a giant sea {serpent} guarding the island.
e.zh: 神话描述了一条守护着小岛的巨大海蛇。

e.en: The {serpentine} road wound slowly up the mountainside.
e.zh: 那条蜿蜒的小路缓缓盘上山腰。

e.en: The river follows a {serpentine} path through the valley.
e.zh: 这条河在山谷中蜿蜒流淌。

serps.t: n. 搜索结果页（SERP 复数）

e.en: Our blog post jumped into the top {serps} this month.
e.zh: 我们的博客文章这个月冲进了搜索结果的前几名。

e.en: SEO experts study how Google {serps} rank different pages.
e.zh: SEO 专家研究谷歌搜索结果页面如何对不同页面排名。

serra.t: n. 锯齿状山脊（地理术语）

e.en: We hiked through the {serra} on a cool spring morning.
e.zh: 我们在一个凉爽的春日清晨穿越了山脉。

e.en: Coffee farms cover the green slopes of the {serra}.
e.zh: 咖啡农场遍布于这片山脉的青翠山坡上。

e.en: Add a chopped {serrano} pepper for extra heat in salsa.
e.zh: 在莎莎酱里加一根切碎的塞拉诺辣椒会更辣。

e.en: Spanish {serrano} ham pairs beautifully with melon and bread.
e.zh: 西班牙塞拉诺火腿配甜瓜和面包非常美味。

e.en: The leaves of this plant {serrate} along their edges.
e.zh: 这种植物的叶子边缘呈锯齿状。

e.en: Manufacturers {serrate} the blade for cleaner cuts through bread.
e.zh: 厂家把刀刃做成锯齿状,以便更利落地切面包。

serrated.t: adj. 锯齿状的；带锯齿的

e.en: A {serrated} knife works much better for slicing tomatoes.
e.zh: 用锯齿刀切番茄要好用得多。

e.en: The leaves had finely {serrated} edges and a glossy surface.
e.zh: 叶子边缘呈细密的锯齿状,表面光亮。

e.en: The {serried} ranks of soldiers stood motionless on the field.
e.zh: 密集排列的士兵在战场上一动不动地站着。

e.en: Rows of {serried} bookshelves filled the old library.
e.zh: 一排排紧挨着的书架填满了那座旧图书馆。

e.en: The doctor sent a blood {serum} sample to the lab.
e.zh: 医生把一份血清样本送到了实验室。

e.en: She applied a vitamin C {serum} to her face every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上往脸上涂维生素C精华液。

e.en: The old mansion still employed a loyal {servant}.
e.zh: 那座老宅仍雇着一位忠诚的仆人。

e.en: A good leader is a {servant} of the people.
e.zh: 一位好领导是人民的公仆。

e.en: The wealthy family hired several {servants} to run the household.
e.zh: 那个富裕家庭雇了几名仆人来打理家务。

e.en: Public officials should remember they are {servants} of the people.
e.zh: 公职人员应记住自己是人民的公仆。

serve.t:
v. 服务；提供
n. 发球

e.en: This restaurant doesn't {serve} breakfast on Sundays.
e.zh: 这家餐厅周日不供应早餐。

e.en: He chose to {serve} his country in the navy.
e.zh: 他选择在海军中为国效力。

served.t: v. serve 的过去式；已提供

e.en: The waiter {served} us a delicious three-course meal.
e.zh: 服务员给我们上了一顿美味的三道菜大餐。

e.en: She {served} as mayor for two terms.
e.zh: 她担任了两届市长。

e.en: The website crashed because the {server} was overloaded.
e.zh: 网站崩溃了,因为服务器负载过重。

e.en: Our {server} brought the wine before the appetizers arrived.
e.zh: 服务员在开胃菜上桌之前就把酒送来了。

e.en: The company migrated all its {servers} to the cloud.
e.zh: 公司把所有服务器都迁移到了云端。

e.en: The restaurant's {servers} were friendly and attentive.
e.zh: 餐厅的服务员既友好又细心。

serves.t: v. serve 的第三人称单数

e.en: This recipe {serves} four people comfortably.
e.zh: 这份食谱可供四人享用。

e.en: The old shed now {serves} as a workshop.
e.zh: 那间旧棚屋现在用作工作间。

service.t:
n. 服务；维修
v. 维护

e.en: The customer {service} team responded within minutes.
e.zh: 客服团队在几分钟内就回复了。

e.en: My car needs a {service} before the long road trip.
e.zh: 长途自驾之前我的车需要保养一下。

e.en: Engineers tested the engine's {serviceability} after years of use.
e.zh: 工程师在使用多年后测试了这台发动机的可用性。

e.en: The report rated the equipment's {serviceability} as excellent.
e.zh: 报告将该设备的可维修性评为优秀。

e.en: The old bike is still {serviceable} after twenty years.
e.zh: 那辆旧自行车用了二十年仍然能用。

e.en: She wore a plain but {serviceable} pair of boots.
e.zh: 她穿着一双朴素但实用的靴子。

e.en: I had my car {serviced} at the dealership last week.
e.zh: 我上周在4S店给车做了保养。

e.en: The bank {serviced} thousands of small business loans.
e.zh: 这家银行为成千上万笔小企业贷款提供了服务。

e.en: The {serviceman} arrived to repair our broken washing machine.
e.zh: 维修工来修理我们坏掉的洗衣机。

e.en: Her father was a decorated {serviceman} during the war.
e.zh: 她的父亲是战时一位获过勋章的军人。

e.en: The mortgage {servicer} sent us a payment reminder.
e.zh: 贷款服务机构给我们寄来了还款提醒。

e.en: Choose a loan {servicer} with a good customer support record.
e.zh: 选择一家客服口碑良好的贷款服务机构。

e.en: The hotel offers a wide range of {services} for guests.
e.zh: 这家酒店为客人提供各种各样的服务。

e.en: Many streaming {services} now produce their own original shows.
e.zh: 许多流媒体平台如今都制作自己的原创剧集。

e.en: The {servicewoman} returned home after a year-long deployment.
e.zh: 这位女军人在为期一年的部署后回到了家。

e.en: Every {servicewoman} at the ceremony wore her dress uniform.
e.zh: 典礼上每位女军人都穿着礼服军装。

servicing.t:
n. 维护；保养
v. 服务中

e.en: Regular {servicing} keeps the air conditioner running efficiently.
e.zh: 定期保养能让空调保持高效运转。

e.en: The bank is {servicing} loans for thousands of small businesses.
e.zh: 这家银行正在为数千家小企业提供贷款服务。

e.en: She folded a paper {serviette} beside each plate.
e.zh: 她在每个盘子旁折好一张纸餐巾。

e.en: Could you pass me a {serviette}, please?
e.zh: 请递给我一张餐巾纸好吗?

e.en: His {servile} smile annoyed everyone in the meeting.
e.zh: 他那卑躬屈膝的笑容让会议上的每个人都厌烦。

e.en: The reporter refused to take a {servile} tone with the minister.
e.zh: 那位记者拒绝对部长采取奴颜婢膝的语气。

e.en: His constant {servility} toward the boss embarrassed his coworkers.
e.zh: 他对老板一贯的卑躬屈膝让同事们感到难堪。

e.en: The novel criticizes the {servility} of court officials.
e.zh: 这部小说批判了朝廷官员的奴性。

serving.t:
n. 一份（食物）
v. 正在服务

e.en: One {serving} of pasta has about 200 calories.
e.zh: 一份意面大约含有两百卡路里。

e.en: She has been {serving} as mayor for six years.
e.zh: 她已经担任市长六年了。

e.en: The medieval lord traveled with a loyal {servitor} at his side.
e.zh: 中世纪的领主身边总跟着一位忠心的侍从。

e.en: He was depicted as a humble {servitor} of the king.
e.zh: 他被描绘成国王谦卑的仆从。

e.en: The treaty officially ended decades of {servitude}.
e.zh: 该条约正式终结了数十年的奴役制度。

e.en: Many felt their long commute was a kind of daily {servitude}.
e.zh: 许多人觉得漫长的通勤就像每日的苦役。

servo.t: n. 伺服系统；伺服电机

e.en: The robot arm uses a tiny {servo} to grip objects.
e.zh: 机械臂用一个小型伺服电机来抓取物体。

e.en: He replaced the broken {servo} in his RC car.
e.zh: 他更换了遥控车里坏掉的伺服器。

e.en: Each joint of the robot is driven by a precise {servomotor}.
e.zh: 机器人的每个关节都由精密的伺服电机驱动。

e.en: The factory uses a powerful {servomotor} to position the parts.
e.zh: 工厂用一台强劲的伺服电机来定位零件。

e.en: Sprinkle some {sesame} seeds on top of the salad.
e.zh: 在沙拉上撒一些芝麻。

e.en: This dressing has a strong {sesame} flavor.
e.zh: 这款调味汁有浓郁的芝麻味。

sesquicentennial.t: n./adj. 一百五十周年（纪念）

e.en: The town celebrated its {sesquicentennial} with a huge parade.
e.zh: 该镇以盛大的游行庆祝建镇一百五十周年。

e.en: The university published a book for its {sesquicentennial} anniversary.
e.zh: 这所大学为其一百五十周年校庆出版了一本书。

e.en: Barnacles are {sessile} creatures that attach to rocks.
e.zh: 藤壶是附着在岩石上的固着生物。

e.en: The plant has small {sessile} leaves growing along the stem.
e.zh: 这种植物的茎上长着无柄小叶。

e.en: Our next coaching {session} is scheduled for Friday.
e.zh: 我们下次的辅导课安排在周五。

e.en: Please log in again — your {session} has expired.
e.zh: 请重新登录——你的会话已过期。

e.en: She works as a {sessional} lecturer at two universities.
e.zh: 她在两所大学担任兼职讲师。

e.en: The committee released its {sessional} report yesterday.
e.zh: 委员会昨天发布了本届会议的报告。

sessions.t: n. 会话；会议（session 复数）

e.en: The conference has three parallel {sessions} this afternoon.
e.zh: 今天下午会议有三个平行分会场。

e.en: He records all his therapy {sessions} in a journal.
e.zh: 他把所有的治疗记录写进了日记。

e.en: Writing a {sestina} requires careful repetition of six end words.
e.zh: 写六节诗需要小心地重复六个尾词。

e.en: Her {sestina} about loss won the poetry contest.
e.zh: 她那首关于失去的六节诗赢得了诗歌比赛。

set.t:
v. 设置；放置
n. 一套；集合

set-up.t:
n. 设置；安排
v. 建立；陷害

e.en: His home office {set-up} includes three monitors.
e.zh: 他的家庭办公布置包括三台显示器。

e.en: The whole prank was an obvious {set-up}.
e.zh: 这整个恶作剧明显是设计好的圈套。

e.en: Streamers love showing off their gaming {set-ups} online.
e.zh: 主播们喜欢在网上展示自己的游戏装备配置。

e.en: The detective recognized one of the classic {set-ups} in the case.
e.zh: 侦探认出了案件中那种典型的栽赃手法。

e.en: Losing the contract was a major {setback} for the startup.
e.zh: 失去这份合同对这家初创公司是个重大挫折。

e.en: Her injury was just a temporary {setback} in training.
e.zh: 她的伤只是训练中的一次小挫折。

e.en: Every entrepreneur faces {setbacks} along the way.
e.zh: 每个创业者一路上都会遇到挫折。

e.en: Despite several {setbacks}, the project launched on time.
e.zh: 尽管遭遇多次挫折,项目还是按时上线了。

e.en: The vet inserted a {seton} to drain the wound.
e.zh: 兽医插入了一根引流线来排出伤口的液体。

e.en: A {seton} is sometimes used to treat complex anal fistulas.
e.zh: 有时医生会用引线来治疗复杂的肛瘘。

sets.t:
n. 集合；套（复数）
v. 设置（第三人称）

e.en: The store {sets} new prices every Monday morning.
e.zh: 这家店每周一早上调整新价格。

e.en: He bought two {sets} of bedsheets for the guest room.
e.zh: 他给客房买了两套床单。

e.en: A badger {sett} can have many tunnels and chambers.
e.zh: 獾的洞穴可以有许多通道和房间。

e.en: The old street was paved with granite {sett} stones.
e.zh: 那条老街是用花岗岩方石铺成的。

e.en: Grandma curled up on the {settee} with her knitting.
e.zh: 奶奶蜷在双人沙发上织着毛衣。

e.en: They bought a vintage {settee} for the living room.
e.zh: 他们为客厅买了一张复古双人沙发。

e.en: The hotel lobby has matching velvet {settees}.
e.zh: 酒店大堂摆着成套的天鹅绒双人沙发。

e.en: Antique {settees} can be expensive but beautiful.
e.zh: 古董双人沙发虽贵,但很漂亮。

e.en: Their Irish {setter} loves running on the beach.
e.zh: 他们家的爱尔兰雪达犬喜欢在沙滩上奔跑。

e.en: As {setter}, she controls the rhythm of the volleyball game.
e.zh: 作为二传手,她掌控着排球比赛的节奏。

e.en: You can change the privacy {setting} in your profile.
e.zh: 你可以在个人资料中更改隐私设置。

e.en: The novel's {setting} is rural Japan in the 1950s.
e.zh: 小说的背景设定在1950年代的日本乡村。

settings.t: n. 设置（应用中的设置项）

e.en: Open {settings} to enable dark mode on your phone.
e.zh: 打开设置即可在手机上开启深色模式。

e.en: The film uses several stunning natural {settings}.
e.zh: 这部电影用了几处令人惊叹的自然外景。

e.en: Let's {settle} the bill and head home.
e.zh: 我们结一下账就回家吧。

e.en: They decided to {settle} in a quiet coastal town.
e.zh: 他们决定在一个安静的海滨小镇定居。

settled.t:
adj. 已解决的；稳定的
v. 解决（过去式）

e.en: The dust finally {settled} after the long argument.
e.zh: 那场漫长的争论终于平息下来。

e.en: They {settled} into their new apartment over the weekend.
e.zh: 他们在周末搬进并安顿好了新公寓。

e.en: The two companies reached a {settlement} out of court.
e.zh: 两家公司在庭外达成了和解。

e.en: Archaeologists found an ancient {settlement} near the river.
e.zh: 考古学家在河边发现了一处古代聚落。

e.en: Several class-action {settlements} were announced this month.
e.zh: 本月公布了几起集体诉讼和解。

e.en: Early human {settlements} often grew along rivers.
e.zh: 早期人类聚落常常沿河而建。

e.en: His ancestor was an early {settler} in the valley.
e.zh: 他的祖先是这个山谷最早的拓荒者之一。

e.en: The museum tells the story of each {settler} family.
e.zh: 博物馆讲述了每个移民家庭的故事。

e.en: Early {settlers} built log cabins along the riverbank.
e.zh: 早期的移民沿着河岸建造了原木小屋。

e.en: The {settlers} negotiated peacefully with local tribes.
e.zh: 这些拓荒者与当地部落进行了和平谈判。

settles.t: v. 解决；安顿（第三人称）

e.en: Dust quickly {settles} on the bookshelves in this room.
e.zh: 灰尘很快就会落在这间房的书架上。

e.en: He always {settles} his bills on the first of the month.
e.zh: 他总是在每月一号结清账单。

e.en: They are finally {settling} into their new apartment downtown.
e.zh: 他们终于在市中心的新公寓安顿下来了。

e.en: We're {settling} the dispute through mediation instead of court.
e.zh: 我们正通过调解而非法庭来解决这场纠纷。

settlor.t: n. 委托人（信托设立人）

e.en: The {settlor} transferred the assets into an irrevocable trust.
e.zh: 信托设立人将资产转入了一个不可撤销的信托。

e.en: As {settlor}, she chose her daughter as the main beneficiary.
e.zh: 作为信托人,她选择女儿作为主要受益人。

e.en: My new gaming {setup} cost almost three thousand dollars.
e.zh: 我的新游戏装备花了将近三千美元。

e.en: The initial {setup} for the app takes about five minutes.
e.zh: 这款应用的初始设置大约需要五分钟。

e.en: {Seurat} pioneered pointillism with tiny dots of pure color.
e.zh: 修拉用纯色小点开创了点彩画派。

e.en: The museum displays a famous painting by {Seurat}.
e.zh: 博物馆里展出了一幅修拉的名画。

e.en: My alarm goes off at {seven} every weekday morning.
e.zh: 工作日每天早上七点我的闹钟都会响。

e.en: There are {seven} continents on planet Earth.
e.zh: 地球上有七大洲。

sevenfold.t:
adj. 七倍的
adv. 七倍地

e.en: The company's revenue grew {sevenfold} after going public.
e.zh: 公司上市后营收增长了七倍。

e.en: Her investment returned a {sevenfold} profit in five years.
e.zh: 她的投资在五年内获得了七倍的利润。

e.en: {Sevenoaks} is a charming commuter town in Kent.
e.zh: 七橡树镇是肯特郡一个迷人的通勤小镇。

e.en: They moved from London to {Sevenoaks} for the schools.
e.zh: 为了孩子的学校,他们从伦敦搬到了七橡树镇。

e.en: She got her driver's license at {seventeen}.
e.zh: 她十七岁就拿到了驾照。

e.en: The recipe calls for {seventeen} grams of fresh ginger.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要十七克新鲜生姜。

seventeenth.t:
num. 第十七
n. 十七分之一

e.en: The novel is set in {seventeenth} century Amsterdam.
e.zh: 这部小说背景设定在十七世纪的阿姆斯特丹。

e.en: Today is my grandfather's {seventeenth} wedding anniversary.
e.zh: 今天是我祖父的十七周年结婚纪念日。

seventh.t:
num. 第七
n. 七分之一

e.en: His office is on the {seventh} floor of the tower.
e.zh: 他的办公室在大厦的七楼。

e.en: She finished {seventh} in the marathon despite an injury.
e.zh: 尽管受伤,她在马拉松比赛中获得了第七名。

e.en: They threw a huge party for her {seventieth} birthday.
e.zh: 他们为她的七十大寿举办了盛大的派对。

e.en: The festival is celebrating its {seventieth} anniversary this year.
e.zh: 该节日今年正在庆祝七十周年。

e.en: My grandmother just turned {seventy} last weekend.
e.zh: 我外婆上周末刚满七十岁。

e.en: The highway speed limit here is {seventy} miles per hour.
e.zh: 这里的高速公路限速是每小时七十英里。

e.en: The company decided to {sever} ties with the controversial supplier.
e.zh: 公司决定与这个有争议的供应商断绝关系。

e.en: A sharp blade can easily {sever} a thick rope.
e.zh: 锋利的刀刃可以轻易切断粗绳。

e.en: I've watched this movie {several} times already.
e.zh: 这部电影我已经看过好几遍了。

e.en: {Several} students raised their hands to answer the question.
e.zh: 好几个学生举手要回答这个问题。

e.en: The partners are {severally} liable for the company's debts.
e.zh: 合伙人对公司债务各自承担连带责任。

e.en: Each defendant must pay damages {severally} as ordered.
e.zh: 每位被告必须按裁定各自支付赔偿金。

e.en: She received six months of {severance} after the layoff.
e.zh: 裁员后她拿到了六个月的离职补偿金。

e.en: The {severance} package included healthcare for one year.
e.zh: 这份遣散方案包含一年的医疗保险。

e.en: The region is experiencing a {severe} drought this summer.
e.zh: 该地区今年夏天正经历严重的干旱。

e.en: He suffered a {severe} concussion during the football game.
e.zh: 他在橄榄球比赛中受到了严重的脑震荡。

severed.t:
adj. 切断的
v. 切断（过去式）

e.en: The accident {severed} a major artery in his leg.
e.zh: 事故切断了他腿部的一条主要动脉。

e.en: Both countries {severed} diplomatic relations after the incident.
e.zh: 事件发生后两国断绝了外交关系。

e.en: The flooding {severely} damaged thousands of homes overnight.
e.zh: 洪水一夜之间严重损毁了数千户人家。

e.en: He was {severely} criticized for his offensive comments.
e.zh: 他因冒犯性言论受到了严厉的批评。

e.en: They are {severing} all business connections with the firm.
e.zh: 他们正在切断与该公司的所有业务往来。

e.en: {Severing} the cable will disconnect the entire building.
e.zh: 切断这根电缆会让整栋楼断电。

e.en: Doctors were shocked by the {severity} of his injuries.
e.zh: 医生们对他伤势的严重程度感到震惊。

e.en: The judge considered the {severity} of the crime carefully.
e.zh: 法官仔细考虑了犯罪的严重性。

e.en: The {Severn} is the longest river in the United Kingdom.
e.zh: 塞文河是英国最长的河流。

e.en: We rented a cottage near the {Severn} estuary last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在塞文河口附近租了一间小屋。

e.en: Professor {Severus} Snape is a complex character in Harry Potter.
e.zh: 西弗勒斯·斯内普教授是《哈利·波特》中一个复杂的角色。

e.en: Emperor {Severus} ruled Rome at the start of the third century.
e.zh: 塞维鲁皇帝在三世纪初统治着罗马帝国。

seville.t: n. 塞维利亚（西班牙城市）

e.en: {Seville} is famous for flamenco dancing and orange trees.
e.zh: 塞维利亚以弗拉门戈舞和橙树而闻名。

e.en: We spent three days exploring the old town of {Seville}.
e.zh: 我们花了三天时间游览塞维利亚的老城区。

e.en: The city upgraded its {sewage} treatment plant last year.
e.zh: 市里去年升级了污水处理厂。

e.en: Heavy rain caused {sewage} to overflow into the river.
e.zh: 大雨导致污水溢流到了河里。

sewed.t: v. 缝合（sew 的过去式）

e.en: My grandmother {sewed} all of my Halloween costumes.
e.zh: 我所有的万圣节服装都是奶奶缝制的。

e.en: The surgeon carefully {sewed} the wound shut with stitches.
e.zh: 外科医生小心地用针线缝合了伤口。

e.en: A blocked {sewer} caused flooding throughout the basement.
e.zh: 下水道堵塞导致整个地下室都被淹了。

e.en: Workers descended into the {sewer} to repair the leak.
e.zh: 工人们下到下水道里去修补漏点。

e.en: The town's old {sewerage} system needs urgent replacement.
e.zh: 小镇陈旧的排污系统急需更换。

e.en: Modern {sewerage} infrastructure prevents the spread of disease.
e.zh: 现代化的排污基础设施可以防止疾病传播。

sewing.t:
n. 缝纫，针线活
v. 缝（sew 的现在分词）

e.en: She loves {sewing} her own clothes from vintage patterns.
e.zh: 她喜欢用复古图样自己缝制衣服。

e.en: My mother bought a new {sewing} machine for her hobby.
e.zh: 我妈妈为她的爱好买了一台新缝纫机。

sewn.t: v. 缝（sew 的过去分词）

e.en: This jacket was hand {sewn} by a local tailor.
e.zh: 这件夹克是当地裁缝手工缝制的。

e.en: The patches are securely {sewn} onto the boy scout uniform.
e.zh: 这些徽章被牢固地缝在童子军制服上。

sews.t: v. 缝合（sew 的第三人称单数）

e.en: My aunt {sews} beautiful quilts for charity auctions.
e.zh: 我姨妈缝制漂亮的被子用于慈善拍卖。

e.en: He {sews} buttons onto his shirts whenever they fall off.
e.zh: 每当衬衫纽扣掉了他都自己缝上。

sex.t:
n. 性别；性
v. 辨别性别

e.en: The study compared health outcomes between the two {sexes}.
e.zh: 该研究比较了两性之间的健康状况。

e.en: Both {sexes} are welcome to join the volunteer program.
e.zh: 志愿者项目欢迎男女两性参加。

e.en: The brand built its image around effortless {sexiness}.
e.zh: 该品牌围绕着不费力的性感打造形象。

e.en: Confidence often adds more {sexiness} than physical beauty.
e.zh: 自信往往比外表更增添性感魅力。

e.en: The company faces serious accusations of workplace {sexism}.
e.zh: 该公司面临严重的职场性别歧视指控。

e.en: Casual {sexism} in advertising has decreased over the decades.
e.zh: 几十年来广告中随意的性别歧视已有所减少。

sexisms.t: n. 性别歧视的言行（复数）

e.en: The book catalogues subtle {sexisms} found in everyday speech.
e.zh: 这本书记录了日常言语中各种微妙的性别歧视现象。

e.en: Many {sexisms} go unnoticed because they feel so normalized.
e.zh: 许多性别歧视因为习以为常而不被察觉。

sexist.t:
adj. 性别歧视的
n. 性别歧视者

e.en: That commercial uses a really outdated and {sexist} stereotype.
e.zh: 那则广告使用了非常过时且带有性别歧视的刻板印象。

e.en: He apologized for the {sexist} joke he made at dinner.
e.zh: 他为晚饭时讲的那个性别歧视笑话道了歉。

sexless.t: adj. 无性别的；无性欲的

e.en: The couple admitted their marriage had become entirely {sexless}.
e.zh: 这对夫妻承认他们的婚姻已经完全没有性生活。

e.en: The robot character was designed to be {sexless} and neutral.
e.zh: 这个机器人角色被设计成无性别且中性的形象。

e.en: A licensed {sexologist} can help couples improve intimacy.
e.zh: 有执照的性学专家可以帮助伴侣改善亲密关系。

e.en: The {sexologist} published a bestselling book on relationships.
e.zh: 这位性学家出版了一本关于两性关系的畅销书。

e.en: She earned a doctorate in {sexology} from a European university.
e.zh: 她在一所欧洲大学获得了性学博士学位。

e.en: Modern {sexology} draws from psychology, biology, and sociology.
e.zh: 现代性学综合了心理学、生物学和社会学。

e.en: The movie cast her as a glamorous Hollywood {sexpot}.
e.zh: 这部电影把她塑造成一个魅惑的好莱坞性感尤物。

e.en: He hated being labeled a {sexpot} early in his career.
e.zh: 他讨厌职业生涯早期被贴上性感偶像的标签。

e.en: Sailors once used a {sextant} to navigate by the stars.
e.zh: 水手们曾用六分仪通过星辰导航。

e.en: The antique {sextant} sold for thousands at the auction.
e.zh: 那台古董六分仪在拍卖会上卖了数千美元。

e.en: The jazz {sextet} performs at the club every Friday night.
e.zh: 这支爵士六重奏每周五晚在俱乐部演出。

e.en: Beethoven composed a beautiful string {sextet} early in his career.
e.zh: 贝多芬在早期创作了一首优美的弦乐六重奏。

e.en: The church {sexton} unlocks the chapel doors at dawn.
e.zh: 教堂司事在黎明时打开礼拜堂的大门。

e.en: Anne {Sexton} wrote deeply personal confessional poetry.
e.zh: 安妮·塞克斯顿写了非常私密的自白派诗歌。

e.en: Each {sextuplet} weighed less than three pounds at birth.
e.zh: 这六胞胎中每个出生时体重都不到三磅。

e.en: The drummer played a quick {sextuplet} fill on the snare.
e.zh: 鼓手在小军鼓上快速打了一组六连音。

e.en: The school offers {sexual} education classes for ninth graders.
e.zh: 这所学校为九年级学生开设性教育课程。

e.en: Many animals exhibit complex {sexual} behaviors during mating season.
e.zh: 许多动物在交配季节会表现出复杂的性行为。

e.en: The conference welcomed people of all {sexualities} and identities.
e.zh: 这场会议欢迎所有性取向和身份认同的人参加。

e.en: The book explores diverse {sexualities} across different cultures.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了不同文化中多元的性取向。

e.en: Many teenagers struggle to understand their own {sexuality}.
e.zh: 许多青少年在理解自己的性取向时感到困惑。

e.en: The film honestly portrays a young woman's awakening {sexuality}.
e.zh: 这部电影坦诚地描绘了一位年轻女性的性意识觉醒。

e.en: Critics condemned the {sexualization} of teenagers in advertising.
e.zh: 批评者谴责广告中对青少年的性化呈现。

e.en: The {sexualization} of female athletes remains a serious issue.
e.zh: 女性运动员被性化的问题依然严重。

e.en: Critics say the ads {sexualize} young teenage girls.
e.zh: 批评者称这些广告将少女性化。

e.en: The film tries not to {sexualize} its female lead.
e.zh: 这部电影尽量不把女主角性化处理。

sexualized.t:
adj. 被性化的
v. sexualize 的过去式

e.en: The costume felt overly {sexualized} for a children's show.
e.zh: 这套服装对一部儿童节目来说过于性感化了。

e.en: She criticized the {sexualized} portrayal of women in games.
e.zh: 她批评游戏中对女性的性化描绘。

e.en: The app warns users about {sexually} explicit content.
e.zh: 该应用会提醒用户注意露骨色情内容。

e.en: Many diseases can be transmitted {sexually} between partners.
e.zh: 许多疾病可以在伴侣之间通过性行为传播。

e.en: She wore a {sexy} black dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条性感的黑色连衣裙去派对。

e.en: Database migrations aren't {sexy}, but they matter.
e.zh: 数据库迁移并不光鲜,但很重要。

e.en: We honeymooned in the {seychelles} last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天在塞舌尔度蜜月。

e.en: The {seychelles} is famous for its turquoise beaches.
e.zh: 塞舌尔以碧绿的海滩闻名。

sfa.t: n. 销售自动化（Sales Force Automation）

sfo.t: n. 旧金山国际机场代码

sgml.t: n. 标准通用标记语言

e.en: HTML was originally derived from {sgml}.
e.zh: HTML 最初是从 SGML 衍生而来的。

e.en: Few developers still write raw {sgml} documents today.
e.zh: 如今几乎没有开发者再手写 SGML 文档了。

sgr.t: n. 控制序列（Select Graphic Rendition）

sgraffito.t: n. 刮花陶器装饰工艺

e.en: The pottery features delicate {sgraffito} patterns scratched through slip.
e.zh: 这件陶器有透过化妆土刮出的精致刻花纹饰。

e.en: Italian Renaissance walls often used {sgraffito} for decoration.
e.zh: 意大利文艺复兴时期的墙面常用刮花装饰。

e.en: He was {shabbily} dressed but spoke with confidence.
e.zh: 他衣着寒酸,说话却很自信。

e.en: The company treated its loyal customers quite {shabbily}.
e.zh: 公司对忠实客户的态度相当差。

e.en: The {shabbiness} of the hotel surprised us.
e.zh: 这家酒店的破旧程度让我们吃惊。

e.en: There's a charming {shabbiness} to old bookshops.
e.zh: 老书店有一种迷人的陈旧感。

e.en: He wore a {shabby} coat with frayed sleeves.
e.zh: 他穿着一件袖口磨破的破旧外套。

e.en: Forty dollars for that meal isn't {shabby} at all.
e.zh: 那顿饭四十美元一点也不算贵。

e.en: They lived in a wooden {shack} by the beach.
e.zh: 他们住在海边的一间木棚屋里。

e.en: The fishing {shack} smelled of salt and old nets.
e.zh: 那间渔棚弥漫着海盐和旧渔网的味道。

shackle.t:
n. 镣铐
v. 束缚，给…上镣铐

e.en: Heavy regulations {shackle} small business owners.
e.zh: 繁重的法规束缚了小企业主。

e.en: The prisoner pulled at the iron {shackle} on his ankle.
e.zh: 囚犯拉扯着脚踝上的铁镣。

shackled.t:
v. 上镣铐（过去式）
adj. 被束缚的

e.en: The defendant was {shackled} as he entered the courtroom.
e.zh: 被告进入法庭时戴着脚镣手铐。

e.en: Many startups feel {shackled} by outdated industry rules.
e.zh: 许多创业公司感到被过时的行业规则束缚。

shackleton.t: n. 沙克尔顿（探险家姓氏）

e.en: Ernest {shackleton} led the famous Endurance expedition to Antarctica.
e.zh: 欧内斯特·沙克尔顿率领著名的耐力号远征南极。

e.en: Books about {shackleton} inspire many modern leaders.
e.zh: 关于沙克尔顿的书激励着许多现代领导者。

e.en: Every spring, fishermen catch {shad} in the river.
e.zh: 每年春天,渔民都在河里捕西鲱鱼。

e.en: Smoked {shad} is a regional delicacy along the coast.
e.zh: 熏西鲱鱼是沿海地区的特色美食。

shade.t:
n. 阴影；色调
v. 遮蔽

e.en: Let's sit in the {shade} of that big oak tree.
e.zh: 我们坐到那棵大橡树的树荫下吧。

e.en: This paint comes in a slightly darker {shade} of blue.
e.zh: 这款油漆有一种略深的蓝色色调。

e.en: We picnicked in a {shaded} corner of the park.
e.zh: 我们在公园一个阴凉的角落野餐。

e.en: The chart's {shaded} region shows the confidence interval.
e.zh: 图表中阴影区域表示置信区间。

shadeless.t: adj. 无遮阴的；无阴影的

e.en: The hike across the {shadeless} desert was brutal.
e.zh: 穿越毫无遮荫的沙漠的徒步极其艰苦。

e.en: Their backyard is completely {shadeless} in the afternoon.
e.zh: 他们的后院下午完全没有遮荫。

shades.t:
n. 墨镜；色调
n. 阴影（复数）

e.en: She put on her {shades} before stepping outside.
e.zh: 她出门前戴上了墨镜。

e.en: The sunset painted the sky in warm {shades} of orange.
e.zh: 夕阳把天空染成温暖的橙色调。

shading.t:
n. 明暗处理；渐变
v. 遮蔽

e.en: The artist added {shading} to make the face look round.
e.zh: 画家加了阴影让脸部显得立体。

e.en: Tall buildings were {shading} the entire street.
e.zh: 高楼把整条街都遮在阴影里。

shadow.t:
n. 阴影；影子
v. 跟踪

e.en: His {shadow} stretched long across the empty parking lot.
e.zh: 他的影子在空荡的停车场上拉得很长。

e.en: She lived in the {shadow} of her famous older sister.
e.zh: 她活在著名姐姐的阴影之下。

shadowed.t:
adj. 有阴影的
v. 跟踪（过去式）

e.en: A reporter {shadowed} the candidate for an entire week.
e.zh: 一名记者跟踪采访了这位候选人整整一周。

e.en: The narrow alley was {shadowed} by tall buildings.
e.zh: 狭窄的小巷被高楼笼罩在阴影中。

shadowing.t:
n. 跟踪；阴影
v. 投影

e.en: New hires spend a week {shadowing} senior engineers.
e.zh: 新员工要花一周时间跟随资深工程师学习。

e.en: Watch out for variable {shadowing} inside nested functions.
e.zh: 小心嵌套函数内的变量遮蔽问题。

e.en: At noon the courtyard looked oddly {shadowless} and flat.
e.zh: 正午时分,庭院显得奇怪地没有阴影、扁平。

e.en: Studio lighting can create a perfectly {shadowless} portrait.
e.zh: 影棚灯光能拍出完全无阴影的肖像。

shadows.t:
n. 阴影（复数）
v. 跟踪

e.en: Long {shadows} crept across the lawn as evening fell.
e.zh: 夜幕降临时,长长的影子爬过草坪。

e.en: He preferred to operate in the {shadows} of the company.
e.zh: 他更喜欢在公司幕后行事。

e.en: A {shadowy} figure stood at the end of the hallway.
e.zh: 走廊尽头站着一个朦胧的身影。

e.en: Investigators uncovered a {shadowy} network of shell companies.
e.zh: 调查人员揭露了一张神秘的空壳公司网络。

shady.t:
adj. 阴凉的
adj. 可疑的

e.en: We found a {shady} spot under the maple tree.
e.zh: 我们在枫树下找到一处阴凉的地方。

e.en: That deal sounds a little {shady} to me.
e.zh: 那笔交易听起来有点不太靠谱。

shaft.t:
n. 轴；竖井
n. 箭杆

e.en: A {shaft} of sunlight broke through the clouds.
e.zh: 一道阳光穿透了云层。

e.en: The elevator {shaft} runs up forty floors.
e.zh: 电梯井向上贯穿四十层楼。

e.en: He felt totally {shafted} by his former business partner.
e.zh: 他觉得自己完全被前合伙人坑了。

e.en: Junior employees often get {shafted} during layoffs.
e.zh: 裁员时基层员工往往受到不公正对待。

shaftesbury.t: n. 沙夫茨伯里（地名/人名）

e.en: Tourists gather around the famous statue at {shaftesbury} Avenue.
e.zh: 游客聚集在沙夫茨伯里大道上著名的雕像周围。

e.en: The earl of {shaftesbury} championed factory reform laws.
e.zh: 沙夫茨伯里伯爵积极推动工厂改革法案。

e.en: Their living room had a thick orange {shag} carpet.
e.zh: 他们的客厅铺着厚厚的橙色长绒地毯。

e.en: Grandpa still smokes {shag} tobacco from a worn pouch.
e.zh: 爷爷还在用一个磨旧的烟袋抽细切烟丝。

e.en: The {shaggy} dog needed a serious haircut.
e.zh: 那只毛茸茸的狗急需理一次毛。

e.en: He showed up with a beard and {shaggy} hair.
e.zh: 他出现时留着胡子,头发蓬乱。

e.en: The last {shah} of Iran was overthrown in 1979.
e.zh: 伊朗末代沙阿于1979年被推翻。

e.en: The palace once belonged to a powerful Persian {shah}.
e.zh: 这座宫殿曾属于一位强大的波斯沙阿。

e.en: In Arabic, {shahid} means a martyr or witness.
e.zh: 在阿拉伯语中,shahid 意为殉道者或见证者。

e.en: {shahid} Kapoor is a popular Bollywood actor.
e.zh: 沙希德·卡普尔是宝莱坞一位人气演员。

e.en: The local {shaikh} welcomed visitors into the mosque.
e.zh: 当地的谢赫欢迎访客进入清真寺。

e.en: A wealthy {shaikh} funded the new university campus.
e.zh: 一位富有的谢赫资助了新的大学校园。

shake.t:
v. 摇晃；握手
n. 奶昔

e.en: Don't forget to {shake} the bottle before opening.
e.zh: 打开前别忘了摇一摇瓶子。

e.en: I ordered a chocolate {shake} with my burger.
e.zh: 我点汉堡时还要了一杯巧克力奶昔。

e.en: The team took the new boat out for a {shakedown} cruise.
e.zh: 团队把新船开出去进行试航测试。

e.en: Police arrested the gang for running a protection {shakedown}.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了实施保护费勒索的团伙。

shaken.t:
adj. 震惊的
v. 摇动（过去分词）

e.en: She felt deeply {shaken} after the car accident.
e.zh: 那场车祸后她深受震动。

e.en: James Bond likes his martini {shaken}, not stirred.
e.zh: 詹姆斯·邦德喜欢摇匀而非搅拌的马提尼。

e.en: The crypto crash caused a major industry {shakeout}.
e.zh: 加密货币崩盘引发了行业大洗牌。

e.en: After the {shakeout}, only three competitors remained.
e.zh: 经过一轮淘汰后,只剩下三家竞争者。

e.en: Pass me the salt {shaker}, please.
e.zh: 请把盐瓶递给我。

e.en: The bartender filled the cocktail {shaker} with ice.
e.zh: 调酒师把冰块装进调酒摇杯里。

shakes.t:
v. 摇动（三单）
n. 颤抖

e.en: He {shakes} hands firmly with every new client.
e.zh: 他和每位新客户都坚定有力地握手。

e.en: Coffee on an empty stomach gives me the {shakes}.
e.zh: 空腹喝咖啡会让我手抖。

e.en: Most students read {shakespeare} at some point in school.
e.zh: 大多数学生在求学阶段都会读莎士比亚。

e.en: {shakespeare} wrote both comedies and tragedies.
e.zh: 莎士比亚既写喜剧也写悲剧。

e.en: The play has a distinctly {shakespearean} sense of tragedy.
e.zh: 这部戏剧带有明显的莎士比亚式悲剧感。

e.en: She trained as a {shakespearean} actress in London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦接受过莎士比亚戏剧演员的训练。

e.en: His ambition has a truly {shakespearian} quality to it.
e.zh: 他的野心带有真正莎士比亚式的特质。

e.en: Critics described the scandal as {shakespearian} in scope.
e.zh: 评论家将这桩丑闻形容为具有莎士比亚式的规模。

e.en: She stood up {shakily} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后她颤颤巍巍地站了起来。

e.en: He answered the question {shakily}, unsure of himself.
e.zh: 他不太自信地颤声回答了问题。

e.en: The {shakiness} of the footage made it hard to watch.
e.zh: 画面的晃动让人难以观看。

e.en: Investors worry about the {shakiness} of the housing market.
e.zh: 投资者担忧住房市场的不稳定。

shaking.t:
v. 摇动；颤抖
n. 震动

e.en: Her hands were {shaking} as she opened the letter.
e.zh: 她拆信时双手在颤抖。

e.en: The whole building started {shaking} during the earthquake.
e.zh: 地震时整栋楼都开始摇晃。

e.en: My grasp of French grammar is still pretty {shaky}.
e.zh: 我对法语语法的掌握还相当不牢靠。

e.en: She drew a {shaky} line on the whiteboard.
e.zh: 她在白板上画了一条歪歪扭扭的线。

e.en: The US energy boom was driven by {shale} oil.
e.zh: 美国能源繁荣是由页岩油推动的。

e.en: We hiked across loose {shale} on the mountainside.
e.zh: 我们在山坡上松散的页岩上徒步。

e.en: {shall} we grab dinner after the meeting?
e.zh: 会议结束后我们一起去吃晚饭好吗?

e.en: The tenant {shall} pay rent on the first of each month.
e.zh: 承租人应于每月一号支付租金。

e.en: The fisherman rowed his small {shallop} across the calm bay.
e.zh: 渔夫划着他的小艇穿过平静的海湾。

e.en: A wooden {shallop} was tied to the old wooden dock.
e.zh: 一艘木制小艇被系在旧木码头上。

e.en: Dice one {shallot} and sauté it until golden brown.
e.zh: 把一颗青葱切丁，炒至金黄色。

e.en: The recipe calls for a finely chopped {shallot} and garlic.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要一颗切碎的青葱和大蒜。

e.en: The pool is {shallow} enough for kids to stand safely.
e.zh: 这个泳池很浅，小孩子可以安全站立。

e.en: His analysis felt {shallow} and missed the real issues.
e.zh: 他的分析显得肤浅，没抓住真正的问题。

e.en: She was breathing {shallowly} after the long sprint uphill.
e.zh: 长距离上坡冲刺后她呼吸短促。

e.en: Plant the seeds {shallowly}, just below the surface of the soil.
e.zh: 把种子浅浅地种下，刚好埋在土面下。

e.en: The {shallowness} of the river made it easy to wade across.
e.zh: 河水很浅，很容易涉水而过。

e.en: Critics pointed out the {shallowness} of his political arguments.
e.zh: 评论者指出他政治论点的肤浅。

shalt.t: aux. shall 的古体第二人称

e.en: Thou {shalt} not steal, the ancient text commands.
e.zh: 古文写道：你不可偷盗。

e.en: The old poem reads, "Thou {shalt} love thy neighbor."
e.zh: 那首古诗写着：你应当爱你的邻人。

sham.t:
adj. 假的
n. 骗局

e.en: The whole charity event turned out to be a {sham}.
e.zh: 整个慈善活动结果是一场骗局。

e.en: Investigators exposed the company's {sham} accounting practices.
e.zh: 调查人员揭露了公司虚假的会计做法。

e.en: The village {shaman} performed a healing ritual at dawn.
e.zh: 村里的萨满在黎明时举行了治疗仪式。

e.en: A {shaman} is believed to communicate with the spirit world.
e.zh: 人们相信萨满能与灵界沟通。

e.en: She studied {shamanic} traditions during her trip to Mongolia.
e.zh: 她去蒙古旅行期间研究了萨满传统。

e.en: The drumming created a deeply {shamanic} atmosphere in the room.
e.zh: 鼓声让房间里充满了浓厚的萨满氛围。

e.en: {Shamanism} remains an important spiritual practice in Siberia.
e.zh: 萨满教在西伯利亚仍是重要的精神实践。

e.en: His thesis explored the role of {shamanism} in indigenous cultures.
e.zh: 他的论文探讨了萨满教在原住民文化中的作用。

e.en: The dance had clearly {shamanistic} roots in tribal ceremonies.
e.zh: 这种舞蹈明显源自部落仪式中的萨满传统。

e.en: He described the experience as almost {shamanistic} in nature.
e.zh: 他形容那次经历几乎带有萨满色彩。

e.en: The tired hikers began to {shamble} back toward camp.
e.zh: 疲惫的徒步者开始拖着脚步往营地走。

e.en: Zombies {shamble} slowly across the screen in the game.
e.zh: 游戏里僵尸在屏幕上缓慢地拖着脚步走。

e.en: The old man {shambled} down the hallway in his slippers.
e.zh: 老人趿拉着拖鞋拖着脚步走过走廊。

e.en: Half-asleep, he {shambled} into the kitchen for coffee.
e.zh: 他睡眼惺忪地拖着脚步走进厨房去倒咖啡。

e.en: After the party, the apartment was a complete {shambles}.
e.zh: 派对过后,公寓里一片狼藉。

e.en: The project ended in {shambles} after the manager quit.
e.zh: 经理辞职后,项目陷入一团糟。

shambling.t: adj. 蹒跚的；拖着脚走的

e.en: A {shambling} bear emerged from the trees at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时分,一头步履蹒跚的熊从树林里走了出来。
