e.en: He had a slow, {shambling} walk that made him easy to spot.
e.zh: 他走起路来慢吞吞、拖拖拉拉的,很容易被认出来。

shambolic.t: adj. 混乱的；杂乱无章的

e.en: The team's {shambolic} performance disappointed the fans.
e.zh: 球队混乱不堪的表现让球迷大失所望。

e.en: Their {shambolic} attempt at organizing the event embarrassed everyone.
e.zh: 他们组织活动的混乱方式让所有人都很尴尬。

shame.t:
n. 羞愧；耻辱
v. 使蒙羞

e.en: He felt deep {shame} after lying to his best friend.
e.zh: 对最好的朋友撒谎之后,他感到深深的羞愧。

e.en: It's a {shame} you couldn't make it to the wedding.
e.zh: 真可惜你没能来参加婚礼。

shamed.t: v. 使羞愧（shame 的过去式）

e.en: The article {shamed} the company into changing its policy.
e.zh: 那篇报道羞辱了该公司,迫使其改变政策。

e.en: She felt {shamed} by her teacher's harsh public criticism.
e.zh: 老师当众严厉的批评让她感到羞愧。

shamefaced.t: adj. 面带愧色的；害羞的

e.en: He gave a {shamefaced} smile after spilling the wine.
e.zh: 洒了酒之后,他露出一个羞愧的笑容。

e.en: The boy looked {shamefaced} when his mother caught him lying.
e.zh: 被妈妈发现撒谎时,男孩一脸羞愧。

shamefacedly.t: adv. 羞愧地；不好意思地

e.en: He {shamefacedly} admitted that he had forgotten her birthday.
e.zh: 他羞愧地承认自己忘了她的生日。

e.en: She {shamefacedly} returned the book she had borrowed years ago.
e.zh: 她羞愧地归还了多年前借走的那本书。

e.en: It's {shameful} how little support these workers receive.
e.zh: 这些工人得到的支持如此之少,实在令人羞愧。

e.en: Cheating on the exam was a {shameful} mistake.
e.zh: 考试作弊是一个可耻的错误。

e.en: The coach {shamefully} blamed the loss on his youngest player.
e.zh: 教练可耻地把失利归咎于队里最年轻的球员。

e.en: Many historic buildings have been {shamefully} neglected by the city.
e.zh: 许多历史建筑被这座城市可耻地忽视了。

e.en: His {shameless} self-promotion on social media annoyed his coworkers.
e.zh: 他在社交媒体上恬不知耻地自我吹捧,让同事们很反感。

e.en: The politician told a {shameless} lie during the debate.
e.zh: 那位政客在辩论中撒了一个无耻的谎。

e.en: He {shamelessly} copied his classmate's homework word for word.
e.zh: 他厚颜无耻地一字不漏地抄了同学的作业。

e.en: The brand {shamelessly} ripped off a smaller designer's work.
e.zh: 那个品牌无耻地抄袭了一位小设计师的作品。

e.en: His {shamelessness} in taking credit for her work shocked everyone.
e.zh: 他厚颜无耻地把她的功劳据为己有,令所有人震惊。

e.en: The audience was stunned by the comedian's pure {shamelessness}.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员的无耻让观众目瞪口呆。

shaming.t:
n. 羞辱；使蒙羞
v. shame 的现在分词

e.en: Public {shaming} on social media can cause serious mental harm.
e.zh: 在社交媒体上公开羞辱他人可能造成严重的心理伤害。

e.en: The teacher avoided {shaming} students who answered incorrectly.
e.zh: 老师避免羞辱那些答错问题的学生。

shampoo.t:
n. 洗发水
v. 洗头

e.en: I bought a new {shampoo} for dry hair yesterday.
e.zh: 我昨天买了一瓶针对干发的新洗发水。

e.en: Remember to {shampoo} your hair twice for a deep clean.
e.zh: 记得洗两遍头才能彻底清洁。

shampooes.t: n. 洗发水（shampoo 的复数）

e.en: The store sells dozens of organic {shampooes} from around the world.
e.zh: 这家店销售数十种来自世界各地的有机洗发水。

e.en: She {shampooes} her dog every weekend in the backyard.
e.zh: 她每个周末都在后院给狗洗澡。

shamrock.t: n. 三叶草（爱尔兰国花）

e.en: The {shamrock} is a popular symbol of Ireland.
e.zh: 三叶草是爱尔兰广为人知的象征。

e.en: She wore a tiny {shamrock} pin on St. Patrick's Day.
e.zh: 圣帕特里克节那天,她别了一枚小小的三叶草胸针。

e.en: I {shan} not be attending the meeting tomorrow afternoon.
e.zh: 我明天下午不会去参加那个会议。

e.en: We {shan} forget the kindness she showed us that day.
e.zh: 我们绝不会忘记那天她对我们的善意。

shandy.t: n. 香迪酒（啤酒兑柠檬汽水）

e.en: On hot afternoons he likes a cold {shandy} in the garden.
e.zh: 炎热的午后,他喜欢在花园里来一杯冰凉的香迪酒。

e.en: The pub serves a refreshing lemon {shandy} in summer.
e.zh: 那家酒吧夏天供应清爽的柠檬香迪啤酒。

shanghai.t:
n. 上海
v. 诱拐；胁迫

e.en: Recruiters tried to {shanghai} him into signing a long contract.
e.zh: 招聘人员试图诱骗他签下一份长期合同。

e.en: They {shanghai} unsuspecting tourists into overpriced tea ceremonies.
e.zh: 他们诱骗毫无防备的游客参加价格虚高的茶艺表演。

e.en: The chef braised a lamb {shank} for three hours.
e.zh: 主厨把羊小腿炖了三个小时。

e.en: He hit the golf ball off the {shank} of the club.
e.zh: 他用球杆的根部把高尔夫球打飞了。

e.en: The river {shannon} is the longest in Ireland.
e.zh: 香农河是爱尔兰最长的河流。

e.en: Claude {shannon} is considered the father of information theory.
e.zh: 克劳德·香农被誉为信息论之父。

e.en: The mantra ends with the word {shanti}, meaning peace.
e.zh: 这段真言以意为和平的「shanti」一词结尾。

e.en: She whispered {shanti} three times at the end of her meditation.
e.zh: 冥想结束时,她轻声念了三遍「shanti」。

e.en: A small fishing {shanty} stood at the edge of the lake.
e.zh: 湖边立着一座小小的渔民棚屋。

e.en: The sailors sang an old sea {shanty} as they worked.
e.zh: 水手们一边干活一边唱着古老的航海号子。

e.en: A sprawling {shantytown} grew up around the city's edge.
e.zh: 一片杂乱的棚户区在城市边缘蔓延开来。

e.en: Volunteers brought clean water to the {shantytown} every week.
e.zh: 志愿者每周都给棚户区送去干净的水。

e.en: Data scientists use {shap} values to explain machine learning predictions.
e.zh: 数据科学家用 SHAP 值来解释机器学习模型的预测结果。

e.en: The team plotted {shap} values to see which features mattered most.
e.zh: 团队绘制了 SHAP 值,以查看哪些特征最为重要。

shape.t:
n. 形状；外形
v. 塑造

e.en: The cookies came out in the {shape} of stars.
e.zh: 做出来的饼干都是星星的形状。

e.en: Childhood experiences {shape} our personality in lasting ways.
e.zh: 童年经历会对我们的性格产生持久的塑造作用。

shaped.t:
adj. 成形的
v. shape 的过去式

e.en: She wore a heart-{shaped} pendant her grandmother gave her.
e.zh: 她戴着一条祖母送的心形项链。

e.en: His travels abroad deeply {shaped} his worldview.
e.zh: 在国外的旅行深深塑造了他的世界观。

shapeless.t: adj. 不成形的；无定形的

e.en: He pulled on a {shapeless} old sweater and headed outside.
e.zh: 他套上一件松松垮垮的旧毛衣就出门了。

e.en: The clay sat in a {shapeless} lump on the table.
e.zh: 那团黏土软塌塌地堆在桌上。

e.en: She admired the {shapely} curves of the antique vase.
e.zh: 她欣赏着那只古董花瓶优美的曲线。

e.en: The dancer had long, {shapely} legs that drew every eye.
e.zh: 那位舞者有一双修长匀称的腿,引来所有人的目光。

e.en: He works as a wood {shaper} in a small furniture studio.
e.zh: 他在一间小型家具工作室里做木工塑形师。

e.en: Music is a powerful {shaper} of cultural identity.
e.zh: 音乐是塑造文化认同的强大力量。

shapes.t:
n. 形状（复数）
v. 塑造

e.en: The app lets kids match colors and {shapes}.
e.zh: 这款应用让孩子们配对颜色和形状。

e.en: Early childhood {shapes} who we become as adults.
e.zh: 童年经历塑造了我们成年后的样子。

shaping.t:
n. 塑造；成形
v. shape 的现在分词

e.en: AI is rapidly {shaping} how we search the web.
e.zh: 人工智能正在迅速改变我们搜索网络的方式。

e.en: She spent hours {shaping} the clay into a vase.
e.zh: 她花了几个小时把黏土捏成花瓶。

e.en: A {shard} of glass cut his finger.
e.zh: 一块玻璃碎片划破了他的手指。

e.en: Each database {shard} handles a slice of the user traffic.
e.zh: 每个数据库分片处理一部分用户流量。

share.t:
v. 分享；共享
n. 份额；股份

e.en: Tap the icon to {share} this article with friends.
e.zh: 点击图标即可把这篇文章分享给朋友。

e.en: Each team member gets a {share} of the bonus.
e.zh: 团队每个成员都能分到一份奖金。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {sharecropper} in the rural South.
e.zh: 他祖父曾在南方农村当佃农。

e.en: The novel follows a {sharecropper} family during the Depression.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述大萧条时期一个佃农家庭的故事。

e.en: After the war, {sharecropping} replaced slavery on many plantations.
e.zh: 战后,许多种植园用佃农制取代了奴隶制。

e.en: The documentary explores the legacy of {sharecropping} in Mississippi.
e.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了密西西比佃农制的历史遗产。

e.en: We {shared} a pizza after the movie.
e.zh: 看完电影后我们一起分了一份披萨。

e.en: The folder is {shared} with the whole team.
e.zh: 这个文件夹已与整个团队共享。

e.en: Every {shareholder} can vote at the annual meeting.
e.zh: 每位股东都可以在年度大会上投票。

e.en: She became a {shareholder} after buying ten shares last year.
e.zh: 她去年买了十股后成了股东。

e.en: The CEO addressed angry {shareholders} at the conference.
e.zh: 首席执行官在大会上回应了愤怒的股东们。

e.en: Major {shareholders} voted against the merger.
e.zh: 主要股东投票反对此次合并。

e.en: His {shareholding} in the company is worth millions.
e.zh: 他在公司的持股价值数百万。

e.en: The fund disclosed a 5% {shareholding} in the startup.
e.zh: 该基金披露持有这家初创公司5%的股份。

e.en: Each {shareowner} received a quarterly dividend.
e.zh: 每位持股人都获得了季度分红。

e.en: The company sent updates to every registered {shareowner}.
e.zh: 公司向每位登记在册的股东发送了最新公告。

e.en: She's a generous {sharer} of her snacks at lunch.
e.zh: 午饭时她总是大方地分享自己的零食。

e.en: The app rewards frequent {sharer} accounts with badges.
e.zh: 该应用会向经常分享的账号奖励徽章。

shares.t:
n. 股份；份额
v. share 的第三人称单数

e.en: He bought a hundred {shares} of Apple last week.
e.zh: 他上周买了一百股苹果股票。

e.en: She {shares} her notes with classmates before exams.
e.zh: 考试前她会把笔记分享给同学。

e.en: In the 90s, kids traded {shareware} games on floppy disks.
e.zh: 九十年代,孩子们用软盘交换共享软件游戏。

e.en: The tool started as {shareware} before going fully open source.
e.zh: 这款工具最初是共享软件,后来完全开源。

e.en: The country's legal system is partly based on {sharia} law.
e.zh: 该国的法律体系部分基于伊斯兰教法。

e.en: Scholars debated how {sharia} applies to modern banking.
e.zh: 学者们讨论了伊斯兰教法如何适用于现代银行业。

sharing.t:
n. 分享；共享
v. 分享（share 的现在分词）

e.en: Thanks for {sharing} that link in the group chat.
e.zh: 谢谢你在群聊里分享那个链接。

e.en: Kids learn the value of {sharing} from an early age.
e.zh: 孩子们从小就学到分享的重要性。

e.en: We took a short drive from Dubai to {Sharjah} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们周末从迪拜驱车短途前往沙迦。

e.en: {Sharjah} is known as the cultural capital of the Emirates.
e.zh: 沙迦被誉为阿联酋的文化之都。

shark.t:
n. 鲨鱼
n. 骗子；放高利贷者

e.en: Surfers spotted a {shark} just offshore yesterday.
e.zh: 冲浪者昨天在近岸处发现了一条鲨鱼。

e.en: He's a real card {shark} at the poker table.
e.zh: 在牌桌上他是个真正的扑克高手。

e.en: He wore a sleek {sharkskin} suit to the gala.
e.zh: 他穿着一身光滑的鲨鱼皮西装出席晚宴。

e.en: The jacket was made of soft, shimmering {sharkskin} fabric.
e.zh: 这件外套是用柔软闪亮的鲨鱼皮面料做的。

e.en: My friend {Sharon} just moved to Singapore for a new job.
e.zh: 我朋友莎伦刚搬到新加坡开始新工作。

e.en: The rose of {Sharon} blooms beautifully in late summer.
e.zh: 木槿花在夏末开得很美。

sharp.t:
adj. 锋利的；敏锐的
adv. 准时地；整

e.en: Be careful — that knife is incredibly {sharp}.
e.zh: 小心，那把刀非常锋利。

e.en: She gave a {sharp} reply that surprised everyone in the meeting.
e.zh: 她做出一个尖锐的回应，让会议上所有人吃惊。

e.en: I need to {sharpen} my pencils before the exam starts.
e.zh: 考试开始前我得把铅笔削尖。

e.en: Reading widely will {sharpen} your critical thinking skills.
e.zh: 广泛阅读会让你的批判性思维更敏锐。

sharpened.t:
adj. 削尖的
v. 削尖（过去式）

e.en: He {sharpened} the kitchen knives over the weekend.
e.zh: 他周末把厨房的刀都磨快了。

e.en: The training {sharpened} her instincts as a negotiator.
e.zh: 这次培训磨练了她作为谈判者的直觉。

e.en: The pencil {sharpener} on her desk was almost full.
e.zh: 她桌上的卷笔刀几乎装满了。

e.en: A good knife {sharpener} can extend the life of your blades.
e.zh: 一个好的磨刀器能延长刀具的使用寿命。

sharpening.t:
n. 磨利；锐化
v. 削尖（现在分词）

e.en: He spent the morning {sharpening} all the chef's knives.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在磨厨师刀。

e.en: Photo editing apps offer automatic {sharpening} to enhance details.
e.zh: 修图软件提供自动锐化功能来增强细节。

sharpie.t: n. 记号笔（品牌名，泛指马克笔）

e.en: Grab a black {sharpie} and label each cardboard box.
e.zh: 拿一支黑色记号笔，把每个纸箱都标上。

e.en: She signed the poster with a thick red {sharpie}.
e.zh: 她用一支粗的红色记号笔在海报上签名。

sharpish.t: adv. 赶快地；迅速地（英式口语）

e.en: You'd better leave {sharpish} if you want to catch the train.
e.zh: 你想赶上火车的话最好赶紧出发。

e.en: Finish your homework {sharpish}, dinner is almost ready.
e.zh: 快点把作业写完，晚饭快好了。

e.en: House prices have risen {sharply} over the past year.
e.zh: 过去一年房价急剧上涨。

e.en: She turned {sharply} and walked out of the room.
e.zh: 她猛地转身走出了房间。

sharpness.t: n. 锐度；锋利；（图像）清晰度

e.en: Test the {sharpness} of the blade before slicing the tomato.
e.zh: 切番茄前先测试一下刀刃的锋利度。

e.en: You can adjust the {sharpness} of the image in settings.
e.zh: 你可以在设置里调整图像的清晰度。

e.en: The army recruited him as a {sharpshooter} after his impressive scores.
e.zh: 由于成绩优异，军队招募他做神枪手。

e.en: She is the team's leading {sharpshooter} from beyond the arc.
e.zh: 她是球队三分线外最厉害的神射手。

shat.t: v. 拉屎（shit 的过去式，粗俗用法）

e.en: The dog {shat} all over the new carpet last night.
e.zh: 那只狗昨晚把新地毯弄得到处都是屎。

e.en: He joked that the bird {shat} on his windshield again.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说鸟又在他挡风玻璃上拉屎了。

e.en: One stray ball can {shatter} the living room window.
e.zh: 一颗乱飞的球就能把客厅窗户砸碎。

e.en: The bad news threatened to {shatter} her confidence completely.
e.zh: 那个坏消息几乎要彻底击碎她的信心。

shattered.t: adj. 破碎的；心力交瘁的

e.en: The vase fell and {shattered} into a hundred pieces.
e.zh: 花瓶掉下来摔成了上百片。

e.en: He was completely {shattered} after the all-night flight.
e.zh: 通宵飞行后他累得筋疲力尽。

e.en: The news of his death was absolutely {shattering} to the team.
e.zh: 他去世的消息让团队彻底崩溃。

e.en: There was a {shattering} crash as the mirror hit the floor.
e.zh: 镜子摔到地上发出震耳欲聋的碎裂声。

e.en: The film's ending was {shatteringly} beautiful and sad.
e.zh: 这部电影的结局美得令人心碎。

e.en: Her honesty was {shatteringly} direct during the interview.
e.zh: 她在采访中诚实得令人震撼。

shatterproof.t: adj. 防碎的；不易破裂的

e.en: Modern phone screens are designed to be nearly {shatterproof}.
e.zh: 现代手机屏幕设计成几乎防碎裂的。

e.en: The lab uses {shatterproof} glass for all dangerous experiments.
e.zh: 实验室所有危险实验都使用防碎玻璃。

shatters.t: v. 打碎；粉碎（第三人称单数）

e.en: A loud noise sometimes {shatters} the silence of the library.
e.zh: 有时一声巨响打破了图书馆的寂静。

e.en: Every dropped phone {shatters} a different way on the pavement.
e.zh: 每部掉在地上的手机碎得方式都不一样。

shave.t:
v. 剃须；剃毛
n. 刮脸

e.en: He likes to {shave} every morning before going to work.
e.zh: 他喜欢每天上班前刮胡子。

e.en: New software can {shave} hours off the daily reporting workflow.
e.zh: 新软件能把每日报表工作时间缩短好几小时。

shaved.t:
adj. 剃过的
v. 剃（过去式）

e.en: He {shaved} his beard off after growing it for a year.
e.zh: 他留了一年的胡子后把它刮掉了。

e.en: The salad came topped with {shaved} parmesan and pine nuts.
e.zh: 沙拉上面撒了刨成片的帕玛森芝士和松子。

e.en: He arrived clean-{shaven} and wearing a crisp blue suit.
e.zh: 他刮得干干净净，穿着笔挺的蓝西装到了。

e.en: The monks all had freshly {shaven} heads in the courtyard.
e.zh: 庭院里的僧人都刚刚剃光了头。

shaver.t: n. 剃须刀；电动刮胡刀

e.en: She bought him an electric {shaver} for his birthday.
e.zh: 她送他一个电动剃须刀作生日礼物。

e.en: The {shaver} needs charging before your morning routine.
e.zh: 早上用之前要先把剃须刀充好电。

shaves.t: v. 剃；刮（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {shaves} every other day to avoid skin irritation.
e.zh: 他每隔一天刮一次胡子以免皮肤过敏。

e.en: The new route {shaves} ten minutes off my commute.
e.zh: 这条新路线让我的通勤少了十分钟。

shaving.t:
n. 刮胡子；刨屑
v. 剃（现在分词）

e.en: He cut himself {shaving} in a hurry this morning.
e.zh: 今早他匆忙刮胡子时划伤了自己。

e.en: The bathroom shelf was crowded with {shaving} cream and razors.
e.zh: 浴室架上堆满了剃须膏和刮胡刀。

e.en: Wood {shavings} covered the carpenter's workshop floor.
e.zh: 木屑铺满了木匠工坊的地板。

e.en: Sprinkle chocolate {shavings} on top of the cappuccino.
e.zh: 在卡布奇诺上撒一些巧克力碎片。

e.en: She wrapped a warm {shawl} around her shoulders on the porch.
e.zh: 她在门廊上把一条暖和的披肩裹在肩上。

e.en: The handmade {shawl} was a gift from her grandmother.
e.zh: 那条手工披肩是她外婆送的礼物。

shea.t: n. 乳木果（shea butter 乳木果油）

e.en: This lotion contains {shea} butter to deeply moisturize dry skin.
e.zh: 这款润肤乳含乳木果油，能深层滋润干燥肌肤。

e.en: {Shea} trees grow widely across the savannas of West Africa.
e.zh: 乳木果树在西非的稀树草原上分布广泛。

sheaf.t: n. 一捆；一束（谷物、纸张等）

e.en: She carried a thick {sheaf} of papers into the meeting.
e.zh: 她抱着厚厚一叠文件走进了会议室。

e.en: The farmer tied each {sheaf} of wheat with twine.
e.zh: 农夫用麻绳把每捆小麦都扎好。

shear.t:
v. 剪；剪毛
n. 剪切力

e.en: Farmers usually {shear} their sheep once a year in spring.
e.zh: 农民通常每年春天给羊剪一次毛。

e.en: Strong winds can {shear} branches off old trees easily.
e.zh: 强风很容易把老树的枝条折断。

sheared.t:
v. 剪（过去式）
adj. 剪过毛的

e.en: The barber {sheared} off most of his long hair.
e.zh: 理发师剪掉了他大部分的长发。

e.en: She watched as the worker {sheared} the wool from the sheep.
e.zh: 她看着工人从羊身上剪下羊毛。

e.en: An experienced {shearer} can clip a sheep in under two minutes.
e.zh: 熟练的剪羊毛工不到两分钟就能剪完一只羊。

e.en: The {shearer} traveled from farm to farm during the season.
e.zh: 剪毛工在剪毛季节走遍各个农场。

shearing.t:
n. 剪毛；剪切
v. 剪（现在分词）

e.en: Sheep {shearing} season starts in early spring on the farm.
e.zh: 农场的剪羊毛季节从初春开始。

e.en: He spent the summer {shearing} sheep in the highlands.
e.zh: 他整个夏天都在高地剪羊毛。

shearling.t: n. 羊羔皮；未剪毛的羔羊

e.en: Her cozy {shearling} coat kept her warm all winter.
e.zh: 她那件舒适的羊毛外套让她整个冬天都暖暖的。

e.en: He bought {shearling} boots for the trip to Iceland.
e.zh: 他买了一双羊毛靴去冰岛旅行。

e.en: I'm allergic to {shellfish}, so no shrimp please.
e.zh: 我对贝类过敏,所以请不要放虾。

e.en: This restaurant serves the freshest {shellfish} in town.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应全城最新鲜的贝类海鲜。

shelling.t:
n. 炮击
v. 剥壳

e.en: Heavy {shelling} damaged the hospital overnight.
e.zh: 夜间的猛烈炮击毁坏了那家医院。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {shelling} fresh walnuts.
e.zh: 她一下午都在剥新鲜的核桃。

e.en: The kids collected colorful {shells} along the beach.
e.zh: 孩子们沿着海滩捡了不少彩色贝壳。

e.en: Artillery {shells} exploded near the abandoned factory.
e.zh: 炮弹在废弃工厂附近爆炸。

shelter.t:
n. 避难所；庇护
v. 庇护

e.en: They ran for {shelter} when the storm started.
e.zh: 暴风雨开始时,他们跑去找避难所。

e.en: The animal {shelter} is looking for volunteers.
e.zh: 动物收容所正在招募志愿者。

e.en: She had a very {sheltered} childhood in the countryside.
e.zh: 她在乡下度过了非常受呵护的童年。

e.en: They {sheltered} from the rain under a big tree.
e.zh: 他们在一棵大树下躲雨。

e.en: Families are {sheltering} in the school gymnasium tonight.
e.zh: 今晚许多家庭在学校体育馆里避难。

e.en: The cliff was {sheltering} hikers from the strong wind.
e.zh: 那道悬崖为登山者挡住了强风。

e.en: The city built new {shelters} for homeless residents.
e.zh: 市政府为无家可归者建造了新的庇护所。

e.en: Bus {shelters} were damaged by last night's storm.
e.zh: 昨晚的暴风雨损坏了公交候车亭。

shelton.t: n. 人名/地名 谢尔顿

e.en: {Shelton} hit a home run in the ninth inning.
e.zh: 谢尔顿在第九局击出了一支全垒打。

e.en: We drove through {Shelton} on the way north.
e.zh: 我们北上时途经谢尔顿。

e.en: The studio decided to {shelve} the film indefinitely.
e.zh: 片方决定无限期搁置这部电影。

e.en: Please {shelve} these returned books before lunch.
e.zh: 请在午饭前把这些归还的书上架。

e.en: The project was {shelved} due to budget cuts.
e.zh: 由于预算削减,该项目被搁置了。

e.en: She {shelved} the new arrivals in the fiction section.
e.zh: 她把新到的书摆放到了小说区的书架上。

shelves.t:
n. 架子（复数）
v. 搁置

e.en: The library {shelves} were packed with old novels.
e.zh: 图书馆的书架上摆满了旧小说。

e.en: New stock {shelves} every Friday at this store.
e.zh: 这家商店每周五都会上新货上架。

shelving.t:
n. 搁架；架子材料
v. 搁置

e.en: We installed metal {shelving} in the garage yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天在车库里装了金属置物架。

e.en: They are {shelving} the proposal until next year.
e.zh: 他们将这项提案搁置到明年再议。

e.en: Not a single {shenanigan} will be tolerated tonight.
e.zh: 今晚绝不容忍任何胡闹行为。

e.en: That last {shenanigan} nearly got him fired.
e.zh: 上次的那种胡闹差点让他被解雇。

e.en: The kids got up to all sorts of {shenanigans}.
e.zh: 那些孩子们搞出了各种各样的恶作剧。

e.en: Investigators uncovered financial {shenanigans} at the firm.
e.zh: 调查人员揭发了该公司的财务舞弊行为。

e.en: The {sheng} produces a haunting sound in Chinese opera.
e.zh: 笙在中国戏曲中能发出悠远动人的声音。

e.en: He learned to play the {sheng} as a child.
e.zh: 他从小就学会了吹笙。

shepherd.t:
n. 牧羊人
v. 引导；照看

e.en: The {shepherd} led his flock down the hillside.
e.zh: 那位牧羊人领着他的羊群下山。

e.en: She will {shepherd} the bill through congress next week.
e.zh: 她下周将引导这项法案通过国会。

e.en: The {shepherdess} guided her flock across the green hillside.
e.zh: 那位牧羊女带领羊群穿过青翠的山坡。

e.en: In the painting, a young {shepherdess} rests beneath an oak tree.
e.zh: 画中一位年轻的牧羊女在橡树下休息。

e.en: The mentor {shepherds} new employees through their first month.
e.zh: 这位导师带领新员工度过第一个月。

e.en: Two {shepherds} watched the sheep from the rocky ridge.
e.zh: 两位牧羊人在岩石山脊上看护羊群。

e.en: The name {Sher} appears in many South Asian families.
e.zh: Sher 这个名字在许多南亚家庭中常见。

e.en: My friend {Sher} just moved to Toronto for work.
e.zh: 我朋友 Sher 刚为工作搬到多伦多。

e.en: We booked a room at the {Sheraton} near the airport.
e.zh: 我们在机场附近的喜来登订了一间房。

e.en: The conference will be held at the downtown {Sheraton} next week.
e.zh: 会议下周将在市中心的喜来登举行。

e.en: I ordered raspberry {sherbet} for dessert on the hot afternoon.
e.zh: 炎热的下午我点了覆盆子果汁冰沙作甜点。

e.en: The kids shared a bowl of orange {sherbet} after dinner.
e.zh: 孩子们晚饭后一起吃了一碗橙味果子露。

e.en: Archaeologists labeled each pottery {sherd} found at the dig site.
e.zh: 考古学家给挖掘现场发现的每块陶片做了标记。

e.en: A small {sherd} of glazed ceramic lay in the soil.
e.zh: 一小块上釉陶片躺在泥土里。

e.en: The county {sheriff} held a press conference about the case.
e.zh: 县治安官就案件召开了新闻发布会。

e.en: The {sheriff} pulled the speeding car over near the highway.
e.zh: 治安官在高速公路附近把超速的车拦了下来。

sherifves.t: (罕用) n. sheriff 的旧式复数

e.en: Old English ballads sometimes spell the plural as {sherifves}.
e.zh: 古英语民谣里有时把复数拼作 sherifves。

e.en: The medieval text mentions several {sherifves} riding to court.
e.zh: 那份中世纪文献提到几位郡守骑马前往朝廷。

e.en: Nice work, {sherlock} — the milk was in the fridge.
e.zh: 真厉害啊大侦探，牛奶就在冰箱里。

e.en: She played a modern {sherlock} solving cybercrime cases.
e.zh: 她饰演一位破解网络犯罪案件的现代福尔摩斯。

sherpa.t: n. 夏尔巴人（喜马拉雅向导）

e.en: A local {sherpa} guided the climbers up Everest safely.
e.zh: 一位当地夏尔巴向导安全地带领登山者登上珠峰。

e.en: My financial advisor is basically my {sherpa} through tax season.
e.zh: 我的理财顾问基本就是我报税季的引路人。

e.en: He kicked the {sherrin} cleanly through the goalposts.
e.zh: 他干净利落地把那只澳式足球踢过球门柱。

e.en: Every kid in Melbourne grew up tossing a {sherrin} around.
e.zh: 墨尔本的孩子从小都会玩那种澳式橄榄球。

e.en: Grandma always pours a small glass of {sherry} after dinner.
e.zh: 奶奶饭后总要倒一小杯雪利酒。

e.en: This recipe calls for a splash of dry {sherry}.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要加一点干雪利酒。

sherwood.t: n. 地名/人名 舍伍德

e.en: Robin Hood famously hid in {sherwood} Forest.
e.zh: 罗宾汉以藏身于舍伍德森林而闻名。

e.en: We hiked through {sherwood} on our trip to Nottingham.
e.zh: 我们去诺丁汉时徒步穿过了舍伍德森林。

shetland.t: n. 设得兰群岛；设得兰羊毛

e.en: She knitted a warm sweater from soft {shetland} wool.
e.zh: 她用柔软的设得兰羊毛织了一件暖和的毛衣。

e.en: A tiny {shetland} pony trotted across the field.
e.zh: 一匹小小的设得兰矮种马跑过田野。

e.en: The {shetlanders} are proud of their Norse heritage.
e.zh: 设得兰人为自己的北欧血统感到自豪。

e.en: Local {shetlanders} celebrate Up Helly Aa every January.
e.zh: 当地的设得兰人每年一月都庆祝火把节。

shew.t:
v. show 的古体
n. 展示

e.en: The old Bible verse reads, "{shew} thyself a man."
e.zh: 那段古旧的圣经经文写道：拿出男子汉的样子来。

e.en: Shakespeare's plays often {shew} characters wrestling with fate.
e.zh: 莎士比亚的戏剧常展现人物与命运的搏斗。

e.en: Iran has a majority {shia} Muslim population.
e.zh: 伊朗人口以什叶派穆斯林为主。

e.en: The mosque serves both Sunni and {shia} worshippers.
e.zh: 这座清真寺同时接待逊尼派和什叶派信众。

e.en: A {shiatsu} massage really helped my shoulder pain.
e.zh: 一次指压按摩真的缓解了我的肩痛。

e.en: She's training to become a certified {shiatsu} therapist.
e.zh: 她正在培训成为一名认证的指压治疗师。

shibboleth.t: n. 口令；陈词滥调；圈内暗语

e.en: "Free markets solve everything" is a tired political {shibboleth}.
e.zh: 自由市场万能论是个早已过时的政治口号。

e.en: Pronouncing that word is a regional {shibboleth} in Boston.
e.zh: 那个词的发音是波士顿地区的身份暗号。

e.en: The shepherd built a stone {shiel} on the hillside.
e.zh: 牧羊人在山坡上建了一座石头小屋。

e.en: They sheltered overnight in an abandoned Highland {shiel}.
e.zh: 他们在一座废弃的高地牧人小屋里过了一夜。

shield.t:
n. 盾牌；防护罩
v. 保护

e.en: Sunscreen helps {shield} your skin from harmful UV rays.
e.zh: 防晒霜有助于保护皮肤免受有害紫外线伤害。

e.en: The knight raised his {shield} to block the arrow.
e.zh: 骑士举起盾牌挡住了箭。

e.en: A {shearwater} glided low over the waves at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时分一只鹱低低地掠过海浪。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {shearwater} off the rocky coast.
e.zh: 观鸟者在礁石海岸外发现了一只罕见的鹱。

sheath.t:
n. 鞘；护套
n. 紧身连衣裙

e.en: He slid the knife back into its leather {sheath}.
e.zh: 他把刀重新插回皮制刀鞘里。

e.en: She wore an elegant black {sheath} dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一条优雅的黑色直筒连衣裙参加晚宴。

e.en: The warrior bowed and chose to {sheathe} his sword.
e.zh: 武士鞠了一躬，选择把剑收回鞘中。

e.en: Workers will {sheathe} the building in glass next month.
e.zh: 工人下个月将给大楼装上玻璃外墙。

sheathed.t: adj. 装入鞘的；有护套的

e.en: He {sheathed} his knife and walked quietly away.
e.zh: 他把刀入鞘，默默地走开了。

e.en: The skyscraper was {sheathed} entirely in reflective glass panels.
e.zh: 那栋摩天大楼整体覆盖着反光玻璃幕墙。

sheathing.t:
n. 护套；外包层
v. 装鞘（sheathe 的现在分词）

e.en: Workers added plywood {sheathing} to the exterior walls of the house.
e.zh: 工人在房屋外墙加上了胶合板覆面。

e.en: He was {sheathing} his sword as the duel ended.
e.zh: 决斗结束时他正把剑收入鞘中。

e.en: Farmers stacked the {sheaves} of wheat in the field.
e.zh: 农民们把一捆捆麦子堆在田里。

e.en: She carried {sheaves} of paper from the printer to her desk.
e.zh: 她把一沓沓纸从打印机搬到桌上。

e.en: The Queen of {Sheba} visited King Solomon, according to legend.
e.zh: 传说中，示巴女王曾拜访所罗门王。

e.en: He named his cat {Sheba} after the ancient queen.
e.zh: 他用古代女王的名字给猫取名为示巴。

shebang.t:
n. 整件事；全套（the whole shebang）
n. 脚本首行 #! 符号

e.en: The {shebang} line tells Linux which interpreter to run the script.
e.zh: shebang 行告诉 Linux 用哪个解释器运行脚本。

e.en: He bought the whole {shebang} for under fifty dollars.
e.zh: 他花不到五十美元就把整套东西全买下了。

shed.t:
n. 棚屋；小屋
v. 脱落；流下

e.en: He keeps his bike and tools in the garden {shed}.
e.zh: 他把自行车和工具放在花园棚屋里。

e.en: The company plans to {shed} two hundred jobs next quarter.
e.zh: 公司计划下个季度裁减两百个职位。

shedding.t:
v. 脱落；掉毛
n. 脱落物

e.en: My golden retriever is {shedding} fur all over the couch.
e.zh: 我家金毛在沙发上到处掉毛。

e.en: The startup is {shedding} costs to survive the downturn.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在削减开支以渡过经济低迷期。

sheds.t:
n. 棚屋（复数）
v. 脱落（第三人称单数）

e.en: The snake {sheds} its skin several times a year.
e.zh: 蛇一年要蜕几次皮。

e.en: Behind the farmhouse stood three wooden tool {sheds}.
e.zh: 农舍后面有三间木制工具棚。

e.en: The polished marble floor had a beautiful {sheen}.
e.zh: 抛光的大理石地板泛着漂亮的光泽。

e.en: Her hair has a healthy {sheen} after the new treatment.
e.zh: 用了新护理产品后，她的头发显得很有光泽。

e.en: A flock of {sheep} grazed peacefully on the hillside.
e.zh: 一群羊在山坡上安静地吃草。

e.en: Don't be a {sheep} and just follow whatever everyone posts.
e.zh: 别像羊一样，别人发什么你就跟着发什么。

e.en: The border collie is a brilliant {sheepdog}.
e.zh: 边境牧羊犬是一种非常聪明的牧羊犬。

e.en: Their {sheepdog} can herd a hundred sheep by itself.
e.zh: 他们家的牧羊犬能独自赶上百只羊。

e.en: At dusk the shepherd led the flock back to the {sheepfold}.
e.zh: 黄昏时分，牧羊人把羊群赶回羊圈。

e.en: A wolf had broken into the {sheepfold} during the night.
e.zh: 夜里有一只狼闯进了羊圈。

e.en: The {sheepherder} guided the flock across the valley.
e.zh: 那位牧羊人领着羊群穿过山谷。

e.en: He worked as a {sheepherder} in Wyoming for years.
e.zh: 他在怀俄明州做了多年的牧羊人。

e.en: He gave a {sheepish} grin after forgetting her name.
e.zh: 忘了她的名字后,他露出了不好意思的笑容。

e.en: She looked {sheepish} when caught eating the cake.
e.zh: 被发现偷吃蛋糕时,她显得有些尴尬。

e.en: He {sheepishly} admitted he had broken the vase.
e.zh: 他不好意思地承认是自己打破了花瓶。

e.en: She smiled {sheepishly} when her phone rang loudly.
e.zh: 手机大声响起时,她羞赧地笑了一下。

e.en: They caught a large {sheepshead} off the pier.
e.zh: 他们在码头边钓到了一条大羊头鲷。

e.en: The {sheepshead} has unusually human-like teeth.
e.zh: 羊头鲷长着异常像人类的牙齿。

e.en: He wore a warm {sheepskin} jacket all winter.
e.zh: 他整个冬天都穿着一件暖和的羊皮夹克。

e.en: The boots are lined with soft {sheepskin}.
e.zh: 这双靴子内衬是柔软的羊皮。

sheer.t:
adj. 纯粹的；十足的
adj. 陡峭的；极薄的

e.en: The climbers stared up at the {sheer} cliff face.
e.zh: 登山者抬头望着那道陡峭的悬崖。

e.en: Winning was a matter of {sheer} luck.
e.zh: 赢下比赛纯粹是靠运气。

e.en: The wall dropped {sheerly} into the canyon below.
e.zh: 那堵墙陡直地落入下方的峡谷。

e.en: He survived {sheerly} by chance, nothing more.
e.zh: 他完全是靠运气才活下来的。

e.en: The {sheerness} of the cliff made climbing impossible.
e.zh: 悬崖的陡峭让攀登变得不可能。

e.en: She admired the {sheerness} of the silk curtains.
e.zh: 她欣赏那丝绸窗帘的轻薄通透。

sheet.t:
n. 床单；一张（纸）
n. 表格；工作表

e.en: Please put a clean {sheet} on the bed.
e.zh: 请在床上铺一张干净的床单。

e.en: He printed the report on a single {sheet}.
e.zh: 他把报告打印在了一张纸上。

e.en: Plastic {sheeting} covered the unfinished roof overnight.
e.zh: 塑料薄膜把未完工的屋顶盖了一夜。

e.en: The workers laid metal {sheeting} along the wall.
e.zh: 工人们沿墙铺设了金属板材。

e.en: He hung new {sheetrock} in the basement himself.
e.zh: 他自己在地下室装上了新的石膏板。

e.en: The contractor patched the damaged {sheetrock} quickly.
e.zh: 承包商很快补好了损坏的石膏板。

e.en: I changed the {sheets} before our guests arrived.
e.zh: 客人到来之前我换好了床单。

e.en: She handed me two {sheets} of blank paper.
e.zh: 她递给我两张白纸。

sheffield.t: n. 谢菲尔德（英国城市）

e.en: {Sheffield} is famous for its high-quality steel.
e.zh: 谢菲尔德以其优质钢材而闻名。

e.en: He grew up in {Sheffield} in northern England.
e.zh: 他在英格兰北部的谢菲尔德长大。

e.en: The {sheik} welcomed the diplomats into his palace.
e.zh: 那位酋长把外交官们迎进了他的宫殿。

e.en: A wealthy {sheik} funded the new university.
e.zh: 一位富有的酋长资助了这所新大学。

e.en: The tiny {sheikdom} grew rich from oil exports.
e.zh: 这个小酋长国靠石油出口致富。

e.en: He ruled the {sheikdom} for over forty years.
e.zh: 他统治了这个酋长国四十多年。

e.en: The {sheikh} owns several luxury hotels in Dubai.
e.zh: 这位酋长在迪拜拥有几家豪华酒店。

e.en: A respected {sheikh} delivered the Friday sermon.
e.zh: 一位受人尊敬的酋长发表了周五的讲道。

shekel.t: n. 谢克尔（以色列货币）

e.en: The price was listed in {shekel} on the menu.
e.zh: 菜单上的价格是以谢克尔标示的。

e.en: One {shekel} is worth about thirty US cents.
e.zh: 一谢克尔大约值三十美分。

shelbourne.t: n. 谢尔本（地名/酒店名）

e.en: We had afternoon tea at the {Shelbourne} hotel.
e.zh: 我们在谢尔本酒店享用了下午茶。

e.en: The {Shelbourne} is a Dublin landmark since 1824.
e.zh: 谢尔本酒店自1824年起便是都柏林的地标。

e.en: A pair of {sheldrake} glided across the pond.
e.zh: 一对麻鸭悠然地划过池塘。

e.en: The {sheldrake} is known for its bright plumage.
e.zh: 这种麻鸭以其鲜艳的羽毛著称。

e.en: A {shelduck} nested near the riverbank this spring.
e.zh: 今年春天有一只麻鸭在河岸附近筑巢。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {shelduck} on the lake.
e.zh: 观鸟者在湖上发现了一只罕见的麻鸭。

e.en: Please put the book back on the top {shelf}.
e.zh: 请把书放回最上面的架子上。

e.en: The product has a six-month {shelf} life.
e.zh: 该产品的保质期为六个月。

e.en: We took the train to {Shelford} for the picnic.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去谢尔福德野餐。

e.en: {Shelford} is a quiet village near Cambridge.
e.zh: 谢尔福德是剑桥附近一个安静的村庄。

shell.t:
n. 外壳；贝壳
n. 命令行/终端（shell）

e.en: The turtle pulled its head into its {shell}.
e.zh: 那只乌龟把头缩进了壳里。

e.en: Open a terminal {shell} and run the command.
e.zh: 打开一个终端窗口并运行该命令。

shellac.t:
n. 虫胶；紫胶漆
v. 涂虫胶；彻底击败

e.en: He applied a coat of {shellac} to the table.
e.zh: 他给桌子涂了一层虫胶清漆。

e.en: The home team will {shellac} their rivals tonight.
e.zh: 主队今晚会把对手打得落花流水。

shellacked.t: v. 涂上虫胶；惨败（过去式）

e.en: Our team got completely {shellacked} in the finals.
e.zh: 我们队在决赛中被打得一败涂地。

e.en: He {shellacked} the wooden floor to a glossy finish.
e.zh: 他把木地板涂上虫胶,显得光亮如新。

shelled.t:
adj. 去壳的；有壳的
v. 炮击（过去式）

e.en: She {shelled} peas while watching the evening news.
e.zh: 她一边看晚间新闻一边剥豌豆。

e.en: The town was {shelled} repeatedly during the war.
e.zh: 战争期间该镇多次遭到炮轰。

e.en: The village was reduced to rubble by {shellfire}.
e.zh: 那个村庄被炮火炸成了一片废墟。

e.en: Soldiers took cover from the heavy {shellfire}.
e.zh: 士兵们躲避着猛烈的炮火。

e.en: An old {shipman} told tales of storms in the North Atlantic.
e.zh: 一位老水手讲述着北大西洋上的风暴故事。

e.en: Chaucer's {shipman} appears in The Canterbury Tales.
e.zh: 乔叟的《坎特伯雷故事集》里有一个船夫角色。

e.en: The {shipmaster} signed the customs documents at dawn.
e.zh: 船长在黎明时分签署了海关文件。

e.en: As {shipmaster}, she is responsible for the entire crew's safety.
e.zh: 作为船长，她要对全体船员的安全负责。

e.en: My old {shipmate} from the navy is visiting next week.
e.zh: 我以前在海军时的老战友下周要来看我。

e.en: He shared a cabin with his {shipmate} for six months.
e.zh: 他和同船战友共用一间舱室长达六个月。

e.en: The {shipment} of laptops should arrive by Thursday.
e.zh: 那批笔记本电脑应该会在周四前送达。

e.en: Customs delayed the {shipment} for an extra two weeks.
e.zh: 海关把这批货物又多扣了两周。

e.en: The Greek {shipowner} controls one of the world's largest fleets.
e.zh: 这位希腊船东掌控着世界上最大的船队之一。

e.en: Each {shipowner} must carry adequate liability insurance.
e.zh: 每位船东都必须购买足额的责任保险。

shipped.t: v. 已发货（ship 的过去式）

e.en: Your order has been {shipped} and will arrive Monday.
e.zh: 您的订单已发货，预计周一送达。

e.en: The team finally {shipped} version 2.0 after months of delays.
e.zh: 团队在拖延数月后终于发布了 2.0 版本。

e.en: The {shipper} provided real-time tracking for every package.
e.zh: 这家承运商为每个包裹提供实时追踪。

e.en: Choose a reliable {shipper} for fragile international parcels.
e.zh: 易碎的国际包裹要选一家可靠的承运商。

shipping.t:
n. 运输；航运
n. 船运费

e.en: Free {shipping} applies to orders over fifty dollars.
e.zh: 订单满五十美元享受免费送货。

e.en: Global {shipping} costs surged during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间全球航运成本大幅飙升。

e.en: Multiple {shippings} per week strain the small warehouse team.
e.zh: 每周多次发货让仓库小团队压力很大。

e.en: Track all your {shippings} from one unified dashboard.
e.zh: 在一个统一的面板上追踪你所有的发货记录。

ships.t:
n. 船只（复数）
v. 发货

e.en: Cargo {ships} pass through the Suez Canal every day.
e.zh: 每天都有货船穿过苏伊士运河。

e.en: Our team {ships} new features every two weeks.
e.zh: 我们团队每两周就会发布新功能。

shipshape.t: adj. 井然有序的；整洁的

e.en: Make sure the kitchen is {shipshape} before the guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人来之前要把厨房收拾得整整齐齐。

e.en: After a weekend of cleaning, the apartment was finally {shipshape}.
e.zh: 打扫了一个周末，公寓终于井井有条了。

e.en: The {shipworm} bored through the wooden hull below the waterline.
e.zh: 船蛆在吃水线以下钻穿了木制船体。

e.en: Sailors used copper plating to protect ships from {shipworm}.
e.zh: 水手们用铜皮包船来防止船蛆蛀蚀。

shipwreck.t:
n. 海难；失事船只
v. 使船只失事

e.en: Divers discovered an ancient {shipwreck} off the Greek coast.
e.zh: 潜水员在希腊海岸附近发现了一艘古代沉船。

e.en: The novel describes a dramatic {shipwreck} in the Caribbean.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了发生在加勒比海的一场惊心动魄的海难。

e.en: The crew was {shipwrecked} on a deserted Pacific island.
e.zh: 船员们在太平洋的一座荒岛上遭遇了海难。

e.en: Robinson Crusoe was {shipwrecked} for nearly thirty years.
e.zh: 鲁滨逊在荒岛上漂流了将近三十年。

e.en: The Mediterranean is full of historic {shipwrecks} waiting to be found.
e.zh: 地中海里到处都是等着被发现的历史沉船。

e.en: Storms last winter caused several {shipwrecks} along the coast.
e.zh: 去年冬天的风暴在沿海造成了几起海难。

e.en: The {shipwright} carefully measured each plank for the new yacht.
e.zh: 造船工仔细测量了新游艇的每一块船板。

e.en: Few traditional {shipwright} skills survive in modern shipyards.
e.zh: 如今的造船厂里很少还有传统造船工艺保留下来。

e.en: The {shipyard} employs over five thousand local workers.
e.zh: 这家造船厂雇用了五千多名当地工人。

e.en: A massive container ship is being built at the {shipyard}.
e.zh: 一艘巨型集装箱船正在那家船厂建造。

shiraz.t: n. 西拉（葡萄品种／红酒）

e.en: She ordered a glass of Australian {shiraz} with her steak.
e.zh: 她点了一杯澳洲西拉葡萄酒配牛排。

e.en: The historic city of {Shiraz} is famous for its gardens and poetry.
e.zh: 古城设拉子以其花园和诗歌而闻名。

e.en: He grew up in a quiet English {shire} near Oxford.
e.zh: 他在牛津附近一个安静的英国郡里长大。

e.en: Frodo left the peaceful {Shire} to begin his journey.
e.zh: 佛罗多离开了宁静的夏尔，开始了他的旅程。

e.en: A good leader doesn't {shirk} responsibility when things go wrong.
e.zh: 好的领导者在出问题时不会逃避责任。

e.en: He never {shirks} his share of the housework.
e.zh: 他从不偷懒推掉自己那份家务。

e.en: He spilled coffee all over his white {shirt}.
e.zh: 他把咖啡洒了一身在白衬衫上。

e.en: This cotton {shirt} is comfortable for hot summer days.
e.zh: 这件棉衬衫在炎热的夏天穿起来很舒服。

e.en: She wore a navy {shirtdress} with white sneakers to brunch.
e.zh: 她穿着海军蓝衬衫裙配小白鞋去吃早午餐。

e.en: A linen {shirtdress} is perfect for hot office days.
e.zh: 亚麻衬衫裙非常适合炎热的上班日。

e.en: He wiped sauce off his {shirtfront} with a napkin.
e.zh: 他用餐巾擦掉衬衫前襟上的酱汁。

e.en: His tie was crooked and his {shirtfront} wrinkled.
e.zh: 他的领带歪了，衬衫前襟皱皱巴巴。

shirtless.t: adj. 未穿衬衫的；赤膊的

e.en: Tourists wandered {shirtless} along the beach all afternoon.
e.zh: 游客们整个下午都光着上身在海滩上闲逛。

e.en: He went for a {shirtless} run in the summer heat.
e.zh: 他在夏日的酷热中光着膀子去跑步。

e.en: I bought three new {shirts} during the online sale.
e.zh: 我在网上促销时买了三件新衬衫。

e.en: The team's jerseys are technically polo {shirts}, not jerseys.
e.zh: 球队的队服严格来说是 POLO 衫，不是球衣。

e.en: He rolled up a {shirtsleeve} to check his watch.
e.zh: 他卷起一只衬衫袖子看了看手表。

e.en: The CEO took a {shirtsleeve} approach, working alongside the team.
e.zh: 这位 CEO 作风务实，亲自和团队一起干活。

e.en: His {shirttail} was hanging out the back of his pants.
e.zh: 他的衬衫下摆从裤子后面露了出来。

e.en: Tuck in your {shirttail} before the interview starts.
e.zh: 面试开始前把你的衬衫下摆塞进去。

e.en: She wore a vintage {shirtwaist} dress to the garden party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条复古的衬衫式连衣裙去花园派对。

e.en: The catalog featured a classic white {shirtwaist} with pearl buttons.
e.zh: 目录里有一件经典的白色衬衫式上衣，配珍珠扣。

shirty.t: adj. 生气的；恼火的（英式口语）

e.en: Don't get {shirty} with me just because you're tired.
e.zh: 别因为累了就对我发脾气。

e.en: He turned {shirty} when the waiter forgot his order.
e.zh: 服务员忘了他的点单，他立刻变得不耐烦起来。

shit.t:
n. 屎；废话（粗俗）
int. 该死

e.en: Oh {shit}, I left my keys in the car.
e.zh: 糟了，我把钥匙落在车里了。

e.en: This movie is total {shit} — don't waste your time.
e.zh: 这部电影烂透了，别浪费时间。

shite.t: n. shit 的变体（英／爱尔兰俚语）

e.en: That new app is absolute {shite} — it crashes constantly.
e.zh: 那个新应用烂得要命，老是崩溃。

e.en: He talks a load of {shite} when he's drunk.
e.zh: 他喝醉了就满嘴胡话。

e.en: Some {shithead} keyed my car in the parking lot.
e.zh: 有个混蛋在停车场用钥匙划了我的车。

e.en: Stop being such a {shithead} to your little brother.
e.zh: 别再这么混账地对你弟弟了。

shithouse.t: n. 厕所；糟糕之处（粗俗）

e.en: The hotel was a complete {shithouse} — never staying again.
e.zh: 那家酒店烂得一塌糊涂，再也不去了。

e.en: His driving skills are absolutely {shithouse} in the rain.
e.zh: 他在雨天的驾驶技术烂到家了。

shitless.t: adv. 吓得屁滚尿流（粗俗）

e.en: That horror movie scared me {shitless} for days.
e.zh: 那部恐怖片把我吓得好几天缓不过来。

e.en: I was bored {shitless} during the three-hour lecture.
e.zh: 那场三小时的讲座把我无聊到极点。

e.en: The {shitter} on the second floor is broken again.
e.zh: 二楼的厕所又坏了。

e.en: My old laptop is a real {shitter} — time to upgrade.
e.zh: 我那台旧笔记本真是个废物，该换了。

shitty.t: adj. 糟糕的；恶心的（粗俗）

e.en: I had a really {shitty} day at work today.
e.zh: 我今天上班过得超级糟糕。

e.en: The Wi-Fi here is {shitty} — pages barely load.
e.zh: 这里的无线网烂得不行，网页几乎打不开。

shiv.t: n. 自制小刀（狱中俚语）

e.en: Guards confiscated a homemade {shiv} from the inmate's cell.
e.zh: 狱警从囚犯牢房里没收了一把自制小刀。

e.en: He pulled a {shiv} from his sleeve during the fight.
e.zh: 打架时他从袖子里抽出一把小刀。

shiva.t:
n. 湿婆（印度教神）
n. 犹太守丧期

e.en: The family is sitting {shiva} for their grandmother.
e.zh: 全家人正在为祖母守丧七日。

e.en: Friends visited the home during {shiva} to offer comfort.
e.zh: 朋友们在守丧期间登门慰问。

shiver.t:
v. 颤抖；打寒战
n. 寒战

e.en: The cold wind made me {shiver} all over.
e.zh: 冷风吹得我浑身发抖。

e.en: That horror movie sent a {shiver} down my spine.
e.zh: 那部恐怖片让我脊背一阵发凉。

e.en: She {shivered} as she stepped out of the pool.
e.zh: 她从泳池出来时冷得直发抖。

e.en: The puppy {shivered} in the cold rain.
e.zh: 小狗在冷雨中瑟瑟发抖。

e.en: The kids were {shivering} after swimming too long.
e.zh: 孩子们游了太久,冷得直打哆嗦。

e.en: He stood {shivering} at the bus stop.
e.zh: 他在公交站冻得直发抖。

shivers.t:
n. 寒颤
v. 颤抖

e.en: That song still gives me {shivers} every time.
e.zh: 那首歌每次都让我起鸡皮疙瘩。

e.en: She {shivers} whenever the door opens.
e.zh: 每次门一开她就打个寒战。

shivery.t: adj. 发抖的；令人寒战的

e.en: I felt a bit {shivery} and went to bed early.
e.zh: 我有点发冷,就早早睡了。

e.en: The cabin felt cold and {shivery} at dawn.
e.zh: 破晓时小木屋又冷又让人发抖。

sho.t: adv. sure 的方言写法；当然

shoal.t:
n. 浅滩
n. 鱼群

e.en: A {shoal} of fish darted past the diver.
e.zh: 一群鱼从潜水员身边迅速游过。

e.en: The boat ran aground on a sandy {shoal}.
e.zh: 船在一片浅沙滩上搁浅了。

e.en: Tourists arrived in {shoals} during the festival.
e.zh: 节日期间游客成群结队地涌来。

e.en: Sailors marked the dangerous {shoals} on their charts.
e.zh: 水手们在海图上标出了危险的浅滩。

e.en: The farmer raised a {shoat} for next year's market.
e.zh: 农夫养着一头小猪准备明年出栏。

e.en: A young {shoat} squealed loudly in the pen.
e.zh: 一头小猪在圈里大声尖叫。

shock.t:
n. 震惊；冲击
v. 使震惊

e.en: The news came as a complete {shock} to everyone.
e.zh: 这消息让所有人都大吃一惊。

e.en: Don't touch that wire or you'll get a {shock}.
e.zh: 别碰那根电线,否则会触电。

e.en: I was {shocked} when I saw the price tag.
e.zh: 看到价签的时候我惊呆了。

e.en: She looked {shocked} but quickly composed herself.
e.zh: 她看上去很震惊,但很快镇定下来。

shielded.t:
adj. 屏蔽的，受保护的
v. shield 的过去式

e.en: Parents {shielded} the kids from the disturbing news.
e.zh: 父母不让孩子接触那些令人不安的新闻。

e.en: The cable is {shielded} to prevent electromagnetic interference.
e.zh: 这根电缆带屏蔽层，可以防止电磁干扰。

shielding.t:
n. 屏蔽层；防护
v. 保护（shield 的现在分词）

e.en: She held up a magazine, {shielding} her eyes from the sun.
e.zh: 她举起一本杂志，遮住眼睛挡太阳。

e.en: The reactor's lead {shielding} blocks dangerous radiation.
e.zh: 反应堆的铅屏蔽层能阻挡危险的辐射。

shields.t:
n. 盾牌；防护罩（复数）
v. 保护

e.en: A good VPN {shields} your browsing data from snoopers.
e.zh: 好的 VPN 能保护你的浏览数据不被偷窥。

e.en: Roman soldiers locked their {shields} into a tight wall.
e.zh: 罗马士兵将盾牌紧密相连组成盾墙。

shift.t:
v. 切换，转移
n. 班次；Shift 键

e.en: I work the night {shift} at the hospital this week.
e.zh: 我这周在医院上夜班。

e.en: Public opinion began to {shift} after the debate.
e.zh: 辩论之后，公众舆论开始转变。

shifted.t: v. 转移了，切换了（shift 的过去式）

e.en: The company {shifted} its focus to mobile apps last year.
e.zh: 公司去年把重心转向了移动应用。

e.en: She {shifted} uncomfortably in her chair during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时她在椅子上不自在地动来动去。

e.en: The gear {shifter} on my bike feels loose lately.
e.zh: 我自行车的变速器最近感觉松动了。

e.en: He's a real shape-{shifter} — different around every crowd.
e.zh: 他真是个变色龙，在不同人群面前都不一样。

e.en: There was a {shiftiness} in his eyes that made me uneasy.
e.zh: 他眼神里那种闪烁让我心里发毛。

e.en: The salesman's {shiftiness} convinced us to walk away.
e.zh: 那销售员鬼鬼祟祟的样子让我们决定走开。

shifting.t:
v. 转移，变换
adj. 变化的，不稳定的

e.en: Consumer habits are {shifting} rapidly toward online shopping.
e.zh: 消费者习惯正迅速转向网购。

e.en: The {shifting} sands made it hard to walk on the dune.
e.zh: 流动的沙子让人很难在沙丘上行走。

e.en: His {shiftless} brother hasn't held a job in years.
e.zh: 他那游手好闲的弟弟好多年没正经工作了。

e.en: The novel's hero is a charming but {shiftless} drifter.
e.zh: 小说的主角是个迷人却懒散的浪荡汉。

shifts.t:
n. 班次；转变（复数）
v. 转移

e.en: Nurses often work twelve-hour {shifts} on weekends.
e.zh: 护士周末经常要上十二小时的班。

e.en: Her mood {shifts} quickly when she's hungry.
e.zh: 她饿的时候情绪转变得很快。

e.en: Years of {shiftwork} disrupted his sleep schedule.
e.zh: 多年的轮班工作打乱了他的作息。

e.en: Many factory employees rely on {shiftwork} for higher pay.
e.zh: 许多工厂员工靠轮班工作赚取更高的工资。

shifty.t: adj. 狡猾的，眼神闪烁的

e.en: That guy at the bar looks really {shifty} — let's leave.
e.zh: 酒吧里那个人看着鬼鬼祟祟的，我们走吧。

e.en: Avoid {shifty} websites that ask for too much personal info.
e.zh: 避开那些索要太多个人信息的可疑网站。

e.en: Contaminated water spread the {shigella} outbreak across the village.
e.zh: 被污染的水让志贺氏菌疫情在村里扩散开。

e.en: Doctors confirmed the diarrhea was caused by {shigella} bacteria.
e.zh: 医生确认那次腹泻是由志贺氏菌引起的。

shigellosis.t: n. 志贺菌感染；细菌性痢疾

e.en: Travelers can catch {shigellosis} from unsafe street food.
e.zh: 游客可能因吃不卫生的街头食物而感染志贺菌病。

e.en: Severe {shigellosis} usually requires antibiotics and hydration.
e.zh: 严重的志贺菌病通常需要抗生素和补液治疗。

e.en: Our {shih} tzu loves chasing squirrels in the yard.
e.zh: 我们家的西施犬最喜欢在院子里追松鼠。

e.en: The {shih} tzu puppy fell asleep on my lap.
e.zh: 那只西施犬幼犬在我腿上睡着了。

e.en: Sauté the {shiitake} mushrooms with garlic and soy sauce.
e.zh: 用蒜和酱油炒一下香菇。

e.en: Fresh {shiitake} adds a deep umami flavor to soup.
e.zh: 新鲜的香菇能给汤增添浓郁的鲜味。

shiite.t:
n. 什叶派穆斯林
adj. 什叶派的

e.en: The town is home to a small {shiite} community.
e.zh: 这个小镇住着一个小型的什叶派穆斯林社区。

e.en: He grew up in a devout {shiite} family in Iraq.
e.zh: 他在伊拉克一个虔诚的什叶派家庭长大。

e.en: His grandmother disapproved when he married a {shiksa}.
e.zh: 他娶了个非犹太裔姑娘，奶奶很不满意。

e.en: The sitcom jokes about a Jewish boy dating a {shiksa}.
e.zh: 那部情景喜剧拿犹太男孩和非犹太女孩约会开玩笑。

shill.t:
n. 托儿，媒子
v. 为…吹捧拉客

e.en: That influencer is just a paid {shill} for the brand.
e.zh: 那个网红不过是品牌花钱请来的托儿。

e.en: Don't {shill} crypto coins to your followers without disclosure.
e.zh: 别不打招呼就向粉丝吹捧加密货币。

e.en: The old Irishman carried a polished {shillelagh} for protection.
e.zh: 那位老爱尔兰人随身带着一根光亮的爱尔兰木棒防身。

e.en: A {shillelagh} hung above the fireplace as a family heirloom.
e.zh: 壁炉上方挂着一根爱尔兰木棒，是家族传家宝。

shilling.t: n. 先令（旧英国货币单位）

e.en: My grandfather used to earn just a {shilling} a day.
e.zh: 我祖父过去一天只能挣一个先令。

e.en: Critics accuse the senator of {shilling} for big oil companies.
e.zh: 批评者指责那位参议员替大石油公司站台。

shim.t:
n. 垫片，衬垫
v. 用垫片垫

e.en: Slide a thin {shim} under the door to stop it rattling.
e.zh: 在门下塞一片薄垫片，门就不会咯吱响了。

e.en: The library includes a {shim} for older browsers.
e.zh: 这个库提供了一个兼容旧版浏览器的垫片。

shimmer.t:
v. 闪烁微光
n. 微光，闪光

e.en: Heat made the desert highway {shimmer} in the distance.
e.zh: 高温让远处的沙漠公路闪烁着波光。

e.en: Her dress had a soft {shimmer} under the stage lights.
e.zh: 她的裙子在舞台灯光下泛着柔和的光泽。

shimmered.t: v. 发出微光（shimmer 的过去式）

e.en: The lake {shimmered} silver in the early morning light.
e.zh: 清晨的阳光下，湖面闪着银色的光。

e.en: Her gold earrings {shimmered} every time she turned her head.
e.zh: 她每转一次头，金耳环就闪烁一次。

shimmering.t:
adj. 闪烁的，微光的
v. 闪烁（现在分词）

e.en: A {shimmering} curtain of rain swept across the valley.
e.zh: 一片闪着光的雨幕扫过山谷。

e.en: She wore a {shimmering} silver dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一条闪闪发光的银色礼服去参加晚会。

shimmers.t:
v. 闪烁微光（第三人称单数）
n. 微光（复数）

e.en: The pool {shimmers} beautifully under the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 午后阳光下，泳池波光粼粼，十分好看。

e.en: This eyeshadow has tiny gold {shimmers} mixed in.
e.zh: 这款眼影里掺着细小的金色闪粉。

e.en: She wore a {shimmery} dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一条闪亮的连衣裙去参加晚会。

e.en: The lake had a {shimmery} surface at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时湖面波光粼粼。

shimmy.t:
v. 摇摆，扭动身体
n. 抖动

e.en: The car began to {shimmy} at high speeds.
e.zh: 汽车在高速行驶时开始抖动。

e.en: She did a quick {shimmy} on the dance floor.
e.zh: 她在舞池里扭了一下身子。

shin.t:
n. 小腿，胫
v. 攀爬

e.en: He bruised his {shin} on the coffee table.
e.zh: 他在茶几上撞青了小腿。

e.en: Soccer players wear pads to protect the {shin}.
e.zh: 足球运动员戴护具来保护小腿。

e.en: She fractured her {shinbone} during the soccer match.
e.zh: 她在足球比赛中摔断了胫骨。

e.en: The doctor pressed gently on his {shinbone}.
e.zh: 医生轻轻按压他的胫骨。

e.en: They threw a huge {shindig} for her birthday.
e.zh: 他们为她的生日办了一场盛大派对。

e.en: The neighborhood {shindig} lasted until midnight.
e.zh: 社区聚会一直热闹到半夜。

shine.t:
v. 发光，照耀
n. 光泽

e.en: Polish the silver until the spoons {shine}.
e.zh: 把银器擦到勺子闪闪发亮。

e.en: Her talent really gets to {shine} on stage.
e.zh: 她的才华在舞台上得以充分展现。

shined.t: v. 擦亮了（鞋等，shine 的过去式）

e.en: He {shined} his shoes before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前他把皮鞋擦得锃亮。

e.en: The flashlight {shined} into the dark cave.
e.zh: 手电筒照进了漆黑的山洞里。

e.en: He came home with a nasty {shiner} after the fight.
e.zh: 打架后他回家时眼眶青了一大块。

e.en: She covered the {shiner} with concealer.
e.zh: 她用遮瑕膏盖住了那只熊猫眼。

shines.t: v. 发光，擦亮（第三人称单数）

e.en: The sun {shines} brightly through my bedroom window.
e.zh: 阳光透过卧室窗户灿烂地照进来。

e.en: She really {shines} when presenting in front of clients.
e.zh: 她在客户面前做演示时特别出彩。

shingle.t:
n. 屋面板，木瓦
v. 铺瓦

e.en: A loose {shingle} on the roof started leaking during the storm.
e.zh: 屋顶一块松动的瓦片在暴风雨中开始漏水。

e.en: After law school he hung out his {shingle} downtown.
e.zh: 法学院毕业后，他在市中心挂牌开了律师事务所。

shingled.t:
adj. 铺有木瓦的
v. 铺瓦（过去式）

e.en: The cottage was {shingled} with weathered cedar.
e.zh: 这座小屋铺着风化的雪松木瓦。

e.en: She wore her hair in a {shingled} bob from the 1920s.
e.zh: 她留着 1920 年代风格的层次短发。

shingles.t:
n. 带状疱疹
n. 屋面板（复数）

e.en: The contractor replaced all the damaged roof {shingles}.
e.zh: 承包商更换了屋顶上所有受损的瓦片。

e.en: My grandmother got {shingles} after a stressful year.
e.zh: 奶奶在压力很大的一年后得了带状疱疹。

shining.t:
adj. 闪耀的，杰出的
v. 发光（现在分词）

e.en: The lake was {shining} under the morning sun.
e.zh: 湖面在晨光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: She is a {shining} example of what hard work can achieve.
e.zh: 她是努力工作所能成就的光辉榜样。

shinny.t:
v. 攀爬
n. 简易冰球

e.en: The kids played {shinny} on the frozen pond all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们在结冰的池塘上打了一下午野冰球。

e.en: He tried to {shinny} up the flagpole on a dare.
e.zh: 他在打赌之下试着爬上旗杆。

e.en: He drives a {shiny} new electric car to work.
e.zh: 他开着一辆崭新锃亮的电动车上班。

e.en: Don't get distracted by every {shiny} new tech trend.
e.zh: 别被每一个新潮的科技趋势带偏注意力。

ship.t:
n. 船，舰
v. 发货，运输

e.en: The cargo {ship} docked at the port early this morning.
e.zh: 那艘货轮今天清早停靠在港口。

e.en: We plan to {ship} the new feature by next Friday.
e.zh: 我们计划下周五前发布这个新功能。

shipboard.t:
adj. 船上的
n. 船上

e.en: Life on {shipboard} can be both exciting and exhausting.
e.zh: 船上生活既刺激又让人疲惫。

e.en: The captain hosted a {shipboard} party for the crew.
e.zh: 船长在船上为全体船员举办了一场派对。

shipbuilder.t: n. 造船工人，造船公司

e.en: His grandfather was a {shipbuilder} in the Glasgow yards.
e.zh: 他祖父曾在格拉斯哥的造船厂当造船工。

e.en: The Korean {shipbuilder} just won a huge LNG carrier order.
e.zh: 那家韩国造船商刚刚拿下一笔巨额液化天然气船订单。

shipbuilders.t: n. 造船工人，造船企业（复数）

e.en: Japanese {shipbuilders} dominated the industry in the 1980s.
e.zh: 日本造船商在 1980 年代主导了整个行业。

e.en: Local {shipbuilders} protested the proposed tariffs on steel.
e.zh: 当地造船商抗议拟议中的钢铁关税。

e.en: {Shipbuilding} has long been a pillar industry in Busan.
e.zh: 造船业长期以来都是釜山的支柱产业。

e.en: The town's economy collapsed after {shipbuilding} moved overseas.
e.zh: 造船业转移海外后，这座小镇的经济陷入崩溃。

shipload.t: n. 一船的货物（或乘客）

e.en: A whole {shipload} of bananas arrived at the harbor today.
e.zh: 一整船香蕉今天运抵港口。

e.en: The factory ordered a {shipload} of raw lithium from Chile.
e.zh: 工厂从智利订购了一整船的锂原料。

shocker.t: n. 令人震惊的事或人

e.en: The season finale was a real {shocker}.
e.zh: 那季的大结局真是出人意料。

e.en: His sudden resignation was quite a {shocker}.
e.zh: 他突然辞职让人大跌眼镜。

shocking.t: adj. 令人震惊的；骇人的

e.en: The documentary revealed some {shocking} statistics.
e.zh: 那部纪录片揭露了一些惊人的数据。

e.en: Her behavior at the party was simply {shocking}.
e.zh: 她在派对上的表现简直令人震惊。

e.en: The exam was {shockingly} easy this year.
e.zh: 今年的考试简单得让人意外。

e.en: He spoke {shockingly} rude words to his boss.
e.zh: 他对老板说了非常无礼的话。

shocks.t:
n. 冲击；震惊
v. 使震惊

e.en: The car needs new {shocks} after that bumpy road.
e.zh: 那段烂路开下来,这车的减震器得换了。

e.en: Nothing {shocks} her after twenty years of nursing.
e.zh: 当了二十年护士,什么事都吓不到她。

e.en: The explosion sent a {shockwave} through the city.
e.zh: 爆炸的冲击波席卷了整座城市。

e.en: His arrest sent a {shockwave} through the industry.
e.zh: 他被捕的消息在业界引发巨大震动。

shod.t: adj. 穿着鞋的（shoe 的过去分词）

e.en: The horses were freshly {shod} before the long ride.
e.zh: 马匹在长途骑行前刚换了新蹄铁。

e.en: The hikers were well {shod} for the rocky trail.
e.zh: 徒步者穿着结实的鞋应对碎石路。

e.en: The apartment was {shoddily} built and leaks everywhere.
e.zh: 这套公寓盖得很糙,到处都漏水。

e.en: The report was {shoddily} written and full of errors.
e.zh: 那份报告写得粗制滥造,错误百出。

e.en: The {shoddiness} of the repair work was obvious.
e.zh: 这次维修做得有多敷衍一目了然。

e.en: Customers complained about the {shoddiness} of the product.
e.zh: 顾客抱怨产品做工粗劣。

shoddy.t: adj. 粗制滥造的；劣质的

e.en: I returned the lamp because of {shoddy} workmanship.
e.zh: 我因为做工粗糙把那盏灯退掉了。

e.en: The contractor was fired for doing {shoddy} work.
e.zh: 那个承包商因为活儿干得太差被解雇了。

e.en: There's a stone stuck in my {shoe}.
e.zh: 我鞋里卡了一颗小石子。

e.en: She tried on every {shoe} in the store.
e.zh: 她把店里每一双鞋都试了一遍。

e.en: I keep old letters in a {shoebox} under my bed.
e.zh: 我把旧信件放在床下的鞋盒里。

e.en: Their first apartment was the size of a {shoebox}.
e.zh: 他们的第一套公寓只有鞋盒那么大。

shoehorn.t:
n. 鞋拔
v. 硬塞进

e.en: Don't try to {shoehorn} extra features into the app.
e.zh: 别硬把多余的功能塞进这个应用里。

e.en: She used a {shoehorn} to slip on her boots.
e.zh: 她用鞋拔子把靴子套上。

e.en: His {shoelace} came untied during the race.
e.zh: 比赛途中他的鞋带散开了。

e.en: Tie your {shoelace} before you trip.
e.zh: 系好鞋带,别绊倒了。

e.en: The kids ran {shoeless} through the wet grass.
e.zh: 孩子们光着脚在湿草地上奔跑。

e.en: He answered the door {shoeless} and sleepy.
e.zh: 他光着脚、睡眼惺忪地去开门。

e.en: The local {shoemaker} repaired my favorite boots.
e.zh: 街角的鞋匠修好了我最爱的靴子。

e.en: Her grandfather worked as a {shoemaker} in the village.
e.zh: 她爷爷在村里当鞋匠。

e.en: Please take off your {shoes} before entering the house.
e.zh: 进屋前请先脱鞋。

e.en: I wouldn't want to be in his {shoes} right now.
e.zh: 我现在可不想处在他的位置上。

e.en: He paid for a quick {shoeshine} at the airport.
e.zh: 他在机场花钱擦了一下皮鞋。

e.en: The old {shoeshine} stand still operates downtown.
e.zh: 市中心那个老擦鞋摊还在营业。

e.en: They produced the film on a {shoestring} budget.
e.zh: 他们用极少的预算拍出了这部电影。

e.en: My {shoestring} snapped on the way to work.
e.zh: 上班路上我的鞋带断了。

e.en: The rabbi blew the {shofar} on Rosh Hashanah.
e.zh: 拉比在犹太新年吹响了羊角号。

e.en: A long blast from the {shofar} ended the service.
e.zh: 羊角号一声长鸣结束了仪式。

e.en: The {shogun} ruled Japan for centuries from Edo.
e.zh: 幕府将军在江户统治日本数百年。

e.en: That novel dramatizes the rise of a powerful {shogun}.
e.zh: 那本小说生动描写了一位幕府将军的崛起。

e.en: Soft light filtered through the paper {shoji} screens.
e.zh: 柔和的光线透过纸糊的障子门洒进来。

e.en: She slid the {shoji} open to reveal the garden.
e.zh: 她推开障子门,庭院映入眼帘。

e.en: Many people in Zimbabwe speak {Shona} at home.
e.zh: 津巴布韦许多人在家里讲绍纳语。

e.en: The museum displayed traditional {Shona} stone sculptures.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了传统的绍纳石雕。

shone.t: v. 发光；照耀（shine 的过去式）

e.en: The sun {shone} brightly all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午阳光灿烂。

e.en: Her eyes {shone} with excitement when she heard the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息,她两眼放光。

shoo.t:
v. 嘘走；赶走
int. 嘘

e.en: She tried to {shoo} the pigeons off the balcony.
e.zh: 她想把鸽子从阳台上赶走。

e.en: Mom would {shoo} us out of the kitchen at dinnertime.
e.zh: 晚饭时妈妈总把我们从厨房里赶出去。

shook.t: v. 摇动；震惊（shake 的过去式）

e.en: He {shook} my hand firmly when we met.
e.zh: 我们见面时他用力握了我的手。

e.en: The earthquake {shook} the entire building violently.
e.zh: 地震把整栋楼摇得剧烈晃动。

shoot.t:
v. 射击；拍摄
n. 拍摄；嫩芽

e.en: We're going to {shoot} the music video tomorrow.
e.zh: 我们明天要拍这支音乐视频。

e.en: Tiny green {shoot} appeared in the garden.
e.zh: 花园里冒出了一棵嫩绿的新芽。

e.en: The team had a light {shootaround} before tip-off.
e.zh: 球队在开赛前进行了简单的赛前投篮训练。

e.en: He skipped the morning {shootaround} due to a sore ankle.
e.zh: 由于脚踝酸痛,他缺席了上午的赛前练投。

e.en: The {shooter} was apprehended by police within minutes.
e.zh: 枪手在几分钟内就被警方抓获。

e.en: She's the team's best three-point {shooter}.
e.zh: 她是队里最厉害的三分射手。

shooting.t:
n. 枪击；拍摄
v. 射击

e.en: They are {shooting} the new season in Vancouver.
e.zh: 他们正在温哥华拍摄新一季。

e.en: A {shooting} star streaked across the night sky.
e.zh: 一颗流星划过夜空。

e.en: The city saw a sharp drop in {shootings} this year.
e.zh: 今年该市的枪击案件明显减少。

e.en: News of the {shootings} dominated headlines all week.
e.zh: 枪击事件的新闻占据了整周的头条。

e.en: The match was decided in a dramatic penalty {shootout}.
e.zh: 比赛在激动人心的点球大战中分出胜负。

e.en: A {shootout} between police and robbers blocked the highway.
e.zh: 警匪枪战把高速公路堵住了。

shoots.t:
v. 射击；拍摄
n. 嫩芽

e.en: The photographer {shoots} weddings on most weekends.
e.zh: 这位摄影师大多数周末都拍婚礼。

e.en: New bamboo {shoots} appear in the garden every spring.
e.zh: 每年春天花园里都会冒出新的竹笋。

shop.t:
n. 商店
v. 购物

e.en: Let's {shop} for groceries before the store closes.
e.zh: 我们趁商店关门前去买点食品吧。

e.en: There's a small coffee {shop} on the corner.
e.zh: 街角有一家小咖啡店。

e.en: My sister is a total {shopaholic} during sales season.
e.zh: 我妹妹在打折季完全就是个购物狂。

e.en: Online deals turn even careful spenders into a {shopaholic}.
e.zh: 网上折扣能把谨慎的消费者也变成购物狂。

e.en: The bakery's {shopfront} is decorated with fairy lights.
e.zh: 那家面包店的店面挂满了彩灯。

e.en: A bright {shopfront} attracts more customers from the street.
e.zh: 明亮的店面能从街上吸引更多顾客。

e.en: The {shopgirl} kindly helped me find the right size.
e.zh: 那位女店员热心地帮我找到合适的尺码。

e.en: She worked as a {shopgirl} while finishing college.
e.zh: 她一边读完大学,一边做女店员。

e.en: The {shopkeeper} greeted every customer with a warm smile.
e.zh: 店主用温暖的微笑迎接每一位顾客。

e.en: A friendly {shopkeeper} remembers what regulars usually buy.
e.zh: 友善的店主会记得熟客常买什么。

e.en: Local {shopkeepers} are worried about rising rent prices.
e.zh: 本地店主们对不断上涨的租金感到担忧。

e.en: Many {shopkeepers} closed early due to the heavy snow.
e.zh: 许多店主因大雪提前关门了。

e.en: Teenagers sometimes {shoplift} on a dare from friends.
e.zh: 青少年有时会因朋友怂恿而行窃。

e.en: It's illegal to {shoplift} even small, inexpensive items.
e.zh: 即使偷小件便宜商品也是违法的。

e.en: He {shoplifted} a candy bar and immediately felt guilty.
e.zh: 他偷了一根糖果棒,马上就感到内疚。

e.en: Several items were {shoplifted} from the cosmetics aisle yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天化妆品区有几件商品被偷了。

e.en: The security guard caught a {shoplifter} near the exit.
e.zh: 保安在出口附近抓住了一名小偷。

e.en: A repeat {shoplifter} was banned from the entire mall.
e.zh: 一名惯偷被禁止进入整个购物中心。

e.en: Cameras help store owners identify {shoplifters} quickly.
e.zh: 摄像头帮助店主快速识别店铺扒手。

e.en: Most {shoplifters} target small, easily hidden products.
e.zh: 大多数扒手专挑容易藏起来的小件商品。

shoplifting.t: n. 商店行窃；顺手牵羊

e.en: {Shoplifting} costs retailers billions of dollars each year.
e.zh: 店铺盗窃每年让零售商损失数十亿美元。

e.en: She was arrested for {shoplifting} a designer handbag.
e.zh: 她因偷窃一只名牌手提包而被捕。

e.en: Reported {shopliftings} have doubled in the downtown area.
e.zh: 市中心地区的盗窃案件数量翻了一番。

e.en: The chain documented hundreds of {shopliftings} last quarter alone.
e.zh: 该连锁店仅上季度就记录了数百起盗窃案。

shoplifts.t: v. 在商店行窃（第三人称单数）

e.en: Whenever he {shoplifts}, the alarm seems to go off.
e.zh: 每次他行窃,警报似乎都会响起。

e.en: Anyone who {shoplifts} here will be prosecuted immediately.
e.zh: 任何在此行窃者将立即被起诉。

shoppe.t: n. 小店（shop 的古旧拼法）

e.en: The old village has a quaint tea {shoppe}.
e.zh: 这个古老的村庄里有一家古色古香的茶馆。

e.en: Tourists love the antique {shoppe} on Main Street.
e.zh: 游客们喜欢主街上的那家古董店。

e.en: We {shopped} online for hours during the Black Friday sale.
e.zh: 黑五大促时我们在网上购物逛了好几个小时。

e.en: She {shopped} her novel to several major publishers.
e.zh: 她把小说推介给了几家大出版社。

e.en: Every {shopper} received a free tote bag at checkout.
e.zh: 每位顾客在结账时都收到了一个免费手提袋。

e.en: She's a careful {shopper} who always compares prices.
e.zh: 她是个精打细算的顾客,总会货比三家。

e.en: Holiday {shoppers} crowded the mall from morning till night.
e.zh: 假日购物者从早到晚挤满了商场。

e.en: Online {shoppers} expect free shipping and quick delivery.
e.zh: 网购用户期待免运费和快速送达。

shopping.t:
n. 购物
v. 购物

e.en: I'm going {shopping} for new running shoes today.
e.zh: 我今天要去买双新跑鞋。

e.en: Online {shopping} has changed how people buy clothes.
e.zh: 网上购物改变了人们买衣服的方式。

e.en: You {should} drink more water during long flights.
e.zh: 长途飞行中你应该多喝水。

e.en: We {should} leave now if we want to catch the train.
e.zh: 如果我们想赶上火车,现在就该出发了。

shoulder.t:
n. 肩膀
v. 承担（责任）

e.en: She tapped my {shoulder} to get my attention in the crowd.
e.zh: 她在人群中拍了拍我的肩膀以引起我的注意。

e.en: The driver pulled onto the {shoulder} after the tire blew out.
e.zh: 轮胎爆了之后司机把车开到了路肩上。

shouldered.t: v. 扛起；承担（shoulder 的过去式）

e.en: She {shouldered} the heavy backpack and started up the trail.
e.zh: 她背起沉重的背包,开始往山路走。

e.en: The team leader {shouldered} the blame for the failed launch.
e.zh: 团队负责人为这次失败的发布承担了责任。

shoulders.t:
n. 肩膀（复数）
v. 承担（第三人称单数）

e.en: Years of stress had tightened the muscles in his {shoulders}.
e.zh: 多年的压力让他的肩膀肌肉变得紧绷。

e.en: She {shoulders} most of the household responsibilities while studying.
e.zh: 她一边读书一边承担着家里大部分家务。

shout.t:
v. 大声喊叫
n. 喊叫声

e.en: Please don't {shout} at the kids when they make mistakes.
e.zh: 孩子犯错时请不要冲他们大喊大叫。

e.en: She gave a quick {shout} on Twitter to thank her supporters.
e.zh: 她在推特上简短发文感谢了她的支持者们。

shouted.t: v. 喊叫（shout 的过去式）

e.en: The coach {shouted} instructions across the noisy basketball court.
e.zh: 教练在嘈杂的篮球场上大声喊出指令。

e.en: He {shouted} her name from the platform as the train left.
e.zh: 火车开走时他在站台上喊着她的名字。

e.en: The morning host is a real {shouter} who never lowers his voice.
e.zh: 早间节目主持人真是个嗓门大王,从不放低音量。

e.en: Every protest seems to attract one loud {shouter} near the front.
e.zh: 每次抗议似乎前排都会有一个特别爱大喊的人。

shouting.t:
v. 正在喊叫
n. 呼喊声

e.en: The neighbors were {shouting} at each other again last night.
e.zh: 昨晚邻居们又互相大吵大叫起来。

e.en: All caps in chat reads like you're {shouting} at people.
e.zh: 聊天里全用大写字母看起来像在对人吼叫。

shouts.t:
n. 喊叫声（复数）
v. 喊叫（第三人称单数）

e.en: Loud {shouts} from the stadium echoed through the entire neighborhood.
e.zh: 体育场传来的喊声响彻了整个街区。

e.en: She always {shouts} when her favorite team scores a goal.
e.zh: 每当她喜欢的球队进球时她都会大叫。

shove.t:
v. 猛推；乱塞
n. 推搡

e.en: Don't {shove} people on the subway during rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰时段在地铁里不要推搡别人。

e.en: He gave the stuck door a hard {shove} and it opened.
e.zh: 他用力推了一下卡住的门,门就开了。

shovel.t:
n. 铲子
v. 铲起

e.en: I need a sturdy {shovel} to dig up these tree roots.
e.zh: 我需要一把结实的铁锹来挖这些树根。

e.en: Please don't {shovel} food into your mouth so quickly.
e.zh: 请别把食物大口大口地往嘴里塞。

e.en: He {shoveled} the driveway clear after the heavy snowstorm.
e.zh: 暴风雪过后他把车道上的雪铲干净了。

e.en: The hungry kid {shoveled} pasta into his mouth without speaking.
e.zh: 那个饥饿的孩子一句话不说,把意大利面大口往嘴里送。

shoveler.t: n. 铲东西的人；琵嘴鸭

e.en: The northern {shoveler} is a duck known for its broad bill.
e.zh: 北方琵嘴鸭是一种以宽喙闻名的鸭子。

e.en: He's a fast {shoveler} who clears the sidewalk in minutes.
e.zh: 他铲雪很快,几分钟就能把人行道清干净。

e.en: She tossed a {shovelful} of dirt onto the garden bed.
e.zh: 她把一铲泥土扔到花圃里。

e.en: He added another {shovelful} of coal to the old furnace.
e.zh: 他又往旧炉子里加了一铲煤。

shoving.t: v. 推挤；乱塞（shove 的现在分词）

e.en: Stop {shoving} your brother every time he walks past you.
e.zh: 别每次你弟弟经过都推他。

e.en: Fans started {shoving} each other near the stage during the concert.
e.zh: 演唱会上观众在舞台附近开始互相推搡。

show.t:
v. 显示；展示
n. 节目；演出

e.en: Can you {show} me how to use this new app?
e.zh: 你能教我怎么用这个新应用吗?

e.en: My favorite cooking {show} streams every Thursday night on Netflix.
e.zh: 我最爱的烹饪节目每周四晚在 Netflix 上线。

showbiz.t: n. 演艺界；娱乐圈（口语）

e.en: After ten years in {showbiz}, she finally won her first award.
e.zh: 在演艺圈打拼十年后,她终于拿到了第一个奖。

e.en: My uncle has worked in {showbiz} since the late seventies.
e.zh: 我叔叔从七十年代末就一直在演艺圈工作。

showbizs.t: n. showbiz 的非标准复数（罕用）

e.en: Different countries' {showbizs} share many of the same hidden problems.
e.zh: 不同国家的演艺圈都有许多相似的隐藏问题。

e.en: Comparing the Korean and American {showbizs} reveals fascinating cultural differences.
e.zh: 对比韩国和美国的演艺圈能看出有趣的文化差异。

showboat.t:
v. 卖弄；爱出风头
n. 演艺船

e.en: The young striker is a {showboat} who loves fancy goal celebrations.
e.zh: 这位年轻前锋很爱表现,喜欢花式庆祝进球。

e.en: Don't {showboat} on the court when your team is losing badly.
e.zh: 球队大比分落后时别在场上炫耀技术。

showboating.t: v. 爱表现；卖弄（showboat 的现在分词）

e.en: The coach benched him for {showboating} during the final minutes.
e.zh: 教练因他在最后几分钟炫技把他换下了场。

e.en: Fans love a little {showboating} when their team is winning easily.
e.zh: 球队大比分领先时,球迷喜欢看一些炫技动作。

e.en: She has spent forty years working in {showbusiness}.
e.zh: 她在演艺事业中已经工作了四十年。

e.en: Breaking into {showbusiness} requires both talent and luck.
e.zh: 想进入演艺圈既需要才华也需要运气。

showcase.t:
n. 展示橱窗
v. 展示；突出呈现

e.en: The new gallery will {showcase} young artists from across Asia.
e.zh: 这家新画廊将展出来自亚洲各地的年轻艺术家作品。

e.en: This portfolio is a {showcase} of her best design work.
e.zh: 这份作品集展示了她最优秀的设计作品。

showcases.t:
n. 陈列柜（复数）
v. 展示（第三人称单数）

e.en: The festival {showcases} indie films from over thirty countries.
e.zh: 该电影节展映来自三十多个国家的独立电影。

e.en: Her resume {showcases} years of leadership in tech startups.
e.zh: 她的简历展示了多年在科技创业公司的领导经验。

e.en: Tonight's match is a {showdown} between the league's top two teams.
e.zh: 今晚的比赛是联赛前两名球队的巅峰对决。

e.en: The CEOs are heading for a {showdown} over company strategy.
e.zh: 两位首席执行官正因公司战略走向最终摊牌。

showed.t: v. 显示（show 的过去式）

e.en: She {showed} me her vacation photos from Iceland yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天给我看了她在冰岛拍的度假照片。

e.en: The data {showed} a clear increase in mobile traffic last quarter.
e.zh: 数据显示上一季度移动端流量明显增长。

shower.t:
n. 淋浴；阵雨
v. 洗澡；倾泻

e.en: I usually take a quick {shower} after my morning run.
e.zh: 我通常晨跑后会快速冲个澡。

e.en: A light {shower} interrupted our picnic in the park.
e.zh: 一阵小雨打断了我们在公园的野餐。

showered.t: v. 洗过澡；大量给予（shower 的过去式）

e.en: She {showered} and got dressed before her early flight.
e.zh: 她在赶早班机前洗了澡并换好衣服。

e.en: Fans {showered} the singer with flowers after the concert.
e.zh: 演唱会后歌迷向歌手献上了无数鲜花。

e.en: I replaced the old {showerhead} with a high-pressure model.
e.zh: 我把旧的花洒换成了一个高压花洒。

e.en: The hotel {showerhead} barely produced any water pressure at all.
e.zh: 酒店的花洒几乎没有什么水压。

showering.t: v. 洗澡；大量给予（shower 的现在分词）

e.en: He was {showering} when the delivery guy rang the doorbell.
e.zh: 快递员按门铃的时候他正在洗澡。

e.en: The crowd kept {showering} the actress with compliments after the play.
e.zh: 演出后观众不停地向那位女演员献上赞美。

showers.t:
n. 淋浴；阵雨（复数）
v. 洗澡（第三人称单数）

e.en: Spring {showers} in Tokyo can last for several days straight.
e.zh: 东京的春雨有时会连续下好几天。

e.en: The gym {showers} were crowded after the morning spin class.
e.zh: 早上的动感单车课后,健身房的淋浴间挤满了人。

e.en: The forecast calls for a cool, {showery} weekend across the region.
e.zh: 预报显示本地区周末天气凉爽多阵雨。

e.en: London in April is often {showery} and unpredictable.
e.zh: 四月的伦敦常常阵雨不断,天气难料。

e.en: The {showgirl} performed nightly at the famous Las Vegas casino.
e.zh: 那位歌舞女郎每晚都在著名的拉斯维加斯赌场表演。

e.en: She trained for years to become a Broadway {showgirl}.
e.zh: 她训练多年才成为百老汇的歌舞女郎。

e.en: Crowds gathered at the {showground} for the annual county fair.
e.zh: 人群聚集在展览场参加一年一度的县集市。

e.en: The {showground} was packed with livestock and food stalls.
e.zh: 展览场上挤满了牲畜和小吃摊。

showier.t: adj. 更炫耀的；更花哨的（showy 的比较级）

e.en: Her new dress is much {showier} than the old one.
e.zh: 她的新裙子比旧的那件华丽得多。

e.en: He prefers subtle designs over {showier} fashion trends.
e.zh: 比起浮夸的时尚潮流,他更喜欢低调的设计。

showiest.t: adj. 最花哨的（showy 的最高级）

e.en: She wore the {showiest} dress at the entire gala.
e.zh: 她在整场晚会上穿了最炫目的礼服。

e.en: Peacocks have the {showiest} feathers of any bird.
e.zh: 孔雀拥有所有鸟类中最华丽的羽毛。

showing.t:
v. 正在展示
n. 表现；放映

e.en: The film is {showing} at our local cinema this weekend.
e.zh: 这部电影本周末在当地影院上映。

e.en: His grades are {showing} steady improvement this semester.
e.zh: 他的成绩这学期呈现稳步提升。

e.en: She won a gold medal in {showjumping} at the Olympics.
e.zh: 她在奥运会马术障碍赛中赢得了金牌。

e.en: {Showjumping} requires excellent communication between rider and horse.
e.zh: 马术障碍赛需要骑手与马之间的默契配合。

showman.t: n. 善于表演的人；演艺人

e.en: P.T. Barnum was the most famous {showman} of his era.
e.zh: 巴纳姆是他那个时代最著名的演艺家。

e.en: The magician was a true {showman} who captivated every audience.
e.zh: 那位魔术师是真正的表演家,迷住了每一位观众。

showmanship.t: n. 表演才能；舞台功力

e.en: His {showmanship} on stage made the concert unforgettable.
e.zh: 他在舞台上的表演功力让那场演唱会令人难忘。

e.en: Great chefs combine cooking skill with theatrical {showmanship}.
e.zh: 出色的厨师将烹饪技艺与戏剧化表演结合在一起。

shown.t: v. 显示（show 的过去分词）

e.en: The data has {shown} a clear upward trend this year.
e.zh: 数据显示今年呈现明显的上升趋势。

e.en: He has {shown} great patience throughout the difficult project.
e.zh: 在这个艰难的项目中,他表现出了极大的耐心。

e.en: The new stadium is the {showpiece} of the city's redevelopment.
e.zh: 新体育场是这座城市重建工程的代表作。

e.en: Her vintage car is the {showpiece} of the collection.
e.zh: 她的老爷车是那个收藏中的镇馆之宝。

e.en: The mansion became a {showplace} for the wealthy family's art.
e.zh: 那座豪宅成了这个富裕家族艺术品的展示之地。

e.en: Their renovated garden is a real {showplace} for tourists.
e.zh: 他们翻新的花园成了游客眼中的胜景。

e.en: The new electric cars are on display in the {showroom}.
e.zh: 新款电动汽车正在展厅内展出。

e.en: She browsed the furniture {showroom} looking for a sofa.
e.zh: 她在家具展厅里逛着想挑一张沙发。

shows.t:
n. 节目（复数）
v. 展示（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {shows} his work to clients before finalizing the design.
e.zh: 他在最终定稿前会把作品展示给客户。

e.en: Netflix released several new {shows} this month.
e.zh: 网飞这个月推出了好几部新剧集。

showstopper.t: n. 压轴好戏；极精彩的表演

e.en: Her solo performance was the absolute {showstopper} of the night.
e.zh: 她的独唱是当晚最精彩绝伦的节目。

e.en: The security bug turned out to be a {showstopper} for launch.
e.zh: 那个安全漏洞成了产品发布的拦路虎。

showtime.t: n. 开演时间；好戏登场

e.en: It's almost {showtime}, so please take your seats.
e.zh: 演出马上开始了,请大家就座。

e.en: The coach gathered the team and said it was {showtime}.
e.zh: 教练把队员召集起来,说该上场表演了。

e.en: She avoided {showy} jewelry and preferred simple accessories.
e.zh: 她不戴炫耀的首饰,更喜欢简约的配饰。

e.en: The garden is full of {showy} tropical flowers.
e.zh: 花园里开满了艳丽夺目的热带花卉。

shrank.t: v. 收缩；缩水（shrink 的过去式）

e.en: My favorite sweater {shrank} in the hot dryer.
e.zh: 我最喜欢的毛衣在烘干机里缩水了。

e.en: The child {shrank} back in fear when the dog barked.
e.zh: 狗一叫,孩子吓得往后缩。

e.en: The soldier was wounded by {shrapnel} from the explosion.
e.zh: 士兵被爆炸的弹片击伤。

e.en: Doctors carefully removed the {shrapnel} from his leg.
e.zh: 医生小心地从他腿里取出弹片。

shred.t:
v. 撕碎；切丝
n. 碎片

e.en: Please {shred} these confidential documents before leaving.
e.zh: 请在离开前把这些机密文件粉碎掉。

e.en: There isn't a {shred} of evidence to support his claim.
e.zh: 没有一丁点证据能支持他的说法。

shops.t:
n. 商店（复数）
v. 购物（第三人称单数）

e.en: Most {shops} on this street close by nine.
e.zh: 这条街上大多数商店九点前就关门了。

e.en: She {shops} at the farmers' market every Saturday.
e.zh: 她每周六都去农贸市场买东西。

e.en: The {shopworker} restocked shelves before the morning rush.
e.zh: 店员在早高峰前补好了货架。

e.en: Every {shopworker} wears a name tag during shifts.
e.zh: 每位店员上班时都佩戴名牌。

shopworn.t: adj. (商品) 陈列久了的；陈旧的

e.en: The {shopworn} jacket was discounted by half.
e.zh: 这件展示用旧的夹克打了五折。

e.en: His arguments sound {shopworn} after years of repetition.
e.zh: 他那些说法重复多年,听起来已经陈腐了。

shore.t:
n. 海岸；岸边
v. 支撑；撑住

e.en: We walked along the {shore} collecting smooth pebbles.
e.zh: 我们沿着海岸捡着光滑的鹅卵石。

e.en: The boat finally reached the {shore} at sunset.
e.zh: 船在日落时分终于靠岸了。

e.en: A small {shorebird} darted across the wet sand.
e.zh: 一只小水鸟掠过湿润的沙滩。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {shorebird} near the estuary.
e.zh: 观鸟者在河口附近发现了一只稀有的水鸟。

e.en: {Shoreditch} is famous for its trendy cafes and street art.
e.zh: 肖尔迪奇区以时尚咖啡馆和街头艺术闻名。

e.en: We met for drinks at a bar in {Shoreditch}.
e.zh: 我们在肖尔迪奇区一家酒吧聚会喝酒。

shorefront.t: n. 滨水地带；沿岸地区

e.en: Their {shorefront} hotel offers stunning ocean views.
e.zh: 他们的海滨酒店有绝美的海景。

e.en: A new {shorefront} promenade opened to the public.
e.zh: 一条新的海滨步道向公众开放了。

e.en: We took the train down to {Shoreham} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去肖勒姆度周末。

e.en: {Shoreham} has a charming little harbor on the south coast.
e.zh: 肖勒姆在英国南海岸有一个迷人的小港口。

e.en: The rocky {shoreline} stretched for miles in both directions.
e.zh: 嶙峋的海岸线向两边延伸了数英里。

e.en: Erosion is slowly changing the {shoreline} every year.
e.zh: 侵蚀正在让海岸线每年缓慢变化。

shores.t:
n. 海岸（复数）
v. 支撑（第三人称单数）

e.en: Refugees arrived on the {shores} after a long voyage.
e.zh: 难民经过长途航行后到达了海岸。

e.en: The lake's {shores} are lined with tall pine trees.
e.zh: 湖岸两边长满了高大的松树。

shoreward.t:
adv. 向岸地
adj. 朝岸的

e.en: The exhausted swimmer finally turned {shoreward}.
e.zh: 精疲力竭的游泳者终于朝岸边游去。

e.en: Strong currents pushed the small boat {shoreward}.
e.zh: 强劲的水流把小船推向岸边。

e.en: The wind blew the sailboat steadily {shorewards}.
e.zh: 风把帆船稳稳地吹向岸边。

e.en: Dolphins were swimming {shorewards} at high speed.
e.zh: 海豚高速朝着岸边游去。

shorn.t: adj. 被剪掉的；被剥夺的（shear 的过去分词）

e.en: The freshly {shorn} sheep huddled together for warmth.
e.zh: 刚剪过毛的羊群挤在一起取暖。

e.en: He looked strange with his head completely {shorn}.
e.zh: 他剃光头后看起来很奇怪。

short.t:
adj. 短的；矮的；不足的
n. 短裤；短片

e.en: The meeting was {short} but very productive.
e.zh: 会议时间不长,但效率很高。

e.en: I'm a bit {short} on cash this week.
e.zh: 我这周手头有点紧。

e.en: The military deployed {short-range} missiles along the border.
e.zh: 军方在边境部署了短程导弹。

e.en: This radio is designed for {short-range} communication only.
e.zh: 这款无线电只用于短距离通讯。

e.en: We need a {short-term} solution before the deadline.
e.zh: 在截止日期前我们需要一个短期解决方案。

e.en: The drug has helpful {short-term} effects on memory.
e.zh: 该药物对记忆有短期的有益作用。

e.en: There is a serious {shortage} of nurses nationwide.
e.zh: 全国范围内护士严重短缺。

e.en: The drought caused a water {shortage} this summer.
e.zh: 干旱导致今年夏天水资源短缺。

e.en: Chip {shortages} have delayed new car production.
e.zh: 芯片短缺延误了新车的生产。

e.en: Food {shortages} hit several regions after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后好几个地区出现食物短缺。

shortbread.t: n. 黄油酥饼；奶油饼干

e.en: My grandma bakes the best {shortbread} every Christmas.
e.zh: 我奶奶每年圣诞都烤最好吃的奶油酥饼。

e.en: This Scottish {shortbread} melts in your mouth.
e.zh: 这种苏格兰奶油酥饼入口即化。

shortcake.t: n. 酥饼；奶油水果松糕

e.en: Strawberry {shortcake} is the perfect summer dessert.
e.zh: 草莓酥饼是完美的夏日甜点。

e.en: She topped the {shortcake} with whipped cream and berries.
e.zh: 她在酥饼上抹了奶油并放上浆果。

e.en: His main {shortcoming} is poor time management.
e.zh: 他主要的缺点是不善于管理时间。

e.en: Every product has at least one notable {shortcoming}.
e.zh: 每款产品都至少有一个明显的缺点。

shortcrust.t: n. 油酥面团（做派皮用）

e.en: The pie crust uses traditional {shortcrust} pastry.
e.zh: 这个派皮用的是传统的酥皮面团。

e.en: {Shortcrust} pastry should be cold before rolling out.
e.zh: 酥皮面团擀开前应该保持冷藏。

e.en: Press Cmd+S as a {shortcut} to save your file.
e.zh: 按 Cmd+S 是保存文件的快捷键。

e.en: We took a {shortcut} through the park to save time.
e.zh: 我们抄近路穿过公园以节省时间。

e.en: Could you {shorten} this paragraph by a few sentences?
e.zh: 你能把这段话删掉几句话缩短一下吗?

e.en: The tailor will {shorten} my pants by two inches.
e.zh: 裁缝会把我的裤子改短两英寸。

shortened.t:
adj. 缩短的
v. 缩短（过去式）

e.en: They {shortened} the meeting to thirty minutes.
e.zh: 他们把会议缩短到了三十分钟。

e.en: The new highway {shortened} our commute considerably.
e.zh: 新的高速公路大大缩短了我们的通勤时间。

shortening.t:
n. 缩短；起酥油
v. 变短（现在分词）

e.en: The recipe calls for two tablespoons of vegetable {shortening}.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要两汤匙植物起酥油。

e.en: They are {shortening} the workweek to four days.
e.zh: 他们正在把工作周缩短到四天。

e.en: The company faces a major budget {shortfall} this quarter.
e.zh: 公司本季度面临严重的预算缺口。

e.en: We need donations to cover the funding {shortfall}.
e.zh: 我们需要捐款来弥补资金缺口。

e.en: Bison once roamed the {shortgrass} prairies of Colorado.
e.zh: 野牛曾经在科罗拉多的矮草草原上漫游。

e.en: {Shortgrass} ecosystems support many burrowing animals.
e.zh: 矮草生态系统养育着许多穴居动物。

e.en: "ASAP" is common email {shorthand} for "as soon as possible".
e.zh: "ASAP"是邮件中"尽快"的常用简写。

e.en: Old reporters used {shorthand} to write down interviews quickly.
e.zh: 老一辈记者用速记快速记下采访内容。

e.en: The farm raises a herd of pedigreed {shorthorn} cattle.
e.zh: 这个农场饲养着一群纯种短角牛。

e.en: {Shorthorn} beef is prized for its tender texture.
e.zh: 短角牛的牛肉因肉质鲜嫩而备受推崇。

e.en: He's a {shortish} man with kind eyes.
e.zh: 他是个稍矮的男人,眼神和善。

e.en: The film has a {shortish} runtime of eighty minutes.
e.zh: 这部电影时长较短,只有八十分钟。

shortlist.t:
n. 最终候选名单
v. 列入候选名单

e.en: She made the {shortlist} for the design award.
e.zh: 她入围了那个设计奖的最终名单。

e.en: Only three candidates remain on the {shortlist}.
e.zh: 最终候选名单上只剩下三位人选。

shortlisted.t: adj. 入围的；进入候选名单的

e.en: Her novel was {shortlisted} for the Booker Prize.
e.zh: 她的小说入围了布克奖的决选名单。

e.en: Five startups were {shortlisted} for the accelerator.
e.zh: 有五家创业公司入选了加速器决选名单。

shortlisting.t: n. 列入候选名单（的过程）

e.en: The committee is {shortlisting} applicants this week.
e.zh: 委员会本周正在筛选最终候选人。

e.en: We finished {shortlisting} resumes for the role.
e.zh: 我们完成了对该职位简历的初筛。

shortlists.t:
n. 候选名单（复数）
v. 列入候选（第三人称单数）

e.en: The agency {shortlists} ten finalists each year.
e.zh: 该机构每年挑选出十位决选入围者。

e.en: Award {shortlists} will be announced next Monday.
e.zh: 获奖入围名单将于下周一公布。

e.en: His excitement over the promotion was {shortlived}.
e.zh: 他对升职的兴奋只持续了很短的时间。

e.en: That trend turned out to be very {shortlived}.
e.zh: 那个潮流最终非常短暂。

e.en: The doctor will see you {shortly}, please wait.
e.zh: 医生很快就会见你,请稍等。

e.en: She replied {shortly} and walked out the door.
e.zh: 她简短地回了一句便走出了门。

e.en: He complained of {shortness} of breath after running.
e.zh: 他跑完步后抱怨呼吸急促。

e.en: The {shortness} of the meeting surprised everyone.
e.zh: 这次会议的简短让所有人都感到意外。

e.en: The therapist noted several {shortnesses} of breath during the patient's exam.
e.zh: 治疗师在检查中记录了病人多次出现的呼吸短促。

e.en: Different {shortnesses} of sleep produced different effects on the test subjects.
e.zh: 不同程度的睡眠不足对受试者产生了不同影响。

e.en: He wore black {shorts} and sneakers to the gym.
e.zh: 他穿着黑色短裤和运动鞋去健身房。

e.en: YouTube {shorts} have become a major source of mobile views.
e.zh: YouTube 短视频已成为移动端流量的重要来源。

shortsighted.t: adj. 近视的；目光短浅的

e.en: Cutting the research budget seems incredibly {shortsighted} to most economists.
e.zh: 在多数经济学家看来,削减研究预算极为短视。

e.en: My grandmother is {shortsighted} and needs glasses for reading signs.
e.zh: 我奶奶有近视,看路牌需要戴眼镜。

e.en: His {shortsightedness} cost the company a major partnership opportunity.
e.zh: 他的目光短浅让公司错失了一次重要合作机会。

e.en: Childhood {shortsightedness} has risen sharply across East Asian cities.
e.zh: 东亚城市儿童近视率急剧上升。

e.en: The {shortstop} dove to catch the line drive in the ninth inning.
e.zh: 游击手在第九局飞身接住了那记平直球。

e.en: She played {shortstop} for her university softball team.
e.zh: 她在大学垒球队担任游击手。

shortwave.t:
n. 短波
adj. 短波的

e.en: My grandfather still listens to {shortwave} radio every evening.
e.zh: 我外公每晚仍会听短波广播。

e.en: The hobbyist tuned his {shortwave} receiver to a Brazilian station.
e.zh: 这位爱好者把短波接收机调到了巴西的一个电台。

shorty.t: n. 矮个子（俚语，常带调侃）

e.en: My little brother got the nickname {shorty} in middle school.
e.zh: 我弟弟在初中被起了"小矮个"这个外号。

e.en: Hey {shorty}, can you grab that book from the shelf?
e.zh: 嘿小个子,你能帮我从书架拿下那本书吗?

shostakovich.t: n. 肖斯塔科维奇（苏联作曲家）

e.en: The orchestra performed {Shostakovich}'s Fifth Symphony last Saturday.
e.zh: 乐团上周六演奏了肖斯塔科维奇的第五交响曲。

e.en: Many critics consider {Shostakovich} the greatest Soviet composer.
e.zh: 许多评论家认为肖斯塔科维奇是最伟大的苏联作曲家。

shot.t:
n. 射击；投篮；一杯
v. shoot 的过去式

e.en: The photographer took a {shot} of the skyline at sunset.
e.zh: 摄影师在日落时拍下了一张城市天际线的照片。

e.en: She {shot} the basketball from beyond the three-point line.
e.zh: 她从三分线外投出了那记篮球。

shotgun.t:
n. 霰弹枪
adj. 强制的；随意的

e.en: The hunter cleaned his {shotgun} after returning from the woods.
e.zh: 猎人从林子回来后擦拭他的猎枪。

e.en: My sister always calls {shotgun} before we get in the car.
e.zh: 上车前我姐姐总是抢着坐副驾驶。

shots.t: n. 射击；投篮；照片（复数）

e.en: The doctor said the kids need two more {shots} this year.
e.zh: 医生说孩子们今年还要再打两针疫苗。

e.en: He took several {shots} at the goal but missed each time.
e.zh: 他朝球门射了好几次,但每次都没中。

e.en: He loaded a fresh {shotshell} into the chamber before the round.
e.zh: 开赛前他往枪膛里装了一发新霰弹。

e.en: Each {shotshell} contains many small pellets instead of a single bullet.
e.zh: 每发霰弹里装的是许多小铅丸,而不是单颗子弹。

shredded.t:
adj. 切碎的；撕碎的
v. shred 的过去式

e.en: She sprinkled {shredded} cheese over the warm pasta.
e.zh: 她把碎奶酪撒在热腾腾的意面上。

e.en: The cat {shredded} the entire roll of toilet paper.
e.zh: 那只猫把整卷卫生纸撕得粉碎。

e.en: Feed the old bank statements through the paper {shredder}.
e.zh: 把旧的银行对账单放进碎纸机里销毁。

e.en: The office {shredder} broke down in the middle of the day.
e.zh: 办公室的碎纸机大白天就坏掉了。

shredding.t:
v. 撕碎；切碎
n. 碎屑

e.en: He spent the afternoon {shredding} confidential client files.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在粉碎机密的客户档案。

e.en: The guitarist was {shredding} solos at the rock concert.
e.zh: 那位吉他手在摇滚演唱会上飙奏独奏。

shrew.t:
n. 鼩鼱（小型哺乳动物）
n. 泼妇

e.en: A tiny {shrew} darted across the forest floor.
e.zh: 一只小鼩鼱飞快地从林地上窜过。

e.en: Shakespeare wrote a famous play about taming a {shrew}.
e.zh: 莎士比亚写过一部关于驯服悍妇的著名戏剧。

e.en: She made a {shrewd} investment in the tech startup.
e.zh: 她对那家科技初创公司做了一笔精明的投资。

e.en: The lawyer is known for her {shrewd} negotiating tactics.
e.zh: 那位律师以精明的谈判手腕而闻名。

e.en: He {shrewdly} bought the property before prices rose.
e.zh: 他精明地在房价上涨前买下了那处房产。

e.en: She {shrewdly} negotiated a higher salary at the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议上精明地谈下了更高的薪水。

e.en: Her business {shrewdness} helped the company survive the recession.
e.zh: 她敏锐的商业头脑帮公司挺过了经济衰退。

e.en: The detective's {shrewdness} cracked the complex case.
e.zh: 侦探的精明洞察破解了那起复杂的案件。

e.en: Her {shrewish} comments made everyone uncomfortable at dinner.
e.zh: 她那些泼辣的评论让晚餐上每个人都不自在。

e.en: He grew tired of his neighbor's {shrewish} complaints.
e.zh: 他厌倦了邻居那些刻薄的抱怨。

shrewsbury.t: n. 什鲁斯伯里（英国地名）

e.en: We took a weekend trip to {Shrewsbury} in the English countryside.
e.zh: 我们去英格兰乡下的什鲁斯伯里度了个周末。

e.en: {Shrewsbury} is famous for its medieval architecture and timber houses.
e.zh: 什鲁斯伯里以中世纪建筑和木结构房屋而闻名。

shriek.t:
v. 尖叫
n. 尖叫声

e.en: She let out a {shriek} when the spider crawled across her hand.
e.zh: 蜘蛛爬过她的手时,她尖叫了一声。

e.en: The children {shriek} with delight on the roller coaster.
e.zh: 孩子们在过山车上兴奋地尖叫。

shrieking.t:
v. 尖叫
adj. 刺耳的

e.en: The {shrieking} alarm woke everyone in the building.
e.zh: 刺耳的警报声吵醒了大楼里的所有人。

e.en: Fans were {shrieking} as the band took the stage.
e.zh: 乐队登台时,粉丝们尖声欢呼。

shrift.t: n. 忏悔；赦罪（多用于 short shrift）

e.en: The proposal got short {shrift} from the skeptical committee.
e.zh: 那份提案被持怀疑态度的委员会草草打发了。

e.en: His complaints received short {shrift} from the busy manager.
e.zh: 忙碌的经理对他的抱怨没怎么搭理。

e.en: The {shrike} impaled its prey on a sharp thorn.
e.zh: 伯劳鸟把猎物钉在尖锐的荆棘上。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {shrike} near the meadow.
e.zh: 观鸟者在草地附近发现了一只罕见的伯劳鸟。

shrill.t:
adj. 尖锐刺耳的
v. 尖声叫喊

e.en: The {shrill} whistle of the kettle filled the kitchen.
e.zh: 水壶尖锐的鸣笛声充满了整个厨房。

e.en: Her voice grew {shrill} as the argument intensified.
e.zh: 随着争吵升级,她的声音变得尖锐刺耳。

e.en: The {shrillness} of her laughter could be heard down the hall.
e.zh: 她那尖利的笑声在走廊尽头都能听到。

e.en: He winced at the {shrillness} of the alarm.
e.zh: 听到警报刺耳的尖叫,他皱起了眉头。

e.en: The whistle blew {shrilly} to signal the end of recess.
e.zh: 哨子尖锐地响起,标志着课间休息结束。

e.en: She laughed {shrilly} at the comedian's punchline.
e.zh: 她对喜剧演员的笑点发出尖锐的笑声。

e.en: We ordered grilled {shrimp} with garlic butter for dinner.
e.zh: 我们晚餐点了配蒜蓉黄油的烤虾。

e.en: Fresh {shrimp} are caught daily off the coast.
e.zh: 新鲜的虾每天都从近海捕捞上来。

e.en: The old {shrimper} headed out to sea before dawn.
e.zh: 那艘老旧的捕虾船在黎明前出海了。

e.en: Her grandfather worked as a {shrimper} in the Gulf.
e.zh: 她祖父曾在墨西哥湾当捕虾渔民。

e.en: The family went {shrimping} along the coast last weekend.
e.zh: 那家人上周末沿着海岸去捕虾了。

e.en: {Shrimping} season brings a busy time for local fishermen.
e.zh: 捕虾季节让当地渔民忙得不可开交。

e.en: Pilgrims visit the ancient {shrine} every spring.
e.zh: 朝圣者每年春天都会拜访那座古老的圣地。

e.en: She built a small {shrine} for her late grandmother.
e.zh: 她为已故的祖母建了一座小小的纪念龛。

shrink.t:
v. 收缩；缩小
n. 心理医生（俚）

e.en: Wool sweaters often {shrink} when washed in hot water.
e.zh: 羊毛衫用热水洗常常会缩水。

e.en: He goes to a {shrink} every Tuesday for therapy.
e.zh: 他每周二都去看心理医生做治疗。

e.en: The store reported significant {shrinkage} from shoplifting last quarter.
e.zh: 那家店上个季度因偷窃造成了严重的损耗。

e.en: Cotton fabrics often experience {shrinkage} after the first wash.
e.zh: 棉布在第一次洗涤后通常会出现缩水。

shrinking.t:
v. 收缩
adj. 畏缩的

e.en: The polar ice caps are {shrinking} due to climate change.
e.zh: 由于气候变化,极地冰盖正在不断缩小。

e.en: Print newspapers face a {shrinking} readership in the digital age.
e.zh: 在数字时代,纸质报纸面临着读者群萎缩的问题。

shrinks.t:
v. 收缩（第三人称单数）
n. 心理医生（复数）

e.en: This shirt {shrinks} a little every time I wash it.
e.zh: 这件衬衫每次洗都会缩水一点。

e.en: The deadline {shrinks} the time available for revisions.
e.zh: 截止日期压缩了可用于修改的时间。

e.en: Grapes {shrivel} into raisins after drying in the sun.
e.zh: 葡萄在阳光下晒干后会皱缩成葡萄干。

e.en: Without water, the leaves quickly {shrivel} and fall.
e.zh: 没有水分,叶子很快就会枯萎掉落。

e.en: The unwatered plants had {shriveled} during the long heatwave.
e.zh: 长时间的热浪中,没浇水的植物都枯萎了。

e.en: He picked up a {shriveled} apple from the bottom of the basket.
e.zh: 他从篮子底部捡起一个干瘪的苹果。
