shrivelled.t: adj. 枯萎的；皱缩的（英式拼写）

e.en: The flowers {shrivelled} in the vase after a week.
e.zh: 花瓶里的花一周后就枯萎了。

e.en: She found a {shrivelled} lemon at the back of the fridge.
e.zh: 她在冰箱后面发现了一个干瘪的柠檬。

shropshire.t: n. 什罗普郡（英国郡名）

e.en: They drove through {Shropshire} on their way to Wales.
e.zh: 他们去威尔士的路上经过了什罗普郡。

e.en: {Shropshire} is known for its rolling hills and quiet villages.
e.zh: 什罗普郡以连绵起伏的山丘和宁静的村庄而闻名。

shroud.t:
n. 裹尸布；遮蔽物
v. 笼罩

e.en: A thick fog began to {shroud} the entire valley.
e.zh: 浓雾开始笼罩整个山谷。

e.en: Mystery continues to {shroud} the missing painting's whereabouts.
e.zh: 那幅失踪画作的下落至今仍是个谜。

e.en: The mountain peaks were {shrouded} in early morning mist.
e.zh: 山峰被清晨的薄雾笼罩着。

e.en: The deal remains {shrouded} in secrecy and speculation.
e.zh: 这笔交易仍笼罩在保密与猜测之中。

shrove.t: v. shrive 的过去式（忏悔）

e.en: We make pancakes every {Shrove} Tuesday as a family tradition.
e.zh: 我们家每年忏悔星期二都会做煎饼,这是家庭传统。

e.en: {Shrove} Tuesday marks the day before Lent begins.
e.zh: 忏悔星期二是大斋期开始前的那一天。

e.en: She planted a small {shrub} near the front gate.
e.zh: 她在前门附近种了一棵小灌木。

e.en: The garden was lined with neatly trimmed {shrub} borders.
e.zh: 花园四周是修剪整齐的灌木丛边界。

e.en: A rabbit darted into the dense {shrubbery} behind the house.
e.zh: 一只兔子窜进了屋后茂密的灌木丛。

e.en: The gardener trimmed the {shrubbery} along the driveway.
e.zh: 园丁修剪了车道两旁的灌木丛。

shrubby.t: adj. 多灌木的；似灌木的

e.en: The hillside was covered with low, {shrubby} vegetation.
e.zh: 山坡上覆盖着低矮的灌木植被。

e.en: This {shrubby} plant thrives in dry, rocky soil.
e.zh: 这种灌木状植物在干燥的岩石土壤中生长良好。

shrug.t:
v. 耸肩
n. 耸肩（动作）

e.en: She gave a quick {shrug} and walked away.
e.zh: 她耸了耸肩,转身走开了。

e.en: Don't just {shrug} off the criticism—think about it.
e.zh: 别只是对批评不屑一顾,认真想一想。

e.en: He {shrugged} when asked about the missing files.
e.zh: 当被问到丢失的文件时,他耸了耸肩。

e.en: She {shrugged} off the rude comment and kept working.
e.zh: 她对那句无礼的话不以为意,继续工作。

e.en: He answered the question while {shrugging} his shoulders.
e.zh: 他一边耸着肩一边回答问题。

e.en: Stop {shrugging} off your responsibilities at work.
e.zh: 别再对工作上的责任不当回事了。

shrugs.t: v. 耸肩（第三人称单数）

e.en: He just {shrugs} whenever I ask for his opinion.
e.zh: 每次我问他意见,他就只是耸耸肩。

e.en: She {shrugs} off setbacks and moves on quickly.
e.zh: 她对挫折一笑置之,很快就重新出发。

shrunk.t: v. shrink 的过去分词；已缩小

e.en: My favorite shirt {shrunk} after one wash in hot water.
e.zh: 我最爱的衬衫用热水洗了一次就缩水了。

e.en: The company has {shrunk} its workforce by twenty percent.
e.zh: 公司已经把员工人数缩减了百分之二十。

e.en: The old apple looked {shrunken} and wrinkled on the table.
e.zh: 那个旧苹果在桌上看起来又干瘪又皱。

e.en: He stared at his {shrunken} savings account in disbelief.
e.zh: 他难以置信地盯着自己缩水的存款账户。

shtetl.t: n. 东欧犹太人小村镇

e.en: Her grandmother grew up in a Polish {shtetl} before the war.
e.zh: 她祖母战前在波兰的一个犹太小镇长大。

e.en: The novel vividly recreates life in an Eastern European {shtetl}.
e.zh: 这部小说生动再现了东欧犹太小镇的生活。

shtick.t: n. 表演者的招牌动作/桥段

e.en: Sarcastic humor is basically that comedian's whole {shtick}.
e.zh: 讽刺幽默基本上就是那位喜剧演员的全部套路。

e.en: Pretending to be clueless is his usual {shtick} on stream.
e.zh: 装傻充愣是他直播时的惯用桥段。

shuck.t:
v. 剥壳；去皮
n. 外壳

e.en: Let me show you how to {shuck} an oyster properly.
e.zh: 我来教你怎么正确地撬开生蚝。

e.en: We sat on the porch to {shuck} corn for dinner.
e.zh: 我们坐在门廊上为晚饭剥玉米皮。

e.en: The chef {shucked} a dozen oysters in under two minutes.
e.zh: 主厨在两分钟内开了一打生蚝。

e.en: She {shucked} her coat and collapsed onto the sofa.
e.zh: 她甩掉外套,瘫倒在沙发上。

shucks.t:
int. 哎呀（表失望/谦虚）
v. 剥壳

e.en: Aw, {shucks}, you really didn't have to buy me flowers.
e.zh: 哎呀,你真的不必给我买花的。

e.en: Well, {shucks}, I forgot my wallet at home again.
e.zh: 哎呀,我又把钱包忘在家里了。

shudder.t:
v. 颤抖；战栗
n. 战栗

e.en: I {shudder} just thinking about that horror movie ending.
e.zh: 一想到那部恐怖片的结局我就发抖。

e.en: A sudden {shudder} ran through the old wooden bridge.
e.zh: 古老的木桥突然抖动了一下。

shuddering.t:
v. 颤抖
adj. 发抖的

e.en: The puppy was {shuddering} from the cold winter rain.
e.zh: 小狗在冬天的冷雨中瑟瑟发抖。

e.en: The old engine kept {shuddering} before it finally died.
e.zh: 老旧的发动机一直颤动,最后彻底熄火了。

shuffle.t:
v. 洗牌；拖着脚走
n. 曳步；打乱顺序

e.en: Please {shuffle} the cards before dealing the next hand.
e.zh: 发下一手牌之前请先洗牌。

e.en: I always listen to my playlist on {shuffle} mode.
e.zh: 我听播放列表总是用随机播放模式。

e.en: They played {shuffleboard} on the cruise ship's upper deck.
e.zh: 他们在游轮上层甲板玩沙狐球。

e.en: The bar has a long {shuffleboard} table near the window.
e.zh: 酒吧靠窗的位置有一张长长的沙狐球桌。

shuffled.t:
v. 洗（牌）过；拖着脚走过
adj. 已打乱顺序的

e.en: The tired old man {shuffled} slowly down the hallway.
e.zh: 疲惫的老人沿着走廊慢慢拖着脚走。

e.en: She {shuffled} the documents and handed me the top one.
e.zh: 她把文件洗了洗,把最上面的一份递给我。

shuffling.t:
v. 洗牌；拖着脚走
n. 拖步而行

e.en: He kept {shuffling} his feet nervously during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时他紧张地不停挪动双脚。

e.en: I heard someone {shuffling} around in the kitchen at midnight.
e.zh: 我听到午夜有人在厨房里走来走去。

e.en: His family walks to {shul} every Saturday morning together.
e.zh: 他家每周六早上一起步行去犹太会堂。

e.en: The small {shul} downtown has been there for a century.
e.zh: 市中心那座小犹太会堂已经存在了一个世纪。

shun.t: v. 回避，避开（某人或某事）

e.en: Many celebrities {shun} social media to protect their privacy.
e.zh: 许多名人为了保护隐私而避开社交媒体。

e.en: The community decided to {shun} anyone who broke the rules.
e.zh: 社区决定排斥任何违反规则的人。

shunned.t: v. 回避，避开（shun 的过去式）

e.en: After the scandal, his colleagues completely {shunned} him.
e.zh: 丑闻之后,他的同事们彻底疏远了他。

e.en: She {shunned} the spotlight despite her growing fame.
e.zh: 尽管名气越来越大,她仍回避镁光灯。

shunt.t:
v. 分流，转移
n. 分流器，旁路

e.en: The hospital had to {shunt} patients to nearby clinics.
e.zh: 医院不得不把病人转送到附近的诊所。

e.en: Workers {shunt} the empty rail cars onto a side track.
e.zh: 工人们把空车厢调到旁边的轨道上。

e.en: The {shunter} moved the freight cars onto the loading siding.
e.zh: 调车工把货车厢调到装货支线上。

e.en: A small diesel {shunter} pushed the wagons into the depot.
e.zh: 一台小型柴油调车机车把车厢推进车库。

shunting.t:
v. 调车；分流
n. 调车作业

e.en: The {shunting} of carriages went on through the night.
e.zh: 车厢的调车作业整夜都在进行。

e.en: Hospitals are {shunting} non-urgent cases to outpatient clinics.
e.zh: 医院正在把非紧急病例分流到门诊部。

shush.t: v. 发“嘘”声制止；使安静

e.en: Please {shush} the kids — the baby just fell asleep.
e.zh: 请让孩子们安静点,宝宝刚睡着。

e.en: The librarian gave me a stern {shush} from across the room.
e.zh: 图书管理员从房间另一头严厉地嘘了我一声。

shut.t:
v. 关闭，合上
adj. 关着的

e.en: Please {shut} the door behind you when you leave.
e.zh: 离开的时候请随手把门关上。

e.en: Many small shops were {shut} during the long holiday.
e.zh: 许多小店在长假期间都关门了。

e.en: The government {shutdown} delayed thousands of passport applications.
e.zh: 政府停摆延误了成千上万的护照申请。

e.en: A planned system {shutdown} will occur this Sunday at midnight.
e.zh: 系统计划于本周日午夜进行停机维护。

shutoff.t:
n. 关闭装置；截止
v. 切断

e.en: The water {shutoff} valve is in the basement near the heater.
e.zh: 水阀总开关在地下室热水器旁边。

e.en: Power {shutoff} notices were sent to customers behind on bills.
e.zh: 停电通知已发给欠费的用户。

shutout.t: n. 零封（对手未得分的比赛）

e.en: The goalie pitched a {shutout} in last night's playoff game.
e.zh: 门将在昨晚的季后赛中打出零封。

e.en: Their pitcher recorded his third {shutout} of the season.
e.zh: 他们的投手取得了本赛季的第三场无失分比赛。

shuts.t: v. 关闭（shut 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The bakery {shuts} at six on weekdays and earlier on Sunday.
e.zh: 面包店工作日六点关门,周日更早。

e.en: He always {shuts} his laptop the moment a meeting ends.
e.zh: 会议一结束他总是立刻合上笔记本电脑。

shutter.t:
n. 快门；百叶窗
v. 关上，停业

e.en: The camera's {shutter} clicked softly as she took the photo.
e.zh: 她拍照时相机的快门轻轻响了一声。

e.en: Strong winds slammed the wooden {shutter} against the wall.
e.zh: 狂风把木百叶窗砸到了墙上。

e.en: My dad is a real {shutterbug} who photographs every sunset.
e.zh: 我爸是个十足的摄影迷,每个日落都要拍。

e.en: As a {shutterbug}, she carries her camera literally everywhere.
e.zh: 作为一个摄影爱好者,她真的随身带着相机。

shuttered.t: adj. 装有百叶窗的；已停业的

e.en: The bookstore {shuttered} last month after thirty years downtown.
e.zh: 那家书店在市中心经营三十年后上个月关门了。

e.en: All the {shuttered} factories along the river look abandoned.
e.zh: 河边所有关闭的工厂都显得废弃荒凉。

shuttering.t:
n. (建筑) 模板
v. 关上百叶窗

e.en: The chain is {shuttering} fifty stores across the country.
e.zh: 该连锁店正在全国关闭五十家门店。

e.en: Workers installed wooden {shuttering} before pouring the concrete.
e.zh: 工人在浇筑混凝土之前安装了木制模板。

shutting.t: v. 关闭（shut 的进行式）

e.en: Thanks for {shutting} the windows before the storm arrived.
e.zh: 谢谢你在暴风雨来临前关上了窗户。

e.en: The cafe is {shutting} early today for a private event.
e.zh: 咖啡馆今天因私人活动会提早关门。

shuttle.t:
n. 班车，穿梭巴士；航天飞机
v. 穿梭往返

e.en: A free {shuttle} runs between the airport and the hotel.
e.zh: 机场和酒店之间有免费班车往返。

e.en: Volunteers {shuttle} supplies between the warehouse and shelters.
e.zh: 志愿者在仓库和避难所之间往返运送物资。

e.en: The {shuttlecock} flew high over the badminton net.
e.zh: 羽毛球高高飞过羽毛球网。

e.en: She served the {shuttlecock} with a quick flick of her wrist.
e.zh: 她手腕一抖把羽毛球发了出去。

shy.t:
adj. 害羞的，腼腆的
v. 畏缩，回避

shylock.t: n. 夏洛克（吝啬放贷者）

e.en: The loan officer treated him like some kind of {shylock}.
e.zh: 贷款员把他当成了放高利贷的人。

e.en: Critics still debate whether {shylock} is villain or victim.
e.zh: 评论家仍在争论夏洛克是恶人还是受害者。

e.en: The little girl {shyly} waved at her new classmates.
e.zh: 小女孩害羞地向她的新同学挥手。

e.en: He {shyly} asked if she wanted to grab coffee sometime.
e.zh: 他羞涩地问她要不要找时间一起喝咖啡。

e.en: Her {shyness} disappears completely once she's on stage.
e.zh: 她一上台,害羞就完全消失了。

e.en: He overcame his {shyness} by joining a public speaking club.
e.zh: 他通过加入演讲俱乐部克服了自己的羞涩。

shyster.t: n. 讼棍，不择手段的律师

e.en: That {shyster} lawyer charged her for emails she never received.
e.zh: 那个奸诈律师为她从未收到的邮件向她收费。

e.en: Avoid online sellers who act like total {shyster} types.
e.zh: 要避开那些一看就是骗子的网络卖家。

e.en: Thailand was historically known as {siam} until 1939.
e.zh: 泰国在1939年之前历史上被称为暹罗。

e.en: The king of {siam} features prominently in the famous musical.
e.zh: 暹罗国王是那部著名音乐剧的核心人物。

siamese.t:
adj. 暹罗的；连体的
n. 暹罗猫

e.en: Her {siamese} cat has striking blue eyes and cream fur.
e.zh: 她的暹罗猫有惊艳的蓝眼睛和奶白色毛发。

e.en: The {siamese} twins were successfully separated by a surgical team.
e.zh: 那对连体双胞胎被手术团队成功分离了。

e.en: My friend {sian} just moved to London for graduate school.
e.zh: 我的朋友茜安刚搬到伦敦读研究生。

e.en: {sian} is a popular Welsh name meaning gracious gift from God.
e.zh: 茜安是一个流行的威尔士名字,意为上帝的恩赐。

sib.t: n. 同胞，兄弟姐妹（sibling 缩写）

sibelius.t: n. 西贝柳斯（芬兰作曲家）

e.en: The orchestra performed {sibelius}'s second symphony last night.
e.zh: 管弦乐团昨晚演奏了西贝柳斯的第二交响曲。

e.en: Composers worldwide still study {sibelius} for his Nordic soundscapes.
e.zh: 全球作曲家仍在研究西贝柳斯的北欧音景。

e.en: Winters in {siberia} can drop below minus forty degrees.
e.zh: 西伯利亚的冬天气温能降到零下四十度以下。

e.en: The trans-{siberia} railway crosses eight time zones across Russia.
e.zh: 西伯利亚大铁路横跨俄罗斯八个时区。

siberian.t:
adj. 西伯利亚的
n. 西伯利亚人

e.en: A {siberian} husky needs lots of exercise and cold weather.
e.zh: 西伯利亚哈士奇需要大量运动和寒冷的天气。

e.en: The {siberian} tiger is the largest cat species on earth.
e.zh: 西伯利亚虎是地球上最大的猫科动物。

sibilant.t:
adj. 发咝音的
n. 咝音

e.en: The microphone picked up every {sibilant} sound she made.
e.zh: 麦克风把她发出的每个嘶嘶音都收了进去。

e.en: His whisper carried a soft {sibilant} hiss across the room.
e.zh: 他的耳语带着轻柔的嘶嘶声传遍房间。

e.en: My younger {sibling} just started high school this fall.
e.zh: 我的弟弟今年秋天刚上高中。

e.en: Sharing a room taught me how to handle {sibling} disputes.
e.zh: 合住一间房让我学会了处理兄弟姐妹间的矛盾。

e.en: She has three {siblings} living in different cities.
e.zh: 她有三个兄弟姐妹住在不同的城市。

e.en: Twin {siblings} often share an unusually close bond.
e.zh: 双胞胎兄弟姐妹之间往往关系格外亲密。

sibyl.t: n. 女预言家；西比尔（女名）

e.en: The ancient {sibyl} was said to predict the fall of empires.
e.zh: 传说那位古代女预言家能预知帝国的覆灭。

e.en: In the novel, a mysterious {sibyl} guides the hero through danger.
e.zh: 小说中一位神秘的女先知引导主角穿越险境。

sic.t: adv. 原文如此（引用标注）

e.en: I love the numbing spice of authentic {Sichuan} cuisine.
e.zh: 我喜欢正宗川菜那种麻辣的味道。

e.en: We visited the giant pandas at a reserve in {Sichuan}.
e.zh: 我们在四川的一个保护区参观了大熊猫。

sicilian.t:
adj. 西西里的
n. 西西里人

e.en: The {Sicilian} coastline is stunning at sunset.
e.zh: 西西里岛的海岸线在日落时美得惊人。

e.en: He ordered a thick-crust {Sicilian} pizza for dinner.
e.zh: 他晚餐点了一份厚底的西西里风味披萨。

e.en: We spent two weeks exploring small towns in {Sicily}.
e.zh: 我们花了两周时间游览西西里岛的小镇。

e.en: Mount Etna in {Sicily} is one of Europe's most active volcanoes.
e.zh: 西西里的埃特纳火山是欧洲最活跃的火山之一。

sick.t: adj. 生病的；恶心的；（俚）酷极了

e.en: I'm calling in {sick} today because I have a fever.
e.zh: 我今天发烧,要请病假。

e.en: That skateboard trick was absolutely {sick}!
e.zh: 那个滑板动作真是太炫了!

e.en: The injured sailor was rushed to the ship's {sickbay}.
e.zh: 受伤的水手被紧急送往船上的医务室。

e.en: The {sickbay} was full of crew members with the flu.
e.zh: 医务室里挤满了得流感的船员。

sidon.t: n. 西顿（古腓尼基城市）

e.en: The ancient port of {Sidon} was a major Phoenician city.
e.zh: 古老的西顿港是腓尼基的一座重要城市。

e.en: Archaeologists discovered Roman ruins near {Sidon} last year.
e.zh: 考古学家去年在西顿附近发现了罗马遗迹。

sieg.t: n. 胜利（德语，常见于人名）

e.en: The German word {Sieg} means victory in English.
e.zh: 德语单词 Sieg 在英语中意为胜利。

e.en: Crowds chanted {Sieg} after the team's championship win.
e.zh: 球队夺冠后,人群高呼 Sieg(胜利)。

siege.t:
n. 围攻；围困
v. 包围

e.en: The castle endured a six-month {siege} before surrendering.
e.zh: 那座城堡在投降前经受了长达六个月的围困。

e.en: Reporters laid {siege} to the actor's house after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻爆发后,记者们围堵了那位演员的家。

siegfried.t: n. 齐格弗里德（日耳曼传说英雄）

e.en: Wagner's opera {Siegfried} tells the story of a legendary hero.
e.zh: 瓦格纳的歌剧《齐格弗里德》讲述了一位传奇英雄的故事。

e.en: The dragon scene in {Siegfried} remains spectacular on stage.
e.zh: 《齐格弗里德》中的屠龙场面在舞台上依然震撼。

siemens.t: n. 西门子（公司/电导单位）

e.en: She works as an engineer at a {Siemens} factory in Germany.
e.zh: 她在德国一家西门子工厂担任工程师。

e.en: Electrical conductance is measured in units called {siemens}.
e.zh: 电导的单位称为西门子。

siena.t: n. 锡耶纳（意大利城市）

e.en: We watched the famous horse race in {Siena} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在锡耶纳观看了著名的赛马比赛。

e.en: The medieval streets of {Siena} are perfect for wandering.
e.zh: 锡耶纳的中世纪街道非常适合漫步。

sienese.t:
adj. 锡耶纳的
n. 锡耶纳人

e.en: The museum displays beautiful {Sienese} paintings from the fourteenth century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了十四世纪精美的锡耶纳画派绘画。

e.en: She is studying {Sienese} architecture for her thesis.
e.zh: 她正在为论文研究锡耶纳建筑。

e.en: He painted the wall a warm {sienna} color.
e.zh: 他把墙刷成了温暖的赭黄色。

e.en: The autumn leaves turned a rich burnt {sienna}.
e.zh: 秋叶变成了浓郁的赭褐色。

e.en: We hiked through the snowy {sierra} for three days.
e.zh: 我们在白雪覆盖的山脉中徒步了三天。

e.en: The {sierra} stretches across the western edge of the state.
e.zh: 这条山脉横贯该州的西部边缘。

siesta.t: n. 午睡（尤指午后小憩）

e.en: In Spain, many shops close for an afternoon {siesta}.
e.zh: 在西班牙,许多商店会因下午午睡而关门。

e.en: After lunch, he took a short {siesta} on the couch.
e.zh: 午饭后,他在沙发上小睡了一会儿。

sieve.t:
n. 筛子
v. 过筛

e.en: Pour the sauce through a fine {sieve} to remove lumps.
e.zh: 把酱汁倒过细筛网以滤掉结块。

e.en: My memory is like a {sieve} these days.
e.zh: 我最近的记忆力简直像漏勺一样。

e.en: Always {sift} the flour before adding it to the batter.
e.zh: 在把面粉加入面糊之前一定要先过筛。

e.en: Investigators had to {sift} through hours of footage.
e.zh: 调查人员不得不仔细筛查数小时的录像。

sifted.t: v. 筛过的（sift 过去式）

e.en: She {sifted} the flour twice for a lighter cake.
e.zh: 她把面粉过筛两次,让蛋糕更松软。

e.en: The team {sifted} through thousands of emails for evidence.
e.zh: 团队从数千封邮件中筛查证据。

e.en: Use a {sifter} to dust powdered sugar over the cake.
e.zh: 用筛糖器在蛋糕上撒上糖粉。

e.en: The flour {sifter} broke after years of heavy use.
e.zh: 那个面粉筛在多年频繁使用后坏了。

sifting.t:
v. 正在筛选
n. 筛出物

e.en: I spent the morning {sifting} through old photographs.
e.zh: 我整个上午都在翻看旧照片。

e.en: {Sifting} the flour helps prevent lumps in the batter.
e.zh: 过筛面粉有助于防止面糊结块。

sigh.t:
v. 叹气
n. 叹息声

e.en: She let out a long {sigh} of relief.
e.zh: 她长长地舒了一口气。

e.en: He couldn't help but {sigh} at the bad news.
e.zh: 听到坏消息,他忍不住叹了口气。

e.en: She {sighed} deeply and closed the laptop.
e.zh: 她深深叹了口气,合上了笔记本电脑。

e.en: He {sighed} with relief when the meeting finally ended.
e.zh: 会议终于结束时,他如释重负地舒了口气。

sighing.t:
v. 正在叹气
n. 叹息

e.en: Stop {sighing} and tell me what's wrong.
e.zh: 别再叹气了,告诉我怎么了。

e.en: The wind was {sighing} through the pine trees.
e.zh: 风在松林中发出叹息般的声响。

sighs.t: n./v. 叹息（sigh 复数/三单）

e.en: She {sighs} every time her phone runs out of battery.
e.zh: 每次手机没电她都会叹气。

e.en: He let out two heavy {sighs} during the lecture.
e.zh: 他在讲座中发出了两声沉重的叹息。

sight.t:
n. 视力；景象
v. 看见

e.en: The mountains are a beautiful {sight} at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时山峦的景色十分美丽。

e.en: He lost his {sight} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后他失去了视力。

sighted.t:
v. 看见（sight 过去式）
adj. 有视力的

e.en: Hikers {sighted} a rare bird near the lake yesterday.
e.zh: 徒步者昨天在湖边发现了一种珍稀鸟类。

e.en: The program offers support for both blind and {sighted} students.
e.zh: 该项目为盲人和明眼学生都提供支持。

e.en: There was a rare whale {sighting} off the coast.
e.zh: 海岸附近有一次罕见的鲸鱼目击事件。

e.en: The {sighting} of the comet drew thousands of stargazers.
e.zh: 这次彗星的出现吸引了成千上万的观星者。

e.en: The injured soldier returned home {sightless} but determined.
e.zh: 那位受伤的士兵失明回家,但意志坚定。

e.en: Her {sightless} eyes still seemed to follow the conversation.
e.zh: 她那失明的双眼似乎仍跟随着谈话。

e.en: He stared {sightlessly} at the wall, lost in thought.
e.zh: 他茫然地盯着墙壁,陷入沉思。

e.en: She wandered {sightlessly} through the dark hallway.
e.zh: 她在漆黑的走廊里盲目地走着。

e.en: The pillar blocks the {sightline} from the back row.
e.zh: 那根柱子挡住了后排的视线。

e.en: Designers carefully planned every {sightline} in the new stadium.
e.zh: 设计师精心规划了新体育场每一条视线。

sights.t: n. 景点；视野（sight 复数）

e.en: We saw all the famous {sights} during our trip to Rome.
e.zh: 我们在罗马旅行时看遍了所有著名景点。

e.en: She has set her {sights} on becoming a doctor.
e.zh: 她立志要成为一名医生。

e.en: We plan to {sightsee} in Kyoto for three days.
e.zh: 我们计划在京都观光三天。

e.en: It's too hot to {sightsee} in the middle of the day.
e.zh: 中午太热,不适合观光。

e.en: We spent the weekend {sightseeing} around the old city.
e.zh: 我们周末在老城区四处观光。

e.en: The bus tour is a great way to do {sightseeing}.
e.zh: 乘坐巴士游览是观光的好方式。

sightseeings.t: n. 观光活动（sightseeing 复数，少用）

e.en: Various {sightseeings} are included in the tour package.
e.zh: 旅行套餐中包含了多项观光活动。

e.en: The brochure listed several {sightseeings} available in the area.
e.zh: 宣传册上列出了该地区可参加的几项观光项目。

e.en: A curious {sightseer} stopped to photograph the old church.
e.zh: 一位好奇的观光客停下来给那座老教堂拍照。

e.en: Every {sightseer} on the bus had a camera ready.
e.zh: 巴士上的每位观光客都准备好了相机。

e.en: Each noble house carried its own ancient {sigil} into battle.
e.zh: 每个贵族家族都将自己古老的徽记带入战场。

e.en: She wore a silver pendant shaped like a magical {sigil}.
e.zh: 她戴着一条形似魔法符印的银吊坠。

e.en: In statistics, {sigma} represents the standard deviation.
e.zh: 在统计学中,sigma 代表标准差。

e.en: The Greek letter {sigma} is often used in math equations.
e.zh: 希腊字母 sigma 经常出现在数学方程中。

sigmoid.t: adj. S 形的；乙状结肠的

e.en: Neural networks often use a {sigmoid} activation function.
e.zh: 神经网络常使用 sigmoid 激活函数。

e.en: The doctor examined a polyp in the {sigmoid} colon.
e.zh: 医生检查了乙状结肠中的一颗息肉。

e.en: The doctor recommended a {sigmoidoscopy} to check for polyps.
e.zh: 医生建议做一次乙状结肠镜检查以排查息肉。

e.en: A {sigmoidoscopy} usually takes only about fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 乙状结肠镜检查通常只需大约十五分钟。

sign.t:
n. 标志；迹象
v. 签名

e.en: Please {sign} your name at the bottom of the form.
e.zh: 请在表格底部签上你的名字。

e.en: The {sign} on the door said the shop was closed.
e.zh: 门上的牌子写着商店已关门。

e.en: The new airport has clear {signage} in three languages.
e.zh: 新机场设有三种语言的清晰指示标识。

e.en: Poor {signage} made it hard to find the exit.
e.zh: 标识不清让人很难找到出口。

signal.t:
n. 信号
v. 示意

e.en: The phone {signal} keeps dropping in this building.
e.zh: 在这栋楼里手机信号总是断断续续。

e.en: A green light is the {signal} to proceed.
e.zh: 绿灯是可以通行的信号。

signaling.t:
v. 发信号
n. 信号传递

e.en: The driver was {signaling} a left turn at the intersection.
e.zh: 司机在路口打信号准备左转。

e.en: Rising prices are {signaling} trouble for the economy.
e.zh: 价格上涨预示着经济将陷入麻烦。

signalled.t: v. 发出信号（signal 过去式）

e.en: The referee {signalled} the end of the match.
e.zh: 裁判示意比赛结束。

e.en: She {signalled} to the waiter for the bill.
e.zh: 她向服务员示意要结账。

e.en: The army {signaller} relayed the message to headquarters.
e.zh: 那名军队信号兵将消息传回了总部。

e.en: A railway {signaller} controls train movements from the box.
e.zh: 铁路信号员在信号塔内控制列车的运行。

e.en: The captain was {signalling} to the other ship with a flag.
e.zh: 船长正用旗帜向另一艘船发出信号。

e.en: His resignation is {signalling} bigger changes at the company.
e.zh: 他的辞职预示着公司将有更大的变动。

e.en: The new policy has {signally} failed to reduce traffic.
e.zh: 新政策在减少交通方面明显失败了。

e.en: She {signally} contributed to the team's success this year.
e.zh: 她对团队今年的成功做出了显著贡献。

e.en: The {signalman} waved the train through the junction safely.
e.zh: 信号员挥手让火车安全通过道岔。

e.en: A {signalman} controls track switches from the small tower.
e.zh: 信号员在小塔楼里控制轨道道岔。

signals.t: n./v. 信号（signal 复数/三单）

e.en: The driver {signals} before changing lanes on the highway.
e.zh: 司机在高速公路上变道前会打信号。

e.en: Weak phone {signals} make it hard to load the page.
e.zh: 手机信号弱,网页很难加载出来。

e.en: China is a {signatory} to the climate agreement.
e.zh: 中国是该气候协议的签署国之一。

e.en: Each {signatory} must ratify the treaty within a year.
e.zh: 每个签署方必须在一年内批准该条约。

signature.t:
n. 签名；特征
n. （数字）签名

e.en: Please add your {signature} at the bottom of the contract.
e.zh: 请在合同底部签上您的名字。

e.en: Spicy noodles are the chef's {signature} dish here.
e.zh: 麻辣面是这位主厨的招牌菜。

e.en: The petition collected over ten thousand {signatures} online.
e.zh: 这份请愿书在网上收集了一万多个签名。

e.en: Two {signatures} are required to authorize the wire transfer.
e.zh: 电汇需要两个签名才能授权。

e.en: A wooden {signboard} hung above the small bookshop door.
e.zh: 小书店门上挂着一块木制招牌。

e.en: The cafe's neon {signboard} glowed brightly at night.
e.zh: 咖啡馆的霓虹招牌在夜里闪闪发光。

signed.t:
adj. 已签名的
v. sign 的过去式

e.en: She {signed} the contract without reading the fine print.
e.zh: 她没看小字条款就签了合同。

e.en: The deaf teacher {signed} the story to her students.
e.zh: 那位聋人老师用手语给学生们讲了那个故事。

e.en: Each {signer} of the petition received a confirmation email.
e.zh: 每位请愿书签名人都收到了确认邮件。

e.en: A skilled {signer} interpreted the speech for the audience.
e.zh: 一位熟练的手语翻译为观众翻译了演讲。

e.en: He pressed his {signet} ring into the warm wax seal.
e.zh: 他把印章戒指按入温热的火漆里。

e.en: The medieval king's {signet} authenticated every royal decree.
e.zh: 中世纪国王的印章为每道王室诏令做认证。

e.en: Historians still debate the {significance} of that battle.
e.zh: 史学家至今仍在争论那场战役的意义。

e.en: The results showed no statistical {significance}.
e.zh: 实验结果未显示出统计上的显著性。

e.en: The novel explores the hidden {significances} behind everyday objects.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了日常物品背后的种种深意。

e.en: Different cultures attach distinct {significances} to the color red.
e.zh: 不同文化赋予红色截然不同的含义。

e.en: There has been {significant} progress on the climate bill.
e.zh: 气候法案取得了重大进展。

e.en: She gave him a {significant} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子意味深长地看了他一眼。

e.en: App downloads grew {significantly} after the redesign.
e.zh: 重新设计后,应用下载量大幅增长。

e.en: He paused {significantly} before naming the suspect.
e.zh: 他意味深长地停顿了一下,才说出嫌疑人的名字。

e.en: The {signification} of the symbol changed over centuries.
e.zh: 这个符号的含义在几个世纪间发生了变化。

e.en: Linguists study the {signification} of each gesture in conversation.
e.zh: 语言学家研究对话中每个手势的意义。

signified.t:
n. 所指（语言学）
v. signify 的过去式

e.en: A green light {signified} that the system was ready.
e.zh: 绿灯亮起,表示系统已就绪。

e.en: In semiotics, the {signified} is the concept a word represents.
e.zh: 在符号学中,所指是词语所代表的概念。

e.en: A wedding ring is a common {signifier} of marriage.
e.zh: 婚戒是婚姻的常见象征。

e.en: In Saussure's theory, the word is the {signifier}.
e.zh: 在索绪尔的理论中,词语就是能指。

e.en: A nodding head usually {signifies} agreement.
e.zh: 点头通常表示同意。

e.en: The dove {signifies} peace in many cultures.
e.zh: 在许多文化中,鸽子象征着和平。

e.en: Please raise your hand to {signify} that you agree.
e.zh: 请举手表示你同意。

e.en: These small changes don't really {signify} much.
e.zh: 这些小变动其实没什么意义。

signifying.t: v. 表示（signify 现在分词）

e.en: She nodded slowly, {signifying} her reluctant approval.
e.zh: 她缓缓点头,表示勉强的认可。

e.en: The flag flew at half-mast, {signifying} national mourning.
e.zh: 国旗降半旗,以示全国哀悼。

signing.t:
n. 签约，签署
v. sign 的现在分词

e.en: The {signing} of the treaty was broadcast live.
e.zh: 条约的签署仪式进行了现场直播。

e.en: The club announced the {signing} of a new striker.
e.zh: 俱乐部宣布签下了一名新前锋。

e.en: The waiter greeted the {signor} with a polite bow.
e.zh: 侍者向那位先生礼貌地鞠躬问好。

e.en: {Signor} Rossi will see you in his office now.
e.zh: 罗西先生现在可以在办公室见你。

e.en: The {signora} welcomed us warmly into her villa.
e.zh: 那位夫人热情地把我们迎进了她的别墅。

e.en: {Signora} Bianchi runs the small bakery on the corner.
e.zh: 比安基夫人经营着街角那家小面包店。

e.en: The {signorina} smiled and ordered a cappuccino.
e.zh: 那位小姐微笑着点了一杯卡布奇诺。

e.en: Excuse me, {signorina}, is this seat taken?
e.zh: 打扰一下,小姐,这个座位有人吗?

e.en: A weathered {signpost} pointed the way to the village.
e.zh: 一块风化的路标指向那个村庄。

e.en: Clear headings {signpost} the structure of a good essay.
e.zh: 清晰的标题能为好文章勾勒出结构脉络。

e.en: Good {signposting} helps readers follow your argument.
e.zh: 清晰的提示语能帮助读者跟上你的论证思路。

e.en: The trail needs better {signposting} near the river crossing.
e.zh: 这条小径在河流交叉处需要更好的路标指示。

e.en: Wooden {signposts} marked every junction along the hiking trail.
e.zh: 徒步小径的每个岔口都立着木制路标。

e.en: These early symptoms are {signposts} of a deeper problem.
e.zh: 这些早期症状是更深层问题的征兆。

signs.t:
n. 标志，迹象
v. sign 的三单

e.en: There are clear {signs} that the economy is recovering.
e.zh: 种种迹象表明经济正在复苏。

e.en: Protesters held colorful {signs} outside the city hall.
e.zh: 抗议者在市政厅外举着五颜六色的标语牌。

e.en: A skilled {signwriter} hand-painted the shop's window logo.
e.zh: 一位熟练的招牌画师手绘了店铺橱窗的标志。

e.en: The local {signwriter} still uses traditional brushes and paints.
e.zh: 当地的招牌画师至今仍使用传统的画笔和颜料。

e.en: A {sika} deer wandered out of the forest at dawn.
e.zh: 一只梅花鹿在黎明时从林中漫步出来。

e.en: Tourists fed crackers to the tame {sika} in the park.
e.zh: 游客给公园里温驯的梅花鹿喂仙贝。

e.en: He said he'd pay for dinner—{sike}, he forgot his wallet.
e.zh: 他说要请吃饭——开玩笑啦,他忘带钱包了。

e.en: A small {sike} trickled down through the moorland heather.
e.zh: 一条小溪从荒原的石南丛中潺潺流下。

sikh.t:
n. 锡克教徒
adj. 锡克教的

e.en: Many {Sikh} men wear a turban as part of their faith.
e.zh: 许多锡克教男子按教义戴头巾。

e.en: The {Sikh} temple offers free meals to all visitors.
e.zh: 那座锡克教寺庙向所有访客提供免费餐食。

e.en: The farmer stored {silage} to feed the cattle through winter.
e.zh: 农民储存青贮饲料以供牛群过冬。

e.en: Fresh {silage} has a distinctly sour, fermented smell.
e.zh: 新鲜的青贮饲料有一种明显的酸涩发酵味。

silence.t:
n. 沉默，寂静
v. 使安静

e.en: An awkward {silence} fell over the dinner table.
e.zh: 餐桌上陷入了一阵尴尬的沉默。

e.en: The government tried to {silence} the journalist.
e.zh: 政府试图让那位记者噤声。

silenced.t:
adj. 被压制的
v. silence 的过去式

e.en: She {silenced} her phone before entering the meeting.
e.zh: 她进会议室前把手机调成了静音。

e.en: Critics were quickly {silenced} after the new law passed.
e.zh: 新法通过后,批评者很快就被压制了。

e.en: The assassin attached a {silencer} to his pistol.
e.zh: 刺客把消音器装到了手枪上。

e.en: A faulty {silencer} made the old car incredibly loud.
e.zh: 消音器坏了,使那辆旧车噪音极大。

silencing.t:
n. 压制，消音
v. silence 的现在分词

e.en: Tech companies are accused of {silencing} dissenting voices online.
e.zh: 科技公司被指控压制网上的异见声音。

e.en: He kept {silencing} his alarm and falling back asleep.
e.zh: 他一次次按掉闹钟,又睡了过去。

e.en: Please keep your phone {silent} during the performance.
e.zh: 演出期间请将手机调成静音。

e.en: The whole class went {silent} when the principal walked in.
e.zh: 校长一进来,整个班就鸦雀无声。

e.en: She slipped {silently} out of the bedroom so as not to wake him.
e.zh: 她悄无声息地溜出卧室,以免吵醒他。

e.en: He cursed {silently} when he saw the parking ticket.
e.zh: 他看到罚单时在心里默默骂了一句。

e.en: {Silesia} has been an industrial heartland for over a century.
e.zh: 西里西亚一个多世纪以来一直是工业重镇。

e.en: Coal mining shaped the economy of {Silesia} for generations.
e.zh: 煤矿开采几代人来塑造着西里西亚的经济。

e.en: She speaks the local {Silesian} dialect with her grandparents.
e.zh: 她和祖父母说当地的西里西亚方言。

e.en: The museum displays traditional {Silesian} folk costumes.
e.zh: 博物馆展出传统的西里西亚民族服饰。

silhouette.t:
n. 剪影，轮廓
v. 衬出轮廓

e.en: His {silhouette} appeared briefly against the lit window.
e.zh: 他的剪影在亮着灯的窗前一闪而过。

e.en: The dress has a flattering A-line {silhouette}.
e.zh: 这条裙子的A字版型很显身材。

e.en: The mountains were {silhouetted} against the orange sunset.
e.zh: 群山在橘色的夕阳下勾勒出剪影。

e.en: A lone tree stood {silhouetted} on the hilltop.
e.zh: 一棵孤树在山顶上映出剪影。

e.en: Dark {silhouettes} of birds passed across the moon.
e.zh: 鸟儿的黑色剪影从月亮前飞过。

e.en: The artist cuts paper {silhouettes} of children's profiles.
e.zh: 那位艺术家剪出儿童侧脸的纸剪影。

e.en: Each shoe box came with a small {silica} gel packet.
e.zh: 每个鞋盒里都附了一小袋硅胶干燥剂。

e.en: Beach sand is mostly composed of {silica}.
e.zh: 海滩上的沙子主要由二氧化硅组成。

e.en: Most of Earth's crust is made of {silicate} minerals.
e.zh: 地壳的大部分由硅酸盐矿物构成。

e.en: The cement contains calcium {silicate} as its main binder.
e.zh: 这种水泥以硅酸钙为主要胶凝成分。

e.en: The cliffs are formed from ancient {siliceous} rocks.
e.zh: 这些悬崖由古老的硅质岩形成。

e.en: Diatoms build {siliceous} shells around their tiny bodies.
e.zh: 硅藻在微小的身躯外形成硅质外壳。

e.en: Modern chips are etched onto thin wafers of {silicon}.
e.zh: 现代芯片是蚀刻在薄薄的硅晶圆上的。

e.en: Many startups dream of moving to {Silicon} Valley.
e.zh: 许多初创公司梦想搬到硅谷去。

e.en: She visited her grandfather at his {sickbed} every afternoon.
e.zh: 她每天下午都到病榻前探望祖父。

e.en: He wrote his final letters from his {sickbed}.
e.zh: 他在病床上写下了最后的几封信。

sicken.t:
v. 使恶心；使厌恶
v. 生病

e.en: Stories of animal cruelty {sicken} most people deeply.
e.zh: 虐待动物的故事让大多数人深感反胃。

e.en: Workers began to {sicken} after exposure to the chemicals.
e.zh: 工人们接触化学品后开始陆续病倒。

sickened.t: adj. 感到恶心的；厌恶的

e.en: He was {sickened} by the violence shown in the news.
e.zh: 新闻里展示的暴力画面让他感到恶心。

e.en: Many residents {sickened} from drinking the contaminated water.
e.zh: 许多居民因饮用受污染的水而生病。

sickening.t: adj. 令人作呕的；令人厌恶的

e.en: The smell from the dumpster was absolutely {sickening}.
e.zh: 垃圾箱传来的气味简直令人作呕。

e.en: There was a {sickening} crunch when the cars collided.
e.zh: 两车相撞时发出令人胆寒的咔嚓声。

sickeningly.t: adv. 令人作呕地；令人厌恶地

e.en: The hotel lobby was {sickeningly} sweet with cheap perfume.
e.zh: 酒店大堂里廉价香水的味道甜得令人作呕。

e.en: He smiled {sickeningly} as he delivered the bad news.
e.zh: 他在传达坏消息时笑得令人反胃。

e.en: The farmer harvested wheat with a curved {sickle}.
e.zh: 农夫用弯弯的镰刀收割小麦。

e.en: A rusty {sickle} hung on the wall of the old barn.
e.zh: 一把生锈的镰刀挂在旧谷仓的墙上。

sickly.t:
adj. 多病的；体弱的
adj. 令人不适的

e.en: The {sickly} kitten needed round-the-clock care.
e.zh: 这只病恹恹的小猫需要全天候照顾。

e.en: The walls were painted a {sickly} shade of green.
e.zh: 墙壁被刷成了一种病态的绿色。

e.en: Morning {sickness} made her first trimester miserable.
e.zh: 晨吐让她怀孕头三个月非常难受。

e.en: He missed two weeks of school due to {sickness}.
e.zh: 他因病缺课两周。

e.en: Vaccines protect children from many serious {sicknesses}.
e.zh: 疫苗能保护儿童免受多种严重疾病侵害。

e.en: Travelers should be aware of common tropical {sicknesses}.
e.zh: 旅行者应留意常见的热带疾病。

e.en: Only a {sicko} would think that prank was funny.
e.zh: 只有变态才会觉得那个恶作剧好笑。

e.en: The detective was hunting a {sicko} who terrorized the neighborhood.
e.zh: 警探正在追捕一个让街区人心惶惶的变态。

e.en: Please keep your voice down outside the {sickroom}.
e.zh: 请在病房外面放低声音。

e.en: Fresh flowers brightened the otherwise gloomy {sickroom}.
e.zh: 鲜花点亮了原本阴沉的病房。

side.t:
n. 一侧；方面；一方
v. 支持（某方）

e.en: Please move to the other {side} of the road.
e.zh: 请走到马路的另一边去。

e.en: Whose {side} are you on in this argument?
e.zh: 在这场争论中你站在谁那边?

e.en: Politicians often {side-step} questions they don't want to answer.
e.zh: 政客们经常回避他们不想回答的问题。

e.en: He tried to {side-step} the puddle but slipped instead.
e.zh: 他想侧身绕过水洼,结果却滑倒了。

side-stepped.t: v. 回避；侧身躲开（过去式）

e.en: The CEO {side-stepped} every question about layoffs.
e.zh: 首席执行官回避了所有关于裁员的问题。

e.en: She {side-stepped} the broken glass on the floor.
e.zh: 她侧身避开了地上的碎玻璃。

side-stepping.t: v. 回避；侧身躲开（进行式）

e.en: He kept {side-stepping} the real issue during the interview.
e.zh: 他在采访中一直回避真正的问题。

e.en: The dancer was {side-stepping} gracefully across the stage.
e.zh: 舞者优雅地在舞台上侧步移动。

side-steps.t: v. 回避（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new policy cleverly {side-steps} the existing regulations.
e.zh: 新政策巧妙地绕开了现行法规。

e.en: She always {side-steps} questions about her age.
e.zh: 她总是回避有关年龄的问题。

e.en: Engineers analyzed the upper {sideband} of the radio signal.
e.zh: 工程师分析了无线电信号的上边带。

e.en: Single {sideband} transmission saves valuable bandwidth.
e.zh: 单边带传输可节省宝贵的带宽。

sidebar.t: n. 侧边栏（网页、应用界面）

e.en: You can find related articles in the right {sidebar}.
e.zh: 你可以在右侧边栏找到相关文章。

e.en: The judge called the lawyers for a quick {sidebar}.
e.zh: 法官把律师叫到旁边简短交谈。

e.en: She displayed her best china on the antique {sideboard}.
e.zh: 她把最好的瓷器摆在古董餐边柜上。

e.en: The {sideboard} held bottles of wine for the dinner party.
e.zh: 餐边柜上摆着供晚宴用的几瓶葡萄酒。

e.en: He trimmed his left {sideburn} a little too short.
e.zh: 他把左边的鬓角剪得有点太短了。

e.en: A single gray {sideburn} betrayed his real age.
e.zh: 一缕花白的鬓角暴露了他的真实年龄。

sidecar.t: n. 边车（摩托车旁挂斗）

e.en: Grandpa rode his motorcycle with a vintage {sidecar} attached.
e.zh: 爷爷骑的那辆摩托车带着一个复古边斗。

e.en: The dog loved riding in the {sidecar} with goggles on.
e.zh: 那条狗特别喜欢戴着护目镜坐在边斗里。

e.en: The sheep grazed quietly on the grassy {sidehill}.
e.zh: 羊群在长满青草的山坡上静静吃草。

e.en: Building on a {sidehill} requires extra foundation work.
e.zh: 在山坡上建房需要额外的地基工程。

e.en: Every great hero needs a loyal {sidekick}.
e.zh: 每个伟大的英雄都需要一个忠实的搭档。

e.en: The detective's {sidekick} provided most of the comic relief.
e.zh: 侦探的搭档承担了大部分的搞笑戏份。

sidelight.t:
n. 侧灯；侧窗
n. 侧面信息

e.en: The article offered an interesting {sidelight} on the scandal.
e.zh: 这篇文章对这桩丑闻提供了有趣的侧面解读。

e.en: A small {sidelight} flanked each side of the front door.
e.zh: 前门两侧各有一扇小小的边窗。

sideline.t:
n. 副业；边线
v. 使靠边；不予起用

e.en: Coaches yelled instructions from the {sideline} all game.
e.zh: 整场比赛教练都在场边大声指挥。

e.en: She runs a baking {sideline} alongside her day job.
e.zh: 她在做正职的同时还经营着烘焙副业。

sidelong.t:
adj. 斜视的；侧面的
adv. 斜向地

e.en: She gave him a {sidelong} glance across the room.
e.zh: 她在房间另一头斜眼瞥了他一眼。

e.en: He caught a {sidelong} look from his suspicious neighbor.
e.zh: 他注意到那位起疑的邻居斜着眼瞄他。

sideman.t: n. 伴奏乐手（爵士乐队）

e.en: The famous trumpeter started his career as a {sideman}.
e.zh: 那位著名的小号手是从乐队伴奏起家的。

e.en: A talented {sideman} can elevate any jazz performance.
e.zh: 出色的伴奏乐手能让任何爵士演出更上一层楼。

sidereal.t: adj. 恒星的；以恒星为准的

e.en: Astronomers measure star positions using {sidereal} time.
e.zh: 天文学家用恒星时来测量星体位置。

e.en: A {sidereal} day is slightly shorter than a solar day.
e.zh: 一个恒星日比一个太阳日稍微短一些。

sides.t: n. 各方；两侧（side 的复数）

e.en: The box has labels on all four {sides}.
e.zh: 这个盒子的四面都贴有标签。

e.en: Both {sides} agreed to continue the negotiations next week.
e.zh: 双方同意下周继续谈判。

sidesaddle.t:
n. 女式横鞍
adv. 侧坐地

e.en: Victorian women often rode {sidesaddle} for modesty.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的女性常以侧坐姿势骑马以示得体。

e.en: She learned to ride {sidesaddle} for the historical reenactment.
e.zh: 她为了历史情景再现学会了侧鞍骑马。

sideshow.t: n. 杂耍小节目；次要事件

e.en: The carnival's {sideshow} featured a sword swallower.
e.zh: 嘉年华的杂耍表演里有个吞剑艺人。

e.en: The scandal became a {sideshow} to the main political race.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻成了这场政治竞选的小插曲。

e.en: The pilot used a controlled {sideslip} to land in the crosswind.
e.zh: 飞行员用可控的侧滑动作在侧风中着陆。

e.en: A sudden {sideslip} on the icy road frightened the driver.
e.zh: 在结冰路面上突然侧滑把司机吓坏了。

sidesplitting.t: adj. 令人捧腹的；爆笑的

e.en: His new stand-up routine was absolutely {sidesplitting}.
e.zh: 他的新单口段子简直让人笑掉大牙。

e.en: We watched a {sidesplitting} comedy film last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我们看了一部令人捧腹的喜剧电影。

e.en: Try not to {sidestep} the question this time.
e.zh: 这次别再回避这个问题了。

e.en: He learned to {sidestep} office politics whenever possible.
e.zh: 他学会了尽可能避开办公室的勾心斗角。

sideswipe.t: n./v. 擦身相撞；顺便抨击

e.en: A speeding truck almost {sideswipe}d our car on the highway.
e.zh: 一辆超速的卡车在高速上差点擦撞到我们的车。

e.en: The senator took a {sideswipe} at his rival during the speech.
e.zh: 参议员在演讲中顺带挖苦了一下他的对手。

e.en: Don't let small problems {sidetrack} you from your goal.
e.zh: 别让小问题把你从目标上岔开。

e.en: Social media can easily {sidetrack} a focused study session.
e.zh: 社交媒体很容易让专注的学习时段分心走神。

e.en: I got {sidetracked} watching videos and forgot the deadline.
e.zh: 我光顾着看视频走了神,忘了截止日期。

e.en: The meeting got {sidetracked} by an unrelated complaint.
e.zh: 会议被一个无关的投诉带偏了。

e.en: Children were drawing with chalk on the {sidewalk}.
e.zh: 孩子们正在人行道上用粉笔画画。

e.en: Watch out for ice patches on the {sidewalk} this winter.
e.zh: 今年冬天小心人行道上的冰面。

e.en: The city repaired the cracked {sidewalks} downtown last summer.
e.zh: 市里去年夏天修补了市中心开裂的人行道。

e.en: Snow piled up on the {sidewalks} after the blizzard.
e.zh: 暴风雪过后,人行道上堆满了积雪。

e.en: Check the tire {sidewall} for the recommended pressure.
e.zh: 查看轮胎侧壁上标注的推荐胎压。

e.en: A nail had punctured the {sidewall} of the front tire.
e.zh: 一根钉子扎穿了前胎的侧壁。

e.en: She took a quick {sideway} step to avoid the puddle.
e.zh: 她迅速侧身一步,避开了水坑。

e.en: The crab moved in a strange {sideway} motion across the sand.
e.zh: 螃蟹以一种奇特的横向动作穿过沙滩。

sideways.t:
adv. 侧向地；斜着
adj. 侧面的

e.en: The cat tilted its head {sideways} at the strange noise.
e.zh: 猫听到奇怪的声音,把头歪向一边。

e.en: The car skidded {sideways} on the icy curve.
e.zh: 汽车在结冰的弯道上横向打滑。

e.en: A {sidewinder} slithered across the hot desert sand.
e.zh: 一条响尾蛇横穿过滚烫的沙漠。

e.en: The fighter jet fired a {sidewinder} missile at the target.
e.zh: 那架战斗机向目标发射了一枚响尾蛇导弹。

e.en: He glanced {sidewise} to check if anyone was watching.
e.zh: 他斜眼一瞥,看是否有人在注意。

e.en: The crab scuttled {sidewise} into a crevice.
e.zh: 那只螃蟹横着钻进了岩缝里。

sidi.t: n. 西迪（阿拉伯尊称／地名）

e.en: We spent the afternoon exploring the markets of {Sidi} Bou Said.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都在逛西迪布赛的市场。

e.en: The old {sidi} was respected throughout the village.
e.zh: 那位老先生在村里备受尊敬。

siding.t:
n. 外墙板
n. 铁路岔道

e.en: They installed new vinyl {siding} on the house last week.
e.zh: 他们上周给房子装了新的乙烯基外墙板。

e.en: The freight train was parked on a {siding} overnight.
e.zh: 那列货车整夜停在侧线上。

e.en: I watched him {sidle} up to the bar quietly.
e.zh: 我看着他悄悄地侧身走到吧台旁。

e.en: The cat tried to {sidle} past me into the kitchen.
e.zh: 那只猫试图侧身溜过我进入厨房。

sidmouth.t: n. 锡德茅斯（英国地名）

e.en: We spent a sunny afternoon walking along the {Sidmouth} seafront.
e.zh: 我们在锡德茅斯海滨度过了一个阳光明媚的下午。

e.en: The town of {Sidmouth} hosts a famous folk festival each summer.
e.zh: 锡德茅斯镇每年夏天都举办著名的民俗节。

silicone.t: n. 硅胶；硅酮（常用于密封、医疗）

e.en: The baking mat is made of flexible heat-resistant {silicone}.
e.zh: 这款烘焙垫由柔韧耐热的硅胶制成。

e.en: She replaced the cracked bathroom {silicone} sealant.
e.zh: 她更换了浴室里开裂的硅胶密封胶。

silicosis.t: n. 矽肺病（粉尘引起的肺部疾病）

e.en: Years of mining left him with severe {silicosis}.
e.zh: 多年的采矿生涯让他患上了严重的矽肺病。

e.en: Stone workers must wear masks to prevent {silicosis}.
e.zh: 石材工人必须戴口罩以预防矽肺病。

e.en: She wore a smooth {silk} scarf around her neck.
e.zh: 她在脖子上系了一条柔滑的丝绸围巾。

e.en: Pure {silk} sheets feel cool against the skin in summer.
e.zh: 纯丝床单在夏天贴着皮肤特别清凉。

silken.t: adj. 丝般柔滑的；如丝的

e.en: Her {silken} hair shone in the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 她如丝绸般的秀发在午后阳光下闪着光。

e.en: He spoke in a {silken} voice that calmed the audience.
e.zh: 他用如丝般柔和的嗓音让观众平静下来。

e.en: The villain spoke {silkily}, hiding his real intentions.
e.zh: 那个反派语调圆滑,掩饰着真实的意图。

e.en: The cat purred {silkily} as she stroked its back.
e.zh: 她抚摸猫背时,猫发出柔滑的呼噜声。

silks.t: n. 丝绸制品；骑师彩衣

e.en: The dancers wore brightly colored {silks} during the performance.
e.zh: 舞者们在表演中身着色彩鲜艳的丝绸服装。

e.en: The jockey's {silks} matched the stable's racing colors.
e.zh: 骑师的赛服与马厩的比赛颜色相配。

e.en: Each {silkworm} spins a cocoon of fine, glossy thread.
e.zh: 每只蚕都会吐出一个由细腻光滑丝线织成的茧。

e.en: Children watched the {silkworm} eat mulberry leaves all day.
e.zh: 孩子们整天看着蚕宝宝吃桑叶。

e.en: Her hair felt {silky} after using the new conditioner.
e.zh: 用了新护发素后,她的头发摸起来很丝滑。

e.en: The singer has a {silky} voice that captivates listeners.
e.zh: 那位歌手有着令人着迷的丝滑嗓音。

e.en: A small cat sat on the window {sill} watching birds.
e.zh: 一只小猫坐在窗台上看着小鸟。

e.en: She placed potted herbs along the kitchen {sill}.
e.zh: 她把盆栽香草摆放在厨房的窗台上。

sillar.t: n. 一种火山凝灰岩（罕用）

e.en: The cathedral in Arequipa is built from white volcanic {sillar}.
e.zh: 阿雷基帕的大教堂是用白色火山凝灰岩建成的。

e.en: Local masons still carve {sillar} blocks for traditional homes.
e.zh: 当地的石匠仍在为传统民居切割凝灰岩石块。

e.en: The kids' {silliness} at bedtime always makes us laugh.
e.zh: 孩子们睡前的傻气总让我们忍俊不禁。

e.en: Enough {silliness} — we need to finish this report tonight.
e.zh: 别再胡闹了,我们今晚必须完成这份报告。

e.en: That's a {silly} question, but I'll answer it anyway.
e.zh: 这是个傻问题,不过我还是回答你吧。

e.en: The puppy made a {silly} face when it saw its reflection.
e.zh: 小狗看到自己的倒影时做了个滑稽的表情。

silo.t: n. 筒仓；（组织）各自为政的部门

e.en: Each team works in its own {silo} with little communication.
e.zh: 每个团队都各自为政，几乎不沟通。

e.en: The farmer filled the {silo} with corn for winter.
e.zh: 农夫把玉米装满了筒仓以备过冬。

silt.t:
n. 淤泥
v. 淤塞

e.en: Heavy rain washed {silt} into the river.
e.zh: 大雨把淤泥冲进了河里。

e.en: The harbor needs dredging because {silt} keeps building up.
e.zh: 港口因不断淤积泥沙需要疏浚。

e.en: {Siltation} has reduced the reservoir's capacity by half.
e.zh: 泥沙淤积使水库容量减少了一半。

e.en: Engineers are studying {siltation} patterns in the delta.
e.zh: 工程师正在研究三角洲的淤积规律。

e.en: The river mouth is {silting} up rapidly each year.
e.zh: 河口每年都在迅速淤积。

e.en: Dam construction caused severe {silting} downstream.
e.zh: 水坝建设导致下游严重淤积。

e.en: The cliff is mostly {siltstone} formed millions of years ago.
e.zh: 这处悬崖主要由数百万年前形成的粉砂岩构成。

e.en: Geologists found fossils embedded in the {siltstone} layer.
e.zh: 地质学家在粉砂岩层中发现了化石。

silty.t: adj. 含淤泥的；多泥沙的

e.en: The {silty} water made it impossible to see the bottom.
e.zh: 浑浊的泥水让人看不见河底。

e.en: Rice grows well in this {silty} soil.
e.zh: 水稻在这种淤泥土壤中生长得很好。

silurian.t:
adj. 志留纪的
n. 志留纪

e.en: These fossils date back to the {Silurian} period.
e.zh: 这些化石可追溯到志留纪时期。

e.en: The museum displays creatures from the {Silurian} seas.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了志留纪海洋中的生物。

silva.t: n. 某地区的树木群；森林志

e.en: The book catalogs the {silva} of the Pacific Northwest.
e.zh: 这本书记录了太平洋西北地区的森林植被。

e.en: Researchers documented every species in the local {silva}.
e.zh: 研究人员记录了当地森林中的每一个物种。

silver.t:
n. 银；银色
adj. 银色的

e.en: She wore a delicate {silver} necklace to the party.
e.zh: 她戴着一条精致的银项链去派对。

e.en: The athlete won a {silver} medal at the Olympics.
e.zh: 这位运动员在奥运会上赢得了银牌。

silverback.t: n. 银背大猩猩（成年雄性）

e.en: The {silverback} gorilla protects his entire family group.
e.zh: 银背大猩猩保护着整个家族群体。

e.en: Tourists watched the {silverback} from a safe distance.
e.zh: 游客们在安全距离外观察这只银背大猩猩。

e.en: The mirror's {silvered} backing had started to peel off.
e.zh: 镜子背面的镀银层已经开始剥落。

e.en: Moonlight {silvered} the surface of the lake.
e.zh: 月光把湖面映得银光闪闪。

e.en: A {silverfish} darted out from behind the old books.
e.zh: 一只蠹鱼从旧书后面窜了出来。

e.en: Keep paper dry to prevent {silverfish} infestations.
e.zh: 保持纸张干燥以防蠹鱼滋生。

e.en: Age gradually {silvers} the hair at his temples.
e.zh: 岁月渐渐让他鬓角的头发变白。

e.en: The team has won three {silvers} this season.
e.zh: 该队本赛季已经赢得了三枚银牌。

silversides.t: n. 银汉鱼（一类小型鱼）

e.en: Schools of {silversides} flashed near the surface.
e.zh: 成群的银汉鱼在水面附近闪闪发光。

e.en: Pelicans dove into the bay to catch {silversides}.
e.zh: 鹈鹕俯冲入海湾捕捉银汉鱼。

e.en: The {silversmith} hammered the metal into a delicate bowl.
e.zh: 银匠将金属敲打成一只精致的碗。

e.en: She apprenticed with a master {silversmith} for five years.
e.zh: 她跟随一位银匠大师当了五年学徒。

silverstone.t: n. 银石（英国赛车场地名）

e.en: The British Grand Prix is held at {Silverstone} every year.
e.zh: 英国大奖赛每年都在银石赛道举行。

e.en: Fans packed {Silverstone} to watch the qualifying laps.
e.zh: 车迷挤满银石赛道观看排位赛。

e.en: Please set the {silverware} on the dining table.
e.zh: 请把餐具摆在餐桌上。

e.en: Grandma polished the {silverware} before Thanksgiving dinner.
e.zh: 奶奶在感恩节晚餐前擦亮了银器。

e.en: The shop sells antique {silverwares} from Victorian England.
e.zh: 这家店出售来自维多利亚时代英国的古董银器。

e.en: Collectors prize handcrafted {silverwares} from this region.
e.zh: 收藏家很看重这个地区的手工银器。

silvery.t: adj. 银色的；银铃般的（声音）

e.en: Fish with {silvery} scales darted through the clear water.
e.zh: 鳞片闪着银光的鱼儿在清澈的水中穿梭。

e.en: She has a {silvery} laugh that lights up the room.
e.zh: 她那银铃般的笑声让整个房间都亮了起来。

e.en: The forest uses modern {silvicultural} techniques to ensure regrowth.
e.zh: 该森林采用现代育林技术以确保再生。

e.en: Researchers study {silvicultural} practices to improve timber yields.
e.zh: 研究人员研究造林方法以提高木材产量。

sim.t: n. 模拟游戏（simulation 缩写）；SIM 卡

simian.t:
adj. 猿猴的
n. 猿猴

e.en: The toddler had a mischievous {simian} grin on his face.
e.zh: 那个幼儿脸上挂着调皮的猴儿般笑容。

e.en: Scientists study {simian} behavior to understand human evolution.
e.zh: 科学家研究猿猴行为以了解人类进化。

e.en: My phone has a {similar} feature, but it works better.
e.zh: 我的手机有类似功能，但用起来更顺手。

e.en: The two paintings look surprisingly {similar} up close.
e.zh: 近看这两幅画惊人地相似。

similarities.t: n. 相似之处（similarity 复数）

e.en: The {similarities} between the two languages surprised the students.
e.zh: 两种语言之间的相似之处让学生们感到意外。

e.en: Detectives noticed {similarities} in how the crimes were committed.
e.zh: 侦探们注意到这些案件的作案手法有相似之处。

e.en: There's a striking {similarity} between her style and her mother's.
e.zh: 她的风格和她母亲的风格惊人地相似。

e.en: The algorithm measures {similarity} between two images.
e.zh: 该算法用于衡量两张图片之间的相似度。

e.en: Cats purr when content; dogs {similarly} wag their tails.
e.zh: 猫满足时会发出呼噜声，狗也同样会摇尾巴。

e.en: The new model is priced {similarly} to last year's version.
e.zh: 新款的定价与去年的版本相近。

e.en: "As brave as a lion" is a classic {simile}.
e.zh: "像狮子一样勇敢"是一个经典的明喻。

e.en: The poet used a striking {simile} to describe loneliness.
e.zh: 诗人用了一个生动的明喻来描绘孤独。

e.en: The portrait captured a remarkable {similitude} to its subject.
e.zh: 这幅肖像与本人有着惊人的相似度。

e.en: Philosophers debated the {similitude} between dreams and reality.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论梦境与现实之间的相似性。

e.en: The British colonial government moved to {Simla} every summer.
e.zh: 英国殖民政府每年夏天都迁往西姆拉。

e.en: Tourists love the colonial architecture of {Simla}.
e.zh: 游客们喜爱西姆拉的殖民地建筑。

simmer.t: v. 慢炖；（情绪）暗自酝酿

e.en: Let the soup {simmer} for twenty minutes before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前让汤再小火慢炖二十分钟。

e.en: Tensions continued to {simmer} between the two departments.
e.zh: 两个部门之间的紧张关系仍在暗暗酝酿。

simmering.t:
v. 文火慢炖
adj. 即将爆发的

e.en: A pot of stew was {simmering} on the stove.
e.zh: 炉子上一锅炖菜正在小火慢煮。

e.en: There's a {simmering} dispute over the new policy.
e.zh: 围绕这项新政策存在着潜在的争议。

e.en: Medieval popes condemned {simony} as a serious sin.
e.zh: 中世纪教皇谴责买卖圣职是严重的罪行。

e.en: The bishop was accused of {simony} for selling church positions.
e.zh: 主教因出卖教会职位而被指控犯下圣职买卖罪。

simper.t:
v. 傻笑；假笑
n. 憨笑

e.en: She gave a coy {simper} when he complimented her.
e.zh: 他夸奖她时，她假装害羞地傻笑。

e.en: Don't {simper} at the camera; just smile naturally.
e.zh: 别对着镜头傻笑，自然地微笑就好。

e.en: The {simpering} salesman annoyed every customer who walked in.
e.zh: 那个谄媚假笑的推销员让每个进店的顾客都厌烦。

e.en: She wore a {simpering} expression that fooled no one.
e.zh: 她那装模作样的笑容骗不了任何人。

e.en: The app has a {simple} interface anyone can use.
e.zh: 这款应用界面简洁，谁都能上手。

e.en: Sometimes the {simple} answer is the right one.
e.zh: 有时候最简单的答案就是正确的答案。

e.en: Don't treat me like a {simpleton}; I understand the situation.
e.zh: 别把我当傻瓜，我明白情况。

e.en: In the fairy tale, the {simpleton} ends up winning the kingdom.
e.zh: 在童话里，那个憨厚的傻瓜最终赢得了王国。

simplex.t:
adj. 单工的；单一的
n. 单纯形

e.en: The radio operates in {simplex} mode for emergency calls.
e.zh: 该无线电在紧急通话时以单工模式运作。

e.en: Mathematicians use the {simplex} method to solve optimization problems.
e.zh: 数学家使用单纯形法来求解最优化问题。

simpliciter.t: adv. 绝对地；无条件地（拉丁语）

e.en: The court ruled {simpliciter} that the contract was void.
e.zh: 法庭直接裁定合同无效。

e.en: He rejected the offer {simpliciter}, without further discussion.
e.zh: 他直截了当地拒绝了提议，未作进一步讨论。

simplicities.t: n. 简单之处（simplicity 复数）

e.en: She loves the small {simplicities} of country life.
e.zh: 她喜爱乡村生活中那些朴素的小确幸。

e.en: The book celebrates the {simplicities} of childhood summers.
e.zh: 这本书赞美童年夏日的种种简单乐趣。

e.en: The design's {simplicity} is what makes it so elegant.
e.zh: 这个设计的简约正是它优雅之处。

e.en: I appreciate the {simplicity} of her writing style.
e.zh: 我很欣赏她那种简洁的写作风格。

e.en: The tax code needs significant {simplification} to help small businesses.
e.zh: 税法需要大幅简化以帮助小企业。

e.en: Saying all teens love TikTok is a gross {simplification}.
e.zh: 说所有青少年都爱抖音是一种过度简化。

e.en: Textbooks often rely on {simplifications} that mislead beginners.
e.zh: 教科书常依赖过度简化的说法，反而误导初学者。

e.en: The new policy introduced several useful {simplifications}.
e.zh: 新政策引入了几项实用的简化措施。

simplified.t:
adj. 简化的
v. 简化（过去式）

e.en: They {simplified} the checkout process to reduce cart abandonment.
e.zh: 他们简化了结账流程以减少购物车放弃率。

e.en: The {simplified} version of the form takes two minutes.
e.zh: 简化版的表格只需两分钟就能填完。

simplifies.t: v. 简化（第三人称单数）

e.en: This tool {simplifies} data analysis for non-technical users.
e.zh: 这个工具为非技术用户简化了数据分析。

e.en: Working from home {simplifies} my daily routine considerably.
e.zh: 在家办公大大简化了我的日常安排。

e.en: Try to {simplify} your code before submitting the pull request.
e.zh: 提交拉取请求前请尽量简化你的代码。

e.en: We need to {simplify} the user signup flow.
e.zh: 我们需要简化用户的注册流程。

e.en: The team is {simplifying} the dashboard based on user feedback.
e.zh: 团队正在根据用户反馈简化仪表盘。

e.en: {Simplifying} my schedule has reduced my stress significantly.
e.zh: 精简日程安排后，我的压力大大减轻了。

e.en: His {simplistic} view of the conflict ignores key historical context.
e.zh: 他对这场冲突的简单看法忽略了关键的历史背景。

e.en: The article offers a {simplistic} solution to a complex problem.
e.zh: 这篇文章对一个复杂问题提出了过于简单化的解决方案。

e.en: The article {simplistically} blames one factor for the entire crisis.
e.zh: 那篇文章把整场危机简单化地归咎于一个因素。

e.en: Don't view the conflict {simplistically} as good versus evil.
e.zh: 不要把这场冲突简单化地看作善恶对立。

e.en: The instructions are written {simply} so anyone can follow them.
e.zh: 说明写得很简单,任何人都能照着做。

e.en: I {simply} forgot to send the email yesterday.
e.zh: 我昨天就是忘了发那封邮件。

sims.t: n. 模拟人生（游戏）；Sim 复数

e.en: She spent hours building a dream house in The {Sims}.
e.zh: 她花了好几个小时在《模拟人生》里建造梦想之家。

e.en: Flight {sims} help pilots train without leaving the ground.
e.zh: 飞行模拟器帮助飞行员在地面上完成训练。

e.en: The theme park is a {simulacrum} of an old European village.
e.zh: 这个主题公园是欧洲古老村庄的仿制品。

e.en: Social media often presents a {simulacrum} of real friendship.
e.zh: 社交媒体常常呈现出真实友谊的仿真假象。

e.en: Engineers use software to {simulate} earthquakes on tall buildings.
e.zh: 工程师用软件来模拟高楼遭遇地震的情况。

e.en: The drill is designed to {simulate} a real emergency.
e.zh: 这次演练旨在模拟真实的紧急情况。

e.en: Pilots train using {simulated} flights before flying real planes.
e.zh: 飞行员在驾驶真飞机前会通过模拟飞行进行训练。

e.en: The jacket is made of {simulated} leather, not real hide.
e.zh: 这件夹克是仿皮做的,不是真皮。

simulates.t: v. 模拟（第三人称单数）

e.en: This app {simulates} the experience of playing a real piano.
e.zh: 这款应用模拟了弹奏真钢琴的体验。

e.en: The wind tunnel {simulates} extreme weather conditions for testing.
e.zh: 风洞模拟极端天气条件以进行测试。

e.en: The lab is {simulating} climate change effects on coral reefs.
e.zh: 实验室正在模拟气候变化对珊瑚礁的影响。

e.en: The actor practiced {simulating} surprise in front of the mirror.
e.zh: 那位演员在镜子前练习装出惊讶的样子。

e.en: The {simulation} predicted exactly how the rocket would behave.
e.zh: 那次模拟准确地预测了火箭的运行情况。

e.en: Students learn surgery through a virtual reality {simulation}.
e.zh: 学生们通过虚拟现实模拟来学习外科手术。

e.en: Researchers ran thousands of {simulations} to test the new design.
e.zh: 研究人员进行了数千次模拟来测试新设计。

e.en: Modern video games rely on physics {simulations} for realism.
e.zh: 现代电子游戏依靠物理模拟来呈现真实感。

e.en: Driving instructors often use a {simulator} to teach beginners.
e.zh: 驾驶教练常常用模拟器来教初学者。

e.en: The flight {simulator} accurately recreates cockpit controls and conditions.
e.zh: 这台飞行模拟器精确地重现了驾驶舱的操作与环境。

simulcast.t: v./n. 电视广播同步播出

e.en: The concert was {simulcast} on radio and television last night.
e.zh: 那场音乐会昨晚在电台和电视台同步播出。

e.en: They will {simulcast} the launch on YouTube and Twitch.
e.zh: 他们将在YouTube和Twitch上同步直播这次发布会。

e.en: Einstein challenged the idea of absolute {simultaneity} between distant events.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦挑战了远处事件之间存在绝对同时性的观念。

e.en: The film explores the {simultaneity} of joy and grief.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了喜悦与悲伤同时存在的状态。

e.en: The two explosions appeared to be nearly {simultaneous}.
e.zh: 那两次爆炸看起来几乎是同时发生的。

e.en: She offers {simultaneous} translation between English and Mandarin.
e.zh: 她提供英语和普通话之间的同声传译。

e.en: You can stream the show on three devices {simultaneously}.
e.zh: 你可以同时在三台设备上观看这部剧。

e.en: The twins started laughing {simultaneously} at the same joke.
e.zh: 双胞胎听到同一个笑话时同时笑了起来。

simvastatin.t: n. 辛伐他汀（降血脂药）

e.en: The doctor prescribed {simvastatin} to lower his cholesterol levels.
e.zh: 医生给他开了辛伐他汀来降低胆固醇水平。

e.en: Some patients report muscle pain while taking {simvastatin}.
e.zh: 一些患者反映服用辛伐他汀时会出现肌肉疼痛。

sin.t:
n. 罪；罪孽
v. 犯罪

e.en: Tourists hike up Mount {Sinai} to watch the sunrise.
e.zh: 游客们徒步登上西奈山去观看日出。

e.en: The {Sinai} Peninsula connects Africa to the Middle East.
e.zh: 西奈半岛将非洲与中东连接在一起。

e.en: Frank {Sinatra} remains one of the most iconic American singers.
e.zh: 弗兰克·辛纳屈仍是美国最具标志性的歌手之一。

e.en: The bar plays {Sinatra} classics every Friday night.
e.zh: 那家酒吧每周五晚上都会播放辛纳屈的经典歌曲。

sinbad.t: n. 辛巴达（航海故事人物）

e.en: {Sinbad} the Sailor is a famous character from Arabian Nights.
e.zh: 水手辛巴达是《一千零一夜》中的著名人物。

e.en: The animated film retells the legend of {Sinbad}.
e.zh: 这部动画电影重新讲述了辛巴达的传奇故事。

since.t:
prep./conj. 自从；既然
adv. 此后

e.en: I haven't seen her {since} we graduated from college.
e.zh: 自从我们大学毕业后,我就再也没见过她。

e.en: We canceled the picnic {since} it was raining heavily.
e.zh: 由于雨下得很大,我们取消了野餐。

e.en: Please accept my {sincere} apologies for the misunderstanding.
e.zh: 请接受我对这次误会的真诚道歉。

e.en: His thank-you note felt warm and {sincere}.
e.zh: 他的感谢信读起来温暖而真诚。

e.en: I {sincerely} hope you recover quickly from your illness.
e.zh: 我真诚地希望你能尽快康复。

e.en: She signed the letter "Yours {sincerely}, Anna."
e.zh: 她在信末签上了"安娜谨上"。

sincerities.t: n. 真诚之举（sincerity 复数）

e.en: Politicians often perform different {sincerities} for different audiences.
e.zh: 政客们常常对不同的听众表演出不同的真诚。

e.en: The poem questions whether all {sincerities} are equally genuine.
e.zh: 这首诗质疑是否所有的真诚都同样发自内心。

e.en: You could hear the {sincerity} in her apology.
e.zh: 你能从她的道歉中听出真诚。

e.en: Voters value {sincerity} more than polished speeches.
e.zh: 选民们看重真诚,胜过华丽的演讲。

e.en: Upton {Sinclair} exposed harsh conditions in the meatpacking industry.
e.zh: 厄普顿·辛克莱揭露了肉类加工业的恶劣条件。

e.en: The {Sinclair} ZX Spectrum was a popular early home computer.
e.zh: 辛克莱ZX Spectrum是一款颇受欢迎的早期家用电脑。

e.en: {Sind} province lies in the southeastern part of Pakistan.
e.zh: 信德省位于巴基斯坦东南部。

e.en: Travelers crossed {Sind} on their way to the Indus delta.
e.zh: 旅行者们穿越信德前往印度河三角洲。

sindy.t: n. 辛迪娃娃（英国玩偶品牌）

e.en: My sister collected {Sindy} dolls throughout the 1980s.
e.zh: 我姐姐在整个八十年代都在收集辛迪娃娃。

e.en: A vintage {Sindy} doll sold for hundreds at the auction.
e.zh: 一只复古辛迪娃娃在拍卖会上卖出了数百英镑。

e.en: The {sine} of ninety degrees equals exactly one.
e.zh: 九十度的正弦值正好等于一。

e.en: Engineers use {sine} waves to model alternating current.
e.zh: 工程师们用正弦波来描述交流电。

e.en: The honorary chairmanship was a {sinecure} with no real duties.
e.zh: 那个名誉主席职位是个挂名差事,没什么实际职责。

e.en: Critics called the appointment a political {sinecure}.
e.zh: 批评者称那项任命不过是个政治闲职。

sinew.t:
n. 筋；肌腱
n. 力量源泉

e.en: You could see every {sinew} flex in the runner's leg.
e.zh: 你能看到那位跑者腿上每一根筋都在绷紧。

e.en: Hard work is the {sinew} of any successful business.
e.zh: 勤奋努力是任何成功事业的支柱。

sinewy.t: adj. 肌肉结实的；强健有力的

e.en: The climber had a lean, {sinewy} build from years of training.
e.zh: 那位攀岩者多年训练练就了精瘦健壮的体格。

e.en: He chewed the {sinewy} piece of beef with difficulty.
e.zh: 他费力地嚼着那块筋多的牛肉。

sinfonia.t: n. 交响曲；小型交响乐团

e.en: The chamber orchestra performed a Bach {sinfonia} this evening.
e.zh: 室内乐团今晚演奏了一首巴赫的小交响曲。

e.en: Each {sinfonia} in the collection has its own distinct character.
e.zh: 集子里的每一首小交响曲都有其独特的风格。

sinfonietta.t: n. 小型交响曲；室内乐团

e.en: Janáček's {sinfonietta} opens with bold brass fanfares.
e.zh: 雅纳切克的小交响曲以雄壮的铜管号声开篇。

e.en: The local {sinfonietta} performs free concerts every spring.
e.zh: 当地的小交响乐团每年春天都会举办免费音乐会。

e.en: The chocolate cake was so rich it felt {sinful}.
e.zh: 那块巧克力蛋糕浓郁得让人觉得简直是种罪过。

e.en: Many religions consider greed a {sinful} attitude.
e.zh: 许多宗教都认为贪婪是一种罪恶的心态。

sinfully.t: adv. 罪恶地；极其放纵地

e.en: This dessert is {sinfully} delicious and full of calories.
e.zh: 这款甜点美味得令人罪恶,而且热量很高。

e.en: The hotel suite was {sinfully} luxurious for the price.
e.zh: 那间酒店套房就这价格而言奢华得近乎过分。

e.en: The sermon focused on human {sinfulness} and the need for grace.
e.zh: 那篇布道讲的是人的罪性以及对恩典的需要。

e.en: He confessed his {sinfulness} and sought forgiveness.
e.zh: 他坦承自己的罪过并寻求宽恕。

sing.t:
v. 唱歌；歌唱
n. 合唱聚会

e.en: My daughter loves to {sing} along to pop songs.
e.zh: 我女儿喜欢跟着流行歌曲一起唱。

e.en: Birds {sing} loudly outside my window every morning.
e.zh: 每天早晨小鸟都在我窗外欢快地鸣叫。

singable.t: adj. 适合歌唱的；好唱的

e.en: The chorus is catchy and very {singable} for everyone.
e.zh: 这段副歌朗朗上口,人人都能跟着唱。

e.en: A good musical needs {singable} melodies that audiences remember.
e.zh: 一部好的音乐剧需要观众记得住、唱得出的旋律。

singalong.t: n. 大家一起唱的活动

e.en: The bar hosts a {singalong} every Thursday night.
e.zh: 那家酒吧每周四晚上都会举办大合唱活动。

e.en: The film ended with a cheerful {singalong} of old hits.
e.zh: 电影以欢快的老歌大合唱收尾。

e.en: {Singapore} is famous for its diverse food and clean streets.
e.zh: 新加坡以多元的美食和整洁的街道而闻名。

e.en: My flight to {Singapore} takes about seven hours from Tokyo.
e.zh: 我从东京飞往新加坡的航班大约需要七个小时。

singaporean.t:
adj. 新加坡的
n. 新加坡人

e.en: My {Singaporean} friend taught me how to make chicken rice.
e.zh: 我的新加坡朋友教我怎么做鸡饭。

e.en: {Singaporean} cuisine blends Chinese, Malay, and Indian influences.
e.zh: 新加坡菜融合了中式、马来和印度的烹饪风格。

singe.t:
v. 烫焦；燎到表面
n. 焦痕

e.en: Be careful not to {singe} your hair on the candle.
e.zh: 小心别让蜡烛烧焦你的头发。

e.en: The chef will {singe} the duck skin to crisp it.
e.zh: 厨师会把鸭皮稍微烧一下,让它变脆。

singed.t:
adj. 被烧焦的
v. singe 过去式

e.en: He {singed} his eyebrows while lighting the barbecue.
e.zh: 他点烧烤架时把眉毛烧焦了。

e.en: The fire {singed} the edges of the old photograph.
e.zh: 火焰把那张老照片的边缘烧焦了。

e.en: The {singer} performed three encores before leaving the stage.
e.zh: 那位歌手在离开舞台前唱了三次返场。

e.en: She trained for years to become a professional opera {singer}.
e.zh: 她苦练多年才成为一名专业的歌剧演唱家。

e.en: The festival featured {singers} from over twenty different countries.
e.zh: 这个音乐节汇集了来自二十多个国家的歌手。

e.en: Backup {singers} added rich harmonies to the lead vocal.
e.zh: 伴唱歌手为主唱增添了丰富的和声。

singes.t: v. singe 的第三人称单数

e.en: A hot iron easily {singes} delicate silk fabric.
e.zh: 高温的熨斗很容易把娇嫩的丝绸面料烫焦。

e.en: The blowtorch {singes} the sugar into a crisp caramel layer.
e.zh: 喷枪把糖烧成一层酥脆的焦糖。

singing.t:
n. 歌唱；唱歌
v. sing 的现在分词

e.en: She loves {singing} in the shower every morning.
e.zh: 她喜欢每天早上在淋浴时唱歌。

e.en: The choir's {singing} filled the entire cathedral.
e.zh: 唱诗班的歌声响彻整座大教堂。

singings.t: n. 歌唱；合唱聚会（复数）

e.en: The folk {singings} were recorded across rural villages.
e.zh: 这些民歌演唱是在乡村各地录制的。

e.en: Group {singings} were a weekly tradition at the camp.
e.zh: 集体合唱是营地每周的传统活动。

single.t:
adj. 单一的；单身的
n. 单曲；单人房

e.en: I haven't missed a {single} episode of the show.
e.zh: 这部剧我一集都没落下。

e.en: She's been {single} for about two years now.
e.zh: 她已经单身大约两年了。

e.en: She values the {singleness} of purpose her career demands.
e.zh: 她珍视事业所要求的专注与目标单一。

e.en: His {singleness} after the divorce lasted nearly a decade.
e.zh: 离婚后他单身了近十年。

singles.t: n. 单身人士；单打比赛

e.en: The app matches local {singles} based on shared hobbies.
e.zh: 这款应用根据共同爱好为本地单身人士配对。

e.en: She won three {singles} matches at the tennis tournament.
e.zh: 她在网球赛上赢得了三场单打比赛。

e.en: The runner wore a bright orange {singlet} during the marathon.
e.zh: 那位跑者在马拉松中穿着亮橙色背心。

e.en: Each electron forms a {singlet} state in this molecule.
e.zh: 在该分子中每个电子形成单态。

e.en: We use a {singleton} pattern to manage the database connection.
e.zh: 我们用单例模式来管理数据库连接。

e.en: She was a {singleton} born after two sets of twins.
e.zh: 她是两对双胞胎之后出生的独生婴儿。

singly.t: adv. 单独地；一个一个地

e.en: The guests entered the hall {singly} rather than in groups.
e.zh: 客人们一个个地进入大厅,而不是成群结队。

e.en: Please package each item {singly} for safer shipping.
e.zh: 请将每件物品单独包装以便安全运输。

sings.t: v. sing 的第三人称单数

e.en: She {sings} in the church choir every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 她每周日早上在教堂唱诗班唱歌。

e.en: The kettle {sings} when the water reaches boiling point.
e.zh: 水烧开时水壶会发出鸣响。

singsong.t:
n. 单调的抑扬声；合唱会
adj. 腔调起伏的

e.en: The teacher read the story in a {singsong} voice.
e.zh: 老师用抑扬顿挫的语调讲了故事。

e.en: The family had a {singsong} around the campfire.
e.zh: 全家人围着篝火齐声欢唱。

singular.t:
adj. 单数的；非凡的
n. 单数形式

e.en: Her talent for languages is truly {singular} among her peers.
e.zh: 她的语言天赋在同辈中实属罕见。

e.en: In English, 'child' is {singular} and 'children' is plural.
e.zh: 在英语中,child 是单数,children 是复数。

e.en: Black holes contain a {singularity} where physics breaks down.
e.zh: 黑洞中心存在一个使物理定律失效的奇点。

e.en: Many futurists predict a technological {singularity} within this century.
e.zh: 许多未来学家预言本世纪将出现技术奇点。

e.en: The film was {singularly} unimpressive despite its huge budget.
e.zh: 尽管预算巨大,这部电影却异常平庸。

e.en: She is {singularly} qualified for this leadership role.
e.zh: 她担任这一领导职位有着无人能及的资历。

e.en: List the {singulars} for each plural noun in the table.
e.zh: 请列出表中每个复数名词的单数形式。

e.en: Some {singulars} in Latin take unexpected plural endings.
e.zh: 拉丁语中某些单数形式的复数变化出人意料。

sinhalese.t:
n. 僧伽罗人；僧伽罗语
adj. 僧伽罗的

e.en: Most of her relatives speak {Sinhalese} at home in Colombo.
e.zh: 她大多数亲戚在科伦坡家中讲僧伽罗语。

e.en: The menu offers traditional {Sinhalese} curries and rice dishes.
e.zh: 菜单上有传统的僧伽罗咖喱和米饭。

e.en: There was something {sinister} about the abandoned hospital at night.
e.zh: 那座废弃医院夜里透着一股阴森气息。

e.en: Investigators uncovered a {sinister} plot behind the company's collapse.
e.zh: 调查人员揭露了公司倒闭背后的险恶阴谋。

sink.t:
n. 水槽；洗手盆
v. 下沉；使沉没

e.en: Please don't leave dirty dishes in the {sink} overnight.
e.zh: 请不要把脏盘子留在水槽里过夜。

e.en: The boat began to {sink} after striking a hidden rock.
e.zh: 船撞上暗礁后开始下沉。

e.en: He attached a heavy {sinker} to keep the bait underwater.
e.zh: 他系上一个重铅坠让鱼饵沉入水下。

e.en: The pitcher's {sinker} fooled three batters in a row.
e.zh: 投手的下沉球连续骗过了三名打者。

e.en: A massive {sinkhole} opened up in the middle of the highway.
e.zh: 高速公路正中突然塌出一个巨大的天坑。

e.en: Heavy rain caused the {sinkhole} to swallow two parked cars.
e.zh: 暴雨导致天坑吞没了两辆停着的汽车。

sinking.t:
n. 下沉；沉没
adj. 渐沉的

e.en: She had a {sinking} feeling when she saw his face.
e.zh: 看到他的表情,她心里一沉。

e.en: Rescue teams searched for survivors of the {sinking} ferry.
e.zh: 救援队搜寻沉没渡轮上的幸存者。

sinks.t:
v. sink 的第三人称单数
n. 水槽（复数）

e.en: The hotel bathroom has two marble {sinks} side by side.
e.zh: 酒店浴室里并排装着两个大理石洗手台。

e.en: The sun {sinks} behind the mountains by seven o'clock.
e.zh: 太阳七点前就会沉到山后。

e.en: The sermon described a perfectly {sinless} life as impossible.
e.zh: 布道说完全无罪的生活是不可能的。

e.en: She lived a quiet, almost {sinless} existence in the village.
e.zh: 她在村中过着平静而几乎无瑕的生活。

e.en: The priest forgave the {sinner} after a long confession.
e.zh: 听完长长的忏悔后,神父原谅了那位罪人。

e.en: He jokingly called himself a {sinner} for skipping the gym.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说自己跳过健身就是个罪人。

sins.t:
n. 罪；过错（复数）
v. 犯罪

e.en: The novel explores the {sins} of an entire generation.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了整整一代人的罪过。

e.en: Eating dessert before dinner is one of her favorite {sins}.
e.zh: 晚饭前吃甜点是她最爱的小放纵之一。

sinuous.t: adj. 蜿蜒的；曲线优美的

e.en: The {sinuous} river winds through dense tropical forest.
e.zh: 蜿蜒的河流穿过茂密的热带森林。

e.en: She admired the dancer's {sinuous} movements across the stage.
e.zh: 她欣赏舞者在舞台上柔美起伏的动作。

e.en: The path climbs {sinuously} up the steep mountainside.
e.zh: 小路蜿蜒曲折地向陡峭山坡攀升。

e.en: Smoke drifted {sinuously} from the chimney into the cold air.
e.zh: 炊烟从烟囱袅袅升入冷空气中。

situationist.t: n. 情境主义者（艺术/政治流派成员）

e.en: The poster echoes classic {situationist} graphic style.
e.zh: 这张海报呼应了经典的情境主义平面风格。

e.en: He wrote a thesis on {situationist} theory and protest art.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于情境主义理论与抗议艺术的论文。

situations.t: n. 情况；处境（situation 的复数）

e.en: Awkward {situations} are unavoidable when meeting new people.
e.zh: 认识新朋友时,尴尬的场面总是难免的。

e.en: The app handles edge {situations} surprisingly well.
e.zh: 这款应用对边缘情况处理得出奇地好。

sixfold.t:
adj. 六倍的
adv. 六倍地

e.en: Online sales saw a {sixfold} increase last quarter.
e.zh: 上季度线上销售实现了六倍增长。

e.en: The risk rises {sixfold} for heavy smokers.
e.zh: 重度吸烟者的风险会增加六倍。

sixpence.t: n. 六便士（旧英国硬币）

e.en: Grandma kept a silver {sixpence} in her wallet for luck.
e.zh: 奶奶在钱包里放着一枚银六便士硬币求好运。

e.en: The old rhyme mentions a pocket full of {sixpence}.
e.zh: 那首老童谣里提到口袋里装满六便士。

e.en: He bought a {sixpenny} novel at the train station.
e.zh: 他在火车站买了一本六便士的廉价小说。

e.en: The shop sold {sixpenny} nails by the handful.
e.zh: 那家店一把一把地卖六便士钉子。

e.en: My daughter just turned {sixteen} last weekend.
e.zh: 我女儿上周末刚满十六岁。

e.en: There are {sixteen} candidates competing for the role.
e.zh: 有十六位候选人在竞争这个职位。

sixteenth.t:
num. 第十六
n. 十六分之一

e.en: Her birthday falls on the {sixteenth} of June.
e.zh: 她的生日在六月十六日。

e.en: This is the {sixteenth} time I've watched that movie.
e.zh: 这是我第十六次看那部电影了。

sixth.t:
num. 第六
n. 六分之一

e.en: I finished in {sixth} place in the marathon.
e.zh: 我在马拉松比赛中获得第六名。

e.en: My office is on the {sixth} floor of the building.
e.zh: 我的办公室在大楼的六楼。

e.en: And {sixthly}, we need to address the budget shortfall.
e.zh: 第六点,我们需要解决预算缺口的问题。

e.en: {Sixthly}, the report recommends stricter safety checks.
e.zh: 第六,报告建议加强安全检查。

e.en: Five {sixths} of the cake was already gone.
e.zh: 蛋糕已经被吃掉了六分之五。

e.en: Cut the pizza into {sixths} so everyone gets a slice.
e.zh: 把披萨切成六块,这样每人都能分到一块。

sixtieth.t:
num. 第六十
n. 六十分之一

e.en: They threw a huge party for his {sixtieth} birthday.
e.zh: 他们为他的六十岁生日办了一场盛大的派对。

e.en: Today marks the company's {sixtieth} anniversary.
e.zh: 今天是公司成立六十周年纪念日。

e.en: My dad just turned {sixty} and still runs marathons.
e.zh: 我爸刚满六十岁,还在跑马拉松。

e.en: The flight was delayed by about {sixty} minutes.
e.zh: 航班延误了大约六十分钟。

e.en: A {sixtyish} man greeted us at the door.
e.zh: 一位六十岁上下的男人在门口迎接我们。

e.en: She's {sixtyish} but full of energy and humor.
e.zh: 她六十岁左右,却精力充沛、风趣幽默。

e.en: The startup raised a {sizable} round of funding.
e.zh: 这家初创公司融到了一大笔资金。

e.en: There's a {sizable} crowd waiting outside the venue.
e.zh: 场馆外面等着不少人。

size.t:
n. 尺寸；大小；尺码
v. 按大小排列

e.en: What {size} shoe do you wear?
e.zh: 你穿多大码的鞋?

e.en: The file {size} is too large to email.
e.zh: 这个文件太大,没法用邮件发送。

e.en: He inherited a {sizeable} estate from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里继承了一大笔财产。

e.en: The protest drew a {sizeable} crowd downtown.
e.zh: 抗议活动在市中心吸引了相当多的人群。

sized.t: adj. 有…尺寸的（常作复合词）

e.en: The shirts come in {sized} from XS to XXL.
e.zh: 这些衬衫的尺码从XS到XXL都有。

e.en: She bought a medium-{sized} suitcase for the trip.
e.zh: 她为这次旅行买了一个中号行李箱。

sizes.t:
n. 尺寸（复数）
v. 衡量（三单）

e.en: The dress is available in three different {sizes}.
e.zh: 这件连衣裙有三种尺码可选。

e.en: Companies of all {sizes} use this software.
e.zh: 各种规模的公司都在使用这款软件。

sizing.t:
n. 上浆剂；尺寸测定
v. 判断大小

e.en: I'm {sizing} up the competition before I bid.
e.zh: 我在出价前先评估一下竞争对手。

e.en: Their {sizing} runs a bit small, so order up.
e.zh: 他们家的尺码偏小,买的时候建议大一码。

sizzle.t:
v. (油煎时) 发出滋滋声
n. 滋滋声

e.en: I love the {sizzle} of bacon in the morning.
e.zh: 我爱听早晨培根在锅里嗞嗞作响的声音。

e.en: The marketing campaign needs more {sizzle} to grab attention.
e.zh: 这次营销活动需要更多亮点才能吸引注意。

sizzler.t: n. 酷热的一天；极精彩的东西

e.en: Today is going to be a real {sizzler} downtown.
e.zh: 市中心今天会是真正的大热天。

e.en: Her debut single was a summer {sizzler} on the charts.
e.zh: 她的出道单曲是夏季排行榜上的爆款。

e.en: They served a {sizzling} plate of fajitas.
e.zh: 他们端上来一盘嗞嗞作响的法吉塔。

e.en: It was a {sizzling} hot afternoon in the city.
e.zh: 那是城里一个酷热难当的下午。

ska.t: n. 斯卡乐（牙买加音乐流派）

skald.t: n. 古斯堪的纳维亚吟唱诗人

e.en: The {skald} recited verses praising the king's bravery.
e.zh: 那位斯卡尔德吟诵诗歌,赞颂国王的英勇。

e.en: In Norse courts, a {skald} held an honored position.
e.zh: 在古挪威宫廷中,吟游诗人地位尊崇。

skank.t:
n. 贱女人（俚语，贬义）
v. 随斯卡乐起舞

e.en: The kids learned to {skank} to the ska band.
e.zh: 孩子们学着随斯卡乐队跳起斯坎克舞。

e.en: Reggae fans love to {skank} on the dance floor.
e.zh: 雷鬼乐迷喜欢在舞池里跳斯坎克舞。

skanky.t: adj. 下贱的；邋遢的（俚语）

e.en: That alley behind the bar looks pretty {skanky}.
e.zh: 酒吧后面那条小巷看起来挺脏乱的。

e.en: He apologized for the {skanky} state of his apartment.
e.zh: 他为自己公寓的脏乱状况道了歉。

skate.t:
v. 滑冰；滑旱冰
n. 冰鞋；溜冰鞋

e.en: My nephew learned to {skate} when he was four.
e.zh: 我侄子四岁就学会了滑冰。

e.en: She bought a new pair of {skate} shoes online.
e.zh: 她在网上买了一双新的滑板鞋。

skateboard.t:
n. 滑板
v. 玩滑板

e.en: He rides his {skateboard} to school every day.
e.zh: 他每天踩滑板去上学。

e.en: She bought her first {skateboard} at age twelve.
e.zh: 她十二岁时买了自己的第一块滑板。

e.en: A young {skateboarder} nailed the trick on her first try.
e.zh: 一位年轻的滑板手第一次尝试就完成了那个动作。

e.en: The pro {skateboarder} signed autographs after the contest.
e.zh: 那位职业滑板手在比赛结束后签名留念。

e.en: Young {skateboarders} gathered at the new downtown park.
e.zh: 年轻的滑板爱好者聚集在市中心的新公园里。

e.en: The {skateboarders} practiced tricks for hours every weekend.
e.zh: 滑板手们每个周末都要练习几个小时的花式动作。

e.en: {Skateboarding} became an Olympic sport in Tokyo 2020.
e.zh: 滑板在2020年东京奥运会上成为正式比赛项目。

e.en: He's been {skateboarding} since he was eight years old.
e.zh: 他从八岁起就开始玩滑板了。

skateboardings.t: n. 滑板运动（罕用复数）

e.en: Different styles of {skateboardings} have emerged over the decades.
e.zh: 几十年来出现了多种不同流派的滑板运动。

e.en: The video showcases various {skateboardings} from around the world.
e.zh: 这部视频展示了世界各地不同风格的滑板运动。

e.en: He customizes {skateboards} and sells them online.
e.zh: 他定制滑板并在网上出售。

e.en: She {skateboards} to school every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上滑滑板去上学。

e.en: The kids {skated} across the frozen pond all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在结冰的池塘上滑冰。

e.en: He {skated} through the interview without preparing much.
e.zh: 他没怎么准备就轻松应付过了面试。

e.en: The young {skater} landed her first triple axel today.
e.zh: 那位年轻的滑冰选手今天首次完成了三周半跳。

e.en: A {skater} in a hoodie cruised down the empty street.
e.zh: 一个穿着连帽衫的滑板手沿着空荡的街道滑过。

skates.t:
n. 冰鞋（复数）
v. 滑冰（三单）

e.en: She laced up her {skates} and stepped onto the ice.
e.zh: 她系好冰鞋,踏上了冰面。

e.en: My brother {skates} to school every morning.
e.zh: 我弟弟每天早上滑滑板去上学。

e.en: We went {skating} at the rink downtown last weekend.
e.zh: 我们上周末去市中心的溜冰场滑冰了。

e.en: She is {skating} dangerously close to breaking the rules.
e.zh: 她已经游走在违反规则的边缘了。

e.en: The coach reviewed her recent {skatings} on video.
e.zh: 教练通过录像复盘了她最近几次的滑冰表现。

e.en: His winter {skatings} on the lake became a family tradition.
e.zh: 他冬天在湖上滑冰成了家里的传统。

skedaddle.t: v. 仓皇逃走；溜走（口语）

e.en: Come on, kids, time to {skedaddle} before it rains.
e.zh: 快走吧孩子们,下雨前赶紧溜。

e.en: The cat saw the dog and decided to {skedaddle}.
e.zh: 猫一看到狗就赶紧溜之大吉。

e.en: He spent the morning shooting {skeet} at the gun club.
e.zh: 他上午在枪械俱乐部打飞碟。

e.en: The {skeet} range opens at eight on Saturdays.
e.zh: 飞碟射击场周六八点开门。

e.en: A {skeeter} bit me three times during the picnic.
e.zh: 野餐时一只蚊子叮了我三下。

e.en: Bring bug spray or the {skeeter} swarms will eat you alive.
e.zh: 带上驱蚊液,不然蚊子能把你吃了。

skein.t: n. 一绞（纱、线）；一群飞鸟

e.en: She bought a {skein} of soft blue yarn for the scarf.
e.zh: 她买了一绞柔软的蓝色毛线来织围巾。

e.en: A {skein} of geese flew over the quiet lake.
e.zh: 一群大雁飞过宁静的湖面。

skeletal.t: adj. 骨骼的；骨瘦如柴的

e.en: The doctor ordered a {skeletal} survey to check for fractures.
e.zh: 医生安排了全身骨骼检查来查找骨折。

e.en: Only a {skeletal} staff was on duty during the holiday.
e.zh: 假期里只有少数核心员工在岗。

e.en: A plastic {skeleton} hung on the door for Halloween.
e.zh: 一个塑料骷髅挂在门上当万圣节装饰。

e.en: He sketched the {skeleton} of the essay before writing.
e.zh: 他在动笔前先列出了文章的大致框架。

e.en: The museum displays dinosaur {skeletons} in the main hall.
e.zh: 博物馆在主厅展出了恐龙骨架。

e.en: Every family has a few {skeletons} in the closet.
e.zh: 每个家庭都有些不愿提起的秘密。

skelmersdale.t: n. 斯凯尔默斯代尔（英国城镇）

e.en: She grew up in {Skelmersdale} before moving to London.
e.zh: 她在斯凯尔默斯代尔长大,后来搬到了伦敦。

e.en: The train to {Skelmersdale} leaves from platform four.
e.zh: 开往斯凯尔默斯代尔的火车从四号站台发车。

e.en: My {sinus} pain always gets worse during allergy season.
e.zh: 过敏季节我的鼻窦疼痛总是加重。

e.en: The doctor ordered a CT scan of her {sinus} cavities.
e.zh: 医生为她的鼻窦腔预约了CT扫描。

e.en: Chronic {sinusitis} has plagued him for most of the winter.
e.zh: 慢性鼻窦炎困扰了他整个冬天的大部分时间。

e.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for her bacterial {sinusitis}.
e.zh: 医生给她的细菌性鼻窦炎开了抗生素。

e.en: The signal traces a perfect {sinusoid} on the oscilloscope.
e.zh: 该信号在示波器上呈现出完美的正弦曲线。

e.en: Blood flows slowly through each liver {sinusoid} for filtration.
e.zh: 血液缓慢流经肝窦以进行过滤。

sinusoidal.t: adj. 正弦的；正弦波形的

e.en: Alternating current follows a {sinusoidal} pattern over time.
e.zh: 交流电随时间呈正弦波形变化。

e.en: The stock price showed a roughly {sinusoidal} seasonal cycle.
e.zh: 股价呈现出大致正弦形的季节性周期。

e.en: The pendulum's position varies {sinusoidally} with respect to time.
e.zh: 摆的位置随时间呈正弦变化。

e.en: Temperatures oscillate {sinusoidally} between day and night.
e.zh: 昼夜温度呈正弦曲线般振荡。

e.en: We took the train to {Sion} for a weekend in the Alps.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去锡永,在阿尔卑斯山度过周末。

e.en: The vineyards around {Sion} produce excellent Swiss white wines.
e.zh: 锡永周边的葡萄园出产优质的瑞士白葡萄酒。

e.en: The museum displays artifacts from several {Sioux} tribes.
e.zh: 博物馆展出多个苏族部落的文物。

e.en: Her grandmother taught her several {Sioux} words as a child.
e.zh: 她奶奶在她小时候教过她几个苏族语词汇。

sip.t:
v. 小口啜饮
n. 一小口

siphon.t:
n. 虹吸管
v. 用虹吸管抽取

e.en: He used a hose to {siphon} gasoline from the tank.
e.zh: 他用一根软管从油箱里虹吸汽油。

e.en: Investigators say the manager tried to {siphon} company funds offshore.
e.zh: 调查人员称经理试图把公司资金转移到海外。

e.en: A giant {siphonophore} can stretch longer than a blue whale.
e.zh: 巨型管水母的体长可以超过蓝鲸。

e.en: Each {siphonophore} is actually a colony of specialized organisms.
e.zh: 每只管水母实际上是由特化生物组成的群体。

sipper.t: n. 吸管；小口啜饮的人

e.en: She's a slow {sipper} who makes one coffee last hours.
e.zh: 她喝东西很慢,一杯咖啡能喝上几个小时。

e.en: The baby drank juice from a soft silicone {sipper}.
e.zh: 宝宝用柔软的硅胶吸嘴杯喝果汁。

sippy.t: adj. 吸嘴式的（sippy cup 学饮杯）

e.en: The toddler refused to drink from any cup but his {sippy}.
e.zh: 那个小孩除了自己的吸管杯,什么杯子都不肯用。

e.en: We packed a {sippy} cup for the long car ride.
e.zh: 我们为长途车程准备了一个儿童吸管杯。

sire.t:
n. 种马（公畜）
v. 做…的父亲

e.en: The champion stallion will {sire} dozens of foals next season.
e.zh: 那匹冠军种马下个赛季将繁育几十只马驹。

e.en: "Your wish, my {sire}," said the loyal knight.
e.zh: "遵命,陛下,"忠诚的骑士说道。

e.en: An ambulance {siren} wailed through the empty city streets.
e.zh: 救护车的警笛声划破了空荡的城市街道。

e.en: Sailors in the myth could not resist the {siren}'s song.
e.zh: 神话中水手们无法抗拒塞壬的歌声。

e.en: {Sirius} is the brightest star visible in the night sky.
e.zh: 天狼星是夜空中最亮的恒星。

e.en: Ancient Egyptians timed the Nile flood by watching {Sirius}.
e.zh: 古埃及人通过观测天狼星来推算尼罗河洪水的时间。

e.en: He ordered a medium-rare {sirloin} with garlic mashed potatoes.
e.zh: 他点了一份三分熟西冷牛排配蒜香土豆泥。

e.en: The butcher recommended a thick cut of {sirloin} for grilling.
e.zh: 屠夫推荐了一块厚切西冷牛排用来烧烤。

sirree.t: n. 先生（yes sirree 中的加强语气）

e.en: No {sirree}, I'm not driving through that snowstorm tonight.
e.zh: 绝对不行,先生,我今晚不会冒雪开车。

e.en: Yes {sirree}, that's the best pie in the whole county.
e.zh: 没错,先生,这就是全县最好吃的派。

sirs.t: n. 先生们（sir 的复数）

e.en: "Good evening, {sirs}," the waiter said with a slight bow.
e.zh: "先生们,晚上好,"侍者微微鞠躬说道。

e.en: The letter was addressed to the gentlemen as "Dear {sirs}".
e.zh: 那封信以"尊敬的先生们"开头致那几位绅士。

e.en: They laid a durable {sisal} rug in the entryway.
e.zh: 他们在门厅铺了一块耐用的剑麻地毯。

e.en: Farmers in Tanzania still grow {sisal} for export rope.
e.zh: 坦桑尼亚的农民仍在种植剑麻用于出口制绳。

e.en: A small {siskin} landed on the bird feeder this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上有只小黄雀落在喂鸟器上。

e.en: The {siskin} is known for its bright yellow wing bars.
e.zh: 黄雀以其鲜亮的黄色翼斑而闻名。

sissy.t:
n. 娘娘腔；胆小鬼
adj. 娘娘腔的

e.en: Don't call him a {sissy} just because he hates horror movies.
e.zh: 别因为他讨厌恐怖片就叫他胆小鬼。

e.en: He insisted that crying at movies doesn't make anyone a {sissy}.
e.zh: 他坚持说看电影哭并不代表谁就是软蛋。

e.en: My younger {sister} just started her first year of college.
e.zh: 我妹妹刚刚开始大学一年级的生活。

e.en: The two cafés are {sister} businesses owned by the same family.
e.zh: 这两家咖啡馆是同一家族经营的姐妹店。

sister-in-law.t: n. 嫂子；弟媳；小姑/大姑

e.en: My {sister-in-law} hosts Thanksgiving dinner for both families every year.
e.zh: 我嫂子每年为两家人主办感恩节晚餐。

e.en: He drove his {sister-in-law} to the airport early Monday morning.
e.zh: 周一一大早他开车送小姑子去了机场。

sister-in-laws.t: n. sisters-in-law 的非正式复数

e.en: Both of his {sister-in-laws} flew in for the wedding.
e.zh: 他的两位嫂子都飞过来参加婚礼。

e.en: Her {sister-in-laws} organized a surprise baby shower last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末她的几位嫂子办了一场惊喜迎婴派对。

sisterhood.t: n. 姐妹情谊；女性团体

e.en: The book celebrates the {sisterhood} formed during their college years.
e.zh: 这本书赞颂了她们大学期间结下的姐妹情谊。

e.en: She joined a local {sisterhood} that supports single mothers.
e.zh: 她加入了一个支持单身母亲的当地姐妹会。

sisterly.t: adj. 姐妹般的；亲如姐妹的

e.en: She gave me a {sisterly} hug at the airport.
e.zh: 她在机场给了我一个姐妹般的拥抱。

e.en: Their bond is warm and deeply {sisterly}.
e.zh: 她们的感情温暖,情同姐妹。

sisters.t: n. 姐妹们（sister 的复数）

e.en: My two {sisters} both live in Shanghai now.
e.zh: 我的两个姐妹现在都住在上海。

e.en: The {sisters} run a small bakery downtown.
e.zh: 这对姐妹在市中心经营一家小面包店。

sistine.t: adj. 西斯廷的（西斯廷礼拜堂）

e.en: We waited an hour to enter the {Sistine} Chapel.
e.zh: 我们排了一个小时的队才进入西斯廷礼拜堂。

e.en: Michelangelo's {Sistine} ceiling still draws huge crowds.
e.zh: 米开朗琪罗的西斯廷天顶画至今仍吸引大量游客。

sisyphean.t: adj. 永无止境的；徒劳的

e.en: Clearing my inbox feels like a {Sisyphean} task.
e.zh: 清理收件箱感觉像是永无止境的徒劳。

e.en: Fighting misinformation online can seem {Sisyphean}.
e.zh: 在网上打击虚假信息常常像西西弗斯式的徒劳。

sisyphus.t: n. 西西弗斯（希腊神话人物）

e.en: He compared his job to that of {Sisyphus}.
e.zh: 他把自己的工作比作西西弗斯。

e.en: In the myth, {Sisyphus} pushes a boulder up forever.
e.zh: 在神话中,西西弗斯永远地推着巨石上山。

e.en: He learned to play the {sitar} in Varanasi.
e.zh: 他在瓦拉纳西学会了弹西塔琴。

e.en: The track opens with a haunting {sitar} melody.
e.zh: 这首曲子以一段萦绕心头的西塔琴旋律开场。

e.en: Friends is probably the most rewatched American {sitcom}.
e.zh: 《老友记》大概是被重看最多次的美国情景喜剧。

e.en: He's writing a {sitcom} pilot for Netflix.
e.zh: 他正在为网飞写一部情景喜剧的试播集。

e.en: The construction {site} is closed to visitors today.
e.zh: 今天工地不对访客开放。

e.en: Their official {site} crashed during the product launch.
e.zh: 他们的官网在产品发布时崩溃了。

sites.t:
n. 网站/地点（复数）
v. site 的第三人称单数

e.en: Several news {sites} reported the same story today.
e.zh: 今天有好几个新闻网站报道了同一则消息。

e.en: Archaeological {sites} dot the entire river valley.
e.zh: 考古遗址遍布整条河谷。

e.en: The {siting} of the new factory caused public protests.
e.zh: 新工厂的选址引发了公众抗议。

e.en: Careful {siting} of solar panels maximizes energy output.
e.zh: 仔细选址安装太阳能板可以最大化发电量。

sitka.t: n. 锡特卡（美国阿拉斯加地名）

e.en: We took the ferry to {Sitka} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们坐渡轮去了锡特卡。

e.en: {Sitka} spruce is prized for making guitars.
e.zh: 锡特卡云杉因适合做吉他而备受推崇。

sits.t: v. sit 的第三人称单数；坐着；位于

e.en: My cat always {sits} on my keyboard while I work.
e.zh: 我工作时,我的猫总是坐在键盘上。

e.en: The village {sits} quietly at the foot of the mountain.
e.zh: 那个村庄静静地坐落在山脚下。

sitter.t: n. 保姆；看护人；坐着的人

e.en: We hired a {sitter} so we could see the movie.
e.zh: 我们请了个临时保姆,这样才能去看电影。

e.en: Our dog {sitter} sends us photos every afternoon.
e.zh: 我们的宠物看护每天下午都会发照片给我们。

sitting.t:
n. 一次静坐；开会
v. sit 的现在分词

e.en: She's {sitting} by the window reading a novel.
e.zh: 她正坐在窗边看小说。

e.en: My laptop has been {sitting} unused for months.
e.zh: 我的笔记本电脑已经闲置好几个月了。

e.en: Tea was served in the small {sitting-room}.
e.zh: 茶被端到那间小起居室里。

e.en: Their {sitting-room} has a fireplace and wooden beams.
e.zh: 他们的起居室有壁炉和木梁。

e.en: Let me {situate} this event in its historical context.
e.zh: 让我把这一事件放到它的历史背景中来看。

e.en: They plan to {situate} the new campus near the river.
e.zh: 他们计划把新校区设在河边附近。

e.en: The hotel is conveniently {situated} near the train station.
e.zh: 这家酒店位置便利,就在火车站附近。

e.en: She's well {situated} in her career right now.
e.zh: 她目前的事业发展得很顺利。

e.en: The {situation} at work has gotten really stressful.
e.zh: 工作上的情况变得压力非常大。

e.en: Let's assess the {situation} before making any decisions.
e.zh: 我们先评估一下情况再做决定。

situational.t: adj. 情境的；因情境而异的

e.en: Good leaders develop strong {situational} awareness.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者会培养很强的情境意识。

e.en: The comedy relies on {situational} humor rather than jokes.
e.zh: 这部喜剧靠情境笑料而不是段子取胜。

skeptic.t: n. 怀疑论者；持怀疑态度的人

e.en: He is a {skeptic} when it comes to crypto investments.
e.zh: 对于加密货币投资,他是个怀疑论者。

e.en: Even the biggest {skeptic} was impressed by the demo.
e.zh: 连最持怀疑态度的人也被这次演示打动了。

e.en: I'm {skeptical} that the new feature will ship on time.
e.zh: 我怀疑这个新功能能不能按时上线。

e.en: She gave him a {skeptical} look and changed the subject.
e.zh: 她怀疑地看了他一眼,转而换了话题。

skeptically.t: adv. 怀疑地；将信将疑地

e.en: He raised an eyebrow {skeptically} at her excuse.
e.zh: 他怀疑地挑了挑眉,听着她的借口。

e.en: The investors listened {skeptically} to the startup's pitch.
e.zh: 投资人将信将疑地听完了创业团队的演示。

skepticism.t: n. 怀疑态度；怀疑主义

e.en: There is growing {skepticism} about the company's earnings claims.
e.zh: 人们对该公司的盈利说法越来越持怀疑态度。

e.en: Healthy {skepticism} helps you avoid online scams.
e.zh: 保持适度的怀疑能帮你避开网络骗局。

e.en: Seals were sunbathing on the rocky {skerry} offshore.
e.zh: 海豹正在近海那块小礁岛上晒太阳。

e.en: The lighthouse stands on a tiny {skerry} in the bay.
e.zh: 灯塔矗立在海湾里一座小礁石上。

sketch.t:
n. 草图；速写
v. 勾勒；简述

e.en: Let me {sketch} the layout on a napkin.
e.zh: 我在餐巾纸上画一下大致布局吧。

e.en: She showed me a quick {sketch} of the new logo.
