e.en: He took an online {songwriting} course during the pandemic.
e.zh: 他在疫情期间上了一门在线词曲创作课程。

e.en: Her {songwriting} blends folk lyrics with electronic beats.
e.zh: 她的词曲创作把民谣歌词与电子节拍融合在一起。

e.en: The new headphones deliver impressive {sonic} clarity.
e.zh: 这款新耳机提供了出色的音质清晰度。

e.en: A {sonic} boom shook the windows of nearby houses.
e.zh: 一声音爆震动了附近房屋的窗户。

sonically.t: adv. 在声音上；音响效果上

e.en: The album is {sonically} richer than her previous work.
e.zh: 这张专辑在音效上比她以前的作品更丰富。

e.en: The film is {sonically} immersive from start to finish.
e.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都极具沉浸式音效。

e.en: He wrote a {sonnet} for her birthday card.
e.zh: 他在她的生日卡上写了一首十四行诗。

e.en: Shakespeare's {sonnet} eighteen is widely quoted today.
e.zh: 莎士比亚的第十八首十四行诗如今被广为引用。

e.en: We studied Petrarch's {sonnets} in literature class.
e.zh: 我们在文学课上学习了彼特拉克的十四行诗。

e.en: She published a slim volume of love {sonnets} last year.
e.zh: 她去年出版了一本薄薄的爱情十四行诗集。

sonny.t: n. 小家伙；小子（对男孩的称呼）

e.en: Hey {sonny}, can you grab the mail for me?
e.zh: 嘿小子，能帮我去拿一下信吗？

e.en: The old man called the boy {sonny} with a smile.
e.zh: 老人微笑着叫那男孩小伙子。

e.en: The doctor showed us the baby's first {sonogram}.
e.zh: 医生给我们看了宝宝的第一张超声图。

e.en: She framed the {sonogram} from her twenty-week scan.
e.zh: 她把二十周产检的超声图裱了起来。

e.en: She studied {sonography} to become a medical imaging technician.
e.zh: 她学习超声成像，想成为一名医学影像技师。

e.en: Modern {sonography} can detect heart problems in unborn babies.
e.zh: 现代超声检查能发现胎儿的心脏问题。

e.en: The cello's deep {sonority} filled the concert hall.
e.zh: 大提琴深沉的音色充满了整个音乐厅。

e.en: His voice has a rich {sonority} that captivates listeners.
e.zh: 他的嗓音浑厚悦耳，能吸引听众。

e.en: The priest read the prayer in a {sonorous} voice.
e.zh: 牧师用洪亮的嗓音诵读祷文。

e.en: A {sonorous} bell rang through the village at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨，洪亮的钟声响彻整个村庄。

e.en: The announcer spoke {sonorously} into the microphone.
e.zh: 播音员对着麦克风声音洪亮地说话。

e.en: The organ played {sonorously} during the wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 婚礼上管风琴奏出洪亮的乐声。

e.en: She has three {sons} who all live abroad.
e.zh: 她有三个儿子，都住在国外。

e.en: Both {sons} took over the family business after college.
e.zh: 两个儿子大学毕业后都接手了家族生意。

e.en: Her two {sons-in-law} get along surprisingly well.
e.zh: 她的两个女婿相处得出奇地好。

e.en: The grandfather treats his {sons-in-law} like his own children.
e.zh: 外公把女婿们当亲生孩子一样对待。

e.en: I bought a new {Sony} camera for my trip.
e.zh: 我为旅行买了一台新的索尼相机。

e.en: {Sony} announced the next PlayStation console at the event.
e.zh: 索尼在活动上公布了新一代 PlayStation 主机。

e.en: The package should arrive {soon}, probably tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 包裹应该很快就到，可能明早就能收到。

e.en: Please call me back as {soon} as possible.
e.zh: 请尽快给我回个电话。

e.en: I wish I had started exercising {sooner}.
e.zh: 我真希望自己更早开始锻炼。

e.en: The {sooner} you apologize, the better it will be.
e.zh: 你越早道歉就越好。

e.en: Send me the report at your {soonest} convenience.
e.zh: 请在你方便时尽早把报告发给我。

e.en: Whoever finishes {soonest} will help the others.
e.zh: 谁最先完成就去帮其他人。

e.en: The chimney was clogged with thick black {soot}.
e.zh: 烟囱里被厚厚的黑色煤灰堵住了。

e.en: His face was covered in {soot} after the fire.
e.zh: 火灾过后，他满脸都是煤灰。

e.en: In {sooth}, the old knight had no fear of death.
e.zh: 说真的，那位老骑士并不畏惧死亡。

e.en: To tell the {sooth}, I never trusted his promises.
e.zh: 老实说，我从不相信他的承诺。

soothe.t: v. 安抚，缓解（情绪、疼痛）

e.en: A warm bath can {soothe} your sore muscles.
e.zh: 洗个热水澡能舒缓你酸痛的肌肉。

e.en: She sang softly to {soothe} the crying baby.
e.zh: 她轻声唱歌哄哭闹的宝宝。

soothed.t: v. soothe 的过去式，已安抚

e.en: His calm voice {soothed} her after the bad news.
e.zh: 听到坏消息后，他平静的声音让她安心了。

e.en: The lotion {soothed} the itching almost immediately.
e.zh: 那款乳液几乎立刻就缓解了瘙痒。

e.en: The baby fell asleep with a {soother} in her mouth.
e.zh: 宝宝含着安抚奶嘴睡着了。

e.en: Lavender oil is a natural {soother} for stressed minds.
e.zh: 薰衣草精油是缓解压力的天然舒缓剂。

soothes.t: v. soothe 的第三人称单数

e.en: Chamomile tea {soothes} my stomach after a heavy meal.
e.zh: 饱餐之后，洋甘菊茶能舒缓我的胃。

e.en: Soft music always {soothes} him before bedtime.
e.zh: 睡前轻柔的音乐总能让他平静下来。

e.en: The {soothing} sound of rain helped me fall asleep.
e.zh: 舒缓的雨声让我很快入睡。

e.en: She used a {soothing} cream on her sunburn.
e.zh: 她在晒伤处涂了舒缓霜。

e.en: He spoke {soothingly} to the frightened puppy.
e.zh: 他温柔地安抚着受惊的小狗。

e.en: The therapist talked {soothingly} during the meditation session.
e.zh: 冥想课上，治疗师用平静的语调说话。

e.en: The {soothsayer} warned Caesar about the Ides of March.
e.zh: 那位预言家警告凯撒要小心三月十五日。

e.en: Ancient kings often consulted a {soothsayer} before battle.
e.zh: 古代国王在出征前常会咨询预言者。

sooty.t: adj. 沾满煤灰的，乌黑的

e.en: The miners came home with {sooty} faces every evening.
e.zh: 矿工们每天晚上都满脸煤灰地回家。

e.en: A {sooty} fingerprint was left on the white wall.
e.zh: 白墙上留下了一个黑乎乎的指印。

sop.t:
n. 安抚之物
v. 浸泡，吸干

sophism.t: n. 诡辩，似是而非的论点

e.en: His argument was clever but ultimately just {sophism}.
e.zh: 他的论点很巧妙，但归根结底只是诡辩。

e.en: The professor exposed the {sophism} hidden in the essay.
e.zh: 教授指出了那篇文章中隐藏的诡辩。

e.en: Critics called him a {sophist} for twisting the facts.
e.zh: 评论者称他是个诡辩者，因为他歪曲事实。

e.en: Plato strongly opposed the teachings of every {sophist}.
e.zh: 柏拉图强烈反对所有诡辩学派的学说。

sophisticate.t:
n. 老于世故者
v. 使复杂化

e.en: She is a true urban {sophisticate} with refined taste.
e.zh: 她是个真正的都市精英，品味高雅。

e.en: Engineers worked to {sophisticate} the algorithm further.
e.zh: 工程师们努力让算法变得更加精密。

sophisticated.t: adj. 精密的，复杂的；老练的

e.en: The app uses a {sophisticated} algorithm to recommend music.
e.zh: 这款应用用复杂的算法来推荐音乐。

e.en: She wore a {sophisticated} black dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一条优雅别致的黑裙参加晚宴。

e.en: The film's visual {sophistication} impressed every critic.
e.zh: 这部电影画面之精致让每位影评人都印象深刻。

e.en: Her writing shows great {sophistication} for someone so young.
e.zh: 作为这么年轻的人，她的文笔相当老练。

e.en: The lawyer's defense was pure {sophistry} from start to finish.
e.zh: 那位律师的辩护从头到尾都是诡辩。

e.en: Don't fall for the {sophistry} in political speeches.
e.zh: 别被政治演说里的诡辩所迷惑。

sophocles.t: n. 索福克勒斯（古希腊剧作家）

e.en: {Sophocles} wrote some of the greatest Greek tragedies ever performed.
e.zh: 索福克勒斯写出了史上最伟大的几部希腊悲剧。

e.en: We read Oedipus Rex by {Sophocles} in literature class.
e.zh: 我们在文学课上读了索福克勒斯的《俄狄浦斯王》。

e.en: She is a {sophomore} majoring in computer science.
e.zh: 她是计算机专业的大二学生。

e.en: His {sophomore} album was even better than the first.
e.zh: 他的第二张专辑比第一张还要出色。

e.en: The {sophomores} organized a charity run on campus.
e.zh: 二年级学生在校园里组织了一场慈善跑。

e.en: Many {sophomores} struggle to choose a major.
e.zh: 许多大二学生在选择专业时很纠结。

sophomoric.t: adj. 自以为是的，幼稚的

e.en: His {sophomoric} jokes embarrassed everyone at the dinner.
e.zh: 他幼稚的玩笑让晚宴上所有人都很尴尬。

e.en: The film relies on {sophomoric} humor and weak plotting.
e.zh: 这部电影靠的是幼稚的笑料和薄弱的剧情。

soporific.t:
adj. 催眠的，令人昏昏欲睡的
n. 安眠药

e.en: The professor's monotone voice had a {soporific} effect.
e.zh: 教授单调的声音让人昏昏欲睡。

e.en: Warm milk acts as a mild {soporific} for many people.
e.zh: 对许多人来说，温牛奶有轻微的助眠作用。

e.en: He came inside {sopping} wet from the rainstorm.
e.zh: 他从暴雨中进来，浑身湿透了。

e.en: The towel was {sopping} after she dried the dog.
e.zh: 她给狗擦干后，毛巾已经湿透了。

soppy.t: adj. 多愁善感的；湿透的

e.en: He cried at every {soppy} romance movie they watched.
e.zh: 每看一部煽情的爱情片他都会哭。

e.en: Stop being so {soppy} and just send the text.
e.zh: 别那么婆婆妈妈了，赶紧把短信发出去吧。

e.en: The lead {soprano} hit every note perfectly tonight.
e.zh: 今晚首席女高音每个音都唱得完美。

e.en: She sings {soprano} in her university choir.
e.zh: 她在大学合唱团里唱女高音。

sopwith.t: n. 索普威思（英国飞机制造商）

e.en: The museum displayed a restored {Sopwith} biplane from 1917.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一架修复过的1917年索普威斯双翼机。

e.en: Pilots flew the {Sopwith} Camel during the First World War.
e.zh: 飞行员们在一战中驾驶索普威斯骆驼战斗机。

e.en: We had lemon {sorbet} between courses to cleanse our palates.
e.zh: 上菜间隙我们吃了柠檬冰沙清口。

e.en: Raspberry {sorbet} is the perfect dessert on a hot day.
e.zh: 覆盆子果冰沙是炎热天气最棒的甜点。

e.en: Sugar-free gum often contains {sorbitol} as a sweetener.
e.zh: 无糖口香糖常用山梨糖醇作为甜味剂。

e.en: Too much {sorbitol} can upset your stomach.
e.zh: 摄入过多山梨糖醇会让肠胃不适。

e.en: She studied philosophy at the {Sorbonne} for two years.
e.zh: 她在索邦大学攻读了两年哲学。

e.en: The {Sorbonne} is one of the oldest universities in Europe.
e.zh: 索邦大学是欧洲最古老的大学之一。

e.en: The garden featured a {sorbus} tree with bright red berries.
e.zh: 花园里有一棵结着鲜红浆果的花楸树。

e.en: Birds love feeding on {sorbus} fruit in autumn.
e.zh: 秋天，鸟儿很喜欢吃花楸果。

e.en: The {sorcerer} cast a spell to protect the village.
e.zh: 巫师施法保护了整个村庄。

e.en: In the game, you play as a powerful fire {sorcerer}.
e.zh: 游戏中你扮演一位强大的火系法师。

e.en: The {sorceress} brewed a potion under the full moon.
e.zh: 女巫在满月下熬制魔药。

e.en: A wise {sorceress} guided the hero through the dark forest.
e.zh: 一位睿智的女法师引领英雄穿过黑暗森林。

e.en: Villagers accused the old woman of practicing {sorcery}.
e.zh: 村民们指控那位老妇人施行巫术。

e.en: How the magician escaped looked like pure {sorcery}.
e.zh: 魔术师逃脱的方式看起来简直就像是巫术。

e.en: The newspaper revealed the {sordid} details of the scandal.
e.zh: 报纸披露了这起丑闻的肮脏细节。

e.en: They lived in a {sordid} apartment near the docks.
e.zh: 他们住在码头附近一间肮脏破败的公寓里。

sore.t:
adj. 疼痛的
n. 疮，痛处

e.en: My legs are {sore} after yesterday's long run.
e.zh: 昨天跑了那么久，我的腿现在很酸。

e.en: She has a {sore} throat and a slight fever.
e.zh: 她喉咙痛，还有点发烧。

e.en: Your help will be {sorely} missed when you leave.
e.zh: 你走后我们会非常想念你的帮助。

e.en: The team is {sorely} lacking a reliable goalkeeper.
e.zh: 球队非常缺一个可靠的门将。

e.en: Stretching after exercise reduces muscle {soreness} the next day.
e.zh: 运动后拉伸能减轻第二天的肌肉酸痛。

e.en: The {soreness} in her shoulder finally went away.
e.zh: 她肩膀的酸痛终于消失了。

e.en: Farmers in this region mainly grow {sorghum} and millet.
e.zh: 这个地区的农民主要种植高粱和小米。

e.en: Pancakes taste great with a drizzle of {sorghum} syrup.
e.zh: 煎饼淋上一点高粱糖浆特别好吃。

sorority.t:
n. 女生联谊会
n. 姐妹情谊

e.en: She joined a {sorority} during her freshman year.
e.zh: 她大一时加入了一个姐妹会。

e.en: The {sorority} hosts a fundraiser every spring semester.
e.zh: 姐妹会每年春季学期都会举办募捐活动。

sorrel.t:
n. 酸模（植物）
adj. 栗色的

e.en: She rode a beautiful {sorrel} mare across the field.
e.zh: 她骑着一匹漂亮的栗色母马穿过田野。

e.en: Add fresh {sorrel} leaves to the soup for tang.
e.zh: 在汤里加些新鲜的酸模叶提味。

sorrow.t:
n. 悲伤；悲痛
v. 感到悲伤

e.en: Her eyes were filled with deep {sorrow}.
e.zh: 她的眼中充满了深深的悲伤。

e.en: Time slowly eased the {sorrow} of losing him.
e.zh: 时间慢慢减轻了失去他的悲痛。

e.en: She gave me a {sorrowful} look before leaving.
e.zh: 她离开前看了我一眼,神情悲伤。

e.en: The song has a slow, {sorrowful} melody.
e.zh: 这首歌有着缓慢而忧伤的旋律。

e.en: He shook his head {sorrowfully} at the news.
e.zh: 听到这消息,他悲伤地摇了摇头。

e.en: She {sorrowfully} packed up her late mother's things.
e.zh: 她悲痛地收拾起亡母的遗物。

e.en: The {sorrowing} family gathered quietly at the funeral.
e.zh: 悲痛的家人在葬礼上静静地聚在一起。

e.en: He comforted the {sorrowing} widow with kind words.
e.zh: 他用温暖的话语安慰那位悲痛的寡妇。

e.en: She drowned her {sorrows} in a glass of wine.
e.zh: 她借一杯酒来浇愁。

e.en: Everyone has joys and {sorrows} in life.
e.zh: 人生中每个人都有喜悦与忧愁。

sorry.t:
adj. 抱歉的；遗憾的
adj. 可怜的

e.en: I'm {sorry} I missed your birthday party.
e.zh: 很抱歉我错过了你的生日派对。

e.en: The abandoned house was in a {sorry} state.
e.zh: 那栋废弃的房子状况很糟糕。

sort.t:
v. 排序；分类
n. 种类

e.en: Please {sort} these files by date created.
e.zh: 请按创建日期对这些文件进行排序。

e.en: What {sort} of music do you usually listen to?
e.zh: 你通常听哪种类型的音乐?

sorta.t: adv. 有点；算是（sort of 的口语）

e.en: I {sorta} like the new design, but not totally.
e.zh: 我有点喜欢新设计,但也不是完全满意。

e.en: It's {sorta} cold today, bring a jacket.
e.zh: 今天有点冷,带件外套吧。

sorted.t: adj. 已排序的；整理好的

e.en: I've {sorted} all the emails into folders.
e.zh: 我已经把所有邮件分类放进文件夹了。

e.en: Don't worry, everything is {sorted} for tomorrow.
e.zh: 别担心,明天的事都安排好了。

e.en: The mail {sorter} machine processes thousands of letters hourly.
e.zh: 邮件分拣机每小时处理数千封信件。

e.en: She works as a package {sorter} at the warehouse.
e.zh: 她在仓库里担任包裹分拣员。

sortie.t:
n. 出击；突围
n. 短途外出

e.en: The fighter jets flew another {sortie} at dawn.
e.zh: 战斗机在黎明时又出动了一次。

e.en: They made a quick {sortie} into enemy territory.
e.zh: 他们对敌方领土进行了一次快速突袭。

e.en: I'm {sorting} through old photos this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末我在整理旧照片。

e.en: The algorithm uses a fast {sorting} method.
e.zh: 该算法使用了一种快速排序方法。

sorts.t:
n. 种类（复数）
v. 排序（三单）

e.en: The shop sells all {sorts} of handmade jewelry.
e.zh: 这家店出售各种各样的手工首饰。

e.en: She {sorts} her laundry by color before washing.
e.zh: 她在洗衣服前会按颜色分类。

e.en: The professor explained the {soteriological} themes in early Christianity.
e.zh: 教授讲解了早期基督教中的救赎论主题。

e.en: His thesis takes a {soteriological} approach to the text.
e.zh: 他的论文从救赎论的角度解读这篇文献。

e.en: {Soteriology} is the study of religious salvation doctrines.
e.zh: 救赎论是研究宗教救赎教义的学问。

e.en: She specializes in Christian {soteriology} at the seminary.
e.zh: 她在神学院专攻基督教救赎论。

e.en: The painting sold for millions at {Sotheby}'s auction.
e.zh: 那幅画在苏富比拍卖会上以数百万售出。

e.en: {Sotheby}'s announced a major contemporary art sale.
e.zh: 苏富比宣布将举办一场重要的当代艺术拍卖。

e.en: He practices Zen meditation in the {Soto} tradition.
e.zh: 他按照曹洞宗的传统修习禅坐。

e.en: The temple belongs to the {Soto} school of Buddhism.
e.zh: 这座寺庙属于佛教曹洞宗。

sou.t: n. 苏（旧法国小额硬币）

e.en: The boxer earned the {soubriquet} "Iron Fist" young.
e.zh: 这位拳手年轻时就赢得了"铁拳"的绰号。

e.en: She acquired the {soubriquet} of "Queen of Pop".
e.zh: 她获得了"流行天后"的别号。

e.en: She baked a perfect cheese {souffle} for dinner.
e.zh: 她为晚餐烤了一个完美的奶酪舒芙蕾。

e.en: The chocolate {souffle} rose beautifully in the oven.
e.zh: 巧克力舒芙蕾在烤箱里漂亮地涨起来了。

sough.t:
n. 飒飒声
v. (风) 呼啸

e.en: You could hear the {sough} of wind through pines.
e.zh: 能听到风穿过松林的飒飒声。

e.en: Leaves {sough} softly in the evening breeze.
e.zh: 树叶在晚风中沙沙作响。

sought.t:
v. seek 的过去式
adj. 受追捧的

e.en: He has long {sought} a solution to this problem.
e.zh: 他一直在寻找解决这个问题的办法。

e.en: She is a highly {sought}-after consultant in finance.
e.zh: 她是金融界备受追捧的咨询师。

souk.t: n. 集市（阿拉伯露天市场）

e.en: We wandered through the busy {souk} in Marrakech.
e.zh: 我们在马拉喀什热闹的露天市场中闲逛。

e.en: The {souk} sells spices, lamps, and handwoven rugs.
e.zh: 这个集市出售香料、灯具和手织地毯。

soul.t:
n. 灵魂；心灵
n. 灵魂乐

e.en: Music has the power to heal the {soul}.
e.zh: 音乐有治愈心灵的力量。

e.en: Not a single {soul} was on the street.
e.zh: 街上一个人影都没有。

soulful.t: adj. 深情的；充满感情的

e.en: She sang the ballad with a {soulful} voice.
e.zh: 她用饱含深情的嗓音演唱了那首民谣。

e.en: The dog gave him a {soulful} look.
e.zh: 那只狗深情地望着他。

e.en: He played the saxophone {soulfully} late into the night.
e.zh: 他深情地吹着萨克斯,直到深夜。

e.en: She gazed {soulfully} into his eyes.
e.zh: 她深情地凝视着他的双眼。

e.en: Her singing has a rare {soulfulness} that moves audiences.
e.zh: 她的歌声有一种打动人心的难得深情。

e.en: The film is praised for its quiet {soulfulness}.
e.zh: 这部电影因其静谧的深情而备受赞誉。

e.en: The new shopping mall feels cold and {soulless}.
e.zh: 这家新商场让人感觉冷漠又毫无生气。

e.en: Critics called the movie a {soulless} cash grab.
e.zh: 评论家称这部电影是一部毫无灵魂的圈钱之作。

e.en: She believes she finally found her {soulmate}.
e.zh: 她相信自己终于找到了灵魂伴侣。

e.en: My best friend has been my {soulmate} since childhood.
e.zh: 我最好的朋友从小就是我的灵魂伴侣。

e.en: The village had only fifty {souls} living there.
e.zh: 那个村子里只住着五十个人。

e.en: Brave {souls} ventured out into the snowstorm.
e.zh: 一些勇敢的人冒着暴风雪外出。

sound.t:
n. 声音
adj. 健全的；可靠的

e.en: The {sound} of rain helps me fall asleep.
e.zh: 雨声能帮我入睡。

e.en: That seems like a {sound} business decision.
e.zh: 那似乎是一个明智的商业决策。

e.en: Politicians often speak in catchy {soundbite} phrases.
e.zh: 政客们常常说些朗朗上口的简短金句。

e.en: The interview was reduced to a single {soundbite}.
e.zh: 整段采访被剪成了一句精彩短语。

e.en: The engineer adjusted levels on the studio {soundboard}.
e.zh: 工程师在录音棚调音台上调整音量。

e.en: I use my friend as a {soundboard} for ideas.
e.zh: 我把朋友当作交流想法的对象。

sounded.t: v. sound 的过去式；听起来

e.en: Her voice {sounded} tired over the phone.
e.zh: 电话里她的声音听起来很疲惫。

e.en: The plan {sounded} reasonable when she explained it.
e.zh: 她解释时,这个计划听起来挺合理。

e.en: After more sleep, his judgment is much {sounder}.
e.zh: 睡眠充足后,他的判断力靠谱多了。

e.en: The diver used a {sounder} to measure ocean depth.
e.zh: 潜水员使用测深仪测量海洋深度。

sounding.t:
n. 探测；试探
adj. 响亮的

e.en: The car engine is {sounding} a bit rough lately.
e.zh: 最近汽车引擎听起来有点不太对劲。

e.en: He used friends as a {sounding} board for ideas.
e.zh: 他把朋友们当作想法的探讨对象。

e.en: She moved across the room with {soundless} steps.
e.zh: 她轻盈无声地穿过房间。

e.en: The forest at midnight was completely {soundless}.
e.zh: 午夜的森林万籁俱寂。

e.en: The cat crept {soundlessly} toward the unsuspecting bird.
e.zh: 那只猫悄无声息地靠近毫无察觉的小鸟。

e.en: Snow fell {soundlessly} throughout the long night.
e.zh: 漫漫长夜里,雪无声地落下。

e.en: After the long hike, she slept {soundly}.
e.zh: 长途徒步之后,她睡得很香。

e.en: Our team was {soundly} defeated in the finals.
e.zh: 我们队在决赛中惨败。

e.en: The {soundman} adjusted the microphones before filming began.
e.zh: 录音师在开拍前调整好了麦克风。

e.en: Our {soundman} caught the dialogue perfectly despite the wind.
e.zh: 尽管有风,我们的录音师还是把对白录得很清楚。

e.en: Investors questioned the {soundness} of the bank's strategy.
e.zh: 投资者质疑这家银行策略的稳健性。

e.en: The engineer verified the structural {soundness} of the bridge.
e.zh: 工程师确认了桥梁的结构稳固性。

soundproof.t:
adj. 隔音的
v. 使隔音

e.en: They built a {soundproof} booth for podcast recording.
e.zh: 他们建了一个隔音棚用来录播客。

e.en: My neighbor's apartment is completely {soundproof}.
e.zh: 我邻居的公寓完全隔音。

e.en: The studio installed thick {soundproofing} on every wall.
e.zh: 录音棚在每面墙上都装了厚厚的隔音材料。

e.en: Good {soundproofing} makes working from home much easier.
e.zh: 良好的隔音让在家办公轻松多了。

sounds.t:
n. 声音（复数）
v. 听起来（三单）

e.en: That {sounds} like a great idea to me.
e.zh: 我觉得这听起来是个好主意。

e.en: Strange {sounds} came from the empty house.
e.zh: 那栋空房子里传出奇怪的声音。

e.en: The album creates a dreamy ambient {soundscape}.
e.zh: 这张专辑营造出梦幻般的氛围音景。

e.en: Birds and rivers form the forest's natural {soundscape}.
e.zh: 鸟鸣与溪流构成了森林的自然音景。

e.en: The movie's {soundtrack} won several major awards.
e.zh: 这部电影的原声带赢得了多个大奖。

e.en: I'm streaming the {soundtrack} from that new film.
e.zh: 我正在听那部新电影的原声带。

e.en: He collects vinyl {soundtracks} from classic films.
e.zh: 他收藏经典电影的黑胶原声带。

e.en: Studio Ghibli {soundtracks} are loved around the world.
e.zh: 吉卜力工作室的电影原声带在全世界都广受喜爱。

e.en: Hot chicken {soup} is perfect for a cold day.
e.zh: 冷天来碗热鸡汤再合适不过了。

e.en: She added more salt to the {soup}.
e.zh: 她又往汤里加了些盐。

e.en: Add just a {soupcon} of garlic to the sauce.
e.zh: 在酱汁里加一点点蒜就行。

e.en: His tone carried a {soupcon} of sarcasm.
e.zh: 他的语气中带着一丝讽刺。

soupy.t: adj. 像汤一样浓稠的；潮湿的

e.en: The pasta sauce turned out a bit too {soupy}.
e.zh: 意面酱做得有点太稀了。

e.en: The morning fog was thick and {soupy}.
e.zh: 清晨的雾又浓又稠。

sour.t:
adj. 酸的；变质的
v. 变坏；恶化

e.en: The milk smelled {sour} after sitting out all night.
e.zh: 牛奶放了一夜，闻起来有股酸味。

e.en: Their friendship turned {sour} after the argument.
e.zh: 那次争吵后，他们的友谊就变僵了。

e.en: Always cite your {source} when quoting facts online.
e.zh: 在网上引用事实时一定要注明出处。

e.en: Solar panels are a clean {source} of energy.
e.zh: 太阳能板是一种清洁的能源。

sourcebook.t: n. 原始资料书；参考书

e.en: The professor recommended a {sourcebook} on medieval history.
e.zh: 教授推荐了一本中世纪历史的资料汇编。

e.en: This {sourcebook} contains primary documents from the Civil War.
e.zh: 这本史料集收录了内战时期的原始文献。

sourceless.t: adj. 无来源的；无出处的

e.en: The rumor seemed {sourceless} but spread quickly online.
e.zh: 那个传闻看似无来源，却在网上迅速扩散。

e.en: Editors rejected the {sourceless} claims in the draft.
e.zh: 编辑驳回了草稿中无出处的说法。

sources.t:
n. 来源 (复数)
v. 采购 (第三人称单数)

e.en: Reliable {sources} confirmed the merger early this morning.
e.zh: 可靠消息来源在今早证实了这次并购。

e.en: The report draws on multiple academic {sources}.
e.zh: 该报告参考了多种学术资料。

e.en: The brand emphasizes ethical {sourcing} of its cocoa.
e.zh: 该品牌强调其可可的道德采购。

e.en: Recruiters spend hours {sourcing} candidates on LinkedIn.
e.zh: 招聘人员花数小时在领英上物色候选人。

e.en: He bakes fresh {sourdough} bread every weekend.
e.zh: 他每个周末都烤新鲜的酸面包。

e.en: The cafe is famous for its tangy {sourdough}.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆以微酸的酸种面包出名。

e.en: The deal {soured} when the partner pulled out.
e.zh: 合伙人退出后，这笔交易就告吹了。

e.en: Hot weather quickly {soured} the leftover cream.
e.zh: 炎热的天气让剩下的奶油很快变酸。

e.en: Rising prices are {souring} consumer confidence this quarter.
e.zh: 物价上涨正使本季度的消费者信心变差。

e.en: A long delay was {souring} everyone's mood at the gate.
e.zh: 长时间的延误让登机口每个人的心情都变糟。

e.en: He responded {sourly} to the manager's feedback.
e.zh: 他对经理的反馈不悦地回应了一句。

e.en: "Whatever," she muttered {sourly} and walked away.
e.zh: "随便吧，"她不悦地嘟囔着走开了。

e.en: A hint of {sourness} balanced the dish's sweetness.
e.zh: 一丝酸味平衡了这道菜的甜。

e.en: You could feel the {sourness} in his tone.
e.zh: 你能感觉到他语气里的不快。

e.en: Don't be such a {sourpuss} at the party tonight.
e.zh: 今晚派对上别这么一副苦瓜脸。

e.en: My uncle is a real {sourpuss} at family dinners.
e.zh: 我叔叔在家庭聚餐上总是一脸不高兴。

e.en: The hills are dotted with blooming {sourwood} trees.
e.zh: 山间点缀着盛开的酸木树。

e.en: Local beekeepers prize honey from {sourwood} blossoms.
e.zh: 当地养蜂人很看重酸木花蜜。

sous.t: adj. 副的（多用于 sous chef 副厨师长）

e.en: He works as a {sous} chef at a busy bistro.
e.zh: 他在一家繁忙的小酒馆当副厨师长。

e.en: The {sous} chef plated every dish with care.
e.zh: 副厨师长精心摆好每一道菜。

sousa.t: n. 苏萨 (美国作曲家姓氏)

e.en: The marching band played a classic {Sousa} tune.
e.zh: 行进乐队演奏了一首经典的苏萨进行曲。

e.en: John Philip {Sousa} composed many famous American marches.
e.zh: 约翰·菲利普·苏萨创作了许多著名的美国进行曲。

sousaphone.t: n. 苏萨大号 (低音铜管乐器)

e.en: He carried a gleaming {sousaphone} during the parade.
e.zh: 游行时他扛着一只闪亮的苏萨大号。

e.en: The {sousaphone} added deep bass to the marching band.
e.zh: 苏萨大号为行进乐队增添了浑厚的低音。

souse.t:
v. 浸泡；腌渍
n. 醉汉

e.en: Grandma would {souse} the herring in vinegar overnight.
e.zh: 奶奶会把鲱鱼浸在醋里腌一整夜。

e.en: A sudden wave gave him a thorough {souse}.
e.zh: 一个突如其来的浪把他浇了个透湿。

e.en: The old village {souter} still mended boots by hand.
e.zh: 村里那位老鞋匠仍然手工修补靴子。

e.en: Justice {Souter} retired from the Supreme Court in 2009.
e.zh: 苏特大法官于2009年从最高法院退休。

south.t:
n. 南方
adj. 南边的

e.en: Birds fly {south} when winter arrives in Canada.
e.zh: 加拿大冬天到来时鸟儿会向南飞。

e.en: Their new office is just {south} of downtown.
e.zh: 他们的新办公室就在市中心南边。

e.en: {Southall} is known for its vibrant South Asian community.
e.zh: 绍索尔以充满活力的南亚社区闻名。

e.en: We had amazing curry at a restaurant in {Southall}.
e.zh: 我们在绍索尔一家餐厅吃到了超棒的咖喱。

southampton.t: n. 南安普顿 (英国港市)

e.en: The cruise ship departed from {Southampton} on Friday evening.
e.zh: 邮轮于周五晚上从南安普顿启航。

e.en: {Southampton} hosts one of England's busiest seaports.
e.zh: 南安普顿拥有英格兰最繁忙的海港之一。

e.en: Traffic on the {southbound} freeway is at a standstill.
e.zh: 南向高速公路上的车流完全停滞。

e.en: We boarded the {southbound} train to Brighton.
e.zh: 我们登上了开往布莱顿的南行列车。

southeast.t:
n. 东南方
adj. 东南的

e.en: Storms are moving in from the {southeast} tonight.
e.zh: 暴风雨今晚将从东南方向来袭。

e.en: She grew up in the {southeast} of Brazil.
e.zh: 她在巴西东南部长大。

southeasterly.t: adj. 来自东南方的；朝东南的

e.en: A steady {southeasterly} wind cooled the harbor all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午稳定的东南风让港口一片凉爽。

e.en: The yacht held a {southeasterly} course toward the islands.
e.zh: 游艇朝东南方向驶向那些岛屿。

e.en: Heavy rain flooded several {southeastern} states this week.
e.zh: 本周大雨淹没了东南部几个州。

e.en: {Southeastern} cuisine often features rice and seafood.
e.zh: 东南部菜肴常以米饭和海鲜为主。

e.en: The map distinguishes the {southeasts} of two neighboring provinces.
e.zh: 这张地图区分了相邻两省的东南部。

e.en: Both {southeasts} of the country experience monsoon rains.
e.zh: 这个国家两片东南区域都经历季风降雨。

e.en: The hurricane drifted {southeastward} over the open ocean.
e.zh: 飓风在公海上向东南方向漂移。

e.en: We hiked {southeastward} until we reached the river.
e.zh: 我们一路向东南徒步，直到抵达那条河。

e.en: Families flock to {Southend} for its long pier.
e.zh: 许多家庭蜂拥前往绍森德参观那条长长的栈桥。

e.en: {Southend} sits at the mouth of the Thames estuary.
e.zh: 绍森德位于泰晤士河口处。

southerly.t: adj. 南面的；来自南方的

e.en: A warm {southerly} breeze carried the scent of jasmine.
e.zh: 温暖的南风带来了茉莉花的香气。

e.en: The flight took a more {southerly} route to avoid storms.
e.zh: 航班选择了更靠南的航线以避开风暴。

e.en: {Southern} hospitality is legendary throughout the United States.
e.zh: 南方人的好客在全美闻名遐迩。

e.en: The wine comes from a {southern} region of Italy.
e.zh: 这款葡萄酒产自意大利南部地区。

e.en: As a proud {southerner}, he loves sweet tea.
e.zh: 作为一个自豪的南方人，他特别喜欢甜茶。

e.en: The {southerner} laughed at the harsh Boston winter.
e.zh: 那位南方人对波士顿严酷的冬天笑了笑。

e.en: Ushuaia is often called the {southernmost} city on Earth.
e.zh: 乌斯怀亚常被称为地球上最南端的城市。

e.en: They visited the {southernmost} tip of the island.
e.zh: 他们游览了该岛最南端。

southey.t: n. 骚塞 (英国诗人姓氏)

e.en: Robert {Southey} served as Britain's Poet Laureate for decades.
e.zh: 罗伯特·骚塞担任英国桂冠诗人长达数十年。

e.en: We read a poem by {Southey} in literature class.
e.zh: 我们在文学课上读了骚塞的一首诗。

southgate.t: n. 索斯盖特 (伦敦地名/姓氏)

e.en: Gareth {Southgate} managed the England football team for years.
e.zh: 加雷斯·索斯盖特执教英格兰足球队多年。

e.en: The new cafe just opened near {Southgate} station.
e.zh: 新咖啡馆刚在索斯盖特地铁站附近开业。

e.en: He returned to the {southland} after years abroad.
e.zh: 在国外多年后，他回到了南方故土。

e.en: Highway 101 stretches through the California {southland}.
e.zh: 101号公路贯穿加州南部地区。

southpaw.t: n. 左撇子 (尤指拳击、棒球)

e.en: The {southpaw} pitcher struck out three batters in a row.
e.zh: 那位左撇子投手连续三振了三名击球员。

e.en: As a {southpaw}, she always carried left-handed scissors.
e.zh: 作为左撇子，她总是随身带着左手剪刀。

southport.t: n. 绍斯波特 (英国海滨城市)

e.en: We spent a sunny weekend at the beach in {Southport}.
e.zh: 我们在绍斯波特海滩度过了阳光明媚的周末。

e.en: {Southport} is famous for its long Victorian pier.
e.zh: 绍斯波特以长长的维多利亚式栈桥而闻名。

e.en: The compass distinguishes magnetic and true {souths} clearly.
e.zh: 罗盘清楚地区分了磁南和真南。

e.en: Both {souths} of the divided country face economic challenges.
e.zh: 这个分裂国家的两个南部都面临经济挑战。

southsea.t: n. 绍斯西 (英国海滨度假区)

e.en: Tourists stroll along the promenade at {Southsea} every summer.
e.zh: 每年夏天游客都会沿着南海城海滨大道散步。

e.en: {Southsea} Castle was built by Henry VIII for coastal defense.
e.zh: 南海城堡是亨利八世为海岸防御而修建的。

e.en: He grew up on the {southside} of Chicago.
e.zh: 他在芝加哥南区长大。

e.en: The {southside} has the city's best taco trucks.
e.zh: 南区有全城最好的塔可餐车。

southward.t:
adv. 向南
adj. 朝南的

e.en: The migrating geese flew {southward} in a perfect V.
e.zh: 迁徙的大雁排成完美的人字形向南飞去。

e.en: From here the trail winds {southward} along the ridge.
e.zh: 从这里小径沿着山脊蜿蜒向南。

e.en: Whales travel {southwards} toward warmer breeding grounds.
e.zh: 鲸鱼向南迁徙，前往更温暖的繁殖地。

e.en: The road continues {southwards} for another twenty miles.
e.zh: 这条路继续向南延伸二十英里。

southwark.t: n. 萨瑟克 (伦敦行政区)

e.en: {Southwark} Cathedral sits beside the River Thames in London.
e.zh: 萨瑟克大教堂坐落在伦敦泰晤士河畔。

e.en: We toured the historic borough of {Southwark} yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天游览了历史悠久的萨瑟克区。

southwell.t: n. 索斯韦尔 (英国地名)

e.en: {Southwell} Minster is famous for its medieval stone carvings.
e.zh: 绍斯韦尔大教堂以其中世纪石雕闻名。

e.en: The poet Robert {Southwell} was canonized as a saint.
e.zh: 诗人罗伯特·绍斯韦尔被封为圣人。

southwest.t:
n. 西南方
adj. 西南的

e.en: Phoenix sits in the American {southwest}, surrounded by desert.
e.zh: 凤凰城位于美国西南部，被沙漠环绕。

e.en: The wind shifted to the {southwest} overnight.
e.zh: 风向连夜转为西南风。

southwesterly.t: adj. 来自西南的；向西南的

e.en: A strong {southwesterly} gale battered the coastline today.
e.zh: 今天强劲的西南大风袭击了海岸线。

e.en: The plane took a {southwesterly} heading after takeoff.
e.zh: 飞机起飞后向西南方向飞行。

southwestern.t: adj. 西南部的；西南方向的

e.en: {Southwestern} cuisine often features chiles and corn.
e.zh: 美国西南部菜肴常以辣椒和玉米为主。

e.en: They bought a ranch in {southwestern} Texas last year.
e.zh: 他们去年在德州西南部买了一座农场。

southwests.t: n. 西南（方向）的复数形式

e.en: The atlas highlights the {southwests} of several large countries.
e.zh: 这本地图集突出显示了几个大国的西南部地区。

e.en: Both {southwests} of the continent share similar climates.
e.zh: 该大陆的两片西南区域气候相似。

southwold.t: n. 绍思沃德（英国地名）

e.en: {Southwold} is famous for its colorful beach huts.
e.zh: 绍斯沃尔德以五颜六色的海滩小屋闻名。

e.en: We rented a cottage in {Southwold} for the holiday.
e.zh: 我们在绍斯沃尔德租了一间小屋度假。

southwood.t: n. 绍斯伍德（人名/地名）

e.en: {Southwood} Park hosts a lively farmers market every Sunday.
e.zh: 南木公园每个周日都有热闹的农夫市场。

e.en: She moved to {Southwood} after graduating from college.
e.zh: 她大学毕业后搬到了南木镇。

souvenir.t: n. 纪念品；旅游伴手礼

e.en: She bought a small {souvenir} keychain from the gift shop.
e.zh: 她在礼品店买了个小钥匙扣作纪念。

e.en: This photo is my favorite {souvenir} from the trip.
e.zh: 这张照片是我那次旅行最珍爱的纪念品。

e.en: Tourists crowded the stalls selling cheap {souvenirs}.
e.zh: 游客们挤在卖廉价纪念品的摊位前。

e.en: He collects {souvenirs} from every city he visits.
e.zh: 他每去一座城市都会收集纪念品。

sov.t: n. sovereign 或 sovereignty 的缩写

sovereign.t:
adj. 拥有主权的
n. 君主；元首

e.en: Each country is a {sovereign} state under international law.
e.zh: 按国际法每个国家都是主权国家。

e.en: The queen remained the {sovereign} ruler for decades.
e.zh: 女王作为最高统治者在位数十年。

e.en: The treaty respects the {sovereignties} of all member nations.
e.zh: 该条约尊重所有成员国的主权。

e.en: Competing {sovereignties} clashed over the disputed islands.
e.zh: 各方主权在争议岛屿问题上发生冲突。

sovereignty.t: n. 主权；国家的最高统治权

e.en: The nation fought hard to defend its {sovereignty}.
e.zh: 这个国家奋力捍卫自己的主权。

e.en: Data {sovereignty} laws require storing user info locally.
e.zh: 数据主权法要求将用户信息存储在本地。

soviet.t:
adj. 苏联的
n. 苏维埃

e.en: The film is set in {soviet}-era Moscow.
e.zh: 这部电影的背景是苏联时代的莫斯科。

e.en: My grandfather grew up under the {soviet} system.
e.zh: 我祖父是在苏维埃体制下长大的。

soviets.t: n. 苏联人；苏维埃（复数）

e.en: The {soviets} launched the first satellite into orbit.
e.zh: 苏联人把第一颗卫星送入了轨道。

e.en: Historians still debate why the {soviets} collapsed.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在讨论苏联为何解体。

sow.t:
v. 播种；撒下（种子）
n. 母猪

e.en: The {sower} scattered seeds across the open field.
e.zh: 播种者将种子撒满开阔的田地。

e.en: Van Gogh's painting depicts a {sower} at sunset.
e.zh: 梵高的画描绘了夕阳下的播种者。

e.en: The fossil was first described by James {Sowerby}.
e.zh: 这块化石最早由詹姆斯·索尔比描述。

e.en: {Sowerby} is a small village in West Yorkshire.
e.zh: 索尔比是西约克郡的一个小村庄。

e.en: {Soweto} played a major role in South Africa's history.
e.zh: 索韦托在南非历史中扮演了重要角色。

e.en: We toured the lively streets of {Soweto} yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天游览了索韦托热闹的街道。

sowing.t:
n. 播种；撒种
v. sow 的现在分词

e.en: Farmers begin {sowing} wheat in early spring.
e.zh: 农民们在初春开始播种小麦。

e.en: His careless words were {sowing} doubt among the team.
e.zh: 他随意的话在团队中播下了怀疑的种子。

e.en: I prefer {soya} milk in my morning coffee.
e.zh: 我喜欢在早晨咖啡里加豆奶。

e.en: The recipe calls for two tablespoons of {soya} sauce.
e.zh: 这道菜需要两汤匙酱油。

e.en: The farm exports {soybean} oil to several countries.
e.zh: 这家农场向多个国家出口大豆油。

e.en: A {soybean} plant can fix nitrogen in the soil.
e.zh: 大豆植物能固定土壤中的氮。

e.en: China imports millions of tons of {soybeans} each year.
e.zh: 中国每年进口数百万吨大豆。

e.en: Roasted {soybeans} make a healthy crunchy snack.
e.zh: 烤大豆是健康酥脆的零食。

e.en: She poured warm {soymilk} over her cereal.
e.zh: 她把热豆奶倒在麦片上。

e.en: Many cafes now offer {soymilk} as a dairy alternative.
e.zh: 许多咖啡店现在都提供豆奶作为牛奶替代品。

space.t:
n. 空间；太空；空位
v. 隔开；留间距

e.en: There isn't enough {space} on my desk for another monitor.
e.zh: 我的桌子上没有空间再放一台显示器了。

e.en: Astronauts spent six months in {space} on the station.
e.zh: 宇航员在空间站上度过了六个月。

e.en: The {spacecraft} successfully landed on Mars yesterday.
e.zh: 该航天器昨天成功登陆了火星。

e.en: Engineers tested the {spacecraft} in a vacuum chamber.
e.zh: 工程师在真空舱里测试了航天器。

spaced.t:
adj. 有间距的
v. space 的过去式

e.en: The fence posts are evenly {spaced} along the path.
e.zh: 栅栏柱沿小路均匀分布。

e.en: I felt totally {spaced} out after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后我整个人都恍恍惚惚的。

e.en: Commercial {spaceflight} has become surprisingly common.
e.zh: 商业航天飞行已经变得出人意料地普遍。

e.en: She dreamed of a career in human {spaceflight}.
e.zh: 她梦想从事载人航天事业。

e.en: My nephew dressed up as a {spaceman} for Halloween.
e.zh: 我侄子万圣节装扮成了宇航员。

e.en: The film's hero is a lonely {spaceman} drifting home.
e.zh: 电影的主角是一位漂流回家的孤独宇航员。

spaceplane.t: n. 太空飞机；空天飞机

e.en: The {spaceplane} glided back to Earth and landed safely.
e.zh: 那架太空飞机滑翔返回地球并安全降落。

e.en: Engineers unveiled a reusable {spaceplane} prototype today.
e.zh: 工程师今天展示了可重复使用的太空飞机原型。

spaceport.t: n. 航天发射场；太空港

e.en: Tourists boarded their flight at the new desert {spaceport}.
e.zh: 游客们在新建的沙漠航天港登机。

e.en: The company is building a private {spaceport} in Texas.
e.zh: 该公司正在德州建造一座私人航天港。

e.en: Insert a small {spacer} between the two metal plates.
e.zh: 在两块金属板之间插入一个小垫片。

e.en: The kit includes screws, washers, and a plastic {spacer}.
e.zh: 套件包括螺丝、垫圈和一个塑料垫片。

spaces.t:
n. 空间（复数）
v. 隔开（第三人称单数）

e.en: Parking {spaces} near the stadium fill up quickly.
e.zh: 体育场附近的停车位很快就被占满了。

e.en: Add two {spaces} after each period if you prefer.
e.zh: 如果你喜欢,可以在每个句号后加两个空格。

e.en: The kids built a cardboard {spaceship} in the garage.
e.zh: 孩子们在车库里搭了一艘纸板宇宙飞船。

e.en: A massive {spaceship} appeared above the city in the film.
e.zh: 电影中一艘巨大的宇宙飞船出现在城市上空。

e.en: The novel imagines {spaceships} traveling between distant galaxies.
e.zh: 小说想象宇宙飞船在遥远星系间穿梭。

e.en: Toy {spaceships} were scattered across the playroom floor.
e.zh: 玩具宇宙飞船散落在游戏室的地板上。

e.en: The astronaut zipped up her bulky white {spacesuit}.
e.zh: 宇航员拉上了她笨重的白色宇航服。

e.en: Each {spacesuit} costs millions of dollars to produce.
e.zh: 每件宇航服的制造成本高达数百万美元。

spacewalk.t: n./v. 太空行走；舱外活动

e.en: Two astronauts performed a six-hour {spacewalk} this morning.
e.zh: 两名宇航员今天上午进行了六小时的太空行走。

e.en: Repairing the antenna requires a difficult {spacewalk}.
e.zh: 修理天线需要进行一次艰难的太空行走。

spacewalker.t: n. 进行太空行走的宇航员

e.en: The veteran {spacewalker} has logged forty hours outside.
e.zh: 这位资深太空行走者已在舱外工作了四十小时。

e.en: Each {spacewalker} carries tools tethered to the suit.
e.zh: 每位太空行走者都把工具系在宇航服上。

spacey.t: adj. 心不在焉的；迷糊的

e.en: I felt a bit {spacey} after skipping breakfast.
e.zh: 没吃早饭后我感觉有点恍惚。

e.en: The album has a dreamy, {spacey} synth sound.
e.zh: 这张专辑有种梦幻迷离的合成器音色。

spacing.t:
n. 间距；行距
v. space 的现在分词

e.en: Adjust the line {spacing} to make the text easier to read.
e.zh: 调整行距让文字更易阅读。

e.en: Proper {spacing} between plants helps them grow well.
e.zh: 植株间合适的间距有助于它们生长良好。

e.en: The apartment has a bright, {spacious} living room.
e.zh: 这套公寓有一个明亮宽敞的客厅。

e.en: Their new SUV feels surprisingly {spacious} inside.
e.zh: 他们的新SUV内部出乎意料地宽敞。

e.en: I love the {spaciousness} of this open-plan kitchen.
e.zh: 我喜欢这个开放式厨房的宽敞感。

e.en: High ceilings give the lobby a sense of {spaciousness}.
e.zh: 高高的天花板让大堂显得宽敞。

spackle.t:
n. 墙面填缝膏
v. 用填缝膏修补

e.en: Use {spackle} to fill the small holes before painting.
e.zh: 刷漆前用腻子填补小洞。

e.en: He had to {spackle} every nail hole in the wall.
e.zh: 他得把墙上每个钉孔都填补好。

spade.t:
n. 铲子；（扑克）黑桃
v. 用铲挖

e.en: He dug the garden bed with a sturdy {spade}.
e.zh: 他用一把结实的铁锹挖花圃。

e.en: She played the ace of {spades} to win the round.
e.zh: 她出黑桃A赢下了这一局。

e.en: The {spadefoot} toad burrows underground to escape the heat.
e.zh: 锄足蟾会钻入地下躲避炎热。

e.en: Researchers spotted a rare {spadefoot} after the rain.
e.zh: 研究人员在雨后发现了一只罕见的锄足蟾。

spadework.t: n. 前期准备工作；基础性工作

e.en: The detectives did the {spadework} that cracked the case.
e.zh: 侦探们做了破案所需的扎实基础工作。

e.en: Years of {spadework} finally led to the breakthrough.
e.zh: 多年的基础工作终于带来了突破。

spading.t: v. 用铲挖掘（spade 的现在分词）

e.en: He spent the morning {spading} the vegetable patch.
e.zh: 他上午都在用铁锹翻菜地。

e.en: {Spading} clay soil takes a lot of effort.
e.zh: 用铁锹翻黏土地相当费力。

e.en: German {spaetzle} pairs perfectly with rich beef stew.
e.zh: 德式面疙瘩配浓郁的炖牛肉再合适不过。

e.en: She learned to make homemade {spaetzle} from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她从奶奶那里学会了自制德式面疙瘩。

spaghetti.t: n. 意大利面；细长意粉

e.en: We had {spaghetti} with meatballs for dinner last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚吃了肉丸意大利面。

e.en: The cables behind the TV look like tangled {spaghetti}.
e.zh: 电视后面的线缆乱得像一团意面。

spaghettini.t: n. 细意大利面（比 spaghetti 更细）

e.en: Cook the {spaghettini} for about seven minutes until al dente.
e.zh: 细意面煮约七分钟至弹牙即可。

e.en: He tossed the {spaghettini} with garlic and olive oil.
e.zh: 他用蒜和橄榄油拌了细意面。

e.en: We're spending two weeks in {Spain} this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天我们要在西班牙待两周。

e.en: {Spain} won the World Cup back in 2010.
e.zh: 西班牙在2010年赢得了世界杯。

spake.t: v. speak 的古语过去式

e.en: Thus {spake} the prophet to the gathered crowd.
e.zh: 先知如此对聚集的人群说道。

e.en: In the old text, the king {spake} of justice.
e.zh: 在古老的文本中,国王讲到了正义。

spalding.t: n. 斯伯丁（人名/体育用品品牌）

e.en: He gripped the {Spalding} basketball and took the shot.
e.zh: 他握紧斯伯丁篮球出手投篮。

e.en: {Spalding} has made sports equipment for over a century.
e.zh: 斯伯丁制造体育用品已超过一个世纪。

spallation.t: n. 散裂（原子核被轰击碎裂）

e.en: Neutron {spallation} is used to study material structures.
e.zh: 中子散裂被用来研究材料结构。

e.en: The lab built a powerful {spallation} source for experiments.
e.zh: 实验室为实验建造了强大的散裂源。

spam.t:
n. 垃圾邮件/信息
v. 刷屏；滥发

e.en: My inbox is full of {spam} from random retailers.
e.zh: 我的收件箱塞满了各种零售商的垃圾邮件。

e.en: Please don't {spam} the chat with the same emoji.
e.zh: 别在聊天里刷同一个表情。

spammer.t: n. 垃圾邮件发送者；刷屏者

e.en: The platform banned the {spammer} after multiple reports.
e.zh: 在多次举报后平台封禁了那个垃圾发送者。

e.en: A persistent {spammer} kept flooding her email account.
e.zh: 一个持续不断的垃圾发送者不停往她邮箱发邮件。

spams.t:
v. spam 的第三人称单数
n. 垃圾信息（复数）

e.en: He {spams} the group chat with cat memes daily.
e.zh: 他每天在群聊里刷各种猫咪表情包。

e.en: The filter blocks {spams} before they reach your inbox.
e.zh: 过滤器在垃圾邮件到达收件箱前就将其拦截。

span.t:
n. 跨度；时长
v. 横跨；持续

e.en: The bridge has a {span} of nearly two kilometers.
e.zh: 这座桥的跨度将近两公里。

e.en: Her career {span} covers more than four decades.
e.zh: 她的职业生涯跨越了四十多年。

e.en: {Spandau} is a historic district in western Berlin.
e.zh: 施潘道是柏林西部的一个历史城区。

e.en: The old {Spandau} citadel still attracts many tourists.
e.zh: 古老的施潘道城堡仍吸引着许多游客。

e.en: Her yoga pants are made of stretchy {spandex} fabric.
e.zh: 她的瑜伽裤是用有弹性的氨纶面料做的。

e.en: Cyclists often wear {spandex} shorts for comfort.
e.zh: 骑行者常穿氨纶短裤以求舒适。

e.en: The cathedral's {spandrel} is decorated with carved angels.
e.zh: 教堂拱肩上雕刻着天使图案。

e.en: Architects filled each {spandrel} with mosaic tiles.
e.zh: 建筑师在每个拱肩处铺满了马赛克瓷砖。

spangle.t:
n. 亮片；闪光饰物
v. 点缀闪光物

e.en: A single gold {spangle} fell from her dress.
e.zh: 一片金色的亮片从她的裙子上掉了下来。

e.en: Stars {spangle} the night sky above the desert.
e.zh: 繁星点缀着沙漠上方的夜空。

spangled.t: adj. 缀满亮片的；闪闪发光的

e.en: She wore a {spangled} gown to the awards ceremony.
e.zh: 她穿了一件缀满亮片的礼服去颁奖典礼。

e.en: The Star-{Spangled} Banner is the U.S. national anthem.
e.zh: 《星条旗》是美国的国歌。

e.en: The {Spaniard} won the tennis tournament in straight sets.
e.zh: 那位西班牙人直落几盘赢得了网球赛冠军。

e.en: Every {Spaniard} I met spoke warmly about their hometown.
e.zh: 我遇到的每个西班牙人都热情地谈论自己的家乡。

e.en: Her cocker {spaniel} wagged its tail by the door.
e.zh: 她的可卡犬在门边摇着尾巴。

e.en: The {spaniel} loves swimming in the lake every weekend.
e.zh: 这只猎犬每个周末都爱在湖里游泳。

spanish.t:
adj. 西班牙的
n. 西班牙语

e.en: I'm learning {Spanish} on a language app every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上用语言应用学习西班牙语。

e.en: We ordered {Spanish} tapas at the new tapas bar.
e.zh: 我们在新开的酒馆点了西班牙小吃。

e.en: In many countries, it's illegal to {spank} children.
e.zh: 在许多国家,打孩子屁股是违法的。

e.en: Don't {spank} the puppy when it has accidents.
e.zh: 小狗大小便失误时不要打它。

spanker.t: n. 后桅纵帆；打屁股的人

e.en: The sailors raised the {spanker} as the wind picked up.
e.zh: 风变大时,水手们升起了后桅纵帆。

e.en: A torn {spanker} flapped loudly at the stern.
e.zh: 船尾一面破损的纵帆啪啪作响。

spanking.t:
n. 打屁股
adj. 强劲的；极好的

e.en: They drove off in a {spanking} new red car.
e.zh: 他们开着一辆崭新的红色汽车走了。

e.en: Most parents today avoid {spanking} as a punishment.
e.zh: 现在大多数父母都不再用打屁股来惩罚孩子。

spanned.t: v. span 的过去式；横跨；持续

e.en: The bridge {spanned} the river for nearly two miles.
e.zh: 这座桥横跨河面将近两英里。

e.en: His career {spanned} four decades of journalism.
e.zh: 他的新闻生涯跨越了四十年。

e.en: Pass me the {spanner} so I can tighten this bolt.
e.zh: 把扳手递给我,我要拧紧这颗螺栓。

e.en: The strike threw a {spanner} into our travel plans.
e.zh: 罢工打乱了我们的旅行计划。

spanning.t:
v. span 的现在分词；横跨
adj. 生成（树）的

e.en: The exhibition shows photos {spanning} thirty years of his career.
e.zh: 展览展出了跨越他三十年职业生涯的照片。

e.en: A footbridge {spanning} the canal connects the two parks.
e.zh: 一座横跨运河的人行桥连接着两座公园。

spans.t:
v. span 的第三人称单数
n. 跨度（复数）

e.en: The novel {spans} three generations of one family.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了一个家庭三代人的故事。

e.en: That suspension bridge {spans} the entire bay.
e.zh: 那座悬索桥横跨整个海湾。

spar.t:
v. 拳击对练；争辩
n. 圆材；晶石

e.en: Boxers {spar} lightly before a big match.
e.zh: 拳击手在大赛前会进行轻量级的对练。

e.en: The two senators continued to {spar} on live television.
e.zh: 两位参议员在电视直播中继续唇枪舌剑。

sparc.t: n. SPARC 处理器架构（Sun 开发）

e.en: Sun's {SPARC} processors once dominated enterprise servers.
e.zh: Sun 的 SPARC 处理器曾在企业服务器领域占据主导地位。

e.en: He still maintains a vintage {SPARC} workstation in his garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里还保养着一台老式 SPARC 工作站。

spare.t:
adj. 备用的；多余的
v. 抽出；饶恕

e.en: Do you have a {spare} charger I could borrow?
e.zh: 你有多余的充电器可以借我吗?

e.en: I usually read in my {spare} time on weekends.
e.zh: 我通常在周末空闲时间看书。

spared.t: v. spare 的过去式；抽出；饶恕

e.en: The storm largely {spared} the coastal villages this year.
e.zh: 今年这场风暴基本没有波及沿海村庄。

e.en: She {spared} no expense planning her daughter's wedding.
e.zh: 她为女儿的婚礼不惜花费。

e.en: The room was {sparely} furnished with just a bed and lamp.
e.zh: 房间布置得十分简朴,只有一张床和一盏灯。

e.en: He writes {sparely}, letting silence carry the emotion.
e.zh: 他文风简练,让沉默承载情感。

e.en: The {spareness} of the design makes the room feel calm.
e.zh: 设计的简约让整个房间显得宁静。

e.en: Critics praised the novel's emotional {spareness}.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这部小说情感表达的克制。

e.en: I gnawed every last bit of meat off the {sparerib}.
e.zh: 我把那根排骨上的肉啃得一干二净。

e.en: Each {sparerib} was glazed with a smoky barbecue sauce.
e.zh: 每根肋排都刷上了烟熏味的烧烤酱。

e.en: We ordered {spareribs} and fried rice for delivery.
e.zh: 我们点了排骨和炒饭外卖。

e.en: Slow-cooked {spareribs} fall off the bone beautifully.
e.zh: 慢炖的排骨肉一咬就脱骨,口感极佳。

spares.t:
n. 备用品；备件
v. spare 的第三人称单数

e.en: He always carries a few {spares} in his backpack.
e.zh: 他总是在背包里带几个备用品。

e.en: The factory keeps extra {spares} for the older machines.
e.zh: 工厂为旧机器保留了一些备用零件。

sparing.t:
adj. 节约的；节制的
v. spare 的现在分词

e.en: Be {sparing} with the salt — the soup is already savory.
e.zh: 盐要少放一点,这汤本来就够鲜了。

e.en: She is {sparing} in her praise, so it means a lot.
e.zh: 她很少夸人,所以她的赞美很有分量。

e.en: Use the expensive olive oil {sparingly} for finishing dishes.
e.zh: 昂贵的橄榄油要少量使用,用来给菜调味。

e.en: The coach uses his star player {sparingly} in preseason.
e.zh: 教练在季前赛中很少让明星球员上场。

spark.t:
n. 火花；火星
v. 引发；激起

e.en: A single {spark} from the campfire started the wildfire.
e.zh: 营火的一点火星引发了这场森林大火。

e.en: Her TED talk hopes to {spark} a national conversation.
e.zh: 她的 TED 演讲希望能引发一场全国性的讨论。

sparked.t: v. spark 的过去式；引发；点燃

e.en: The tweet {sparked} a heated debate online.
e.zh: 那条推文在网上引发了激烈的讨论。

e.en: Faulty wiring {sparked} the apartment fire last night.
e.zh: 昨晚的公寓火灾是电线故障引起的。

e.en: The geologist used a {sparker} to map the seafloor layers.
e.zh: 地质学家用电火花震源仪绘制了海床的地层图。

e.en: He pulled out a flint {sparker} to light the stove.
e.zh: 他拿出打火石点燃了炉子。

sparking.t: v. spark 的现在分词；引发；冒火花

e.en: The film is {sparking} renewed interest in classic literature.
e.zh: 这部电影正在重新激起人们对经典文学的兴趣。

e.en: I noticed the outlet was {sparking} and unplugged everything.
e.zh: 我发现插座在打火,就把东西全拔掉了。

sparkle.t:
v. 闪耀；发光
n. 光芒；活力

e.en: Her eyes {sparkle} whenever she talks about her grandkids.
e.zh: 她一谈起孙子孙女,眼睛就会发光。

e.en: Add a little glitter for extra {sparkle} on the card.
e.zh: 加点闪粉,让贺卡更闪亮一些。

e.en: Each child held a {sparkler} on the Fourth of July.
e.zh: 国庆日那天每个孩子都拿着一根烟花棒。

e.en: That diamond ring is a real {sparkler}.
e.zh: 那枚钻戒真是闪闪发光。

sparkles.t:
v. sparkle 的第三人称单数
n. 闪光（复数）

e.en: The lake {sparkles} in the early morning sunlight.
e.zh: 清晨的阳光下,湖面波光粼粼。

e.en: She decorated the cake with edible {sparkles}.
e.zh: 她在蛋糕上撒了可食用的亮片装饰。

sparkling.t: adj. 闪耀的；气泡的（饮料）

e.en: I'd like a glass of {sparkling} water, please.
e.zh: 请给我一杯气泡水。

e.en: She gave a {sparkling} performance on opening night.
e.zh: 首演之夜她的表演精彩绝伦。

e.en: My niece insists on wearing her {sparkly} pink shoes everywhere.
e.zh: 我侄女走到哪儿都坚持要穿她那双闪闪的粉色鞋。

e.en: The dress had a {sparkly} silver belt at the waist.
e.zh: 这条裙子腰间系着一条闪亮的银色腰带。

sparks.t:
n. 火花（复数）
v. spark 的第三人称单数

e.en: {Sparks} flew from the welder's torch in the workshop.
e.zh: 车间里焊枪喷出阵阵火花。

e.en: That book really {sparks} my imagination every time I reread it.
e.zh: 每次重读那本书都能激发我的想象力。

sparky.t: adj. 生气勃勃的；电工（英俚）

e.en: The puppy has a {sparky} personality and never sits still.
e.zh: 这只小狗活泼好动,从不安分。

e.en: My uncle works as a {sparky} on construction sites.
e.zh: 我叔叔在工地上当电工。

sparring.t:
n. 拳击对练；争辩
v. spar 的现在分词

e.en: The two boxers were {sparring} in the gym before the match.
e.zh: 两位拳击手赛前在健身房进行对练。

e.en: Their friendly {sparring} on Twitter amuses millions of fans.
e.zh: 他们在推特上友好斗嘴,逗乐了数百万粉丝。

e.en: A {sparrow} landed on the windowsill looking for crumbs.
e.zh: 一只麻雀落在窗台上找面包屑。

e.en: The garden is full of {sparrow} chirps each morning.
e.zh: 每天早上花园里都满是麻雀的叫声。

e.en: A {sparrowhawk} swooped down and snatched the small bird.
e.zh: 一只雀鹰俯冲下来抓走了那只小鸟。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {sparrowhawk} near the cliffs.
e.zh: 观鸟者在悬崖附近发现了一只罕见的雀鹰。

e.en: A flock of {sparrows} chattered in the hedge outside.
e.zh: 一群麻雀在外面的篱笆里叽叽喳喳。

e.en: City {sparrows} have grown bolder around outdoor cafés.
e.zh: 城里的麻雀在露天咖啡馆周围越来越大胆了。

e.en: Hair grew {sparse} on the top of his head.
e.zh: 他头顶的头发越来越稀疏。

e.en: Information about the new product is still {sparse}.
e.zh: 关于这款新产品的信息仍然很少。

e.en: Mongolia is one of the most {sparsely} populated countries.
e.zh: 蒙古是世界上人口最稀少的国家之一。

e.en: The walls were {sparsely} decorated with a few photos.
e.zh: 墙上只挂着几张照片,装饰得很简单。

e.en: The {sparseness} of the desert landscape feels almost spiritual.
e.zh: 沙漠景观的空旷给人一种近乎神圣的感觉。

e.en: I love the {sparseness} of his prose — every word counts.
e.zh: 我喜欢他文笔的简练——每个字都不浪费。

e.en: Researchers exploit data {sparsity} to speed up the model.
e.zh: 研究人员利用数据稀疏性来加快模型运行速度。

e.en: The {sparsity} of trees on the plain surprised the hikers.
e.zh: 平原上树木的稀少让徒步者感到意外。

sparta.t: n. 斯巴达（古希腊城邦）

e.en: Ancient {Sparta} was famous for its disciplined warriors.
e.zh: 古代斯巴达以其训练有素的战士而闻名。

e.en: Tourists visit ruins from {Sparta}'s long-vanished empire.
e.zh: 游客们参观早已消失的斯巴达帝国留下的遗迹。

spartak.t: n. 斯巴达克（俄罗斯体育俱乐部名）

e.en: {Spartak} Moscow won the cup final in extra time.
e.zh: 莫斯科斯巴达克队在加时赛中赢得了杯赛冠军。

e.en: Fans packed the stadium to cheer for {Spartak}.
e.zh: 球迷挤满了体育场为斯巴达克队加油。

spartan.t:
adj. 简朴的；清苦的
n. 斯巴达人

e.en: The hotel room was clean but {spartan}, with no decorations.
e.zh: 酒店房间干净却简陋,没有任何装饰。

e.en: He follows a {spartan} diet of vegetables and brown rice.
e.zh: 他遵循一种简朴的饮食,只吃蔬菜和糙米。

spas.t: n. 水疗馆；温泉浴场（spa 的复数）

e.en: Many {spas} offer hot stone massages and facials.
e.zh: 许多水疗中心都提供热石按摩和面部护理。

e.en: The resort has three {spas} and an indoor pool.
e.zh: 这家度假村有三个水疗中心和一个室内泳池。

e.en: She felt a sudden muscle {spasm} in her calf.
e.zh: 她小腿突然抽筋了。

e.en: A {spasm} of guilt washed over him after the lie.
e.zh: 撒谎之后,一阵内疚涌上他心头。

spasmodic.t: adj. 痉挛性的；间歇性的

e.en: His writing efforts have been {spasmodic} at best.
e.zh: 他写作充其量也只是断断续续的。

e.en: The patient suffered {spasmodic} coughing throughout the night.
e.zh: 病人整夜都在阵发性地咳嗽。

e.en: The old engine coughed {spasmodically} before finally starting up.
e.zh: 那台旧引擎断断续续地咳了几声才终于启动。

e.en: She laughed {spasmodically} as she watched the comedy clip.
e.zh: 她看那段喜剧片段时一阵阵地大笑。

spastic.t:
adj. 痉挛的
n. 痉挛症患者

e.en: The child has {spastic} muscles due to a neurological condition.
e.zh: 由于神经系统疾病，这个孩子的肌肉痉挛。

e.en: His {spastic} reaction to the news made everyone uneasy.
e.zh: 他对这消息的过激反应让大家都不自在。

e.en: His leg twitched {spastically} after the long marathon.
e.zh: 跑完长马拉松后，他的腿不停地抽搐。

e.en: The puppet's arms moved {spastically} when the strings tangled.
e.zh: 绳子缠在一起时，木偶的手臂胡乱抽动。

spasticity.t: n. 痉挛状态；肌张力亢进

e.en: Physical therapy can help reduce muscle {spasticity} after a stroke.
e.zh: 物理治疗有助于减轻中风后的肌肉痉挛。

e.en: Doctors prescribed medication to manage her chronic {spasticity}.
e.zh: 医生开了药来控制她的慢性肌肉痉挛。

e.en: The charity was founded to support children diagnosed as {spastics}.
e.zh: 该慈善机构成立的初衷是帮助被诊断为痉挛症的儿童。

e.en: Older medical texts referred to such patients as {spastics}.
e.zh: 较早的医学文献把这类病人称为痉挛症患者。

spat.t:
n. 小争吵；口角
v. 吐（spit 的过去式）

e.en: The couple had a brief {spat} over the dishes.
e.zh: 那对夫妻为洗碗的事拌了几句嘴。

e.en: He {spat} out the bitter coffee in disgust.
e.zh: 他厌恶地把那口苦咖啡吐了出来。

spate.t:
n. 一连串；大量
n. 洪水

e.en: There has been a {spate} of burglaries in the neighborhood.
e.zh: 最近这个社区接连发生了多起入室盗窃案。

e.en: The river was in {spate} after three days of rain.
e.zh: 连下三天雨后，那条河水势汹涌。

e.en: Architects need strong {spatial} reasoning skills.
e.zh: 建筑师需要很强的空间思维能力。

e.en: The app uses {spatial} audio to enhance immersion.
e.zh: 这款应用使用空间音频来增强沉浸感。

e.en: The artist explores {spatiality} through layered glass sculptures.
e.zh: 这位艺术家通过分层玻璃雕塑探索空间性。

e.en: Her thesis examines {spatiality} in modern urban design.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨了现代城市设计中的空间性。

spatially.t: adv. 在空间上；在空间方面

e.en: The data is organized {spatially} on an interactive map.
e.zh: 这些数据按空间位置组织在一张交互地图上。

e.en: Children learn to think {spatially} through building blocks.
e.zh: 孩子们通过搭积木学会进行空间思维。

spatter.t:
v. 溅洒；飞溅
n. 溅落声

e.en: Raindrops began to {spatter} the windshield.
e.zh: 雨点开始溅落在挡风玻璃上。

e.en: A {spatter} of mud covered his white shoes.
e.zh: 他的白鞋上沾了一片泥点。

e.en: A light {spattering} of rain greeted us at the door.
e.zh: 我们到门口时，迎面下起了一阵小雨。

e.en: Hot oil was {spattering} all over the stovetop.
e.zh: 热油溅得整个灶台到处都是。

e.en: Use a rubber {spatula} to scrape the batter from the bowl.
e.zh: 用橡皮刮刀把碗里的面糊刮干净。

e.en: He flipped the pancake skillfully with a {spatula}.
e.zh: 他用锅铲熟练地把薄饼翻了个面。

spatz.t: n. 鞋罩（spats 的变体；人名）

e.en: Grandma served homemade {spatz} with rich beef gravy.
e.zh: 奶奶端上自制的德式面疙瘩，配着浓郁的牛肉汁。

e.en: The chef showed us how to make {spatz} from scratch.
e.zh: 厨师向我们演示了如何从头制作德式面疙瘩。

spawn.t:
v. 生成；衍生；产卵
n. 卵

e.en: The viral video {spawned} dozens of imitations online.
e.zh: 那段爆红视频在网上引发了几十个模仿作品。

e.en: Salmon return upstream every year to {spawn}.
e.zh: 每年三文鱼都会洄游上溯产卵。

e.en: Place a monster {spawner} near the trap in the game.
e.zh: 游戏中把怪物刷怪笼放在陷阱旁边。

e.en: Each female salmon {spawner} lays thousands of eggs.
e.zh: 每条产卵的雌鲑鱼能产下数千枚卵。

spawning.t:
n. 产卵；生成
v. 产卵中

e.en: The hit show is {spawning} countless fan theories online.
e.zh: 这部热门剧集在网上催生了无数粉丝理论。

e.en: Trout migrate upstream during the {spawning} season.
e.zh: 鳟鱼会在产卵季节洄游到上游。

spay.t: v. 给（雌性动物）做绝育手术

e.en: The vet recommended we {spay} our cat next month.
e.zh: 兽医建议我们下个月给猫做绝育手术。

e.en: Many shelters {spay} every animal before adoption.
e.zh: 许多收容所在领养前都会给动物做绝育。

spaz.t: n. 笨手笨脚的人（俚语）

e.en: Don't {spaz} out over a tiny typo in the email.
e.zh: 别为邮件里一个小错别字就抓狂。

e.en: He totally {spazzed} when he saw the surprise party.
e.zh: 看到惊喜派对时，他整个人都激动疯了。

e.en: The tutorial used {spck} as a placeholder for unknown text.
e.zh: 教程里用 spck 作为未知文本的占位符。

e.en: Type {spck} into the search bar to test the filter.
e.zh: 在搜索栏里输入 spck 来测试过滤器。

e.en: Could you {speak} a little more slowly, please?
e.zh: 你能说得慢一点吗？

e.en: The CEO will {speak} at the conference tomorrow.
e.zh: 首席执行官明天将在会议上发言。

speakeasy.t: n. 地下酒吧（尤指禁酒时期）

e.en: They sipped cocktails at a hidden {speakeasy} downtown.
e.zh: 他们在市中心一家隐秘的地下酒吧品着鸡尾酒。

e.en: The bar is designed to feel like a 1920s {speakeasy}.
e.zh: 这家酒吧的设计让人仿佛置身于二十年代的地下酒馆。

speaker.t:
n. 扬声器；音箱
n. 演讲者

e.en: The keynote {speaker} captivated the entire audience.
e.zh: 主讲人吸引了全场观众的注意。

e.en: My Bluetooth {speaker} died right in the middle of the song.
e.zh: 我的蓝牙音箱在歌曲中途突然没电了。

speakerphone.t: n. 免提电话；扬声电话

e.en: Put the call on {speakerphone} so everyone can hear.
e.zh: 把电话开成免提，让大家都能听到。

e.en: He answered through the car's built-in {speakerphone}.
e.zh: 他通过车载免提接听了电话。

e.en: The {speakers} on this laptop sound surprisingly good.
e.zh: 这台笔记本的扬声器听起来出奇地好。

e.en: Native {speakers} often use idioms unfamiliar to learners.
e.zh: 母语者常用一些学习者不熟悉的习语。

e.en: She won the {speakership} after a tense party vote.
e.zh: 经过紧张的党内投票，她当选了议长。

e.en: His {speakership} lasted only two years before he resigned.
e.zh: 他的议长任期仅两年便辞职了。

speaking.t:
v. 说话（进行时）
adj. 说话的

e.en: She is {speaking} at the tech summit next week.
e.zh: 她下周将在科技峰会上发言。

e.en: Generally {speaking}, remote work boosts productivity for many.
e.zh: 总的来说，远程办公能提升许多人的工作效率。

speaks.t: v. 说（speak 的第三人称单数）

e.en: He {speaks} four languages fluently.
e.zh: 他能流利地说四种语言。

e.en: Her silence on the issue {speaks} volumes.
e.zh: 她对此事的沉默已经说明了一切。

spear.t:
n. 长矛；鱼叉
v. 用矛刺

e.en: The ancient warrior carried a long wooden {spear}.
e.zh: 古代武士手持一根长长的木矛。

e.en: She used a fork to {spear} a piece of broccoli.
e.zh: 她用叉子叉起一块西兰花。

spearfish.t:
v. 用鱼枪捕鱼
n. 旗鱼类

e.en: Locals still {spearfish} along the reef at low tide.
e.zh: 当地人退潮时仍会沿着礁石用鱼叉捕鱼。

e.en: He caught a large {spearfish} during the deep-sea trip.
e.zh: 他在深海垂钓时叉到一条大旗鱼。

spearhead.t:
v. 带头；领导
n. 先锋

e.en: She will {spearhead} the company's new climate initiative.
e.zh: 她将牵头公司新的气候行动计划。

e.en: Engineers were chosen to {spearhead} the AI research project.
e.zh: 工程师被选中来领导这项人工智能研究项目。

e.en: A lone {spearman} stood guard at the castle gate.
e.zh: 一名持矛兵独自守在城堡门口。

e.en: The {spearman} threw with deadly accuracy in the tournament.
e.zh: 那名矛兵在比赛中投掷得极为精准。

e.en: I love the cool taste of {spearmint} gum.
e.zh: 我喜欢留兰香口香糖那种清凉的味道。

e.en: Add fresh {spearmint} leaves to your iced tea.
e.zh: 在冰茶里加几片新鲜的留兰香叶。

spec.t: n. 规格；规范（specification 的缩写）

e.en: The engineer reviewed the {spec} before writing any code.
e.zh: 工程师在动手写代码前先审阅了规格说明。

e.en: This laptop's {spec} is perfect for video editing.
e.zh: 这台笔记本的配置非常适合视频剪辑。

special.t:
adj. 特别的；特殊的
n. 特辑；特价

e.en: Today is a {special} day — our tenth anniversary.
e.zh: 今天是个特别的日子——我们的十周年纪念日。

e.en: The restaurant offers a lunch {special} on weekdays.
e.zh: 这家餐厅工作日提供午餐特价套餐。

specialisation.t: n. 专业化；专长（英式拼写）

e.en: Her {specialisation} is pediatric cardiology.
e.zh: 她的专业方向是儿科心脏病学。

e.en: Modern medicine increasingly relies on deep {specialisation}.
e.zh: 现代医学越来越依赖于深入的专业分工。

specialise.t: v. 专门研究；专攻（英式拼写）

e.en: Many young lawyers {specialise} in tech and privacy law.
e.zh: 许多年轻律师专攻科技与隐私法领域。

e.en: This bakery {specialises} in handmade French pastries.
e.zh: 这家面包房专营手工法式糕点。

specialised.t: adj. 专门的；专业的（英式拼写）

e.en: The hospital has a {specialised} unit for rare diseases.
e.zh: 这家医院设有专门收治罕见病的科室。

e.en: She {specialised} in marine biology during graduate school.
e.zh: 她在研究生阶段专攻海洋生物学。

specialises.t: v. 专攻；专门研究（英式拼写）

e.en: Our team {specialises} in mobile app security audits.
e.zh: 我们团队专门从事移动应用的安全审计。

e.en: He {specialises} in restoring vintage motorcycles.
e.zh: 他专门修复老式摩托车。

specialising.t: v. 专攻；专门从事（英式拼写）

e.en: She is {specialising} in machine learning for healthcare.
e.zh: 她正专攻医疗领域的机器学习。

e.en: The clinic is {specialising} in sports injury rehabilitation.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门从事运动损伤康复。

e.en: His {specialism} is forensic accounting.
e.zh: 他的专业方向是法务会计。

e.en: Choosing a {specialism} early can shape your whole career.
e.zh: 早早选定专业方向可能影响你的整个职业生涯。

e.en: You should see a skin {specialist} for that rash.
e.zh: 那种皮疹你应该去看皮肤科专科医生。

e.en: She works as a cybersecurity {specialist} at a bank.
e.zh: 她在一家银行担任网络安全专家。

specialists.t: n. 专家们；专科医生（复数）

e.en: Several {specialists} were consulted about the rare diagnosis.
e.zh: 医院请了几位专科医生会诊这个罕见病例。

e.en: Top {specialists} in AI ethics gathered at the summit.
e.zh: 人工智能伦理领域的顶尖专家齐聚峰会。

speciality.t: n. 特长；招牌（英式拼写）

e.en: Spicy noodles are this restaurant's {speciality}.
e.zh: 麻辣面是这家餐厅的招牌菜。

e.en: His {speciality} is debugging legacy systems.
e.zh: 他的专长是调试遗留系统。

e.en: Her {specialization} is natural language processing.
e.zh: 她的研究方向是自然语言处理。

e.en: The course offers a {specialization} in data engineering.
e.zh: 这门课程提供数据工程方向的专业化培训。

e.en: We {specialize} in cloud migration for small businesses.
e.zh: 我们专门为小企业提供云迁移服务。

e.en: Many doctors {specialize} after a few years of practice.
e.zh: 许多医生在执业几年后会选择专科方向。

e.en: Repairing this engine requires {specialized} tools.
e.zh: 修理这台发动机需要专门的工具。

e.en: He {specialized} in international tax law at his firm.
e.zh: 他在事务所里专攻国际税法。

specializes.t: v. 专攻（第三人称单数）

e.en: This cafe {specializes} in single-origin pour-over coffee.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆专门做单一产地手冲咖啡。

e.en: Dr. Lee {specializes} in pediatric neurology.
e.zh: 李医生专攻儿科神经病学。

specializing.t: v. 正在专攻；专门研究

e.en: She is {specializing} in renewable energy law.
e.zh: 她正在专攻可再生能源法律。

e.en: The startup is {specializing} in privacy-focused tools.
e.zh: 这家初创公司专注于注重隐私的工具。

e.en: This cake was {specially} made for your birthday.
e.zh: 这个蛋糕是专门为你的生日做的。

e.en: The room was {specially} designed for music recording.
e.zh: 这个房间是为音乐录制专门设计的。

e.en: The {specialness} of the moment made everyone fall silent.
e.zh: 那一刻的特别让所有人都安静了下来。

e.en: Handwritten letters have a {specialness} that emails lack.
e.zh: 手写信有一种电子邮件没有的独特感。

e.en: The chef's {specialties} include grilled seafood and homemade pasta.
e.zh: 主厨的招牌菜包括烤海鲜和手工意面。

e.en: Hospitals often list their medical {specialties} on the website.
e.zh: 医院通常在网站上列出他们的专科领域。

e.en: Cybersecurity is her professional {specialty}.
e.zh: 网络安全是她的专业方向。

e.en: Try the {specialty} of the house — it's amazing.
e.zh: 尝尝这家店的招牌菜,真的很棒。

e.en: Geographic isolation often drives {speciation} in animal populations.
e.zh: 地理隔离常常推动动物种群的物种形成。

e.en: Darwin studied finches to understand {speciation} in the Galápagos.
e.zh: 达尔文研究雀鸟以理解加拉帕戈斯的物种分化。

e.en: The bank held large reserves of gold {specie} in its vault.
e.zh: 银行金库里存有大量的金属硬币储备。

e.en: Payments were once made in {specie} rather than paper money.
e.zh: 过去交易用的是金属货币而不是纸币。

e.en: Pandas are an endangered {species} native to China.
e.zh: 熊猫是中国特有的濒危物种。

e.en: Scientists discovered a new {species} of frog in the rainforest.
e.zh: 科学家在雨林中发现了一种新的青蛙物种。

specifiable.t: adj. 可指定的；可明确说明的

e.en: The font size is easily {specifiable} in the settings menu.
e.zh: 在设置菜单中可以轻松指定字体大小。

e.en: Each parameter must be clearly {specifiable} by the user.
e.zh: 每个参数都必须由用户明确指定。

e.en: Can you give me a more {specific} example?
e.zh: 你能给我一个更具体的例子吗?

e.en: This medicine targets a {specific} type of bacteria.
e.zh: 这种药针对一种特定的细菌。

e.en: This phone was designed {specifically} for gamers.
e.zh: 这款手机是专门为游戏玩家设计的。

e.en: I came here {specifically} to talk to you.
e.zh: 我特意来这里就是要和你谈谈。

e.en: The engineer reviewed every detail of the technical {specification}.
e.zh: 工程师审查了技术规格的每一个细节。

e.en: Please follow the {specification} when writing the API.
e.zh: 编写接口时请遵循该规范。

specifications.t: n. 规格参数；技术指标（复数）

e.en: Check the laptop's {specifications} before placing your order.
e.zh: 下单前请查看笔记本电脑的规格参数。

e.en: The contractor built the house to the client's exact {specifications}.
e.zh: 承包商完全按照客户的要求建造了房子。

e.en: The report's {specificity} made it easy to act on.
e.zh: 这份报告的具体程度让人很容易据此行动。

e.en: This test has high {specificity} for detecting the virus.
e.zh: 这项检测在识别该病毒上具有很高的特异性。

e.en: We agreed in principle, but the {specifics} need work.
e.zh: 我们原则上同意,但具体细节还需要敲定。

e.en: Don't worry about the {specifics} — focus on the big picture.
e.zh: 别纠结于细节,把注意力放在大方向上。

specified.t:
adj. 指定的
v. 已指明

e.en: Please pay the amount {specified} on the invoice.
e.zh: 请支付发票上注明的金额。

e.en: The contract clearly {specified} the delivery date.
e.zh: 合同明确规定了交货日期。

specifier.t: n. 说明符；限定符（编程）

e.en: In CSS, a class {specifier} starts with a dot.
e.zh: 在 CSS 中,类选择符以点号开头。

e.en: The format {specifier} %d prints an integer in C.
e.zh: 在 C 语言中,格式说明符 %d 用于打印整数。

e.en: The recipe {specifies} two cups of flour, not three.
e.zh: 食谱写明用两杯面粉,而不是三杯。

e.en: This config file {specifies} the database connection.
e.zh: 这个配置文件指定了数据库的连接方式。

e.en: Please {specify} your preferred delivery time at checkout.
e.zh: 请在结账时指定您希望的送货时间。

e.en: You need to {specify} which file you want to open.
e.zh: 你需要指明想打开哪个文件。

specifying.t: v. 正在指定；明确说明

e.en: The form requires {specifying} your country of residence.
e.zh: 表格要求填写你的居住国家。

e.en: He sent an email {specifying} the meeting agenda.
e.zh: 他发了一封邮件,详细说明了会议议程。

e.en: The lab analyzed a blood {specimen} from the patient.
e.zh: 实验室分析了这位病人的一份血液样本。

e.en: This rock is a fine {specimen} of volcanic basalt.
e.zh: 这块岩石是一块上好的火山玄武岩标本。

specious.t: adj. 似是而非的；华而不实的

e.en: His argument sounds convincing but is actually {specious}.
e.zh: 他的论点听上去有道理,其实是似是而非。

e.en: The salesman's promises turned out to be {specious}.
e.zh: 那个销售员的承诺最后被证明是花言巧语。

e.en: There's a tiny {speck} of dust on the camera lens.
e.zh: 相机镜头上有一个小小的灰尘斑点。

e.en: From the plane, the village looked like a {speck}.
e.zh: 从飞机上看,那个村子像一个小点。

speckle.t:
n. 斑点
v. 使布满斑点

e.en: Tiny stars {speckle} the night sky over the desert.
e.zh: 点点繁星点缀着沙漠上方的夜空。

e.en: Raindrops began to {speckle} the dusty windshield.
e.zh: 雨点开始在落满灰尘的挡风玻璃上点点洒落。

e.en: The hen laid a small, brown {speckled} egg.
e.zh: 母鸡下了一个棕色带斑点的小蛋。

e.en: Her face was lightly {speckled} with freckles.
e.zh: 她的脸上有些淡淡的雀斑。

e.en: The opening ceremony was an unforgettable {spectacle}.
e.zh: 开幕式是一场令人难忘的盛大场面。

e.en: Don't make a {spectacle} of yourself in public.
e.zh: 不要在公共场合出洋相。

e.en: A {spectacled} librarian helped me find the book.
e.zh: 一位戴眼镜的图书管理员帮我找到了那本书。

e.en: The {spectacled} bear is native to South America.
e.zh: 眼镜熊原产于南美洲。

e.en: He cleaned his {spectacles} with the corner of his shirt.
e.zh: 他用衬衫的一角擦了擦眼镜。

e.en: Grandpa can't read without his {spectacles}.
e.zh: 爷爷不戴眼镜就看不了书。

e.en: The view from the mountaintop was absolutely {spectacular}.
e.zh: 从山顶看到的景色简直是壮观至极。

e.en: She made a {spectacular} comeback in the final round.
e.zh: 她在最后一轮上演了精彩的逆转。

spectacularly.t: adv. 壮观地；引人注目地

e.en: The startup failed {spectacularly} after losing major clients.
e.zh: 那家初创公司在失去主要客户后惨败收场。

e.en: The fireworks lit up the sky {spectacularly}.
e.zh: 焰火把夜空照得绚丽夺目。

e.en: You can {spectate} live esports matches on Twitch for free.
e.zh: 你可以在 Twitch 上免费观看电竞直播比赛。

e.en: Parents came to {spectate} the school sports day.
e.zh: 家长们来观看学校的运动会。

e.en: Every {spectator} stood up to cheer the winning goal.
e.zh: 每一位观众都站起来为这粒制胜进球欢呼。

e.en: He prefers to be a {spectator} rather than a player.
e.zh: 他更喜欢当观众,而不是当选手。

e.en: The film adopts a cool, {spectatorial} tone toward its characters.
e.zh: 这部电影对人物采取了一种冷静的旁观态度。

e.en: His {spectatorial} stance kept him out of the conflict.
e.zh: 他的旁观立场让他没有卷入这场冲突。

e.en: Thousands of {spectators} packed the stadium for the final.
e.zh: 成千上万的观众挤满了决赛的体育场。

e.en: The {spectators} cheered as the runners crossed the finish line.
e.zh: 当选手们冲过终点线时,观众们欢呼起来。

specter.t: n. 幽灵；隐忧（美式拼写）

e.en: The {specter} of inflation worries many small business owners.
e.zh: 通胀的阴影让许多小企业主感到担忧。

e.en: Children claimed they saw a {specter} in the old house.
e.zh: 孩子们说他们在那座老房子里看到了一个幽灵。

e.en: Astronomers study stellar {spectra} to determine a star's composition.
e.zh: 天文学家通过研究恒星光谱来确定其成分。

e.en: Different elements emit distinct light {spectra} when heated.
e.zh: 不同的元素受热时会发出不同的光谱。

e.en: A {spectral} figure seemed to drift through the foggy graveyard.
e.zh: 一个幽灵般的身影似乎飘过雾气弥漫的墓地。

e.en: The telescope captured the {spectral} signature of the distant galaxy.
e.zh: 望远镜捕捉到了那个遥远星系的光谱特征。

spectre.t: n. 幽灵；隐忧（英式拼写）

e.en: The {spectre} of unemployment hangs over the industry.
e.zh: 失业的阴影笼罩着整个行业。

e.en: Local legend claims a {spectre} haunts the lighthouse.
e.zh: 当地传说有一个幽灵在那座灯塔出没。

e.en: The {spectrograph} split the starlight into a rainbow of colors.
e.zh: 光谱仪把星光分解成了彩虹般的色带。

e.en: Engineers used a {spectrograph} to analyze the sample's composition.
e.zh: 工程师们用光谱仪分析了样品的成分。

spectrographic.t: adj. 摄谱仪的；光谱记录的

e.en: {Spectrographic} analysis revealed traces of iron in the meteorite.
e.zh: 光谱分析显示这块陨石中含有微量的铁。

e.en: The lab uses {spectrographic} techniques to identify pollutants.
e.zh: 实验室使用光谱技术来识别污染物。

e.en: The mass {spectrometer} measured the molecule's exact weight.
e.zh: 质谱仪测出了这个分子的精确重量。

e.en: Scientists rely on a {spectrometer} to identify unknown substances.
e.zh: 科学家依靠光谱仪来识别未知物质。

e.en: Mass {spectrometry} is widely used in modern drug testing.
e.zh: 质谱法在现代药物检测中应用广泛。

e.en: The lab specializes in environmental {spectrometry} analysis.
e.zh: 该实验室专门从事环境光谱分析。

e.en: The {spectrophotometer} measures how much light a sample absorbs.
e.zh: 分光光度计可以测量样品对光的吸收量。

e.en: We calibrated the {spectrophotometer} before testing the solutions.
e.zh: 在测试溶液前,我们校准了分光光度计。

e.en: Through the {spectroscope}, the flame revealed bright sodium lines.
e.zh: 通过分光镜,火焰显出了明亮的钠谱线。

e.en: The chemistry teacher demonstrated a simple {spectroscope} in class.
e.zh: 化学老师在课堂上演示了一个简单的分光镜。

spectroscopic.t: adj. 分光镜的；光谱学的

e.en: {Spectroscopic} data confirmed the presence of water on the planet.
e.zh: 光谱数据证实了那颗行星上存在水。

e.en: Researchers performed a {spectroscopic} study of the new material.
e.zh: 研究人员对这种新材料进行了光谱学研究。

e.en: The {spectroscopist} interpreted the strange peaks in the data.
e.zh: 那位光谱学家解读了数据中那些奇怪的峰值。

e.en: She trained as a {spectroscopist} before joining the space agency.
e.zh: 她在加入航天局之前接受过光谱学家的训练。

e.en: Infrared {spectroscopy} helps chemists identify molecular structures.
e.zh: 红外光谱学帮助化学家识别分子结构。

e.en: The course covers the basics of laser {spectroscopy}.
e.zh: 该课程涵盖激光光谱学的基础知识。

e.en: The policy attracted support from across the political {spectrum}.
e.zh: 这项政策获得了政治光谱各方的支持。

e.en: A prism splits sunlight into a colorful {spectrum}.
e.zh: 棱镜可以把阳光分解成绚丽的光谱。

e.en: The two devices emit light in completely different {spectrums}.
e.zh: 这两种设备发出的光处于完全不同的光谱范围。

e.en: His friends span the {spectrums} of age and background.
e.zh: 他的朋友横跨各种年龄段和背景。

e.en: The {specular} reflection on the lake mirrored the mountains perfectly.
e.zh: 湖面的镜面反射把群山映照得清清楚楚。

e.en: Game artists tweak {specular} highlights to make surfaces look shiny.
e.zh: 游戏美术会调整高光反射,让表面看上去更有光泽。

e.en: It's too early to {speculate} about the cause of the crash.
e.zh: 现在猜测事故原因还为时过早。

e.en: Investors {speculate} on which startup will go public next.
e.zh: 投资者们猜测下一家上市的会是哪家初创公司。

e.en: Analysts {speculated} that the company would announce layoffs soon.
e.zh: 分析师推测该公司很快会宣布裁员。

e.en: Fans {speculated} for weeks about the show's secret ending.
e.zh: 粉丝们围绕剧集隐藏的结局猜测了好几周。

speculates.t: v. speculate 的第三人称单数

e.en: He often {speculates} about the future of artificial intelligence.
e.zh: 他经常对人工智能的未来进行猜测。

e.en: She {speculates} on tech stocks during her free time.
e.zh: 她空闲时会投机买卖科技股。

e.en: Stop {speculating} and wait for the official announcement.
e.zh: 别再瞎猜了，等官方公告吧。

e.en: He lost money {speculating} in the crypto market.
e.zh: 他在加密货币市场投机时亏了钱。

speculation.t: n. 猜测、推测；投机行为

e.en: The merger sparked widespread {speculation} among investors.
e.zh: 这次合并在投资者中引发了广泛的猜测。

e.en: Real estate {speculation} drove housing prices to record highs.
e.zh: 房地产投机将房价推至历史新高。

e.en: Online {speculations} about the celebrity's health turned out false.
e.zh: 网上关于这位名人健康状况的种种猜测都不属实。

e.en: His {speculations} about quantum physics filled an entire notebook.
e.zh: 他对量子物理的种种推测写满了整本笔记本。

e.en: The report is purely {speculative} and lacks hard evidence.
e.zh: 这份报告纯属推测，缺乏确凿证据。

e.en: She prefers {speculative} fiction over historical novels.
e.zh: 她更喜欢科幻类小说，而不是历史小说。

e.en: He glanced {speculatively} at the locked door.
e.zh: 他若有所思地瞥了一眼那扇锁着的门。

e.en: Investors moved {speculatively} into emerging markets last quarter.
e.zh: 投资者上季度投机性地进入了新兴市场。

e.en: The {speculator} made millions during the housing boom.
e.zh: 那位投机商在房地产繁荣期赚了数百万。

e.en: Critics called him a reckless {speculator}, not an investor.
e.zh: 批评者称他为鲁莽的投机者，而非投资者。

e.en: The doctor used a {speculum} during the routine examination.
e.zh: 医生在常规检查中使用了窥器。

e.en: Modern {speculum} designs aim to reduce patient discomfort.
e.zh: 现代窥器的设计旨在减少患者的不适感。

sped.t: v. speed 的过去式，快速行进

e.en: The ambulance {sped} through traffic with sirens blaring.
e.zh: 救护车鸣着警笛在车流中飞驰而过。

e.en: Time {sped} by during the exciting concert.
e.zh: 在那场精彩的演唱会上时间飞快地流逝。

e.en: Her graduation {speech} moved everyone in the audience.
e.zh: 她的毕业演讲感动了在场的每一个人。

e.en: Free {speech} is protected by the constitution.
e.zh: 言论自由受宪法保护。

e.en: The senator gave several {speeches} during the campaign tour.
e.zh: 那位参议员在竞选巡回中发表了多次演讲。

e.en: His political {speeches} are known for being short and sharp.
e.zh: 他的政治演讲以简短犀利著称。

speechless.t: adj. 无言的、说不出话的

e.en: The surprise party left her completely {speechless}.
e.zh: 那场惊喜派对让她完全说不出话来。

e.en: He stood {speechless} after hearing the shocking news.
e.zh: 听到这个震惊的消息后他呆站着说不出话。

e.en: Her {speechlessness} revealed just how shocked she really was.
e.zh: 她的无言以对显示出她真的有多震惊。

e.en: A moment of {speechlessness} followed his unexpected proposal.
e.zh: 他出乎意料的求婚之后是一阵哑口无言。

e.en: Many deaf children learn to {speechread} from an early age.
e.zh: 许多聋哑儿童从小就学习读唇。

e.en: She can {speechread} well enough to follow most conversations.
e.zh: 她唇读能力很好，能跟上大部分对话。

e.en: The president hired a new {speechwriter} before the campaign.
e.zh: 总统在竞选前雇了一位新的演讲撰稿人。

e.en: A skilled {speechwriter} can shape a politician's public image.
e.zh: 一位优秀的演讲撰稿人能塑造政治家的公众形象。

speed.t:
n. 速度
v. 加速、飞驰

e.en: The car was traveling at incredible {speed} on the highway.
e.zh: 那辆车在高速公路上以惊人的速度行驶。

e.en: You can {speed} up the video by tapping twice.
e.zh: 双击可以加快视频播放速度。

e.en: He trains daily by hitting the {speedball} at the gym.
e.zh: 他每天在健身房打速度球进行训练。

e.en: Mixing drugs into a {speedball} is extremely dangerous.
e.zh: 把毒品混合成速度球极其危险。

e.en: They rented a {speedboat} for the afternoon on the lake.
e.zh: 他们租了一艘快艇在湖上玩了一下午。

e.en: The {speedboat} cut sharply across the calm water.
e.zh: 快艇在平静的水面上急速划过。

e.en: The officer pulled over a {speeder} on the freeway.
e.zh: 警官在高速公路上拦下了一名超速司机。

e.en: That {speeder} was clocked at 130 kilometers per hour.
e.zh: 那名超速司机被测到时速达130公里。

e.en: Police set up cameras to catch {speeders} downtown.
e.zh: 警方在市中心装了摄像头来抓超速司机。

e.en: The new road signs warn {speeders} about the strict fines.
e.zh: 新的路标警告超速者将面临严厉罚款。

e.en: The team {speedily} resolved the customer's complaint.
e.zh: 团队迅速地解决了客户的投诉。

e.en: News of the discovery spread {speedily} across social media.
e.zh: 这一发现的消息在社交媒体上迅速传开。

speeding.t:
n. 超速行驶
v. 疾驰

e.en: He got a ticket for {speeding} on the highway.
e.zh: 他因在高速公路上超速被开了罚单。

e.en: A {speeding} train rushed past the small station.
e.zh: 一列疾驰的火车从那个小车站飞驰而过。

e.en: Glance at the {speedo} before changing lanes.
e.zh: 换道前瞄一眼速度表。

e.en: He bought a new {speedo} for swim practice.
e.zh: 他为游泳训练买了一条新的速比涛泳裤。

e.en: The {speedometer} showed we were going eighty kilometers an hour.
e.zh: 速度表显示我们正以每小时八十公里行驶。

e.en: My bike's {speedometer} stopped working after the rain.
e.zh: 我自行车的码表在雨后就坏了。

speeds.t: n./v. speed 的复数或第三人称单数

e.en: The new fiber connection reaches download {speeds} of one gigabit.
e.zh: 新的光纤连接下载速度可达一千兆。

e.en: This medication {speeds} up the recovery process significantly.
e.zh: 这种药能显著加快恢复过程。

e.en: The {speedster} won every race at the school sports day.
e.zh: 这位飞毛腿在校运会上每场比赛都赢了。

e.en: He drives a red {speedster} that turns heads everywhere.
e.zh: 他开着一辆红色跑车，所到之处都吸引目光。

e.en: Thousands gathered at the {speedway} for the championship final.
e.zh: 数千人聚集在赛车场观看冠军决赛。

e.en: The local {speedway} hosts races every Saturday night.
e.zh: 当地赛车场每周六晚上举办比赛。

e.en: Tiny blue {speedwell} flowers covered the meadow in spring.
e.zh: 春天里，小小的蓝色婆婆纳花布满了草地。

e.en: She planted {speedwell} along the garden border.
e.zh: 她在花园边界种了一排婆婆纳。

e.en: We wish you a {speedy} recovery from your surgery.
e.zh: 祝你手术后早日康复。

e.en: The shop is known for {speedy} delivery within the city.
e.zh: 这家店以市内快速送达而闻名。

e.en: His passion for {speleology} took him into caves worldwide.
e.zh: 他对洞穴学的热爱带他去探索了世界各地的洞穴。

e.en: The university offers a course in {speleology} each semester.
e.zh: 这所大学每学期都开设一门洞穴学课程。

spell.t:
v. 拼写
n. 咒语；一段时间

e.en: Can you {spell} your last name for me?
e.zh: 你能把你的姓拼一下给我听吗？

e.en: The witch cast a {spell} to protect the village.
e.zh: 女巫施了一个咒语来保护村庄。

e.en: Great storytellers can {spellbind} an audience for hours.
e.zh: 出色的说故事者能让观众入迷数小时。

e.en: Her violin solo seemed to {spellbind} the entire concert hall.
e.zh: 她的小提琴独奏似乎让整个音乐厅都为之倾倒。

spellbinding.t: adj. 引人入胜的、令人着迷的

e.en: The film offered a {spellbinding} mix of drama and adventure.
e.zh: 这部电影是一部扣人心弦的戏剧与冒险结合之作。

e.en: She gave a {spellbinding} performance on opening night.
e.zh: 她在首演之夜献上了令人着迷的表演。

e.en: The children sat {spellbound} as the magician performed.
e.zh: 孩子们入迷地坐着看魔术师表演。

e.en: Audiences were {spellbound} by the orchestra's powerful finale.
e.zh: 观众被乐团震撼的终曲深深迷住。

spider.t:
n. 蜘蛛
n. 网络爬虫

e.en: A tiny {spider} was spinning a web in the corner.
e.zh: 一只小蜘蛛正在墙角织网。

e.en: The search {spider} crawls millions of pages each day.
e.zh: 搜索爬虫每天抓取数百万个网页。

e.en: The robot moved with {spiderlike} legs over the rubble.
e.zh: 机器人用蜘蛛般的腿在瓦砾上移动。

e.en: His long, {spiderlike} fingers raced across the keyboard.
e.zh: 他细长如蜘蛛的手指在键盘上飞快敲打。

e.en: Most {spiders} are harmless and actually help control pests.
e.zh: 大多数蜘蛛是无害的,反而能帮忙控制害虫。

e.en: She's terrified of {spiders} crawling near her bed.
e.zh: 她害怕蜘蛛爬到她床边。

e.en: Dew drops sparkled on the {spiderweb} at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时露珠在蜘蛛网上闪闪发光。

e.en: The crash left a {spiderweb} crack on the windshield.
e.zh: 那次撞击在挡风玻璃上留下了蛛网状裂痕。

e.en: His {spidery} handwriting filled the margins of the book.
e.zh: 他那细长如蛛丝的字迹布满了书的页边。

e.en: Thin, {spidery} cracks ran across the old wall.
e.zh: 细如蛛丝的裂纹布满了那面旧墙。

spied.t: v. 窥探；察觉（spy 的过去式）

e.en: She {spied} her keys hidden under the couch cushion.
e.zh: 她瞥见钥匙藏在沙发垫下面。

e.en: He {spied} for the agency throughout the war.
e.zh: 战争期间他一直为该机构做间谍。

spiegel.t: n. 施皮格尔（人名/品牌名）

e.en: Der {Spiegel} broke the story before any other outlet.
e.zh: 《明镜周刊》比其他任何媒体都先报道了这个新闻。

e.en: She browsed the {Spiegel} catalog for new bedroom furniture.
e.zh: 她翻阅施皮格尔目录,挑选新的卧室家具。

spiel.t:
n. 一套说辞；推销话术
v. 滔滔不绝地说

e.en: The salesman launched into his usual {spiel} about features.
e.zh: 那位销售员又开始了他那套关于功能的老一套说辞。

e.en: Skip the {spiel} and tell me the price.
e.zh: 别绕圈子了,直接告诉我价格。

spielberg.t: n. 斯皮尔伯格（导演姓氏）

e.en: Steven {Spielberg} directed some of the highest-grossing films ever.
e.zh: 史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格执导过一些史上最卖座的电影。

e.en: The new biopic feels almost like a {Spielberg} production.
e.zh: 这部新传记片几乎有种斯皮尔伯格作品的味道。

e.en: The Gothic cathedral's {spiers} pierced the morning fog.
e.zh: 哥特式大教堂的尖顶刺破了清晨的薄雾。

e.en: Two slender {spiers} marked the old town hall.
e.zh: 两座细长的尖塔是旧市政厅的标志。

spies.t:
n. 间谍（复数）
v. 窥探

e.en: Cold War {spies} often used coded radio messages.
e.zh: 冷战时期的间谍常用密码无线电传递信息。

e.en: He {spies} on competitors through their public job postings.
e.zh: 他通过对手公开的招聘启事来打探情报。

spiff.t:
n. 销售提成奖金
v. 打扮整洁

e.en: Let's {spiff} up the living room before guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人来之前我们把客厅收拾整齐些吧。

e.en: The store offers a {spiff} for every laptop sold.
e.zh: 店里每卖出一台笔记本电脑都会发一笔奖金。

e.en: He showed up in a {spiffy} new suit and tie.
e.zh: 他穿着一身崭新漂亮的西装领带出现了。

e.en: The redesigned app looks really {spiffy} on mobile.
e.zh: 重新设计的应用在手机上看起来非常时髦。

e.en: Turn the {spigot} clockwise to shut off the water.
e.zh: 顺时针转动龙头就能把水关掉。

e.en: Funding flowed like a wide-open {spigot} that year.
e.zh: 那一年资金像敞开的水龙头一样源源不断。

spike.t:
n. 尖刺；峰值
v. 激增；掺料

e.en: We saw a sudden {spike} in traffic after the launch.
e.zh: 产品发布后我们看到流量出现了急剧飙升。

e.en: Don't {spike} the punch at the office party.
e.zh: 别在办公室聚会的潘趣酒里偷偷加酒。

spiked.t: adj. 带尖刺的；掺了酒的

e.en: Sales {spiked} sharply during the holiday weekend.
e.zh: 假日周末销量急剧飙升。

e.en: Someone {spiked} her drink at the bar last night.
e.zh: 昨晚有人在酒吧偷偷往她的饮料里下了东西。

spiking.t: v. 激增；加料（spike 的现在分词）

e.en: Server costs are {spiking} after our viral post.
e.zh: 那篇帖子爆火后,我们的服务器成本正在急剧上升。

e.en: He was caught {spiking} the team's water bottles.
e.zh: 他被抓到往队友的水瓶里偷偷加东西。

e.en: He styles his hair into short, {spiky} tufts.
e.zh: 他把头发弄成短短的、一根根竖起来的样子。

e.en: Be careful—those plants have very {spiky} leaves.
e.zh: 小心点,那些植物的叶子非常带刺。

spill.t:
v. 洒出；溢出
n. 泄漏

e.en: Try not to {spill} coffee on the new keyboard.
e.zh: 尽量别把咖啡洒到新键盘上。

e.en: Come on, just {spill} the details about the date!
e.zh: 快说嘛,把约会的细节都告诉我!

e.en: Cleanup crews responded quickly to the oil {spillage}.
e.zh: 清理人员迅速对漏油事件做出了反应。

e.en: Use a tray to catch any {spillage} from the bottle.
e.zh: 用托盘接住瓶子里溢出来的液体。

spilled.t: v. 洒出（spill 的过去式）

e.en: He {spilled} coffee all over his new keyboard.
e.zh: 他把咖啡洒得新键盘上到处都是。

e.en: A whistleblower {spilled} the company's secrets to reporters.
e.zh: 一名举报人向记者透露了公司的秘密。

e.en: The clumsy {spiller} ruined the carpet at the party.
e.zh: 那个笨手笨脚的人在派对上毁了地毯。

e.en: Oil {spiller} ships face heavy fines under the new law.
e.zh: 漏油船只在新法律下面临巨额罚款。

spilling.t: v. 洒出；溢出（现在分词）

e.en: Tears were {spilling} down her cheeks during the speech.
e.zh: 演讲时泪水顺着她的脸颊往下流。

e.en: Fans were {spilling} out of the stadium after the match.
e.zh: 比赛结束后球迷们涌出体育场。

e.en: The conflict caused {spillover} effects on neighboring countries.
e.zh: 这场冲突对邻国产生了溢出效应。

e.en: There was significant {spillover} from the tech boom into housing.
e.zh: 科技热潮对房地产市场产生了显著的连带影响。

spills.t:
n. 泄漏（复数）
v. 洒出

e.en: Please clean up any {spills} on the kitchen floor immediately.
e.zh: 请立即清理厨房地板上的任何洒落物。

e.en: This mug {spills} easily if you tilt it.
e.zh: 这个杯子一倾斜就容易洒出来。

e.en: The dam's {spillway} released excess water during the flood.
e.zh: 洪水期间大坝的溢洪道排出了多余的水。

e.en: Engineers inspected the {spillway} after the heavy storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后工程师检查了溢洪道。

spilt.t: v. 洒出（spill 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: There's no use crying over {spilt} milk.
e.zh: 覆水难收,无需懊悔。

e.en: She {spilt} red wine on the white tablecloth.
e.zh: 她把红酒洒在了白桌布上。

spin.t:
v. 旋转；纺
n. 自旋；舆论导向

e.en: Let's take the new car for a {spin} this weekend.
e.zh: 周末我们开新车出去兜一圈吧。

e.en: Politicians often {spin} bad news to sound positive.
e.zh: 政客经常把坏消息粉饰得听起来很正面。

e.en: Add fresh {spinach} to the smoothie for extra iron.
e.zh: 在奶昔里加点新鲜菠菜补铁。

e.en: Popeye gets his strength from eating {spinach}.
e.zh: 大力水手靠吃菠菜获得力量。

e.en: The market sells several varieties of {spinaches} from local farms.
e.zh: 市场出售当地农场的几种菠菜品种。

e.en: Different {spinaches} have slightly different flavors and textures.
e.zh: 不同品种的菠菜在味道和口感上略有差别。

e.en: He suffered a serious {spinal} injury in the accident.
e.zh: 他在事故中脊柱严重受伤。

e.en: The doctor ordered a {spinal} tap to confirm the diagnosis.
e.zh: 医生要求做腰椎穿刺以确认诊断。

spindle.t:
n. 纺锤；轴
v. 装在轴上

e.en: The old sewing machine had a wooden {spindle}.
e.zh: 那台旧缝纫机有一个木制的纺锤。

e.en: She pricked her finger on the {spindle} of the wheel.
e.zh: 她的手指被纺车的轴尖刺破了。

e.en: The newborn calf wobbled on its {spindly} legs.
e.zh: 刚出生的小牛在细长的腿上摇摇晃晃。

e.en: A {spindly} tree grew in the corner of the yard.
e.zh: 院子角落里长着一棵瘦长的小树。

e.en: The wind blew {spindrift} off the crests of the waves.
e.zh: 风把浪尖上的浪花吹散开来。

e.en: Sailors watched the {spindrift} swirl across the stormy sea.
e.zh: 水手们看着浪沫在暴风雨的海面上飞舞。

spine.t:
n. 脊柱；书脊
n. 刺（动植物）

e.en: Sitting up straight is good for your {spine}.
e.zh: 坐直对你的脊柱有好处。

e.en: The book's title was printed on the {spine}.
e.zh: 书名印在书脊上。

e.en: The {spined} cactus thrives in the desert heat.
e.zh: 这种带刺的仙人掌在沙漠高温下生长旺盛。

e.en: Be careful handling the {spined} fish from the reef.
e.zh: 处理那条来自珊瑚礁的带刺鱼时要小心。

e.en: He was too {spineless} to stand up to his boss.
e.zh: 他太懦弱了，不敢顶撞老板。

e.en: Jellyfish are {spineless} creatures that drift with the currents.
e.zh: 水母是没有脊椎的生物，随海流漂动。

e.en: The sea urchin's tiny {spinelet} broke off in his finger.
e.zh: 海胆的小棘刺断在了他的手指里。

e.en: Each {spinelet} on the cactus is sharper than it looks.
e.zh: 仙人掌上的每根小刺都比看起来更尖。

e.en: The library shelves displayed colorful book {spines} in neat rows.
e.zh: 图书馆书架上整齐地展示着五颜六色的书脊。

e.en: Cactus {spines} can cause painful skin irritation.
e.zh: 仙人掌的刺会引起疼痛的皮肤刺激。

e.en: She inherited an antique {spinet} from her great-aunt.
e.zh: 她从姑婆那里继承了一架古董小型钢琴。

e.en: The {spinet} in the corner needed tuning before the recital.
e.zh: 角落里的小型钢琴在演奏会前需要调音。

e.en: A small {spink} flitted between the hedgerow branches.
e.zh: 一只小苍头燕雀在树篱间穿梭。

e.en: The birdwatcher noted a bright {spink} in his journal.
e.zh: 那位观鸟者在日记里记下了一只鲜艳的苍头燕雀。

e.en: Several {spinks} gathered at the feeder this morning.
e.zh: 今早有几只苍头燕雀聚集在喂食器旁。

e.en: The garden was filled with the chirping of {spinks}.
e.zh: 花园里满是苍头燕雀的啁啾声。

spinmeister.t: n. 舆论公关高手；话术大师

e.en: The campaign hired a {spinmeister} to handle the scandal.
e.zh: 竞选团队聘请了一位舆论高手来应对丑闻。

e.en: He's the {spinmeister} who turned every gaffe into good press.
e.zh: 他就是那个能把每次失言都包装成正面新闻的舆论高手。

e.en: The yacht's colorful {spinnaker} billowed in the strong breeze.
e.zh: 游艇上彩色的球帆在强风中鼓胀开来。

e.en: They hoisted the {spinnaker} to catch the downwind speed.
e.zh: 他们升起球帆以借顺风加速。

spinner.t:
n. 加载转圈；旋转者
n. 纺纱工

e.en: The webpage shows a loading {spinner} while fetching data.
e.zh: 网页在加载数据时会显示一个旋转图标。

e.en: He bought a fidget {spinner} to help with focus.
e.zh: 他买了个指尖陀螺来帮助集中注意力。

e.en: A spider's {spinneret} produces silk for building webs.
e.zh: 蜘蛛的吐丝器能产出织网用的丝。

e.en: Scientists studied the {spinneret} to design stronger synthetic fibers.
e.zh: 科学家研究蜘蛛吐丝器以设计更坚韧的合成纤维。

e.en: The fox disappeared into the small {spinney} behind the field.
e.zh: 狐狸消失在田野后方的小树丛里。

e.en: We picnicked at the edge of a quiet {spinney}.
e.zh: 我们在一片安静的小树林边野餐。

spinning.t:
v. 旋转
n. 纺纱；动感单车

e.en: My head is {spinning} after that long meeting.
e.zh: 开完那个漫长的会议后，我头都晕了。

e.en: She takes a {spinning} class at the gym every Tuesday.
e.zh: 她每周二在健身房上动感单车课。

spinoff.t: n. 衍生作品；分拆公司

e.en: The popular show got a {spinoff} focused on a side character.
e.zh: 那部热门剧集推出了一部聚焦配角的衍生剧。

e.en: This startup is a {spinoff} from a university research lab.
e.zh: 这家初创公司是从一所大学的研究实验室分拆出来的。
