e.en: The Vienna café is famous for its flaky {strudel}.
e.zh: 这家维也纳咖啡馆以酥脆的果馅卷而闻名。

struggle.t:
v. 挣扎；努力
n. 斗争；奋斗

e.en: Many students {struggle} with math at first.
e.zh: 许多学生一开始都觉得数学很吃力。

e.en: Her memoir describes the {struggle} of growing up poor.
e.zh: 她的回忆录描写了贫困中成长的艰辛。

struggled.t: v. 挣扎；奋斗（struggle 的过去式）

e.en: He {struggled} to open the rusty old door.
e.zh: 他费力地想打开那扇生锈的旧门。

e.en: The team {struggled} all season but never gave up.
e.zh: 球队整个赛季都很挣扎,但从未放弃。

e.en: She was a {struggler} in school but became a great writer.
e.zh: 她在学校学习吃力,后来却成了优秀作家。

e.en: Every {struggler} deserves a chance to prove themselves.
e.zh: 每一个奋斗者都值得有机会证明自己。

struggles.t:
n. 斗争（复数）
v. 挣扎（第三人称单数）

e.en: The film honestly portrays the {struggles} of immigrants.
e.zh: 这部电影真实刻画了移民的艰辛。

e.en: He {struggles} to balance work and family life.
e.zh: 他在平衡工作与家庭生活上很吃力。

struggling.t:
adj. 苦苦挣扎的
v. 正在挣扎

e.en: Many small businesses are {struggling} with rising costs.
e.zh: 许多小企业正因成本上涨而苦苦挣扎。

e.en: I'm {struggling} to understand this chapter of the book.
e.zh: 我很难理解这本书的这一章。

strum.t: v. 弹奏；拨弄（吉他等弦乐器）

e.en: He likes to {strum} his guitar by the campfire.
e.zh: 他喜欢在篝火旁弹弹吉他。

e.en: Even beginners can {strum} a few simple chords quickly.
e.zh: 即使是初学者也能很快弹出几个简单和弦。

strumming.t: v. 弹拨弦乐（strum 的现在分词）

e.en: She was {strumming} a soft tune on the ukulele.
e.zh: 她在尤克里里上轻轻弹着一段曲子。

e.en: His {strumming} pattern gives the song a relaxed feel.
e.zh: 他的扫弦节奏让这首歌显得很轻松。

e.en: In the old play, she was unfairly called a {strumpet}.
e.zh: 在那部古老剧作中,她被冤枉地称作荡妇。

e.en: The word {strumpet} sounds harsh and outdated today.
e.zh: 如今“荡妇”一词听起来刺耳又过时。

strung.t: v. 串连；绷紧（string 的过去式）

e.en: Colorful lanterns were {strung} across the street for the festival.
e.zh: 为了节日,街上挂起了五彩灯笼。

e.en: He has {strung} the tennis racket with new strings.
e.zh: 他给网球拍换上了新球弦。

strut.t:
v. 趾高气扬地走
n. 支柱；撑杆

e.en: He likes to {strut} around in his new suit.
e.zh: 他喜欢穿着新西装到处神气地走。

e.en: A metal {strut} supports the roof of the garage.
e.zh: 一根金属支柱撑起了车库的屋顶。

strutting.t: v. 昂首阔步走（strut 的现在分词）

e.en: The peacock was {strutting} proudly across the lawn.
e.zh: 孔雀在草坪上骄傲地踱步。

e.en: Stop {strutting} around and help with the dishes.
e.zh: 别再到处神气活现了,过来帮忙洗碗。

strychnine.t: n. 士的宁（一种剧毒生物碱）

e.en: The villain poisoned the wine with {strychnine}.
e.zh: 反派在酒里下了士的宁毒药。

e.en: {Strychnine} was once used to kill rats and stray dogs.
e.zh: 士的宁曾被用来毒杀老鼠和流浪狗。

sts.t: n. Saints 的缩写；圣徒们

stuart.t: n. 斯图亚特（人名/英国王朝）

e.en: The {Stuart} kings ruled England in the seventeenth century.
e.zh: 斯图亚特王朝的国王们在十七世纪统治英格兰。

e.en: My friend {Stuart} just moved to Singapore for work.
e.zh: 我朋友斯图尔特刚因工作搬到新加坡。

stub.t:
n. 存根；短截
v. 踢到；掐灭（烟）

e.en: Please keep your ticket {stub} as proof of purchase.
e.zh: 请保留票根作为购买凭证。

e.en: I wrote a quick {stub} function to test the API.
e.zh: 我写了一个简单的存根函数来测试 API。

stubbed.t: v. 踢到；掐灭（stub 的过去式）

e.en: I {stubbed} my toe on the corner of the bed.
e.zh: 我的脚趾撞到了床角。

e.en: He {stubbed} out his cigarette in the ashtray.
e.zh: 他把烟在烟灰缸里掐灭了。

e.en: He hadn't shaved, so his chin showed dark {stubble}.
e.zh: 他没刮胡子,下巴上长着一层黑色胡茬。

e.en: Birds searched the field of {stubble} for fallen grain.
e.zh: 鸟儿在残茬的田里寻找掉落的谷粒。

stubbled.t: adj. 有胡茬的；留有残茬的

e.en: His {stubbled} face made him look tired and rugged.
e.zh: 他长着胡茬的脸看上去疲惫又粗犷。

e.en: We walked across the {stubbled} field after the harvest.
e.zh: 我们走过收割后留着残茬的田地。

stubbly.t: adj. 长有短胡茬的；粗糙的

e.en: He rubbed his {stubbly} chin while thinking.
e.zh: 他一边思考,一边摸着满是胡茬的下巴。

e.en: The lawn looked {stubbly} after the rough mowing.
e.zh: 草坪粗糙修剪后显得参差不齐。

e.en: My grandfather is too {stubborn} to ask for help.
e.zh: 我祖父太固执了,不肯求助。

e.en: This {stubborn} stain just won't come out of the shirt.
e.zh: 这块顽固的污渍怎么也洗不掉。

e.en: He {stubbornly} refused to change his mind.
e.zh: 他固执地拒绝改变主意。

e.en: The lid {stubbornly} stayed shut despite my efforts.
e.zh: 尽管我使了劲,盖子还是顽固地打不开。

e.en: Her {stubbornness} sometimes helps her finish difficult projects.
e.zh: 她的固执有时帮她完成艰难的项目。

e.en: His {stubbornness} cost him several good friendships.
e.zh: 他的固执让他失去了几段好友谊。

e.en: The baby grabbed my finger with her {stubby} hand.
e.zh: 宝宝用她胖乎乎的小手抓住我的手指。

e.en: He wrote the note with a {stubby} pencil.
e.zh: 他用一支短粗的铅笔写下那张便条。

stucco.t:
n. 灰泥（墙面装饰材料）
v. 涂灰泥

e.en: The house has white {stucco} walls and a red roof.
e.zh: 这栋房子有白色灰泥墙和红色屋顶。

e.en: Workers applied fresh {stucco} to the building's exterior.
e.zh: 工人们在建筑外墙抹上了新的灰泥。

e.en: The villa has beautiful white {stuccoed} walls.
e.zh: 这栋别墅有漂亮的白色灰泥墙。

e.en: They {stuccoed} the exterior of the house last summer.
e.zh: 他们去年夏天给房子外墙抹了灰泥。

stuck.t:
v. 卡住；动不了 (stick 的过去式)
adj. 被困住的

e.en: My car got {stuck} in the mud after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后我的车陷在了泥里。

e.en: I'm {stuck} on this math problem and need help.
e.zh: 我被这道数学题难住了,需要帮助。

stud.t:
n. 饰钉；铆钉
n. 种马；(俚) 猛男

e.en: He wore a single diamond {stud} in his ear.
e.zh: 他耳朵上戴着一颗钻石耳钉。

e.en: You need to find a wall {stud} before hanging the shelf.
e.zh: 挂架子之前你得先找到墙里的木龙骨。

e.en: She wore a leather jacket {studded} with metal spikes.
e.zh: 她穿着一件镶满金属铆钉的皮夹克。

e.en: The night sky was {studded} with bright stars.
e.zh: 夜空中点缀着明亮的星星。

e.en: She is a brilliant {student} in our chemistry class.
e.zh: 她是我们化学课上的一名优秀学生。

e.en: Every {student} must register before the deadline.
e.zh: 每位学生都必须在截止日期前注册。

e.en: The {students} gathered in the hall for the assembly.
e.zh: 学生们聚集在大厅参加集会。

e.en: Many {students} struggle to balance work and study.
e.zh: 许多学生很难平衡工作和学习。

e.en: She won a {studentship} to study physics at Oxford.
e.zh: 她获得了一份在牛津学习物理的奖学金。

e.en: The university offers a {studentship} covering tuition and living costs.
e.zh: 该大学提供一份涵盖学费和生活费的研究生奖学金。

studied.t:
v. 学习 (study 过去式)
adj. 刻意的；有意的

e.en: She {studied} hard for the chemistry exam last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚为化学考试努力学习。

e.en: He gave a {studied} smile that seemed rehearsed.
e.zh: 他露出一个像是刻意练过的微笑。

studies.t:
n. 研究；学业
v. 学习 (第三人称单数)

e.en: Recent {studies} show that sleep improves memory.
e.zh: 最新研究表明睡眠能增强记忆力。

e.en: My sister {studies} law at a top university.
e.zh: 我姐姐在一所顶尖大学攻读法律。

studio.t: n. 工作室；录音棚；影棚

e.en: She rented a small {studio} in downtown Brooklyn.
e.zh: 她在布鲁克林市中心租了一间单间公寓。

e.en: The band recorded their album in a London {studio}.
e.zh: 乐队在伦敦的一间录音棚录制了专辑。

e.en: Hollywood {studios} are investing heavily in streaming content.
e.zh: 好莱坞各大制片公司正大力投资流媒体内容。

e.en: Several yoga {studios} opened near my apartment this year.
e.zh: 今年我家附近开了好几家瑜伽馆。

e.en: He was a quiet, {studious} boy who loved books.
e.zh: 他是个安静好学、热爱书本的男孩。

e.en: She made a {studious} effort to avoid the topic.
e.zh: 她刻意地回避那个话题。

e.en: He {studiously} ignored her texts all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午他都刻意无视她的短信。

e.en: She {studiously} reviewed every line of the contract.
e.zh: 她仔细认真地审阅了合同的每一行。

study.t:
v. 学习；研究
n. 研究；书房

e.en: I need to {study} more before the final exam.
e.zh: 期末考试前我得再多复习一下。

e.en: The {study} found a clear link between stress and insomnia.
e.zh: 该研究发现压力与失眠之间存在明显关联。

studying.t: v. 正在学习；研究 (进行时)

e.en: She is {studying} computer science at Stanford.
e.zh: 她正在斯坦福大学攻读计算机科学。

e.en: Scientists are {studying} how the virus spreads in cities.
e.zh: 科学家正在研究该病毒在城市中的传播方式。

stuff.t:
n. 东西；玩意儿
v. 塞满；填入

e.en: Can you move your {stuff} off the couch, please?
e.zh: 你能把你的东西从沙发上拿走吗?

e.en: Don't {stuff} too many clothes into one suitcase.
e.zh: 别把太多衣服塞进一个行李箱里。

stuffed.t: adj. 塞满的；(人) 吃撑了

e.en: The kids hugged their {stuffed} animals before bed.
e.zh: 孩子们睡前抱着他们的毛绒玩具。

e.en: After Thanksgiving dinner, I felt completely {stuffed}.
e.zh: 感恩节大餐之后,我感觉吃得撑爆了。

e.en: The envelope {stuffer} machine jammed during the mailing job.
e.zh: 信封装填机在邮寄作业时卡住了。

e.en: Grandma was the family's traditional turkey {stuffer} every year.
e.zh: 奶奶每年都是家里负责给火鸡填料的人。

e.en: He spoke {stuffily} about manners and proper etiquette.
e.zh: 他一本正经地大谈礼节与教养。

e.en: The old professor lectured {stuffily} for two long hours.
e.zh: 那位老教授拘谨刻板地讲了整整两个小时。

e.en: Open a window to relieve the {stuffiness} in here.
e.zh: 开扇窗,让屋里的闷气散散。

e.en: His formal {stuffiness} made the dinner feel awkward.
e.zh: 他那种古板做作让晚餐气氛很尴尬。

e.en: Different rooms had their own peculiar {stuffinesses} and odd smells.
e.zh: 不同房间各有其独特的闷气和怪味。

e.en: The novel mocked the various {stuffinesses} of Victorian society.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了维多利亚社会种种古板的做派。

stuffing.t:
n. 填料；馅料
v. 塞入 (进行时)

e.en: Mom's turkey {stuffing} is the best part of Thanksgiving.
e.zh: 妈妈做的火鸡馅料是感恩节最棒的部分。

e.en: The dog tore the cushion, scattering {stuffing} everywhere.
e.zh: 狗把垫子撕了,填充物撒得到处都是。

stuffs.t:
n. 东西（复数）
v. 填塞 (第三人称单数)

e.en: He always {stuffs} his backpack with snacks before hiking.
e.zh: 他每次徒步前都会把背包塞满零食。

e.en: She sells handmade {stuffs} at the weekend market.
e.zh: 她在周末集市上卖手工小物件。

stuffy.t:
adj. 闷热的；不通风的
adj. 古板的

e.en: The conference room felt hot and {stuffy} by noon.
e.zh: 到中午时,会议室又热又闷。

e.en: My nose is {stuffy} because of this terrible cold.
e.zh: 我感冒得厉害,鼻子塞得难受。

stultified.t: v. 使显得愚蠢 (过去式)

e.en: Years of bureaucracy {stultified} the once-creative team.
e.zh: 多年的官僚作风让这支曾富有创意的团队变得僵化。

e.en: She felt {stultified} by the repetitive office routine.
e.zh: 她被办公室一成不变的工作折磨得麻木了。

e.en: Endless meetings only {stultifies} genuine innovation at the company.
e.zh: 无休止的会议只会扼杀公司真正的创新。

e.en: Strict censorship {stultifies} artistic expression in many countries.
e.zh: 严格的审查在许多国家压制了艺术表达。

stultify.t: v. 使显得愚蠢；使无效

e.en: Rigid rules can {stultify} a child's natural curiosity.
e.zh: 刻板的规则会扼杀孩子天生的好奇心。

e.en: Long commutes {stultify} the mind after a few months.
e.zh: 长时间通勤几个月后会让人头脑变得迟钝。

stultifying.t: adj. 令人麻木的；扼杀思维的

e.en: He quit his {stultifying} desk job to travel the world.
e.zh: 他辞掉了那份令人麻木的办公室工作去环游世界。

e.en: The lecture was so {stultifying} that students fell asleep.
e.zh: 那场讲座枯燥到学生们都睡着了。

e.en: The training video was {stultifyingly} dull and seemed endless.
e.zh: 那段培训视频枯燥得让人发懵,似乎没完没了。

e.en: Life in the small town was {stultifyingly} predictable.
e.zh: 小镇生活单调得令人窒息,毫无悬念。

stumble.t:
v. 绊倒；磕磕绊绊地走
v. 偶然发现 (upon)

e.en: Be careful not to {stumble} on the loose carpet.
e.zh: 小心别被松动的地毯绊倒。

e.en: I sometimes {stumble} over difficult words while reading aloud.
e.zh: 朗读时我有时会在生词上结巴。

e.en: She {stumbled} on a rare book at the flea market.
e.zh: 她在跳蚤市场偶然发现了一本珍本书。

e.en: He {stumbled} over the cable and almost fell.
e.zh: 他被电缆绊了一下,差点摔倒。

stumbles.t:
v. 绊倒 (第三人称单数)
n. 绊脚

e.en: Even an expert occasionally {stumbles} during a live demo.
e.zh: 即使是专家在现场演示时偶尔也会出错。

e.en: The toddler {stumbles} but quickly gets back up.
e.zh: 小孩子摔了一下,但很快又爬起来。

stumbling.t:
adj. 绊脚的；结巴的
v. 绊 (进行时)

e.en: Cost remains the main {stumbling} block to wider adoption.
e.zh: 成本仍是更广泛普及的主要绊脚石。

e.en: He kept {stumbling} through his speech from nervousness.
e.zh: 他紧张得演讲时频频结巴。

stump.t:
n. 树桩；残肢
v. 难住；使困惑

e.en: We sat on a tree {stump} to rest.
e.zh: 我们坐在一截树桩上休息。

e.en: That riddle continues to {stump} even the smartest students.
e.zh: 那个谜语连最聪明的学生都难住了。

e.en: The logging company paid {stumpage} fees to harvest the timber.
e.zh: 伐木公司支付了立木采伐费来砍伐这些木材。

e.en: Rising {stumpage} prices have hurt small lumber mills.
e.zh: 立木价格上涨打击了小型木材厂。

e.en: The detective was completely {stumped} by the missing evidence.
e.zh: 那位侦探被丢失的证据彻底难住了。

e.en: Even the math teacher was {stumped} by the puzzle.
e.zh: 连数学老师都被这道谜题难倒了。

stumper.t: n. 难题；难倒人的问题

e.en: That trivia question turned out to be a real {stumper}.
e.zh: 那道冷知识题真是个让人犯难的难题。

e.en: The interviewer asked a {stumper} about quantum mechanics.
e.zh: 面试官问了一道关于量子力学的难题。

stumping.t: v. 巡回演说拉票；难住 (进行时)

e.en: The senator is {stumping} across Iowa for votes.
e.zh: 那位参议员正在爱荷华州各地巡回拉票。

e.en: This crossword clue is really {stumping} me today.
e.zh: 今天这道填字游戏的提示真把我难住了。

e.en: The bulldog wagged its short, {stumpy} tail happily.
e.zh: 那只斗牛犬开心地摇着它短粗的小尾巴。

e.en: He had {stumpy} fingers but played piano beautifully.
e.zh: 他手指短粗,但钢琴弹得很优美。

e.en: The plot twist will {stun} every viewer at home.
e.zh: 这个剧情反转会让每个观众都目瞪口呆。

e.en: Police used a {stun} gun to subdue the suspect.
e.zh: 警察用电击枪制服了嫌疑人。

e.en: She {stuned} the audience with her unexpected piano performance.
e.zh: 她用一场意外的钢琴表演震撼了全场观众。

e.en: He looked {stuned} when he heard the surprising news.
e.zh: 听到这个惊人消息时,他看起来呆住了。

e.en: The sunset over the ocean was absolutely {stuning} tonight.
e.zh: 今晚海面上的日落美得令人惊叹。

e.en: She wore a {stuning} red dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一件惊艳的红裙子出席晚会。

stunk.t: v. 发臭 (stink 的过去分词)

e.en: The garbage had {stunk} up the entire kitchen overnight.
e.zh: 垃圾一夜之间把整个厨房熏得臭气熏天。

e.en: His first attempt at cooking really {stunk}, honestly.
e.zh: 说实话,他第一次做饭做得真糟糕。

stunned.t: adj. 震惊的；目瞪口呆的

e.en: Fans were {stunned} by the singer's surprise retirement announcement.
e.zh: 歌迷们对这位歌手突然宣布退休感到震惊。

e.en: The bright camera flash {stunned} her for a second.
e.zh: 相机的强闪光灯让她愣了一下。

stunner.t: n. 极出众的人或物；美人

e.en: That last-minute goal was an absolute {stunner}.
e.zh: 最后一刻的那个进球真是惊艳。

e.en: The new actress is a real {stunner} on screen.
e.zh: 这位新演员在银幕上美得让人惊艳。

stunning.t: adj. 极美的；令人震惊的

e.en: The view from the hotel balcony is absolutely {stunning}.
e.zh: 从酒店阳台看出去的景色美得惊人。

e.en: She delivered a {stunning} upset victory in the finals.
e.zh: 她在决赛中爆冷夺冠,令人震惊。

e.en: The new phone is {stunningly} fast compared to older models.
e.zh: 这款新手机比旧款快得令人惊叹。

e.en: She looked {stunningly} beautiful in the wedding photos.
e.zh: 她在婚礼照片里美得惊艳。

stuns.t: v. 使震惊；使昏迷（stun 的三单）

e.en: His performance always {stuns} first-time concert audiences.
e.zh: 他的表演总是让初次听音乐会的观众惊叹不已。

e.en: The taser briefly {stuns} an attacker without causing injury.
e.zh: 电击枪能短暂使袭击者瘫软而不造成伤害。

stunt.t:
n. 特技；噱头
v. 阻碍发育

e.en: The actor performed every dangerous {stunt} without a double.
e.zh: 那位演员所有危险特技都亲自上阵,没用替身。

e.en: Lack of sunlight will {stunt} the plant's growth.
e.zh: 缺乏阳光会阻碍植物的生长。

stunted.t: adj. 发育不良的；受阻的

e.en: Poor nutrition has {stunted} growth in many rural children.
e.zh: 营养不良影响了许多农村儿童的发育。

e.en: Bonsai trees are deliberately {stunted} for aesthetic reasons.
e.zh: 盆栽树木出于美学考虑被故意限制生长。

e.en: A {stuntman} performed the dangerous car chase scene.
e.zh: 那段危险的飞车追逐戏由特技演员完成。

e.en: He worked as a Hollywood {stuntman} for twenty years.
e.zh: 他在好莱坞当了二十年特技演员。

e.en: Pilgrims walked clockwise around the ancient {stupa}.
e.zh: 朝圣者顺时针绕着古老的佛塔行走。

e.en: The white {stupa} on the hill is centuries old.
e.zh: 山上那座白色佛塔有数百年历史。

e.en: She stared at the news in complete {stupefaction}.
e.zh: 她目瞪口呆地盯着那条新闻。

e.en: His {stupefaction} showed when he heard the verdict.
e.zh: 听到判决时,他显得目瞪口呆。

e.en: The audience sat {stupefied} after the shocking ending.
e.zh: 震撼的结局让观众们呆坐在那里。

e.en: Heat and exhaustion {stupefied} the hikers by noon.
e.zh: 高温和疲惫到中午时让徒步者们昏昏沉沉。

e.en: The magician's tricks never fail to {stupefy} the children.
e.zh: 魔术师的把戏总能让孩子们目瞪口呆。

e.en: Loud music can {stupefy} you after a long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后,大声的音乐会让你晕头转向。

stupefying.t: adj. 令人发愣的；令人震惊的

e.en: The view from the cliff was absolutely {stupefying}.
e.zh: 从悬崖上看到的景色令人惊叹不已。

e.en: He gave a {stupefying} answer that left everyone speechless.
e.zh: 他给出的答案令人瞠目结舌。

stupefyingly.t: adv. 惊人地；令人发愣地

e.en: The new phone is {stupefyingly} expensive this year.
e.zh: 今年的新手机贵得离谱。

e.en: Her debut novel was {stupefyingly} good for a beginner.
e.zh: 作为新人,她的处女作好得令人惊叹。

e.en: The team made a {stupendous} comeback in the final minute.
e.zh: 球队在最后一分钟完成了惊人的逆转。

e.en: They built a {stupendous} tower overlooking the harbor.
e.zh: 他们建造了一座俯瞰港口的宏伟高塔。

e.en: The startup grew {stupendously} fast in its first year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司第一年发展得惊人地快。

e.en: His latest film was {stupendously} successful at the box office.
e.zh: 他的新片在票房上取得了惊人的成功。

e.en: That was a {stupid} mistake to make on the test.
e.zh: 在考试中犯这种错误真是太蠢了。

e.en: Don't ask {stupid} questions during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时别问愚蠢的问题。

stupidest.t: adj. 最蠢的（stupid 最高级）

e.en: That was the {stupidest} idea I've ever heard.
e.zh: 那是我听过最愚蠢的主意。

e.en: Buying crypto with rent money was his {stupidest} move.
e.zh: 用房租钱去买加密货币是他最蠢的举动。

e.en: I can't believe the {stupidity} of his latest decision.
e.zh: 我真不敢相信他最近的决定有多愚蠢。

e.en: Sheer {stupidity} caused the company to lose millions.
e.zh: 纯粹的愚蠢让公司损失了数百万。

e.en: I {stupidly} left my passport in the hotel room.
e.zh: 我蠢到把护照落在酒店房间里了。

e.en: He grinned {stupidly} when she said hello.
e.zh: 她打招呼时,他傻乎乎地咧嘴笑了。

e.en: He sat in a drunken {stupor} on the couch.
e.zh: 他醉醺醺地瘫坐在沙发上。

e.en: The fever left her in a {stupor} for days.
e.zh: 高烧让她昏昏沉沉了好几天。

e.en: The patient was {stuporous} after the heavy sedation.
e.zh: 病人在大剂量镇静后陷入了昏迷状态。

e.en: He gave a {stuporous} nod and fell back asleep.
e.zh: 他迷迷糊糊地点了点头,又睡着了。

e.en: The shelves are {sturdily} built and hold heavy books.
e.zh: 这些书架做得很结实,能放重书。

e.en: She walked {sturdily} up the steep mountain trail.
e.zh: 她稳健地走上陡峭的山路。

e.en: I love the {sturdiness} of this old wooden table.
e.zh: 我喜欢这张旧木桌的结实感。

e.en: The boots are praised for their {sturdiness} and comfort.
e.zh: 这款靴子因其结实耐用和舒适而广受好评。

e.en: You need a {sturdy} pair of boots for hiking.
e.zh: 徒步旅行你需要一双结实的靴子。

e.en: The bridge looks old but is still very {sturdy}.
e.zh: 这座桥虽然旧了,但仍然非常牢固。

e.en: Caviar comes from the eggs of the {sturgeon}.
e.zh: 鱼子酱是从鲟鱼的卵中提取的。

e.en: Fishermen caught a huge {sturgeon} in the river yesterday.
e.zh: 渔民昨天在河里捕到了一条巨大的鲟鱼。

stutter.t:
v. 口吃；结巴地说
n. 口吃

e.en: He began to {stutter} when the teacher called on him.
e.zh: 老师点到他时,他开始结巴起来。

e.en: The engine gave a {stutter} before finally starting.
e.zh: 发动机抖动了一下才终于启动。

e.en: As a child, he was a severe {stutterer}.
e.zh: 小时候,他口吃得很严重。

e.en: The {stutterer} found speaking in public extremely stressful.
e.zh: 这位口吃者觉得当众讲话压力很大。

stuttering.t:
n. 口吃
adj. 结巴的

e.en: Speech therapy helped reduce his {stuttering} significantly.
e.zh: 语言治疗显著缓解了他的口吃。

e.en: The {stuttering} engine finally died on the highway.
e.zh: 那台一直抖动的发动机终于在高速公路上熄火了。

stuttgart.t: n. 斯图加特（德国城市）

e.en: Mercedes-Benz has its headquarters in {Stuttgart}, Germany.
e.zh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰的总部位于德国斯图加特。

e.en: We took a fast train from Munich to {Stuttgart}.
e.zh: 我们坐高铁从慕尼黑到了斯图加特。

stv.t: n. 苏格兰电视台（缩写）

e.en: The cave was filled with a {stygian} darkness.
e.zh: 洞穴里弥漫着一片地狱般的黑暗。

e.en: They descended into the {stygian} gloom of the basement.
e.zh: 他们走入地下室那阴森幽暗之中。

style.t:
n. 风格；样式
v. 设计；命名

e.en: I really love the {style} of her writing.
e.zh: 我真的很喜欢她的写作风格。

e.en: That jacket is totally out of {style} now.
e.zh: 那件外套现在已经完全过时了。

stylebook.t: n. 文体手册；样式指南

e.en: Reporters follow the AP {stylebook} for consistency.
e.zh: 记者们遵循美联社风格手册以保持一致性。

e.en: Our company has its own internal {stylebook} for emails.
e.zh: 我们公司有自己内部的电子邮件风格手册。

styled.t:
adj. 设计成…的
v. style 的过去式

e.en: Her hair was {styled} into a messy bun.
e.zh: 她的头发被弄成了一个随意的丸子头。

e.en: The website is {styled} with a clean, modern look.
e.zh: 这个网站设计得简洁现代。

e.en: This new hair {styler} works on both wet and dry hair.
e.zh: 这款新的造型器干湿两用都好使。

e.en: She's a talented {styler} who works with celebrities.
e.zh: 她是一位为明星服务的天才造型师。

styles.t:
n. 风格（复数）
v. 设计（三单）

e.en: This shop sells shoes in many different {styles}.
e.zh: 这家店卖各种不同款式的鞋子。

e.en: He {styles} his hair the same way every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上都把头发弄成同一个样子。

e.en: The {styling} of the new car is very sleek.
e.zh: 新车的造型设计非常流畅。

e.en: I'm {styling} my hair differently for the wedding.
e.zh: 我打算为婚礼换一个不同的发型。

stylise.t: v. 使程式化；风格化（英式拼写）

e.en: Designers often {stylise} animal shapes for children's logos.
e.zh: 设计师常把动物形象风格化用于儿童品牌标志。

e.en: The artist tends to {stylise} her portraits dramatically.
e.zh: 这位艺术家倾向于把肖像画得非常风格化。

stylised.t: adj. 风格化的；程式化的

e.en: The logo features a {stylised} image of a bird.
e.zh: 这个标志的特色是一只风格化的鸟形图案。

e.en: Japanese theater uses highly {stylised} movements and gestures.
e.zh: 日本戏剧采用高度程式化的动作和手势。

e.en: She always wears such {stylish} outfits to work.
e.zh: 她上班总是穿得很时髦。

e.en: The new café has a really {stylish} interior.
e.zh: 那家新咖啡馆的内部装修非常时尚。

e.en: He dresses {stylishly} even on casual weekends.
e.zh: 即使在休闲的周末,他也穿得很时髦。

e.en: The apartment was {stylishly} decorated with mid-century furniture.
e.zh: 公寓用世纪中期的家具装饰得很有格调。

e.en: Her outfit had a quiet {stylishness} that turned heads.
e.zh: 她的穿搭有种低调的时髦感,让人忍不住回头看。

e.en: The brand is famous for its understated {stylishness}.
e.zh: 这个品牌以其低调的时尚感而闻名。

e.en: I made an appointment with my {stylist} for Saturday.
e.zh: 我和我的造型师约了周六见面。

e.en: A celebrity {stylist} chose her dress for the awards.
e.zh: 一位明星造型师为她选了颁奖典礼的礼服。

e.en: The novel has many {stylistic} similarities to her earlier work.
e.zh: 这部小说在风格上与她早期作品有许多相似之处。

e.en: Critics praised the film's bold {stylistic} choices.
e.zh: 评论家赞扬了这部电影大胆的风格选择。

e.en: The two albums are {stylistically} very different.
e.zh: 这两张专辑在风格上非常不同。

e.en: Her paintings are {stylistically} influenced by Picasso.
e.zh: 她的画作在风格上受到毕加索的影响。

e.en: She studies {stylistics} in the linguistics department.
e.zh: 她在语言学系研究文体学。

e.en: The course covers basic {stylistics} of modern poetry.
e.zh: 这门课涵盖现代诗歌的基本文体学。

subduction.t: n. (地质) 板块俯冲作用

e.en: The Pacific Ring of Fire is shaped by {subduction} zones.
e.zh: 环太平洋火山带是由俯冲带塑造的。

e.en: {Subduction} of the ocean plate triggered the massive earthquake.
e.zh: 海洋板块的俯冲引发了那次大地震。

subdue.t:
v. 制服，征服
v. 减弱，缓和

e.en: Police struggled to {subdue} the angry crowd peacefully.
e.zh: 警方努力想和平地制服愤怒的人群。

e.en: Soft lighting can {subdue} the harshness of a room.
e.zh: 柔和的灯光可以让房间不那么生硬。

subdued.t:
adj. 压抑的，柔和的
adj. 被征服的

e.en: The room had a {subdued} atmosphere after the bad news.
e.zh: 听到坏消息后,房间里气氛变得沉闷。

e.en: She wore a {subdued} gray dress to the meeting.
e.zh: 她穿了一条素雅的灰色连衣裙去开会。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with a {subdural} hematoma after the fall.
e.zh: 摔倒后,病人被诊断为硬膜下血肿。

e.en: A {subdural} bleed can develop slowly after a head injury.
e.zh: 硬膜下出血可能在头部受伤后缓慢出现。

subfamily.t:
n. (生物) 亚科
n. 子家族

e.en: Lions and tigers belong to the same {subfamily} of cats.
e.zh: 狮子和老虎属于猫科中的同一个亚科。

e.en: Botanists recently reclassified the plant into a different {subfamily}.
e.zh: 植物学家最近把这种植物重新归入了另一个亚科。

e.en: Machine learning is a fast-growing {subfield} of computer science.
e.zh: 机器学习是计算机科学中一个快速发展的分支领域。

e.en: She built her career in a niche {subfield} of economics.
e.zh: 她在经济学的一个小众分支领域里建立了自己的事业。

e.en: We had to replace the rotted {subfloor} before laying tile.
e.zh: 我们得先换掉腐烂的底层地板,才能铺瓷砖。

e.en: Plywood is commonly used as a {subfloor} in modern homes.
e.zh: 现代家庭常用胶合板作为底层地板。

e.en: Cyberpunk is a popular {subgenre} of science fiction.
e.zh: 赛博朋克是科幻小说中很受欢迎的一个子类型。

e.en: The band defined a whole new {subgenre} of metal.
e.zh: 这支乐队开创了金属乐中一个全新的子类型。

e.en: The doctor noted swelling in the {subglottic} airway.
e.zh: 医生注意到声门下气道有肿胀。

e.en: {Subglottic} stenosis can make breathing very difficult.
e.zh: 声门下狭窄会让呼吸变得非常困难。

subgroup.t:
n. 子群，小组
n. (数) 子群

e.en: One {subgroup} of patients responded much better to the drug.
e.zh: 其中一个亚组的病人对药物反应明显更好。

e.en: The team split into a smaller {subgroup} for brainstorming.
e.zh: 团队分成了一个更小的小组进行头脑风暴。

e.en: Add a clear {subhead} to break up that long paragraph.
e.zh: 加一个清晰的小标题,把那段长文字分开。

e.en: The article's {subhead} hinted at a surprising twist.
e.zh: 文章的副标题暗示了一个意想不到的转折。

e.en: Each section starts with a bold {subheading} for easy scanning.
e.zh: 每个部分都以加粗的小标题开头,方便快速浏览。

e.en: Use a descriptive {subheading} to guide readers through the page.
e.zh: 用一个描述性的小标题来引导读者浏览页面。

subhuman.t: adj. 低于人类的，未开化的

e.en: The propaganda cruelly depicted the enemy as {subhuman}.
e.zh: 那种宣传残忍地把敌人描绘成低于人类的存在。

e.en: Workers complained about the {subhuman} living conditions in the camps.
e.zh: 工人们抱怨营地里非人的生活条件。

subject.t:
n. 主题；学科；对象
v. 使遭受

e.en: Math was always my favorite {subject} in school.
e.zh: 数学一直是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

e.en: Please change the email {subject} before forwarding it.
e.zh: 请在转发前修改邮件的主题。

subjected.t: v. 使经受，使遭受 (subject 的过去式)

e.en: The new battery was {subjected} to extreme temperature tests.
e.zh: 新电池经受了极端温度的测试。

e.en: He was {subjected} to constant criticism from his manager.
e.zh: 他不断受到经理的批评。

e.en: The novel describes the {subjection} of an entire population.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了整个民族被征服奴役的过程。

e.en: Their long {subjection} to harsh rule finally sparked revolt.
e.zh: 他们长期处于严酷统治之下,终于爆发了反抗。

e.en: Beauty is highly {subjective} and varies across cultures.
e.zh: 美是非常主观的,在不同文化中各有不同。

e.en: The reviewer admitted his rating was purely {subjective}.
e.zh: 那位评审承认他的评分纯属主观。

e.en: Pain is experienced {subjectively} by every patient.
e.zh: 每个病人对疼痛的感受都是主观的。

e.en: The judges scored the dance routines {subjectively}.
e.zh: 评委对舞蹈表演的打分带有主观成分。

e.en: Critics accused the philosopher of pure {subjectivism} in his ethics.
e.zh: 批评者指责这位哲学家的伦理学纯属主观主义。

e.en: Modern art often embraces {subjectivism} over objective realism.
e.zh: 现代艺术常常拥抱主观主义而非客观写实。

e.en: He took a {subjectivist} approach to evaluating beauty.
e.zh: 他以主观主义的视角来评判美。

e.en: The {subjectivist} argues that morality depends on personal feelings.
e.zh: 主观主义者认为道德取决于个人感受。

e.en: Reviewers should acknowledge their own {subjectivity} when rating films.
e.zh: 影评人在打分时应承认自己的主观性。

e.en: Good journalism aims to limit {subjectivity} in reporting.
e.zh: 优秀的新闻业力求减少报道中的主观性。

subjects.t:
n. 主题/学科 (复数)
v. 使遭受 (第三人称)

e.en: Math and science are her favorite {subjects} at school.
e.zh: 数学和科学是她在学校最喜欢的科目。

e.en: The study recruited 200 {subjects} for the sleep experiment.
e.zh: 该研究招募了200名受试者参加睡眠实验。

e.en: The empire tried to {subjugate} neighboring tribes through war.
e.zh: 该帝国试图通过战争征服邻近的部落。

e.en: She refused to let fear {subjugate} her ambitions.
e.zh: 她拒绝让恐惧压制自己的雄心。

subjugated.t: v. 已征服 (subjugate 的过去式)

e.en: The conquered people were {subjugated} for nearly a century.
e.zh: 被征服的民族遭奴役了将近一个世纪。

e.en: He felt {subjugated} by his demanding boss.
e.zh: 他觉得自己被苛刻的老板压得抬不起头。

e.en: The novel describes the {subjugation} of women in that era.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了那个时代女性所受的压迫。

e.en: Colonial {subjugation} left deep scars on the country.
e.zh: 殖民统治给这个国家留下了深深的伤痕。

e.en: Spanish learners often struggle with the {subjunctive} mood.
e.zh: 西班牙语学习者常常对虚拟语气感到吃力。

e.en: "If I were rich" uses the {subjunctive} form.
e.zh: "If I were rich"使用的是虚拟语气形式。

e.en: French grammar books list dozens of {subjunctives} to memorize.
e.zh: 法语语法书列出了几十种需要记忆的虚拟语气形式。

e.en: English uses {subjunctives} less often than Romance languages.
e.zh: 英语使用虚拟语气的频率低于罗曼语族。

e.en: She decided to {sublease} her apartment while studying abroad.
e.zh: 她决定在出国留学期间把公寓转租出去。

e.en: The {sublease} agreement requires the landlord's written approval.
e.zh: 该转租协议需要房东的书面同意。

e.en: I'm trying to {sublet} my room for the summer.
e.zh: 我打算把我的房间夏天转租出去。

e.en: He found a cheap {sublet} near campus on Craigslist.
e.zh: 他在Craigslist上找到了校园附近便宜的转租房。

e.en: Athletes often {sublimate} stress into intense training.
e.zh: 运动员常常把压力转化为高强度的训练。

e.en: Dry ice can {sublimate} directly into gas at room temperature.
e.zh: 干冰在常温下可以直接升华成气体。

sublimated.t: v. 已升华 (sublimate 过去式)

e.en: He {sublimated} his anger into creative writing.
e.zh: 他把愤怒升华成了创作的动力。

e.en: The frozen sample {sublimated} overnight in the vacuum chamber.
e.zh: 冷冻样品在真空舱中过夜升华了。

e.en: Freeze-drying relies on the {sublimation} of ice into vapor.
e.zh: 冷冻干燥依赖于冰直接升华成水蒸气。

e.en: Freud described art as the {sublimation} of unconscious desires.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德将艺术描述为潜意识欲望的升华。

e.en: The view from the mountaintop was absolutely {sublime}.
e.zh: 山顶上的景色简直美得令人惊叹。

e.en: She baked a {sublime} chocolate cake for the party.
e.zh: 她为聚会烤了一个绝妙的巧克力蛋糕。

e.en: The orchestra played the symphony {sublimely}.
e.zh: 乐团把这部交响曲演奏得美妙绝伦。

e.en: He seemed {sublimely} unaware of the chaos around him.
e.zh: 他对周围的混乱似乎浑然不觉。

e.en: Advertisers sometimes use {subliminal} cues to influence buyers.
e.zh: 广告商有时使用潜意识暗示来影响消费者。

e.en: The film contained a {subliminal} message about freedom.
e.zh: 这部电影中含有关于自由的潜意识信息。

e.en: The jingle {subliminally} reminds shoppers of the brand.
e.zh: 这段广告曲在潜意识里让顾客想起这个品牌。

e.en: Colors can {subliminally} affect how we feel in a room.
e.zh: 颜色会在潜意识层面影响我们在房间中的感受。

e.en: Romantic poets celebrated the {sublimity} of nature.
e.zh: 浪漫主义诗人歌颂大自然的崇高之美。

e.en: There is a quiet {sublimity} to her late paintings.
e.zh: 她晚期的画作中蕴含着一种静谧的崇高感。

e.en: Place the {sublingual} tablet under your tongue until it dissolves.
e.zh: 将舌下含片放在舌头下面直至溶解。

e.en: {Sublingual} vitamin B12 absorbs faster than the swallowed kind.
e.zh: 舌下含服的维生素B12比吞服的吸收更快。

e.en: The chiropractor diagnosed a minor spinal {subluxation}.
e.zh: 脊椎按摩师诊断出轻微的脊椎半脱位。

e.en: Shoulder {subluxation} is common after certain strokes.
e.zh: 某些中风后肩关节半脱位很常见。

submachine.t: adj. 冲锋枪的 (常用 submachine gun)

e.en: The soldiers carried compact {submachine} guns on patrol.
e.zh: 士兵们巡逻时携带着小型冲锋枪。

e.en: Police rarely deploy {submachine} weapons in routine arrests.
e.zh: 警方在常规抓捕中很少动用冲锋枪。

e.en: The dentist felt swollen {submandibular} glands during the exam.
e.zh: 牙医在检查时摸到了肿大的下颌下腺。

e.en: Saliva flows from the {submandibular} duct into the mouth.
e.zh: 唾液经下颌下腺导管流入口腔。

submarine.t:
n. 潜水艇
adj. 海底的

e.en: The {submarine} stayed underwater for three months straight.
e.zh: 这艘潜艇连续在水下航行了三个月。

e.en: He ordered a turkey {submarine} sandwich for lunch.
e.zh: 他午餐点了一个火鸡潜艇堡。

e.en: Her grandfather served as a {submariner} during the war.
e.zh: 她的祖父在战时是一名潜艇兵。

e.en: Every {submariner} undergoes intense psychological screening.
e.zh: 每位潜艇兵都要接受严格的心理筛查。

e.en: Modern nuclear {submarines} can stay submerged for months.
e.zh: 现代核潜艇可以在水下潜伏数月之久。

e.en: The deli's hot {submarines} are popular at lunchtime.
e.zh: 这家熟食店的热潜艇堡在午餐时间很受欢迎。

e.en: Extract the upper-left {submatrix} for the calculation.
e.zh: 提取左上角的子矩阵用于计算。

e.en: Each {submatrix} represents a different region of pixels.
e.zh: 每个子矩阵代表一片不同的像素区域。

submaximal.t: adj. 次最大的，亚极量的

e.en: Beginners should start with {submaximal} weights to avoid injury.
e.zh: 初学者应从次最大重量开始,以免受伤。

e.en: The treadmill test uses {submaximal} effort to assess fitness.
e.zh: 该跑步机测试通过次最大强度来评估体能。

submenu.t: n. 子菜单，下拉子选项

e.en: Hover over Settings to open the {submenu}.
e.zh: 将鼠标悬停在"设置"上即可打开子菜单。

e.en: You'll find export options in the File {submenu}.
e.zh: 导出选项在"文件"子菜单中可以找到。

submerge.t:
v. 浸没，淹没
v. 潜入水下

e.en: Slowly {submerge} the eggs in cold water before boiling.
e.zh: 煮之前先把鸡蛋慢慢浸入冷水中。

e.en: The flood threatened to {submerge} the entire village.
e.zh: 洪水眼看就要淹没整个村庄。

e.en: The car was completely {submerged} after the heavy rain.
e.zh: 暴雨过后那辆车完全被水淹没了。

e.en: She felt {submerged} by emails after returning from vacation.
e.zh: 度假回来后她感觉被邮件淹没了。

e.en: Coastal {submergence} threatens many low-lying island nations.
e.zh: 海岸沉降威胁着许多低洼的岛国。

e.en: The crew tested the sub's maximum {submergence} depth.
e.zh: 船员测试了潜艇的最大下潜深度。

e.en: Top {stylists} prepared the models before the runway show.
e.zh: 顶级造型师在走秀前为模特做造型。

e.en: The salon hired three new {stylists} this month.
e.zh: 这家沙龙这个月新聘了三位造型师。

stylization.t: n. 风格化；程式化处理

e.en: The painting shows a clear {stylization} of natural forms.
e.zh: 这幅画对自然形态进行了明显的风格化处理。

e.en: Anime is known for its dramatic {stylization} of characters.
e.zh: 动漫以对人物的夸张风格化处理而著称。

stylize.t: v. 使风格化；程式化表现

e.en: Cartoonists often {stylize} faces to make them expressive.
e.zh: 漫画家常把人脸风格化以增强表现力。

e.en: The director chose to {stylize} the fight scenes heavily.
e.zh: 导演选择对打斗场面进行高度风格化处理。

stylized.t: adj. 风格化的；程式化的

e.en: The app icon uses a {stylized} version of a leaf.
e.zh: 该应用图标使用了风格化的叶子图案。

e.en: Her dance moves are highly {stylized} and elegant.
e.zh: 她的舞蹈动作高度风格化且优雅。

e.en: The doctor examined the {styloid} process of his wrist bone.
e.zh: 医生检查了他腕骨的茎突。

e.en: A fractured {styloid} can cause significant wrist pain.
e.zh: 茎突骨折会引起严重的腕部疼痛。

e.en: I prefer drawing on the tablet with a {stylus}.
e.zh: 我更喜欢用触控笔在平板上画画。

e.en: The record player needs a new {stylus} to sound right.
e.zh: 这台唱片机需要换个新唱针才能放出好声音。

e.en: Bad weather will {stymie} our plans for the picnic.
e.zh: 坏天气会让我们的野餐计划泡汤。

e.en: Budget cuts continue to {stymie} the research team.
e.zh: 预算削减一直在阻碍研究团队的工作。

stymied.t: adj. 受阻的；陷入僵局的

e.en: The detective was {stymied} by the lack of evidence.
e.zh: 侦探因为缺乏证据而陷入困境。

e.en: Heavy traffic {stymied} our attempts to reach the airport.
e.zh: 严重的交通拥堵让我们去机场的努力受阻。

e.en: Strict regulations can {stymy} small business growth.
e.zh: 严格的法规可能会阻碍小企业的发展。

e.en: Don't let small setbacks {stymy} your long-term goals.
e.zh: 别让小挫折阻挡你的长期目标。

e.en: Polystyrene foam is made by polymerizing liquid {styrene}.
e.zh: 聚苯乙烯泡沫是由液态苯乙烯聚合而成的。

e.en: Workers must avoid prolonged exposure to {styrene} fumes.
e.zh: 工人必须避免长时间接触苯乙烯气体。

e.en: Many cafes are replacing {styrofoam} cups with paper ones.
e.zh: 许多咖啡店正用纸杯替换泡沫塑料杯。

e.en: The fragile vase was packed in {styrofoam} peanuts.
e.zh: 那只易碎的花瓶用泡沫颗粒包了起来。

e.en: In Greek myth, souls cross the river {Styx} after death.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,亡魂死后要渡过冥河斯堤克斯。

e.en: The poet compared the dark river to the {Styx}.
e.zh: 诗人把那条幽暗的河比作冥河斯堤克斯。

e.en: The central bank relied on moral {suasion} to calm markets.
e.zh: 央行靠道义劝说来稳定市场。

e.en: Gentle {suasion} worked better than threats with the children.
e.zh: 对孩子们而言,温和的劝导比威胁更有效。

suave.t: adj. 温文尔雅的；圆滑的

e.en: The {suave} diplomat charmed everyone at the embassy reception.
e.zh: 那位温文尔雅的外交官在大使馆招待会上迷倒了所有人。

e.en: He gave a {suave} reply that defused the tension.
e.zh: 他圆滑地回了一句,化解了紧张气氛。

suavely.t: adv. 温文尔雅地；圆滑地

e.en: The host {suavely} introduced each guest to the audience.
e.zh: 主持人从容优雅地把每位嘉宾介绍给观众。

e.en: He {suavely} ordered wine for the entire table.
e.zh: 他风度翩翩地为全桌点了葡萄酒。

sub.t:
n. 替补；潜艇
v. 替代（substitute 的缩写）

e.en: The {subaltern} saluted the colonel and reported for duty.
e.zh: 那位下级军官向上校敬礼并报到。

e.en: Her research focuses on {subaltern} voices in colonial history.
e.zh: 她的研究关注殖民历史中底层群体的声音。

e.en: Doctors detected a {subarachnoid} hemorrhage on the brain scan.
e.zh: 医生在脑部扫描中发现了蛛网膜下腔出血。

e.en: The {subarachnoid} space contains cerebrospinal fluid that cushions the brain.
e.zh: 蛛网膜下腔含有保护大脑的脑脊液。

subarctic.t: adj. 亚北极的；近北极圈的

e.en: Reindeer roam freely across the {subarctic} tundra in summer.
e.zh: 夏天驯鹿在亚北极的苔原上自由游荡。

e.en: The town endures harsh {subarctic} winters every year.
e.zh: 这座小镇每年都要熬过严酷的亚北极冬天。

e.en: He drives a blue {Subaru} with all-wheel drive.
e.zh: 他开一辆蓝色的全轮驱动斯巴鲁。

e.en: My old {Subaru} handles snowy roads beautifully.
e.zh: 我那辆老斯巴鲁在雪路上跑得很稳。

e.en: Each {subassembly} is tested before joining the main production line.
e.zh: 每个分总成在进入主生产线前都要先测试。

e.en: The engine {subassembly} arrives pre-built from another factory.
e.zh: 发动机分总成由另一家工厂预先组装好后送来。

subatomic.t: adj. 亚原子的；比原子更小的

e.en: Physicists study {subatomic} particles using massive accelerators.
e.zh: 物理学家用巨型加速器研究亚原子粒子。

e.en: At the {subatomic} level, classical physics no longer applies.
e.zh: 在亚原子层面,经典物理学已不再适用。

e.en: Please file the report under the correct {subcategory}.
e.zh: 请把报告归到正确的子类别下。

e.en: Each product page lists every available {subcategory} on the left.
e.zh: 每个产品页面左侧都列出所有可选的子类别。

e.en: The book opens each {subchapter} with a short anecdote.
e.zh: 这本书每个小节开头都有一段简短的轶事。

e.en: Read the {subchapter} on tax exemptions before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前请先看一下关于免税的那一小节。

e.en: Create a {subclass} that overrides the default render method.
e.zh: 创建一个子类来重写默认的渲染方法。

e.en: Dolphins belong to a {subclass} of mammals called cetaceans.
e.zh: 海豚属于哺乳动物中一个叫鲸目的亚纲。

subclavian.t: adj. 锁骨下的（动脉、静脉）

e.en: The surgeon inserted a catheter into the {subclavian} vein.
e.zh: 外科医生将导管插入了锁骨下静脉。

e.en: Blood flow through the {subclavian} artery supplies the arm.
e.zh: 锁骨下动脉的血流为手臂供血。

subclinical.t: adj. 亚临床的；无症状的

e.en: Many people carry a {subclinical} infection without ever feeling sick.
e.zh: 许多人携带亚临床感染却从未感到不适。

e.en: Her thyroid issue remained {subclinical} for years.
e.zh: 她的甲状腺问题多年来一直处于亚临床状态。

subcommittee.t: n. 小组委员会；分委会

e.en: The {subcommittee} will draft new safety regulations next month.
e.zh: 小组委员会下个月将起草新的安全法规。

e.en: She chairs a {subcommittee} on digital privacy.
e.zh: 她担任一个数字隐私小组委员会的主席。

e.en: A {subcompact} car is perfect for crowded city streets.
e.zh: 小型车非常适合拥挤的城市街道。

e.en: Rental agencies often run out of {subcompact} models first.
e.zh: 租车公司的小型车款通常最先被租光。

subconscious.t:
n. 潜意识
adj. 下意识的

e.en: Dreams may reveal what your {subconscious} mind is processing.
e.zh: 梦境可能揭示你的潜意识正在处理什么。

e.en: Her fear of dogs is a {subconscious} reaction from childhood.
e.zh: 她对狗的恐惧是来自童年的潜意识反应。

subconsciously.t: adv. 下意识地；潜意识里

e.en: He {subconsciously} taps his foot when he's anxious.
e.zh: 他焦虑时会下意识地用脚打拍子。

e.en: We {subconsciously} mirror the body language of people we like.
e.zh: 我们会下意识地模仿喜欢的人的肢体动作。

subcontinent.t: n. 次大陆（如印度次大陆）

e.en: Cricket is hugely popular across the Indian {subcontinent}.
e.zh: 板球在印度次大陆非常流行。

e.en: Monsoon rains shape life on the {subcontinent} every summer.
e.zh: 季风雨每年夏天都影响着次大陆的生活。

e.en: The chef specializes in {subcontinental} cuisine and spices.
e.zh: 这位厨师专攻次大陆风味的菜肴和香料。

e.en: Researchers tracked {subcontinental} weather patterns for a decade.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了次大陆气候模式整整十年。

e.en: Geographers sometimes split Asia into several distinct {subcontinents}.
e.zh: 地理学家有时把亚洲划分成几个不同的次大陆。

e.en: Both {subcontinents} share a long colonial history.
e.zh: 这两个次大陆都有着漫长的殖民历史。

subcontract.t:
v. 分包；转包
n. 分包合同

e.en: We {subcontract} the cleaning work to a local company.
e.zh: 我们把清洁工作分包给一家本地公司。

e.en: The builder signed a {subcontract} for the electrical work.
e.zh: 承建商签了一份电气工程的分包合同。

e.en: The studio is {subcontracting} animation to overseas teams.
e.zh: 这家工作室正在把动画工作分包给海外团队。

e.en: {Subcontracting} can lower costs but raises quality concerns.
e.zh: 分包可以降低成本,但会带来质量隐患。

e.en: The {subcontractor} finished the plumbing two days early.
e.zh: 分包商提前两天完成了水管工程。

e.en: Hiring a reliable {subcontractor} keeps the project on schedule.
e.zh: 雇一个靠谱的分包商能让项目按计划推进。

e.en: Emotion processing relies heavily on {subcortical} brain structures.
e.zh: 情绪处理在很大程度上依赖于皮层下的脑结构。

e.en: The MRI revealed a small {subcortical} lesion.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示有一处小的皮层下病变。

subcritical.t: adj. 次临界的；亚临界的

e.en: The reactor was kept {subcritical} during routine maintenance.
e.zh: 反应堆在例行维护期间保持在次临界状态。

e.en: Engineers ran a {subcritical} test to verify safety margins.
e.zh: 工程师做了次临界测试以确认安全余量。

e.en: Skateboarding has its own rich {subcultural} traditions.
e.zh: 滑板有自己丰富的亚文化传统。

e.en: The film captures the {subcultural} energy of 1980s punk.
e.zh: 这部电影捕捉到了八十年代朋克的亚文化气息。

e.en: Tokyo's street fashion {subculture} fascinates designers worldwide.
e.zh: 东京街头时尚亚文化让全球设计师着迷。

e.en: Online gaming has spawned a thriving {subculture}.
e.zh: 网络游戏催生了一个蓬勃发展的亚文化。

e.en: The city is home to dozens of vibrant {subcultures}.
e.zh: 这座城市孕育了数十种充满活力的亚文化。

e.en: Music often defines and unites different {subcultures}.
e.zh: 音乐常常塑造并凝聚着不同的亚文化。

e.en: The nurse gave her a {subcutaneous} injection in the arm.
e.zh: 护士在她手臂上做了一次皮下注射。

e.en: {Subcutaneous} fat helps the body retain heat.
e.zh: 皮下脂肪有助于身体保持热量。

e.en: Forensic linguistics is a fascinating {subdiscipline} of language studies.
e.zh: 司法语言学是语言研究中一个引人入胜的子学科。

e.en: She specializes in a narrow {subdiscipline} of marine biology.
e.zh: 她专攻海洋生物学中一个细分的子学科。

e.en: Developers plan to {subdivide} the farmland into housing lots.
e.zh: 开发商打算把这片农田划分成住宅地块。

e.en: You can {subdivide} the project into smaller, manageable tasks.
e.zh: 你可以把这个项目细分成更小、更好管理的任务。

e.en: The estate was {subdivided} among the four siblings.
e.zh: 这处房产被分给了四个兄弟姐妹。

e.en: Our team {subdivided} the workload by feature area.
e.zh: 我们团队按功能模块细分了工作量。

e.en: They moved into a quiet {subdivision} outside the city.
e.zh: 他们搬进了城外一个安静的住宅小区。

e.en: Each department has its own internal {subdivision} of duties.
e.zh: 每个部门内部都有自己的职责划分。

e.en: The county contains several wealthy residential {subdivisions}.
e.zh: 该县内有好几个富裕的住宅小区。

e.en: The textbook breaks each chapter into clear {subdivisions}.
e.zh: 这本教科书把每一章都划分成清晰的小节。

e.en: Oceanic plates {subduct} beneath continental ones over millions of years.
e.zh: 海洋板块在数百万年间俯冲到大陆板块之下。

e.en: Where two plates meet, one may {subduct} into the mantle.
e.zh: 两个板块相遇时,其中一个可能俯冲进入地幔。

submersed.t: adj. 浸入水中的；淹没的

e.en: The plant's roots stay {submersed} in nutrient-rich water.
e.zh: 这种植物的根部一直浸没在富含养分的水中。

e.en: He {submersed} the film reel to wash off the chemicals.
e.zh: 他把胶卷浸入水中以洗去化学药剂。

submersible.t:
adj. 可潜水的
n. 潜水器

e.en: The {submersible} dove to record depths in the Pacific.
e.zh: 这艘潜水器在太平洋下潜到了创纪录的深度。

e.en: This pump is fully {submersible} and safe underwater.
e.zh: 这款水泵完全可潜入水中,水下使用安全。

e.en: Brief {submersion} in ice water reduces inflammation.
e.zh: 短暂浸入冰水中可以减轻炎症。

e.en: The diver trained for prolonged {submersion} in cold seas.
e.zh: 这名潜水员接受了在冷海中长时间下潜的训练。

submicroscopic.t: adj. 亚微观的；超显微的

e.en: Viruses are {submicroscopic} particles invisible to light microscopes.
e.zh: 病毒是光学显微镜看不见的亚微观颗粒。

e.en: Engineers studied {submicroscopic} cracks in the metal.
e.zh: 工程师们研究了金属中的亚微观裂纹。

submillimeter.t: adj. 亚毫米的（尺寸/波长）

e.en: The laser cuts with {submillimeter} precision.
e.zh: 这种激光的切割精度可达亚毫米级。

e.en: Astronomers used {submillimeter} telescopes to study cold dust clouds.
e.zh: 天文学家用亚毫米望远镜研究冷尘埃云。

submission.t:
n. 提交（的内容）；投稿
n. 顺从

e.en: The deadline for {submission} of applications is Friday.
e.zh: 申请提交的截止日期是周五。

e.en: The fighter forced his opponent into {submission}.
e.zh: 这名格斗选手迫使对手认输。

submissions.t: n. 提交的内容；投稿（复数）

e.en: The contest received over 500 {submissions} this year.
e.zh: 今年比赛收到了五百多份投稿。

e.en: Late {submissions} will not be graded.
e.zh: 逾期提交的作业将不予评分。

e.en: The dog rolled over in a {submissive} posture.
e.zh: 那只狗翻身露肚做出顺从的姿势。

e.en: She refused to play a {submissive} role in the relationship.
e.zh: 她拒绝在这段关系中扮演顺从的角色。

e.en: He nodded {submissively} and left the office without arguing.
e.zh: 他顺从地点点头,没有争辩就离开了办公室。

e.en: The puppy approached {submissively}, tail tucked low.
e.zh: 小狗顺从地走近,尾巴低低地夹着。

e.en: Her quiet {submissiveness} masked a fierce inner strength.
e.zh: 她安静的顺从外表下藏着坚强的内心。

e.en: The training discouraged {submissiveness} and built confidence.
e.zh: 这项训练摒弃顺从,着重培养自信。

submit.t:
v. 提交（表单、申请）
v. 屈服；服从

e.en: Please {submit} the form before midnight tomorrow.
e.zh: 请在明天午夜之前提交表格。

e.en: He refused to {submit} to unfair demands.
e.zh: 他拒绝屈服于不公正的要求。

submits.t: v. 提交（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {submits} a weekly report every Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 她每周五下午都会提交一份周报。

e.en: The system automatically {submits} your answers when time runs out.
e.zh: 时间一到,系统就会自动提交你的答案。

e.en: The contractor prepared a detailed {submittal} for the architect.
e.zh: 承包商为建筑师准备了一份详细的提交文件。

e.en: Each {submittal} must include drawings and material samples.
e.zh: 每份提交文件必须包含图纸和材料样品。

submitted.t: v. 已提交（submit 的过去式）

e.en: I just {submitted} my application to the graduate program.
e.zh: 我刚刚把研究生项目的申请提交了。

e.en: After hours of debate, he finally {submitted} to the plan.
e.zh: 经过几个小时的辩论,他最终屈服于这个方案。

submitting.t: v. 正在提交（submit 的现在分词）

e.en: Double-check your essay before {submitting} it online.
e.zh: 在线提交论文之前请仔细检查一遍。

e.en: She is {submitting} bug reports to the developers daily.
e.zh: 她每天都在向开发者提交错误报告。

subnational.t: adj. 次国家级的；地方性的

e.en: Many {subnational} governments set their own climate policies.
e.zh: 许多次国家级政府制定自己的气候政策。

e.en: The data is broken down by {subnational} regions and cities.
e.zh: 数据按次国家级地区和城市进行了细分。

subnormal.t: adj. 低于正常的；偏低的

e.en: The patient's body temperature was {subnormal} after the surgery.
e.zh: 患者术后体温低于正常值。

e.en: Sales were {subnormal} during the unusually rainy summer.
e.zh: 在异常多雨的夏季,销售低于正常水平。

subnotebook.t: n. 超便携笔记本电脑

e.en: He carries a tiny {subnotebook} for taking notes on the train.
e.zh: 他随身带着一台小型笔记本电脑在火车上做笔记。

e.en: The {subnotebook} weighs less than a kilogram.
e.zh: 这款迷你笔记本电脑重量不到一公斤。

suboptimal.t: adj. 次优的；未达最佳的

e.en: The current routing algorithm gives {suboptimal} results during peak hours.
e.zh: 当前的路由算法在高峰时段表现欠佳。

e.en: Sleeping only four hours leads to {suboptimal} performance at work.
e.zh: 只睡四小时会导致工作表现不理想。

e.en: The company launched a {suborbital} flight carrying six tourists.
e.zh: 该公司发射了一次载有六名游客的亚轨道飞行。

e.en: A {suborbital} rocket reaches space but does not circle Earth.
e.zh: 亚轨道火箭能到达太空,但不会环绕地球。

subordinate.t:
n. 下属
adj. 下级的；从属的

e.en: A good manager listens carefully to every {subordinate} on the team.
e.zh: 好的管理者会认真倾听团队里每一位下属。

e.en: Personal goals should not {subordinate} the needs of the project.
e.zh: 个人目标不应凌驾于项目需求之上。

subordinated.t: adj. 从属的；次级的（债务）

e.en: He {subordinated} his own ambitions to support his family.
e.zh: 他把个人抱负放在次要位置,以支持家庭。

e.en: The bank issued {subordinated} debt to strengthen its capital base.
e.zh: 该银行发行了次级债务以增强资本基础。

subordinates.t:
n. 下属（复数）
v. 使从属

e.en: She treats her {subordinates} with respect and patience.
e.zh: 她以尊重和耐心对待自己的下属。

e.en: A strong leader never publicly humiliates {subordinates} during meetings.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者绝不会在会议上公开羞辱下属。

e.en: Military discipline depends on the strict {subordination} of lower ranks.
e.zh: 军队纪律依赖于下级对上级的严格服从。

e.en: The contract specified the {subordination} of one loan to another.
e.zh: 合同规定了一笔贷款相对于另一笔的次级地位。

e.en: The lawyer was accused of trying to {suborn} a witness.
e.zh: 那位律师被指控试图唆使证人作伪证。

e.en: It is a serious crime to {suborn} perjury in federal court.
e.zh: 在联邦法庭教唆作伪证是严重罪行。

e.en: He was charged with {subornation} of perjury after the trial.
e.zh: 庭审后他被控教唆伪证罪。

e.en: {Subornation} of witnesses can lead to a mistrial being declared.
e.zh: 教唆证人作伪证可能导致审判被宣告无效。

e.en: Each {subpart} of the regulation addresses a different category of products.
e.zh: 该法规的每个分部分针对不同类别的产品。

e.en: Please refer to {subpart} B for the licensing requirements.
e.zh: 请参阅B分部以了解许可要求。

e.en: The surgeon performed a {subperiosteal} dissection along the jawbone.
e.zh: 外科医生沿下颌骨进行了骨膜下剥离。

e.en: X-rays revealed a {subperiosteal} hemorrhage near the fracture site.
e.zh: X光显示骨折部位附近有骨膜下出血。

subplot.t: n. 支线剧情；次要情节

e.en: The romantic {subplot} added warmth to an otherwise dark thriller.
e.zh: 爱情副线为这部本来阴暗的惊悚片增添了暖意。

e.en: A clever {subplot} can deepen the main story without distracting viewers.
e.zh: 巧妙的副线情节能深化主线,又不会分散观众注意力。

e.en: The novel weaves several {subplots} together by the final chapter.
e.zh: 小说在最后一章把多条副线巧妙地交织在一起。

e.en: Too many {subplots} can confuse readers and slow the pacing.
e.zh: 副线情节过多会让读者困惑,也会拖慢节奏。

subpoena.t:
n. 传票
v. 传唤出庭

e.en: The court issued a {subpoena} for the company's email records.
e.zh: 法院签发了传票,调取该公司的邮件记录。

e.en: Ignoring a {subpoena} can result in serious legal consequences.
e.zh: 无视传票可能带来严重的法律后果。

subpoenaed.t: v. 已传唤出庭（过去式）

e.en: Two former executives were {subpoenaed} to testify before Congress.
e.zh: 两名前高管被传唤到国会作证。

e.en: The journalist was {subpoenaed} for her notes on the source.
e.zh: 那位记者因其消息来源的笔记被传唤出庭。

e.en: The drug worked best in a small {subpopulation} of patients.
e.zh: 该药物在一小部分患者亚群中效果最佳。

e.en: Researchers identified a vulnerable {subpopulation} of urban songbirds.
e.zh: 研究人员识别出一种脆弱的城市鸣禽亚群。

e.en: The 2008 crisis began with risky {subprime} mortgage lending.
e.zh: 2008年的危机始于高风险的次级抵押贷款。

e.en: Banks tightened rules after billions were lost on {subprime} loans.
e.zh: 在次级贷款损失数十亿后,银行收紧了规则。

e.en: Southeast Asia is an important {subregion} for global trade.
e.zh: 东南亚是全球贸易中一个重要的次区域。

e.en: Each {subregion} has its own dialect and culinary traditions.
e.zh: 每个次区域都有自己的方言和饮食传统。

e.en: The summit focused on {subregional} cooperation in West Africa.
e.zh: 峰会聚焦于西非的次区域合作。

e.en: They held a {subregional} tournament before the national finals.
e.zh: 他们在全国决赛前举办了一场次区域比赛。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed a small {subretinal} hemorrhage in her left eye.
e.zh: 医生诊断她左眼有小范围视网膜下出血。

e.en: New gene therapies use {subretinal} injections to deliver treatment.
e.zh: 新型基因疗法通过视网膜下注射来输送药物。

e.en: This {subroutine} handles all the file-saving logic in the program.
e.zh: 这个子程序处理程序中所有的文件保存逻辑。

e.en: Refactor the loop into a reusable {subroutine} for clarity.
e.zh: 为了清晰,把这段循环重构成一个可复用的子程序。

e.en: We analyzed a random {subsample} of one thousand survey responses.
e.zh: 我们分析了一千份调查回复中的随机子样本。

e.en: The study used a {subsample} of teenagers from rural areas.
e.zh: 该研究使用了来自农村地区的青少年子样本。

e.en: The anxiety {subscale} showed the highest scores among college freshmen.
e.zh: 焦虑分量表在大一新生中得分最高。

e.en: Each {subscale} measures a distinct aspect of customer satisfaction.
e.zh: 每个分量表都测量客户满意度的不同方面。

e.en: Her reading {subscore} was much higher than her math result.
e.zh: 她的阅读分项得分比数学成绩高得多。

e.en: The report breaks the test into four separate {subscore} categories.
e.zh: 该报告将测试拆分为四个独立的分项得分类别。

subscribe.t:
v. 订阅（频道、服务）
v. 赞同

e.en: Click below to {subscribe} to our weekly newsletter.
e.zh: 点击下方订阅我们的每周通讯。

e.en: I don't {subscribe} to the idea that money buys happiness.
e.zh: 我并不认同金钱能买到幸福这种说法。

e.en: Every paying {subscriber} gets early access to new episodes.
e.zh: 每位付费订阅者都可提前观看新一集。

e.en: The channel gained a million {subscriber} milestone last week.
e.zh: 该频道上周达到了百万订阅者的里程碑。

e.en: The streaming service lost two million {subscribers} this quarter.
e.zh: 该流媒体服务本季度流失了两百万订阅用户。

e.en: We send exclusive discounts to our email {subscribers} every Friday.
e.zh: 我们每周五向邮件订阅者发送专属折扣。

e.en: The chemical formula uses a {subscript} two after the H.
e.zh: 该化学式在H后使用了下标二。

e.en: In LaTeX, you can add a {subscript} with the underscore symbol.
e.zh: 在LaTeX中,可以用下划线符号添加下标。

e.en: My streaming {subscription} renews automatically every month.
e.zh: 我的流媒体订阅每月自动续费。

e.en: Cancel your {subscription} anytime with a single click.
e.zh: 您可以随时一键取消订阅。

subscriptions.t: n. 订阅（复数）；订阅服务

e.en: I'm trying to cut back on monthly {subscriptions} I rarely use.
e.zh: 我正努力减少那些很少用的每月订阅服务。

e.en: The app helps you track all your recurring {subscriptions} in one place.
e.zh: 这款应用帮你在一个地方跟踪所有的定期订阅。

e.en: Engineers installed a {subsea} pipeline connecting two offshore platforms.
e.zh: 工程师们安装了一条连接两个海上平台的海底管道。

e.en: The company specializes in {subsea} robotics for deep-water inspection.
e.zh: 该公司专注于深海检测用的海底机器人技术。

e.en: Please read the third {subsection} of the contract carefully.
e.zh: 请仔细阅读合同的第三小节。

e.en: Each {subsection} of the report includes its own summary chart.
e.zh: 报告的每个小节都附有自己的概要图表。

e.en: Renewable energy is the fastest-growing {subsector} of the industry.
e.zh: 可再生能源是该行业增长最快的子板块。

e.en: The fintech {subsector} attracted record investment last year.
e.zh: 金融科技子行业去年吸引了创纪录的投资。

e.en: The first meeting went well, but {subsequent} ones were tense.
e.zh: 第一次会议顺利,但后续几次气氛紧张。

e.en: Any {subsequent} changes will require approval from the board.
e.zh: 任何后续变更都需要董事会批准。

e.en: He resigned in March and {subsequently} moved to Berlin.
e.zh: 他三月辞职,随后搬到了柏林。

e.en: The bug was reported and {subsequently} fixed in the next release.
e.zh: 这个漏洞被报告后,在下个版本中得到了修复。

e.en: These regulations {subserve} the broader goal of consumer protection.
e.zh: 这些规定服务于保护消费者这一更宏大的目标。

e.en: All departments must {subserve} the company's long-term mission.
e.zh: 所有部门都必须服务于公司的长期使命。

e.en: He resented the expected {subservience} to his domineering boss.
e.zh: 他厌恶必须对那位专横老板表现出顺从。

e.en: The novel criticizes blind {subservience} to outdated traditions.
e.zh: 这部小说批判了对过时传统的盲目屈从。

subservient.t: adj. 卑躬屈膝的；从属的

e.en: She refused to be {subservient} to anyone, no matter their title.
e.zh: 无论对方头衔多大,她都拒绝卑躬屈膝。

e.en: The smaller country grew tired of being {subservient} to its neighbor.
e.zh: 那个小国厌倦了一直屈从于其邻国。

e.en: Only a small {subset} of users tested the new feature.
e.zh: 只有一小部分用户测试了这个新功能。

e.en: Prime numbers form a {subset} of the natural numbers.
e.zh: 质数是自然数的一个子集。

e.en: The fever should {subside} within a day or two.
e.zh: 发烧应该会在一两天内退去。

e.en: Once the protests {subside}, normal traffic will return downtown.
e.zh: 抗议平息后,市中心交通就会恢复正常。

subsided.t: v. 已平息；已消退（subside 过去式）

e.en: The storm finally {subsided} after pounding the coast for hours.
e.zh: 暴风雨在猛烈袭击海岸数小时后终于平息。

e.en: Her anger {subsided} once she heard his sincere apology.
e.zh: 听到他真诚的道歉后,她的怒气消退了。

e.en: Old mining tunnels caused noticeable ground {subsidence} beneath the houses.
e.zh: 老旧的矿井导致房屋下方明显地面沉降。

e.en: Engineers monitor {subsidence} closely along the riverbank.
e.zh: 工程师们密切监测河岸沿线的地面沉降。

subsides.t: v. 平息；消退（subside 第三人称单数）

e.en: The pain usually {subsides} after taking the medication.
e.zh: 服药后疼痛通常会减轻。

e.en: Once the laughter {subsides}, the speaker continues her story.
e.zh: 笑声平息后,演讲者继续讲述她的故事。

subsidiarity.t: n. 辅助性原则（权力下放）

e.en: The EU defends {subsidiarity} so local issues stay locally decided.
e.zh: 欧盟坚持辅助性原则，让地方事务由地方决定。

e.en: Our org chart follows {subsidiarity} by empowering team leads.
e.zh: 我们的组织架构遵循辅助性原则，把决策权下放给团队负责人。

subsidiary.t:
n. 子公司
adj. 附属的；次要的

e.en: The bank's Asian {subsidiary} reported strong quarterly profits.
e.zh: 该银行的亚洲子公司公布了强劲的季度利润。

e.en: Cost is a {subsidiary} concern compared to product quality.
e.zh: 与产品质量相比，成本只是次要问题。

subsidies.t: n. 补贴；津贴（subsidy 复数）

e.en: Farmers rely on government {subsidies} during droughts.
e.zh: 农民在干旱时期依赖政府补贴。

e.en: EV buyers can claim generous {subsidies} this year.
e.zh: 今年购买电动车可以享受丰厚的补贴。

e.en: The floodwaters are slowly {subsiding} after three rainy days.
e.zh: 三天雨后，洪水正在慢慢退去。

e.en: My headache is finally {subsiding} after the medication.
e.zh: 吃了药后我的头痛终于在缓解。

subsidise.t: v. 补贴；资助（英式拼写）

e.en: The council will {subsidise} school meals for low-income families.
e.zh: 议会将为低收入家庭的学校餐补贴。

e.en: Many cities {subsidise} public transport to reduce traffic.
e.zh: 许多城市补贴公共交通以减少拥堵。

subsidised.t: adj. 受补贴的（英式拼写）

e.en: Employees enjoy {subsidised} lunches at the office canteen.
e.zh: 员工在公司食堂可以吃到有补贴的午餐。

e.en: The {subsidised} housing program helped thousands of young families.
e.zh: 这项保障性住房计划帮助了成千上万的年轻家庭。

e.en: Critics argue {subsidization} of fossil fuels delays the green transition.
e.zh: 批评者认为对化石燃料的补贴拖慢了绿色转型。

e.en: The report calls for greater {subsidization} of renewable energy.
e.zh: 报告呼吁加大对可再生能源的补贴力度。

e.en: The company will {subsidize} gym memberships for all staff.
e.zh: 公司将为所有员工补贴健身房会员费。

e.en: Governments often {subsidize} farmers to keep food prices stable.
e.zh: 政府常常补贴农民以保持食品价格稳定。

subsidized.t: adj. 受补贴的；有津贴的

e.en: She moved into a {subsidized} apartment near the university.
e.zh: 她搬进了大学附近一套有政府补贴的公寓。

e.en: The {subsidized} childcare program eased pressure on working parents.
e.zh: 这项有补贴的托育项目减轻了上班族父母的压力。

subsidizes.t: v. 补贴；资助（第三人称单数）

e.en: The state {subsidizes} solar panels for homeowners.
e.zh: 该州对房主安装太阳能板提供补贴。

e.en: This program {subsidizes} health insurance for freelance workers.
e.zh: 这个项目为自由职业者补贴医疗保险。

e.en: The government is {subsidizing} electric vehicles to reduce emissions.
e.zh: 政府正在补贴电动汽车以减少排放。

e.en: Many tech firms are {subsidizing} employees' commuting costs.
e.zh: 许多科技公司正在补贴员工的通勤费用。

e.en: Farmers received a {subsidy} to offset rising fuel prices.
e.zh: 农民获得补贴以抵消上涨的燃料价格。

e.en: The housing {subsidy} helps low-income families pay rent.
e.zh: 住房补贴帮助低收入家庭支付房租。

subsist.t: v. 勉强维持生活；存在

e.en: Many villagers {subsist} on rice and vegetables they grow.
e.zh: 许多村民靠自己种的米和蔬菜维生。

e.en: Refugees {subsist} on aid from international agencies.
e.zh: 难民靠国际机构的援助维生。

e.en: During the war they {subsisted} on bread and water.
e.zh: 战争期间他们靠面包和水维生。

e.en: The hikers {subsisted} on dried fruit for three days.
e.zh: 徒步者靠果干维持了三天。

e.en: The farmer earns barely enough for {subsistence}.
e.zh: 那位农民挣的钱仅够糊口。

e.en: Many families live below the {subsistence} level.
e.zh: 许多家庭生活在最低生活水平之下。

subsistences.t: n. 生计；维持生活的手段

e.en: Different cultures developed unique {subsistences} based on local resources.
e.zh: 不同文化基于当地资源发展出独特的生计方式。

e.en: Anthropologists study traditional {subsistences} of indigenous peoples.
e.zh: 人类学家研究原住民的传统生计方式。

e.en: Refugees were {subsisting} on minimal food rations.
e.zh: 难民们靠极少的口粮勉强度日。

e.en: The startup is {subsisting} on its founders' savings.
e.zh: 这家初创公司靠创始人的积蓄维持运营。

subsists.t: v. 维持生活（第三人称单数）

e.en: The tribe still {subsists} mainly through hunting and fishing.
e.zh: 该部落仍主要靠狩猎和捕鱼维生。

e.en: This rare plant {subsists} only in the highlands.
e.zh: 这种珍稀植物只生长在高地。

e.en: Plant roots reach deep into the {subsoil} for water.
e.zh: 植物的根深入下层土壤吸收水分。

e.en: The {subsoil} here is rich in clay and minerals.
e.zh: 这里的下层土壤富含黏土和矿物质。

e.en: Most commercial flights travel at {subsonic} speeds.
e.zh: 大多数商业航班以亚音速飞行。

e.en: The new drone uses {subsonic} engines for quieter operation.
e.zh: 这款新无人机使用亚音速引擎以降低噪音。

e.en: Linear algebra defines a {subspace} as a subset closed under operations.
e.zh: 线性代数将子空间定义为对运算封闭的子集。

e.en: The Star Trek crew sent a message through {subspace}.
e.zh: 《星际迷航》的船员通过子空间发送信息。

e.en: She chose pediatric cardiology as her medical {subspecialty}.
e.zh: 她选择小儿心脏病学作为她的医学亚专科。

e.en: This {subspecialty} requires three additional years of training.
e.zh: 这个亚专科需要额外三年的培训。

e.en: Scientists discovered a new {subspecies} of mountain gorilla.
e.zh: 科学家发现了一个山地大猩猩的新亚种。

e.en: This {subspecies} is found only on the island.
e.zh: 这个亚种仅在该岛上发现。

e.en: The mysterious {substance} dissolved quickly in water.
e.zh: 那种神秘物质很快在水中溶解。

e.en: His speech lacked any real {substance} or new ideas.
e.zh: 他的演讲缺乏实质内容和新观点。

substances.t: n. 物质；实质（substance 复数）

e.en: The lab tests for harmful {substances} in drinking water.
e.zh: 实验室检测饮用水中的有害物质。

e.en: Certain {substances} are banned in professional sports.
e.zh: 某些物质在职业体育中被禁用。

substandard.t: adj. 低于标准的；不合格的

e.en: The inspector rejected the {substandard} construction materials.
e.zh: 检查员拒收了不合格的建筑材料。

e.en: Customers complained about the {substandard} service quality.
e.zh: 顾客抱怨服务质量不达标。

substantial.t: adj. 大量的；重要的；结实的

e.en: She received a {substantial} bonus at the end of the year.
e.zh: 她在年底拿到了一笔可观的奖金。

e.en: There has been {substantial} progress on the climate deal.
e.zh: 气候协议方面已取得重大进展。

e.en: The {substantiality} of the evidence convinced the jury.
e.zh: 证据的充实性说服了陪审团。

e.en: Critics questioned the {substantiality} of the company's profits.
e.zh: 批评者质疑公司利润的真实性。

e.en: Sales have grown {substantially} since the redesign.
e.zh: 自重新设计以来,销售额大幅增长。

e.en: The two reports are {substantially} the same.
e.zh: 两份报告大体上是一致的。

e.en: You need evidence to {substantiate} that claim.
e.zh: 你需要证据来证实那个说法。

e.en: The journalist couldn't {substantiate} the rumors.
e.zh: 记者无法证实那些传言。

e.en: Researchers {substantiated} the theory with new data.
e.zh: 研究人员用新数据证实了这一理论。

e.en: His allegations were never properly {substantiated}.
e.zh: 他的指控从未得到充分证实。

substantiates.t: v. 证实（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new study {substantiates} earlier findings on sleep.
e.zh: 这项新研究证实了早期关于睡眠的发现。

e.en: This document {substantiates} her ownership of the property.
e.zh: 这份文件证实了她对该房产的所有权。

e.en: The lawyer is {substantiating} every detail of the testimony.
e.zh: 律师正在核实证词的每个细节。

e.en: They submitted documents {substantiating} their tax deductions.
e.zh: 他们提交了证明其税务扣除的文件。

e.en: The accusation requires further {substantiation} before publication.
e.zh: 该指控在发表前需要进一步的证实。

e.en: Without {substantiation}, the rumor cannot be reported as fact.
e.zh: 没有证据,这个传言不能作为事实报道。

e.en: The two leaders had a {substantive} discussion about trade.
e.zh: 两位领导人就贸易进行了实质性讨论。

e.en: We need {substantive} changes, not cosmetic ones.
e.zh: 我们需要实质性的改变,而非表面功夫。

e.en: The proposal differs {substantively} from last year's version.
e.zh: 该提案与去年的版本在实质上不同。

e.en: They engaged {substantively} with the customer's feedback.
e.zh: 他们认真处理了客户的反馈意见。

e.en: A power {substation} explosion left thousands without electricity.
e.zh: 一座变电站爆炸导致数千人断电。

e.en: The new {substation} will serve the growing suburb.
e.zh: 新变电站将为日益扩张的郊区供电。

e.en: Economists study the {substitutability} of one product for another.
e.zh: 经济学家研究一种产品对另一种的可替代性。

e.en: The {substitutability} of renewable energy depends on storage tech.
e.zh: 可再生能源的可替代性取决于储能技术。

e.en: Olive oil is easily {substitutable} for butter in baking.
e.zh: 在烘焙中,橄榄油很容易替代黄油。

e.en: These two parts are fully {substitutable} in the assembly.
e.zh: 这两个零件在装配中可以完全互换。

substitute.t:
v. 替代；代替
n. 替代品；替补

e.en: You can {substitute} almond milk for regular milk in this recipe.
e.zh: 在这道食谱中,你可以用杏仁奶代替普通牛奶。

e.en: The {substitute} teacher arrived just before class started.
e.zh: 代课老师在上课前刚好赶到。

substituted.t: v. 替换，代替（substitute 的过去式）

e.en: The coach {substituted} the injured player at halftime.
e.zh: 教练在中场休息时替换下了受伤的球员。

e.en: She {substituted} honey for sugar in the cookies.
e.zh: 她在饼干里用蜂蜜替代了糖。

substitutes.t:
n. 替代品
v. 替换（substitute 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Plant-based {substitutes} for meat are gaining popularity.
e.zh: 植物性肉类替代品越来越受欢迎。

e.en: The recipe {substitutes} yogurt for sour cream.
e.zh: 这道食谱用酸奶代替酸奶油。

substituting.t: v. 正在替换、代替（substitute 的现在分词）

e.en: Try {substituting} oats for flour to make it healthier.
e.zh: 试试用燕麦代替面粉,这样更健康。

e.en: The manager is {substituting} junior staff during the shortage.
e.zh: 经理在人手短缺时让初级员工顶替。

e.en: The coach made a {substitution} in the final minute.
e.zh: 教练在最后一分钟做了换人。

e.en: This {substitution} reduces the recipe's calorie count.
e.zh: 这种替换降低了食谱的卡路里。

e.en: The theology emphasizes the {substitutionary} nature of the sacrifice.
e.zh: 该神学强调这一牺牲的代赎性质。

e.en: He proposed a {substitutionary} model for the failed parts.
e.zh: 他为损坏的部件提出了一个替代模型。

e.en: The menu allows several {substitutions} for dietary restrictions.
e.zh: 菜单允许针对饮食限制进行多种替换。

e.en: Both teams made tactical {substitutions} after the goal.
e.zh: 两队在进球后都做了战术换人。

substitutive.t: adj. 可替代的，代替性的

e.en: Researchers explored {substitutive} materials to replace plastic.
e.zh: 研究人员探索可替代塑料的替代性材料。

e.en: The drug has a {substitutive} effect on the natural hormone.
e.zh: 该药物对天然激素具有替代作用。

e.en: The enzyme binds to its {substrate} and starts the reaction.
e.zh: 酶与其底物结合并开始反应。

e.en: Choose a sturdy {substrate} before painting the mural.
e.zh: 在画壁画之前选择一个坚固的底材。

e.en: A rocky {substratum} lies beneath the topsoil here.
e.zh: 这里的表土之下是岩石底层。

e.en: Folk beliefs form the {substratum} of this culture.
e.zh: 民间信仰构成了这个文化的底层基础。

substructure.t: n. 下部结构，基础结构

e.en: Engineers inspected the bridge's {substructure} for cracks.
e.zh: 工程师检查桥梁下部结构是否有裂缝。

e.en: The building's {substructure} was reinforced after the earthquake.
e.zh: 地震后建筑物的下部结构得到加固。

e.en: The new department will {subsume} three smaller existing teams.
e.zh: 新部门将合并三个现有的小团队。

e.en: Critics argue the law tries to {subsume} too many issues at once.
e.zh: 批评者认为该法律试图一次性涵盖过多议题。

e.en: The merger led to the {subsumption} of the brand into a larger group.
e.zh: 合并导致该品牌被并入更大的集团之中。

e.en: Logical {subsumption} means one concept fully contains another.
e.zh: 逻辑上的归入意味着一个概念完全包含另一个。

subsurface.t:
adj. 地表下的
n. 地下层

e.en: Radar revealed a complex network of {subsurface} water channels.
e.zh: 雷达探测到地下复杂的水道网络。

e.en: They drilled deep to study {subsurface} rock formations.
e.zh: 他们深入钻探以研究地下的岩石构造。

e.en: A faulty cooling {subsystem} caused the entire server to crash.
e.zh: 一个故障的冷却子系统导致整台服务器崩溃。

e.en: Each {subsystem} can be tested independently before integration.
e.zh: 每个子系统在集成前都可以单独测试。

subtend.t: v. (几何) 对向，对着（角或边）

e.en: Two radii {subtend} an angle at the center of the circle.
e.zh: 两条半径在圆心处对应一个角。

e.en: The chord {subtend} a sixty-degree arc on the diagram.
e.zh: 图中那条弦对着一个六十度的弧。

e.en: He used clever {subterfuge} to sneak out of the boring meeting.
e.zh: 他用巧妙的诡计溜出了那场无聊的会议。

e.en: The spy relied on {subterfuge} to avoid being identified.
e.zh: 那名间谍依靠诡计来避免暴露身份。

e.en: Tourists explored the vast {subterranean} caves with flashlights.
e.zh: 游客们用手电筒探索巨大的地下洞穴。

e.en: The city hides a {subterranean} network of forgotten tunnels.
e.zh: 这座城市隐藏着一片被遗忘的地下隧道网络。

e.en: Students performed best on the vocabulary {subtest} of the exam.
e.zh: 学生们在该考试的词汇分测验中表现最好。

e.en: Each {subtest} measures a specific cognitive skill in young children.
e.zh: 每个分测验测量幼儿的一项特定认知能力。

e.en: Her polite reply had a clear {subtext} of frustration.
e.zh: 她礼貌的回复中明显透着一丝不满。

e.en: The film's {subtext} explores grief beneath its comedic surface.
e.zh: 这部电影喜剧的表面下暗含对悲伤的探讨。

e.en: Loneliness is a recurring {subtheme} in his novels.
e.zh: 孤独是他小说中反复出现的次要主题。

e.en: The conference had a {subtheme} on AI ethics.
e.zh: 这次会议设有一个关于人工智能伦理的子主题。

e.en: The book's {subtitle} hints at its true subject.
e.zh: 这本书的副标题暗示了它真正的主题。

e.en: Please turn on the English {subtitle} track.
e.zh: 请打开英文字幕轨道。

subtitled.t:
adj. 带字幕的
v. 加字幕（过去式）

e.en: We watched a {subtitled} Korean drama last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚看了一部带字幕的韩剧。

e.en: The report is {subtitled} "A Decade of Change."
e.zh: 这份报告的副标题是“变革的十年”。

e.en: I always watch foreign films with English {subtitles}.
e.zh: 我看外语片总是开着英文字幕。

e.en: The streaming app added auto-generated {subtitles} last week.
e.zh: 这款流媒体应用上周新增了自动生成字幕功能。

subtle.t: adj. 微妙的，细微的；精巧的

e.en: There's a {subtle} difference between the two shades of blue.
e.zh: 这两种蓝色之间有微妙的差别。

e.en: He dropped a {subtle} hint about wanting a promotion.
e.zh: 他不动声色地暗示了想升职。

e.en: The painting's beauty lies in its {subtlety}.
e.zh: 这幅画的美在于它的细腻含蓄。

e.en: His jokes lack {subtlety} and often offend people.
e.zh: 他的笑话缺乏分寸,常常冒犯别人。

subtly.t: adv. 微妙地，不易察觉地

e.en: The lighting {subtly} shifts to match the mood.
e.zh: 灯光会微妙地变化以契合氛围。

e.en: She {subtly} changed the topic to avoid awkwardness.
e.zh: 她不动声色地转移了话题以避免尴尬。

e.en: Each chapter covers a different {subtopic} of climate science.
e.zh: 每一章涵盖气候科学的一个不同子话题。

e.en: Let's break this discussion into a smaller {subtopic}.
e.zh: 让我们把讨论拆成一个更小的子话题。

e.en: The {subtotal} appears before tax and shipping fees.
e.zh: 小计显示在税费和运费之前。

e.en: Please check the {subtotal} on your receipt.
e.zh: 请核对一下您收据上的小计金额。

e.en: {Subtract} the discount from the original price.
e.zh: 用原价减去折扣金额。

e.en: You need to {subtract} taxes before calculating profit.
e.zh: 算利润之前要先扣除税款。

e.en: The cashier {subtracted} the coupon from my total.
e.zh: 收银员从我的总额里扣除了优惠券金额。

e.en: Once expenses are {subtracted}, very little profit remains.
e.zh: 扣除开支之后,剩下的利润所剩无几。

subtracting.t: v. 正在减去（subtract 的现在分词）

e.en: He's {subtracting} fees to find his real earnings.
e.zh: 他在扣除手续费以算出真实收入。

e.en: Try {subtracting} ten from each side of the equation.
e.zh: 试着在方程两边各减去十。

e.en: My daughter is learning {subtraction} in first grade.
e.zh: 我女儿在一年级学减法。

e.en: A simple {subtraction} reveals the budget shortfall.
e.zh: 简单一减就能看出预算缺口。

e.en: Printers use a {subtractive} color model based on CMYK.
e.zh: 打印机采用基于 CMYK 的减色模型。

e.en: The sculptor's process is purely {subtractive}—he chips away stone.
e.zh: 这位雕塑家的创作完全是减法——一点点凿掉石头。

subtracts.t: v. 减去（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app automatically {subtracts} expenses from your balance.
e.zh: 这款应用会自动从余额里扣除支出。

e.en: Each mistake {subtracts} two points from your score.
e.zh: 每错一题就从你的分数里扣两分。

e.en: Florida has a humid {subtropical} climate year-round.
e.zh: 佛罗里达全年都是潮湿的亚热带气候。

e.en: This plant thrives in warm {subtropical} regions.
e.zh: 这种植物在温暖的亚热带地区长势良好。

e.en: Hurricanes often form in the {subtropics} during summer.
e.zh: 夏季飓风常在亚热带地区形成。

e.en: Citrus fruits grow well in the {subtropics}.
e.zh: 柑橘类水果在亚热带地区长得很好。

e.en: This {subtype} of diabetes appears mainly in adults.
e.zh: 这种糖尿病亚型主要出现在成年人身上。

e.en: In TypeScript, a {subtype} must satisfy the parent interface.
e.zh: 在 TypeScript 中,子类型必须满足父接口的约束。

e.en: Each protein {subunit} folds into a specific shape.
e.zh: 每个蛋白质亚基都折叠成特定的形状。

e.en: The cent is a {subunit} of the dollar.
e.zh: 分是美元的一个辅币单位。

e.en: They moved to a quiet {suburb} after the baby arrived.
e.zh: 宝宝出生后他们搬到了一个安静的郊区。

e.en: This {suburb} is famous for its excellent school district.
e.zh: 这个郊区以其优秀的学区而闻名。

e.en: He grew up in a typical {suburban} neighborhood.
e.zh: 他在一个典型的郊区社区长大。

e.en: {Suburban} families often rely heavily on cars.
e.zh: 郊区家庭往往非常依赖汽车出行。

e.en: As a lifelong {suburbanite}, she found city noise overwhelming.
e.zh: 作为一个一辈子住郊区的人,她觉得城市的噪音难以忍受。

e.en: The shop caters mostly to the weekend {suburbanite}.
e.zh: 这家店主要面向周末来逛的郊区居民。

e.en: Postwar {suburbanization} reshaped American family life.
e.zh: 战后的郊区化重塑了美国的家庭生活。

e.en: Rapid {suburbanization} has put pressure on local farmland.
e.zh: 快速的郊区化给当地农田带来了压力。

suburbia.t: n. 郊区（总称）；郊区生活

e.en: He longed to escape the dull routine of {suburbia}.
e.zh: 他渴望逃离郊区生活的单调日常。

e.en: The novel paints a dark portrait of American {suburbia}.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了美国郊区生活的阴暗一面。

e.en: The film contrasts the {suburbias} of Tokyo and Los Angeles.
e.zh: 这部电影对比了东京与洛杉矶的郊区景象。

e.en: Different {suburbias} across the country share surprising similarities.
e.zh: 全国各地不同的郊区社区有着惊人的相似之处。

e.en: Many young families are moving to the {suburbs}.
e.zh: 许多年轻家庭正在搬往郊区。

e.en: The {suburbs} of Beijing have expanded rapidly.
e.zh: 北京的郊区扩张得非常迅速。

e.en: The opera house relies on government {subvention} to survive.
e.zh: 这座歌剧院依靠政府补助才能维持运转。

e.en: Researchers applied for a {subvention} to fund the study.
e.zh: 研究人员申请了一笔补助金来资助这项研究。

e.en: The novel is a clever {subversion} of fairy tale tropes.
e.zh: 这部小说巧妙地颠覆了童话的套路。

e.en: He was arrested on charges of political {subversion}.
e.zh: 他因政治颠覆罪名被捕。

subversive.t:
adj. 颠覆性的
n. 颠覆分子

e.en: Her artwork carries a quietly {subversive} message.
e.zh: 她的作品悄然传达着一种颠覆性的讯息。

e.en: The regime banned the book as {subversive}.
e.zh: 当局以颠覆性为由查禁了这本书。

e.en: The comedian {subversively} mocks corporate culture in every show.
e.zh: 这位喜剧演员每场演出都在以颠覆的方式嘲讽企业文化。

e.en: She {subversively} reinterprets classic paintings with modern themes.
e.zh: 她以颠覆性的方式用现代主题重新诠释经典画作。

e.en: The hackers tried to {subvert} the election system.
e.zh: 黑客试图破坏选举系统。

e.en: Good satire can {subvert} authority without saying so directly.
e.zh: 好的讽刺能在不明说的情况下颠覆权威。

subverted.t: v. 颠覆；破坏（subvert 过去式）

e.en: The director {subverted} every expectation in the final scene.
e.zh: 导演在最后一幕颠覆了所有人的预期。

e.en: Corruption gradually {subverted} the country's young democracy.
e.zh: 腐败逐渐侵蚀了这个国家年轻的民主制度。

subway.t:
n. 地铁
n. 地下通道（英）

e.en: I take the {subway} to work every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上坐地铁上班。

e.en: The {subway} runs every three minutes during rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰时段地铁每三分钟一班。

e.en: Tokyo's {subways} are famously clean and punctual.
e.zh: 东京的地铁以干净准点闻名。

e.en: Many older {subways} are being upgraded for accessibility.
e.zh: 许多老旧的地铁系统正在进行无障碍改造。

subwoofer.t: n. 低音炮；重低音扬声器

e.en: The {subwoofer} adds deep bass to action movies.
e.zh: 低音炮为动作片增添了厚重的低音效果。

e.en: My neighbor's {subwoofer} shakes my walls every weekend.
e.zh: 邻居的低音炮每个周末都把我家的墙震得发抖。

succeed.t:
v. 成功
v. 继任；接替

e.en: You won't {succeed} without taking some risks.
e.zh: 不冒点风险你是不会成功的。

e.en: She is expected to {succeed} her father as CEO.
e.zh: 预计她将接替父亲出任首席执行官。

succeeded.t: v. 成功；继任（succeed 过去式）

e.en: The startup {succeeded} despite a tough first year.
e.zh: 尽管第一年很艰难,这家创业公司还是成功了。

e.en: Tim Cook {succeeded} Steve Jobs as Apple's CEO.
e.zh: 蒂姆·库克接替史蒂夫·乔布斯出任苹果首席执行官。

succeeding.t:
adj. 随后的；接下来的
v. 成功（进行式）

e.en: He's finally {succeeding} after years of hard work.
e.zh: 经过多年的努力,他终于开始有所成就。

e.en: The discovery influenced every {succeeding} generation of scientists.
e.zh: 这一发现影响了之后每一代科学家。

succeeds.t: v. 成功；继任（第三人称单数）

e.en: Whoever {succeeds} the chairman will face huge challenges.
e.zh: 无论谁接替主席职位都将面临巨大挑战。

e.en: This strategy rarely {succeeds} in a competitive market.
e.zh: 这种策略在竞争激烈的市场中很少成功。

e.en: The launch was a huge {success} for the team.
e.zh: 这次发布对团队来说是一次巨大的成功。

e.en: Her {success} comes from years of consistent practice.
e.zh: 她的成功源于多年坚持不懈的练习。

e.en: She runs a {successful} bakery in the old town.
e.zh: 她在老城区经营着一家很成功的面包店。

e.en: The campaign was surprisingly {successful} on social media.
e.zh: 这次活动在社交媒体上出乎意料地成功。

e.en: The team {successfully} launched the product ahead of schedule.
e.zh: 团队提前成功发布了这款产品。

e.en: She {successfully} defended her thesis last Friday.
e.zh: 她上周五成功通过了论文答辩。

succession.t:
n. 一连串；接连
n. 继承；继位

e.en: The company faced a leadership {succession} after the founder retired.
e.zh: 创始人退休后,公司面临领导层的接班问题。

e.en: He won three games in {succession}.
e.zh: 他连续赢了三场比赛。

e.en: Forests go through several {successional} stages after a fire.
e.zh: 森林在火灾后会经历几个演替阶段。

e.en: Ecologists study {successional} changes in restored wetlands.
e.zh: 生态学家研究恢复湿地中的演替变化。

e.en: Royal {successions} have shaped European history for centuries.
e.zh: 王位的更替塑造了欧洲数百年的历史。

e.en: The team suffered a string of {successions} in coaching.
e.zh: 球队经历了一连串的教练更替。

e.en: The store has lost money for three {successive} quarters.
e.zh: 这家店已经连续三个季度亏损。

e.en: {Successive} governments have failed to fix the housing crisis.
e.zh: 历届政府都未能解决住房危机。

e.en: She held three jobs {successively} before finding her passion.
e.zh: 她先后做过三份工作,才找到自己热爱的事业。

e.en: The temperature dropped {successively} over the past five days.
e.zh: 过去五天气温接连下降。

successor.t:
n. 继任者；接班人
n. 后继产品

e.en: The CEO has yet to name a clear {successor}.
e.zh: 首席执行官尚未指定明确的接班人。

e.en: This phone is the {successor} to last year's model.
e.zh: 这款手机是去年那款的后继机型。

successors.t: n. 继任者；后继者（复数）

e.en: Her {successors} struggled to maintain the company's culture.
e.zh: 她的几任继任者都难以维持公司的文化。

e.en: Modern smartphones are the {successors} to early flip phones.
e.zh: 现代智能手机是早期翻盖手机的后继产品。

e.en: Please keep your answer {succinct} and to the point.
e.zh: 请把答案说得简洁一点，直奔主题。

e.en: The manager gave a {succinct} summary of the project.
e.zh: 经理对项目做了简短扼要的总结。

e.en: She {succinctly} explained the new policy in one minute.
e.zh: 她用一分钟简明地解释了新政策。

e.en: The report {succinctly} captures the key risks involved.
e.zh: 这份报告简洁地概括了所涉及的主要风险。

succinylcholine.t: n. 琥珀胆碱（肌肉松弛药）

e.en: The anesthesiologist administered {succinylcholine} before intubating the patient.
e.zh: 麻醉师在给病人插管前注射了琥珀胆碱。

e.en: {Succinylcholine} causes brief muscle paralysis during surgery.
e.zh: 琥珀胆碱在手术中可造成短暂的肌肉麻痹。

succor.t:
n. 援助；救助
v. 援助（美式拼写）

e.en: The charity offered {succor} to families displaced by the flood.
e.zh: 慈善机构向因洪水流离失所的家庭提供救助。

e.en: He found {succor} in his old friends after the loss.
e.zh: 失去亲人后，他在老朋友身上找到了慰藉。

succotash.t: n. 豆煮玉米（美式杂烩菜）

e.en: Grandma served {succotash} with corn and lima beans for dinner.
e.zh: 奶奶晚饭做了用玉米和青豆煮的杂烩菜。

e.en: This vegan {succotash} recipe is perfect for summer.
e.zh: 这道纯素玉米豆菜炖菜很适合夏天吃。

succour.t: n. 援助；救助（英式拼写）

e.en: Volunteers brought {succour} to the earthquake survivors.
e.zh: 志愿者向地震幸存者伸出援手。

e.en: The kind words gave him much-needed {succour}.
e.zh: 那些温暖的话语给了他急需的安慰。

e.en: The horror game features a {succubus} as the final boss.
e.zh: 这款恐怖游戏的最终 Boss 是一个魅魔。

e.en: In medieval lore, a {succubus} visited men in their dreams.
e.zh: 在中世纪传说中，魅魔会在男人的梦中现身。

e.en: The {succulence} of the steak surprised everyone at the table.
e.zh: 这块牛排的多汁让餐桌上的每个人都很惊喜。

e.en: Slow cooking preserves the {succulence} of the meat.
e.zh: 慢炖可以保留肉的鲜嫩多汁。

succulent.t:
adj. 多汁的；鲜美的
n. 多肉植物

e.en: She bit into the {succulent} peach and smiled.
e.zh: 她咬了一口多汁的桃子，笑了起来。

e.en: My desk has a small {succulent} that needs little water.
e.zh: 我桌上有一盆小多肉植物，几乎不需要浇水。

e.en: The ribs were {succulently} glazed and fell off the bone.
e.zh: 那排骨被刷上汁料，肉嫩多汁，一碰就脱骨。

e.en: The chef cooks salmon {succulently} every single time.
e.zh: 那位厨师每次都能把三文鱼煎得鲜嫩多汁。

e.en: My apartment is full of {succulents} and houseplants.
e.zh: 我的公寓里摆满了多肉植物和室内盆栽。

e.en: {Succulents} are perfect for people who forget to water plants.
e.zh: 多肉植物很适合那些常忘记浇水的人。

succumb.t:
v. 屈服；抵挡不住
v. 死于（疾病等）

e.en: Try not to {succumb} to peer pressure when shopping online.
e.zh: 网购时尽量别屈服于同伴的压力。

e.en: Many trees {succumb} to disease during the rainy season.
e.zh: 许多树木在雨季会因病害而枯死。

succumbed.t: v. 屈服；死于（succumb 过去式）

e.en: He finally {succumbed} to temptation and bought the new phone.
e.zh: 他最终抵不住诱惑，买下了那部新手机。

e.en: The patient {succumbed} to her injuries early Monday morning.
e.zh: 病人在周一清晨因伤重不治去世。

succumbing.t: v. 屈服；抵挡不住（进行式）

e.en: She avoided {succumbing} to stress by meditating each morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上冥想，避免被压力击垮。

e.en: Several startups are {succumbing} to rising interest rates.
e.zh: 好几家初创公司正因利率上升而撑不下去。

succumbs.t: v. 屈服；死于（第三人称单数）

e.en: Whoever {succumbs} to the prank first owes everyone coffee.
e.zh: 谁先中招，谁就请大家喝咖啡。

e.en: The hero never {succumbs} to despair in this novel.
e.zh: 小说中的主人公从不向绝望屈服。

such.t:
adj. 这样的；如此的
pron. 这样的人或事

e.en: I've never seen {such} a beautiful sunset before.
e.zh: 我从没见过这么美的日落。

e.en: Apps {such} as TikTok and Instagram dominate teen screen time.
e.zh: 像 TikTok 和 Instagram 这样的应用占据了青少年的屏幕时间。

suchlike.t:
adj. 诸如此类的
pron. 此类事物

e.en: The shop sells pens, notebooks, and {suchlike} stationery.
e.zh: 这家店卖钢笔、笔记本以及诸如此类的文具。

e.en: Bring snacks, drinks, and {suchlike} for the road trip.
e.zh: 自驾路上带些零食、饮料之类的东西。

suck.t:
v. 吸；吮
v. 糟糕（俚）

e.en: Mondays really {suck} when you didn't sleep enough.
e.zh: 没睡够的时候，星期一真的太难熬了。

e.en: Babies instinctively {suck} on their thumbs for comfort.
e.zh: 婴儿会本能地吮吸拇指来获得安慰。

sucked.t: v. 吸；糟透了（suck 过去式）

e.en: The vacuum {sucked} up every crumb on the carpet.
e.zh: 吸尘器把地毯上的每一粒碎屑都吸走了。

e.en: That movie really {sucked} despite the great trailer.
e.zh: 那部电影预告很棒，正片却烂透了。

sucker.t:
n. 易受骗的人
n. 吸盘；吸管

e.en: Don't be a {sucker} for those flashy online ads.
e.zh: 别被那些花里胡哨的网络广告骗了。

e.en: I'm a total {sucker} for cheesy romantic comedies.
e.zh: 我特别吃肉麻浪漫喜剧这一套。

sucking.t:
v. 吸吮（进行式）
adj. 乳臭未干的

e.en: The toddler kept {sucking} on a lollipop during the drive.
e.zh: 小孩在车上一直含着一根棒棒糖。

e.en: That email thread is {sucking} hours out of my day.
e.zh: 那个邮件串正在吞噬我一天里好几个小时。

e.en: The newborn calves {suckle} from their mother for months.
e.zh: 刚出生的小牛会吃几个月的母奶。

e.en: Lambs instinctively {suckle} within minutes of being born.
e.zh: 小羊出生几分钟内就会本能地去吃奶。

suckler.t: n. 哺乳中的幼崽；哺乳母畜

e.en: The farm specializes in {suckler} cows raised on pasture.
e.zh: 这个农场专门饲养在草场上放养的哺乳母牛。

e.en: A healthy {suckler} herd is vital to beef production.
e.zh: 健康的哺乳牛群对肉牛生产至关重要。

suckling.t:
n. 乳婴；乳兽
v. 哺乳（进行式）

e.en: The chef roasted a whole {suckling} pig for the festival.
e.zh: 厨师为节日烤了一整只乳猪。

e.en: Photos of the {suckling} kittens went viral online.
e.zh: 那些哺乳期小猫的照片在网上爆红。

sucks.t:
v. 糟透了（俚）
v. 吸（第三人称单数）

e.en: It {sucks} that the concert got canceled last minute.
e.zh: 演唱会在最后关头被取消，真是太扫兴了。

e.en: This straw barely {sucks} up any of the smoothie.
e.zh: 这根吸管几乎吸不上来任何奶昔。

e.en: I had a really {sucky} day at work today.
e.zh: 我今天上班过得特别糟。

e.en: That update made the app feel {sucky} and slow.
e.zh: 那次更新让这款应用变得既糟糕又卡顿。

sucralose.t: n. 三氯蔗糖（人工甜味剂）

e.en: This diet soda is sweetened with {sucralose} instead of sugar.
e.zh: 这款无糖汽水用三氯蔗糖代替了糖。

e.en: Some baked goods use {sucralose} to cut calories.
e.zh: 有些烘焙食品用三氯蔗糖来降低卡路里。

e.en: Table sugar is essentially pure {sucrose} extracted from cane.
e.zh: 白砂糖基本上就是从甘蔗中提取的纯蔗糖。

e.en: The label shows {sucrose} as the second ingredient.
e.zh: 配料表上把蔗糖列为第二种成分。

suction.t:
n. 吸力；抽吸
v. 抽吸

e.en: The robot vacuum has powerful {suction} for pet hair.
e.zh: 这款扫地机器人吸力很强，对付宠物毛很在行。

e.en: I mounted the phone holder using a {suction} cup.
e.zh: 我用吸盘把手机支架装在了上面。

sud.t: n. 肥皂泡（suds 单数，罕用）

e.en: Aid workers struggled to deliver food across {Sudan} this month.
e.zh: 援助人员本月在苏丹境内运送食物困难重重。

e.en: The Nile River flows north through {Sudan} into Egypt.
e.zh: 尼罗河自南向北穿过苏丹流入埃及。

sudanese.t:
adj. 苏丹的
n. 苏丹人

e.en: The {Sudanese} community in our city hosted a cultural night.
e.zh: 我们市的苏丹社区举办了一场文化之夜。

e.en: She enjoyed authentic {Sudanese} food at the new restaurant.
e.zh: 她在那家新开的餐厅品尝了正宗的苏丹菜。

e.en: My cousin moved to {Sudbury} for a mining engineering job.
e.zh: 我表哥为了一份采矿工程的工作搬到了萨德伯里。

e.en: {Sudbury} is famous for its huge nickel deposits in Canada.
e.zh: 萨德伯里以加拿大丰富的镍矿储量而闻名。

e.en: There was a {sudden} drop in temperature overnight.
e.zh: 一夜之间气温骤降。

e.en: His {sudden} resignation shocked the entire engineering team.
e.zh: 他突然辞职让整个工程团队都震惊了。

e.en: The lights {suddenly} went out during the live stream.
e.zh: 直播过程中灯突然熄灭了。

e.en: She {suddenly} realized she had left the stove on.
e.zh: 她突然意识到自己忘了关炉子。

e.en: The {suddenness} of the layoffs caught everyone off guard.
e.zh: 裁员来得太突然，所有人都措手不及。

e.en: What surprised me was the {suddenness} of his apology.
e.zh: 让我惊讶的是他道歉来得如此突然。

sudetenland.t: n. 苏台德地区（捷克地名）

e.en: Hitler annexed the {Sudetenland} from Czechoslovakia in 1938.
e.zh: 希特勒于 1938 年从捷克斯洛伐克吞并了苏台德地区。

e.en: The {Sudetenland} crisis preceded the outbreak of World War II.
e.zh: 苏台德危机发生在第二次世界大战爆发之前。

e.en: The kids splashed happily in the bubble bath {suds}.
e.zh: 孩子们在泡泡浴的肥皂泡里开心地玩水。

e.en: Rinse the dishes thoroughly to remove all the {suds}.
e.zh: 把盘子彻底冲洗一下，把所有泡沫都冲掉。

sudsy.t: adj. 起泡沫的；多肥皂沫的

e.en: She washed the car with a {sudsy} sponge.
e.zh: 她用满是泡沫的海绵洗车。

e.en: Pour the {sudsy} water down the drain when finished.
e.zh: 洗完后把那些带泡沫的水倒进下水道。

sued.t: v. 起诉（sue 的过去式）

e.en: The startup got {sued} for using copyrighted images online.
e.zh: 那家初创公司因在网上使用受版权保护的图片而被起诉。

e.en: He {sued} the contractor after the renovation went wrong.
e.zh: 装修出问题后，他把承包商告上了法庭。

e.en: Her new {suede} jacket looks great with jeans.
e.zh: 她的新麂皮夹克和牛仔裤搭起来很好看。

e.en: Avoid wearing {suede} shoes in the rain.
e.zh: 下雨天不要穿麂皮鞋。

sues.t: v. 起诉（sue 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The author {sues} the publisher over unpaid royalties.
e.zh: 那位作者就未付版税起诉了出版商。

e.en: He often {sues} companies for false advertising claims.
e.zh: 他经常起诉公司虚假广告。

e.en: Traditional Christmas pudding contains beef {suet} and dried fruit.
e.zh: 传统圣诞布丁含有牛板油和干果。

e.en: Birds love nibbling at {suet} cakes in winter.
e.zh: 鸟儿喜欢在冬天啄食板油饼。

e.en: Cargo ships pass through the {Suez} Canal daily.
