e.zh: 货船每天都会通过苏伊士运河。

e.en: The {Suez} Crisis reshaped Middle Eastern politics in 1956.
e.zh: 1956年的苏伊士危机重塑了中东政治格局。

suffer.t:
v. 遭受；忍受
v. 患（病）

e.en: Many people {suffer} from chronic back pain at work.
e.zh: 许多人在工作中长期受到背痛折磨。

e.en: Crops will {suffer} if the drought continues much longer.
e.zh: 如果干旱持续下去,庄稼会受到严重影响。

e.en: They stayed in the country on {sufferance} only.
e.zh: 他们只是被勉强容许留在该国。

e.en: His presence at meetings was tolerated on {sufferance}.
e.zh: 他出席会议只是被勉强容忍而已。

suffered.t: v. 遭受（suffer 的过去式）

e.en: She {suffered} a serious knee injury during practice.
e.zh: 她在训练中膝盖严重受伤。

e.en: The economy {suffered} badly after the trade dispute.
e.zh: 贸易争端之后经济严重受挫。

e.en: As a long-time migraine {sufferer}, she avoids bright lights.
e.zh: 作为一名长期偏头痛患者,她避开强光。

e.en: Each {sufferer} described their symptoms during the support group.
e.zh: 每位患者在互助小组中描述了自己的症状。

suffering.t:
n. 苦难；痛苦
v. 正在遭受

e.en: The charity aims to reduce {suffering} among refugees worldwide.
e.zh: 该慈善机构旨在减轻全球难民的苦难。

e.en: She is {suffering} from a bad cold this week.
e.zh: 她这周得了重感冒,很难受。

e.en: The memoir vividly describes the {sufferings} of war refugees.
e.zh: 这本回忆录生动描绘了战争难民的种种苦难。

e.en: Religious texts often address the {sufferings} of humanity.
e.zh: 宗教典籍常常论及人类的种种苦难。

e.en: He {suffers} from severe seasonal allergies every spring.
e.zh: 他每年春天都饱受严重的季节性过敏之苦。

e.en: Productivity {suffers} when employees don't get enough sleep.
e.zh: 员工睡眠不足时,生产力会下降。

e.en: A short email should {suffice} as confirmation.
e.zh: 发一封简短的邮件作为确认就够了。

e.en: Two cups of flour will {suffice} for this recipe.
e.zh: 两杯面粉足够做这道食谱了。

sufficed.t: v. 足够（suffice 的过去式）

e.en: A short nap {sufficed} to clear her tired mind.
e.zh: 小睡一会儿就足以让她疲惫的头脑清醒。

e.en: One look at the bill {sufficed} to ruin his mood.
e.zh: 看一眼账单就足以毁了他的心情。

e.en: A simple password no longer {suffices} for online banking.
e.zh: 对于网上银行,简单的密码已经不够用了。

e.en: One example {suffices} to prove the rule wrong.
e.zh: 一个例子就足以证明这条规则是错的。

e.en: The report questioned the {sufficiency} of current safety measures.
e.zh: 报告质疑现行安全措施是否充分。

e.en: Food {sufficiency} remains a major concern in the region.
e.zh: 食物是否充足仍是该地区的主要问题。

e.en: Eight hours of sleep is {sufficient} for most adults.
e.zh: 对大多数成年人来说,八小时睡眠就够了。

e.en: The evidence was not {sufficient} to convict him.
e.zh: 证据不足以定他的罪。

e.en: The cake is {sufficiently} cool to frost now.
e.zh: 蛋糕已经凉得差不多,可以涂糖霜了。

e.en: She was {sufficiently} fluent to handle the interview.
e.zh: 她流利得足以应付这次面试。

sufficing.t: v. 足够（suffice 的现在分词）

e.en: With one meal {sufficing} per day, he saved money.
e.zh: 每天一顿饭就够吃,他因此省下了钱。

e.en: A polite nod, {sufficing} as a greeting, kept things brief.
e.zh: 礼貌地点头作为问候,事情就简短带过了。

suffix.t:
n. 后缀
v. 添加后缀

e.en: Add the {suffix} '-ing' to form the present participle.
e.zh: 加上后缀 '-ing' 构成现在分词。

e.en: Every filename should end with the correct {suffix}.
e.zh: 每个文件名都应以正确的后缀结尾。

e.en: English {suffixes} like '-ness' often turn adjectives into nouns.
e.zh: 英语后缀如 '-ness' 常把形容词变成名词。

e.en: The script renames files by stripping their {suffixes}.
e.zh: 该脚本通过去掉文件后缀来重命名文件。

e.en: Plastic bags can {suffocate} small children if left around.
e.zh: 如果塑料袋随意乱放,可能会闷死小孩。

e.en: Strict rules can {suffocate} creativity in the workplace.
e.zh: 严苛的规定会扼杀职场上的创造力。

suffocating.t: adj. 令人窒息的；闷热的

e.en: The {suffocating} heat made it hard to sleep.
e.zh: 令人窒息的高温让人难以入睡。

e.en: She found her parents' constant attention {suffocating}.
e.zh: 她觉得父母无时无刻的关注令人窒息。

e.en: The victim died from {suffocation} caused by smoke.
e.zh: 受害者因烟雾导致窒息而死。

e.en: The crowded subway gave him a feeling of {suffocation}.
e.zh: 拥挤的地铁让他有种窒息的感觉。

e.en: They spent the weekend in a quiet {Suffolk} village.
e.zh: 他们在一个安静的萨福克村庄度过了周末。

e.en: {Suffolk} is famous for its picturesque coastal towns.
e.zh: 萨福克郡以风景如画的海滨小镇闻名。

e.en: The diocese appointed a new {suffragan} bishop last month.
e.zh: 该教区上个月任命了一位新的副主教。

e.en: A {suffragan} assists the senior bishop with regional duties.
e.zh: 副主教协助主教处理地区事务。

e.en: Women fought for decades to win the right of {suffrage}.
e.zh: 女性奋斗了几十年才争得选举权。

e.en: Universal {suffrage} is a cornerstone of modern democracy.
e.zh: 普选权是现代民主的基石。

suffragette.t: n. (20世纪初) 争取妇女选举权者

e.en: Her grandmother was a famous {suffragette} in the 1910s.
e.zh: 她的祖母是1910年代著名的妇女参政论者。

e.en: The film tells the story of a brave {suffragette}.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了一位勇敢的妇女参政者的故事。

suffragist.t: n. 主张扩大选举权者

e.en: The {suffragist} movement gradually won broader public support.
e.zh: 争取选举权运动逐渐赢得了更广泛的公众支持。

e.en: She admired her great-aunt, a tireless {suffragist}.
e.zh: 她敬佩她那位为选举权奔走不息的姑婆。

e.en: Soft lamps {suffuse} the room with a warm glow.
e.zh: 柔和的灯光让房间充满了温暖的光晕。

e.en: Joy seemed to {suffuse} her entire face.
e.zh: 喜悦似乎洋溢在她整张脸上。

suffused.t: v. 弥漫（suffuse 的过去式）

e.en: The sunset {suffused} the sky with deep orange.
e.zh: 夕阳把天空染成了浓郁的橙色。

e.en: Her cheeks were {suffused} with a sudden blush.
e.zh: 她的脸颊突然泛起一片红晕。

e.en: Morning light {suffuses} the kitchen through the gauze curtains.
e.zh: 晨光透过纱帘洒满整个厨房。

e.en: A quiet sadness {suffuses} every page of the novel.
e.zh: 一种淡淡的忧伤弥漫在小说的每一页。

suffusing.t: v. 弥漫（suffuse 的现在分词）

e.en: The candlelight was {suffusing} the room with calm.
e.zh: 烛光让整个房间弥漫着宁静。

e.en: Pride was {suffusing} her face as she spoke.
e.zh: 她说话时,脸上洋溢着自豪。

e.en: I usually take my coffee without {sugar}.
e.zh: 我喝咖啡通常不加糖。

e.en: Too much {sugar} in your diet harms your teeth.
e.zh: 饮食中糖分过多会损害牙齿。

e.en: Brazil produces huge amounts of {sugarcane} each year.
e.zh: 巴西每年生产大量甘蔗。

e.en: Workers were cutting {sugarcane} under the burning sun.
e.zh: 工人们在烈日下砍着甘蔗。

sugared.t: adj. 加糖的；甜言蜜语的

e.en: She offered me a bowl of {sugared} almonds.
e.zh: 她递给我一碗裹糖的杏仁。

e.en: His {sugared} words could not hide his real intent.
e.zh: 他甜言蜜语掩盖不了真实的意图。

e.en: He chews {sugarless} gum to protect his teeth.
e.zh: 他嚼无糖口香糖来保护牙齿。

e.en: The cafe now offers a {sugarless} version of every drink.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆现在每种饮品都提供无糖版本。

e.en: The children dreamed of a {sugarplum} on Christmas Eve.
e.zh: 孩子们在平安夜梦到了一颗糖梅。

e.en: She danced the role of the {Sugarplum} Fairy beautifully.
e.zh: 她把糖梅仙子这个角色跳得十分动人。

e.en: Doctors warn against drinking too many {sugary} sodas.
e.zh: 医生警告不要喝太多含糖汽水。

e.en: His {sugary} compliments made everyone feel uneasy.
e.zh: 他过分甜腻的恭维让大家感到不自在。

suggest.t:
v. 建议；提议
v. 暗示

e.en: Can you {suggest} a good restaurant near the hotel?
e.zh: 你能推荐一家酒店附近的好餐厅吗?

e.en: The data {suggest} that sales will rise next quarter.
e.zh: 数据显示下一季度销售额将会上升。

suggested.t:
v. 建议（suggest 的过去式）
adj. 推荐的

e.en: My friend {suggested} watching a movie tonight.
e.zh: 朋友建议今晚去看电影。

e.en: Her tired eyes {suggested} she hadn't slept well.
e.zh: 她疲惫的眼神显示她没睡好。

e.en: Children's high {suggestibility} makes advertising especially effective on them.
e.zh: 儿童极易受暗示的特点使广告对他们格外有效。

e.en: The witness's {suggestibility} weakened her testimony in court.
e.zh: 该证人易受暗示削弱了她在法庭上的证词。

e.en: Young viewers are highly {suggestible} to online trends.
e.zh: 年轻观众非常容易受到网络潮流的影响。

e.en: Tired people tend to be more {suggestible} than usual.
e.zh: 疲劳的人往往比平时更容易受暗示。

suggesting.t: v. 建议；暗示（suggest 的现在分词）

e.en: She raised an eyebrow, {suggesting} she didn't believe him.
e.zh: 她挑了挑眉,暗示她不相信他。

e.en: He kept {suggesting} that we leave the party early.
e.zh: 他不停地建议我们早点离开聚会。

e.en: Thanks for the {suggestion}—I'll try that restaurant tonight.
e.zh: 谢谢你的建议,我今晚去试试那家餐厅。

e.en: There's not even a {suggestion} of wind today.
e.zh: 今天连一丝风的迹象都没有。

e.en: Please send any {suggestions} for improvement to the team.
e.zh: 请把任何改进建议发给团队。

e.en: The app shows song {suggestions} based on your taste.
e.zh: 这款应用会根据你的口味推荐歌曲。

suggestive.t: adj. 暗示的；引人联想的

e.en: The painting's colors are {suggestive} of a stormy sea.
e.zh: 画作的色调让人联想到风暴中的大海。

e.en: The platform removed posts containing {suggestive} content.
e.zh: 平台删除了含有暗示性内容的帖子。

suggestively.t: adv. 暗示地；含沙射影地

e.en: He raised his eyebrows {suggestively} at the punchline.
e.zh: 他在抖包袱时意味深长地挑了挑眉。

e.en: The menu was named {suggestively} to spark curiosity.
e.zh: 菜单的命名颇具暗示性,以激起好奇。

e.en: The film was banned for its {suggestiveness} and crude language.
e.zh: 这部电影因其暗示性内容和粗俗语言被禁。

e.en: Critics praised the {suggestiveness} of the poem's imagery.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这首诗意象的丰富暗示性。

suggests.t: v. 建议；表明（第三人称单数）

e.en: Her smile {suggests} she already knows the answer.
e.zh: 她的微笑暗示她早已知道答案。

e.en: Recent research {suggests} a strong link between sleep and memory.
e.zh: 近期研究表明睡眠与记忆之间有密切联系。

suicidal.t: adj. 想自杀的；自取灭亡的

e.en: The hotline supports people having {suicidal} thoughts.
e.zh: 该热线为有自杀念头的人提供帮助。

e.en: Investing all his savings in one stock was {suicidal}.
e.zh: 把全部积蓄都投到一只股票上简直是自杀行为。

e.en: The startup's pricing was {suicidally} low for the market.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的定价低得简直是自寻死路。

e.en: He drove {suicidally} fast on the mountain road.
e.zh: 他在山路上开得快得简直在玩命。

suicide.t:
n. 自杀
v. 自杀

e.en: The hotline offers help to people considering {suicide}.
e.zh: 该热线为有自杀念头的人提供帮助。

e.en: Launching that product now would be commercial {suicide}.
e.zh: 现在推出那款产品无异于商业自杀。

e.en: Researchers study why teen {suicides} have risen recently.
e.zh: 研究人员探究为何近期青少年自杀率上升。

e.en: Early intervention programs aim to prevent {suicides}.
e.zh: 早期干预项目旨在预防自杀事件。

suing.t: v. 控告；起诉（sue 的现在分词）

e.en: The customer is {suing} the company for false advertising.
e.zh: 那位顾客正在因虚假广告起诉该公司。

e.en: Several artists are {suing} the AI startup over copyright.
e.zh: 多位艺术家正就版权问题起诉那家AI初创公司。

suis.t: (罕用) 法语 être 的第一人称变位

e.en: In French class she learned to say 'je {suis}' for 'I am'.
e.zh: 在法语课上她学会用'je suis'表达'我是'。

e.en: The phrase 'je {suis}' appears constantly in beginner French textbooks.
e.zh: 'je suis'这个短语在法语初学者教材中频繁出现。

e.en: Credit {Suisse} was acquired by UBS in a historic deal.
e.zh: 瑞士信贷在一笔历史性交易中被瑞银收购。

e.en: He flew to Geneva for a meeting at a {Suisse} bank.
e.zh: 他飞往日内瓦,在一家瑞士银行开会。

suit.t:
n. 西装；诉讼
v. 适合

e.en: He wore a navy {suit} to the job interview.
e.zh: 他穿着藏青色西装去面试。

e.en: That schedule doesn't really {suit} my routine.
e.zh: 那个时间安排不太适合我的日常作息。

e.en: They tested the soil's {suitability} for growing grapes.
e.zh: 他们测试了土壤是否适合种植葡萄。

e.en: The interview assesses each candidate's {suitability} for the role.
e.zh: 面试评估每位候选人对该职位的适合度。

e.en: This movie isn't {suitable} for young children.
e.zh: 这部电影不适合幼儿观看。

e.en: We're looking for a {suitable} venue for the wedding.
e.zh: 我们正在寻找一个合适的婚礼场地。

e.en: Please dress {suitably} for the formal dinner.
e.zh: 请为正式晚宴穿着得体。

e.en: The team was {suitably} impressed by the demo.
e.zh: 团队对这次演示留下了恰如其分的好印象。

e.en: She packed her {suitcase} the night before the trip.
e.zh: 她在出行前一晚收拾好了行李箱。

e.en: The airline lost his {suitcase} on the connecting flight.
e.zh: 航空公司在转机航班上把他的行李箱弄丢了。

e.en: We packed three {suitcases} for the family vacation.
e.zh: 我们为家庭度假打包了三个行李箱。

e.en: Heavy {suitcases} crowded the hotel lobby that morning.
e.zh: 那天早上沉重的行李箱挤满了酒店大堂。

e.en: They booked a honeymoon {suite} overlooking the harbor.
e.zh: 他们订了一间俯瞰港口的蜜月套房。

e.en: Microsoft Office is a popular productivity {suite}.
e.zh: 微软Office是流行的办公软件套件。

suited.t:
adj. 适合的
v. 适合（过去式）

e.en: This laptop is {suited} for video editing tasks.
e.zh: 这台笔记本电脑很适合视频剪辑工作。

e.en: He arrived at the meeting {suited} and confident.
e.zh: 他西装革履、自信地出席了会议。

e.en: She bought a two-{suiter} bag for business trips.
e.zh: 她买了一个能装两套西装的旅行袋出差用。

e.en: The leather {suiter} kept his jacket wrinkle-free.
e.zh: 那个皮质西装包让他的外套保持平整。

e.en: The hotel offers luxury {suites} with ocean views.
e.zh: 这家酒店提供带海景的豪华套房。

e.en: Modern software {suites} bundle many useful tools together.
e.zh: 现代软件套件将许多实用工具捆绑在一起。

suiting.t:
n. 西装面料
v. 适合（现在分词）

e.en: The tailor chose fine wool {suiting} for the jacket.
e.zh: 裁缝为这件外套选用了上等羊毛西装料。

e.en: The new role is really {suiting} her personality.
e.zh: 这个新职位非常适合她的性格。

e.en: Her wealthy {suitor} sent flowers every single week.
e.zh: 她那位富有的追求者每周都送花。

e.en: The company rejected the latest takeover {suitor}.
e.zh: 公司拒绝了最新的收购方。

e.en: Several {suitors} competed for the princess's hand.
e.zh: 几位求婚者争相向公主求婚。

e.en: The startup attracted multiple {suitors} from Silicon Valley.
e.zh: 这家初创公司吸引了硅谷多位收购方。

suits.t:
n. 西装（复数）
v. 适合

e.en: He owns three tailored {suits} for client meetings.
e.zh: 他有三套定制西装用于客户会议。

e.en: This schedule {suits} my morning routine perfectly.
e.zh: 这个时间表非常符合我的晨间习惯。

e.en: The brain's central {sulcus} separates motor and sensory areas.
e.zh: 大脑的中央沟将运动区和感觉区分开。

e.en: Anatomists labeled each {sulcus} on the cortex diagram.
e.zh: 解剖学家在大脑皮层图上标出了每条沟。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {sulfa} drug for the infection.
e.zh: 医生开了磺胺类药物治疗感染。

e.en: Some patients have allergic reactions to {sulfa} medications.
e.zh: 有些患者对磺胺类药物过敏。

e.en: This shampoo is free of {sulfate} and parabens.
e.zh: 这款洗发水不含硫酸盐和防腐剂。

e.en: Copper {sulfate} is often used to kill algae.
e.zh: 硫酸铜常被用来杀灭藻类。

e.en: Hydrogen {sulfide} smells strongly like rotten eggs.
e.zh: 硫化氢有浓烈的臭鸡蛋气味。

e.en: The mine produces large amounts of zinc {sulfide}.
e.zh: 这座矿山出产大量硫化锌。

e.en: Many wines contain {sulfite} as a preservative.
e.zh: 许多葡萄酒含有亚硫酸盐作为防腐剂。

e.en: She gets headaches from foods with added {sulfite}.
e.zh: 她吃了添加亚硫酸盐的食物会头痛。

e.en: The volcano released clouds of {sulfur} into the air.
e.zh: 火山向空中释放出大量硫磺。

e.en: {Sulfur} is essential for many industrial chemical processes.
e.zh: 硫对许多工业化学过程至关重要。

e.en: Car batteries contain dilute {sulfuric} acid inside them.
e.zh: 汽车电池里含有稀释的硫酸。

e.en: {Sulfuric} acid burned a hole through the cloth.
e.zh: 硫酸在布上烧出了一个洞。

e.en: A {sulfurous} smell drifted from the hot springs.
e.zh: 温泉飘来一阵硫磺气味。

e.en: The factory emitted thick {sulfurous} fumes all day.
e.zh: 工厂整天排放着浓浓的硫磺烟雾。

e.en: The lab catalogs different {sulfurs} for industrial research.
e.zh: 实验室为工业研究分类了多种硫品种。

e.en: Various {sulfurs} are used in agricultural fungicides.
e.zh: 多种硫制剂被用于农业杀菌剂。

sulk.t:
v. 生闷气；愠怒
n. 愠怒

e.en: Don't {sulk} just because you lost the game.
e.zh: 别因为输了比赛就生闷气。

e.en: He went off to {sulk} in his bedroom.
e.zh: 他跑到卧室里生闷气去了。

sulkily.t: adv. 愠怒地；闷闷不乐地

e.en: The child answered {sulkily} when asked about homework.
e.zh: 被问到作业时,孩子赌气地回答。

e.en: She stared {sulkily} out the rainy window.
e.zh: 她闷闷不乐地望着雨中的窗外。

e.en: He's been {sulking} ever since his promotion was denied.
e.zh: 自从晋升被拒后,他就一直在闹情绪。

e.en: Stop {sulking} and come help with the dishes.
e.zh: 别闹脾气了,过来帮忙洗碗。

e.en: The teenager became {sulky} when his phone was confiscated.
e.zh: 手机被没收后,这个少年变得闷闷不乐。

e.en: A {sulky} silence filled the dinner table.
e.zh: 餐桌上弥漫着一种赌气的沉默。

e.en: She gave him a {sullen} look and left.
e.zh: 她阴沉地瞥了他一眼便离开了。

e.en: The {sullen} sky promised rain by evening.
e.zh: 阴沉的天空预示着傍晚会下雨。

e.en: He nodded {sullenly} and refused to say more.
e.zh: 他阴郁地点了点头,不肯再多说。

e.en: The boy ate his vegetables {sullenly} at dinner.
e.zh: 那男孩晚餐时阴沉地吃着蔬菜。

e.en: His {sullenness} cast a shadow over the party.
e.zh: 他的阴郁情绪给聚会蒙上了一层阴影。

e.en: The coach grew tired of the player's {sullenness}.
e.zh: 教练对那名球员的阴沉态度感到厌烦。

sullied.t: v. 玷污；弄脏（sully 的过去式）

e.en: The scandal {sullied} the politician's once-spotless reputation.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻玷污了这位政客原本无瑕的声誉。

e.en: Mud {sullied} her white wedding dress completely.
e.zh: 泥巴把她的白色婚纱完全弄脏了。

e.en: He refused to {sully} his name with bribery.
e.zh: 他拒绝因受贿而玷污自己的名声。

e.en: Don't let one mistake {sully} years of hard work.
e.zh: 别让一个错误毁掉多年的努力。

sulphasalazine.t: n. 柳氮磺吡啶（一种药物）

e.en: The doctor prescribed {sulphasalazine} for her ulcerative colitis.
e.zh: 医生为她的溃疡性结肠炎开了柳氮磺胺吡啶。

e.en: {Sulphasalazine} can help reduce joint inflammation in arthritis.
e.zh: 柳氮磺胺吡啶有助于减轻关节炎的关节炎症。

e.en: Magnesium {sulphate} is commonly known as Epsom salt.
e.zh: 硫酸镁通常被称为泻盐。

e.en: Look for shampoos without {sulphate} for sensitive scalps.
e.zh: 敏感头皮可选择不含硫酸盐的洗发水。

e.en: Hydrogen {sulphide} gas is dangerous in enclosed spaces.
e.zh: 硫化氢气体在密闭空间中很危险。

e.en: The ore is rich in iron {sulphide} deposits.
e.zh: 这种矿石富含硫化铁矿藏。

e.en: Volcanic vents released yellow {sulphur} onto the rocks.
e.zh: 火山口在岩石上喷出了黄色的硫磺。

e.en: {Sulphur} is widely used in matches and gunpowder.
e.zh: 硫磺广泛用于火柴和火药。

e.en: {Sulphuric} acid is a key industrial chemical worldwide.
e.zh: 硫酸是全球重要的工业化学品。

e.en: Always wear gloves when handling {sulphuric} acid solutions.
e.zh: 处理硫酸溶液时务必戴手套。

e.en: A {sulphurous} stench rose from the swamp at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分,沼泽散发出一股硫磺臭味。

e.en: Old factories spewed {sulphurous} smoke into the city.
e.zh: 老旧工厂向城市排放着含硫的烟雾。

e.en: The chemist organized various {sulphurs} on the lab shelf.
e.zh: 化学家把各种硫品在实验室架上分类摆好。

e.en: Different {sulphurs} react differently with heated metal.
e.zh: 不同的硫品与加热的金属反应各异。

sultan.t: n. 苏丹（伊斯兰国家君主）

e.en: The {sultan} ruled the kingdom for forty years.
e.zh: 这位苏丹统治王国长达四十年。

e.en: Tourists visited the {sultan}'s magnificent palace in Istanbul.
e.zh: 游客们参观了伊斯坦布尔苏丹宏伟的宫殿。

sultana.t: n. 无籽葡萄干；苏丹王后

e.en: She sprinkled {sultana} raisins over her morning oatmeal.
e.zh: 她在早晨的燕麦粥上撒了无核小葡萄干。

e.en: The {sultana} hosted a lavish reception at the palace.
e.zh: 苏丹王妃在宫中举办了一场盛大的招待会。

sultanate.t: n. 苏丹国；苏丹的统治

e.en: Oman is the only remaining {sultanate} in the region.
e.zh: 阿曼是该地区仅存的苏丹国。

e.en: The historic {sultanate} controlled trade across the Indian Ocean.
e.zh: 这个历史悠久的苏丹国控制着印度洋的贸易。

sultry.t: adj. 闷热的；（女子）性感撩人的

e.en: The {sultry} August afternoon made everyone feel drowsy.
e.zh: 闷热的八月午后让每个人都昏昏欲睡。

e.en: She sang the ballad in a {sultry} voice.
e.zh: 她用性感低沉的嗓音唱了那首民谣。

sum.t:
n. 总和；金额
v. 总结；求和

e.en: Middle Eastern dishes often use ground {sumac} for flavor.
e.zh: 中东菜肴常用磨碎的漆树果调味。

e.en: The {sumac} bush turned bright red in autumn.
e.zh: 漆树丛在秋天变得火红。

sumatra.t: n. 苏门答腊（印尼岛屿）

e.en: We trekked through the rainforests of {Sumatra} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们徒步穿越了苏门答腊的雨林。

e.en: {Sumatra} is home to some of the rarest tigers on Earth.
e.zh: 苏门答腊岛栖息着地球上最稀有的一些虎种。

sumatran.t:
adj. 苏门答腊的
n. 苏门答腊人

e.en: The zoo welcomed a newborn {Sumatran} tiger cub last week.
e.zh: 上周动物园迎来了一只新出生的苏门答腊虎幼崽。

e.en: He brews a rich, earthy {Sumatran} coffee every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上冲一杯醇厚带泥土香的苏门答腊咖啡。

sumerian.t:
adj. 苏美尔的
n. 苏美尔人/语

e.en: The {Sumerian} civilization invented one of the earliest writing systems.
e.zh: 苏美尔文明发明了最早的书写系统之一。

e.en: Scholars are still deciphering ancient {Sumerian} clay tablets.
e.zh: 学者们仍在破译古代苏美尔的泥板文书。

sumitomo.t: n. 住友（日本企业集团）

e.en: She accepted a position at {Sumitomo} Bank in Tokyo.
e.zh: 她接受了东京住友银行的一份工作。

e.en: {Sumitomo} reported strong earnings for the third quarter.
e.zh: 住友公布了强劲的第三季度财报。

summa.t: n. 大全；总论（常指学术著作）

e.en: She graduated {summa} cum laude from Harvard last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天以最优等成绩从哈佛毕业。

e.en: Aquinas's {Summa} Theologica remains a cornerstone of theology.
e.zh: 阿奎那的《神学大全》至今仍是神学的基石。

summaries.t: n. 摘要；概要（summary 的复数）

e.en: The app sends daily news {summaries} to your inbox.
e.zh: 这款应用每天会把新闻摘要发送到你的邮箱。

e.en: Please attach the meeting {summaries} from last quarter.
e.zh: 请附上上一季度的会议纪要。

e.en: The proposal was {summarily} rejected by the board.
e.zh: 该提案被董事会立即驳回。

e.en: He was {summarily} dismissed without any warning.
e.zh: 他在毫无预警的情况下被即刻解雇。

summarise.t: v. 总结；概括（英式拼写）

e.en: Could you {summarise} the report in three bullet points?
e.zh: 你能用三个要点把这份报告概括一下吗?

e.en: The AI can {summarise} long articles in seconds.
e.zh: 这款 AI 能在几秒内总结长篇文章。

summarised.t: v. 总结（summarise 的过去式）

e.en: She {summarised} the meeting in a short email.
e.zh: 她用一封短邮件总结了会议内容。

e.en: The lawyer {summarised} the case before closing arguments.
e.zh: 律师在结案陈词前对案件做了总结。

summarises.t: v. 总结（summarise 第三人称单数）

e.en: This chart {summarises} our sales over the past year.
e.zh: 这张图表概括了我们过去一年的销售情况。

e.en: The opening paragraph {summarises} the article's main argument.
e.zh: 开头一段概括了文章的主要论点。

summarising.t: v. 总结（summarise 的现在分词）

e.en: He spent the afternoon {summarising} the team's research findings.
e.zh: 他花了一下午时间总结团队的研究成果。

e.en: I'm {summarising} the customer feedback for tomorrow's review.
e.zh: 我正在为明天的评审整理客户反馈摘要。

summarization.t: n. 摘要；概括（如AI文本摘要）

e.en: Automatic {summarization} helps users digest long articles quickly.
e.zh: 自动摘要功能帮助用户快速消化长篇文章。

e.en: The AI tool offers {summarization} of meeting transcripts.
e.zh: 该 AI 工具可以对会议记录进行总结。

e.en: Could you {summarize} the report in three bullet points?
e.zh: 你能用三个要点总结一下这份报告吗？

e.en: Let me {summarize} what we discussed in today's meeting.
e.zh: 让我总结一下我们今天会议讨论的内容。

summarized.t: v. 总结（summarize 的过去式）

e.en: She {summarized} the novel in a single paragraph.
e.zh: 她用一段话概括了这本小说。

e.en: The findings are {summarized} in the table below.
e.zh: 研究结果已在下表中加以总结。

summarizes.t: v. 总结（summarize 第三人称单数）

e.en: This chart {summarizes} our quarterly sales figures.
e.zh: 这张图表概括了我们的季度销售数据。

e.en: The abstract {summarizes} the paper's main argument.
e.zh: 摘要概括了这篇论文的主要论点。

summarizing.t: v. 总结（summarize 的现在分词）

e.en: He spent the morning {summarizing} customer feedback.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在总结客户反馈。

e.en: The app is good at {summarizing} long PDFs.
e.zh: 这款应用擅长概括长篇 PDF 文件。

summary.t:
n. 摘要；概要
adj. 简要的；即决的

e.en: Please send me a {summary} of the meeting by tonight.
e.zh: 请在今晚之前给我发一份会议摘要。

e.en: The article includes a brief {summary} at the top.
e.zh: 这篇文章在开头附有简短的内容提要。

e.en: He muttered {summat} under his breath as he left.
e.zh: 他离开时低声咕哝了点什么。

e.en: There's {summat} odd about how this app behaves.
e.zh: 这个应用的表现有点儿怪。

summation.t: n. 求和；总结；（法庭）结案陈词

e.en: In {summation}, the project succeeded beyond expectations.
e.zh: 总而言之，这个项目的成功超出了预期。

e.en: The lawyer's closing {summation} swayed the jury.
e.zh: 律师的结案陈词打动了陪审团。

e.en: Students take a {summative} exam at the end of term.
e.zh: 学生在学期末参加一次总结性考试。

e.en: The teacher gave a {summative} assessment of the project.
e.zh: 老师对该项目做出了总结性的评估。

summed.t: v. 总结；求和（sum 的过去式）

e.en: That tweet {summed} up exactly how I felt.
e.zh: 那条推文完全总结了我的感受。

e.en: She {summed} the column of numbers in seconds.
e.zh: 她几秒钟就把这一列数字加总好了。

e.en: We're planning a road trip this {summer}.
e.zh: 我们计划今年夏天来一次公路旅行。

e.en: The kids love swimming during {summer} break.
e.zh: 孩子们很喜欢在暑假期间游泳。

summerfield.t: n. 萨默菲尔德（地名/姓氏）

e.en: They bought a cottage near {Summerfield} last year.
e.zh: 他们去年在萨默菲尔德附近买了一栋小屋。

e.en: The hike ended at a sunlit {summerfield} of wildflowers.
e.zh: 徒步终点是一片洒满阳光、长满野花的夏日草地。

e.en: We had tea in the garden {summerhouse}.
e.zh: 我们在花园的凉亭里喝了茶。

e.en: Her family rents a {summerhouse} by the lake every July.
e.zh: 她家每年七月都在湖边租一座避暑别墅。

summers.t: n. 夏季（复数）；萨默斯（姓氏）

e.en: He spent his childhood {summers} at his grandparents' farm.
e.zh: 他童年的每个夏天都在祖父母的农场度过。

e.en: Recent {summers} have been hotter than ever recorded.
e.zh: 最近几个夏天比以往任何记录都更加炎热。

e.en: In {summertime}, the park is full of picnickers.
e.zh: 夏天的时候，公园里到处都是野餐的人。

e.en: Ice cream sales peak during {summertime}.
e.zh: 冰淇淋的销量在夏季达到高峰。

summery.t: adj. 夏日的；适合夏季的

e.en: She wore a light, {summery} dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿着一条轻盈的夏日连衣裙去参加聚会。

e.en: The cafe has a bright, {summery} feel year-round.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆一年四季都有种明亮的夏日氛围。

summing.t: v. 求和；汇总（sum 的现在分词）

e.en: "Worth every penny," she said, {summing} up the trip.
e.zh: "物超所值，"她总结这次旅行时说。

e.en: The spreadsheet is {summing} the values automatically.
e.zh: 电子表格正在自动求和这些数值。

e.en: They reached the {summit} just before sunrise.
e.zh: 他们在日出前刚好登上了山顶。

e.en: World leaders met at the climate {summit} in Geneva.
e.zh: 世界各国领导人齐聚日内瓦出席气候峰会。

summiteer.t: n. 峰会与会者；登顶者

e.en: Every {summiteer} carried oxygen on the final ascent.
e.zh: 每位登顶者在最后冲顶时都背着氧气瓶。

e.en: The veteran {summiteer} has climbed all fourteen 8000-meter peaks.
e.zh: 这位资深登顶者已经登上了所有十四座八千米高峰。

summitry.t: n. 峰会外交；首脑会晤

e.en: Cold War {summitry} often produced more symbolism than substance.
e.zh: 冷战时期的首脑外交往往象征意义大于实质成果。

e.en: Modern diplomacy still relies heavily on personal {summitry}.
e.zh: 现代外交仍然在很大程度上依赖首脑会晤。

e.en: The Alps have several {summits} above 4,000 meters.
e.zh: 阿尔卑斯山有几座海拔超过四千米的山峰。

e.en: G20 {summits} are held annually in different countries.
e.zh: G20 峰会每年在不同国家举行。

summon.t:
v. 召唤；传唤
n. 召集

e.en: She tried to {summon} the courage to speak up.
e.zh: 她努力鼓起勇气开口说话。

e.en: You can {summon} a ride in seconds with this app.
e.zh: 用这款应用几秒钟就能叫到一辆车。

summoning.t:
v. 召唤（summon 的现在分词）
n. 召唤

e.en: He stood there, {summoning} the nerve to apologize.
e.zh: 他站在那里，鼓起勇气想要道歉。

e.en: The court issued a letter {summoning} her as a witness.
e.zh: 法院发出了传唤她出庭作证的文书。

summons.t:
n. 传票；传唤
v. 传唤出庭

e.en: He received a court {summons} in the mail today.
e.zh: 他今天收到了一份邮寄来的法庭传票。

e.en: The boss sent a {summons} for an urgent meeting.
e.zh: 老板发出召集令，要求紧急开会。

sumo.t: n. 相扑（日本摔跤运动）

e.en: We watched a {sumo} match on TV in Tokyo.
e.zh: 我们在东京时通过电视看了一场相扑比赛。

e.en: Professional {sumo} wrestlers follow strict diets and routines.
e.zh: 职业相扑选手都遵循严格的饮食和训练规律。

e.en: The basement {sump} pump kicked on during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间地下室的集水坑泵自动启动了。

e.en: Oil collects in the engine's {sump} at the bottom.
e.zh: 机油会汇集到发动机底部的油底壳里。

sumpter.t: n. 驮运货物的牲口（罕用）

e.en: The medieval traveler led a tired {sumpter} up the path.
e.zh: 那位中世纪旅人牵着一匹疲惫的驮马走上小径。

e.en: Each {sumpter} carried provisions for the long journey.
e.zh: 每匹驮马都驮着这趟长途旅行所需的物资。

sumptuary.t: adj. 限制消费的；节俭法的

e.en: Medieval {sumptuary} laws restricted what commoners could wear.
e.zh: 中世纪的禁奢法规限制了平民可以穿戴的服饰。

e.en: The new tax acts as a kind of {sumptuary} measure.
e.zh: 这项新税相当于一种限制奢侈消费的措施。

e.en: They served a {sumptuous} dinner at the wedding.
e.zh: 他们在婚礼上提供了一顿豪华的晚宴。

e.en: The hotel lobby was decorated in {sumptuous} velvet and gold.
e.zh: 酒店大堂装饰着华丽的天鹅绒与金饰。

e.en: The penthouse was {sumptuously} furnished with antiques.
e.zh: 这间顶层公寓用古董豪华地布置了一番。

e.en: Guests dined {sumptuously} on lobster and champagne.
e.zh: 宾客们享用了龙虾和香槟，吃得极为丰盛。

sums.t:
n. 总和；金额
v. 总计（sum 的三单）

e.en: That review {sums} up my feelings about the movie.
e.zh: 那篇评论完全总结了我对这部电影的感受。

e.en: Large {sums} of money were transferred overnight.
e.zh: 大笔款项在一夜之间被转走了。

sun.t:
n. 太阳；阳光
v. 晒太阳

e.en: Tourists love to {sunbathe} on the white sand beach.
e.zh: 游客们喜欢在白沙滩上晒日光浴。

e.en: It's too hot to {sunbathe} this afternoon.
e.zh: 今天下午太热了，不适合晒日光浴。

e.en: They {sunbathed} by the pool all afternoon.
e.zh: 他们整个下午都在泳池边晒太阳。

e.en: She {sunbathed} on the deck while reading her novel.
e.zh: 她一边在甲板上晒太阳一边读小说。

e.en: A lone {sunbather} stretched out on the empty beach.
e.zh: 一位独自晒太阳的人在空旷的海滩上躺着。

e.en: Every {sunbather} should wear strong sunscreen.
e.zh: 每位晒日光浴的人都应该涂上高倍防晒霜。

e.en: My cat {sunbathes} by the window every morning.
e.zh: 我家的猫每天早上都在窗边晒太阳。

e.en: She {sunbathes} on the rooftop whenever it's warm.
e.zh: 只要天气暖和，她就在屋顶上晒日光浴。

sunbathing.t:
n. 日光浴
v. 晒日光浴

e.en: Doctors warn against {sunbathing} without sunscreen.
e.zh: 医生警告不要在不涂防晒霜的情况下晒日光浴。

e.en: They spent the holiday {sunbathing} on a Greek island.
e.zh: 他们在希腊一座岛上晒着日光浴度过了假期。

e.en: A single {sunbeam} broke through the clouds.
e.zh: 一缕阳光穿透了云层。

e.en: The kitten chased a {sunbeam} across the floor.
e.zh: 小猫追着地板上的一束阳光跑来跑去。

e.en: {Sunbeams} streamed through the stained-glass windows.
e.zh: 阳光透过彩色玻璃窗洒了进来。

e.en: Dust danced in the {sunbeams} above the old desk.
e.zh: 灰尘在旧书桌上方的光束中翩翩起舞。

e.en: She booked a {sunbed} session before her beach vacation.
e.zh: 她在去海边度假前预约了一次日晒床。

e.en: Doctors warn that frequent {sunbed} use raises skin cancer risk.
e.zh: 医生警告说频繁使用日晒床会增加皮肤癌风险。

sunbelt.t: n. 阳光地带（美国南部）

e.en: Many retirees are moving to {Sunbelt} states like Florida and Arizona.
e.zh: 许多退休人员正搬往佛罗里达和亚利桑那等阳光地带各州。

e.en: The {Sunbelt} has seen rapid population growth over recent decades.
e.zh: 近几十年阳光地带的人口增长十分迅速。

e.en: A tiny {sunbird} hovered near the red flowers in the garden.
e.zh: 一只小太阳鸟在花园的红花旁悬停。

e.en: The male {sunbird} flashes brilliant iridescent feathers in sunlight.
e.zh: 雄性太阳鸟在阳光下展示出绚丽的虹彩羽毛。

e.en: Don't forget to apply {sunblock} before going to the beach.
e.zh: 去海滩前别忘了涂防晒霜。

e.en: This {sunblock} is reef-safe and won't harm coral.
e.zh: 这款防晒霜对珊瑚礁友好，不会伤害珊瑚。

sunburn.t:
n. 晒伤
v. 晒伤皮肤

e.en: I got a painful {sunburn} after hiking without a hat.
e.zh: 我没戴帽子去徒步，结果晒伤得很严重。

e.en: Aloe vera gel can soothe a mild {sunburn} quickly.
e.zh: 芦荟胶可以快速缓解轻度的晒伤。

e.en: His shoulders were badly {sunburned} after a day on the boat.
e.zh: 在船上待了一天后，他的肩膀晒得很厉害。

e.en: Tourists often arrive home {sunburned} from tropical vacations.
e.zh: 游客从热带度假回来常常被晒得通红。

e.en: Her nose looked {sunburnt} after the long picnic in the park.
e.zh: 在公园里野餐了很久后，她的鼻子被晒红了。

e.en: The {sunburnt} farmer wiped sweat from his weathered forehead.
e.zh: 那位被晒得黝黑的农夫擦了擦饱经风霜的额头上的汗。

sunburst.t: n. 突现的阳光；放射状图案

e.en: A {sunburst} broke through the clouds after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，阳光从云层中倾泻而下。

e.en: The mirror has a beautiful gold {sunburst} frame.
e.zh: 这面镜子有一个漂亮的金色放射状边框。

e.en: We're driving out to {Sunbury} for the weekend music festival.
e.zh: 我们这周末要开车去森伯里参加音乐节。

e.en: {Sunbury} sits along the Thames just west of London.
e.zh: 森伯里位于伦敦以西的泰晤士河沿岸。

e.en: I ordered a hot fudge {sundae} with extra whipped cream.
e.zh: 我点了一份加多奶油的热巧克力圣代。

e.en: The diner is famous for its giant banana split {sundae}.
e.zh: 这家餐厅以巨型香蕉船圣代而闻名。

sundance.t: n. 圣丹斯（电影节/人名）

e.en: The indie film premiered at the {Sundance} Film Festival this year.
e.zh: 这部独立电影今年在圣丹斯电影节首映。

e.en: Winning a prize at {Sundance} can launch a director's career.
e.zh: 在圣丹斯电影节获奖可以开启一位导演的职业生涯。

e.en: We have brunch with friends every {Sunday} morning.
e.zh: 我们每个星期日早上都和朋友一起吃早午餐。

e.en: The shop is closed on {Sunday} for the holiday.
e.zh: 这家店周日因假期休息。

sundays.t: n. 每周日；星期日（复数）

e.en: On {Sundays} I usually sleep in until ten.
e.zh: 星期天我通常会睡到十点。

e.en: The market only opens on {Sundays} and Wednesdays.
e.zh: 这个市场只在周日和周三开放。

e.en: Guests can relax on the {sundeck} overlooking the pool.
e.zh: 客人可以在俯瞰泳池的日光甲板上放松。

e.en: She read her book on the cruise ship's {sundeck}.
e.zh: 她在游轮的日光甲板上看书。

sunder.t: v. 分开；分离（文学用语）

e.en: Nothing could {sunder} the bond between the twin sisters.
e.zh: 没有什么能割断这对双胞胎姐妹之间的纽带。

e.en: The earthquake threatened to {sunder} the old stone bridge.
e.zh: 地震险些将那座古老的石桥震断。

e.en: He grew up in {Sunderland} before moving to London.
e.zh: 他在桑德兰长大,后来搬到了伦敦。

e.en: {Sunderland} drew one-all against Newcastle last weekend.
e.zh: 桑德兰队上周末与纽卡斯尔一比一战平。

e.en: The {sundew} traps insects with sticky droplets on its leaves.
e.zh: 茅膏菜用叶子上的黏液滴困住昆虫。

e.en: We spotted a tiny {sundew} growing in the bog.
e.zh: 我们在沼泽里发现了一株小小的茅膏菜。

e.en: An old {sundial} stands in the center of the garden.
e.zh: 花园中央矗立着一个古老的日晷。

e.en: The {sundial} showed it was nearly three in the afternoon.
e.zh: 日晷显示快到下午三点了。

e.en: Ancient {sundials} were used long before mechanical clocks existed.
e.zh: 在机械钟出现之前,古人就已使用日晷。

e.en: The museum displays several beautifully carved bronze {sundials}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几座雕刻精美的青铜日晷。

e.en: The hikers planned to reach camp before {sundown}.
e.zh: 徒步者打算在日落前到达营地。

e.en: At {sundown} the desert turns shades of orange and pink.
e.zh: 日落时分,沙漠染上了橙色和粉色。

e.en: She wore a yellow {sundress} to the beach picnic.
e.zh: 她穿着一条黄色的吊带连衣裙去海滩野餐。

e.en: This light cotton {sundress} is perfect for hot weather.
e.zh: 这条轻薄的棉质背心裙非常适合炎热天气。

sundry.t: adj. 各种各样的；杂项的

e.en: The drawer was filled with {sundry} items like keys and coins.
e.zh: 抽屉里装着钥匙、硬币等各种杂物。

e.en: He chatted about {sundry} topics throughout the meeting.
e.zh: 整场会议他都在闲聊各种杂事。

e.en: A massive {sunfish} drifted lazily near the boat.
e.zh: 一条巨大的翻车鱼懒洋洋地漂在船边。

e.en: Divers spotted a {sunfish} basking near the surface.
e.zh: 潜水员发现一条翻车鱼在水面附近晒太阳。

e.en: A single tall {sunflower} bloomed at the edge of the field.
e.zh: 田边开着一株高高的向日葵。

e.en: She painted a vibrant {sunflower} for her grandmother.
e.zh: 她为奶奶画了一朵鲜艳的向日葵。

e.en: Rows of {sunflowers} stretched across the Tuscan countryside.
e.zh: 一排排向日葵在托斯卡纳的乡间延绵不绝。

e.en: Bees buzzed happily around the bright yellow {sunflowers}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂在鲜黄的向日葵周围嗡嗡欢飞。

sung.t: v. 唱（sing 的过去分词）

e.en: That lullaby has been {sung} to children for generations.
e.zh: 这首摇篮曲已经传唱了好几代人。

e.en: The anthem was {sung} beautifully before the match.
e.zh: 比赛前国歌被深情地唱响。

sunglass.t: n. 太阳镜（单只）；聚光镜

e.en: He cracked the {sunglass} lens when he dropped them.
e.zh: 他把太阳镜摔了一下,镜片裂了。

e.en: The store has a wide {sunglass} display by the entrance.
e.zh: 店铺入口处有一排太阳镜展柜。

e.en: Don't forget your {sunglasses} — it's really bright today.
e.zh: 别忘了带太阳镜,今天阳光特别强。

e.en: She bought polarized {sunglasses} for the road trip.
e.zh: 她为公路旅行买了一副偏光太阳镜。

e.en: The toddler refused to wear her floppy {sunhat}.
e.zh: 那个小女孩不肯戴她的软边遮阳帽。

e.en: Pack a wide-brimmed {sunhat} for the desert tour.
e.zh: 沙漠之旅请带上一顶宽边遮阳帽。

sunk.t:
v. 沉没（sink 的过去分词）
adj. 下陷的

e.en: The ship had {sunk} long before rescuers arrived.
e.zh: 在救援人员赶到之前,那艘船早已沉没。

e.en: His heart {sunk} when he saw the exam results.
e.zh: 看到考试成绩,他的心一下子沉了下去。

e.en: Divers explored the {sunken} ship off the coast of Florida.
e.zh: 潜水员们探访了佛罗里达海岸附近的沉船。

e.en: After the long flight, his eyes looked tired and {sunken}.
e.zh: 长途飞行后,他的双眼疲倦而凹陷。

e.en: The {sunless} apartment felt gloomy all year round.
e.zh: 这间不见阳光的公寓一年到头都很阴沉。

e.en: She prefers {sunless} tanning lotions to actual sunbathing.
e.zh: 比起真正晒太阳,她更喜欢用免晒美黑乳液。

e.en: Bright {sunlight} streamed through the kitchen window.
e.zh: 明亮的阳光透过厨房窗户洒了进来。

e.en: Plants need {sunlight} to make their own food.
e.zh: 植物需要阳光来制造养分。

sunlights.t: n. 阳光（sunlight 的复数，罕用）

e.en: The salon offers subtle {sunlights} to brighten dark hair.
e.zh: 这家美发店提供低调的浅色挑染来提亮深色发。

e.en: She booked an appointment for {sunlights} before her vacation.
e.zh: 度假前她预约了做浅色挑染。

sunlit.t: adj. 阳光照耀的；被日光照亮的

e.en: They had lunch on a {sunlit} terrace by the river.
e.zh: 他们在河边洒满阳光的露台上吃了午饭。

e.en: The cat curled up on the {sunlit} windowsill.
e.zh: 那只猫蜷在洒满阳光的窗台上。

sunni.t:
n. 逊尼派（伊斯兰教）
adj. 逊尼派的

e.en: Most of the country's population follows {Sunni} Islam.
e.zh: 该国大多数人口信奉逊尼派伊斯兰教。

e.en: The mosque welcomes both {Sunni} and Shia worshippers.
e.zh: 这座清真寺欢迎逊尼派和什叶派信众前来礼拜。

sunny.t: adj. 晴朗的；阳光充足的

e.en: It's a {sunny} day — perfect for a picnic.
e.zh: 今天阳光明媚,正适合去野餐。

e.en: Her {sunny} personality cheers everyone up at work.
e.zh: 她开朗的性格让办公室里每个人都心情愉快。

e.en: We sip coffee on the {sunporch} every weekend morning.
e.zh: 每个周末早上我们都在阳光房里喝咖啡。

e.en: The old house has a cozy {sunporch} facing the garden.
e.zh: 这栋老房子有一间面朝花园的温馨阳光房。

e.en: We hiked to the summit to watch the {sunrise}.
e.zh: 我们徒步登顶去看日出。

e.en: The bakery opens just before {sunrise} every morning.
e.zh: 这家面包店每天日出前就开门了。

e.en: Some of the most beautiful {sunrises} happen after a storm.
e.zh: 最美的日出往往出现在暴风雨之后。

e.en: He photographs {sunrises} from his balcony every weekend.
e.zh: 他每个周末都从阳台上拍日出照片。

e.en: She opened the {sunroof} to enjoy the warm breeze.
e.zh: 她打开天窗,享受暖暖的微风。

e.en: The new model comes with a panoramic {sunroof}.
e.zh: 新款车型配有全景天窗。

e.en: The {sunroom} is the warmest spot in the house.
e.zh: 阳光房是家里最暖和的地方。

e.en: They added a small {sunroom} off the kitchen last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他们在厨房外加建了一间小阳光房。

e.en: Some distant planets orbit two {suns} at the same time.
e.zh: 有些遥远的行星会同时绕着两颗恒星运转。

e.en: The Phoenix {Suns} won their game last night.
e.zh: 菲尼克斯太阳队昨晚赢了比赛。

e.en: Remember to apply {sunscreen} every two hours at the beach.
e.zh: 在海滩上记得每两小时涂一次防晒霜。

e.en: This {sunscreen} is light and doesn't leave a white cast.
e.zh: 这款防晒霜很轻薄,不会泛白。

e.en: We watched the {sunset} from the rooftop bar.
e.zh: 我们在天台酒吧看了日落。

e.en: The company's old logo is being phased out at {sunset}.
e.zh: 公司的旧标志将在过渡期结束后停用。

e.en: Bali is famous for its breathtaking ocean {sunsets}.
e.zh: 巴厘岛以其令人惊叹的海上日落而闻名。

e.en: She paints {sunsets} using bold pinks and oranges.
e.zh: 她用浓烈的粉色和橙色描绘日落。

e.en: We set up a {sunshade} over the picnic table.
e.zh: 我们在野餐桌上方撑起了一把遮阳伞。

e.en: The car's windshield {sunshade} keeps the interior cool.
e.zh: 车前挡风玻璃的遮阳板让车内保持凉爽。

e.en: After a week of rain, the {sunshine} felt wonderful.
e.zh: 下了一周的雨后,这阳光让人感觉太棒了。

e.en: Her smile brought a little {sunshine} into our day.
e.zh: 她的笑容给我们的一天带来了一点阳光。

sunshiny.t: adj. 阳光充足的；晴朗的

e.en: It was a {sunshiny} morning, perfect for a long walk.
e.zh: 那是个阳光灿烂的早晨,正适合悠闲散步。

e.en: The kids ran outside on the {sunshiny} afternoon.
e.zh: 在那个阳光明媚的下午,孩子们跑到户外去玩。

e.en: Astronomers tracked a huge {sunspot} crossing the sun's surface.
e.zh: 天文学家追踪到一个巨大的太阳黑子掠过日面。

e.en: This {sunspot} could trigger geomagnetic storms on Earth.
e.zh: 这个太阳黑子可能在地球上引发地磁暴。

e.en: Drink plenty of water to avoid {sunstroke} in this heat.
e.zh: 这么热的天要多喝水以防中暑。

e.en: The hiker collapsed from {sunstroke} on the trail.
e.zh: 那名徒步者在小道上中暑晕倒了。

suntan.t:
n. 晒黑的肤色
v. 晒黑皮肤

e.en: She came back from Bali with a deep {suntan}.
e.zh: 她从巴厘岛回来时晒得黝黑。

e.en: Don't forget to pack {suntan} lotion for the beach.
e.zh: 去海滩别忘了带防晒霜。

e.en: He returned from Greece looking healthy and {suntanned}.
e.zh: 他从希腊回来,看上去既健康又晒黑了。

e.en: Her {suntanned} arms still smelled of coconut oil.
e.zh: 她晒黑的手臂上还有椰子油的味道。

e.en: The fishermen head out to sea before {sunup}.
e.zh: 渔民们在日出前就出海了。

e.en: We hiked from {sunup} until late afternoon.
e.zh: 我们从日出一直徒步到傍晚。

e.en: The sailboat tilted {sunward} as the wind picked up.
e.zh: 风势加大时,帆船朝着太阳的方向倾斜。

e.en: Sunflowers always turn their heads {sunward}.
e.zh: 向日葵总是把花盘朝向太阳。

e.en: Buddhist philosophy explores the concept of {sunyata}, or emptiness.
e.zh: 佛教哲学探讨“空性”这一概念。

e.en: The monk gave a lecture on {sunyata} and compassion.
e.zh: 那位僧人讲了一堂关于空性与慈悲的课。

sup.t:
(口语) 怎么样；问候语（what's up 的缩写）
v. 啜饮

super.t:
adj. 极好的；超级的
adv. 非常

e.en: That movie was {super} fun to watch with friends.
e.zh: 那部电影和朋友一起看超有意思的。

e.en: Thanks for your help — you've been {super} kind.
e.zh: 谢谢你的帮忙——你真是太好了。

e.en: There's a {superabundance} of cheap content on streaming platforms.
e.zh: 流媒体平台上充斥着大量廉价内容。

e.en: The harvest brought a {superabundance} of tomatoes this year.
e.zh: 今年收成的西红柿多得吃不完。

superalloy.t: n. 超级合金；高温合金

e.en: Jet engine blades are usually made from a nickel {superalloy}.
e.zh: 喷气发动机叶片通常由镍基高温合金制成。

e.en: The new {superalloy} can withstand extreme temperatures.
e.zh: 这种新型高温合金能承受极端温度。

e.en: The office still relies on a {superannuated} fax machine.
e.zh: 办公室还在用一台过时的传真机。

e.en: Many of his ideas now feel rather {superannuated}.
e.zh: 他的许多想法如今显得相当陈旧过时。

e.en: Australian workers contribute part of their wages to {superannuation}.
e.zh: 澳大利亚的工人会把部分工资缴入退休金账户。

e.en: She checked her {superannuation} balance before retiring.
e.zh: 她在退休前查看了自己的养老金余额。

e.en: The chef prepared a {superb} three-course meal.
e.zh: 那位厨师做了一顿极为出色的三道菜大餐。

e.en: Her performance in the final was absolutely {superb}.
e.zh: 她在决赛中的表现简直出类拔萃。

e.en: The orchestra performed {superbly} at last night's gala concert.
e.zh: 管弦乐团在昨晚的盛大音乐会上表现出色。

e.en: This jacket is {superbly} tailored for cold winter mornings.
e.zh: 这件夹克为寒冷的冬日早晨精心剪裁。

e.en: Doctors worry that overusing antibiotics breeds a deadly {superbug}.
e.zh: 医生们担心滥用抗生素会催生致命的超级细菌。

e.en: Researchers discovered a new {superbug} resistant to most drugs.
e.zh: 研究人员发现了一种对大多数药物耐药的新型超级细菌。

supercalc.t: n. SuperCalc（早期电子表格软件）

e.en: My grandfather still uses {supercalc} on his old DOS computer.
e.zh: 我祖父还在用旧 DOS 电脑跑 SuperCalc。

e.en: Before Excel, accountants relied on {supercalc} for spreadsheets.
e.zh: 在 Excel 出现之前,会计师靠 SuperCalc 做电子表格。

e.en: He saved for years to buy his dream Italian {supercar}.
e.zh: 他攒了多年钱才买下心仪的意大利超级跑车。

e.en: The new electric {supercar} hits 100 km/h in two seconds.
e.zh: 这款新型电动超跑两秒内就能加速到一百公里。

supercede.t: v. 取代；替代（supersede 的异体）

e.en: This new policy will {supercede} all previous office guidelines.
e.zh: 这项新政策将取代之前所有的办公室规定。

e.en: Modern smartphones quickly {supercede} last year's flagship models.
e.zh: 现代智能手机很快就会取代去年的旗舰机型。

e.en: We bought groceries and tires at the Walmart {supercenter}.
e.zh: 我们在沃尔玛超级购物中心买了食品杂货和轮胎。

e.en: The new {supercenter} downtown employs over five hundred locals.
e.zh: 市中心新开的超级商场雇用了五百多名当地员工。

e.en: Coffee can {supercharge} your morning productivity if used wisely.
e.zh: 如果使用得当,咖啡能让你早晨的效率大幅提升。

e.en: AI tools {supercharge} the workflow of modern software developers.
e.zh: AI 工具大大增强了现代软件开发者的工作流程。

supercharged.t: adj. 增压的；动力强劲的

e.en: The startup's {supercharged} growth surprised every Wall Street analyst.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的超速增长让每位华尔街分析师都感到意外。

e.en: His {supercharged} V8 engine roared down the empty highway.
e.zh: 他那台增压 V8 引擎在空旷的高速公路上轰鸣而过。

e.en: Tesla opened a new {supercharger} station near the highway exit.
e.zh: 特斯拉在高速出口附近开设了新的超级充电站。

e.en: The mechanic installed a {supercharger} to boost engine power.
e.zh: 机械师装了一个增压器来提升发动机的功率。

supercilious.t: adj. 傲慢的；目中无人的

e.en: The waiter gave us a {supercilious} look when we ordered tap water.
e.zh: 我们点白开水时,服务员投来一个傲慢的眼神。

e.en: Her {supercilious} tone made everyone in the meeting uncomfortable.
e.zh: 她那种高傲的语气让会议上每个人都感到不自在。

e.en: Astronomers mapped a massive galaxy {supercluster} stretching billions of light-years.
e.zh: 天文学家绘制出一个跨越数十亿光年的巨型星系超团。

e.en: Our Milky Way belongs to the Laniakea {supercluster}.
e.zh: 我们的银河系属于拉尼亚凯亚超星系团。

e.en: The Large Hadron {supercollider} smashes protons at near light speed.
e.zh: 大型强子对撞机以接近光速让质子相撞。

e.en: Scientists hope the new {supercollider} reveals undiscovered particles.
e.zh: 科学家希望这台新对撞机能揭示未被发现的粒子。

e.en: Japan's fastest {supercomputer} simulates climate models for weather forecasts.
e.zh: 日本最快的超级计算机用来模拟气候模型以做天气预报。

e.en: Training large AI models requires a powerful {supercomputer} cluster.
e.zh: 训练大型 AI 模型需要强大的超级计算机集群。

e.en: The university opened a new {supercomputing} center for genomics research.
e.zh: 该大学为基因组学研究开设了新的超级计算中心。

e.en: Cloud {supercomputing} now lets startups run massive simulations affordably.
e.zh: 云端超级计算让初创公司也能负担得起大规模模拟。

e.en: MRI machines rely on {superconducting} magnets cooled with liquid helium.
e.zh: 核磁共振仪依靠用液氦冷却的超导磁铁工作。

e.en: Engineers built a {superconducting} cable to transmit power without loss.
e.zh: 工程师造出一条无损耗输电的超导电缆。

e.en: At very low temperatures, this metal becomes perfectly {superconductive}.
e.zh: 在极低温下,这种金属会变得完全超导。

e.en: Researchers seek a room-temperature {superconductive} material for power grids.
e.zh: 研究人员正寻找适用于电网的常温超导材料。

e.en: The discovery of {superconductivity} earned the physicists a Nobel Prize.
e.zh: 超导现象的发现为这些物理学家赢得了诺贝尔奖。

e.en: Room-temperature {superconductivity} would revolutionize electronics and energy transmission.
e.zh: 常温超导将彻底改变电子学和能量传输领域。

e.en: Engineers cooled the {superconductor} below its critical temperature for testing.
e.zh: 工程师将超导体冷却到临界温度以下进行测试。

e.en: A practical room-temperature {superconductor} remains the holy grail of physics.
e.zh: 实用的常温超导体至今仍是物理学的圣杯。

e.en: Millions of years ago, all land formed a single {supercontinent} called Pangaea.
e.zh: 数百万年前,所有陆地构成一个名叫盘古大陆的超大陆。

e.en: Geologists predict another {supercontinent} will form in 250 million years.
e.zh: 地质学家预测两亿五千万年后还会形成一个超大陆。

supercooled.t: adj. 过冷的（低于冰点仍未凝固）

e.en: The {supercooled} water froze instantly when the bottle was tapped.
e.zh: 那瓶过冷水一被轻敲就瞬间结冰了。

e.en: Aircraft icing happens when {supercooled} droplets hit cold metal wings.
e.zh: 过冷水滴撞到冰冷机翼时,飞机就会结冰。

supercritical.t: adj. 超临界的（物理/化学状态）

e.en: At {supercritical} pressure, carbon dioxide acts as both gas and liquid.
e.zh: 在超临界压力下,二氧化碳同时具有气体和液体的特性。

e.en: The reactor reached a {supercritical} state during the routine power test.
e.zh: 反应堆在常规功率测试中进入了超临界状态。

superego.t: n. 超我（精神分析术语）

e.en: Freud described the {superego} as the moral conscience of the mind.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德将超我描述为心灵的道德良知。

e.en: Her strong {superego} kept her from cheating on the exam.
e.zh: 她那强烈的超我让她没有在考试中作弊。

e.en: The cut was only {superficial} and didn't need any stitches.
e.zh: 伤口只是表皮的,根本不需要缝针。

e.en: His knowledge of the topic seemed rather {superficial} during the interview.
e.zh: 面试中他对这个话题的了解显得相当肤浅。

e.en: She criticized the {superficiality} of celebrity culture in her essay.
e.zh: 她在文章中批评了名人文化的肤浅。

e.en: The novel exposes the {superficiality} of suburban social life.
e.zh: 这部小说揭示了郊区社交生活的肤浅。

e.en: The two products look {superficially} similar but differ in quality.
e.zh: 这两款产品表面看起来相似,但质量却有差别。

e.en: He {superficially} understood the code but couldn't explain its logic.
e.zh: 他对代码只是一知半解,无法解释其中的逻辑。

e.en: Bakers prefer {superfine} sugar because it dissolves quickly into batter.
e.zh: 烘焙师偏爱超细砂糖,因为它能迅速溶进面糊。

e.en: This sweater is woven from {superfine} merino wool.
e.zh: 这件毛衣由超细美利奴羊毛织成。

superfluid.t:
n. 超流体
adj. 超流的

e.en: Liquid helium becomes a {superfluid} when cooled below two kelvin.
e.zh: 液氦冷却到两开尔文以下时会变成超流体。

e.en: A {superfluid} can flow upward against gravity without friction.
e.zh: 超流体可以无摩擦地逆着重力向上流动。

e.en: {Superfluidity} allows helium to climb the walls of its container.
e.zh: 超流性使氦能沿着容器壁向上爬。

e.en: The discovery of {superfluidity} reshaped our understanding of quantum mechanics.
e.zh: 超流性的发现重塑了我们对量子力学的理解。

e.en: The mansion contained a {superfluity} of unused rooms and hallways.
e.zh: 这座豪宅里有许多多余且无人使用的房间和走廊。

e.en: He complained about the {superfluity} of options on the menu.
e.zh: 他抱怨菜单上选项多得过剩。

e.en: The editor cut several {superfluous} paragraphs from the long article.
e.zh: 编辑从这篇长文中删掉了几段多余的内容。

e.en: In modern kitchens, a separate microwave often feels {superfluous}.
e.zh: 在现代厨房里,单独的微波炉常常显得多余。

e.en: He {superfluously} repeated every instruction the manager had already given.
e.zh: 经理已经讲过的每条指示,他都多此一举地又重复了一遍。

e.en: The report was padded {superfluously} with charts and irrelevant data.
e.zh: 报告里多余地塞满了图表和无关数据。

superfund.t: n. 超级基金（美国环保拨款）

e.en: The EPA added the abandoned factory to its {superfund} cleanup list.
e.zh: 环保署将这家废弃工厂列入了超级基金清理名单。

e.en: Decades later, the {superfund} site is finally safe for housing.
e.zh: 几十年后,这个超级基金污染场址终于可以安全用于建房。

e.en: Betelgeuse is a red {supergiant} nearing the end of its life.
e.zh: 参宿四是一颗接近生命终点的红超巨星。

e.en: Astronomers detected a blue {supergiant} in a distant galaxy.
e.zh: 天文学家在一个遥远星系中发现了一颗蓝超巨星。

e.en: A drop of {superglue} fixed the broken handle in seconds.
e.zh: 一滴强力胶几秒钟就把断掉的把手粘好了。

e.en: Be careful — {superglue} bonds skin almost instantly on contact.
e.zh: 小心——强力胶碰到皮肤几乎瞬间就会粘住。

supergroup.t: n. 超级乐队（明星组合）

e.en: The rock {supergroup} reunited for one final farewell tour.
e.zh: 那支摇滚超级乐队为最后一次告别巡演重组了。

e.en: Critics called the new band an instant pop {supergroup}.
e.zh: 乐评人称这支新乐队一登场就是流行超级组合。

superheat.t:
v. 使过热
n. 过热（蒸汽）

e.en: Don't {superheat} water in the microwave or it may explode.
e.zh: 不要在微波炉里把水加热到过热,否则可能会爆开。

e.en: Engineers {superheat} steam to drive turbines more efficiently.
e.zh: 工程师将蒸汽加热到过热状态以更高效地驱动涡轮机。

e.en: The {superheated} steam shot out of the cracked pipe dangerously.
e.zh: 过热蒸汽从裂开的管道中危险地喷出。

e.en: Pizza ovens use {superheated} air to crisp the crust quickly.
e.zh: 披萨烤箱用过热空气快速烤脆饼底。

e.en: Every kid in class wanted to be a {superhero}.
e.zh: 班上每个孩子都想当超级英雄。

e.en: The new {superhero} movie broke box-office records.
e.zh: 这部新的超级英雄电影打破了票房纪录。

superhighway.t: n. 超级高速公路；信息高速路

e.en: The information {superhighway} changed how we share knowledge.
e.zh: 信息高速公路改变了我们分享知识的方式。

e.en: A new {superhighway} now connects the two coastal cities.
e.zh: 一条新的高速公路如今连接着这两座沿海城市。

e.en: The rescuers showed {superhuman} strength digging through rubble.
e.zh: 救援人员在废墟中挖掘时展现了超人般的力量。

e.en: Finishing the marathon required {superhuman} willpower.
e.zh: 跑完马拉松需要超凡的意志力。

e.en: You can {superimpose} text onto the photo in this app.
e.zh: 你可以用这款应用把文字叠加到照片上。

e.en: Editors {superimpose} subtitles to make videos accessible.
e.zh: 剪辑师叠加字幕,让视频更易于观看。

superimposed.t: adj. 叠加的；覆盖其上的

e.en: A logo was {superimposed} on the corner of every frame.
e.zh: 每一帧的角落都叠加了一个标志。

e.en: The map {superimposed} subway lines onto the city streets.
e.zh: 地图把地铁线路叠加在了城市街道之上。

e.en: The {superimposition} of two images created a ghostly effect.
e.zh: 两张图像的叠加产生了一种幽灵般的效果。

e.en: Careful {superimposition} let the designer compare both layouts.
e.zh: 细致的叠加让设计师能够对比两种版式。

e.en: She was hired to {superintend} the new factory's operations.
e.zh: 她被聘来监管新工厂的运营。

e.en: A senior engineer will {superintend} the bridge construction.
e.zh: 一位资深工程师将监督这座桥的施工。

superintendency.t: n. 监督职权；主管辖区

e.en: He resigned from the {superintendency} after only two years.
e.zh: 他担任督察一职仅两年便辞职了。

e.en: Her {superintendency} of the school improved test scores dramatically.
e.zh: 她对学校的管理使考试成绩大幅提升。

e.en: The building {superintendent} fixed our broken heater quickly.
e.zh: 大楼管理员很快修好了我们坏掉的暖气。

e.en: The school {superintendent} announced new safety policies today.
e.zh: 学区总监今天宣布了新的安全政策。

e.en: All the district {superintendents} met to discuss budget cuts.
e.zh: 各学区督学齐聚一堂,讨论预算削减问题。

e.en: The {superintendents} of several factories signed the safety agreement.
e.zh: 几家工厂的厂长签署了这份安全协议。

superior.t:
adj. 更好的；上级的
n. 上司

e.en: This phone has a {superior} camera compared to the older model.
e.zh: 与旧款相比,这款手机的相机更出色。

e.en: You should report the issue to your immediate {superior}.
e.zh: 你应该把这个问题反映给你的直属上级。

e.en: He has a clear sense of {superiority} over his classmates.
e.zh: 他对同学有一种明显的优越感。

e.en: The team proved its {superiority} by winning every match.
e.zh: 球队赢下每场比赛，证明了自己的实力。

superiorly.t: adv. 优越地；高人一等地

e.en: The new model performs {superiorly} in low-light conditions.
e.zh: 新机型在弱光环境下表现更出色。

e.en: The muscle attaches {superiorly} to the shoulder blade.
e.zh: 该肌肉在上方附着于肩胛骨。

superlative.t:
adj. 最高级的；极好的
n. 最高级

e.en: The chef received {superlative} reviews from every food critic.
e.zh: 这位厨师获得了所有美食评论家的最高赞誉。

e.en: "Best" is the {superlative} form of "good".
e.zh: "best" 是 "good" 的最高级形式。

superlatives.t: n. 最高级形式；溢美之词（复数）

e.en: Critics ran out of {superlatives} to describe the film.
e.zh: 影评人都找不到更多最高级词汇来形容这部电影了。

e.en: English {superlatives} usually end in -est or use "most".
e.zh: 英语最高级通常以 -est 结尾或加 "most"。

e.en: Physics says no signal can travel at {superluminal} speeds.
e.zh: 物理学指出，没有信号能以超光速传播。

e.en: The novel imagines a {superluminal} drive for interstellar travel.
e.zh: 这部小说设想了一种用于星际旅行的超光速引擎。

e.en: The amendment needs a {supermajority} of two-thirds to pass.
e.zh: 该修正案需要三分之二的绝对多数才能通过。

e.en: Republicans lost their {supermajority} in the state senate.
e.zh: 共和党失去了在州参议院的绝对多数席位。

e.en: Don't try to be a {superman} — ask for help.
e.zh: 别想着当超人，需要帮忙就开口。

e.en: The new {Superman} movie breaks box office records this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天新版《超人》电影打破了票房纪录。

e.en: I'll stop by the {supermarket} on my way home.
e.zh: 我回家路上顺便去趟超市。

e.en: This {supermarket} stays open twenty-four hours a day.
e.zh: 这家超市二十四小时营业。

e.en: Most {supermarkets} now offer online delivery within the hour.
e.zh: 大多数超市现在都提供一小时内的在线送达。

e.en: Local {supermarkets} have raised prices on imported goods.
e.zh: 本地超市上调了进口商品的价格。

supermax.t: n. 超高安全级别监狱

e.en: The convict was transferred to a {supermax} prison upstate.
e.zh: 这名罪犯被转往州北部的超级监狱。

e.en: Inmates in {supermax} units spend most hours in isolation.
e.zh: 超级监狱的犯人大部分时间都被单独关押。

e.en: She became a {supermodel} after her first Vogue cover.
e.zh: 她登上《Vogue》封面后成为了超模。

e.en: The brand hired a {supermodel} to launch its new fragrance.
e.zh: 该品牌请了一位超模来发布新款香水。

supernal.t: adj. 天上的；崇高的（文言）

e.en: The cathedral's stained glass cast a {supernal} glow inside.
e.zh: 教堂的彩色玻璃在室内投下天国般的光辉。

e.en: The choir sang with {supernal} beauty that silenced everyone.
e.zh: 唱诗班的歌声美得超凡脱俗，令所有人静默。

supernatant.t:
n. 上清液
adj. 浮在上层的

e.en: Pour the {supernatant} into a clean tube after centrifuging.
e.zh: 离心后将上清液倒入干净的试管中。

e.en: The {supernatant} liquid contains the dissolved proteins we need.
e.zh: 上清液中含有我们需要的可溶性蛋白质。

e.en: She doesn't believe in ghosts or anything {supernatural}.
e.zh: 她不相信鬼魂或任何超自然的东西。

e.en: The horror series explores {supernatural} events in a small town.
e.zh: 这部恐怖剧探讨小镇上发生的超自然事件。

supernaturalism.t: n. 超自然信仰；灵异论

e.en: The philosopher rejected {supernaturalism} in favor of pure materialism.
e.zh: 这位哲学家反对超自然主义，主张纯粹的唯物论。

e.en: Folk religion often blends {supernaturalism} with everyday rituals.
e.zh: 民间宗教常将超自然信仰与日常仪式结合在一起。

e.en: The actress is {supernaturally} good at remembering long scripts.
e.zh: 这位女演员记长台词的能力简直神乎其神。

e.en: The room felt {supernaturally} cold the moment we entered.
e.zh: 我们一进屋，房间就冷得诡异。

supernormal.t: adj. 超出常态的；异常的

e.en: The athlete shows {supernormal} reaction times under pressure.
e.zh: 这位运动员在压力下展现出超常的反应速度。

e.en: Bright colors act as {supernormal} stimuli for many birds.
e.zh: 鲜艳的颜色对许多鸟类来说是超常刺激。

e.en: Astronomers observed a {supernova} in a nearby galaxy last night.
e.zh: 天文学家昨晚在邻近星系观测到一颗超新星。

e.en: The band's debut album went {supernova} on streaming charts.
e.zh: 这支乐队的首张专辑在流媒体榜单上爆红。

supernumerary.t:
adj. 编外的；多余的
n. 临时演员

e.en: She worked as a {supernumerary} in several Broadway productions.
e.zh: 她曾在多部百老汇剧目中担任群众演员。

e.en: The baby was born with a {supernumerary} finger on each hand.
e.zh: 这名婴儿出生时每只手都多长了一根手指。

superordinate.t:
adj. 上级的；上位的
n. 上级

e.en: "Animal" is the {superordinate} category that includes "dog" and "cat".
e.zh: "动物" 是包含 "狗" 和 "猫" 的上位概念。

e.en: Team success is the {superordinate} goal everyone works toward.
e.zh: 团队的成功是大家共同努力的更高目标。

e.en: A bee colony functions as a single {superorganism}.
e.zh: 一个蜂群就像一个单一的超个体在运作。

e.en: Some biologists view ant nests as a {superorganism}.
e.zh: 一些生物学家把蚁巢视为一个超个体。

e.en: Cells produce {superoxide} as a byproduct of normal metabolism.
e.zh: 细胞在正常代谢过程中会产生超氧化物。

e.en: Antioxidants help neutralize {superoxide} radicals in the body.
e.zh: 抗氧化剂有助于中和体内的超氧自由基。

e.en: You can {superpose} two images to compare the differences.
e.zh: 你可以把两张图叠加起来对比差异。

e.en: Engineers {superpose} the load curves to model total stress.
e.zh: 工程师将载荷曲线叠加以模拟总应力。

e.en: Quantum particles can exist in a {superposition} of states.
e.zh: 量子粒子可以处于多种状态的叠加之中。

e.en: The diagram shows the {superposition} of two sound waves.
e.zh: 图中展示了两列声波的叠加。

superpower.t:
n. 超能力
n. 超级大国

e.en: If you had any {superpower}, what would you choose?
e.zh: 如果你能拥有任何超能力，你会选什么？

e.en: China has emerged as an economic {superpower} in recent decades.
e.zh: 近几十年中国已崛起为经济超级大国。

superscalar.t: adj. 超标量的（处理器架构）

e.en: Modern CPUs use {superscalar} designs to execute instructions in parallel.
e.zh: 现代 CPU 采用超标量设计以并行执行指令。

e.en: The chip's {superscalar} pipeline handles multiple operations per clock cycle.
e.zh: 该芯片的超标量流水线每个时钟周期处理多个操作。

e.en: Use a {superscript} to format the exponent in the equation.
e.zh: 用上标来排版方程中的指数。

e.en: Footnote numbers usually appear in {superscript} after the sentence.
e.zh: 脚注编号通常以上标形式出现在句末。

e.en: The new policy will {supersede} all previous guidelines next month.
e.zh: 新政策将于下月取代此前所有的指导方针。

e.en: Email did not entirely {supersede} traditional letters in business.
e.zh: 电子邮件并未完全取代商业中的传统信件。

e.en: My skin is {supersensitive} to fragrance in laundry detergents.
e.zh: 我的皮肤对洗衣液里的香精特别敏感。

e.en: The microphone is {supersensitive} and picks up tiny background noises.
e.zh: 这只麦克风极其敏感，连细微的背景音都能录到。

e.en: The {supersession} of film by digital cameras happened quickly.
e.zh: 数码相机迅速取代了胶片相机。

e.en: Many theologians debate the {supersession} of the old covenant.
e.zh: 许多神学家就旧约被取代一事进行争论。

superset.t: n. 超集（包含另一集合的集合）

e.en: Python 3 is largely a {superset} of basic scripting features.
e.zh: Python 3 在基本脚本功能上基本是一个超集。

e.en: He finished the workout with a tough {superset} of squats.
e.zh: 他以一组高强度的深蹲超级组结束了训练。

supersize.t:
v. 加大份量
adj. 超大号的

e.en: Would you like to {supersize} your fries for a dollar?
e.zh: 加一块钱要不要把薯条升级成超大份？

e.en: The chain stopped offering {supersize} drinks after public backlash.
e.zh: 在公众反对后，这家连锁店停止提供超大杯饮品。

e.en: The jet broke the sound barrier at {supersonic} speeds.
e.zh: 这架喷气机以超音速突破了音障。

e.en: Engineers are designing a quieter {supersonic} passenger plane.
e.zh: 工程师正在设计一款更安静的超音速客机。

e.en: She became a tennis {superstar} before turning twenty.
e.zh: 她还没满二十岁就成了网坛巨星。

e.en: Every team needs more than just a single {superstar}.
e.zh: 每支队伍都不能只靠一个巨星。

e.en: That viral video catapulted him to instant {superstardom}.
e.zh: 那段爆红视频让他一夜之间成为巨星。

e.en: Few young actors handle {superstardom} without burning out.
e.zh: 少有年轻演员能在巨星光环下不被掏空。

e.en: The concert featured three pop {superstars} on the same stage.
e.zh: 这场演唱会让三位流行巨星同台演出。

e.en: NBA {superstars} earn most of their income from endorsements.
e.zh: NBA 巨星的大部分收入来自代言。

superstate.t: n. 超级国家；超国家实体

e.en: Critics worry the EU is becoming a federal {superstate}.
e.zh: 批评者担心欧盟正变成一个联邦超级国家。

e.en: The novel imagines a {superstate} that rules the entire planet.
e.zh: 这部小说设想了一个统治整个地球的超级国家。

superstation.t: n. 超级电视台（卫星转播台）

e.en: TBS started as a local channel and grew into a {superstation}.
e.zh: TBS 最初是地方频道，后来发展成全国超级电视台。

e.en: Cable systems carried the {superstation} into millions of homes.
e.zh: 有线电视系统把这家超级电视台送进了千家万户。

e.en: It's just a {superstition} that breaking a mirror brings bad luck.
e.zh: 打碎镜子会带来霉运只是一种迷信。

e.en: Many cultures share the {superstition} about the number thirteen.
e.zh: 许多文化都有关于数字十三的迷信。

e.en: Many cultures have {superstitions} about black cats.
e.zh: 许多文化都有关于黑猫的迷信说法。

e.en: He laughs at {superstitions} but still avoids ladders.
e.zh: 他嘲笑迷信，却仍然避免从梯子下走过。

e.en: My grandmother is {superstitious} about the number four.
e.zh: 我奶奶对数字四有些迷信。

e.en: Athletes can be surprisingly {superstitious} before big games.
e.zh: 运动员在大赛前往往异常迷信。

e.en: He {superstitiously} knocks on wood after every compliment.
e.zh: 每次受到夸奖后，他都迷信地敲一下木头。

e.en: She {superstitiously} avoids walking under ladders downtown.
e.zh: 她出于迷信，在市区从不从梯子下经过。

superstore.t: n. 大卖场；超大型商店

e.en: We do our weekly shopping at the new {superstore}.
e.zh: 我们每周都在新开的大型超市采购。

e.en: The {superstore} sells everything from groceries to furniture.
e.zh: 这家大卖场什么都卖，从食品到家具一应俱全。

e.en: {Superstring} theory tries to unify all fundamental forces.
e.zh: 超弦理论试图将所有基本作用力统一起来。

e.en: Few experiments can directly test {superstring} predictions.
e.zh: 几乎没有实验能够直接验证超弦理论的预言。

superstructure.t: n. 上层建筑；上部结构

e.en: The bridge's steel {superstructure} took years to complete.
e.zh: 这座大桥的钢制上层结构花了数年才建成。

e.en: Engineers inspected the ship's {superstructure} for damage.
e.zh: 工程师检查了这艘船上层建筑的受损情况。

e.en: Physicists searched for {supersymmetric} particles at the LHC.
e.zh: 物理学家在大型强子对撞机上寻找超对称粒子。

e.en: No {supersymmetric} partner has yet been confirmed experimentally.
e.zh: 目前尚未通过实验证实任何一种超对称伴子。

e.en: {Supersymmetry} predicts a partner for every known particle.
e.zh: 超对称理论预言每种已知粒子都有一个伴子。

e.en: Many physicists are losing faith in {supersymmetry}.
e.zh: 许多物理学家正在对超对称理论失去信心。

e.en: The {supertanker} carried two million barrels of crude oil.
e.zh: 这艘超级油轮装载了两百万桶原油。

e.en: A grounded {supertanker} blocked the strait for days.
e.zh: 一艘搁浅的超级油轮把海峡堵了好几天。

supervene.t: v. 接着发生；继而出现

e.en: Unexpected complications often {supervene} during long surgeries.
e.zh: 长时间手术中常常会出现意想不到的并发情况。

e.en: New evidence may {supervene} and change the verdict.
e.zh: 新的证据可能会随后出现并改变判决结果。

e.en: A senior nurse will {supervise} the new interns today.
e.zh: 今天将由一位资深护士来指导新来的实习生。

e.en: Parents should {supervise} young children near the pool.
e.zh: 家长应该在泳池附近照看好年幼的孩子。

supervised.t:
adj. 有监督的（学习）
v. 监督（过去式）

e.en: She {supervised} the construction project for two years.
e.zh: 她负责监督这个建筑项目长达两年。

e.en: {Supervised} learning requires labeled training data.
e.zh: 监督学习需要带标签的训练数据。

supervises.t: v. 监督（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {supervises} a team of twelve junior engineers.
e.zh: 她管理着一个由十二名初级工程师组成的团队。

e.en: A senior nurse {supervises} every shift in the ward.
e.zh: 病房里每个班次都有一名资深护士监督。

supervising.t:
v. 监督（现在分词）
adj. 监管的

e.en: He spent the summer {supervising} interns at the startup.
e.zh: 他整个夏天都在那家初创公司带实习生。

e.en: Parents should be {supervising} kids when they swim.
e.zh: 孩子游泳时家长应当在旁看护。

e.en: Children use the playground under adult {supervision}.
e.zh: 孩子们在大人的看护下使用游乐场。

e.en: The project finished on time thanks to careful {supervision}.
e.zh: 多亏了细致的监督,项目按时完成。

e.en: Weekly {supervisions} help new therapists improve quickly.
e.zh: 每周的督导帮助新治疗师快速进步。

e.en: The clinic schedules monthly {supervisions} for all trainees.
e.zh: 诊所为所有受训者安排每月一次的督导会。

e.en: Please email your {supervisor} before taking sick leave.
e.zh: 请假前请先给你的主管发邮件。

e.en: My PhD {supervisor} reviewed the draft over the weekend.
e.zh: 我的博士导师周末审阅了这份草稿。

e.en: All shift {supervisors} must complete the safety training.
e.zh: 所有的班组主管都必须完成安全培训。

e.en: The factory hired three new {supervisors} last month.
e.zh: 工厂上个月新招了三名主管。

e.en: She was promoted to a {supervisory} role last year.
e.zh: 她去年晋升到了一个管理岗位。

e.en: The board has {supervisory} authority over the executives.
e.zh: 董事会对高管拥有监督权。

e.en: She works full-time and raises three kids — a real {superwoman}.
e.zh: 她全职工作还要养三个孩子,简直是女超人。

e.en: Stop trying to be a {superwoman} and ask for help.
e.zh: 别再逞强当女超人了,该求助就求助。

e.en: Runners with excessive {supination} often need special insoles.
e.zh: 足部外旋过度的跑者通常需要专门的鞋垫。

e.en: The therapist measured the {supination} of the patient's wrist.
e.zh: 治疗师测量了病人手腕的旋后角度。

supine.t:
adj. 仰卧的
adj. 消极的

e.en: Lie {supine} on the mat with your knees bent.
e.zh: 仰卧在垫子上,屈膝。

e.en: The press was criticized for being {supine} before the regime.
e.zh: 媒体因在该政权面前唯唯诺诺而受到批评。

e.en: We usually have {supper} around seven on weekdays.
e.zh: 工作日我们一般七点左右吃晚饭。

e.en: Grandma invited the whole family over for {supper}.
e.zh: 奶奶请全家人来吃晚饭。

e.en: Sunday {suppers} at her place are a family tradition.
e.zh: 在她家吃周日晚餐是家族的传统。

e.en: The church hosts community {suppers} every Friday night.
e.zh: 教堂每周五晚都举办社区聚餐。

e.en: The kids come running home right at {suppertime}.
e.zh: 孩子们一到晚饭时间就跑回家。

e.en: Please finish your homework before {suppertime}.
e.zh: 请在晚饭时间前完成作业。

e.en: Streaming services have begun to {supplant} traditional cable TV.
e.zh: 流媒体服务已开始取代传统的有线电视。

e.en: No app can fully {supplant} face-to-face conversation.
e.zh: 没有任何应用能完全取代面对面的交流。

e.en: Daily yoga keeps her body strong and {supple}.
e.zh: 每天练瑜伽让她的身体既强健又柔韧。

e.en: The jacket is made of soft, {supple} leather.
e.zh: 这件夹克由柔软而有韧性的皮革制成。

supplement.t:
n. 补充；增刊
v. 补充

e.en: Many runners take a vitamin {supplement} every morning.
e.zh: 许多跑步者每天早上都会服用维生素补充剂。

e.en: He took a part-time job to {supplement} his income.
e.zh: 他做了份兼职以补贴收入。

e.en: The textbook comes with {supplemental} videos online.
e.zh: 这本教材配有网上的补充视频。

e.en: Patients may need {supplemental} oxygen during the flight.
e.zh: 病人在飞行途中可能需要补充供氧。

e.en: The teacher handed out {supplementary} reading for the unit.
e.zh: 老师为这一单元发了补充阅读材料。

e.en: Please refer to the {supplementary} notes at the back.
e.zh: 请参阅书后的补充说明。

e.en: Iron {supplementation} is often recommended during pregnancy.
e.zh: 孕期通常建议补充铁剂。

e.en: The study examined the effects of vitamin D {supplementation}.
e.zh: 该研究考察了补充维生素D的效果。

supplemented.t: v. 补充（supplement 的过去式）

e.en: She {supplemented} her salary with freelance design work.
e.zh: 她靠接些自由设计的活儿来补贴工资。

e.en: The lecture was {supplemented} by hands-on lab sessions.
e.zh: 讲座由动手实验课作为补充。

supplementing.t: v. 补充（supplement 的现在分词）

e.en: He's {supplementing} his diet with extra protein.
e.zh: 他正在通过额外的蛋白质来补充饮食。

e.en: The teacher is {supplementing} the textbook with online videos.
e.zh: 老师正在用网络视频来补充课本内容。

supplements.t:
n. 补充剂；增补
v. 补充

e.en: Many athletes take protein {supplements} after workouts.
e.zh: 许多运动员在锻炼后会服用蛋白补剂。

e.en: Her side gig {supplements} the family's monthly income.
e.zh: 她的副业补贴了家里每月的收入。

e.en: Stretching daily improves the {suppleness} of your muscles.
e.zh: 每天拉伸可以增强肌肉的柔韧性。

e.en: The dancer is admired for the {suppleness} of her movements.
e.zh: 这位舞者因动作灵动柔美而备受赞赏。

suppliant.t:
n. 恳求者
adj. 恳求的

e.en: The {suppliant} knelt before the king begging for mercy.
e.zh: 那名恳求者跪在国王面前乞求宽恕。

e.en: She raised her hands in a {suppliant} gesture.
e.zh: 她举起双手做出恳求的姿态。

e.en: The temple was filled with {supplicant} pilgrims at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分,庙里挤满了祈愿的朝圣者。

e.en: He stood as a humble {supplicant} before the council.
e.zh: 他作为一名卑微的请愿者站在议会面前。

e.en: The villagers came to {supplicate} the gods for rain.
e.zh: 村民们前来向神明祈求降雨。

e.en: He refused to {supplicate} his rivals for forgiveness.
e.zh: 他拒绝向对手低声下气地求得原谅。

e.en: She bowed her head in silent {supplication}.
e.zh: 她低头默默祈求。

e.en: His letter was a desperate {supplication} for help.
e.zh: 他的信是一封绝望的求助恳请。

supplied.t: v. 供应（supply 的过去式）

e.en: The charity {supplied} blankets to families after the flood.
e.zh: 该慈善机构在洪灾后向受灾家庭提供了毛毯。

e.en: Lunch will be {supplied} for all conference attendees.
e.zh: 将为所有与会者提供午餐。

e.en: We switched to a local {supplier} to cut shipping costs.
e.zh: 我们换成了本地供应商以降低运费。

e.en: The {supplier} delivered the parts a day early.
e.zh: 供应商提前一天送来了零件。

e.en: The company works with dozens of overseas {suppliers}.
e.zh: 这家公司与数十家海外供应商合作。

e.en: Small {suppliers} are struggling with rising material costs.
e.zh: 小型供应商正受到原材料涨价的困扰。

supplies.t:
n. 物资；补给
v. 供应

e.en: The hikers ran out of {supplies} on the third day.
e.zh: 徒步者在第三天就把补给用光了。

e.en: Office {supplies} are kept in the cabinet near reception.
e.zh: 办公用品放在前台旁的柜子里。

supply.t:
v. 供应；提供
n. 供应；补给

e.en: The factory will {supply} parts to several car makers.
e.zh: 这家工厂将向几家汽车制造商供应零件。

e.en: Bottled water is in short {supply} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,瓶装水严重短缺。

supplying.t: v. 供应（supply 的现在分词）

e.en: Local farms have been {supplying} the restaurant for years.
e.zh: 当地农场多年来一直为这家餐厅供货。

e.en: The pipeline is {supplying} natural gas to three cities.
e.zh: 这条管道正向三座城市输送天然气。

support.t:
v. 支持；支撑
n. 支持；技术支持

e.en: Thanks for your {support} during a really tough year.
e.zh: 谢谢你在这艰难的一年里给我的支持。

e.en: This phone doesn't {support} the latest software update.
e.zh: 这部手机不支持最新的系统更新。

supportable.t: adj. 可支持的；可忍受的

e.en: His claims are simply not {supportable} by the evidence.
e.zh: 他的说法根本无法被证据所支持。

e.en: The pain became barely {supportable} after the surgery.
e.zh: 手术后疼痛已经几乎难以忍受。

supported.t:
v. 支持（过去式）
adj. 受支持的（如版本）

e.en: My family {supported} my decision to study abroad.
e.zh: 家人支持我出国留学的决定。

e.en: The roof is {supported} by four steel columns.
e.zh: 屋顶由四根钢柱支撑。

e.en: She's been a loyal {supporter} of the team since childhood.
e.zh: 她从小就是这支球队的忠实球迷。

e.en: He's a strong {supporter} of renewable energy policies.
e.zh: 他大力支持可再生能源政策。

e.en: Hundreds of {supporters} gathered outside the courthouse.
e.zh: 数百名支持者聚集在法院外。

e.en: The candidate thanked his {supporters} after the victory.
e.zh: 获胜后,这位候选人向支持者表示感谢。

supporting.t:
v. 支持
adj. 辅助的；配角的

e.en: She won an Oscar for best {supporting} actress this year.
e.zh: 她今年获得了奥斯卡最佳女配角奖。

e.en: My family has been {supporting} me throughout this difficult career change.
e.zh: 在这次艰难的转行过程中,家人一直支持着我。

supportive.t: adj. 给予支持的；鼓励的

e.en: My boss has been incredibly {supportive} during my parental leave.
e.zh: 我休育儿假期间,老板一直非常支持我。

e.en: These running shoes are comfortable and very {supportive} on long runs.
e.zh: 这双跑鞋穿着舒适,长跑时支撑性也很好。

e.en: She nodded {supportively} as her friend explained the difficult situation.
e.zh: 朋友讲述这个困境时,她支持地点了点头。

e.en: The coach spoke {supportively} to the player after the loss.
e.zh: 输球之后,教练用支持的口吻和球员谈话。

e.en: I deeply appreciate the {supportiveness} of my colleagues this year.
e.zh: 我非常感激今年同事们给予的支持。

e.en: Her {supportiveness} made the new employee feel welcome immediately.
e.zh: 她的支持让新员工立刻感到受欢迎。

supports.t:
v. 支持（第三人称单数）
n. 支撑物

e.en: This phone {supports} fast charging and wireless charging out of the box.
e.zh: 这款手机开箱即支持快充和无线充电。

e.en: A steel beam {supports} the entire weight of the second floor.
e.zh: 一根钢梁支撑着整个二楼的重量。

e.en: I {suppose} we should leave early to avoid the traffic.
e.zh: 我想我们应该早点出发,免得遇上堵车。

e.en: {Suppose} you won the lottery — what would you do first?
e.zh: 假设你中了彩票,你会先做什么?

e.en: You're {supposed} to submit the report by Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 你本应该在周五下午前交报告。

e.en: This restaurant is {supposed} to have the best ramen in town.
e.zh: 听说这家餐厅的拉面是镇上最好吃的。

e.en: The new update {supposedly} fixes the battery drain issue.
e.zh: 据说新版本更新修复了耗电问题。

e.en: He's {supposedly} working from home, but no one can reach him.
e.zh: 他声称在家办公,但没人能联系上他。

supposes.t: v. 假设（第三人称单数）

e.en: Everyone {supposes} the merger will be announced next month.
e.zh: 大家都猜测合并会在下个月宣布。

e.en: She {supposes} her keys are still on the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 她以为她的钥匙还放在厨房台面上。

supposing.t:
conj. 假如
v. 假设（现在分词）

e.en: {Supposing} it rains tomorrow, should we postpone the picnic?
e.zh: 假如明天下雨,我们要把野餐推迟吗?

e.en: {Supposing} the deal falls through, we'll need a backup plan.
e.zh: 万一这笔交易告吹,我们就得有备用方案。

e.en: Your argument rests entirely on an unproven {supposition}.
e.zh: 你的论点完全建立在一个未经证实的假设之上。

e.en: It's only a {supposition}, but the data seems to support it.
e.zh: 这只是一个推测,但数据似乎支持它。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {suppository} to reduce the child's fever.
e.zh: 医生开了一种栓剂帮孩子退烧。

e.en: She struggled to read the instructions on the {suppository} package.
e.zh: 她费力地辨认栓剂包装上的说明。

suppress.t: v. 抑制；镇压；禁止显示

e.en: She tried to {suppress} a laugh during the boring presentation.
e.zh: 在那场无聊的演讲中,她努力憋住没笑出来。

e.en: The government attempted to {suppress} news of the protests online.
e.zh: 政府试图在网上压制抗议活动的消息。

e.en: She takes a cough {suppressant} before bed each night.
e.zh: 她每晚睡前服用一片止咳药。

e.en: This appetite {suppressant} should not replace a balanced diet.
e.zh: 这种食欲抑制剂不能替代均衡饮食。

suppressed.t:
v. 抑制（过去式）
adj. 被压抑的

e.en: He {suppressed} a laugh during the serious meeting.
e.zh: 严肃的会议中他憋住了笑。

e.en: The government {suppressed} the report for political reasons.
e.zh: 政府出于政治原因压下了那份报告。

suppresses.t: v. 抑制（第三人称单数）

e.en: This medication {suppresses} the immune system temporarily.
e.zh: 这种药会暂时抑制免疫系统。

e.en: The app {suppresses} notifications during your focus hours.
e.zh: 该应用会在你的专注时段屏蔽通知。

e.en: She kept {suppressing} her tears throughout the speech.
e.zh: 整场演讲她都强忍着泪水。

e.en: The filter is {suppressing} background noise on the call.
e.zh: 滤波器正在抑制通话中的背景噪音。

e.en: The {suppression} of free speech sparked global protests.
e.zh: 对言论自由的压制引发了全球抗议。

e.en: Noise {suppression} on these headphones works surprisingly well.
e.zh: 这副耳机的降噪效果出人意料地好。

e.en: Long-term steroid use has a {suppressive} effect on immunity.
e.zh: 长期使用类固醇对免疫力有抑制作用。

e.en: The regime relied on {suppressive} tactics to silence critics.
e.zh: 该政权靠压制手段让批评者噤声。

e.en: He attached a {suppressor} to reduce the rifle's noise.
e.zh: 他给步枪装了消音器以降低噪音。

e.en: Scientists discovered a tumor {suppressor} gene in the study.
e.zh: 科学家在研究中发现了一种抑癌基因。

e.en: If untreated, the wound may {suppurate} and become infected.
e.zh: 伤口若不治疗可能会化脓并感染。

e.en: Old abscesses sometimes {suppurate} weeks after the initial injury.
e.zh: 旧脓肿有时会在受伤数周后化脓。

e.en: The child was diagnosed with acute {suppurative} otitis media.
e.zh: 该名儿童被诊断为急性化脓性中耳炎。

e.en: A {suppurative} infection requires immediate antibiotic treatment.
e.zh: 化脓性感染需要立即使用抗生素治疗。

e.en: See {supra} note 12 for the full citation.
e.zh: 完整出处参见上文注释十二。

e.en: The argument outlined {supra} applies equally here.
e.zh: 上文阐述的论点同样适用于此。

e.en: The doctor palpated a swollen {supraclavicular} lymph node.
e.zh: 医生触诊到一个肿大的锁骨上淋巴结。

e.en: Anesthesia was delivered via a {supraclavicular} nerve block.
e.zh: 麻醉通过锁骨上神经阻滞实施。

e.en: The child suffered a {supracondylar} fracture after falling off the swing.
e.zh: 那孩子从秋千上摔下后骨折在肱骨髁上。

e.en: A {supracondylar} fracture often requires careful surgical pinning.
e.zh: 髁上骨折通常需要小心地手术钉固定。

e.en: Paramedics inserted a {supraglottic} airway during the emergency.
e.zh: 急救人员在紧急情况下置入了声门上气道。

e.en: The tumor was located in the {supraglottic} region of the larynx.
e.zh: 肿瘤位于喉部的声门上区。

e.en: The EU operates as a {supranational} body across member states.
e.zh: 欧盟在各成员国之上以超国家组织形式运作。

e.en: Climate change demands {supranational} cooperation among governments.
e.zh: 气候变化需要各国政府的超国家级合作。

e.en: Her ECG revealed episodes of {supraventricular} tachycardia.
e.zh: 她的心电图显示出室上性心动过速发作。

e.en: Doctors prescribed medication to control her {supraventricular} arrhythmia.
e.zh: 医生开了药物来控制她的室上性心律失常。

e.en: The platform banned several {supremacist} accounts last week.
e.zh: 该平台上周封禁了多个白人至上主义账号。

e.en: He renounced his former {supremacist} beliefs in public.
e.zh: 他公开放弃了从前的种族至上主义信仰。

e.en: China challenged America's long-held tech {supremacy}.
e.zh: 中国挑战了美国长期保持的科技霸主地位。

e.en: The team's {supremacy} in the league lasted nearly a decade.
e.zh: 该队在联赛中的霸主地位持续了将近十年。

e.en: The {Supreme} Court ruled on the case yesterday.
e.zh: 最高法院昨天对该案作出了裁决。

e.en: She made the {supreme} sacrifice to save her teammates.
e.zh: 她为救队友作出了最高的牺牲。

e.en: He felt {supremely} confident before the final exam.
e.zh: 期末考前他感到极其自信。

e.en: The chef was {supremely} talented at fusion cooking.
e.zh: 那位主厨在融合料理上极具天赋。

e.en: The marketing {supremo} unveiled a bold new campaign.
e.zh: 营销总掌门人推出了一项大胆的新活动。

e.en: Tech {supremo} Elon Musk announced another company acquisition.
e.zh: 科技大佬马斯克宣布了又一项公司收购。

e.en: The school district hired a new {Supt} this fall.
e.zh: 该学区今秋聘请了一位新的教育局长。

e.en: Memo from {Supt} Johnson outlines next year's budget cuts.
e.zh: 约翰逊总监的备忘录概述了明年的预算削减。

e.en: He recited a short {sura} during morning prayers.
e.zh: 他在晨礼中诵读了一段简短的古兰经章节。

e.en: The first {sura} of the Quran is called Al-Fatiha.
e.zh: 古兰经的第一章名为开端章。

surbiton.t: n. 瑟比顿（伦敦郊区地名）

e.en: She caught the train home to {Surbiton} after work.
e.zh: 下班后她搭火车回到萨比顿的家。

e.en: {Surbiton} is a quiet suburb southwest of central London.
e.zh: 萨比顿是伦敦市中心西南方一座宁静的郊区。

surcease.t:
n. 中止；停止
v. 停歇

e.en: The medication brought a brief {surcease} from his chronic pain.
e.zh: 那药物让他的慢性疼痛得到了短暂的缓解。

e.en: There seemed to be no {surcease} from the relentless rain.
e.zh: 那场不停歇的雨似乎没有要停下的意思。

surcharge.t:
n. 附加费
v. 加收费用

e.en: The airline added a fuel {surcharge} to every ticket.
e.zh: 该航空公司在每张机票上加收了燃油附加费。

e.en: Late payments incur a ten percent {surcharge} on the balance.
e.zh: 逾期付款将按余额加收百分之十的附加费。

e.en: The knight wore a heraldic {surcoat} over his armor.
e.zh: 骑士在盔甲外披着一件绘有纹章的罩袍。

e.en: Her costume included a velvet {surcoat} embroidered with gold.
e.zh: 她的戏服包括一件绣金的丝绒罩袍。

sure.t:
adj. 确信的；肯定的
adv. 当然

e.en: Are you {sure} you locked the front door?
e.zh: 你确定你锁了前门吗?

e.en: {Sure}, I can grab coffee with you tomorrow.
e.zh: 当然,我明天可以和你一起喝咖啡。

surefire.t: adj. 必定成功的；万无一失的

e.en: Adding humor is a {surefire} way to engage readers.
e.zh: 加入幽默是吸引读者的万无一失的方法。

e.en: There's no {surefire} cure for the common cold.
e.zh: 目前还没有根治普通感冒的灵丹妙药。

e.en: You {surely} don't believe everything you read online.
e.zh: 你总不至于网上看到什么都信吧。

e.en: Slowly but {surely}, the project came together.
e.zh: 项目虽然进展缓慢,但稳步推进着。

e.en: She answered every question with calm {sureness}.
e.zh: 她带着平静的笃定回答了每个问题。

e.en: His {sureness} on the tightrope amazed the audience.
e.zh: 他在钢丝上的稳健让观众惊叹不已。

e.en: The bank required a {surety} before issuing the loan.
e.zh: 银行在发放贷款前要求提供担保人。

e.en: His father stood as {surety} for the apartment lease.
e.zh: 他父亲为这份公寓租约充当担保人。

surf.t:
n. 拍岸浪
v. 冲浪；上网浏览

e.en: They flew to Bali to {surf} the famous waves.
e.zh: 他们飞往巴厘岛去冲那些著名的浪。

e.en: I like to {surf} the web during my lunch break.
e.zh: 我喜欢在午休时间随便上网浏览。

surface.t:
n. 表面
v. 浮现；浮出水面

e.en: Wipe the kitchen {surface} clean before preparing food.
e.zh: 备餐前先把厨房台面擦干净。

e.en: New evidence began to {surface} during the investigation.
e.zh: 调查过程中新的证据开始浮出水面。

surfaced.t: v. 浮现；铺面（surface 过去式）

e.en: The submarine {surfaced} just off the coast at dawn.
e.zh: 潜艇黎明时分在海岸附近浮出水面。

e.en: Old photos {surfaced} online after the celebrity's death.
e.zh: 那位名人去世后,旧照片在网上浮现了出来。

surfaces.t:
n. 表面（复数）
v. 浮现（第三人称）

e.en: Disinfect all hard {surfaces} in the kitchen daily.
e.zh: 每天给厨房所有硬质表面消毒。

e.en: A new bug {surfaces} every time we ship an update.
e.zh: 我们每发布一次更新就会冒出新的漏洞。

e.en: Memories from childhood kept {surfacing} during the therapy session.
e.zh: 心理治疗中童年的记忆不断浮现。

e.en: The contractor is {surfacing} the driveway with fresh asphalt.
e.zh: 承包商正在用新沥青铺设车道路面。

e.en: Soap contains a {surfactant} that helps lift grease away.
e.zh: 肥皂含有能去油的表面活性剂。

e.en: Premature babies often lack pulmonary {surfactant} at birth.
e.zh: 早产儿出生时往往缺乏肺表面活性物质。

e.en: He waxed his {surfboard} before paddling out.
e.zh: 他给冲浪板打蜡后才划水出海。

e.en: A vintage {surfboard} hung on the cafe wall as decor.
e.zh: 咖啡馆墙上挂着一块复古冲浪板作装饰。

surfed.t: v. 冲浪；浏览（surf 过去式）

e.en: We {surfed} the North Shore for two weeks last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在北岸冲浪了两个星期。

e.en: She {surfed} the web for vacation deals all afternoon.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在网上找度假优惠。

surfeit.t:
n. 过量；过度
v. 使过饱

e.en: The holidays brought a {surfeit} of cookies and cake.
e.zh: 假期里饼干和蛋糕多得吃不完。

e.en: There's a {surfeit} of streaming options these days.
e.zh: 如今流媒体平台多得让人挑花了眼。

surfer.t: n. 冲浪者；网上浏览者

e.en: The {surfer} caught a perfect wave at sunrise.
e.zh: 那位冲浪者在日出时分赶上了一道完美的浪。

e.en: As an avid {surfer}, he checks the forecast daily.
e.zh: 作为一个狂热的冲浪爱好者,他每天都看浪况预报。

e.en: Local {surfers} gathered at the beach before dawn.
e.zh: 本地的冲浪者们在天亮前聚集到海滩上。

e.en: The competition attracted {surfers} from over twenty countries.
e.zh: 比赛吸引了来自二十多个国家的冲浪选手。

surfing.t:
n. 冲浪运动
v. 上网浏览

e.en: He spent the morning {surfing} at Bondi Beach.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在邦迪海滩冲浪。

e.en: I was {surfing} TikTok when the notification popped up.
e.zh: 通知弹出来时我正在刷抖音国际版。

e.en: Her weekend {surfings} along the coast became a beloved ritual.
e.zh: 她周末沿海岸的几次冲浪成了心爱的固定活动。

e.en: The film documented several legendary {surfings} from the 1960s.
e.zh: 这部影片记录了上世纪六十年代几次传奇的冲浪经历。

surfs.t: v. 冲浪；浏览（第三人称）

e.en: She {surfs} every Saturday morning before work.
e.zh: 她每个周六上班前都会去冲浪。

e.en: He {surfs} dating apps whenever he feels lonely.
e.zh: 每当感到孤单他就会刷交友软件。

surge.t:
n. 激增；浪涌
v. 涌动；猛增

e.en: There was a {surge} in online orders during lockdown.
e.zh: 封控期间网购订单激增。

e.en: Crowds {surge} forward the moment the gates open.
e.zh: 大门一开,人群便蜂拥向前。

surged.t: v. 涌起；激增（surge 过去式）

e.en: Bitcoin prices {surged} after the regulatory announcement.
e.zh: 监管消息发布后比特币价格飙升。

e.en: Fans {surged} toward the stage when the band appeared.
e.zh: 乐队一出场,粉丝们就涌向了舞台。

e.en: The {surgeon} explained the risks before the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术前讲解了相关风险。

e.en: She trained for ten years to become a heart {surgeon}.
e.zh: 她苦学十年才成为一名心脏外科医生。

e.en: Top {surgeons} from around the world attended the conference.
e.zh: 来自世界各地的顶尖外科医生出席了那场会议。

e.en: The hospital has a team of pediatric {surgeons} on call.
e.zh: 那家医院有一支儿科外科医生团队随时待命。

e.en: He underwent three knee {surgeries} during his career.
e.zh: 他职业生涯中做过三次膝盖手术。

e.en: Cosmetic {surgeries} have become increasingly common among young adults.
e.zh: 整形手术在年轻人中变得越来越普遍。

e.en: She is recovering well after knee {surgery} last month.
e.zh: 她上个月做了膝盖手术，现在恢复得不错。

e.en: The clinic offers minor {surgery} on weekday mornings.
e.zh: 该诊所在工作日上午提供小型手术服务。

surges.t:
n. 浪涌（复数）
v. 涌起

e.en: Online traffic {surges} whenever a new episode drops.
e.zh: 每当新一集上线，网络流量就会激增。

e.en: The app handles sudden {surges} in user signups smoothly.
e.zh: 该应用能从容应对用户注册量的突然激增。

e.en: Doctors performed a {surgical} procedure to remove the tumor.
e.zh: 医生通过手术切除了肿瘤。

e.en: The editor made {surgical} cuts to tighten the script.
e.zh: 编辑做了精准的删减以使剧本更紧凑。

e.en: The damaged tendon was {surgically} repaired last week.
e.zh: 受损的肌腱上周通过手术修复了。

e.en: The team {surgically} removed bugs from the legacy code.
e.zh: 团队精准地清除了旧代码中的漏洞。

surging.t: v. 涌动；激增（surge 现在分词）

e.en: Electricity demand is {surging} during the heat wave.
e.zh: 热浪期间用电需求正在激增。

e.en: Crowds came {surging} toward the stage when the band appeared.
e.zh: 乐队出现时，人群涌向舞台。

e.en: My grandfather was born in {Surinam} before independence.
e.zh: 我祖父在独立前出生于苏里南。

e.en: The old map still labels the region as {Surinam}.
e.zh: 那张旧地图仍把该地区标为苏里南。

surinamese.t:
adj. 苏里南的
n. 苏里南人

e.en: She married a {Surinamese} engineer she met in Amsterdam.
e.zh: 她嫁给了在阿姆斯特丹认识的一位苏里南工程师。

e.en: The restaurant serves authentic {Surinamese} roti and curry.
e.zh: 那家餐厅供应正宗的苏里南薄饼和咖喱。

e.en: His usual {surliness} disappeared when his daughter walked in.
e.zh: 女儿一走进来，他平日的乖戾立刻消失了。

e.en: The waiter's {surliness} ruined an otherwise lovely evening.
e.zh: 服务员的粗鲁态度毁了原本美好的一晚。

surly.t: adj. 乖戾的；粗暴无礼的

e.en: The {surly} clerk barely looked up from his phone.
e.zh: 那个态度恶劣的店员几乎没从手机上抬起头。

e.en: My neighbor turns {surly} whenever the kids play loudly.
e.zh: 孩子们一吵闹，我邻居就变得很暴躁。

surmise.t:
v. 推测；猜测
n. 推测

e.en: From her smile, I {surmise} the interview went well.
e.zh: 从她的笑容看，我猜面试进行得不错。

e.en: Detectives can only {surmise} what happened that night.
e.zh: 侦探们对那晚发生的事只能进行推测。

e.en: Startups must {surmount} many obstacles in the first year.
e.zh: 初创公司在第一年必须克服许多障碍。

e.en: She worked hard to {surmount} her fear of public speaking.
e.zh: 她努力克服了在公众面前讲话的恐惧。

surmountable.t: adj. 可克服的；可战胜的

e.en: These technical issues are difficult but clearly {surmountable}.
e.zh: 这些技术问题虽然棘手，但显然是可以克服的。

e.en: With practice, the language barrier becomes {surmountable}.
e.zh: 通过练习，语言障碍是可以克服的。

e.en: Please enter your first name and {surname} on the form.
e.zh: 请在表格上填写您的名字和姓氏。

e.en: After marriage, she kept her maiden {surname}.
e.zh: 婚后她保留了娘家的姓氏。

e.en: Many Korean {surnames} are derived from ancient clan names.
e.zh: 许多韩国姓氏源自古代的氏族名称。

e.en: The database lists customer {surnames} in alphabetical order.
e.zh: 该数据库按字母顺序列出客户的姓氏。

e.en: This year's sales are expected to {surpass} last year's record.
e.zh: 今年的销售额预计将超过去年的纪录。

e.en: Few films can {surpass} the original in storytelling.
e.zh: 很少有电影能在叙事上超越原作。

e.en: The athlete is {surpassing} every expectation this season.
e.zh: 这名运动员本赛季正在超越所有人的期待。
