e.en: She painted with {surpassing} skill for someone her age.
e.zh: 以她的年龄而言，她绘画的技巧出众。

e.en: The view from the summit was {surpassingly} beautiful.
e.zh: 山顶上的景色美得无与伦比。

e.en: Her debut novel is {surpassingly} confident for a first work.
e.zh: 作为处女作，她的小说自信得出奇。

surplice.t: n. (教士穿的) 白色法衣

e.en: The choirboy adjusted his white {surplice} before the service.
e.zh: 礼拜开始前，唱诗班男孩整理了他的白色法衣。

e.en: A linen {surplice} hung neatly in the priest's wardrobe.
e.zh: 一件亚麻法衣整齐地挂在牧师的衣柜里。

surplus.t:
n. 剩余，盈余
adj. 多余的

e.en: The country reported a trade {surplus} for the third quarter.
e.zh: 该国第三季度公布了贸易顺差。

e.en: We donated our {surplus} office chairs to a local school.
e.zh: 我们把多余的办公椅捐给了当地一所学校。

e.en: Several states are running budget {surpluses} this year.
e.zh: 今年有几个州出现了预算盈余。

e.en: Farmers struggle to sell their grain {surpluses} abroad.
e.zh: 农民们难以将他们多余的粮食销往国外。

surprise.t:
n. 惊讶，意外
v. 使惊讶

e.en: My friends threw a {surprise} party for my birthday.
e.zh: 朋友们为我的生日办了一场惊喜派对。

e.en: It came as no {surprise} that the flight was delayed.
e.zh: 航班延误了，这一点也不意外。

e.en: I was {surprised} to see her at the conference.
e.zh: 在会议上看到她，我感到很惊讶。

e.en: He looked genuinely {surprised} when his name was called.
e.zh: 当叫到他的名字时，他看起来真的很惊讶。

surprises.t:
v. 使惊讶
n. 惊喜（复数）

e.en: Life is full of unexpected {surprises}, both good and bad.
e.zh: 生活充满了意想不到的惊喜，有好有坏。

e.en: The new update {surprises} users with a redesigned interface.
e.zh: 新版本以重新设计的界面让用户惊喜。

e.en: It's not {surprising} that remote work is here to stay.
e.zh: 远程办公会持续下去，这并不令人意外。

e.en: The film has a {surprising} twist near the end.
e.zh: 这部电影在接近结尾时有一个出人意料的反转。

e.en: The budget laptop runs games {surprisingly} well.
e.zh: 这款廉价笔记本运行游戏出乎意料地流畅。

e.en: {Surprisingly}, the meeting ended ten minutes early.
e.zh: 令人意外的是，会议提前十分钟结束了。

surreal.t: adj. 超现实的，梦幻般的

e.en: Walking through the empty city felt completely {surreal}.
e.zh: 走过空荡荡的城市感觉完全不真实。

e.en: The dream had a {surreal} quality I couldn't shake.
e.zh: 那个梦带有一种我挥之不去的超现实感。

e.en: Dalí became one of the most famous painters of {surrealism}.
e.zh: 达利成为超现实主义最著名的画家之一。

e.en: The exhibition explores {surrealism} and its modern influence.
e.zh: 该展览探讨了超现实主义及其现代影响。

e.en: The critic compared various national {surrealisms} from the 1930s.
e.zh: 评论家比较了上世纪三十年代各国的超现实主义流派。

e.en: Her essay distinguishes between literary and visual {surrealisms}.
e.zh: 她的文章区分了文学与视觉上的各种超现实主义。

surrealist.t:
n. 超现实主义者
adj. 超现实主义的

e.en: The gallery features a {surrealist} painting by Magritte.
e.zh: 画廊展出了一幅马格利特的超现实主义画作。

e.en: His short film has a strong {surrealist} flavor.
e.zh: 他的短片带有浓厚的超现实主义风格。

e.en: The novel uses {surrealistic} imagery to depict grief.
e.zh: 这部小说运用超现实主义的意象来描绘悲伤。

e.en: Her photography has a dreamlike, {surrealistic} feel.
e.zh: 她的摄影作品带有梦幻般的超现实主义感觉。

surrealists.t: n. 超现实主义者（复数）

e.en: The {surrealists} drew inspiration from dreams and the unconscious.
e.zh: 超现实主义者们从梦境和潜意识中汲取灵感。

e.en: Many famous {surrealists} gathered in Paris during the 1920s.
e.zh: 许多著名的超现实主义者于二十年代聚集在巴黎。

e.en: The streets were {surreally} quiet during the lockdown.
e.zh: 封锁期间，街道安静得不真实。

e.en: Snow fell {surreally} on the beach that summer afternoon.
e.zh: 那个夏日午后，雪居然超现实地落在沙滩上。

surrender.t:
v. 投降，屈服
n. 投降，放弃

e.en: The troops refused to {surrender} despite being outnumbered.
e.zh: 尽管寡不敌众，部队仍拒绝投降。

e.en: You must {surrender} your passport at the front desk.
e.zh: 您必须在前台交出您的护照。

e.en: The suspect {surrendered} peacefully to the police.
e.zh: 嫌疑人和平地向警方投降。

e.en: She finally {surrendered} her old phone for a new one.
e.zh: 她终于把旧手机交出去换了部新的。

e.en: He's not {surrendering} the title without a serious fight.
e.zh: 他不会不经过激烈较量就拱手让出冠军头衔。

e.en: {Surrendering} control of the project was difficult for her.
e.zh: 放弃对项目的控制权对她来说很困难。

e.en: The chess player rarely {surrenders}, even in losing positions.
e.zh: 这位棋手即使处于劣势也很少认输。

e.en: History records many famous battlefield {surrenders}.
e.zh: 历史记载了许多著名的战场投降事件。

surreptitious.t: adj. 偷偷摸摸的，秘密的

e.en: She took a {surreptitious} glance at her phone during class.
e.zh: 上课时她偷偷瞄了一眼手机。

e.en: He made a {surreptitious} exit through the back door.
e.zh: 他从后门偷偷溜了出去。

e.en: The cat {surreptitiously} stole a piece of fish from the table.
e.zh: 那只猫偷偷地从桌上叼走了一块鱼。

e.en: He {surreptitiously} recorded the meeting on his phone.
e.zh: 他偷偷用手机录下了那场会议。

surrey.t: n. 萨里郡（英国）；四轮马车

e.en: They moved to a quiet village in {Surrey} last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天他们搬到了萨里郡的一个安静村庄。

e.en: {Surrey} is known for its scenic countryside and golf clubs.
e.zh: 萨里以风景秀丽的乡村和高尔夫俱乐部而闻名。

e.en: The couple chose {surrogacy} to start their family.
e.zh: 这对夫妇选择通过代孕来组建家庭。

e.en: Laws around {surrogacy} vary widely between countries.
e.zh: 各国关于代孕的法律差异很大。

surrogate.t:
n. 代理人，替代者
adj. 代替的

e.en: His older brother became a {surrogate} father after their dad left.
e.zh: 父亲离开后，哥哥成了他的代理父亲。

e.en: The team used a {surrogate} metric to estimate user satisfaction.
e.zh: 团队用一个替代指标来估算用户满意度。

e.en: Tall mountains {surround} the small alpine village.
e.zh: 高山环绕着这座阿尔卑斯山的小村庄。

e.en: Try to {surround} yourself with supportive friends.
e.zh: 试着让自己身边都是支持你的朋友。

e.en: The cabin was {surrounded} by tall pine trees.
e.zh: 小木屋被高大的松树环绕着。

e.en: She felt {surrounded} by love at her retirement party.
e.zh: 在退休派对上，她感到自己被爱包围着。

e.en: The hotel offers stunning views of the {surrounding} hills.
e.zh: 酒店可以欣赏到周围群山的迷人景色。

e.en: Rumors {surrounding} the merger have spread quickly online.
e.zh: 围绕这次合并的传言在网上迅速传开。

e.en: It took the puppy a few days to adjust to its new {surroundings}.
e.zh: 小狗花了几天时间才适应新环境。

e.en: She paused to take in the peaceful forest {surroundings}.
e.zh: 她停下来欣赏宁静的森林环境。

e.en: A high stone wall {surrounds} the old monastery.
e.zh: 一堵高高的石墙环绕着这座古老的修道院。

e.en: Mystery still {surrounds} the disappearance of the ship.
e.zh: 那艘船的失踪至今仍是个谜。

e.en: The government imposed a {surtax} on luxury vehicles.
e.zh: 政府对豪华车征收了附加税。

e.en: High earners may face an additional {surtax} this year.
e.zh: 今年高收入者可能要缴纳额外的附加税。

e.en: The store relies on {surveillance} cameras to deter theft.
e.zh: 商店依靠监控摄像头来防止偷窃。

e.en: Privacy advocates worry about increased online {surveillance}.
e.zh: 隐私倡导者担心网络监控日益加强。

e.en: Police conducted several overnight {surveillances} of the warehouse.
e.zh: 警方对那间仓库进行了几次通宵监视。

e.en: The agency authorized targeted {surveillances} of suspected hackers.
e.zh: 该机构批准了对可疑黑客的定点监视。

e.en: He often {surves} the word 'serves' when typing quickly.
e.zh: 他打字快的时候经常把 serves 误打成 surves。

e.en: The spell-checker flagged {surves} as a likely misspelling.
e.zh: 拼写检查工具把 surves 标记为可能的拼写错误。

survey.t:
n. 调查，问卷
v. 调查，勘测

e.en: The company will {survey} customers about the new feature.
e.zh: 公司将就新功能向客户进行调查。

e.en: He climbed the hill to {survey} the valley below.
e.zh: 他爬上山坡俯瞰下面的山谷。

e.en: We {surveyed} over 500 users before launching the app.
e.zh: 我们在应用上线前调查了五百多名用户。

e.en: She {surveyed} the messy room with a sigh.
e.zh: 她叹了口气,环顾这凌乱的房间。

surveying.t:
n. 测量学
v. 调查（进行式）

e.en: The team is {surveying} residents about traffic concerns.
e.zh: 团队正在就交通问题对居民进行调查。

e.en: He stood {surveying} the crowd from the stage.
e.zh: 他站在台上打量着人群。

e.en: The {surveyor} measured the property boundaries carefully.
e.zh: 那位测量员仔细丈量了地产边界。

e.en: A licensed {surveyor} must sign off on the plans.
e.zh: 必须由持证的测量师在图纸上签字确认。

surveys.t:
n. 调查（复数）
v. 调查（三单）

e.en: Online {surveys} often have low response rates.
e.zh: 网上调查问卷的回复率通常很低。

e.en: She {surveys} the kitchen before starting to cook.
e.zh: 她在开始做饭前先打量了一下厨房。

e.en: Engineers tested the drone's {survivability} in harsh weather.
e.zh: 工程师们测试了无人机在恶劣天气下的存活能力。

e.en: Early diagnosis greatly improves patient {survivability}.
e.zh: 早期诊断能大幅提高患者的生存率。

survivable.t: adj. 可存活的，能挺过的

e.en: The crash was barely {survivable} for the passengers.
e.zh: 那场撞车事故乘客几乎无法生还。

e.en: With proper gear, the cold night is {survivable}.
e.zh: 只要装备得当,寒夜是可以挺过去的。

e.en: Clean water is essential for human {survival}.
e.zh: 清洁的水是人类生存的必需品。

e.en: He packed a {survival} kit for the hike.
e.zh: 他为徒步旅行准备了一个生存包。

e.en: The {survivalist} built a cabin deep in the woods.
e.zh: 那位野外生存者在森林深处搭了一间小屋。

e.en: He's a {survivalist} who stockpiles food and water.
e.zh: 他是个囤积食物和水的生存主义者。

e.en: These traditions are {survivals} from medieval times.
e.zh: 这些传统是从中世纪流传下来的遗存。

e.en: Miraculous {survivals} from the avalanche made the news.
e.zh: 雪崩中的奇迹生还者登上了新闻。

e.en: Plants can't {survive} without sunlight and water.
e.zh: 植物没有阳光和水就无法存活。

e.en: Few startups {survive} their first three years.
e.zh: 很少有初创公司能熬过头三年。

e.en: She {survived} the accident with only minor injuries.
e.zh: 她在事故中只受了轻伤就活了下来。

e.en: The old building {survived} the earthquake intact.
e.zh: 那栋老建筑在地震中完好无损地保存了下来。

e.en: Only one copy of the manuscript still {survives}.
e.zh: 那份手稿如今只有一份还留存于世。

e.en: He {survives} on coffee during exam week.
e.zh: 考试周他全靠咖啡撑着。

e.en: She is the last {surviving} member of the family.
e.zh: 她是家中唯一在世的成员。

e.en: They are barely {surviving} on a single income.
e.zh: 他们仅靠一份收入勉强度日。

e.en: The {survivor} shared her story with reporters.
e.zh: 那位幸存者向记者讲述了她的经历。

e.en: He's a cancer {survivor} who runs marathons now.
e.zh: 他是位癌症康复者,现在还跑马拉松。

survivors.t: n. 幸存者们（survivor 的复数）

e.en: Rescue teams searched for {survivors} in the rubble.
e.zh: 救援队在废墟中搜寻幸存者。

e.en: Support groups help {survivors} of trauma heal.
e.zh: 互助小组帮助创伤幸存者疗愈心灵。

sus.t: adj. 可疑的（网络用语，suspicious 的缩写）

e.en: Stress increases your {susceptibility} to colds and flu.
e.zh: 压力会增加你患感冒和流感的易感性。

e.en: Genetic factors influence {susceptibility} to certain diseases.
e.zh: 基因因素会影响对某些疾病的易感性。

susceptible.t: adj. 易受影响的；易感染的

e.en: Young children are more {susceptible} to infections.
e.zh: 幼儿更容易受到感染。

e.en: Old phones are {susceptible} to overheating issues.
e.zh: 老款手机容易出现过热问题。

e.en: Let's grab some {sushi} for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我们去吃寿司吧。

e.en: This restaurant serves the freshest {sushi} in town.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应全城最新鲜的寿司。

suspect.t:
v. 怀疑
n. 嫌疑人

e.en: Police arrested the main {suspect} this morning.
e.zh: 警方今早逮捕了主要嫌疑人。

e.en: I {suspect} he's lying about where he was.
e.zh: 我怀疑他在撒谎,他没说真去过哪里。

suspected.t:
adj. 疑似的
v. 怀疑（过去式）

e.en: She {suspected} something was wrong with the contract.
e.zh: 她怀疑合同有些地方不对劲。

e.en: He was the {suspected} source of the leak.
e.zh: 他被怀疑是泄密的源头。

e.en: She walked in not {suspecting} a surprise party awaited.
e.zh: 她走进来时没料到有个惊喜派对在等她。

e.en: He kept asking questions, clearly {suspecting} foul play.
e.zh: 他不停地追问,显然怀疑事有蹊跷。

suspects.t:
n. 嫌疑人（复数）
v. 怀疑（三单）

e.en: Detectives are questioning two {suspects} about the robbery.
e.zh: 警探正在就抢劫案审问两名嫌疑人。

e.en: She {suspects} her colleague leaked the email.
e.zh: 她怀疑那封邮件是同事泄露出去的。

e.en: The school may {suspend} students for cheating.
e.zh: 学校可能会因作弊而停学学生。

e.en: You can {suspend} your subscription for one month.
e.zh: 你可以暂停订阅一个月。

e.en: His account was {suspended} for violating the rules.
e.zh: 他的账号因违规被封停了。

e.en: A chandelier was {suspended} from the ceiling.
e.zh: 天花板上吊着一盏枝形吊灯。

suspender.t: n. 吊袜带；(美) 背带

e.en: One {suspender} strap snapped during the performance.
e.zh: 演出中有一根背带突然断了。

e.en: He fixed the broken {suspender} on his trousers.
e.zh: 他把裤子上断掉的吊带修好了。

e.en: He wore red {suspenders} with his black suit.
e.zh: 他穿着黑色西装,配了一副红色吊带。

e.en: My grandfather always wore {suspenders} instead of a belt.
e.zh: 我爷爷向来用吊带裤而不系腰带。

suspending.t: v. 暂停；悬挂（现在分词）

e.en: The league is {suspending} the player for three games.
e.zh: 联盟将禁赛该球员三场比赛。

e.en: They are {suspending} all flights due to the storm.
e.zh: 由于风暴,他们暂停了所有航班。

e.en: The platform {suspends} accounts that post spam.
e.zh: 该平台会封停发垃圾信息的账号。

e.en: A thin wire {suspends} the lamp above the desk.
e.zh: 一根细线把灯悬挂在桌子上方。

e.en: The movie kept us in {suspense} until the end.
e.zh: 这部电影让我们一直紧张悬念到结尾。

e.en: Don't keep me in {suspense}—what did she say?
e.zh: 别再吊我胃口了,她到底说了什么?

e.en: It was a {suspenseful} thriller with a clever twist.
e.zh: 这是一部扣人心弦、转折巧妙的惊悚片。

e.en: The final chapter was incredibly {suspenseful}.
e.zh: 最后一章悬念十足,扣人心弦。

suspension.t:
n. 暂停；停职
n. 悬挂系统

e.en: He received a two-week {suspension} from school.
e.zh: 他被学校停课两周。

e.en: The car's {suspension} handles bumpy roads well.
e.zh: 这辆车的悬挂在颠簸路面上表现很好。

e.en: Repeated {suspensions} hurt the team's playoff chances.
e.zh: 接连的禁赛影响了球队进入季后赛的机会。

e.en: The league announced several {suspensions} this week.
e.zh: 联盟本周宣布了多起禁赛处罚。

e.en: His behavior aroused her {suspicion} immediately.
e.zh: 他的举动立刻引起了她的怀疑。

e.en: She was arrested on {suspicion} of fraud.
e.zh: 她因涉嫌诈骗被逮捕。

e.en: My {suspicions} were confirmed when I saw the receipt.
e.zh: 我看到收据后,怀疑得到了证实。

e.en: She voiced her {suspicions} about the new manager.
e.zh: 她说出了对新经理的疑虑。

e.en: The bank flagged a {suspicious} login from another country.
e.zh: 银行标记了一次来自其他国家的可疑登录。

e.en: She gave the salesman a {suspicious} look and walked away.
e.zh: 她怀疑地看了那个推销员一眼,然后走开了。

e.en: The package was priced {suspiciously} low for a real iPhone.
e.zh: 作为真品 iPhone,这个包裹的价格低得可疑。

e.en: He glanced {suspiciously} at the stranger near the door.
e.zh: 他怀疑地瞥了门口那个陌生人一眼。

e.en: Her general {suspiciousness} made it hard to build trust.
e.zh: 她普遍的多疑让人很难建立信任。

e.en: The model scores each transaction's {suspiciousness} in real time.
e.zh: 该模型实时评估每笔交易的可疑程度。

e.en: Give me a minute to {suss} out how this API works.
e.zh: 给我一点时间搞清楚这个 API 怎么用。

e.en: Users quickly {suss} when an app is collecting too much data.
e.zh: 用户很快就能察觉到应用在收集过多数据。

sussex.t: n. 萨塞克斯（英国郡名）

e.en: They spent the weekend hiking through the {sussex} countryside.
e.zh: 他们周末在萨塞克斯的乡间徒步。

e.en: The bakery in {sussex} won a national pastry award.
e.zh: 萨塞克斯的那家面包店赢得了全国糕点大奖。

e.en: This battery can {sustain} a full day of heavy use.
e.zh: 这块电池能支撑一整天的重度使用。

e.en: It's hard to {sustain} momentum after the launch hype fades.
e.zh: 在发布的热度退去后,很难维持势头。

e.en: The startup published its first {sustainability} report this year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司今年发布了首份可持续发展报告。

e.en: Investors increasingly care about {sustainability} alongside revenue growth.
e.zh: 投资者越来越在意可持续性以及收入增长。

e.en: We're switching to more {sustainable} packaging next quarter.
e.zh: 我们下个季度将改用更环保的包装。

e.en: This growth rate isn't {sustainable} without more engineers.
e.zh: 如果不增加工程师,这种增长速度无法持续。

e.en: The coffee is grown {sustainably} on small family farms.
e.zh: 这种咖啡在小型家庭农场以可持续方式种植。

e.en: We need to scale {sustainably} rather than burn cash quickly.
e.zh: 我们需要可持续地扩张,而不是快速烧钱。

sustained.t:
adj. 持续的
v. 维持（过去式）

e.en: The team {sustained} double-digit growth for three years.
e.zh: 团队连续三年保持了两位数的增长。

e.en: He {sustained} a minor injury during yesterday's match.
e.zh: 他在昨天的比赛中受了轻伤。

e.en: Coffee is the main {sustainer} of my afternoon productivity.
e.zh: 咖啡是支撑我下午工作效率的主要东西。

e.en: The rocket's {sustainer} engine fired for several minutes.
e.zh: 火箭的续航发动机点火持续了好几分钟。

sustaining.t:
adj. 支持的
v. 维持（现在分词）

e.en: Sleep is essential for {sustaining} long-term focus at work.
e.zh: 睡眠对于在工作中维持长期专注至关重要。

e.en: The charity relies on small donors for {sustaining} its programs.
e.zh: 该慈善机构依靠小额捐赠者来维持其项目。

e.en: The contract covers software {sustainment} for the next five years.
e.zh: 该合同涵盖未来五年的软件维护支持。

e.en: Long-term {sustainment} costs often exceed initial purchase prices.
e.zh: 长期维持成本往往超过最初的购买价格。

e.en: Hope {sustains} her through these long medical treatments.
e.zh: 希望支撑着她度过这些漫长的治疗。

e.en: A steady client base {sustains} the small design studio.
e.zh: 稳定的客户群维持着这家小型设计工作室。

e.en: Hikers carried enough {sustenance} for three days in the wild.
e.zh: 徒步者带了足够在野外待三天的食物。

e.en: Reading provides emotional {sustenance} during stressful weeks.
e.zh: 阅读在紧张的几周里提供了情感上的滋养。

susu.t: n. 民间互助储蓄会（罕用）

e.en: Many immigrant families join a {susu} to save money together.
e.zh: 许多移民家庭会加入合会一起存钱。

e.en: She runs a monthly {susu} with friends from her hometown.
e.zh: 她和老家的朋友们每月组织一次合会。

e.en: A soft {susurration} of leaves filled the quiet garden.
e.zh: 安静的花园里满是树叶的轻柔沙沙声。

e.en: You could hear the {susurration} of whispers across the hall.
e.zh: 你能听见大厅里此起彼伏的低语声。

e.en: The {sutler} sold supplies to soldiers near the army camp.
e.zh: 随军商贩在军营附近向士兵出售物资。

e.en: Old letters describe the {sutler} as a shrewd businessman.
e.zh: 旧信件把那位随军商人描述成精明的生意人。

e.en: The monk chanted a Buddhist {sutra} at dawn.
e.zh: 那位僧人在黎明时分诵念佛经。

e.en: She studies an ancient {sutra} written in Sanskrit.
e.zh: 她研究一部用梵文写成的古老经文。

suture.t:
n. 缝合线；手术缝线
v. 缝合（伤口）

e.en: The surgeon used a fine {suture} to close the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生用细线缝合了伤口。

e.en: The nurse will remove the {suture} after one week.
e.zh: 护士会在一周后拆除缝线。

e.en: We flew into {Suva}, the capital city of Fiji.
e.zh: 我们飞抵斐济首都苏瓦。

e.en: The conference was held in downtown {Suva} last month.
e.zh: 会议上个月在苏瓦市中心举行。

e.en: The small kingdom paid yearly tribute to its {suzerain}.
e.zh: 那个小国每年向其宗主国缴纳贡品。

e.en: China was historically the {suzerain} of several neighboring states.
e.zh: 中国历史上是若干周边国家的宗主国。

e.en: The empire claimed {suzerainty} over the entire region.
e.zh: 帝国宣称对整个地区拥有宗主权。

e.en: Tibet's {suzerainty} status was debated by many historians.
e.zh: 许多历史学家争论过西藏的宗主权地位。

suzuki.t: n. 铃木（日本姓氏/汽车品牌）

e.en: My first motorcycle was a small {Suzuki} from Japan.
e.zh: 我的第一辆摩托车是日本产的小铃木。

e.en: She learned violin using the {Suzuki} method as a child.
e.zh: 她小时候用铃木教学法学小提琴。

svelte.t:
adj. 苗条优雅的
n. Svelte（前端框架）

e.en: She looked {svelte} in the black evening dress.
e.zh: 她穿着黑色晚礼服显得身材苗条。

e.en: The new laptop has a remarkably {svelte} design.
e.zh: 这款新笔记本电脑的设计十分轻薄。

svengali.t: n. 幕后操纵者；蛊惑人心者

e.en: The pop star's manager acted like a controlling {Svengali}.
e.zh: 那位流行歌星的经纪人活像个控制狂幕后操纵者。

e.en: Critics called the coach a {Svengali} who manipulated young players.
e.zh: 评论员说那教练是操控年轻球员的幕后黑手。

swab.t:
n. 棉签；拭子
v. 擦拭；采样

e.en: The nurse took a {swab} from my throat for testing.
e.zh: 护士从我的喉咙取了拭子做检查。

e.en: Please {swab} the wound gently with antiseptic.
e.zh: 请用消毒液轻轻擦拭伤口。

swabian.t:
adj. 施瓦本的
n. 施瓦本人

e.en: He grew up speaking a strong {Swabian} dialect.
e.zh: 他从小说着浓重的施瓦本方言。

e.en: The restaurant serves traditional {Swabian} dumplings and noodles.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应传统的施瓦本饺子和面食。

e.en: New parents learn how to {swaddle} a baby properly.
e.zh: 新手父母学习如何正确地襁褓包裹婴儿。

e.en: The nurse showed me how to {swaddle} my newborn.
e.zh: 护士教我如何用襁褓裹好新生儿。

swaddled.t: v. 被襁褓包裹（swaddle 过去式）

e.en: The baby slept peacefully, tightly {swaddled} in soft cotton.
e.zh: 宝宝被柔软的棉布紧紧裹着,睡得很安稳。

e.en: She {swaddled} the infant before placing him in the crib.
e.zh: 她把婴儿包好后放进了婴儿床。

swaddling.t:
v. 包裹婴儿
n. 襁褓

e.en: The hospital provides {swaddling} blankets for every newborn.
e.zh: 医院为每个新生儿提供襁褓毯。

e.en: She is {swaddling} the baby to help him sleep.
e.zh: 她正在给宝宝包襁褓以帮助他入睡。

swag.t:
n. 周边赠品；战利品
adj. 酷炫拉风（俚）

e.en: The conference attendees received free {swag} bags.
e.zh: 参会者都收到了免费的赠品袋。

e.en: He walked into the room with serious {swag}.
e.zh: 他带着十足的派头走进了房间。

swagger.t:
v. 大摇大摆地走
n. 神气；自信气场

e.en: He walked in with the confident {swagger} of a champion.
e.zh: 他带着冠军般自信的傲然步态走进来。

e.en: Don't {swagger} around the office like you own it.
e.zh: 别在办公室里大摇大摆,好像这地方是你的。

swaggering.t: adj. 大摇大摆的；趾高气扬的

e.en: The {swaggering} young actor annoyed the entire film crew.
e.zh: 那个趾高气扬的年轻演员惹恼了整个剧组。

e.en: He came {swaggering} into the bar like a movie star.
e.zh: 他像电影明星一样大摇大摆地走进酒吧。

swahili.t: n. 斯瓦希里语；斯瓦希里人

e.en: {Swahili} is widely spoken across East Africa today.
e.zh: 斯瓦希里语在当今东非被广泛使用。

e.en: She is learning {Swahili} before her trip to Kenya.
e.zh: 她在去肯尼亚之前正在学习斯瓦希里语。

e.en: The poem describes a young {swain} courting his beloved.
e.zh: 这首诗描绘了一位年轻情郎追求心上人的情景。

e.en: She had several country {swain} vying for her hand.
e.zh: 她有好几个乡村追求者争着向她求婚。

swale.t: n. 低洼湿地；排水沟槽

e.en: Rainwater collected in the grassy {swale} behind the house.
e.zh: 雨水汇集在房子后面的草地洼地里。

e.en: We dug a {swale} to redirect runoff from the garden.
e.zh: 我们挖了一条排水洼以引走花园里的径流。

e.en: The landscape designer added {swales} to manage stormwater naturally.
e.zh: 景观设计师增设了洼沟以自然地管理雨水。

e.en: Wildflowers bloomed across the gentle {swales} in spring.
e.zh: 春天里,野花在平缓的洼地上竞相绽放。

swallow.t:
v. 吞咽；忍受
n. 燕子

e.en: Take a sip of water and {swallow} the pill.
e.zh: 喝口水把这粒药吞下去。

e.en: A {swallow} darted gracefully across the evening sky.
e.zh: 一只燕子优雅地掠过傍晚的天空。

e.en: He {swallowed} his pride and apologized to her.
e.zh: 他咽下自尊,向她道了歉。

e.en: The crowd {swallowed} him before I could say goodbye.
e.zh: 还没等我道别,他就被人群淹没了。

swallowing.t:
v. 吞咽中
n. 吞咽动作

e.en: She had trouble {swallowing} the large vitamin pill.
e.zh: 她吞那颗大维生素片有点困难。

e.en: The whale appeared to be {swallowing} an entire school of fish.
e.zh: 那头鲸鱼看起来正在吞下整群鱼。

swallows.t:
v. 吞下（三单）
n. 燕子（复数）

e.en: Each spring, {swallows} return to nest under our roof.
e.zh: 每年春天,燕子都会回来在我们屋檐下筑巢。

e.en: He {swallows} his medicine without any complaint.
e.zh: 他毫无怨言地把药吞了下去。

e.en: A beautiful {swallowtail} butterfly landed on the lavender.
e.zh: 一只漂亮的凤蝶落在了薰衣草上。

e.en: He wore an elegant {swallowtail} coat to the wedding.
e.zh: 他穿着一件优雅的燕尾服去参加婚礼。

swam.t: v. 游泳（swim 的过去式）

e.en: We {swam} across the lake before sunset yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天日落前游过了那个湖。

e.en: The dolphins {swam} alongside the boat for miles.
e.zh: 海豚伴着船游了好几英里。

e.en: The {swami} taught meditation classes at the ashram.
e.zh: 这位印度教师在静修处教授冥想课程。

e.en: Many followers traveled far to hear the {swami} speak.
e.zh: 许多信徒不远千里前来聆听这位大师讲道。

swamp.t:
n. 沼泽
v. 使不堪重负；淹没

e.en: Alligators live in the muddy {swamp} south of town.
e.zh: 鳄鱼生活在城南那片泥泞的沼泽里。

e.en: Emails always {swamp} my inbox after a long vacation.
e.zh: 长假之后,邮件总是把我的收件箱淹没。

e.en: Developers drained the {swampland} to build new houses.
e.zh: 开发商抽干了那片沼泽地以建造新房屋。

e.en: This protected {swampland} is home to rare birds.
e.zh: 这片受保护的沼泽地是珍稀鸟类的家园。

e.en: The trail became {swampy} after three days of rain.
e.zh: 下了三天雨后,这条小路变得泥泞不堪。

e.en: Mosquitoes thrive in the {swampy} areas near the river.
e.zh: 蚊子在河边的沼泽地区大量繁殖。

e.en: A graceful {swan} glided across the still pond.
e.zh: 一只优雅的天鹅在平静的池塘上滑行。

e.en: The white {swan} spread its enormous wings to fly.
e.zh: 那只白天鹅展开巨大的翅膀准备起飞。

swank.t:
v. 炫耀；摆阔
adj. 奢华的

e.en: They had dinner at a {swank} hotel downtown.
e.zh: 他们在市中心一家豪华酒店吃了晚餐。

e.en: He likes to {swank} about his expensive car.
e.zh: 他喜欢炫耀自己那辆昂贵的车。

swanky.t: adj. 豪华时髦的；阔气的

e.en: She moved into a {swanky} apartment near the park.
e.zh: 她搬进了公园附近一套豪华的公寓。

e.en: We celebrated at a {swanky} rooftop bar.
e.zh: 我们在一家高档的屋顶酒吧庆祝。

e.en: Two white {swans} glided across the calm lake.
e.zh: 两只白天鹅在平静的湖面上滑行。

e.en: The {swans} returned to the pond every spring.
e.zh: 每年春天天鹅都会回到这个池塘。

e.en: The pillow was stuffed with soft {swansdown}.
e.zh: 那只枕头里塞满了柔软的天鹅绒毛。

e.en: Her robe was trimmed with delicate {swansdown}.
e.zh: 她的睡袍上饰有精致的天鹅绒边。

swansea.t: n. 斯旺西（英国威尔士城市）

e.en: We took the train from London to {Swansea}.
e.zh: 我们从伦敦坐火车去了斯旺西。

e.en: {Swansea} sits on the southern coast of Wales.
e.zh: 斯旺西位于威尔士南部海岸。

e.en: This album is the singer's official {swansong}.
e.zh: 这张专辑是这位歌手的告别之作。

e.en: The match proved to be his {swansong} as captain.
e.zh: 那场比赛成了他作为队长的最后一战。

e.en: We drove through {Swanton} on the way to the lake.
e.zh: 我们去湖边的路上经过了斯旺顿镇。

e.en: {Swanton} is a small town in northern Vermont.
e.zh: 斯旺顿是佛蒙特州北部的一个小镇。

swap.t:
v. 交换；调换
n. 互换；掉期交易

e.en: Let's {swap} seats so you can see better.
e.zh: 咱们换个座位吧,这样你能看得更清楚。

e.en: Can I {swap} this shirt for a larger size?
e.zh: 我能把这件衬衫换成大一号的吗?

swapo.t: n. 西南非洲人民组织（纳米比亚政党）

e.en: {SWAPO} has governed Namibia since independence in 1990.
e.zh: 自1990年独立以来,人组党一直执政纳米比亚。

e.en: The party {SWAPO} won the latest national election.
e.zh: 人组党在最近的全国大选中获胜。

e.en: We {swapped} phone numbers before leaving the cafe.
e.zh: 离开咖啡馆前我们交换了电话号码。

e.en: She {swapped} her old laptop for a tablet.
e.zh: 她把旧笔记本电脑换成了一台平板。

swapping.t: v. 交换；互换（swap 的现在分词）

e.en: They were {swapping} stories about their travels.
e.zh: 他们在互相分享各自的旅行故事。

e.en: I'm {swapping} my car for a smaller model.
e.zh: 我打算把车换成一辆小一点的车型。

swaps.t:
v. 交换
n. 互换物

e.en: The app {swaps} your face with a celebrity's.
e.zh: 这个应用能把你的脸和明星的脸互换。

e.en: Players make {swaps} during the trade window.
e.zh: 球员们会在交易窗口期内进行互换。

e.en: The children played on the green {sward} outside.
e.zh: 孩子们在外面绿油油的草坪上玩耍。

e.en: A soft {sward} covered the gentle hillside.
e.zh: 柔软的草皮覆盖着平缓的山坡。

swarm.t:
n. 蜂群；一大群
v. 蜂拥；成群

e.en: A {swarm} of bees flew past the window.
e.zh: 一群蜜蜂从窗前飞过。

e.en: Tourists {swarm} the beach every summer.
e.zh: 游客们每年夏天都涌向海滩。

e.en: The kitchen was {swarming} with ants this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上厨房里爬满了蚂蚁。

e.en: Fans were {swarming} around the singer outside.
e.zh: 歌迷们在外面把歌手团团围住。

swarms.t:
n. 蜂群
v. 蜂拥而至

e.en: Bees {swarms} appeared near the orchard last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天果园附近出现了成群的蜜蜂。

e.en: The app {swarms} with ads after the latest update.
e.zh: 最新更新后这个应用充斥着大量广告。

e.en: A {swarthy} sailor stepped off the ship at dawn.
e.zh: 一个肤色黝黑的水手在黎明时下了船。

e.en: The novel describes a tall, {swarthy} stranger entering the inn.
e.zh: 小说描写一个高大黝黑的陌生人走进客栈。

swash.t:
n. 拍岸浪
v. 溅泼

e.en: Waves {swash} gently against the wooden pier.
e.zh: 海浪轻轻拍打着木制码头。

e.en: You can hear the {swash} of the tide all night.
e.zh: 整夜都能听见潮水拍岸的声音。

swashbuckle.t: v. 虚张声势；炫耀武力

e.en: Old pirate films love to {swashbuckle} across stormy decks.
e.zh: 老式海盗片喜欢在风暴甲板上大显身手。

e.en: He likes to {swashbuckle} through every meeting like a hero.
e.zh: 他喜欢在每次会议上像英雄般招摇登场。

swashbuckler.t: n. 好斗的冒险家；侠客片

e.en: The film stars a charming {swashbuckler} chasing buried treasure.
e.zh: 这部电影主角是一位追寻宝藏的迷人冒险家。

e.en: She played a fearless {swashbuckler} in the new pirate series.
e.zh: 她在新海盗剧中饰演一位无畏的剑客。

swashbuckling.t: adj. 冒险刺激的；大胆豪侠的

e.en: Kids loved the {swashbuckling} adventure on the streaming service.
e.zh: 孩子们很喜欢流媒体上那部冒险刺激的影片。

e.en: He gave a {swashbuckling} speech full of bold promises.
e.zh: 他发表了一场豪气十足、充满大胆承诺的演讲。

e.en: Someone spray-painted a {swastika} on the wall overnight.
e.zh: 有人趁夜在墙上喷了一个纳粹十字符号。

e.en: The platform automatically removes posts containing a {swastika}.
e.zh: 该平台会自动删除含有纳粹标志的帖子。

swat.t:
v. 猛拍（苍蝇等）
n. 重拍

e.en: I tried to {swat} the mosquito buzzing near my laptop.
e.zh: 我想拍掉在笔记本旁嗡嗡叫的蚊子。

e.en: She gave the fly a quick {swat} with the magazine.
e.zh: 她用杂志迅速拍了那只苍蝇一下。

e.en: The designer sent a {swatch} of fabric for approval.
e.zh: 设计师寄来一块布料样品供确认。

e.en: Pick a color {swatch} from the palette in Figma.
e.zh: 从 Figma 调色板里选一个色样吧。

swath.t: n. 一长条区域；割下的一行庄稼

e.en: The storm cut a {swath} of damage through the coastal town.
e.zh: 风暴在沿海小镇上留下了大片破坏。

e.en: A wide {swath} of users abandoned the app after the redesign.
e.zh: 重新设计后大批用户弃用了这款应用。

swathe.t:
v. 包裹；缠绕
n. 长条

e.en: Nurses {swathe} the wound carefully in clean bandages.
e.zh: 护士小心地用干净绷带把伤口包好。

e.en: Mist began to {swathe} the mountain peak at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时雾气开始笼罩山峰。

e.en: Keep a fly {swatter} near the kitchen window in summer.
e.zh: 夏天在厨房窗边备一把苍蝇拍。

e.en: He bought a plastic {swatter} from the dollar store.
e.zh: 他在一元店买了一把塑料苍蝇拍。

sway.t:
v. 摇摆；影响
n. 摇动；支配

e.en: Tall trees {sway} gently in the evening breeze.
e.zh: 高大的树木在晚风中轻轻摇曳。

e.en: Celebrity endorsements still {sway} a lot of young buyers.
e.zh: 名人代言仍然能左右许多年轻消费者。

e.en: The old {swaybacked} horse still grazed peacefully in the field.
e.zh: 那匹背凹陷的老马仍在田里安静吃草。

e.en: Their {swaybacked} sofa finally collapsed during the move.
e.zh: 他们那张塌陷的沙发在搬家时终于散架了。

e.en: The crowd was {swaying} to the rhythm of the music.
e.zh: 人群随着音乐节奏摇摆。

e.en: Lanterns kept {swaying} above the busy night market.
e.zh: 灯笼在热闹的夜市上方不停摇晃。

swazi.t:
adj. 斯威士兰的
n. 斯威士人

e.en: She interviewed a {swazi} entrepreneur for the podcast.
e.zh: 她为播客采访了一位斯威士兰创业者。

e.en: The festival featured traditional {swazi} dances and music.
e.zh: 节日上展示了传统的斯威士兰舞蹈和音乐。

swaziland.t: n. 斯威士兰（非洲国家）

e.en: He spent two years teaching English in {swaziland}.
e.zh: 他在斯威士兰教了两年英语。

e.en: {swaziland} was officially renamed Eswatini in 2018.
e.zh: 斯威士兰于2018年正式更名为埃斯瓦蒂尼。

swb.t: n. 短轴距（short wheelbase 缩写）

swe.t: n. 瑞典（Sweden 国家代码）

e.en: I {swear} I sent that email this morning.
e.zh: 我发誓我今天早上发了那封邮件。

e.en: Please don't {swear} in front of the kids.
e.zh: 请不要在孩子面前说脏话。

swearing.t:
n. 咒骂；宣誓
v. 发誓

e.en: The streamer got banned for {swearing} on live chat.
e.zh: 那位主播因在直播中爆粗口被封号了。

e.en: He kept {swearing} the bug was already fixed yesterday.
e.zh: 他一直坚称那个 bug 昨天就修好了。

e.en: My friend {swears} by this brand of noise-canceling headphones.
e.zh: 我朋友极力推崇这个牌子的降噪耳机。

e.en: He {swears} he locked the door before leaving.
e.zh: 他发誓离开前已经锁了门。

sweat.t:
v. 出汗
n. 汗水；辛苦

e.en: My shirt was soaked in {sweat} after the workout.
e.zh: 锻炼之后我的衬衫被汗水浸湿了。

e.en: Don't {sweat} the small stuff before a big launch.
e.zh: 大型发布之前别为小事烦恼。

e.en: He wore a bright orange {sweatband} during the tennis match.
e.zh: 他在网球比赛中戴着一条亮橙色的吸汗带。

e.en: Pull the {sweatband} up over your forehead before running.
e.zh: 跑步前把吸汗带拉到额头上方。

e.en: I bought a wool {sweater} for the trip to Tokyo.
e.zh: 我为去东京的旅行买了一件羊毛衫。

e.en: This {sweater} shrunk after one wash in hot water.
e.zh: 这件毛衣用热水洗一次就缩水了。

e.en: All the {sweaters} are 30% off this weekend online.
e.zh: 这周末网店所有毛衣打七折。

e.en: She knits {sweaters} for her grandchildren every winter.
e.zh: 她每年冬天给孙辈织毛衣。

e.en: I'm {sweating} just from carrying these grocery bags upstairs.
e.zh: 光是把这些菜拎上楼我就出汗了。

e.en: Engineers are {sweating} the demo before tomorrow's keynote.
e.zh: 工程师们在为明天主题演讲的演示而紧张赶工。

sweats.t:
n. 运动服
v. 出汗

e.en: He wore gray {sweats} to the morning coffee run.
e.zh: 他穿着灰色运动裤去买早晨的咖啡。

e.en: She always {sweats} a lot during spin class.
e.zh: 她在动感单车课上总是大汗淋漓。

e.en: I grabbed a hooded {sweatshirt} before heading to the airport.
e.zh: 我去机场前抓了件连帽卫衣。

e.en: His college {sweatshirt} is finally falling apart after ten years.
e.zh: 他的大学卫衣穿了十年终于破了。

e.en: The startup gave away branded {sweatshirts} at the conference.
e.zh: 那家初创公司在大会上派发印有品牌的卫衣。

e.en: Cozy {sweatshirts} sell out fast every autumn.
e.zh: 舒适的卫衣每年秋天都很快卖光。

e.en: The brand was accused of using a {sweatshop} overseas.
e.zh: 该品牌被指控在海外使用血汗工厂。

e.en: Investigators uncovered a hidden {sweatshop} in the basement.
e.zh: 调查人员在地下室发现了一家隐藏的血汗工厂。

e.en: She lounged at home in a soft pink {sweatsuit}.
e.zh: 她在家穿着柔软的粉色运动套装休息。

e.en: He bought a matching {sweatsuit} for his morning jog.
e.zh: 他买了一套配套的运动服用来晨跑。

e.en: My palms get {sweaty} before every public talk.
e.zh: 每次公开演讲前我的手心都会冒汗。

e.en: The gym smelled of {sweaty} towels and rubber mats.
e.zh: 健身房里弥漫着汗湿毛巾和橡胶垫的气味。

e.en: My new colleague is a {swede} who moved to Berlin.
e.zh: 我的新同事是一位搬到柏林的瑞典人。

e.en: She roasted a {swede} with carrots for Sunday dinner.
e.zh: 她为周日晚餐烤了一个芜菁甘蓝配胡萝卜。

e.en: The company opened a new office in {sweden} last month.
e.zh: 公司上个月在瑞典开设了新办公室。

e.en: {sweden} is famous for its long, dark winters.
e.zh: 瑞典以漫长而黑暗的冬天闻名。

swedenborgian.t:
adj. 史威登堡派的
n. 其信徒

e.en: He attends a small {Swedenborgian} church in the suburbs.
e.zh: 他在郊区一座小型瑞登堡派教堂做礼拜。

e.en: The author was deeply influenced by {Swedenborgian} mysticism.
e.zh: 这位作家深受瑞登堡神秘主义的影响。

swedish.t:
adj. 瑞典的
n. 瑞典语

e.en: She speaks fluent {Swedish} after living in Stockholm.
e.zh: 在斯德哥尔摩生活之后,她瑞典语说得很流利。

e.en: We had {Swedish} meatballs with mashed potatoes for dinner.
e.zh: 我们晚餐吃了瑞典肉丸配土豆泥。

e.en: The musical {Sweeney} Todd remains a Broadway favorite.
e.zh: 音乐剧《理发师陶德》至今仍是百老汇的热门作品。

e.en: Detective {Sweeney} solved the case in just two days.
e.zh: 斯威尼侦探仅用两天就破了案。

sweep.t:
v. 扫；席卷
n. 清扫；范围

e.en: Please {sweep} the kitchen floor before our guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人来之前请把厨房地板扫一下。

e.en: The team won a clean {sweep} of all five matches.
e.zh: 该队以五场全胜的成绩横扫对手。

e.en: The street {sweeper} comes by our block every Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 清扫车每周二早晨都会到我们这个街区。

e.en: He plays {sweeper} for the local football club.
e.zh: 他在当地足球俱乐部担任清道夫位置。

sweeping.t:
adj. 影响广泛的；彻底的
n. 清扫

e.en: The new law brought {sweeping} changes to healthcare policy.
e.zh: 新法律为医疗政策带来了广泛的变革。

e.en: She is {sweeping} the leaves off the front porch.
e.zh: 她正在清扫前门廊上的落叶。

e.en: The judge {sweepingly} dismissed all charges against the defendant.
e.zh: 法官全面驳回了对被告的所有指控。

e.en: He {sweepingly} criticized the entire industry in his speech.
e.zh: 他在演讲中对整个行业进行了全面批评。

e.en: The cleaner {sweeps} the lobby every morning at six.
e.zh: 清洁工每天早上六点打扫大堂。

e.en: Networks save big stories for the November ratings {sweeps}.
e.zh: 电视台会把大新闻留到十一月的收视调查期。

sweepstake.t: n. 抽奖活动；赌金全赢制

e.en: She won a vacation in the magazine's annual {sweepstake}.
e.zh: 她在那家杂志的年度抽奖中赢得了一次度假。

e.en: Enter the {sweepstake} for a chance to win a car.
e.zh: 参加这次抽奖活动就有机会赢得一辆汽车。

swinging.t:
v. 摇摆；摆动
adj. 活跃的

e.en: The kids were {swinging} from the monkey bars.
e.zh: 孩子们在攀爬架上荡来荡去。

e.en: London in the {swinging} sixties was full of energy.
e.zh: 摇摆的六十年代伦敦充满了活力。

swingman.t: n. (篮球) 摇摆人（兼任两个位置的球员）

e.en: The team's new {swingman} can play both guard and forward.
e.zh: 球队的新摇摆人既能打后卫又能打前锋。

e.en: A versatile {swingman} is valuable in modern basketball.
e.zh: 一名全能摇摆人在现代篮球中非常有价值。

swings.t:
v. 摆动；挥动
n. 秋千；波动

e.en: The playground has new {swings} and a slide.
e.zh: 游乐场有新的秋千和滑梯。

e.en: Stock prices saw wild {swings} after the announcement.
e.zh: 消息公布后股价大幅波动。

swingy.t: adj. 有摆动感的；节奏轻快的

e.en: She wore a {swingy} skirt to the party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条飘逸的裙子去参加派对。

e.en: The song has a {swingy} rhythm that's easy to dance to.
e.zh: 这首歌节奏摇摆，很容易跟着跳。

swinton.t: n. 斯温顿（地名或姓氏）

e.en: Tilda {Swinton} is admired for her unconventional roles.
e.zh: 蒂尔达·斯文顿因其不落俗套的角色而受人敬佩。

e.en: {Swinton} is a town near Manchester in England.
e.zh: 斯温顿是英格兰曼彻斯特附近的一个城镇。

swipe.t:
v. 滑动（屏幕）；刷卡
n. 猛击

e.en: {Swipe} right to unlock your phone.
e.zh: 向右滑动解锁手机。

e.en: Someone tried to {swipe} my wallet on the train.
e.zh: 有人在火车上想偷我的钱包。

e.en: {Swire} Group has major operations across Asia.
e.zh: 太古集团在亚洲有大规模业务。

e.en: She works at {Swire} Properties in Hong Kong.
e.zh: 她在香港太古地产工作。

swirl.t:
n. 漩涡
v. 打旋；卷动

e.en: Cream {swirl}s beautifully into the dark coffee.
e.zh: 奶油在黑咖啡里漂亮地打着旋。

e.en: Leaves began to {swirl} in the autumn wind.
e.zh: 树叶开始在秋风中打转。

e.en: Rumors are {swirling} about a possible merger.
e.zh: 关于可能合并的传言四起。

e.en: She watched the {swirling} snow outside her window.
e.zh: 她望着窗外飞舞的雪花。

e.en: The latte had a {swirly} pattern on top.
e.zh: 那杯拿铁顶上有一个漩涡花纹。

e.en: She drew {swirly} doodles all over her notebook.
e.zh: 她在笔记本上画满了漩涡状的涂鸦。

swish.t:
v. 发出嗖嗖声
adj. 时髦的

e.en: The horse's tail gave a quick {swish}.
e.zh: 那匹马的尾巴轻快地甩了一下。

e.en: They stayed at a {swish} hotel in Paris.
e.zh: 他们在巴黎住了一家时髦的酒店。

swishing.t: v. 发出嗖嗖声；挥动作响

e.en: Her long skirt was {swishing} as she walked.
e.zh: 她走路时长裙发出沙沙的摆动声。

e.en: I heard the {swishing} of leaves in the wind.
e.zh: 我听见树叶在风中沙沙作响。

swishy.t: adj. 飘摆发声的；华丽的

e.en: She wore a {swishy} silk dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条飘逸的丝绸连衣裙去派对。

e.en: The dancer's {swishy} skirt twirled with every step.
e.zh: 舞者那条飘动的裙子随着每一步旋转。

swiss.t:
adj. 瑞士的
n. 瑞士人

e.en: He bought a {Swiss} watch on his trip.
e.zh: 他在旅途中买了一块瑞士手表。

e.en: The recipe calls for melted {Swiss} cheese.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要融化的瑞士奶酪。

switch.t:
v. 切换；转换
n. 开关

e.en: Please {switch} off the lights when you leave.
e.zh: 离开时请把灯关掉。

e.en: She decided to {switch} careers after ten years.
e.zh: 十年后她决定转行。

switchable.t: adj. 可切换的；可转换的

e.en: The phone has a {switchable} dual SIM feature.
e.zh: 这款手机具有可切换的双卡功能。

e.en: These glasses have {switchable} tinted lenses for sunlight.
e.zh: 这副眼镜有可切换的变色镜片以应对阳光。

switchback.t: n. 之字形公路；急转弯

e.en: The mountain road climbs in a steep {switchback}.
e.zh: 那条山路以陡峭的之字形向上盘旋。

e.en: We hiked up the {switchback} trail for hours.
e.zh: 我们沿着之字形小径徒步走了好几个小时。

e.en: The suspect was carrying an illegal {switchblade}.
e.zh: 嫌疑人随身带着一把非法的弹簧刀。

e.en: He flicked open the {switchblade} with one hand.
e.zh: 他单手弹开了那把弹簧刀。

e.en: The hotel {switchboard} routes calls to each room.
e.zh: 酒店总机会把电话转接到各个房间。

e.en: She worked as a {switchboard} operator in the 1960s.
e.zh: 她在六十年代当过电话总机接线员。

e.en: I {switched} jobs last month for better pay.
e.zh: 上个月我为了更高的工资换了工作。

e.en: He {switched} the TV to the news channel.
e.zh: 他把电视换到了新闻频道。

e.en: The video {switcher} lets directors cut between cameras.
e.zh: 视频切换台让导演能在多个摄像机之间切换。

e.en: He's a brand {switcher} who tries every new phone.
e.zh: 他是个品牌切换者,每款新手机都要试。

e.en: The movie ends with a clever {switcheroo}.
e.zh: 这部电影以一个巧妙的反转结尾。

e.en: She pulled a {switcheroo} and gave him decaf instead.
e.zh: 她偷偷换了包,给他喝的是无咖啡因咖啡。

switches.t:
n. 开关
v. 切换

e.en: The dashboard has several {switches} for the headlights.
e.zh: 仪表盘上有几个用于车头灯的开关。

e.en: He often {switches} between English and Spanish.
e.zh: 他经常在英语和西班牙语之间切换。

e.en: Farmers grow {switchgrass} to make biofuel.
e.zh: 农民种植柳枝稷来制造生物燃料。

e.en: Tall {switchgrass} swayed across the prairie.
e.zh: 高高的柳枝稷在草原上摇曳。

switching.t:
n. 切换；交换
v. 切换

e.en: I'm {switching} to a vegetarian diet next month.
e.zh: 我下个月要改吃素食。

e.en: The network handles packet {switching} efficiently.
e.zh: 该网络能高效地处理数据包交换。

e.en: The {switchover} to the new system happens tonight.
e.zh: 今晚将切换到新系统。

e.en: There was a brief outage during the {switchover}.
e.zh: 切换过程中出现了短暂的中断。

e.en: We went skiing in {Switzerland} last winter.
e.zh: 去年冬天我们去瑞士滑雪了。

e.en: {Switzerland} is famous for chocolate and watches.
e.zh: 瑞士以巧克力和钟表闻名。

swivel.t:
v. 旋转
n. 转轴；转椅底座

e.en: My new office chair can {swivel} all the way around.
e.zh: 我的新办公椅可以三百六十度旋转。

e.en: She turned the {swivel} stool to face me.
e.zh: 她转动旋转凳面向我。

e.en: He {swiveled} his chair toward the window.
e.zh: 他把椅子转向窗户。

e.en: Every head {swiveled} when she walked in.
e.zh: 她走进来时所有人都转头看她。

e.en: The camera kept {swiveling} to track the speaker.
e.zh: 摄像机不停地转动以跟拍演讲者。

e.en: She sat {swiveling} in her chair while thinking.
e.zh: 她一边思考一边在椅子上转来转去。

swivelling.t: v. 旋转（swiveling 的英式拼写）

e.en: The lamp has a {swivelling} arm for easy adjustment.
e.zh: 这盏台灯有一个可旋转的灯臂方便调节。

e.en: He kept {swivelling} his head to look around.
e.zh: 他不停地转头四处张望。

swivels.t:
v. 旋转
n. 转轴

e.en: This monitor {swivels} for sharing the screen easily.
e.zh: 这台显示器可以旋转,便于分享屏幕。

e.en: The boat seat {swivels} a full 360 degrees.
e.zh: 船上的座椅可以三百六十度旋转。

swizzle.t:
v. 搅拌（饮料）
n. 调和酒

e.en: She stirred her cocktail with a colorful {swizzle} stick.
e.zh: 她用一根彩色的搅拌棒搅动鸡尾酒。

e.en: The bartender mixed a tropical rum {swizzle}.
e.zh: 调酒师调了一杯热带朗姆漩涡鸡尾酒。

e.en: My ankle was {swollen} after the fall.
e.zh: 摔倒后我的脚踝肿了起来。

e.en: Heavy rain left the river dangerously {swollen}.
e.zh: 大雨让河水危险地暴涨起来。

swoon.t:
v. 着迷；昏厥
n. 昏厥

e.en: Fans {swoon} whenever the singer steps on stage.
e.zh: 每次那位歌手登台,粉丝们都为之倾倒。

e.en: The chocolate dessert made everyone {swoon}.
e.zh: 那道巧克力甜点让大家都陶醉了。

e.en: Critics are {swooning} over her latest novel.
e.zh: 评论家们都对她的新小说赞不绝口。

e.en: The crowd was {swooning} at the actor's smile.
e.zh: 人群被那位演员的笑容迷得神魂颠倒。

swoop.t:
v. 俯冲；突袭
n. 猛扑

e.en: Eagles {swoop} down to catch fish from the lake.
e.zh: 老鹰俯冲下来从湖里抓鱼。

e.en: The police made the arrests in one {swoop}.
e.zh: 警方一举完成了所有逮捕。

e.en: Bats were {swooping} through the evening sky.
e.zh: 蝙蝠在傍晚的天空中俯冲飞掠。

e.en: The drone kept {swooping} low over the field.
e.zh: 无人机不断在田野上方低空俯冲。

swoosh.t:
n. 嗖的一声
v. 飞速掠过

e.en: The sneakers feature the iconic Nike {swoosh}.
e.zh: 这双运动鞋带有标志性的耐克对勾标志。

e.en: The arrow flew past with a soft {swoosh}.
e.zh: 箭嗖的一声轻轻地飞过。

e.en: Want to {swop} seats so you can see better?
e.zh: 想换下座位让你看得更清楚吗?

e.en: The kids agreed to {swop} their lunch snacks.
e.zh: 孩子们同意交换各自的午餐零食。

e.en: The knight drew his {sword} and bowed.
e.zh: 骑士拔出佩剑然后鞠了一躬。

e.en: A samurai's {sword} is forged with great care.
e.zh: 武士的刀是经过精心锻造的。

e.en: He grilled fresh {swordfish} steaks for dinner.
e.zh: 他煎了新鲜的剑鱼排作为晚餐。

e.en: A huge {swordfish} leaped from the waves.
e.zh: 一条巨大的剑鱼从浪中跃起。

e.en: The film features stunning {swordplay} choreography.
e.zh: 这部电影有令人惊叹的剑斗设计。

e.en: He trained for years to master {swordplay}.
e.zh: 他训练了多年才精通剑术。

e.en: The museum displays ancient {swords} from many cultures.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了多种文化的古代刀剑。

e.en: The two warriors crossed {swords} at dawn.
e.zh: 两位武士在黎明时分交锋。

e.en: He was the finest {swordsman} in the kingdom.
e.zh: 他是王国里最出色的剑客。

e.en: Every {swordsman} respected the old master's skill.
e.zh: 每位剑客都敬重那位老前辈的剑技。

swore.t: v. 发誓；咒骂（swear 过去式）

e.en: She {swore} she would never lie to me again.
e.zh: 她发誓再也不会对我撒谎了。

e.en: He {swore} loudly when he stubbed his toe.
e.zh: 他踢到脚趾时大声咒骂。

sworn.t:
adj. 宣誓过的
v. swear 的过去分词

e.en: The witness has {sworn} to tell the truth.
e.zh: 证人已经宣誓说出真相。

e.en: They've been {sworn} enemies since high school.
e.zh: 他们从高中起就是死对头。

swot.t:
v. 苦读；用功
n. 书呆子

e.en: I need to {swot} for the math exam tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚得为数学考试用功复习。

e.en: He's a real {swot} who studies every weekend.
e.zh: 他是个真正的书呆子,每个周末都在学习。

swum.t: v. 游泳（swim 的过去分词）

e.en: She has {swum} across the lake many times.
e.zh: 她已经多次游过那个湖了。

e.en: I had never {swum} in the ocean before today.
e.zh: 在今天之前我从未在海里游过泳。

swung.t: v. 摆动（swing 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: He {swung} the bat and hit a home run.
e.zh: 他挥棒击出了一记本垒打。

e.en: The door {swung} open in the strong wind.
e.zh: 大风把门吹得猛地敞开了。

sweet.t:
adj. 甜的；可爱的
n. 糖果

e.en: This mango is incredibly {sweet} and juicy.
e.zh: 这个芒果非常甜,而且多汁。

e.en: That was such a {sweet} thing to say to her.
e.zh: 对她说这种话真是太贴心了。

sweetbreads.t: n. （食用）牛羊的胰脏或胸腺

e.en: The chef prepared {sweetbreads} as the evening's special dish.
e.zh: 主厨把胰脏作为今晚的特色菜。

e.en: Many diners are reluctant to try {sweetbreads} for the first time.
e.zh: 很多食客都不太愿意第一次尝试胰脏菜。

e.en: I love grilled {sweetcorn} with butter and salt.
e.zh: 我喜欢涂上黄油和盐的烤甜玉米。

e.en: She added {sweetcorn} to the chicken salad for crunch.
e.zh: 她在鸡肉沙拉里加了甜玉米增加口感。

e.en: Add a spoonful of honey to {sweeten} your tea.
e.zh: 加一勺蜂蜜让你的茶变甜。

e.en: They offered extra benefits to {sweeten} the job offer.
e.zh: 他们提供了额外福利以使工作邀约更具吸引力。

sweetened.t:
adj. 加了糖的
v. sweeten 的过去式

e.en: This yogurt is {sweetened} with natural fruit juice only.
e.zh: 这种酸奶只用天然果汁来增加甜味。

e.en: The company {sweetened} the deal with a signing bonus.
e.zh: 公司用签约奖金让这笔交易更具吸引力。

sweetener.t: n. 甜味剂；（口）好处、贿赂

e.en: Many sodas use artificial {sweetener} instead of real sugar.
e.zh: 许多汽水使用人造甜味剂而不是真正的糖。

e.en: Free shipping was the {sweetener} that closed the sale.
e.zh: 免运费就是促成这笔成交的诱饵。

e.en: He gave his {sweetheart} a dozen red roses today.
e.zh: 他今天送给心上人一打红玫瑰。

e.en: My grandmother is such a {sweetheart} to all the neighbors.
e.zh: 我奶奶对所有邻居都非常贴心。

sweethearts.t: n. sweetheart 的复数；恋人们

e.en: They were childhood {sweethearts} who married after college.
e.zh: 他们是青梅竹马,大学毕业后就结婚了。

e.en: The two {sweethearts} held hands throughout the entire movie.
e.zh: 那对小情侣在整部电影里一直牵着手。

e.en: Come here, {sweetie}, and give grandma a hug.
e.zh: 过来,小宝贝,给奶奶一个拥抱。

e.en: My new coworker is a real {sweetie} to everyone.
e.zh: 我的新同事对每个人都非常和善可爱。

e.en: The sauce had a {sweetish} aftertaste that surprised me.
e.zh: 这酱料带有一丝意想不到的甜味余韵。

e.en: He spoke in a {sweetish} tone that felt insincere.
e.zh: 他用一种略显甜腻的语气说话，让人觉得不真诚。

e.en: The baby smiled {sweetly} at the camera.
e.zh: 宝宝对着镜头甜甜地笑了。

e.en: The engine runs {sweetly} after the tune-up.
e.zh: 调校之后，发动机运转得非常顺畅。

e.en: She offered guests a tray of colorful {sweetmeat} treats.
e.zh: 她端出一盘色彩缤纷的蜜饯招待客人。

e.en: Each {sweetmeat} was wrapped in delicate gold paper.
e.zh: 每一颗糖果都用精致的金纸包着。

e.en: I love the natural {sweetness} of ripe mangoes.
e.zh: 我喜欢成熟芒果那种天然的甜味。

e.en: There's a quiet {sweetness} in her personality.
e.zh: 她的性格里有一种淡淡的温柔。

e.en: She planted {sweetpea} along the garden fence.
e.zh: 她在花园篱笆旁种了香豌豆花。

e.en: The {sweetpea} bloomed in soft pink and lavender.
e.zh: 香豌豆开出了淡粉色和淡紫色的花。

e.en: The kids begged for {sweets} after dinner.
e.zh: 孩子们饭后吵着要糖吃。

e.en: She avoids {sweets} to keep her blood sugar stable.
e.zh: 为了稳定血糖，她不吃甜食。

e.en: The corner {sweetshop} has been open since 1952.
e.zh: 街角那家糖果店从1952年开到现在。

e.en: Children pressed their noses against the {sweetshop} window.
e.zh: 孩子们把鼻子贴在糖果店的橱窗上。

e.en: Come here, {sweety}, let me tie your shoelaces.
e.zh: 过来，宝贝，我帮你系鞋带。

e.en: Thanks for helping out, {sweety}.
e.zh: 谢谢你帮忙，亲爱的。

swell.t:
v. 膨胀；增大
n. 涌浪

e.en: My ankle started to {swell} after the fall.
e.zh: 摔了一跤后我的脚踝开始肿起来。

e.en: Surfers waited for the next big {swell}.
e.zh: 冲浪者等待着下一个大涌浪。

swelled.t: v. swell 的过去式；膨胀

e.en: The crowd {swelled} to over ten thousand by noon.
e.zh: 到中午人群已经涨到一万多人。

e.en: Her eyes {swelled} from crying all night.
e.zh: 她哭了一整夜，眼睛都肿了。

swelling.t:
n. 肿块；肿胀
v. 膨胀（现在分词）

e.en: Ice helps reduce {swelling} after an injury.
e.zh: 受伤后冰敷有助于消肿。

e.en: There's a noticeable {swelling} on his left knee.
e.zh: 他左膝上有一处明显的肿胀。

swells.t:
n. 涌浪
v. 膨胀（三单）

e.en: The boat rocked as huge {swells} rolled in.
e.zh: 巨浪涌来时船摇晃得厉害。

e.en: His chest {swells} with pride at the ceremony.
e.zh: 在典礼上他自豪得胸膛挺起。

e.en: Workers {swelter} under the August sun all day.
e.zh: 工人们在八月烈日下挥汗如雨地干了一整天。

e.en: Tourists {swelter} in the crowded subway cars.
e.zh: 游客们在拥挤的地铁车厢里热得难受。

e.en: It was a {sweltering} afternoon with no breeze.
e.zh: 那是个闷热无风的下午。

e.en: They escaped the {sweltering} city for the coast.
e.zh: 他们逃离闷热的城市前往海边。

swept.t: v. sweep 的过去式；扫、席卷

e.en: She {swept} the kitchen floor before guests arrived.
e.zh: 客人到来之前她扫了厨房的地板。

e.en: A wave of nostalgia {swept} over him.
e.zh: 一阵怀旧之情涌上他的心头。

swerve.t:
v. 突然转向
n. 急转弯

e.en: The driver had to {swerve} to avoid a deer.
e.zh: 司机不得不急转弯以避开一只鹿。

e.en: He never {swerve}s from his principles under pressure.
e.zh: 他在压力下从不偏离自己的原则。

e.en: Local farmers still practice {swidden} agriculture in the hills.
e.zh: 当地农民在山区仍然采用刀耕火种的农业方式。

e.en: The {swidden} plot was burned and replanted each season.
e.zh: 那块烧垦地每季都要焚烧并重新种植。

swift.t:
adj. 迅速的
n. 雨燕

e.en: She made a {swift} decision and booked the flight.
e.zh: 她迅速做了决定，订下了航班。

e.en: A {swift} darted across the evening sky.
e.zh: 一只雨燕掠过傍晚的天空。

e.en: The {swiftlet} builds its nest in dark caves.
e.zh: 金丝燕在黑暗的洞穴里筑巢。

e.en: Edible {swiftlet} nests are highly prized in Asian cuisine.
e.zh: 可食用的金丝燕燕窝在亚洲菜中非常珍贵。

e.en: The team responded {swiftly} to the customer complaint.
e.zh: 团队迅速回应了客户的投诉。

e.en: News of the merger spread {swiftly} online.
e.zh: 合并的消息在网上迅速传开。

e.en: Everyone admired the {swiftness} of his reply.
e.zh: 大家都赞叹他回复之迅速。

e.en: The cheetah is famous for its {swiftness}.
e.zh: 猎豹以速度快而闻名。

swig.t:
v. 大口喝
n. 一大口

e.en: He took a long {swig} from the water bottle.
e.zh: 他从水瓶里痛快地灌了一大口。

e.en: She {swig}ged her coffee and rushed out the door.
e.zh: 她灌下咖啡，匆匆冲出门去。

swill.t:
n. 泔水；猪食
v. 畅饮

e.en: Farmers used to feed pigs kitchen {swill}.
e.zh: 以前农民会用厨余泔水喂猪。

e.en: He {swill}ed the mouthwash and spat it out.
e.zh: 他漱了漱漱口水然后吐了出来。

swim.t:
v. 游泳
n. 游泳

e.en: I {swim} laps every morning before work.
e.zh: 我每天上班前都游几圈。

e.en: My head started to {swim} after the second drink.
e.zh: 喝到第二杯我就开始头晕了。

e.en: She trained as a competitive {swimmer} for years.
e.zh: 她做了好几年的竞技游泳选手。

e.en: Even a strong {swimmer} should respect the riptide.
e.zh: 即使是游泳高手也要警惕离岸流。

swimmers.t: n. swimmer 的复数；游泳者

e.en: Olympic {swimmers} train up to six hours daily.
e.zh: 奥运游泳选手每天最多训练六个小时。

e.en: Several {swimmers} were rescued from the rough surf.
e.zh: 几名游泳者从汹涌的海浪中被救起。

swimming.t:
n. 游泳
adj. 游泳的

e.en: {Swimming} is great low-impact exercise for any age.
e.zh: 游泳是适合各年龄段的低冲击运动。

e.en: The kids went {swimming} in the lake all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在湖里游泳。

swimmingly.t: adv. 顺利地；轻松愉快地

e.en: The product launch went {swimmingly} despite our worries.
e.zh: 尽管我们担心，产品发布还是非常顺利。

e.en: Their first date went {swimmingly}.
e.zh: 他们第一次约会进行得很顺利。

e.en: Frequent {swimmings} in cold water built her endurance.
e.zh: 频繁的冷水游泳锻炼了她的耐力。

e.en: The diary recorded her morning {swimmings} that summer.
e.zh: 日记记录了她那个夏天每天早晨的游泳。

swims.t: v. swim 的第三人称单数

e.en: He {swims} twice a week to stay in shape.
e.zh: 他每周游两次泳来保持身材。

e.en: The dog happily {swims} after the tennis ball.
e.zh: 狗狗欢快地游过去追网球。

e.en: She bought a new {swimsuit} for the beach trip.
e.zh: 她为这次海滩之旅买了一件新泳衣。

e.en: Don't forget your {swimsuit} and sunscreen tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天别忘了带泳衣和防晒霜。

e.en: The store has {swimsuits} on sale this week.
e.zh: 这家店本周泳衣都在打折。

e.en: Modern {swimsuits} are designed for both style and speed.
e.zh: 现代泳衣兼顾了款式和速度的设计。

e.en: The brand specializes in eco-friendly {swimwear}.
e.zh: 该品牌专注于环保泳装。

e.en: You'll find {swimwear} on the third floor.
e.zh: 泳装区在三楼。

swinburne.t: n. 斯温伯恩（英国诗人姓氏）

e.en: {Swinburne} University is well known across Australia.
e.zh: 斯威本大学在澳大利亚很有名。

e.en: The poet Algernon {Swinburne} was famous in Victorian England.
e.zh: 诗人阿尔杰农·斯温伯恩在维多利亚时代的英国很有名。

swindle.t:
v. 诈骗
n. 骗局

e.en: They tried to {swindle} elderly people out of their savings.
e.zh: 他们企图骗走老年人的积蓄。

e.en: The whole investment turned out to be a {swindle}.
e.zh: 整个投资原来是一场骗局。

e.en: Police arrested the {swindler} after a long investigation.
e.zh: 经过长时间调查，警方逮捕了那名骗子。

e.en: Don't trust him — he's a known {swindler}.
e.zh: 别相信他，他是个出了名的骗子。

swindon.t: n. 斯温顿（英国城镇名）

e.en: {Swindon} is a town in Wiltshire, England.
e.zh: 斯温登是英格兰威尔特郡的一个城镇。

e.en: The train from London to {Swindon} takes about an hour.
e.zh: 从伦敦到斯温登的火车大约要一个小时。

e.en: The farm raises healthy {swine} for the market.
e.zh: 这个农场饲养健康的猪供应市场。

e.en: {Swine} flu spread rapidly across several countries.
e.zh: 猪流感在多个国家迅速蔓延。

swing.t:
v. 摇摆；摆动
n. 秋千；摇摆

e.en: Push me higher on the {swing}!
e.zh: 把我推得再高一点，秋千！

e.en: His mood can {swing} from happy to angry quickly.
e.zh: 他的情绪能很快从开心转为愤怒。

e.en: The government announced {swingeing} cuts to public spending.
e.zh: 政府宣布对公共支出进行大幅削减。

e.en: Critics warned of {swingeing} fines for late filers.
e.zh: 批评者警告说迟报者将面临巨额罚款。

swinger.t: n. 爱换偶的人；活跃分子

e.en: He's a real {swinger} on the dance floor.
e.zh: 他在舞池里真是个活跃分子。

e.en: The mood {swinger} made teamwork difficult.
e.zh: 那个情绪多变的人让团队合作变得困难。

e.en: He's a true {sybarite} who loves luxury and fine wine.
e.zh: 他是个真正的享乐主义者,喜爱奢华和美酒。

e.en: Only a {sybarite} would book that lavish suite.
e.zh: 只有讲究享乐的人才会订那间奢华套房。

e.en: They lived a {sybaritic} lifestyle on the Riviera.
e.zh: 他们在里维埃拉过着奢华享乐的生活。

e.en: The spa offered a truly {sybaritic} experience.
e.zh: 那家水疗会所提供真正奢华的享受。

e.en: Our legacy system still runs on a {Sybase} database.
e.zh: 我们的遗留系统仍然在 Sybase 数据库上运行。

e.en: He spent years writing queries against {Sybase} servers.
e.zh: 他多年来一直在为 Sybase 服务器编写查询。

sycamore.t: n. 梧桐树；美国悬铃木

e.en: A huge {sycamore} tree shaded the entire yard.
e.zh: 一棵巨大的悬铃木为整个院子遮阴。

e.en: The {sycamore} dropped its leaves early this autumn.
e.zh: 那棵悬铃木今年秋天落叶很早。

e.en: The boss surrounded himself with shameless {sycophancy}.
e.zh: 那位老板身边围满了无耻的阿谀奉承。

e.en: Her promotion came through hard work, not {sycophancy}.
e.zh: 她的升职靠的是努力工作,而非拍马屁。

e.en: He's just a {sycophant} who agrees with everything.
e.zh: 他不过是个事事附和的马屁精。

e.en: The CEO grew tired of every {sycophant} in the room.
e.zh: 那位总裁厌倦了房间里的每一个谄媚者。

e.en: His {sycophantic} emails to the boss made everyone cringe.
e.zh: 他对老板那些阿谀奉承的邮件让大家都尴尬。

e.en: The reporter asked tough, not {sycophantic}, questions.
e.zh: 记者提的是尖锐的问题,而不是奉承式的。

sycorax.t: n. 西考拉克斯（《暴风雨》人物；天王星卫星）

e.en: In Shakespeare's Tempest, {Sycorax} is Caliban's witch mother.
e.zh: 在莎士比亚的《暴风雨》中,西考拉克斯是卡列班的女巫母亲。

e.en: Scholars often debate the role of {Sycorax} in the play.
e.zh: 学者们常讨论西考拉克斯在该剧中的作用。

sydenham.t: n. 锡德纳姆（人名/地名）

e.en: They moved to a quiet street in {Sydenham}, London.
e.zh: 他们搬到了伦敦锡德纳姆一条安静的街上。

e.en: The doctor described a classic case of {Sydenham} chorea.
e.zh: 医生描述了一个典型的西德纳姆舞蹈病病例。

sydney.t: n. 悉尼（澳大利亚城市）

e.en: We booked a weekend trip to {sydney} to see the harbor.
e.zh: 我们订了周末去悉尼的行程，想去看看海港。

e.en: My cousin {sydney} just started her first tech job.
e.zh: 我表妹西德尼刚开始了她的第一份科技工作。

e.en: Japanese hiragana is a {syllabary} rather than an alphabet.
e.zh: 日语的平假名是一种音节文字，而不是字母表。

e.en: The Cherokee {syllabary} was created by Sequoyah in the 1820s.
e.zh: 切罗基音节文字是塞阔雅在1820年代创制的。

syllabic.t: adj. 音节的；构成音节的

e.en: Chinese poetry often follows strict {syllabic} patterns.
e.zh: 中国诗歌常常遵循严格的音节格律。

e.en: The letter L can act as a {syllabic} consonant in English.
e.zh: 字母L在英语中可以作为成音节辅音使用。

e.en: Stress the first {syllable} when you say the word "happy".
e.zh: 说"happy"这个词时要重读第一个音节。

e.en: He didn't say a {syllable} during the entire meeting.
e.zh: 他在整个会议中一个字也没说。

e.en: A haiku traditionally contains seventeen {syllables}.
e.zh: 俳句传统上由十七个音节组成。

e.en: Toddlers often drop {syllables} when learning to talk.
e.zh: 幼儿在学说话时常常会漏掉音节。

syllabus.t: n. 课程大纲；教学计划

e.en: The professor posted the {syllabus} on the course website.
e.zh: 教授把教学大纲发到了课程网站上。

e.en: Check the {syllabus} to see when the midterm is scheduled.
e.zh: 看一下教学大纲，确认期中考试的时间。

e.en: Aristotle's classic {syllogism} starts with "all men are mortal".
e.zh: 亚里士多德的经典三段论以"所有人都会死"开头。

e.en: Her argument was just a flawed {syllogism} dressed up in jargon.
e.zh: 她的论点只是个用术语包装起来的有缺陷的三段论。

e.en: The lawyer used {syllogistic} reasoning to convince the jury.
e.zh: 律师用三段论式的推理来说服陪审团。

e.en: Philosophy class introduced us to {syllogistic} logic.
e.zh: 哲学课向我们介绍了三段论逻辑。

sylph.t:
n. 苗条优雅的女子
n. 空气精灵

e.en: The dancer moved across the stage like a {sylph}.
e.zh: 那位舞者像精灵一般滑过舞台。

e.en: In folklore, a {sylph} is a spirit of the air.
e.zh: 在民间传说里，西尔芙是一种空气精灵。

sylvan.t: adj. 森林的；林木茂盛的

e.en: They held the wedding in a quiet {sylvan} clearing.
e.zh: 他们在一片幽静的林间空地举行了婚礼。

e.en: The cabin sat in a peaceful {sylvan} valley.
e.zh: 那间小屋坐落在一个宁静的林间山谷里。

e.en: The bacteria living in our gut act as a helpful {symbiont}.
e.zh: 生活在我们肠道里的细菌是一种有益的共生体。

e.en: Coral relies on a tiny algal {symbiont} for its color.
e.zh: 珊瑚的颜色依赖于一种微小的共生藻类。

e.en: Bees and flowers exist in a perfect {symbiosis}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂和花朵之间存在一种完美的共生关系。

e.en: There's a real {symbiosis} between the designers and engineers here.
e.zh: 这里的设计师和工程师之间有着真正的共生协作。

symbiote.t: n. 共生体（漫威：毒液族）

e.en: In the comic, Venom is an alien {symbiote} bonded to its host.
e.zh: 在漫画里，毒液是一种与宿主共生的外星共生体。

e.en: Each clownfish has an anemone {symbiote} for protection.
e.zh: 每条小丑鱼都有一只海葵作为保护它的共生伙伴。

e.en: The startup has a {symbiotic} relationship with its biggest customer.
e.zh: 这家初创公司和它最大的客户之间是共生关系。

e.en: Lichens are a {symbiotic} mix of fungus and algae.
e.zh: 地衣是真菌和藻类的共生组合。

e.en: The two companies operate {symbiotically}, sharing customers and data.
e.zh: 这两家公司共生运作，共享客户和数据。

e.en: Certain ants and acacia trees live {symbiotically} in the savanna.
e.zh: 某些蚂蚁和金合欢树在草原上共生生活。

e.en: The dove is a universal {symbol} of peace.
e.zh: 鸽子是和平的普世象征。

e.en: Tap the heart {symbol} to save the post.
e.zh: 点击爱心图标就可以收藏这条帖子。

e.en: Her resignation was {symbolic} of the company's deeper problems.
e.zh: 她的辞职象征着公司更深层的问题。

e.en: The handshake was a {symbolic} end to the long dispute.
e.zh: 那次握手象征着这场长期争端的结束。

e.en: He {symbolically} handed over the keys to the new owner.
e.zh: 他象征性地把钥匙交给了新业主。

e.en: The team wore black armbands {symbolically} to honor their coach.
e.zh: 队员们戴上黑臂章，象征性地悼念他们的教练。

symbolise.t: v. 象征；代表（英式拼法）

e.en: Red roses traditionally {symbolise} love and passion.
e.zh: 红玫瑰传统上象征着爱情与热情。

e.en: The empty chair was meant to {symbolise} the missing soldiers.
e.zh: 那把空椅子是用来象征那些失踪的士兵的。

symbolism.t: n. 象征手法；象征主义

e.en: The novel is full of religious {symbolism}.
e.zh: 这部小说充满了宗教象征意味。

e.en: Critics praised the film's rich visual {symbolism}.
e.zh: 影评人称赞了这部电影丰富的视觉象征。

e.en: Mallarmé was a leading {symbolist} poet of the 19th century.
e.zh: 马拉美是19世纪重要的象征主义诗人。

e.en: The gallery features {symbolist} paintings from late 1800s France.
e.zh: 这家画廊展出了19世纪末法国的象征主义画作。

e.en: The flag's {symbolization} of national unity is widely recognized.
e.zh: 这面旗帜对民族团结的象征意义被广泛认可。

e.en: Map design relies on clear {symbolization} of features like rivers.
e.zh: 地图设计依赖于对河流等地物的清晰符号化表达。

e.en: In Chinese culture, dragons {symbolize} power and good fortune.
e.zh: 在中国文化中，龙象征着力量与好运。

e.en: The broken chain is meant to {symbolize} freedom from oppression.
e.zh: 那条断裂的锁链象征着摆脱压迫获得自由。

symbology.t: n. 符号体系；图标规范

e.en: The book explores the {symbology} of medieval cathedrals.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了中世纪教堂的符号体系。

e.en: Tarot cards have a rich {symbology} that takes years to learn.
e.zh: 塔罗牌有一套需要多年才能掌握的丰富符号体系。

e.en: Most keyboards have special {symbols} above the number row.
e.zh: 大多数键盘的数字键上方都有特殊符号。

e.en: Ancient {symbols} were carved into the stone walls.
e.zh: 古代的符号被刻在那些石墙上。

e.en: A butterfly's wings are almost perfectly {symmetric}.
e.zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀几乎是完全对称的。

e.en: The algorithm uses a {symmetric} encryption key for both sides.
e.zh: 该算法在双方都使用一个对称加密密钥。

e.en: The architect designed a perfectly {symmetrical} facade.
e.zh: 建筑师设计了一个完全对称的正面。

e.en: Her face is strikingly {symmetrical}, which photographs love.
e.zh: 她的脸非常对称，特别上镜。

e.en: The chairs were arranged {symmetrically} around the table.
e.zh: 椅子对称地摆放在桌子周围。

e.en: Place the lights {symmetrically} on either side of the door.
e.zh: 把灯对称地安在门的两侧。

e.en: There's a beautiful {symmetry} to the temple's design.
e.zh: 这座寺庙的设计有一种优美的对称感。

e.en: Physicists love equations that show {symmetry} in nature.
e.zh: 物理学家喜欢能体现自然对称性的方程。

e.en: My boss was very {sympathetic} when I explained the situation.
e.zh: 我向老板说明情况后，他非常体谅。

e.en: The judge gave the defendant a {sympathetic} hearing.
e.zh: 法官给了被告一个充满同情的聆讯。

e.en: She nodded {sympathetically} as he described his bad week.
e.zh: 他描述自己糟糕的一周时，她同情地点了点头。

e.en: The article {sympathetically} portrays the struggles of new parents.
e.zh: 这篇文章充满同情地描绘了新手父母的艰辛。

sympathies.t: n. 同情；慰问（sympathy 复数）

e.en: Please accept my deepest {sympathies} on the loss of your father.
e.zh: 请接受我对令尊去世最深切的慰问。

e.en: His political {sympathies} clearly lie with the reform movement.
e.zh: 他的政治同情显然倾向于改革派。

sympathise.t: v. 同情；体谅（英式拼法）

e.en: I really {sympathise} with parents juggling work and childcare.
e.zh: 我真的很同情那些既要工作又要带娃的父母。

e.en: Many readers {sympathise} with the main character's struggle.
e.zh: 许多读者对主角的挣扎深感同情。

e.en: She {sympathised} with him after he lost his job.
e.zh: 他失业后她很同情他。

e.en: The audience {sympathised} with the underdog throughout the film.
e.zh: 观众整部电影都同情那个弱者。

sympathiser.t: n. 同情者；支持者（英式）

e.en: He was branded a {sympathiser} of the rebel cause.
e.zh: 他被冠以叛军同情者的标签。

e.en: The journalist was no {sympathiser} of either political party.
e.zh: 这位记者并不是任何一个政党的同情者。

sympathises.t: v. 同情（第三人称单数，英式）

e.en: The boss {sympathises} with employees working long hours.
e.zh: 老板很体谅长时间加班的员工。

e.en: She {sympathises} with anyone who has lost a pet.
e.zh: 她对任何失去宠物的人都深表同情。

sympathising.t: v. 同情（现在分词，英式）

e.en: He nodded, {sympathising} with her frustration about the delay.
e.zh: 他点了点头,对她因延误而产生的沮丧表示理解。

e.en: While {sympathising} with the protesters, the mayor urged calm.
e.zh: 市长在同情抗议者的同时呼吁保持冷静。

e.en: I {sympathize} with anyone trying to learn a new language.
e.zh: 对于任何在学习新语言的人,我都深感同情。

e.en: It's hard not to {sympathize} with overworked nurses.
e.zh: 很难不去同情那些过度劳累的护士。

e.en: Friends {sympathized} with her after the breakup.
e.zh: 分手后朋友们都很同情她。

e.en: The teacher {sympathized} with students stressed about exams.
e.zh: 老师对因考试而焦虑的学生表示理解。

e.en: He was accused of being a {sympathizer} of the opposition.
e.zh: 他被指控是反对派的同情者。

e.en: She is a known animal-rights {sympathizer} and vegan.
e.zh: 她是公认的动物权利支持者,也是位素食者。

sympathizes.t: v. 同情（第三人称单数）

e.en: My manager {sympathizes} with us about the tight deadline.
e.zh: 我的经理对我们紧迫的截止期限表示理解。

e.en: The author clearly {sympathizes} with her tragic heroine.
e.zh: 作者显然对她笔下的悲剧女主角充满同情。

e.en: She listened, {sympathizing} with every word he said.
e.zh: 她听着,对他说的每句话都感同身受。

e.en: Without {sympathizing} with the criminal, the judge considered context.
e.zh: 法官并不同情罪犯,但仍考虑了背景因素。

e.en: She sent a card to express her {sympathy} for his loss.
e.zh: 她寄了张卡片,对他的失去表示慰问。

e.en: I have no {sympathy} for people who lie repeatedly.
e.zh: 对反复撒谎的人我毫无同情心。

sympatric.t: adj. 同域分布的（生物学）

e.en: The two species are {sympatric} and share the same forest.
e.zh: 这两个物种是同域分布的,共享同一片森林。

e.en: Biologists study {sympatric} speciation in nearby populations.
e.zh: 生物学家研究相邻种群间的同域物种形成。

e.en: The film features a sweeping {symphonic} score.
e.zh: 这部电影有一段恢弘的交响乐配乐。

e.en: The band added {symphonic} elements to their new album.
e.zh: 乐队在新专辑中加入了交响乐元素。

e.en: Beethoven composed nine famous {symphonies}.
e.zh: 贝多芬创作了九部著名的交响曲。

e.en: The orchestra performs classical {symphonies} every weekend.
e.zh: 交响乐团每个周末都演奏古典交响曲。

e.en: We listened to a Mahler {symphony} at the concert hall.
e.zh: 我们在音乐厅听了一首马勒的交响曲。

e.en: The garden was a {symphony} of colors in spring.
e.zh: 春天的花园是一曲色彩的交响乐。

symposia.t: n. 研讨会（symposium 的复数）

e.en: The university hosts several academic {symposia} each year.
e.zh: 这所大学每年举办几场学术研讨会。

e.en: Scientists travel widely to attend international {symposia}.
e.zh: 科学家们四处奔波参加国际学术研讨会。

e.en: She presented her research at a tech {symposium} in Berlin.
e.zh: 她在柏林的一个科技研讨会上展示了她的研究。

e.en: The {symposium} brought together experts from around the world.
e.zh: 这场研讨会汇聚了来自世界各地的专家。

e.en: A persistent cough can be a {symptom} of allergies.
e.zh: 持续咳嗽可能是过敏的一种症状。

e.en: Rising prices are just one {symptom} of the bigger problem.
e.zh: 物价上涨只是更大问题的一个表征。

symptomatic.t: adj. 有症状的；作为征兆的

e.en: His fatigue is {symptomatic} of a deeper health problem.
e.zh: 他的疲倦是更深层健康问题的征兆。

e.en: The bug is {symptomatic} of poor code review practices.
e.zh: 这个漏洞反映出代码审查流程不严谨。

e.en: Doctors first treated the patient {symptomatically} before tests came back.
e.zh: 医生先对症治疗,等检查结果出来再说。

e.en: The clinic handles flu cases {symptomatically} during peak season.
e.zh: 流感高峰期诊所对症处理病例。

e.en: The textbook covers the {symptomatology} of common viral infections.
e.zh: 该教材介绍了常见病毒感染的症状学。

e.en: Her thesis explores the {symptomatology} of long COVID patients.
e.zh: 她的论文研究长新冠患者的症状表现。

e.en: Many early-stage cancers are completely {symptomless}.
e.zh: 许多早期癌症完全没有症状。

e.en: He was a {symptomless} carrier of the virus for weeks.
e.zh: 他几周来一直是无症状的病毒携带者。

symptomology.t: n. 症状学（symptomatology 的变体）

e.en: The doctor reviewed the patient's {symptomology} before ordering scans.
e.zh: 医生在安排扫描前先回顾了病人的症状。

e.en: Her notes detailed the {symptomology} of the rare disorder.
e.zh: 她的笔记详细记录了这种罕见疾病的症状。

e.en: Common flu {symptoms} include fever, cough, and body aches.
e.zh: 常见的流感症状包括发烧、咳嗽和全身酸痛。

e.en: The rising prices are just {symptoms} of a broken economy.
e.zh: 物价上涨只是经济失灵的表象。

e.en: The old {synagogue} downtown holds services every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 市中心那座老犹太会堂每周六上午举行礼拜。

e.en: Tourists often visit the historic {synagogue} in the Jewish quarter.
e.zh: 游客常去犹太区参观那座历史悠久的会堂。

synapse.t: n. 突触（神经元连接处）

e.en: Each {synapse} in the brain transmits signals between neurons.
e.zh: 大脑中的每个突触在神经元之间传递信号。

e.en: Learning a new skill creates fresh connections at every {synapse}.
e.zh: 学习新技能会在每个突触处形成新的连接。

e.en: Sleep helps strengthen {synaptic} connections formed during the day.
e.zh: 睡眠有助于巩固白天形成的突触连接。

e.en: The drug targets {synaptic} activity to reduce seizures.
e.zh: 这种药物作用于突触活动以减少癫痫发作。

e.en: My phone won't {sync} with the laptop over Wi-Fi.
e.zh: 我的手机无法通过 Wi-Fi 与笔记本同步。

e.en: The dancers moved in perfect {sync} with the music.
e.zh: 舞者们的动作与音乐完美同步。

e.en: Make sure the audio is in {synch} with the video.
e.zh: 要确保音频和视频对得上。

e.en: Click here to {synch} your contacts to the cloud.
e.zh: 点这里把通讯录同步到云端。

synchro.t: n. 同步装置；同步电机

e.en: She trains for {synchro} swimming every morning at the pool.
e.zh: 她每天早上去泳池训练花样游泳。

e.en: The team won gold in {synchro} diving at the Olympics.
e.zh: 该队在奥运会双人跳水项目中夺金。

e.en: Linguists use a {synchronic} approach to study modern language use.
e.zh: 语言学家用共时方法研究现代语言的使用。

e.en: His {synchronic} analysis ignores how the dialect evolved historically.
e.zh: 他的共时分析忽略了方言的历史演变。

e.en: Meeting her there felt like pure {synchronicity}, not coincidence.
e.zh: 在那里遇见她感觉像是冥冥注定,而不是巧合。

e.en: The film explores the strange {synchronicity} of two parallel lives.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了两段平行人生奇妙的同步性。

e.en: The {synchronisation} between the servers takes about ten seconds.
e.zh: 服务器之间的同步大约需要十秒钟。

e.en: Poor {synchronisation} caused the dancers to fall out of step.
e.zh: 配合不到位让舞者们步伐错乱。

e.en: Please {synchronise} your watch with the official time signal.
e.zh: 请把你的手表与官方报时信号校准。

e.en: The app lets teams {synchronise} calendars across different time zones.
e.zh: 这款应用让团队跨时区同步日程。

synchronised.t: v. 已同步；adj. 同步的（英式）

e.en: The fountain show is perfectly {synchronised} with classical music.
e.zh: 喷泉表演与古典音乐配合得天衣无缝。

e.en: All my devices are {synchronised} through the same cloud account.
e.zh: 我所有设备都通过同一个云账号同步。

synchronistic.t: adj. 同时发生的；共时的

e.en: Their {synchronistic} ideas appeared in different journals the same week.
e.zh: 他们不约而同的想法在同一周登上不同期刊。

e.en: Jung wrote about {synchronistic} events that defy ordinary causality.
e.zh: 荣格写过那些违背常规因果的同步性事件。

e.en: Cloud {synchronization} keeps your files updated across every device.
e.zh: 云同步让你的文件在每台设备上保持最新。

e.en: The orchestra's {synchronization} with the soloist was flawless.
e.zh: 乐团与独奏者的配合堪称完美。

e.en: The app will {synchronize} your photos automatically when you connect.
e.zh: 连接后,应用会自动同步你的照片。

e.en: Let's {synchronize} our watches before splitting up.
e.zh: 我们分头行动前先把表对一下。

synchronized.t: v. 已同步；adj. 同步的

e.en: Our project deadlines are now {synchronized} across all five teams.
e.zh: 我们的项目截止日期已在五个团队间统一。

e.en: The {synchronized} swimmers performed flawlessly under the spotlights.
e.zh: 花样游泳运动员在聚光灯下完美演绎。

e.en: The audio {synchronizer} fixes lip-sync issues in old footage.
e.zh: 这个音频同步器能修复老片子的对口型问题。

e.en: A built-in {synchronizer} keeps the two motors running at identical speeds.
e.zh: 内置同步器让两台电机保持相同转速。

synchronous.t: adj. 同步的；同时发生的

e.en: This API call is {synchronous}, so it blocks until completion.
e.zh: 这个 API 调用是同步的,会阻塞直到完成。

e.en: The lectures are {synchronous}, meeting live every Tuesday at noon.
e.zh: 课程是实时的,每周二中午同步上课。

e.en: The function executes {synchronously} and returns the result immediately.
e.zh: 该函数同步执行,立即返回结果。

e.en: Both engines fired {synchronously} during the rocket's launch.
e.zh: 火箭发射时两台发动机同步点火。

e.en: The fireflies blinked in perfect {synchrony} across the meadow.
e.zh: 萤火虫在草地上同步闪烁,毫厘不差。

e.en: Heartbeats can fall into {synchrony} between people in love.
e.zh: 相爱的人心跳可以渐渐同步。

e.en: Researchers use the {synchrotron} to study atomic structures of proteins.
e.zh: 研究人员用同步加速器研究蛋白质的原子结构。

e.en: The new {synchrotron} cost nearly a billion dollars to build.
e.zh: 这台新的同步加速器造价近十亿美元。

e.en: Jazz drummers love to {syncopate} the basic four-beat rhythm.
e.zh: 爵士鼓手喜欢把基本的四拍节奏切分。

e.en: Try to {syncopate} the melody by accenting the offbeats.
e.zh: 试着重音落在弱拍,把旋律切分一下。

e.en: The song features a {syncopated} beat that's hard to dance to.
e.zh: 这首歌有切分节奏,跳起舞来不太好踩点。

e.en: Ragtime piano is famous for its lively {syncopated} rhythms.
e.zh: 拉格泰姆钢琴以活泼的切分节奏闻名。

e.en: The drummer added subtle {syncopation} to liven up the chorus.
e.zh: 鼓手加入细腻的切分,让副歌更有活力。

e.en: Funk music relies heavily on {syncopation} and groove.
e.zh: 放克音乐很依赖切分节奏和律动。

syncope.t:
n. 晕厥
n. 中间音省略（语言学）

e.en: The patient was rushed in after a sudden episode of {syncope}.
e.zh: 病人在突然晕厥后被紧急送医。

e.en: Dehydration is a common cause of fainting and {syncope}.
e.zh: 脱水是导致昏厥和晕厥的常见原因。

e.en: Brazilian Candomblé is a {syncretic} blend of African and Catholic traditions.
e.zh: 巴西康东布雷教融合了非洲与天主教传统。

e.en: His art has a {syncretic} style drawing from many cultures.
e.zh: 他的艺术风格融合了多种文化元素。

syncretism.t: n. (宗教、文化) 融合主义

e.en: Religious {syncretism} is common where different faiths coexist for centuries.
e.zh: 在多种信仰共存数百年的地方,宗教融合很常见。

e.en: The festival reflects the cultural {syncretism} of the colonial era.
e.zh: 这个节日体现了殖民时代的文化融合。

e.en: Brazilian Candomblé is a famously {syncretistic} religion.
e.zh: 巴西的坎东布雷教是著名的混合性宗教。

e.en: The temple shows {syncretistic} blends of Buddhist and Hindu art.
e.zh: 这座寺庙呈现出佛教与印度教艺术融合的混合风格。

e.en: Early 20th-century {syndicalism} pushed for worker-controlled industries.
e.zh: 20世纪初的工团主义主张由工人控制各行各业。

e.en: He wrote his thesis on French {syndicalism} between the wars.
e.zh: 他的论文研究的是两次大战之间的法国工团主义。

syndicalist.t:
n. 工团主义者
adj. 工团主义的

e.en: The {syndicalist} movement was strong among Spanish dockworkers.
e.zh: 工团主义运动在西班牙码头工人中曾很有影响力。

e.en: He identified as a {syndicalist} during his student years.
e.zh: 他在学生时代自认是一名工团主义者。

syndicate.t:
n. 财团；辛迪加
v. 联合经营；联合发布

e.en: A criminal {syndicate} was running the smuggling operation.
e.zh: 一个犯罪集团在操控这桩走私行动。

e.en: They plan to {syndicate} the column to dozens of newspapers.
e.zh: 他们打算把这个专栏联合刊载到几十家报纸上。

syndicated.t: adj. 多家媒体联合发布的

e.en: Her advice column is {syndicated} in over 200 papers.
e.zh: 她的建议专栏在200多家报纸上联合刊载。

e.en: The talk show became hugely popular once it was {syndicated}.
e.zh: 这档脱口秀在被联合发行后变得极为火爆。

syndication.t: n. 联合经营；联合发布

e.en: The sitcom still earns millions each year from {syndication}.
e.zh: 这部情景喜剧每年仍能从联合发行中赚到数百万。

e.en: Newspaper {syndication} used to be how cartoonists made a living.
e.zh: 过去漫画家就是靠报纸联合发行谋生的。

e.en: A major {syndicator} picked up the radio show last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天一家大型联合发行商签下了这档广播节目。

e.en: The {syndicator} distributes content to local stations nationwide.
e.zh: 这家联合发行商把内容分发给全国的地方电台。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed her with carpal tunnel {syndrome}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她患了腕管综合征。

e.en: Imposter {syndrome} is common among first-year graduate students.
e.zh: 冒名顶替综合征在研一学生中很常见。

e.en: Several rare genetic {syndromes} affect fewer than 1 in 100,000 people.
e.zh: 有几种罕见的遗传综合征发病率不到十万分之一。

e.en: The clinic specializes in autoimmune {syndromes}.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门研究自身免疫综合征。

syne.t: adv. 从前；以来（苏格兰语，罕用）

e.en: We sang "Auld Lang {syne}" together at midnight.
e.zh: 午夜时我们一起唱了《友谊地久天长》。

e.en: In old Scots, "{syne}" simply means "since" or "long ago".
e.zh: 在古苏格兰语中，"syne"就是"自从"或"很久以前"的意思。

e.en: Saying "all hands on deck" is a classic {synecdoche} for sailors.
e.zh: "all hands on deck"是用部分代整体指代水手的经典提喻。

e.en: Calling a car "a set of wheels" is a common {synecdoche}.
e.zh: 把汽车称作"四个轮子"是一种常见的提喻。

e.en: The two drugs have a {synergic} effect on lowering blood pressure.
e.zh: 这两种药物在降血压方面具有协同效应。

e.en: Their {synergic} partnership doubled the firm's output.
e.zh: 他们协同合作的伙伴关系使公司产出翻倍。

e.en: There's clear {synergism} between caffeine and a good night's sleep.
e.zh: 咖啡因和优质睡眠之间存在明显的协同作用。

e.en: The team's {synergism} made every project run smoother.
e.zh: 团队的协同效应让每个项目都运行得更顺畅。

e.en: The two startups formed a {synergistic} partnership last year.
e.zh: 这两家初创公司去年建立了协同合作关系。

e.en: Vitamin C and iron have a {synergistic} effect on absorption.
e.zh: 维生素C和铁在吸收上具有协同作用。

e.en: The marketing and sales teams now work {synergistically}.
e.zh: 现在市场和销售团队协同合作。

e.en: These herbs act {synergistically} to calm the nervous system.
e.zh: 这些草药协同作用，可以舒缓神经系统。

e.en: There's great {synergy} between the design and engineering teams.
e.zh: 设计团队和工程团队之间有很好的协同效应。

e.en: Mergers often promise {synergy} that never actually materializes.
e.zh: 并购往往承诺协同效应，结果却从未真正实现。

e.en: People with {synesthesia} might see colors when they hear music.
e.zh: 有联觉的人可能在听到音乐时看到颜色。

e.en: Her {synesthesia} causes every letter to have a specific color.
e.zh: 她的联觉让每个字母都对应一种特定的颜色。

e.en: The artist created a {synesthetic} installation blending sound and light.
e.zh: 这位艺术家创作了一个融合声音与光的联觉装置。

e.en: He has a {synesthetic} response where numbers feel like personalities.
e.zh: 他有一种联觉反应，数字对他而言就像有性格一样。

e.en: The church {synod} voted to update its policies on membership.
e.zh: 教会主教会议投票更新了成员资格政策。

e.en: Bishops gathered at the {synod} to discuss reforms.
e.zh: 主教们齐聚宗教会议讨论改革事宜。

e.en: The {synodic} month measures the moon's phases from new to new.
e.zh: 朔望月以从新月到新月来测量月相周期。

e.en: Astronomers calculated the {synodic} period of Venus precisely.
e.zh: 天文学家精确计算了金星的会合周期。

e.en: "Happy" is a common {synonym} for "glad".
e.zh: "happy"是"glad"常用的同义词。

e.en: For many people, Hollywood is a {synonym} for the film industry.
e.zh: 对许多人来说,好莱坞就是电影业的代名词。

e.en: His name became {synonymous} with innovation in tech.
e.zh: 他的名字成了科技创新的代名词。

e.en: The two terms are nearly {synonymous} in casual speech.
e.zh: 这两个词在日常口语中几乎可以互换。

e.en: The words "big" and "large" are often used {synonymously}.
e.zh: "big"和"large"这两个词常被当作同义词使用。

e.en: People use "phone" and "mobile" {synonymously} these days.
e.zh: 如今人们把"phone"和"mobile"当同义词来用。

e.en: The thesaurus lists dozens of {synonyms} for "smart".
e.zh: 同义词词典列出了"smart"的几十个同义词。

e.en: Search engines also match {synonyms} of your keywords.
e.zh: 搜索引擎还会匹配你关键词的同义词。

e.en: The website provides short {synopses} of each episode.
e.zh: 该网站提供了每集剧情的简短梗概。

e.en: Editors read the book {synopses} before requesting full manuscripts.
e.zh: 编辑会先看图书梗概再索取完整稿件。

e.en: Please send a one-page {synopsis} of your novel.
e.zh: 请发送一份一页纸的小说梗概。

e.en: The trailer gives a quick {synopsis} of the movie's plot.
e.zh: 预告片快速概述了电影的情节。

e.en: The report offers a {synoptic} view of last quarter's sales.
e.zh: 这份报告提供了上季度销售的概览视图。

e.en: Meteorologists use {synoptic} charts to forecast weather.
e.zh: 气象学家使用天气综观图来预测天气。

synoptics.t:
n. 对观福音书
n. 综观学

e.en: The {synoptics} of the gospels share many similar passages.
e.zh: 对观福音书之间有许多相似的段落。

e.en: Scholars compare the {synoptics} to study early Christian texts.
e.zh: 学者比较对观福音以研究早期基督教文本。

e.en: The knee is a {synovial} joint with a fluid-filled capsule.
e.zh: 膝关节是带有滑液囊的滑膜关节。

e.en: {Synovial} fluid lubricates the moving joints in your body.
e.zh: 滑液润滑着身体里活动的关节。

e.en: The compiler reported a {syntactic} error on line 42.
e.zh: 编译器在第42行报告了一个语法错误。

e.en: Linguists analyze {syntactic} patterns across different languages.
e.zh: 语言学家分析不同语言中的句法模式。

e.en: The essay had several {syntactical} issues that confused readers.
e.zh: 这篇文章有几处句法问题让读者感到困惑。

e.en: Programming languages enforce strict {syntactical} rules.
e.zh: 编程语言强制执行严格的语法规则。

e.en: The sentence is {syntactically} correct but sounds awkward.
e.zh: 这个句子语法上正确,但听起来别扭。

e.en: The code is {syntactically} valid yet logically wrong.
e.zh: 这段代码语法上有效,但逻辑上是错的。

syntagmatic.t: adj. 组合关系的（语言学）

e.en: Linguists study {syntagmatic} relationships between adjacent words.
e.zh: 语言学家研究相邻词之间的组合关系。

e.en: Word order reflects {syntagmatic} structure in a sentence.
e.zh: 词序体现了句子中的组合结构关系。

syntax.t: n. 句法；(代码) 语法

e.en: Python has cleaner {syntax} than many older languages.
e.zh: Python的语法比许多老语言都更简洁。

e.en: Children master complex {syntax} surprisingly early.
e.zh: 孩子们出人意料地早就掌握了复杂的句法。

synth.t: n. 合成器（synthesizer 的缩写）

e.en: He bought a vintage {synth} for his home studio.
e.zh: 他给自己的家庭录音棚买了一台复古合成器。

e.en: The track opens with a dreamy {synth} melody.
e.zh: 这首曲子以梦幻的合成器旋律开场。

e.en: ATP {synthase} produces energy molecules inside mitochondria.
e.zh: ATP合成酶在线粒体内生产能量分子。

e.en: The enzyme citrate {synthase} catalyzes a key metabolic step.
e.zh: 柠檬酸合成酶催化代谢中的一个关键步骤。

e.en: The chemist completed several drug {syntheses} this week.
e.zh: 这位化学家本周完成了几项药物合成。

e.en: His book offers fresh {syntheses} of old ideas.
e.zh: 他的书对旧观念给出了新颖的综合阐释。

e.en: The paper presents a {synthesis} of recent climate research.
e.zh: 这篇论文综合了近期的气候研究成果。

e.en: Speech {synthesis} has improved dramatically with AI.
e.zh: 语音合成技术随着AI发展有了显著进步。

e.en: Researchers can {synthesise} this compound in just two steps.
e.zh: 研究人员可以仅用两步合成这种化合物。

e.en: The app can {synthesise} natural-sounding speech from text.
e.zh: 这款应用能从文本合成自然的语音。

e.en: The team {synthesised} a new antibiotic last year.
e.zh: 该团队去年合成了一种新抗生素。

e.en: She {synthesised} ideas from many sources into one report.
e.zh: 她将多方观点整合到一份报告中。

e.en: He plays a vintage {synthesiser} in the band.
e.zh: 他在乐队里弹一台复古合成器。

e.en: The {synthesiser} produces every sound in the song.
e.zh: 这首歌里的每个音色都来自合成器。

e.en: AI tools can {synthesize} a voice from a short clip.
e.zh: AI工具能从一小段音频合成出某人的声音。

e.en: Students learn to {synthesize} information from multiple papers.
e.zh: 学生学会从多篇论文中综合信息。

e.en: The lab {synthesized} a more stable version of the molecule.
e.zh: 实验室合成了这种分子更稳定的版本。

e.en: Her report {synthesized} months of user research.
e.zh: 她的报告综合了几个月的用户研究成果。

synthesizer.t: n. 合成器（尤指电子乐器）

e.en: He composed the soundtrack on a modular {synthesizer}.
e.zh: 他用模块合成器创作了这部配乐。

e.en: This {synthesizer} can mimic almost any acoustic instrument.
e.zh: 这款合成器几乎能模仿任何原声乐器。

e.en: The jacket is made of {synthetic} fibers, not wool.
e.zh: 这件外套是合成纤维做的,不是羊毛的。

e.en: Companies train models on {synthetic} data to protect privacy.
e.zh: 公司用合成数据训练模型以保护隐私。

e.en: This vitamin can be produced {synthetically} in a lab.
e.zh: 这种维生素可以在实验室里人工合成。

e.en: The diamond was created {synthetically} but looks identical to natural ones.
e.zh: 这颗钻石是人工合成的,但与天然钻石看起来无异。

e.en: Doctors treat {syphilis} effectively with penicillin.
e.zh: 医生用青霉素能有效治疗梅毒。

e.en: Cases of {syphilis} have risen sharply in recent years.
e.zh: 梅毒病例近年来急剧上升。

syphilitic.t:
adj. 梅毒的
n. 梅毒患者

e.en: The historian studied {syphilitic} patients in Victorian asylums.
e.zh: 这位历史学家研究了维多利亚时代精神病院里的梅毒患者。

e.en: Doctors recognized the {syphilitic} rash immediately.
e.zh: 医生立刻认出了那种梅毒疹。

syphon.t:
n. 虹吸管
v. 用虹吸管吸

e.en: He used a hose to {syphon} gas from the tank.
e.zh: 他用一根软管从油箱里虹吸出汽油。

e.en: The scheme tried to {syphon} money from the company accounts.
e.zh: 这个骗局试图从公司账户中抽走资金。

e.en: She studied journalism at {Syracuse} University in New York.
e.zh: 她在纽约的雪城大学学习新闻学。

e.en: Ancient {Syracuse} was a powerful Greek city in Sicily.
e.zh: 古叙拉古是西西里岛上一座强大的希腊城邦。

e.en: She paired the steak with a bold Australian {syrah}.
e.zh: 她用一款浓郁的澳洲西拉葡萄酒搭配牛排。

e.en: This {syrah} has notes of black pepper and dark berries.
e.zh: 这款西拉带有黑胡椒和深色浆果的香气。

e.en: The ancient ruins of Palmyra lie in the deserts of {Syria}.
e.zh: 古城帕尔米拉的废墟坐落在叙利亚的沙漠中。

e.en: Many refugees fled {Syria} during the long civil war.
e.zh: 许多难民在漫长的内战中逃离了叙利亚。

syrian.t:
adj. 叙利亚的
n. 叙利亚人

e.en: The restaurant serves authentic {Syrian} dishes like kibbeh and fattoush.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应正宗的叙利亚菜,如基贝和法图什。

e.en: She grew up speaking a {Syrian} dialect of Arabic at home.
e.zh: 她在家从小说叙利亚方言的阿拉伯语。

syringe.t:
n. 注射器
v. 注射

e.en: The nurse filled the {syringe} carefully before giving the injection.
e.zh: 护士仔细地把针筒抽满药再注射。

e.en: Always dispose of a used {syringe} in a sharps container.
e.zh: 用过的针筒一定要丢进利器盒里。

e.en: He poured maple {syrup} all over his stack of pancakes.
e.zh: 他把枫糖浆浇满了一摞煎饼。

e.en: The cough {syrup} tastes terrible but works within an hour.
e.zh: 这款止咳糖浆味道很难闻,但一小时内见效。

e.en: The dessert was too {syrupy} and sweet for my taste.
e.zh: 这道甜点对我来说太黏太甜了。

e.en: Her {syrupy} compliments felt insincere and a little creepy.
e.zh: 她那番油腻的恭维听着既不真诚又有点让人不舒服。

e.en: The new payment {system} processes thousands of transactions per second.
e.zh: 新的支付系统每秒能处理数千笔交易。

e.en: My immune {system} took a hit after that long flight.
e.zh: 经过那趟长途飞行,我的免疫系统受到了打击。

e.en: The team took a {systematic} approach to debugging the production issue.
e.zh: 团队用系统化的方法排查线上故障。

e.en: Researchers conducted a {systematic} review of the published evidence.
e.zh: 研究者对已发表的证据进行了系统综述。

e.en: He gave a {systematical} explanation of every step in the proof.
e.zh: 他对证明的每一步都做了系统化的讲解。

e.en: The book offers a {systematical} overview of modern macroeconomics.
e.zh: 这本书系统地概述了现代宏观经济学。

e.en: She {systematically} reviewed every line of code before merging.
e.zh: 她在合并前系统地审查了每一行代码。

e.en: The company {systematically} ignored complaints from junior employees.
e.zh: 公司一贯无视初级员工的投诉。

e.en: Modern {systematics} uses DNA sequencing to classify living organisms.
e.zh: 现代系统分类学利用 DNA 测序对生物进行分类。

e.en: She teaches plant {systematics} at the university's biology department.
e.zh: 她在大学生物系教授植物系统分类学。

systematise.t: v. 使系统化（英式拼写）

e.en: The new manager tried to {systematise} how the office handled requests.
e.zh: 新经理试图让办公室处理请求的方式系统化。

e.en: We need to {systematise} our notes before the audit next week.
e.zh: 我们得在下周审计前把笔记整理系统化。

e.en: The {systematization} of medical records improved patient care dramatically.
e.zh: 病历的系统化大大改善了病人的就医体验。

e.en: Her thesis focused on the {systematization} of folk knowledge.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于民间知识的系统化整理。

e.en: The startup is trying to {systematize} its hiring process this quarter.
e.zh: 这家初创公司本季度想把招聘流程系统化。

e.en: He worked for years to {systematize} the field's scattered terminology.
e.zh: 他多年致力于把这一领域零散的术语系统化。

systematized.t:
v. systematize 的过去式
adj. 已系统化的

e.en: They {systematized} customer feedback into clear actionable categories.
e.zh: 他们把客户反馈系统化整理成清晰的行动类别。

e.en: The library {systematized} its archives using a new digital catalog.
e.zh: 图书馆用新的数字目录把档案系统化整理。

systemic.t: adj. 全身性的；全系统的

e.en: The report exposed {systemic} racism within the police department.
e.zh: 报告揭露了警察部门内部的系统性种族歧视。

e.en: This drug works {systemic} rather than just on the affected area.
e.zh: 这种药是全身作用的,不只针对患处。

systemically.t: adv. 全身性地；系统性地

e.en: The bank is considered {systemically} important to the global economy.
e.zh: 这家银行被视为对全球经济具有系统重要性。

e.en: Bias in hiring needs to be addressed {systemically}, not case by case.
e.zh: 招聘中的偏见需要系统性解决,而不是逐案处理。

e.en: Modern cars rely on dozens of computer {systems} working together.
e.zh: 现代汽车依靠数十个计算机系统协同工作。

e.en: Our {systems} will be down for maintenance Saturday night.
e.zh: 我们的系统将于周六晚上停机维护。

e.en: During {systole}, the heart pushes blood out into the arteries.
e.zh: 在心脏收缩期，心脏将血液推送至动脉。
