e.en: The biologist identified the small {scoopfish} by its unusual mouth.
e.zh: 生物学家凭它奇特的嘴认出了这条小匙鱼。

e.en: A {scoopfish} hovered near the sandy bottom.
e.zh: 一条铲口鱼在沙质水底附近游动。

e.en: Add one {scoopful} of flour to the bowl.
e.zh: 往碗里加一满勺面粉。

e.en: He tossed a {scoopful} of sand into the bucket.
e.zh: 他把一铲沙子倒进桶里。

e.en: She served three {scoopfuls} of rice onto his plate.
e.zh: 她给他的盘子盛了三勺米饭。

e.en: The children carried {scoopfuls} of gravel across the yard.
e.zh: 孩子们把一铲铲碎石搬过院子。

scoopmobile.t: 新闻采访车；流动采访车

e.en: The reporters followed the mayor in their {scoopmobile}.
e.zh: 记者们开着新闻采访车跟在市长后面。

e.en: An old {scoopmobile} was parked outside the newspaper office.
e.zh: 一辆旧的流动采访车停在报社外面。

e.en: The spoon has a deep, {scoopy} bowl.
e.zh: 这把勺子的勺头很深，呈勺状。

e.en: Her {scoopy} style made the column feel lively.
e.zh: 她爱挖独家消息的风格让专栏显得很有活力。

scooterist.t: 骑小型摩托车的人；滑板车骑手

e.en: The {scooterist} waited patiently at the red light.
e.zh: 那名小型摩托车骑手耐心地等在红灯前。

e.en: A careful {scooterist} should always wear a helmet.
e.zh: 谨慎的滑板车骑手应该始终戴头盔。

e.en: The {scop} recited heroic tales in the hall.
e.zh: 那位古英语吟游诗人在大厅里吟诵英雄故事。

e.en: A medieval {scop} preserved history through song.
e.zh: 中世纪吟游诗人通过歌唱保存历史。

e.en: The bee's {scopa} was packed with yellow pollen.
e.zh: 蜜蜂的携粉毛上沾满了黄色花粉。

e.en: Under the lens, the {scopa} looked like a tiny brush.
e.zh: 在镜头下，花粉刷毛看起来像一把小刷子。

scopey.t: 范围过宽的；题材宏大的

e.en: The proposal felt too {scopey} for a small team.
e.zh: 这个方案对一个小团队来说显得范围太大。

e.en: His novel is ambitious and {scopey}, covering three generations.
e.zh: 他的小说野心很大、格局宏阔，写了三代人的故事。

e.en: The museum displayed a rare {scophony} projector.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台罕见的早期电视投影机。

e.en: Engineers once hoped {scophony} would improve television images.
e.zh: 工程师们曾希望这种早期电视投影技术能改善电视图像。

e.en: The insect has {scopiform} hairs on its legs.
e.zh: 这种昆虫腿上有刷状的毛。

e.en: A {scopiform} structure helps collect pollen efficiently.
e.zh: 刷状结构有助于高效收集花粉。

scopine.t: 莨菪烷衍生物；东莨菪醇胺

e.en: The chemist isolated {scopine} from the reaction mixture.
e.zh: 化学家从反应混合物中分离出莨菪烷衍生物。

e.en: {Scopine} is discussed mainly in specialized organic chemistry texts.
e.zh: 东莨菪醇胺主要出现在专业有机化学文献中。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {scopolamine} for severe motion sickness.
e.zh: 医生开了东莨菪碱来治疗严重晕动病。

e.en: Too much {scopolamine} can cause confusion and dry mouth.
e.zh: 东莨菪碱过量可能导致意识混乱和口干。

scopoletin.t: 东莨菪素；香豆素化合物

e.en: Researchers measured {scopoletin} levels in the plant extract.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了植物提取物中的东莨菪素含量。

e.en: {Scopoletin} fluoresces under certain laboratory conditions.
e.zh: 东莨菪素在某些实验条件下会发出荧光。

scopoline.t: 东莨菪苷类物质；生物碱衍生物

e.en: The sample contained traces of {scopoline}.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量东莨菪苷类物质。

e.en: {Scopoline} appears in discussions of plant alkaloid chemistry.
e.zh: 东莨菪苷类物质会出现在植物生物碱化学的讨论中。

scopomannite.t: 东莨菪甘露醇；罕见植物醇

e.en: The old paper reported {scopomannite} in the plant roots.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文称植物根部含有东莨菪甘露醇。

e.en: Few modern texts mention {scopomannite} outside phytochemistry.
e.zh: 除植物化学外，现代文献很少提到东莨菪甘露醇。

e.en: The clinic used {scopometry} to assess visual performance.
e.zh: 诊所用视觉测量法评估视功能。

e.en: Early {scopometry} relied on simple optical instruments.
e.zh: 早期视力测定依靠简单的光学仪器。

e.en: The essay links cinema with {scopophilia}.
e.zh: 这篇文章把电影与窥视癖联系起来。

e.en: Freud used {scopophilia} to describe pleasure in looking.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德用窥视欲来描述观看带来的快感。

e.en: The fungus produced a {scopospore} inside the cell.
e.zh: 这种真菌在细胞内产生了一个内生孢子。

e.en: A mature {scopospore} can be seen under high magnification.
e.zh: 在高倍放大下可以看到成熟的囊内孢子。

e.en: A {scops} owl called from the olive trees.
e.zh: 一只角鸮在橄榄树间鸣叫。

e.en: The guide spotted a tiny {scops} at dusk.
e.zh: 向导在黄昏时发现了一只小耳鸮。

e.en: The spider's {scopula} helped it grip the glass.
e.zh: 蜘蛛足上的密毛垫帮助它抓住玻璃表面。

e.en: Each {scopula} contains many fine adhesive hairs.
e.zh: 每个密毛垫都含有许多细小的黏附毛。

scopulae.t: 密毛垫复数；蜘蛛足刷毛

e.en: The tarantula's {scopulae} are visible under magnification.
e.zh: 狼蛛的足部密毛垫在放大后清晰可见。

e.en: Damaged {scopulae} can reduce a spider's climbing ability.
e.zh: 密毛垫受损会降低蜘蛛的攀爬能力。

e.en: The species has {scopulate} feet suited for climbing.
e.zh: 这个物种有适合攀爬的密毛垫足。

e.en: A {scopulate} surface may look velvety under the microscope.
e.zh: 具刷毛的表面在显微镜下可能看起来像天鹅绒。

e.en: The sailor showed {scorbutic} symptoms after months without fresh food.
e.zh: 几个月没有新鲜食物后，那名水手出现了坏血病症状。

e.en: A {scorbutic} diet lacks enough vitamin C.
e.zh: 容易导致坏血病的饮食缺乏足够的维生素C。

e.en: Old medical texts called scurvy {scorbutus}.
e.zh: 旧医学文献把坏血病称为scorbutus。

e.en: The crew feared {scorbutus} during the long voyage.
e.zh: 船员们在漫长航行中害怕患上坏血病。

e.en: The army used a {scorched-earth} strategy while retreating.
e.zh: 军队撤退时采用了焦土策略。

e.en: Her {scorched-earth} campaign left no room for compromise.
e.zh: 她那种彻底打击对手的竞选方式没有留下妥协空间。

e.en: She used a {scorchpencil} to darken the wooden pattern.
e.zh: 她用烙画笔加深木头上的图案。

e.en: The old {scorchpencil} left a smoky line on the board.
e.zh: 那支旧烙画笔在木板上留下了一道烟熏般的线。

scordato.t: 变格调弦的；特殊调弦的

e.en: The violin part is marked {scordato} in the manuscript.
e.zh: 手稿中的小提琴声部标有特殊调弦。

e.en: A {scordato} passage can sound brighter than normal tuning.
e.zh: 一段变格调弦的乐句可能比普通调弦更明亮。

e.en: The composer used {scordatura} to create a darker resonance.
e.zh: 作曲家使用特殊调弦来营造更低沉的共鸣。

e.en: Players must retune the strings before performing the {scordatura}.
e.zh: 演奏这段变格调弦作品前，乐手必须重新调弦。

e.en: The damaged {scordboard} failed during the final inning.
e.zh: 受损的记分板在最后一局时失灵了。

e.en: Fans watched the {scordboard} as the home team caught up.
e.zh: 主队追上比分时，球迷都盯着记分牌。

e.en: Please sign your golf {score-card} after the round.
e.zh: 打完一轮高尔夫后，请在记分卡上签名。

e.en: The agency published a {score-card} on school performance.
e.zh: 该机构发布了一份学校表现成绩单。

e.en: The coach checked the {scorebook} after the game.
e.zh: 比赛结束后，教练查看了记分簿。

e.en: Her piano {scorebook} was full of handwritten notes.
e.zh: 她的钢琴乐谱集里写满了手写批注。

e.en: Keep a {scorepad} beside the cards.
e.zh: 把记分本放在纸牌旁边。

e.en: He tore a page from the {scorepad} after the match.
e.zh: 比赛结束后，他从记分本上撕下一页。

e.en: Black {scoria} covered the slope below the crater.
e.zh: 黑色火山渣覆盖了火山口下方的斜坡。

e.en: The furnace left chunks of {scoria} near the wall.
e.zh: 熔炉在墙边留下了几块熔渣。

scoriaceous.t: 似火山渣的；多孔渣状的

e.en: The geologist described the rock as {scoriaceous}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这块岩石描述为火山渣状。

e.en: A {scoriaceous} surface can feel rough and porous.
e.zh: 渣状表面摸起来可能粗糙而多孔。

e.en: Loose {scoriae} rolled down the volcanic cone.
e.zh: 松散的火山渣从火山锥上滚落下来。

e.en: The workers cleared {scoriae} from beside the smelter.
e.zh: 工人清理了冶炼炉旁的熔渣。

e.en: The assay required {scorification} before the metal could be weighed.
e.zh: 这项化验需要先进行造渣处理，才能称量金属。

e.en: Poor {scorification} left impurities in the sample.
e.zh: 造渣处理不充分使样品中残留了杂质。

e.en: The technician weighed the {scorified} residue carefully.
e.zh: 技术员仔细称量了已熔渣化的残渣。

e.en: A {scorified} surface formed on the heated ore.
e.zh: 加热后的矿石表面形成了渣化层。

e.en: The assayer placed the sample in a clay {scorifier}.
e.zh: 化验员把样品放进陶制造渣皿里。

e.en: A cracked {scorifier} can ruin the metal assay.
e.zh: 有裂纹的造渣皿会毁掉金属化验。

e.en: The process {scorifies} impurities during heating.
e.zh: 这个过程在加热时使杂质形成熔渣。

e.en: Flux {scorifies} the unwanted material in the ore.
e.zh: 熔剂会使矿石中的无用物质造渣。

e.en: The lava cooled into a {scoriform} mass.
e.zh: 熔岩冷却成一团火山渣状物。

e.en: A {scoriform} crust covered the old slag heap.
e.zh: 旧渣堆上覆盖着一层渣状硬壳。

e.en: Technicians {scorify} the ore to separate impurities.
e.zh: 技术员对矿石进行造渣处理以分离杂质。

e.en: High heat can {scorify} the surface of the sample.
e.zh: 高温会使样品表面熔渣化。

e.en: The {scorifying} step removed most of the unwanted minerals.
e.zh: 造渣步骤去除了大部分无用矿物。

e.en: He watched the {scorifying} ore bubble in the furnace.
e.zh: 他看着熔炉中正在熔渣化的矿石冒泡。

e.en: The geologist identified the green crystals as {scorodite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这些绿色晶体鉴定为臭葱石。

e.en: Old mine waste may contain {scorodite} formed from arsenic minerals.
e.zh: 旧矿渣中可能含有由砷矿物形成的臭葱石。

e.en: A {scorpaenid} can hide among rocks with remarkable camouflage.
e.zh: 鲉科鱼能凭借出色的伪装藏在岩石间。

e.en: The diver avoided touching the {scorpaenid} spines.
e.zh: 潜水员避开了那条鲉科鱼的毒刺。

e.en: The specimen had a broad head and other {scorpaenoid} features.
e.zh: 这个标本头部宽大，并有其他鲉形鱼类特征。

e.en: Several {scorpaenoid} fishes live near the reef floor.
e.zh: 几种鲉形鱼类生活在礁石底部附近。

e.en: She used a {scorper} to hollow the wood block.
e.zh: 她用雕刻刀把木块内部挖空。

e.en: The old {scorper} left clean grooves in the soft stone.
e.zh: 那把旧刮刀在软石上留下了干净的槽痕。

e.en: The {scorpionfish} waited motionless on the seabed.
e.zh: 那条蝎子鱼一动不动地伏在海床上。

e.en: A careless swimmer can be stung by a hidden {scorpionfish}.
e.zh: 粗心的游泳者可能会被藏着的蝎子鱼刺伤。

e.en: The manuscript had a dark {scorteal} cover.
e.zh: 这份手稿有一层深色的皮革封面。

e.en: A {scorteal} texture made the old case feel expensive.
e.zh: 皮革般的质感让这个旧盒子显得很贵重。

e.en: The collector bought a small piece of blue {scorzalite}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一小块蓝色的蓝磷铁锰矿。

e.en: Under bright light, the {scorzalite} showed a glassy shine.
e.zh: 在强光下，蓝磷铁锰矿显出玻璃般的光泽。

e.en: The chef roasted {scorzonera} with butter and herbs.
e.zh: 厨师用黄油和香草烤了黑婆罗门参。

e.en: Wild {scorzonera} grows in dry fields across parts of Europe.
e.zh: 野生鸦葱生长在欧洲部分地区的干燥田野里。

e.en: The main suspect walked away {scot-free}.
e.zh: 主要嫌疑人毫发无损地逍遥法外。

e.en: He broke the rules but got off {scot-free}.
e.zh: 他违反了规定，却没有受到任何惩罚。

e.en: Two {Scotchmen} were listed among the early settlers.
e.zh: 早期定居者名单中列有两名苏格兰男子。

e.en: The play portrays the {Scotchmen} in old-fashioned language.
e.zh: 这部戏用过时的语言描写那些苏格兰人。

e.en: The medieval scholar was known as a committed {Scotist}.
e.zh: 这位中世纪学者以坚定的司各脱学派信徒著称。

e.en: A {Scotist} reading of the passage emphasizes individual form.
e.zh: 对这段文字的司各脱学派解读强调个体形式。

e.en: After standing too quickly, she felt brief {scotodinia}.
e.zh: 她起身太快后，短暂感到眼前发黑般的头晕。

e.en: The doctor asked when the episodes of {scotodinia} began.
e.zh: 医生询问这种眼前发黑性头晕是从什么时候开始的。

e.en: The inventor demonstrated a {scotograph} for writing without light.
e.zh: 发明者演示了一种可在无光中书写的暗写仪。

e.en: A nineteenth-century {scotograph} appears in the museum catalogue.
e.zh: 博物馆目录中出现了一台十九世纪的暗室记录器。

e.en: The lecture mentioned {scotography} as an early photographic technique.
e.zh: 讲座提到暗室摄影法是一种早期摄影技术。

e.en: Soldiers practiced {scotography} to write messages in darkness.
e.zh: 士兵练习暗中书写，以便在黑暗中传递信息。

e.en: The patient described flashing lights around several {scotomata}.
e.zh: 病人说几个视野暗点周围有闪光。

e.en: Migraine attacks can produce temporary {scotomata}.
e.zh: 偏头痛发作可能造成暂时性的视野盲点。

e.en: The clinic used a {scotometer} to map the blind spot.

e.en: A small {screw-jack} can adjust the machine's height.
e.zh: 一个小型螺旋千斤顶可以调节机器高度。

e.en: People said he had a {screw-loose} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后人们说他脑子有点不正常。

e.en: That {screw-loose} plan somehow worked.
e.zh: 那个古怪得离谱的计划竟然成功了。

e.en: This bottle has a {screw-top} instead of a cork.
e.zh: 这个瓶子用的是螺旋盖，不是软木塞。

e.en: She bought a {screw-top} jar for the jam.
e.zh: 她买了一个带螺旋盖的罐子装果酱。

e.en: The medicine came in a {screw-topped} bottle.
e.zh: 这种药装在带螺旋盖的瓶子里。

e.en: Keep the oil in a {screw-topped} container.
e.zh: 把油保存在带螺旋盖的容器里。

screw-tops.t: 螺旋盖；带螺旋盖的瓶子

e.en: The factory makes plastic {screw-tops} for bottles.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产瓶子用的塑料螺旋盖。

e.en: Some wine lovers dislike {screw-tops}.
e.zh: 有些葡萄酒爱好者不喜欢螺旋盖酒瓶。

e.en: Please do not {screw-up} the booking again.
e.zh: 请不要再把预订搞砸了。

e.en: The missing file was a major {screw-up}.
e.zh: 文件丢失是一次严重失误。

e.en: A {screwbean} grew near the desert wash.
e.zh: 一棵螺旋豆树长在沙漠冲沟附近。

e.en: The {screwbean} pods twist into tight spirals.
e.zh: 螺旋豆荚会卷成紧密的螺旋形。

e.en: The wine has a metal {screwcap}.
e.zh: 这瓶酒用的是金属螺旋盖。

e.en: Replace the {screwcap} tightly after use.
e.zh: 用完后把螺旋瓶盖拧紧。

e.en: The schedule was completely {screwed-up} by the storm.
e.zh: 日程被暴风雨彻底打乱了。

e.en: He felt too {screwed-up} to make decisions.
e.zh: 他觉得自己状态太混乱，无法做决定。

e.en: The {screwhead} was too worn to turn.
e.zh: 螺丝头磨损太严重，已经拧不动了。

e.en: Choose a bit that fits the {screwhead}.
e.zh: 选择一个适合螺丝头的钻头。

e.en: His excuses became {screwier} every day.
e.zh: 他的借口一天比一天荒唐。

e.en: This town feels {screwier} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后，这座小镇显得更加古怪。

e.en: That was the {screwiest} idea in the meeting.
e.zh: 那是会议上最荒唐的主意。

e.en: She told the {screwiest} story about the missing keys.
e.zh: 她讲了个关于钥匙失踪的最古怪故事。

e.en: The film's {screwiness} is part of its charm.
e.zh: 这部电影的古怪劲儿正是它的魅力之一。

e.en: I could not ignore the {screwiness} of his explanation.
e.zh: 我无法忽视他那套解释里的荒唐之处。

screwloose.t: 脑子不正常的人；疯癫的

e.en: Everyone called him a {screwloose}, but he was harmless.
e.zh: 大家都叫他怪人，但他并无恶意。

e.en: Her {screwloose} humor made the party lively.
e.zh: 她疯疯癫癫的幽默让聚会热闹起来。

e.en: The {screwman} adjusted the press before production started.
e.zh: 生产开始前，螺旋压力机工调好了机器。

e.en: A skilled {screwman} could spot the fault quickly.
e.zh: 熟练的螺丝工能很快发现故障。

e.en: Use a {screwtap} to cut the internal thread.
e.zh: 用丝锥切出内螺纹。

e.en: The old {screwtap} snapped inside the hole.
e.zh: 旧丝锥断在孔里面了。

e.en: The {screwthread} must match the nut exactly.
e.zh: 螺纹必须和螺母完全匹配。

e.en: Dirt in the {screwthread} made the cap stick.
e.zh: 螺纹里的污垢让盖子卡住了。

e.en: The vinegar comes with a plastic {screwtop}.
e.zh: 这瓶醋配有塑料螺旋盖。

e.en: He opened the {screwtop} and poured a drink.
e.zh: 他拧开螺旋盖，倒了一杯饮料。

e.en: The delay was a serious {screwup} by the airline.
e.zh: 这次延误是航空公司的一次严重失误。

e.en: He is not a {screwup}; he just needs training.
e.zh: 他不是废物，只是需要培训。

e.en: The fortune-teller {scried} in a bowl of water.
e.zh: 占卜师在一碗水中进行窥视占卜。

e.en: She {scried} for signs of the lost child.
e.zh: 她通过占卜寻找失踪孩子的线索。

scries.t: 占卜窥视；用水晶球占卜

e.en: He {scries} by candlelight every winter solstice.
e.zh: 每年冬至，他都会在烛光下占卜窥视。

e.en: The novel's witch {scries} the future in smoke.
e.zh: 小说里的女巫在烟雾中占卜未来。

e.en: He had to {scrieve} along the road before dusk.
e.zh: 他得在天黑前沿路快步赶去。

e.en: She tried to {scrieve} a note before leaving.
e.zh: 她临走前想匆匆写张便条。

e.en: He {scrieves} across the yard when rain starts.
e.zh: 一下雨，他就快步穿过院子。

e.en: The clerk {scrieves} the names into a ledger.
e.zh: 职员把名字匆匆写进账簿。

e.en: That was the {scrimpiest} lunch I have ever been served.
e.zh: 那是我吃过分量最少的一顿午餐。

e.en: Even the {scrimpiest} budget should include safety checks.
e.zh: 即使是最紧巴的预算，也应包含安全检查。

e.en: The museum gave us a {scrimpy} handout with almost no details.
e.zh: 博物馆给我们的资料很简略，几乎没有细节。

e.en: He was too {scrimpy} to pay for proper repairs.
e.zh: 他太吝啬，不肯花钱好好维修。

e.en: The old sailor became a {scrimshander} after leaving the sea.
e.zh: 那位老水手离海后成了贝雕工匠。

e.en: She learned to {scrimshander} small scenes on polished bone.
e.zh: 她学会在抛光骨片上雕刻小场景。

e.en: A {scrimshandered} whale tooth sat in the glass case.
e.zh: 一个经过贝雕装饰的鲸牙摆在玻璃柜里。

e.en: He {scrimshandered} a tiny ship onto the ivory handle.
e.zh: 他在象牙手柄上雕出了一艘小船。

e.en: The sergeant accused him of trying to {scrimshank} during inspection.
e.zh: 中士指责他在检查时想逃避职责。

e.en: Do not {scrimshank} when the whole team is under pressure.
e.zh: 整个团队有压力时别偷懒躲活。

e.en: He {scrimshanked} his way out of kitchen duty again.
e.zh: 他又耍滑逃掉了厨房值勤。

e.en: The officer knew the recruit had {scrimshanked} the hard work.
e.zh: 军官知道那个新兵逃避了苦活。

e.en: His constant {scrimshanking} annoyed the rest of the crew.
e.zh: 他总是偷懒躲活，让其他船员很恼火。

e.en: She called his excuse {scrimshanking}, not illness.
e.zh: 她说他的借口是在逃避职责，不是生病。

e.en: He {scrimshanks} whenever the work becomes unpleasant.
e.zh: 工作一变得不讨好，他就偷懒躲开。

e.en: The captain dislikes anyone who {scrimshanks} on watch.
e.zh: 船长不喜欢值班时逃避职责的人。

e.en: The manuscript was stored in a wooden {scrinium}.
e.zh: 那份手稿被存放在一个木制书卷箱里。

e.en: A Roman clerk might keep official papers in a {scrinium}.
e.zh: 古罗马文书可能把公文放在文书匣中。

e.en: The print bears the note {scripsit} beside the artist's name.
e.zh: 这幅版画在艺术家姓名旁有题署作者的字样。

e.en: Scholars debated whether the word {scripsit} proved his authorship.
e.zh: 学者们争论scripsit一词是否证明了他的作者身份。

e.en: The {script-writer} revised the final scene overnight.
e.zh: 编剧连夜修改了最后一场戏。

e.en: A good {script-writer} gives every character a clear voice.
e.zh: 优秀的剧本作者会让每个角色都有鲜明的声音。

e.en: The inventor displayed a {scriptron} that typed coded messages.
e.zh: 发明者展示了一台能打出加密信息的自动打字装置。

e.en: Few offices ever used the experimental {scriptron}.
e.zh: 很少有办公室真正使用过这种实验性的自动打字装置。

e.en: The carver chose a smooth {scrivello} for the miniature portrait.
e.zh: 雕刻师选了一片光滑的小象牙来刻微型肖像。

e.en: A thin {scrivello} can crack if it dries too quickly.
e.zh: 薄薄的象牙片如果干得太快会开裂。

e.en: The beetle's shell looked {scrobiculate} under the lens.
e.zh: 在镜头下，甲虫的外壳显得布满小凹坑。

e.en: Weathering began to {scrobiculate} the limestone surface.
e.zh: 风化开始把石灰岩表面侵蚀成一个个小坑。

e.en: The fossil had a {scrobiculated} outer surface.
e.zh: 这块化石外表布满细小凹坑。

e.en: Botanists noted the seed's {scrobiculated} coat.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到那粒种子的外皮有细小凹坑。

e.en: Doctors once blamed repeated swollen glands on {scrofulism}.
e.zh: 医生过去曾把反复的腺体肿大归因于淋巴结核体质。

e.en: The old case notes mention {scrofulism} as a family tendency.
e.zh: 旧病历把淋巴结核体质记作一种家族倾向。

e.en: The child was treated for {scrofulosis} in the hospital ward.
e.zh: 那个孩子在病房里接受淋巴结核病治疗。

e.en: Modern medicine rarely uses the term {scrofulosis}.
e.zh: 现代医学很少再使用scrofulosis这个术语。

e.en: The doctor described the swelling as {scrofulous}.
e.zh: 医生把那处肿胀描述为淋巴结核性的。

e.en: They lived in a {scrofulous} alley behind the market.
e.zh: 他们住在市场后面一条污秽的小巷里。

e.en: We crossed a {scroggy} hillside covered with thorn bushes.
e.zh: 我们穿过一片长满荆棘灌木的山坡。

e.en: The old horse looked {scroggy} after the hard winter.
e.zh: 熬过严冬后，那匹老马显得又瘦又弱。

e.en: The report opens in a {scrollable} window on the dashboard.
e.zh: 报告会在仪表板上的可滚动窗口中打开。

e.en: Make the table {scrollable} on small phone screens.
e.zh: 在小手机屏幕上要让表格可以滚动浏览。

e.en: The violin maker carved a delicate {scrollhead}.
e.zh: 制琴师雕出了一个精致的涡卷头。

e.en: A broken {scrollhead} reduced the value of the antique chair.
e.zh: 卷形装饰端破损降低了那把古董椅的价值。

e.en: The children had to {scrooch} together on the narrow bench.
e.zh: 孩子们只好在窄长凳上挤成一团。

e.en: She tried to {scrooch} past without waking the dog.
e.zh: 她想蜷着身子挤过去，免得吵醒狗。

e.en: The silk made a faint {scroop} as she walked.
e.zh: 她走路时，丝绸发出轻微的摩擦声。

e.en: Old hinges {scroop} unless they are oiled.
e.zh: 旧铰链不上油就会嘎吱作响。

e.en: He had to {scrootch} under the low fence.
e.zh: 他只好蜷着身子从低矮的栅栏下钻过去。

e.en: Everyone {scrootched} closer when the last passenger boarded.
e.zh: 最后一名乘客上车时，大家都往里挤了挤。

e.en: The botanist identified several {scrophulariaceous} plants near the stream.
e.zh: 植物学家在溪边认出了几种玄参科植物。

e.en: Older manuals used {scrophulariaceous} for members of the figwort family.
e.zh: 旧手册用scrophulariaceous来指玄参科成员。

e.en: The clerk was {scruting} every faded signature.
e.zh: 那名办事员正在仔细审查每个褪色的签名。

e.en: She spent the evening {scruting} the strange report.
e.zh: 她整个晚上都在严密察看那份奇怪的报告。

e.en: His {scrutinous} gaze made everyone nervous.
e.zh: 他那审视仔细的目光让大家都很紧张。

e.en: The proposal faced a {scrutinous} review by experts.
e.zh: 这项提案受到专家们苛察般的审查。

scry.t: 占卜窥视；用水晶球预见

e.en: The witch tried to {scry} the king's fate.
e.zh: 女巫试图占卜窥视国王的命运。

e.en: He would {scry} in a dark bowl of water.
e.zh: 他会对着一碗黑水进行占卜。

e.en: We went {scuba-diving} near the reef.
e.zh: 我们在珊瑚礁附近进行了水肺潜水。

e.en: {Scuba-diving} requires training and careful planning.
e.zh: 水肺潜水需要训练和周密计划。

e.en: The merchant counted twenty {scudi} on the table.
e.zh: 商人数了数桌上的二十枚意大利旧银币。

e.en: Old contracts sometimes list payments in {scudi}.
e.zh: 旧契约有时会把款项记为斯库迪银币。

e.en: He paid one {scudo} for the small engraving.
e.zh: 他花了一枚意大利旧银币买下那幅小版画。

e.en: A {scudo} could buy a modest meal then.
e.zh: 在当时，一枚斯库多银币可以买一顿简单的饭。

e.en: The frightened boy chose to {scug} behind the shed.
e.zh: 受惊的男孩选择躲在棚屋后面。

e.en: Thieves would {scug} in the alley until nightfall.
e.zh: 小偷们会在巷子里潜伏到夜幕降临。

e.en: The editor removed the passage of {sculduddery}.
e.zh: 编辑删去了那段淫秽描写。

e.en: His friends laughed at the old man's {sculduddery}.
e.zh: 朋友们嘲笑那位老人开的猥亵玩笑。

e.en: The spy tried to {sculk} through the courtyard.
e.zh: 间谍试图鬼祟地穿过庭院。

e.en: Do not {sculk} in corners during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时不要躲在角落里偷偷摸摸。

e.en: A {sculker} was seen near the locked gate.
e.zh: 有人看见一个鬼祟潜行者在锁着的大门附近。

e.en: The captain despised every {sculker} in battle.
e.zh: 队长鄙视战斗中每个躲躲藏藏的人。

e.en: The {scullion} scrubbed pots until midnight.
e.zh: 厨房杂役一直刷锅刷到午夜。

e.en: He was treated like a {scullion} by the nobles.
e.zh: 他被贵族们当作卑贱仆人对待。

e.en: The artist began to {sculp} a face in stone.
e.zh: 艺术家开始在石头上雕刻一张脸。

e.en: They would {sculp} initials into the old bench.
e.zh: 他们会把姓名首字母刻在那张旧长椅上。

e.en: The mountain had a {sculptine} outline at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时那座山呈现出雕塑般的轮廓。

e.en: Her poem praised the statue's {sculptine} grace.
e.zh: 她的诗赞美了那尊雕像雕刻似的优雅。

sculpturesque.t: 如雕塑般的；有雕塑美的

e.en: The dancer held a {sculpturesque} pose.
e.zh: 舞者保持着一个如雕塑般的姿势。

e.en: Morning light gave the ruins a {sculpturesque} beauty.
e.zh: 晨光赋予废墟一种雕塑般的美感。

e.en: She stood {sculpturesquely} beside the marble column.
e.zh: 她如雕塑般地站在大理石柱旁。

e.en: The cliffs rose {sculpturesquely} above the bay.
e.zh: 悬崖在海湾上方雕塑般地耸立。

e.en: Painters often {scumble} pale color over dark paint.
e.zh: 画家常在深色颜料上薄涂浅色来柔化色调。

e.en: She used a dry brush to {scumble} the clouds.
e.zh: 她用干画笔薄涂云朵，使其显得柔和。

scumbled.t: 薄涂过的；柔化了色调的

e.en: The sky was {scumbled} with thin gray paint.
e.zh: 天空被薄薄的灰色颜料柔化了色调。

e.en: His {scumbled} shadows made the portrait softer.
e.zh: 他薄涂处理过的阴影让肖像更柔和。

e.en: She {scumbles} white over blue for mist.
e.zh: 她在蓝色上薄涂白色来表现雾气。

e.en: The canvas shows several delicate {scumbles}.
e.zh: 这幅画布上可见几层细腻的薄涂层。

e.en: {Scumbling} can make harsh colors look softer.
e.zh: 薄涂技法能让刺眼的颜色显得柔和。

e.en: He was {scumbling} the edges of the portrait.
e.zh: 他正在薄涂处理肖像的边缘。

e.en: The worker cleaned the {scumboard} after each batch.
e.zh: 工人每处理完一批就清洁撇浮渣板。

e.en: A broken {scumboard} let grease enter the drain.
e.zh: 坏掉的除渣挡板让油脂流进了排水口。

e.en: The room was {scummily} lit and badly kept.
e.zh: 房间灯光昏暗肮脏，维护得很差。

e.en: He acted {scummily} toward people who trusted him.
e.zh: 他卑劣地对待那些信任他的人。

scuncheon.t: 门窗内侧斜面；窗洞侧壁

e.en: Dust gathered on the old window {scuncheon}.
e.zh: 灰尘积在旧窗洞的侧壁上。

e.en: The mason repaired the stone {scuncheon} by the door.
e.zh: 石匠修补了门边的石质内侧斜面。

scroteotomy.t: 阴囊切开术；阴囊切口手术例）

e.en: The surgeon performed a {scroteotomy} to drain the abscess.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了阴囊切开术，以引流脓肿。

e.en: A {scroteotomy} is rarely mentioned outside specialist medical texts.
e.zh: 阴囊切开术很少在专业医学文本之外被提到。

e.en: The doctor treated the patient's {scrotitis} with antibiotics.
e.zh: 医生用抗生素治疗了患者的阴囊炎。

e.en: Severe {scrotitis} can cause swelling and pain.
e.zh: 严重的阴囊炎会导致肿胀和疼痛。

e.en: The examination suggested a possible {scrotocele}.
e.zh: 检查结果提示可能有阴囊疝。

e.en: An untreated {scrotocele} may become uncomfortable over time.
e.zh: 未经治疗的阴囊疝久而久之可能会让人不适。

e.en: People began to {scrouge} toward the narrow exit.
e.zh: 人们开始朝狭窄的出口推挤过去。

e.en: The old dialect word {scrouge} means to crowd or jostle.
e.zh: 这个古老方言词scrouge的意思是拥挤或推搡。

e.en: He wore a {scroungy} coat to the meeting.
e.zh: 他穿着一件邋遢的外套去开会。

e.en: The kitchen looked {scroungy} after weeks of neglect.
e.zh: 厨房被忽视了几周后显得又脏又破。

scrub-up.t: 刷洗干净；术前洗手消毒

e.en: The nurses began their {scrub-up} before surgery.
e.zh: 护士们在手术前开始洗手消毒。

e.en: The old tiles need a thorough {scrub-up}.
e.zh: 这些旧瓷砖需要彻底刷洗一遍。

e.en: Choose {scrubbable} paint for the kitchen walls.
e.zh: 厨房墙面要选可刷洗的涂料。

e.en: The table has a {scrubbable} plastic surface.
e.zh: 这张桌子有一层耐擦洗的塑料表面。

scrubbiest.t: 最矮小杂乱的；最破旧的

e.en: We crossed the {scrubbiest} part of the field.
e.zh: 我们穿过了田里灌木最杂乱的一片地方。

e.en: He picked the {scrubbiest} towel from the pile.
e.zh: 他从那堆毛巾里挑了最破旧的一条。

e.en: She cleaned the shirt on a wooden {scrubboard}.
e.zh: 她在木制搓衣板上清洗那件衬衫。

e.en: The museum displayed an old {scrubboard} from the laundry room.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块洗衣房里的旧搓衣板。

e.en: The bathroom needs a full {scrubdown} this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末浴室需要彻底擦洗一遍。

e.en: After the muddy race, every bike got a {scrubdown}.
e.zh: 泥泞的比赛结束后，每辆自行车都被彻底清洗了一遍。

e.en: A tired {scrubwoman} worked late in the empty office.
e.zh: 一名疲惫的女清洁工在空荡的办公室里工作到很晚。

e.en: The novel follows a poor {scrubwoman} in the city.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位城市贫穷女清洁工的生活。

e.en: He arrived {scruffily} dressed for the interview.
e.zh: 他衣着邋遢地来参加面试。

e.en: The note was {scruffily} written on torn paper.
e.zh: 那张便条潦草地写在一张破纸上。

e.en: His {scruffiness} did not bother his friends.
e.zh: 他的邋遢并没有让朋友们介意。

e.en: The room's {scruffiness} made the landlord suspicious.
e.zh: 房间的不整洁让房东起了疑心。

e.en: The {scrum-half} passed quickly from the base of the scrum.
e.zh: 这名橄榄球传锋从争球底部迅速传球。

e.en: A good {scrum-half} controls the tempo of the match.
e.zh: 优秀的传锋能控制比赛节奏。

e.en: The {scrumhalf} shouted instructions to the forwards.
e.zh: 这名传锋向前锋们大声下达指令。

e.en: She became the team's first-choice {scrumhalf}.
e.zh: 她成了球队的首选传锋。

e.en: This cake is absolutely {scrummy}.
e.zh: 这块蛋糕真是美味极了。

e.en: We found a {scrummy} little cafe near the river.
e.zh: 我们在河边找到了一家很棒的小咖啡馆。

e.en: The boys used to {scrump} apples from the orchard.
e.zh: 那些男孩过去常从果园里偷摘苹果。

e.en: He was caught trying to {scrump} pears after school.
e.zh: 他放学后试图偷摘梨子时被抓住了。

e.en: She likes to {scrunch-dry} her curls after washing them.
e.zh: 她喜欢洗完头后用抓揉的方式吹干卷发。

e.en: Use a towel to {scrunch-dry} the hair gently.
e.zh: 用毛巾轻轻抓揉，把头发弄干。

e.en: She tied her hair with a blue {scrunchy}.
e.zh: 她用一个蓝色布发圈扎起头发。

e.en: The drawer was full of old {scrunchies}.
e.zh: 抽屉里装满了旧的松紧布发带。

scrupulist.t: 拘泥小节者；过分谨慎者

e.en: The {scrupulist} worried over every minor rule.
e.zh: 那个拘泥小节的人为每一条小规定担忧。

e.en: A moral {scrupulist} may fear harmless mistakes.
e.zh: 道德上过分谨慎的人可能会害怕无害的小错误。

scrupulosity.t: 过分谨慎；道德强迫倾向

e.en: His {scrupulosity} made simple choices exhausting.
e.zh: 他的过分谨慎让简单选择也变得令人疲惫。

e.en: Therapy helped her manage religious {scrupulosity}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她应对宗教方面的道德强迫倾向。

e.en: The {scrutator} checked each ballot carefully.
e.zh: 审查员仔细核对每一张选票。

e.en: As a sharp {scrutator}, she noticed the tiny error.
e.zh: 作为一名敏锐的观察者，她注意到了那个小错误。

e.en: The old sink was coated with {scunge}.
e.zh: 旧水槽上沾满了肮脏的污垢。

e.en: He wore a {scunge} jacket to rehearsal.
e.zh: 他穿着一件邋遢的夹克去排练。

e.en: We ordered {scungilli} with lemon and parsley.
e.zh: 我们点了配柠檬和欧芹的意式海螺肉。

e.en: The deli sells cold {scungilli} salad.
e.zh: 那家熟食店卖冷拌意式海螺沙拉。

e.en: They rented a {scungy} room above the bar.
e.zh: 他们租了酒吧楼上一间又脏又破的房间。

e.en: His {scungy} sneakers smelled of rain.
e.zh: 他那双邋遢的运动鞋有股雨水味。

scunner.t: 厌恶；令人厌烦的人或事

e.en: The endless delay gave her a real {scunner}.
e.zh: 没完没了的拖延让她真心厌烦。

e.en: That smug clerk is a proper {scunner}.
e.zh: 那个自鸣得意的店员真是个讨厌鬼。

e.en: The fishermen caught several {scup} near the rocks.
e.zh: 渔民在礁石附近捕到几条大西洋鲷鱼。

e.en: Grilled {scup} is popular along the coast.
e.zh: 烤大西洋鲷鱼在沿海一带很受欢迎。

e.en: He landed hard on his {scupseat}.
e.zh: 他重重地摔坐在屁股上。

e.en: Move your {scupseat} and help me lift this.
e.zh: 挪挪你的屁股，帮我把这个抬起来。

e.en: White {scurf} showed on his dark collar.
e.zh: 白色头皮屑落在他的深色衣领上。

e.en: The rash left dry {scurf} on her arm.
e.zh: 皮疹在她手臂上留下了干燥的皮屑。

e.en: The kitten had a {scurfy} patch behind one ear.
e.zh: 小猫一只耳朵后面有块起皮屑的地方。

e.en: A {scurfy} crust formed on the wound.
e.zh: 伤口上结了一层鳞屑状的痂。

e.en: The little {scurrier} vanished under the porch.
e.zh: 那个小小的飞跑者一下钻到门廊下面不见了。

e.en: He was a nervous {scurrier} in crowded offices.
e.zh: 在拥挤的办公室里，他总是紧张地匆匆跑来跑去。

e.en: The pamphlet contained {scurril} attacks on the judge.
e.zh: 那本小册子里有对法官的粗俗诽谤。

e.en: She dismissed the {scurril} joke without smiling.
e.zh: 她没有笑，直接无视了那个下流的笑话。

e.en: A {scurrile} rumor spread through the court.
e.zh: 一则粗俗的诽谤谣言在宫廷里传开。

e.en: The critic enjoyed {scurrile} insults more than argument.
e.zh: 那位评论家更爱粗鄙辱骂，而不是讲道理。

e.en: The debate collapsed into {scurrilities} and shouting.
e.zh: 辩论变成了粗俗辱骂和大声叫嚷。

e.en: His letters were full of petty {scurrilities}.
e.zh: 他的信里满是小气而下流的诽谤话。

e.en: The editor refused to print such {scurrility}.
e.zh: 编辑拒绝刊登这种粗俗诽谤。

e.en: Political {scurrility} filled the cheap newspapers.
e.zh: 廉价报纸上充斥着政治上的下流辱骂。

e.en: He treated his old friends {scurvily}.
e.zh: 他卑鄙地对待自己的老朋友。

e.en: The prisoners were {scurvily} fed and housed.
e.zh: 那些囚犯吃住都受到恶劣对待。

e.en: The captain condemned the crew's {scurviness}.
e.zh: 船长谴责船员们的卑劣行径。

e.en: The doctor noted signs of {scurviness} among the sailors.
e.zh: 医生注意到水手中出现了坏血病的迹象。

e.en: The beetle's {scuta} were examined under a lens.
e.zh: 研究人员用放大镜观察甲虫的盾片。

e.en: Turtle {scuta} can show patterns of growth.
e.zh: 龟的盾状鳞板能显示生长纹理。

e.en: The knight paid {scutage} instead of serving in war.
e.zh: 那名骑士缴纳盾牌钱，以代替参战服役。

e.en: Historians traced changes in medieval {scutage}.
e.zh: 历史学家追溯了中世纪免役税的变化。

e.en: The insect's {scutal} markings helped identify it.
e.zh: 昆虫盾片上的斑纹帮助人们识别它。

e.en: A {scutal} plate covered the small fossil.
e.zh: 一块盾状甲片覆盖着那件小化石。

e.en: The leaf has a {scutate} base.
e.zh: 这片叶子的基部呈盾形。

e.en: The lizard's back is {scutate} and rough.
e.zh: 这只蜥蜴的背部有盾状鳞片，摸起来粗糙。

e.en: Workers {scutch} flax before spinning the fibers.
e.zh: 工人在纺纤维前先打麻除杂。

e.en: The old {scutch} hung beside the loom.
e.zh: 那件旧打麻工具挂在织布机旁边。

e.en: The women {scutched} the flax by hand.
e.zh: 妇女们用手给亚麻打麻除杂。

e.en: Bundles of {scutched} hemp dried in the shed.
e.zh: 一捆捆除过杂的麻在棚子里晾干。

e.en: A lion decorated the family {scutcheon}.
e.zh: 家族纹章盾上装饰着一头狮子。

e.en: The keyhole had a brass {scutcheon}.
e.zh: 钥匙孔周围有一块黄铜盾形饰板。

e.en: The gate was {scutcheoned} with noble arms.
e.zh: 大门上饰有贵族纹章盾。

e.en: A {scutcheoned} coach waited outside the hall.
e.zh: 一辆饰有纹章盾的马车等在大厅外。

e.en: The {scutcher} cleaned flax for the village weavers.
e.zh: 打麻工为村里的织工清理亚麻。

e.en: A noisy {scutcher} stood in the mill.
e.zh: 磨坊里放着一台吵闹的打麻机。

e.en: The mill used {scutching} to clean the flax fibers.
e.zh: 这家工厂用打麻工序清理亚麻纤维。

e.en: After {scutching}, the stalks were ready for spinning.
e.zh: 打麻之后，茎秆就可以用来纺纱了。

e.en: A turtle's shell is covered with each tough {scute}.
e.zh: 乌龟的壳上覆盖着一片片坚硬的鳞甲。

e.en: The fossil showed a single bony {scute} near the tail.
e.zh: 化石显示尾部附近有一块骨质盾板。

e.en: The insect's back had several tiny {scutella}.
e.zh: 这只昆虫背上有几个细小的小盾片。

e.en: Botanists compared the seed {scutella} under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下比较种子的小盾片。

e.en: The beetle had a dark {scutellar} mark on its back.
e.zh: 这只甲虫背部的小盾片位置有一块深色斑纹。

e.en: Researchers measured the {scutellar} length of each specimen.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了每个标本的小盾片长度。

e.en: The lizard's {scutellate} skin looked like armor.
e.zh: 这只蜥蜴带鳞甲的皮肤看起来像盔甲。

e.en: A {scutellate} surface protected the seed from damage.
e.zh: 带小盾片的表面保护种子免受损伤。

e.en: The wasp's {scutellum} was bright yellow.
e.zh: 这只黄蜂的小盾片呈鲜黄色。

e.en: In grasses, the {scutellum} helps absorb nutrients for the embryo.
e.zh: 在禾本科植物中，小盾片帮助胚吸收养分。

e.en: The turtle's {scuti} formed a neat pattern.
e.zh: 乌龟的鳞甲排列成整齐的图案。

e.en: Several fossil {scuti} were found beside the skeleton.
e.zh: 骨架旁发现了几块化石盾板。

e.en: The old guide listed the limpet as a {scutibranch}.
e.zh: 那本旧指南把这种帽贝列为盾鳃类软体动物。

e.en: A {scutibranch} usually has gills protected by a shell.
e.zh: 盾鳃类软体动物的鳃通常受外壳保护。

e.en: The pendant had a {scutiform} outline.
e.zh: 这个吊坠有盾牌一样的轮廓。

e.en: A {scutiform} plate covered the insect's thorax.
e.zh: 一块盾形硬板覆盖着昆虫的胸部。

e.en: Interns often get stuck with the {scutwork}.
e.zh: 实习生常常被安排做那些乏味杂活。

e.en: She automated the {scutwork} so the team could focus on analysis.
e.zh: 她把苦差事自动化，让团队能专注于分析。

e.en: There was {scuzz} around the old sink.
e.zh: 旧水槽周围积着一层污垢。

e.en: He looked like total {scuzz} after sleeping in the station.
e.zh: 他在车站睡了一晚后显得邋遢极了。

e.en: Only a {scuzzball} would steal from his friends.
e.zh: 只有下流讨厌鬼才会偷朋友的东西。

e.en: He felt like a {scuzzball} after three days without a shower.
e.zh: 三天没洗澡后，他觉得自己邋遢得不行。

e.en: The tailor adjusted the {scye} for a better fit.
e.zh: 裁缝调整了袖窿，让衣服更合身。

e.en: A tight {scye} can make a jacket uncomfortable.
e.zh: 袖窿太紧会让夹克穿起来不舒服。

e.en: The lab detected {scyllitol} in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 实验室在组织样本中检测到了鲨肌醇。

e.en: Some researchers study {scyllitol} as a rare sugar alcohol.
e.zh: 一些研究人员把鲨肌醇作为稀有糖醇来研究。

e.en: The chemist isolated {scymnol} from shark bile.
e.zh: 化学家从鲨鱼胆汁中分离出鲨醇。

e.en: Old studies described {scymnol} as a bile alcohol.
e.zh: 早期研究把鲨醇描述为一种胆汁醇。

e.en: The archaeologist found a {scyphate} coin with a shallow curve.
e.zh: 考古学家发现了一枚略微弯曲的杯形钱币。

e.en: A {scyphate} flower held rainwater after the storm.
e.zh: 暴雨后，一朵杯形花里盛着雨水。

scyphi.t: 杯状结构复数；古杯复数

e.en: The manuscript described two silver {scyphi}.
e.zh: 手稿中描述了两只银制古杯。

e.en: Several lichen {scyphi} rose from the damp bark.
e.zh: 潮湿树皮上长出了几个地衣的杯状结构。

e.en: The fungus produced a {scyphiform} fruiting body.
e.zh: 这种真菌长出了杯状的子实体。

e.en: A {scyphiform} vessel was placed near the altar.
e.zh: 一只杯形器皿被放在祭坛旁。

e.en: The jellyfish begins as a tiny {scyphistoma}.
e.zh: 这种水母最初是一个很小的钵水母幼体。

e.en: A {scyphistoma} can produce young medusae by strobilation.
e.zh: 钵水母幼体能通过横裂产生幼小的水母体。

e.en: The tank contained dozens of {scyphistomae}.
e.zh: 水箱里有几十个钵水母幼体。

e.en: Scientists counted the {scyphistomae} before changing the water.
e.zh: 科学家换水前清点了这些钵水母幼体。

e.en: Several {scyphistomata} attached to the glass wall.
e.zh: 几个钵水母幼体附着在玻璃壁上。

e.en: The {scyphistomata} developed faster in warmer water.
e.zh: 这些钵水母幼体在较温暖的水中发育更快。

e.en: A moon jelly is a common {scyphozoan}.
e.zh: 海月水母是一种常见的钵水母纲动物。

e.en: The exhibit explained the {scyphozoan} life cycle.
e.zh: 展览讲解了钵水母纲动物的生命周期。

e.en: The museum displayed a bronze {scyphus}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一只青铜古代双耳杯。

e.en: Each lichen {scyphus} collected a drop of dew.
e.zh: 每个地衣杯状体里都积了一滴露水。

scytheman.t: 持镰割草者；用镰刀的人

e.en: The {scytheman} worked slowly across the field.
e.zh: 那个持镰割草者慢慢穿过田地劳作。

e.en: In the old tale, the {scytheman} appears at dusk.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里，持镰刀的人在黄昏出现。

scythemen.t: 持长柄镰刀的人；割草者

e.en: The {scythemen} moved slowly through the tall grass.
e.zh: 持长柄镰刀的人慢慢穿过高草地。

e.en: Medieval {scythemen} sometimes joined peasant armies.
e.zh: 中世纪的持镰农民有时会加入农民军。

sea-based.t: 以海上为基地的；海基的

e.en: The navy tested a {sea-based} missile system.
e.zh: 海军测试了一套海基导弹系统。

e.en: They invested in {sea-based} wind farms.
e.zh: 他们投资了海上风电场。

e.en: Cables run across the {sea-bed} between the islands.
e.zh: 电缆穿过岛屿之间的海床。

e.en: Divers found pottery on the {sea-bed}.
e.zh: 潜水员在海底发现了陶器。

e.en: A white {sea-bird} circled above the boat.
e.zh: 一只白色海鸟在船上方盘旋。

e.en: Oil spills can kill many {sea-birds}.
e.zh: 石油泄漏会导致许多海鸟死亡。

sea-born.t: 生于海上的；海中产生的

e.en: The old tale tells of a {sea-born} hero.
e.zh: 这个古老传说讲述了一位生于海上的英雄。

e.en: A {sea-born} mist covered the coast.
e.zh: 海上升起的雾笼罩了海岸。

e.en: The city depended on {sea-borne} trade.
e.zh: 这座城市依赖海运贸易。

e.en: Doctors tracked a {sea-borne} infection among sailors.
e.zh: 医生追踪了一种在水手间经海上传播的感染。

e.en: The election caused a {sea-change} in public policy.
e.zh: 这次选举引发了公共政策的巨大转变。

e.en: Her illness brought a {sea-change} in his attitude.
e.zh: 她的病让他的态度发生了彻底变化。

e.en: The sailor kept letters in his {sea-chest}.
e.zh: 那名水手把信件放在自己的水手衣物箱里。

e.en: Engineers inspected the ship's {sea-chest} for blockage.
e.zh: 工程师检查船上的海水箱是否堵塞。

e.en: Waves crashed below the high {sea-cliff}.
e.zh: 海浪撞击着高高海崖下方的岩石。

e.en: The path follows the {sea-cliff} for miles.
e.zh: 这条小路沿着临海峭壁延伸数英里。

e.en: They built a cottage near the {sea-coast}.
e.zh: 他们在海岸附近建了一座小屋。

e.en: Storms often hit the eastern {sea-coast}.
e.zh: 暴风雨常常袭击东部沿海地区。

e.en: The {sea-cook} prepared soup for the crew.
e.zh: 船上厨师为船员准备了汤。

e.en: In the novel, the {sea-cook} hides his past.
e.zh: 在这部小说中，船上厨师隐瞒了自己的过去。

e.en: A {sea-cucumber} lay on the sandy bottom.
e.zh: 一只海参躺在沙质海底。

e.en: Dried {sea-cucumber} is used in many banquet dishes.
e.zh: 干海参常用于许多宴席菜肴。

e.en: He requested {sea-duty} after two years ashore.
e.zh: 在岸上待了两年后，他申请海上服役。

e.en: Long {sea-duty} can be hard on families.
e.zh: 长期舰上勤务会给家庭带来很大压力。

e.en: The diver pried a {sea-ear} from the rock.
e.zh: 潜水员从岩石上撬下一只鲍鱼。

e.en: A {sea-ear} shell shone with pearly colors.
e.zh: 鲍鱼壳闪着珍珠般的色泽。

e.en: Every {sea-farer} knew the danger of that reef.
e.zh: 每个航海者都知道那片礁石的危险。

e.en: The poem praises the lonely {sea-farer}.
e.zh: 这首诗赞美孤独的海员。

e.en: Scientists mapped the {sea-floor} with sonar.
e.zh: 科学家用声呐绘制海底地图。

e.en: Strange vents rise from the deep {sea-floor}.
e.zh: 奇特的喷口从深海海床上升起。

e.en: White {sea-foam} covered the black rocks.
e.zh: 白色海沫覆盖着黑色岩石。

e.en: Her dress was the color of {sea-foam}.
e.zh: 她的裙子是海沫般的颜色。

e.en: The sailors prayed to the {sea-god}.
e.zh: 水手们向海神祈祷。

e.en: A statue of the {sea-god} stood by the harbor.
e.zh: 港口旁立着一尊海神雕像。

e.en: The islanders worshipped a {sea-goddess}.
e.zh: 岛民崇拜一位海女神。

e.en: The painting shows a {sea-goddess} rising from waves.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘一位海女神从海浪中升起。

e.en: She wore a {sea-green} scarf.
e.zh: 她戴着一条海绿色围巾。

e.en: The bathroom tiles were pale {sea-green}.
e.zh: 浴室瓷砖是淡淡的海绿色。

e.en: A {sea-gull} stole chips from my plate.
e.zh: 一只海鸥从我的盘子里叼走了薯条。

e.en: We heard the {sea-gull} cry above the pier.
e.zh: 我们听见海鸥在码头上方鸣叫。

e.en: Pirates threatened a busy {sea-lane}.
e.zh: 海盗威胁了一条繁忙的海上航道。

e.en: The treaty protects important {sea-lanes}.
e.zh: 该条约保护重要的海运通道。

e.en: It took me a day to find my {sea-leg}.
e.zh: 我花了一天才适应船上的颠簸。

e.en: New sailors often lack a steady {sea-leg}.
e.zh: 新水手常常还没有稳稳适应海上颠簸的能力。

e.en: The old port once used a {seatrain} to move freight across the bay.
e.zh: 这座老港口曾用海上列车渡船把货物运过海湾。

e.en: A {seatrain} carried loaded railcars between the islands.
e.zh: 一艘海上列车渡船在岛屿之间运送满载的铁路货车。

e.en: She found a purple {seaurchin} in the tide pool.
e.zh: 她在潮池里发现了一只紫色海胆。

e.en: The chef served fresh {seaurchin} with rice.
e.zh: 厨师把新鲜海胆配米饭端了上来。

e.en: The course made young sailors more {seaware} before their first voyage.
e.zh: 这门课程让年轻水手在首次航行前更有海洋意识。

e.en: A {seaware} captain reads the weather before leaving harbor.
e.zh: 懂航海的船长会在离港前判断天气。

e.en: The {seawise} fisherman refused to sail into that wind.
e.zh: 那位熟悉海况的渔民拒绝迎着那种风出海。

e.en: Her advice sounded plain but deeply {seawise}.
e.zh: 她的建议听起来朴素，却很有航海经验。

e.en: The polymer sample contained a flexible {sebacate} compound.
e.zh: 这个聚合物样品含有一种柔性的癸二酸酯化合物。

e.en: Engineers selected dioctyl {sebacate} for low-temperature performance.
e.zh: 工程师选择癸二酸二辛酯来改善低温性能。

e.en: The lab ordered {sebacic} acid for the synthesis.
e.zh: 实验室订购了癸二酸用于合成。

e.en: A {sebacic} derivative improved the plasticizer's stability.
e.zh: 一种癸二酸衍生物提高了增塑剂的稳定性。

sebastomania.t: 对圣塞巴斯蒂安的狂热崇拜

e.en: The historian described a wave of {sebastomania} in the old city.
e.zh: 历史学家描述了这座老城一阵对圣塞巴斯蒂安的狂热崇拜。

e.en: His essay treats {sebastomania} as a curious religious fashion.
e.zh: 他的文章把对圣塞巴斯蒂安的狂热视为一种奇特的宗教风尚。

e.en: The manufacturer used a {sebate} to soften the resin.
e.zh: 制造商使用一种癸二酸酯来软化树脂。

e.en: This {sebate} remains stable at low temperatures.
e.zh: 这种癸二酸酯在低温下仍保持稳定。

e.en: After the rain, the {sebcha} shone white under the sun.
e.zh: 雨后，那片盐沼在阳光下泛着白光。

e.en: Camels crossed the dry {sebcha} before noon.
e.zh: 骆驼在中午前穿过了干涸的盐湖地。

e.en: The apothecary kept dried {sebesten} in a small jar.
e.zh: 药剂师把干塞贝斯坦果装在一个小罐里。

e.en: Old medical recipes sometimes mention {sebesten} as a soothing fruit.
e.zh: 古老药方有时把塞贝斯坦果列为一种润缓的果实。

e.en: The dermatologist avoided any {sebiagogic} ingredient in the lotion.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生避免在乳液中使用任何促皮脂分泌成分。

e.en: A {sebiagogic} drug may worsen oily skin.
e.zh: 促皮脂分泌的药物可能会加重油性皮肤。

e.en: The doctor examined the {sebiferous} glands near the rash.
e.zh: 医生检查了皮疹附近产生皮脂的腺体。

e.en: Some plants have {sebiferous} seeds rich in oil.
e.zh: 有些植物的种子含脂，油分很丰富。

e.en: The caravan skirted the edge of the {sebkha}.
e.zh: 商队沿着那片盐沼的边缘绕行。

e.en: Crystals formed across the dry {sebkha} after evaporation.
e.zh: 水分蒸发后，干盐湖表面形成了结晶。

e.en: The cream helped reduce her {seborrhoeic} dermatitis.
e.zh: 这种乳膏帮助减轻了她的脂溢性皮炎。

e.en: A {seborrhoeic} scalp can feel itchy and greasy.
e.zh: 脂溢性头皮可能会又痒又油。

e.en: The paper discussed {sebotrophic} changes in aging skin.
e.zh: 论文讨论了老化皮肤中影响皮脂营养的变化。

e.en: Researchers tested the {sebotrophic} effect of the new treatment.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了这种新疗法对皮脂营养的影响。

e.en: Draw a {secant} through the circle at two points.
e.zh: 画一条割线，让它与圆相交于两点。

e.en: In trigonometry, {secant} is the reciprocal of cosine.
e.zh: 在三角学中，正割是余弦的倒数。

e.en: The {seacopter} landed beside the rescue vessel.
e.zh: 那架海上直升机降落在救援船旁。

e.en: Engineers tested a new {seacopter} for offshore patrols.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一种用于近海巡逻的新型海上直升机。

e.en: Small {seacraft} must avoid the shipping lane.
e.zh: 小型海船必须避开航道。

e.en: The navy inspected several unmanned {seacraft}.
e.zh: 海军检查了几艘无人海上航行器。

e.en: The old {seadog} knew every current in the bay.
e.zh: 那位老水手熟悉海湾里的每一道洋流。

e.en: A playful {seadog} followed the boat for miles.
e.zh: 一只顽皮的海豹跟着船游了好几英里。

e.en: The island's {seadrome} closed during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间，岛上的水上飞机场关闭了。

e.en: Pilots used the sheltered bay as a temporary {seadrome}.
e.zh: 飞行员把这个避风海湾当作临时水上飞机场。

e.en: Divers photographed a bright {seaflower} on the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员拍到礁石上一朵色彩鲜艳的海花。

e.en: The poem compares foam to a pale {seaflower}.
e.zh: 这首诗把海沫比作一朵浅色的海花。

e.en: The {seafolk} repaired their nets before dawn.
e.zh: 海边居民在黎明前修补渔网。

e.en: Legends say the {seafolk} could read the winds.
e.zh: 传说海上人家能看懂风向。

e.en: A lone {seafowl} circled above the harbor.
e.zh: 一只孤单的海鸟在港口上空盘旋。

e.en: The cliffs are nesting grounds for {seafowl}.
e.zh: 这些悬崖是海鸟筑巢的地方。

e.en: Several {seafowls} skimmed the grey waves.
e.zh: 几只海鸟掠过灰色的海浪。

e.en: Local laws protect migratory {seafowls} each spring.
e.zh: 当地法律每年春天保护迁徙的海鸟。

e.en: The fisherman mistook the {seafox} for a shark.
e.zh: 渔夫把那条长尾鲨误认成普通鲨鱼。

e.en: Everyone called the smuggler a {seafox}.
e.zh: 大家都把那个走私者称作狡猾的海上老手。

e.en: They settled on a {seagirt} island.
e.zh: 他们定居在一座四面环海的小岛上。

e.en: The anthem praises a {seagirt} homeland.
e.zh: 那首颂歌赞美一个四面环海的祖国。

e.en: Workers raised the platform with a hydraulic {seajack}.
e.zh: 工人用液压海上千斤顶升起平台。

e.en: The angler caught a small {seajack} near the pier.
e.zh: 钓鱼人在码头附近钓到一条小海鲹。

e.en: The rough crossing made him {seak}.
e.zh: 颠簸的渡海让他晕船了。

e.en: She felt {seak} before the boat left harbor.
e.zh: 船还没离港，她就已经觉得晕船。

e.en: They served steamed {seakale} with butter.
e.zh: 他们端上了配黄油的蒸海甘蓝。

e.en: Wild {seakale} grows along shingle beaches.
e.zh: 野生海甘蓝生长在砾石海滩一带。

e.en: The yacht has excellent {seakeeping} in heavy weather.
e.zh: 这艘游艇在恶劣天气下耐波性很好。

e.en: Designers improved the hull's {seakeeping}.
e.zh: 设计师改进了船体的耐波性能。

e.en: The captain praised the boat's {seakindly} motion.
e.zh: 船长称赞这艘船航行时平稳适航。

e.en: A {seakindly} hull makes long voyages less tiring.
e.zh: 适航平稳的船体能让长途航行不那么疲惫。

e.en: The lab measured the package's {sealability}.
e.zh: 实验室测量了包装的可密封性。

e.en: Heat and pressure affect the film's {sealability}.
e.zh: 温度和压力会影响薄膜的封合性能。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the cracked {sealed-beam} headlight.
e.zh: 技师更换了破裂的封闭式前照灯。

e.en: Older cars often used {sealed-beam} lamps.
e.zh: 老式汽车常使用封闭式车灯。

e.en: The remote {sealery} was protected by law.
e.zh: 那处偏远的海豹栖息地受到法律保护。

e.en: Hunters once visited the {sealery} each winter.
e.zh: 猎人过去每年冬天都会去那个猎海豹场。

e.en: The herbalist pointed out a rare {sealflower}.
e.zh: 草药师指出了一种罕见的海豹花。

e.en: Old field guides list {sealflower} under coastal plants.
e.zh: 旧版野外指南把海豹花列在海岸植物中。

e.en: The police began {sealing-off} the station entrance.
e.zh: 警方开始封锁车站入口。

e.en: Careful {sealing-off} prevented dust from spreading.
e.zh: 仔细的隔离封闭防止了灰尘扩散。

e.en: She closed the letter with red {sealing-wax}.
e.zh: 她用红色封蜡封好了信。

e.en: The old document still smelled of {sealing-wax}.
e.zh: 那份旧文件仍有火漆的气味。

e.en: The monk dried {sealwort} for medicine.
e.zh: 修士把黄精属草药晒干入药。

e.en: In old herbals, {sealwort} was linked with healing wounds.
e.zh: 在古老草药书中，印草被认为有助于疗伤。

sea-level.t: 海平面高度；海拔零点以上高度

e.en: The village is only two meters above {sea-level}.
e.zh: 这个村庄只比海平面高两米。

e.en: Rising {sea-level} threatens many coastal cities.
e.zh: 不断上升的海平面威胁着许多沿海城市。

e.en: The old sailor claimed he had seen a {sea-maid}.
e.zh: 那位老水手声称自己见过美人鱼。

e.en: A {sea-maid} sang beneath the moon in the tale.
e.zh: 故事里，一位海中仙女在月下歌唱。

e.en: The poem describes a lonely {sea-maiden} on the rocks.
e.zh: 这首诗描写岩石上一位孤独的海中少女。

e.en: Children listened to legends of a beautiful {sea-maiden}.
e.zh: 孩子们听着关于一位美丽美人鱼的传说。

sea-monster.t: 海怪；传说中的海中巨兽

e.en: The sailors feared a {sea-monster} beneath the waves.
e.zh: 水手们害怕海浪下面藏着海怪。

e.en: The movie turns the whale into a terrifying {sea-monster}.
e.zh: 这部电影把鲸鱼塑造成可怕的海中巨兽。

e.en: A {sea-nymph} appears in the ancient myth.
e.zh: 古代神话中出现了一位海中仙女。

e.en: The statue shows a {sea-nymph} holding a shell.
e.zh: 这座雕像表现的是一位手持贝壳的海仙女。

e.en: We found a dried {sea-purse} on the beach.
e.zh: 我们在海滩上发现了一个干掉的鲨鱼卵囊。

e.en: A {sea-purse} can look like a small black pouch.
e.zh: 鲨鱼或鳐鱼的卵囊看起来像个小黑袋子。

e.en: The warning sign mentioned a dangerous {sea-puss}.
e.zh: 警示牌提到这里有危险的离岸流。

e.en: Swimmers were pulled sideways by the strong {sea-puss}.
e.zh: 游泳者被强劲的海岸急流横向拖走。

e.en: The new {sea-route} shortened the trip by two days.
e.zh: 新的海上航线把行程缩短了两天。

e.en: Traders used this {sea-route} for centuries.
e.zh: 商人们沿用这条海路已有数百年。

e.en: Sprinkle a little {sea-salt} over the tomatoes.
e.zh: 在番茄上撒一点海盐。

e.en: This soap contains minerals from natural {sea-salt}.
e.zh: 这款肥皂含有天然海盐中的矿物质。

e.en: They walked along the {sea-shore} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们沿着海岸散步。

e.en: Small shells covered the sandy {sea-shore}.
e.zh: 沙质海滨上铺满了小贝壳。

e.en: I felt {sea-sick} during the rough crossing.
e.zh: 海上颠簸横渡时我感到晕船。

e.en: She gets {sea-sick} even on short boat trips.
e.zh: 即使坐很短的船，她也会晕船。

e.en: A {sea-snake} swam near the coral reef.
e.zh: 一条海蛇在珊瑚礁附近游动。

e.en: Some species of {sea-snake} are highly venomous.
e.zh: 有些种类的海蛇毒性很强。

e.en: The diver pointed out a bright orange {sea-squirt}.
e.zh: 潜水员指给我们看一只亮橙色的海鞘。

e.en: A {sea-squirt} filters tiny particles from seawater.
e.zh: 海鞘会从海水中过滤微小颗粒。

e.en: A tall {sea-stack} stood beyond the cliff.
e.zh: 悬崖外矗立着一座高高的海蚀柱。

e.en: Waves slowly separated the {sea-stack} from the coast.
e.zh: 海浪慢慢把这根岩柱与海岸分离开来。

e.en: The town built a {sea-wall} after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后，小镇修建了一道海堤。

e.en: Waves crashed against the old {sea-wall}.
e.zh: 海浪猛烈拍打着那道旧防波墙。

e.en: A cool {sea-wind} blew through the open window.
e.zh: 一阵凉爽的海风吹进敞开的窗户。

e.en: The flags snapped sharply in the strong {sea-wind}.
e.zh: 旗帜在强劲的海风中啪啪作响。

sea-worn.t: 受海水侵蚀的；海浪磨损的

e.en: We collected smooth, {sea-worn} stones from the shore.
e.zh: 我们从海岸捡了些被海浪磨得光滑的石头。

e.en: The cottage had a {sea-worn} door and faded paint.
e.zh: 那间小屋的门受海风海水侵蚀，油漆也褪色了。

e.en: The restaurant serves grilled {seabass} with lemon.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应配柠檬的烤海鲈鱼。

e.en: Fresh {seabass} is popular in Mediterranean cooking.
e.zh: 新鲜海鲈鱼在地中海菜里很受欢迎。

e.en: The children built castles on the wide {seabeach}.
e.zh: 孩子们在宽阔的海滨沙滩上堆城堡。

e.en: Storm debris was scattered across the {seabeach}.
e.zh: 风暴留下的杂物散落在海滩各处。

e.en: The {Seabees} built roads and airstrips during the war.
e.zh: 战争期间，美国海军工程兵修建道路和简易机场。

e.en: He served with the {Seabees} after joining the navy.
e.zh: 他加入海军后在海军工程兵部队服役。

e.en: The jam is made from tart orange {seaberry}.
e.zh: 这种果酱是用酸酸的橙色沙棘果做成的。

e.en: A hardy {seaberry} shrub grew near the dunes.
e.zh: 一株耐寒的沙棘灌木长在沙丘附近。

e.en: The sailors ate {seabiscuit} when fresh bread ran out.
e.zh: 新鲜面包吃完后，水手们就吃船上硬饼干。

e.en: Old {seabiscuit} was hard enough to crack a tooth.
e.zh: 陈旧的船用硬饼干硬得能把牙咬崩。

e.en: {Seaborgium} is a synthetic element with atomic number 106.
e.zh: 𬭳是一种原子序数为106的人工合成元素。

e.en: Scientists create {seaborgium} in particle accelerators.
e.zh: 科学家在粒子加速器中制造𬭳元素。

e.en: The mechanic closed the {seacock} before repairing the hose.
e.zh: 机械师在修理软管前关闭了船底通海阀。

e.en: A leaking {seacock} can quickly flood a small boat.
e.zh: 漏水的海水阀可能很快淹没一艘小船。

e.en: His {seamanlike} handling of the boat impressed the crew.
e.zh: 他熟练而像水手般操船，让船员们很佩服。

e.en: The ropes were coiled in a neat, {seamanlike} way.
e.zh: 绳索被整齐地盘好，很有水手作风。

e.en: The lighthouse served as a {seamark} for ships near the coast.
e.zh: 那座灯塔是近岸船只的航标。

e.en: Old charts showed a rocky {seamark} at the harbor entrance.
e.zh: 旧海图标出了港口入口处的一处岩石海标。

e.en: The report exposed the {seamiest} corners of the industry.
e.zh: 这份报告揭露了该行业最丑恶的角落。

e.en: He grew up in the {seamiest} part of town.
e.zh: 他在城里最混乱肮脏的地区长大。

e.en: The {seamost} houses took the full force of the storm.
e.zh: 最靠海的房屋承受了风暴的全部冲击。

e.en: They stood on the {seamost} edge of the cliff.
e.zh: 他们站在悬崖最临海的边缘。

e.en: The old {seamster} repaired coats for the whole village.
e.zh: 那位老裁缝为全村人修补外套。

e.en: A skilled {seamster} can make a suit fit perfectly.
e.zh: 手艺好的缝纫工能把西装做得十分合身。

e.en: She learned {seamstering} from her grandmother as a child.
e.zh: 她小时候跟祖母学会了缝纫。

e.en: His careful {seamstering} made the costume look expensive.
e.zh: 他细致的裁缝活让这套服装显得很昂贵。

e.en: The factory uses {seamwelding} to seal metal tanks.
e.zh: 工厂用缝焊来密封金属罐。

e.en: Good {seamwelding} prevents leaks along the joint.
e.zh: 良好的接缝焊接能防止接头处漏水。

e.en: The map marked a hidden {seapeak} beneath the waves.
e.zh: 地图标出了一座隐藏在浪下的海底山峰。

e.en: Divers found coral growing around the {seapeak}.
e.zh: 潜水员发现珊瑚围着那座海中峰生长。

e.en: The gallery displayed a dramatic {seapiece} by Turner.
e.zh: 画廊展出了一幅特纳创作的壮阔海景画。

e.en: She painted a quiet {seapiece} after visiting the coast.
e.zh: 她游览海岸后画了一幅宁静的海景作品。

e.en: A powerful {seaquake} shook the seabed before the tsunami.
e.zh: 海啸发生前，一场强烈海震震动了海床。

e.en: The instruments detected a small {seaquake} offshore.
e.zh: 仪器探测到近海发生了一次小规模海底地震。

e.en: The children watched dolphins at the {seaquarium}.
e.zh: 孩子们在大型海洋水族馆观看海豚。

e.en: A new {seaquarium} opened near the waterfront.
e.zh: 滨水区附近开了一家新的海洋水族馆。

e.en: A {search-light} swept across the dark harbor.
e.zh: 一束探照灯扫过黑暗的港口。

e.en: The guards aimed the {search-light} at the fence.
e.zh: 警卫把搜索灯照向围栏。

e.en: A {search-party} entered the forest at dawn.
e.zh: 一支搜救队在黎明时进入森林。

e.en: The village formed a {search-party} for the missing child.
e.zh: 村里组织了一支搜索队寻找失踪的孩子。

e.en: The poet called the heart a {searchless} mystery.
e.zh: 诗人把人心称作无法探究的谜。

e.en: Much of the old archive remained {searchless} and forgotten.
e.zh: 那批旧档案大多仍未被搜寻，渐渐被遗忘。

e.en: The surgeon heated a {searing-iron} to close the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生加热烙铁来封住伤口。

e.en: A rancher once marked cattle with a {searing-iron}.
e.zh: 牧场主过去会用烧灼铁器给牛做标记。

e.en: The fisherman caught a small {searobin} near the pier.
e.zh: 渔夫在码头附近钓到一条小海鲂鱼。

e.en: A {searobin} uses its fin rays to feel the seabed.
e.zh: 海知更鱼会用鳍条感触海底。

e.en: The rain arrived {seasonably} after weeks of dry weather.
e.zh: 干旱数周后，这场雨来得正合时宜。

e.en: She dressed {seasonably} for the cold autumn morning.
e.zh: 她为寒冷的秋晨穿得很合季节。

e.en: A bright orange {seastar} clung to the rock.
e.zh: 一只亮橙色的海星附在岩石上。

e.en: The aquarium keeps each {seastar} in a shallow tank.
e.zh: 水族馆把每只海星养在浅水缸里。

e.en: They walked along the quiet {seastrand} at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时，他们沿着安静的海滨散步。

e.en: Shells and driftwood covered the {seastrand} after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后，海岸滩地上满是贝壳和浮木。

e.en: Please fasten your {seat-belts} before the car starts.
e.zh: 汽车启动前请系好安全带。

e.en: The law requires {seat-belts} for every passenger.
e.zh: 法律要求每位乘客都必须系安全带。

e.en: It was a {seat-of-the-pants} decision made under pressure.
e.zh: 那是在压力下凭直觉作出的决定。

e.en: Their {seat-of-the-pants} flying saved the damaged plane.
e.zh: 他们临场摸索式的飞行操作救下了受损飞机。

e.en: The waiter recommended a chilled {secco} with seafood.
e.zh: 服务员推荐用冰镇半干型葡萄酒配海鲜。

e.en: The church wall was painted in {secco}, not true fresco.
e.zh: 教堂墙面用的是干壁画技法，不是真正的湿壁画。

e.en: The scholar tried to {secern} fact from legend.
e.zh: 那位学者试图把事实同传说分辨开来。

e.en: Certain glands {secern} fluids into the digestive tract.
e.zh: 某些腺体会向消化道分泌液体。

e.en: The judge {secerned} the relevant evidence from rumor.
e.zh: 法官把相关证据从流言中分辨出来。

e.en: The substance was {secerned} by tiny cells in the tissue.
e.zh: 这种物质是由组织中的微小细胞分泌出来的。

e.en: The doctor studied the organ's {secernent} tissue.
e.zh: 医生研究了该器官具有分泌功能的组织。

e.en: His {secernent} judgment separated style from substance.
e.zh: 他敏锐的判断把形式和实质区分开来。

e.en: She was {secerning} truth from theatrical exaggeration.
e.zh: 她正在把真相从戏剧化的夸张中分辨出来。

e.en: The membrane is {secerning} a protective layer of fluid.
e.zh: 这层膜正在分泌一层保护性液体。

e.en: Good editing requires the {secernment} of signal from noise.
e.zh: 好的编辑需要从杂音中分辨出有价值的信息。

e.en: The paper describes the {secernment} of enzymes by the gland.
e.zh: 论文描述了腺体分泌酶的过程。

e.en: A careful reader {secerns} irony beneath the praise.
e.zh: 细心的读者能从赞美之下分辨出讽刺意味。

e.en: The gland {secerns} a bitter fluid when stimulated.
e.zh: 这种腺体受到刺激时会分泌苦味液体。

e.en: Regional {secessionism} grew after years of political neglect.
e.zh: 多年政治忽视之后，地区分离主义逐渐壮大。

e.en: The historian traced {secessionism} to economic grievances.
e.zh: 历史学家把脱离运动的根源追溯到经济不满。

e.en: He chose a {seclusive} life in the hills.
e.zh: 他选择在山中隐居的生活。

e.en: The monastery had a {seclusive} rule for new members.
e.zh: 修道院对新成员有一条隔离式的规定。

e.en: She lived {seclusively} after the scandal faded.
e.zh: 丑闻平息后，她过着隐居生活。

e.en: The patients were housed {seclusively} during treatment.
e.zh: 治疗期间，病人被隔离安置。

e.en: His {seclusiveness} made neighbors curious about him.
e.zh: 他的隐居性格让邻居们对他很好奇。

e.en: The island's {seclusiveness} protected its old customs.
e.zh: 这座岛的隔绝状态保护了当地古老习俗。

e.en: The lab detected {secobarbital} in the blood sample.
e.zh: 实验室在血样中检出了司可巴比妥。

e.en: Doctors rarely prescribe {secobarbital} for insomnia now.
e.zh: 如今医生很少开司可巴比妥来治疗失眠。

e.en: The chemist synthesized a new {secocubane} derivative.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种新的开环立方烷衍生物。

e.en: A {secocubane} framework can rearrange under heat.
e.zh: 开环立方烷骨架在受热时可能发生重排。

e.en: The old textbook defined a {secohm} in electrical terms.
e.zh: 那本旧教材用电学术语定义了秒欧姆。

e.en: Few modern engineers ever use the {secohm}.
e.zh: 现代工程师几乎不会再使用秒欧姆这个单位。

e.en: Flaxseed contains {secoisolarciresinol} and related lignans.
e.zh: 亚麻籽含有开环异落叶松树脂酚及相关木脂素。

e.en: Researchers measured {secoisolarciresinol} in the supplement.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了该补充剂中的开环异落叶松树脂酚含量。

e.en: We accepted the {second-best} option because time was short.
e.zh: 因为时间紧，我们接受了次优方案。

e.en: She hates feeling like someone's {second-best} choice.
e.zh: 她讨厌觉得自己只是别人第二好的选择。

e.en: Their {second-born} son became a musician.
e.zh: 他们第二个出生的儿子成了一名音乐家。

e.en: As the {second-born}, she inherited fewer family duties.
e.zh: 作为第二个出生的孩子，她承担的家庭责任较少。

e.en: They bought {second-class} train tickets to save money.
e.zh: 他们买了二等火车票来省钱。

e.en: No citizen should be treated as {second-class}.
e.zh: 任何公民都不应被当作低人一等来对待。

e.en: He suffered {second-degree} burns on his arm.
e.zh: 他的手臂遭受了二度烧伤。

e.en: The suspect was charged with {second-degree} murder.
e.zh: 嫌疑人被控二级谋杀。

e.en: My {second-grade} teacher loved science projects.
e.zh: 我二年级的老师很喜欢科学项目。

e.en: The factory rejected the {second-grade} materials.
e.zh: 工厂拒收了这些二等材料。

e.en: Don't {second-guess} every decision you make.
e.zh: 别对自己做的每个决定都事后怀疑。

e.en: Analysts tried to {second-guess} the minister's next move.
e.zh: 分析人士试图猜测部长下一步会怎么做。

e.en: She {second-guessed} her answer after leaving the exam room.
e.zh: 她离开考场后又怀疑起自己的答案。

e.en: The market had already {second-guessed} the bank's announcement.
e.zh: 市场已经提前猜到了银行的公告内容。

e.en: He always {second-guesses} himself before sending emails.
e.zh: 他发邮件前总是反复怀疑自己。

e.en: The press {second-guesses} every hint from the campaign team.
e.zh: 媒体会猜测竞选团队放出的每一个暗示。

e.en: Constant {second-guessing} made the team move too slowly.
e.zh: 不断的事后怀疑让团队行动得太慢。

e.en: There is no point {second-guessing} the referee now.
e.zh: 现在再去质疑裁判已经没有意义。

e.en: The team scored twice in the {second-half}.
e.zh: 球队在下半场进了两个球。

e.en: The novel improves in the {second-half}.
e.zh: 这本小说到后半部分变得更好看。

e.en: They bought a {second-home} near the coast.
e.zh: 他们在海边买了一处第二居所。

e.en: This little cafe became her {second-home}.
e.zh: 这家小咖啡馆成了她常待的地方。

e.en: The captain's {second-in-command} handled the briefing.
e.zh: 船长的副手主持了情况说明会。

e.en: She became {second-in-command} after the director resigned.
e.zh: 主任辞职后，她成了二把手。

e.en: The generals met with their {second-in-commands}.
e.zh: 将军们会见了各自的副手。

e.en: Good {second-in-commands} keep teams steady during crises.
e.zh: 优秀的二把手能在危机中稳住团队。

e.en: They called in {second-line} support for the server issue.
e.zh: 他们为服务器问题请来了二线支持。

e.en: A {second-line} defense waited behind the hill.
e.zh: 山后还部署着第二道防线。

e.en: The hotel looked expensive but felt {second-rate}.
e.zh: 这家酒店看着昂贵，却让人觉得很二流。

e.en: She refused to accept a {second-rate} solution.
e.zh: 她拒绝接受一个质量低劣的方案。

e.en: The film's {second-rateness} showed in every scene.
e.zh: 这部电影每一幕都显出二流品质。

e.en: He hated the quiet {second-rateness} of the old office.
e.zh: 他讨厌那间旧办公室隐隐透出的低劣感。

e.en: Critics dismissed him as a {second-rater}.
e.zh: 评论家把他贬为二流人物。

e.en: The club stopped hiring {second-rater} coaches.
e.zh: 俱乐部不再聘用蹩脚教练。

e.en: The {second-seeded} player won in straight sets.
e.zh: 二号种子选手直落两盘获胜。

e.en: They upset the {second-seeded} team in the semifinal.
e.zh: 他们在半决赛中爆冷击败了二号种子队。

e.en: The villagers believed the old woman was {second-sighted}.
e.zh: 村民们相信那位老妇人有预知能力。

e.en: His almost {second-sighted} warnings later proved accurate.
e.zh: 他近乎有预见力的警告后来被证明很准确。

e.en: The journalist confirmed the claim with a {second-source}.
e.zh: 记者用第二个消息来源核实了这一说法。

e.en: We need a {second-source} for this critical component.
e.zh: 这个关键部件我们需要一个替代供应商。

e.en: Her bedroom is on the {second-story}.
e.zh: 她的卧室在二楼。

e.en: A {second-story} window was left open.
e.zh: 二楼的一扇窗户没有关。

second-strike.t: 第二次核打击；反击能力

e.en: The treaty limited {second-strike} nuclear forces.
e.zh: 该条约限制了第二次核打击力量。

e.en: A credible {second-strike} capability can deter attack.
e.zh: 可信的核反击能力可以阻止攻击。

e.en: The coach started the {second-string} quarterback.
e.zh: 教练派上了替补四分卫首发。

e.en: They assigned the project to a {second-string} team.
e.zh: 他们把这个项目交给了一支二线团队。

e.en: A {second-stringer} scored the winning goal.
e.zh: 一名替补队员打进了制胜球。

e.en: He felt like a {second-stringer} at the firm.
e.zh: 他觉得自己在公司里像个二线人员。

e.en: As a {second-timer}, she knew what to expect.
e.zh: 作为第二次经历的人，她知道会发生什么。

e.en: The program welcomes both beginners and {second-timer} applicants.
e.zh: 这个项目欢迎新手，也欢迎第二次申请的人。

e.en: The report stressed the {secondariness} of short-term profits.
e.zh: 报告强调短期利润只是次要因素。

e.en: Her role's {secondariness} frustrated her at work.
e.zh: 她职位的从属性让她在工作中感到沮丧。

e.en: The instructor demonstrated {seconde} during the fencing lesson.
e.zh: 教练在击剑课上示范了第二姿势。

e.en: Her blade moved smoothly into {seconde}.
e.zh: 她的剑顺畅地转入第二姿势。

e.en: The {secondi} entered softly after the main violins.
e.zh: 第二声部在主小提琴之后轻柔进入。

e.en: He asked the {secondi} to play with more warmth.
e.zh: 他要求副奏者们演奏得更温暖些。

e.en: The boxer listened carefully to his {secondman}.
e.zh: 拳击手认真听着助手的建议。

e.en: Every lead climber needs a reliable {secondman}.
e.zh: 每个领攀者都需要一个可靠的副手。

e.en: She played the {secondo} part in the piano duet.
e.zh: 她在钢琴二重奏中弹第二声部。

e.en: The {secondo} must keep the rhythm steady.
e.zh: 低音部必须保持节奏稳定。

e.en: The botanist examined the {secotyl} under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下观察了这个子叶隔。

e.en: Damage to the {secotyl} affected the seed's early growth.
e.zh: 子叶隔受损影响了种子的早期生长。

e.en: The lab tested the patient's {secreta} for infection.
e.zh: 实验室检测了病人的分泌物以判断是否感染。

e.en: Certain glands release {secreta} during digestion.
e.zh: 某些腺体会在消化过程中释放分泌物。

e.en: She kept old letters inside the {secretaire}.
e.zh: 她把旧信件放在那张写字柜里。

e.en: The antique {secretaire} folded open into a small desk.
e.zh: 那件古董秘书式书桌可以翻开成一张小书桌。

e.en: The committee sent the report to the {secretariate}.
e.zh: 委员会把报告送交秘书处。

e.en: A small {secretariate} managed the conference schedule.
e.zh: 一个小型秘书处负责管理会议日程。

e.en: Several former {secretaries-general} attended the ceremony.
e.zh: 几位前秘书长出席了典礼。

e.en: The {secretaries-general} issued a joint statement on climate policy.
e.zh: 这些秘书长就气候政策发表了联合声明。

e.en: The {secretary-general} opened the summit with a warning.
e.zh: 秘书长以一番警告开启了峰会。

e.en: She was elected {secretary-general} of the international union.
e.zh: 她当选为这个国际联盟的总干事。

e.en: Two past {secretary-generals} criticized the decision.
e.zh: 两位前秘书长批评了这一决定。

e.en: The organization invited its regional {secretary-generals} to meet in Geneva.
e.zh: 该组织邀请各地区总干事到日内瓦开会。

e.en: Researchers measured {secretinase} activity in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了组织样本中的促胰液素酶活性。

e.en: Low {secretinase} levels may alter hormone breakdown.
e.zh: 促胰液素酶水平偏低可能会改变激素分解过程。

e.en: A healthy gland is an active {secretor} of hormones.
e.zh: 健康的腺体是活跃的激素分泌者。

e.en: Blood tests showed that he was a {secretor}.
e.zh: 血液检测显示他属于分泌型个体。

e.en: The historian traced the rise of a small {secta}.
e.zh: 历史学家追溯了一个小宗派的兴起。

e.en: Members of the {secta} followed strict rules.
e.zh: 这个派别的成员遵守严格的规条。

e.en: The dispute had a strongly {sectarial} character.
e.zh: 这场争端带有强烈的宗派色彩。

e.en: He avoided {sectarial} language in the public statement.
e.zh: 他在公开声明中避免使用教派性的措辞。

e.en: The campaign tried to {sectarianize} a local dispute.
e.zh: 这场运动试图把地方争端宗派化。

e.en: Leaders warned that such rhetoric could {sectarianize} the conflict.
e.zh: 领导人警告说，这种言辞可能使冲突带上宗派色彩。

e.en: The pamphlet attacked the {sectaries} as dangerous radicals.
e.zh: 这本小册子把那些教派成员攻击为危险的激进分子。

e.en: Many {sectaries} gathered outside the old chapel.
e.zh: 许多宗派分子聚集在那座旧礼拜堂外。

e.en: He was denounced as a {sectary} by the established church.
e.zh: 他被正统教会斥为宗派信徒。

e.en: A zealous {sectary} refused to compromise on doctrine.
e.zh: 一名狂热的教派成员拒绝在教义上妥协。

e.en: Gold is a {sectile} metal that can be cut with a knife.
e.zh: 黄金是一种可切割的金属，可以用刀切开。

e.en: The mineral was soft and {sectile} rather than brittle.
e.zh: 这种矿物柔软且易切，而不是易碎。

e.en: The jeweler tested the stone's {sectility} with a blade.
e.zh: 珠宝匠用刀片测试这块石头的可切性。

e.en: High {sectility} helps distinguish waxy minerals from glassy ones.
e.zh: 较高的易切性有助于区分蜡状矿物和玻璃状矿物。

e.en: The engineers planned to {sectionalise} the pipeline for repairs.
e.zh: 工程师计划把管道分段以便维修。

e.en: Partisan media can {sectionalise} national debate.
e.zh: 党派媒体可能会使全国性辩论地方化。

sectionalist.t: 地方主义者；分区主义者

e.en: Critics called him a {sectionalist} with narrow loyalties.
e.zh: 批评者称他是个忠诚范围狭窄的地方主义者。

e.en: The {sectionalist} argued for regional control of taxes.
e.zh: 这位分区主义者主张由地方控制税收。

e.en: The {sectionalization} of the grid limited the power outage.
e.zh: 电网的分区限制了停电范围。

e.en: Political {sectionalization} deepened after the disputed election.
e.zh: 有争议的选举后，政治上的地域分化加深了。

e.en: They will {sectionalize} the building to improve fire safety.
e.zh: 他们将把大楼分区以提高消防安全。

e.en: The debate began to {sectionalize} voters by region.
e.zh: 这场辩论开始按地区分化选民。

e.en: The new system {sectionalizes} the network automatically.
e.zh: 新系统会自动把网络分区。

e.en: This rhetoric {sectionalizes} the electorate along regional lines.
e.zh: 这种言辞按地域界线分化了选民。

e.en: Crews are {sectionalizing} the rail line for maintenance.
e.zh: 工人们正在把铁路线分段以便维护。

e.en: The speech had a {sectionalizing} effect on the party.
e.zh: 这次演讲对该党产生了分化作用。

e.en: The report compares {sectorial} growth across the economy.
e.zh: 这份报告比较了整个经济中各部门的增长。

e.en: The diagram shows a {sectorial} area of the circle.
e.zh: 这张图显示了圆中的一个扇形区域。

sectrometer.t: 分段测量仪；扇区测量仪

e.en: The engineer calibrated the {sectrometer} before testing the metal sample.
e.zh: 工程师在测试金属样品前校准了分段测量仪。

e.en: A damaged {sectrometer} gave inconsistent readings throughout the experiment.
e.zh: 一台受损的扇区测量仪在整个实验中读数不一致。

e.en: The country's rapid {secularisation} changed public attitudes toward education.
e.zh: 这个国家迅速的世俗化改变了公众对教育的态度。

e.en: Historians still debate the {secularisation} of church lands after the reform.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在争论改革后教会土地的世俗化。

secularise.t: 使世俗化；脱离宗教控制

e.en: The new law aimed to {secularise} the school system.
e.zh: 这项新法律旨在使学校体系世俗化。

e.en: Reformers wanted to {secularise} marriage and civil records.
e.zh: 改革者希望让婚姻和民事登记脱离宗教控制。

secularistic.t: 世俗主义的；主张世俗化的

e.en: The essay presents a strongly {secularistic} view of politics.
e.zh: 这篇文章呈现了强烈的世俗主义政治观点。

e.en: Some voters rejected his {secularistic} language as too dismissive of faith.
e.zh: 一些选民认为他的世俗主义措辞过于轻视信仰。

secund.t: 偏向一侧的；单侧排列的

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {secund} flowers along the stem.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这株植物的花沿茎偏向一侧排列。

e.en: A {secund} arrangement of leaves helped identify the specimen.
e.zh: 叶片单侧排列的特征帮助确认了这个标本。

e.en: The chart identified the patient as a {secundigravida}.
e.zh: 病历将这名患者标注为第二次怀孕的女性。

e.en: A {secundigravida} may still need careful prenatal screening.
e.zh: 第二次怀孕的女性仍可能需要仔细的产前筛查。

e.en: The midwife checked that the {secundina} had been fully delivered.
e.zh: 助产士检查胞衣是否已经完整娩出。

e.en: Retained {secundina} can cause dangerous bleeding after birth.
e.zh: 胎盘及胎膜滞留可能导致产后危险出血。

e.en: The nurse recorded her as a {secundipara} after delivery.
e.zh: 分娩后，护士记录她为第二次分娩的产妇。

e.en: A {secundipara} often has different labor patterns from a first-time mother.
e.zh: 第二次分娩的产妇常有不同于初产妇的产程表现。

e.en: {Secundo}, the contract never mentioned delivery dates.
e.zh: 其次，合同从未提到交货日期。

e.en: The lecturer said, {secundo}, that evidence must be checked carefully.
e.zh: 讲师说，第二，证据必须仔细核查。

e.en: The phrase means acting {secundum} the established rules.
e.zh: 这个短语表示按照既定规则行事。

e.en: A diagnosis {secundum} artem required careful observation.
e.zh: 依照专业规范作出诊断需要仔细观察。

e.en: The manuscript labels this speaker as {secundus}.
e.zh: 手稿把这位发言者标为第二位。

e.en: In the old list, Marcus was written as {secundus}.
e.zh: 在旧名单中，马库斯被写作第二位。

e.en: The loan is {securable} with a modest deposit.
e.zh: 这笔贷款可以用一小笔押金获得。

e.en: All panels must be {securable} before the machine is shipped.
e.zh: 机器发货前，所有面板都必须能够固定牢靠。

e.en: Proper {securement} of the cargo prevents accidents on the road.
e.zh: 货物妥善固定可以防止路上发生事故。

e.en: The lawyer handled the {securement} of funding for the project.
e.zh: 律师负责为这个项目取得资金保障。

securite.t: 安全通报；海上安全信号

e.en: The radio operator repeated {securite} before the navigation warning.
e.zh: 无线电操作员在航行警告前重复播报安全通报信号。

e.en: A {securite} message alerted nearby vessels to floating debris.
e.zh: 一条海上安全通报警告附近船只注意漂浮残骸。

e.en: Mortgage {securitisation} spread the risk across many investors.
e.zh: 抵押贷款证券化把风险分散给了许多投资者。

e.en: The {securitisation} of migration changed the tone of public debate.
e.zh: 把移民问题安全化处理改变了公共辩论的语气。

e.en: The bank plans to {securitize} a pool of car loans.
e.zh: 银行计划把一组汽车贷款证券化。

e.en: Politicians sometimes {securitize} public health issues during crises.
e.zh: 政客有时会在危机中把公共卫生问题安全化看待。

securocrat.t: 安全机构官僚；安全部门官员

e.en: The article accused a senior {securocrat} of blocking reform.
e.zh: 文章指责一名高级安全机构官僚阻挠改革。

e.en: A former {securocrat} defended the expanded surveillance powers.
e.zh: 一名前安全部门官员为扩大监控权力辩护。

e.en: The {secutor} wore a smooth helmet in the arena.
e.zh: 这名古罗马追击角斗士在竞技场上戴着光滑头盔。

e.en: Museum visitors saw a bronze figurine of a {secutor}.
e.zh: 博物馆参观者看到了一尊追击角斗士的青铜小像。

e.en: She remained the {sedatest} person in the crowded room.
e.zh: 在拥挤的房间里，她仍是最沉着的人。

e.en: Even the {sedatest} judge seemed surprised by the verdict.
e.zh: 即使是最镇静的法官似乎也对判决感到惊讶。

e.en: He worked {sedentarily} for years and developed back pain.
e.zh: 他多年久坐工作，后来出现了背痛。

e.en: The community began living {sedentarily} near the river.
e.zh: 这个群体开始在河边定居生活。

e.en: Doctors warned that {sedentariness} increases the risk of disease.
e.zh: 医生警告说，久坐状态会增加患病风险。

e.en: Archaeologists studied the tribe's growing {sedentariness}.
e.zh: 考古学家研究了这个部落日益增强的定居性。

sedentarization.t: 定居化；由游牧转为定居

e.en: State policy encouraged the {sedentarization} of nomadic families.
e.zh: 国家政策鼓励游牧家庭定居化。

e.en: The {sedentarization} process changed local patterns of land use.
e.zh: 定居化过程改变了当地的土地利用方式。

seder.t: 逾越节家宴仪式；家宴礼

e.en: Our neighbors invited us to a {seder} on Friday night.
e.zh: 邻居邀请我们周五晚上参加逾越节家宴仪式。

e.en: The family read prayers during the {seder}.
e.zh: 一家人在逾越节家宴仪式中诵读祷文。

e.en: The clerk entered the decision in the {sederunt}.
e.zh: 书记员把决定记入会议记录。

e.en: An old {sederunt} listed every judge present.
e.zh: 一份旧出席名单列出了到场的每位法官。

e.en: Birds nested in the quiet {sedgeland} near the river.
e.zh: 鸟儿在河边安静的莎草湿地筑巢。

e.en: The reserve protects rare plants growing across the {sedgeland}.
e.zh: 保护区守护着遍布莎草地的珍稀植物。

e.en: We crossed a {sedgy} marsh at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时我们穿过一片长满莎草的沼泽。

e.en: The lake had a {sedgy} edge full of insects.
e.zh: 湖边长着莎草，昆虫很多。

e.en: The priest sat in the carved {sedile}.
e.zh: 神父坐在雕刻精美的祭坛旁座位上。

e.en: Restorers cleaned the medieval stone {sedile}.
e.zh: 修复人员清理了中世纪的石制祭坛旁座位。

e.en: The church still preserves its thirteenth-century {sedilia}.
e.zh: 这座教堂仍保存着十三世纪的祭坛旁座席。

e.en: Three priests used the {sedilia} during the service.
e.zh: 礼拜时三位神职人员使用了祭坛旁座席。

e.en: Divers examined the {sediment-covered} wreck on the seabed.
e.zh: 潜水员检查了海床上被沉积物覆盖的沉船。

e.en: The fossils lay beneath a {sediment-covered} slope.
e.zh: 这些化石埋在被沉积物覆盖的斜坡下。

e.en: The lab measured the {sedimentable} particles in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室测量了样本中可沉降的颗粒。

e.en: Only the {sedimentable} material settled after an hour.
e.zh: 一小时后只有能沉淀的物质沉了下来。

e.en: The geologist described the river's {sedimental} layers.
e.zh: 地质学家描述了这条河的沉积层。

e.en: A {sedimental} deposit formed at the bottom of the tank.
e.zh: 水箱底部形成了一层沉淀物。

e.en: The solution began to {sedimentate} overnight.
e.zh: 这份溶液一夜之间开始沉淀。

e.en: Technicians {sedimentate} the solids before testing the liquid.
e.zh: 技术人员先让固体沉降，再检测液体。

e.en: Researchers detected {sedimentin} in the experimental sample.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验样本中检测到沉积素。

e.en: The paper linked {sedimentin} to changes in cell structure.
e.zh: 论文把沉积素与细胞结构变化联系起来。

e.en: The course covers {sedimentogenesis} in ancient oceans.
e.zh: 这门课讲授古代海洋中的沉积生成作用。

e.en: Climate can influence {sedimentogenesis} in coastal basins.
e.zh: 气候会影响海岸盆地的沉积生成作用。

sedimentography.t: 沉积物记录法；沉积学图示

e.en: The team used {sedimentography} to compare grain sizes.
e.zh: 团队用沉积物记录法比较颗粒大小。

e.en: Her thesis included detailed {sedimentography} of the core samples.
e.zh: 她的论文包含岩芯样本的详细沉积学图示。

e.en: The report offered a {sedimentologic} interpretation of the basin.
e.zh: 报告对该盆地作出了沉积学解释。

e.en: They collected cores for {sedimentologic} analysis.
e.zh: 他们采集岩芯用于沉积学分析。

e.en: A {sedimentologist} mapped the ancient shoreline.
e.zh: 一位沉积学家绘制了古海岸线图。

e.en: The oil company hired a {sedimentologist} for the survey.
e.zh: 石油公司聘请了一名沉积学家参与勘测。

e.en: Several {sedimentologists} studied the delta deposits.
e.zh: 几位沉积学家研究了三角洲沉积物。

e.en: The conference brought together {sedimentologists} from many countries.
e.zh: 这次会议汇集了来自多国的沉积学家。

e.en: She specialized in {sedimentology} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学专攻沉积学。

e.en: Modern {sedimentology} helps reconstruct ancient environments.
e.zh: 现代沉积学有助于重建古代环境。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {sedimentometer} before the test.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前校准了沉降测定仪。

e.en: A {sedimentometer} recorded how fast the particles settled.
e.zh: 沉积计记录了颗粒沉降的速度。

e.en: The pamphlet was condemned as {seditionary}.
e.zh: 这本小册子被斥为煽动叛乱的材料。

e.en: Officials feared the speech had a {seditionary} tone.
e.zh: 官员担心这场演讲带有煽动性语气。

e.en: The governor called the editor a {seditionist}.
e.zh: 州长称那名编辑为煽动叛乱者。

e.en: A suspected {seditionist} was questioned after the rally.
e.zh: 集会后，一名涉嫌煽动叛乱者受到讯问。

seditty.t: 自命不凡的；装腔作势的

e.en: She mocked his {seditty} way of talking.
e.zh: 她嘲笑他说话那副自命不凡的样子。

e.en: The club felt too {seditty} for the old neighbors.
e.zh: 老邻居们觉得这个俱乐部太装腔作势了。

e.en: The pathway produces {sedoheptose} during carbon metabolism.
e.zh: 这条途径在碳代谢过程中产生景天庚糖。

e.en: They measured {sedoheptose} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 他们测定了植物提取物中的景天庚糖。

e.en: The chemist isolated {sedoheptulosan} from the sample.
e.zh: 化学家从样本中分离出景天庚酮糖聚糖。

e.en: Few textbooks mention {sedoheptulosan} in detail.
e.zh: 很少有教材详细提到景天庚酮糖聚糖。

e.en: Photosynthesis can involve {sedoheptulose} phosphates.
e.zh: 光合作用可能涉及景天庚酮糖磷酸酯。

e.en: The enzyme acts on {sedoheptulose} in the reaction.
e.zh: 这种酶在反应中作用于景天庚酮糖。

seednet.t: 种子网；种子覆盖网；种子传播网

e.en: The botanists mapped the {seednet} across the restored prairie.
e.zh: 植物学家绘制了恢复草原上的种子传播网。

e.en: A biodegradable {seednet} can hold soil in place after planting.
e.zh: 可降解的种子覆盖网能在播种后固定土壤。

e.en: The village grew busy at {seedtime}.
e.zh: 到了播种季节，村里变得忙碌起来。

e.en: In the old proverb, {seedtime} promises a later harvest.
e.zh: 在这句古谚里，播种期预示着日后的收成。

e.en: The falconer would {seel} the hawk before training.
e.zh: 驯鹰人会在训练前暂时缝住鹰的眼睑。

e.en: Jealousy can {seel} a person's judgment.
e.zh: 嫉妒会蒙蔽一个人的判断。

e.en: The {seeled} hawk rested quietly on the glove.
e.zh: 那只被缝住眼睑的鹰安静地停在手套上。

e.en: He moved through the scandal with {seeled} understanding.
e.zh: 他对这场丑闻几乎被蒙蔽，糊里糊涂地走了过去。

e.en: She smiled {seelily} after the long illness.
e.zh: 久病之后，她无力地笑了笑。

e.en: The old dog followed {seelily} behind the cart.
e.zh: 那条老狗可怜巴巴地跟在车后。

e.en: {Seeling} a falcon was once part of training.
e.zh: 缝住猎鹰的眼睑曾是训练的一部分。

e.en: Fear was {seeling} his mind to obvious facts.
e.zh: 恐惧正在蒙蔽他的头脑，让他看不见明显的事实。

e.en: The ceremony had a quiet {seemliness}.
e.zh: 这场仪式有一种安静而得体的气度。

e.en: She cared more for {seemliness} than display.
e.zh: 她更看重合宜端庄，而不是张扬排场。

e.en: The {seepy} bank made the path slippery.
e.zh: 渗水的河岸让小路变得很滑。

e.en: We avoided the {seepy} corner of the cellar.
e.zh: 我们避开了地窖里那处潮湿渗水的角落。

e.en: The king consulted a {seeress} before battle.
e.zh: 国王在开战前请教了一位女预言家。

e.en: In the poem, the {seeress} speaks in riddles.
e.zh: 在诗中，那位女先知用谜语般的话说话。

e.en: He lit a {segar} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他点了一支雪茄。

e.en: The room smelled faintly of old {segars}.
e.zh: 房间里隐约有陈旧雪茄的气味。

segetal.t: 生于庄稼地的；农田杂草的

e.en: The survey recorded several {segetal} weeds among the wheat.
e.zh: 调查记录了小麦地里的几种农田杂草。

e.en: {Segetal} plants often depend on traditional farming cycles.
e.zh: 生于庄稼地的植物常常依赖传统耕作周期。

e.en: Each vase was placed inside a {seggar} before firing.
e.zh: 每只花瓶入窑烧制前都放进匣钵里。

e.en: The cracked {seggar} protected the pottery from ash.
e.zh: 那只裂开的耐火陶盒保护陶器免受灰烬污染。

e.en: A clump of {seggie} grew beside the ditch.
e.zh: 沟边长着一丛莎草。

e.en: The basket was woven from dried {seggie}.
e.zh: 这个篮子是用晒干的水边草编成的。

e.en: The report described the {segistration} of waste materials.
e.zh: 报告描述了废料的分离处理。

e.en: Social {segistration} deepened tensions in the town.
e.zh: 社会隔离加深了镇上的紧张关系。

e.en: The audio file is {segmentable} into short phrases.
e.zh: 这个音频文件可以切分成短语。

e.en: A {segmentable} market lets the team target buyers more precisely.
e.zh: 可细分的市场让团队能更精准地定位买家。

segmentalize.t: 分段；使分节；分割成部分

e.en: The software can {segmentalize} speech into phonetic units.
e.zh: 这款软件能把语音分割成音素单位。

e.en: Managers sometimes {segmentalize} work to control risk.
e.zh: 管理者有时会把工作分段，以控制风险。

e.en: The biologist examined each {segmentum} of the insect.
e.zh: 生物学家检查了昆虫身体的每一个分节。

e.en: A damaged {segmentum} can affect the whole spinal pattern.
e.zh: 受损的一个节段可能影响整个脊柱结构。

e.en: The pianist returned to the {segno} near the top of the page.
e.zh: 钢琴手回到了页面上方附近的反复记号处。

e.en: A missing {segno} confused the orchestra during rehearsal.
e.zh: 缺少一个音乐反复标记让乐团排练时感到困惑。

e.en: The score used two {segnos} in the final section.
e.zh: 这份乐谱在最后一段用了两个反复记号。

e.en: Beginners often overlook {segnos} when reading music.
e.zh: 初学者读谱时常常会忽略反复记号。

e.en: The {sego} bloomed after the desert rain.
e.zh: 沙漠雨后，美花百合开花了。

e.en: Native people once ate the bulb of the {sego}.
e.zh: 原住民过去曾食用美花百合的鳞茎。

e.en: The mixed plastics were not easily {segregable}.
e.zh: 这些混合塑料并不容易分离。

e.en: The policy treated patients as {segregable} groups.
e.zh: 这项政策把患者视为可以隔离划分的群体。

segregant.t: 分离个体；分离群体成员

e.en: Each {segregant} carried a different genetic marker.
e.zh: 每个分离个体都带有不同的遗传标记。

e.en: The lab compared the resistant {segregants} after breeding.
e.zh: 实验室比较了育种后产生的抗性分离个体。

e.en: The policy had a clearly {segregative} effect on housing.
e.zh: 这项政策对住房明显产生了隔离作用。

e.en: Researchers studied the {segregative} pattern in the offspring.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了后代中的分离模式。

e.en: The judge criticized the school {segregator} in strong terms.
e.zh: 法官严厉批评了那名学校隔离政策推行者。

e.en: A mechanical {segregator} sorted the grains by size.
e.zh: 一台机械分离器按大小分拣谷粒。

e.en: The guitarist played a lively {seguidilla} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后，吉他手演奏了一首欢快的塞吉迪亚舞曲。

e.en: Her poem followed the rhythm of a {seguidilla}.
e.zh: 她的诗采用了塞吉迪亚诗歌的节奏。

seicentist.t: 十七世纪意大利文艺研究者

e.en: The {seicentist} analyzed a forgotten Baroque poem.
e.zh: 这位十七世纪意大利文艺研究者分析了一首被遗忘的巴洛克诗。

e.en: As a {seicentist}, she focused on Italian theater.
e.zh: 作为十七世纪意大利文艺研究者，她专注于意大利戏剧。

seicento.t: 意大利十七世纪文艺时期

e.en: The museum opened a show on {seicento} painting.
e.zh: 博物馆开设了一场关于意大利十七世纪绘画的展览。

e.en: His lectures connect {seicento} art with politics.
e.zh: 他的讲座把意大利十七世纪艺术与政治联系起来。

e.en: A sudden {seiche} flooded the lakeside path.
e.zh: 突发的湖面定振波淹没了湖边小路。

e.en: Wind and pressure changes can trigger a {seiche}.
e.zh: 风和气压变化可能引发湖湾水面定振波。

e.en: The old {seichometer} still recorded small lake oscillations.
e.zh: 那台旧的湖面定振波测量仪仍能记录细小的湖水振荡。

e.en: Engineers installed a {seichometer} beside the reservoir.
e.zh: 工程师在水库旁安装了一台湖面定振波测量仪。

e.en: The saga describes {seid} as a powerful magic art.
e.zh: 这部萨迦把北欧巫术描述成一种强大的魔法技艺。

e.en: Scholars debate the role of {seid} in Norse religion.
e.zh: 学者们争论北欧巫术在古诺斯宗教中的作用。

e.en: A long {seif} dune stretched across the desert.
e.zh: 一条长长的纵向沙丘横亘在沙漠中。

e.en: Satellite images revealed several parallel {seif} dunes.
e.zh: 卫星图像显示出几条平行的剑形沙丘。

e.en: The villagers owed rent to the local {seignior}.
e.zh: 村民们要向当地封建领主缴纳租金。

e.en: The letter addressed him as a noble {seignior}.
e.zh: 信中把他称作尊贵的先生。

e.en: The crown gained {seigniorage} from minting silver coins.
e.zh: 王室通过铸造银币获得了铸币税收益。

e.en: Central banks still earn {seigniorage} on issued currency.
e.zh: 中央银行仍能从发行货币中获得铸币收益。

e.en: The peasants challenged the {seigniorial} rights of the estate.
e.zh: 农民们挑战了庄园的封建领主权利。

e.en: A {seigniorial} court handled disputes in the village.
e.zh: 一个领主法庭处理村里的纠纷。

e.en: The family lost its {seigniory} after the revolt.
e.zh: 叛乱之后，这个家族失去了封建领地。

e.en: Documents defined the taxes owed within the {seigniory}.
e.zh: 文件规定了该领地内应缴的税款。

e.en: The mint charged {seignorage} on every new coin.
e.zh: 铸币厂对每枚新币收取铸币税。

e.en: Economists measured the state's {seignorage} during inflation.
e.zh: 经济学家衡量了通胀期间国家的货币发行收益。

seignorial.t: 封建领主的；领地制度的

e.en: The village preserved traces of a {seignorial} system.
e.zh: 这个村庄保留着封建领地制度的痕迹。

e.en: The archive contains many {seignorial} records.
e.zh: 档案馆保存着许多领主相关记录。

e.en: His {seignory} included three villages and a mill.
e.zh: 他的封建领地包括三个村庄和一座磨坊。

e.en: The treaty transferred the {seignory} to another noble.
e.zh: 条约把这项领主权转给了另一位贵族。

e.en: The philosopher used {seir} to discuss human perception.
e.zh: 那位哲学家用seir来讨论人的知觉。

e.en: In old medical writing, {seir} could mean sensation itself.
e.zh: 在旧医学文献中，seir可指感觉本身。

e.en: The manuscript spells seize as {seis} throughout the page.
e.zh: 这份手稿整页都把seize写成seis。

e.en: He wrote {seis} where modern readers expect seize.
e.zh: 他写了seis，而现代读者会期待seize这个拼法。

seise.t: 依法占有；使取得所有权

e.en: The court could {seise} the heir of the estate.
e.zh: 法院可以使继承人依法取得该地产。

e.en: Old legal forms often {seise} a tenant in land.
e.zh: 旧式法律文书常写明让承租人取得土地占有权。

e.en: The patient reported unusual {seisesthesia} during the tremor.
e.zh: 病人在震动期间报告了异常的震动感觉。

e.en: Researchers studied {seisesthesia} in people living near faults.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了断层附近居民的地震感知。

e.en: The deed gave her {seisin} of the farm.
e.zh: 这份契约使她依法占有那座农场。

e.en: Medieval lawyers treated {seisin} as proof of possession.
e.zh: 中世纪律师把seisin视为占有的证明。

e.en: A minor {seism} shook the valley at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨一次轻微地震震动了山谷。

e.en: The poem compares grief to a hidden {seism}.
e.zh: 这首诗把悲伤比作隐伏的震动。

e.en: The engineer reviewed the building's {seismal} risk.
e.zh: 工程师审查了这栋楼的地震风险。

e.en: A {seismal} wave passed beneath the island.
e.zh: 一道地震波从岛屿下方通过。

e.en: The archive contains early {seismetic} observations from Japan.
e.zh: 档案中保存着日本早期的地震观测记录。

e.en: She corrected the obsolete term {seismetic} in the report.
e.zh: 她在报告中修正了seismetic这个过时术语。

seismicrophone.t: 地震检波器；震动传声器

e.en: The team buried a {seismicrophone} beside the test well.
e.zh: 团队在试验井旁埋设了一台地震检波器。

e.en: A sensitive {seismicrophone} recorded traffic vibrations overnight.
e.zh: 一台灵敏的震动传声器记录了整夜的交通震动。

e.en: The paper described local {seismism} after the eruption.
e.zh: 论文描述了喷发后的当地地震活动。

e.en: Early scientists used {seismism} for earthquake phenomena generally.
e.zh: 早期科学家用seismism泛指地震现象。

e.en: The museum displayed a handmade {seismitron} from the 1920s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台20世纪20年代的手工测震装置。

e.en: Engineers calibrated the {seismitron} before the field survey.
e.zh: 工程师在野外勘测前校准了那台地震仪器。

e.en: The {seismocardiogram} showed subtle changes after exercise.
e.zh: 心震图显示运动后出现了细微变化。

e.en: Doctors compared the {seismocardiogram} with the ECG.
e.zh: 医生把心震图与心电图进行了比较。

e.en: The trial used {seismocardiographic} sensors on the chest.
e.zh: 这项试验在胸部使用了心震图传感器。

e.en: She analyzed {seismocardiographic} signals from sleeping patients.
e.zh: 她分析了睡眠患者的心震描记信号。

seismocardiography.t: 心震描记法；心震图检查

e.en: {Seismocardiography} measures tiny vibrations from the beating heart.
e.zh: 心震描记法测量心脏跳动产生的微小振动。

e.en: The clinic tested {seismocardiography} as a noninvasive tool.
e.zh: 诊所测试了心震图检查作为一种无创工具。

e.en: The old {seismochronograph} marked each tremor with a time trace.
e.zh: 那台旧地震计时记录仪用时间轨迹标记每次震动。

e.en: A restored {seismochronograph} stood in the observatory.
e.zh: 一台修复后的地震计时记录仪陈列在观测站里。

e.en: The {seismogram} showed a sharp arrival wave.
e.zh: 地震图显示出一道清晰的初至波。

e.en: Students learned to read a {seismogram} in geology class.
e.zh: 学生们在地质课上学习解读地震图。

e.en: The station keeps {seismographic} records from every major quake.
e.zh: 该观测站保存每次大地震的地震记录。
