e.en: A {seismographic} needle traced waves on smoked paper.
e.zh: 地震仪指针在烟熏纸上描出了波形。

e.en: Her thesis examined {seismographical} methods used in mines.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了矿山中使用的地震记录方法。

e.en: The library holds rare {seismographical} charts from that era.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏了那个时代罕见的地震记录图表。

e.en: Modern {seismography} can detect quakes across oceans.
e.zh: 现代地震记录学能够探测到大洋彼岸的地震。

e.en: He studied {seismography} before joining the observatory.
e.zh: 他在加入观测站前学习了地震测记。

e.en: The agency released a {seismologic} report after the quake.
e.zh: 该机构在地震后发布了一份地震学报告。

e.en: New {seismologic} models improved the hazard map.
e.zh: 新的地震学模型改进了灾害风险图。

e.en: A French {seismologue} warned of aftershocks.
e.zh: 一位法国地震学家警告可能发生余震。

e.en: The {seismologue} explained the fault line on television.
e.zh: 那位地震学家在电视上解释了断层线。

e.en: The lab upgraded its {seismometric} equipment this year.
e.zh: 实验室今年升级了测震设备。

e.en: Precise {seismometric} data helped locate the epicenter.
e.zh: 精确的地震测量数据帮助确定了震中。

e.en: {Seismometry} revealed movement along the offshore fault.
e.zh: 地震测量揭示了近海断层的活动。

e.en: The course introduces basic {seismometry} and wave analysis.
e.zh: 这门课程介绍基础测震法和波形分析。

seismonastic.t: 感震运动的；震动反应的

e.en: The plant showed a {seismonastic} response when touched.
e.zh: 这种植物被触碰时表现出感震运动反应。

e.en: Botanists measured {seismonastic} folding in the leaves.
e.zh: 植物学家测量了叶片的震动反应性折叠。

e.en: {Seismonasty} causes the leaflets to close after a shake.
e.zh: 感震运动会使小叶在震动后闭合。

e.en: The class observed {seismonasty} in a sensitive plant.
e.zh: 课堂上观察了含羞草的触震性运动。

e.en: The ancient {seismoscope} showed that an earthquake had occurred far away.
e.zh: 那台古代验震器显示远处发生了地震。

e.en: A {seismoscope} detects shaking but does not record a full waveform.
e.zh: 验震器能检出震动，但不会记录完整波形。

e.en: The museum displayed early {seismoscopic} instruments from China.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了中国早期的验震仪器。

e.en: The report compared {seismoscopic} evidence with modern sensor data.
e.zh: 报告把验震资料与现代传感器数据作了比较。

e.en: The remote {seismostation} sent data through a satellite link.
e.zh: 那座偏远的地震观测站通过卫星链路传送数据。

e.en: Engineers repaired the {seismostation} after the winter storm.
e.zh: 冬季风暴过后，工程师修好了地震观测站。

e.en: The team mapped the region's {seismotectonic} zones.
e.zh: 团队绘制了该地区的地震构造带。

e.en: Her {seismotectonic} analysis linked the quake to a buried fault.
e.zh: 她的地震构造分析把这次地震同一条隐伏断层联系起来。

e.en: The bridge showed slight {seismotic} damage after the tremor.
e.zh: 震动过后，这座桥出现了轻微的地震损伤。

e.en: Researchers studied the {seismotic} signals from the volcano.
e.zh: 研究人员分析了火山传来的震动信号。

e.en: She grilled {seitan} for the vegan barbecue.
e.zh: 她为纯素烧烤烤了面筋素食肉。

e.en: The noodles came with spicy {seitan} instead of beef.
e.zh: 这碗面配的是辣味面筋素肉，而不是牛肉。

e.en: The philosopher wrote about the {seity} of the divine.
e.zh: 那位哲学家论述了神性的自身存在。

e.en: In the poem, each object seems to possess its own {seity}.
e.zh: 在这首诗里，每个物体似乎都有自己的自性。

e.en: The court ruled that the assets were {seizable}.
e.zh: 法院裁定这些资产可以被扣押。

e.en: The fortress had one {seizable} gate on the eastern wall.
e.zh: 这座要塞东墙有一处可以夺取的城门。

e.en: The deed confirmed his {seizin} of the estate.
e.zh: 契约确认了他对该地产的依法占有。

e.en: Medieval law treated {seizin} as a key proof of ownership.
e.zh: 中世纪法律把土地占有权视为所有权的重要证明。

e.en: The law required the {seizor} to list every item taken.
e.zh: 法律要求扣押者列出所有被拿走的物品。

e.en: In the old tale, the {seizor} lost the crown he had stolen.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里，夺取者失去了偷来的王冠。

e.en: The shield showed a lion {sejant} beneath three stars.
e.zh: 盾徽上画着一头端坐的狮子，下面有三颗星。

e.en: Heraldic artists distinguish {sejant} beasts from crouching ones.
e.zh: 纹章画师会区分端坐姿态的兽和蹲伏的兽。

e.en: The manuscript describes a griffin {sejeant} on a red field.
e.zh: 手稿描述红底上有一只端坐的狮鹫。

e.en: A lion {sejeant} appears on the family's old coat of arms.
e.zh: 家族旧纹章上有一头端坐的狮子。

e.en: The corner ended in {seki}, so neither player could capture.
e.zh: 角上形成了双活，因此双方都不能提子。

e.en: Beginners often mistake {seki} for a dead group.
e.zh: 初学者常把围棋里的双活误认为死棋。

e.en: The fossil belonged to an ancient {selachian}.
e.zh: 这块化石属于一种古代鲨鳐类动物。

e.en: Marine biologists study {selachian} teeth to trace shark evolution.
e.zh: 海洋生物学家研究鲨鳐类牙齿来追踪鲨鱼演化。

e.en: The specimen had a distinctly {selachoid} body shape.
e.zh: 这个标本有明显似鲨鳐类的体形。

e.en: Its {selachoid} features suggested a close link to early sharks.
e.zh: 它似鲨鳐类的特征表明与早期鲨鱼关系密切。

seladang.t: 马来野牛；白肢野牛属动物

e.en: A {seladang} stood quietly at the forest edge.
e.zh: 一头马来野牛静静站在森林边缘。

e.en: The reserve protects the rare {seladang} from hunting.
e.zh: 这个保护区保护稀有的马来野牛免遭猎杀。

e.en: The psalm ends the verse with {selah}.
e.zh: 这首诗篇在诗句末尾用了停顿标记。

e.en: She read {selah} as a cue for silence.
e.zh: 她把selah读作一个保持沉默的提示。

e.en: Visitors waited in the {selamlik} before meeting the official.
e.zh: 访客在男宾接待区等候，然后才见那位官员。

e.en: The old house still had a separate {selamlik}.
e.zh: 那座老房子仍保留着单独的男宾区。

e.en: The radio operator sent a {selcall} to the patrol boat.
e.zh: 无线电员向巡逻艇发送了选择呼叫信号。

e.en: A {selcall} alert woke the crew at midnight.
e.zh: 午夜时分，一个选择呼叫警报叫醒了船员。

e.en: The valley had a {selcouth} beauty after snow.
e.zh: 雪后山谷有一种奇异而陌生的美。

e.en: He enjoyed the {selcouth} words in old poems.
e.zh: 他喜欢旧诗里那些陌生奇特的词。

e.en: The engineer measured the filter's {selectance} under load.
e.zh: 工程师测量了滤波器在负载下的选择度。

e.en: Higher {selectance} made the receiver reject nearby signals.
e.zh: 更高的选择性使接收机能排除邻近信号。

e.en: The verb has strict {selectional} restrictions on its object.
e.zh: 这个动词对宾语有严格的选择限制。

e.en: They studied {selectional} pressure in the isolated population.
e.zh: 他们研究了这个孤立种群中的选择压力。

selectionist.t: 选择论者；自然选择论者

e.en: A {selectionist} explains the trait through survival advantages.
e.zh: 选择论者会用生存优势来解释这种特征。

e.en: The debate divided neutralist and {selectionist} biologists.
e.zh: 这场争论把中性论和选择论生物学家分成两派。

selectmen.t: 镇政委员；地方行政委员

e.en: The {selectmen} voted to repair the bridge.
e.zh: 镇政委员投票决定修缮那座桥。

e.en: Residents questioned the {selectmen} at the town meeting.
e.zh: 居民在镇民大会上质询了镇政委员。

e.en: The lab used a {selectode} to detect nitrate ions.
e.zh: 实验室用选择性电极检测硝酸根离子。

e.en: A damaged {selectode} gave unstable readings.
e.zh: 受损的选择电极给出了不稳定的读数。

selectorate.t: 有权选择领导者的群体

e.en: The party's {selectorate} chose a moderate candidate.
e.zh: 该党有权挑选候选人的群体选择了一名温和派。

e.en: Authoritarian leaders often depend on a small {selectorate}.
e.zh: 威权领导人往往依赖一个很小的选任群体。

selectorates.t: 有权选择领导者的群体

e.en: Different {selectorates} reward leaders in different ways.
e.zh: 不同的选任群体会以不同方式回报领导者。

e.en: The study compared party {selectorates} across three countries.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了三个国家的党内选任群体。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {selectrode} before testing.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前校准了选择电极。

e.en: This {selectrode} responds mainly to potassium ions.
e.zh: 这种选择性电极主要对钾离子有响应。

e.en: The chemist synthesized {selenanthrene} in a sealed tube.
e.zh: 化学家在密封管中合成了硒蒽类化合物。

e.en: They analyzed {selenanthrene} with a mass spectrometer.
e.zh: 他们用质谱仪分析了硒蒽化合物。

e.en: The soil sample contained traces of {selenate}.
e.zh: 土壤样本中含有微量硒酸盐。

e.en: Plants can absorb {selenate} from irrigation water.
e.zh: 植物能从灌溉水中吸收硒酸根。

selenazolobenzothiazole.t: 硒唑并苯并噻唑化合物

e.en: The paper describes a new {selenazolobenzothiazole} dye.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种新的硒唑并苯并噻唑染料。

e.en: They tested {selenazolobenzothiazole} for fluorescent properties.
e.zh: 他们测试了硒唑并苯并噻唑化合物的荧光性质。

e.en: The sample released a sharp {selenic} odor when heated.
e.zh: 样品受热时释放出刺鼻的含硒气味。

e.en: The reaction produced {selenic} acid in small amounts.
e.zh: 该反应产生了少量硒酸。

e.en: Cadmium {selenide} is used in some solar cells.
e.zh: 硒化镉用于某些太阳能电池。

e.en: The mineral contains a rare metal {selenide}.
e.zh: 这种矿物含有一种稀有金属硒化物。

e.en: Cattle avoided the {seleniferous} plants on the hillside.
e.zh: 牛避开了山坡上那些富硒植物。

e.en: The region is known for {seleniferous} soils.
e.zh: 这个地区以含硒土壤闻名。

e.en: The molecule includes a reactive {seleninyl} group.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个活泼的硒酰基。

e.en: They prepared a {seleninyl} chloride for the next step.
e.zh: 他们制备了硒酰氯用于下一步反应。

e.en: The chemist detected a reactive {seleniol} in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家在样品中检测到一种活泼的硒醇。

e.en: A {seleniol} can oxidize more readily than many thiols.
e.zh: 硒醇可能比许多硫醇更容易被氧化。

e.en: The lab stored {selenious} acid in a sealed bottle.
e.zh: 实验室把亚硒酸存放在密封瓶中。

e.en: Some {selenious} compounds require careful handling.
e.zh: 一些亚硒化合物需要小心处理。

e.en: The water sample contained traces of {selenite}.
e.zh: 水样中含有微量亚硒酸盐。

e.en: She placed a piece of {selenite} on the shelf.
e.zh: 她把一块透明石膏放在架子上。

selenitic.t: 亚硒酸盐的；含透明石膏的

e.en: The report described a {selenitic} mineral deposit.
e.zh: 报告描述了一处含透明石膏的矿床。

e.en: Researchers measured the {selenitic} content of the solution.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了溶液中的亚硒酸盐含量。

selenitical.t: 亚硒酸盐的；似透明石膏的

e.en: The old text used {selenitical} to describe the crystals.
e.zh: 那本旧书用似透明石膏的来描述这些晶体。

e.en: A {selenitical} reaction was noted in the assay.
e.zh: 化验中记录到一种亚硒酸盐相关反应。

e.en: The probe entered a {selenocentric} orbit yesterday.
e.zh: 探测器昨天进入了以月球为中心的轨道。

e.en: Astronomers calculated the {selenocentric} coordinates of the landing site.
e.zh: 天文学家计算了着陆点的月心坐标。

e.en: Modern {selenodesy} refined maps of the lunar surface.
e.zh: 现代月球测地学改进了月球表面的地图。

e.en: Her thesis in {selenodesy} focused on crater elevations.
e.zh: 她的月球测地学论文关注陨石坑高程。

e.en: The museum displayed an early {selenograph} of the Moon.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一幅早期月面图。

e.en: A careful {selenograph} recorded every visible crater.
e.zh: 一位细致的月面描绘者记录了每个可见的陨石坑。

e.en: The {selenographist} compared drawings from several observatories.
e.zh: 这位月面学家比较了几个天文台的图稿。

e.en: A patient {selenographist} worked by telescope and lamplight.
e.zh: 一位耐心的月面绘图者借助望远镜和灯光工作。

e.en: Early {selenography} depended on patient visual observation.
e.zh: 早期月面学依赖耐心的目视观测。

e.en: The course introduced {selenography} through lunar maps.
e.zh: 这门课通过月球地图介绍月面制图。

e.en: The mission returned valuable {selenological} data.
e.zh: 这次任务带回了宝贵的月球学数据。

e.en: A {selenological} survey helped choose the landing zone.
e.zh: 一项月球学调查帮助选择了着陆区。

e.en: The {selenologist} studied rocks from the lunar highlands.
e.zh: 这位月球学家研究了月球高地的岩石。

e.en: As a {selenologist}, he cared about tiny surface changes.
e.zh: 作为月球学家，他关注月表的细微变化。

e.en: She specialized in {selenology} after studying geology.
e.zh: 她学过地质学后专攻月球学。

e.en: The book explains {selenology} for advanced astronomy students.
e.zh: 这本书为高阶天文学学生讲解月球学。

e.en: His research in {selenomorphology} mapped ancient lava plains.
e.zh: 他的月球地貌学研究绘制了古老熔岩平原。

e.en: {Selenomorphology} helps scientists interpret lunar craters.
e.zh: 月球地貌学帮助科学家解读月球陨石坑。

e.en: The team synthesized a stable {selenone} derivative.
e.zh: 团队合成了一种稳定的硒酮衍生物。

e.en: A {selenone} may show unusual electronic behavior.
e.zh: 硒酮可能表现出不寻常的电子行为。

e.en: Chronic {selenosis} can damage hair and nails.
e.zh: 慢性硒中毒会损害头发和指甲。

e.en: The veterinarian suspected {selenosis} in the grazing cattle.
e.zh: 兽医怀疑这些放牧牛患有硒中毒。

e.en: The plant was described as {selenotropic} in the old study.
e.zh: 那项旧研究把这种植物描述为受月光影响。

e.en: Some writers imagined {selenotropic} flowers opening at moonrise.
e.zh: 一些作家想象向月的花在月升时开放。

seletron.t: 选择管；早期电子存储管

e.en: The archive preserved a diagram of the {seletron}.
e.zh: 档案馆保存了一张选择管的示意图。

e.en: Engineers once explored the {seletron} for computer memory.
e.zh: 工程师曾研究用选择管作为计算机存储器。

e.en: He lived a {self-abandoned} life after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻之后，他过着放纵自弃的生活。

e.en: The dancer moved with {self-abandoned} joy.
e.zh: 舞者带着忘我的喜悦起舞。

e.en: Her grief led to a period of {self-abandonment}.
e.zh: 她的悲痛使她经历了一段自我放弃的时期。

e.en: The music invited complete {self-abandonment} on the dance floor.
e.zh: 这音乐让人在舞池里完全忘我投入。

e.en: He wrote frankly about shame and {self-abhorrence}.
e.zh: 他坦率写下羞耻和自我厌恶。

e.en: Therapy helped her move beyond constant {self-abhorrence}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她摆脱持续的自我厌恶。

e.en: Her {self-abnegating} habits impressed the whole community.
e.zh: 她舍己的习惯给整个社区留下深刻印象。

e.en: The novel questions such {self-abnegating} devotion.
e.zh: 这部小说质疑这种自我克制式的奉献。

e.en: The order praised poverty and {self-abnegation}.
e.zh: 这个修会推崇贫穷和自我克制。

e.en: Parenthood should not require total {self-abnegation}.
e.zh: 为人父母不应要求完全舍己。

e.en: His {self-absorption} made every conversation exhausting.
e.zh: 他的只顾自己让每次谈话都令人疲惫。

e.en: During illness, a little {self-absorption} is understandable.
e.zh: 生病时稍微自我专注是可以理解的。

e.en: The counselor asked about signs of {self-abuse}.
e.zh: 咨询师询问是否有自我伤害的迹象。

e.en: Victorian doctors often used {self-abuse} to mean masturbation.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的医生常用这个词指自慰。

e.en: His speech ended in awkward {self-applause}.
e.zh: 他的演讲最后变成了尴尬的自我喝彩。

e.en: The article sounded less like analysis than {self-applause}.
e.zh: 这篇文章听起来不像分析，更像自我称赞。

e.en: A {self-appointed} expert criticized every decision.
e.zh: 一位自封的专家批评了每个决定。

e.en: She became the {self-appointed} guardian of office rules.
e.zh: 她成了办公室规则的自任守护者。

e.en: The workshop encouraged healthy {self-appreciation}.
e.zh: 这个工作坊鼓励健康的自我肯定。

e.en: His {self-appreciation} sometimes sounded like vanity.
e.zh: 他的自我欣赏有时听起来像虚荣。

e.en: She no longer needed constant {self-approval}.
e.zh: 她不再需要不断寻求自我认可。

e.en: His smile showed quiet {self-approval}.
e.zh: 他的微笑流露出安静的自我赞许。

e.en: The molecules can {self-assemble} into thin films.
e.zh: 这些分子可以自组装成薄膜。

e.en: The shelf is designed to {self-assemble} with minimal tools.
e.zh: 这个架子设计成只用少量工具就能自行组装。

e.en: Protein {self-assembly} is central to the study.
e.zh: 蛋白质自组装是这项研究的核心。

e.en: The toy uses a simple {self-assembly} system.
e.zh: 这个玩具采用了简单的自行组装系统。

self-asserting.t: 坚持自我的；自我主张的

e.en: The child became more {self-asserting} at school.
e.zh: 这个孩子在学校里变得更能坚持自我。

e.en: Her {self-asserting} tone surprised the committee.
e.zh: 她自我主张的语气让委员会感到意外。

self-assertingly.t: 自信坚持地；果断表态地

e.en: He spoke {self-assertingly} during the debate.
e.zh: 他在辩论中自信而果断地发言。

e.en: She stepped forward {self-assertingly} and answered first.
e.zh: 她果断地走上前，第一个作答。

self-assertive.t: 自信果断的；敢于表达的

e.en: Managers value a {self-assertive} but respectful style.
e.zh: 管理者重视自信果断但尊重他人的风格。

e.en: He became more {self-assertive} after training.
e.zh: 培训后他变得更敢于表达自己。

self-assertively.t: 自信果断地；敢于表达地

e.en: She answered {self-assertively} without sounding rude.
e.zh: 她自信果断地回答，却不显得无礼。

e.en: He negotiated {self-assertively} for better terms.
e.zh: 他果断地谈判，争取更好的条件。

e.en: Students submitted weekly {self-assessments}.
e.zh: 学生每周提交自我评估。

e.en: The manager compared the {self-assessments} with peer reviews.
e.zh: 经理把自评表和同事评价进行了比较。

e.en: His {self-assumed} authority annoyed the team.
e.zh: 他自以为拥有的权威让团队很恼火。

e.en: She carried a {self-assumed} responsibility for the failure.
e.zh: 她自行承担了这次失败的责任。

e.en: The theory rests on a risky {self-assumption}.
e.zh: 这个理论建立在一个冒险的自我假定上。

e.en: His {self-assumption} of blame was unnecessary.
e.zh: 他自行承担责备其实没有必要。

e.en: She handled the interview with calm {self-assurance}.
e.zh: 她沉着自信地应对了面试。

e.en: His {self-assurance} bordered on arrogance.
e.zh: 他的自信近乎傲慢。

e.en: The young lawyer sounded surprisingly {self-assured}.
e.zh: 这位年轻律师听起来出人意料地自信。

e.en: Her {self-assured} manner calmed the room.
e.zh: 她沉着自信的举止让全场安定下来。

e.en: He walked {self-assuredly} onto the stage.
e.zh: 他自信地走上舞台。

e.en: She replied {self-assuredly} to every challenge.
e.zh: 她沉着地回应了每一个质疑。

e.en: Her {self-assuredness} impressed the interviewers.
e.zh: 她的自信给面试官留下了深刻印象。

e.en: The actor brought quiet {self-assuredness} to the role.
e.zh: 这位演员给角色注入了沉静的自信。

self-aware.t: 有自知之明的；自我觉察的

e.en: A good leader is {self-aware} about weaknesses.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者对自己的弱点有自知之明。

e.en: The film is witty and {self-aware}.
e.zh: 这部电影机智而且带有自我觉察。

e.en: Therapy helped him develop {self-awareness}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他培养了自我意识。

e.en: Her {self-awareness} made the apology more convincing.
e.zh: 她的自知之明让道歉更有说服力。

e.en: He bought a {self-balancing} scooter.
e.zh: 他买了一辆自动平衡滑板车。

e.en: The machine uses a {self-balancing} control system.
e.zh: 这台机器使用自平衡控制系统。

e.en: The coach tried to build her {self-belief}.
e.zh: 教练努力帮她建立自信。

e.en: Strong {self-belief} carried him through the setback.
e.zh: 坚定的自我信念帮助他挺过了挫折。

e.en: The coat has a {self-belt} in matching fabric.
e.zh: 这件外套配有同面料的自带式腰带。

e.en: She tied the {self-belt} loosely at the waist.
e.zh: 她把自系腰带松松地系在腰间。

e.en: Taking the job felt like {self-betrayal}.
e.zh: 接受那份工作让人感觉像是违背本心。

e.en: His silence became a form of {self-betrayal}.
e.zh: 他的沉默成了一种自我背叛。

e.en: The study measured {self-bias} in memory.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了记忆中的自我偏见。

e.en: Investors must watch for {self-bias} after losses.
e.zh: 投资者在亏损后必须警惕自利偏差。

e.en: The powder acts as a {self-binder} when heated.
e.zh: 这种粉末受热后会起到自结合剂的作用。

e.en: Engineers tested a {self-binder} for recycled fibers.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一种用于再生纤维的自黏结材料。

self-access.t: 自主使用；自助访问；自学资料使用权

e.en: The language center offers {self-access} materials for evening study.
e.zh: 语言中心提供可自主使用的资料，方便学生晚上学习。

e.en: Students valued the {self-access} room because it stayed open late.
e.zh: 学生很看重那间自助学习室，因为它开放到很晚。

e.en: His diary was full of {self-accusation} after the failed project.
e.zh: 项目失败后，他的日记里充满了自我指责。

e.en: She rejected endless {self-accusation} and focused on repairing the mistake.
e.zh: 她不再没完没了地自责，而是专注于弥补错误。

e.en: He is a {self-acknowledged} novice in financial planning.
e.zh: 他自己承认在理财规划方面是个新手。

e.en: The essay came from a {self-acknowledged} admirer of the poet.
e.zh: 这篇文章出自一位自认仰慕那位诗人的作者之手。

self-acting.t: 自动运作的；自行作用的

e.en: The machine uses a {self-acting} valve to control pressure.
e.zh: 这台机器使用自动阀门来控制压力。

e.en: Victorian engineers admired {self-acting} mechanisms that needed little attention.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的工程师欣赏那种无需太多看管的自动机构。

e.en: The software allows {self-activation} after the user enters a code.
e.zh: 用户输入代码后，软件可以自动激活。

e.en: Researchers studied {self-activation} in immune cells after infection.
e.zh: 研究人员研究感染后免疫细胞的自我激活过程。

e.en: The teacher encouraged {self-activity} instead of passive listening.
e.zh: 老师鼓励学生自主活动，而不是被动听讲。

e.en: The compound showed weak {self-activity} in the laboratory test.
e.zh: 这种化合物在实验室测试中表现出较弱的自身活性。

self-actualization.t: 自我实现；发挥个人潜能

e.en: For her, {self-actualization} meant choosing work that matched her values.
e.zh: 对她来说，自我实现意味着选择符合自己价值观的工作。

e.en: The course links creativity with {self-actualization} and emotional growth.
e.zh: 这门课程把创造力同自我实现和情感成长联系起来。

self-actualize.t: 实现自我；发挥自身潜能

e.en: He hoped to {self-actualize} through art rather than corporate success.
e.zh: 他希望通过艺术实现自我，而不是靠职场成功。

e.en: The program helps young adults {self-actualize} by setting personal goals.
e.zh: 这个项目通过设定个人目标，帮助年轻人发挥自身潜能。

self-actualized.t: 已实现自我的；充分发挥潜能的

e.en: She seemed calm, confident, and {self-actualized} in her later years.
e.zh: 晚年的她显得平静、自信，像是已经实现了自我。

e.en: The book describes a {self-actualized} person as creative and independent.
e.zh: 这本书把充分实现自我的人描述为有创造力且独立。

e.en: Please include a {self-addressed} envelope with your application.
e.zh: 请在申请材料中附上一个写有自己地址的信封。

e.en: The clerk returned the documents in the {self-addressed} package.
e.zh: 办事员把文件装进写有申请人地址的包裹寄回。

e.en: Use a {self-adhesive} label on each storage box.
e.zh: 在每个储物箱上贴一张自粘标签。

e.en: The bandage is {self-adhesive}, so you do not need tape.
e.zh: 这种绷带是自粘的，所以不需要胶带。

self-adjusting.t: 自动调节的；自我调整的

e.en: The chair has a {self-adjusting} backrest for better support.
e.zh: 这把椅子有自动调节的靠背，支撑效果更好。

e.en: A healthy market is partly {self-adjusting} when demand changes.
e.zh: 当需求变化时，健康的市场在一定程度上会自我调整。

self-administrations.t: 自行给药；自我管理行为

e.en: The trial recorded all insulin {self-administrations} in a digital diary.
e.zh: 试验把所有自行注射胰岛素的记录都写入了电子日记。

e.en: Repeated {self-administrations} of the drug raised safety concerns.
e.zh: 反复自行使用这种药物引发了安全方面的担忧。

e.en: His speech drifted into obvious {self-admiration}.
e.zh: 他的演讲渐渐变成了明显的自我欣赏。

e.en: A little {self-admiration} can be harmless after a hard victory.
e.zh: 艰难取胜之后，稍微自我欣赏一下也无伤大雅。

self-admitted.t: 自己承认的；自行入院的

e.en: The witness was a {self-admitted} liar with a weak memory.
e.zh: 这名证人自己承认说过谎，而且记忆并不可靠。

e.en: He was {self-admitted} to the clinic after a panic attack.
e.zh: 他在一次惊恐发作后自行住进了诊所。

self-advancement.t: 自我提升；谋求个人进步

e.en: She saw night classes as a path to {self-advancement}.
e.zh: 她把夜校课程看作自我提升的一条路。

e.en: The manager mistook ambition for selfish {self-advancement}.
e.zh: 经理把抱负误解成了自私地谋求个人升迁。

self-affected.t: 自受影响的；矫揉造作的

e.en: The system includes a {self-affected} feedback loop that changes its output.
e.zh: 这个系统包含一个会影响自身输出的反馈回路。

e.en: His {self-affected} manner made the interview feel theatrical.
e.zh: 他矫揉造作的举止让面试显得像在演戏。

e.en: Daily {self-affirmation} helped her face criticism with more confidence.
e.zh: 每天的自我肯定帮助她更有信心地面对批评。

e.en: The protest became an act of cultural {self-affirmation}.
e.zh: 这场抗议成了一种文化自我确认的行动。

self-aggrandizing.t: 自我吹嘘的；抬高自己的

e.en: The memoir sounded {self-aggrandizing} rather than honest.
e.zh: 这本回忆录听起来像是在自我吹嘘，而不是真诚叙述。

e.en: He avoided {self-aggrandizing} claims during the campaign.
e.zh: 竞选期间，他避免发表抬高自己的言论。

e.en: The device performs {self-alignment} before taking measurements.
e.zh: 设备在测量前会进行自动对齐。

e.en: Her coaching focuses on {self-alignment} between values and daily habits.
e.zh: 她的辅导重点是让个人价值观与日常习惯保持一致。

e.en: The novel is full of sharp {self-analysis}.
e.zh: 这部小说充满了犀利的自我剖析。

e.en: After the argument, he tried {self-analysis} instead of blame.
e.zh: 争吵之后，他尝试自我分析，而不是责怪别人。

self-analytical.t: 善于自我分析的；自省式的

e.en: Her letters are unusually {self-analytical} for such a young writer.
e.zh: 以这样年轻的作者来说，她的信件异常善于自我分析。

e.en: A {self-analytical} leader can admit mistakes before others point them out.
e.zh: 善于自省的领导者能在别人指出前承认错误。

e.en: The alloy showed {self-annealing} after several hours at room temperature.
e.zh: 这种合金在室温下放置数小时后表现出自退火现象。

e.en: Engineers designed a {self-annealing} material for tiny circuit defects.
e.zh: 工程师设计了一种能自行修复微小电路缺陷的材料。

e.en: The poem imagines love as a form of {self-annihilation}.
e.zh: 这首诗把爱情想象成一种自我毁灭。

e.en: In physics, {self-annihilation} can describe particles destroying themselves in pairs.
e.zh: 在物理学中，自我湮灭可指粒子成对相互湮灭。

self-applauding.t: 自我喝彩的；自鸣得意的

e.en: The article ended with a {self-applauding} note about the company's courage.
e.zh: 文章结尾自鸣得意地赞扬了公司的勇气。

e.en: He gave a {self-applauding} laugh after explaining his clever plan.
e.zh: 解释完自己的聪明计划后，他得意地笑了起来。

self-blimped.t: 自我膨胀的；自大的感觉膨胀

e.en: His {self-blimped} confidence annoyed the whole team.
e.zh: 他那种自我膨胀的信心让整个团队都很反感。

e.en: The essay mocked a {self-blimped} sense of importance.
e.zh: 这篇文章讽刺了一种自以为重要的膨胀感。

self-blinded.t: 自我蒙蔽的；故意不看事实的

e.en: She was {self-blinded} to the risks of the plan.
e.zh: 她对这个计划的风险自我蒙蔽。

e.en: A {self-blinded} leader ignores every warning sign.
e.zh: 一个自我蒙蔽的领导会无视所有警告信号。

e.en: The myth describes a {self-born} god emerging from darkness.
e.zh: 这个神话描写一位自生的神从黑暗中出现。

e.en: He called the idea {self-born}, needing no outside cause.
e.zh: 他说这个想法是自行产生的，不需要外部原因。

e.en: They bought land for a {self-build} project.
e.zh: 他们买地是为了做一个自建房项目。

e.en: A {self-build} home can take years to finish.
e.zh: 一套自行建造的房子可能要几年才能完工。

self-builder.t: 自建房者；自己施工的人

e.en: The {self-builder} managed most of the work alone.
e.zh: 这位自建房者独自处理了大部分工程。

e.en: Every {self-builder} must understand local planning rules.
e.zh: 每个自己建房的人都必须了解当地规划规定。

e.en: He lives in a {self-built} wooden cabin.
e.zh: 他住在一间自己建造的木屋里。

e.en: The robot used a {self-built} navigation system.
e.zh: 这个机器人使用了一套自制导航系统。

self-buried.t: 自我埋没的；自己掩埋的

e.en: Her talent remained {self-buried} for many years.
e.zh: 她的才华多年里一直被自己埋没。

e.en: The file was {self-buried} under layers of folders.
e.zh: 这个文件被自己层层放进文件夹深处。

e.en: The sensor measures {self-capacitance} at each touch point.
e.zh: 传感器会测量每个触点的自电容。

e.en: High {self-capacitance} can affect the circuit response.
e.zh: 较高的自身电容会影响电路响应。

e.en: Regular sleep is part of good {self-care}.
e.zh: 规律睡眠是良好自我照护的一部分。

e.en: After surgery, patients learn basic {self-care} at home.
e.zh: 手术后，患者会学习在家进行基本自我护理。

self-catering.t: 可自己做饭的；自炊式的

e.en: We rented a {self-catering} apartment by the sea.
e.zh: 我们在海边租了一套可自己做饭的公寓。

e.en: The price includes {self-catering}, not hotel meals.
e.zh: 这个价格包含自炊式住宿，不含酒店餐食。

e.en: Fear of criticism led to quiet {self-censorship}.
e.zh: 害怕批评导致了悄然的自我审查。

e.en: Writers sometimes practice {self-censorship} before publication.
e.zh: 作家有时会在出版前进行自我删改。

self-centered.t: 以自我为中心的；自私的

e.en: He sounded {self-centered} during the whole conversation.
e.zh: 整场谈话中他听起来都很以自我为中心。

e.en: A {self-centered} decision hurt the rest of the family.
e.zh: 一个自私的决定伤害了家里其他人。

self-centering.t: 自动回中的；自我居中的

e.en: The steering wheel has a {self-centering} mechanism.
e.zh: 方向盘带有自动回中机构。

e.en: The app uses {self-centering} text on the screen.
e.zh: 这个应用在屏幕上使用自动居中的文字。

self-centred.t: 以自我为中心的；自私的

e.en: She seemed {self-centred} in her early interviews.
e.zh: 她在早期采访中显得很以自我为中心。

e.en: His {self-centred} attitude made teamwork difficult.
e.zh: 他自私的态度让团队合作变得困难。

e.en: Her {self-centredness} became obvious during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间，她的自我中心变得很明显。

e.en: The novel gently satirizes middle-class {self-centredness}.
e.zh: 这部小说温和地讽刺了中产阶级的自私自利。

self-centring.t: 自动回中的；自我居中的

e.en: The {self-centring} valve returns to its neutral position.
e.zh: 这个自动回中的阀门会回到中立位置。

e.en: Use {self-centring} alignment for the title block.
e.zh: 标题区请使用自动居中对齐。

e.en: Do a quick {self-check} before submitting the form.
e.zh: 提交表格前先快速自我检查一下。

e.en: The machine runs a {self-check} when it starts.
e.zh: 机器启动时会运行一次自检。

self-checking.t: 自我检查的；自动校验的

e.en: The guide includes {self-checking} questions after each chapter.
e.zh: 这本指南每章后都有自我检查题。

e.en: The device has a {self-checking} safety system.
e.zh: 这台设备带有自动校验安全系统。

e.en: I used the {self-checkout} lane for two items.
e.zh: 我买两样东西时用了自助结账通道。

e.en: The store added more {self-checkout} machines this year.
e.zh: 这家商店今年增加了更多自助收银机。

self-chutter.t: 自言自语地咕哝；低声碎念

e.en: He began to {self-chutter} while fixing the old radio.
e.zh: 他修那台旧收音机时开始低声自言自语。

e.en: Her nervous {self-chutter} filled the quiet room.
e.zh: 她紧张的低声碎念充满了安静的房间。

e.en: The oven has a {self-cleaning} mode.
e.zh: 这台烤箱有自动清洁模式。

e.en: Scientists developed a {self-cleaning} glass coating.
e.zh: 科学家开发出一种自洁玻璃涂层。

e.en: Install a {self-closing} gate near the pool.
e.zh: 在泳池旁安装一扇自动关闭的门。

e.en: The code uses a {self-closing} tag here.
e.zh: 这段代码在这里使用了自闭合标签。

self-collected.t: 自己收集的；镇定自持的

e.en: The report is based on {self-collected} survey data.
e.zh: 这份报告基于自己收集的调查数据。

e.en: Despite the pressure, she remained {self-collected}.
e.zh: 尽管压力很大，她仍然镇定自持。

e.en: The jacket has {self-colored} buttons and stitching.
e.zh: 这件夹克配有同色纽扣和缝线。

e.en: A {self-colored} fabric looks plain but elegant.
e.zh: 单色面料看起来朴素但很优雅。

e.en: The artist let the clay keep its {self-colour}.
e.zh: 艺术家让黏土保留自身颜色。

e.en: This wool has a warm natural {self-colour}.
e.zh: 这种羊毛有一种温暖的天然本色。

e.en: The fabric was {self-coloured}, with no printed pattern.
e.zh: 这块布是纯本色的，没有印花图案。

e.en: She chose a {self-coloured} ribbon to match the dress.
e.zh: 她选了一条同色缎带来配那件裙子。

e.en: He showed remarkable {self-command} under pressure.
e.zh: 他在压力下表现出非凡的自制力。

e.en: Years of practice had taught her {self-command}.
e.zh: 多年的练习让她学会了克制自己。

e.en: The retreat gave him time for {self-communion}.
e.zh: 那次静修让他有时间进行自我沉思。

e.en: Her poems often turn inward toward {self-communion}.
e.zh: 她的诗常常转向内心的自我对话。

e.en: The theory requires strict {self-compatibility} between its claims.
e.zh: 这个理论要求各项主张之间严格自相容。

e.en: Engineers tested the system for {self-compatibility}.
e.zh: 工程师测试了该系统的自身兼容性。

e.en: The rules must be {self-compatible} before we apply them.
e.zh: 这些规则在应用前必须自相容。

e.en: This device is {self-compatible} across its own modules.
e.zh: 这台设备在自身模块之间是兼容的。

e.en: His {self-complacence} made criticism impossible.
e.zh: 他的自满让任何批评都难以进行。

e.en: The essay warns against national {self-complacence}.
e.zh: 这篇文章警告人们不要陷入民族自满。

e.en: Success can breed dangerous {self-complacency}.
e.zh: 成功可能滋生危险的自满情绪。

e.en: Her smile had a trace of {self-complacency}.
e.zh: 她的笑容里带着一丝自我满足。

e.en: The manager sounded {self-complacent} after the easy win.
e.zh: 轻松获胜后，经理听起来有些自鸣得意。

e.en: A {self-complacent} attitude can hide serious problems.
e.zh: 自满的态度可能掩盖严重问题。

self-composed.t: 镇定自若的；自我克制的

e.en: She remained {self-composed} during the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试中始终镇定自若。

e.en: His {self-composed} manner calmed the anxious team.
e.zh: 他沉着克制的态度安抚了焦虑的团队。

e.en: Her {self-composedness} impressed the judges.
e.zh: 她的沉着自持给评委留下了深刻印象。

e.en: He lost his usual {self-composedness} for a moment.
e.zh: 他一时失去了平日的镇定。

e.en: His {self-conceit} annoyed everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他的自负惹恼了屋里的每个人。

e.en: The novel mocks the hero's {self-conceit}.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了主人公的自以为是。

e.en: He was too {self-conceited} to accept advice.
e.zh: 他太自负了，听不进建议。

e.en: Her letters reveal a {self-conceited} young artist.
e.zh: 她的信件显露出一个自命不凡的年轻艺术家。

e.en: A child's {self-concept} develops through family and school.
e.zh: 孩子的自我概念会在家庭和学校中形成。

e.en: Therapy helped him rebuild a healthier {self-concept}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他重建了更健康的自我认知。

e.en: Her {self-conception} changed after becoming a parent.
e.zh: 成为父母后，她的自我认识发生了变化。

e.en: The book studies national {self-conception} after war.
e.zh: 这本书研究战后国家的自我观念。

e.en: People's {self-conceptions} often shift with age.
e.zh: 人们的自我认识常会随年龄而变化。

e.en: The survey compared different cultural {self-conceptions}.
e.zh: 这项调查比较了不同文化中的自我观念。

e.en: His decision showed more {self-concern} than loyalty.
e.zh: 他的决定体现的更多是利己心，而不是忠诚。

e.en: Some {self-concern} is necessary for personal boundaries.
e.zh: 一定程度的自我关切对个人边界是必要的。

self-concerned.t: 只顾自己的；自我关切的

e.en: He seemed {self-concerned} when others needed help.
e.zh: 别人需要帮助时，他显得只顾自己。

e.en: A {self-concerned} response is not always selfish.
e.zh: 出于自我关切的回应并不总是自私的。

e.en: He felt {self-condemned} after betraying his friend.
e.zh: 背叛朋友后，他感到深深自责。

e.en: The confession left him effectively {self-condemned}.
e.zh: 那份供认实际上让他自我定罪了。

e.en: He is a {self-confessed} coffee addict.
e.zh: 他自称是个咖啡成瘾者。

e.en: The {self-confessed} thief returned the money.
e.zh: 那个自己承认偷窃的人归还了钱。

e.en: Recovery began with honest {self-confrontation}.
e.zh: 康复始于诚实地面对自己。

e.en: The film turns grief into a scene of {self-confrontation}.
e.zh: 这部电影把悲伤转化为一场自我对质。

e.en: The team exchanged {self-congratulations} after the launch.
e.zh: 发布之后，团队成员相互也带着自我祝贺。

e.en: His speech was full of {self-congratulations}.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了自鸣得意的内容。

self-congratulatory.t: 自我庆贺的；自鸣得意的

e.en: The report sounded oddly {self-congratulatory}.
e.zh: 这份报告听起来奇怪地自鸣得意。

e.en: They avoided a {self-congratulatory} tone in the announcement.
e.zh: 他们在公告中避免了自我庆贺的语气。

e.en: The novel explores several competing {self-consciousnesses}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了几种相互竞争的自我意识。

e.en: Their teenage {self-consciousnesses} made every silence awkward.
e.zh: 他们青春期的拘谨让每次沉默都显得尴尬。

e.en: He spoke with unbearable {self-consequence}.
e.zh: 他说话时带着令人难忍的自大感。

e.en: Her air of {self-consequence} faded after the mistake.
e.zh: 犯错之后，她那种自以为了不起的神气消退了。

e.en: The explanation is logical and {self-consistent}.
e.zh: 这个解释合乎逻辑，而且前后一致。

e.en: A model can be {self-consistent} but still wrong.
e.zh: 一个模型可以是自洽的，但仍然是错的。

e.en: The {self-constituted} committee issued rules without approval.
e.zh: 这个自行组成的委员会未经批准就发布了规则。

e.en: He acted as a {self-constituted} guardian of public morals.
e.zh: 他以自封的公共道德守护者身份行事。

e.en: Her anger became a {self-consuming} force.
e.zh: 她的愤怒变成了一种自我消耗的力量。

e.en: The regime followed a {self-consuming} policy of endless purges.
e.zh: 该政权奉行无休止清洗的自毁性政策。

self-contained.t: 自成一体的；独立完备的

e.en: Each lesson is a {self-contained} unit.
e.zh: 每一课都是一个独立完备的单元。

e.en: They rented a {self-contained} apartment near campus.
e.zh: 他们在校园附近租了一套设施齐全的独立公寓。

e.en: The chapter works {self-containedly} as a short essay.
e.zh: 这一章本身就能作为一篇短文独立成立。

e.en: The program runs {self-containedly} without external libraries.
e.zh: 这个程序无需外部库也能独立运行。

self-containedness.t: 自成一体性；独立完备性

e.en: The design values {self-containedness} over flexibility.
e.zh: 这个设计更看重独立完备性，而不是灵活性。

e.en: Her prose has a quiet {self-containedness}.
e.zh: 她的散文有一种安静的自足感。

e.en: His calm showed remarkable {self-containment}.
e.zh: 他的冷静显示出惊人的自我克制。

e.en: The module was praised for its {self-containment}.
e.zh: 这个模块因自成一体而受到称赞。

e.en: Poor lab habits can cause {self-contamination}.
e.zh: 不良的实验习惯可能导致自身污染。

e.en: The argument suffers from {self-contamination} by its own assumptions.
e.zh: 这个论证被自身假设污染，因而站不稳。

e.en: The retreat encouraged quiet {self-contemplation}.
e.zh: 这次静修鼓励人们安静地自我沉思。

e.en: His poems turn grief into {self-contemplation}.
e.zh: 他的诗把悲伤转化为自我观照。

e.en: Her diary records many private {self-contemplations}.
e.zh: 她的日记记录了许多私密的自我沉思。

e.en: The book gathers his late {self-contemplations} on aging.
e.zh: 这本书汇集了他晚年关于衰老的自我观照。

e.en: Failure filled him with {self-contempt}.
e.zh: 失败让他充满了自我鄙视。

e.en: Her jokes hid a deep {self-contempt}.
e.zh: 她的玩笑掩盖着深深的自轻自贱。

e.en: He gave a {self-contemptuous} laugh after the mistake.
e.zh: 犯错后，他发出一声自我鄙视的笑。

e.en: The letter has a bitter, {self-contemptuous} tone.
e.zh: 这封信带着苦涩而自轻的语气。

e.en: She lived in quiet {self-content}.
e.zh: 她安静地生活在自我满足之中。

e.en: His {self-content} sometimes looked like indifference.
e.zh: 他的安于自身有时看起来像冷漠。

self-contented.t: 自得其乐的；自我满足的

e.en: The cat looked perfectly {self-contented} by the window.
e.zh: 那只猫在窗边显得完全自得其乐。

e.en: He was too {self-contented} to seek promotion.
e.zh: 他太自我满足了，不愿争取升职。

e.en: She smiled {self-contentedly} after finishing the puzzle.
e.zh: 拼完拼图后，她自得其乐地笑了。

e.en: He sat {self-contentedly} in the warm kitchen.
e.zh: 他心满意足地坐在温暖的厨房里。

e.en: His {self-contentedness} made criticism useless.
e.zh: 他的自我满足让批评变得毫无用处。

e.en: There was a gentle {self-contentedness} in her smile.
e.zh: 她的笑容里有一种温和的自得其乐。

e.en: The statement contains a clear {self-contradiction}.
e.zh: 这句话包含明显的自相矛盾。

e.en: Modern life often feels like a {self-contradiction}.
e.zh: 现代生活常常让人觉得充满内在矛盾。

e.en: The report is full of {self-contradictions}.
e.zh: 这份报告充满了自相矛盾之处。

e.en: Good fiction can expose a character's {self-contradictions}.
e.zh: 好的小说能揭示人物内心的矛盾。

e.en: His explanation was {self-contradictory}.
e.zh: 他的解释自相矛盾。

e.en: The policy sends a {self-contradictory} message.
e.zh: 这项政策传递出自相矛盾的信息。

e.en: It takes {self-control} to ignore the insult.
e.zh: 要无视这种侮辱需要自制力。

e.en: Children gradually learn {self-control} through routine.
e.zh: 孩子们会通过日常习惯逐渐学会自我控制。

e.en: She remained {self-controlled} during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间她一直保持克制。

e.en: His voice was calm and {self-controlled}.
e.zh: 他的声音平静而有自制力。

e.en: The engine is {self-cooled} by circulating oil.
e.zh: 这台发动机通过循环机油自行冷却。

e.en: They installed a {self-cooled} reactor design.
e.zh: 他们安装了一种自冷却反应堆设计。

self-correcting.t: 自我修正的；自动纠错的

e.en: Science is a {self-correcting} process.
e.zh: 科学是一个自我修正的过程。

e.en: The keyboard has a {self-correcting} feature.
e.zh: 这个键盘有自动纠错功能。

e.en: Her draft included several {self-corrections}.
e.zh: 她的草稿里有几处自行更正。

e.en: The transcript preserves the speaker's {self-corrections}.
e.zh: 文字记录保留了说话者的自我修正。

self-corrective.t: 自我纠正的；有纠偏作用的

e.en: The market has some {self-corrective} mechanisms.
e.zh: 市场有一些自我纠正机制。

e.en: Honest feedback can be {self-corrective}.
e.zh: 坦诚的反馈可以起到纠偏作用。

e.en: She is unusually {self-critical} about her work.
e.zh: 她对自己的工作格外自我批评。

e.en: A {self-critical} culture can improve decisions.
e.zh: 一种自省的文化能改善决策。

e.en: Her report included honest {self-criticism} about the failed launch.
e.zh: 她的报告中对发布失败作了坦诚的自我批评。

e.en: Too much {self-criticism} can damage your confidence.
e.zh: 过度自我批评会伤害你的自信。

e.en: Victorian writers often praised {self-culture} through reading.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的作家常赞扬通过阅读进行自我修养。

e.en: He saw music as a path to {self-culture}.
e.zh: 他把音乐看作自我陶冶的一条途径。

e.en: The director was accused of {self-dealing} in the merger.
e.zh: 那名董事被指在并购中进行自我交易。

e.en: Strict rules prevent {self-dealing} by public officials.
e.zh: 严格规定防止公职人员谋取私利。

e.en: His optimism had become a form of {self-deceit}.
e.zh: 他的乐观已经变成了一种自欺。

e.en: The memoir exposes years of private {self-deceit}.
e.zh: 这本回忆录揭露了多年的个人自我欺骗。

e.en: She was {self-deceived} about his real intentions.
e.zh: 她对他的真实意图一直自欺。

e.en: A {self-deceived} leader ignores every warning sign.
e.zh: 受自我蒙蔽的领导者会忽视每一个警讯。

e.en: His {self-deceiving} excuses fooled no one else.
e.zh: 他那些自欺的借口骗不了别人。

e.en: It is {self-deceiving} to call the delay harmless.
e.zh: 把这次延误说成无害，是在欺骗自己。

e.en: Denial is a common form of {self-deception}.
e.zh: 否认是一种常见的自我欺骗。

e.en: The policy rested on dangerous {self-deception}.
e.zh: 这项政策建立在危险的自欺之上。

e.en: That argument is emotionally comforting but {self-deceptive}.
e.zh: 那个论点在情感上让人安心，却带有自欺性。

e.en: He gave a {self-deceptive} account of his addiction.
e.zh: 他对自己的成瘾作了欺骗自己的描述。

e.en: The {self-declared} expert had no formal training.
e.zh: 这位自称的专家没有受过正规训练。

e.en: A {self-declared} ceasefire began at midnight.
e.zh: 一项自行宣布的停火在午夜开始。

self-defeating.t: 弄巧成拙的；适得其反的

e.en: Refusing help was a {self-defeating} choice.
e.zh: 拒绝帮助是个弄巧成拙的选择。

e.en: The company adopted a {self-defeating} pricing strategy.
e.zh: 公司采取了一种适得其反的定价策略。

e.en: She took a course in {self-defence}.
e.zh: 她上了一门自卫课程。

e.en: The lawyer argued that he acted in {self-defence}.
e.zh: 律师辩称他是出于正当防卫。

e.en: He sounded {self-defensive} when questioned about the mistake.
e.zh: 被问到这个错误时，他听起来很戒备。

e.en: Her {self-defensive} tone made discussion difficult.
e.zh: 她自我防卫的语气让讨论变得困难。

self-defined.t: 自我定义的；自行界定的

e.en: Success is {self-defined} in this program.
e.zh: 在这个项目中，成功由个人自行界定。

e.en: The group followed a {self-defined} code of ethics.
e.zh: 这个团体遵循一套自我定义的道德准则。

e.en: Language became central to her {self-definition}.
e.zh: 语言成了她自我定位的核心。

e.en: The movement struggled over its political {self-definition}.
e.zh: 这场运动在政治自我定义上陷入争论。

self-deluded.t: 自我蒙蔽的；妄自欺骗的

e.en: Only a {self-deluded} manager would ignore those numbers.
e.zh: 只有自我蒙蔽的经理才会无视那些数字。

e.en: He remained {self-deluded} about his chances of winning.
e.zh: 他对自己获胜的机会仍然妄自欺骗。

e.en: Her confidence bordered on {self-delusion}.
e.zh: 她的自信几乎成了自欺妄想。

e.en: The scandal revealed a culture of {self-delusion}.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻暴露出一种集体自我蒙蔽的文化。

e.en: Engineers measured {self-demagnetization} in the permanent magnet.
e.zh: 工程师测量了永磁体中的自退磁现象。

e.en: The design reduces {self-demagnetization} under heavy load.
e.zh: 该设计降低了重载下的自我消磁。

e.en: Monastic life demanded strict {self-denial}.
e.zh: 修道生活要求严格克己。

e.en: His silence was an act of {self-denial}.
e.zh: 他的沉默是一种自我否认。

e.en: She led a {self-denying} life of service.
e.zh: 她过着克己奉献的生活。

e.en: His {self-denying} generosity impressed the whole village.
e.zh: 他自我牺牲式的慷慨打动了全村人。

e.en: He {self-denyingly} gave the prize money away.
e.zh: 他克己地把奖金捐了出去。

e.en: She worked {self-denyingly} for her younger siblings.
e.zh: 她为弟妹自我牺牲地工作。

e.en: The essay praises {self-dependence} over inherited privilege.
e.zh: 这篇文章赞扬独立自主，而不是继承来的特权。

e.en: Years alone taught him practical {self-dependence}.
e.zh: 多年的独处教会了他实际的自我依靠。

e.en: She opened the speech with a {self-deprecating} joke.
e.zh: 她用一个自嘲的笑话开始演讲。

e.en: His {self-deprecating} manner hid real ambition.
e.zh: 他自我贬低的态度掩盖了真正的野心。

e.en: British comedy often relies on {self-deprecation}.
e.zh: 英国喜剧常常依靠自嘲。

e.en: Constant {self-deprecation} made her achievements seem smaller.
e.zh: 不断自我贬低让她的成就显得不那么重要。

self-derived.t: 自我衍生的；自身得出的

e.en: The theory used a {self-derived} set of rules.
e.zh: 这个理论使用了一套自身得出的规则。

e.en: Some cells produce {self-derived} signals during repair.
e.zh: 一些细胞在修复过程中产生自我衍生的信号。

e.en: A {self-described} beginner solved the puzzle quickly.
e.zh: 一位自称初学者的人很快解出了谜题。

e.en: The artist is a {self-described} outsider.
e.zh: 这位艺术家自称是局外人。

self-descriptions.t: 自我描述；自我介绍说法

e.en: Their {self-descriptions} sounded more confident than their actions.
e.zh: 他们的自我描述听起来比实际行动更自信。

e.en: The survey compared students' {self-descriptions} with teacher reports.
e.zh: 这项调查把学生的自我描述与教师报告作了比较。

e.en: Her {self-designation} as an outsider shaped the memoir.
e.zh: 她自称局外人的身份塑造了这本回忆录。

e.en: The group's {self-designation} changed after the political reforms.
e.zh: 政治改革后，这个群体的自我命名发生了变化。

e.en: His letters reveal a period of {self-despair} and isolation.
e.zh: 他的信件透露出一段自我绝望和孤立的时期。

e.en: Therapy helped her move beyond {self-despair}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她走出了对自身的绝望。

e.en: The message will {self-destruct} after ten seconds.
e.zh: 这条消息会在十秒后自动销毁。

e.en: He seemed determined to {self-destruct} under pressure.
e.zh: 他在压力下似乎执意要自毁前程。

e.en: The file {self-destructed} before investigators could copy it.
e.zh: 调查人员来得及复制前，文件已经自动销毁了。

e.en: His campaign {self-destructed} after several careless remarks.
e.zh: 几次草率发言后，他的竞选活动自毁了。

self-destructing.t: 正在自毁；会自动销毁的

e.en: The app uses {self-destructing} photos for private chats.
e.zh: 这个应用在私密聊天中使用会自动销毁的照片。

e.en: She recognized her {self-destructing} habits too late.
e.zh: 她太晚才意识到自己那些自毁的习惯。

e.en: The device has a built-in {self-destruction} mechanism.
e.zh: 这个装置内置了自动销毁机制。

e.en: Addiction led him toward {self-destruction}.
e.zh: 成瘾把他推向了自我毁灭。

e.en: He needed help with {self-destructive} behavior.
e.zh: 他需要帮助来处理自毁行为。

e.en: Ignoring every warning was a {self-destructive} strategy.
e.zh: 无视所有警告是一种自毁式策略。

e.en: She reacted {self-destructively} to every setback.
e.zh: 她面对每次挫折都以自毁的方式反应。

e.en: The party behaved {self-destructively} during the negotiations.
e.zh: 该党在谈判中表现得近乎自毁。

e.en: The novel explores the hero's {self-destructiveness}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了主人公的自毁倾向。

e.en: Her {self-destructiveness} became clear in stressful situations.
e.zh: 在压力情境中，她的自我伤害性变得很明显。

e.en: The note {self-destructs} once it is opened.
e.zh: 这张便条一打开就会自动销毁。

e.en: The team {self-destructs} whenever expectations rise.
e.zh: 每当外界期待升高，这支队伍就会自毁局面。

e.en: The movement demanded national {self-determination}.
e.zh: 这场运动要求民族自决。

e.en: She valued {self-determination} in choosing her career.
e.zh: 她很看重在职业选择上的自主决定权。

e.en: The plan was entirely {self-determined}.
e.zh: 这个计划完全是自主决定的。

e.en: He was a {self-determined} student who rarely needed reminders.
e.zh: 他是个很有主见的学生，很少需要别人提醒。

self-determining.t: 自主决定的；自我决定的

e.en: The region sought a {self-determining} political status.
e.zh: 该地区寻求一种自主决定的政治地位。

e.en: Adults are usually treated as {self-determining} agents.
e.zh: 成年人通常被视为能够自我决定的主体。

self-determinism.t: 自我决定论；自主决定观

e.en: The essay defends {self-determinism} against strict fatalism.
e.zh: 这篇文章为自我决定论辩护，反对严格宿命论。

e.en: His politics combined nationalism with {self-determinism}.
e.zh: 他的政治理念把民族主义与自主决定观结合在一起。

e.en: The company encourages {self-development} through online courses.
e.zh: 公司鼓励员工通过在线课程实现自我发展。

e.en: Travel became part of her {self-development}.
e.zh: 旅行成了她个人成长的一部分。

self-devotedness.t: 自我奉献精神；忘我投入

e.en: His {self-devotedness} impressed everyone at the shelter.
e.zh: 他在收容所里的忘我奉献精神打动了所有人。

e.en: The biography praises her quiet {self-devotedness}.
e.zh: 这本传记赞扬了她低调的自我奉献精神。

e.en: Her {self-devotion} to science left little time for leisure.
e.zh: 她对科学的专心投入让她几乎没有闲暇。

e.en: The community depended on his {self-devotion}.
e.zh: 这个社区依靠他的自我奉献维系运转。

e.en: The model describes {self-diffusion} in a liquid.
e.zh: 这个模型描述了液体中的自扩散现象。

e.en: The poem suggests a mystical {self-diffusion} into nature.
e.zh: 这首诗暗示一种神秘的自我弥散，融入自然之中。

e.en: The course is designed for {self-directed} learners.
e.zh: 这门课程是为自主学习者设计的。

e.en: His anger was mostly {self-directed}.
e.zh: 他的愤怒主要是冲着自己来的。

e.en: Battery {self-discharge} increases in hot weather.
e.zh: 炎热天气会加快电池自放电。

e.en: The patient requested {self-discharge} against medical advice.
e.zh: 这名病人不顾医嘱要求自行出院。

e.en: Trust often grows through careful {self-disclosure}.
e.zh: 信任往往通过谨慎的自我表露逐渐建立。

e.en: The interview required more {self-disclosure} than she expected.
e.zh: 这次访谈需要透露的私事比她预想的更多。

e.en: College was a time of {self-discovery} for him.
e.zh: 大学时期是他认识自我的阶段。

e.en: The journey became an exercise in {self-discovery}.
e.zh: 这趟旅程变成了一次自我发现的过程。

e.en: The speech felt more like {self-display} than leadership.
e.zh: 这场演讲更像是在炫耀自己，而不是展现领导力。

e.en: Social media encourages constant {self-display}.
e.zh: 社交媒体鼓励人们不断进行自我展示。

self-dissatisfaction.t: 自我不满；对自己不满意

e.en: Her {self-dissatisfaction} pushed her to practice harder.
e.zh: 她对自己的不满促使她更加努力练习。

e.en: Constant {self-dissatisfaction} can damage mental health.
e.zh: 长期对自己不满意会损害心理健康。

self-distrust.t: 对自己的不信任；自我怀疑

e.en: His {self-distrust} made every decision painfully slow.
e.zh: 他对自己的不信任让每个决定都变得异常缓慢。

e.en: The essay explores {self-distrust} in young artists.
e.zh: 这篇文章探讨年轻艺术家的自我怀疑。

self-distrustful.t: 不相信自己的；自我怀疑的

e.en: She became {self-distrustful} after the public criticism.
e.zh: 受到公开批评后，她变得不相信自己。

e.en: His {self-distrustful} tone weakened the proposal.
e.zh: 他自我怀疑的语气削弱了这项提案的说服力。

e.en: She overcame her {self-doubt} before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前，她克服了自己的自我怀疑。

e.en: A little {self-doubt} can make a writer revise carefully.
e.zh: 一点自我怀疑会让作家更认真地修改。

self-dramatization.t: 自我戏剧化；夸张表现自己

e.en: His memoir is full of {self-dramatization}.
e.zh: 他的回忆录充满了自我戏剧化的描写。

e.en: The speech avoided {self-dramatization} and sounded sincere.
e.zh: 这次演讲避免了夸张表现自己，听起来很真诚。

e.en: Everyone knew him as a charming {self-dramatizer}.
e.zh: 大家都知道他是个迷人但爱自我戏剧化的人。

e.en: A skilled {self-dramatizer} can turn failure into legend.
e.zh: 擅长自我戏剧化的人能把失败说成传奇。

self-dramatizing.t: 自我戏剧化的；夸张表现自己的

e.en: Her {self-dramatizing} letters annoyed her practical sister.
e.zh: 她那些自我戏剧化的信让务实的姐姐很烦。

e.en: The actor gave a {self-dramatizing} account of his childhood.
e.zh: 那位演员夸张地讲述了自己的童年。

e.en: Her {self-drive} helped her finish the course alone.
e.zh: 她的自我驱动力帮助她独自完成了课程。

e.en: The car has a basic {self-drive} mode for highways.
e.zh: 这辆车有适合高速公路的基础自动驾驶模式。

self-driven.t: 自我驱动的；主动上进的

e.en: We need {self-driven} people who can manage their time.
e.zh: 我们需要能管理好时间、主动上进的人。

e.en: The project uses a {self-driven} robot to map the warehouse.
e.zh: 这个项目用一台自动驱动机器人绘制仓库地图。

e.en: He was a {self-educated} engineer with remarkable skill.
e.zh: 他是一位自学成才、技术出众的工程师。

e.en: Many {self-educated} readers built libraries at home.
e.zh: 许多靠自学的人在家里建立了藏书。

e.en: Her {self-effacement} made colleagues underestimate her influence.
e.zh: 她的谦逊低调让同事低估了她的影响力。

e.en: The poem treats love as an act of {self-effacement}.
e.zh: 这首诗把爱描写成一种自我淡化的行为。

self-effacing.t: 谦逊低调的；不出风头的

e.en: His {self-effacing} humor made the audience trust him.
e.zh: 他谦逊低调的幽默让观众信任他。

e.en: She gave a {self-effacing} smile and changed the subject.
e.zh: 她谦逊地笑了笑，然后换了话题。

e.en: He became the {self-elected} leader of the group.
e.zh: 他成了这个小组自封的领导者。

e.en: The committee was {self-elected} and had no public mandate.
e.zh: 这个委员会是自行选出的，并没有公众授权。

self-employed.t: 个体经营的；自由职业的

e.en: She is {self-employed} and works from home.
e.zh: 她是自由职业者，在家工作。

e.en: Many {self-employed} drivers buy their own insurance.
e.zh: 许多个体经营的司机会自己购买保险。

e.en: {Self-employment} gives him more control over his schedule.
e.zh: 自由职业让他能更好地掌控自己的时间安排。

e.en: The tax rules for {self-employment} can be confusing.
e.zh: 个体经营的税务规则可能让人困惑。

self-energizing.t: 自我激励的；能自行供能的

e.en: The routine is {self-energizing} once it becomes a habit.
e.zh: 一旦成为习惯，这套日常安排就能自我激励。

e.en: Engineers tested a {self-energizing} brake system.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一套能自行供能的制动系统。

self-enforcing.t: 自动执行的；自我约束的

e.en: The agreement is largely {self-enforcing} because both sides benefit.
e.zh: 由于双方都受益，这项协议基本能自动执行。

e.en: A {self-enforcing} rule reduces the need for constant supervision.
e.zh: 一条能自我约束的规则会减少持续监督的需要。

self-engendered.t: 自身产生的；自我造成的

e.en: The crisis was partly {self-engendered} by poor planning.
e.zh: 这场危机部分是糟糕规划自我造成的。

e.en: He mistook his {self-engendered} fear for real danger.
e.zh: 他把自身产生的恐惧误当成了真实危险。

e.en: Reading after work became a form of {self-enrichment}.
e.zh: 下班后阅读成了她自我充实的一种方式。

e.en: Officials were accused of {self-enrichment} through public contracts.
e.zh: 官员被指通过公共合同谋取私利。

e.en: Praise can help build a child's {self-esteem}.
e.zh: 表扬能帮助孩子建立自尊和自信。

e.en: Losing the job damaged his {self-esteem}.
e.zh: 失去那份工作伤害了他的自尊。

e.en: Employees submit {self-evaluations} before the annual review.
e.zh: 员工在年度评估前提交自我评价。

e.en: Her {self-evaluations} were honest but too harsh.
e.zh: 她的自评很诚实，但过于严厉。

self-evident.t: 不言自明的；显而易见的

e.en: The benefits of clean water are {self-evident}.
e.zh: 清洁饮水的好处是不言自明的。

e.en: It was not {self-evident} why the rule mattered.
e.zh: 这条规则为什么重要并不是显而易见的。

e.en: The scandal forced the company into {self-examination}.
e.zh: 这场丑闻迫使公司进行自我反省。

e.en: Regular breast {self-examination} can reveal early changes.
e.zh: 定期乳房自我检查能发现早期变化。

e.en: The course ends with written {self-examinations}.
e.zh: 这门课程以书面自我反省作为结尾。

e.en: Doctors teach patients how to perform {self-examinations}.
e.zh: 医生会教患者如何进行自我检查。

self-examining.t: 自我反省的；自我检查的

e.en: The novel has a quiet, {self-examining} voice.
e.zh: 这部小说有一种安静而自我反省的叙述声音。

e.en: He followed a {self-examining} routine after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后他遵循了一套自我检查的流程。

e.en: The generator failed because of unstable {self-excitation}.
e.zh: 发电机因自激不稳定而发生故障。

e.en: The crowd's noise created a mood of {self-excitation}.
e.zh: 人群的喧闹营造出一种自我兴奋的气氛。

e.en: The {self-excited} circuit began to oscillate without an external signal.
e.zh: 这个自激电路在没有外部信号时开始振荡。

e.en: A {self-excited} vibration can damage the machine over time.
e.zh: 自激振动久而久之会损坏机器。

e.en: The generator uses a {self-exciter} to build its magnetic field.
e.zh: 这台发电机用自励器来建立磁场。

e.en: Engineers replaced the faulty {self-exciter} during maintenance.
e.zh: 工程师在维护时更换了故障的自激装置。

self-executing.t: 自动执行的；自行生效的

e.en: The file contains a {self-executing} script.
e.zh: 这个文件包含一个会自动执行的脚本。

e.en: The treaty was considered {self-executing} under domestic law.
e.zh: 该条约被认为在国内法下可自行生效。

e.en: The writer chose {self-exile} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻之后，这位作家选择了自我流放。

e.en: Years of {self-exile} changed his view of home.
e.zh: 多年的自愿离乡改变了他对故乡的看法。

self-exiled.t: 自我流放的；自愿离乡的

e.en: The {self-exiled} poet lived quietly in Paris.
e.zh: 这位自我流放的诗人在巴黎安静地生活。

e.en: Many {self-exiled} activists continued their work abroad.
e.zh: 许多自愿离乡的活动人士在海外继续工作。

e.en: The philosopher described God as {self-existent}.
e.zh: 这位哲学家把上帝描述为自存的存在。

e.en: No institution is truly {self-existent} without social support.
e.zh: 没有社会支持，任何制度都不可能真正独立存在。

self-explaining.t: 能自我解释的；自动说明的

e.en: The diagram is almost {self-explaining}.
e.zh: 这张图几乎能自己说明问题。

e.en: A {self-explaining} interface reduces the need for training.
e.zh: 能自动说明用法的界面可以减少培训需求。

self-explanatory.t: 不言自明的；一看就懂的

e.en: The title is {self-explanatory}.
e.zh: 这个标题是不言自明的。

e.en: Most buttons in the app are {self-explanatory}.
e.zh: 这个应用里的大多数按钮一看就懂。

e.en: Travel became a form of {self-exploration} for her.
e.zh: 旅行成了她自我探索的一种方式。

e.en: The course encourages honest {self-exploration}.
e.zh: 这门课鼓励学生真诚地认识自己。

e.en: The memoir involved painful {self-exposure}.
e.zh: 这本回忆录包含了令人痛苦的自我暴露。

e.en: The camera supports {self-exposure} control in automatic mode.
e.zh: 这台相机在自动模式下支持自行曝光控制。

e.en: Art gave him a channel for {self-expression}.
e.zh: 艺术给了他一个自我表达的渠道。

e.en: Teenagers often use fashion as {self-expression}.
e.zh: 青少年常常用时尚来表达个性。

self-expressive.t: 善于自我表达的；表现自我的

e.en: She found dance deeply {self-expressive}.
e.zh: 她觉得舞蹈非常能表达自我。

e.en: The school encourages {self-expressive} writing.
e.zh: 学校鼓励学生进行表现自我的写作。

e.en: The carpenter used {self-faced} panels for the cabinet doors.
e.zh: 木匠用同材面层板制作柜门。

e.en: A {self-faced} brick wall needs no extra cladding.
e.zh: 自表面的砖墙不需要额外覆面。

e.en: The printer has a reliable {self-feed} mechanism.
e.zh: 这台打印机有可靠的自动进纸机构。

e.en: Some drills use {self-feed} bits for faster boring.
e.zh: 有些电钻使用自进给钻头来更快钻孔。

self-feeder.t: 自动供料器；自进给装置

e.en: The farm installed a {self-feeder} for the calves.
e.zh: 农场为小牛安装了一台自动喂料器。

e.en: This lathe requires a working {self-feeder}.
e.zh: 这台车床需要一个能正常工作的自进给装置。

self-feeding.t: 自动供料的；自行进食的

e.en: The machine has a {self-feeding} cutting head.
e.zh: 这台机器有一个自动进给的切割头。

e.en: The therapist encouraged {self-feeding} after surgery.
e.zh: 治疗师鼓励患者术后自行进食。

e.en: Some plants reproduce through {self-fertilisation}.
e.zh: 有些植物通过自花受精繁殖。

e.en: The study compared crossbreeding with {self-fertilisation}.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了异交和自体受精。

self-fertility.t: 自体可育性；自花结实性

e.en: The crop's {self-fertility} helps farmers in isolated fields.
e.zh: 这种作物的自花结实性有助于偏远田地里的农民。

e.en: Researchers measured {self-fertility} in several plant varieties.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了几个植物品种的自体可育性。

e.en: Peas can reproduce by {self-fertilization}.
e.zh: 豌豆可以通过自花受精繁殖。

e.en: The biologist studied {self-fertilization} in hermaphroditic animals.
e.zh: 这位生物学家研究雌雄同体动物的自体受精。

e.en: The company plans to {self-finance} the expansion.
e.zh: 公司计划自筹资金进行扩张。

e.en: Few students can {self-finance} an overseas degree.
e.zh: 很少有学生能自行负担海外学位费用。

self-financing.t: 自筹资金的；自行融资的

e.en: The project is largely {self-financing}.
e.zh: 这个项目基本上是自筹资金的。

e.en: They built a {self-financing} community clinic.
e.zh: 他们建立了一家自行融资的社区诊所。

e.en: His apology turned into public {self-flagellation}.
e.zh: 他的道歉变成了公开的自我鞭挞。

e.en: There is no value in endless {self-flagellation}.
e.zh: 无休止的过度自责没有任何意义。

self-flattering.t: 自我吹捧的；自以为是的

e.en: That is a rather {self-flattering} account of events.
e.zh: 那是对这些事件相当自我吹捧的说法。

e.en: He gave a {self-flattering} speech about his leadership.
e.zh: 他发表了一通自我吹捧的领导力演讲。

e.en: Her memoir avoids obvious {self-flattery}.
e.zh: 她的回忆录避免了明显的自我吹捧。

e.en: Calling the plan brilliant was pure {self-flattery}.
e.zh: 把这个计划称为绝妙纯粹是自我奉承。

e.en: Her {self-forgetful} kindness impressed everyone.
e.zh: 她那种忘我的善良打动了所有人。

e.en: In a {self-forgetful} moment, he rushed into danger.
e.zh: 在一个不顾自己的瞬间，他冲进了危险之中。

e.en: She listened {self-forgetfully} to the music.
e.zh: 她忘我地听着音乐。

e.en: He worked {self-forgetfully} for the cause.
e.zh: 他为这项事业不顾自己地工作。

e.en: Her {self-forgetfulness} made her performance moving.
e.zh: 她的忘我让表演格外动人。

e.en: True service requires some {self-forgetfulness}.
e.zh: 真正的服务需要一些不计较自己的心态。

e.en: He smiled {self-forgettingly} at their success.
e.zh: 看到他们成功，他无私地笑了。

e.en: She gave herself {self-forgettingly} to the task.
e.zh: 她忘我地投入到这项任务中。

self-fruitful.t: 自身有成果的；自生结果的

e.en: The idea proved {self-fruitful} over time.
e.zh: 这个想法后来证明自身很有成果。

e.en: Their method was {self-fruitful} without outside help.
e.zh: 他们的方法无需外助也能自行产生效果。

self-fulfilling.t: 自我实现的；因预期成真的

e.en: Fear of failure became a {self-fulfilling} prophecy.
e.zh: 对失败的恐惧变成了自我实现的预言。

e.en: The work felt deeply {self-fulfilling}.
e.zh: 这份工作让人深感自我实现。

e.en: She sought {self-fulfillment} through painting.
e.zh: 她通过绘画追求自我实现。

e.en: Money alone rarely brings {self-fulfillment}.
e.zh: 单靠金钱很少能带来自我满足。

e.en: Teaching gave him a sense of {self-fulfilment}.
e.zh: 教学给了他一种自我实现感。

e.en: The book links freedom with {self-fulfilment}.
e.zh: 这本书把自由与自我满足联系起来。

e.en: The report used {self-generated} survey data.
e.zh: 这份报告使用了自行产生的调查数据。

e.en: A {self-generated} code appeared on the screen.
e.zh: 屏幕上出现了一个自动生成的代码。

self-generating.t: 自我生成的；能自行产生的

e.en: The system is partly {self-generating}.
e.zh: 这个系统在一定程度上能自我生成。

e.en: They described culture as a {self-generating} force.
e.zh: 他们把文化描述为一种自行产生的力量。

e.en: The model allows {self-generation} of text.
e.zh: 这个模型允许文本自行生成。

e.en: Biologists studied the cell's {self-generation} process.
e.zh: 生物学家研究了细胞的自我生成过程。

e.en: He lived by a {self-given} rule.
e.zh: 他按照一条自定的规则生活。

e.en: The title was {self-given}, not official.
e.zh: 这个头衔是自封的，并非官方授予。

e.en: Her {self-giving} love shaped the family.
e.zh: 她无私奉献的爱塑造了这个家庭。

e.en: The speech praised a {self-giving} life.
e.zh: 演讲赞扬了一种献身他人的人生。

e.en: The memoir often slips into {self-glorification}.
e.zh: 这本回忆录常常滑向自我吹捧。

e.en: They rejected art used for {self-glorification}.
e.zh: 他们反对把艺术用于自我美化。

self-glorifying.t: 自我吹捧的；自我美化的

e.en: His {self-glorifying} speech annoyed the audience.
e.zh: 他那番自我吹捧的讲话惹恼了听众。

e.en: The portrait felt less honest than {self-glorifying}.
e.zh: 这幅肖像与其说诚实，不如说是在自我美化。

e.en: The poem warns against {self-glory}.
e.zh: 这首诗告诫人们不要自我夸耀。

e.en: He mistook humility for hidden {self-glory}.
e.zh: 他把谦卑误认为隐藏的自我荣耀。

e.en: The platform introduced rules for {self-governance}.
e.zh: 该平台引入了自我治理的规则。

e.en: Local {self-governance} strengthened public trust.
e.zh: 地方自治管理增强了公众信任。

e.en: The island became largely {self-governed}.
e.zh: 这座岛基本实现了自治。

e.en: A {self-governed} team sets its own priorities.
e.zh: 自我管理的团队会自行确定优先事项。

e.en: They formed a {self-governing} community.
e.zh: 他们组成了一个自治社区。

e.en: The school encourages {self-governing} study groups.
e.zh: 学校鼓励自我管理的学习小组。

e.en: The colony demanded {self-government}.
e.zh: 这个殖民地要求自治。

e.en: Children learn {self-government} through responsibility.
e.zh: 孩子们通过承担责任学习自我管理。

e.en: He pursued pleasure through {self-gratification}.
e.zh: 他通过自我取悦来追求快乐。

e.en: The article criticizes instant {self-gratification}.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评即时的自我满足。

e.en: We took a {self-guided} tour of the museum.
e.zh: 我们在博物馆进行了一次自助式参观。

e.en: The course includes {self-guided} learning modules.
e.zh: 这门课程包含自我引导的学习模块。

e.en: The repair uses a {self-hardening} resin.
e.zh: 这次修补使用了一种自硬化树脂。

e.en: His emotional {self-hardening} worried his friends.
e.zh: 他情感上的自我硬化让朋友们担心。

e.en: The clinic treats teenagers at risk of {self-harm}.
e.zh: 这家诊所治疗有自伤风险的青少年。

e.en: Online posts about {self-harm} need careful handling.
e.zh: 关于自残的网络帖子需要谨慎处理。

e.en: Therapy helped him face his {self-hate}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他面对自己的自我憎恨。

e.en: The novel explores shame and {self-hate}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了羞耻和自厌。

e.en: Small cuts can often {self-heal}.
e.zh: 小伤口通常可以自行愈合。

e.en: The material can {self-heal} after scratches.
e.zh: 这种材料被刮伤后可以自我修复。

e.en: She reads {self-help} books before bed.
e.zh: 她睡前会读一些自助类书籍。

e.en: The group promotes {self-help} among new parents.
e.zh: 这个小组鼓励新手父母互相支持、自我改善。

e.en: The receiver uses a {self-heterodyne} method to measure phase noise.
e.zh: 该接收器使用自差拍方法测量相位噪声。

e.en: A {self-heterodyne} setup can reveal tiny frequency fluctuations.
e.zh: 自外差装置可以显示微小的频率波动。

e.en: His apology felt more like {self-humiliation} than regret.
e.zh: 他的道歉更像是自我羞辱，而不是真正后悔。

e.en: She refused to turn honesty into public {self-humiliation}.
e.zh: 她拒绝把坦诚变成公开的自取其辱。

e.en: He learned {self-hypnosis} to manage chronic pain.
e.zh: 他学习自我催眠来控制慢性疼痛。

e.en: The athlete used {self-hypnosis} before important races.
e.zh: 这名运动员在重要比赛前使用自我催眠。

e.en: In logic, every object is {self-identical}.
e.zh: 在逻辑学中，每个对象都是自身同一的。

e.en: The theory treats consciousness as a {self-identical} process.
e.zh: 该理论把意识视为一个自等同的过程。

self-identification.t: 自我认同；自行表明身份

e.en: The survey relies on voluntary {self-identification}.
e.zh: 这项调查依赖受访者自愿表明身份。

e.en: Teenagers often struggle with {self-identification}.
e.zh: 青少年常常会为自我认同而困惑。

e.en: Many students {self-identify} as bilingual.
e.zh: 许多学生自称会说两种语言。

e.en: Applicants may {self-identify} their ethnic background.
e.zh: 申请人可以自行填写自己的族裔背景。

self-identifying.t: 自我认定的；自行表明的

e.en: The form includes a {self-identifying} gender question.
e.zh: 表格中有一个要求自行表明性别的问题。

e.en: He joined a group of {self-identifying} artists.
e.zh: 他加入了一个自称为艺术家的群体。

e.en: Her {self-identity} changed after moving abroad.
e.zh: 移居国外后，她的自我认同发生了变化。

e.en: The novel explores memory and {self-identity}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨记忆与自我身份。

e.en: Dry hay can {self-ignite} under the wrong conditions.
e.zh: 干草在不当条件下可能会自燃。

e.en: The chemical may {self-ignite} when exposed to air.
e.zh: 这种化学物质接触空气时可能自行点燃。

e.en: The report blamed {self-ignition} for the warehouse fire.
e.zh: 报告认为仓库火灾是由自燃造成的。

e.en: Engineers tested the fuel's {self-ignition} temperature.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种燃料的自燃温度。

e.en: Advertising can affect a teenager's {self-image}.
e.zh: 广告可能影响青少年的自我形象。

e.en: He has a confident {self-image} at work.
e.zh: 他在工作中对自己的评价很自信。

e.en: The film shows a {self-immolating} protester in silence.
e.zh: 影片静静呈现了一名自焚抗议者。

e.en: Her {self-immolating} loyalty harmed her career.
e.zh: 她那种自我牺牲式的忠诚损害了自己的事业。

e.en: The monk's {self-immolation} shocked the world.
e.zh: 那位僧人的自焚震惊了世界。

e.en: The essay criticizes political {self-immolation}.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评政治上的自我牺牲行为。

e.en: Several {self-immolations} occurred during the protests.
e.zh: 抗议期间发生了多起自焚事件。

e.en: Historians documented the {self-immolations} in detail.
e.zh: 历史学家详细记录了这些自焚事件。

e.en: The antenna's {self-impedance} changes with frequency.
e.zh: 天线的自阻抗会随频率变化。

e.en: They calculated the coil's {self-impedance} from measurements.
e.zh: 他们根据测量结果计算线圈的自阻抗。

e.en: His {self-importance} annoyed the whole team.
e.zh: 他的自以为重要让整个团队都很反感。

e.en: The title gave her a sense of {self-importance}.
e.zh: 这个头衔让她产生了一种自负感。

e.en: The manager sounded {self-important} in every meeting.
e.zh: 那位经理在每次会议上都显得妄自尊大。

e.en: He gave a {self-important} little speech.
e.zh: 他发表了一段自以为是的小演讲。

e.en: He spoke {self-importantly} about his minor role.
e.zh: 他神气活现地谈起自己那个很小的角色。

e.en: She nodded {self-importantly} at the reporters.
e.zh: 她自负地向记者们点了点头。

self-imposed.t: 自愿承受的；自己规定的

e.en: He lived under a {self-imposed} silence.
e.zh: 他过着一种自己选择的沉默生活。

e.en: The team met a {self-imposed} deadline.
e.zh: 团队赶上了自己设定的截止日期。

e.en: She sees exercise as part of {self-improvement}.
e.zh: 她把锻炼看作自我提升的一部分。

e.en: The company encourages constant {self-improvement}.
e.zh: 公司鼓励员工不断自我改进。

e.en: He listed several {self-improvements} in his review.
e.zh: 他在评估中列出了几项自我改进之处。

e.en: Small {self-improvements} can change daily habits.
e.zh: 小小的自我改进也能改变日常习惯。

e.en: A serious {self-improver} tracks progress every week.
e.zh: 认真追求自我提升的人每周都会记录进展。

e.en: The podcast appeals to the busy {self-improver}.
e.zh: 这档播客吸引忙碌但想提升自己的人。

e.en: The definition is {self-inclusive} by design.
e.zh: 这个定义在设计上就是包含自身的。

e.en: A {self-inclusive} system can refer to its own rules.
e.zh: 自包容系统可以引用自身的规则。

e.en: Many flowering plants show {self-incompatibility}.
e.zh: 许多开花植物表现出自交不亲和性。

e.en: Researchers mapped genes linked to {self-incompatibility}.
e.zh: 研究人员定位了与自交不亲和性相关的基因。

self-incompatible.t: 自交不亲和的；自相矛盾的

e.en: The plant is {self-incompatible} and needs pollen from another variety.
e.zh: 这种植物自交不亲和，需要另一品种的花粉。

e.en: His two promises were {self-incompatible} in practice.
e.zh: 他的两个承诺在实际中彼此矛盾。

self-incriminating.t: 使自己受罪的；自证其罪的

e.en: She refused to answer the {self-incriminating} question.
e.zh: 她拒绝回答那个可能让自己受罪的问题。

e.en: The email contained several {self-incriminating} details.
e.zh: 那封邮件包含几个自证其罪的细节。

e.en: The constitution protects suspects from {self-incrimination}.
e.zh: 宪法保护嫌疑人免于自证其罪。

e.en: His lawyer warned him against accidental {self-incrimination}.
e.zh: 他的律师提醒他不要无意中说出对自己不利的话。

self-induced.t: 自我造成的；自行诱发的

e.en: The panic was largely {self-induced}.
e.zh: 这场恐慌很大程度上是自己造成的。

e.en: Doctors suspected a {self-induced} reaction to the medication.
e.zh: 医生怀疑这是自行诱发的药物反应。

e.en: The coil's {self-inductance} affects the circuit's response time.
e.zh: 线圈的自感会影响电路的响应时间。

e.en: Engineers measured the {self-inductance} before testing the new transformer.
e.zh: 工程师在测试新变压器前测量了自感系数。

e.en: The table lists the {self-inductances} of several coils.
e.zh: 表中列出了几个线圈的自感系数。

e.en: Different winding patterns produced different {self-inductances}.
e.zh: 不同的绕线方式产生了不同的自感。

e.en: The lesson introduced {self-induction} in simple electrical circuits.
e.zh: 这节课介绍了简单电路中的自感现象。

e.en: Some therapists discuss {self-induction} in hypnosis training.
e.zh: 一些治疗师会在催眠训练中讨论自我诱导。

e.en: The technician replaced the damaged {self-inductor}.
e.zh: 技术员更换了损坏的自感器。

e.en: A small {self-inductor} can smooth sudden current changes.
e.zh: 一个小型自感线圈可以缓和电流突变。

e.en: Buying the expensive watch was an act of {self-indulgence}.
e.zh: 买那块昂贵手表是一种自我放纵。

e.en: The memoir sometimes slips into {self-indulgence}.
e.zh: 这本回忆录有时流于自我陶醉。

e.en: She allowed herself a few small {self-indulgences} during the holiday.
e.zh: 假期里她允许自己有几次小小的享乐。

e.en: His late-night snacks were harmless {self-indulgences}.
e.zh: 他的夜宵只是无伤大雅的自我放纵。

self-indulgent.t: 自我放纵的；任性享乐的

e.en: The dessert felt wonderfully {self-indulgent} after a hard week.
e.zh: 辛苦一周后，这道甜点让人觉得特别纵容自己。

e.en: Critics called the film slow and {self-indulgent}.
e.zh: 评论家认为这部电影节奏拖沓且过于自我陶醉。

self-indulgently.t: 自我放纵地；任性享乐地

e.en: He smiled {self-indulgently} and ordered another bottle.
e.zh: 他纵容自己地一笑，又点了一瓶酒。

e.en: The author writes {self-indulgently} about every minor feeling.
e.zh: 作者把每一点细微感受都写得过于自我陶醉。

self-inflicted.t: 自己造成的；自作自受的

e.en: The wound appeared to be {self-inflicted}.
e.zh: 那处伤口看起来是自己造成的。

e.en: Their financial crisis was partly {self-inflicted}.
e.zh: 他们的财务危机部分是自作自受。

self-initiated.t: 自行发起的；自我启动的

e.en: The students completed a {self-initiated} research project.
e.zh: 学生们完成了一个自行发起的研究项目。

e.en: The software runs a {self-initiated} check every morning.
e.zh: 这个软件每天早上会自行启动一次检查。

e.en: The nurse taught him safe {self-injection} at home.
e.zh: 护士教他如何在家安全地自行注射。

e.en: The treatment requires weekly {self-injection}.
e.zh: 这种治疗需要每周自行注射一次。

self-insure.t: 自我保险；自行承担风险

e.en: Large companies often {self-insure} against minor employee health claims.
e.zh: 大公司常常对小额员工医疗索赔实行自我保险。

e.en: They chose to {self-insure} rather than buy a costly policy.
e.zh: 他们选择自行承担风险，而不是购买昂贵的保单。

e.en: The hospital became a {self-insurer} for workers' compensation.
e.zh: 这家医院成了员工工伤赔偿的自我保险机构。

e.en: A {self-insurer} must keep enough reserves for future claims.
e.zh: 自保者必须保留足够准备金以应对未来索赔。

self-interactions.t: 自身相互作用；自相互作用

e.en: The model includes particle {self-interactions} at high energies.
e.zh: 该模型包含高能状态下的粒子自身相互作用。

e.en: Researchers studied the network's {self-interactions} over time.
e.zh: 研究人员考察了这个网络随时间产生的自相互作用。

e.en: Politicians often act out of {self-interest}.
e.zh: 政客常常出于自身利益行事。

e.en: Healthy {self-interest} can help you set boundaries.
e.zh: 适度的利己心能帮助你设定界限。

e.en: His apology sounded {self-interested} rather than sincere.
e.zh: 他的道歉听起来像是出于私利，而不是真诚。

e.en: Economists often study {self-interested} choices in markets.
e.zh: 经济学家常研究市场中的利己选择。

e.en: The essay criticizes the {self-interestedness} of the ruling class.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评统治阶层的利己性。

e.en: Her theory treats human {self-interestedness} as only one motive.
e.zh: 她的理论把人的自利倾向只看作一种动机。

self-invited.t: 不请自来的；自行邀请的

e.en: A {self-invited} guest arrived just before dinner.
e.zh: 一位不请自来的客人晚饭前到了。

e.en: He was effectively {self-invited} to the meeting through his own emails.
e.zh: 他实际上是通过自己的邮件把自己请进了会议。

self-involved.t: 只顾自己的；自我沉迷的

e.en: She found him charming but deeply {self-involved}.
e.zh: 她觉得他很有魅力，但也非常只顾自己。

e.en: The novel's narrator is witty and {self-involved}.
e.zh: 这部小说的叙述者机智却沉迷于自我。

e.en: His speech was full of {self-justification}.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了自我辩解。

e.en: People often use {self-justification} to avoid admitting mistakes.
e.zh: 人们常用自我开脱来避免承认错误。

e.en: Her letter offered several weak {self-justifications}.
e.zh: 她的信里提出了几个站不住脚的开脱理由。

e.en: The report dismissed their {self-justifications} as unconvincing.
e.zh: 报告认为他们的自我辩解缺乏说服力。

e.en: His {self-justifying} speech convinced no one.
e.zh: 他那番为自己辩解的讲话没有说服任何人。

e.en: The report sounded defensive and {self-justifying}.
e.zh: 这份报告听起来像在防御，也像在替自己开脱。

e.en: Her {self-knowing} smile ended the argument.
e.zh: 她一个带着自知之明的微笑结束了争论。

e.en: The novel has a witty, {self-knowing} narrator.
e.zh: 这部小说有一位机智而自知的叙述者。

e.en: Therapy helped him gain deeper {self-knowledge}.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮助他获得了更深的自我认识。

e.en: True {self-knowledge} can be uncomfortable.
e.zh: 真正的自知有时会让人不舒服。

self-limiting.t: 自我限制的；会自行消退的

e.en: Fear became a {self-limiting} belief.
e.zh: 恐惧变成了一种自我限制的信念。

e.en: The infection is usually {self-limiting}.
e.zh: 这种感染通常会自行消退。

e.en: The bridge was funded by a {self-liquidating} loan.
e.zh: 这座桥由一笔以自身收益偿还的贷款资助。

e.en: They preferred {self-liquidating} projects with clear revenue.
e.zh: 他们更偏好收入明确、可自行偿债的项目。

self-loader.t: 自动装填装置；自装货车

e.en: The old camera used a noisy {self-loader}.
e.zh: 那台旧相机使用一个噪声很大的自动装片装置。

e.en: A {self-loader} carried logs from the roadside.
e.zh: 一辆自装货车从路边运走了木材。

e.en: The factory installed a {self-loading} conveyor.
e.zh: 工厂安装了一条自动装载的传送带。

e.en: He demonstrated a {self-loading} rifle.
e.zh: 他演示了一支自动装填步枪。

e.en: Years of failure fed his {self-loathing}.
e.zh: 多年的失败滋长了他的自我厌恶。

e.en: The memoir describes addiction and {self-loathing}.
e.zh: 这本回忆录描写了成瘾和自我憎恨。

e.en: The gate has a {self-locking} latch.
e.zh: 这扇门有一个自动锁定的门闩。

e.en: Use {self-locking} nuts on the wheel assembly.
e.zh: 在车轮组件上使用自锁螺母。

e.en: She learned {self-love} after years of criticism.
e.zh: 多年受批评之后，她学会了爱自己。

e.en: The essay contrasts {self-love} with selfishness.
e.zh: 这篇文章把自爱和自私作了对比。

e.en: The hinge uses a {self-lubricating} bearing.
e.zh: 这个铰链使用自润滑轴承。

e.en: These {self-lubricating} parts need little maintenance.
e.zh: 这些自润滑零件几乎不需要维护。

e.en: She became a {self-made} millionaire.
e.zh: 她成了一位白手起家的百万富翁。

e.en: The documentary celebrates {self-made} success.
e.zh: 这部纪录片赞颂靠自己打拼得来的成功。

e.en: The charity sent a folded {self-mailer}.
e.zh: 慈善机构寄来了一份折叠后可直接邮寄的宣传单。

e.en: A {self-mailer} needs no envelope.
e.zh: 可直接邮寄的印刷品不需要信封。

e.en: They designed a {self-mailing} brochure.
e.zh: 他们设计了一份可直接邮寄的小册子。

e.en: The form came in a {self-mailing} packet.
e.zh: 这张表装在一个可直接邮寄的封套里。

e.en: Meditation helped her develop {self-mastery}.
e.zh: 冥想帮助她培养自我掌控能力。

e.en: The course teaches discipline and {self-mastery}.
e.zh: 这门课程教授自律和自我控制。

e.en: Many patients {self-medicate} with painkillers.
e.zh: 许多患者会自行服用止痛药。

e.en: He used alcohol to {self-medicate} his anxiety.
e.zh: 他用酒精来缓解自己的焦虑。

e.en: Her speech was full of gentle {self-mockery}.
e.zh: 她的演讲里满是温和的自嘲。

e.en: He uses {self-mockery} to ease tension.
e.zh: 他用自我调侃来缓和紧张气氛。

e.en: He gave a {self-mocking} laugh.
e.zh: 他自嘲地笑了一声。

e.en: The article has a sharp, {self-mocking} tone.
e.zh: 这篇文章带着尖锐的自我调侃语气。

e.en: The monk practiced severe {self-mortification}.
e.zh: 那位僧侣进行严厉的自我苦修。

e.en: Her guilt turned into constant {self-mortification}.
e.zh: 她的内疚变成了持续的自我折磨。

e.en: The theory explains apparent {self-motion}.
e.zh: 这个理论解释了表面上的自行运动。

e.en: The sculpture creates an illusion of {self-motion}.
e.zh: 这座雕塑造成了一种自发运动的错觉。

e.en: We need {self-motivated} people for remote work.
e.zh: 远程工作需要有自我动力的人。

e.en: She is disciplined and highly {self-motivated}.
e.zh: 她很自律，也非常有内驱力。

e.en: Online learning requires strong {self-motivation}.
e.zh: 在线学习需要很强的自我激励。

e.en: His {self-motivation} impressed the coach.
e.zh: 他的内驱力给教练留下了深刻印象。

e.en: The cart seemed {self-moved} in the dark.
e.zh: 那辆手推车在黑暗中像是自己动了起来。

e.en: Aristotle described the divine as {self-moved}.
e.zh: 亚里士多德把神性描述为由自身推动的存在。

e.en: The machine showed unexpected {self-movement}.
e.zh: 这台机器出现了意外的自行运动。

e.en: Philosophers debated the idea of {self-movement}.
e.zh: 哲学家们讨论过自我运动这一概念。

e.en: The exhibit included a {self-moving} model train.
e.zh: 展览中有一列自行移动的模型火车。

e.en: He imagined a {self-moving} universe.
e.zh: 他设想了一个能够自我运动的宇宙。

e.en: The old report described the death as {self-murder}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把这起死亡称为自杀。

e.en: Critics called the policy economic {self-murder}.
e.zh: 批评者称这项政策是经济上的自我毁灭。

e.en: The clinic recorded several cases of {self-mutilations}.
e.zh: 诊所记录了几起自残行为。

e.en: Her drawings hinted at private {self-mutilations}.
e.zh: 她的画暗示了私下的自我伤害。

self-neglect.t: 自我忽视；疏于照顾自己

e.en: Severe {self-neglect} can endanger an elderly person.
e.zh: 严重的自我忽视可能危及老人的安全。

e.en: The social worker noticed signs of {self-neglect}.
e.zh: 社工注意到他疏于照顾自己的迹象。

e.en: Daily journaling encourages careful {self-observation}.
e.zh: 每天写日记能促使人更仔细地自我观察。

e.en: The meditation course begins with quiet {self-observation}.
e.zh: 这门冥想课从安静地反观自身开始。

self-obsessed.t: 过度关注自己的；自恋的

e.en: He sounded {self-obsessed} during the interview.
e.zh: 他在采访中听起来过度关注自己。

e.en: The novel mocks a {self-obsessed} celebrity culture.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了一种自恋的名人文化。

self-opinion.t: 自我评价；对自己的看法

e.en: Her {self-opinion} improved after the project succeeded.
e.zh: 项目成功后，她对自己的评价提高了。

e.en: A child's {self-opinion} can be shaped by praise.
e.zh: 孩子对自己的看法会受到表扬的影响。

self-opinionated.t: 固执己见的；自以为是的

e.en: The committee struggled with a {self-opinionated} chairman.
e.zh: 委员会很难应付一位固执己见的主席。

e.en: She became less {self-opinionated} after listening to others.
e.zh: 听取别人意见后，她不那么自以为是了。

e.en: His {self-opinionatedness} made compromise almost impossible.
e.zh: 他的固执己见让妥协几乎不可能。

e.en: The essay criticizes the {self-opinionatedness} of experts.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评专家们的自以为是。

self-opinioned.t: 自以为是的；固执己见的

e.en: The old critic was famously {self-opinioned}.
e.zh: 那位老评论家以自以为是出名。

e.en: A {self-opinioned} leader rarely admits mistakes.
e.zh: 固执己见的领导很少承认错误。

e.en: He acted as the town's {self-ordained} moral judge.
e.zh: 他以镇上自封的道德裁判自居。

e.en: The group followed a {self-ordained} preacher.
e.zh: 这个团体追随一位自行受任的传教者。

self-organization.t: 自我组织；自主形成秩序

e.en: Ant colonies show remarkable {self-organization}.
e.zh: 蚁群表现出惊人的自我组织能力。

e.en: The team relied on {self-organization} instead of strict hierarchy.
e.zh: 这个团队依靠自我组织，而不是严格等级。

e.en: The volunteers formed a {self-organized} rescue network.
e.zh: 志愿者组成了一个自组织的救援网络。

e.en: Students joined {self-organized} study groups online.
e.zh: 学生们加入了网上自主安排的学习小组。

e.en: The circuit entered {self-oscillation} at high gain.
e.zh: 电路在高增益下进入自振荡状态。

e.en: Engineers reduced {self-oscillation} in the control system.
e.zh: 工程师减少了控制系统中的自激振动。

e.en: The course is fully {self-paced}.
e.zh: 这门课程完全可以按自己的进度学习。

e.en: She preferred a {self-paced} training program.
e.zh: 她更喜欢按自己进度进行的培训项目。

e.en: The sequel feels like {self-parody}.
e.zh: 这部续集像是在自我戏仿。

e.en: His speech slipped into deliberate {self-parody}.
e.zh: 他的演讲转向了刻意的自我讽刺。

self-partial.t: 偏袒自己的；自私偏私的

e.en: A judge must not be {self-partial}.
e.zh: 法官不能偏袒自己一方。

e.en: His advice seemed {self-partial} and unreliable.
e.zh: 他的建议显得自私偏私，不太可靠。

e.en: The philosopher warned against hidden {self-partiality}.
e.zh: 那位哲学家提醒人们警惕隐藏的自我偏私。

e.en: Her decision showed obvious {self-partiality}.
e.zh: 她的决定表现出明显的偏袒自己。

self-perceptions.t: 自我认知；对自己的看法

e.en: Teenagers' {self-perceptions} change quickly.
e.zh: 青少年的自我认知变化很快。

e.en: The survey compared patients' {self-perceptions} with medical records.
e.zh: 这项调查把患者对自己的看法与病历作了比较。

self-perpetuating.t: 自我延续的；自行维持的

e.en: Poverty can become a {self-perpetuating} cycle.
e.zh: 贫困可能变成一个自我延续的循环。

e.en: The rumor created a {self-perpetuating} panic.
e.zh: 这个谣言造成了自行维持的恐慌。

e.en: The system was designed for {self-perpetuation}.
e.zh: 这个系统被设计成能够自我延续。

e.en: Political elites often seek {self-perpetuation}.
e.zh: 政治精英常常追求自行维持其地位。

e.en: He sank into {self-pity} after losing his job.
e.zh: 失业后，他陷入了自怜。

e.en: There is no {self-pity} in her memoir.
e.zh: 她的回忆录里没有顾影自怜。

e.en: His tone became increasingly {self-pitying}.
e.zh: 他的语气变得越来越自怜。

e.en: She refused to write a {self-pitying} account.
e.zh: 她拒绝写一篇顾影自怜的叙述。

e.en: He looked at the empty room {self-pityingly}.
e.zh: 他自怜地看着空荡荡的房间。

e.en: She laughed {self-pityingly} at her own bad luck.
e.zh: 她顾影自怜地嘲笑自己的霉运。

e.en: Years of practice gave her {self-poise}.
e.zh: 多年的练习让她拥有镇定自若的气度。

e.en: His {self-poise} impressed everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他的自持给房间里的每个人留下了印象。

e.en: She remained {self-poised} under intense questioning.
e.zh: 在激烈盘问下，她依然镇定自若。

e.en: The young speaker sounded unusually {self-poised}.
e.zh: 这位年轻演讲者听起来异常自持。

e.en: The industry relies on {self-policing} to prevent fraud.
e.zh: 该行业依靠自我监管来防止欺诈。

e.en: Strong {self-policing} kept the online group civil.
e.zh: 严格的自我约束让这个线上群体保持了礼貌。

e.en: Some tomato plants can {self-pollinate} without insects.
e.zh: 有些番茄植株不用昆虫也能自花授粉。

e.en: The breeder chose flowers that {self-pollinate} reliably indoors.
e.zh: 育种者选择了在室内能稳定自花授粉的花。

e.en: The {self-pollinated} flowers produced uniform seeds.
e.zh: 这些已自花授粉的花结出了性状一致的种子。

e.en: A {self-pollinated} crop may need fewer bees.
e.zh: 自花授粉的作物可能不太需要蜜蜂。

e.en: Farmers planted a {self-pollinating} variety of beans.
e.zh: 农民种下了一种能自花授粉的豆类品种。

e.en: The greenhouse favors {self-pollinating} plants for stable yields.
e.zh: 温室更适合能自花授粉的植物，以保证产量稳定。

e.en: {Self-pollination} helps the plant reproduce in isolation.
e.zh: 自花授粉帮助这种植物在孤立环境中繁殖。

e.en: Too much {self-pollination} can reduce genetic diversity.
e.zh: 过多的自花授粉可能降低遗传多样性。

e.en: The museum displayed her first {self-portrait}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了她的第一幅自画像。

e.en: The essay reads like a quiet {self-portrait}.
e.zh: 这篇文章读起来像一幅平静的自我描写。

e.en: His later {self-portraits} show a darker mood.
e.zh: 他后期的自画像表现出更阴郁的情绪。

e.en: These memoirs are literary {self-portraits}.
e.zh: 这些回忆录是文学性的自我描写。

e.en: She stayed {self-possessed} during the difficult interview.
e.zh: 在那场艰难的面试中，她始终沉着镇定。

e.en: His {self-possessed} manner impressed the committee.
e.zh: 他镇定自若的举止给委员会留下了深刻印象。

e.en: He answered {self-possessedly} despite the pressure.
e.zh: 尽管压力很大，他还是镇定自若地作答。

e.en: She walked {self-possessedly} onto the stage.
e.zh: 她沉着地走上了舞台。

e.en: He showed remarkable {self-possession} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后，他表现出非凡的沉着。

e.en: Public speaking requires practice and {self-possession}.
e.zh: 公开演讲需要练习，也需要镇定自若。

e.en: The sensor is {self-powered} by a small solar cell.
e.zh: 这个传感器由一块小太阳能电池自供电。

e.en: They tested a {self-powered} wheelchair on the ramp.
e.zh: 他们在坡道上测试了一辆自身驱动的轮椅。

e.en: Her speech contained more {self-praise} than evidence.
e.zh: 她的演讲里自我夸奖多于实际证据。

e.en: A little {self-praise} can sound confident, not arrogant.
e.zh: 适度的自我肯定可以显得自信，而不是傲慢。

e.en: Fear is often linked to {self-preservation}.
e.zh: 恐惧常常与求生本能有关。

e.en: She lied out of {self-preservation}, not malice.
e.zh: 她撒谎是出于自我保护，并非恶意。

self-preserving.t: 自我保护的；保全自己的

e.en: His {self-preserving} instincts took over in the crisis.
e.zh: 危机中，他自我保护的本能占了上风。

e.en: The policy created a {self-preserving} bureaucracy.
e.zh: 这项政策造就了一个只顾保全自己的官僚体系。

e.en: Her {self-pride} helped her recover from failure.
e.zh: 她的自尊帮助她从失败中恢复过来。

e.en: The award restored his sense of {self-pride}.
e.zh: 这个奖项恢复了他的自豪感。

e.en: He is a {self-proclaimed} expert on coffee.
e.zh: 他自称是咖啡方面的专家。

e.en: The {self-proclaimed} leader had little real support.
e.zh: 这位自封的领袖几乎没有真正的支持。

e.en: The band released a {self-produced} album online.
e.zh: 这支乐队在网上发布了一张自行制作的专辑。

e.en: Her {self-produced} videos attracted a loyal audience.
e.zh: 她自制的视频吸引了一批忠实观众。

e.en: The child used a {self-pronouncing} dictionary at school.
e.zh: 这个孩子在学校使用一本标明发音的词典。

e.en: A {self-pronouncing} guide helps readers say names correctly.
e.zh: 标明发音的指南能帮助读者正确读出姓名。

e.en: The army tested a {self-propelled} artillery vehicle.
e.zh: 军方测试了一辆自行推进的火炮车。

e.en: A {self-propelled} mower saves time on large lawns.
e.zh: 自走式割草机在大草坪上能节省时间。

e.en: The robot uses wheels for {self-propulsion}.
e.zh: 这个机器人靠轮子实现自行推进。

e.en: Fish achieve {self-propulsion} by moving their tails.
e.zh: 鱼通过摆动尾巴获得自推进力。

e.en: The course teaches basic {self-protection} skills.
e.zh: 这门课教授基本的防身技能。

e.en: He avoided the argument as a form of {self-protection}.
e.zh: 他避开争论，是一种自我保护。

e.en: Her {self-published} novel sold thousands of copies.
e.zh: 她自行出版的小说卖出了数千册。

e.en: Many {self-published} writers market their books online.
e.zh: 许多自行出版作品的作家在网上推广自己的书。

e.en: The device contains a {self-pulsing} laser diode.
e.zh: 该设备含有一个自行脉动的激光二极管。

e.en: Researchers observed a {self-pulsing} rhythm in the circuit.
e.zh: 研究人员在电路中观察到一种自行脉动的节奏。

e.en: Wetlands support the {self-purification} of polluted water.
e.zh: 湿地有助于污染水体的自行净化。

e.en: The ritual symbolized moral {self-purification}.
e.zh: 这个仪式象征着道德上的自我净化。

e.en: Writers often {self-question} during revision.
e.zh: 作家在修改时常常反躬自问。

e.en: A hard {self-question} can reveal hidden motives.
e.zh: 一次深刻的自我质问能揭示隐藏的动机。

e.en: Her {self-questioning} made the decision slower.
e.zh: 她的自我质疑让这个决定变得更慢。

e.en: The essay has a tone of honest {self-questioning}.
e.zh: 这篇文章带有真诚自我追问的语气。

e.en: His repeated {self-questionings} filled the diary.
e.zh: 他反复的自我质疑写满了日记。

e.en: The memoir records many private {self-questionings}.

e.en: The retailer tracks {sell-through} for every new jacket.
e.zh: 零售商会跟踪每款新夹克的售出率。

e.en: Strong {sell-through} encouraged the brand to reorder stock.
e.zh: 终端销售强劲，促使品牌追加订货。

e.en: The old horse developed {sellanders} near the hock.
e.zh: 那匹老马在跗关节附近患上了皮肤病。

e.en: The groom treated the {sellanders} with a prescribed ointment.
e.zh: 马夫用处方药膏治疗那处马跗关节皮肤病。

e.en: The brand measured {sellin} before checking store demand.
e.zh: 品牌在查看门店需求前先衡量向渠道的销售量。

e.en: High {sellin} did not guarantee that customers would buy.
e.zh: 渠道进货量高并不保证顾客一定会购买。

e.en: The stable entered a tired {selling-plater} in the race.
e.zh: 马房派出一匹疲惫的廉价赛马参赛。

e.en: He bought the {selling-plater} after its final run.
e.zh: 那匹低价赛马跑完最后一场后，他把它买了下来。

e.en: A sudden {selloff} pushed technology shares lower.
e.zh: 突如其来的抛售压低了科技股价格。

e.en: The warehouse held a weekend {selloff} of returned goods.
e.zh: 仓库周末对退货商品进行了廉价出售。

e.en: The farmer applied {selocide} to protect the sheep.
e.zh: 农民使用杀螨剂来保护羊群。

e.en: Labels must state how much {selocide} the product contains.
e.zh: 标签必须标明产品含有多少杀螨剂。

e.en: The antenna used a {selsyn} to repeat its position.
e.zh: 天线使用自整角机来同步显示位置。

e.en: A faulty {selsyn} made the indicator drift slowly.
e.zh: 一个有故障的同步传感器使指示器缓慢漂移。

e.en: The rider placed a wool {seltrap} under the saddle.
e.zh: 骑手在马鞍下面垫了一块羊毛鞍垫。

e.en: An embroidered {seltrap} covered the ceremonial horse.
e.zh: 一块绣花鞍下布盖在礼仪用马上。

e.en: The old bar kept a glass {seltzogene} on the counter.
e.zh: 那家老酒吧把一个玻璃苏打水机放在柜台上。

e.en: He repaired the {seltzogene} so it could fizz again.
e.zh: 他修好了那个充气水瓶，让它又能冒气泡。
