e.zh: 宴会上他们端上了一道浓郁的宫廷咖喱。

e.en: The falconer trained a young {shahin} for hunting.
e.zh: 驯鹰人训练了一只年轻的沙欣隼来狩猎。

e.en: A {shahin} can dive with remarkable speed.
e.zh: 沙欣隼俯冲时速度惊人。

e.en: The village {shaik} welcomed the travelers politely.
e.zh: 村里的谢赫礼貌地欢迎了旅人。

e.en: A respected {shaik} settled the dispute.
e.zh: 一位受尊敬的阿拉伯首领调解了争端。

e.en: The tale warned children about the {shaitan}.
e.zh: 这个故事告诫孩子们要提防恶魔。

e.en: He called temptation the whisper of {shaitan}.
e.zh: 他把诱惑称作撒旦的低语。

e.en: The loose railing was clearly {shakable}.
e.zh: 那段松动的栏杆显然可以摇动。

e.en: Her confidence was not easily {shakable}.
e.zh: 她的信心并不容易被动摇。

e.en: The two leaders {shake-hands} after the meeting.
e.zh: 两位领导人在会后握手。

e.en: Children learn to {shake-hands} when they meet guests.
e.zh: 孩子们学习见到客人时要握手。

e.en: She tried to {shake-off} the bad mood.
e.zh: 她努力摆脱坏心情。

e.en: The runner could not {shake-off} his closest rival.
e.zh: 那名跑者无法甩掉紧追的对手。

shake-out.t: 整顿；淘汰；试车检验；抖落东西；打散

e.en: The merger led to a painful {shake-out} in middle management.
e.zh: 这次合并导致中层管理出现痛苦的整顿淘汰。

e.en: Give the blanket a good {shake-out} before folding it.
e.zh: 折毯子前先把它好好抖一抖。

e.en: The new chief promised a major {shake-up} of the department.
e.zh: 新主管承诺对这个部门进行重大改组。

e.en: A sudden injury caused a {shake-up} in the team's lineup.
e.zh: 一次突发伤病让球队阵容发生了大变动。

e.en: Several {shake-ups} followed the company's poor results.
e.zh: 公司业绩不佳之后发生了几次改组。

e.en: Political {shake-ups} can unsettle financial markets.
e.zh: 政治上的一系列变动可能会扰乱金融市场。

e.en: The old railing was loose and {shakeable}.
e.zh: 那段旧栏杆松了，可以被摇动。

e.en: Her confidence was not easily {shakeable}.
e.zh: 她的信心并不容易被动摇。

e.en: The camera came in a {shakeproof} carrying case.
e.zh: 这台相机配有一个防震携带盒。

e.en: Engineers tested the {shakeproof} mounting on rough roads.
e.zh: 工程师在颠簸路面上测试了抗振安装件。

shakerful.t: 一摇瓶的量；一调味瓶的量

e.en: Add one {shakerful} of salt to the brine.
e.zh: 往盐水里加一调味瓶的盐。

e.en: She sprinkled a {shakerful} of glitter over the card.
e.zh: 她把一小瓶亮粉撒在卡片上。

e.en: The director tried to {shakespearize} the modern crime story.
e.zh: 导演试图把这个现代犯罪故事处理成莎士比亚风格。

e.en: Students often {shakespearize} simple lines with archaic words.
e.zh: 学生常用古体词把简单台词写得像莎士比亚作品。

e.en: The play ends with a {shakesperian} mix of comedy and sorrow.
e.zh: 这出戏以莎士比亚式的喜悲交织收尾。

e.en: His speech had a grand, {shakesperian} rhythm.
e.zh: 他的演讲带着宏大而莎士比亚式的节奏。

e.en: The cabinet {shakeup} surprised even senior officials.
e.zh: 这次内阁改组连高级官员都感到意外。

e.en: The coach announced a {shakeup} after three losses.
e.zh: 三连败后，教练宣布进行阵容大调整。

e.en: The whole room was {shakin} with the bass.
e.zh: 整个房间都随着低音在震动。

e.en: He came in cold and {shakin} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后他走进来，冻得直发抖。

e.en: She was {shaking-out} the rug on the balcony.
e.zh: 她正在阳台上把地毯抖干净。

e.en: The industry is {shaking-out} weaker competitors.
e.zh: 这个行业正在淘汰较弱的竞争者。

e.en: The drummer wore a tall {shako} with a brass badge.
e.zh: 鼓手戴着一顶有铜徽章的高筒军帽。

e.en: A faded {shako} sat in the museum case.
e.zh: 一顶褪色的军用高筒帽陈列在博物馆柜中。

e.en: The soldiers polished the badges on their {shakoes}.
e.zh: 士兵们擦亮了他们高筒军帽上的徽章。

e.en: Old {shakoes} lined the shelf above the uniforms.
e.zh: 几顶旧高筒军帽排在制服上方的架子上。

e.en: The actor delivered the curse in a {shakspearian} tone.
e.zh: 演员用莎士比亚式的腔调说出了诅咒。

e.en: Her novel uses a {shakspearian} pattern of mistaken identity.
e.zh: 她的小说采用了莎士比亚式的身份误认模式。

e.en: In the lecture, {shakti} was described as divine energy.
e.zh: 讲座中，沙克蒂被描述为神圣能量。

e.en: The temple ritual honored {shakti} as the power of creation.
e.zh: 寺庙仪式把沙克蒂尊为创造之力。

e.en: He learned to play the {shakuhachi} during his stay in Kyoto.
e.zh: 他在京都期间学会了吹尺八。

e.en: The {shakuhachi} gave the recording a quiet, breathy sound.
e.zh: 尺八让这段录音带上了安静而带气息感的声音。

e.en: The path crossed a {shaley} slope above the river.
e.zh: 小路穿过河上方一片含页岩的斜坡。

e.en: Roots struggled to grow in the dry, {shaley} soil.
e.zh: 在干燥而似页岩的土壤中，植物根系很难生长。

e.en: The old gloves were made of soft {shamoy}.
e.zh: 那副旧手套是用柔软的麂皮做的。

e.en: She polished the silver with a piece of {shamoy}.
e.zh: 她用一块羚羊皮擦亮银器。

e.en: He spent the morning {shamoying} the car windows.
e.zh: 他花了一上午用麂皮擦车窗。

e.en: The jeweler was {shamoying} the polished stones carefully.
e.zh: 珠宝匠正小心地用麂皮擦拭抛光后的宝石。

e.en: I need to buy more {shampooo} before the trip.
e.zh: 旅行前我需要再买些洗发水。

e.en: The stylist will {shampooo} your hair first.
e.zh: 发型师会先给你洗头。

e.en: The widow hired a {shamus} to follow her husband.
e.zh: 那位寡妇雇了一名私家侦探跟踪她的丈夫。

e.en: In old crime novels, every {shamus} has a messy office.
e.zh: 在老式犯罪小说里，每个私家侦探都有一间凌乱的办公室。

e.en: Two {shamuses} waited outside the hotel entrance.
e.zh: 两名私家侦探在酒店入口外等着。

e.en: The story mocks the tough-talking {shamuses} of pulp fiction.
e.zh: 这个故事嘲讽了低俗小说里说话强硬的私家侦探们。

e.en: Colorful {shamyanas} shaded the guests during the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼上，彩色的印度大帐篷为宾客遮阳。

e.en: Vendors slept beneath the {shamyanas} after the fair closed.
e.zh: 集市关闭后，小贩们睡在那些大帐篷下面。

e.en: I {shan't} forget your kindness.
e.zh: 我不会忘记你的好意。

e.en: We {shan't} be staying late tonight.
e.zh: 我们今晚不会待到很晚。

e.en: The old {shanachy} told stories by the fire.
e.zh: 那位年老的爱尔兰说书人在火边讲故事。

e.en: Every village once valued a skilled {shanachy}.
e.zh: 过去每个村庄都看重一位能讲故事的说书人。

e.en: The sample contained tiny grains of {shandite}.
e.zh: 这个样品里含有细小的硫镍铅矿颗粒。

e.en: Geologists identified {shandite} in the altered ore body.
e.zh: 地质学家在蚀变矿体中鉴定出硫镍铅矿。

e.en: The family arrived in a creaking {shandrydan}.
e.zh: 那家人坐着一辆吱呀作响的老式敞篷马车到了。

e.en: A dusty {shandrydan} stood outside the inn.
e.zh: 一辆满是尘土的老式马车停在客栈外。

e.en: He ordered a cold {shandygaff} after work.
e.zh: 下班后他点了一杯冰凉的啤酒姜汁混饮。

e.en: The tavern served {shandygaff} in tall glasses.
e.zh: 那家酒馆用高杯供应啤酒姜汁混饮。

e.en: My grandmother still speaks {Shanghainese} at home.
e.zh: 我奶奶在家里仍然说上海话。

e.en: Several {Shanghainese} artists joined the exhibition.
e.zh: 几位上海艺术家参加了这次展览。

e.en: The prisoner's {shangles} clinked on the stone floor.
e.zh: 囚犯的脚镣在石地上叮当作响。

e.en: The poem describes poverty as invisible {shangles}.
e.zh: 这首诗把贫困描写成看不见的镣铐。

e.en: The island seemed like a private {shangri-la}.
e.zh: 那座岛像是一处私人世外桃源。

e.en: For many workers, remote life was no {shangri-la}.
e.zh: 对许多员工来说，远程生活并不是什么理想乐土。

e.en: They imagined retirement as a quiet {shangrila}.
e.zh: 他们把退休生活想象成宁静的世外桃源。

e.en: The resort markets itself as a mountain {shangrila}.
e.zh: 这家度假村把自己宣传成山中的理想乐土。

e.en: The soup was flavored with a roasted {shankbone}.
e.zh: 这锅汤用烤过的腿骨提味。

e.en: Archaeologists found a human {shankbone} near the burial site.
e.zh: 考古学家在墓地附近发现了一根人类胫骨。

e.en: Add the {shankpiece} and simmer it slowly.
e.zh: 加入那块腿肉，然后慢慢炖煮。

e.en: The butcher wrapped a small {shankpiece} for the stew.
e.zh: 肉贩包好一小块适合炖菜的胫部肉。

e.en: The workers slept in rough {shannies} near the river.
e.zh: 工人们睡在河边简陋的棚屋里。

e.en: Several old {shannies} stood behind the abandoned mill.
e.zh: 废弃磨坊后面立着几间旧棚屋。

e.en: A small {shanny} hid among the rocks.
e.zh: 一条小海鱼躲在岩石之间。

e.en: The child watched a {shanny} dart through the tide pool.
e.zh: 孩子看着一条小海鱼在潮池里穿梭。

e.en: They opened a bottle of {shant} after the race.
e.zh: 比赛后他们开了一瓶香槟酒。

e.en: The old tavern served cheap {shant} to sailors.
e.zh: 那家老酒馆给水手们卖廉价劣酒。

e.en: The crew sang a loud {shantey} while pulling the rope.
e.zh: 船员们一边拉绳一边高唱水手号子。

e.en: He learned an old {shantey} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里学会了一首古老的船歌。

e.en: The family moved into a {shanty-town} outside the city.
e.zh: 那家人搬进了城外的棚户区。

e.en: Aid workers brought clean water to the {shanty-town}.
e.zh: 援助人员把干净的水送到贫民窟。

e.en: The old {shantyman} led the chorus on deck.
e.zh: 那位老水手在甲板上领唱船歌。

e.en: A famous {shantyman} taught sailors the rhythm of the work.
e.zh: 一位有名的船歌手教水手们掌握劳动节奏。

e.en: The clay is {shapable} when it is warm.
e.zh: 黏土加热后是可以塑形的。

e.en: Young habits are still {shapable} through steady practice.
e.zh: 年轻时的习惯仍可通过持续练习来塑造。

e.en: The manager demanded a quick {shape-up} before the audit.
e.zh: 经理要求在审计前迅速整顿。

e.en: After months of mistakes, the team needed a serious {shape-up}.
e.zh: 出了几个月差错后，团队需要认真改善表现。

e.en: The alloy's {shapeability} made it useful in aircraft parts.
e.zh: 这种合金的成形能力使它适用于飞机零件。

e.en: A child's emotional {shapeability} depends partly on family life.
e.zh: 儿童情绪的可塑性部分取决于家庭生活。

e.en: The warm wax is easily {shapeable} by hand.
e.zh: 温热的蜡很容易用手塑形。

e.en: Public opinion is {shapeable} during a crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间公众舆论是可以被塑造的。

e.en: The new cut made the jacket look {shapelier}.
e.zh: 新的剪裁让这件夹克显得更有型。

e.en: She chose exercises that made her legs {shapelier}.
e.zh: 她选择了能让双腿更匀称的锻炼。

e.en: The statue's {shapeliness} impressed every visitor.
e.zh: 雕像的匀称美给每位参观者留下了深刻印象。

e.en: The tailor improved the {shapeliness} of the coat.
e.zh: 裁缝改善了这件外套的版型美感。

e.en: The loaf was oddly {shapen} after baking.
e.zh: 面包烤好后形状很奇怪。

e.en: Her ideas were still half {shapen} and hard to explain.
e.zh: 她的想法还只是半成形，很难解释清楚。

e.en: He wore a thick {shapka} in the snow.
e.zh: 他在雪地里戴着一顶厚厚的俄式皮帽。

e.en: The soldier's {shapka} was trimmed with dark fur.
e.zh: 士兵的俄式皮帽镶着深色毛边。

e.en: A fur {shapshka} kept his ears warm.
e.zh: 一顶毛皮俄式帽让他的耳朵保持温暖。

e.en: The portrait shows him wearing a tall {shapshka}.
e.zh: 画像中他戴着一顶高高的俄式皮帽。

e.en: The caravan crossed a dry {shar} at noon.
e.zh: 商队在中午穿过一片干涸的盐沼。

e.en: Wind blew white dust across the {shar}.
e.zh: 风把白色尘土吹过那片沙漠盐湖。

shalification.t: 转化为页岩的作用或过程

e.en: The geologist described {shalification} in the ancient seabed deposits.
e.zh: 地质学家描述了古海床沉积物中的页岩化过程。

e.en: Slow compaction encouraged {shalification} of the muddy layers.
e.zh: 缓慢压实促使泥质层发生页岩化。

e.en: The lining was made of faded {shalloon}.
e.zh: 衬里是用褪色的轻薄毛斜纹布做的。

e.en: Old tailors sometimes chose {shalloon} for coat linings.
e.zh: 老裁缝有时会选用shalloon毛织物来做外套衬里。

e.en: The essay mocked a {shallow-brained} politician.
e.zh: 那篇文章嘲讽了一位头脑浅薄的政客。

e.en: She dismissed the rumor as {shallow-brained} chatter.
e.zh: 她把那个传言斥为浅薄无聊的闲话。

e.en: He sounded {shallow-headed} during the debate.
e.zh: 他在辩论中听起来浅薄无知。

e.en: A {shallow-headed} answer will not solve this problem.
e.zh: 没头脑的回答解决不了这个问题。

e.en: The old comedy features a {shallow-pated} servant.
e.zh: 那部老喜剧里有个头脑浅薄的仆人。

e.en: Do not follow every {shallow-pated} scheme he proposes.
e.zh: 别照着他提出的每个愚钝计划去做。

e.en: His {shallowheaded} remarks annoyed the audience.
e.zh: 他那些浅薄的言论惹恼了听众。

e.en: The plan seemed {shallowheaded} from the start.
e.zh: 这个计划从一开始就显得没头脑。

e.en: He greeted the family with {shalom}.
e.zh: 他用“shalom”向那家人问好。

e.en: The word {shalom} can mean peace as well as hello.
e.zh: shalom这个词既可表示平安，也可用来问候。

e.en: The recipe calls for one chopped {shalot}.
e.zh: 这道菜谱需要一个切碎的小葱头。

e.en: She fried the {shalot} until it turned golden.
e.zh: 她把小葱头煎到金黄色。

e.en: She wore a blue {shalwar} with a long tunic.
e.zh: 她穿着蓝色南亚宽松裤，搭配长上衣。

e.en: The loose {shalwar} was comfortable in the heat.
e.zh: 宽松的shalwar裤在炎热天气里很舒服。

e.en: The path crossed a slope of {shaly} rock.
e.zh: 小路穿过一片页岩质岩石斜坡。

e.en: Water drained quickly through the {shaly} soil.
e.zh: 水很快从页岩质土壤中渗走。

e.en: A {shama} sang loudly from the bamboo grove.
e.zh: 一只沙玛鸟在竹林里高声鸣唱。

e.en: Birdkeepers prize the {shama} for its clear song.
e.zh: 养鸟人看重沙玛鸟清亮的鸣声。

e.en: A hot {shamal} blew dust across the road.
e.zh: 炎热的夏季西北风把尘土吹过道路。

e.en: Flights were delayed when the {shamal} reduced visibility.
e.zh: shamal风降低能见度，航班因此延误。

e.en: The writer tried to {shamanise} the hero's journey.
e.zh: 作者试图给英雄旅程染上萨满教色彩。

e.en: Some artists {shamanise} ordinary rituals in performance.
e.zh: 一些艺术家在表演中把日常仪式萨满化。

e.en: The village invited a {shamanist} to lead the ceremony.
e.zh: 村里请来一位萨满教徒主持仪式。

e.en: The film uses {shamanist} images throughout its dream scenes.
e.zh: 这部电影在梦境场景中大量使用萨满教意象。

shamanize.t: 使萨满化；按萨满方式解释

e.en: Critics say the novel tends to {shamanize} mental illness.
e.zh: 批评者说这部小说倾向于把精神疾病萨满化。

e.en: The ritual can {shamanize} a simple healing practice.
e.zh: 这种仪式能把简单的疗愈做法转化为萨满式实践。

shamateur.t: 假业余选手；冒牌业余者

e.en: The boxer was called a {shamateur} after taking secret payments.
e.zh: 那名拳手因私下收钱而被称为假业余选手。

e.en: Fans accused the league of protecting every {shamateur}.
e.zh: 球迷指责联盟包庇每个冒牌业余者。

shamateurism.t: 假业余主义；伪业余身份

e.en: The scandal exposed {shamateurism} in college sports.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻揭露了大学体育中的假业余主义。

e.en: Officials denied that {shamateurism} had become common.
e.zh: 官员否认伪业余身份已经变得普遍。

e.en: Her family grows maize on a small {shamba}.
e.zh: 她家在一块小农场上种玉米。

e.en: After school, he helped weed the {shamba}.
e.zh: 放学后，他帮忙给那片田地除草。

shame-making.t: 令人羞愧的；制造羞耻的

e.en: The judge condemned the {shame-making} treatment of prisoners.
e.zh: 法官谴责了那种令人羞愧的囚犯待遇。

e.en: Public blame can become a {shame-making} ritual.
e.zh: 公开责备可能变成一种制造羞耻的仪式。

e.en: The poem praises a {shamefast} young knight.
e.zh: 这首诗赞美了一位知羞耻的年轻骑士。

e.en: Her {shamefast} silence was mistaken for weakness.
e.zh: 她端庄的沉默被误认为软弱。

shammies.t: 麂皮布；擦拭用软皮复数

e.en: Keep clean {shammies} in the car for the windows.
e.zh: 车里备些干净的麂皮布擦车窗。

e.en: The detailer washed the {shammies} after polishing the paint.
e.zh: 汽车美容师抛光车漆后清洗了那些擦拭软皮。

e.en: He dried the windshield with a {shammy}.
e.zh: 他用麂皮布擦干了挡风玻璃。

e.en: Please {shammy} the car before the wax dries.
e.zh: 请在车蜡变干前用麂皮把车擦一遍。

e.en: The antique manual recommends polishing silver with {shamois}.

e.en: The clay had a {sheety} texture when it dried.
e.zh: 黏土干后呈现出片状的质地。

e.en: Her grandfather jokingly called him a {shegetz}.
e.zh: 她祖父开玩笑地叫他非犹太小子。

e.en: In the old story, the {shegetz} causes trouble in town.
e.zh: 在那个老故事里，这个顽皮小子在镇上惹了麻烦。

e.en: The small {sheikhdom} grew rich from oil exports.
e.zh: 这个小酋长国靠石油出口变得富有。

e.en: Travelers crossed the border into another {sheikhdom}.
e.zh: 旅行者越过边境，进入了另一个酋长领地。

e.en: Several {sheikhdoms} joined to form a federation.
e.zh: 几个酋长国联合起来组成了一个联邦。

e.en: The treaty affected trade among the coastal {sheikhdoms}.
e.zh: 这项条约影响了沿海各酋长领地之间的贸易。

e.en: She bought a new {sheitel} before the holiday.
e.zh: 节日前她买了一顶新的犹太已婚妇女假发。

e.en: The salon specializes in styling a {sheitel} naturally.
e.zh: 这家发廊专门把这种假发打理得很自然。

e.en: The hymn speaks of the {shekinah} filling the temple.
e.zh: 这首圣歌讲到上帝临在的荣光充满圣殿。

e.en: Mystics described {shekinah} as a divine presence.
e.zh: 神秘主义者把舍金纳描述为一种神圣临在。

e.en: A {sheld} duck stood near the reeds.
e.zh: 一只带斑纹的鸭子站在芦苇旁。

e.en: The old text mentions a {sheld} pattern on the bird.
e.zh: 那段古文提到鸟身上有杂色花纹。

shelf-stacker.t: 超市理货员；货架补货员

e.en: He worked evenings as a {shelf-stacker} at the supermarket.
e.zh: 他晚上在超市当货架补货员。

e.en: The {shelf-stacker} quickly replaced the empty cereal boxes.
e.zh: 理货员很快补上了空掉的麦片盒。

e.en: She donated a {shelfful} of old novels.
e.zh: 她捐出了一整架子的旧小说。

e.en: A {shelfful} of spices lined the kitchen wall.
e.zh: 厨房墙边摆着满满一架子的香料。

e.en: This sauce has a long {shelflife}.
e.zh: 这种酱料保质期很长。

e.en: Fame can have a short {shelflife} online.
e.zh: 在网上，名气的寿命可能很短。

e.en: The rocks formed a {shelfy} ledge above the river.
e.zh: 岩石在河面上方形成了像架子的突出平台。

e.en: That corner feels too {shelfy} with all those boards.
e.zh: 那个角落放了那么多板子，显得太像一排架子了。

e.en: A {shell-burst} shook the trench at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时一声炮弹爆炸震动了战壕。

e.en: The report described injuries from a nearby {shell-burst}.
e.zh: 报告描述了附近弹片炸裂造成的伤情。

e.en: We have a {shedload} of work to finish today.
e.zh: 我们今天有一大堆工作要完成。

e.en: He spent a {shedload} of money on repairs.
e.zh: 他在维修上花了大量的钱。

e.en: The old novel uses {sheeney} as an offensive slur.
e.zh: 那本旧小说把sheeney用作冒犯性的蔑称。

e.en: Editors removed {sheeney} from the dialogue because it was hateful.
e.zh: 编辑删去了对话中的sheeney，因为它带有仇恨意味。

e.en: The gang shouted {sheenies} in a racist chant.
e.zh: 那伙人在种族主义口号中喊出sheenies这个蔑称。

e.en: Modern editions mark {sheenies} as an offensive historical term.
e.zh: 现代版本把sheenies标注为冒犯性的历史用语。

e.en: The beetle had a {sheeny} green shell.
e.zh: 那只甲虫有一层发亮的绿色外壳。

e.en: In old slang, {sheeny} was used as an offensive slur.
e.zh: 在旧俚语中，sheeny曾被用作冒犯性的蔑称。

e.en: The farmer mixed fresh {sheep-dip} before treating the flock.
e.zh: 农夫在给羊群处理前调好了新的羊药浴液。

e.en: They had to {sheep-dip} every animal after the outbreak.
e.zh: 疫情暴发后，他们不得不给每只羊做药浴。

e.en: The {sheep-dog} guided the flock through the gate.
e.zh: 牧羊犬把羊群引过了大门。

e.en: A good {sheep-dog} responds quickly to whistles.
e.zh: 训练有素的牧羊犬会迅速响应口哨声。

e.en: The {sheep-farmer} repairs fences every spring.
e.zh: 这位羊农每年春天都会修补围栏。

e.en: A local {sheep-farmer} sells wool at the market.
e.zh: 当地一位养羊农民在市场上卖羊毛。

e.en: The path was dotted with dry {sheepberry} after the flock passed.
e.zh: 羊群经过后，小路上散落着干羊粪粒。

e.en: Children laughed at the word {sheepberry} in the rural glossary.
e.zh: 孩子们看到乡村词汇表里的sheepberry这个词都笑了。

e.en: The lambs slept safely inside the {sheepcot}.
e.zh: 小羊羔在羊圈里安全地睡着。

e.en: An abandoned {sheepcot} stood beside the stone wall.
e.zh: 一座废弃的羊栏立在石墙旁边。

e.en: The shepherd led the flock back to the {sheepcote}.
e.zh: 牧羊人把羊群带回了羊舍。

e.en: A ruined {sheepcote} appears in the old estate map.
e.zh: 旧庄园地图上标着一处破败的羊圈。

e.en: The vet recommended a stronger {sheepdip} for the parasites.
e.zh: 兽医建议用更强效的羊药浴液来除寄生虫。

e.en: Workers {sheepdip} the flock before moving it to summer pasture.
e.zh: 工人们在把羊群转到夏季牧场前给它们做药浴。

e.en: He learned {sheepherding} from his grandfather in the hills.
e.zh: 他在山里跟祖父学会了牧羊。

e.en: Modern {sheepherding} often uses dogs and portable fences.
e.zh: 现代放羊常常会用到牧羊犬和移动围栏。

e.en: The shepherd pulled the branch aside with his {sheephook}.
e.zh: 牧羊人用羊钩把树枝拨到一边。

e.en: A carved {sheephook} hung above the cottage door.
e.zh: 一根雕花的牧羊杖挂在小屋门上方。

e.en: The animal made a soft, {sheeplike} sound.
e.zh: 那只动物发出柔和的、像羊一样的声音。

e.en: The crowd followed with {sheeplike} obedience.
e.zh: 人群以盲从般的顺服跟了上去。

e.en: The old {sheepman} knew every trail across the moor.
e.zh: 那位老牧羊人熟悉荒原上的每一条小路。

e.en: A successful {sheepman} watches weather and wool prices closely.
e.zh: 成功的养羊人会密切关注天气和羊毛价格。

e.en: The {sheepmaster} hired two boys for lambing season.
e.zh: 羊群主人在产羔季雇了两个男孩帮忙。

e.en: As {sheepmaster}, he decided where the flock would graze.
e.zh: 作为牧羊主，他决定羊群在哪里吃草。

e.en: The report compared beef, pork, and {sheepmeat} prices.
e.zh: 报告比较了牛肉、猪肉和羊肉的价格。

e.en: Some regions export frozen {sheepmeat} to overseas markets.
e.zh: 一些地区向海外市场出口冷冻羊肉。

e.en: The family bought a large {sheeprun} near the river.
e.zh: 这家人在河边买下了一大片放羊牧场。

e.en: Rain turned the remote {sheeprun} into a muddy plain.
e.zh: 大雨把偏远的羊场变成了一片泥泞平地。

e.en: The sailor tied a {sheepshank} to shorten the rope.
e.zh: 水手打了一个缩帆结来缩短绳子。

e.en: The butcher set aside a {sheepshank} for the stew.
e.zh: 屠夫留出一块羊腿骨部位来炖菜。

e.en: The {sheepshearer} worked quickly in the crowded shed.
e.zh: 剪羊毛工在拥挤的棚屋里干得很快。

e.en: A skilled {sheepshearer} can handle hundreds of animals a day.
e.zh: 熟练的剪羊毛工一天能处理数百只羊。

e.en: The village holds a {sheepshearing} contest every summer.
e.zh: 这个村庄每年夏天都会举办剪羊毛比赛。

e.en: During {sheepshearing}, extra workers sleep in the barn.
e.zh: 剪毛季期间，额外雇来的工人睡在谷仓里。

e.en: The hillside served as a {sheepwalk} for generations.
e.zh: 这片山坡世世代代都是羊群放牧地。

e.en: Old maps mark the common {sheepwalk} beyond the village.
e.zh: 旧地图标出了村外的公共羊群放牧地。

e.en: It was the {sheerest} luck that saved them.
e.zh: 救了他们的完全是最纯粹的运气。

e.en: The climbers faced the {sheerest} wall on the mountain.
e.zh: 登山者面对着山上最陡峭的岩壁。

e.en: The harbor used a {sheerhulk} to raise heavy masts.
e.zh: 港口用一艘装有起重架的旧船来吊起沉重的桅杆。

e.en: A rusting {sheerhulk} remained moored near the dock.
e.zh: 一艘生锈的起重旧船仍停泊在码头旁。

e.en: The farmer planted {shelterbelts} around the fields.
e.zh: 农民在田地周围种了防护林带。

e.en: Old {shelterbelts} reduced wind damage in winter.
e.zh: 老防风林带减少了冬季风害。

e.en: The storm left many families {shelterless}.
e.zh: 暴风雨使许多家庭无处栖身。

e.en: A {shelterless} traveler slept under the bridge.
e.zh: 一个无庇护的旅人睡在桥下。

sheltery.t: 有遮蔽感的；可避风雨的

e.en: We found a {sheltery} corner near the wall.
e.zh: 我们在墙边找到一个能避风的角落。

e.en: The trees made the path feel {sheltery}.
e.zh: 那些树让小路显得很有遮蔽感。

e.en: Her {sheltie} followed her across the yard.
e.zh: 她的喜乐蒂牧羊犬跟着她穿过院子。

e.en: A nervous {sheltie} barked at the gate.
e.zh: 一只紧张的喜乐蒂牧羊犬在门口吠叫。

shelty.t: 喜乐蒂犬；矮小设得兰马

e.en: Their {shelty} won a small dog show.
e.zh: 他们的喜乐蒂犬赢得了一场小型犬展。

e.en: The child rode a calm {shelty} pony.
e.zh: 那个孩子骑着一匹温顺的设得兰小马。

e.en: The cave wall looked rough and {shelvy}.
e.zh: 洞壁看起来粗糙而且有层架状突起。

e.en: She chose a {shelvy} cabinet for the pantry.
e.zh: 她给食品储藏室选了一个带搁板的柜子。

shemale.t: 带冒犯性的跨性别女性称呼

e.en: The term {shemale} is widely considered offensive.
e.zh: “shemale”这个词普遍被认为带有冒犯性。

e.en: Avoid using {shemale} to describe a person.
e.zh: 不要用“shemale”来称呼一个人。

e.en: The scholar compared several {shemitish} languages.
e.zh: 那位学者比较了几种闪语族语言。

e.en: Older books sometimes use the spelling {shemitish}.
e.zh: 较旧的书有时会使用“shemitish”这种拼法。

e.en: The meeting became a complete {shemozzle}.
e.zh: 会议变成了一场彻底的混乱。

e.en: Their travel plans ended in a {shemozzle}.
e.zh: 他们的旅行计划最后乱成一团。

e.en: In Chinese thought, {shen} can mean spirit.
e.zh: 在中国思想中，shen可以指精神。

e.en: The text discusses {shen} and human vitality.
e.zh: 这篇文字讨论了神与人的生命活力。

e.en: The old tale says pride will {shend} him.
e.zh: 这个古老故事说骄傲会使他蒙羞。

e.en: The knight feared he would be {shent}.
e.zh: 那名骑士担心自己会受辱。

e.en: The poem describes honor slowly {shending} away.
e.zh: 这首诗描写荣誉逐渐受损消逝。

e.en: His harsh words were {shending} the young servant.
e.zh: 他的刻薄话正在羞辱那个年轻仆人。

e.en: He stood {shent} before the angry lord.
e.zh: 他羞愧地站在愤怒的领主面前。

e.en: The guilty messenger felt thoroughly {shent}.
e.zh: 那个有错的信使感到十分羞惭。

e.en: The teacher explained {shenti} as the human body.
e.zh: 老师解释说shenti指人的身体。

e.en: In the notes, {shenti} appears beside qi.
e.zh: 在笔记里，shenti出现在“气”的旁边。

e.en: The {shepherdless} flock wandered near the road.
e.zh: 那群无人看管的羊在路边游荡。

e.en: They felt {shepherdless} after their leader resigned.
e.zh: 领导辞职后，他们觉得无人引领。

e.en: The factory will {sherardize} the steel bolts.
e.zh: 工厂会用锌粉渗镀这些钢螺栓以防锈。

e.en: Engineers {sherardize} small parts for corrosion resistance.
e.zh: 工程师会给小零件做锌粉渗镀来抗腐蚀。

e.en: {Sherardizing} protects iron parts from rust.
e.zh: 锌粉渗镀能保护铁件不生锈。

e.en: The manual explains {sherardizing} in detail.
e.zh: 手册详细解释了锌粉渗镀工艺。

e.en: She ordered orange {sherbert} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后她点了橙味冰沙。

e.en: The children dipped candy into {sherbert} powder.
e.zh: 孩子们把糖果蘸进果味汽水粉里。

e.en: The old poem speaks of {shere} delight.
e.zh: 那首古诗写到纯粹的欢喜。

e.en: A {shere} light seemed to fill the hall.
e.zh: 一种明亮的光仿佛充满了大厅。

shereef.t: 谢里夫；伊斯兰贵族称号

e.en: The visitor was introduced as a {shereef}.
e.zh: 那位来客被介绍为一名谢里夫。

e.en: A local {shereef} settled the dispute.
e.zh: 当地一位谢里夫调解了这场纠纷。

e.en: The museum displayed a rare {shergottite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块罕见的辉玻无球粒陨石。

e.en: Scientists linked the {shergottite} to Mars.
e.zh: 科学家把这块辉玻无球粒陨石与火星联系起来。

e.en: The article discusses {sheria} in family law.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论了家庭法中的伊斯兰教法。

e.en: Different courts interpret {sheria} differently.
e.zh: 不同法院对沙里亚法有不同解释。

e.en: The records describe the {sheriffalty} in unusual detail.
e.zh: 这些记录异常详细地描述了郡长辖区。

e.en: He treated the {sheriffalty} as a family privilege.
e.zh: 他把郡长职位视为家族特权。

e.en: The boundary of the {sheriffwick} changed after the reform.
e.zh: 改革后，郡长管辖区的边界发生了变化。

e.en: Taxes were gathered throughout the {sheriffwick}.
e.zh: 税款在整个郡长管辖区内征收。

e.en: She served {sherried} soup before the main course.
e.zh: 她在主菜前端上了加雪利酒的汤。

e.en: The chef made a {sherried} sauce for the mushrooms.
e.zh: 厨师为蘑菇做了一种加雪利酒的酱汁。

e.en: The sign misspelled {sherrif} in large letters.
e.zh: 那块牌子用大字把警长一词误拼成了 sherrif。

e.en: He typed {sherrif} instead of sheriff.
e.zh: 他把 sheriff 错打成了 sherrif。

e.en: Falstaff praises {sherris} in the play.
e.zh: 福斯塔夫在剧中赞美雪利酒。

e.en: The manuscript uses {sherris} where modern readers expect sherry.
e.zh: 手稿用了 sherris，而现代读者会以为是 sherry。

e.en: She filled each {sherry-glass} only halfway.
e.zh: 她只把每只雪利酒杯倒到半满。

e.en: A tiny {sherry-glass} stood beside the decanter.
e.zh: 醒酒瓶旁放着一只小小的雪利酒杯。

e.en: We took a {sherut} from the airport to Jerusalem.
e.zh: 我们从机场搭了一辆以色列合乘小巴去耶路撒冷。

e.en: The {sherut} leaves when all the seats are full.
e.zh: 这种合乘小巴坐满后就发车。

e.en: He wore a cream {sherwani} at the wedding.
e.zh: 他在婚礼上穿了一件奶油色的南亚男式长外套。

e.en: The tailor embroidered the {sherwani} with gold thread.
e.zh: 裁缝用金线给那件长外套绣花。

e.en: {She's} ready for the meeting now.
e.zh: 她现在已经准备好开会了。

e.en: {She's} been here since morning.
e.zh: 她从早上起就一直在这里。

e.en: They played {sheshbesh} outside the cafe.
e.zh: 他们在咖啡馆外下中东双陆棋。

e.en: My grandfather taught me {sheshbesh} during long evenings.
e.zh: 祖父在漫长的夜晚教我玩中东双陆棋。

e.en: Rainwater ran quickly through the {sheugh}.
e.zh: 雨水很快流过那条沟渠。

e.en: The sheep crossed a narrow {sheugh} near the field.
e.zh: 羊群越过田边一条狭窄的沟。

e.en: The teacher marked a {sheva} under the Hebrew letter.
e.zh: 老师在那个希伯来字母下面标了一个弱元音符号。

e.en: A silent {sheva} can affect the rhythm of reading.
e.zh: 不发音的 sheva 会影响朗读节奏。

e.en: The priest placed the {shewbread} on the table.
e.zh: 祭司把陈设饼放在桌上。

e.en: The passage describes the {shewbread} in the temple.
e.zh: 这段经文描述了圣殿中的供饼。

e.en: {Shhhh}, I can hear someone outside.
e.zh: 嘘，我听见外面有人。

e.en: He said {shhhh} and pointed at the stage.
e.zh: 他说了声嘘，然后指向舞台。

e.en: The judo {shiai} began after the warm-up.
e.zh: 柔道试合在热身后开始。

e.en: She entered her first {shiai} with quiet confidence.
e.zh: 她带着沉稳的自信参加了第一次武术比赛。

e.en: The spa advertised {shiatzu} massages downtown.
e.zh: 那家水疗中心在市中心宣传指压按摩。

e.en: He wrote {shiatzu}, though most signs used shiatsu.
e.zh: 他写成 shiatzu，不过多数招牌用的是 shiatsu。

e.en: The family observed {shibah} after the funeral.
e.zh: 葬礼后，全家守了犹太七日丧期。

e.en: Friends visited during {shibah} to offer comfort.
e.zh: 朋友们在丧期中前来探望并安慰家人。

e.en: The old cabinet was coated with {shell-lac}.
e.zh: 这个旧柜子涂了一层虫胶漆。

e.en: Artists once used {shell-lac} to seal delicate surfaces.
e.zh: 艺术家过去会用虫胶来封护细致的表面。

e.en: The recipe calls for {shell-less} shrimp.
e.zh: 这道菜需要去壳虾。

e.en: Scientists studied a rare {shell-less} egg.
e.zh: 科学家研究了一枚罕见的无壳蛋。

e.en: The lamp had a {shell-like} shade.
e.zh: 这盏灯有一个贝壳状的灯罩。

e.en: A {shell-like} curve framed the entrance.
e.zh: 一道像贝壳的弧线围住了入口。

e.en: The mason mixed {shell-lime} with sand.
e.zh: 泥瓦匠把贝壳石灰和沙子混合。

e.en: Old coastal houses often used {shell-lime} mortar.
e.zh: 老海边房屋常用壳灰砂浆。

shell-shocked.t: 炮弹休克的；震惊失措的

e.en: The soldier returned {shell-shocked} from the front.
e.zh: 那名士兵从前线回来时患上炮弹休克。

e.en: Investors looked {shell-shocked} after the sudden crash.
e.zh: 市场突然暴跌后，投资者显得惊慌失措。

e.en: They planned to {shellack} the wooden table.
e.zh: 他们打算给木桌涂上虫胶漆。

e.en: Our team got {shellacked} in the final game.
e.zh: 我们队在决赛中被打得惨败。

shellback.t: 老水手；越过赤道的水手

e.en: The {shellback} told stories about crossing the equator.
e.zh: 那位老水手讲起穿越赤道的故事。

e.en: New sailors were welcomed by the veteran {shellback}.
e.zh: 新水手受到那位资深赤道水手的欢迎。

e.en: A tall {shellbark} grew near the creek.
e.zh: 小溪旁长着一棵高大的剥壳山核桃树。

e.en: The {shellbark} nuts were hard to crack.
e.zh: 剥壳山核桃的果仁很难砸开。

e.en: A sudden {shellburst} shook the trench.
e.zh: 突如其来的炮弹爆炸震动了战壕。

e.en: They waited silently after the last {shellburst}.
e.zh: 最后一声炮弹爆炸后，他们静静等待。

e.en: He caught a large {shellcracker} in the lake.
e.zh: 他在湖里钓到一条很大的裂壳鱼。

e.en: The bird is a natural {shellcracker}.
e.zh: 这种鸟天生会啄开硬壳取食。

e.en: The village depends on its {shellfishery}.
e.zh: 这个村子依靠当地的贝类渔业。

e.en: Pollution forced the {shellfishery} to close.
e.zh: 污染迫使那片贝类养殖场关闭。

e.en: She planted {shellflower} beside the path.
e.zh: 她在小路旁种了贝壳花。

e.en: The vase was decorated with a carved {shellflower}.
e.zh: 花瓶上装饰着一朵雕刻的壳状花。

e.en: The beach sand had a noticeable {shelliness}.
e.zh: 这片海滩的沙子明显含有许多贝壳碎片。

e.en: The designer liked the fabric's slight {shelliness}.
e.zh: 设计师喜欢这种面料略带壳状的质感。

e.en: The turtle looked oddly {shellless} in the drawing.
e.zh: 画里的乌龟没有壳，看起来很奇怪。

e.en: Buy {shellless} seeds for easier baking.
e.zh: 买去壳的种子会更方便烘焙。

e.en: They built a {shellproof} shelter underground.
e.zh: 他们在地下建了一个防炮弹掩体。

e.en: No wall was truly {shellproof} under heavy fire.
e.zh: 在猛烈炮火下，没有哪堵墙真正防得住炮击。

e.en: Many veterans suffered from {shellshock} after the war.
e.zh: 许多退伍军人在战后患有炮弹休克。

e.en: The news left the whole office in {shellshock}.
e.zh: 这个消息让整个办公室都陷入极度震惊。

shellshocked.t: 炮弹休克的；震惊失措的

e.en: The survivors looked {shellshocked} and exhausted.
e.zh: 幸存者看上去惊魂未定、疲惫不堪。

e.en: Fans were {shellshocked} by the last-minute defeat.
e.zh: 球迷被最后一分钟的失利惊得目瞪口呆。

e.en: The mirror frame was covered in {shellwork}.
e.zh: 镜框上布满了贝壳装饰。

e.en: She learned {shellwork} from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她从祖母那里学会了贝壳工艺。

shelta.t: 谢尔塔语；爱尔兰流浪者隐语

e.en: Some Irish Travellers traditionally spoke {Shelta}.
e.zh: 一些爱尔兰流浪者传统上讲谢尔塔语。

e.en: The linguist recorded words from {Shelta}.
e.zh: 那位语言学家记录了谢尔塔语中的词汇。

e.en: Farmers planted a {shelter-belt} along the fields.
e.zh: 农民在田边种了一条防护林带。

e.en: The {shelter-belt} reduced wind damage to crops.
e.zh: 这条防风林带减少了作物的风害。

e.en: The government protected the mountain {shelter-forest}.
e.zh: 政府保护了山上的防护林。

e.en: A {shelter-forest} can slow erosion on steep slopes.
e.zh: 防护林能减缓陡坡上的水土流失。

e.en: A dense {shelterbelt} stood behind the farmhouse.
e.zh: 农舍后面有一片茂密的防护林带。

e.en: The new {shelterbelt} helped protect young trees.
e.zh: 新的防风林带帮助保护幼树。

e.en: The actor used a {shibilant} whisper on stage.
e.zh: 那名演员在台上用了带咝音的低语。

e.en: A {shibilant} sound came from the old pipe.
e.zh: 旧管道里传来一阵咝咝声。

e.en: A {shicer} of glass glittered on the floor.
e.zh: 地板上一小片玻璃闪着光。

e.en: He kept a {shicer} of bread for later.
e.zh: 他留了一小片面包待会儿吃。

e.en: He poured a {shick} before dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭前他倒了一小杯酒。

e.en: The old inn served ale by the {shick}.
e.zh: 那家老客栈按小杯卖麦酒。

e.en: They went out to {shicker} after the fair.
e.zh: 集市结束后他们出去喝酒作乐。

e.en: His habit of {shicker} worried his family.
e.zh: 他酗酒的习惯让家人担心。

e.en: He came home {shickered} and singing loudly.
e.zh: 他醉醺醺地回家，还大声唱着歌。

e.en: The {shickered} guests left after midnight.
e.zh: 那些喝醉的客人午夜后才离开。

e.en: She placed a dry {shide} on the fire.
e.zh: 她往火里放了一块干木柴。

e.en: The carpenter split the log into a {shide}.
e.zh: 木匠把原木劈成了一块木片。

e.en: He took a {shie} at the tin cans.
e.zh: 他朝那些罐头盒投了一下。

e.en: The horse began to {shie} at the noise.
e.zh: 那匹马听到响声后突然躲闪。

e.en: A green {shieldbug} rested on the leaf.
e.zh: 一只绿色盾蝽停在叶子上。

e.en: The child watched the {shieldbug} crawl slowly.
e.zh: 孩子看着那只椿象慢慢爬动。

e.en: The knight stood {shieldless} before the gate.
e.zh: 骑士没有盾牌，站在城门前。

e.en: The tiny village was {shieldless} against storms.
e.zh: 这个小村庄面对风暴毫无防护。

e.en: She was the {shiest} child in class.
e.zh: 她是班里最害羞的孩子。

e.en: Even the {shiest} kitten came closer.
e.zh: 连最胆怯的小猫也靠近了。

e.en: He took a quick {shiff} at the letter.
e.zh: 他匆匆看了一眼那封信。

e.en: Give the list a {shiff} before we leave.
e.zh: 我们走之前你快看一眼清单。

e.en: A {shift-worker} often sleeps during the day.
e.zh: 轮班工人常常在白天睡觉。

e.en: The hospital hired another {shift-worker} for nights.
e.zh: 医院又雇了一名夜班员工。

e.en: The design's {shiftability} made updates easier.
e.zh: 这种设计的可变换性让更新更容易。

e.en: Managers valued the team's {shiftability} under pressure.
e.zh: 经理们看重团队在压力下的可调整性。

e.en: The shelves are {shiftable} for different displays.
e.zh: 这些架子可以移动，以适应不同陈列。

e.en: The deadline is {shiftable} if problems appear.
e.zh: 如果出现问题，截止日期可以调整。

e.en: He was the {shiftiest} man in the room.
e.zh: 他是房间里最可疑的人。

e.en: The {shiftiest} excuses came after midnight.
e.zh: 最狡猾的借口是在午夜后冒出来的。

e.en: He looked {shiftily} toward the exit.
e.zh: 他鬼鬼祟祟地看向出口。

e.en: The salesman smiled {shiftily} during the deal.
e.zh: 交易时那个推销员狡黠地笑了笑。

e.en: A {shifty-eyed} stranger waited outside.
e.zh: 一个眼神闪烁的陌生人在外面等着。

e.en: The witness described a {shifty-eyed} young man.
e.zh: 目击者描述了一名眼神可疑的年轻男子。

e.en: The colonel went on {shikar} in India.
e.zh: 那位上校在印度参加了狩猎。

e.en: Old journals described weeks of {shikar}.
e.zh: 旧日记描述了持续数周的猎游。

e.en: The {shikari} led the party through the forest.
e.zh: 那名狩猎向导带着队伍穿过森林。

e.en: In the old memoir, a {shikari} tracks a tiger at dawn.
e.zh: 在那本旧回忆录里，一名猎人在黎明追踪老虎。

e.en: The chemist isolated {shikimin} from the plant sample.
e.zh: 化学家从植物样本中分离出了莽草酸相关物质。

e.en: Older papers sometimes mention {shikimin} in studies of star anise.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时会在研究八角时提到莽草酸相关物质。

e.en: The old novel uses {shikse} in a dismissive way.
e.zh: 那本旧小说用“非犹太女子”这个词，语气带有轻蔑。

e.en: He winced when his aunt called his girlfriend a {shikse}.
e.zh: 姨妈把他的女友叫作非犹太女子时，他听了很不舒服。

e.en: The guard carried a heavy {shilalah} at his side.
e.zh: 守卫身边带着一根沉重的爱尔兰橡木棍。

e.en: In the song, a {shilalah} becomes a comic weapon.
e.zh: 在那首歌里，爱尔兰棍棒成了一件滑稽的武器。

e.en: Her {shilful} handling of the horse impressed everyone.
e.zh: 她熟练地驾驭那匹马，让所有人都很佩服。

e.en: The cabinet showed a {shilful} use of simple materials.
e.zh: 这个柜子体现出对普通材料的巧妙运用。

e.en: He raised the {shillalah} above his shoulder.
e.zh: 他把那根爱尔兰橡木棍举过肩头。

e.en: The tale gives every village fighter a stout {shillalah}.
e.zh: 这个故事让每个村里的斗士都拿着一根结实的棍棒。

e.en: The old man tapped his {shillelah} on the stones.
e.zh: 老人用他的爱尔兰橡木棍敲着石板路。

e.en: A carved {shillelah} hung over the tavern door.
e.zh: 一根雕花的爱尔兰棍棒挂在酒馆门上方。

e.en: She bought a {shillingsworth} of apples at the market.
e.zh: 她在市场上买了一先令价值的苹果。

e.en: A {shillingsworth} of coal was enough for one cold evening.
e.zh: 一先令价值的煤足够撑过一个寒冷的夜晚。

e.en: The committee {shilly-shallied} until the deadline passed.
e.zh: 委员会一直犹豫拖延，直到期限过去。

e.en: He {shilly-shallied} over the invitation for days.
e.zh: 他为那份邀请犹豫了好几天。

e.en: She {shilly-shallies} whenever a firm answer is needed.
e.zh: 每当需要明确答复时，她总是犹豫不决。

e.en: The team {shilly-shallies} over minor details instead of deciding.
e.zh: 团队在小细节上拖拖拉拉，就是不作决定。

e.en: Do not {shilly-shally} when the train is leaving.
e.zh: 火车快开了，就别再犹豫拖拉了。

e.en: His habit of {shilly-shally} annoyed the whole office.
e.zh: 他拖拖拉拉的习惯让整个办公室都很烦。

e.en: After hours of {shilly-shallying}, they finally chose a date.
e.zh: 犹豫了好几个小时后，他们终于选定了日期。

e.en: Her {shilly-shallying} made the simple purchase take all morning.
e.zh: 她的迟疑拖拉让一件简单的采购耗掉了整个上午。

e.en: They {shillyshallied} over the contract until the client left.
e.zh: 他们在合同问题上拖拖拉拉，直到客户离开。

e.en: He {shillyshallied} before admitting what he wanted.
e.zh: 他说出自己想要什么之前，先犹豫了半天。

e.en: We cannot {shillyshally} with a storm approaching.
e.zh: 暴风雨快来了，我们不能再犹豫拖延。

e.en: Her speech had a {shillyshally} quality that weakened the proposal.
e.zh: 她的发言显得犹豫不定，削弱了这项提案的力度。

e.en: Several {shipfuls} of grain arrived before winter.
e.zh: 入冬前来了好几船粮食。

e.en: The port handled two {shipfuls} of refugees that week.
e.zh: 那个星期港口接纳了两船难民。

e.en: The cabin walls were covered with white {shiplap}.
e.zh: 小屋的墙面铺着白色搭接木板。

e.en: They installed {shiplap} behind the kitchen shelves.
e.zh: 他们在厨房架子后面装了企口板。

e.en: The fishermen were {shipless} after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后，渔民们没有船可用。

e.en: A {shipless} navy could not defend the coast.
e.zh: 没有船只的海军无法保卫海岸。

e.en: The island still received {shipmail} once a month.
e.zh: 那座岛仍每月收到一次船运邮件。

e.en: Old letters marked as {shipmail} filled the drawer.
e.zh: 抽屉里塞满了标着海邮的旧信。

e.en: The vase is fragile but still {shippable}.
e.zh: 这个花瓶很脆弱，但仍可以发货。

e.en: Only finished products are {shippable} from this warehouse.
e.zh: 这个仓库只发运成品。

e.en: The cows slept in the old {shippen}.
e.zh: 奶牛睡在那间旧牛棚里。

e.en: They converted the stone {shippen} into a cottage.
e.zh: 他们把石砌牲口棚改成了小屋。

e.en: Two ruined {shippens} stood behind the farmhouse.
e.zh: 农舍后面有两间废弃的牛棚。

e.en: The estate map showed barns and {shippens}.
e.zh: 庄园地图上标出了谷仓和牲口棚。

e.en: The invoice misspelled {shippment} instead of shipment.
e.zh: 发票把shipment误拼成了shippment。

e.en: Searches for {shippment} usually mean shipment tracking.
e.zh: 搜索shippment通常是想查货运追踪。

e.en: A low stone {shippon} stood beside the lane.
e.zh: 小路旁有一间低矮的石头牛棚。

e.en: The farmer cleaned the {shippon} before milking.
e.zh: 农夫挤奶前清扫了牛棚。

e.en: Cargo was delivered directly to the {shipside}.
e.zh: 货物被直接送到船边。

e.en: The crane moved slowly along the {shipside}.
e.zh: 起重机沿着靠船一侧缓慢移动。

e.en: The new trawler rested on the {shipway}.
e.zh: 新拖网渔船停放在船台上。

e.en: Workers greased the {shipway} before launch.
e.zh: 工人在下水前给滑道抹油。

e.en: He carried his {shiralee} across the dusty road.
e.zh: 他背着随身包袱走过尘土飞扬的路。

e.en: The child became his unexpected {shiralee}.
e.zh: 那个孩子成了他意想不到的负担。

e.en: She will {shirr} the fabric at the waist.
e.zh: 她会在腰部给布料抽褶。

e.en: The pattern tells you to {shirr} three rows.
e.zh: 纸样要求你缝三排松紧褶。

e.en: The dress had a {shirred} waist and short sleeves.
e.zh: 这条裙子有抽褶腰身和短袖。

e.en: She wore a {shirred} cotton top in summer.
e.zh: 夏天她穿了一件抽褶棉上衣。

e.en: The {shirring} made the blouse fit comfortably.
e.zh: 抽褶让这件衬衫穿起来很合身。

e.en: Use elastic thread for neat {shirring}.
e.zh: 用弹力线可以做出整齐的松紧褶。

e.en: The old sailor looked like a {shilpit} after weeks at sea.
e.zh: 那位老水手在海上待了几周后，看起来像个邋遢散漫的人。

e.en: She called him a {shilpit} when he arrived in torn clothes.
e.zh: 他穿着破衣服到来时，她说他像个邋遢鬼。

e.en: The beach was covered with broken {shils} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，海滩上满是破碎的壳片。

e.en: He collected tiny {shils} and kept them in a jar.
e.zh: 他收集了许多小壳，把它们装在罐子里。

e.en: The child smiled {shily} at the visitor.
e.zh: 那个孩子害羞地朝访客笑了笑。

e.en: She answered {shily} when the teacher praised her work.
e.zh: 老师表扬她的作业时，她腼腆地回答了。

e.en: She did a little {shimmey} across the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 她在厨房地板上轻轻扭着身子走过去。

e.en: The dancer's playful {shimmey} made the crowd laugh.
e.zh: 舞者俏皮的扭摆让观众笑了起来。

e.en: The students held noisy {shindies} every weekend.
e.zh: 学生们每个周末都举行吵闹的聚会。

e.en: Several political {shindies} broke out before the vote.
e.zh: 投票前爆发了几场政治骚动。

e.en: They threw a {shindy} in the barn after harvest.
e.zh: 收获之后，他们在谷仓里办了一场热闹聚会。

e.en: A {shindy} started when the neighbors argued about parking.
e.zh: 邻居们为停车争吵时，一阵骚动就开始了。

e.en: The carpenter began to {shing} the roof before noon.
e.zh: 木匠中午前开始给屋顶铺木瓦。

e.en: They used a sharp tool to {shing} the old timber.
e.zh: 他们用锋利工具把旧木料削成薄片。

e.en: We walked along the {shingly} beach at low tide.
e.zh: 退潮时，我们沿着满是卵石的海滩散步。

e.en: The hut had a {shingly} roof that rattled in the wind.
e.zh: 那间小屋有个木瓦屋顶，在风中嘎嘎作响。

e.en: The defender adjusted his {shinguard} before the match.
e.zh: 比赛前，那名后卫调整了自己的护胫。

e.en: A cracked {shinguard} can still protect your leg poorly.
e.zh: 裂开的护腿板仍可能无法很好地保护你的腿。

e.en: The wax gave the floor a soft {shininess}.
e.zh: 蜡让地板泛出柔和的光泽。

e.en: Too much {shininess} can make a photo look artificial.
e.zh: 过强的光亮会让照片显得不自然。

e.en: We took the {shinkansen} from Tokyo to Kyoto.
e.zh: 我们乘新干线从东京去了京都。

e.en: The {shinkansen} is known for speed and punctuality.
e.zh: 新干线以速度快和准点闻名。

e.en: A {shinkin} bank often serves small local businesses.
e.zh: 信用金库银行常为当地小企业提供服务。

e.en: The town's {shinkin} cooperative offered modest loans.
e.zh: 镇上的信用金库合作机构提供小额贷款。

e.en: The herbalist pointed out {shinleaf} near the path.
e.zh: 草药师指着小路旁的一株胫叶草给大家看。

e.en: Old guides sometimes list {shinleaf} among woodland plants.
e.zh: 旧手册有时把胫叶草列入林地植物。

e.en: Quail disappeared into the {shinnery} beyond the fence.
e.zh: 鹌鹑钻进了篱笆外的矮橡灌丛地。

e.en: Ranchers crossed miles of dry {shinnery} in summer.
e.zh: 牧场主们夏天穿过数英里的干燥矮橡灌丛地。

e.en: The boys played {shinney} on the frozen pond.
e.zh: 男孩们在结冰的池塘上玩简易曲棍球。

e.en: A rough game of {shinney} filled the winter afternoon.
e.zh: 一场粗犷的简易曲棍球赛占满了那个冬日下午。

e.en: He forgot one {shinpad} before the football match.
e.zh: 足球赛前他忘带了一块护胫。

e.en: A cracked {shinpad} offered little protection from the tackle.
e.zh: 裂开的护腿板几乎挡不住那次铲球。

shinplaster.t: 小额纸币；旧时劣质票据

e.en: The shopkeeper refused the torn {shinplaster}.
e.zh: 店主拒收那张破旧的小额纸币。

e.en: During the shortage, local banks issued {shinplasters} for everyday trade.
e.zh: 短缺时期，当地银行发行小额票据供日常交易使用。

shinsplints.t: 胫骨疼痛；小腿胫部炎症

e.en: Long runs on concrete gave her {shinsplints}.
e.zh: 长期在水泥路上跑步让她患上了胫骨疼痛。

e.en: The coach told him to rest until the {shinsplints} eased.
e.zh: 教练让他休息到小腿胫部疼痛缓解为止。

e.en: Many Japanese festivals have roots in {Shinto} traditions.
e.zh: 许多日本节日都源于神道教传统。

e.en: The shrine is still used for {Shinto} ceremonies.
e.zh: 这座神社仍用于举行神道教仪式。

e.en: The village kept several {Shintoistic} customs alive.
e.zh: 这个村庄保留了几种带有神道色彩的习俗。

e.en: His essay described the poem's {Shintoistic} view of nature.
e.zh: 他的文章描述了这首诗中神道教式的自然观。

e.en: They played {shinty} on the frozen field.
e.zh: 他们在结冰的球场上打辛提球。

e.en: The village {shinty} team trains every Saturday.
e.zh: 村里的辛提球队每周六训练。

e.en: The {ship-breaker} bought the rusting tanker for scrap.
e.zh: 拆船商买下那艘生锈的油轮当废料处理。

e.en: A careful {ship-breaker} removes hazardous materials first.
e.zh: 谨慎的拆船工会先清除危险材料。

e.en: Her grandfather worked as a {ship-builder} in Glasgow.
e.zh: 她祖父曾在格拉斯哥当造船工。

e.en: The {ship-builder} won a contract for two ferries.
e.zh: 这家造船企业拿到了两艘渡轮的合同。

e.en: The {ship-fitter} installed pipes below deck.
e.zh: 船舶装配工在甲板下安装管道。

e.en: A skilled {ship-fitter} can read complex hull plans.
e.zh: 熟练的船体钳工能看懂复杂的船体图纸。

ship-handling.t: 船舶操纵；船只驾驶技术

e.en: Good {ship-handling} is vital in a crowded harbor.
e.zh: 在拥挤的港口，良好的船舶操纵至关重要。

e.en: The simulator teaches basic {ship-handling} in bad weather.
e.zh: 这台模拟器教授恶劣天气下的基本船只驾驶技术。

e.en: The museum displays a model of a {ship-rigged} vessel.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一艘全帆装船只的模型。

e.en: A {ship-rigged} sailing ship required a large crew.
e.zh: 一艘横帆装帆船需要大量船员。

e.en: The captain kept every cabin {ship-shape}.
e.zh: 船长让每个舱室都保持整洁有序。

e.en: We need the files {ship-shape} before the audit.
e.zh: 审计前我们得把文件整理得井井有条。

e.en: The child ate from a {ship-shaped} bowl.
e.zh: 孩子用一个船形的碗吃饭。

e.en: A {ship-shaped} shadow moved across the fog.
e.zh: 一个像船的影子在雾中移动。

e.en: The navy practiced {ship-to-ship} refueling at dawn.
e.zh: 海军在黎明练习船对船加油。

e.en: Investigators traced the oil through a {ship-to-ship} transfer.
e.zh: 调查人员通过一次船间转运追踪到了这批石油。

e.en: The captain used the {ship-to-shore} radio during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中船长使用了船岸无线电。

e.en: A {ship-to-shore} cable carried power to the docked vessel.
e.zh: 一根船到岸电缆为停靠的船只供电。

e.en: The old map marked the site of a {ship-wreck}.
e.zh: 那张旧地图标出了沉船残骸的位置。

e.en: Bad weather could {ship-wreck} even an experienced crew.
e.zh: 恶劣天气甚至可能让经验丰富的船员遭遇船只失事。

e.en: The patrol detected {shipborne} radar signals offshore.
e.zh: 巡逻队在近海探测到舰载雷达信号。

e.en: The island depends on {shipborne} fuel deliveries.
e.zh: 这座岛依赖船运输送燃料。

e.en: {Shipbreaking} can expose workers to toxic materials.
e.zh: 拆船业可能使工人接触有毒材料。

e.en: The port once made money from {shipbreaking}.
e.zh: 这个港口过去曾靠拆解船只赚钱。

e.en: The {shipbroker} arranged a charter for the cargo.
e.zh: 船舶经纪人为这批货安排了租船。

e.en: A good {shipbroker} knows freight rates in every major port.
e.zh: 优秀的租船经纪了解各大港口的运价。

shipentine.t: 小型双桅帆船；旧式帆船

e.en: The novel mentions a {shipentine} crossing the bay.
e.zh: 小说提到一艘小型双桅帆船穿过海湾。

e.en: A restored {shipentine} appeared in the maritime parade.
e.zh: 一艘修复后的旧式帆船出现在海事游行中。

e.en: The {shipfitter} repaired a bulkhead after the collision.
e.zh: 碰撞后，船舶装配工修好了隔舱壁。

e.en: Each apprentice {shipfitter} learned welding and blueprint reading.
e.zh: 每名船体钳工学徒都学习焊接和读图。

e.en: The tailor {shirrs} the fabric along the neckline.
e.zh: 裁缝沿着领口把布料打成褶。

e.en: She {shirrs} the curtains to make them hang softly.
e.zh: 她把窗帘打褶，让它们垂得更柔和。

e.en: He rolled up one {shirt-sleeve} before washing the dishes.
e.zh: 洗碗前，他卷起了一只衬衫袖子。

e.en: A coffee stain marked her left {shirt-sleeve}.
e.zh: 她左边的衬衫袖子上有一块咖啡渍。

e.en: His {shirt-tail} came untucked during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时，他的衬衫下摆从裤子里滑了出来。

e.en: She wiped the dust with her {shirt-tail}.
e.zh: 她用衬衫下摆擦掉了灰尘。

e.en: The old {shirtband} was stiff with starch.
e.zh: 那条旧衬衫领带浆得很硬。

e.en: A narrow {shirtband} finished the cuff neatly.
e.zh: 一条窄窄的衬衫袖口带让袖口收得很整齐。

e.en: The {shirtmaker} measured his neck and shoulders carefully.
e.zh: 衬衫裁缝仔细量了他的颈围和肩宽。

e.en: A local {shirtmaker} supplies uniforms to the hotel.
e.zh: 一家本地衬衫制造商给这家酒店供应制服。

e.en: We ordered lamb {shish} with rice and salad.
e.zh: 我们点了羊肉烤串，配米饭和沙拉。

e.en: The crowd answered with a loud {shish}.
e.zh: 人群用一阵响亮的嘘声回应。

e.en: They chose a {shishi} restaurant with tiny portions.
e.zh: 他们选了一家装腔作势、分量很小的餐厅。

e.en: Her {shishi} accent disappeared when she was angry.
e.zh: 她一生气，那种矫揉造作的口音就没了。

e.en: He grilled {shishkebab} over hot coals.
e.zh: 他在炭火上烤肉串。

e.en: The menu listed chicken {shishkebab} with yogurt sauce.
e.zh: 菜单上有配酸奶酱的鸡肉烤串。

e.en: The cliff was made of dark {shist}.
e.zh: 那面悬崖由深色片岩构成。

e.en: Miners found quartz veins inside the {shist}.
e.zh: 矿工在片岩里发现了石英脉。

e.en: These {shists} split easily into thin layers.
e.zh: 这些片岩很容易裂成薄层。

e.en: The valley exposes ancient {shists} and gneiss.
e.zh: 山谷里露出了古老的片岩和片麻岩。

e.en: He got {shit-faced} at the office party.
e.zh: 他在办公室聚会上喝得烂醉。

e.en: Nobody wanted to drive with her {shit-faced}.
e.zh: 她醉成那样，没人愿意让她开车。

e.en: She is a {shit-hot} lawyer in court.
e.zh: 她在法庭上是个非常厉害的律师。

e.en: That band sounded {shit-hot} last night.
e.zh: 那支乐队昨晚演得棒极了。

e.en: I was {shit-scared} before the surgery.
e.zh: 手术前我吓得要命。

e.en: The noise left the children {shit-scared}.
e.zh: 那阵噪音把孩子们吓坏了。

e.en: He called the apartment a {shithole}.
e.zh: 他把那套公寓叫作脏乱破地方。

e.en: They escaped from a miserable {shithole} of a town.
e.zh: 他们逃离了那个糟糕透顶的小镇。

e.en: After the mistake, he was on the boss's {shitlist}.
e.zh: 出了那个错之后，他上了老板的黑名单。

e.en: She keeps a mental {shitlist} of unreliable suppliers.
e.zh: 她心里记着一份不靠谱供应商的黑名单。

e.en: The old text mentions wood from the {shittah}.
e.zh: 那部古书提到了金合欢树的木材。

e.en: A {shittah} tree can grow in dry country.
e.zh: 金合欢树能在干旱地区生长。

e.en: His speech was ruined by one childish {shitticism}.
e.zh: 他的一句幼稚蠢话毁了整场演讲。

e.en: She ignored the online {shitticism} and kept working.
e.zh: 她无视网上那句刻薄废话，继续工作。

e.en: The ark was said to be made of {shittim} wood.
e.zh: 据说约柜是用金合欢木做成的。

e.en: Ancient builders valued {shittim} for its hard timber.
e.zh: 古代工匠看重金合欢树坚硬的木材。

e.en: Interns often get the {shitwork} nobody else wants.
e.zh: 实习生常常被分到别人都不想干的脏活累活。

e.en: He quit after months of unpaid {shitwork}.
e.zh: 干了几个月没报酬的烂差事后，他辞职了。

e.en: The rabbi gave a weekly {shiur} after dinner.
e.zh: 拉比每周晚饭后讲一堂犹太教经课。

e.en: Students gathered early for the morning {shiur}.
e.zh: 学生们早早聚在一起参加早晨的经课。

e.en: The family sat {shivah} after their grandfather died.
e.zh: 祖父去世后，全家按犹太习俗守七日丧。

e.en: Neighbors brought food during the {shivah}.
e.zh: 七日服丧期间，邻居们送来了食物。

e.en: The newlyweds woke to a noisy {shivaree} outside.
e.zh: 新婚夫妇被屋外喧闹的闹婚声吵醒。

e.en: The protest turned into a political {shivaree}.
e.zh: 抗议变成了一场喧闹的政治骚动。

e.en: A sharp {shive} stuck in his palm.
e.zh: 一片尖木片扎进了他的手掌。

e.en: The mill separated fiber from each woody {shive}.
e.zh: 工厂把纤维和每片木质碎屑分离开来。

e.en: They threw a noisy {shivoo} after the match.
e.zh: 比赛后他们办了一场吵闹的庆祝会。

e.en: The office {shivoo} lasted until midnight.
e.zh: 办公室的热闹聚会一直持续到午夜。

e.en: The poor {shlemiel} spilled coffee on his report.
e.zh: 那个可怜的笨蛋把咖啡洒在报告上。

e.en: In the story, the {shlemiel} always means well.
e.zh: 在故事里，这个倒霉蛋总是出于好意。

e.en: I had to {shlep} two suitcases across town.
e.zh: 我不得不费劲地把两个行李箱拖过城。

e.en: She made the long {shlep} to the airport alone.
e.zh: 她独自费力赶了很远的路去机场。

e.en: We had to {shlepp} the boxes upstairs.
e.zh: 我们只好费劲地把箱子搬上楼。

e.en: The daily {shlepp} across campus wore him out.
e.zh: 每天穿过校园的辛苦奔波让他筋疲力尽。

e.en: The old {shlepper} carried bags for tips.
e.zh: 那个老搬运工靠替人提包挣小费。

e.en: Stop being such a {shlepper} and hurry up.
e.zh: 别这么拖拖拉拉的，快一点。

e.en: The shop was full of plastic {shlock}.
e.zh: 这家店里全是廉价的塑料劣质品。

e.en: Critics dismissed the movie as sentimental {shlock}.
e.zh: 评论家把这部电影贬为煽情的低俗作品。

shlocky.t: 廉价劣质的；低俗俗气的

e.en: The lobby had a {shlocky} imitation chandelier.
e.zh: 大厅里挂着一盏俗气的仿制吊灯。

e.en: He enjoys {shlocky} horror films from the seventies.
e.zh: 他喜欢七十年代那些低俗的恐怖片。

e.en: He felt like a {shlub} in his wrinkled shirt.
e.zh: 他穿着皱巴巴的衬衫，觉得自己像个邋遢鬼。

e.en: The comedy turns an ordinary {shlub} into a hero.
e.zh: 这部喜剧把一个普通窝囊废变成了英雄。

shlump.t: 懒散邋遢的人；沉重拖行

e.en: Don't sit there like a {shlump} all afternoon.
e.zh: 别整个下午都像个懒散鬼一样坐在那里。

e.en: He had to {shlump} through snow to reach home.
e.zh: 他不得不踩着雪艰难地拖着步子回家。

e.en: He wore a {shlumpy} sweater to the interview.
e.zh: 他穿着一件邋遢的毛衣去面试。

e.en: After lunch, everyone felt {shlumpy} and slow.
e.zh: 午饭后大家都觉得没精打采、反应迟钝。

e.en: The ending was pure {shmaltz}, but I cried anyway.
e.zh: 结尾完全是过分煽情，但我还是哭了。

e.en: Traditional recipes often used {shmaltz} for frying onions.
e.zh: 传统食谱常用鸡油来炒洋葱。

e.en: She wiped the counter with an old {shmatte}.
e.zh: 她用一块旧破布擦了柜台。

e.en: He called the designer dress an overpriced {shmatte}.
e.zh: 他把那条名牌裙子说成是贵得离谱的破衣服。

shmo.t: 普通笨人；无足轻重的人

e.en: Some {shmo} parked in my space again.
e.zh: 又有个不知哪来的家伙把车停在我的车位上。

e.en: The book explains finance for the average {shmo}.
e.zh: 这本书给普通人讲解金融知识。

e.en: The cartoon {shmoo} became a symbol of easy abundance.
e.zh: 漫画里的舒穆成了轻易富足的象征。

e.en: The diagram looked like a rounded {shmoo}.
e.zh: 那张图看起来像个圆滚滚的舒穆形状。

e.en: Only a {shmuck} would ignore that warning.
e.zh: 只有蠢货才会无视那个警告。

e.en: He apologized for acting like a {shmuck}.
e.zh: 他为自己表现得像个讨厌鬼而道歉。

e.en: Those {shmucks} forgot to lock the door.
e.zh: 那帮蠢货忘了锁门。

e.en: The manager treated us like {shmucks}.
e.zh: 经理把我们当成一群傻瓜对待。

e.en: You have some {shmutz} on your sleeve.
e.zh: 你的袖子上有点脏东西。

e.en: Wipe the {shmutz} off the camera lens.
e.zh: 把相机镜头上的污垢擦掉。

e.en: He poured a small glass of {shnaps}.
e.zh: 他倒了一小杯烈性甜酒。

e.en: The villagers served {shnaps} after the winter meal.
e.zh: 村民们在冬日晚餐后端上了烈酒。

e.en: Don't be a {shnook} and pay full price.
e.zh: 别当冤大头付全价。

e.en: The con man was looking for some trusting {shnook}.
e.zh: 那个骗子正在找容易相信人的傻瓜。

e.en: The prospector found {shoad} near the stream.
e.zh: 探矿者在溪边发现了矿脉碎石。

e.en: Scattered {shoad} led them toward the hidden vein.
e.zh: 散落的露头矿石把他们引向隐藏的矿脉。

e.en: The map warned sailors about the bay's {shoaliness}.
e.zh: 地图提醒水手注意海湾多浅滩的情况。

e.en: Seasonal storms increased the river's {shoaliness}.
e.zh: 季节性风暴加重了河道的浅滩状态。

e.en: They avoided the {shoaly} water near the reef.
e.zh: 他们避开了礁石附近多浅滩的水域。

e.en: A {shoaly} coast can trap careless boats.
e.zh: 多浅滩的海岸会困住粗心的船只。

e.en: The helmet has a {shock-absorbing} inner layer.
e.zh: 这顶头盔有一层吸收冲击的内衬。

e.en: They installed {shock-absorbing} pads under the machine.
e.zh: 他们在机器下面安装了减震垫。

shock-and-awe.t: 震慑战术；强势震撼手段

e.en: The army used a {shock-and-awe} campaign at the start.
e.zh: 军队一开始采用了震慑战术。

e.en: The company launched a {shock-and-awe} marketing push.
e.zh: 公司发起了一场声势浩大的营销攻势。

e.en: The little {shock-head} ran in from the rain.
e.zh: 那个头发蓬乱的小孩从雨里跑了进来。

e.en: Everyone laughed kindly at the sleepy {shock-head}.
e.zh: 大家善意地笑那个睡眼惺忪、头发乱糟糟的人。

e.en: A {shock-headed} boy opened the door.
e.zh: 一个头发蓬乱的男孩打开了门。

e.en: The old portrait shows a {shock-headed} poet.
e.zh: 那幅旧画像里是一位乱发诗人。

e.en: {Shock-horror}, the train was late again.
e.zh: 真是夸张地说一句，火车又晚点了。

e.en: He forgot the meeting, {shock-horror}, after setting three reminders.
e.zh: 他设了三个提醒却还是忘了会议，真让人哭笑不得。

e.en: This watch is advertised as {shock-proof}.
e.zh: 这块手表宣传说是防震的。

e.en: Keep the hard drive in a {shock-proof} case.
e.zh: 把硬盘放在防震外壳里。

e.en: The phone has a {shock-resistant} outer shell.
e.zh: 这部手机有一个抗冲击外壳。

e.en: Engineers chose {shock-resistant} glass for the train windows.
e.zh: 工程师为列车窗户选用了耐冲击玻璃。

e.en: The {shockheaded} child looked half asleep.
e.zh: 那个头发蓬乱的孩子看起来半睡半醒。

e.en: A {shockheaded} figure appeared in the doorway.
e.zh: 门口出现了一个乱发身影。

e.en: My old camera came in a {shockproof} box.
e.zh: 我的旧相机装在一个防震盒里。

e.en: The case is not fully {shockproof}.
e.zh: 这个保护壳并不是完全抗冲击的。

e.en: The horse stood {shodden} and ready for the road.
e.zh: 那匹马已经钉好蹄铁，准备上路。

e.en: The children came in {shodden} with muddy boots.
e.zh: 孩子们穿着沾满泥的靴子走了进来。

e.en: The prospector found {shode} near the stream.
e.zh: 探矿者在溪边发现了矿石碎片。

e.en: A trail of {shode} led them uphill.
e.zh: 一串矿脉线索石把他们引向山坡。

e.en: She kept the letters in a {shoe-box}.
e.zh: 她把那些信放在一个鞋盒里。

e.en: His first apartment was a tiny {shoe-box}.
e.zh: 他的第一套公寓小得像个鞋盒。

e.en: The silver {shoe-buckle} caught the light.
e.zh: 银色鞋扣反射着光。

e.en: He repaired the broken {shoe-buckle} before the dance.
e.zh: 舞会前他修好了坏掉的鞋扣。

e.en: Your {shoe-lace} is coming undone.
e.zh: 你的鞋带快松开了。

e.en: She tied the {shoe-lace} in a double knot.
e.zh: 她把鞋带打成了双结。

e.en: The boots were made of tough {shoe-leather}.
e.zh: 这双靴子是用结实的鞋革做的。

e.en: Good reporting still requires plenty of {shoe-leather}.
e.zh: 好的报道仍然需要大量实地奔走。

e.en: The {shoe-maker} measured my feet carefully.
e.zh: 制鞋匠仔细量了我的脚。

e.en: Her grandfather worked as a village {shoe-maker}.
e.zh: 她祖父曾是村里的鞋匠。

e.en: He got a quick {shoe-shine} at the station.
e.zh: 他在车站快速擦了次鞋。

e.en: The hotel offers a morning {shoe-shine} service.
e.zh: 这家酒店提供早晨擦鞋服务。

e.en: Put a {shoe-tree} inside each leather shoe.
e.zh: 在每只皮鞋里放一个鞋撑。

e.en: A cedar {shoe-tree} helps the shoe keep its shape.
e.zh: 雪松鞋撑有助于鞋子保持形状。

e.en: The {shoebill} stood motionless in the swamp.

e.zh: 这张票适用于近程火车出行。

e.en: The charity faces a large {short-fall} in donations.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构面临很大的捐款缺口。

e.en: A budget {short-fall} forced the project to pause.
e.zh: 预算不足迫使项目暂停。

e.en: My boss is {short-fused} during budget season.
e.zh: 预算季时我的老板很容易发火。

e.en: A {short-fused} reply made the meeting tense.
e.zh: 一句急躁的回应让会议气氛紧张起来。

e.en: I booked a {short-haul} flight to Bangkok.
e.zh: 我订了一班飞往曼谷的短途航班。

e.en: The company specializes in {short-haul} freight.
e.zh: 这家公司专做短程货运。

e.en: The horse won by a {short-head}.
e.zh: 那匹马以短头距离险胜。

e.en: She kept a {short-head} lead until the finish.
e.zh: 她把微弱领先保持到了终点。

e.en: The breed is known for its {short-headed} shape.
e.zh: 这个品种以短头型外貌著称。

e.en: A {short-headed} skull appears wider than average.
e.zh: 短头型头骨看起来比一般头骨更宽。

short-landed.t: 着陆距离不足的；短着陆的

e.en: The plane {short-landed} before the runway threshold.
e.zh: 飞机在跑道入口前就短着陆了。

e.en: A {short-landed} approach can damage the landing gear.
e.zh: 着陆距离不足的进近可能会损坏起落架。

short-list.t: 入围名单；列入候选名单

e.en: Her novel made the prize {short-list}.
e.zh: 她的小说进入了该奖项的入围名单。

e.en: We will {short-list} five candidates this week.
e.zh: 我们本周会把五名候选人列入候选名单。

short-listed.t: 入围的；被列入候选名单

e.en: The film was {short-listed} for several awards.
e.zh: 这部电影入围了多个奖项。

e.en: Only three firms were {short-listed} for the contract.
e.zh: 只有三家公司被列入这份合同的候选名单。

e.en: The panel is {short-listing} applicants today.
e.zh: 评审小组今天正在筛选申请者入围。

e.en: Careful {short-listing} reduced the interview schedule.
e.zh: 仔细列候选名单减少了面试安排。

short-lists.t: 入围名单；列入候选名单

e.en: The committee publishes its {short-lists} every spring.
e.zh: 委员会每年春天公布入围名单。

e.en: She {short-lists} candidates after reading their portfolios.
e.zh: 她看完作品集后把候选人列入候选名单。

e.en: Their excitement was {short-lived} after the bad news.
e.zh: 坏消息传来后，他们的兴奋很快就消退了。

e.en: The company enjoyed a {short-lived} rise in sales.
e.zh: 这家公司经历了一阵短暂的销售增长。

e.en: He worked as a {short-order} cook downtown.
e.zh: 他在市中心当过快餐厨师。

e.en: The manager wanted a {short-order} solution by noon.
e.zh: 经理希望中午前拿出一个迅速可行的方案。

e.en: The invoice was {short-paid} by twenty dollars.
e.zh: 这张发票少付了二十美元。

e.en: A {short-paid} letter may be returned to the sender.
e.zh: 邮资不足的信件可能会被退回寄件人。

e.en: The study tracked patients over a {short-period}.
e.zh: 这项研究在短时期内跟踪了患者。

e.en: A {short-period} loan helped cover the repair costs.
e.zh: 一笔短期贷款帮助支付了维修费用。

e.en: The policy may work in the {short-run}.
e.zh: 这项政策在短期内可能有效。

e.en: We made a {short-run} batch of the poster.
e.zh: 我们小批量印制了这张海报。

e.en: Press this key to {short-save} your progress.
e.zh: 按这个键可以快速保存你的进度。

e.en: A {short-save} kept the draft from disappearing.
e.zh: 一次临时存档让草稿没有丢失。

e.en: The supplier {short-shipped} our order by ten units.
e.zh: 供应商给我们的订单少发了十件。

e.en: A {short-shipped} carton delayed the installation.
e.zh: 一箱发货不足的货物耽误了安装。

e.en: She published a {short-short} in the magazine.
e.zh: 她在杂志上发表了一篇极短篇小说。

e.en: The editor wanted a {short-short} version of the article.
e.zh: 编辑想要一版超短的文章。

e.en: He wore a {shortcoat} over his shirt.
e.zh: 他在衬衫外穿了一件短外套。

e.en: The old uniform included a dark {shortcoat}.
e.zh: 那套旧制服包括一件深色短上衣。

e.en: The sailors packed their {shortcoats} for winter.
e.zh: 水手们把冬天穿的短外套收进行李。

e.en: Several {shortcoats} hung by the door.
e.zh: 门边挂着好几件短上衣。

e.en: The coupon was {shortdated} and expired quickly.
e.zh: 这张优惠券有效期很短，很快就过期了。

e.en: The store discounted {shortdated} dairy products.
e.zh: 商店给临近保质期的乳制品打了折。

e.en: The editor was {shorterizing} the long article.
e.zh: 编辑正在把那篇长文章缩短。

e.en: They tried {shorterizing} the process without losing quality.
e.zh: 他们尝试简化流程，同时不降低质量。

e.en: The team practiced passing on a {shortfield}.
e.zh: 球队在短场地上练习传球。

e.en: A fielder moved into the {shortfield}.
e.zh: 一名外野手移到了近场防守区。

e.en: Their cat is a gray {shorthair}.
e.zh: 他们家的猫是一只灰色短毛猫。

e.en: The photo showed a confident {shorthair} in uniform.
e.zh: 照片里是一位留短发、穿制服的自信人物。

e.en: The skull was classified as a {shorthead}.
e.zh: 这个头骨被归为短头型。

e.en: Older manuals used {shorthead} as a physical description.
e.zh: 旧手册曾用短头型来描述人的体貌。

e.en: The kids called him {shortie} in a teasing voice.
e.zh: 孩子们用开玩笑的语气叫他小矮个。

e.en: She chose a warm {shortie} jacket for spring.
e.zh: 她为春天选了一件暖和的短款夹克。

e.en: The broker sounded like a committed {shortite}.
e.zh: 那位经纪人听起来像坚定的做空派。

e.en: A {shortite} expects prices to fall soon.
e.zh: 做空派预期价格很快会下跌。

e.en: A {shortman} stood near the counter.
e.zh: 一个矮个男人站在柜台旁。

e.en: The farm hired a {shortman} for harvest week.
e.zh: 农场在收获周雇了一名短工。

e.en: This is a {shortrun} solution to the shortage.
e.zh: 这是解决短缺问题的短期办法。

e.en: The printer specializes in {shortrun} book production.
e.zh: 这家印刷厂专门做小批量图书印制。

e.en: Her father was polite but {shortspoken}.
e.zh: 她父亲很有礼貌，但说话简短。

e.en: The {shortspoken} reply ended the argument.
e.zh: 那句简短的回答结束了争论。

e.en: He gets {shorttempered} when he is tired.
e.zh: 他累的时候脾气会变得急躁。

e.en: A {shorttempered} manager can frighten the staff.
e.zh: 脾气急躁的经理会让员工害怕。

e.en: We need a {shortterm} plan first.
e.zh: 我们首先需要一个短期计划。

e.en: The medicine caused some {shortterm} side effects.
e.zh: 这种药造成了一些短期副作用。

e.en: They sat on the {shortwall} beside the garden.
e.zh: 他们坐在花园旁的矮墙上。

e.en: A {shortwall} separated the kitchen from the hall.
e.zh: 一道短墙把厨房和大厅隔开。

e.en: The customer complained about {shortweight} flour.
e.zh: 顾客投诉面粉分量不足。

e.en: Inspectors fined shops for selling {shortweight} goods.
e.zh: 检查员因商店短斤少两而开了罚单。

e.en: The guard wore a {shot-proof} vest.
e.zh: 警卫穿着一件防弹背心。

e.en: The old door was not truly {shot-proof}.
e.zh: 那扇旧门并不真正耐枪击。

e.en: She won gold in the {shot-put}.
e.zh: 她在铅球项目中赢得了金牌。

e.en: The coach taught him proper {shot-put} technique.
e.zh: 教练教他正确的推铅球技术。

e.en: The {shot-putter} trained every morning.
e.zh: 这名铅球运动员每天早晨训练。

e.en: A strong {shot-putter} needs balance as well as power.
e.zh: 优秀的铅球运动员既需要力量，也需要平衡。

e.en: A young {shote} ran across the yard.
e.zh: 一头小猪跑过院子。

e.en: The farmer bought a {shote} at the market.
e.zh: 农夫在市场上买了一头幼猪。

e.en: The miners prepared to {shotfire} the tunnel wall.
e.zh: 矿工们准备对隧道壁点炮爆破。

e.en: Only trained workers may handle {shotfire} equipment.
e.zh: 只有受过训练的工人才可以操作爆破引火设备。

e.en: A fresh {shothole} marked the wooden door.
e.zh: 木门上留下了一个新的弹孔。

e.en: The crew drilled a {shothole} for the charge.
e.zh: 施工队钻了一个爆破孔来放炸药。

e.en: The council made a {short-sighted} decision to cut school funding.
e.zh: 市议会削减学校经费的决定很目光短浅。

e.en: She is {short-sighted} and needs glasses for driving.
e.zh: 她有近视，开车时需要戴眼镜。

e.en: They {short-sightedly} ignored the long-term costs of the project.
e.zh: 他们目光短浅地忽视了这个项目的长期成本。

e.en: The company {short-sightedly} dismissed its most experienced staff.
e.zh: 公司短视地解雇了最有经验的员工。

e.en: He wore a {short-sleeve} shirt to the picnic.
e.zh: 他穿了一件短袖衬衫去野餐。

e.en: This {short-sleeve} is too thin for cold weather.
e.zh: 这件短袖在冷天穿太薄了。

e.en: The manager was {short-spoken} but not unkind.
e.zh: 经理说话简短冷淡，但并不刻薄。

e.en: His {short-spoken} reply ended the discussion quickly.
e.zh: 他简短生硬的回答很快结束了讨论。

e.en: The hospital was {short-staffed} during the holiday weekend.
e.zh: 假日周末期间，这家医院人手不足。

e.en: We are {short-staffed} today, so service may be slow.
e.zh: 我们今天人手不够，所以服务可能会慢一些。

e.en: They booked a {short-stay} apartment near the station.
e.zh: 他们在车站附近订了一间短租公寓。

e.en: The clinic has a {short-stay} ward for minor operations.
e.zh: 这家诊所有一个供小手术病人短期留院的病房。

e.en: She wrote a {short-story} about her childhood village.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于童年村庄的短篇小说。

e.en: The teacher asked us to read one {short-story} tonight.
e.zh: 老师让我们今晚读一篇短篇小说。

e.en: The golfer used a {short-swing} to control the ball.
e.zh: 那名高尔夫球手用短挥杆来控制球。

e.en: The clock's {short-swing} made the ticking sound uneven.
e.zh: 钟摆短幅摆动，使滴答声听起来不均匀。

e.en: He becomes {short-tempered} when he is tired.
e.zh: 他累的时候就容易发脾气。

e.en: The {short-tempered} chef shouted at everyone in the kitchen.
e.zh: 那位脾气暴躁的厨师对厨房里的每个人大喊。

e.en: Investors criticized the board's {short-termism}.
e.zh: 投资者批评董事会的短期主义。

e.en: Political {short-termism} can damage public services for years.
e.zh: 政治上的短视做法可能多年损害公共服务。

short-timer.t: 即将离职者；短期服役者

e.en: As a {short-timer}, he avoided taking on new projects.
e.zh: 作为快要离职的人，他避免接手新项目。

e.en: The soldiers called him a {short-timer} near the end of his service.
e.zh: 服役快结束时，士兵们叫他短期服役快满的人。

e.en: A {short-waisted} jacket can make the legs look longer.
e.zh: 短腰夹克能让腿看起来更长。

e.en: She is {short-waisted}, so high-rise jeans fit her differently.
e.zh: 她腰身较短，所以高腰牛仔裤穿在她身上效果不同。

e.en: They listened to news on a {short-wave} radio.
e.zh: 他们用短波收音机收听新闻。

e.en: The station broadcasts on {short-wave} frequencies at night.
e.zh: 这个电台夜间用短波频率广播。

e.en: The customer complained about {short-weight} in the rice bag.
e.zh: 顾客投诉那袋米分量不足。

e.en: Inspectors fined the shop for selling {short-weight} goods.
e.zh: 检查员因商店售卖短斤少两的商品而罚款。

short-weighted.t: 给分量不足的；短斤少两的

e.en: Several packages were {short-weighted} by almost ten percent.
e.zh: 有几包商品少给了将近一成分量。

e.en: The vendor denied that he had {short-weighted} the vegetables.
e.zh: 摊贩否认自己给蔬菜短斤少两。

e.en: The market inspector found {short-weights} on two stalls.
e.zh: 市场检查员在两个摊位发现了短斤少两的问题。

e.en: Old trade laws punished merchants for using {short-weights}.
e.zh: 旧时贸易法会惩罚使用不足重量欺骗顾客的商人。

e.en: Her {short-winded} speech pleased the tired audience.
e.zh: 她简短的演讲让疲惫的听众很满意。

e.en: After climbing the hill, he felt {short-winded}.
e.zh: 爬上山后，他感到呼吸短促。

e.en: The {short-winged} bird could only fly short distances.
e.zh: 那只短翅鸟只能飞很短的距离。

e.en: Researchers studied a {short-winged} form of the insect.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了这种昆虫的短翅型。

e.en: The toddler wore a denim {shortall} in summer.
e.zh: 那个幼儿夏天穿着一件牛仔短裤连身衣。

e.en: She bought a cotton {shortall} for the beach trip.
e.zh: 她为海边旅行买了一件棉质短裤连身衣。

e.en: The cashier did not mean to {shortchange} the customer.
e.zh: 收银员并不是故意少找顾客钱。

e.en: Schools should not {shortchange} children from poor families.
e.zh: 学校不应该亏待贫困家庭的孩子。

e.en: The dishonest vendor was known as a {shortchanger}.
e.zh: 那个不诚实的小贩以少找钱出名。

e.en: Critics called the policy a {shortchanger} of rural students.
e.zh: 批评者称这项政策亏待了农村学生。

e.en: The machine sometimes {shortchanges} people by a few cents.
e.zh: 这台机器有时会少找人们几分钱。

e.en: The report says the budget {shortchanges} public hospitals.
e.zh: 报告称这项预算亏待了公立医院。

e.en: They accused the store of {shortchanging} customers.
e.zh: 他们指控这家店少找顾客钱。

e.en: By cutting training, the company is {shortchanging} its staff.
e.zh: 公司削减培训，其实是在亏待员工。

e.en: Water can {shortcircuit} the electrical system.
e.zh: 水可能会使电气系统短路。

e.en: The mayor tried to {shortcircuit} the normal approval process.
e.zh: 市长试图绕过正常审批程序。

e.en: The baby was dressed in {shortclothes} for the warm afternoon.
e.zh: 天气暖和的下午，宝宝穿着幼儿短衣。

e.en: In old portraits, young children often wear {shortclothes}.
e.zh: 在旧画像中，年幼的孩子常穿短装。

e.en: The miners drilled {shotholes} before setting the charges.
e.zh: 矿工们先钻好爆破孔，再安放炸药。

e.en: Rainwater collected in the old {shotholes} along the quarry wall.
e.zh: 雨水积在采石场岩壁上的旧炮眼里。

shotmaking.t: 击球技巧；投篮创造能力

e.en: Her {shotmaking} improved after months of practice.
e.zh: 经过几个月练习，她的击球技巧提高了。

e.en: The guard's quick {shotmaking} kept the team in the game.
e.zh: 那名后卫迅速创造投篮机会，让球队仍有胜算。

e.en: The technician replaced the worn {shotpin} in the device.
e.zh: 技术员更换了装置里磨损的击发销。

e.en: A bent {shotpin} can make the mechanism unreliable.
e.zh: 弯曲的定位销会让这个机构变得不可靠。

e.en: The coach marked each {shotpoint} on the practice chart.
e.zh: 教练在训练图上标出了每个投篮位置。

e.en: From that {shotpoint}, the target was partly hidden.
e.zh: 从那个射击点看，目标有一部分被遮住了。

e.en: He won a medal in the {shotput} event.
e.zh: 他在铅球项目中赢得了一枚奖牌。

e.en: The athlete practiced {shotput} every afternoon.
e.zh: 那名运动员每天下午练习推铅球。

e.en: The {shotten} arrow lay beside the broken target.
e.zh: 那支已射出的箭落在破损靶子旁边。

e.en: A {shotten} bird fell into the reeds.
e.zh: 一只被射中的鸟落进了芦苇丛。

e.en: He kept a {shotty} behind the cabin door.
e.zh: 他在小屋门后放着一把猎枪。

e.en: The repair work was {shotty} and did not last.
e.zh: 这次维修质量很差，没撑多久。

e.en: I {shoulda} called you last night.
e.zh: 我昨晚本该给你打电话的。

e.en: You {shoulda} seen his face when he won.
e.zh: 他赢的时候，你真该看看他的表情。

e.en: She put her wallet in a {shoulder-bag}.
e.zh: 她把钱包放进了单肩包里。

e.en: A small {shoulder-bag} is useful when traveling.
e.zh: 旅行时，一个小肩背包很实用。

e.en: The shop sells leather {shoulder-bags} near the entrance.
e.zh: 这家店在入口附近卖皮质单肩包。

e.en: Their {shoulder-bags} were too heavy for the long walk.
e.zh: 他们的肩背包太重，不适合走那么远。

e.en: The doctor recommended a {shoulder-brace} after the injury.
e.zh: 受伤后，医生建议他使用肩部支具。

e.en: She wore a {shoulder-brace} during basketball practice.
e.zh: 她在篮球训练时戴着护肩带。

e.en: The water was {shoulder-high} in the flooded street.
e.zh: 被淹的街道上，水已经齐肩高。

e.en: They built a {shoulder-high} fence around the garden.
e.zh: 他们在花园周围修了一道齐肩高的围栏。

e.en: She has {shoulder-length} hair and dark glasses.
e.zh: 她留着齐肩发，戴着深色眼镜。

e.en: The stylist cut it to a {shoulder-length} bob.
e.zh: 发型师把它剪成了齐肩短发。

e.en: The jacket has a thin {shoulder-pad} inside.
e.zh: 这件夹克里面有一片薄肩垫。

e.en: A football {shoulder-pad} helps absorb hard impacts.
e.zh: 橄榄球护肩垫有助于缓冲猛烈撞击。

shoulder-pegged.t: 肩部固定的；肩部钉住的

e.en: The antique cabinet had a {shoulder-pegged} joint.
e.zh: 这件古董柜有一个肩部榫钉固定的接合处。

e.en: His tunic was {shoulder-pegged} with a small bronze pin.
e.zh: 他的束腰外衣用一枚小铜针固定在肩部。

e.en: The {shoulder-strap} snapped on her bag.
e.zh: 她包上的肩带突然断了。

e.en: Adjust the {shoulder-strap} before lifting the camera.
e.zh: 拿起相机前先调好肩带。

e.en: The backpack's {shoulder-straps} were padded and wide.
e.zh: 这个背包的肩带又宽又有软垫。

e.en: Her dress had thin {shoulder-straps} made of silk.
e.zh: 她的裙子有细细的丝质肩带。

e.en: Commuters stood {shoulder-to-shoulder} on the crowded train.
e.zh: 通勤者在拥挤的列车上肩并肩站着。

e.en: The two groups worked {shoulder-to-shoulder} after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后，两个团体并肩合作。

e.en: Stand with your feet {shoulder-width} apart.
e.zh: 双脚分开站立，距离与肩同宽。

e.en: The tailor measured his {shoulder-width} carefully.
e.zh: 裁缝仔细量了他的肩宽。

e.en: The grass grew {shoulderhigh} by late summer.
e.zh: 到夏末，草已经长到齐肩高。

e.en: A {shoulderhigh} wall blocked their view.
e.zh: 一道齐肩高的墙挡住了他们的视线。

e.en: Thou {shouldest} speak truth in all matters.
e.zh: 你在一切事情上都应当说真话。

e.en: If thou {shouldest} fail, try again.
e.zh: 倘若你失败了，就再试一次。

e.en: You {shouldn't} drive when you are tired.
e.zh: 你累的时候不应该开车。

e.en: We {shouldn't} ignore such a serious warning.
e.zh: 我们不该忽视这样严重的警告。

shouldna.t: 不应该的方言缩写；不该

e.en: You {shouldna} tell lies to your mother.
e.zh: 你不该对你母亲撒谎。

e.en: I {shouldna} have spent all that money.
e.zh: 我本不该把那些钱全花掉。

e.en: Thou {shouldst} speak the truth.
e.zh: 汝应当说实话。

e.en: If thou {shouldst} fail, try again.
e.zh: 倘若你失败了，就再试一次。

e.en: She gave a {shout-out} to her team.
e.zh: 她公开向自己的团队致谢。

e.en: The host sent a {shout-out} to listeners in Beijing.
e.zh: 主持人向北京的听众点名问候。

shouty.t: 大喊大叫的；刺眼张扬的

e.en: The manager became {shouty} under pressure.
e.zh: 经理一有压力就变得大喊大叫。

e.en: The poster used {shouty} colors and huge letters.
e.zh: 海报用了很刺眼的颜色和超大的字。

e.en: They played {shove-halfpenny} in the pub.
e.zh: 他们在酒馆里玩推半便士棋。

e.en: The old board was made for {shove-halfpenny}.
e.zh: 那块旧木板是用来玩推半便士棋的。

e.en: A {shovel-nosed} ray rested on the sand.
e.zh: 一条吻部扁宽的鳐鱼趴在沙地上。

e.en: The truck had a {shovel-nosed} front end.
e.zh: 那辆卡车的车头呈铲形。

e.en: A {shovelbill} fed in the shallow water.
e.zh: 一只琵嘴鸭在浅水里觅食。

e.en: The guide pointed out a rare {shovelbill}.
e.zh: 向导指出了一只少见的铲嘴鸟。

e.en: The {shovelfish} hid near the riverbed.
e.zh: 那条铲吻鱼躲在河床附近。

e.en: Fishermen sometimes catch {shovelfish} by accident.
e.zh: 渔民有时会意外捕到铲鼻鱼。

e.en: The {shovelhead} swam close to shore.
e.zh: 那条铲头鲨游到了近岸处。

e.en: Collectors prize the old Harley {shovelhead} engine.
e.zh: 收藏者很看重老款哈雷铲头发动机。

e.en: The {shovelman} cleared snow from the platform.
e.zh: 铲土工把站台上的雪清掉了。

e.en: A tired {shovelman} leaned on his tool.
e.zh: 一个疲惫的用铲工人倚着工具休息。

e.en: The aquarium kept a {shovelnose} catfish.
e.zh: 水族馆养着一条铲鼻鲶鱼。

e.en: Its broad {shovelnose} helps it stir the mud.
e.zh: 它宽宽的铲形鼻有助于搅动淤泥。

e.en: The game collection was mostly {shovelware}.
e.zh: 那套游戏合集大多是粗制滥造的软件。

e.en: Publishers filled the disc with cheap {shovelware}.
e.zh: 出版商把光盘塞满了廉价劣质内容。

e.en: Maya brought a shell for {show-and-tell}.
e.zh: 玛雅带了一个贝壳参加展示讲述活动。

e.en: The engineer turned the demo into {show-and-tell}.
e.zh: 工程师把演示变成了边展示边讲解。

e.en: The shop placed a {show-card} in the window.
e.zh: 商店在橱窗里放了一张广告展示卡。

e.en: The announcer held up a {show-card}.
e.zh: 报幕员举起了一张节目牌。

e.en: The workshop included a brief {show-how}.
e.zh: 工作坊包含一段简短的操作示范。

e.en: His {show-how} made the repair look simple.
e.zh: 他的示范说明让维修显得很简单。

e.en: Her {show-jumper} cleared every fence.
e.zh: 她的场地障碍赛马越过了每一道栏。

e.en: He trained as a professional {show-jumper}.
e.zh: 他接受训练，成为职业障碍赛骑手。

e.en: She competes in {show-jumping} every summer.
e.zh: 她每年夏天都参加马术场地障碍赛。

e.en: The crowd cheered during the {show-jumping} final.
e.zh: 观众在场地障碍赛决赛中欢呼。

e.en: He took a {show-me} attitude toward the claim.
e.zh: 他对这个说法抱着要求证据的态度。

e.en: Investors are in a {show-me} mood this year.
e.zh: 今年投资者心态谨慎，不轻易相信承诺。

e.en: Please do not {show-off} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时请不要炫耀。

e.en: Everyone knew he was a {show-off}.
e.zh: 大家都知道他是个爱炫耀的人。

e.en: His new watch felt a bit {show-offy}.
e.zh: 他的新手表显得有点爱炫耀。

e.en: The party was stylish without being {show-offy}.
e.zh: 那场派对很有格调，却不显摆。

e.en: The hall became the museum's {show-piece}.
e.zh: 这座大厅成了博物馆的代表性展示空间。

e.en: That aria is a {show-piece} for sopranos.
e.zh: 那段咏叹调是女高音的炫技代表作。

e.en: Her final song was a {show-stopper}.
e.zh: 她最后一首歌是全场最精彩的压轴。

e.en: The security flaw became a {show-stopper}.
e.zh: 这个安全漏洞成了严重阻碍。

show-stopping.t: 惊艳全场的；造成停滞的

e.en: She wore a {show-stopping} red dress.
e.zh: 她穿了一条惊艳全场的红裙。

e.en: The update caused a {show-stopping} bug.
e.zh: 这次更新造成了一个让项目停摆的错误。

e.en: Only the finished photos are {showable}.
e.zh: 只有完成后的照片才拿得出手。

e.en: The prototype is barely {showable} yet.
e.zh: 这个原型目前还勉强能展示。

e.en: The priest placed the {showbread} on the table.
e.zh: 祭司把陈设饼放在桌上。

e.en: The passage describes the holy {showbread}.
e.zh: 这段经文描述了神圣的供饼。

e.en: She pinned the {showcard} to her jacket before entering the hall.
e.zh: 进大厅前，她把展会入场卡别在外套上。

e.en: The old circus {showcard} listed every performer by name.
e.zh: 那张旧马戏节目卡按姓名列出了每位表演者。

e.en: The {showeriness} of April made outdoor plans uncertain.
e.zh: 四月常有阵雨，使户外计划很难确定。

e.en: Forecasters noted the afternoon's increasing {showeriness}.
e.zh: 预报员提到下午阵雨增多的情况。

e.en: The cabin was small and {showerless}, but it had a clean sink.
e.zh: 小屋很小，也没有淋浴，但有一个干净的水槽。

e.en: We enjoyed a bright, {showerless} morning on the coast.
e.zh: 我们在海边度过了一个晴朗无阵雨的早晨。

e.en: The cafe was crowded with {showfolk} after the final curtain.
e.zh: 谢幕后，咖啡馆里挤满了演艺圈人士。

e.en: Old {showfolk} often told stories of touring by train.
e.zh: 老一辈演艺人常讲乘火车巡演的往事。

e.en: They visited the {showhouse} before choosing a plot nearby.
e.zh: 他们先参观了样板房，然后在附近选了一块地。

e.en: The charity opened a decorated {showhouse} to attract donors.
e.zh: 慈善机构开放了一栋装饰好的展览房屋来吸引捐款人。

e.en: He dressed {showily} for a quiet family dinner.
e.zh: 只是家里一顿安静的晚餐，他却穿得很炫耀。

e.en: The singer bowed {showily} after the final note.
e.zh: 最后一个音符落下后，歌手花哨地鞠了一躬。

e.en: The room had color without too much {showiness}.
e.zh: 这个房间有色彩感，但并不过分花哨。

e.en: Critics disliked the film's {showiness} more than its slow pace.
e.zh: 影评人不喜欢这部电影的炫耀感，甚于它的慢节奏。

e.en: The designer opened a small {showshop} near the studio.
e.zh: 设计师在工作室附近开了一家小型展示商店。

e.en: Their {showshop} displayed samples rather than full stock.
e.zh: 他们的陈列店展示的是样品，而不是完整库存。

e.en: Her {showstopping} solo brought the audience to its feet.
e.zh: 她惊艳全场的独唱让观众起立鼓掌。

e.en: The restaurant is known for a {showstopping} chocolate dessert.
e.zh: 这家餐厅以一道惊艳的巧克力甜点闻名。

e.en: His late {showup} annoyed everyone waiting at the gate.
e.zh: 他迟迟才到场，让等在门口的所有人都很恼火。

e.en: The audit became a public {showup} for the careless manager.
e.zh: 那次审计成了对这位粗心经理的公开揭短。

e.en: Add a spoonful of {shoyu} to deepen the broth.
e.zh: 加一勺日式酱油，让汤底味道更浓。

e.en: The chef preferred {shoyu} over salt for the marinade.
e.zh: 厨师腌制时更喜欢用日式酱油，而不是盐。

e.en: After years of {shram}, he finally bought his own shop.
e.zh: 多年辛苦劳作之后，他终于买下了自己的店。

e.en: The poem treats daily {shram} as a form of dignity.
e.zh: 这首诗把日常苦工写成一种尊严。

e.en: The floor was oddly {shredless} after the dog found the newspaper.
e.zh: 狗找到报纸之后，地板上竟然没有碎片，显得很奇怪。

e.en: She wanted a smooth, {shredless} sauce for the noodles.
e.zh: 她想给面条配一种顺滑、没有碎屑的酱汁。

e.en: The {shrewd-brained} lawyer noticed the hidden clause at once.
e.zh: 那位头脑精明的律师立刻注意到了隐藏条款。

e.en: A {shrewd-brained} investor waits before following a fashionable trend.
e.zh: 头脑精明的投资者不会急着追随流行趋势。

e.en: Her {shrewd-headed} advice saved the firm from a bad deal.
e.zh: 她头脑精明的建议让公司避开了一笔糟糕交易。

e.en: The villagers trusted the {shrewd-headed} old mayor in disputes.
e.zh: 村民在纠纷中信任那位会算计的老镇长。

e.en: A {shrewd-looking} clerk watched every customer near the counter.
e.zh: 一个看起来精明的店员盯着柜台附近的每位顾客。

e.en: The portrait shows a {shrewd-looking} woman with narrow eyes.
e.zh: 这幅画像画的是一位眼睛细长、看起来精明的女人。

e.en: The fossil had a small, {shrewlike} skull and sharp teeth.
e.zh: 这块化石有一个像鼩鼱的小头骨和尖牙。

e.en: He disliked her {shrewlike} temper during arguments.
e.zh: 他不喜欢她争吵时那种泼辣尖刻的脾气。

e.en: The barn sheltered several {shrewmice} during the winter.
e.zh: 冬天，谷仓里住着几只鼩鼱类小兽。

e.en: Biologists trapped {shrewmice} to study their rapid metabolism.
e.zh: 生物学家捕捉鼩鼱类小兽，以研究它们快速的新陈代谢。

e.en: A tiny {shrewmouse} darted under the leaves.
e.zh: 一只小鼩鼱迅速钻到落叶下面。

e.en: The old field guide called the animal a {shrewmouse}.
e.zh: 那本旧野外指南把这种动物称作尖鼠。

e.en: The museum displayed a {shrieval} chain from the county ceremony.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一条县郡仪式上用的郡长链饰。

e.en: His paper examined {shrieval} duties in medieval England.
e.zh: 他的论文研究中世纪英格兰郡长的职责。

e.en: The records date from his {shrievalty} in Kent.
e.zh: 这些记录可追溯到他在肯特担任郡长的时期。

e.en: She wrote about the powers attached to the {shrievalty}.
e.zh: 她写到了郡长职位所附带的权力。

e.en: The {shrieve} rode out to enforce the king's order.
e.zh: 郡长骑马出发去执行国王的命令。

e.en: In the old charter, the local {shrieve} collected fines.
e.zh: 在那份旧宪章中，当地治安官负责收取罚金。

e.en: A {shrimpfish} floated upright among the seagrass.
e.zh: 一条虾鱼在海草间直立着漂浮。

e.en: The aquarium keeps several {shrimpfish} in a quiet tank.
e.zh: 水族馆在一个安静的水箱里养了几条玻甲鱼。

e.en: The larva has a {shrimplike} body and long feelers.
e.zh: 这种幼虫身体像虾，还有长长的触须。

e.en: He found tiny {shrimplike} creatures in the pond water.
e.zh: 他在池塘水里发现了很小的虾状生物。

e.en: He was a {shrimpy} kid but surprisingly strong.
e.zh: 他小时候瘦瘦小小，却出奇地有力气。

e.en: The soup had a rich, {shrimpy} smell.
e.zh: 这汤有一股浓郁的虾味。

shrink-wrap.t: 热缩塑封；用收缩膜包装

e.en: Please {shrink-wrap} the manuals before shipping them.
e.zh: 发货前请把这些手册用收缩膜包装好。

e.en: The new software arrived in {shrink-wrap}.
e.zh: 新软件是带着热缩塑封送到的。

shrink-wrapped.t: 热缩塑封的；包得严实的

e.en: The {shrink-wrapped} books looked untouched.
e.zh: 这些热缩塑封的书看起来从未被翻过。

e.en: They bought a {shrink-wrapped} set of old DVDs.
e.zh: 他们买了一套热缩塑封的旧DVD。

e.en: Choose a {shrinkable} fabric only if you can wash it carefully.
e.zh: 只有能小心清洗时，才选择会缩水的布料。

e.en: The image is {shrinkable} without losing much detail.
e.zh: 这张图可以缩小，而且不会丢失太多细节。

e.en: She prefers {shrinkproof} wool for winter sweaters.
e.zh: 她冬天的毛衣更喜欢用防缩水羊毛。

e.en: The label says the socks are {shrinkproof}.
e.zh: 标签上写着这些袜子防缩水。

shrinkwrap.t: 热缩塑封；用收缩膜包装

e.en: The factory will {shrinkwrap} each game box.
e.zh: 工厂会把每个游戏盒都用收缩膜包装。

e.en: He tore the {shrinkwrap} from the new album.
e.zh: 他撕掉了新专辑外面的热缩塑封。

e.en: The phone was still {shrinkwrapped} when it arrived.
e.zh: 手机送到时仍然是热缩塑封的。

e.en: Rows of {shrinkwrapped} pallets filled the warehouse.
e.zh: 一排排用收缩膜包好的托盘堆满了仓库。

e.en: The workers began {shrinkwrapping} the gift baskets.
e.zh: 工人们开始给礼篮做热缩包装。

e.en: Poor {shrinkwrapping} can trap moisture inside the package.
e.zh: 热缩包装做得不好会把湿气困在包装里。

shrinkwraps.t: 热缩塑封；用收缩膜包装

e.en: She {shrinkwraps} the prints before mailing them.
e.zh: 她邮寄印刷品前会先用收缩膜包装。

e.en: The shop sells clear {shrinkwraps} for small products.
e.zh: 这家店出售小商品用的透明热缩膜。

e.en: The priest came to {shrive} the dying soldier.
e.zh: 神父前来听那名垂死士兵忏悔并赦罪。

e.en: In the poem, pilgrims seek to {shrive} their souls.
e.zh: 在诗中，朝圣者寻求让灵魂经忏悔获得赦免。

e.en: The monk {shrived} the prisoner before dawn.
e.zh: 黎明前，修士听囚犯忏悔并为他赦罪。

e.en: She felt {shrived} after confessing her guilt.
e.zh: 承认罪过后，她觉得自己获得了赦免。

e.en: He died {shriven} and at peace.
e.zh: 他临终前忏悔获赦，内心平静。

e.en: The novel presents a {shriven} villain seeking mercy.
e.zh: 小说写了一个忏悔获赦、寻求宽恕的恶人。

e.en: The chaplain {shrives} sailors before dangerous voyages.
e.zh: 随船牧师会在危险航行前听水手忏悔并赦罪。

e.en: In the legend, the hermit {shrives} anyone who crosses the hill.
e.zh: 传说中，隐士会为每个翻过山的人听忏悔并赦罪。

e.en: The rite of {shriving} was held in a small chapel.
e.zh: 听忏悔赦罪的仪式在一间小教堂举行。

e.en: After the {shriving}, he spoke with unusual calm.
e.zh: 忏悔获赦之后，他说话时异常平静。

e.en: The hotel {shroff} counted the cash twice.
e.zh: 酒店收银员把现金数了两遍。

e.en: A market {shroff} changed foreign coins for traders.
e.zh: 市场里的银钱兑换商为商人兑换外国硬币。

e.en: The receipt included a small {shroffage} fee.
e.zh: 收据里包括一笔小额兑换手续费。

e.en: Old ledgers describe the bank's {shroffage} in detail.
e.zh: 旧账簿详细记录了这家银行的收银兑换业务。

e.en: We added sliced {shrooms} to the pasta sauce.
e.zh: 我们把切片蘑菇加进了意面酱里。

e.en: He warned them that wild {shrooms} can be dangerous.
e.zh: 他警告他们，野生蘑菇可能很危险。

shroud-waving.t: 像挥裹尸布般的动作或姿态；阴森招摇的

e.en: The performer made a {shroud-waving} entrance through the smoke.
e.zh: 表演者在烟雾中以挥舞裹尸布般的姿态登场。

e.en: His speech had a {shroud-waving} gloom that unsettled the room.
e.zh: 他的演讲带着阴森招摇的悲观气氛，让全场不安。

shroudless.t: 没有裹尸布的；无遮盖的

e.en: The old statue stood {shroudless} in the rain.
e.zh: 那座旧雕像无遮无盖地立在雨中。

e.en: The body was left {shroudless} after the hurried evacuation.
e.zh: 匆忙撤离后，遗体没有裹尸布遮盖。

shrubbiness.t: 灌木丛生的状态；矮灌木特征

e.en: The garden's {shrubbiness} gave birds plenty of cover.
e.zh: 花园里灌木丛生，给鸟儿提供了很多遮蔽。

e.en: Too much {shrubbiness} can make a small yard feel cramped.
e.zh: 灌木太密会让小院子显得局促。

shrubless.t: 没有灌木的；无灌木覆盖的

e.en: The hillside was strangely {shrubless} after the fire.
e.zh: 火灾过后，那片山坡奇怪地没有了灌木。

e.en: They chose a {shrubless} path across the open field.
e.zh: 他们选择了一条穿过空旷田野、没有灌木的路。

e.en: Her novel begins in a poor {shtetel} before the war.
e.zh: 她的小说从战前一个贫穷的东欧犹太小镇写起。

e.en: The museum recreated a {shtetel} street with shops and homes.
e.zh: 博物馆重现了一条有商铺和住家的东欧犹太小镇街道。

e.en: His comic {shtik} worked better on stage than on television.
e.zh: 他的喜剧招牌套路在舞台上比在电视上更有效。

e.en: Playing the angry expert became her familiar {shtik}.
e.zh: 扮演愤怒专家成了她熟悉的表演噱头。

e.en: We were in serious {shtook} when the engine failed.
e.zh: 发动机出故障时，我们陷入了严重麻烦。

e.en: He got into {shtook} for missing the deadline again.
e.zh: 他又错过截止日期，因此惹上了麻烦。

e.en: The witnesses stayed {shtoom} until the police arrived.
e.zh: 证人们一直保持沉默，直到警察到场。

e.en: She kept {shtoom} about the surprise party all week.
e.zh: 她整整一周都对惊喜派对闭口不提。

shtup.t: 与人性交；粗俗地发生性关系

e.en: The tabloid claimed he had tried to {shtup} a colleague.
e.zh: 小报声称他曾试图和一名同事发生性关系。

e.en: The joke used {shtup} for a deliberately crude effect.
e.zh: 这个笑话使用这个粗俗词，是为了刻意制造粗鄙效果。

e.en: He felt {shuddery} after walking home through the storm.
e.zh: 他冒着暴风雨走回家后，觉得浑身发抖。

e.en: The film had a {shuddery} atmosphere from the first scene.
e.zh: 这部电影从第一幕起就有一种令人战栗的气氛。

e.en: Have a {shufti} at this report before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前快速看一眼这份报告。

e.en: The mechanic took a quick {shufti} under the bonnet.
e.zh: 机械师迅速查看了一下引擎盖下面。

e.en: Take a {shufty} at the map before we leave.
e.zh: 我们出发前先看一眼地图。

e.en: She had a quick {shufty} round the flat.
e.zh: 她在公寓里快速看了一圈。

e.en: The old table felt {shuggy} on the uneven floor.
e.zh: 旧桌子放在不平的地板上，感觉摇摇晃晃。

e.en: Grandad sat in his {shuggy} by the fire.
e.zh: 爷爷坐在炉火旁的摇椅里。

shunga.t: 日本春画；浮世绘情色画

e.en: The exhibition included Edo-period {shunga} prints.
e.zh: 展览包括江户时期的日本春画版画。

e.en: Scholars study {shunga} as both erotic art and social history.
e.zh: 学者把日本春画同时作为情色艺术和社会史来研究。

e.en: The pendant was made from polished {shungite}.
e.zh: 这个吊坠是用抛光的次石墨制成的。

e.en: Some sellers claim {shungite} can purify water.
e.zh: 一些卖家声称次石墨可以净化水。

shunless.t: 未被回避的；无人躲避的

e.en: The controversial speaker stood {shunless} before a curious crowd.
e.zh: 这位有争议的演讲者站在好奇的人群面前，并未被人回避。

e.en: Her direct questions left no topic {shunless}.
e.zh: 她直截了当的提问让任何话题都没有被避开。

e.en: We {shunpiked} through farm roads to avoid the toll.
e.zh: 我们沿着乡间小路绕行，避开了收费站。

e.en: Local drivers often {shunpike} when the highway is jammed.
e.zh: 高速堵车时，当地司机常走小路绕过去。

e.en: A seasoned {shunpiker} knows every back road near the bridge.
