e.zh: 老练的绕路司机知道桥附近每一条小路。

e.en: The motel owner gave the {shunpiker} a hand-drawn map.
e.zh: 汽车旅馆老板给那位避收费路的人画了一张地图。

e.en: Their weekend trip involved plenty of {shunpiking} through quiet villages.
e.zh: 他们周末旅行时多次穿过安静村庄绕行避费。

e.en: {Shunpiking} can save money but add an hour to the drive.
e.zh: 走小路避收费能省钱，但可能让车程多出一小时。

e.en: The old elevator used a {shunt-wound} motor.
e.zh: 那台旧电梯使用的是并励绕组电动机。

e.en: A {shunt-wound} generator keeps its voltage relatively steady.
e.zh: 并励发电机能让电压保持相对稳定。

e.en: The technician measured the {shunting-in} resistance of the circuit.
e.zh: 技术员测量了电路的分流输入电阻。

e.en: The crew delayed the {shunting-in} of the freight cars.
e.zh: 工作人员推迟了货车车厢的调车入线。

e.en: The council met in {shura} before announcing its decision.
e.zh: 委员会先举行协商会议，然后才宣布决定。

e.en: Some constitutions mention {shura} as a principle of governance.
e.zh: 一些宪法把舒拉协商列为治理原则。

e.en: I need some {shut-eye} before the early flight.
e.zh: 赶早班飞机前，我需要睡一会儿。

e.en: The nurse grabbed ten minutes of {shut-eye} during her break.
e.zh: 护士在休息时抓紧睡了十分钟。

shut-in.t: 足不出户者；被关在室内的

e.en: After the accident, he lived as a {shut-in} for months.
e.zh: 事故之后，他好几个月都像隐居者一样不出门。

e.en: The storm left the family {shut-in} for two days.
e.zh: 暴风雪让这家人被困在屋里两天。

e.en: The plumber found the main water {shut-off} valve.
e.zh: 水管工找到了总水阀的关闭阀门。

e.en: A sudden {shut-off} of power damaged the machine.
e.zh: 突然断电损坏了那台机器。

e.en: Fans felt {shut-out} of the club's decision-making.
e.zh: 球迷觉得自己被排除在俱乐部决策之外。

e.en: The goalie earned a {shut-out} in the final match.
e.zh: 守门员在决赛中完成了零封。

e.en: The operator checked the press {shutheight} before production.
e.zh: 操作员在生产前检查了冲床的闭合高度。

e.en: Incorrect {shutheight} can damage the die set.
e.zh: 合模高度不正确可能会损坏模具组。

e.en: The phone uses a {shutterless} camera design.
e.zh: 这部手机采用无机械快门的相机设计。

e.en: A {shutterless} window faced the narrow street.
e.zh: 一扇没有百叶窗的窗户朝着狭窄的街道。

e.en: The factory installed {shuttleless} looms last year.
e.zh: 工厂去年安装了无梭织机。

e.en: {Shuttleless} weaving can run faster and more quietly.
e.zh: 无梭织造速度更快，也更安静。

e.en: He was criticized for using the slur {shvartze}.
e.zh: 他因使用“shvartze”这个侮辱黑人词语而受到批评。

e.en: The novel includes {shvartze} to show a character's prejudice.
e.zh: 小说使用“shvartze”一词来表现人物的偏见。

e.en: The final vowel in sofa is often a {shwa}.
e.zh: sofa 末尾的元音常读作中央元音。

e.en: English learners often miss the {shwa} in unstressed syllables.
e.zh: 英语学习者常漏掉非重读音节里的弱读音。

e.en: Stop {shypooing} and help us load the truck.
e.zh: 别再闲晃了，过来帮我们装车。

e.en: They spent the afternoon {shypooing} around town.
e.zh: 他们整个下午都在镇上闲逛。

e.en: The pony {shys} whenever a bus passes.
e.zh: 每当公交车经过，那匹小马就会受惊躲闪。

e.en: He {shys} away from any discussion of money.
e.zh: 他总是避开任何关于钱的讨论。

e.en: Geology texts once described continents as resting on {sial}.
e.zh: 地质学教材曾把大陆描述为位于硅铝层之上。

e.en: The term {sial} contrasts with the denser sima below.
e.zh: “sial”这个术语与下方密度更高的硅镁层相对。

sialadenitis.t: 涎腺炎；唾液腺发炎，属于医学术语。常用于临床诊断。

e.en: The dentist diagnosed {sialadenitis} after the patient's cheek became swollen.
e.zh: 患者脸颊肿起后，牙医诊断为涎腺炎。

e.en: Acute {sialadenitis} can cause pain when eating sour food.
e.zh: 急性涎腺炎在吃酸味食物时可能会引起疼痛。

sialadenotomy.t: 涎腺切开术；唾液腺切开，医学手术术语。

e.en: The surgeon performed a {sialadenotomy} to drain the blocked gland.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了涎腺切开术，以引流堵塞的腺体。

e.en: A {sialadenotomy} is rarely needed for minor salivary problems.
e.zh: 轻微的唾液腺问题通常很少需要涎腺切开术。

sialagogue.t: 促唾液剂；促进唾液分泌的物质。

e.en: The doctor suggested a {sialagogue} for her dry mouth.
e.zh: 医生建议她使用促唾液剂来缓解口干。

e.en: Lemon candy can act as a mild {sialagogue}.
e.zh: 柠檬糖可以起到温和促唾液剂的作用。

sialectasis.t: 涎管扩张；唾液腺管异常扩张。

e.en: Imaging showed {sialectasis} in the parotid duct.
e.zh: 影像检查显示腮腺导管有涎管扩张。

e.en: Chronic inflammation may lead to {sialectasis}.
e.zh: 慢性炎症可能导致涎管扩张。

sialic.t: 唾液酸的；与唾液酸有关。

e.en: The study measured {sialic} acid levels in the sample.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了样本中的唾液酸水平。

e.en: Some viruses bind to {sialic} residues on cell surfaces.
e.zh: 有些病毒会结合细胞表面的唾液酸残基。

sialid.t: 唾液酸苷；含唾液酸的糖苷类物质。

e.en: The enzyme reacted with a synthetic {sialid} in the test tube.
e.zh: 这种酶在试管中与一种合成唾液酸苷发生反应。

e.en: Researchers used the {sialid} to study carbohydrate binding.
e.zh: 研究人员用这种唾液酸苷来研究糖类结合。

sialidan.t: 唾液酸酐类化合物；罕见生化术语。

e.en: The paper described a rare {sialidan} derivative.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种罕见的唾液酸酐衍生物。

e.en: Only specialists would recognize the term {sialidan}.
e.zh: 只有专业人士才会认得唾液酸酐这个术语。

sialidase.t: 唾液酸酶；分解唾液酸的酶。

e.en: The bacterium produces {sialidase} during infection.
e.zh: 这种细菌在感染过程中会产生唾液酸酶。

e.en: Scientists measured {sialidase} activity in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 科学家测量了组织样本中的唾液酸酶活性。

e.en: The medication caused {sialism} as an unwanted side effect.
e.zh: 这种药物引起了流涎症这一不良副作用。

e.en: Severe {sialism} can make speaking uncomfortable.
e.zh: 严重流涎症会让说话变得不舒服。

sialisterium.t: 吐唾器；旧式接唾液器具。

e.en: The old clinic kept a porcelain {sialisterium} beside the chair.
e.zh: 那家老诊所在椅子旁放着一个瓷制吐唾器。

e.en: A {sialisterium} appears in descriptions of early dental rooms.
e.zh: 早期牙科诊室的描述中会出现吐唾器。

siallite.t: 涎石；唾液腺或导管中的结石。

e.en: The scan revealed a small {siallite} near the duct opening.
e.zh: 扫描显示导管开口附近有一颗小涎石。

e.en: A painful {siallite} may block the flow of saliva.
e.zh: 疼痛的涎石可能会阻塞唾液流动。

sialoglycoprotein.t: 唾液酸糖蛋白；含唾液酸的糖蛋白。

e.en: The membrane contains a {sialoglycoprotein} important for cell recognition.
e.zh: 细胞膜含有一种对细胞识别很重要的唾液酸糖蛋白。

e.en: Researchers purified the {sialoglycoprotein} from blood plasma.
e.zh: 研究人员从血浆中纯化了这种唾液酸糖蛋白。

sialogogue.t: 促唾液剂；刺激唾液分泌的东西。

e.en: Chewing gum can be used as a simple {sialogogue}.
e.zh: 口香糖可以作为一种简单的促唾液剂。

e.en: The pharmacist recommended a {sialogogue} for dry mouth symptoms.
e.zh: 药剂师建议用促唾液剂缓解口干症状。

sialoid.t: 似唾液的；与唾液相似的。

e.en: The sample had a thick, {sialoid} texture.
e.zh: 这个样本具有黏稠、类似唾液的质地。

e.en: The doctor noted a {sialoid} secretion from the lesion.
e.zh: 医生记录到病灶有一种似唾液的分泌物。

e.en: A {sialolith} was removed from the patient's salivary duct.
e.zh: 医生从患者的唾液腺导管中取出了一颗涎石。

e.en: The pain worsened when the {sialolith} blocked saliva flow.
e.zh: 涎石阻塞唾液流动时，疼痛加重了。

sialolithiasis.t: 涎石病；唾液腺结石形成。

e.en: The swelling was caused by {sialolithiasis}.
e.zh: 这处肿胀是由涎石病引起的。

e.en: Recurrent {sialolithiasis} may require surgical treatment.
e.zh: 反复发生的涎石病可能需要手术治疗。

sialomucin.t: 唾液酸黏蛋白；含唾液酸的黏蛋白。

e.en: The gland secreted {sialomucin} into the oral cavity.
e.zh: 该腺体向口腔分泌唾液酸黏蛋白。

e.en: Pathologists identified {sialomucin} in the tumor sample.
e.zh: 病理学家在肿瘤样本中发现了唾液酸黏蛋白。

sialon.t: 赛隆陶瓷；硅铝氧氮陶瓷材料。

e.en: The cutting tool was made from {sialon}.
e.zh: 这件切削工具由赛隆陶瓷制成。

e.en: Engineers choose {sialon} for its heat resistance.
e.zh: 工程师选择赛隆陶瓷，是因为它耐热。

sialoprotein.t: 唾液酸蛋白；含唾液酸的蛋白质。

e.en: Bone {sialoprotein} helps cells attach to mineral surfaces.
e.zh: 骨唾液酸蛋白帮助细胞附着在矿物表面。

e.en: The lab tested {sialoprotein} levels in the tissue.
e.zh: 实验室检测了组织中的唾液酸蛋白水平。

siamang.t: 合趾猿；东南亚大型长臂猿。

e.en: A {siamang} called loudly from the treetop.
e.zh: 一只合趾猿在树顶大声鸣叫。

e.en: The zoo's {siamang} has a large throat sac.
e.zh: 动物园里的合趾猿有一个很大的喉囊。

sibb.t: 有亲属关系的；古英语亲近的。

e.en: The poet used {sibb} to mean closely related.
e.zh: 诗人用sibb表示关系亲近。

e.en: In old texts, {sibb} can describe kinship or peace.
e.zh: 在古文本中，sibb可表示亲属关系或和睦。

siberite.t: 红电气石；西伯利亚红色碧玺。

e.en: The collector bought a polished {siberite} gemstone.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一颗抛光的红电气石宝石。

e.en: Deep pink {siberite} is valued by mineral enthusiasts.
e.zh: 深粉色红电气石受到矿物爱好者重视。

e.en: The microphone exaggerated the singer's {sibilance}.
e.zh: 麦克风放大了歌手声音里的咝咝声。

e.en: English words like sit and hiss contain clear {sibilance}.
e.zh: sit和hiss这样的英语词带有明显的齿擦音特征。

e.en: The recording captured the snake's {sibilancy} clearly.
e.zh: 录音清楚地捕捉到了蛇发出的咝咝声。

e.en: Her whisper had a sharp {sibilancy}.
e.zh: 她的耳语带着尖锐的咝音感。

e.en: The actor was trained not to {sibilate} his lines.
e.zh: 那位演员受过训练，说台词时不要发出过重的咝音。

e.en: Steam began to {sibilate} through the valve.
e.zh: 蒸汽开始从阀门里咝咝地冒出来。

e.en: She {sibilated} the warning through clenched teeth.
e.zh: 她咬紧牙关，咝声说出了警告。

e.en: The word was {sibilated} in the old recording.
e.zh: 这个词在那段老录音里带着明显的咝音。

e.en: The pipe {sibilates} whenever pressure builds inside.
e.zh: 管道内部压力升高时就会发出咝咝声。

e.en: He {sibilates} every final s when he speaks.
e.zh: 他说话时每个词尾的 s 都发得带咝音。

e.en: A {sibilating} hiss came from the kettle.
e.zh: 水壶里传来一阵咝咝的响声。

e.en: The teacher corrected his {sibilating} pronunciation.
e.zh: 老师纠正了他带咝音的发音。

e.en: The microphone exaggerated the singer's {sibilation}.
e.zh: 麦克风放大了歌手发音中的咝音。

e.en: Linguists noted {sibilation} in the regional accent.
e.zh: 语言学家注意到这种地方口音里有咝音化现象。

sibylic.t: 女预言者般的；神秘预言的

e.en: Her {sibylic} tone made the warning sound ancient.
e.zh: 她那女预言者般的语气让警告听起来古老而神秘。

e.en: The poem ends with a {sibylic} image of fire.
e.zh: 这首诗以一个带有预言意味的火焰意象结尾。

e.en: The minister gave a {sibylline} answer to the question.
e.zh: 部长对这个问题给出了一个晦涩如预言般的回答。

e.en: Her notes were brief and {sibylline}.
e.zh: 她的笔记简短而神秘难懂。

e.en: The museum displayed a Roman {sica} behind glass.
e.zh: 博物馆把一把罗马短匕首陈列在玻璃柜后。

e.en: The assassin's {sica} was curved and short.
e.zh: 刺客的短匕首弯而短。

e.en: The novel follows a young {sicario} in Bogotá.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述一名年轻的波哥大职业杀手。

e.en: Police said the {sicario} worked for a cartel.
e.zh: 警方称这名职业杀手为一个贩毒集团效力。

e.en: The editor added a {sicative} note after the error.
e.zh: 编辑在错误后加了一个表示原文如此的说明。

e.en: A {sicative} mark preserved the writer's spelling.
e.zh: 一个原文如此的标记保留了作者的拼写。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {sicca} syndrome.
e.zh: 患者被诊断为干燥综合征。

e.en: Her eyes felt worse during the {sicca} episode.
e.zh: 干燥症发作时，她的眼睛感觉更难受。

e.en: The painter mixed a {siccative} into the oil.
e.zh: 画家在油彩里混入了一种催干剂。

e.en: This varnish has a strong {siccative} effect.
e.zh: 这种清漆有很强的催干作用。

e.en: She {sicced} the guard dog on the intruder.
e.zh: 她放出看门狗去扑咬闯入者。

e.en: The company {sicced} its lawyers on the blogger.
e.zh: 公司派律师去对付那名博主。

siccing.t: 正在唆使攻击；派去对付

e.en: He was {siccing} his dog on the trespassers.
e.zh: 他正唆使自己的狗去攻击那些擅入者。

e.en: They accused her of {siccing} reporters on them.
e.zh: 他们指责她把记者招来对付他们。

e.en: He rolled a {sice} and won the game.
e.zh: 他掷出了六点，赢下了这局游戏。

e.en: The old rule counted a {sice} as lucky.
e.zh: 旧规则把骰子的六点视为好运。

siciliano.t: 西西里舞曲；西西里风格的

e.en: The suite includes a gentle {siciliano}.
e.zh: 这组曲中包含一段柔和的西西里舞曲。

e.en: The melody has a lilting {siciliano} rhythm.
e.zh: 这段旋律带有轻快摇曳的西西里舞曲节奏。

sick-making.t: 令人作呕的；讨厌透顶的

e.en: The smell from the drain was {sick-making}.
e.zh: 下水道传来的气味令人作呕。

e.en: His smug apology felt {sick-making} to everyone.
e.zh: 他那自鸣得意的道歉让所有人都觉得恶心。

e.en: The nurse kept the {sick-room} quiet at night.
e.zh: 护士夜里让病房保持安静。

e.en: Flowers brightened the small {sick-room}.
e.zh: 鲜花让那间小病房显得明亮了一些。

e.en: She reached for the {sickbag} during turbulence.
e.zh: 飞机颠簸时，她伸手去拿呕吐袋。

e.en: Every seat had a fresh {sickbag} in the pocket.
e.zh: 每个座位的袋子里都有一个新的呕吐袋。

e.en: The camp nurse checked each {sickee} before breakfast.
e.zh: 营地护士在早餐前检查了每个病人。

e.en: The boss suspected the {sickee} wanted a long weekend.
e.zh: 老板怀疑那个请病假的人只是想过个长周末。

e.en: The wasteful bonuses were real {sickeners} for the staff.
e.zh: 那些浪费的奖金让员工们十分反感。

e.en: News of the fraud became one of the day's {sickeners}.
e.zh: 诈骗的消息成了当天令人恶心的事之一。

e.en: He smiled {sickerly} at the cruel joke.
e.zh: 听到那个残酷的笑话，他病态地笑了。

e.en: The room smelled {sickerly} sweet after the spill.
e.zh: 液体洒出后，房间里有股甜得发腻的怪味。

e.en: She trusted the {sickerness} of his promise.
e.zh: 她相信他的承诺是可靠的。

e.en: Old writers praised the {sickerness} of honest counsel.
e.zh: 古代作家赞赏诚实建议的稳妥可靠。

e.en: He pulled a {sickie} after the concert.
e.zh: 音乐会之后，他装病请了一天假。

e.en: Taking a {sickie} before exams looked suspicious.
e.zh: 考试前请病假看起来很可疑。

e.en: I felt {sickish} after the long bus ride.
e.zh: 坐了很久公交后，我觉得有点恶心。

e.en: The paint had a {sickish} green color.
e.zh: 那种油漆带着一种病态的绿色。

e.en: A wave of {sickishness} followed the medicine.
e.zh: 吃药后，一阵轻微恶心涌了上来。

e.en: The room's heat gave him a feeling of {sickishness}.
e.zh: 房间里的闷热让他感到有些不适。

e.en: The doctor tested the child for {sicklanemia}.
e.zh: 医生给孩子做了镰状细胞贫血症检查。

e.en: Older records sometimes used {sicklanemia} for sickle-cell anemia.
e.zh: 旧记录有时用这个词指镰状细胞贫血症。

e.en: She was diagnosed with {sickle-cell} disease as a child.
e.zh: 她小时候被诊断出患有镰状细胞病。

e.en: A {sickle-cell} test is common in some clinics.
e.zh: 在一些诊所，镰状细胞检测很常见。

e.en: She took {sickleave} after the operation.
e.zh: 手术后她请了病假。

e.en: The company changed its {sickleave} policy this year.
e.zh: 公司今年修改了病假政策。

e.en: A {sicklebill} probed the flower with its curved beak.
e.zh: 一只镰嘴鸟用弯喙探进花里。

e.en: The guide pointed out a rare {sicklebill} in the forest.
e.zh: 向导指出森林里有一只罕见的镰嘴鸟。

e.en: The lab reported a low {sicklecrit} value.
e.zh: 实验室报告了较低的镰状细胞压积值。

e.en: Doctors used the {sicklecrit} to follow his condition.
e.zh: 医生用镰状细胞压积测定来跟踪他的病情。

e.en: The {sickleman} worked slowly through the tall grain.
e.zh: 那个持镰刀的人慢慢割过高高的谷物。

e.en: In the old tale, a {sickleman} guarded the field.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里，一个持镰刀的人守着田地。

e.en: The {sicklemen} entered the field at dawn.
e.zh: 持镰刀的人们在黎明时走进田里。

e.en: Medieval records mention {sicklemen} hired for harvest.
e.zh: 中世纪记录提到雇来收割的割草工。

e.en: The paper discussed {sicklemia} in rural families.
e.zh: 这篇论文讨论了农村家庭中的镰状细胞贫血症。

e.en: Modern doctors rarely use {sicklemia} in everyday speech.
e.zh: 现代医生日常很少使用这个词。

e.en: He coughed {sicklily} through the meeting.
e.zh: 他开会时一直病恹恹地咳嗽。

e.en: The lamp burned {sicklily} in the damp room.
e.zh: 潮湿的房间里，灯光病态地昏黄着。

e.en: Her childhood was marked by frequent {sickliness}.
e.zh: 她的童年常常伴随着多病体弱。

e.en: The plant's {sickliness} came from poor soil.
e.zh: 这株植物的不健康是土壤贫瘠造成的。

e.en: Teachers staged a {sickout} to protest budget cuts.
e.zh: 教师们集体称病请假，抗议预算削减。

e.en: The airline canceled flights during the pilots' {sickout}.
e.zh: 飞行员集体称病罢工期间，航空公司取消了航班。

e.en: The dessert was too sweet and {sicky}.
e.zh: 那道甜点太甜了，让人发腻恶心。

e.en: She stayed home with a {sicky} child.
e.zh: 她留在家里照顾一个病恹恹的孩子。

e.en: The tired child said, "I need to {siddown}."
e.zh: 那个累坏的孩子说：“我得坐下。”

e.en: In the comic dialogue, the farmer told everyone to {siddown}.
e.zh: 在那段滑稽对白里，农夫叫大家坐下。

e.en: We found two seats near the {side-aisle}.
e.zh: 我们在侧边通道附近找到了两个座位。

e.en: The church's {side-aisle} was quieter than the nave.
e.zh: 教堂的侧廊比中殿安静。

e.en: The article includes a {side-bar} with useful dates.
e.zh: 这篇文章有一个侧栏，列出了一些有用日期。

e.en: During the meeting, their budget talk became a long {side-bar}.
e.zh: 开会时，他们关于预算的讨论变成了一段很长的附带话题。

e.en: He placed a small {side-bet} on the final score.
e.zh: 他对最终比分下了一小笔附加赌注。

e.en: Their private {side-bet} made the game more intense.
e.zh: 他们私下的旁注让比赛更紧张。

e.en: A {side-branch} blocked part of the narrow path.
e.zh: 一根侧枝挡住了狭窄小路的一部分。

e.en: The railway's {side-branch} serves three small villages.
e.zh: 这条铁路支线连接着三个小村庄。

e.en: His left {side-burn} was longer than the right one.
e.zh: 他的左边鬓角比右边更长。

e.en: The actor wore a fake {side-burn} for the period film.
e.zh: 那位演员为这部年代片贴了假鬓角。

e.en: The two children sat {side-by-side} on the bench.
e.zh: 两个孩子并排坐在长椅上。

e.en: The report offers a {side-by-side} comparison of costs.
e.zh: 这份报告对成本作了并列比较。

e.en: The mower has a {side-discharging} chute for grass clippings.
e.zh: 这台割草机有一个侧向排草口。

e.en: A {side-discharging} conveyor moved the grain into trucks.
e.zh: 一台侧向卸料输送机把谷物送进卡车。

e.en: Please use the {side-door} after ten o'clock.
e.zh: 十点以后请走侧门。

e.en: The thief escaped through a hidden {side-door}.
e.zh: 小偷从一扇隐蔽的旁门逃走了。

e.en: Farmers often {side-dress} corn when it starts growing fast.
e.zh: 玉米开始快速生长时，农民常会给它侧施肥。

e.en: You can {side-dress} the vegetables with compost in June.
e.zh: 六月时可以给蔬菜侧施堆肥。

e.en: A light {side-dressing} of nitrogen helped the plants recover.
e.zh: 少量侧施氮肥帮助这些植物恢复了长势。

e.en: The gardener added a {side-dressing} of compost around each tomato.
e.zh: 园丁在每株番茄旁边加了一圈追肥用的堆肥。

e.en: The parade began with a sharp {side-drum} rhythm.
e.zh: 游行以清脆的小军鼓节奏开始。

e.en: He learned the {side-drum} before joining the band.
e.zh: 他加入乐队前先学了小军鼓。

e.en: Drowsiness is a common {side-effect} of this medicine.
e.zh: 嗜睡是这种药常见的副作用。

e.en: A useful {side-effect} of cycling was better sleep.
e.zh: 骑车带来的一个有益附带影响是睡眠改善了。

e.en: The doctor explained the possible {side-effects} clearly.
e.zh: 医生清楚解释了可能出现的副作用。

e.en: The policy had unexpected {side-effects} on small businesses.
e.zh: 这项政策对小企业产生了意外的附带影响。

e.en: She learned to {side-foot} the ball into the corner.
e.zh: 她学会了用脚内侧把球踢进角落。

e.en: The striker chose to {side-foot} the penalty calmly.
e.zh: 前锋选择冷静地用脚内侧踢点球。

e.en: His {side-footed} shot rolled past the goalkeeper.
e.zh: 他用脚内侧踢出的球滚过了守门员。

e.en: A gentle {side-footed} pass opened the defense.
e.zh: 一次轻巧的脚内侧传球撕开了防线。

e.en: She gave him a quick {side-glance} across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子快速斜眼看了他一下。

e.en: His nervous {side-glance} revealed that he knew the answer.
e.zh: 他紧张地侧目一瞥，暴露出他知道答案。

e.en: Let's not turn this meeting into a debate over a {side-issue}.
e.zh: 别让这次会议变成对枝节问题的争论。

e.en: Parking is a {side-issue}; funding is the real problem.
e.zh: 停车只是次要议题，资金才是真正的问题。

e.en: The detective's loyal {side-kick} noticed the missing key.
e.zh: 侦探忠诚的助手注意到了丢失的钥匙。

e.en: At school, Ben was always his funny {side-kick}.
e.zh: 在学校里，本一直是他那个风趣的好伙伴。

e.en: A broken {side-light} made the car hard to see at night.
e.zh: 一盏坏掉的侧灯让这辆车夜里不太显眼。

e.en: Soft sun entered through the narrow {side-light} beside the door.
e.zh: 柔和的阳光从门边狭窄的旁窗照了进来。

e.en: The horse stood {side-on} to the camera.
e.zh: 那匹马侧身对着镜头站着。

e.en: A {side-on} view shows the slope more clearly.
e.zh: 从侧面看能更清楚地看到坡度。

e.en: The trainer adjusted the {side-rein} before the lesson.
e.zh: 训练师在课程开始前调整了马的侧缰。

e.en: A tight {side-rein} can make the horse uncomfortable.
e.zh: 侧缰太紧会让马感到不舒服。

e.en: We turned onto a quiet {side-road} near the river.
e.zh: 我们拐上了河边一条安静的支路。

e.en: The main street was closed, so drivers used a {side-road}.
e.zh: 主街封闭了，所以司机们改走一条小路。

e.en: She rode {side-saddle} in the historical parade.
e.zh: 她在历史游行中侧坐在马鞍上骑行。

e.en: The old portrait shows a woman sitting {side-saddle}.
e.zh: 那幅旧画像里，一名女子横坐在马鞍上。

e.en: The dress split at the {side-seam}.
e.zh: 那条裙子的侧缝裂开了。

e.en: Measure from the waist down the {side-seam}.
e.zh: 从腰部沿侧缝向下量尺寸。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the damaged {side-sheet}.
e.zh: 机修工更换了受损的侧板。

e.en: A thin {side-sheet} protects the machine housing.
e.zh: 一块薄侧板保护着机器外壳。

e.en: Cut each {side-shoot} before it grows too long.
e.zh: 每根侧枝长得太长之前都要剪掉。

e.en: A new {side-shoot} appeared near the base of the plant.
e.zh: 植物根部附近长出了一根新的侧芽。

e.en: The fair had a noisy {side-show} near the entrance.
e.zh: 集市入口附近有个吵闹的杂耍小摊。

e.en: The argument became a political {side-show}.
e.zh: 这场争论变成了政治上的次要闹剧。

e.en: His {side-splitting} story made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他那个令人捧腹的故事把大家都逗笑了。

e.en: The play was funny, but not exactly {side-splitting}.
e.zh: 这出戏很好笑，但还不到让人笑破肚皮的程度。

e.en: The truck gave our car a {side-swipe}.
e.zh: 那辆卡车从侧面擦撞了我们的车。

e.en: Her speech included a {side-swipe} at her rivals.
e.zh: 她的演讲里夹带了对竞争对手的间接批评。

e.en: Do not let small details {side-track} the meeting.
e.zh: 别让细枝末节把会议带偏。

e.en: The train waited on a {side-track}.
e.zh: 那列火车停在一条支线轨道上等待。

e.en: The drawing shows a {side-view} of the engine.
e.zh: 这张图展示了发动机的侧面图。

e.en: From the {side-view}, the chair looks very slim.
e.zh: 从侧面看，这把椅子显得很轻薄。

e.en: The horse moved {side-ward} to avoid the gate.
e.zh: 那匹马向侧面移动，避开了大门。

e.en: He gave a quick {side-ward} glance.
e.zh: 他迅速朝旁边瞥了一眼。

e.en: The old steamer had a large {side-wheel}.
e.zh: 那艘老汽船有一个巨大的船侧明轮。

e.en: Mud jammed the small {side-wheel} on the machine.
e.zh: 泥巴卡住了机器上的小侧轮。

e.en: A restored {side-wheeler} carried tourists down the river.
e.zh: 一艘修复后的侧轮船载着游客顺河而下。

e.en: The museum displays a model of a nineteenth-century {side-wheeler}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一艘十九世纪侧轮船的模型。

e.en: The judge wore impressive {side-whiskers}.
e.zh: 那位法官留着很醒目的两颊胡须。

e.en: His gray {side-whiskers} made him look older.
e.zh: 他灰白的络腮胡让他显得更老。

e.en: A strong {side-wind} pushed the bicycle across the lane.
e.zh: 一阵强侧风把自行车吹得偏过了车道。

e.en: Pilots train to land in a {side-wind}.
e.zh: 飞行员会训练在侧风中降落。

e.en: The officer carried a {sidearm} on duty.
e.zh: 那名警官执勤时佩带随身手枪。

e.en: He throws {sidearm} to surprise the batter.
e.zh: 他用侧手投球来出其不意地对付击球手。

e.en: The farrier suspected {sidebone} in the old horse.
e.zh: 蹄铁匠怀疑那匹老马患有蹄侧骨病。

e.en: X-rays confirmed {sidebone} near the hoof.
e.zh: X光确认蹄部附近有侧骨病变。

e.en: The study measured hand {sidedness} in young children.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了幼儿用手的偏侧性。

e.en: Political {sidedness} shaped the debate.
e.zh: 政治立场的偏向影响了这场辩论。

e.en: A blue {sideflash} marked the bird's wing.
e.zh: 鸟翅上有一块蓝色的侧面色斑。

e.en: The camera caught a brief {sideflash} of light.
e.zh: 相机捕捉到一道短暂的侧面闪光。

e.en: Players often {sidefoot} the ball for accuracy.
e.zh: 球员常用脚侧踢球，以提高准确度。

e.en: He struck it with the {sidefoot}, not the toe.
e.zh: 他是用脚侧部踢的，不是用脚尖。

e.en: She {sidefooted} the ball into the corner.
e.zh: 她用脚侧把球踢进了角落。

e.en: A calm {sidefooted} finish won the match.
e.zh: 一次冷静的脚侧推射赢下了比赛。

e.en: The cart slipped {sideling} down the muddy bank.
e.zh: 手推车沿着泥泞的岸坡侧斜滑下去。

e.en: He gave her a {sideling} look across the table.
e.zh: 他隔着桌子斜眼看了她一眼。

e.en: She added a {sidenote} about the source.
e.zh: 她加了一条关于出处的旁注。

e.en: As a {sidenote}, the restaurant closes early on Sundays.
e.zh: 顺便一提，那家餐馆星期天很早关门。

e.en: The carpenter fitted the wooden {sidepiece} carefully.
e.zh: 木匠小心地装好了那块木制侧件。

e.en: The song mentions a secret {sidepiece}.
e.zh: 这首歌提到了一个秘密情人。

e.en: The museum displayed a rare {sideraerolite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块罕见的铁石陨石。

e.en: Scientists classified the specimen as a {sideraerolite}.
e.zh: 科学家把这个标本归类为铁石陨石。

e.en: The observatory recorded {sideral} time.
e.zh: 天文台记录了恒星时。

e.en: Ancient writers used {sideral} imagery in poems.
e.zh: 古代作家在诗中使用星辰意象。

e.en: The {sidesman} greeted worshippers at the church door.
e.zh: 那名教区助理在教堂门口迎接礼拜者。

e.en: A {sidesman} showed the family to their pew.
e.zh: 一位座席引导员把那家人带到长椅座位。

sidesmen.t: 教区助理们；座席引导员

e.en: The {sidesmen} collected the offering after the hymn.
e.zh: 唱完圣歌后，教区助理们收取奉献。

e.en: Two {sidesmen} guided late arrivals to empty seats.
e.zh: 两名座席引导员把迟到的人带到空座位。

e.en: The tennis ball curved because of heavy {sidespin}.
e.zh: 网球因强烈侧旋而弯曲飞行。

e.en: He added {sidespin} to make the cue ball drift.
e.zh: 他加上侧旋，让母球偏向一边。

sidesplitter.t: 令人捧腹的笑话或表演

e.en: Her story was a real {sidesplitter} at dinner.
e.zh: 她讲的故事在晚餐时真让人笑破肚皮。

e.en: The comedian saved his best {sidesplitter} for the finale.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员把最逗的段子留到结尾。

e.en: A small {sidestream} joined the river below the bridge.
e.zh: 一条小支流在桥下汇入大河。

e.en: The device measured particles in a {sidestream} of air.
e.zh: 这台设备测量旁路气流中的颗粒。

e.en: She used the {sidestroke} to cross the cold lake.
e.zh: 她用侧泳横渡那片寒冷的湖。

e.en: Lifeguards often learn the {sidestroke} for rescues.
e.zh: 救生员常学习侧泳以便救援。

e.en: The headset has adjustable {sidetone} for clearer calls.
e.zh: 这副耳机有可调侧音，通话更清楚。

e.en: Without {sidetone}, speakers may raise their voices.
e.zh: 没有电话回听声时，说话者可能会提高音量。

e.en: The crab made a quick {sideward} movement.
e.zh: 螃蟹迅速向侧面移动了一下。

e.en: She gave him a {sideward} glance during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议中她侧眼看了他一下。

e.en: The car slid {sidewards} on the icy road.
e.zh: 汽车在结冰的路面上侧滑。

e.en: Move {sidewards} so everyone can fit in the photo.
e.zh: 往旁边挪一挪，这样大家都能进照片。

e.en: The old {sidewheeler} carried passengers along the river.
e.zh: 那艘老式侧轮船沿河运送乘客。

e.en: A painted {sidewheeler} appears on the museum poster.
e.zh: 博物馆海报上画着一艘侧轮汽船。

e.en: A truck tried to {sidewipe} the parked car.
e.zh: 一辆卡车差点侧面擦撞那辆停着的车。

e.en: His speech included a {sidewipe} at the previous manager.
e.zh: 他的讲话顺带挖苦了前任经理。

e.en: Soldiers filled a {siege-basket} with earth for cover.
e.zh: 士兵把围城用柳条防护篮装满泥土作掩护。

e.en: The old manual described how to weave a {siege-basket}.
e.zh: 那本旧手册说明了如何编制攻城防护篮。

e.en: The army rolled a {siege-engine} toward the walls.
e.zh: 军队把一台攻城器械推向城墙。

e.en: A catapult was a common medieval {siege-engine}.
e.zh: 投石机是中世纪常见的攻城器械。

e.en: The {siege-train} arrived days after the infantry.
e.zh: 攻城炮队在步兵之后数日抵达。

e.en: Rain slowed the heavy {siege-train} on muddy roads.
e.zh: 大雨让沉重的攻城装备队在泥路上行进缓慢。

e.en: Engineers built {siege-works} around the fortress.
e.zh: 工程兵在堡垒周围修建围城工事。

e.en: The defenders burned the enemy's {siege-works} at night.
e.zh: 守军夜里烧毁了敌人的攻城工事。

e.en: The monument was carved from pale {sienite}.
e.zh: 这座纪念碑由浅色正长岩雕成。

e.en: Geologists identified {sienite} in the quarry wall.
e.zh: 地质学家在采石场岩壁中识别出正长岩。

e.en: The old romance addressed the knight as {sier}.
e.zh: 那部古老传奇把骑士称作先生。

e.en: In the manuscript, {sier} appears before a nobleman's name.
e.zh: 在手稿中，sier 出现在一位贵族姓名之前。

e.en: Wheat grows poorly in untreated {sierozem}.
e.zh: 未经改良的灰漠土不利于小麦生长。

e.en: The survey mapped {sierozem} across the dry basin.
e.zh: 调查把干旱盆地中的灰漠土分布标了出来。

e.en: The letter called him {sieur} de Montfort.
e.zh: 信中称他为蒙福尔先生。

e.en: In old French records, {sieur} often precedes a landowner's title.
e.zh: 在法国旧档案中，sieur 常放在地主头衔前。

e.en: She planted {sieva} beans beside the fence.
e.zh: 她在篱笆旁种下小粒利马豆。

e.en: The recipe uses dried {sieva} for a creamy stew.
e.zh: 这道食谱用干小粒利马豆做成浓稠炖菜。

sifaka.t: 冕狐猴，一种马达加斯加狐猴

e.en: A {sifaka} leaped sideways across the ground.
e.zh: 一只冕狐猴侧身跳过地面。

e.en: The guide pointed out a sleeping {sifaka}.
e.zh: 向导指出了一只正在睡觉的冕狐猴。

e.en: She can {sight-read} difficult piano music.
e.zh: 她能视奏难度很高的钢琴曲。

e.en: The choir was asked to {sight-read} the new hymn.
e.zh: 合唱团被要求看谱即唱那首新赞美诗。

sight-reader.t: 能视奏的人；看谱即唱者

e.en: He is a confident {sight-reader} on the violin.
e.zh: 他是个很自信的小提琴视奏者。

e.en: A good {sight-reader} saves rehearsal time.
e.zh: 好的视奏者能节省排练时间。

e.en: Her {sight-reading} improved after daily practice.
e.zh: 每天练习后，她的视奏能力提高了。

e.en: The exam includes a short {sight-reading} test.
e.zh: 考试包含一段简短的看谱即唱测试。

e.en: She {sight-reads} new pieces with surprising ease.
e.zh: 她视奏新曲时轻松得令人惊讶。

e.en: The singer {sight-reads} most hymns accurately.
e.zh: 这位歌手能准确地看谱即唱大多数赞美诗。

e.en: We plan to {sight-see} in Paris tomorrow.
e.zh: 我们计划明天在巴黎观光。

e.en: They had only one afternoon to {sight-see}.
e.zh: 他们只有一个下午可以游览名胜。

e.en: We spent the morning {sight-seeing} by bus.
e.zh: 我们上午坐巴士观光。

e.en: The hotel offers several {sight-seeing} tours.
e.zh: 这家酒店提供几条观光线路。

e.en: Every {sight-seer} stopped to photograph the tower.
e.zh: 每位观光客都停下来拍那座塔。

e.en: The museum was crowded with {sight-seers} today.
e.zh: 今天博物馆里挤满了游客。

e.en: Check the oil level through the {sightglass}.
e.zh: 通过观察窗检查油位。

e.en: Steam clouded the boiler's {sightglass}.
e.zh: 蒸汽使锅炉的液位视镜变得模糊。

e.en: He looked through the {sighthole} in the door.
e.zh: 他透过门上的窥视孔往外看。

e.en: The old rifle had a tiny {sighthole}.
e.zh: 那支旧步枪有一个很小的瞄准孔。

e.en: The new fence is {sightlier} than the old wall.
e.zh: 新栅栏比旧墙更好看。

e.en: A coat of paint made the room {sightlier}.
e.zh: 刷上一层漆让房间更悦目。

e.en: That cottage is the {sightliest} house on the lane.
e.zh: 那间小屋是巷子里最好看的房子。

e.en: She chose the {sightliest} flowers for the table.
e.zh: 她挑了最悦目的花放在桌上。

e.en: The garden's {sightliness} attracted many visitors.
e.zh: 花园的悦目景致吸引了许多游客。

e.en: The renovation improved the building's {sightliness}.
e.zh: 翻修提升了这栋建筑的美观程度。

e.en: They installed a {sightproof} screen around the patio.
e.zh: 他们在露台周围装了防窥屏。

e.en: The file was kept in a {sightproof} folder.
e.zh: 那份文件被放在遮住内容的文件夹里。

e.en: Few students can {sightread} this score perfectly.
e.zh: 很少有学生能完美视奏这份乐谱。

e.en: He learned to {sightread} choral music quickly.
e.zh: 他很快学会了看谱即唱合唱曲。

e.en: Regular practice makes {sightreading} less stressful.
e.zh: 经常练习会让视奏不那么紧张。

e.en: Her {sightreading} of the aria impressed the teacher.
e.zh: 她看谱即唱那段咏叹调，给老师留下了深刻印象。

e.en: He {sightreads} jazz charts very well.
e.zh: 他视奏爵士乐谱很出色。

e.en: The choir {sightreads} new music every Friday.
e.zh: 合唱团每周五都会看谱即唱新曲。

e.en: The photographer raised a {sightscreen} to reduce glare.
e.zh: 摄影师升起遮光屏以减少眩光。

e.en: The instrument's {sightscreen} helped align the target.
e.zh: 仪器的瞄准屏帮助对准目标。

e.en: The class practices {sightsinging} every morning.
e.zh: 这个班每天早上练习看谱即唱。

e.en: Her {sightsinging} was accurate despite the odd rhythm.
e.zh: 尽管节奏奇特，她的看谱即唱仍然很准确。

sightworthy.t: 值得一看的；值得观赏的

e.en: The old bridge is still {sightworthy}.
e.zh: 那座老桥仍然值得一看。

e.en: Only a few buildings here are truly {sightworthy}.
e.zh: 这里真正值得观赏的建筑只有几栋。

siderism.t: 铁中毒；铁沉着病；铁疗法

e.en: The old medical text described {siderism} among metalworkers.
e.zh: 那本旧医学书描述了金属工人中的铁沉着病。

e.en: Some physicians once used {siderism} to treat chronic weakness.
e.zh: 一些医生曾用铁疗法治疗慢性虚弱。

e.en: The specimen contained pale brown {siderite} crystals.
e.zh: 这块标本含有浅褐色的菱铁矿晶体。

e.en: A rare {siderite} was displayed with other meteorites.
e.zh: 一块罕见的陨铁石和其他陨石一起展出。

e.en: The smear showed a ringed {sideroblast} under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下的涂片显示出一个环形铁粒幼红细胞。

e.en: A high {sideroblast} count suggested a marrow disorder.
e.zh: 铁粒幼红细胞计数偏高提示骨髓可能有异常。

e.en: The fungus released a {siderochrome} to capture iron.
e.zh: 这种真菌释放铁载体色素来捕获铁。

e.en: Researchers isolated the {siderochrome} from the culture fluid.
e.zh: 研究人员从培养液中分离出了这种含铁色素。

e.en: The technician identified a {siderocyte} in the blood film.
e.zh: 技术员在血涂片中识别出一个含铁红细胞。

e.en: An increased {siderocyte} level can follow splenic damage.
e.zh: 脾脏受损后，含铁红细胞水平可能升高。

e.en: The meteorite sample included traces of {sideroferrite}.
e.zh: 这块陨石样品中含有少量铁镍矿物。

e.en: Mineralogists debated whether the grain was {sideroferrite}.
e.zh: 矿物学家争论那颗颗粒是否为陨铁成分。

e.en: The archive preserves several {siderographic} prints from the period.
e.zh: 档案馆保存了那个时期的几幅铁版印刷品。

e.en: His paper explained the {siderographic} method in detail.
e.zh: 他的论文详细解释了铁版术的方法。

e.en: Early banknotes were sometimes produced by {siderography}.
e.zh: 早期纸币有时采用铁版印刷术制作。

e.en: The museum demonstrated {siderography} with a restored press.
e.zh: 博物馆用一台修复的印刷机演示铁版画法。

e.en: The collector bought a polished slice of {siderolite}.
e.zh: 收藏家买了一片抛光的石铁陨石。

e.en: A {siderolite} contains both metal and silicate minerals.
e.zh: 石铁陨石同时含有金属和硅酸盐矿物。

e.en: His lectures on {siderology} covered ores and smelting.
e.zh: 他的铁学课程涵盖矿石和冶炼。

e.en: Modern {siderology} draws on chemistry and geology.
e.zh: 现代铁矿研究借助化学和地质学。

sideromelane.t: 玄武玻璃；黑色火山玻璃

e.en: The ash layer contained shards of {sideromelane}.
e.zh: 火山灰层中含有玄武玻璃碎片。

e.en: Fresh basaltic eruptions can form {sideromelane} rapidly.
e.zh: 新鲜的玄武质喷发能迅速形成黑色火山玻璃。

e.en: The engineer calibrated the {siderometer} before the survey.
e.zh: 工程师在勘测前校准了磁力计。

e.en: A laboratory {siderometer} measured the iron in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室的铁量测定器测量了样品中的铁含量。

e.en: The new {sideromycin} entered bacteria through iron uptake pathways.
e.zh: 这种新的铁载体抗生素通过铁摄取通道进入细菌。

e.en: Scientists tested the {sideromycin} against resistant infections.
e.zh: 科学家测试这种铁载体抗生素对耐药感染的效果。

sideromycosis.t: 铁尘性肺病；肺铁沉着病

e.en: The miner was diagnosed with {sideromycosis} after years underground.
e.zh: 这名矿工多年井下工作后被诊断为铁尘性肺病。

e.en: Chest imaging helped distinguish {sideromycosis} from other lung disease.
e.zh: 胸部影像帮助区分肺铁沉着病和其他肺部疾病。

e.en: Nickel is a {siderophil} element in planetary chemistry.
e.zh: 在行星化学中，镍是一种亲铁元素。

e.en: The old club jokingly called each railway fan a {siderophil}.
e.zh: 那个老俱乐部开玩笑地把每个铁路迷称为嗜铁者。

e.en: The assay measured {siderophilin} in the patient's serum.
e.zh: 这项检测测量了患者血清中的转铁蛋白。

e.en: Low {siderophilin} levels may affect iron transport.
e.zh: 转铁蛋白水平偏低可能影响铁的运输。

e.en: The composer added a bright {siderophone} to the ensemble.
e.zh: 作曲家在合奏中加入了一件音色明亮的铁琴。

e.en: A simple {siderophone} can be made from tuned metal bars.
e.zh: 简单的金属音响器可以用调好音的金属条制成。

e.en: The geologist labeled the dark sample as {siderophyre}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这块深色样品标为含铁火成岩。

e.en: Veins of {siderophyre} crossed the older volcanic rock.
e.zh: 铁斑岩脉穿过了更古老的火山岩。

e.en: The quarry exposed a band of {siderophyry}.
e.zh: 采石场露出了一条铁斑岩带。

e.en: Collectors prize {siderophyry} for its unusual speckled texture.
e.zh: 收藏者看重铁斑岩不寻常的斑点纹理。

e.en: The conservator used a {sideroscope} to find hidden nails.
e.zh: 文物修复师用铁检器寻找隐藏的钉子。

e.en: A sensitive {sideroscope} can detect tiny magnetic particles.
e.zh: 灵敏的磁性探测器能发现微小的磁性颗粒。

siderosis.t: 铁沉着病；肺铁末沉着症

e.en: Long exposure to iron dust caused pulmonary {siderosis}.
e.zh: 长期接触铁尘导致了肺铁末沉着症。

e.en: The biopsy confirmed {siderosis} in the liver tissue.
e.zh: 活检证实肝组织中存在铁沉着病。

siderostat.t: 定天镜；跟踪太阳的平面镜

e.en: The observatory adjusted the {siderostat} before dawn.
e.zh: 天文台在黎明前调整了定天镜。

e.en: A {siderostat} reflects sunlight steadily into a fixed telescope.
e.zh: 定天镜能把阳光稳定地反射进固定望远镜。

e.en: The stream left a {siderous} stain on the rocks.
e.zh: 溪水在岩石上留下了铁质污痕。

e.en: Workers smelled the {siderous} dust inside the mill.
e.zh: 工人在工厂里闻到含铁粉尘的气味。

e.en: The debate split the committee into two {siders}.
e.zh: 这场辩论把委员会分成了两派站队者。

e.en: The roofing crew hired extra {siders} for the new houses.
e.zh: 屋顶施工队为新房子额外雇了几名外墙板工人。

e.en: She took the {sideseat} beside the driver.
e.zh: 她坐在司机旁边的侧座上。

e.en: The old carriage had a narrow {sideseat} near the door.
e.zh: 那辆旧马车门边有一个狭窄的侧座。

e.en: The red mark was {significative} of danger.
e.zh: 那个红色标记表示有危险。

e.en: Her silence was {significative} in that tense meeting.
e.zh: 在那场紧张的会议上，她的沉默意味深长。

e.en: The gesture was {significatory}, not accidental.
e.zh: 这个手势具有象征意义，并不是偶然的。

e.en: They studied the {significatory} role of ritual objects.
e.zh: 他们研究仪式物品所承载的意义作用。

e.en: She wrote a thesis on {significs} and language.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于意义学和语言的论文。

e.en: Early {significs} influenced some theories of communication.
e.zh: 早期意义学影响了一些传播理论。

e.en: The servant bowed to the {signior} at the door.
e.zh: 仆人在门口向那位先生鞠躬。

e.en: A proud {signior} addressed the council.
e.zh: 一位骄傲的意大利绅士向议会发言。

e.en: The family defended its {signiory} for generations.
e.zh: 这个家族世代维护自己的领主权。

e.en: Taxes supported the old {signiory} in the valley.
e.zh: 税收支撑着山谷中的旧领地统治。

e.en: The {signman} painted new letters on the shop board.
e.zh: 制牌工在店铺招牌上刷上新的字母。

e.en: A railway {signman} warned the crew about the track.
e.zh: 一名铁路信号员提醒乘务组注意轨道情况。

e.en: We need final {signoff} before releasing the update.
e.zh: 发布更新前，我们需要最后批准。

e.en: Her email {signoff} sounded unusually formal.
e.zh: 她邮件里的结束语听起来异常正式。

e.en: Good evening, {signore}, your table is ready.
e.zh: 晚上好，先生，您的桌位已经准备好了。

e.en: The old {signore} owned a small cafe near the square.
e.zh: 那位老先生在广场附近开了一家小咖啡馆。

e.en: The waiter greeted the {signori} with a bow.
e.zh: 侍者鞠躬迎接各位先生。

e.en: Several wealthy {signori} funded the chapel.
e.zh: 几位富有的意大利绅士资助了那座小礼拜堂。

e.en: The palace kept its {signorian} dignity after centuries.
e.zh: 几个世纪之后，这座宫殿仍保有领主般的威严。

e.en: His {signorian} manners amused the younger guests.
e.zh: 他那种贵族式的举止逗乐了年轻客人。

signorine.t: 小姐们；意大利未婚女子

e.en: The {signorine} entered the ballroom together.
e.zh: 几位小姐一起走进舞厅。

e.en: Two young {signorine} waited outside the school.
e.zh: 两位年轻的意大利小姐在学校外等候。

e.en: The maid called the boy {signorino} with affection.
e.zh: 女仆亲切地称那个男孩为小先生。

e.en: A spoiled {signorino} demanded a better horse.
e.zh: 一个被宠坏的年轻少爷要求换一匹更好的马。

e.en: The duke expanded his {signory} through marriage.
e.zh: 公爵通过婚姻扩大了自己的领地。

e.en: Villagers challenged the harsh {signory} in court.
e.zh: 村民们在法庭上挑战严苛的领主权。

e.en: The website made {signup} quick and simple.
e.zh: 这个网站让注册变得又快又简单。

e.en: Early {signup} gives students a lower price.
e.zh: 提前报名可以让学生享受更低价格。

e.en: They restored a historic {siheyuan} in Beijing.
e.zh: 他们修复了北京一座历史悠久的四合院。

e.en: The {siheyuan} had rooms around a quiet courtyard.
e.zh: 这座四合院的房间围着一个安静的院子。

e.en: She translated a Korean {sijo} for the class.
e.zh: 她为课堂翻译了一首韩国时调诗。

e.en: A {sijo} often turns sharply in its final line.
e.zh: 时调诗常在最后一行出现明显转折。

e.en: He studied {Sikhism} at university.
e.zh: 他在大学里研究锡克教。

e.en: {Sikhism} began in the Punjab region.
e.zh: 锡克教起源于旁遮普地区。

e.en: The clerk will {sigillate} the document before filing it.
e.zh: 职员会先给文件盖印再归档。

e.en: They used wax to {sigillate} the royal letter.
e.zh: 他们用蜡封印那封王室信件。

e.en: The archive keeps the {sigillated} charter in a glass case.
e.zh: 档案馆把那份盖有封印的宪章放在玻璃柜里。

e.en: A {sigillated} pattern appears around the edge of the seal.
e.zh: 封印边缘出现了带印纹的图案。

e.en: The {sigillographer} dated the seal to the thirteenth century.
e.zh: 这位印章学家把那枚封印断代为十三世纪。

e.en: A careful {sigillographer} can identify tiny differences in wax impressions.
e.zh: 细心的封印研究者能辨认蜡印中的细微差别。

e.en: She studies {sigillography} to interpret medieval documents.
e.zh: 她研究印章学，以解读中世纪文献。

e.en: The museum offered a lecture on {sigillography} and royal authority.
e.zh: 博物馆举办了一场关于封印研究与王权的讲座。

e.en: The editor explained the {sigla} used in the manuscript notes.
e.zh: 编辑解释了手稿注释中使用的符号标记。

e.en: Different {sigla} identify the surviving copies of the poem.
e.zh: 不同的缩写符号标示这首诗现存的各个抄本。

e.en: The collector bought a {siglos} from an ancient Persian hoard.
e.zh: 收藏家从一批古波斯窖藏中买到一枚古银币。

e.en: A worn {siglos} lay beside the other coins in the display.
e.zh: 一枚磨损的古波斯银币陈列在其他钱币旁边。

e.en: Researchers tested {siglure} in traps across the orchard.
e.zh: 研究人员在果园各处的诱捕器中测试昆虫性引诱剂。

e.en: The farmer used {siglure} to monitor fruit fly activity.
e.zh: 农民使用昆虫性引诱剂来监测果蝇活动。

e.en: The scholar noted a {sigmate} mark in the old inscription.
e.zh: 学者注意到古铭文中有一个西格马形标记。

e.en: A {sigmate} curve decorated the corner of the manuscript page.
e.zh: 手稿页面角落装饰着一条西格马形曲线。

e.en: The therapist treated the child's {sigmatism} with daily exercises.
e.zh: 治疗师通过每日练习矫正孩子的咝音发音缺陷。

e.en: Critics noticed the poet's heavy {sigmatism} in one stanza.
e.zh: 评论者注意到诗人在某一节中过多使用了s音。

e.en: The lab replaced the old {sigmatron} in the detector.
e.zh: 实验室更换了探测器里的旧电子倍增管。

e.en: A faulty {sigmatron} made the readings unstable.
e.zh: 一个有故障的西格马管导致读数不稳定。

e.en: The chemist proposed a {sigmatropic} shift in the reaction pathway.
e.zh: 化学家提出反应路径中发生了σ迁移。

e.en: A {sigmatropic} rearrangement can form a new carbon bond.
e.zh: σ键重排可以形成新的碳键。

e.en: The linguist described the {sigmic} ending in the ancient verb form.
e.zh: 语言学家描述了这个古代动词形式中的s音词尾。

e.en: A {sigmic} symbol was added to the mathematical notation.
e.zh: 数学记号中加入了一个西格马符号。

e.en: The population increased {sigmoidally} after the initial delay.
e.zh: 经过最初的延迟后，种群数量按S形曲线增长。

e.en: The vine bent {sigmoidally} around the old railing.
e.zh: 藤蔓呈S形绕过旧栏杆。

e.en: The surgeon recommended a {sigmoidectomy} after repeated infections.
e.zh: 反复感染后，外科医生建议进行乙状结肠切除术。

e.en: Recovery from a {sigmoidectomy} may take several weeks.
e.zh: 乙状结肠切除术后的恢复可能需要数周。

e.en: The scan suggested {sigmoiditis} rather than a simple stomach upset.
e.zh: 扫描结果提示是乙状结肠炎，而不是普通胃部不适。

e.en: Doctors treated her {sigmoiditis} with antibiotics and rest.
e.zh: 医生用抗生素和休息来治疗她的乙状结肠炎。

e.en: The doctor inserted a {sigmoidoscope} to examine the lower colon.
e.zh: 医生插入乙状结肠镜检查下段结肠。

e.en: A flexible {sigmoidoscope} made the procedure less uncomfortable.
e.zh: 柔性乙状结肠镜让检查过程没那么不适。

e.en: The patient needed a {sigmoidostomy} after the bowel injury.
e.zh: 肠道受伤后，患者需要进行乙状结肠造口术。

e.en: Nurses taught him how to care for the {sigmoidostomy}.
e.zh: 护士教他如何护理乙状结肠造口。

e.en: She learned {sign-language} to talk with her deaf cousin.
e.zh: 她学习手语，以便和失聪的表亲交流。

e.en: The speech was translated into {sign-language} on television.
e.zh: 电视上把这场演讲翻译成了手语。

e.en: We need the manager's {sign-off} before publishing the report.
e.zh: 发布报告前，我们需要经理批准。

e.en: Her email {sign-off} was friendly but brief.
e.zh: 她邮件末尾的结束语友好但简短。

e.en: Use your employee number at {sign-on}.
e.zh: 登录时使用你的员工编号。

e.en: The studio offered him a generous {sign-on} bonus.
e.zh: 工作室给了他一笔丰厚的签约奖金。

e.en: Please {sign-out} before leaving the shared computer.
e.zh: 离开共用电脑前请退出登录。

e.en: Visitors must {sign-out} at the front desk.
e.zh: 访客必须在前台签退。

e.en: The old {sign-post} pointed toward the village.
e.zh: 那块旧路标指向村庄。

e.en: Good headings {sign-post} the argument for readers.
e.zh: 好的标题能为读者明确指出论证脉络。

e.en: The village used a {sign-system} for road warnings.
e.zh: 这个村庄用一套符号系统来发出道路警示。

e.en: Researchers compared the local {sign-system} with formal sign language.
e.zh: 研究人员把当地的手势体系与正式手语作了比较。

e.en: Online {sign-up} closes on Friday.
e.zh: 网上报名将在星期五截止。

e.en: The app offers a quick {sign-up} process.
e.zh: 这个应用提供快速注册流程。

e.en: The shop hired a {sign-writer} for its new window.
e.zh: 这家店请了一名招牌书写员来装饰新橱窗。

e.en: A skilled {sign-writer} can make plain words look elegant.
e.zh: 熟练的写招牌者能把普通文字写得很雅致。

e.en: The contract is {signable} after legal review.
e.zh: 合同经过法律审查后就可以签署。

e.en: The word is not easily {signable} in that language.
e.zh: 这个词在那种手语里不太容易表达。

e.en: The receiver detected a weak {signal-wave} from the satellite.
e.zh: 接收器检测到来自卫星的微弱信号波。

e.en: Engineers analyzed the {signal-wave} on the screen.
e.zh: 工程师分析了屏幕上的讯号波形。

e.en: The lights {signalise} the entrance to the tunnel.
e.zh: 这些灯标明了隧道入口的位置。

e.en: Writers sometimes {signalise} irony with exaggerated praise.
e.zh: 作家有时用夸张的赞美来表示讽刺。

e.en: The discovery had unusual {signality} for the debate.
e.zh: 这一发现对这场争论具有不同寻常的显著性。

e.en: Critics discussed the {signality} of color in the film.
e.zh: 评论家讨论了这部电影中色彩的符号性。

e.en: The ceremony will {signalize} the start of peace talks.
e.zh: 这场仪式将标志和平谈判的开始。

e.en: Bright flags {signalize} the dangerous bend ahead.
e.zh: 鲜艳的旗帜标示出前方危险的弯道。

e.en: The intersection was {signalized} after several accidents.
e.zh: 几起事故之后，这个路口设置了信号灯。

e.en: Her speech {signalized} a change in policy.
e.zh: 她的讲话标志着政策发生了变化。

e.en: The bell {signalizes} the end of class.
e.zh: 铃声标志着下课。

e.en: A red icon {signalizes} a serious system error.
e.zh: 红色图标表示严重的系统错误。

e.en: The flag is {signalizing} that swimmers should leave the water.
e.zh: 这面旗正在示意游泳者离开水面。

e.en: The vote was {signalizing} a broader political shift.
e.zh: 这次投票正标志着更广泛的政治转变。

e.en: The police recorded the suspect's {signalment} carefully.
e.zh: 警方仔细记录了嫌疑人的相貌描述。

e.en: Age and height formed part of the horse's {signalment}.
e.zh: 年龄和身高构成了这匹马的识别特征。

e.en: In semiotics, the {signans} differs from the concept it evokes.
e.zh: 在符号学中，能指不同于它所唤起的概念。

e.en: The sound became the {signans} of a hidden fear.
e.zh: 这种声音成了隐藏恐惧的表示成分。

e.en: The manuscript included a {signary} of unfamiliar marks.
e.zh: 手稿中附有一份陌生符号表。

e.en: Each culture may develop its own {signary}.
e.zh: 每种文化都可能发展出自己的符号体系。

e.en: Each {signatary} agreed to the new treaty.
e.zh: 每个签署方都同意了这项新条约。

e.en: The letter named her as a {signatary}.
e.zh: 信中把她列为签约者。

e.en: The map showed the {signate} boundary of the estate.
e.zh: 地图显示了这处地产明确标出的边界。

e.en: Only the {signate} members could enter the chamber.
e.zh: 只有指定成员才能进入会议厅。

e.en: A {signatureless} note was left on the desk.
e.zh: 桌上留着一张未署名的便条。

e.en: The lawyer rejected the {signatureless} contract.
e.zh: 律师拒收了这份没有签名的合同。

e.en: Each {signee} must provide proof of identity.
e.zh: 每位签署人都必须提供身份证明。

e.en: The company welcomed its newest {signee} to the team.
e.zh: 公司欢迎最新签约对象加入团队。

e.en: Not every feeling is easily {signifiable} in words.
e.zh: 并非每种感受都容易用语言表示。

e.en: The gesture became {signifiable} only within that ritual.
e.zh: 这个手势只有在那种仪式中才具有意义。

e.en: The {signifiant} is the sound or image of the sign.
e.zh: 能指是符号的声音或形象。

e.en: Poets often play with the {signifiant} more than the message.
e.zh: 诗人常常更多地玩味有意义的形式，而不只是信息本身。

e.en: The judge questioned the {significancy} of that evidence.
e.zh: 法官质疑那项证据的重要性。

e.en: Its cultural {significancy} grew over time.
e.zh: 它的文化意义随着时间逐渐增加。

e.en: The {significans} points toward a separate meaning.
e.zh: 能指指向另一个独立的意义。

e.en: Scholars debated whether the image was a true {significans}.
e.zh: 学者们争论这幅图像是否是真正的表示者。

e.en: The coating releases {silane} during curing.
e.zh: 这种涂层在固化过程中会释放硅烷。

e.en: Chemists handled the {silane} under dry nitrogen.
e.zh: 化学人员在干燥氮气中处理硅烷。

e.en: The glass surface needed {silanization} before bonding.
e.zh: 玻璃表面在粘接前需要进行硅烷化处理。

e.en: Poor {silanization} reduced the sensor's stability.
e.zh: 硅烷化处理不佳降低了传感器的稳定性。

e.en: They {silanize} the particles to improve adhesion.
e.zh: 他们对颗粒作硅烷处理以提高附着力。

e.en: The technician {silanized} the slides overnight.
e.zh: 技术员把载玻片硅烷化处理了一整夜。

e.en: The archaeologists found tools made from {silcrete}.
e.zh: 考古学家发现了用硅质硬壳岩制成的工具。

e.en: A hard layer of {silcrete} capped the old soil.
e.zh: 一层坚硬的硅质硬壳岩覆盖在古土壤上。

e.en: The café served {sild} with rye bread.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应小鲱鱼配黑麦面包。

e.en: Pickled {sild} is common in northern markets.
e.zh: 腌小鲱鱼在北方市场很常见。

e.en: The doctor discussed {sildenafil} with the patient.
e.zh: 医生和病人讨论了西地那非的用法。

e.en: Some medicines interact dangerously with {sildenafil}.
e.zh: 有些药物会与西地那非发生危险相互作用。

e.en: They let the cider {sile} through cloth.
e.zh: 他们让苹果酒透过布慢慢滤出。

e.en: Rainwater began to {sile} into the cellar.
e.zh: 雨水开始渗进地窖。

e.en: The paper measured {silenosterone} in plant extracts.
e.zh: 论文测定了植物提取物中的蝉蜕甾酮。

e.en: Researchers compared {silenosterone} with related steroids.
e.zh: 研究人员把蝉蜕甾酮与相关甾体作了比较。

e.en: A {silentiary} guarded the emperor's private chamber.
e.zh: 一名肃静官守卫着皇帝的私人寝室。

e.en: In the novel, the old {silentiary} rarely speaks.
e.zh: 在小说中，那位沉默寡言的老人很少开口。

e.en: The {silentious} hall made every footstep sound loud.
e.zh: 寂静的大厅让每一步脚步声都显得很响。

e.en: He remained {silentious} during the accusation.
e.zh: 面对指控时，他一直保持沉默。

e.en: Ancient knives were often made of {silex}.
e.zh: 古代刀具常由燧石制成。

e.en: The furnace lining contained powdered {silex}.
e.zh: 炉衬中含有粉末状硅石。

e.en: The geologist identified the sample as {silexite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这个样本鉴定为硅石岩。

e.en: Layers of {silexite} appeared beneath the clay.
e.zh: 黏土下面出现了层状硅石岩。

e.en: A {silhouettist} cut portraits at the fair.
e.zh: 一位剪影画家在集市上剪人物肖像。

e.en: The museum displayed work by a Victorian {silhouettist}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一位维多利亚时代剪影画家的作品。

e.en: The lab synthesized a new {silicane} derivative.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一种新的硅烷类衍生物。

e.en: This {silicane} reacts quickly with moisture.
e.zh: 这种硅烷类化合物会迅速与水分反应。

e.en: The ore shows strong {silicatization} along the vein.
e.zh: 矿石沿矿脉显示出强烈的硅酸盐化作用。

e.en: Heat accelerated {silicatization} in the altered rock.
e.zh: 高温加快了蚀变岩中的硅酸盐化作用。

e.en: Granite is rich in {silicic} minerals.
e.zh: 花岗岩富含含硅矿物。

e.en: The solution contained weak {silicic} acid.
e.zh: 该溶液含有弱硅酸。

e.en: The botanist recorded several {silicicolous} lichens.
e.zh: 植物学家记录了几种生长于硅质土的地衣。

e.en: These {silicicolous} plants avoid limestone slopes.
e.zh: 这些硅质土生植物避开石灰岩坡地。

e.en: The chip uses a thin {silicide} contact layer.
e.zh: 这块芯片使用一层很薄的硅化物接触层。

e.en: Iron {silicide} can form at high temperatures.
e.zh: 硅化铁可在高温下形成。

e.en: Engineers {silicidize} the surface to lower resistance.
e.zh: 工程师使表面形成硅化物以降低电阻。

e.en: The wafer was {silicidized} after metal deposition.
e.zh: 晶圆在金属沉积后被硅化处理。

e.en: The wood underwent {silification} over millions of years.
e.zh: 这块木头在数百万年里经历了硅化。

e.en: Geologists studied the {silification} of the ancient fossils.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了这些古老化石的硅化过程。

e.en: The botanist opened a dry {siliqua} from the plant.
e.zh: 植物学家剖开了这株植物的干长角果。

e.en: A {siliqua} was a small coin in late Roman currency.
e.zh: 在晚期罗马货币中，siliqua是一种小币。

e.en: Several {siliquae} hung from the mustard plant.
e.zh: 芥菜植株上挂着几个长角果。

e.en: The museum displayed silver {siliquae} from the empire.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了帝国时期的银质小币。

e.en: The specimen had a narrow {siliquaeform} fruit.
e.zh: 这个标本有一个狭长的长角果状果实。

e.en: Her notes described the pod as {siliquaeform}.
e.zh: 她的笔记把这个荚果描述为长角果状。

e.en: A {silique} splits open when its seeds are ripe.
e.zh: 长角果在种子成熟时会裂开。

e.en: The teacher showed us a {silique} from a cabbage relative.
e.zh: 老师给我们看了一种甘蓝近缘植物的长角果。

e.en: The old circuit used a {silistor} for switching.
e.zh: 这块旧电路用硅可控开关元件来进行开关控制。

e.en: He replaced the damaged {silistor} in the power unit.
e.zh: 他更换了电源装置里损坏的硅可控开关元件。

e.en: They used {silk-screen} printing for the posters.
e.zh: 他们用丝网印刷来制作海报。

e.en: The artist cleaned the {silk-screen} after each color.
e.zh: 艺术家每印完一种颜色后都会清洗丝印网版。

e.en: He mocked the town's {silk-stocking} reformers.
e.zh: 他嘲笑镇上那些富贵阶层出身的改革者。

e.en: She found one torn {silk-stocking} in the drawer.
e.zh: 她在抽屉里找到一只破了的丝长袜。

e.en: The label recommended {silkaline} for the embroidery.
e.zh: 标签建议刺绣时使用丝光棉线。

e.en: She chose blue {silkaline} to mend the trim.
e.zh: 她选了蓝色仿丝线来缝补饰边。

e.en: The basket was woven from dried {silkgrass}.
e.zh: 这个篮子是用晒干的丝草编成的。

e.en: Local people gathered {silkgrass} for making cord.
e.zh: 当地人采集丝草来制作绳索。

e.en: The {silkgrower} checked the mulberry leaves daily.
e.zh: 养蚕者每天检查桑叶的情况。

e.en: A successful {silkgrower} depends on healthy worms.
e.zh: 成功的蚕丝生产者离不开健康的蚕。

e.en: The lotion adds {silkiness} without feeling greasy.
e.zh: 这款乳液能增加柔滑感，又不会觉得油腻。

e.en: Judges praised the {silkiness} of the sauce.
e.zh: 评委称赞这款酱汁的丝滑质地。

e.en: The petals had a {silklike} texture.
e.zh: 花瓣有一种像丝一样的质感。

e.en: A {silklike} thread covered the seed pod.
e.zh: 种荚上覆盖着一层柔滑的丝状物。

e.en: The {silkman} sold bright cloth in the market.
e.zh: 这位丝绸商在市场上出售鲜亮的布料。

e.en: A skilled {silkman} inspected every woven panel.
e.zh: 熟练的丝织工检查每一块织好的布面。

silkmen.t: 丝绸商复数；丝织工复数

e.en: The {silkmen} met buyers at the fair.
e.zh: 这些丝绸商在集市上会见买主。

e.en: Experienced {silkmen} could spot flaws quickly.
e.zh: 有经验的丝织工能很快发现瑕疵。

e.en: The quilt backing was made of {silkoline}.
e.zh: 这床被子的背衬是用仿丝棉布做的。

e.en: She bought patterned {silkoline} for the curtains.
e.zh: 她买了带图案的丝光棉布来做窗帘。

e.en: We will {silkscreen} the logo onto each shirt.
e.zh: 我们会把标志丝网印刷到每件衬衫上。

e.en: Her first {silkscreen} sold at the gallery.
e.zh: 她的第一幅丝印作品在画廊售出。

e.en: The paper criticized the {silkstocking} district.
e.zh: 报纸批评了那个富人区。

e.en: A single {silkstocking} lay beside the bed.
e.zh: 床边放着一只丝长袜。

e.en: Butterflies gathered around the {silkweed} in bloom.
e.zh: 蝴蝶聚集在开花的丝草周围。

e.en: The healer dried {silkweed} for a traditional remedy.
e.zh: 这位民间医者把丝草晒干，用作传统药方。

e.en: The cabinet was carved from pale {silkwood}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用浅色丝木雕成的。

e.en: Fibers from {silkwood} were used for cordage.
e.zh: 丝木的纤维曾被用来制作绳索。

e.en: The fossil shows clear {silicification} of the original wood.
e.zh: 这块化石显示原木发生了明显的硅化作用。

e.en: Slow {silicification} helped preserve the shell's fine details.
e.zh: 缓慢的硅化过程帮助保存了贝壳的细微结构。

e.en: The museum displayed a {silicified} tree trunk from the desert.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一段来自沙漠的硅化树干。

e.en: Some {silicified} tissues can survive for millions of years.
e.zh: 有些硅化组织可以保存数百万年。

e.en: Mineral-rich water can {silicify} buried wood over time.
e.zh: 富含矿物质的水久而久之会使埋藏木材硅化。

e.en: Under these conditions, the plant remains may {silicify}.
e.zh: 在这些条件下，植物遗骸可能会变成硅质。

e.en: The {silicifying} solution slowly entered the porous rock.
e.zh: 这种使其硅化的溶液慢慢渗入多孔岩石。

e.en: Scientists studied the {silicifying} tissues under a microscope.
e.zh: 科学家在显微镜下研究正在硅化的组织。

e.en: The sponge has tiny {silicious} needles in its body.
e.zh: 这种海绵体内有细小的硅质针状结构。

e.en: Farmers found the soil was unusually {silicious}.
e.zh: 农民发现这片土壤含硅量异常高。

e.en: Older chemistry books sometimes call silicon {silicium}.
e.zh: 较早的化学书有时把硅称为silicium。

e.en: The symbol for {silicium} remains Si in several languages.
e.zh: 在多种语言中，硅元素的符号仍是Si。

e.en: Engineers tried to {silicize} the surface for better heat resistance.
e.zh: 工程师试图对表面进行硅化处理以提高耐热性。

e.en: Groundwater can {silicize} organic remains deep underground.
e.zh: 地下水可以使深埋地下的有机遗骸硅化。

e.en: The botanist measured each {silicle} after the flowers faded.
e.zh: 花谢后，植物学家测量了每个短角果。

e.en: A ripe {silicle} split open and released several seeds.
e.zh: 成熟的短角果裂开，释放出几粒种子。

silicoblast.t: 成硅细胞；硅质形成细胞

e.en: A {silicoblast} helps form the glassy skeleton of some sponges.
e.zh: 成硅细胞有助于形成某些海绵的玻璃状骨架。

e.en: The researcher identified a damaged {silicoblast} in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员在样本中发现了一个受损的成硅细胞。

e.en: The lab stored {silicochloroform} under dry nitrogen.
e.zh: 实验室把三氯硅烷保存在干燥氮气中。

e.en: Moist air can make {silicochloroform} react violently.
e.zh: 潮湿空气可能使硅氯仿发生剧烈反应。

e.en: The foundry added {silicochromium} to adjust the alloy.
e.zh: 铸造厂加入硅铬合金来调整合金成分。

e.en: High-carbon {silicochromium} is used in some steelmaking processes.
e.zh: 高碳硅铬铁用于某些炼钢工艺。

e.en: The cement sample contained a small amount of {silicoferrite}.
e.zh: 水泥样品中含有少量硅铁酸盐。

e.en: Researchers examined {silicoferrite} phases in the clinker.
e.zh: 研究人员检查了熟料中的硅铁酸盐相。

e.en: The water report listed traces of {silicofluoride}.
e.zh: 水质报告列出了微量氟硅酸盐。

e.en: Some factories once used {silicofluoride} compounds in treatment systems.
e.zh: 一些工厂过去曾在处理系统中使用硅氟化物。

e.en: The technician applied {silicoil} to reduce friction in the joint.
e.zh: 技术员涂上硅油以减少接头处的摩擦。

e.en: A thin layer of {silicoil} protected the instrument from moisture.
e.zh: 一层薄薄的硅油保护了仪器免受潮气影响。

e.en: The chemist detected {silicol} groups on the surface.
e.zh: 化学家在表面检测到硅醇基团。

e.en: This reaction can produce a small amount of {silicol}.
e.zh: 这种反应可能生成少量硅醇类物质。

e.en: The steel plant imported {silicomanganese} for deoxidation.
e.zh: 钢厂进口硅锰合金用于脱氧。

e.en: Prices for {silicomanganese} rose after the supply shortage.
e.zh: 供应短缺后，硅锰铁价格上涨。

e.en: The paper described a reactive {silicomethane} compound.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种活泼的硅甲烷化合物。

e.en: They handled {silicomethane} only inside a sealed apparatus.
e.zh: 他们只在密封装置内处理硅甲烷。

e.en: The part was cast from a {silicon-aluminium} alloy.
e.zh: 这个零件由硅铝合金铸成。

e.en: A {silicon-aluminium} coating improved the panel's durability.
e.zh: 硅铝涂层提高了面板的耐用性。

e.en: The chip used a {silicon-on-sapphire} design for radiation resistance.
e.zh: 这款芯片采用蓝宝石上硅设计以增强抗辐射能力。

e.en: Early {silicon-on-sapphire} devices were expensive to manufacture.
e.zh: 早期的蓝宝石上硅器件制造成本很高。

siliconite.t: 碳化硅材料；硅石质材料

e.en: The furnace element was made of {siliconite}.
e.zh: 炉子的加热元件由碳化硅材料制成。

e.en: Old catalogs sold {siliconite} parts for high-temperature equipment.
e.zh: 旧目录出售用于高温设备的硅石质部件。

e.en: The {siliconized} paper released the adhesive cleanly.
e.zh: 这种涂硅纸能干净地剥离胶层。

e.en: A {siliconized} surface resists heat and chemical attack.
e.zh: 硅化处理的表面能耐热并抗化学腐蚀。

e.en: The plant used a {silicothermic} process to produce magnesium.
e.zh: 这家工厂采用硅热法生产镁。

e.en: A {silicothermic} reaction can reach very high temperatures.
e.zh: 硅热还原反应可能达到很高温度。

e.en: Each {silicula} held only a few tiny seeds.
e.zh: 每个短角果里只有几粒细小种子。

e.en: The dried {silicula} helped identify the mustard relative.
e.zh: 干燥的短角果帮助鉴定了这种芥科近缘植物。

e.en: The plant's {silicular} fruit distinguished it from nearby species.
e.zh: 这种植物的短角果状果实使它区别于附近物种。

e.en: She noted the {silicular} shape in her field notebook.
e.zh: 她在野外笔记中记录了这种小荚果状形态。

e.en: A round {silicule} formed after the white flowers dropped.
e.zh: 白花凋谢后形成了一个圆形短角果。

e.en: The key asks whether the pod is a {silicule} or a silique.
e.zh: 检索表会询问这个果荚是短角果还是长角果。

silundum.t: 碳化硅耐火材料；硅碳棒材料

e.en: The furnace used {silundum} elements for steady high heat.
e.zh: 这座炉子使用碳化硅元件来保持稳定高温。

e.en: Old technical manuals often mention {silundum} in kiln construction.
e.zh: 旧技术手册常在窑炉建造中提到硅碳材料。

e.en: The biologist identified the fish as a {silurid}.
e.zh: 那位生物学家把这条鱼鉴定为鲶鱼科鱼类。

e.en: Several {silurid} species live in muddy rivers.
e.zh: 几种鲶鱼科鱼类生活在浑浊的河流里。

e.en: The museum displayed a large {siluroid} skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一具大型鲶形鱼骨骼。

e.en: Its whisker-like barbels gave it a {siluroid} appearance.
e.zh: 它须状的触须让它看起来像鲶鱼。

e.en: They followed a narrow {silvan} path through the oaks.
e.zh: 他们沿着一条狭窄的林间小路穿过橡树林。

e.en: The poem praises the quiet {silvan} life.
e.zh: 这首诗赞美宁静的森林生活。

e.en: The abbey kept a {silver-gilt} chalice in its treasury.
e.zh: 修道院在宝库里保存着一只鎏金银圣杯。

e.en: She admired the {silver-gilt} frame around the icon.
e.zh: 她欣赏那幅圣像周围的镀金银框。

e.en: A {silver-gray} mist covered the lake at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时一层银灰色薄雾笼罩着湖面。

e.en: He chose a {silver-gray} suit for the ceremony.
e.zh: 他为典礼选了一套银灰色西装。

e.en: Her {silver-grey} hair was tied neatly back.
e.zh: 她的银灰色头发整齐地束在脑后。

e.en: The sky turned {silver-grey} before the rain began.
e.zh: 下雨前，天空变成了银灰色。

e.en: A {silver-haired} woman greeted us at the door.
e.zh: 一位银发女士在门口迎接了我们。

e.en: The film follows a {silver-haired} detective near retirement.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述一位临近退休的白发侦探。

e.en: The workshop can {silver-plate} old brass fittings.
e.zh: 这家工坊可以给旧黄铜配件镀银。

e.en: Most of the cutlery was {silver-plate}, not solid silver.
e.zh: 大多数餐具是镀银的，不是纯银的。

e.en: She wore a {silver-plated} bracelet to the party.
e.zh: 她戴着一只镀银手镯去参加派对。

e.en: The contacts are {silver-plated} to improve conductivity.
e.zh: 这些触点镀了银，以提高导电性。

e.en: The factory {silver-plates} small parts for electronics.
e.zh: 这家工厂给电子设备的小零件镀银。

e.en: The cabinet held several antique {silver-plates}.
e.zh: 柜子里放着几只古董镀银盘。

e.en: The {silver-plating} began to wear off the handle.
e.zh: 手柄上的镀银层开始磨损。

e.en: They use {silver-plating} to protect delicate connectors.
e.zh: 他们用镀银工艺来保护精密连接器。

e.en: He was born with a {silver-spoon} advantage.
e.zh: 他一出生就拥有富贵家庭带来的优势。

e.en: The baby chewed on a tiny {silver-spoon}.
e.zh: 婴儿咬着一把小小的银勺。

e.en: The {silver-tongued} lawyer persuaded the jury.
e.zh: 那位能言善辩的律师说服了陪审团。

e.en: Beware of {silver-tongued} sellers promising easy profits.
e.zh: 要提防那些口才很好、承诺轻松赚钱的推销员。

e.en: They polished the {silver-ware} before dinner.
e.zh: 他们在晚餐前擦亮了银餐具。

e.en: The museum displayed Victorian {silver-ware} behind glass.
e.zh: 博物馆把维多利亚时代的银器陈列在玻璃后面。

e.en: The {silverbeater} hammered the metal into thin leaves.
e.zh: 银箔匠把金属锤成薄薄的叶片。

e.en: A skilled {silverbeater} could produce remarkably even foil.
e.zh: 熟练的打银箔工能做出非常均匀的箔片。

e.en: The {silverberry} bush had pale leaves and red fruit.
e.zh: 那丛银莓灌木长着浅色叶子和红色果实。

e.en: Birds gathered around the ripe {silverberry} in autumn.
e.zh: 秋天，鸟儿聚在成熟的银莓果旁。

e.en: The {silverhaired} professor spoke with quiet authority.
e.zh: 那位银发教授说话沉稳而有威信。

e.en: A {silverhaired} man sat reading by the window.
e.zh: 一位白发男子坐在窗边读书。

e.en: The moonlight gave the water a strange {silveriness}.
e.zh: 月光让水面泛出一种奇异的银色光泽。

e.en: She liked the soft {silveriness} of the old photograph.
e.zh: 她喜欢那张老照片柔和的银白感。

e.en: The fish had a {silverish} stripe along its side.
e.zh: 这条鱼身体侧面有一道带银色的条纹。

e.en: Her dress looked {silverish} under the stage lights.
e.zh: 在舞台灯光下，她的裙子显得有些银色。

e.en: The process can {silverize} the surface of glass.
e.zh: 这种工艺能使玻璃表面变成银色。

e.en: They decided to {silverize} the mirror backing again.
e.zh: 他们决定重新给镜子的背面镀银。

e.en: The {silverized} glass reflected the room clearly.
e.zh: 镀银后的玻璃清楚地映出了房间。

e.en: Clouds turned {silverized} as the sun went down.
e.zh: 太阳落山时，云朵变得银光闪闪。

e.en: The lab tested a new {silverizing} solution for mirrors.
e.zh: 实验室测试了一种新的镜面镀银溶液。

e.en: Age was slowly {silverizing} his dark hair.
e.zh: 岁月正慢慢把他的黑发染成银白色。

silviculturist.t: 造林学家；森林培育专家

e.en: The {silviculturist} advised thinning the young pines.
e.zh: 这位森林培育专家建议疏伐幼松。

e.en: A {silviculturist} studies how forests regenerate after fire.
e.zh: 造林学家研究火灾后森林如何再生。

e.en: The chemist will {silylanize} the surface before analysis.
e.zh: 化学家会在分析前对表面进行硅烷化处理。

e.en: Researchers {silylanized} the compound to improve its stability.
e.zh: 研究人员将该化合物硅烷化以提高稳定性。

e.en: {Silylation} made the sample easier to detect.
e.zh: 硅烷化使样品更容易被检测到。

e.en: The paper describes a mild {silylation} method.
e.zh: 论文介绍了一种温和的硅基化方法。

e.en: Geologists once used {sima} for the oceanic crust.
e.zh: 地质学家曾用硅镁层指称大洋地壳。

e.en: The term {sima} contrasts with sial in older geology.
e.zh: 在旧地质学中，sima一词与硅铝层相对。

e.en: The healer prepared {simaruba} as a bitter tonic.
e.zh: 医者把苦木制成一种苦味补药。

e.en: {Simaruba} bark was once used in traditional medicine.
e.zh: 苦木树皮曾被用于传统医学。

e.en: The farm stopped using {simazin} near the stream.
e.zh: 农场停止在溪流附近使用西玛津。

e.en: Residues of {simazin} were found in the soil sample.
e.zh: 土壤样本中发现了西玛津残留。

e.en: {Simazine} can control weeds in orchards.
e.zh: 西玛津可用于果园除草。

e.en: The report measured {simazine} levels in groundwater.
e.zh: 报告测量了地下水中的西玛津含量。

e.en: The laboratory tested water for {simetone}.
e.zh: 实验室检测水中是否含有西美通。

e.en: {Simetone} belongs to the triazine herbicides.
e.zh: 西美通属于三嗪类除草剂。

e.en: The study compared {simfibrate} with older lipid drugs.
e.zh: 这项研究将辛贝特与较早的降脂药作比较。

e.en: Doctors rarely prescribe {simfibrate} today.
e.zh: 如今医生很少开辛贝特这种药。

e.en: The stones formed a rough {simicircle} around the fire.
e.zh: 石头在火堆周围围成一个粗略的半圆。

e.en: She drew a {simicircle} above the doorway.
e.zh: 她在门口上方画了一个半圆形。

e.en: The botanist grouped the {similiflorous} plants together.
e.zh: 植物学家把花形相似的植物归在一起。

e.en: These {similiflorous} species can be hard to identify.
e.zh: 这些花形相似的物种可能很难辨认。

e.en: The poet tried to {similize} grief with winter rain.
e.zh: 诗人试图把悲伤比作冬雨。

e.en: Writers sometimes {similize} memory to a fading photograph.
e.zh: 作家有时把记忆比拟成褪色的照片。

e.en: The mask had a strangely {simious} grin.
e.zh: 那副面具露出一种奇怪的猿猴般笑容。

e.en: He noticed the statue's {simious} posture.
e.zh: 他注意到雕像那种像猴子的姿态。

e.en: The old warrior carried a curved {simitar}.
e.zh: 那位老战士佩着一把弯刀。

e.en: A jeweled {simitar} hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 一把镶宝石的弯刀挂在壁炉上方。

e.en: They served {simnel} cake at Easter.
e.zh: 他们在复活节供应西姆内尔水果蛋糕。

e.en: The bakery decorated the {simnel} with marzipan balls.
e.zh: 面包店用杏仁糖球装饰这款西姆内尔蛋糕。

e.en: He paid twenty {simoleons} for the old radio.
e.zh: 他花了二十美元买下那台旧收音机。

e.en: I need a few more {simoleons} before payday.
e.zh: 发工资前我还需要再弄点钱。

e.en: She claimed to be a {simon-pure} reformer.
e.zh: 她自称是一个真正纯粹的改革者。

e.en: His {simon-pure} honesty impressed even his critics.
e.zh: 他纯正无伪的诚实连批评者也印象深刻。

simoniac.t: 买卖圣职者；圣职买卖的

e.en: The bishop denounced the {simoniac} before the council.
e.zh: 主教在会议前谴责了那个买卖圣职的人。

e.en: A {simoniac} bargain tainted the appointment.
e.zh: 一桩买卖圣职的交易玷污了这次任命。

e.en: The reformers attacked {simoniacal} practices in the church.
e.zh: 改革者抨击教会中的买卖圣职行为。

e.en: His {simoniacal} deal made the office suspect.
e.zh: 他的买卖圣职交易让这个职位受到质疑。

e.en: The post was obtained {simoniacally}, according to his enemies.
e.zh: 按他的敌人说法，这个职位是通过买卖圣职取得的。

e.en: They accused him of acting {simoniacally} during the election.
e.zh: 他们指控他在选举期间以买卖圣职的方式行事。

e.en: The monk called the wealthy priest a {simonist}.
e.zh: 那位修士称这个富有的神父为买卖圣职者。

e.en: No {simonist} could hold office under the new rule.
e.zh: 按照新规定，任何买卖圣职者都不能任职。

e.en: A fierce {simoom} swept across the dunes.
e.zh: 一阵猛烈的沙漠热风掠过沙丘。

e.en: Travelers feared the choking {simoom} more than hunger.
e.zh: 旅人害怕令人窒息的沙漠热风，甚于饥饿。

e.en: The caravan stopped when the {simoon} darkened the sky.
e.zh: 沙漠热风吹得天空昏暗时，商队停了下来。

e.en: He described the {simoon} as a wall of burning dust.
e.zh: 他把西蒙风形容成一堵灼热的尘墙。

e.en: Online commenters mocked him as a {simp}.
e.zh: 网上评论者嘲笑他是个过分讨好心仪对象的人。

e.en: Do not {simp} for someone who ignores you.
e.zh: 别为一个不理你的人低声下气地讨好。

e.en: She found her new colleagues surprisingly {simpatico}.
e.zh: 她发现新同事意外地合得来。

e.en: The director wanted a {simpatico} actor for the role.
e.zh: 导演想找一位讨人喜欢的演员来演这个角色。

e.en: That is a {simple-minded} answer to a hard problem.
e.zh: 对这个难题来说，那是个头脑简单的回答。

e.en: Her {simple-minded} trust made people protective of her.
e.zh: 她天真的信任让人们想保护她。

e.en: The {simplehearted} farmer welcomed every stranger.
e.zh: 那位淳朴的农夫欢迎每一个陌生人。

e.en: His {simplehearted} kindness softened the argument.
e.zh: 他单纯善良的好意缓和了争执。

e.en: The proposal seemed {simpleminded} to experienced lawyers.
e.zh: 在经验丰富的律师看来，这个提议显得头脑简单。

e.en: He gave her a {simpleminded} smile of trust.
e.zh: 他带着天真的信任向她笑了笑。

e.en: He {simplemindedly} believed every rumor he heard.
e.zh: 他头脑简单地相信自己听到的每个谣言。

e.en: She {simplemindedly} expected honesty from everyone.
e.zh: 她天真地期待每个人都诚实。

e.en: His {simplemindedness} made the scheme look easy.
e.zh: 他的头脑简单让这个计划看起来很容易。

e.en: There was a touching {simplemindedness} in her faith.
e.zh: 她的信念里有一种令人动容的天真。

e.en: The proof uses two adjoining {simplices}.
e.zh: 这个证明用到了两个相邻的单纯形。

e.en: Higher-dimensional {simplices} are hard to draw.
e.zh: 高维单纯形很难画出来。

e.en: The theorem concerns a {simplicial} complex.
e.zh: 这个定理涉及一个单纯复形。

e.en: They built a {simplicial} model of the space.
e.zh: 他们建立了这个空间的单纯形模型。

e.en: The spaces are {simplicially} equivalent in this construction.
e.zh: 在这个构造中，这些空间以单纯形方式等价。

e.en: The map is defined {simplicially} on each face.
e.zh: 这个映射在每个面上按单纯形方式定义。

e.en: The old coin was {silverless} despite its shine.
e.zh: 那枚旧硬币虽然发亮，却并不含银。

e.en: She chose a {silverless} design for the necklace.
e.zh: 她为项链选择了不带银色的设计。

e.en: The lake shone in the {silverlight}.
e.zh: 湖面在银色光辉中闪闪发亮。

e.en: A thin {silverlight} touched the roofs at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时一抹银白的光照在屋顶上。

e.en: He found a tiny {silverling} in the drawer.
e.zh: 他在抽屉里找到一枚小银币。

e.en: A {silverling} flashed beneath the clear water.
e.zh: 一条银色小鱼在清水下闪了一下。

e.en: The knight carried a {silvern} shield.
e.zh: 那名骑士拿着一面银制盾牌。

e.en: A {silvern} mist covered the field.
e.zh: 一层银色薄雾笼罩着田野。

e.en: The cabinet displayed old {silverplate} from her family.
e.zh: 柜子里陈列着她家传下来的旧镀银器皿。

e.en: They decided to {silverplate} the worn brass handles.
e.zh: 他们决定给磨旧的黄铜把手镀银。

e.en: The portrait was drawn in {silverpoint}.
e.zh: 这幅肖像是用银尖笔画法画成的。

e.en: She sharpened the {silverpoint} before starting the sketch.
e.zh: 她在开始素描前削好了银尖笔。

e.en: The museum owns several Renaissance {silverpoints}.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏了几幅文艺复兴时期的银尖笔画。

e.en: His box held pencils, chalks, and {silverpoints}.
e.zh: 他的盒子里装着铅笔、粉笔和银尖笔。

e.en: The archive preserved the original {silverprint}.
e.zh: 档案馆保存了那张原始银盐照片。

e.en: A faded {silverprint} hung above the desk.
e.zh: 一张褪色的银盐照片挂在书桌上方。

e.en: The jeweler measured the thin {silverrod}.
e.zh: 珠宝匠量了那根细银杆。

e.en: A patch of {silverrod} grew beside the path.
e.zh: 小路旁长着一片银杆草。

e.en: She roasted {silverside} for Sunday dinner.
e.zh: 她烤了牛臀肉作为周日晚餐。

e.en: The {silverside} moved in bright schools near shore.
e.zh: 银侧鱼成群在岸边闪亮地游动。

e.en: A {silvertail} darted across the stream.
e.zh: 一条银尾鱼飞快地穿过溪流。

e.en: The guide pointed out a rare {silvertail}.
e.zh: 向导指出了一只罕见的银尾鸟。

e.en: The cat rolled happily on the {silvervine}.
e.zh: 那只猫在木天蓼上开心地打滚。

e.en: Gardeners trained {silvervine} along the fence.
e.zh: 园丁让木天蓼沿着篱笆攀爬。

e.en: They celebrated their {silverwedding} with close friends.
e.zh: 他们和亲近的朋友一起庆祝银婚纪念日。

e.en: Her parents received flowers for their {silverwedding}.
e.zh: 她父母在银婚纪念日收到了鲜花。

e.en: {Silverweed} spread across the damp meadow.
e.zh: 银叶委陵菜在潮湿的草地上蔓延开来。

e.en: The herbalist collected {silverweed} near the river.
e.zh: 草药师在河边采集银草。

e.en: The farm stopped using {silvex} decades ago.
e.zh: 这座农场几十年前就停止使用这种除草剂。

e.en: Tests found traces of {silvex} in the soil.
e.zh: 检测在土壤中发现了少量西尔维克斯除草剂。

e.en: The report described the tree's {silvical} requirements.
e.zh: 报告描述了这种树的森林生态需求。

e.en: They compared {silvical} data from several regions.
e.zh: 他们比较了几个地区的林学数据。

silvichemical.t: 林产化学品；木材化学的

e.en: The plant produced {silvichemical} products from pine resin.
e.zh: 这家工厂用松脂生产林产化学品。

e.en: Researchers studied a new {silvichemical} process.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了一种新的木材化学工艺。

e.en: The agency banned the {silvicide} near waterways.
e.zh: 该机构禁止在水道附近使用这种杀树剂。

e.en: Excessive {silvicide} damaged young forest growth.
e.zh: 过量灭林剂损害了幼林的生长。

e.en: The survey focused on {silvicolous} insects.
e.zh: 这项调查重点研究栖于森林的昆虫。

e.en: Some {silvicolous} plants cannot survive open fields.
e.zh: 有些林生植物无法在开阔田野中存活。

silvics.t: 森林生态学；树木生长学

e.en: She studied {silvics} before managing the woodland.
e.zh: 她在管理林地前学习了森林生态学。

e.en: The book explains the {silvics} of native trees.
e.zh: 这本书讲解本地树种的树木生长学。

e.en: Modern {silviculture} balances timber and habitat needs.
e.zh: 现代造林学会兼顾木材生产和栖息地需求。

e.en: He teaches {silviculture} at the forestry college.
e.zh: 他在林业学院教授森林培育。

sillabub.t: 甜酒奶油甜点；泡沫饮品

e.en: The cook served {sillabub} after dinner.
e.zh: 厨师在晚餐后端上甜酒奶油甜点。

e.en: Her old recipe for {sillabub} used lemon and cream.
e.zh: 她那份老式甜酒奶油甜点食谱用了柠檬和奶油。

sillibub.t: 甜酒奶油甜点；泡沫饮品

e.en: They tasted a bowl of {sillibub} at the festival.
e.zh: 他们在节日上尝了一碗甜酒奶油甜点。

e.en: The diary mentions {sillibub} with wine and sugar.
e.zh: 日记里提到一种加酒和糖的泡沫甜点。

e.en: The servants carried several {sillibubs} into the hall.
e.zh: 仆人们把几份甜酒奶油甜点端进大厅。

e.en: Old cookbooks describe {sillibubs} in many flavors.
e.zh: 老食谱书中描述了多种口味的甜酒奶油甜点。

e.en: Miners once faced a high risk of {sillicosis}.
e.zh: 矿工过去曾面临很高的矽肺病风险。

e.en: The report misspelled silicosis as {sillicosis}.
e.zh: 报告把 silicosis 误拼成了 sillicosis。

e.en: He grinned {sillily} at his own mistake.
e.zh: 他为自己的错误傻乎乎地咧嘴笑。

e.en: The dog ran {sillily} around the kitchen.
e.zh: 那只狗滑稽地在厨房里跑来跑去。

e.en: The rock contains small crystals of {sillimanite}.
e.zh: 这块岩石含有细小的硅线石晶体。

e.en: Geologists use {sillimanite} to study high-temperature metamorphism.
e.zh: 地质学家用硅线石研究高温变质作用。

e.en: The ancient {sillographer} mocked famous philosophers.
e.zh: 这位古代讽刺诗作者嘲弄了著名哲学家。

e.en: A clever {sillographer} could ruin a public reputation.
e.zh: 机敏的讥讽文人能毁掉一个人的公众名声。

e.en: The engineer checked the {sillometer} beside the river.
e.zh: 工程师检查了河边的泥沙测量仪。

e.en: A broken {sillometer} gave unreliable readings after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后，坏掉的泥沙测量仪给出了不可靠的读数。

e.en: The label printed {sillver} instead of silver.
e.zh: 标签把 silver 误印成了 sillver。

e.en: Her search for {sillver} jewelry returned a spelling suggestion.
e.zh: 她搜索 sillver 首饰时，系统给出了拼写建议。

sillyhow.t: 傻乎乎的方式；胡闹样子

e.en: He explained the rule in a {sillyhow} manner.
e.zh: 他用一种傻乎乎的方式解释了规则。

e.en: The word {sillyhow} sounds playful and old-fashioned.
e.zh: sillyhow 这个词听起来俏皮又有些老派。

e.en: The factory installed a {silometer} above the storage bin.
e.zh: 工厂在储料仓上方安装了一台筒仓测量仪。

e.en: A calibrated {silometer} helped monitor the material level.
e.zh: 校准过的筒仓测量仪帮助监测物料高度。

silorator.t: 筒仓通风器；料仓充气器

e.en: The farmer repaired the {silorator} before harvest.
e.zh: 农民在收割前修好了筒仓通风器。

e.en: A clogged {silorator} slowed the flow of grain.
e.zh: 堵塞的料仓充气器减慢了谷物流动。

e.en: The sealant contains a flexible {siloxane} polymer.
e.zh: 这种密封剂含有柔性的硅氧烷聚合物。

e.en: Scientists measured {siloxane} levels in the biogas plant.
e.zh: 科学家测量了沼气厂中的硅氧烷含量。

e.en: The sample of {siloxen} reacted slowly with water.
e.zh: 这份硅氧烯样品与水反应缓慢。

e.en: Researchers studied {siloxen} as a layered silicon compound.
e.zh: 研究人员把硅氧烯作为层状硅化合物来研究。

e.en: The old novel calls her a graceful {silp}.
e.zh: 那本旧小说称她为一个纤细优雅的女子。

e.en: He looked like a pale {silp} in the portrait.
e.zh: 画像里的他看起来像个苍白瘦高的人。

e.en: The dancer moved like a {silphid} onstage.
e.zh: 那位舞者在台上像精灵般轻盈地移动。

e.en: Victorian writers praised the heroine as a {silphid}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的作家把女主人公赞作纤弱飘逸的女子。

e.en: The {silt-laden} river turned brown after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后，这条含大量淤泥的河变成了褐色。

e.en: Farmers avoided using the {silt-laden} water for pumps.
e.zh: 农民避免把含泥沙很多的水用于水泵。

e.en: The chemist synthesized a new {silthiane} derivative.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种新的硅噻烷衍生物。

e.en: This {silthiane} ring is stable under mild conditions.
e.zh: 这个硅噻烷环在温和条件下很稳定。

e.en: The engine part was cast from {silumin}.
e.zh: 这个发动机零件是用硅铝合金铸成的。

e.en: Manufacturers value {silumin} for its light weight.
e.zh: 制造商看重硅铝合金的轻量特性。

simplicidentate.t: 单齿的；单配位的硅酸盐结构

e.en: The mineral has a {simplicidentate} silicate structure.
e.zh: 这种矿物具有单齿的硅酸盐结构。

e.en: A {simplicidentate} group bonds through one point only.
e.zh: 单配位基团只通过一个位点成键。

e.en: A {simplicist} answer ignored the hard details.
e.zh: 这种过分简单化的回答忽略了棘手细节。

e.en: He sounded like a {simplicist}, not a serious analyst.
e.zh: 他听起来像个把问题简单化的人，而不是严肃的分析者。

e.en: The teacher was a gifted {simplifier} of difficult ideas.
e.zh: 这位老师很擅长把难懂的概念讲简单。

e.en: This app works as a text {simplifier} for learners.
e.zh: 这个应用可作为学习者的文本简化工具。

e.en: His argument collapsed into political {simplism}.
e.zh: 他的论证沦为政治上的过度简化论。

e.en: The design avoids clutter without falling into {simplism}.
e.zh: 这个设计避免杂乱，却没有陷入简单主义。

simplist.t: 简单主义者；过度简化者

e.en: The {simplist} treated every illness as stress.
e.zh: 这个过度简化者把每种病都归因于压力。

e.en: She preferred a {simplist} style in furniture.
e.zh: 她在家具上偏爱简单主义风格。

e.en: The sample was identified as {simplotite} under the microscope.
e.zh: 这份样本在显微镜下被鉴定为辛普洛特石。

e.en: Collectors rarely find good crystals of {simplotite}.
e.zh: 收藏者很少能找到品相好的辛普洛特石晶体。

e.en: The streamer mocked the {simps} in chat.
e.zh: 主播嘲笑了聊天室里的那些过分讨好者。

e.en: They called him a {simp} for buying every gift.
e.zh: 他们说他每件礼物都买，简直是舔狗。

e.en: She sprinkled {simsim} over the warm bread.
e.zh: 她把芝麻撒在热面包上。

e.en: The sauce was thickened with ground {simsim}.
e.zh: 这种酱用磨碎的芝麻调得更浓。

e.en: The museum displayed wax {simulacra} of famous rulers.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了著名统治者的蜡制拟像。

e.en: Online profiles can become {simulacra} of real identities.
e.zh: 网络个人资料可能变成真实身份的仿真物。

e.en: The city became a {simulacre} of luxury.
e.zh: 这座城市成了奢华生活的拟像。

e.en: His smile was only a {simulacre} of welcome.
e.zh: 他的笑容只是欢迎姿态的仿制幻影。

e.en: The trainees reacted to a virtual {simuland}.
e.zh: 受训者对一个虚拟模拟对象作出反应。

e.en: Each {simuland} in the model follows simple rules.
e.zh: 模型中的每个被模拟系统都遵循简单规则。

e.en: Cubic zirconia is a common diamond {simulant}.
e.zh: 立方氧化锆是一种常见的钻石仿制品。

e.en: The lab used a soil {simulant} for the Mars test.
e.zh: 实验室在火星测试中使用了土壤模拟物。

e.en: A clever {simular} can hide his fear well.
e.zh: 聪明的伪装者能很好地掩饰恐惧。

e.en: The old text describes a {simular} display of grief.
e.zh: 这篇旧文描写了一种假装出来的悲伤表现。

e.en: The software provides a {simulative} training environment.
e.zh: 这款软件提供模拟的训练环境。

e.en: His {simulative} sorrow fooled no one.
e.zh: 他假装的悲伤没有骗过任何人。

e.en: The team built a {simulatory} model of traffic flow.
e.zh: 团队建立了一个用于模拟交通流的模型。

e.en: Pilots trained in a {simulatory} cockpit first.
e.zh: 飞行员先在模拟性的驾驶舱里训练。

e.en: A {simulfix} can change several sounds at once.
e.zh: 同时词缀可以一次改变几个语音成分。

e.en: The linguist analyzed the plural {simulfix} in that language.
e.zh: 语言学家分析了那种语言中的复数同时词缀。

e.en: The painter was influenced by {simultaneism}.
e.zh: 这位画家受到同时主义的影响。

e.en: Her essay links film montage with {simultaneism}.
e.zh: 她的文章把电影蒙太奇与同步表现法联系起来。

simurgh.t: 西默格神鸟；波斯神话鸟

e.en: The poem describes the {simurgh} as a wise bird.
e.zh: 这首诗把西默格神鸟描写成一只智慧之鸟。

e.en: In Persian myth, the {simurgh} helps lost heroes.
e.zh: 在波斯神话中，西默格神鸟会帮助迷失的英雄。

e.en: The manuscript uses {simutaneous} where modern English writes simultaneous.
e.zh: 这份手稿用simutaneous来表示现代英语中的simultaneous。

e.en: Editors corrected the rare spelling {simutaneous} in the proof.
e.zh: 编辑在校样中改正了simutaneous这个罕见拼法。

e.en: The analyst measured {sinalbin} in the mustard sample.
e.zh: 分析员测定了芥末样品中的白芥籽苷含量。

e.en: {Sinalbin} gives white mustard much of its sharp taste.
e.zh: 白芥籽苷赋予白芥末很大一部分辛辣味。

e.en: The old paper described {sinamine} as a mustard compound.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文把芥子胺描述为一种芥末化合物。

e.en: Few modern chemists still use the name {sinamine}.
e.zh: 如今很少有化学家还使用白芥碱这个名称。

e.en: Researchers extracted {sinapin} from crushed mustard seeds.
e.zh: 研究人员从碾碎的芥菜籽中提取了芥子碱。

e.en: The level of {sinapin} can affect the seed's bitterness.
e.zh: 芥子碱的含量会影响种子的苦味。

e.en: The laboratory tested the oilseed meal for {sinapine}.
e.zh: 实验室检测了油籽粕中的芥子碱。

e.en: High {sinapine} content may reduce the feed's appeal.
e.zh: 芥子碱含量高可能会降低这种饲料的吸引力。

e.en: The nurse prepared a {sinapism} for the patient's chest.
e.zh: 护士为病人的胸口准备了芥末膏药。

e.en: A {sinapism} was once used to warm aching muscles.
e.zh: 过去人们曾用芥子泥敷剂来温热酸痛的肌肉。

e.en: The essay links {sinarchism} to secretive political control.
e.zh: 这篇文章把共治主义与隐秘的政治控制联系起来。

e.en: Some historians treat {sinarchism} as a fringe ideology.
e.zh: 一些历史学家把协同统治论视为边缘意识形态。

e.en: The pamphlet accused him of being a {sinarchist}.
e.zh: 那本小册子指控他是共治主义者。

e.en: A {sinarchist} movement appeared in the region briefly.
e.zh: 一个共治主义运动曾在该地区短暂出现。

e.en: The lecture discussed {sinarquism} in twentieth-century Mexico.
e.zh: 讲座讨论了二十世纪墨西哥的共治主义运动。

e.en: {Sinarquism} attracted conservative rural supporters at first.
e.zh: 墨西哥共治主义运动起初吸引了保守的农村支持者。

e.en: The archive contains letters from a committed {sinarquista}.
e.zh: 档案中保存着一名坚定墨西哥共治主义者的书信。

e.en: A {sinarquista} newspaper promoted Catholic social ideals.
e.zh: 一份墨西哥共治主义者报纸宣传天主教社会理念。

e.en: The doctor noted a {sincipital} swelling after the fall.
e.zh: 医生注意到他摔倒后前头部出现肿胀。

e.en: The skull showed a small {sincipital} fracture.
e.zh: 头骨显示有一处小的额顶部骨折。

e.en: The blow landed on the {sinciput}, not the back of the head.
e.zh: 这一击打在前头部，而不是后脑勺。

e.en: Anatomy students learned to identify the {sinciput}.
e.zh: 解剖学学生学习辨认额顶部。

e.en: The relic was wrapped in a pale {sindon}.
e.zh: 那件圣物被包在一块浅色细麻布中。

e.en: Scholars debated whether the {sindon} was ancient.
e.zh: 学者们争论这块裹尸布是否来自古代。

e.en: Her book surveys the history of {sindonology}.
e.zh: 她的书概述了都灵裹尸布研究的历史。

e.en: {Sindonology} combines religious interest with forensic analysis.
e.zh: 都灵裹尸布研究结合了宗教兴趣和法医学分析。

e.en: Critics called the official a comfortable {sinecurist}.
e.zh: 批评者称这名官员是安逸的挂名领薪者。

e.en: The reform removed several posts held by {sinecurists}.
e.zh: 这项改革撤销了几个由闲职人员占据的职位。

e.en: The dancer's {sinewiness} made every movement precise.
e.zh: 舞者筋肉发达，使每个动作都很精准。

e.en: There was a certain {sinewiness} in his lean prose.
e.zh: 他简练的散文中有一种强劲有力的质感。

e.en: His {sinewless} arm could barely lift the bag.
e.zh: 他无力的手臂几乎提不起那个包。

e.en: The proposal sounded {sinewless} without a clear budget.
e.zh: 没有明确预算，这项提议听起来缺乏力量。

e.en: The bar hosted a cheerful {sing-a-long} after dinner.
e.zh: 那家酒吧晚餐后举办了一场热闹的跟唱活动。

e.en: They printed {sing-a-long} lyrics for the audience.
e.zh: 他们为观众印了跟唱歌词。

e.en: The summer camp ended each night with {sing-a-longs}.
e.zh: 夏令营每天晚上都以跟唱活动结束。

e.en: Old movie {sing-a-longs} are popular at the theater.
e.zh: 老电影跟唱活动在这家影院很受欢迎。

e.en: We joined a {sing-along} around the piano.
e.zh: 我们围在钢琴旁参加了一场跟唱活动。

e.en: The video includes {sing-along} subtitles for children.
e.zh: 这个视频为孩子们配有跟唱字幕。

sing-song.t: 单调有节奏的腔调；儿歌般的

e.en: She read the rhyme in a {sing-song} voice.
e.zh: 她用儿歌般抑扬顿挫的声音读那首押韵诗。

e.en: His {sing-song} accent made the warning sound less serious.
e.zh: 他那种单调有节奏的口音让警告听起来不那么严肃。

sing-songs.t: 单调有节奏地说唱；儿歌腔

e.en: The teacher {sing-songs} the alphabet with the children.
e.zh: 老师和孩子们一起用儿歌腔唱字母表。

e.en: He {sing-songs} every announcement until nobody listens.
e.zh: 他每次通知都用拖腔拖调的方式说，后来没人听了。

e.en: The {singer-songwriter} released her first album today.
e.zh: 这位创作型歌手今天发行了她的第一张专辑。

e.en: He works as a {singer-songwriter} in small clubs.
e.zh: 他在小俱乐部里做创作型歌手。

e.en: Several {singer-songwriters} performed at the festival.
e.zh: 几位创作型歌手在音乐节上演出。

e.en: Young {singer-songwriters} often post demos online.
e.zh: 年轻的创作型歌手常把试听小样发到网上。

e.en: They were {singin} on the porch after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们在门廊上唱着歌。

e.en: The poster said everyone was {singin} country songs tonight.
e.zh: 海报上说今晚大家都要唱乡村歌。

e.en: A strict {singing-master} trained the choir every morning.
e.zh: 一位严格的声乐教师每天早晨训练合唱团。

e.en: The novel mentions a village {singing-master} with many pupils.
e.zh: 小说里提到一位有许多学生的乡村唱歌老师。

e.en: The pump uses a {single-acting} piston.
e.zh: 这台泵使用单作用活塞。

e.zh: 单作用气缸只向一个方向施加力。

e.en: He carried an old {single-action} revolver.
e.zh: 他带着一把老式单动左轮手枪。

e.en: The mechanism is simple and {single-action}.
e.zh: 这个机械结构很简单，是单动作的。

e.en: The farmer kept a {single-barreled} shotgun by the door.
e.zh: 农夫把一支单管猎枪放在门边。

e.en: They served a {single-barreled} bourbon from Kentucky.
e.zh: 他们端上了一款来自肯塔基的单桶波本威士忌。

e.en: He restored a {single-barrelled} hunting gun.
e.zh: 他修复了一支单管猎枪。

e.en: The pub offered a {single-barrelled} whisky special.
e.zh: 那家酒吧推出了一款单桶威士忌特饮。

e.en: I prefer a {single-blade} razor for shaving.
e.zh: 我刮胡子时更喜欢用单刀片剃须刀。

e.en: The prototype used a {single-blade} propeller.
e.zh: 这个原型机使用了单叶片螺旋桨。

e.zh: 团队进行了一项单盲试验。

e.zh: 在单盲研究中，参与者不知道自己属于哪一组。

e.zh: 他穿了一套海军蓝单排扣西装。

e.en: A {single-breasted} coat usually looks less formal.
e.zh: 单排扣大衣通常显得没那么正式。

e.zh: 那台旧收音机是单声道声音。

e.en: We tested a {single-channel} sensor first.
e.zh: 我们先测试了一个单通道传感器。

e.zh: 这个山谷依赖单一作物农业。

e.en: A {single-crop} system can leave farmers vulnerable.
e.zh: 单作物种植制度可能让农民更脆弱。

e.en: The processor can finish this instruction in one {single-cycle} operation.
e.zh: 处理器可以用一次单周期操作完成这条指令。

e.en: A {single-cycle} test checks the battery once.
e.zh: 单循环测试会对电池检查一次。

e.en: The scooter has a {single-cylinder} engine.
e.zh: 这辆踏板车装的是单缸发动机。

e.en: A {single-cylinder} machine is easier to repair.
e.zh: 单缸机器维修起来更容易。

e.en: We took a {single-decker} bus into town.
e.zh: 我们坐单层巴士进了城。

e.en: The company ordered new {single-decker} coaches.
e.zh: 公司订购了新的单层长途客车。

e.en: Use a {single-end} connector for this cable.
e.zh: 这根电缆要用单端连接器。

e.en: The old loom made {single-end} repairs difficult.
e.zh: 那台旧织机让单端修补变得很困难。

e.en: The amplifier uses a {single-ended} design.
e.zh: 这台放大器采用单端设计。

e.en: A {single-ended} signal is cheaper but less resistant to noise.
e.zh: 单端信号成本较低，但抗噪能力较弱。

e.en: A {single-eyed} statue stood near the gate.
e.zh: 一尊独眼雕像立在大门附近。

e.en: The tale describes a {single-eyed} giant in the mountains.
e.zh: 故事描写了山里一个独眼巨人。

e.en: The horse moved in a smooth {single-foot} gait.
e.zh: 那匹马以平稳的单脚步态前进。

e.en: The dancer practiced a {single-foot} balance.
e.zh: 舞者练习单脚平衡。

e.en: The rider chose a calm {single-footer} for the parade.
e.zh: 骑手为游行选了一匹性情温和、会走单脚步态的马。

e.en: A good {single-footer} gives a very smooth ride.
e.zh: 一匹好的单脚步态马骑起来非常平稳。

e.en: She completed the rescue {single-handed}.
e.zh: 她独自完成了救援。

e.en: The sailor made a {single-handed} crossing of the Atlantic.
e.zh: 那名水手独自横渡了大西洋。

e.zh: 这篇文章用一份单一来源的报告来支持说法。

e.en: A {single-source} supplier can simplify purchasing.
e.zh: 单一来源的供应商可以简化采购。

single-space.t: 单倍行距；设为单倍行距

e.zh: 请把参考文献部分设为单倍行距。

e.zh: 这张表格只要求使用单倍行距文本。

e.zh: 这篇文章必须是单倍行距，并且少于两页。
