e.en: His {step-son} joined the family business.
e.zh: 他的继子加入了家族生意。

e.en: She treats her {step-son} like her own child.
e.zh: 她像对待亲生孩子一样对待继子。

e.en: The child stood on a {step-stool} to brush his teeth.
e.zh: 孩子站在踏脚凳上刷牙。

e.en: Keep a {step-stool} in the kitchen cupboard.
e.zh: 在厨房柜子里放一个小梯凳。

e.en: The company will {step-up} production next month.
e.zh: 公司下个月会提高产量。

e.en: Someone must {step-up} and lead the team.
e.zh: 必须有人挺身而出带领团队。

e.en: He became a {stepchild} when his mother remarried.
e.zh: 母亲再婚后，他成了继子。

e.en: Public transport is often the city budget's {stepchild}.
e.zh: 公共交通常常是城市预算中被忽视的一块。

e.en: The old tale describes a cruel {stepdame}.
e.zh: 这个古老故事描写了一位残酷的继母。

e.en: In the poem, the {stepdame} speaks with icy formality.
e.zh: 在诗中，那位继母说话冷冰冰而拘谨。

e.en: Their {stepfamily} spends holidays together.
e.zh: 他们的重组家庭会一起过节。

e.en: A new {stepfamily} may need time to adjust.
e.zh: 一个新的继亲家庭可能需要时间适应。

e.en: He called the empire his {stepfatherland}, never his home.
e.zh: 他把那个帝国称为自己的非亲生祖国，而不是家。

e.en: The essay uses {stepfatherland} as a bitter political metaphor.
e.zh: 这篇文章把“继父之国”用作辛辣的政治隐喻。

stephanotis.t: 非洲茉莉；白花藤本植物

e.en: The bride carried a bouquet of {stephanotis}.
e.zh: 新娘捧着一束非洲茉莉。

e.en: A sweet {stephanotis} scent filled the greenhouse.
e.zh: 温室里弥漫着非洲茉莉的甜香。

e.en: The scooter has a {stepless} automatic transmission.
e.zh: 这辆踏板车配有无级自动变速器。

e.en: Use the dial for {stepless} control of the light.
e.zh: 用这个旋钮可以无级调节灯光。

e.en: The printer uses a {stepmotor} to move the paper.
e.zh: 这台打印机用步进电机移动纸张。

e.en: A faulty {stepmotor} made the robot arm shake.
e.zh: 一个故障的步进电机让机械臂抖动起来。

e.en: The airport introduced {stepped-up} security after the threat.
e.zh: 威胁出现后，机场加强了安保。

e.en: The team maintained a {stepped-up} pace through the final week.
e.zh: 团队在最后一周保持了加快的节奏。

stepping-stone.t: 踏脚石；垫脚石；过渡阶段

e.en: This internship could be a {stepping-stone} to a better job.
e.zh: 这份实习可能成为通向更好工作的垫脚石。

e.en: Flat rocks formed a {stepping-stone} path across the stream.
e.zh: 平坦的石头在小溪上形成了一条踏脚石小路。

steppingstone.t: 踏脚石；垫脚石；过渡阶段

e.en: The course became a {steppingstone} for her research career.
e.zh: 这门课程成了她科研生涯的垫脚石。

e.en: Each island served as a {steppingstone} for migrating birds.
e.zh: 每座小岛都成了候鸟迁徙途中的落脚点。

e.en: A mossy {stepstone} lay near the garden gate.
e.zh: 花园门旁有一块长满苔藓的踏脚石。

e.en: He treated the junior role as a {stepstone} to management.
e.zh: 他把这个初级职位看作迈向管理层的垫脚石。

e.en: The repair manual divides the process into clear {stepwork}.
e.zh: 维修手册把流程分成清楚的分步作业。

e.en: The old terrace showed careful {stepwork} in the stone walls.
e.zh: 旧梯田的石墙显出精细的阶梯式结构。

e.en: The forester measured the logs by the {ster}.
e.zh: 林务员按立方米旧单位计量木材。

e.en: One {ster} of firewood filled the corner of the shed.
e.zh: 一立方米柴火堆满了棚屋的一角。

e.en: The detector covered nearly one {sterad} of solid angle.
e.zh: 探测器覆盖了接近一球面度的立体角。

e.en: Engineers recorded the beam spread in {sterads}.
e.zh: 工程师用球面度记录光束的扩散范围。

e.en: A {steradian} measures solid angle in three-dimensional space.
e.zh: 球面度用于测量三维空间中的立体角。

e.en: The lamp's output was specified per {steradian}.
e.zh: 这盏灯的输出按每球面度标明。

e.en: Doctors linked the stool color to {stercobilin} levels.
e.zh: 医生把粪便颜色与粪胆素水平联系起来。

e.en: {Stercobilin} gives normal feces much of its brown color.
e.zh: 粪胆素使正常粪便呈现主要的棕色。

e.en: The cave had a strong {stercoraceous} odor.
e.zh: 洞穴里有一股强烈的粪便气味。

e.en: The report described the material as {stercoraceous}.
e.zh: 报告把这种物质描述为似粪的。

e.en: The chemist identified {stercorin} in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家在样品中鉴定出粪甾醇。

e.en: Older texts sometimes discuss {stercorin} under fecal sterols.
e.zh: 旧文献有时在粪便固醇项下讨论粪甾醇。

e.en: The botanist noted several {sterculiaceous} features in the plant.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这株植物有几项梧桐科特征。

e.en: Old classifications placed cacao among {sterculiaceous} plants.
e.zh: 旧分类曾把可可归入梧桐科植物。

e.en: The buyer ordered one {stere} of seasoned firewood.
e.zh: 买家订购了一立方米风干柴火。

e.en: French records listed the timber volume in {steres}.
e.zh: 法国记录用立方米旧单位列出木材体积。

stereoacuity.t: 立体视敏度；深度辨别力

e.en: The eye test measured the child's {stereoacuity}.
e.zh: 眼科检查测量了孩子的立体视敏度。

e.en: Poor {stereoacuity} can make depth judgment harder.
e.zh: 立体视敏度差会让深度判断更困难。

stereoautograph.t: 立体测图仪；立体自动绘图仪

e.en: The survey team used a {stereoautograph} to map the terrain.
e.zh: 测量队使用立体测图仪绘制地形图。

e.en: A historic {stereoautograph} stood in the photogrammetry lab.
e.zh: 摄影测量实验室里放着一台旧式立体自动绘图仪。

e.en: The camera rig needed a wider {stereobase}.
e.zh: 这套相机装置需要更宽的立体基线。

e.en: Changing the {stereobase} altered the perceived depth.
e.zh: 改变双目基距会改变感知到的深度。

e.en: The temple columns rose from a broad {stereobate}.
e.zh: 神庙的柱子立在宽阔的台基上。

e.en: Archaeologists repaired the cracked {stereobate} first.
e.zh: 考古人员先修复了开裂的建筑基座。

e.en: The paper described a compact {stereobetatron} design.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种紧凑的立体电子感应加速器设计。

e.en: Few laboratories ever built a working {stereobetatron}.
e.zh: 很少有实验室真正造出可运行的立体电子感应加速器。

e.en: The rover's {stereocamera} captured depth information.
e.zh: 探测车的立体相机捕捉了深度信息。

e.en: She restored an old {stereocamera} for 3D photographs.
e.zh: 她修复了一台旧双镜头相机来拍三维照片。

e.en: The print shop still demonstrated {stereocasting} for visitors.
e.zh: 印刷作坊仍向游客演示铅版浇铸。

e.en: Modern equipment replaced {stereocasting} in most newspapers.
e.zh: 现代设备在多数报社取代了铅版浇铸。

e.en: The molecule has one {stereocenter} at the carbon atom.
e.zh: 该分子在这个碳原子上有一个手性中心。

e.en: Changing a {stereocenter} can alter a drug's activity.
e.zh: 改变一个立体中心可能会改变药物活性。

stereochemistry.t: 立体化学；空间结构化学

e.en: The course introduces {stereochemistry} after basic bonding.
e.zh: 这门课在基础成键之后介绍立体化学。

e.en: Drug designers study {stereochemistry} to predict biological effects.
e.zh: 药物设计者研究立体化学来预测生物效应。

stereochromic.t: 立体彩色的；固色壁画的

e.en: The exhibit included an early {stereochromic} image.
e.zh: 展览中包括一幅早期立体彩色图像。

e.en: Restorers examined the {stereochromic} paint on the wall.
e.zh: 修复人员检查了墙上的固色壁画颜料。

e.en: The program writes logs to {stdiostream} by default.
e.zh: 这个程序默认把日志写入标准输入输出流。

e.en: A broken {stdiostream} can make debugging harder.
e.zh: 标准输入输出流出问题会让调试更困难。

e.en: The metallurgist identified {steadite} in the cast iron sample.
e.zh: 冶金师在铸铁样品中识别出了斯特德磷共晶体。

e.en: Excess {steadite} can make the alloy brittle.
e.zh: 过多的斯特德磷共晶体会使合金变脆。

e.en: He is a {steady-going} manager who rarely panics.
e.zh: 他是个稳健踏实的经理，很少惊慌。

e.en: Their {steady-going} approach won clients' trust.
e.zh: 他们不急不躁的做法赢得了客户信任。

e.en: The reactor reached a {steady-state} temperature after ten minutes.
e.zh: 十分钟后，反应器达到了稳态温度。

e.en: Economists modeled the economy in a {steady-state} condition.
e.zh: 经济学家模拟了经济处于稳定状态时的情况。

e.en: We booked a table at the new {steak-house}.
e.zh: 我们在那家新牛排馆订了一桌。

e.en: The old {steak-house} is famous for grilled ribs.
e.zh: 那家老牛排馆以烤排骨出名。

e.en: Do not leave {stealable} items near the window.
e.zh: 不要把容易被盗的物品放在窗边。

e.en: The idea is clever but hardly {stealable}.
e.zh: 这个想法很巧妙，但很难被照搬。

e.en: The cat made a {stealthful} move toward the bowl.
e.zh: 那只猫悄悄地朝碗边挪去。

e.en: Their {stealthful} tactics avoided public attention.
e.zh: 他们隐秘的策略避开了公众注意。

e.en: The {stealthiest} player slipped past the guards.
e.zh: 最擅长隐蔽行动的玩家溜过了守卫。

e.en: This is their {stealthiest} aircraft design so far.
e.zh: 这是他们迄今最隐蔽的飞机设计。

e.en: The robot's {stealthiness} impressed the engineers.
e.zh: 机器人的隐蔽性让工程师们印象深刻。

e.en: Her {stealthiness} made the prank possible.
e.zh: 她偷偷摸摸的本事让这场恶作剧成了可能。

e.en: The wall was painted a pale {steam-color}.
e.zh: 墙被刷成了淡淡的蒸汽般颜色。

e.en: She chose a {steam-color} fabric for the curtains.
e.zh: 她为窗帘选了一种像蒸汽一样的浅色布料。

e.en: The mist gave the hills a soft {steam-colour}.
e.zh: 薄雾让群山呈现出柔和的蒸汽般颜色。

e.en: He mixed white and gray to get a {steam-colour}.
e.zh: 他把白色和灰色混合，调出一种蒸汽般的颜色。

e.en: The museum displays a restored {steam-engine}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台修复过的蒸汽机。

e.en: A {steam-engine} once powered this old factory.
e.zh: 这座老工厂过去曾由蒸汽机提供动力。

e.en: The pipe carried hot {steam-gas} from the boiler.
e.zh: 管道从锅炉输送高温水蒸气气体。

e.en: Early engineers studied {steam-gas} for industrial heating.
e.zh: 早期工程师研究蒸汽煤气用于工业供热。

e.en: The plant installed a new {steam-generator} last year.
e.zh: 这家工厂去年安装了一台新的蒸汽发生器。

e.en: A faulty {steam-generator} delayed the test.
e.zh: 一台有故障的蒸汽发生器推迟了测试。

e.en: The ship uses two {steam-generators} for power.
e.zh: 这艘船使用两台蒸汽发生器供能。

e.en: Technicians inspected the {steam-generators} before startup.
e.zh: 技术人员在启动前检查了这些蒸汽发生器。

e.en: The old forge still has a working {steam-hammer}.
e.zh: 这座老锻造厂仍有一台能运转的蒸汽锤。

e.en: A {steam-hammer} shaped the red-hot metal.
e.zh: 蒸汽锤把烧红的金属锻造成形。

e.en: The apartment still relies on {steam-heat}.
e.zh: 这套公寓仍然依靠蒸汽供暖。

e.en: Dry air often comes with old {steam-heat} systems.
e.zh: 老式蒸汽供暖系统常会带来空气干燥。

e.en: They rented a {steam-heated} apartment downtown.
e.zh: 他们在市中心租了一套蒸汽供暖的公寓。

e.en: The jacket was dried in a {steam-heated} cabinet.
e.zh: 那件夹克是在蒸汽加热柜里烘干的。

e.en: The system {steam-heats} every room in winter.
e.zh: 这个系统在冬天为每个房间提供蒸汽供暖。

e.en: The factory {steam-heats} water for cleaning equipment.
e.zh: 工厂用蒸汽加热清洗设备所需的水。

stereomicroscope.t: 体视显微镜；立体显微镜

e.en: The technician examined the insect under a {stereomicroscope}.
e.zh: 技术员在体视显微镜下检查那只昆虫。

e.en: A {stereomicroscope} gives a clear three-dimensional view of small parts.
e.zh: 体视显微镜能清楚呈现小部件的三维视图。

stereomicroscopy.t: 体视显微术；立体显微观察

e.en: The lab uses {stereomicroscopy} to inspect tiny cracks.
e.zh: 实验室用体视显微术检查细小裂纹。

e.en: Students learned basic {stereomicroscopy} before handling delicate specimens.
e.zh: 学生在处理脆弱标本前学习了基础体视显微观察。

stereomodifier.t: 立体修饰剂；立体调节物

e.en: The chemist added a {stereomodifier} to influence the polymer structure.
e.zh: 化学家加入立体修饰剂来影响聚合物结构。

e.en: This {stereomodifier} can change how the catalyst controls shape.
e.zh: 这种立体调节物会改变催化剂控制构型的方式。

stereomotor.t: 立体运动的；双眼运动的

e.en: The experiment measured {stereomotor} responses during depth perception tasks.
e.zh: 实验测量了深度知觉任务中的双眼运动反应。

e.en: Some patients show weak {stereomotor} coordination after eye surgery.
e.zh: 有些患者眼部手术后表现出较弱的立体运动协调能力。

e.en: The paper described a rare {stereomutation} in the crystal lattice.
e.zh: 论文描述了晶格中一种罕见的立体突变。

e.en: A small {stereomutation} can alter the molecule's biological activity.
e.zh: 细微的构型变化可能改变分子的生物活性。

e.en: The concert was recorded {stereophonically} for radio broadcast.
e.zh: 这场音乐会以立体声方式录制，用于广播。

e.en: Voices move {stereophonically} across the speakers in the final mix.
e.zh: 在最终混音中，人声以立体声方式在扬声器之间移动。

e.en: Early engineers experimented with {stereophony} in cinema sound.
e.zh: 早期工程师在电影声音中试验立体声效果。

e.en: Good {stereophony} makes the listener feel surrounded by music.
e.zh: 好的立体声会让听众感觉被音乐包围。

e.en: Surveyors used {stereophotogrammetry} to map the steep valley.
e.zh: 测量人员用立体摄影测量术绘制陡峭山谷的地图。

e.en: Modern {stereophotogrammetry} can produce accurate three-dimensional models.
e.zh: 现代立体摄影测量术能生成精确的三维模型。

e.en: The archive preserves several {stereophotographic} views of the old city.
e.zh: 档案馆保存了几张老城的立体摄影图像。

e.en: A {stereophotographic} camera captures depth through paired images.
e.zh: 立体摄影相机通过成对图像捕捉深度。

e.en: Victorian travelers enjoyed {stereophotography} as a form of visual entertainment.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的旅行者把立体摄影当作一种视觉娱乐。

e.en: The class used {stereophotography} to study depth and perspective.
e.zh: 课堂用立体摄影来研究深度和透视。

e.en: Researchers used {stereophotomicrography} to document the crystal surface.
e.zh: 研究人员用立体显微摄影术记录晶体表面。

e.en: The museum displayed images made by {stereophotomicrography}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了用立体显微摄影术拍摄的图像。

e.en: The team applied {stereophototopography} to chart the glacier surface.
e.zh: 团队采用立体摄影地形测量来绘制冰川表面。

e.en: Old maps based on {stereophototopography} still guide the survey.
e.zh: 基于立体摄影地形测量的旧地图仍在指导这次测量。

e.en: The cartographer adjusted the {stereoplanigraph} before tracing contour lines.
e.zh: 制图员在描绘等高线前调整了立体平面测图仪。

e.en: A {stereoplanigraph} converts paired photographs into usable maps.
e.zh: 立体平面测图仪能把成对照片转换成可用地图。

e.en: The old biology text referred to firm cell material as {stereoplasm}.
e.zh: 那本旧生物学教材把坚实的细胞物质称为立体胞质。

e.en: Some nineteenth-century writers contrasted {stereoplasm} with more fluid protoplasm.
e.zh: 一些十九世纪作者把细胞支撑质与更流动的原生质作对比。

e.en: The operator used a {stereoplotter} to draw the terrain model.
e.zh: 操作员使用立体测图仪绘制地形模型。

e.en: Digital software has replaced many functions of the old {stereoplotter}.
e.zh: 数字软件已经取代了旧式立体测图仪的许多功能。

e.en: Geologists use {stereoprojection} to represent crystal orientations.
e.zh: 地质学家用立体投影表示晶体取向。

e.en: The lecture introduced {stereoprojection} with a simple sphere diagram.
e.zh: 讲座用一个简单的球面图介绍了立体投影。

e.en: Poor {stereopsis} can make it difficult to judge distance.
e.zh: 双眼立体视觉差会让判断距离变得困难。

e.en: The eye test measured the child's {stereopsis} with patterned cards.
e.zh: 眼科测试用图案卡片测量孩子的双眼立体视觉。

e.en: The course covers {stereoptics} and the physics of depth perception.
e.zh: 这门课程涵盖立体光学和深度知觉的物理原理。

e.en: Early studies of {stereoptics} influenced camera design.
e.zh: 早期立体光学研究影响了相机设计。

e.en: The surgeon reviewed a {stereoradiograph} before planning the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在制定手术方案前查看了立体放射照片。

e.en: A {stereoradiograph} can reveal depth that a single X-ray hides.
e.zh: 立体放射照片能显示单张X光片看不出的深度信息。

stereorubber.t: 立构橡胶；定向聚合橡胶

e.en: The factory tested {stereorubber} for improved tire performance.
e.zh: 工厂测试立构橡胶以提升轮胎性能。

e.en: Chemists developed {stereorubber} by controlling the polymer's structure.
e.zh: 化学家通过控制聚合物结构开发出定向聚合橡胶。

e.en: The clinic once used {stereosalpingography} to assess tubal blockage.
e.zh: 那家诊所曾用立体输卵管造影术评估输卵管堵塞。

e.en: Older textbooks describe {stereosalpingography} as a specialized imaging method.
e.zh: 旧教材把立体输卵管造影术描述为一种专门影像方法。

e.en: The exhibit included several {stereoscopical} photographs from the 1860s.
e.zh: 展览包括几张十九世纪六十年代的立体镜照片。

e.en: His drawings create a {stereoscopical} effect without special glasses.
e.zh: 他的画不用特殊眼镜也能产生立体感。

stereoscopically.t: 以立体镜方式；有立体感地

e.en: The two images were viewed {stereoscopically} through a simple device.
e.zh: 这两幅图像通过一个简单装置以立体镜方式观看。

e.en: The software renders the scene {stereoscopically} for virtual reality headsets.
e.zh: 该软件为虚拟现实头显以立体方式渲染场景。

stereoscopist.t: 立体摄影师；立体镜专家

e.en: The {stereoscopist} carefully aligned the two photographs.
e.zh: 立体摄影师仔细对齐了两张照片。

e.en: A skilled {stereoscopist} can detect depth errors quickly.
e.zh: 熟练的立体镜专家能很快发现深度误差。

stereoscopy.t: 立体镜术；立体视觉技术

e.en: The museum demonstrated {stereoscopy} with antique viewers.
e.zh: 博物馆用古董观片器演示立体镜术。

e.en: Modern {stereoscopy} is widely used in medical imaging and robotics.
e.zh: 现代立体视觉技术广泛用于医学成像和机器人领域。

e.en: The captain watched from the {sterncastle} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中，船长从船尾楼上观察情况。

e.en: Old warships often had a high {sterncastle}.
e.zh: 古老战船常常有高高的艉楼。

e.en: The damaged boat drifted {sternforemost} toward the pier.
e.zh: 受损的小船船尾朝前地漂向码头。

e.en: They backed the vessel {sternforemost} into the narrow slip.
e.zh: 他们让船尾朝前倒进狭窄的泊位。

e.en: The insect's second {sternite} was darker than the rest.
e.zh: 这只昆虫的第二块腹板比其余部分更深。

e.en: She examined each {sternite} under the microscope.
e.zh: 她在显微镜下检查每一块腹部硬片。

e.en: The {sternman} kept the canoe steady in the current.
e.zh: 船尾划手让独木舟在水流中保持平稳。

e.en: A skilled {sternman} can steer without speaking.
e.zh: 熟练的艉部船员不用说话也能操船。

e.en: The cargo was stored in the {sternmost} compartment.
e.zh: 货物存放在最靠船尾的舱室里。

e.en: He sat on the {sternmost} bench of the boat.
e.zh: 他坐在船上最后部的长凳上。

e.en: The doctor checked the {sternocostal} joint for tenderness.
e.zh: 医生检查胸骨肋骨关节是否有压痛。

e.en: A strain near the {sternocostal} area made breathing painful.
e.zh: 胸骨肋骨区域附近的拉伤让呼吸变得疼痛。

sternopleura.t: 侧胸腹板；昆虫侧胸部位

e.en: The fly's {sternopleura} bore several fine bristles.
e.zh: 这只苍蝇的侧胸腹板上有几根细毛。

e.en: Researchers used the {sternopleura} to identify the specimen.
e.zh: 研究人员通过侧胸腹板来鉴定这个标本。

sternorhabdite.t: 腹杆状体；腹部杆状构造

e.en: The worm's {sternorhabdite} was visible after staining.
e.zh: 染色后，这条虫的腹杆状体变得清晰可见。

e.en: He described the {sternorhabdite} in a technical note.
e.zh: 他在一篇技术笔记中描述了这种腹部杆状构造。

e.en: The rudder was fixed to the old {sternpost}.
e.zh: 船舵固定在那根老旧的艉柱上。

e.en: Rot had weakened the wooden {sternpost}.
e.zh: 腐烂已经削弱了木制船尾柱。

e.en: The {sterntrawler} returned with a full hold.
e.zh: 那艘艉拖网渔船满载而归。

e.en: Modern crews prefer a {sterntrawler} for deep-sea fishing.
e.zh: 现代船员更喜欢用艉拖网渔船进行深海捕鱼。

e.en: Dust caused repeated {sternutation} during the inspection.
e.zh: 检查时灰尘让人不停打喷嚏。

e.en: The old medical text discussed {sternutation} as a symptom.
e.zh: 那本旧医学书把打喷嚏作为一种症状来讨论。

e.en: The powder had a strong {sternutative} effect.
e.zh: 这种粉末有很强的催喷嚏作用。

e.en: His {sternutative} fit interrupted the lecture.
e.zh: 他一阵打喷嚏打断了讲座。

e.en: The apothecary sold the herb as a {sternutator}.
e.zh: 药剂师把这种草药当作催喷嚏剂出售。

e.en: A chronic {sternutator} should avoid dusty rooms.
e.zh: 经常打喷嚏的人应避免待在多尘的房间。

e.en: The doctor avoided using a {sternutatory} powder.
e.zh: 医生避免使用催喷嚏的粉末。

e.en: Pepper has a familiar {sternutatory} quality.
e.zh: 胡椒有一种常见的催喷嚏特性。

e.en: The crew moved {sternward} as the bow lifted.
e.zh: 船头抬起时，船员们向船尾移动。

e.en: Water ran {sternward} along the deck.
e.zh: 水沿着甲板朝艉部流去。

e.en: They walked {sternwards} to inspect the engine room.
e.zh: 他们朝船尾走去检查机舱。

e.en: The smoke drifted {sternwards} in the light wind.
e.zh: 烟在微风中向船尾飘去。

e.en: The tug gathered {sternway} before turning sharply.
e.zh: 拖船先向后退行，然后急转弯。

e.en: Too much {sternway} can make docking difficult.
e.zh: 后退速度过大可能会让靠泊变得困难。

e.en: A restored {sternwheeler} carried tourists down the river.
e.zh: 一艘修复后的艉轮船载着游客顺河而下。

e.en: The old {sternwheeler} churned the muddy water behind it.
e.zh: 那艘老式尾轮汽船搅动着身后的浑水。

e.en: Stress can alter {steroidogenesis} in the adrenal glands.
e.zh: 压力会改变肾上腺中的类固醇生成。

e.en: The study measured {steroidogenesis} in cultured cells.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了培养细胞中的类固醇生成。

e.en: The seed oil contained a small amount of {steroline}.
e.zh: 这种籽油含有少量甾醇苷。

e.en: Chemists isolated {steroline} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 化学家从植物提取物中分离出固醇苷。

e.en: The laboratory synthesized a new {sterone} derivative.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一种新的甾酮衍生物。

e.en: This {sterone} appears in several hormone pathways.
e.zh: 这种甾酮类化合物出现在多条激素通路中。

e.en: The museum displayed old {steroscopic} photographs of the city.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了这座城市的旧立体照片。

e.en: His helmet gave him a {steroscopic} view of the terrain.
e.zh: 他的头盔让他能以立体视觉观察地形。

e.en: A low {stertor} came from the sleeping patient.
e.zh: 睡着的病人发出低沉的鼾声般呼吸。

e.en: The doctor noticed the {stertor} during the examination.
e.zh: 医生在检查时注意到那种粗重的呼吸声。

e.en: His {stertorous} breathing alarmed the nurse.
e.zh: 他粗重如鼾的呼吸让护士感到担心。

e.en: The room was quiet except for a {stertorous} snore.
e.zh: 房间里很安静，只听见一声粗重的鼾声。

e.en: The old man breathed {stertorously} after the climb.
e.zh: 老人爬完坡后粗重如鼾地喘着气。

e.en: She slept {stertorously} through the storm outside.
e.zh: 外面暴风雨大作，她却粗重打鼾地睡着。

e.en: The editor wrote {stet} beside the deleted paragraph.
e.zh: 编辑在被删段落旁写上保留原文。

e.en: Please {stet} the original spelling in this quotation.
e.zh: 请在这段引文中保留原来的拼写。

e.en: The physician used a {stethometer} to measure chest movement.
e.zh: 医生用胸廓运动测量器测量胸部起伏。

e.en: An old {stethometer} stood in the medical display case.
e.zh: 一个旧胸廓测量器摆在医学陈列柜里。

e.en: The report described the {stethoscopic} signs in detail.
e.zh: 报告详细描述了听诊时发现的体征。

e.en: She made a {stethoscopic} examination of the patient's lungs.
e.zh: 她对病人的肺部进行了听诊检查。

e.en: The lecture covered several {stethoscopical} methods.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了几种听诊方法。

e.en: His {stethoscopical} findings supported the diagnosis.
e.zh: 他的听诊发现支持了这个诊断。

e.en: A skilled {stethoscopist} can detect subtle heart sounds.
e.zh: 熟练的听诊医生能察觉细微的心音。

e.en: The trainee watched the {stethoscopist} examine each patient.
e.zh: 实习生看着那位听诊医生检查每个病人。

e.en: Careful {stethoscopy} revealed fluid in the lungs.
e.zh: 仔细听诊发现肺部有积液。

e.en: The course teaches basic {stethoscopy} to medical students.
e.zh: 这门课向医学生教授基本听诊法。

e.en: She {stets} changes that were made by mistake.
e.zh: 她会把误改的地方标明保留原文。

e.en: The proofreader's {stets} confused the typesetter.
e.zh: 校对员的保留标记让排字工感到困惑。

e.en: The editor {stetted} the sentence after checking the source.
e.zh: 编辑核对来源后标明该句保留原文。

e.en: Several deleted words were {stetted} in the final proof.
e.zh: 终校样中有几个被删的词被标明恢复。

e.en: She was {stetting} the passage when the author called.
e.zh: 作者来电话时，她正在标明那段文字保留原文。

e.en: The manual explains {stetting} and other proof marks.
e.zh: 手册解释了保留原文标记和其他校对符号。

e.en: The invoice included {stevedorage} for unloading the cargo.
e.zh: 发票中包含卸货所需的码头装卸费。

e.en: The port company expanded its {stevedorage} services.
e.zh: 港口公司扩大了自己的装卸业务。

e.en: The lab measured {steviol} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 实验室测定了植物提取物中的甜菊醇含量。

e.en: Some sweeteners break down into {steviol} during digestion.
e.zh: 有些甜味剂在消化过程中会分解成甜菊醇。

e.en: The drink uses {stevioside} instead of sugar.
e.zh: 这种饮料用甜菊苷代替糖。

e.en: Researchers tested the purity of the {stevioside} sample.
e.zh: 研究人员检测了甜菊苷样品的纯度。

e.en: Choose tougher, {stewable} cuts for this recipe.
e.zh: 这道菜要选较韧、适合炖煮的肉块。

e.en: The ripe tomatoes were still {stewable} after a day.
e.zh: 这些熟番茄放了一天后仍然适合炖煮。

e.en: The old {stewbum} slept behind the closed bar.
e.zh: 那个老酒鬼睡在关门的酒吧后面。

e.en: He wrote a harsh novel about a lonely {stewbum}.
e.zh: 他写了一本冷峻的小说，讲一个孤独的流浪醉汉。

e.en: She warmed the milk in a small {stewpan}.
e.zh: 她用一个小炖锅把牛奶热了。

e.en: The sauce stuck to the bottom of the {stewpan}.
e.zh: 酱汁粘在了深平底锅的锅底。

e.en: The shepherd climbed the {stey} path at dawn.
e.zh: 牧羊人黎明时爬上那条陡峭的小路。

e.en: They avoided the {stey} bank after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后他们避开了那段难走的陡岸。

e.en: The old physics text measured force in {sthenes}.
e.zh: 那本旧物理教材用斯坦来计量力。

e.en: A {sthene} is rarely used in modern engineering.
e.zh: 斯坦在现代工程中很少使用。

e.en: The physician described the patient's {sthenia} as unusual.
e.zh: 医生说这名病人的体力旺盛得不寻常。

e.en: Classical medicine linked {sthenia} with excessive vitality.
e.zh: 古典医学把强健状态与生命力过盛联系起来。

e.en: The doctor noted a {sthenic} constitution in the report.
e.zh: 医生在报告中记录了强健的体质。

e.en: Older writers called the fever a {sthenic} disorder.
e.zh: 早期作者把这种发热称为亢奋性疾病。

e.en: The diagnosis of {sthenopyra} appears in nineteenth-century texts.
e.zh: 十九世纪的文献中出现过亢奋性发热这一诊断。

e.en: Few modern doctors would use {sthenopyra} in a case note.
e.zh: 现代医生几乎不会在病历里使用亢奋性发热这个词。

e.en: The sculptor used {stiacciato} to suggest distant hills.
e.zh: 雕塑家用浅浮雕技法表现远处的山丘。

e.en: In {stiacciato}, tiny changes of depth create soft shadows.
e.zh: 在浅浮雕技法中，细微的深浅变化会形成柔和阴影。

e.en: The forester checked the trunk with a {stiameter}.
e.zh: 林务员用测径仪检查树干。

e.en: A {stiameter} helps estimate timber volume quickly.
e.zh: 测树干直径的仪器有助于快速估算木材体积。

e.en: The paper mentioned {stibacetin} as an old treatment.
e.zh: 论文提到斯替巴西丁曾是一种旧疗法。

e.en: Supplies of {stibacetin} disappeared from the clinic years ago.
e.zh: 这种含锑药物多年前就从诊所供应中消失了。

e.en: Doctors once used {stibamine} against tropical infections.
e.zh: 医生曾用斯替巴明治疗热带感染。

e.en: The museum label described {stibamine} as an antimonial drug.
e.zh: 博物馆标签把斯替巴明说明为一种含锑药物。

e.en: The chemist drew the {stibenyl} group on the board.
e.zh: 化学家在黑板上画出了锑苯基。

e.en: A {stibenyl} compound may react differently from arsenic analogues.
e.zh: 含锑有机化合物的反应可能不同于砷类似物。

e.en: The assay detected a {stibial} residue in the sample.
e.zh: 化验在样品中检测到含锑残留。

e.en: Ancient cosmetics sometimes included {stibial} minerals.
e.zh: 古代化妆品有时含有锑类矿物。

e.en: The laboratory monitored {stibine} because it is highly toxic.
e.zh: 实验室监测锑化氢，因为它毒性很强。

e.en: Heating the mixture accidentally released {stibine}.
e.zh: 加热混合物时意外释放出了锑化氢。

e.en: Medieval alchemists called antimony {stibium}.
e.zh: 中世纪炼金术士把锑称为stibium。

e.en: The symbol Sb comes from the Latin word {stibium}.
e.zh: 元素符号Sb来自锑的拉丁名stibium。

e.en: The reaction produced a stable {stibonium} salt.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种稳定的锑鎓盐。

e.en: Researchers compared the {stibonium} ion with related phosphonium ions.
e.zh: 研究人员把锑鎓离子与相关的鏻离子作比较。

e.en: The formula listed {stiburea} among experimental compounds.
e.zh: 配方把含锑脲类化合物列入实验化合物。

e.en: Little clinical evidence supports {stiburea} today.
e.zh: 如今几乎没有临床证据支持这种含锑脲类化合物。

e.en: The editor preserved the poem's {stichic} layout.
e.zh: 编辑保留了这首诗按诗行排列的版式。

e.en: A {stichic} passage can look plain beside ornate prose.
e.zh: 分行排列的段落放在华丽散文旁可能显得朴素。

e.en: The manuscript includes a {stichometrical} note at the end.
e.zh: 手稿末尾有一条按行数计量文本的说明。

e.en: Scholars used {stichometrical} evidence to estimate the lost section.
e.zh: 学者用行数计量证据估算遗失部分。

e.en: Ancient scribes used {stichometry} to price copied works.
e.zh: 古代抄写员用行数计量来给抄本定价。

e.en: The article explains {stichometry} in biblical manuscripts.
e.zh: 这篇文章解释了圣经手稿中的行数计量法。

stichomythia.t: 戏剧中一人一句的对白

e.en: The argument becomes {stichomythia} in the final scene.
e.zh: 争吵在最后一幕变成了一人一句的对白。

e.en: Greek tragedy often uses {stichomythia} to quicken tension.
e.zh: 希腊悲剧常用一人一句的对白来加快紧张节奏。

e.en: Their {stichomythic} exchange made the scene feel urgent.
e.zh: 他们一人一句的对白让这一幕显得紧迫。

e.en: The playwright wrote a {stichomythic} quarrel for the rivals.
e.zh: 剧作家为两个对手写了一段一人一句式的争吵。

stichomythy.t: 戏剧中一人一句的对白

e.en: The scene relies on {stichomythy} rather than long speeches.
e.zh: 这一幕依靠一人一句的对白，而不是长篇演说。

e.en: Students noticed the rapid {stichomythy} between the two kings.
e.zh: 学生们注意到两位国王之间快速的一人一句对白。

e.en: Her {stick-at-itiveness} helped the project survive repeated delays.
e.zh: 她的坚持不懈让项目挺过了一再拖延。

e.en: The coach valued {stick-at-itiveness} more than early talent.
e.zh: 教练更看重韧劲，而不是早期显露的天赋。

e.en: Don't be a {stick-in-the-mud}; come dancing with us.
e.zh: 别当个守旧无趣的人，跟我们一起去跳舞吧。

e.en: The committee dismissed him as a cautious {stick-in-the-mud}.
e.zh: 委员会把他看作一个谨慎又守旧无趣的人。

e.en: The proposal was blocked by a few {stick-in-the-muds}.
e.zh: 这个提案被几个顽固守旧的人挡了下来。

e.en: Don't be such {stick-in-the-muds} about the new schedule.
e.zh: 别对新日程这么死守老一套。

e.en: She used a {stick-on} label for the jar.
e.zh: 她给罐子贴了一个粘贴式标签。

e.en: The costume came with a {stick-on} mustache.
e.zh: 这套服装配有一撮贴上去的胡子。

e.en: The brake noise was caused by {stick-slip} motion.
e.zh: 刹车噪声是由黏滑运动造成的。

e.en: Engineers measured {stick-slip} along the fault model.
e.zh: 工程师测量了断层模型中的黏滑现象。

e.en: Her {stick-to-itive} attitude helped finish the project.
e.zh: 她坚持不懈的态度帮助完成了项目。

e.en: You need a {stick-to-itive} spirit in research.
e.zh: 做研究需要一种有毅力的精神。

e.en: The police linked three {stick-ups} to one gang.
e.zh: 警方把三起持枪抢劫案与同一个团伙联系起来。

e.en: Old films often show dramatic bank {stick-ups}.
e.zh: 老电影常常展现戏剧化的银行抢劫。

e.en: The tape's {stickability} weakens in humid weather.
e.zh: 这种胶带在潮湿天气里黏着力会变弱。

e.en: Her {stickability} impressed the whole team.
e.zh: 她坚持到底的能力让整个团队印象深刻。

stickful.t: 一棍量；一棒所能盛的量

e.en: He added a {stickful} of wax to the pot.
e.zh: 他往锅里加了一棍量的蜡。

e.en: The old recipe called for a {stickful} of butter.
e.zh: 这份老食谱要求加入一条黄油的量。

stickfuls.t: 若干棍量；几棒所盛的量

e.en: She stirred in two {stickfuls} of paste.
e.zh: 她搅入了两棒量的糊状物。

e.en: The children collected {stickfuls} of sticky mud.
e.zh: 孩子们用棍子挑起了一团团黏泥。

e.en: He can {stickhandle} through heavy traffic on the ice.
e.zh: 他能在冰上密集防守中控球穿过。

e.en: She had to {stickhandle} a difficult political debate.
e.zh: 她不得不巧妙应付一场棘手的政治辩论。

stickhandler.t: 冰球控球手；善于应付者

e.en: The young {stickhandler} drew cheers from the crowd.
e.zh: 这名年轻的冰球控球手赢得了观众喝彩。

e.en: He is a skilled {stickhandler} in tense negotiations.
e.zh: 他在紧张谈判中是个善于周旋的人。

e.en: The syrup ran {stickily} down his fingers.
e.zh: 糖浆黏糊糊地顺着他的手指流下。

e.en: The meeting moved {stickily} through old disputes.
e.zh: 会议在旧争议中尴尬而拖沓地推进。

e.en: Price remains the main {sticking-point} in the deal.
e.zh: 价格仍然是这笔交易的主要争议焦点。

e.en: The only {sticking-point} was who would pay first.
e.zh: 唯一的症结是谁先付款。

e.en: Mark the {stickingplace} before removing the label.
e.zh: 撕下标签前先标出粘附的位置。

e.en: The argument reached a {stickingplace} over costs.
e.zh: 争论在费用问题上陷入了停滞点。

e.en: She put a {stickingplaster} on the small cut.
e.zh: 她在小伤口上贴了一片创可贴。

e.en: The nurse changed the {stickingplaster} every morning.
e.zh: 护士每天早上更换那块橡皮膏。

e.en: I can {stickit} for one more week.
e.zh: 我还能再忍受一个星期。

e.en: If you {stickit} out, you may succeed.
e.zh: 如果你坚持到底，就可能成功。

e.en: The children bought {stickjaw} from the corner shop.
e.zh: 孩子们从街角小店买了黏牙糖果。

e.en: That {stickjaw} nearly pulled out my filling.
e.zh: 那块太妃糖差点把我的补牙材料粘下来。

e.en: He will {stickle} over every comma in the contract.
e.zh: 他会对合同里的每个逗号都斤斤计较。

e.en: Editors often {stickle} for accuracy and consistency.
e.zh: 编辑常常坚持准确性和一致性。

e.en: She {stickled} over the wording of the apology.
e.zh: 她对道歉声明的措辞斤斤计较。

e.en: The committee {stickled} for proper procedure.
e.zh: 委员会坚持要遵守正当程序。

e.en: He {stickles} about titles at formal dinners.
e.zh: 他在正式晚宴上很在意头衔称呼。

e.en: The lawyer {stickles} for precise definitions.
e.zh: 那位律师坚持使用精确的定义。

e.en: The insect had long {sticklike} legs.
e.zh: 那只昆虫有细长得像棍子的腿。

e.en: His {sticklike} figure looked fragile in the coat.
e.zh: 他穿着外套时细长僵硬的身形显得很脆弱。

e.en: Her {stickling} over etiquette annoyed the guests.
e.zh: 她对礼节的斤斤计较惹恼了客人。

e.en: A {stickling} editor caught every small inconsistency.
e.zh: 一位严格抠细节的编辑发现了每个小小的不一致。

e.en: He drew a {stickman} beside the house.
e.zh: 他在房子旁边画了一个火柴人。

e.en: The circus {stickman} balanced a pole on his chin.
e.zh: 马戏团的持棍表演者用下巴平衡一根杆子。

stickseed.t: 粘籽草；带刺粘人的种子

e.en: The dog came home covered in {stickseed}.
e.zh: 狗回家时身上沾满了粘人的刺籽。

e.en: {Stickseed} grows along many dry paths.
e.zh: 粘籽草生长在许多干燥小路旁。

stereocilium.t: 听觉细胞的静纤毛突起

e.en: Each {stereocilium} bends when sound vibrates the inner ear.
e.zh: 声音使内耳振动时，每根静纤毛都会弯曲。

e.en: Damage to a {stereocilium} can reduce hearing sensitivity.
e.zh: 静纤毛受损可能会降低听觉敏感度。

e.en: The surveyor used a {stereocomparagraph} to compare aerial photographs.
e.zh: 测量员用立体摄影测距仪比较航空照片。

e.en: An old {stereocomparagraph} stood beside the mapping table.
e.zh: 一台旧式立体摄影测距仪放在制图桌旁。

e.en: The astronomer checked the plates with a {stereocomparator}.
e.zh: 天文学家用立体比较仪检查底片。

e.en: A {stereocomparator} helps detect tiny differences between paired images.
e.zh: 立体比较仪有助于发现成对图像中的细微差异。

e.en: The surgeon reviewed the fracture with {stereofluoroscopy}.
e.zh: 外科医生通过立体透视检查复看骨折情况。

e.en: Early {stereofluoroscopy} required carefully aligned X-ray images.
e.zh: 早期立体透视检查需要精确对齐的X光图像。

e.en: The doctor tested her {stereognosis} with a key.
e.zh: 医生用一把钥匙测试她的触觉辨物能力。

e.en: Poor {stereognosis} may follow certain parietal lobe injuries.
e.zh: 某些顶叶损伤后可能出现触觉辨物能力下降。

e.en: The lab measured crystal angles with a {stereogoniometer}.
e.zh: 实验室用立体测角仪测量晶体角度。

e.en: A {stereogoniometer} records orientation in three dimensions.
e.zh: 立体测角仪会记录三维空间中的方位。

e.en: She stared at the {stereogram} until a dolphin appeared.
e.zh: 她盯着那张立体图看，直到看出一只海豚。

e.en: The textbook included a {stereogram} of the molecule.
e.zh: 教材里附有该分子的立体图。

e.en: Engineers used {stereogrammetry} to model the cliff face.
e.zh: 工程师用立体图测量法建立崖面的模型。

e.en: Modern {stereogrammetry} can estimate depth from paired images.
e.zh: 现代立体图测量法能从成对图像估算深度。

stereographical.t: 立体绘图的；球面投影的

e.en: The atlas used a {stereographical} projection for the polar map.
e.zh: 这本地图集用球面投影绘制极地图。

e.en: Her {stereographical} drawings made the structure easier to see.
e.zh: 她的立体绘图让结构更容易看清。

stereographically.t: 以立体绘图方式；用球面投影

e.en: The poles were mapped {stereographically} for clarity.
e.zh: 为了清晰显示，两极区域采用球面投影绘制。

e.en: The crystals were represented {stereographically} in the report.
e.zh: 报告中以立体绘图方式表示这些晶体。

stereography.t: 立体绘图法；立体摄影术

e.en: Victorian photographers experimented with {stereography} for depth.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的摄影师用立体摄影术尝试表现深度。

e.en: The course introduced {stereography} as a mapping technique.
e.zh: 这门课把立体绘图法作为一种制图技术介绍。

e.en: The paper discussed {stereohybridization} in complex organic molecules.
e.zh: 论文讨论了复杂有机分子中的空间杂化。

e.en: Chemists modeled {stereohybridization} to explain the unusual bond angles.
e.zh: 化学家建立空间杂化模型来解释异常键角。

e.en: One {stereoisomer} of the drug is more active.
e.zh: 这种药物的一个立体异构体活性更强。

e.en: The reaction produced a different {stereoisomer} under light.
e.zh: 该反应在光照下生成了另一种立体异构体。

e.en: The two compounds are {stereoisomeric} but not identical.
e.zh: 这两种化合物属于立体异构关系，但并不相同。

e.en: Researchers separated the {stereoisomeric} forms by chromatography.
e.zh: 研究人员用色谱法分离这些立体异构形式。

e.en: The lecture explained {stereoisomerism} with simple models.
e.zh: 讲座用简单模型解释了立体异构现象。

e.en: Biological activity can depend on {stereoisomerism}.
e.zh: 生物活性可能取决于立体异构现象。

stereological.t: 体视学的；立体定量分析的

e.en: The study used {stereological} methods to count neurons.
e.zh: 这项研究用体视学方法统计神经元数量。

e.en: A {stereological} estimate avoids measuring every cell directly.
e.zh: 体视学估计可以避免逐个直接测量每个细胞。

e.en: The tissue samples were analyzed {stereologically} after staining.
e.zh: 组织样本染色后按体视学方法进行分析。

e.en: Researchers {stereologically} estimated the organ's total cell volume.
e.zh: 研究人员按体视学方法估算该器官的细胞总体积。

stereology.t: 体视学；立体定量分析学

e.en: She applied {stereology} to estimate tumor volume.
e.zh: 她运用体视学估算肿瘤体积。

e.en: Modern {stereology} links two-dimensional slices to three-dimensional structure.
e.zh: 现代体视学把二维切片与三维结构联系起来。

e.en: The museum used {stereomacrography} to photograph the coin.
e.zh: 博物馆用立体宏观摄影术拍摄这枚硬币。

e.en: Insects reveal surface detail through {stereomacrography}.
e.zh: 通过立体宏观摄影术，昆虫的表面细节会显现出来。

e.en: The botanist described the stem's {stereome} in detail.
e.zh: 植物学家详细描述了茎中的厚壁支持组织。

e.en: A strong {stereome} helps the plant remain upright.
e.zh: 坚固的厚壁支持组织有助于植物保持直立。

e.en: The technician used a {stereometer} to measure volume.
e.zh: 技术员用体积计测量体积。

e.en: An antique {stereometer} lay in the physics cabinet.
e.zh: 一台老式体积计放在物理仪器柜里。

stereometric.t: 立体测量的；体积测定的

e.en: The architect checked the {stereometric} proportions of the model.
e.zh: 建筑师检查了模型的立体测量比例。

e.en: A {stereometric} calculation gave the container's volume.
e.zh: 一次体积测定计算得出了容器的容积。

stereometry.t: 立体测量学；体积测定法

e.en: Ancient mathematicians studied {stereometry} alongside plane geometry.
e.zh: 古代数学家在研究平面几何的同时也研究立体测量学。

e.en: The lab used {stereometry} to determine the specimen's volume.
e.zh: 实验室用体积测定法确定样本体积。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {stereomicrometer} before the measurement.
e.zh: 技术员在测量前校准了立体显微测量器。

e.en: A {stereomicrometer} can measure tiny depth differences.
e.zh: 立体显微测量器可以测量极小的深度差异。

e.en: The bone sample was examined with {stereomicroradiography}.
e.zh: 骨样本通过立体显微射线摄影术进行检查。

e.en: Researchers used {stereomicroradiography} to reveal mineral patterns.
e.zh: 研究人员用立体显微射线摄影术显示矿物分布模式。

sticktight.t: 黏附植物；黏人的东西或人

e.en: The dog's fur was full of {sticktights} after the walk.
e.zh: 散步后，狗毛里沾满了黏人的小刺果。

e.en: That salesman became a real {sticktight} after one meeting.
e.zh: 只见过一次面后，那个推销员就变得特别缠人。

e.en: The receiver rubbed {stickum} on his gloves before practice.
e.zh: 训练前，接球手在手套上抹了增黏剂。

e.en: A little {stickum} kept the label from peeling off.
e.zh: 一点黏胶让标签没有翘起来。

e.en: The cashier stayed calm during the {stickup}.
e.zh: 收银员在那次持枪抢劫中保持了冷静。

e.en: Police arrested two men after a bank {stickup}.
e.zh: 银行抢劫案发生后，警方逮捕了两名男子。

e.en: The path was lined with {stickweed} and dry grass.
e.zh: 小路两旁长满了黏性杂草和干草。

e.en: Seeds from the {stickweed} clung to our socks.
e.zh: 刺果草的种子粘在了我们的袜子上。

e.en: The old fence was built with rough {stickwork}.
e.zh: 那道旧篱笆是用粗糙的木棍编成的。

e.en: Her basket showed delicate {stickwork} around the rim.
e.zh: 她的篮子边缘有精细的枝条编作。

e.en: Use {sticky-back} plastic to cover the notebook.
e.zh: 用背面带胶的塑料膜把笔记本包起来。

e.en: The photo was printed on {sticky-back} paper.
e.zh: 这张照片印在背面带胶的纸上。

e.en: The manager watched the {sticky-fingered} customer near the display.
e.zh: 经理盯着展示架旁那个手脚不干净的顾客。

e.en: A {sticky-fingered} child had taken coins from the drawer.
e.zh: 一个爱偷东西的孩子从抽屉里拿走了硬币。

e.en: The {sticky-handed} toddler left jam on the door.
e.zh: 那个满手黏糊糊的幼儿把果酱蹭在门上。

e.en: They suspected a {sticky-handed} employee of taking supplies.
e.zh: 他们怀疑有个手脚不干净的员工偷拿用品。

e.en: Our neighbor is a {stickybeak} who reads everyone's mail labels.
e.zh: 我们的邻居很爱打听，连别人信件上的标签都要看。

e.en: Don't {stickybeak} into matters that don't concern you.
e.zh: 别去打听那些和你无关的事。

e.en: Engineers reduced {stiction} in the tiny mechanical switch.
e.zh: 工程师降低了微型机械开关中的静摩擦黏滞。

e.en: Old hard drives sometimes failed because of {stiction}.
e.zh: 旧硬盘有时会因起动阻滞而失灵。

e.en: The pigs were {stied} behind the barn for the night.
e.zh: 那些猪晚上被关在谷仓后面的猪圈里。

e.en: He felt {stied} in the cramped basement room.
e.zh: 他觉得自己像被关在狭小的地下室里。

e.en: The runner used a {stiff-arm} to avoid the tackle.
e.zh: 跑锋用直臂推开对手，避开了擒抱。

e.en: The committee gave his proposal a polite {stiff-arm}.
e.zh: 委员会客气却冷淡地拒绝了他的提案。

e.en: The trainer replaced the {stiff-bit} with a gentler one.
e.zh: 驯马师把硬口马嚼子换成了更温和的。

e.en: A {stiff-bit} can make a nervous horse harder to handle.
e.zh: 硬口马嚼子可能让紧张的马更难驾驭。

e.en: His {stiff-necked} refusal delayed the whole project.
e.zh: 他固执地拒绝，拖慢了整个项目。

e.en: After the long flight, she felt tired and {stiff-necked}.
e.zh: 长途飞行后，她又累又觉得脖子僵硬。

e.en: She kept a {stiff-upper-lip} throughout the hearing.
e.zh: 整个听证过程中，她都保持坚忍克制。

e.en: The family valued a {stiff-upper-lip} in times of crisis.
e.zh: 这个家庭重视危机时不露感情的克制态度。

e.en: The officers kept their {stiff-upper-lips} despite the bad news.
e.zh: 尽管消息很糟，军官们仍保持克制。

e.en: Their {stiff-upper-lips} cracked when the children started crying.
e.zh: 孩子们哭起来时，他们强撑的克制终于崩了。

e.en: My back felt {stiffish} after the train ride.
e.zh: 坐完火车后，我的背有点僵硬。

e.en: The dough should be {stiffish} but still easy to roll.
e.zh: 面团应当稍硬，但仍然容易擀开。

e.en: The boys cruelly called the new pupil a {stig}.
e.zh: 那些男孩残忍地叫新来的学生邋遢鬼。

e.en: He felt treated like a {stig} because of his accent.
e.zh: 因为口音，他觉得自己被当成底层人看待。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {stigasterol} from plant oil.
e.zh: 样品中含有来自植物油的少量豆甾醇。

e.en: Researchers measured {stigasterol} levels in the seed extract.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了种子提取物中的豆甾醇含量。

e.en: The negotiations reached a {stillstand} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜后谈判陷入停滞。

e.en: Traffic came to a complete {stillstand} in the snow.
e.zh: 大雪中交通完全停住了。

e.en: Mosquitoes breed easily in {stillwater} near the house.
e.zh: 房子附近的静水很容易滋生蚊子。

e.en: The canoe drifted across the {stillwater} at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时独木舟漂过平静的水面。

e.en: The lake lay {stilly} under the moon.
e.zh: 月光下湖面静静地躺着。

e.en: A {stilly} room can make every sound seem loud.
e.zh: 寂静的房间会让每个声响都显得很大。

e.en: A {stilt-walker} waved above the festival crowd.
e.zh: 一名踩高跷的人在人群上方向大家挥手。

e.en: The child stared as the {stilt-walker} crossed the square.
e.zh: 孩子盯着那个踩高跷的人穿过广场。

e.en: The bird moved on {stilty} legs through the marsh.
e.zh: 那只鸟用细长像高跷的腿穿过沼泽。

e.en: The old chair had a strangely {stilty} look.
e.zh: 那把旧椅子看起来支脚细长，很奇怪。

e.en: The scribe scratched the wax with a {stilus}.
e.zh: 抄写员用铁笔在蜡板上刻写。

e.en: A Roman {stilus} was found near the ruins.
e.zh: 遗址附近发现了一支罗马时代的书写尖笔。

e.en: A {stime} of dust clung to the glass.
e.zh: 玻璃上粘着一点点灰尘。

e.en: There was not a {stime} of pity in his voice.
e.zh: 他的声音里没有一丝怜悯。

e.en: The rescue team was {stimied} by the storm.
e.zh: 救援队被暴风雨阻住了。

e.en: She felt {stimied} by the vague instructions.
e.zh: 那些含糊的指示让她觉得无从下手。

e.en: The missing permit {stimies} the whole project.
e.zh: 缺少许可证阻碍了整个项目。

e.en: He often {stimies} opponents with unexpected questions.
e.zh: 他常用出人意料的问题让对手为难。

e.en: Too many {stims} can make the game overwhelming.
e.zh: 刺激元素太多会让这个游戏令人吃不消。

e.en: He uses small hand {stims} to calm himself.
e.zh: 他会用小幅手部自我刺激动作让自己平静下来。

e.en: The paper described a hormone-like {stimulin}.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种类似激素的刺激素。

e.en: Researchers tested whether the {stimulin} affected growth.
e.zh: 研究人员测试这种促刺激物质是否影响生长。

e.en: A lack of funds can {stimy} good ideas.
e.zh: 资金不足可能会阻碍好想法实现。

e.en: The puzzle seemed designed to {stimy} beginners.
e.zh: 这个谜题似乎就是为了难住初学者。

e.en: The old inventory listed one {stin} of grain.
e.zh: 旧清单上列着一斯廷谷物。

e.en: Few readers know what a {stin} measured.
e.zh: 很少有读者知道斯廷曾用来计量什么。

e.en: A {stingaree} hid under the sand in shallow water.
e.zh: 一条刺魟藏在浅水的沙下。

e.en: The fisherman released the small {stingaree} carefully.
e.zh: 渔民小心地放走了那条小黄貂鱼。

e.en: Do not touch a {stingfish} with bare hands.
e.zh: 不要徒手触碰带毒刺的鱼。

e.en: The guide pointed out a {stingfish} near the rocks.
e.zh: 向导指出岩石旁有一条刺鱼。

e.en: This landlord is {stingier} than the last one.
e.zh: 这个房东比上一个更小气。

e.en: The new policy is {stingier} with travel money.
e.zh: 新政策在差旅经费上给得更抠。

e.en: He tipped the waiter {stingily} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他很小气地给了服务员一点小费。

e.en: The room was {stingily} lit by one weak bulb.
e.zh: 房间只靠一只昏暗灯泡勉强照亮。

e.en: A jellyfish uses a {stinging-cell} to catch prey.
e.zh: 水母用螫刺细胞捕捉猎物。

e.en: Under the microscope, each {stinging-cell} looked like a capsule.
e.zh: 显微镜下，每个刺细胞都像一个小囊。

e.en: Some farmers keep {stingless} bees for honey.
e.zh: 有些农民饲养无刺蜂来取蜜。

e.en: The joke was sharp but ultimately {stingless}.
e.zh: 这个笑话听着尖刻，但其实并不伤人。

e.en: The inn was famous for its strong {stingo}.
e.zh: 这家小旅馆以烈性啤酒出名。

e.en: His reply had enough {stingo} to silence the room.
e.zh: 他的回答带着足够的讽刺，令全场安静下来。

e.en: The pamphlet called the corrupt official a {stinkard}.
e.zh: 那本小册子把贪官骂作卑鄙讨厌鬼。

e.en: No one wanted the {stinkard} near the kitchen.
e.zh: 没人想让那个浑身发臭的人靠近厨房。

stigmaria.t: 石松类化石根状体；痕根化石

e.en: The shale slab preserved a clear {stigmaria} fossil.
e.zh: 这块页岩保存着清晰的痕根化石。

e.en: Collectors often mistake {stigmaria} for ordinary roots.
e.zh: 收藏者常把石松类化石根状体误认成普通树根。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {stigmastane} after extraction.
e.zh: 样品萃取后含有微量豆甾烷。

e.en: Chemists use {stigmastane} as a reference structure.
e.zh: 化学家把豆甾烷用作参考结构。

e.en: Soybean oil naturally contains {stigmasterol}.
e.zh: 大豆油天然含有豆甾醇。

e.en: The lab measured {stigmasterol} in several plant extracts.
e.zh: 实验室测定了几种植物提取物中的豆甾醇。

e.en: The policy carried a {stigmatic} effect for applicants.
e.zh: 这项政策对申请者带有污名化影响。

e.en: The bee brushed against the flower's {stigmatic} surface.
e.zh: 蜜蜂擦过花朵的柱头表面。

e.en: Patients were {stigmatically} labeled as irresponsible.
e.zh: 患者被带着污名地贴上不负责任的标签。

e.en: The pollen was deposited {stigmatically} during pollination.
e.zh: 授粉时花粉以柱头接触的方式沉积下来。

e.en: Public campaigns can reduce the {stigmatisation} of illness.
e.zh: 公共宣传可以减少对疾病的污名化。

e.en: The report criticized the {stigmatisation} of poor families.
e.zh: 报告批评了对贫困家庭贴耻辱标签的做法。

e.en: The optician recorded {stigmatism} in the patient's left eye.
e.zh: 验光师记录到患者左眼为无散光状态。

e.en: Perfect {stigmatism} is uncommon in practical lens systems.
e.zh: 实际透镜系统中完美无散光并不常见。

stigmatist.t: 有圣痕者；施加污名的人

e.en: The villagers believed the {stigmatist} had received a sign.
e.zh: 村民相信那位有圣痕者得到了某种神迹。

e.en: A careless {stigmatist} can damage a whole community.
e.zh: 随意施加污名的人可能伤害整个群体。

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {stigmatose} markings.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物带有斑点状标记。

e.en: A {stigmatose} surface helped catch the drifting pollen.
e.zh: 具柱头特征的表面有助于捕捉飘来的花粉。

e.en: The old photometer reported brightness in {stilb}.
e.zh: 那台旧光度计用熙提表示亮度。

e.en: Few engineers still use the {stilb} in calculations.
e.zh: 现在很少有工程师还在计算中使用熙提。

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {stilbamidine} for certain infections.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用芪脒治疗某些感染。

e.en: The study compared {stilbamidine} with newer treatments.
e.zh: 这项研究把芪脒与较新的疗法作了比较。

e.en: The reaction produced a small amount of {stilbazole}.
e.zh: 该反应生成了少量芪唑。

e.en: Researchers tested {stilbazole} derivatives for optical properties.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了芪唑衍生物的光学性质。

e.en: Resveratrol belongs to the {stilbene} family.
e.zh: 白藜芦醇属于二苯乙烯类化合物。

e.en: The chemist synthesized {stilbene} under ultraviolet light.
e.zh: 化学家在紫外光下合成了二苯乙烯。

e.en: They chose to {still-hunt} deer before sunrise.
e.zh: 他们选择在日出前潜行猎鹿。

e.en: The detective began a careful {still-hunt} for clues.
e.zh: 侦探开始悄悄而细致地搜寻线索。

e.en: She painted a {still-life} with pears and blue cloth.
e.zh: 她画了一幅有梨和蓝布的静物画。

e.en: The museum displayed several Dutch {still-life} paintings.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几幅荷兰静物画。

still-room.t: 蒸馏室；旧式家政储藏室

e.en: The herbs were dried in the manor's {still-room}.
e.zh: 这些草药在庄园的旧式家政储藏室里晾干。

e.en: Servants prepared cordials in the {still-room}.
e.zh: 仆人们在蒸馏室里调制甜酒。

e.en: The distillery treated the {stillage} before disposal.
e.zh: 酒厂在排放前处理了蒸馏废液。

e.en: Workers stacked the barrels on a wooden {stillage}.
e.zh: 工人把木桶堆放在木制货物托架上。

e.en: The lake was {stillest} just before dawn.
e.zh: 黎明前湖面最平静。

e.en: She chose the {stillest} room for meditation.
e.zh: 她选择了最安静的房间冥想。

e.en: Smoke rose from the old {stillhouse}.
e.zh: 烟从那座旧酿酒蒸馏房升起。

e.en: Visitors toured the {stillhouse} after lunch.
e.zh: 游客午饭后参观了蒸馏车间。

e.en: The merchant weighed spices on {stilliards}.
e.zh: 商人用旧式杆秤称香料。

e.en: A rusty pair of {stilliards} hung in the shop.
e.zh: 店里挂着一副生锈的旧式秤具。

e.en: The steady {stillicide} kept him awake all night.
e.zh: 持续的滴水声让他整夜无法入睡。

e.en: Moss grew where the roof's {stillicide} struck the stones.
e.zh: 屋檐滴水落在石头上的地方长出了苔藓。

e.en: The {stillman} checked the temperature every hour.
e.zh: 蒸馏工每小时检查一次温度。

e.en: A skilled {stillman} can judge the spirit by smell.
e.zh: 熟练的蒸馏工能凭气味判断烈酒品质。

e.en: The copper {stillpot} gleamed in the distillery.
e.zh: 铜制蒸馏锅在酒厂里闪闪发亮。

e.en: They repaired the {stillpot} before the next batch.
e.zh: 他们在下一批生产前修好了釜式蒸馏器。

stillroom.t: 蒸馏室；旧式家政储藏室

e.en: Jam jars lined the shelves of the {stillroom}.
e.zh: 果酱罐摆满了旧式家政储藏室的架子。

e.en: The cook kept medicinal herbs in the {stillroom}.
e.zh: 厨师把药草存放在蒸馏室里。

stinkaroo.t: 臭味；糟糕透顶的东西或事物

e.en: That forgotten lunchbox was a real {stinkaroo}.
e.zh: 那个被忘掉的午餐盒真是臭得要命。

e.en: The movie turned out to be a total {stinkaroo}.
e.zh: 那部电影结果烂得一塌糊涂。

stinkball.t: 臭球；臭气熏人的人或东西

e.en: The old cheese became a {stinkball} in the fridge.
e.zh: 那块旧奶酪在冰箱里变成了一个臭球。

e.en: After practice, his gym bag was a complete {stinkball}.
e.zh: 训练后，他的运动包简直臭气熏天。

e.en: A {stinkbug} crawled across the window screen.
e.zh: 一只椿象爬过了纱窗。

e.en: Do not crush a {stinkbug} indoors.
e.zh: 不要在室内拍死臭虫。

e.en: The bin grew {stinkier} in the heat.
e.zh: 垃圾桶在热天里变得更臭了。

e.en: His excuse sounded even {stinkier} after we checked the facts.
e.zh: 我们核实事实后，他的借口听起来更可疑了。

e.en: He came home {stinko} after the party.
e.zh: 聚会后他醉醺醺地回到家。

e.en: The plan was {stinko} from the start.
e.zh: 这个计划从一开始就糟透了。

e.en: The inspectors used a {stinkometer} near the factory.
e.zh: 检查员在工厂附近使用了臭味计。

e.en: My son jokingly called his nose a {stinkometer}.
e.zh: 我儿子开玩笑说自己的鼻子是臭味探测器。

e.en: The soldiers threw a {stinkpot} to drive people away.
e.zh: 士兵投出一枚臭气弹来驱散人群。

e.en: That drain is a little {stinkpot} in summer.
e.zh: 那条排水沟夏天就是个小臭源。

stinkstone.t: 臭石灰岩；摩擦会发臭的石头

e.en: The geologist showed us a piece of {stinkstone}.
e.zh: 地质学家给我们看了一块臭石灰岩。

e.en: When struck, the {stinkstone} released a sulfurous smell.
e.zh: 这块臭石灰岩被敲击时散发出硫磺味。

e.en: The ditch was full of {stinkweed}.
e.zh: 沟里长满了有臭味的杂草。

e.en: Farmers pulled the {stinkweed} before it spread.
e.zh: 农民在臭草蔓延前把它拔掉了。

stinkwood.t: 臭木；有臭味的木材或树

e.en: The cabinet was made from dark {stinkwood}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用深色臭木做成的。

e.en: Cutting {stinkwood} filled the shed with a sharp odor.
e.zh: 切割臭木让棚屋里充满刺鼻气味。

e.en: The {stintedness} of the budget hurt the project.
e.zh: 预算的受限影响了这个项目。

e.en: Her emotional {stintedness} made praise difficult.
e.zh: 她情感上的吝于表达让赞美变得困难。

e.en: They funded the library {stintingly} for years.
e.zh: 他们多年来一直吝啬地资助这座图书馆。

e.en: He praised the team only {stintingly}.
e.zh: 他只是很克制地表扬了团队。

e.en: She gave {stintless} care to the sick child.
e.zh: 她毫不吝惜地照料那个生病的孩子。

e.en: The volunteers showed {stintless} patience during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间，志愿者表现出无限的耐心。

e.en: The botanist marked each {stip} on the drawing.
e.zh: 植物学家在图上标出了每个托叶部位。

e.en: A tiny {stip} supported the specimen in the tray.
e.zh: 一个小短柄支撑着托盘里的标本。

e.en: The fungus has a {stipate} fruiting body.
e.zh: 这种真菌有具柄的子实体。

e.en: A {stipate} structure held the tiny capsule upright.
e.zh: 一个有柄结构托住了小蒴果，使其直立。

e.en: The mushroom's {stipe} was thick and white.
e.zh: 这朵蘑菇的菌柄又粗又白。

e.en: The seaweed's {stipe} anchored it to the rock.
e.zh: 海藻的柄把它固定在岩石上。

e.en: The sample was a small {stiped} mushroom.
e.zh: 这个样本是一朵小小的有柄蘑菇。

e.en: The drawing showed a {stiped} leaf gland.
e.zh: 图中画出了一个有柄的叶腺。

e.en: Each leaflet had a tiny {stipel} at its base.
e.zh: 每片小叶基部都有一个细小的小托叶。

e.en: The missing {stipel} helped identify the plant.
e.zh: 缺少小托叶这一点帮助识别了这种植物。

e.en: He accepted a {stipendless} research position.
e.zh: 他接受了一个没有津贴的研究职位。

e.en: The fellowship was prestigious but {stipendless}.
e.zh: 这项奖学金很有声望，但没有补助金。

e.en: The mushrooms had long, fragile {stipes}.
e.zh: 这些蘑菇有细长而脆弱的菌柄。

e.en: Several algae showed flexible {stipes} under the lens.
e.zh: 镜头下几株海藻呈现出柔韧的柄。

e.en: The specimen was clearly {stipitate} under magnification.
e.zh: 放大后可以清楚看到这个标本是有柄的。

e.en: A {stipitate} gland rose from the leaf surface.
e.zh: 一个具柄腺体从叶面上突起。

e.en: The artist sharpened her {stipple-graver} before work.
e.zh: 艺术家开工前磨利了她的点刻雕刻刀。

e.en: A {stipple-graver} can make very fine dots in metal.
e.zh: 点刻雕刻刀能在金属上刻出很细的点。

e.en: The plant has a clear {stipular} sheath.
e.zh: 这种植物有清晰的托叶鞘。

e.en: The botanist compared the {stipular} scars on the stem.
e.zh: 植物学家比较了茎上的托叶痕。

e.en: The {stipulator} insisted on written guarantees.
e.zh: 订约者坚持要有书面保证。

e.en: As {stipulator}, she defined the payment schedule.
e.zh: 作为规定条件的人，她确定了付款时间表。

stiver.t: 旧时小硬币；微不足道的钱

e.en: He would not pay a {stiver} more for the damaged chair.
e.zh: 那把椅子已经坏了，他一分钱也不肯多付。

e.en: The old sailor saved every {stiver} he earned.
e.zh: 那位老水手把挣来的每一枚小钱都攒起来。

e.en: The workers were {stiving} the tobacco into barrels.
e.zh: 工人们正把烟草装进桶里。

e.en: They were {stiving} supplies into every empty corner.
e.zh: 他们把补给品塞进每一个空角落。

stivy.t: 闷热污浊的；令人窒息的

e.en: The attic felt {stivy} after the windows stayed shut all week.
e.zh: 窗户关了一整周后，阁楼里闷热又污浊。

e.en: He escaped the {stivy} office for a walk outside.
e.zh: 他离开令人窒息的办公室，到外面走了一会儿。

e.en: The child had a {stmachache} after eating too much cake.
e.zh: 那个孩子蛋糕吃太多后肚子痛。

e.en: A mild {stmachache} kept him awake at night.
e.zh: 轻微的胃痛让他夜里睡不着。

e.en: Philosophers once gathered in the painted {stoa}.
e.zh: 哲学家们曾聚集在那条彩绘柱廊里。

e.en: The museum rebuilt a small {stoa} beside the courtyard.
e.zh: 博物馆在庭院旁重建了一小段柱廊。

e.en: The sample was later identified as {stoadite}.
e.zh: 这块样本后来被鉴定为一种名叫stoadite的稀有矿物。

e.en: Only a specialist recognized the pale grains of {stoadite}.
e.zh: 只有专家认出了那些浅色的stoadite矿粒。

e.en: The fencer ended the duel with a quick {stoccado}.
e.zh: 那名剑手用一次迅速的突刺结束了决斗。

e.en: In the old manual, a {stoccado} was a thrust, not a cut.
e.zh: 在那本旧手册里，stoccado指的是刺击，不是劈砍。

e.en: The particles move {stochastically} through the fluid.
e.zh: 这些粒子在流体中随机运动。

e.en: The model chooses routes {stochastically} rather than by a fixed rule.
e.zh: 这个模型按概率选择路线，而不是遵循固定规则。

e.en: He drove a {stock-car} on the oval track.
e.zh: 他在椭圆赛道上驾驶一辆改装赛车。

e.en: The team rebuilt the {stock-car} after the crash.
e.zh: 撞车后，车队重新修好了那辆赛车。

stock-cars.t: 改装赛车；量产赛车复数

e.en: Several {stock-cars} roared past the grandstand.
e.zh: 几辆改装赛车轰鸣着驶过看台。

e.en: Old {stock-cars} are displayed in the racing museum.
e.zh: 赛车博物馆里展出了几辆老式改装赛车。

e.en: Dry humor is her {stock-in-trade}.
e.zh: 冷幽默是她最拿手的本领。

e.en: Rumor and exaggeration became the paper's {stock-in-trade}.
e.zh: 谣言和夸张成了那家报纸的惯用手段。

stock-jobber.t: 证券经纪人；股票交易商

e.en: A London {stock-jobber} handled the purchase of shares.
e.zh: 一名伦敦证券交易商办理了这笔股票购买。

e.en: The novel portrays the {stock-jobber} as clever but ruthless.
e.zh: 小说把那名股票交易商描写得精明却冷酷。

e.en: The manager checks the {stock-level} every morning.
e.zh: 经理每天早上检查库存水平。

e.en: Low {stock-level} forced the shop to delay orders.
e.zh: 库存量偏低迫使商店推迟订单。

e.en: A sudden {stock-out} delayed the hospital's deliveries.
e.zh: 突然缺货耽误了医院的配送。

e.en: Better forecasting can prevent a costly {stock-out}.
e.zh: 更好的预测可以避免代价高昂的库存耗尽。

e.en: The town kept a {stock-pile} of emergency food.
e.zh: 镇上保留了一批应急食品储备。

e.en: They began to {stock-pile} fuel before winter arrived.
e.zh: 冬天到来前，他们开始囤积燃料。

e.en: She stood {stock-still} when she heard the noise.
e.zh: 她听到响声时站着一动不动。

e.en: The deer remained {stock-still} in the tall grass.
e.zh: 那只鹿在高草丛里纹丝不动。

e.en: The store closed early for its annual {stock-take}.
e.zh: 商店为了年度盘点提前关门。

e.en: After the crisis, leaders began a serious {stock-take}.
e.zh: 危机过后，领导层开始认真盘点形势。

e.en: Cattle waited in the {stock-yard} before the auction.
e.zh: 拍卖前，牛群在牲畜围栏里等候。

e.en: The old {stock-yard} became a busy meat market.
e.zh: 旧牲畜市场后来变成了繁忙的肉类市场。

e.en: The satire mocks a greedy {stockateer} chasing quick profits.
e.zh: 这部讽刺作品嘲笑一个追逐快钱的贪婪股票投机者。

e.en: Every hopeful {stockateer} crowded around the exchange board.
e.zh: 每个满怀希望的证券玩家都挤在交易牌前。

e.en: The {stockboy} filled the shelves before opening time.
e.zh: 开店前，理货员把货架补满了。

e.en: She asked the {stockboy} where the batteries were kept.
e.zh: 她问那名理货员电池放在哪里。

e.en: The {stockbreeder} selected only the healthiest calves.
e.zh: 那位牲畜育种人只挑选最健康的小牛。

e.en: A skilled {stockbreeder} understands both genetics and pasture.
e.zh: 熟练的牲畜饲养者既懂遗传，也懂牧场管理。

e.en: The valley has a long tradition of {stockbreeding}.
e.zh: 这个山谷有悠久的牲畜饲养传统。

e.en: Modern {stockbreeding} uses careful records and genetic tests.
e.zh: 现代畜牧育种会使用详细记录和基因检测。

stockbrokerage.t: 证券经纪业务；经纪公司

e.en: He joined a small {stockbrokerage} after graduation.
e.zh: 毕业后，他加入了一家小型证券经纪公司。

e.en: Online platforms changed the economics of {stockbrokerage}.
e.zh: 线上平台改变了证券经纪业务的经济模式。

e.en: Her first {stockcar} race attracted a huge crowd.
e.zh: 她的第一场改装赛车比赛吸引了大批观众。

e.en: The mechanic tuned the {stockcar} for better acceleration.
e.zh: 技师调校了那辆赛车，让它加速更快。

stipulatory.t: 规定的；约定的；契约性的

e.en: The contract included a {stipulatory} clause about delivery dates.
e.zh: 合同中有一项关于交货日期的约定条款。

e.en: His role was mainly {stipulatory}, setting conditions for the grant.
e.zh: 他的职责主要是规定性的，为补助金设定条件。

e.en: A small {stipule} grew beside the leaf stalk.
e.zh: 叶柄旁长出了一片小托叶。

e.en: The botanist used the {stipule} to identify the plant.
e.zh: 植物学家根据托叶来辨认这种植物。

stipuled.t: 有托叶的；具小附属片的

e.en: The {stipuled} leaf helped confirm the species.
e.zh: 这片有托叶的叶子帮助确认了物种。

e.en: A {stipuled} stem may look slightly fringed near each leaf.
e.zh: 有托叶的茎在每片叶子附近可能显得略有边缘。

e.en: The drawing labels the tiny {stipulode} near the leaf base.
e.zh: 图中标出了叶基附近细小的退化托叶。

e.en: A {stipulode} can be easy to miss without magnification.
e.zh: 不用放大镜时，退化托叶很容易被忽略。

e.en: After three rainy days indoors, the children were {stir-crazy}.
e.zh: 连续三天下雨待在屋里，孩子们都快憋坏了。

e.en: I get {stir-crazy} when I cannot leave the apartment.
e.zh: 不能离开公寓时，我会闷得发慌。

e.en: We served rice with {stir-fried} vegetables.
e.zh: 我们配米饭吃了炒蔬菜。

e.en: The noodles tasted smoky and {stir-fried}.
e.zh: 这份面有爆炒后的烟火香。

e.en: She often makes quick vegetable {stir-fries} for dinner.
e.zh: 她晚饭常做快捷的蔬菜炒菜。

e.en: He {stir-fries} the beef over very high heat.
e.zh: 他用大火快速翻炒牛肉。

e.en: This chicken {stir-fry} is ready in ten minutes.
e.zh: 这道鸡肉炒菜十分钟就能做好。

e.en: Please {stir-fry} the garlic before adding the greens.
e.zh: 加入青菜前，请先把蒜翻炒一下。

e.en: Keep the vegetables moving while {stir-frying} them.
e.zh: 翻炒蔬菜时要不断拨动它们。

e.en: {Stir-frying} uses high heat and very little oil.
e.zh: 爆炒用高温，而且只需要很少的油。

e.en: The old recipe made a thick {stirabout} from oats.
e.zh: 这份老食谱用燕麦做成浓稠的稀粥。

e.en: They ate plain {stirabout} before going to the fields.
e.zh: 他们下地前吃了些清淡的燕麦粥。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {stiripentol} for severe childhood epilepsy.
e.zh: 医生为严重儿童癫痫开了司替戊醇。

e.en: {Stiripentol} must be taken exactly as directed.
e.zh: 司替戊醇必须严格按医嘱服用。

e.en: The farmer moved the {stirk} into a separate pen.
e.zh: 农民把那头一两岁的幼牛赶进单独的栏里。

e.en: A healthy {stirk} can gain weight quickly in spring.
e.zh: 健康的幼牛在春天能很快增重。

e.en: Several {stirks} were grazing near the stone wall.
e.zh: 几头一两岁的幼牛在石墙旁吃草。

e.en: The auction listed ten {stirks} from a local farm.
e.zh: 拍卖清单上列着本地农场的十头幼牛。

stirless.t: 静止不动的；毫无动静的

e.en: The lake lay {stirless} under the morning fog.
e.zh: 晨雾下，湖面静止不动。

e.en: He stood {stirless} while the judge read the sentence.
e.zh: 法官宣读判决时，他一动不动地站着。

e.en: The old chronicle traced his {stirp} back to nobles.
e.zh: 那部古老编年史把他的血统追溯到贵族。

e.en: Lawyers discussed each {stirp} in the inheritance case.
e.zh: 律师们在继承案中讨论了每一个家系。

e.en: The estate was divided per {stirpes} among the descendants.
e.zh: 遗产按各支家系分给后代。

e.en: In legal Latin, {stirpes} refers to family branches.
e.zh: 在法律拉丁语中，stirpes 指家族分支。

e.en: Victorian writers sometimes promoted {stirpiculture} as social reform.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的作者有时把优生培育宣传成社会改革。

e.en: The term {stirpiculture} now sounds archaic and troubling.
e.zh: stirpiculture 这个词如今听起来既古旧又令人不安。

e.en: Each {stirps} received an equal share of the estate.
e.zh: 每一支家系都得到相等的遗产份额。

e.en: The scholar used {stirps} to describe a line of descent.
e.zh: 学者用 stirps 来描述一条血统传承线。

e.en: He accepted a final {stirrup-piece} before riding away.
e.zh: 他骑马离开前接受了最后一杯临别酒。

e.en: The host poured a {stirrup-piece} for the departing guest.
e.zh: 主人给即将离去的客人倒了一杯上马酒。

stishovite.t: 斯石英；高压二氧化硅矿物

e.en: The meteor crater contained traces of {stishovite}.
e.zh: 陨石坑中含有少量斯石英。

e.en: {Stishovite} forms under extremely high pressure.
e.zh: 斯石英是在极高压力下形成的。

e.en: Her careful {stitchwork} made the quilt look handmade.
e.zh: 她细致的针线活让被子显得很有手工质感。

e.en: The costume's {stitchwork} was visible under the stage lights.
e.zh: 舞台灯光下，戏服的缝制纹理清晰可见。

stitchwort.t: 繁缕属植物；星状白花野草

e.en: White {stitchwort} flowers brightened the hedgerow.
e.zh: 白色的繁缕花点亮了树篱边。

e.en: The guidebook describes {stitchwort} as a common woodland plant.
e.zh: 指南把繁缕描述为常见的林地植物。

e.en: Sparks flew across the old {stithy}.
e.zh: 火花飞过那间老铁匠铺。

e.en: The hammer rang on the {stithy} all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午，锤子都在铁砧上叮当作响。

e.en: The crowded room began to {stive} in the summer heat.
e.zh: 夏日炎热中，拥挤的房间开始变得闷热难耐。

e.en: Do not {stive} the seedlings in an unventilated box.
e.zh: 不要把幼苗闷在不通风的箱子里。

e.en: We felt {stived} in the airless carriage.
e.zh: 在不透气的车厢里，我们觉得闷得难受。

e.en: The plants were {stived} under a plastic cover.
e.zh: 这些植物被塑料罩闷住了。

stodginess.t: 沉闷古板；难消化的沉重感

e.en: The report's {stodginess} made it hard to finish.
e.zh: 这份报告沉闷古板，让人很难读完。

e.en: She complained about the {stodginess} of the heavy meal.
e.zh: 她抱怨这顿大餐太厚重，让胃不舒服。

e.en: They sat on the {stoep} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后，他们坐在屋前的门廊上。

e.en: A dog slept quietly under the shaded {stoep}.
e.zh: 一只狗安静地睡在有阴影的门廊下。

stogy.t: 廉价粗雪茄；沉闷守旧的

e.en: He lit a cheap {stogy} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后，他点了一支廉价的粗雪茄。

e.en: The lecture felt {stogy} and old-fashioned.
e.zh: 那场讲座让人觉得沉闷又守旧。

stoichiological.t: 关于元素或基本原理的

e.en: The book begins with a {stoichiological} discussion of matter.
e.zh: 这本书开头讨论了物质的基本组成原理。

e.en: His argument had a dry, {stoichiological} structure.
e.zh: 他的论证结构枯燥，像是在讲基本原理。

stoichiometric.t: 化学计量的；按定量比例的

e.en: The reaction requires a {stoichiometric} amount of oxygen.
e.zh: 这个反应需要化学计量比例的氧气。

e.en: They adjusted the mixture to a {stoichiometric} balance.
e.zh: 他们把混合物调到精确定量的比例平衡。

e.en: The sailors worked below in the {stokehold}.
e.zh: 水手们在下层的锅炉舱里工作。

e.en: Heat poured from the ship's crowded {stokehold}.
e.zh: 热气从船上拥挤的炉舱里涌出来。

e.en: Coal was shoveled through the {stokehole}.
e.zh: 煤被铲进炉口里。

e.en: The old factory's {stokehole} was black with soot.
e.zh: 老工厂的锅炉房被烟灰熏得漆黑。

e.en: She joined a {stokvel} to save money with friends.
e.zh: 她加入了一个互助储蓄会，和朋友一起攒钱。

e.en: The {stokvel} helped members pay school fees.
e.zh: 这个民间储蓄会帮助成员支付学费。

e.en: The statue shows a woman wearing a {stola}.
e.zh: 这座雕像展示了一名穿着古罗马女长袍的女子。

e.en: The priest arranged the {stola} before the service.
e.zh: 礼拜前，神父整理好了圣带。

e.en: Several {stolae} were displayed in the museum case.
e.zh: 博物馆展柜里陈列着几件古罗马女长袍。

e.en: The embroidered {stolae} were kept for special services.
e.zh: 这些刺绣圣带被留作特别礼拜时使用。

e.en: We bought {stollen} from the bakery in December.
e.zh: 十二月时，我们从面包店买了德国圣诞甜面包。

e.en: The {stollen} was dusted with thick powdered sugar.
e.zh: 那块果脯甜面包上撒了厚厚的糖粉。

stolon.t: 植物匍匐茎；无性繁殖枝

e.en: The strawberry plant sent out a new {stolon}.
e.zh: 这株草莓长出了一条新的匍匐茎。

e.en: Grass can spread quickly by {stolons} underground.
e.zh: 草可以通过地下匍匐茎迅速蔓延。

e.en: I have a {stomach-ache} after eating too much.
e.zh: 我吃太多后肚子疼。

e.en: Her {stomach-ache} kept her home from school.
e.zh: 她因为胃痛没有去上学。

e.en: The children had {stomach-aches} after the picnic.
e.zh: 野餐后，孩子们都肚子疼。

e.en: Frequent {stomach-aches} can signal a food problem.
e.zh: 经常胃痛可能说明饮食有问题。

stomach-churning.t: 令人反胃的；极其恶心的

e.en: The documentary showed {stomach-churning} scenes of war.
e.zh: 这部纪录片展示了令人反胃的战争场面。

e.en: Waiting for the verdict was a {stomach-churning} experience.
e.zh: 等待判决是一段让人紧张到反胃的经历。

e.en: He ate a {stomachful} of rice before work.
e.zh: 上班前，他吃了满满一肚子米饭。

e.en: A {stomachful} of cold water made her feel sick.
e.zh: 一肚子冷水让她觉得不舒服。

e.en: The herb was sold as a {stomachic} remedy.
e.zh: 这种草药作为健胃药出售。

e.en: He described a dull {stomachic} pain after meals.
e.zh: 他说饭后胃部有一种钝痛。

stomachless.t: 无胃的；没有食欲或胆量的

e.en: Some tiny animals are effectively {stomachless}.
e.zh: 有些微小动物实际上没有胃。

e.en: He felt {stomachless} before the dangerous climb.
e.zh: 在危险的攀登前，他觉得自己没了胆量。

e.en: The old portrait shows a {stomachy} gentleman.
e.zh: 那幅老肖像画里是一位大肚子的绅士。

e.en: She gave a {stomachy} reply to the insult.
e.zh: 面对侮辱，她作出了强硬而有胆气的回应。

e.en: The stew was thickened with soaked {stockfish}.
e.zh: 这锅炖菜用泡软的鳕鱼干增添了厚味。

e.en: Norwegian {stockfish} is dried in the cold sea air.
e.zh: 挪威鳕鱼干是在寒冷的海风中晾成的。

e.en: The grain was kept in a dry {stockhouse}.
e.zh: 谷物被存放在一间干燥的仓库里。

e.en: They converted the old {stockhouse} into offices.
e.zh: 他们把旧库房改成了办公室。

e.en: He was the {stockiest} player on the team.
e.zh: 他是队里最矮壮的球员。

e.en: The {stockiest} chair survived years of rough use.
e.zh: 最结实的那把椅子经受住了多年粗用。

e.en: The wrestler was {stockily} built and very strong.
e.zh: 那名摔跤手身材矮壮，非常有力。

e.en: A {stockily} shaped bottle sat on the shelf.
e.zh: 架子上放着一个造型敦实的瓶子。

e.en: His {stockiness} made him hard to knock down.
e.zh: 他的矮壮身材让人很难把他撞倒。

e.en: The design has a reassuring {stockiness}.
e.zh: 这个设计带着一种让人放心的敦实感。

e.en: The nurse covered the cast with {stockinet}.
e.zh: 护士用弹力套布包住了石膏。

e.en: This soft {stockinet} is used for lining gloves.
e.zh: 这种柔软的针织布常用来给手套做衬里。

e.en: She knitted the body in {stockinette} stitch.
e.zh: 她用平针织法织了衣身部分。

e.en: The wound dressing included a layer of {stockinette}.
e.zh: 伤口敷料里有一层弹力针织套布。

e.en: She bought a puzzle as a {stocking-filler}.
e.zh: 她买了一个拼图当圣诞袜小礼物。

e.en: The shop sells cheap toys for {stocking-filler} gifts.
e.zh: 这家店卖适合塞进圣诞袜的便宜玩具。

e.en: We picked up some chocolates as {stocking-fillers}.
e.zh: 我们买了些巧克力当圣诞袜小礼物。

e.en: Small books make excellent {stocking-fillers} for children.
e.zh: 小开本书很适合作为孩子的圣诞袜礼物。

e.en: The actor had a {stockish} build in his youth.
e.zh: 那位演员年轻时身材略显矮壮。

e.en: The article used a {stockish} photo of smiling workers.
e.zh: 那篇文章用了张很像图库素材的工人微笑照片。

e.en: A London {stockjobber} handled the purchase quietly.
e.zh: 一名伦敦证券经纪人低调处理了这笔购买。

e.en: The novel mocks a greedy {stockjobber} in the city.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了城里一个贪婪的股票掮客。

e.en: The old exchange was crowded with {stockjobbers}.
e.zh: 旧证券交易所里挤满了股票经纪商。

e.en: Pamphlets blamed {stockjobbers} for the market panic.
e.zh: 小册子把市场恐慌归咎于股票掮客。

stockjobbing.t: 证券经纪业务；股票投机

e.en: He made money through {stockjobbing} in London.
e.zh: 他在伦敦靠证券经纪业务赚钱。

e.en: The essay attacked reckless {stockjobbing} as immoral.
e.zh: 那篇文章抨击鲁莽的股票投机不道德。

e.en: The company runs a {stockless} online store.
e.zh: 这家公司经营一家无库存的网店。

e.en: A {stockless} farm relies on crops rather than animals.
e.zh: 无牲畜农场主要依靠种植作物而非养殖动物。

e.en: A supplier delay caused a {stockout} of batteries.
e.zh: 供应商延误导致电池缺货。

e.en: The system warns managers before a {stockout} occurs.
e.zh: 系统会在库存耗尽前提醒经理。

e.en: The {stockrider} checked the fence after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后，骑马牧工检查了围栏。

e.en: A skilled {stockrider} can turn a herd quickly.
e.zh: 熟练的赶牲畜者能迅速调转整群牲口。

e.en: The shop closed early for its annual {stocktake}.
e.zh: 商店为了年度盘点提前关门。

e.en: After the crisis, ministers began a political {stocktake}.
e.zh: 危机过后，部长们开始重新审视政治局势。

e.en: The {stocktaker} counted every box in the warehouse.
e.zh: 盘点员清点了仓库里的每一个箱子。

e.en: A careful {stocktaker} noticed the missing tablets.
e.zh: 一名细心的盘点员发现药片少了。

e.en: The rider cracked a {stockwhip} near the gate.
e.zh: 骑手在门口附近甩响了一条牧畜长鞭。

e.en: An old {stockwhip} hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉上方挂着一条旧牧畜长鞭。

e.en: The geologist mapped the quartz {stockwork} carefully.
e.zh: 地质学家仔细绘制了石英网状矿脉图。

e.en: He learned basic {stockwork} on his uncle's ranch.
e.zh: 他在叔叔的牧场学会了基本的牧场活计。

e.en: The sequel felt {stodgier} than the original film.
e.zh: 这部续集感觉比原片更沉闷。

e.en: This pudding is {stodgier} than the fruit tart.
e.zh: 这份布丁比水果挞更厚重难消化。

e.en: It was the {stodgiest} lecture of the conference.
e.zh: 那是整场会议中最沉闷的一场讲座。

e.en: The {stodgiest} dish was a dense suet pudding.
e.zh: 最难消化的菜是一份厚实的牛脂布丁。

e.en: The report was written {stodgily} and without flair.
e.zh: 这份报告写得沉闷乏味，毫无亮点。

e.en: He moved {stodgily} in his heavy winter coat.
e.zh: 他穿着厚重的冬衣，行动显得笨重。

e.en: The {stomapod} struck its prey with remarkable speed.
e.zh: 这只虾蛄以惊人的速度击中了猎物。

e.en: A colorful {stomapod} hid among the reef rocks.
e.zh: 一只色彩鲜艳的虾蛄躲在礁石间。

e.en: The patient reported severe {stomatalgia} after the procedure.
e.zh: 手术后，患者说口腔疼痛很严重。

e.en: Persistent {stomatalgia} can make eating difficult.
e.zh: 持续的口腔疼痛会让进食变得困难。

e.en: The doctor examined the {stomatic} tissues carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了口腔组织。

e.en: Some insects have specialized {stomatic} structures for feeding.
e.zh: 有些昆虫有专门用于取食的口部结构。

e.en: The medication caused painful {stomatitis} in some patients.
e.zh: 这种药让一些患者出现了疼痛的口腔炎。

e.en: Good oral care may reduce episodes of {stomatitis}.
e.zh: 良好的口腔护理可以减少口腔炎发作。

e.en: The embryologist identified the early {stomatodeum} under the microscope.
e.zh: 胚胎学家在显微镜下辨认出早期原口腔。

e.en: In development, the {stomatodeum} helps form the mouth region.
e.zh: 在发育过程中，原口腔参与形成口部区域。

e.en: Researchers studied the crab's {stomatogastric} nervous system.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了螃蟹的口胃神经系统。

e.en: The {stomatogastric} rhythm controls parts of digestion.
e.zh: 口胃节律控制着部分消化活动。

e.en: A {stomatologist} treated the ulcer in her mouth.
e.zh: 一名口腔科医生治疗了她口中的溃疡。

e.en: The hospital hired a new {stomatologist} for complex cases.
e.zh: 医院聘请了一位新的口腔科医生处理复杂病例。

e.en: She chose {stomatology} as her medical specialty.
e.zh: 她选择口腔医学作为自己的医学专科。

e.en: Modern {stomatology} includes surgery, prevention, and diagnosis.
e.zh: 现代口腔医学包括外科、预防和诊断。

e.en: The dentist used a {stomatoscope} to inspect the lesion.
e.zh: 牙医用口腔检查镜查看那处病变。

e.en: An old {stomatoscope} lay in the medical display case.
e.zh: 一个旧口腔检查镜放在医学展柜里。

e.en: The textbook described several forms of {stomatosis}.
e.zh: 教科书描述了几种口腔病变。

e.en: Chronic {stomatosis} may require specialist treatment.
e.zh: 慢性口腔病变可能需要专科治疗。

e.en: The bird's {stomatotheca} was damaged in the accident.
e.zh: 那只鸟的喙鞘在事故中受损。

e.en: Researchers measured the {stomatotheca} of each specimen.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了每个标本的喙鞘。

e.en: The tiny organism is {stomatous} and feeds through a small opening.
e.zh: 这种微小生物有口，通过一个小开口进食。

e.en: A {stomatous} leaf surface allows gas exchange.
e.zh: 具气孔的叶面能够进行气体交换。

e.en: The diagram showed the {stomodaeal} opening in the embryo.
e.zh: 图中显示了胚胎的原口腔开口。

e.en: The {stomodaeal} region develops into part of the mouth.
e.zh: 原口腔区域会发育成口部的一部分。

e.en: The {stomodaeum} appears early in embryonic development.
e.zh: 原口腔在胚胎发育早期出现。

e.en: In many arthropods, the {stomodaeum} forms part of the foregut.
e.zh: 在许多节肢动物中，前肠由原口腔部分形成。

e.en: He wore heavy {stompers} through the muddy field.
e.zh: 他穿着厚重的大靴子走过泥地。

e.en: The upstairs {stompers} kept everyone awake at night.
e.zh: 楼上那些重步走路的人让大家夜里睡不着。

e.en: He crushed the {stompie} under his shoe.
e.zh: 他用鞋底踩灭了那个烟蒂。

e.en: A few {stompies} littered the pavement outside the bar.
e.zh: 酒吧外的人行道上散落着几个烟蒂。

e.en: The museum displayed {stone-age} tools and weapons.
