e.zh: 导演让莉娜为开场戏画分镜。

e.en: We should {story-board} the customer journey before designing the app.
e.zh: 设计应用前，我们应该先把用户流程做成分镜。

e.en: The novel has a confusing {story-line} near the end.
e.zh: 这部小说到结尾附近情节有些混乱。

e.en: Fans complained that the show's main {story-line} moved too slowly.
e.zh: 粉丝抱怨这部剧的主线剧情推进得太慢。

e.en: Her {story-post} disappeared after twenty-four hours.
e.zh: 她的限时故事帖二十四小时后就消失了。

e.en: The campaign used a short {story-post} to announce the sale.
e.zh: 这次活动用一条简短的故事帖宣布促销。

e.en: The magazine hired a young {storywriter} for its children's section.
e.zh: 这本杂志为儿童栏目聘请了一位年轻故事作者。

e.en: A good {storywriter} can make ordinary events feel dramatic.
e.zh: 优秀的故事作者能把普通事件写得很有戏剧感。

e.en: The antelope began to {stot} across the grassland.
e.zh: 羚羊开始在草原上蹦跳着前进。

e.en: Some deer {stot} when they notice a predator nearby.
e.zh: 有些鹿发现附近有捕食者时会跳跃前行。

e.en: The young gazelle was a graceful {stoter} on the plain.
e.zh: 那只年轻瞪羚是平原上优雅跳跃的动物。

e.en: Researchers filmed each {stoter} as it crossed the open ground.
e.zh: 研究人员拍下每只跳跃前进的动物穿过空地的过程。

e.en: He found a single {stotinka} in the old drawer.
e.zh: 他在旧抽屉里找到一枚保加利亚小面额硬币。

e.en: The price was rounded because no one had a {stotinka}.
e.zh: 因为没人有斯托廷卡零钱，价格被四舍五入了。

e.en: The bus ticket used to cost fifty {stotinki}.
e.zh: 这张公交票过去要五十斯托廷卡。

e.en: She kept a few {stotinki} as souvenirs from Bulgaria.
e.zh: 她留了几枚斯托廷卡当作保加利亚纪念品。

e.en: The biologist noted that this species is a frequent {stotter}.
e.zh: 生物学家指出这个物种经常跳跃前进。

e.en: A nervous {stotter} may leap high before running away.
e.zh: 紧张的跳跃动物可能先高高跳起再逃走。

e.en: She filled the {stotty} with ham and cheese.
e.zh: 她在厚圆面包里夹了火腿和奶酪。

e.en: The old pony looked {stotty} but surprisingly strong.
e.zh: 那匹老矮马看起来敦实，却出奇地强壮。

e.en: For a {stound}, the room was completely silent.
e.zh: 有那么一小会儿，房间里完全安静。

e.en: A sharp {stound} of pain ran through his arm.
e.zh: 一阵剧痛掠过他的手臂。

e.en: The report revealed a {stounding} level of waste.
e.zh: 报告揭示了惊人的浪费程度。

e.en: Her recovery was {stounding} to everyone at the clinic.
e.zh: 她的康复让诊所里的每个人都感到震惊。

e.en: The meeting turned into a political {stoush}.
e.zh: 会议变成了一场政治争吵。

e.en: Police broke up a {stoush} outside the pub.
e.zh: 警方制止了酒吧外的一场打斗。

e.en: The {stout-hearted} captain refused to abandon the ship.
e.zh: 那位勇敢坚定的船长拒绝弃船。

e.en: They needed a {stout-hearted} leader during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间他们需要一位勇敢坚定的领袖。

e.en: She {stout-heartedly} defended her decision before the board.
e.zh: 她在董事会面前勇敢坚定地为自己的决定辩护。

e.en: The villagers {stout-heartedly} rebuilt after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，村民们坚定勇敢地重建家园。

e.en: His {stout-heartedness} inspired the exhausted team.
e.zh: 他的勇敢坚定鼓舞了疲惫的团队。

e.en: The story celebrates quiet {stout-heartedness} in ordinary people.
e.zh: 这个故事赞颂普通人身上沉静的刚毅。

e.en: Good food and rest began to {stouten} the child.
e.zh: 充足的食物和休息开始让孩子变得结实。

e.en: The young tree will {stouten} as its trunk thickens.
e.zh: 随着树干变粗，这棵小树会变得更壮。

e.en: A {stoutish} man waited beside the ticket office.
e.zh: 一个有点胖的男人在售票处旁边等着。

e.en: The vase had a {stoutish} shape with a narrow neck.
e.zh: 这个花瓶外形略显敦实，瓶颈很窄。

e.en: The local {stovemaker} repaired our old iron range.
e.zh: 当地的炉具制造商修好了我们的旧铁炉灶。

e.en: A skilled {stovemaker} can design a stove for a tiny cabin.
e.zh: 熟练的炉具制造商能为小木屋设计炉子。

e.en: Keep the {stovetop} clean after cooking dinner.
e.zh: 做完晚饭后要把灶台擦干净。

e.en: The soup simmered on the {stovetop} for an hour.
e.zh: 汤在炉灶上小火炖了一个小时。

e.en: We ate hot {stovies} after the winter walk.
e.zh: 冬日散步后，我们吃了热乎乎的苏格兰土豆炖肉。

e.en: Her grandmother made {stovies} with leftover roast beef.
e.zh: 她祖母用剩下的烤牛肉做了苏格兰土豆炖菜。

e.en: He slipped away {stownlins} before the guests noticed.
e.zh: 他趁客人还没注意，偷偷溜走了。

e.en: The children shared the sweets {stownlins} behind the shed.
e.zh: 孩子们在棚子后面暗中分吃糖果。

e.en: He raised a wooden {stowp} at the feast.
e.zh: 宴会上他举起一个木制酒杯。

e.en: The old inn kept a silver {stowp} above the hearth.
e.zh: 那家老客栈把一只银杯放在壁炉上方。

e.en: The mason set a firm {stoy} under the beam.
e.zh: 石匠在横梁下安了一根牢固的支柱。

e.en: Without the central {stoy}, the frame began to sag.
e.zh: 没有中间的支撑物，框架开始下沉。

e.en: The doctor noted a slight {strabismal} tendency in the child.
e.zh: 医生注意到这个孩子有轻微的斜视倾向。

e.en: Older texts sometimes describe crossed eyes as {strabismal}.
e.zh: 较早的文献有时把斗鸡眼描述为斜视的。

e.en: The clinic offers therapy for {strabismic} patients.
e.zh: 这家诊所为斜视患者提供治疗。

e.en: A {strabismic} eye may turn inward or outward.
e.zh: 斜视的眼睛可能向内或向外偏斜。

e.en: The surgeon studied the child's {strabismical} condition carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细研究了孩子的斜视状况。

e.en: The article used the older term {strabismical} for eye misalignment.
e.zh: 那篇文章用较旧的“斜视的”一词来指眼位不正。

e.en: The specialist measured the angle with a {strabismometer}.
e.zh: 专科医生用斜视测量仪测量角度。

e.en: An old {strabismometer} sat in the ophthalmology museum.
e.zh: 眼科博物馆里放着一台旧斜视测量仪。

e.en: The textbook described {strabotomy} as an early eye operation.
e.zh: 教科书把斜视矫正手术描述为早期眼科手术。

e.en: Modern techniques have largely replaced traditional {strabotomy}.
e.zh: 现代技术已在很大程度上取代了传统斜视手术。

stracciatella.t: 意式蛋花汤；巧克力碎冰淇淋

e.en: She ordered {stracciatella} gelato after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后她点了巧克力碎意式冰淇淋。

e.en: The chef served {stracciatella} soup with fresh parsley.
e.zh: 厨师端上撒了新鲜欧芹的意式蛋花汤。

e.en: The old road ran {strack} across the moor.
e.zh: 那条古道笔直地穿过荒原。

e.en: He kept a {strack} rule over the household.
e.zh: 他用严格的规矩管理家里。

e.en: The historian described the battle as a terrible {strage}.
e.zh: 历史学家把那场战斗描述为可怕的大屠杀。

e.en: After the election, newspapers called the result a political {strage}.
e.zh: 选举后，报纸称这个结果是一场政治惨败。

e.en: His beard looked {stragglier} after a week outdoors.
e.zh: 在户外待了一周后，他的胡子显得更凌乱了。

e.en: The hedge grew {stragglier} near the dry end of the garden.
e.zh: 篱笆在花园较干的一头长得更稀疏。

e.en: She trimmed the {straggliest} branches first.
e.zh: 她先修剪那些最凌乱的枝条。

e.en: The {straggliest} runner still finished the race.
e.zh: 那个落得最远的选手还是跑完了比赛。

e.en: The museum displayed a Roman {stragulum} beside the bedframe.
e.zh: 博物馆在床架旁展出了一件罗马覆盖物。

e.en: A coarse {stragulum} protected the goods during travel.
e.zh: 一块粗糙的毯状覆盖物在旅途中保护货物。

storify.t: 把素材编成故事式叙述

e.en: The app can {storify} a stream of short posts.
e.zh: 这个应用能把一连串短帖编成故事式叙述。

e.en: Journalists often {storify} scattered facts into a clear narrative.
e.zh: 记者常把零散事实整理成清晰的故事叙述。

e.en: Her thesis explored {storiology} in modern video games.
e.zh: 她的论文研究现代电子游戏中的故事学。

e.en: The course treats {storiology} as a branch of narrative theory.
e.zh: 这门课把故事学视为叙事理论的一个分支。

e.en: The {storm-beaten} lighthouse still guided ships at night.
e.zh: 那座饱受风暴侵袭的灯塔夜里仍为船只导航。

e.en: They found shelter in a {storm-beaten} cottage by the cliff.
e.zh: 他们在悬崖边一间被风雨打旧的小屋里避难。

e.en: The town lies within a dangerous {storm-belt}.
e.zh: 这座小镇位于危险的风暴多发带内。

e.en: Meteorologists mapped the coastal {storm-belt} after years of data.
e.zh: 气象学家根据多年数据绘制了沿海风暴带。

storm-card.t: 风暴信号牌；风暴警报牌

e.en: The harbor master raised a {storm-card} before sunset.
e.zh: 港务长在日落前升起了风暴警报牌。

e.en: Sailors checked the {storm-card} before leaving port.
e.zh: 水手们离港前查看了风暴信号牌。

e.en: A dark {storm-cloud} gathered above the valley.
e.zh: 一片乌黑的暴风云在山谷上空聚集。

e.en: Debt became a {storm-cloud} over the young company.
e.zh: 债务成了笼罩这家年轻公司的不祥阴影。

e.en: The coastguard hoisted the {storm-cone} as winds strengthened.
e.zh: 风势增强时，海岸警卫队升起了风暴信号锥。

e.en: Fishermen watched the {storm-cone} before deciding to sail.
e.zh: 渔民们先看风暴信号锥，再决定是否出海。

storm-drum.t: 风暴鼓声；暴风般的鼓响

e.en: We heard the {storm-drum} of rain on the roof.
e.zh: 我们听见雨点在屋顶上敲出暴风般的鼓响。

e.en: The ritual began with a deep {storm-drum}.
e.zh: 仪式以一阵低沉如风暴的鼓声开始。

e.en: The {storm-tossed} boat finally reached the harbor.
e.zh: 那艘被风暴抛荡的小船终于抵达港口。

e.en: He wrote about a {storm-tossed} life of exile.
e.zh: 他写下了自己漂泊动荡的流亡人生。

e.en: The novel describes a ruthless {storm-trooper} in battle.
e.zh: 小说描写了一名在战斗中冷酷无情的突击队员。

e.en: Historically, a {storm-trooper} belonged to a special assault unit.
e.zh: 从历史上看，冲锋队员属于特殊突击部队。

e.en: Flights were diverted around the {storm-zone}.
e.zh: 航班绕开了风暴影响区域。

e.en: Residents inside the {storm-zone} received evacuation alerts.
e.zh: 风暴区内的居民收到了疏散警报。

e.en: We were {stormbound} in the mountain cabin for two days.
e.zh: 我们因暴风雨在山间小屋里困了两天。

e.en: The {stormbound} passengers slept on the station floor.
e.zh: 那些因风暴受困的旅客睡在车站地板上。

e.en: The new {stormbreaker} protected the harbor from heavy waves.
e.zh: 新的破浪堤保护港口免受巨浪冲击。

e.en: They planted trees as a living {stormbreaker}.
e.zh: 他们种下树木，作为一道活的防风屏障。

e.en: She packed a {stormcoat} for the wet hike.
e.zh: 她为这次潮湿的徒步带上了一件防风雨外套。

e.en: His old {stormcoat} kept out the rain remarkably well.
e.zh: 他的旧防雨外套挡雨效果出奇地好。

e.en: A {stormcock} sang loudly from the bare tree.
e.zh: 一只槲鸫在光秃秃的树上高声鸣叫。

e.en: Country people once treated the {stormcock} as a weather sign.
e.zh: 乡下人过去把槲鸫看作天气变化的征兆。

e.en: They crossed the sea during a {stormful} week.
e.zh: 他们在一个多风暴的星期里渡过了大海。

e.en: The king faced a {stormful} period of rebellion.
e.zh: 国王面临一段叛乱四起的动荡时期。

e.en: She left the room {stormily} after the argument.
e.zh: 争吵之后，她怒气冲冲地离开了房间。

e.en: The waves crashed {stormily} against the pier.
e.zh: 海浪风暴般地拍打着码头。

e.en: The island is known for its winter {storminess}.
e.zh: 这座岛以冬季多风暴而闻名。

e.en: There was real {storminess} in his reply.
e.zh: 他的回答里带着真正激烈的情绪。

e.en: We enjoyed a rare {stormless} night at sea.
e.zh: 我们在海上度过了一个少有的无风暴夜晚。

e.en: Her childhood was almost {stormless} and secure.
e.zh: 她的童年几乎平静安稳，没有什么波折。

e.en: The shelter is {stormproof} enough for coastal winds.
e.zh: 这处避难所足以抵御沿海强风暴。

e.en: They installed {stormproof} windows before hurricane season.
e.zh: 飓风季来临前，他们安装了抗风雨窗户。

e.en: The sheep grazed on a {stormswept} hillside.
e.zh: 羊群在被风暴横扫过的山坡上吃草。

e.en: He loved the lonely, {stormswept} coast.
e.zh: 他喜爱那片孤寂而饱受风暴吹打的海岸。

stormward.t: 朝风暴方向；迎向风暴的

e.en: The ship turned {stormward} despite the warnings.
e.zh: 尽管收到警告，那艘船仍转向风暴方向。

e.en: He made a {stormward} journey into the dark hills.
e.zh: 他朝着风暴来临的方向，走进黑暗的群山。

e.en: The singer ended with a playful {stornello}.
e.zh: 歌手最后唱了一首俏皮的意大利民歌短诗。

e.en: A {stornello} often has a light, improvised feeling.
e.zh: 意大利民歌短诗常带有轻快的即兴感。

e.en: The inspector measured the {straigheness} of the beam.
e.zh: 检查员测量了这根梁的笔直程度。

e.en: Its poor {straigheness} made the board hard to fit.
e.zh: 它的直度很差，所以木板很难装上。

straight-arm.t: 伸直手臂推开；僵硬拒绝

e.en: The runner used a {straight-arm} to keep the defender away.
e.zh: 跑锋用伸直手臂的动作挡开防守队员。

e.en: She gave the proposal a firm {straight-arm}.
e.zh: 她坚决地拒绝了这个提议。

e.en: A {straight-backed} woman sat near the window.
e.zh: 一位背挺得很直的女人坐在窗边。

e.en: The room had only two {straight-backed} chairs.
e.zh: 房间里只有两把直靠背椅子。

e.en: He bought {straight-cut} jeans for work.
e.zh: 他买了一条上班穿的直筒牛仔裤。

e.en: Use a ruler to make a {straight-cut} edge.
e.zh: 用尺子切出一条笔直的边。

e.en: Draw the line with a {straight-edge}.
e.zh: 用直尺把这条线画出来。

e.en: He joined the {straight-edge} punk scene in college.
e.zh: 他大学时加入了拒绝烟酒毒品的清规戒律朋克圈。

e.en: The old sedan had a smooth {straight-eight} engine.
e.zh: 那辆老轿车装着运转平顺的直列八缸发动机。

e.en: Collectors still praise the {straight-eight} for its quiet power.
e.zh: 收藏家仍称赞直列八缸发动机动力安静而充沛。

e.en: She stayed {straight-faced} during the silly speech.
e.zh: 那段傻乎乎的演讲中，她一直板着脸。

e.en: He made a {straight-faced} apology that fooled no one.
e.zh: 他一本正经地道歉，但没有骗过任何人。

e.en: He {straight-facedly} claimed he had never seen the cake.
e.zh: 他一本正经地声称自己从没见过那块蛋糕。

e.en: She {straight-facedly} delivered the absurd instruction.
e.zh: 她板着脸说出了那条荒唐的指示。

e.en: We need a {straight-from-the-shoulder} answer today.
e.zh: 我们今天需要一个直截了当的答复。

e.en: His {straight-from-the-shoulder} style upset some managers.
e.zh: 他坦率直接的风格让一些经理不太舒服。

e.en: Choose {straight-grained} wood for the frame.
e.zh: 给框架选用木纹顺直的木材。

e.en: The carpenter preferred {straight-grained} oak for carving.
e.zh: 木匠更喜欢用纹理直的橡木来雕刻。

e.en: The patient was placed in a {straight-jacket}.
e.zh: 病人被套上了束缚衣。

e.en: The old rules became a {straight-jacket} for the team.
e.zh: 旧规则成了束缚这个团队的枷锁。

e.en: The hospital no longer uses {straight-jackets}.
e.zh: 这家医院不再使用束缚衣。

e.en: Rigid budgets {straight-jackets} creative planning.
e.zh: 僵硬的预算限制束缚了创意规划。

e.en: She prefers {straight-leg} trousers with flats.
e.zh: 她喜欢用平底鞋搭配直筒长裤。

e.en: The trainer added a {straight-leg} raise to the routine.
e.zh: 教练在训练中加入了直腿抬高动作。

e.en: He stood {straight-legged} at attention.
e.zh: 他双腿挺直地立正站着。

e.en: The dancer made a {straight-legged} jump.
e.zh: 舞者做了一个直腿跳跃。

e.en: The city is only a {straight-line} mile away.
e.zh: 按直线距离算，那座城市只有一英里远。

e.en: Managers wanted a {straight-line} process for approvals.
e.zh: 经理们想要一个直接明了的审批流程。

e.en: She told him {straight-out} that he was wrong.
e.zh: 她直截了当地告诉他，他错了。

e.en: They refused the offer {straight-out}.
e.zh: 他们毫不犹豫地拒绝了这个报价。

straight-ticket.t: 全投同党候选人的选票

e.en: Many voters cast a {straight-ticket} ballot.
e.zh: 许多选民投了同一政党的整张选票。

e.en: The campaign relied on {straight-ticket} support.
e.zh: 这场竞选依赖选民全投本党候选人的支持。

e.en: Everyone saw him as a reliable {straightarrow}.
e.zh: 大家都把他看作可靠又循规蹈矩的人。

e.en: The film turns the {straightarrow} officer into a rebel.
e.zh: 影片把那位正派警官塑造成了反叛者。

straightbred.t: 纯种培育的；血统纯正的

e.en: The farm advertised {straightbred} cattle for sale.
e.zh: 农场登广告出售纯种培育的牛。

e.en: A {straightbred} line can be vulnerable to disease.
e.zh: 血统单一的品系可能更容易感染疾病。

straightfoward.t: 直截了当的；简单明了的

e.en: The task looked {straightfoward} at first.
e.zh: 这项任务起初看起来很简单明了。

e.en: He gave a {straightfoward} explanation of the mistake.
e.zh: 他对这个错误作了直截了当的解释。

straightlaced.t: 古板拘谨的；一本正经的

e.en: Her {straightlaced} parents disliked the loud party.
e.zh: 她古板拘谨的父母不喜欢那场吵闹的聚会。

e.en: The comedy mocks a {straightlaced} office culture.
e.zh: 这部喜剧嘲讽了一种一本正经的办公室文化。

e.en: The machinist selected a {straightreamer} for the hole.
e.zh: 机工选用直槽铰刀来加工这个孔。

e.en: A dull {straightreamer} can damage the metal surface.
e.zh: 变钝的直槽铰刀会损伤金属表面。

e.en: The engineer installed a {strainmeter} on the bridge.
e.zh: 工程师在桥上安装了一台应变测量仪。

e.en: Data from the {strainmeter} showed slow movement underground.
e.zh: 应变计的数据表明地下正在缓慢移动。

e.en: The lab calibrated the {strainometer} before testing.
e.zh: 实验室在测试前校准了应变仪。

e.en: A sensitive {strainometer} recorded tiny changes in the sample.
e.zh: 灵敏的应变仪记录了样品中的细微变化。

e.en: The novel imagines a harsh {stratocracy} after the civil war.
e.zh: 这部小说设想内战后出现了严酷的军人统治。

e.en: In a {stratocracy}, generals often control civilian offices.
e.zh: 在军政府体制下，将领往往掌控文职机构。

e.en: Low {stratocumulus} covered the coast all morning.
e.zh: 低低的层积云整个上午笼罩着海岸。

e.en: Pilots reported broken {stratocumulus} near the airport.
e.zh: 飞行员报告机场附近有零散的层积云。

e.en: The archaeologist used {stratography} to interpret the buried walls.
e.zh: 考古学家用地层记录法解读埋在地下的墙体。

e.en: Careful {stratography} revealed several phases of occupation.
e.zh: 细致的层序描述揭示了几段不同的居住时期。

e.en: Temperatures rise near the {stratopause} before falling again higher up.
e.zh: 气温在平流层顶附近升高，随后在更高处又下降。

e.en: The balloon carried instruments close to the {stratopause}.
e.zh: 气球把仪器带到了接近平流层顶的高度。

e.en: Engineers once dreamed of a fast {stratoplane} for long routes.
e.zh: 工程师们曾设想用高速高空飞机执行远程航线。

e.en: The experimental {stratoplane} needed a pressurized cabin.
e.zh: 这架实验性平流层飞机需要增压座舱。

e.en: The cliff showed a {stratose} pattern of pale and dark rock.
e.zh: 峭壁呈现出浅色和深色岩层相间的层状纹理。

e.en: A {stratose} cloud sheet spread across the winter sky.
e.zh: 一片层状云铺展在冬日天空中。

e.en: The instruments measured winds {stratospherically} above the storm.
e.zh: 这些仪器测量了风暴上方平流层中的风。

e.en: Housing prices rose {stratospherically} after the new rail line opened.
e.zh: 新铁路开通后，房价飙升到极高水平。

e.en: Mount Fuji is a famous {stratovolcano} with a graceful cone.
e.zh: 富士山是一座著名的成层火山，锥形山体优美。

e.en: A {stratovolcano} can produce explosive eruptions and ash clouds.
e.zh: 成层火山可能发生爆炸式喷发并产生火山灰云。

e.en: He {straucht} his back after hours at the loom.
e.zh: 他在织机前坐了几小时后伸直了背。

e.en: The old dialect word {straucht} means to stretch or straighten.
e.zh: 这个古老方言词straucht的意思是伸展或拉直。

e.en: They liked to {stravage} through the old lanes at dusk.
e.zh: 他们喜欢黄昏时在老巷子里闲逛。

e.en: After work, she would {stravage} without any fixed destination.
e.zh: 下班后，她常常没有固定目的地地到处游荡。

e.en: We decided to {stravaig} around Glasgow for the afternoon.
e.zh: 我们决定下午在格拉斯哥四处闲逛。

e.en: He would {stravaig} for miles when he needed to think.
e.zh: 他需要思考时，会漫无目的地走上好几英里。

e.en: She {stravaigs} through markets whenever she visits a new city.
e.zh: 每到一座新城市，她都会在市场里闲逛。

e.en: His weekend {stravaigs} often ended in tiny seaside pubs.
e.zh: 他的周末游荡常常以走进海边小酒馆告终。

e.en: She wore a {straw-colored} linen dress to the picnic.
e.zh: 她穿着一条稻草色的亚麻裙去野餐。

e.en: The dog had {straw-colored} fur and bright eyes.
e.zh: 那只狗有淡黄色的毛和明亮的眼睛。

e.en: The cottage had {straw-coloured} walls and blue shutters.
e.zh: 那间小屋有淡黄色的墙和蓝色百叶窗。

e.en: A {straw-coloured} liquid filled the glass tube.
e.zh: 玻璃管里装着一种稻草色的液体。

e.en: He wore a wide {straw-hat} in the summer fields.
e.zh: 他在夏天的田野里戴着一顶宽边草帽。

e.en: The shop sells a simple {straw-hat} for beach trips.
e.zh: 这家店卖一种适合海边旅行的简单草帽。

e.en: Her {strait-laced} aunt disapproved of dancing after dinner.
e.zh: 她那位拘谨守旧的姨妈不赞成晚饭后跳舞。

e.en: The office used to be too {strait-laced} for casual clothes.
e.zh: 这间办公室过去太一本正经，不适合穿休闲服。

e.en: The patient was placed in a {strait-waistcoat} for safety.
e.zh: 为了安全，病人被套上了紧身约束衣。

e.en: Those rules became a {strait-waistcoat} for creative teachers.
e.zh: 那些规定成了束缚有创造力教师的枷锁。

e.en: The failed harvest began to {straiten} the whole village.
e.zh: 歉收开始使整个村庄陷入窘迫。

e.en: Rigid customs can {straiten} a young person's choices.
e.zh: 僵硬的习俗会限制年轻人的选择。

e.en: The war was {straitening} supplies across the region.
e.zh: 战争正在使整个地区的物资变得紧缺。

e.en: She felt the {straitening} effect of family expectations.
e.zh: 她感到家庭期望带来的束缚作用。

e.en: Debt {straitens} families who already live modestly.
e.zh: 债务使本来就过得节俭的家庭更加窘迫。

e.en: A narrow doctrine {straitens} honest public debate.
e.zh: 狭隘的教条限制了坦诚的公共辩论。

e.en: Victorian manners seemed to {straitlace} every public gesture.
e.zh: 维多利亚式礼仪似乎把每个公开举止都束缚住了。

e.en: Do not {straitlace} the children with needless rules.
e.zh: 不要用不必要的规矩把孩子们管得太拘谨。

e.en: His {straitlaced} parents expected formal speech at meals.
e.zh: 他拘谨守旧的父母要求吃饭时说话也要正式。

e.en: The town looked respectable but painfully {straitlaced}.
e.zh: 这座小镇看起来体面，却拘谨得令人难受。

e.en: He began to {stram} across the muddy field.
e.zh: 他开始大步穿过泥泞的田地。

e.en: The angry guard would {stram} through the corridor.
e.zh: 那名愤怒的卫兵会粗鲁地穿过走廊。

e.en: There was a terrible {stramash} outside the stadium.
e.zh: 体育场外发生了一场可怕的混乱。

e.en: The meeting ended in a political {stramash}.
e.zh: 会议最后变成了一场政治上的吵闹争执。

e.en: The bird had pale {stramineous} feathers on its breast.
e.zh: 那只鸟胸前有淡淡的稻草色羽毛。

e.en: A {stramineous} hat hung beside the cottage door.
e.zh: 一顶稻草色的帽子挂在小屋门旁。

e.en: The old herbal text warned that {stramonium} was poisonous.
e.zh: 那本旧草药书警告说曼陀罗有毒。

e.en: Doctors once used {stramonium} in very controlled doses.
e.zh: 医生过去曾在严格控制剂量下使用曼陀罗药材。

e.en: The gardener removed the {stramony} from the path.
e.zh: 园丁把小路边的曼陀罗草清除了。

e.en: Old remedies sometimes mentioned {stramony} for asthma.
e.zh: 旧时偏方有时提到用曼陀罗治疗哮喘。

e.en: Each {strandee} received a blanket at the airport.
e.zh: 每名滞留者都在机场领到了一条毯子。

e.en: A rescued {strandee} thanked the volunteers on camera.
e.zh: 一名获救的受困者在镜头前感谢志愿者。

e.en: Shells were scattered across the wide {strandflat}.
e.zh: 贝壳散落在宽阔的海滨平地上。

e.en: The tide slowly covered the muddy {strandflat}.
e.zh: 潮水慢慢淹没了泥泞的潮滩。

e.en: Seaweed marked the {strandline} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，海藻标出了海滩的潮痕线。

e.en: Researchers mapped the ancient {strandline} above the bay.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了海湾上方的古岸线。

e.en: The killer tried to {strangulate} his victim.
e.zh: 凶手试图勒死受害者。

e.en: Swelling can {strangulate} blood flow to the tissue.
e.zh: 肿胀会阻断流向组织的血液。

e.en: A tight cord {strangulates} the young tree.
e.zh: 一根紧绳勒住了那棵小树。

e.en: The hernia {strangulates} part of the intestine.
e.zh: 疝气使部分肠道发生绞窄。

e.en: He was accused of {strangulating} the prisoner.
e.zh: 他被指控勒住那名囚犯使其窒息。

e.en: The doctor found a {strangulating} loop of tissue.
e.zh: 医生发现了一圈造成绞窄的组织。

e.en: The patient described a {strangurious} pain each morning.
e.zh: 病人说每天早晨都有排尿疼痛。

e.en: Old medical notes recorded {strangurious} symptoms after fever.
e.zh: 旧病历记录了发热后的排尿困难症状。

e.en: The infection caused severe {strangury} at night.
e.zh: 感染导致夜间严重尿痛。

e.en: Ancient physicians wrote about {strangury} in detail.
e.zh: 古代医师曾详细记述排尿困难。

e.en: The museum displayed a small sample of {stranskiite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一小块斯特兰斯基石样本。

e.en: Miners rarely find {stranskiite} in large crystals.
e.zh: 矿工很少能发现大晶体的斯特兰斯基石。

e.en: Every {strap-hanger} swayed as the train stopped suddenly.
e.zh: 火车突然停下时，每个站立乘客都摇晃了一下。

e.en: The mayor promised better service for the weary {strap-hanger}.
e.zh: 市长承诺为疲惫的通勤族改善服务。

strap-laid.t: 加带铺设的；带状加固的

e.en: The carpenter used {strap-laid} boards for extra strength.
e.zh: 木匠使用带状加固的木板来增加强度。

e.en: A {strap-laid} cable ran beneath the old floor.
e.zh: 一根加带铺设的电缆从旧地板下穿过。

e.en: The sailor feared {strap-oil} more than the storm.
e.zh: 那名水手害怕旧时的鞭打惩罚甚于暴风雨。

e.en: The old schoolmaster jokingly called discipline {strap-oil}.
e.zh: 那位老校长开玩笑把管教称作鞭打惩罚。

e.en: Commuters had to {straphang} during the crowded ride.
e.zh: 通勤者在拥挤的车程中只好拉着吊环站乘。

e.en: I learned to {straphang} without losing my balance.
e.zh: 我学会了拉吊环站着而不失去平衡。

e.en: Every {straphanger} on the train looked exhausted.
e.zh: 车上每个拉吊环站着的乘客都显得很疲惫。

e.en: The newspaper wrote about the daily life of a {straphanger}.
e.zh: 报纸写到了地铁站乘族的日常生活。

e.en: The plant had long {straplike} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物长着细长的带状叶子。

e.en: A {straplike} band of leather held the case shut.
e.zh: 一条像皮带的皮革带把箱子扣住了。

e.en: She sat on a {strapontin} near the theater aisle.
e.zh: 她坐在剧院过道旁的一张折叠小座椅上。

e.en: The old carriage had a narrow {strapontin} by the door.
e.zh: 那节旧车厢门边有一张狭窄的折叠小座椅。

e.en: The prisoner was threatened with the {strappado}.
e.zh: 囚犯受到要施以吊腕酷刑的威胁。

e.en: Historians described the {strappado} as a brutal punishment.
e.zh: 历史学家把吊腕酷刑描述为一种残酷惩罚。

e.en: The records mention several {strappadoes} in the prison.
e.zh: 记录中提到监狱里发生过几次吊腕酷刑。

e.en: Such {strappadoes} were condemned by later reformers.
e.zh: 这种吊腕酷刑后来受到改革者谴责。

e.en: The ceiling was covered with painted {strapwork}.
e.zh: 天花板上布满了彩绘的带状装饰纹样。

e.en: Renaissance furniture often used carved {strapwork}.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的家具常采用雕刻的带状纹饰。

e.en: The botanist found {strapwort} growing near the marsh.
e.zh: 植物学家发现沼泽附近长着一种带叶草本植物。

e.en: Old herbals listed {strapwort} among useful plants.
e.zh: 古老草药书把strapwort列为有用植物之一。

e.en: Her costume glittered with {strass} stones.
e.zh: 她的戏服上镶着水钻，闪闪发亮。

e.en: The necklace was not diamond but {strass}.
e.zh: 那条项链不是钻石，而是仿钻玻璃。

e.en: His clever {stratage} saved the company money.
e.zh: 他的巧妙计谋为公司省了钱。

e.en: The general relied on {stratage} rather than force.
e.zh: 那位将军依靠策略而不是武力。

e.en: Her {stratagemical} answer avoided a direct refusal.
e.zh: 她那带有策略性的回答避免了直接拒绝。

e.en: The play depends on a {stratagemical} exchange of letters.
e.zh: 这部戏依靠一次充满计谋的书信交换推进情节。

e.en: The map shows several {stratal} boundaries.
e.zh: 这张地图显示了几条地层边界。

e.en: Geologists studied the {stratal} pattern in the cliff.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了悬崖中的层状结构。

e.en: The army chose a {strategetic} position on the hill.
e.zh: 军队在山上选择了一个战略位置。

e.en: Her {strategetic} planning impressed the committee.
e.zh: 她的策略性规划给委员会留下了深刻印象。

e.en: The {strategos} led the city army into battle.
e.zh: 这位古希腊将军率领城邦军队投入战斗。

e.en: In Athens, a {strategos} could hold great political power.
e.zh: 在雅典，统帅可能拥有很大的政治权力。

e.en: The Roman writer praised the {strategus} for his caution.
e.zh: 那位罗马作家称赞这名统帅行事谨慎。

e.en: A skilled {strategus} avoided unnecessary battles.
e.zh: 高明的古代将军会避免不必要的战斗。

e.en: The lower {strati} contain older fossils.
e.zh: 较低的地层含有更古老的化石。

e.en: Researchers compared the {strati} from two valleys.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了两个山谷中的地层。

e.en: Pressure can {straticulate} the soft sediment.
e.zh: 压力会使柔软沉积物形成细层。

e.en: The sample appeared {straticulate} under the lens.
e.zh: 样本在镜头下显得呈细层状。

e.en: The rock shows clear {straticulation} after weathering.
e.zh: 岩石风化后显示出清晰的细层结构。

e.en: The report discusses {straticulation} in lake deposits.
e.zh: 报告讨论了湖泊沉积物中的细层化现象。

e.en: The mine contains a {stratiform} ore body.
e.zh: 这座矿中有一个层状矿体。

e.en: A {stratiform} cloud covered the afternoon sky.
e.zh: 层云状的云覆盖了午后的天空。

e.en: The observer recorded a cloud variety called {stratiformis}.
e.zh: 观测员记录了一种称为层状云的云类变种。

e.en: Altocumulus {stratiformis} spread across the western sky.
e.zh: 层状高积云铺展在西边天空。

e.en: The {stratigrapher} dated the layers by their fossils.
e.zh: 地层学家根据化石确定各层年代。

e.en: A careful {stratigrapher} notices tiny changes in sediment.
e.zh: 细心的地层学家会注意沉积物中的细微变化。

e.en: The pilots trained inside a {stratochamber}.
e.zh: 飞行员在平流层模拟舱内接受训练。

e.en: Engineers used the {stratochamber} to test pressure suits.
e.zh: 工程师用平流层模拟舱测试加压服。

e.en: Thin {stratocirrus} drifted above the mountains.
e.zh: 薄薄的层状卷云飘过群山上空。

e.en: The forecast mentioned {stratocirrus} before sunset.
e.zh: 天气预报提到日落前会有层状卷云。

e.en: The model house was built from {strawboard}.
e.zh: 这座模型房子是用草板做成的。

e.en: Old boxes used cheap {strawboard} instead of wood.
e.zh: 旧箱子用廉价的稻草纸板代替木材。

e.en: She planted {strawflowers} along the sunny path.
e.zh: 她在阳光充足的小路旁种了蜡菊。

e.en: A dried {strawflower} kept its bright color.
e.zh: 一朵干燥的草花仍保持着鲜艳的颜色。

e.en: He wore a wide {strawhat} in the field.
e.zh: 他在田里戴着一顶宽边草帽。

e.en: Her old {strawhat} hung by the door.
e.zh: 她的旧草帽挂在门边。

e.en: The {strawtrusser} worked beside the barn all morning.
e.zh: 那个捆草工整个上午都在谷仓旁干活。

e.en: A skilled {strawtrusser} could bind a stack quickly.
e.zh: 熟练的捆稻草工能很快扎好一堆草。

e.en: The fair hired a {strawwalker} to amuse children.
e.zh: 集市雇了一个踩高跷的人来逗孩子们开心。

e.en: A careful {strawwalker} crossed the wet meadow slowly.
e.zh: 一个小心走草地的人慢慢穿过湿草甸。

e.en: A {strawworm} curled under the dry stalk.
e.zh: 一条草虫蜷在干草茎下面。

e.en: The farmer blamed {strawworms} for the damaged thatch.
e.zh: 农夫认为茅草受损是食草小虫造成的。

e.en: The horse chewed the {strawy} hay slowly.
e.zh: 那匹马慢慢嚼着像稻草一样的干草。

e.en: Her hair looked dry and {strawy} after swimming.
e.zh: 游泳后，她的头发显得干枯发黄。

e.en: Security chased the {streakers} across the pitch.
e.zh: 保安追着那些裸奔者穿过球场。

e.en: The sky was full of bright {streakers} during the meteor shower.
e.zh: 流星雨时，天空布满了明亮飞掠的光迹。

streakier.t: 条纹更多的；更不均匀的

e.en: This bacon is {streakier} than the last pack.
e.zh: 这包培根比上一包肥瘦条纹更多。

e.en: The paint looked {streakier} after the second coat.
e.zh: 刷第二遍后，油漆看起来更不均匀了。

streakiest.t: 条纹最多的；最不均匀的

e.en: She chose the {streakiest} marble for the countertop.
e.zh: 她为台面选了纹理最多的大理石。

e.en: That window was the {streakiest} after cleaning.
e.zh: 清洁后，那扇窗反而是痕迹最明显的。

e.en: The ink dried {streakily} on the glossy paper.
e.zh: 墨水在光面纸上干得一道一道的。

e.en: Sunlight fell {streakily} through the broken blinds.
e.zh: 阳光透过破损的百叶窗斑驳地洒下来。

e.en: The photographer liked the {streakiness} of the rain on glass.
e.zh: 摄影师喜欢雨水在玻璃上形成的条纹感。

e.en: Extra sanding reduced the {streakiness} in the finish.
e.zh: 多打磨一下减少了表面的不均匀。

e.en: Her novel uses a {stream-of-consciousness} style.
e.zh: 她的小说采用意识流写法。

e.en: He gave a {stream-of-consciousness} speech with no clear order.
e.zh: 他发表了一段意识流式的讲话，毫无清晰顺序。

e.en: Heavy rain increased the {streamflow} overnight.
e.zh: 大雨使夜间河川流量增加了。

e.en: Scientists measured {streamflow} below the dam.
e.zh: 科学家在大坝下游测量溪流流量。

e.en: The library improved {streamhandling} for large video files.
e.zh: 这个库改进了大型视频文件的数据流处理。

e.en: Good {streamhandling} prevents the app from freezing.
e.zh: 良好的流处理能防止应用卡死。

e.en: The poem has a quiet {streaminess} in its rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗的节奏有一种安静的流水感。

e.en: Designers praised the {streaminess} of the fabric pattern.
e.zh: 设计师称赞这种布料图案的流动感。

e.en: They crossed a dry, {streamless} valley at noon.
e.zh: 中午他们穿过一个干燥无溪流的山谷。

e.en: The {streamless} pipe made the pump overheat.
e.zh: 没有水流的管道让水泵过热。

e.en: A clear {streamlet} ran behind the cottage.
e.zh: 一条清澈的小溪从小屋后面流过。

e.en: Meltwater formed a {streamlet} beside the road.
e.zh: 融雪水在路边形成了一股细流。

e.en: We ate lunch on a {streamside} rock.
e.zh: 我们坐在溪边的一块石头上吃午饭。

e.en: The {streamside} plants stayed green through summer.
e.zh: 溪畔的植物整个夏天都保持青绿。

e.en: The valley was cool and {streamy} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后山谷清凉，到处有溪流。

e.en: Her music had a soft, {streamy} quality.
e.zh: 她的音乐有一种柔和如流水的感觉。

e.en: They {streek} the cloth across the table.
e.zh: 他们把布在桌上铺展开。

e.en: Old villagers would {streek} the body before burial.
e.zh: 旧时村民会在下葬前把遗体安放平直。

e.en: The neighbors called her a {streel} because of her torn coat.
e.zh: 邻居因她穿着破外套而叫她邋遢女人。

e.en: He began to {streel} his feet through the dust.
e.zh: 他开始拖着脚穿过尘土。

e.en: She took the {street-car} downtown every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上坐有轨电车去市中心。

e.en: An old {street-car} rattled past the hotel.
e.zh: 一辆老式有轨电车哐当哐当地驶过旅馆。

e.en: A musician played trumpet on the {street-corner}.
e.zh: 一名乐手在街角吹小号。

e.en: They held a {street-corner} meeting after work.
e.zh: 下班后他们在街头角落开了个小会。

e.en: The police broke up a violent {street-gang} last year.
e.zh: 警方去年瓦解了一个暴力街头帮派。

e.en: He joined a {street-gang} when he was only thirteen.
e.zh: 他年仅十三岁时就加入了街头帮派。

e.en: A broken {street-lamp} left the corner dark.
e.zh: 一盏坏掉的路灯让街角一片昏暗。

e.en: She waited under the old {street-lamp}.
e.zh: 她在那盏旧路灯下等着。

e.en: The {street-light} outside my window stays on all night.
e.zh: 我窗外的路灯整夜都亮着。

e.en: Turn left at the next {street-light}.
e.zh: 在下一个交通信号灯处左转。

e.en: We used a {street-map} to find the hotel.
e.zh: 我们用街道地图找到了那家酒店。

e.en: The tourist folded the {street-map} into his pocket.
e.zh: 游客把街道地图折好塞进口袋。

e.en: The {street-market} sells fresh fruit every morning.
e.zh: 这个露天街市每天早上卖新鲜水果。

e.en: We bought handmade bowls at a busy {street-market}.
e.zh: 我们在热闹的街头市场买了手工碗。

e.en: The old {street-plan} shows lanes that no longer exist.
e.zh: 这张旧街道规划图标出了如今已不存在的小巷。

e.en: Urban designers revised the {street-plan} after public comments.
e.zh: 城市设计师根据公众意见修改了街道规划图。

e.en: A {street-sweeper} cleared leaves from the curb.
e.zh: 一名清扫街道的人把路边的落叶扫走了。

e.en: The noisy {street-sweeper} passed our house before dawn.
e.zh: 那辆吵闹的扫街车天亮前经过了我家。

e.en: A {street-trader} sold hot chestnuts near the station.
e.zh: 一个街头小贩在车站附近卖热栗子。

e.en: The council gave each {street-trader} a numbered permit.
e.zh: 市政会给每个街头小贩发了编号许可证。

e.en: We took a slow {street-walk} through the old quarter.
e.zh: 我们在老城区沿街慢慢散步。

e.en: The report described how women were forced to {street-walk}.
e.zh: 报告描述了一些女性如何被迫在街头拉客卖淫。

e.en: The novel portrays a lonely {street-walker} without sentimentality.
e.zh: 这部小说冷静地描写了一名孤独的街头妓女。

e.en: Police arrested a suspected {street-walker} near the hotel.
e.zh: 警方在酒店附近逮捕了一名疑似街头妓女。

e.en: He learned {streetball} on the courts behind his school.
e.zh: 他是在学校后面的球场学会街头篮球的。

e.en: The tournament mixed professional players with {streetball} legends.
e.zh: 这场锦标赛把职业球员和街头篮球传奇人物聚到了一起。

e.en: His {streetboard} has two pivoting foot plates.
e.zh: 他的街板有两个可转动的踏板。

e.en: She practiced turns on a {streetboard} after class.
e.zh: 她课后用街板练习转弯。

e.en: The app downloaded a detailed {streetmap} of Berlin.
e.zh: 这个应用下载了一份柏林的详细街道地图。

e.en: A faded {streetmap} hung behind the taxi desk.
e.zh: 出租车服务台后面挂着一张褪色的街道地图。

e.en: The guide offers a morning {streetwalk} through historic alleys.
e.zh: 导游提供一条清晨穿过历史小巷的沿街步行路线。

e.en: Some victims were pressured to {streetwalk} for money.
e.zh: 一些受害者被迫在街头拉客赚钱。

e.en: The law treated {streetwalking} as a public-order offence.
e.zh: 法律把街头卖淫视为扰乱公共秩序的行为。

e.en: Her photographs capture ordinary {streetwalking} in the rain.
e.zh: 她的照片捕捉了雨中普通人沿街行走的景象。

e.en: The cat slipped {streetward} through the open gate.
e.zh: 那只猫从敞开的门溜出去，朝街道方向跑去。

e.en: A narrow passage led {streetward} from the courtyard.
e.zh: 一条狭窄通道从院子通向街道方向。

e.en: A {streetworker} visits homeless teenagers at night.
e.zh: 一名街头社工夜里探访无家可归的青少年。

e.en: The {streetworker} repaired potholes after the storm.
e.zh: 那名街道工人在暴风雨后修补路坑。

e.en: The form contained the typo {strenghth} instead of strength.
e.zh: 表格里把strength误拼成了strenghth。

e.en: Her teacher marked {strenghth} as a spelling mistake.
e.zh: 老师把strenghth标为拼写错误。

e.en: After the fever, he felt almost {strengthless}.
e.zh: 发烧过后，他几乎觉得浑身无力。

e.en: The argument seemed {strengthless} without any evidence.
e.zh: 没有任何证据，这个论点显得缺乏说服力。

e.en: The {strenuosity} of the climb surprised everyone.
e.zh: 这次攀登的艰苦程度让所有人都很意外。

e.en: He admired the {strenuosity} of her daily training.
e.zh: 他佩服她日常训练的高强度。

e.en: The {strepitant} machines shook the factory floor.
e.zh: 轰鸣的机器震得工厂地面发抖。

e.en: A {strepitant} cheer rose from the crowded stadium.
e.zh: 拥挤的体育场里爆发出喧闹的欢呼声。

e.en: The finale should be played {strepitoso}, with reckless energy.
e.zh: 终曲应当强烈响亮地演奏，带着奔放的力量。

e.en: The orchestra entered {strepitoso} after a sudden pause.
e.zh: 短暂停顿后，管弦乐队以喧闹强烈的方式进入。

e.en: The {strepitous} crowd drowned out the speaker.
e.zh: 喧闹的人群盖过了演讲者的声音。

e.en: A {strepitous} crash came from the kitchen.
e.zh: 厨房里传来一声轰响。

e.en: The culture grew faster after {strepogenin} was added.
e.zh: 加入链霉菌生长因子后，培养物生长得更快。

e.en: Researchers tested {strepogenin} in several bacterial media.
e.zh: 研究人员在几种细菌培养基中测试了链霉菌生长因子。

e.en: The biologist identified a {strepsipterous} parasite in the specimen.
e.zh: 生物学家在标本中鉴定出一种捻翅目寄生昆虫。

e.en: Its {strepsipterous} features were visible under magnification.
e.zh: 放大后可以看到它具有捻翅目昆虫的特征。

e.en: The assay used {streptavidin} to capture biotinylated proteins.
e.zh: 该检测使用链霉亲和素捕获生物素化蛋白。

e.en: Scientists coated the plate with {streptavidin} before adding samples.
e.zh: 科学家在加入样品前用链霉亲和素包被了平板。

e.en: {Streptidine} forms part of the streptomycin molecule.
e.zh: 链霉胍胺是链霉素分子的一部分。

e.en: The chemist analyzed {streptidine} derivatives in the lab.
e.zh: 化学家在实验室分析了链霉胍胺衍生物。

e.en: {Streptimidone} was isolated from a soil microorganism.
e.zh: 链霉酰亚胺酮是从一种土壤微生物中分离出来的。

e.en: The paper describes {streptimidone} as an antibiotic compound.
e.zh: 论文把链霉酰亚胺酮描述为一种抗生素化合物。

e.en: A {streptobacillus} infection can follow a rat bite.
e.zh: 链杆菌感染可能发生在鼠咬之后。

e.en: The microscope showed chains typical of {streptobacillus}.
e.zh: 显微镜显示出链杆菌典型的链状排列。

e.en: {Streptobiosamine} is a sugar component of streptomycin.
e.zh: 链霉二糖胺是链霉素中的一种糖组分。

e.en: The analysis detected {streptobiosamine} after hydrolysis.
e.zh: 水解后，分析检测到了链霉二糖胺。

e.en: She grew a purple {streptocarpus} on the windowsill.
e.zh: 她在窗台上种了一株紫色的旋蒴苣苔。

e.en: The greenhouse specializes in {streptocarpus} hybrids.
e.zh: 这座温室专门培育旋蒴苣苔杂交品种。

streptococcic.t: 链球菌的；由链球菌引起的

e.en: The doctor suspected a {streptococcic} throat infection.
e.zh: 医生怀疑这是链球菌引起的咽喉感染。

e.en: {Streptococcic} bacteria spread quickly in crowded rooms.
e.zh: 链球菌类细菌在拥挤的房间里传播很快。

streptodornase.t: 链道酶；链球菌脱氧核糖核酸酶

e.en: The treatment included {streptodornase} to break down pus.
e.zh: 治疗中使用链道酶来分解脓液。

e.en: {Streptodornase} can reduce the viscosity of infected material.
e.zh: 链道酶可以降低感染物质的黏稠度。

e.en: The culture grew faster after {strepogenin} was added.
e.zh: 加入链霉菌生长因子后，培养物生长得更快。

e.en: Researchers tested {strepogenin} in several bacterial media.
e.zh: 研究人员在几种细菌培养基中测试了链霉菌生长因子。

e.en: The resistant infection responded to a {streptogramin} antibiotic.
e.zh: 这种耐药感染对一种链阳菌素类抗生素有反应。

e.en: {Streptogramin} drugs are sometimes combined for stronger effect.
e.zh: 链阳菌素类药物有时会联合使用以增强效果。

e.en: {Streptolydigin} inhibits bacterial RNA polymerase.
e.zh: 链霉溶菌素会抑制细菌RNA聚合酶。

e.en: The study used {streptolydigin} to block transcription.
e.zh: 这项研究使用链霉溶菌素来阻断转录。

e.en: The test measured antibodies against {streptolysin}.
e.zh: 该检测测量了针对链球菌溶血素的抗体。

e.en: {Streptolysin} can damage red blood cells.
e.zh: 链球菌溶血素会损伤红细胞。

e.en: A soil {streptomycete} produced the new antibiotic.
e.zh: 一种土壤链霉菌类细菌产生了这种新抗生素。

e.en: The lab screened each {streptomycete} for useful metabolites.
e.zh: 实验室筛查每种链霉菌类细菌是否产生有用代谢物。

e.en: {Streptonigrin} showed strong activity against tumor cells.
e.zh: 链黑菌素对肿瘤细胞表现出很强活性。

e.en: The researchers handled {streptonigrin} with special caution.
e.zh: 研究人员在处理链黑菌素时格外小心。

e.en: {Streptose} is one component of the streptomycin structure.
e.zh: 链霉糖是链霉素结构中的一个组成部分。

e.en: The reaction released {streptose} from the antibiotic molecule.
e.zh: 该反应从抗生素分子中释放出链霉糖。

e.en: {Streptothricin} was studied for its antibacterial properties.
e.zh: 人们研究链丝菌素类抗生素的抗菌特性。

e.en: The isolate produced a {streptothricin} compound in culture.
e.zh: 该分离株在培养中产生了一种链丝菌素类化合物。

e.en: The veterinarian diagnosed {streptothricosis} in the cattle.
e.zh: 兽医诊断这群牛患有链丝菌病。

e.en: Wet weather can worsen outbreaks of {streptothricosis}.
e.zh: 潮湿天气会加重链丝菌病的暴发。

e.en: The old article spelled the compound {streptothrycin}.
e.zh: 那篇旧文章把这种化合物拼作链丝菌素的异拼形式。

e.en: Some catalogs list {streptothrycin} as a variant name.
e.zh: 有些目录把streptothrycin列为链丝菌素的变体名称。

e.en: {Streptovaricin} blocks RNA synthesis in bacteria.
e.zh: 链霉瓦利菌素会阻断细菌中的RNA合成。

e.en: The team compared {streptovaricin} with rifamycin antibiotics.
e.zh: 团队将链霉瓦利菌素与利福霉素类抗生素进行了比较。

e.en: Researchers used {streptozotocin} to induce diabetes in mice.
e.zh: 研究人员用链脲佐菌素诱导小鼠患糖尿病。

e.en: The doctor discussed {streptozotocin} as a treatment option.
e.zh: 医生讨论了把链脲佐菌素作为一种治疗选择。

e.en: The dictionary places a {stress-mark} before the main syllable.
e.zh: 这本词典在主重音音节前标出重音符号。

e.en: Add a {stress-mark} to show how the word is pronounced.
e.zh: 加上一个重音符号来表示这个词的读法。

e.en: The engineer plotted a {stress-strain} curve for the metal.
e.zh: 工程师绘制了这种金属的应力应变曲线。

e.en: Their report compares {stress-strain} behavior under heat.
e.zh: 他们的报告比较了高温下的应力应变行为。

e.en: English is often described as a {stress-timed} language.
e.zh: 英语常被描述为一种重音计时语言。

e.en: In {stress-timed} speech, unstressed syllables may become shorter.
e.zh: 在重音计时的语流中，非重读音节可能会变短。

e.en: Only certain syllables are {stressable} in this pattern.
e.zh: 在这种模式中，只有某些音节可以加重音。

e.en: The material is {stressable} but returns to its shape quickly.
e.zh: 这种材料可以受压，但很快会恢复原状。

stressed-out.t: 压力很大的；焦虑疲惫的

e.en: She felt {stressed-out} before the final exam.
e.zh: 期末考试前，她感到压力很大。

e.en: After weeks of overtime, the team looked {stressed-out}.
e.zh: 连续几周加班后，团队看起来焦虑又疲惫。

e.en: They wanted a {stressless} holiday by the sea.
e.zh: 他们想要一个在海边度过的轻松假期。

e.en: Good planning can make the move almost {stressless}.
e.zh: 周密计划能让搬家几乎没有压力。

e.en: Meditation gave her a rare feeling of {stresslessness}.
e.zh: 冥想让她难得地感到毫无压力。

e.en: The resort sells an image of complete {stresslessness}.
e.zh: 这家度假村营造出一种完全轻松无压的形象。

e.en: The app works like a simple {stressometer} for daily moods.
e.zh: 这个应用像一个简单的压力测量器，用来记录每日情绪。

e.en: He joked that his inbox needed a {stressometer}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说自己的收件箱需要一个压力测量器。

e.en: A pale {stretch-mark} showed on her hip.
e.zh: 她臀部露出一道浅色的皮肤扩张纹。

e.en: Many people get a {stretch-mark} after rapid weight changes.
e.zh: 许多人在体重快速变化后会出现皮肤扩张纹。

e.en: You should {stretch-out} your legs after the flight.
e.zh: 飞行结束后你应该伸展一下双腿。

e.en: They tried to {stretch-out} the project over three months.
e.zh: 他们试图把这个项目延长到三个月。

e.en: He lay {stretched-out} on the sofa.
e.zh: 他伸展开身体躺在沙发上。

e.en: The meeting felt {stretched-out} and unfocused.
e.zh: 这场会议让人觉得拖得很长，而且没有重点。

e.en: A {stretcher-bearer} carried the injured player away.
e.zh: 一名担架搬运员把受伤的球员抬走了。

e.en: During the war, he served as a {stretcher-bearer}.
e.zh: 战争期间，他担任担架搬运员。

e.en: Two {stretcher-bearers} entered the field quickly.
e.zh: 两名担架搬运员迅速进入球场。

e.en: The {stretcher-bearers} worked under heavy shellfire.
e.zh: 这些担架搬运员在猛烈炮火下工作。

e.en: A {stretcher-party} was sent to the front line.
e.zh: 一支担架队被派往前线。

e.en: The hospital organized a {stretcher-party} after the crash.
e.zh: 事故发生后，医院组织了一支担架队。

e.en: This fabric is {stretchier} than the old one.
e.zh: 这种布料比旧的更有弹性。

e.en: The dough becomes {stretchier} after resting.
e.zh: 面团静置后会变得更有延展性。

e.en: Choose the {stretchiest} band for this exercise.
e.zh: 做这个练习时选择最有弹性的带子。

e.en: The {stretchiest} dough made the best noodles.
e.zh: 延展性最好的面团做出了最好的面条。

e.en: She noticed a new {stretchmark} on her thigh.
e.zh: 她注意到大腿上有一道新的皮肤扩张纹。

e.en: A {stretchmark} can fade over time.
e.zh: 皮肤扩张纹会随着时间慢慢变淡。

e.en: The opera ends with a brilliant {stretta}.
e.zh: 这部歌剧以一段精彩的结尾加速段收尾。

e.en: The conductor drove the {stretta} forward with energy.
e.zh: 指挥充满力量地推进那段结尾加速段。

e.en: {Streuth}, that was a close call!
e.zh: 天哪，刚才真是好险！

e.en: He looked at the bill and said, {streuth}.
e.zh: 他看到账单后说了一声，哎呀。

e.en: A {strewment} of petals covered the path.
e.zh: 一片散落的花瓣铺满了小路。

e.zh: 那座火山整夜都出现斯特龙博利式的间歇喷发。

e.en: Geologists recorded a {strombolian} eruption with glowing lava fountains.
e.zh: 地质学家记录到一次伴有发光熔岩喷泉的斯特龙博利式喷发。

e.en: The specimen has a {strombuliform} outline near the aperture.
e.zh: 这个标本在壳口附近呈现出类似翼螺的轮廓。

e.en: She drew the {strombuliform} ornament in careful detail.
e.zh: 她细致地画下了那个螺壳形装饰。

e.en: The vein contains {stromeyerite} mixed with quartz.
e.zh: 这条矿脉中含有与石英混杂的硫银铜矿。

e.en: Collectors prize {stromeyerite} for its metallic luster.
e.zh: 收藏者看重硫银铜矿的金属光泽。

e.en: The landlord tried to {strong-arm} the tenants into leaving.
e.zh: 房东试图威逼租客搬走。

e.en: They used {strong-arm} tactics during the negotiation.
e.zh: 他们在谈判中用了强硬胁迫的手段。

e.en: She felt {strong-armed} into signing the agreement.
e.zh: 她觉得自己是被逼着签下了协议。

e.en: The committee {strong-armed} the proposal through a vote.
e.zh: 委员会强行推动那项提案通过了投票。

e.en: The union accused management of {strong-arming} workers.
e.zh: 工会指责管理层威逼工人。

e.en: His {strong-arming} only made the partners more resistant.
e.zh: 他的强行施压只让合伙人更加抵触。

e.en: The gang {strong-arms} shopkeepers for protection money.
e.zh: 那个团伙威逼店主交保护费。

e.en: She never {strong-arms} clients into buying extra services.
e.zh: 她从不强迫客户购买额外服务。

strong-bodied.t: 体格强壮的；酒体厚重的

e.en: A {strong-bodied} runner led the team uphill.
e.zh: 一名体格强壮的跑者带着队伍向山上跑。

e.en: This {strong-bodied} red wine suits roasted meat.
e.zh: 这款酒体厚重的红葡萄酒适合配烤肉。

e.en: The {strong-headed} child refused to apologize.
e.zh: 那个倔强的孩子拒绝道歉。

e.en: A {strong-headed} manager can ignore useful advice.
e.zh: 固执的经理可能会无视有用的建议。

e.en: A {strong-looking} guard stood by the gate.
e.zh: 一个看起来强壮的保安站在门口。

e.en: The bridge has a {strong-looking} steel frame.
e.zh: 这座桥有一个看起来很结实的钢架。

e.en: She is too {strong-minded} to follow every trend.
e.zh: 她很有主见，不会什么潮流都跟。

e.en: A {strong-minded} leader stayed calm under pressure.
e.zh: 一位意志坚定的领导者在压力下保持冷静。

e.en: Their {strong-willed} daughter wanted to choose her own school.
e.zh: 他们意志很强的女儿想自己选择学校。

e.en: You need a {strong-willed} team to finish this project.
e.zh: 完成这个项目需要一支意志坚定的团队。

e.en: Officials should not {strongarm} witnesses into changing stories.
e.zh: 官员不应威逼证人改变说法。

e.en: The report described several {strongarm} methods used by debt collectors.
e.zh: 报告描述了讨债人使用的几种威逼手段。

strongbodied.t: 体格强壮的；酒体厚重的

e.en: The {strongbodied} horse pulled the cart easily.
e.zh: 那匹体格强壮的马轻松拉动了车。

e.en: They served a {strongbodied} coffee after dinner.
e.zh: 他们晚餐后端上了一杯口感浓厚的咖啡。

e.en: The {stronghearted} nurse worked through the crisis.
e.zh: 那位勇敢坚毅的护士挺过了危机中的工作。

e.en: Only a {stronghearted} person could face such loss calmly.
e.zh: 只有内心坚强的人才能平静面对这样的失去。

e.en: The tea is {strongish}, but not bitter.
e.zh: 这茶味道挺浓，但不苦。

e.en: There was a {strongish} smell of paint in the hall.
e.zh: 大厅里有一股比较明显的油漆味。

e.en: The vet found a {strongyle} infection in the horse.
e.zh: 兽医发现这匹马感染了圆线虫。

e.en: A {strongyle} can damage the intestines of grazing animals.
e.zh: 圆线虫会损害放牧动物的肠道。

e.en: The sample contained a {strongylid} egg under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，这个样本里有一枚圆线虫类虫卵。

e.en: Researchers tracked {strongylid} parasites in wild horses.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了野马体内的圆线虫类寄生虫。

e.en: The medieval bestiary described a {strix} as a night bird.
e.zh: 中世纪动物志把strix描述成夜间活动的鸟。

e.en: In Roman folklore, the {strix} was feared as an omen.
e.zh: 在罗马民间传说中，strix被视为可怕的凶兆。

e.en: They liked to {stroam} through the lanes after supper.
e.zh: 他们喜欢晚饭后在小巷里慢慢闲逛。

e.en: The old diary says he would {stroam} for hours by the river.
e.zh: 旧日记里说，他常在河边游荡好几个小时。

e.en: The wounded man began to {stroan} in the dark room.
e.zh: 伤者在黑暗的房间里开始低声呻吟。

e.en: Old poems sometimes use {stroan} for a mournful sound.
e.zh: 古诗有时用stroan表示哀伤的声音。

e.en: The engineer measured the {strobic} effect on the rotating fan.
e.zh: 工程师测量了旋转风扇上的频闪效应。

e.en: A {strobic} lamp can make motion appear strangely frozen.
e.zh: 频闪灯会让运动看起来像被奇怪地定住。

e.en: The botanist examined the pine {strobil} under a lens.
e.zh: 植物学家用放大镜观察松树的球果。

e.en: Each {strobil} carried many tightly packed reproductive scales.
e.zh: 每个球果上都有许多紧密排列的繁殖鳞片。

e.en: The parasite's {strobila} is made of many repeating segments.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫的绦虫体节链由许多重复体节组成。

e.en: In jellyfish development, a {strobila} releases young medusae.
e.zh: 在水母发育中，横裂体会释放幼小水母。

e.en: The plant bears a {strobilaceous} cluster near the stem tip.
e.zh: 这种植物在茎端附近长着松果状的簇。

e.en: Its {strobilaceous} structure protects the developing spores.
e.zh: 它的球果状结构保护正在发育的孢子。

e.en: The jellyfish polyp undergoes {strobilation} in spring.
e.zh: 水母的水螅体在春季进行横裂生殖。

e.en: Researchers filmed {strobilation} as the segments separated.
e.zh: 研究人员拍下了体节分离时的横裂过程。

e.en: A pine cone is a familiar kind of {strobile}.
e.zh: 松果是一种常见的球果。

e.en: The fossil {strobile} helped identify the ancient plant.
e.zh: 这枚化石孢子叶穗帮助确认了那种古植物。

e.en: Temperature changes can trigger {strobilization} in some jellyfish.
e.zh: 温度变化会触发某些水母的横裂生殖。

e.en: The textbook explains {strobilization} in tapeworm development.
e.zh: 教材解释了绦虫发育中的体节形成过程。

e.en: The lab used a {strobophonometer} to study vocal vibrations.
e.zh: 实验室用频闪测音仪研究声带振动。

e.en: A damaged {strobophonometer} made the acoustic readings unreliable.
e.zh: 损坏的频闪测音仪让声学读数变得不可靠。

e.en: The physician compared each {stroboradiograph} frame carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细比较了每一帧频闪射线照片。

e.en: A {stroboradiograph} can show rapid motion inside a joint.
e.zh: 频闪射线照片能显示关节内部的快速运动。

e.en: The hospital tested {stroboradiography} for swallowing disorders.
e.zh: 医院测试了频闪射线摄影术来检查吞咽障碍。

e.en: Early {stroboradiography} required careful timing of the flashes.
e.zh: 早期频闪射线摄影需要精确控制闪光时机。

e.en: The mechanic used a {stroboscope} to check the engine timing.
e.zh: 机械师用频闪仪检查发动机点火正时。

e.en: Under the {stroboscope}, the spinning disk seemed still.
e.zh: 在频闪灯下，旋转的圆盘看起来像静止了一样。

e.en: The rotor was filmed {stroboscopically} during the stress test.
e.zh: 转子在压力测试中以频闪方式被拍摄。

e.en: Viewed {stroboscopically}, the dancer's movement looked fragmented.
e.zh: 以频闪方式观看时，舞者的动作显得断断续续。

e.en: The old camera relied on a {strobotron} for bright flashes.
e.zh: 这台老相机依靠频闪放电管产生强闪光。

e.en: Engineers replaced the failing {strobotron} in the timing system.
e.zh: 工程师更换了计时系统中失效的频闪放电管。

e.en: The sudden {strock} of metal startled the workers.
e.zh: 突如其来的金属撞击声吓了工人们一跳。

e.en: A single {strock} on the bell called everyone inside.
e.zh: 钟的一下敲击把大家叫进了屋里。

e.en: The village stood beside a narrow {strom}.
e.zh: 村庄坐落在一条狭窄的溪流旁。

e.en: Old maps marked the {strom} before it joined the river.
e.zh: 旧地图标出了这条溪流汇入河流前的位置。

e.en: The fungus formed dark {stromata} on the dead bark.
e.zh: 真菌在枯死树皮上形成了深色子座。

e.en: Geologists studied the layered {stromata} in the ancient rock.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了古岩石中的层状基质体。

e.en: The limestone contained irregular {stromatactoids} filled with calcite.
e.zh: 石灰岩中含有被方解石填充的不规则层孔状空腔体。

e.en: These {stromatactoids} help geologists interpret ancient reef deposits.
e.zh: 这些层孔状空腔体有助于地质学家解释古礁沉积。

e.en: The paper described {stromatin} as a protein in cell structure.
e.zh: 论文把stromatin描述为细胞结构中的一种蛋白。

e.en: Changes in {stromatin} may affect how the tissue holds together.
e.zh: stromatin的变化可能影响组织结合的方式。

e.en: The museum displayed a polished {stromatite} from an ancient shore.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块来自古海岸的抛光叠层岩。

e.en: A {stromatite} can preserve traces of early microbial life.
e.zh: 叠层岩可以保存早期微生物生命的痕迹。

e.en: The {stromatolith} showed fine layers built by microbes.
e.zh: 这块叠层石显示出由微生物形成的细密层理。

e.en: Scientists dated the {stromatolith} to the Precambrian era.
e.zh: 科学家把这块叠层岩测定为前寒武纪年代。

e.en: The cliff contains {stromatolitic} limestone from a shallow sea.
e.zh: 这处悬崖含有来自浅海的叠层石质石灰岩。

e.en: Researchers mapped the {stromatolitic} layers across the basin.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了盆地内叠层岩状层位的分布。

e.en: The lab identified a {strongyloid} parasite in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室在样本中发现了一种类圆线虫寄生虫。

e.en: Doctors suspected a {strongyloid} infection after the rash appeared.
e.zh: 皮疹出现后，医生怀疑是类圆线虫感染。

e.en: Untreated {strongyloidiasis} can become dangerous in weak patients.
e.zh: 类圆线虫病若不治疗，在体弱患者身上可能变得危险。

e.en: The clinic screens migrants for {strongyloidiasis}.
e.zh: 这家诊所会为移民筛查类圆线虫病。

e.en: The horse was treated for {strongylosis} in spring.
e.zh: 这匹马在春天接受了强线虫病治疗。

e.en: Severe {strongylosis} may cause weight loss in livestock.
e.zh: 严重的强线虫病可能导致牲畜体重下降。

e.en: The old text spelled strontium as {strontiam}.
e.zh: 那本旧书把锶写作strontiam这一旧式拼法。

e.en: A chemist marked {strontiam} as an obsolete term.
e.zh: 一位化学家把strontiam标注为过时术语。

e.en: The mineral showed a {strontian} composition under analysis.
e.zh: 分析显示这种矿物具有含锶成分。

e.en: Early chemists called the substance {strontian} earth.
e.zh: 早期化学家把这种物质称为锶土。

e.en: The collector bought a pale crystal of {strontianite}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一块浅色的菱锶矿晶体。

e.en: Miners once extracted strontium from {strontianite}.
e.zh: 矿工过去曾从菱锶矿中提取锶。

e.en: The paper describes a {strontic} compound used in ceramics.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种用于陶瓷的含锶化合物。

e.en: A {strontic} salt gave the flame a red color.
e.zh: 一种锶盐使火焰呈现红色。

e.en: The bell {strook} midnight in the poem.
e.zh: 诗中钟声敲响了午夜。

e.en: He {strook} the shield with his sword.
e.zh: 他用剑击打了盾牌。

e.en: Researchers measured {strophanthidin} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了植物提取物中的毒毛旋花苷元。

e.en: The drug's effect resembled that of {strophanthidin}.
e.zh: 这种药物的作用类似毒毛旋花苷元。

e.en: The physician mentioned {strophanthin} in an old pharmacology lecture.
e.zh: 医生在一堂旧药理课上提到了毒毛旋花苷。

e.en: Small doses of {strophanthin} affect the heart.
e.zh: 小剂量毒毛旋花苷会影响心脏。

e.en: The chemist isolated {strophanthobiose} from the glycoside.
e.zh: 化学家从糖苷中分离出了毒毛旋花二糖。

e.en: Few textbooks discuss {strophanthobiose} in detail.
e.zh: 很少有教材详细讨论毒毛旋花二糖。

e.en: The seeds of {strophanthus} contain powerful cardiac compounds.
e.zh: 毒毛旋花属植物的种子含有强效心脏活性化合物。

e.en: Explorers recorded {strophanthus} vines in the forest.
e.zh: 探险者记录了森林中的毒毛旋花藤本植物。

e.en: The hymn has a simple {strophic} form.
e.zh: 这首圣歌采用简单的分节歌形式。

e.en: Her lecture compared strophic and non-{strophic} poems.
e.zh: 她的讲座比较了诗节式和非诗节式诗歌。

e.en: The botanist pointed out the {strophiole} on the seed.
e.zh: 植物学家指出了种子上的种阜。

e.en: A small {strophiole} helps ants carry some seeds.
e.zh: 小小的种阜能帮助蚂蚁搬运某些种子。

strophoid.t: 螺旋状曲线的；似带状的

e.en: The diagram showed a {strophoid} curve crossing itself.
e.zh: 图中显示了一条自交的螺旋状曲线。

e.en: A {strophoid} pattern appeared in the mathematical model.
e.zh: 数学模型中出现了类似螺旋曲线的图案。

e.en: The infant's rash was diagnosed as {strophulus}.
e.zh: 这个婴儿的皮疹被诊断为婴儿丘疹性皮疹。

e.en: Old medical books often mention {strophulus}.
e.zh: 旧医学书中常提到婴儿丘疹性皮疹。

e.en: He became {stroppier} after waiting for an hour.
e.zh: 等了一个小时后，他变得更易怒。

e.en: The teenager sounded {stroppier} than usual today.
e.zh: 这个少年今天听起来比平时更难相处。

e.en: She was the {stroppiest} customer in the queue.
e.zh: 她是队伍里最难伺候的顾客。

e.en: Even his {stroppiest} remarks made us laugh.
e.zh: 即使是他最冲的那些话也让我们笑了。

e.en: They {strow} petals along the wedding path.
e.zh: 他们在婚礼通道上撒下花瓣。

e.en: Old winds {strow} leaves across the lane.
e.zh: 秋风把叶子撒满小巷。

e.en: The children {strowed} flowers before the procession.
e.zh: 孩子们在队伍前撒下鲜花。

e.en: Ashes were {strowed} over the cold ground.
e.zh: 灰烬被撒在冰冷的地面上。

e.en: The floor was {strown} with torn paper.
e.zh: 地板上散落着撕碎的纸片。

e.en: Stars seemed {strown} across the winter sky.
e.zh: 星星仿佛撒满了冬夜的天空。

e.en: She {strows} herbs over the soup before serving.
e.zh: 上菜前，她把香草撒在汤上。

e.en: The wind {strows} sand across the road.
e.zh: 风把沙子吹散到路面上。

e.en: The archaic verb {stroy} means to destroy.
e.zh: 古词stroy的意思是毁坏。

e.en: Wars can {stroy} cities in old chronicles.
e.zh: 在旧编年史中，战争会摧毁城市。

e.en: The line says he was {strucken} with fear.
e.zh: 这一行写着他被恐惧击中。

e.en: In dialect, the bell had {strucken} noon.
e.zh: 在方言中，这句话表示钟已敲响正午。

e.en: The parser stores each token in a {struct}.
e.zh: 解析器把每个标记存入一个结构体。

e.en: This C {struct} holds the user's settings.
e.zh: 这个C语言结构体保存用户设置。

e.en: The old text uses {struction} to mean building.
e.zh: 这篇旧文用struction表示建造。

e.en: His argument depends on the {struction} of the sentence.
e.zh: 他的论证取决于这个句子的构造。

e.en: Each {structon} was treated as a basic unit.
e.zh: 每个结构子都被视为基本单位。

e.en: The theory assigns a role to every {structon}.
e.zh: 该理论给每个结构单元都分配了作用。

e.en: The editor tried to {structuralize} the essay.
e.zh: 编辑试图把这篇文章整理成有结构的形式。

e.en: Some critics {structuralize} myths into repeated patterns.
e.zh: 一些评论家把神话按反复出现的模式来结构化解读。

e.en: The meeting felt {structureless} and exhausting.
e.zh: 这场会议显得毫无章法，令人疲惫。

e.en: A {structureless} liquid has no fixed internal pattern.
e.zh: 无结构液体没有固定的内部排列。

e.en: His early essays were influenced by {structurism}.
e.zh: 他的早期文章受到结构主义影响。

e.en: The course contrasts {structurism} with later theories.
e.zh: 这门课把结构论与后来的理论作比较。

e.en: A {structurist} might focus on hidden patterns.
e.zh: 结构主义者可能会关注隐藏的模式。

e.en: The architect was called a {structurist} by critics.
e.zh: 评论家称这位建筑师为结构论者。

e.en: We need to {structurize} the raw survey data.
e.zh: 我们需要把原始调查数据结构化。

e.en: The teacher helped students {structurize} their ideas.
e.zh: 老师帮助学生把想法组织成形。

e.en: Swift imagined a {struldbrug} cursed with endless age.
e.zh: 斯威夫特想象出一种受无尽衰老诅咒的不死人。

e.en: He joked that immortality would make him a {struldbrug}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说，永生会让他变成永老不死的人。

struldbruggian.t: 永老不死的；不死人般的

e.en: The novel gives immortality a {struldbruggian} horror.
e.zh: 这部小说把永生写成一种永老不死般的恐怖。

e.en: His {struldbruggian} fantasy soon turned bleak.
e.zh: 他那种不死人式的幻想很快变得阴郁。

e.en: The doctor examined the patient's {struma}.
e.zh: 医生检查了病人的甲状腺肿。

e.en: Old medical books often described {struma} in detail.
e.zh: 旧医学书常详细描述瘰疬性肿块。

e.en: Several {strumae} were noted during the examination.
e.zh: 检查中记录到几个甲状腺肿块。

e.en: The report compared benign and malignant {strumae}.
e.zh: 报告比较了良性和恶性的甲状腺肿块。

e.en: The surgeon recommended a {strumectomy} after testing.
e.zh: 检查后，外科医生建议做甲状腺肿切除术。

e.en: Recovery from {strumectomy} required careful monitoring.
e.zh: 甲状腺肿切除术后的恢复需要仔细监测。

e.en: The swelling was diagnosed as {strumitis}.
e.zh: 这处肿胀被诊断为甲状腺肿炎症。

e.en: Rare cases of {strumitis} can cause fever.
e.zh: 少见的甲状腺肿炎症病例可能引起发热。

e.en: The plant had a {strumose} base near the root.
e.zh: 这株植物靠近根部有瘰疬样的膨大基部。

e.en: Doctors described the neck as {strumose}.
e.zh: 医生把颈部描述为有肿块的。

e.en: The child showed signs of a {strumous} swelling.
e.zh: 这个孩子出现了瘰疬性肿胀的迹象。

e.en: A {strumous} condition was noted in the record.
e.zh: 病历中记录了一种甲状腺肿样病况。

e.en: The physician noted the tissue's {strumousness}.
e.zh: 医生注意到这块组织的瘰疬性特征。

e.en: Old diagnoses often relied on visible {strumousness}.
e.zh: 旧时诊断常依赖肉眼可见的肿块性表现。

strung-out.t: 筋疲力尽的；吸毒恍惚的

e.en: After three night shifts, she looked {strung-out}.
e.zh: 连续上了三个夜班后，她看起来筋疲力尽。

e.en: He was too {strung-out} to answer clearly.
e.zh: 他恍恍惚惚，没法清楚回答。

e.en: He began to {strunt} across the yard.
e.zh: 他开始昂首阔步地穿过院子。

e.en: Do not {strunt} just because you lost.
e.zh: 别因为输了就绷着脸闹别扭。

e.en: The collector labeled the yellow crystal as {strunzite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把这块黄色晶体标为纤磷铁矿。

e.en: Small sprays of {strunzite} formed in the cavity.
e.zh: 空洞里形成了小簇纤磷铁矿。

e.en: The engineer replaced the cracked {strutbeam}.
e.zh: 工程师更换了开裂的支撑梁。

e.en: A steel {strutbeam} kept the frame rigid.
e.zh: 一根钢制撑杆梁使框架保持刚性。

e.en: The fossil showed several {struthonian} features.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出几个鸵鸟类特征。

e.en: His {struthonian} stride made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他那鸵鸟般的大步走姿逗笑了大家。

e.en: The sample contained dark grains of {struverite}.
e.zh: 样本中含有深色的钽铁金红石颗粒。

e.en: Miners separated {struverite} from the heavy sand.
e.zh: 矿工从重砂中分离出钽铁金红石。

e.en: The kidney stone was made mostly of {struvite}.
e.zh: 这颗肾结石主要由鸟粪石构成。

e.en: Wastewater plants can recover {struvite} as fertilizer.
e.zh: 污水处理厂可以回收磷酸镁铵石作为肥料。

e.en: A single {stry} stuck to his coat.
e.zh: 一根细草茎粘在他的外套上。

e.en: The dialect word {stry} means a straw.
e.zh: 方言词stry的意思是一根稻草。

strychnia.t: 士的宁；番木鳖碱类似物或旧称

e.en: The old medical text mentioned {strychnia} as a dangerous stimulant.
e.zh: 那本旧医学书把士的宁称作一种危险的兴奋剂。

e.en: Investigators tested the powder for {strychnia} and other poisons.
e.zh: 调查人员检测了粉末中是否含有士的宁和其他毒物。

e.en: The chemist noted a {strychnic} odor in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家注意到样品中有类似士的宁的气味。

e.en: Old reports described the symptoms as {strychnic} poisoning.
e.zh: 旧报告把这些症状描述为士的宁中毒。

strychnin.t: 士的宁；番木鳖碱的旧拼法

e.en: The label used the older spelling {strychnin} for strychnine.
e.zh: 标签使用了strychnine的旧拼法士的宁。

e.en: A trace of {strychnin} was found in the vial.
e.zh: 小瓶中发现了微量士的宁。

strychninize.t: 用士的宁处理；使含士的宁

e.en: They tried to {strychninize} bait to kill pests.
e.zh: 他们试图给诱饵加士的宁来消灭害虫。

e.en: The verb {strychninize} appears mostly in old toxicology notes.
e.zh: 动词strychninize主要出现在旧毒理学笔记中。

e.en: The form contained a typo: {ststment} instead of statement.
e.zh: 表格里有个拼写错误，把statement写成了ststment。

e.en: She corrected {ststment} before sending the report.
e.zh: 她在发送报告前改正了ststment这个错词。

e.en: He picked the {stubbiest} candle from the drawer.
e.zh: 他从抽屉里挑了最短粗的蜡烛。

e.en: The {stubbiest} branch still carried several apples.
e.zh: 最粗短的那根树枝上仍挂着几个苹果。

e.en: The chair's {stubbiness} made it look sturdy.
e.zh: 这把椅子的短粗感让它看起来很结实。

e.en: She disliked the {stubbiness} of the cropped haircut.
e.zh: 她不喜欢这款短发显出的矮短感。

e.en: He was the {stubbornest} child in the class.
e.zh: 他是班上最倔强的孩子。

e.en: Even the {stubbornest} stain came out eventually.
e.zh: 就连最顽固的污渍最后也洗掉了。

stuccowork.t: 灰泥装饰；灰泥粉刷工程

e.en: The palace ceiling had elaborate {stuccowork}.
e.zh: 宫殿天花板上有精致的灰泥装饰。

e.en: Rain damaged the exterior {stuccowork} over time.
e.zh: 雨水久而久之损坏了外墙的灰泥粉刷。

e.en: She sounded {stuck-up} during the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试中听起来有点自命不凡。

e.en: People thought the club was too {stuck-up} for newcomers.
e.zh: 大家觉得这个俱乐部对新人太傲慢了。

e.en: The mare was listed in the national {studbook}.
e.zh: 这匹母马被登记在全国种畜血统簿中。

e.en: Breeders consult the {studbook} before pairing horses.
e.zh: 育种者在配种前会查阅血统登记簿。

e.en: The jeweler placed the ring on a small {studdie}.
e.zh: 珠宝匠把戒指放在一个小砧上。

e.en: A worn {studdie} lay beside the old workbench.
e.zh: 旧工作台旁放着一个磨损的小铁砧。

student-oriented.t: 以学生为中心的；面向学生的

e.en: The college launched a more {student-oriented} website.
e.zh: 学院推出了一个更面向学生的网站。

e.en: Her teaching style is highly {student-oriented}.
e.zh: 她的教学风格非常以学生为中心。

e.en: The school welcomed three {student-teachers} this term.
e.zh: 这所学校本学期接收了三名实习教师。

e.en: Experienced mentors observed the {student-teachers} in class.
e.zh: 有经验的导师在课堂上观察这些师范实习生。

e.en: The hatchery kept a strong {studfish} for breeding.
e.zh: 孵化场保留了一条强壮的雄性种鱼用于繁殖。

e.en: Farmers selected each {studfish} for size and health.
e.zh: 养殖户按体型和健康状况挑选每条种鱼。

e.en: The ranch bought a new {studhorse} last spring.
e.zh: 牧场去年春天买了一匹新的种马。

e.en: A valuable {studhorse} requires careful daily care.
e.zh: 一匹贵重的种马需要每天精心照料。

e.en: She is a careful {studier} of ancient maps.
e.zh: 她是一位细心研究古地图的人。

e.en: A serious {studier} needs quiet time every day.
e.zh: 认真的学习者每天都需要安静的时间。

studmuffin.t: 性感帅哥；有魅力的男人

e.en: His friends jokingly called him a {studmuffin}.
e.zh: 他的朋友们开玩笑地叫他性感帅哥。

e.en: The movie marketed its lead actor as a {studmuffin}.
e.zh: 这部电影把男主角宣传成很有魅力的男人。

studwork.t: 立柱骨架；墙体龙骨结构

e.en: The builder inspected the timber {studwork} before plastering.
e.zh: 施工人员在抹灰前检查了木质墙体龙骨。

e.en: New wiring was threaded through the {studwork}.
e.zh: 新的电线穿过了墙体立柱骨架。

stuntster.t: 玩特技的人；冒险表演者

e.en: The young {stuntster} loved dangerous motorcycle jumps.
e.zh: 那个年轻的冒险表演者喜欢危险的摩托车跳跃。

e.en: A veteran {stuntster} advised the actors on safety.
e.zh: 一位老练的特技表演者给演员们提出安全建议。

e.en: The {stuntwoman} jumped through the window herself.
e.zh: 那名女特技演员亲自从窗户跳了过去。

e.en: A skilled {stuntwoman} doubled for the lead actress.
e.zh: 一位技术娴熟的女特技演员替主演完成了动作戏。

stunty.t: 特技味很重的；发育不良的

e.en: The film felt too {stunty} and lacked a story.
e.zh: 这部电影特技味太重，缺少故事。

e.en: Poor soil left the shrubs small and {stunty}.
e.zh: 贫瘠的土壤让灌木长得矮小又发育不良。

e.en: The nurse packed the wound with {stupe}.
e.zh: 护士用麻絮填塞了伤口。

e.en: Old upholstery shed bits of {stupe} onto the floor.
e.zh: 旧家具的软垫把一些短纤维掉在了地板上。

e.en: The {stuped} cloth warmed his aching shoulder.
e.zh: 那块湿热敷过的布温暖了他酸痛的肩膀。

e.en: Her swollen wrist was gently {stuped} before bandaging.
e.zh: 包扎前，她肿胀的手腕被轻轻做了湿热敷。

stupefacient.t: 麻醉性的；使昏迷的药物

e.en: The doctor warned that the drug was {stupefacient}.
e.zh: 医生警告说这种药有麻醉致昏作用。

e.en: A {stupefacient} was sometimes used before surgery.
e.zh: 过去手术前有时会使用使人昏迷的药物。

e.en: The heat had a {stupefactive} effect on everyone.
e.zh: 炎热让每个人都变得昏昏沉沉。

e.en: He escaped the {stupefactive} routine of office life.
e.zh: 他摆脱了令人麻木的办公室日常。

e.en: Alcohol can become a {stupefier} rather than comfort.
e.zh: 酒精可能会变成麻木人的东西，而不是安慰。

e.en: The lecturer was a real {stupefier} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后那位讲师真让人昏昏欲睡。

e.en: They faced a {stupend} task in rebuilding the bridge.
e.zh: 他们面临着重建桥梁的巨大任务。

e.en: The old chronicle describes a {stupend} storm at sea.
e.zh: 那部旧编年史描写了一场惊人的海上风暴。

e.en: The plant had a {stupeous} covering on its stem.
e.zh: 这种植物的茎上有一层像麻絮的覆盖物。

e.en: A {stupeous} mass collected inside the old cushion.
e.zh: 旧坐垫里积了一团纤维状的东西。

e.en: The nurse was {stuping} the patient's bruised arm.
e.zh: 护士正在给病人瘀伤的手臂做湿热敷。

e.en: Repeated {stuping} eased the stiffness in his neck.
e.zh: 反复热敷缓解了他脖子的僵硬。

e.en: The leaf surface was slightly {stupulose} under the lens.
e.zh: 在镜头下，叶面略微覆有细绒毛。

e.en: Botanists noted the {stupulose} texture of the stem.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到茎部有细绒毛质感。

e.en: The frame {sturdied} after we added cross braces.
e.zh: 加上交叉支撑后，框架变得更结实了。

e.en: He {sturdied} the shelf with two extra screws.
e.zh: 他用两颗额外的螺丝把架子加固了。

e.en: The horse was {sturting} at every sudden noise.
e.zh: 那匹马一听到突然的声音就惊跳。

e.en: His {sturting} movements betrayed his nervousness.
e.zh: 他猛然一动一动的动作暴露了紧张。

e.en: He began to {stut} when the room went silent.
e.zh: 房间安静下来时，他开始结结巴巴。

e.en: The child would {stut} only when nervous.
e.zh: 那个孩子只有紧张时才会口吃。

e.en: Students held a {study-in} at the library overnight.
e.zh: 学生们在图书馆举行了通宵静坐读书抗议。

e.en: The peaceful {study-in} drew attention to tuition cuts.
e.zh: 这场和平的静坐读书活动引起了人们对削减学费补助的关注。

e.en: The room looked strangely {stuffless} after the move.
e.zh: 搬家后，这个房间看起来奇怪地空无一物。

e.en: His speech was polished but {stuffless}.
e.zh: 他的演讲很圆熟，却没有什么实质内容。

e.en: The farmer rode a {stuggy} little pony.
e.zh: 农夫骑着一匹矮胖结实的小马。

e.en: A {stuggy} tree grew beside the stone wall.
e.zh: 石墙旁长着一棵粗短结实的树。

e.en: The old {stull} held the tunnel roof in place.
e.zh: 那根旧矿井支柱撑住了隧道顶。

e.en: Miners replaced a cracked {stull} before entering.
e.zh: 矿工们进洞前更换了一根开裂的支撑木。

e.en: Water drained through the narrow {stulm} below the mine.
e.zh: 水从矿井下方狭窄的排水巷流走。

e.en: They mapped the forgotten {stulm} under the hillside.
e.zh: 他们绘出了山坡下那条被遗忘的矿井平硐。

e.en: Endless routine led to his gradual {stultification}.
e.zh: 无休止的例行事务让他逐渐变得麻木迟钝。

e.en: The policy caused the {stultification} of public debate.
e.zh: 这项政策压制了公共辩论的发展。

e.en: The vintner tasted the sweet {stum} before fermentation.
e.zh: 酿酒师在发酵前尝了尝甜甜的未发酵葡萄汁。

e.en: They used {stum} to revive a dull wine.
e.zh: 他们用新酒来改善一桶味道平淡的酒。

e.en: The comedy cast him as a lovable {stumblebum}.
e.zh: 这部喜剧把他塑造成一个可爱的笨手笨脚的人。

e.en: Critics called the corrupt official a political {stumblebum}.
e.zh: 评论人士把那个腐败官员称作政治上的废物。

e.en: Funding became the main {stumbling-block} for the project.
e.zh: 资金成了这个项目的主要障碍。

e.en: Pronunciation is often a {stumbling-block} for beginners.
e.zh: 发音常常是初学者的一块绊脚石。

e.en: Legal costs were serious {stumbling-blocks} to reform.
e.zh: 法律成本是改革面临的严重障碍。

e.en: She listed the {stumbling-blocks} before proposing a solution.
e.zh: 她先列出各种绊脚石，然后提出解决方案。

e.en: The watch looked expensive but was a {stumer}.
e.zh: 那块手表看着很贵，其实是假货。

e.en: He sold me a {stumer} of a ticket.
e.zh: 他卖给我一张骗人的假票。

e.en: The cellar master {stummed} the weak wine carefully.
e.zh: 酒窖主管小心地用未发酵葡萄汁处理那桶淡酒。

e.en: A {stummed} cask may ferment again unexpectedly.
e.zh: 处理过的酒桶可能会意外再次发酵。

e.en: The winemaker began {stumming} the pale vintage.
e.zh: 酿酒师开始用未发酵葡萄汁调理那批淡酒。

e.en: Old manuals describe {stumming} as a risky practice.
e.zh: 旧手册把这种用葡萄汁调酒的做法描述为有风险。

e.en: A strange {stumour} spread through the village.
e.zh: 一个奇怪的传闻在村子里传开了。

e.en: The pamphlet repeated every {stumour} about the court.
e.zh: 那本小册子重复了关于宫廷的每一条谣言。

e.en: The farmer repaired the old {stump-jumper} before spring.
e.zh: 农夫在春耕前修好了那台旧越树桩犁。

e.en: City boys mocked him as a {stump-jumper}.
e.zh: 城里的男孩嘲笑他是个乡下佬。

e.en: The second candle was {stumpier} than the first.
e.zh: 第二支蜡烛比第一支更短粗。

e.en: He chose a {stumpier} brush for the rough work.
e.zh: 他选了一把更短粗的刷子来做粗活。

e.en: The {stumpiest} tree survived the storm best.
e.zh: 那棵最矮粗的树最经得住风暴。

e.en: She picked the {stumpiest} pencil from the drawer.
e.zh: 她从抽屉里挑出最短粗的铅笔。

e.en: The sculpture's {stumpiness} made it look solid.
e.zh: 那座雕塑的矮粗感让它显得很结实。

e.en: He joked about the {stumpiness} of his fingers.
e.zh: 他拿自己手指短粗这点开玩笑。

e.en: The old coach called the clumsy player a {stumpster}.
e.zh: 老教练把那个笨拙的球员叫作笨家伙。

e.en: A cheerful {stumpster} waddled onto the stage.
e.zh: 一个乐呵呵的矮胖家伙摇摇摆摆走上舞台。

e.en: The officer carried a {stun-gun} on patrol.
e.zh: 那名警员巡逻时带着一把电击枪。

e.en: A {stun-gun} can disable someone without a bullet.
e.zh: 电击枪不用子弹也能让人失去行动能力。

e.en: The crew set a {stunsail} in the light wind.
e.zh: 船员们在微风中升起了一面辅助帆。

e.en: A torn {stunsail} slowed the old brig.
e.zh: 一面撕裂的翼帆拖慢了那艘旧双桅船。

stuttle.t: 笨拙地行动；迟钝的人或动物

e.en: The old horse {stuttled} through the muddy lane.
e.zh: 那匹老马笨拙地穿过泥泞的小路。

e.en: He moved like a {stuttle} after the long climb.
e.zh: 长途攀爬之后，他走起路来像个迟钝笨拙的人。

e.en: A painful {stye} appeared on her lower eyelid.
e.zh: 她下眼睑上长了一个疼痛的麦粒肿。

e.en: The doctor said the {stye} should clear within a week.
e.zh: 医生说这个麦粒肿应该会在一周内消退。

e.en: Recurring {styes} can make the eyelids sore.
e.zh: 反复出现的麦粒肿会让眼睑疼痛。

e.en: The old farm had three empty {styes}.
e.zh: 那座旧农场有三个空猪圈。

stygophilous.t: 喜地下水环境的；爱黑暗潮湿处的

e.en: The cave survey found several {stygophilous} insects near the stream.
e.zh: 洞穴调查在溪流附近发现了几种喜地下水环境的昆虫。

e.en: Some {stygophilous} species can live both in caves and on the surface.
e.zh: 有些喜地下水环境的物种既能生活在洞穴里，也能生活在地表。

e.en: The workers were {stying} the pigs before cleaning the yard.
e.zh: 工人在清理院子前正把猪关进猪圈。

e.en: Her left eye was {stying} again after the infection.
e.zh: 感染之后，她的左眼又开始长麦粒肿。

e.en: The critic attacked the building's {stylelessness}.
e.zh: 评论家批评这栋建筑毫无风格。

e.en: Its deliberate {stylelessness} made the film feel strangely honest.
e.zh: 影片刻意的无风格感反而让它显得奇异地真诚。

e.en: The website loads a separate {stylesheet} for mobile screens.
e.zh: 这个网站会为手机屏幕加载单独的样式表。

e.en: Editors followed the journal's {stylesheet} for headings and citations.
e.zh: 编辑按照期刊的版式规范处理标题和引文。

e.en: The mosquito pierces skin with a fine {stylet}.
e.zh: 蚊子用细小的口针刺入皮肤。

e.en: The surgeon used a slender {stylet} to guide the tube.
e.zh: 外科医生用一根细长的探针来引导导管。

styletable.t: 可设定样式的；可按风格调整的

e.en: The chart is {styletable} through the theme settings.
e.zh: 这张图表可以通过主题设置来调整样式。

e.en: Each {styletable} component keeps its default spacing.
e.zh: 每个可设定样式的组件都会保留默认间距。

stylewise.t: 从风格上看；就样式而言

e.en: {Stylewise}, the jacket works better with dark jeans.
e.zh: 从风格上看，这件夹克配深色牛仔裤更合适。

e.en: The two poems are similar {stylewise} but very different in tone.
e.zh: 这两首诗在风格上相近，但语气很不一样。

styli.t: 触控笔；唱针；尖笔的复数

e.en: The museum displayed Roman wax tablets and metal {styli}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了罗马蜡板和金属尖笔。

e.en: Replacement {styli} for old record players are hard to find.
e.zh: 老式唱机的替换唱针很难找到。

e.en: The plant has narrow {styliform} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物长着狭窄的针状叶。

e.en: A {styliform} projection extends from the small bone.
e.zh: 一处尖柱状突起从那块小骨头上伸出。

e.en: The film uses heavy {stylisation} in its fight scenes.
e.zh: 这部电影在打斗场面中大量使用风格化处理。

e.en: Her portrait avoids realism through bold {stylisation}.
e.zh: 她的肖像通过大胆的艺术化处理避开了写实风格。

e.en: She became the team's informal {stylishner} before every photo shoot.
e.zh: 每次拍照前，她都成了团队里非正式的造型改造者。

e.en: A bright scarf can be a quick {stylishner} for a plain coat.
e.zh: 一条亮色围巾能很快让朴素外套显得更时髦。

e.en: The essay makes several {stylistical} choices that feel old-fashioned.
e.zh: 这篇文章在文体上有几处选择显得过时。

e.en: Her editor suggested only minor {stylistical} changes.
e.zh: 她的编辑只建议做些风格方面的小修改。

e.en: A {stylistician} analyzed the rhythm of the novel's prose.
e.zh: 一位文体学家分析了这部小说散文的节奏。

e.en: The court consulted a {stylistician} about the disputed letter.
e.zh: 法院就那封有争议的信咨询了一位风格研究者。

e.en: The medieval {stylite} lived for years atop a pillar.
e.zh: 那位中世纪柱头修士在柱顶生活了多年。

e.en: Visitors stared up at the ruins linked to a famous {stylite}.
e.zh: 游客仰望着与一位著名立柱苦行者有关的遗迹。

stylitic.t: 柱头修士的；立柱苦行的

e.en: The monastery preserved a record of {stylitic} devotion.
e.zh: 修道院保存了一份关于立柱苦行虔修的记录。

e.en: His extreme habits reminded scholars of {stylitic} asceticism.
e.zh: 他的极端习惯让学者想起柱头修士式的苦行。

e.en: He signed the form with a cheap {stylo}.
e.zh: 他用一支便宜的钢笔签了表格。

e.en: The designer gave the room a retro {stylo}.
e.zh: 设计师给这个房间做出了复古的造型风格。

e.en: The columns rest on a raised marble {stylobate}.
e.zh: 这些柱子立在一座抬高的大理石柱列基座上。

e.en: Archaeologists measured the temple's {stylobate} before restoration.
e.zh: 修复前，考古学家测量了神庙的柱础台。

e.en: He preferred a {stylograph} for precise lettering.
e.zh: 他更喜欢用针管笔写出精确的字母。

e.en: The antique {stylograph} still held dried ink inside.
e.zh: 那支古董自来水笔里仍残留着干掉的墨水。

e.en: The archive includes several {stylographic} samples from the inventor.
e.zh: 档案中有几份发明者留下的针管笔书写样本。

e.en: Her {stylographic} analysis focused on sentence length and rhythm.
e.zh: 她的文体描写分析集中在句长和节奏上。

e.en: The old manual described {stylography} as a precise writing technique.
e.zh: 那本旧手册把尖笔书写法描述为一种精确的书写技巧。

e.en: Her prints imitated the fine lines of {stylography}.
e.zh: 她的版画模仿了铁笔画法的细密线条。

e.en: The surgeon checked the {stylohyoid} ligament during the examination.
e.zh: 外科医生在检查中查看了茎突舌骨韧带。

e.en: Pain near the jaw was linked to the {stylohyoid} region.
e.zh: 下颌附近的疼痛与茎突舌骨区域有关。

e.en: A dark {stylolite} crossed the limestone sample.
e.zh: 一条深色的缝合线状构造横穿石灰岩样本。

e.en: Geologists used the {stylolite} to study pressure in the rock.
e.zh: 地质学家利用这条缝合线状构造研究岩石中的压力。

e.en: The cliff showed clear {stylolitic} seams in the limestone.
e.zh: 悬崖的石灰岩中显示出清晰的缝合线状层缝。

e.en: Her paper focused on {stylolitic} textures formed under pressure.
e.zh: 她的论文关注在压力下形成的缝合线状构造纹理。

e.en: The specimen seemed to {stylopize} as it developed a narrow stalk.
e.zh: 标本长出细柄时似乎变成了带柄形态。

e.en: Botanists may {stylopize} the structure in technical descriptions.
e.zh: 植物学家可能在技术描述中把该结构称作带小柱。

e.en: The fossil preserved part of the animal's {stylopod}.
e.zh: 这块化石保存了该动物近端肢节的一部分。

e.en: In anatomy, the {stylopod} includes the upper limb segment.
e.zh: 在解剖学中，stylopod 指包括上肢近端的一段。

e.en: The drawing labeled two small {stylopodia} at the fruit's base.
e.zh: 图中标出了果实基部的两个小花柱足。

e.en: Some umbellifers have visible {stylopodia} above the ovary.
e.zh: 一些伞形科植物在子房上方有可见的花柱足。

e.en: A swollen {stylopodium} sat at the top of the ovary.
e.zh: 一个膨大的花柱足位于子房顶部。

e.en: The botanist measured the {stylopodium} under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下测量了花柱基盘。

e.en: A {stylops} can live as a parasite inside a bee.
e.zh: 扇跗目寄生昆虫可以寄生在蜜蜂体内。

e.en: The researcher found a {stylops} emerging from the host.
e.zh: 研究人员发现一只扇跗目昆虫正从宿主体内露出。

e.en: The team used {stylostatistics} to compare the disputed letters.
e.zh: 团队用文体统计学比较那些有争议的信件。

e.en: Modern {stylostatistics} can reveal patterns in an author's prose.
e.zh: 现代文体统计学能揭示作者散文中的模式。

e.en: Ancient physicians practiced {stylostixis} for certain pains.
e.zh: 古代医师用针刺术治疗某些疼痛。

e.en: The text defines {stylostixis} as treatment by puncturing the skin.
e.zh: 该文本把针刺术定义为通过刺入皮肤进行治疗。

e.en: The artist chose {stylotint} for the delicate landscape.
e.zh: 艺术家选择钢笔淡彩画法来表现这幅精细的风景。

e.en: A lesson on {stylotint} followed the section on line drawing.
e.zh: 线描部分之后是一节钢笔淡彩画法课程。

e.en: The printer tested {stylotypite} for casting durable type.
e.zh: 印刷工测试了柱状铅字合金，用来铸造耐用铅字。

e.en: Old manuals mention {stylotypite} among specialist printing materials.
e.zh: 旧手册在专业印刷材料中提到柱状铅字合金。

e.en: The lotion caused mild {stypsis} on the irritated skin.
e.zh: 这种洗剂在受刺激的皮肤上产生了轻微收敛作用。

e.en: Doctors once valued alum for its {stypsis}.
e.zh: 医生过去看重明矾的止血收敛作用。

e.en: He pressed a {styptic} pencil against the shaving cut.
e.zh: 他把止血笔按在刮胡子划破的伤口上。

e.en: The herb was used as a {styptic} in folk medicine.
e.zh: 这种草药在民间医学中被用作止血剂。

e.en: The powder had a {styptical} effect on small wounds.
e.zh: 这种粉末对小伤口有止血作用。

e.en: Older pharmacists described the solution as {styptical}.
e.zh: 早期药剂师把这种溶液描述为具有收敛性。

e.en: The formula included {stypticin} for controlling bleeding.
e.zh: 该配方含有止血碱，用于控制出血。

e.en: Early reports discussed {stypticin} as a uterine hemostatic drug.
e.zh: 早期报告把止血碱作为子宫止血药来讨论。

e.en: The chemist measured the {stypticity} of the new compound.
e.zh: 化学家测定了这种新化合物的止血性。

e.en: Its strong {stypticity} made the solution useful after shaving.
e.zh: 它很强的收敛性使这种溶液适合剃须后使用。

e.en: The old prescription listed {styptol} among its active ingredients.
e.zh: 旧处方把止血酚列为活性成分之一。

e.en: Pharmacists studied {styptol} for its ability to reduce bleeding.
e.zh: 药剂师研究止血酚减少出血的能力。

e.en: The garden displayed several {styracaceous} shrubs in bloom.
e.zh: 花园里有几株开花的安息香科灌木。

e.en: A {styracaceous} tree may produce fragrant resin.
e.zh: 安息香科树木可能产生芳香树脂。

e.en: The resin sample contained traces of {styracin}.
e.zh: 树脂样本中含有微量苏合香脂成分。

e.en: Chemists isolated {styracin} from storax resin.
e.zh: 化学家从苏合香树脂中分离出 styracin。

e.en: The analysis detected {styracol} in the fragrant resin.
e.zh: 分析在芳香树脂中检测到了苏合香酚类化合物。

e.en: Older chemistry texts describe {styracol} as a resin derivative.
e.zh: 较早的化学教材把 styracol 描述为一种树脂衍生物。

styremic.t: 苯乙烯的；与苯乙烯有关的

e.en: The lab tested a {styremic} compound for industrial use.
e.zh: 实验室测试了一种用于工业用途的苯乙烯化合物。

e.en: Workers monitored {styremic} vapors near the storage tanks.
e.zh: 工人监测储罐附近与苯乙烯有关的蒸气。

e.en: The old manual called the liquid {styren}.
e.zh: 那本旧手册把这种液体称为苯乙烯。

e.en: Chemists once used {styren} as another name for styrene.
e.zh: 化学家曾把苯乙烯这个词作为 styrene 的别称。

e.en: The factory ordered more {styrol} for resin production.
e.zh: 工厂为生产树脂订购了更多苯乙烯。

e.en: Older chemistry books often list {styrol} beside styrene.
e.zh: 旧化学书常把苯乙烯这个旧名和 styrene 并列列出。

e.en: The article described {styrolene} as a volatile aromatic liquid.
e.zh: 文章把苯乙烯的旧称描述为一种易挥发的芳香液体。

e.en: Students may meet {styrolene} in nineteenth-century chemical texts.
e.zh: 学生可能会在十九世纪化学文献中见到苯乙烯的旧称。

styrone.t: 苯乙烯类物质；旧化学名

e.en: The archive labels the sample as {styrone}.
e.zh: 档案把这个样品标注为一种旧称的苯乙烯类物质。

e.en: Few modern chemists would use {styrone} in a report.
e.zh: 如今很少有化学家会在报告中使用 styrone 这个旧化学名。

e.en: She developed two painful {stys} after the infection.
e.zh: 感染后她长了两个疼痛的麦粒肿。

e.en: Warm compresses can help small {stys} heal faster.
e.zh: 热敷可以帮助小的针眼更快痊愈。

e.en: The lawyer questioned the company's {suability} in that jurisdiction.
e.zh: 律师质疑该公司在那个司法辖区是否具有可起诉性。

e.en: The statute limits the {suability} of public officials.
e.zh: 该法规限制了公职人员被控告的可能性。

e.en: The contractor is {suable} for breach of contract.
e.zh: 该承包商可因违约而被起诉。

e.en: Some agencies are not {suable} without special permission.
e.zh: 有些机构未经特别许可不能被起诉。

e.en: My grandfather taught me to count on a {suanpan}.
e.zh: 祖父教我用中国算盘算数。

e.en: The museum displayed an old wooden {suanpan}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一把旧木制中国算盘。

e.en: The committee seemed {suasible} after hearing the evidence.
e.zh: 听完证据后，委员会似乎可以被说服。

e.en: He was stubborn, but not entirely {suasible}.
e.zh: 他很固执，但并非完全不能劝服。

e.en: Her {suasive} speech changed several votes.
e.zh: 她有说服力的演讲改变了几张选票。

e.en: The letter used a calm but {suasive} tone.
e.zh: 那封信用平静却带劝诱性的语气写成。

e.en: He argued {suasively} for a slower approach.
e.zh: 他有说服力地主张采取更慢的办法。

e.en: The witness spoke {suasively} but without exaggeration.
e.zh: 证人说得很有说服力，但没有夸张。

e.en: The proposal gained {suasiveness} from its clear data.
e.zh: 这项提案因数据清晰而更有说服力。

e.en: Her quiet {suasiveness} worked better than pressure.
e.zh: 她温和的劝诱力比施压更有效。

e.en: The judge noted the brief's {suasory} force.
e.zh: 法官注意到这份辩护书的说服作用。

e.en: His {suasory} style relied on patience, not drama.
e.zh: 他的劝说风格依靠耐心，而不是戏剧化表达。

e.en: The manuscript uses {suat} where modern English would say persuade.
e.zh: 这份手稿用 suat 这个旧词来表达现代英语中的 persuade。

e.en: Scholars marked {suat} as an obsolete form in the glossary.
e.zh: 学者们在词汇表中把 suat 标为废旧形式。

suavest.t: 最温文尔雅的；最圆滑的

e.en: He was the {suavest} host at the reception.
e.zh: 他是招待会上最温文尔雅的主人。

e.en: Even her {suavest} apology sounded calculated.
e.zh: 即使她最圆滑的道歉听起来也像是算计好的。

e.en: The critic mocked the politician's empty {suaviloquence}.
e.zh: 评论家嘲讽那位政客空洞而甜美流畅的言辞。

e.en: Her {suaviloquence} made the difficult argument easier to hear.
e.zh: 她甜美流畅的表达让这个艰难论点更容易被接受。

e.en: He greeted every guest with practiced {suavity}.
e.zh: 他以训练有素的温文尔雅招呼每位客人。

e.en: The diplomat's {suavity} hid a very firm position.
e.zh: 那位外交官的圆滑得体掩盖了十分坚定的立场。

e.en: The biologist tagged a {sub-adult} eagle near the coast.
e.zh: 生物学家在海岸附近给一只亚成年鹰做了标记。

e.en: A {sub-adult} animal may look mature but still be growing.
e.zh: 亚成年动物可能看起来成熟，但仍在生长。

e.en: Each {sub-area} has its own traffic rules.
e.zh: 每个子区域都有自己的交通规则。

e.en: The research team focused on one {sub-area} of linguistics.
e.zh: 研究团队专注于语言学的一个分支领域。

e.en: This {sub-case} requires a separate proof.
e.zh: 这个子情形需要单独证明。

e.en: The report treats fraud as a {sub-case} of misconduct.
e.zh: 报告把欺诈视为不当行为的一个子案例。

e.en: The charity opened a {sub-center} in the northern district.
e.zh: 该慈善机构在北区开设了一个分中心。

e.en: A busy {sub-center} formed around the new station.
e.zh: 新车站周围形成了一个繁忙的次级中心。

e.en: The database added a new {sub-classification} for rare diseases.
e.zh: 数据库为罕见病新增了一个子分类。

e.en: This {sub-classification} helps researchers compare similar cases.
e.zh: 这个细分类别有助于研究人员比较相似病例。

e.en: The guide lists several {sub-classifications} under each main topic.
e.zh: 指南在每个主题下列出若干子分类。

e.en: These {sub-classifications} make the archive easier to search.
e.zh: 这些细分类别让档案更容易检索。

sub-classify.t: 进一步细分归类；下级分类

e.en: Researchers {sub-classify} the samples by age and origin.
e.zh: 研究人员按年龄和来源进一步细分这些样本。

e.en: The database can {sub-classify} errors into smaller groups.
e.zh: 这个数据库能把错误再分成更小的类别。

e.en: The model treats each {sub-cloud} as a separate gas region.
e.zh: 该模型把每个子云都视为独立的气体区域。

e.en: A bright {sub-cloud} formed beneath the main storm front.
e.zh: 主风暴锋面下方形成了一小片明亮云团。

sub-consciousnesses.t: 潜意识层面；多个潜意识

e.en: The novel imagines several {sub-consciousnesses} inside one mind.
e.zh: 这部小说想象一个心灵里有多个潜意识层面。

e.en: Therapy can reveal hidden {sub-consciousnesses} behind repeated choices.
e.zh: 治疗可能揭示反复选择背后的隐藏潜意识。

e.en: Skateboarding became a powerful youth {sub-culture}.
e.zh: 滑板运动成了一种很有影响力的青年亚文化。

e.en: Each online {sub-culture} has its own jokes and rules.
e.zh: 每个网络小众文化群体都有自己的笑话和规矩。

e.en: Save the images in the {sub-directory} named assets.
e.zh: 把这些图片保存在名为 assets 的子目录里。

e.en: The script scans every {sub-directory} for log files.
e.zh: 这个脚本会扫描每个下级文件夹里的日志文件。

e.en: Biophysics is a {sub-discipline} of modern biology.
e.zh: 生物物理学是现代生物学的一个分支学科。

e.en: She chose a narrow {sub-discipline} within economic history.
e.zh: 她选择了经济史中一个很细的专业分支。

e.en: The clinic serves a rural {sub-district} near the river.
e.zh: 这家诊所服务河边的一个农村分区。

e.en: Officials divided the city into smaller {sub-districts}.
e.zh: 官员把这座城市划分成更小的下辖区。

e.en: We need to {sub-divide} the land into four plots.
e.zh: 我们需要把这块地再分成四块。

e.en: Teachers {sub-divide} the class for group work.
e.zh: 老师把班级细分成小组来完成任务。

e.en: The report includes a {sub-division} for each region.
e.zh: 报告为每个地区都列出一个细分部分。

e.en: They bought a house in a quiet {sub-division}.
e.zh: 他们在一个安静的住宅分区买了房子。

e.en: The blog runs on a separate {sub-domain}.
e.zh: 这个博客运行在一个单独的子域名上。

e.en: Speech recognition is a {sub-domain} of artificial intelligence.
e.zh: 语音识别是人工智能的一个子领域。

e.en: A {sub-editor} checked the headline before publication.
e.zh: 一名助理编辑在发布前检查了标题。

e.en: The {sub-editor} tightened the article without changing its tone.
e.zh: 文字编辑压缩了文章篇幅，但没有改变语气。

e.en: The software creates isolated {sub-environments} for testing.
e.zh: 该软件会创建隔离的子环境用于测试。

e.en: Different {sub-environments} in the cave support different species.
e.zh: 洞穴中的不同局部环境养活了不同物种。

e.en: Each {sub-file} stores metadata for one image.
e.zh: 每个子文件都保存一张图片的元数据。

e.en: The archive contains a damaged {sub-file} from last year.
e.zh: 这个压缩包里有一个去年留下的损坏附属文件。

e.en: The survey opens a {sub-form} for medical details.
e.zh: 这份调查会打开一个填写医疗详情的附属表单。

e.en: Poets treated the sonnet as a {sub-form} of lyric poetry.
e.zh: 诗人把十四行诗视为抒情诗的一种子形式。

e.en: The plan gives each {sub-government} limited budget control.
e.zh: 该计划给每个下级政府有限的预算控制权。

e.en: A regional {sub-government} handled the emergency response.
e.zh: 一个地方分政府负责了这次应急响应。

e.en: The inspector marked the material as {sub-grade}.
e.zh: 检查员把这种材料标为次级等级。

e.en: Workers compacted the {sub-grade} before laying asphalt.
e.zh: 工人在铺沥青前压实了路基层。
