e.en: The article uses a bold {sub-head} for each section.
e.zh: 这篇文章给每一节都用了加粗小标题。

e.en: A clear {sub-head} can guide readers through a long report.
e.zh: 清楚的副标题能引导读者读完长报告。

e.en: The prisoners were kept in {sub-human} conditions.
e.zh: 囚犯被关押在非人的环境中。

e.en: The insult implied that outsiders were {sub-human}.
e.zh: 这句侮辱暗示外来者低人一等。

e.en: The textbook places algae in a separate {sub-kingdom}.
e.zh: 这本教材把藻类归入一个单独的亚界。

e.en: Legends describe a hidden {sub-kingdom} beneath the mountains.
e.zh: 传说描写群山之下有一个隐藏的下级王国。

e.en: She {sub-lets} her room during the summer.
e.zh: 她夏天把自己的房间转租出去。

e.en: The lease says he cannot {sub-let} the apartment.
e.zh: 租约写明他不能转租这套公寓。

sub-licensee.t: 再许可持有人；分授权方

e.en: Each {sub-licensee} must follow the original contract.
e.zh: 每个再许可持有人都必须遵守原合同。

e.en: The company appointed a {sub-licensee} for local distribution.
e.zh: 公司指定了一名分授权方负责本地分销。

e.en: The agreement allows three {sub-licenses} in Asia.
e.zh: 该协议允许在亚洲发放三项分授权许可。

e.en: He {sub-licenses} the technology to smaller manufacturers.
e.zh: 他把这项技术再许可给较小的制造商。

e.en: The {sub-lieutenant} reported to the captain at dawn.
e.zh: 那名海军少尉在黎明向舰长报到。

e.en: A young {sub-lieutenant} led the patrol through the village.
e.zh: 一名年轻中尉带领巡逻队穿过村庄。

e.en: The policy sets a {sub-limit} for dental treatment.
e.zh: 这份保单为牙科治疗设定了子限额。

e.en: Each account has a monthly {sub-limit} for transfers.
e.zh: 每个账户都有每月转账的次级限制。

e.en: The guard carried a {sub-machine-gun} at the gate.
e.zh: 守卫在大门口携带一支冲锋枪。

e.en: The museum displayed an old {sub-machine-gun} from the war.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一支战争时期的旧冲锋枪。

e.en: The guards carried {sub-machine-guns} outside the bank.
e.zh: 警卫在银行外携带着冲锋枪。

e.en: Old war photos showed soldiers with {sub-machine-guns}.
e.zh: 旧战争照片里有士兵拿着冲锋枪。

e.en: The cruel law treated prisoners as {sub-men}.
e.zh: 那项残酷法律把囚犯当成低人一等的人。

e.en: He rejected the racist idea of a {sub-man}.
e.zh: 他拒绝接受所谓次等人的种族主义观念。

e.en: The {sub-mariner} spent months below the surface.
e.zh: 那名潜艇艇员在水下待了好几个月。

e.en: A skilled {sub-mariner} checked the hull for damage.
e.zh: 一名熟练的潜水者检查船体是否受损。

e.en: Luxury watches form a profitable {sub-market} online.
e.zh: 奢侈手表在线上形成了有利可图的细分市场。

e.en: The company entered a {sub-market} for elderly users.
e.zh: 这家公司进入了面向老年用户的子市场。

e.en: The script stores each address as a {sub-object}.
e.zh: 脚本把每个地址存成一个子对象。

e.en: In the theory, desire creates a {sub-object} of attention.
e.zh: 在该理论中，欲望会产生一个从属的注意客体。

e.en: Install the {sub-package} before running the plugin.
e.zh: 运行插件前先安装这个子包。

e.en: Each {sub-package} contains its own documentation.
e.zh: 每个附属包都包含自己的说明文档。

e.en: One {sub-part} of the engine failed.
e.zh: 发动机的一个子部件出了故障。

e.en: The report examines each {sub-part} separately.
e.zh: 这份报告分别考察每个组成小部分。

e.en: The dynasty is divided into three {sub-periods}.
e.zh: 这个王朝被分为三个较短时期。

e.en: Sales rose during the second {sub-period}.
e.zh: 销售额在第二个分期内上升了。

e.en: The romance {sub-plot} slowed the movie down.
e.zh: 这条爱情副线拖慢了电影节奏。

e.en: A comic {sub-plot} runs through the novel.
e.zh: 小说中贯穿着一条喜剧性的次要情节。

e.en: Many banks sold {sub-prime} mortgages before the crash.
e.zh: 金融危机前，许多银行出售次级抵押贷款。

e.en: The scandal exposed risky {sub-prime} lending practices.
e.zh: 这起丑闻暴露了高风险的次贷放贷做法。

e.en: We solved each {sub-problem} before combining the answers.
e.zh: 我们先解决每个子问题，再合并答案。

e.en: The hardest {sub-problem} involved missing data.
e.zh: 最难的局部问题涉及缺失数据。

e.en: She managed a {sub-project} within the larger program.
e.zh: 她负责大型计划中的一个子项目。

e.en: Each {sub-project} has its own budget.
e.zh: 每个分项目都有自己的预算。

e.en: The tenant paid {sub-rent} to the leaseholder.
e.zh: 租客向承租人支付转租租金。

e.en: Their contract limits the amount of {sub-rent}.
e.zh: 他们的合同限制分租租金的金额。

e.en: The deal was arranged {sub-rosa} by senior officials.
e.zh: 这笔交易由高级官员暗中安排。

e.en: They held {sub-rosa} talks before the public meeting.
e.zh: 公开会议前他们进行了秘密会谈。

e.en: Malaria remains common in parts of {sub-Saharan} Africa.
e.zh: 疟疾在撒哈拉以南非洲的一些地区仍很常见。

e.en: The study focuses on {sub-Saharan} trade networks.
e.zh: 这项研究关注撒哈拉以南地区的贸易网络。

e.en: The anxiety {sub-scale} had ten questions.
e.zh: 焦虑分量表包含十个问题。

e.en: Researchers measured changes at the {sub-scale} level.
e.zh: 研究人员在子尺度层面测量变化。

e.en: Please {sub-scribe} your name below the statement.
e.zh: 请在声明下方签上你的名字。

e.en: Medieval clerks would {sub-scribe} notes beneath the text.
e.zh: 中世纪文书会在正文下方写下注释。

e.en: Tourism is a growing {sub-sector} of the economy.
e.zh: 旅游业是经济中正在增长的一个分行业。

e.en: The report compares every energy {sub-sector}.
e.zh: 报告比较了能源领域的每个子部门。

e.en: Only a small {sub-set} of users saw the warning.
e.zh: 只有一小部分用户看到了警告。

e.en: In math, this group is a {sub-set} of integers.
e.zh: 在数学中，这个集合是整数的子集。

e.en: Pronunciation is one {sub-skill} in language learning.
e.zh: 发音是语言学习中的一项子技能。

e.en: The course tests each writing {sub-skill} separately.
e.zh: 这门课程分别测试每项写作分项技能。

e.en: This rare {sub-species} lives only on the island.
e.zh: 这个稀有亚种只生活在那座岛上。

e.en: Scientists identified a new tiger {sub-species}.
e.zh: 科学家鉴定出一个新的老虎亚种。

e.en: The project entered its final {sub-stage} in June.
e.zh: 项目在六月进入最后一个子阶段。

e.en: Each developmental {sub-stage} shows different behavior.
e.zh: 每个发展分阶段都会表现出不同的行为。

e.en: The inspector rejected the {sub-standard} wiring.
e.zh: 检查员否决了不达标的布线。

e.en: Families were forced to live in {sub-standard} housing.
e.zh: 许多家庭被迫住在条件低劣的住房里。

e.en: The storm damaged a nearby electrical {sub-station}.
e.zh: 暴风雨损坏了附近的一座变电站。

e.en: Police opened a small {sub-station} in the village.
e.zh: 警方在村里设立了一个小分站。

sub-structure.t: 下部结构；基础构造结构

e.en: Engineers inspected the bridge's {sub-structure} after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，工程师检查了桥梁的下部结构。

e.en: The theory has a hidden {sub-structure} of older assumptions.
e.zh: 这个理论有一层由旧假设构成的隐含底层结构。

e.en: The team mapped {sub-surface} water beneath the desert.
e.zh: 团队绘制了沙漠地下水的分布图。

e.en: Tiny cracks caused {sub-surface} damage to the coating.
e.zh: 细小裂纹造成了涂层表层以下的损伤。

e.en: The lease forbids any {sub-tenancy} without written consent.
e.zh: 租约禁止未经书面同意的任何转租关系。

e.en: Her {sub-tenancy} ended when the main tenant moved out.
e.zh: 主租客搬走后，她的分租权也终止了。

e.en: The {sub-tenant} paid rent directly to the main tenant.
e.zh: 这名转租客直接把房租付给主租客。

e.en: A {sub-tenant} must still follow the building rules.
e.zh: 分租承租人仍必须遵守大楼规定。

e.en: Each {sub-test} measures a different reading skill.
e.zh: 每个分项测试衡量一种不同的阅读能力。

e.en: She passed the speaking {sub-test} but failed writing.
e.zh: 她通过了口语子测验，但写作没有通过。

e.en: The {sub-text} of his apology was obvious to everyone.
e.zh: 他道歉里的潜台词大家都听得出来。

e.en: A good actor can reveal {sub-text} without extra lines.
e.zh: 好演员不用加台词也能表现出言外之意。

e.en: The report has a short {sub-title} under the main heading.
e.zh: 报告主标题下面有一个简短的副标题。

e.en: Please add a Chinese {sub-title} to the video.
e.zh: 请给这段视频加上中文字幕。

e.en: We watched a {sub-titled} film from Spain.
e.zh: 我们看了一部带字幕的西班牙电影。

e.en: The article was {sub-titled} with a provocative question.
e.zh: 这篇文章用了一个挑衅性问题作副标题。

e.en: The island has a warm {sub-tropical} climate.
e.zh: 这座岛属于温暖的亚热带气候。

e.en: Many {sub-tropical} plants cannot survive hard frost.
e.zh: 许多亚热带植物经不起严重霜冻。

sub-underwriters.t: 分承销商；再保险承保人

e.en: Several {sub-underwriters} shared the risk of the bond issue.
e.zh: 几家分承销商分担了这次债券发行的风险。

e.en: The lead insurer appointed {sub-underwriters} for the large policy.
e.zh: 主保险人为这份大额保单指定了再保险承保人。

e.en: Each {sub-unit} reports its budget separately.
e.zh: 每个子单位都单独上报预算。

e.en: The protein contains a smaller {sub-unit} that binds oxygen.
e.zh: 这种蛋白含有一个能结合氧气的较小亚基。

e.en: The climbers faced {sub-zero} temperatures overnight.
e.zh: 登山者夜里遭遇了零度以下的气温。

e.en: This battery performs well in {sub-zero} conditions.
e.zh: 这种电池在零下环境中表现良好。

e.en: The doctor noted {subabdominal} tenderness during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查中发现腹部下方有压痛。

e.en: Some insects have {subabdominal} markings near the rear body segment.
e.zh: 有些昆虫在腹下靠近后体节的位置有斑纹。

e.en: The chemist prepared lead {subacetate} for the old assay.
e.zh: 化学师为这项旧式测定制备了碱式乙酸铅。

e.en: A bottle labeled {subacetate} sat in the laboratory cabinet.
e.zh: 实验室柜子里放着一瓶标有碱式乙酸盐的试剂。

e.en: The berries had a pleasant {subacid} taste.
e.zh: 这些浆果有一种令人愉快的微酸味。

e.en: A {subacid} soil can suit certain garden plants.
e.zh: 略偏酸性的土壤适合某些园艺植物。

e.en: The fruit smelled {subacidly} fresh after cutting.
e.zh: 水果切开后闻起来带着微酸的清新气味。

e.en: She replied {subacidly} that the plan was hardly new.
e.zh: 她略带尖刻地回答说，这个计划根本不新鲜。

e.en: The wine's {subacidness} balanced its sweetness.
e.zh: 这款酒的微酸味平衡了甜度。

e.en: Gardeners tested the {subacidness} of the soil before planting.
e.zh: 园丁在种植前测试了土壤的微酸性。

e.en: The sensor detected {subacoustic} vibrations in the machinery.
e.zh: 传感器检测到机器中低于可闻声的振动。

e.en: Researchers studied {subacoustic} signals produced by the engine.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了发动机产生的亚声信号。

e.en: The patient showed signs of {subacute} infection.
e.zh: 病人出现了亚急性感染的迹象。

e.en: A {subacute} angle is smaller than a right angle.
e.zh: 稍锐角小于直角。

e.en: The symptoms developed {subacutely} over several weeks.
e.zh: 这些症状在几周内以亚急性方式发展。

e.en: The pain returned {subacutely} rather than suddenly.
e.zh: 疼痛不是突然回来，而是较缓地再次出现。

e.en: The model assumes a {subadditive} cost function.
e.zh: 这个模型假设成本函数是次可加的。

e.en: A {subadditive} measure can make combined risks look smaller.
e.zh: 次可加的度量会让合并后的风险显得更小。

e.en: The proof relies on the {subadditivity} of the function.
e.zh: 这个证明依赖于函数的次可加性。

e.en: Economists discussed {subadditivity} in the firm's production costs.
e.zh: 经济学家讨论了该公司生产成本中的次可加性。

subadiabatic.t: 亚绝热的；低于绝热递减率的

e.en: The atmosphere showed a {subadiabatic} temperature gradient.
e.zh: 大气呈现出低于绝热递减率的温度梯度。

e.en: A {subadiabatic} layer can suppress vertical air movement.
e.zh: 亚绝热层会抑制空气的垂直运动。

subadolescent.t: 青春期前后的；未完全青春期的

e.en: The clinic designed programs for {subadolescent} children.
e.zh: 诊所为青春期前后的儿童设计了项目。

e.en: A {subadolescent} reader may miss the novel's darker themes.
e.zh: 未完全进入青春期的读者可能会忽略小说较阴暗的主题。

subaerial.t: 地表上的；近地面的；陆上的

e.en: The geologist studied {subaerial} lava flows on the island.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了岛上暴露在地表的熔岩流。

e.en: Wind can reshape {subaerial} dunes within a season.
e.zh: 风能在一个季节内重塑陆上的沙丘。

e.en: The sediment was deposited {subaerially} after the lake dried.
e.zh: 湖泊干涸后，沉积物是在地表环境中形成的。

e.en: Some rocks weather {subaerially} before being buried again.
e.zh: 有些岩石在再次被掩埋前会在地表风化。

e.en: The survey divided children into each {subage} group.
e.zh: 这项调查把儿童划分到各个更细的年龄小组。

e.en: Mortality rates varied by {subage} within the cohort.
e.zh: 同一群体内部，不同细分年龄段的死亡率有所不同。

e.en: A small {subagency} handled local permits for the department.
e.zh: 一个小型下属机构负责该部门的地方许可事务。

e.en: The insurer works through a regional {subagency}.
e.zh: 这家保险公司通过一个地区分代理机构开展业务。

e.en: The broker appointed a {subagent} to manage rural clients.
e.zh: 经纪人任命了一名副代理人来管理乡村客户。

e.en: A {subagent} cannot exceed the authority granted by the agent.
e.zh: 下级代理人不能超出代理人授予的权限。

e.en: The entomologist measured the {subalare} plate of the insect.
e.zh: 昆虫学家测量了这只昆虫的翼下部骨片。

e.en: A dark mark appeared near the {subalare} region.
e.zh: 在翼下区域附近出现了一块深色斑纹。

e.en: The seed has a {subalate} edge that catches the wind.
e.zh: 这种种子有略呈翼状的边缘，能借风传播。

e.en: Botanists described the stem as {subalate}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这根茎描述为近似有翅状。

e.en: The spring water was mildly {subalkaline}.
e.zh: 这处泉水呈轻微的弱碱性。

e.en: Geologists classified the basalt as {subalkaline}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这种玄武岩归为亚碱性岩类。

e.en: The parser checks each {subalphabaet} before reading the code.
e.zh: 解析器在读取代码前会检查每个字母子集。

e.en: A {subalphabaet} may contain only vowels in this exercise.
e.zh: 在这个练习中，一个子字母表可以只包含元音。

e.en: The trail passes through {subalpine} meadows and fir forests.
e.zh: 这条小径穿过亚高山草甸和冷杉林。

e.en: Snow lingers longer in the {subalpine} zone.
e.zh: 积雪在亚高山带停留的时间更久。

e.en: The leaves show a {subalternate} arrangement along the stem.
e.zh: 这些叶子沿茎呈现出次交错排列。

e.en: The philosopher discussed a {subalternate} relation between propositions.
e.zh: 这位哲学家讨论了命题之间的副交替关系。

subalternated.t: 次交错排列的；已副交替的

e.en: The markings were {subalternated} along the shell.
e.zh: 这些斑纹在贝壳上呈次交错排列。

e.en: Several clauses were {subalternated} in the formal proof.
e.zh: 在这个形式证明中，几个命题从属地交替出现。

subalternating.t: 次交错的；正在副交替的

e.en: The plant has {subalternating} leaves near the top.
e.zh: 这种植物顶部附近有次交错排列的叶子。

e.en: The argument uses {subalternating} statements in its structure.
e.zh: 这个论证在结构中使用了副交替命题。

subangiocarp.t: 半被果式真菌；近被果体

e.en: The fungus develops as a {subangiocarp} before opening.
e.zh: 这种真菌在张开前会发育成近被果体。

e.en: Mycologists noted the {subangiocarp} form of the specimen.
e.zh: 真菌学家注意到该标本的半被果式形态。

e.en: The diagram labels each {subangle} inside the triangle.
e.zh: 图中标出了三角形内部的每个小角。

e.en: A rough {subangle} appears where the two surfaces meet.
e.zh: 两个表面相接处出现了一个不明显的次角。

e.en: The expedition studied birds on {subantarctic} islands.
e.zh: 考察队研究了亚南极群岛上的鸟类。

e.en: Strong winds shape the {subantarctic} climate.
e.zh: 强风塑造了亚南极地区的气候。

e.en: A {subapical} spot marks the insect's wing.
e.zh: 昆虫翅膀上有一个近顶端的斑点。

e.en: The surgeon avoided the {subapical} tissue during the procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中避开了顶端下方的组织。

subapostolic.t: 使徒时代后的；次使徒的

e.en: The text belongs to the {subapostolic} period of Christianity.
e.zh: 这部文本属于基督教使徒时代之后的时期。

e.en: Scholars debate the authority of {subapostolic} writings.
e.zh: 学者们争论次使徒时期著作的权威性。

e.en: The diver entered a {subaquatic} cave system.
e.zh: 潜水员进入了一个水下洞穴系统。

e.en: Some {subaquatic} plants root in mud but rise above water.
e.zh: 有些半水生植物扎根于泥中，却伸出水面。

e.en: The volcano produced {subaqueous} lava beneath the lake.
e.zh: 这座火山在湖底产生了水下熔岩。

e.en: Fine clay settled in a {subaqueous} environment.
e.zh: 细黏土沉积在水下环境中。

e.en: Each {subarea} of the city has its own clinic.
e.zh: 城市的每个子区域都有自己的诊所。

e.en: Machine learning is a {subarea} of computer science.
e.zh: 机器学习是计算机科学的一个分领域。

e.en: The shrubs survive in a {subarid} climate.
e.zh: 这些灌木能在半干旱气候中生存。

e.en: Farmers adjusted irrigation for the {subarid} valley.
e.zh: 农民为这个偏干旱的山谷调整了灌溉方式。

subarkose.t: 亚长石砂岩；次长石砂岩

e.en: The outcrop contains layers of {subarkose} and shale.
e.zh: 这处露头含有亚长石砂岩和页岩层。

e.en: Students identified the sandstone as {subarkose}.
e.zh: 学生们把这种砂岩鉴定为次长石砂岩。

subassembler.t: 子汇编器；分组件装配工

e.en: The old compiler used a separate {subassembler}.
e.zh: 这款旧编译器使用了一个单独的子汇编器。

e.en: A {subassembler} built the brake module for the factory.
e.zh: 一家分组件装配商为工厂制造了刹车模块。

e.en: The poet imagined a {subastral} world beneath the stars.
e.zh: 诗人想象了一个星空之下的世界。

e.en: They spoke of human life as a {subastral} struggle.
e.zh: 他们把人类生活说成星辰下的挣扎。

e.en: The herb has a {subastringent} taste when chewed.
e.zh: 这种草药咀嚼时有点微涩。

e.en: A {subastringent} lotion may gently tighten the skin.
e.zh: 微收敛性的润肤液可能会轻轻紧致皮肤。

e.en: The chamber was kept at {subatmospheric} pressure.
e.zh: 这个腔室保持在低于大气压的压力下。

e.en: Engineers measured {subatmospheric} conditions inside the sealed vessel.
e.zh: 工程师测量了密封容器内的低压状态。

e.en: A {subatom} can be discussed only in specialized physics contexts.
e.zh: 亚原子这一概念通常只在专业物理语境中讨论。

e.en: The old text used {subatom} where modern writers say subatomic particle.
e.zh: 那本旧书用 subatom 表达现代所说的亚原子粒子。

e.en: The critic explained the {subaudi} behind the ironic remark.
e.zh: 评论家解释了那句讽刺话背后的言外之意。

e.en: In legal phrasing, a {subaudi} may be supplied from context.
e.zh: 在法律措辞中，省略的含义可由上下文补出。

e.en: Her reply depended on the {subaudition} of an unstated condition.
e.zh: 她的回答依赖于对一个未明说条件的默会理解。

e.en: Classical rhetoricians treated {subaudition} as meaning supplied by the listener.
e.zh: 古典修辞学家把言外理解视为听者补出的意义。

e.en: The doctor noted swelling in the {subauricular} area.
e.zh: 医生注意到耳下区域有肿胀。

e.en: A small incision was made along the {subauricular} fold.
e.zh: 医生沿耳廓下方的皱褶做了一个小切口。

e.en: The school offered help to students with {subaverage} reading scores.
e.zh: 学校为阅读成绩低于平均水平的学生提供帮助。

e.en: Rainfall was {subaverage} across the region this spring.
e.zh: 今年春季该地区降雨量低于平均水平。

e.en: The signal was divided into a lower {subband}.
e.zh: 该信号被划分到一个较低的子频带中。

e.en: Audio compression analyzes each {subband} separately.
e.zh: 音频压缩会分别分析每个分频段。

e.en: Workers compacted the gravel {subbase} before laying asphalt.
e.zh: 工人在铺沥青前压实了砾石底基层。

e.en: The column rests on a hidden {subbase} of reinforced concrete.
e.zh: 这根柱子立在隐藏的钢筋混凝土下部基座上。

e.en: The archive is stored in the building's {subbasement}.
e.zh: 档案存放在这栋楼的地下二层。

e.en: Water seeped into the {subbasement} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后，水渗进了更低层的地下室。

e.en: The organ's {subbass} notes shook the old church.
e.zh: 管风琴的超低音震动了那座老教堂。

e.en: The producer added a deep {subbass} under the kick drum.
e.zh: 制作人在底鼓下方加入了深沉的超低音。

e.en: The plant burns {subbituminous} coal from nearby mines.
e.zh: 这家电厂燃烧附近矿山出产的次烟煤。

e.en: {Subbituminous} deposits usually contain more moisture than bituminous coal.
e.zh: 次烟煤矿层通常比烟煤含有更多水分。

e.en: The craftsman placed a {subbolster} beneath the cushion.
e.zh: 工匠在坐垫下放了一只下垫枕。

e.en: A steel {subbolster} supports the larger bearing block.
e.zh: 一个钢制副承枕支撑着较大的轴承座。

e.en: Phonetics is a {subbranch} of linguistics.
e.zh: 语音学是语言学的一个下属分支。

e.en: The river's {subbranch} disappears into the marsh.
e.zh: 这条河的支脉消失在沼泽里。

e.en: The kennel recognizes this dog as a local {subbreed}.
e.zh: 犬舍承认这种狗是一个地方亚品种。

e.en: Farmers selected a hardy {subbreed} for the colder hills.
e.zh: 农民为较冷的山区选育了一个耐寒的次级品系。

e.en: The plant has a {subbulbous} base just above the root.
e.zh: 这种植物在根上方有近球茎状的基部。

e.en: A {subbulbous} swelling appears at the end of the stem.
e.zh: 茎的末端出现了一个稍膨大的部分。

e.en: The president formed a {subcabinet} group on trade policy.
e.zh: 总统成立了一个负责贸易政策的次内阁小组。

e.en: The amplifier fits inside a smaller {subcabinet}.
e.zh: 放大器装在一个较小的下级柜体里。

e.en: The crew trained with {subcaliber} ammunition.
e.zh: 机组人员使用次口径弹药进行训练。

e.en: A {subcaliber} projectile needs a sabot to fit the barrel.
e.zh: 小于口径的弹丸需要弹托才能适配炮管。

e.en: British manuals describe the device as {subcalibre} equipment.
e.zh: 英国手册把该装置称为次口径设备。

e.en: The gun used {subcalibre} rounds during practice.
e.zh: 这门炮在训练中使用了次口径弹。

e.en: The scan showed a {subcapsular} hematoma in the liver.
e.zh: 扫描显示肝脏有包膜下血肿。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {subcapsular} cataract closely.
e.zh: 医生密切观察这处囊下白内障。

e.en: The old formula included bismuth {subcarbonate}.
e.zh: 这个旧配方含有碱式碳酸铋。

e.en: Chemists identified the powder as a {subcarbonate}.
e.zh: 化学家认定这种粉末是一种碱式碳酸盐。

e.en: The receiver locks onto the color {subcarrier}.
e.zh: 接收机会锁定彩色副载波。

e.en: Each {subcarrier} carries part of the digital signal.
e.zh: 每个子载波都承载数字信号的一部分。

e.en: The lizard has small {subcaudal} scales beneath its tail.
e.zh: 这只蜥蜴尾巴下方有细小的尾下鳞片。

e.en: The surgeon noted a {subcaudal} swelling during the examination.
e.zh: 外科医生在检查时注意到尾部下方有肿胀。

e.en: The poet called human sorrow a {subcelestial} burden.
e.zh: 诗人把人类的悲伤称为尘世的重负。

e.en: Medieval writers often contrasted heavenly order with the {subcelestial} world.
e.zh: 中世纪作家常把天上的秩序与天以下的世界相对照。

e.en: The old house had a damp {subcellar} below the wine room.
e.zh: 这座老房子的酒窖下面还有一层潮湿的地下室。

e.en: Workers found Roman bricks in the {subcellar} during repairs.
e.zh: 工人在维修时在地下室下层发现了罗马砖。

subcellular.t: 亚细胞的；细胞内结构的

e.en: The dye reveals {subcellular} structures under the microscope.
e.zh: 这种染料能在显微镜下显示亚细胞结构。

e.en: Researchers tracked the protein's {subcellular} location after infection.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪感染后这种蛋白在细胞内的位置。

e.en: The diagram marks a {subcentral} region just below the main hub.
e.zh: 图中标出了主枢纽下方的次中央区域。

e.en: A {subcentral} office handled routine requests for the district.
e.zh: 一个次级中心办公室负责处理该区的日常请求。

e.en: The fibers are arranged {subcentrally} around the smaller duct.
e.zh: 这些纤维近中心地排列在较小管道周围。

e.en: Power was managed {subcentrally} rather than by the capital alone.
e.zh: 权力由次级中心管理，而不是只由首都掌控。

e.en: The clinic opened a {subcentre} in the northern villages.
e.zh: 诊所在北部村庄开设了一个分中心。

e.en: Each {subcentre} reports weekly data to the main office.
e.zh: 每个分中心每周向总办公室报告数据。

e.en: The experiment tested {subception} of threatening images.
e.zh: 这项实验测试人们对威胁性图像的潜意识感知。

e.en: Some psychologists use {subception} to describe awareness before conscious recognition.
e.zh: 一些心理学家用阈下知觉来描述有意识识别前的感知。

e.en: The scan showed pressure in a {subcerebral} area.
e.zh: 扫描显示大脑下方区域存在压力。

e.en: The study focused on {subcerebral} pathways involved in reflexes.
e.zh: 这项研究关注参与反射的脑下通路。

e.en: The {subchairman} opened the meeting in the chairman's absence.
e.zh: 主席缺席时，副主席主持了会议开场。

e.en: She served as {subchairman} of the regional committee.
e.zh: 她担任地区委员会的副主席。

e.en: A small {subchaser} escorted the convoy through dangerous waters.
e.zh: 一艘小型猎潜艇护送船队穿过危险海域。

e.en: The museum restored a wartime {subchaser} for display.
e.zh: 博物馆修复了一艘战时猎潜艇用于展出。

e.en: The {subchief} settled disputes while the chief was away.
e.zh: 首领外出时，副首领负责调解纠纷。

e.en: Several villages answered to a local {subchief}.
e.zh: 几个村庄归一名当地下级酋长管理。

e.en: The {subchiefs} gathered before the annual council.
e.zh: 副首领们在年度议会前聚集起来。

e.en: Colonial officers often negotiated with local {subchiefs}.
e.zh: 殖民官员常与当地下级酋长们谈判。

e.en: The chemist described the residue as a {subchloride}.
e.zh: 化学家把这种残留物描述为低氯化物。

e.en: Old manuals mention mercury {subchloride} in medical preparations.
e.zh: 旧手册提到药剂中使用过汞的低氯化物。

e.en: The engineer measured the {subchord} of the truss carefully.
e.zh: 工程师仔细测量了桁架的次弦。

e.en: A short {subchord} supports the lower edge of the frame.
e.zh: 一根短次弦支撑着框架的下边缘。

subchromonema.t: 亚染色丝；染色丝下结构

e.en: The paper describes a fine {subchromonema} within the chromosome thread.
e.zh: 论文描述了染色体丝内部的一种细微亚染色丝。

e.en: Early cytologists debated whether the {subchromonema} was visible with standard stains.
e.zh: 早期细胞学家曾争论普通染色能否看到亚染色丝。

e.en: The archive uses {subclassification} to separate legal records from financial ones.
e.zh: 档案馆用子分类把法律记录和财务记录分开。

e.en: Further {subclassification} helped doctors identify the rare tumor type.
e.zh: 进一步再分类帮助医生识别出这种罕见肿瘤类型。

e.en: The team will {subclassify} the samples by genetic markers.
e.zh: 团队将根据遗传标记把样本再分类。

e.en: Teachers may {subclassify} errors into grammar, spelling, and style.
e.zh: 教师可以把错误划分为语法、拼写和文体等子类。

e.en: The fungus has {subclavate} spores under magnification.
e.zh: 放大观察时，这种真菌有略呈棒状的孢子。

e.en: Botanists described the petal tips as {subclavate}.
e.zh: 植物学家把花瓣尖端描述为略呈棒状。

e.en: Fire can maintain a forest in a {subclimax} state.
e.zh: 火灾可能使森林长期保持在亚顶极群落状态。

e.en: The novel reaches a tense {subclimax} before the final revelation.
e.zh: 小说在最终揭示前达到一个紧张的次高潮。

e.en: The radar detected movement beneath the {subclutter}.
e.zh: 雷达在杂波下层检测到了移动。

e.en: Engineers filtered the {subclutter} to improve the signal.
e.zh: 工程师过滤次级杂波以改善信号。

e.en: Apply a {subcoat} before the final layer of paint.
e.zh: 涂最后一层油漆前先刷一层底漆。

e.en: The dog grows a dense {subcoat} in winter.
e.zh: 这只狗冬天会长出浓密的内层毛。

e.en: This {subcollection} contains letters from the 1890s.
e.zh: 这个分藏品收有十九世纪九十年代的信件。

e.en: The database returns a {subcollection} of matching records.
e.zh: 数据库返回一组匹配记录的子集合。

e.en: The university created a {subcollege} for vocational programs.
e.zh: 大学为职业课程设立了一个分学院。

e.en: Each {subcollege} manages its own admissions process.
e.zh: 每个分学院负责管理自己的招生流程。

e.en: The course is designed for {subcollegiate} students.
e.zh: 这门课程是为低于大学程度的学生设计的。

e.en: The report compared college and {subcollegiate} reading levels.
e.zh: 报告比较了大学和低于大学程度的阅读水平。

e.en: The engineer marked a {subcrossing} beneath the main rail line.
e.zh: 工程师标出了主铁路线下方的一处次级横越点。

e.en: A narrow {subcrossing} carried drainage under the old road.
e.zh: 一条狭窄的下方交叉通道把排水引到旧路下面。

e.en: The survey suggested movement in the {subcrust} below the basin.
e.zh: 勘测显示盆地下方的地壳下层有活动。

e.en: Geologists modeled heat flow through the {subcrust}.
e.zh: 地质学家模拟了热量穿过壳下部分的过程。

e.en: The quake began in a {subcrustal} zone far offshore.
e.zh: 这次地震始于远海的一处地壳下区域。

e.en: Researchers measured {subcrustal} heat beneath the plateau.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了高原下方的壳下热量。

e.en: The sample showed a {subcrystalline} structure under magnification.
e.zh: 样品在放大观察下呈现亚晶质结构。

e.en: A {subcrystalline} film formed as the solution cooled.
e.zh: 溶液冷却时形成了一层近似结晶的薄膜。

e.en: The magazine covered a local {subcult} of experimental musicians.
e.zh: 这本杂志报道了当地一个实验音乐小众亚文化群体。

e.en: Online forums helped the {subcult} find new members.
e.zh: 网络论坛帮助这个小众亚文化群体找到新成员。

e.en: The lab used {subcultivation} to keep the cells alive.
e.zh: 实验室通过继代培养让这些细胞保持存活。

e.en: Repeated {subcultivation} changed the behavior of the bacteria.
e.zh: 反复再培养改变了这些细菌的行为。

e.en: The insect has a {subcuticular} layer that stores pigment.
e.zh: 这种昆虫有一层储存色素的角质层下组织。

e.en: Doctors noted {subcuticular} swelling around the wound.
e.zh: 医生注意到伤口周围有表皮下肿胀。

e.en: The needle reached the {subcutis} without entering muscle.
e.zh: 针头到达皮下组织，但没有进入肌肉。

e.en: Fat cells in the {subcutis} help insulate the body.
e.zh: 皮下层中的脂肪细胞有助于身体保温。

e.en: The fossil had a {subcylindrical} stem with faint ridges.
e.zh: 这块化石有一根带浅脊的近圆柱形茎。

e.en: Botanists described the fruit as {subcylindrical} and slightly curved.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种果实描述为近圆柱形且略微弯曲。

e.en: The {subdeacon} read the epistle during the service.
e.zh: 礼拜中，副执事诵读了使徒书信。

e.en: In the old rite, a {subdeacon} assisted the deacon at the altar.
e.zh: 在旧礼仪中，次助祭在祭坛旁协助执事。

subdeaconate.t: 副执事职位；次助祭品级

e.en: He entered the {subdeaconate} before becoming a deacon.
e.zh: 他在成为执事之前先进入副执事品级。

e.en: The council discussed whether the {subdeaconate} should remain a major order.
e.zh: 会议讨论次助祭品级是否仍应列为大品。

subdeaconry.t: 副执事职务；次助祭任期

e.en: His {subdeaconry} lasted only two years.
e.zh: 他的副执事任期只持续了两年。

e.en: The records mention a vacant {subdeaconry} in the cathedral.
e.zh: 档案提到主教座堂有一个空缺的副执事职务。

e.en: The {subdean} managed the cathedral while the dean was away.
e.zh: 主任牧师不在时，副主任牧师管理主教座堂。

e.en: A college {subdean} handled student discipline.
e.zh: 一名学院副院长负责处理学生纪律事务。

subdeanery.t: 副主任牧师职位；副院长职务

e.en: The bishop confirmed his appointment to the {subdeanery}.
e.zh: 主教确认任命他担任副主任牧师职位。

e.en: She held the {subdeanery} during a difficult period for the college.
e.zh: 她在学院艰难时期担任副院长职务。

subdeb.t: 未正式亮相社交界的少女

e.en: The novel portrays a nervous {subdeb} before her first ball.
e.zh: 小说描写了一位首次参加舞会前紧张的未成年社交少女。

e.en: As a {subdeb}, she watched the older girls enter society.
e.zh: 作为尚未正式亮相社交界的少女，她看着年长女孩进入社交圈。

subdebutante.t: 未正式初入社交界的少女

e.en: A shy {subdebutante} stood beside her mother at the reception.
e.zh: 一位腼腆的未正式初入社交界的少女站在母亲身旁参加招待会。

e.en: The column mentioned several {subdebutantes} from prominent families.
e.zh: 专栏提到了几位出身名门、尚未正式亮相社交界的少女。

subdecanal.t: 副主任牧师的；副院长的

e.en: He carried out {subdecanal} duties during the dean's illness.
e.zh: 主任牧师患病期间，他履行了副主任牧师的职责。

e.en: The college revised its {subdecanal} responsibilities last year.
e.zh: 学院去年修订了副院长职责。

e.en: The minister may {subdelegate} routine decisions to a junior official.
e.zh: 部长可以把日常决定转委托给下级官员。

e.en: A {subdelegate} attended the meeting on behalf of the commission.
e.zh: 一名副代表代表委员会参加了会议。

e.en: The director avoided {subdelegating} powers without written approval.
e.zh: 主任避免在没有书面批准的情况下转委托权力。

e.en: By {subdelegating} minor tasks, she kept the project moving.
e.zh: 通过再授权一些小任务，她让项目继续推进。

e.en: The patient showed {subdelirium} after several nights without sleep.
e.zh: 病人连续几晚失眠后出现了轻度谵妄。

e.en: Doctors monitored his {subdelirium} before it became more severe.
e.zh: 医生监测他的亚谵妄状态，以免情况加重。

e.en: The leaf edge was {subdentate} rather than fully serrated.
e.zh: 叶缘只是略有齿状，并非完全锯齿状。

e.en: A {subdentate} margin helped identify the species.
e.zh: 近齿状的边缘有助于鉴定这个物种。

e.en: The archive became a {subdepartment} of the library.
e.zh: 档案馆成了图书馆下属的一个分部门。

e.en: Each {subdepartment} submits its own budget proposal.
e.zh: 每个下属部门都会提交自己的预算方案。

e.en: Supplies were moved from the main depot to a {subdepot}.
e.zh: 补给品从主仓库转移到一个分仓库。

e.en: The army built a {subdepot} near the rail junction.
e.zh: 军队在铁路交会处附近建了一个分补给站。

e.en: The chemist described the compound as a {subderivative} of the original drug.
e.zh: 化学家把这种化合物描述为原药物的次级派生物。

e.en: The dictionary lists the form as a {subderivative} of an older verb.
e.zh: 词典把这个形式列为一个旧动词的再衍生词。

e.en: The candidate received the {subdiaconate} in a formal ceremony.
e.zh: 候选人在正式仪式中领受了副执事品级。

e.en: Some churches no longer treat the {subdiaconate} as a major order.
e.zh: 有些教会不再把次助祭职视为大品。

e.en: The mineral formed a {subcolumnar} mass in the crack.
e.zh: 这种矿物在裂缝中形成了近柱状的团块。

e.en: Some cells appear {subcolumnar} under the microscope.
e.zh: 有些细胞在显微镜下看起来略呈柱形。

e.en: The tool lists all available {subcommands} on the help page.
e.zh: 这个工具会在帮助页面列出所有可用的子命令。

e.en: Several {subcommands} require administrator permission.
e.zh: 有几个下级指令需要管理员权限。

e.en: A {subcommission} reviewed the technical evidence.
e.zh: 一个分委员会审查了这些技术证据。

e.en: The treaty created a {subcommission} on border issues.
e.zh: 该条约设立了一个处理边界问题的小委员会。

e.en: The {subcommissioner} signed the local inspection report.
e.zh: 副专员签署了当地的检查报告。

e.en: A {subcommissioner} handled complaints from the district.
e.zh: 一名下级委员负责处理该区的投诉。

e.en: The forum has a {subcommunity} for new parents.
e.zh: 这个论坛有一个面向新手父母的子社区。

e.en: Each {subcommunity} developed its own informal rules.
e.zh: 每个小群体都形成了自己的非正式规则。

e.en: The proof depends on a {subcommutation} relation between operators.
e.zh: 这个证明依赖于算子之间的子换位关系。

e.en: Engineers modeled {subcommutation} within the switching circuit.
e.zh: 工程师对开关电路中的次级对易进行了建模。

e.en: The foreign {subcompany} reports profits separately.
e.zh: 这家海外子公司会单独报告利润。

e.en: A {subcompany} guarded the eastern gate overnight.
e.zh: 一个下属连队整夜守卫东门。

e.en: The sample contained a rare {subcompound} of the main salt.
e.zh: 样品中含有主盐的一种罕见子化合物。

e.en: Linguists treated the phrase as a {subcompound} word.
e.zh: 语言学家把这个短语视为一个次级复合词。

e.en: The cable includes a smaller {subconductor} for sensing.
e.zh: 这根电缆包含一条用于感测的较小次导体。

e.en: The {subconductor} led rehearsals when the conductor was away.
e.zh: 指挥不在时，副指挥负责排练。

subconical.t: 近圆锥形的；略呈锥状的

e.en: The shell has a {subconical} tip.
e.zh: 这个贝壳有一个近圆锥形的尖端。

e.en: A {subconical} hill rises beyond the village.
e.zh: 村子外面耸起一座略呈锥状的小山。

e.en: The two plots are {subcontiguous} but not legally connected.
e.zh: 这两块地近乎相邻，但在法律上并不相连。

e.en: The lesions appeared {subcontiguous} along the nerve.
e.zh: 这些病灶沿神经呈几乎接触的分布。

e.en: The organ pedal reached into the {subcontraoctave}.
e.zh: 管风琴踏板音延伸到了次低八度音域。

e.en: Few singers can project notes in the {subcontraoctave}.
e.zh: 很少有歌手能清晰唱出次低八度音域的音。

subcontraries.t: 下反对命题；可同真不可同假

e.en: In traditional logic, {subcontraries} cannot both be false.
e.zh: 在传统逻辑中，下反对命题不能同时为假。

e.en: The teacher compared contraries with {subcontraries}.
e.zh: 老师把反对命题和下反对命题作了比较。

e.en: The diagram shows {subcontrariety} at the lower edge.
e.zh: 这张图在下边显示了下反对关系。

e.en: Students often confuse contradiction with {subcontrariety}.
e.zh: 学生常把矛盾关系和下反对关系混淆。

e.en: These two statements are {subcontrary} in classical logic.
e.zh: 在古典逻辑中，这两个陈述是下反对的。

e.en: A {subcontrary} can be true together with its pair.
e.zh: 一个下反对命题可以和它的配对命题同时为真。

e.en: The lens has a {subconvex} surface.
e.zh: 这片透镜有一个略凸的表面。

e.en: The insect's back is described as {subconvex}.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的背部被描述为近凸形。

subcool.t: 使过冷；降至饱和温度以下

e.en: The system can {subcool} the liquid before expansion.
e.zh: 系统可以在膨胀前使液体过冷。

e.en: Engineers {subcool} refrigerant to improve efficiency.
e.zh: 工程师让制冷剂过冷以提高效率。

subcooled.t: 过冷的；低于饱和温度的

e.en: The pipe carries {subcooled} water under pressure.
e.zh: 这根管道输送的是加压过冷水。

e.en: A {subcooled} liquid may flash into vapor suddenly.
e.zh: 过冷液体可能会突然闪蒸成蒸汽。

e.en: The leaf base is {subcordate} rather than fully heart-shaped.
e.zh: 叶基只是近心形，并非完全心形。

e.en: Botanists noted the plant's {subcordate} leaves.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物略呈心形的叶子。

e.en: The injury affected the {subcortex} more than the surface.
e.zh: 这处损伤影响皮质下层多于表层。

e.en: Signals from the {subcortex} shaped the response.
e.zh: 来自下皮质的信号影响了这种反应。

e.en: The patient felt pain in the right {subcostal} area.
e.zh: 患者感到右侧肋下区域疼痛。

e.en: A {subcostal} incision gives access to the liver.
e.zh: 肋下切口可以进入肝脏区域。

e.en: The scan revealed pressure in the {subcranial} space.
e.zh: 扫描显示颅下空间存在压力。

e.en: Surgeons approached the tumor through a {subcranial} route.
e.zh: 外科医生通过颅下路径接近肿瘤。

e.en: Please {subcribe} your initials beneath the note.
e.zh: 请在便条下方署上你姓名的首字母。

e.en: The clerk forgot to {subcribe} the witness's name.
e.zh: 书记员忘了在下方写上证人的姓名。

e.en: The map marks a coal {subcrop} beneath shallow soil.
e.zh: 地图标出了浅层土壤下的煤层隐伏露头。

e.en: Drilling confirmed the {subcrop} along the valley edge.
e.zh: 钻探证实了山谷边缘的近地表岩层。

e.en: This village speaks a {subdialect} of the regional language.
e.zh: 这个村子说的是该地区语言的一种次方言。

e.en: The study compares each {subdialect} in detail.
e.zh: 这项研究详细比较了每一种方言分支。

e.en: Save the images in a separate {subdirectory}.
e.zh: 把这些图片保存在单独的子目录里。

e.en: The script scans every {subdirectory} automatically.
e.zh: 这个脚本会自动扫描每个下级文件夹。

e.en: The clinic serves a small {subdistrict} outside the city.
e.zh: 这家诊所服务于城外一个小分区。

e.en: Each {subdistrict} elects its own local committee.
e.zh: 每个下辖区都会选出自己的地方委员会。

e.en: The land is legally {subdividable} into smaller lots.
e.zh: 这块土地依法可以再细分成更小的地块。

e.en: The category is {subdividable} by age and income.
e.zh: 这个类别可以按年龄和收入进一步细分。

e.en: The property is {subdivisible} under local planning rules.
e.zh: 根据当地规划规定，这处房产可以分割。

e.en: The concept is {subdivisible} into several practical cases.
e.zh: 这个概念可以细分为几个实际情形。

e.en: The villain used a {subdolous} argument to mislead the court.
e.zh: 那个反派用狡猾阴险的论点误导法庭。

e.en: Her {subdolous} smile made him distrust the offer.
e.zh: 她阴险的微笑让他不信任这个提议。

e.en: Large websites often use several {subdomains} for different services.
e.zh: 大型网站常用多个子域来提供不同服务。

e.en: Linguistics contains many {subdomains} with their own methods.
e.zh: 语言学包含许多各有方法的分领域。

e.en: The species remained {subdominant} in the forest canopy.
e.zh: 这个物种在森林冠层中仍处于次优势地位。

e.en: The melody briefly moves to the {subdominant}.
e.zh: 旋律短暂转向了下属音。

e.en: The engineers mapped the field's {subdrainage} system.
e.zh: 工程师绘制了这片田地的次排水系统图。

e.en: Poor {subdrainage} caused water to collect under the road.
e.zh: 分流域排水不良导致道路下方积水。

e.en: The crew used {subdrilling} to reach the lower seam.
e.zh: 施工队通过辅助钻孔到达较低的矿层。

e.en: Careful {subdrilling} reduced damage to the main borehole.
e.zh: 谨慎的次级钻探减少了对主井孔的损伤。

e.en: The fire was still {subduable} with enough water.
e.zh: 只要水量充足，这场火仍可被压制住。

e.en: He believed the rebellion was {subduable} by negotiation.
e.zh: 他认为这场叛乱可以通过谈判平息。

e.en: The army completed the {subdual} of the fortress.
e.zh: 军队完成了对这座堡垒的征服。

e.en: The medicine helped with the {subdual} of severe pain.
e.zh: 这种药有助于压制剧烈疼痛。

e.en: The formula can {subduce} one value from another.
e.zh: 这个公式可以从一个数值中减去另一个数值。

e.en: Geologists say one plate may {subduce} beneath another.
e.zh: 地质学家说，一个板块可能会俯冲到另一个板块之下。

e.en: The treaty followed the {subduement} of the border tribes.
e.zh: 这项条约是在边境部族被征服之后签订的。

e.en: The poem describes the {subduement} of anger by reason.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了理性对愤怒的抑制。

e.en: The ratio is {subduple} when one quantity is half the other.
e.zh: 当一个量是另一个量的一半时，这个比例就是二分之一的。

e.en: The old treatise calls this a {subduple} proportion.
e.zh: 那本旧论著把这称作半比。

e.en: Astronomers identified the object as a hot {subdwarf}.
e.zh: 天文学家把这个天体识别为一颗炽热的次矮星。

e.en: A {subdwarf} is fainter than many ordinary stars.
e.zh: 次矮星比许多普通恒星更暗。

e.en: The mine contains {subeconomic} amounts of copper.
e.zh: 这座矿含有未达经济开采价值的铜。

e.en: Rising prices may make the {subeconomic} deposit profitable.
e.zh: 价格上涨可能让这处原本无经济价值的矿床变得有利可图。

e.en: She was hired to {subedit} the weekly magazine.
e.zh: 她受聘为这本周刊审改稿件。

e.en: Please {subedit} the article before it goes online.
e.zh: 文章上线前请先做副编辑审改。

subedited.t: 已审改的；经副编辑处理的

e.en: The report was {subedited} before publication.
e.zh: 这份报告在发表前已经过审改。

e.en: He {subedited} the copy for style and accuracy.
e.zh: 他从文风和准确性上审改了这份稿件。

e.en: Good {subediting} made the article much clearer.
e.zh: 出色的审改让这篇文章清楚了许多。

e.en: She learned {subediting} at a national newspaper.
e.zh: 她在一家全国性报社学习副编辑工作。

e.en: The {subeditor} corrected the headline before printing.
e.zh: 副编辑在印刷前改正了标题。

e.en: A careful {subeditor} catches errors reporters miss.
e.zh: 细心的文字编辑能发现记者漏掉的错误。

e.en: The newspaper changed its {subeditorial} policy last year.
e.zh: 这家报纸去年调整了副编辑政策。

e.en: Her {subeditorial} notes improved the structure of the piece.
e.zh: 她的审稿编辑意见改善了文章结构。

e.en: The {subeditors} checked every caption for accuracy.
e.zh: 副编辑们核对了每条图片说明的准确性。

e.en: Experienced {subeditors} often rewrite awkward headlines.
e.zh: 有经验的文字编辑常会改写别扭的标题。

e.en: She {subedits} features for a Sunday newspaper.
e.zh: 她为一家星期日报纸审改专题稿件。

e.en: The final {subedits} removed several unclear sentences.
e.zh: 最后的副编辑改动删去了几句不清楚的话。

e.en: Many graduates feel {subemployed} in low-paid temporary jobs.
e.zh: 许多毕业生在低薪临时工作中感到就业不足。

e.en: The survey counted workers who were {subemployed} but not unemployed.
e.zh: 这项调查统计了就业不足但并非失业的工人。

subemployment.t: 次级就业；从属就业身份

e.en: The survey counted seasonal farm work as {subemployment} rather than full employment.
e.zh: 这项调查把季节性农活算作次级就业，而不是充分就业。

e.en: Workers in {subemployment} often lack benefits and stable hours.
e.zh: 处于从属就业状态的工人往往没有福利，工时也不稳定。

e.en: The dictionary lists this spelling as a {subentry} under the main word.
e.zh: 这本词典把这个拼写列为主词下的子条目。

e.en: Each invoice {subentry} shows a different tax rate.
e.zh: 发票上的每个分项条目都显示不同的税率。

e.en: The doctor noticed a {subepidermal} blister on her hand.
e.zh: 医生注意到她手上有一个表皮下水疱。

e.en: Researchers measured changes in the {subepidermal} tissue.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了表皮下组织的变化。

e.en: The two leaf segments are {subequal} in length.
e.zh: 这两个叶片部分长度近乎相等。

e.en: A {subequal} partner still had less voting power.
e.zh: 这个地位略次的合伙人仍然拥有较少投票权。

e.en: The species thrives in {subequatorial} forests with heavy rainfall.
e.zh: 这个物种在雨量充沛的近赤道森林中繁盛生长。

e.en: Satellites tracked storms across the {subequatorial} ocean.
e.zh: 卫星追踪了赤道附近海域上空的风暴。

e.en: The wound began to {suberate} as the plant healed.
e.zh: 植物愈合时，伤口开始木栓化。

e.en: A {suberate} layer protected the stem from drying out.
e.zh: 一层含木栓质的组织保护茎部不致干枯。

e.en: The shrub has {suberect} branches near the base.
e.zh: 这种灌木基部附近有近直立的枝条。

e.en: Its ears remained {suberect} when it listened.
e.zh: 它倾听时耳朵保持半竖起的状态。

e.en: The bark becomes {subereose} as the stem ages.
e.zh: 随着茎变老，树皮会变得软木状。

e.en: A {subereose} texture covered the old root.
e.zh: 老根表面覆盖着木栓质的纹理。

e.en: The fruit had a dry, {subereous} outer layer.
e.zh: 这种果实有一层干燥的软木质外皮。

e.en: Botanists described the stem as {subereous} near the scar.
e.zh: 植物学家描述说，伤痕附近的茎呈木栓样。

e.en: The lab prepared a sample of {suberic} acid.
e.zh: 实验室制备了一份辛二酸样品。

e.en: This reaction produces {suberic} derivatives used in polymers.
e.zh: 这个反应会生成用于聚合物的辛二酸衍生物。

e.en: Cork cells contain {suberin}, which helps block water loss.
e.zh: 软木细胞含有木栓质，有助于阻止水分流失。

e.en: The roots deposited {suberin} after exposure to salt.
e.zh: 根部在接触盐分后沉积了木栓质。

e.en: The coal sample contained visible bands of {suberinite}.
e.zh: 这份煤样中含有可见的木栓质煤素条带。

e.en: Petrographers identified {suberinite} under reflected light.
e.zh: 岩相学人员在反射光下识别出木栓质煤素。

suberinitecollinite.t: 木栓质胶质煤素混合物

e.en: The report classified the particle as {suberinitecollinite}.
e.zh: 报告把这个颗粒归类为木栓质胶质煤素混合物。

e.en: Analysts found {suberinitecollinite} in the polished coal section.
e.zh: 分析人员在抛光煤片中发现了木栓质胶质煤素混合物。

e.en: Root {suberization} increased after drought stress.
e.zh: 干旱胁迫后，根部木栓化过程增强了。

e.en: The experiment measured {suberization} around the damaged tissue.
e.zh: 实验测量了受损组织周围的木栓化情况。

e.en: Plants often {suberize} cells around a wound.
e.zh: 植物常会使伤口周围的细胞木栓化。

e.en: The outer layer will {suberize} as the tuber matures.
e.zh: 块茎成熟时，外层会发生木栓化。

suberose.t: 软木状的；粗糙木栓质的

e.en: The old stem had a {suberose} surface.
e.zh: 老茎表面呈软木状。

e.en: A {suberose} covering formed over the injury.
e.zh: 伤口上形成了一层粗糙的木栓质覆盖物。

e.en: The assay used {suberylarginine} as a synthetic substrate.
e.zh: 该测定使用辛二酰精氨酸作为合成底物。

e.en: Researchers tracked how quickly {suberylarginine} was cleaved.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪辛二酰精氨酸被裂解的速度。

e.en: The platform routes small trades through a regional {subexchange}.
e.zh: 该平台通过区域子交换所处理小额交易。

e.en: Each {subexchange} reports prices to the central system.
e.zh: 每个分级交易所都会向中央系统报告价格。

e.en: The generator failed when the {subexciter} lost power.
e.zh: 副励磁机断电后，发电机发生故障。

e.en: Engineers replaced the {subexciter} during the outage.
e.zh: 工程师在停机期间更换了辅助激励器。

e.en: She remained {subfebrile} for two days after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后两天，她一直处于低热状态。

e.en: The patient had {subfebrile} symptoms but no clear infection.
e.zh: 患者有微发热症状，但没有明确感染。

e.en: Power reached the workshop through a {subfeeder} line.
e.zh: 电力通过一条支馈线输送到车间。

e.en: The mill uses a {subfeeder} to control grain flow.
e.zh: 磨坊使用次级给料器来控制谷物流量。

e.en: The formula uses a {subfix} to mark each variable.
e.zh: 这个公式用下标记号标出每个变量。

e.en: Editors added a {subfix} to distinguish the two terms.
e.zh: 编辑加了一个附加下标来区分这两个术语。

e.en: Chemists isolated a rare metal {subfluoride}.
e.zh: 化学家分离出一种罕见的金属低氟化物。

e.en: The {subfluoride} decomposes rapidly in moist air.
e.zh: 这种次氟化物在潮湿空气中会迅速分解。

e.en: The survey mapped {subfluvial} channels beneath the riverbed.
e.zh: 调查绘制了河床下方的河底通道。

e.en: Engineers studied {subfluvial} sediments before building the bridge.
e.zh: 工程师在建桥前研究了河流下方的沉积物。

e.en: The database opens a {subform} for each customer order.
e.zh: 数据库会为每个客户订单打开一个分表单。

e.en: This dialect is a {subform} of a broader regional variety.
e.zh: 这种方言是更大区域变体的一种子形式。

e.en: The geologist mapped a smaller {subformation} beneath the main layer.
e.zh: 地质学家绘出了主岩层下方较小的次级形成层。

e.en: A local {subformation} handled logistics for the wider unit.
e.zh: 一个地方下属编队负责整个部队的后勤工作。

e.en: The cave contained {subfossil} bones of extinct birds.
e.zh: 洞穴里有已灭绝鸟类的半化石骨骼。

e.en: Scientists dated the {subfossil} wood using radiocarbon methods.
e.zh: 科学家用放射性碳法测定这块亚化石木材的年代。

e.en: The mechanic replaced both damaged {subframes} after the crash.
e.zh: 事故后，修理工更换了两个受损的副车架。

e.en: The video codec divides each scene into smaller {subframes}.
e.zh: 这种视频编码器把每个场景分成更小的子帧。

e.en: The team trained in {subfreezing} temperatures all week.
e.zh: 整个星期，队伍都在低于冰点的气温中训练。

e.en: Road salt is less effective during prolonged {subfreezing} weather.
e.zh: 在长期低于冰点的天气里，融雪盐效果会变差。

e.en: The broker listed the shipment as {subfreight} under the main contract.
e.zh: 经纪人把这批货列为主合同下的次级货运。

e.en: Small carriers handled the {subfreight} between rural depots.
e.zh: 小型承运商负责乡村仓库之间的分段货运。

e.en: The receiver locked onto a weak {subfrequency} in the signal.
e.zh: 接收器锁定了信号中一个微弱的子频率。

e.en: Engineers adjusted each {subfrequency} to reduce interference.
e.zh: 工程师调整每个分频以减少干扰。

e.en: The students wore {subfusc} for the formal examination.
e.zh: 学生们穿着牛津正式礼服参加考试。

e.en: A {subfusc} light filled the old reading room.
e.zh: 昏暗的光线充满了旧阅览室。

e.en: The moth had {subfuscous} wings with pale edges.
e.zh: 那只蛾子的翅膀呈暗褐色，边缘较浅。

e.en: A {subfuscous} haze settled over the valley.
e.zh: 一层阴暗的薄雾笼罩了山谷。

e.en: The painter chose a {subfusk} tone for the background.
e.zh: 画家为背景选了一种略显昏暗的色调。

e.en: Old varnish gave the portrait a {subfusk} appearance.
e.zh: 旧清漆让这幅肖像显得色调暗沉。

e.en: The surgeon noted swelling in the {subgenital} area.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到生殖器下方区域有肿胀。

e.en: Some insects have distinctive {subgenital} plates.
e.zh: 有些昆虫具有明显的生殖器下板。

e.en: This orchid belongs to a rare {subgenus}.
e.zh: 这种兰花属于一个罕见的亚属。

e.en: The paper moved two species into a new {subgenus}.
e.zh: 这篇论文把两个物种归入一个新的亚属。

e.en: The guide compares several {subgenuses} of desert plants.
e.zh: 这本指南比较了几类沙漠植物的亚属。

e.en: Taxonomists disagreed about how many {subgenuses} the group contains.
e.zh: 分类学家对这一类群包含多少个亚属意见不一。

e.en: The telescope detected a yellow {subgiant} near the cluster.
e.zh: 望远镜在星团附近探测到一颗黄色亚巨星。

e.en: A {subgiant} is brighter than a dwarf star but smaller than a giant.
e.zh: 亚巨星比矮星更亮，但比巨星小。

e.en: Researchers found a {subglacial} lake beneath the ice sheet.
e.zh: 研究人员在冰盖下发现了一个冰下湖。

e.en: The eruption released water through {subglacial} channels.
e.zh: 火山喷发使水通过冰川下的通道流出。

e.en: The rocks were carved {subglacially} during the last ice age.
e.zh: 这些岩石是在上一个冰河时期由冰川下作用刻蚀而成的。

e.en: Water moves {subglacially} toward the edge of the ice sheet.
e.zh: 水在冰川下朝冰盖边缘流动。

e.en: The province created a {subgovernment} to manage local services.
e.zh: 该省设立了一个下级政府来管理地方服务。

e.en: Each {subgovernment} reported its budget separately.
e.zh: 每个次级政府都单独报告自己的预算。

e.en: The crew compacted the {subgrade} before laying asphalt.
e.zh: 施工队在铺沥青前压实了路基。

e.en: Poor drainage weakened the road's {subgrade}.
e.zh: 排水不良削弱了道路的底基层。

e.en: She ordered {subgum} chow mein from the old diner.
e.zh: 她在那家老餐馆点了一份什锦炒面。

e.en: The menu described the soup as {subgum} style.
e.zh: 菜单把这道汤描述为什锦风味。

e.en: The lab prepared a silver {subhalide} for the experiment.
e.zh: 实验室为这项实验制备了一种银的低卤化物。

e.en: A {subhalide} contains less halogen than a normal halide.
e.zh: 亚卤化物所含卤素少于普通卤化物。

e.en: The instrument produced a strong {subharmonic} below the main tone.
e.zh: 这种乐器在主音下方产生了强烈的次谐波。

e.en: Engineers measured {subharmonic} vibration in the rotating shaft.
e.zh: 工程师测量了旋转轴中的次谐波振动。

e.en: The amplifier added unwanted {subharmonics} to the signal.
e.zh: 放大器给信号加入了不需要的次谐波。

e.en: Singers sometimes create {subharmonics} below their normal range.
e.zh: 歌手有时会发出低于正常音域的分谐波。

e.en: The clinic promoted screenings for people in {subhealth}.
e.zh: 诊所推广面向亚健康人群的筛查。

e.en: Long stress can push workers into {subhealth} before illness appears.
e.zh: 长期压力会在疾病出现前使员工进入亚健康状态。

e.en: The thin section showed {subhedral} crystals of feldspar.
e.zh: 薄片中显示出长石的半自形晶体。

e.en: A {subhedral} grain has some but not all crystal faces.
e.zh: 半自形颗粒具有部分晶面，但并不完整。

e.en: The scan showed fluid in the {subhepatic} space.
e.zh: 扫描显示肝下间隙有积液。

e.en: Surgeons drained a {subhepatic} abscess after the operation.
e.zh: 手术后，外科医生引流了一个肝下脓肿。

e.en: The specimen showed {subheteromorphous} structures under magnification.
e.zh: 标本在放大后显示出略异形的结构。

e.en: Botanists described the leaves as {subheteromorphous} rather than uniform.
e.zh: 植物学家把这些叶子描述为近异形，而不是形态一致。

e.en: The crystals were described as {subhomomorphous} under the microscope.
e.zh: 这些晶体在显微镜下被描述为近似同形。

e.en: A {subhomomorphous} structure can resemble another without matching it exactly.
e.zh: 近似同形结构可能像另一种结构，但并不完全一致。

e.en: The region has a {subhumid} climate with seasonal rainfall.
e.zh: 该地区属半湿润气候，降雨有季节性。

e.en: Farmers adapted their crops to the {subhumid} conditions.
e.zh: 农民根据半湿润的环境调整了作物。

e.en: The fungus showed a dense {subhymenium} beneath the spore-bearing layer.
e.zh: 这种真菌在产孢层下方有致密的子实层下组织。

e.en: Researchers examined the {subhymenium} to identify the mushroom.
e.zh: 研究人员检查子实层下组织来鉴定这种蘑菇。

e.en: The thin section contained several {subidiomorphic} mineral grains.
e.zh: 这张薄片中含有几颗半自形矿物颗粒。

e.en: A {subidiomorphic} crystal has partly developed natural faces.
e.zh: 半自形晶体具有部分发育出的天然晶面。

e.en: The mayfly rests briefly as a {subimago} before its final molt.
e.zh: 蜉蝣在最后一次蜕皮前会短暂停留在亚成虫阶段。

e.en: A {subimago} often has duller wings than the adult insect.
e.zh: 亚成虫的翅膀通常比成虫更暗淡。

e.en: The metal glowed with a {subincandescent} red heat.
e.zh: 金属发出近白热的红光。

e.en: A {subincandescent} filament may still emit visible light.
e.zh: 微炽的灯丝仍可能发出可见光。

e.en: The formula uses a {subindex} to distinguish each variable.
e.zh: 这个公式用下标区分每个变量。

e.en: The archive added a {subindex} for medieval manuscripts.
e.zh: 档案馆为中世纪手稿增设了分索引。

e.en: Different {subindices} mark the rows and columns in the matrix.
e.zh: 不同下标标记矩阵中的行和列。

e.en: The catalog contains separate {subindices} for authors and subjects.
e.zh: 这本目录有按作者和主题分列的分索引。

e.en: The lord could {subinfeudate} part of his estate to a knight.
e.zh: 领主可以把部分地产转封给一名骑士。

e.en: They chose to {subinfeudate} the manor rather than manage it directly.
e.zh: 他们选择把庄园转封出去，而不是直接管理。

e.en: {Subinfeudation} complicated the chain of feudal obligations.
e.zh: 转封采邑制度使封建义务链条变得复杂。

e.en: The statute limited {subinfeudation} in medieval landholding.
e.zh: 该法令限制了中世纪土地持有中的转封采邑。

e.en: A {subinfeudatory} owed service to an intermediate lord.
e.zh: 次级封臣要向中间领主履行服役义务。

e.en: The charter recorded a {subinfeudatory} grant of the land.
e.zh: 这份特许状记录了该土地的转封授予。

e.en: The {subinspector} reviewed the safety report before noon.
e.zh: 副检查员在中午前审查了安全报告。

e.en: A police {subinspector} questioned the witnesses at the station.
e.zh: 一名警察副督察在警局询问了证人。

e.en: Divide the line into each smaller {subinterval} before integrating.
e.zh: 积分前先把这条线分成各个较小的子区间。

e.en: The estimate is constant on every {subinterval} of the partition.
e.zh: 该估计在划分出的每个子区间上都是常数。

e.en: The old text mentions mercury {subiodide} as a compound.
e.zh: 这本旧书把低碘化汞列为一种化合物。

e.en: A {subiodide} contains less iodine than the normal iodide.
e.zh: 低碘化物所含的碘少于普通碘化物。

e.en: The farm uses pipes to {subirrigate} the greenhouse beds.
e.zh: 农场用管道对温室苗床进行地下灌溉。

e.en: Engineers planned to {subirrigate} the field from below the root zone.
e.zh: 工程师计划从根区下方对田地进行地下灌溉。

e.en: The {subirrigated} plots stayed moist during the dry week.
e.zh: 这些经地下灌溉的地块在干旱的一周里仍保持湿润。

e.en: Lettuce grew evenly in the {subirrigated} trays.
e.zh: 生菜在地下灌溉的育苗盘中长势均匀。

e.en: The patient felt a {subitaneous} pain in his chest.
e.zh: 病人胸口突然感到一阵疼痛。

e.en: Some insects produce {subitaneous} eggs that hatch without delay.
e.zh: 有些昆虫会产下可立即孵化的即时卵。

e.en: The music shifts {subito} from soft strings to brass.
e.zh: 音乐突然从柔和的弦乐转为铜管声部。

e.en: The score marks the passage {subito} piano.
e.zh: 乐谱把这一段标为突然转弱。

e.en: The map shows the {subjacency} of clay beneath the sand.
e.zh: 地图显示黏土位于沙层下方。

e.en: Engineers studied the {subjacency} of the tunnel to old foundations.
e.zh: 工程师研究了隧道与旧地基的下承邻接关系。

e.en: The {subjacent} rock layer supports the entire slope.
e.zh: 位于下方的岩层支撑着整个斜坡。

e.en: Moisture rose from the {subjacent} soil into the wall.
e.zh: 水分从下方土壤上升进入墙体。

e.en: The second layer lies {subjacently} to the loose gravel.
e.zh: 第二层位于松散砾石的下方。

e.en: The membrane is positioned {subjacently} within the tissue sample.
e.zh: 这层膜在组织样本中位于下方。

e.en: Choose a {subject-area} before searching the database.
e.zh: 搜索数据库前先选择一个学科领域。

e.en: Her strongest {subject-area} is environmental law.
e.zh: 她最擅长的学科领域是环境法。

e.en: The librarian updated the book's {subject-headings}.
e.zh: 图书管理员更新了这本书的主题标目。

e.en: Search results improve when {subject-headings} are consistent.
e.zh: 主题标目保持一致时，搜索结果会更好。

e.en: The course covers difficult {subject-matter} in clear steps.
e.zh: 这门课用清晰步骤讲解困难的主题内容。

e.en: The painting's {subject-matter} shocked many viewers.
e.zh: 这幅画的题材让许多观众感到震惊。

e.en: The teacher explained the {subject-predicate} pattern in simple sentences.
e.zh: 老师讲解了简单句中的主谓结构。

e.en: A clear {subject-predicate} relation helps readers parse the clause.
e.zh: 清晰的主谓关系有助于读者理解从句。

e.en: The essay tries to {subjectify} historical facts through personal memory.
e.zh: 这篇文章试图通过个人记忆使历史事实主观化。

e.en: Some philosophers argue that perception can {subjectify} the world we describe.
e.zh: 一些哲学家认为，知觉会赋予我们所描述的世界以主体性。

e.en: The linguist marked the {subjectival} role in the sentence.
e.zh: 语言学家标出了句子中的主语作用。

e.en: The theory gives unusual weight to {subjectival} experience.
e.zh: 这一理论格外重视与主体相关的经验。

e.en: The critic tends to {subjectivise} every political argument.
e.zh: 这位评论家往往把每个政治论点都主观化。

e.en: Artists may {subjectivise} ordinary scenes through color and rhythm.
e.zh: 艺术家可以通过色彩和节奏按主观方式表现日常场景。

e.en: His {subjectivistic} account ignored the material conditions of the workers.
e.zh: 他的主观主义叙述忽视了工人的物质处境。

e.en: The review sounded too {subjectivistic} to guide other readers.
e.zh: 这篇评论听起来过于主观，难以指导其他读者。

e.en: The novel shows the {subjectivization} of public history.
e.zh: 这部小说展现了公共历史的主观化过程。

e.en: Modern education can involve the {subjectivization} of moral choices.
e.zh: 现代教育可能涉及道德选择的主体化。

e.en: The narrator begins to {subjectivize} the war after losing his brother.
e.zh: 叙述者在失去兄弟后开始把战争经验主观化。

e.en: The method can {subjectivize} data that should remain objective.
e.zh: 这种方法可能会使本应客观的数据主观化。

e.en: The teacher asked why the clause was {subjectless}.
e.zh: 老师问为什么这个从句没有主语。

e.en: The painting presents a cold, {subjectless} view of modern life.
e.zh: 这幅画呈现出现代生活冷峻而无主体的景象。

e.en: Please {subjoin} your references at the end of the report.
e.zh: 请在报告末尾附上你的参考文献。

e.en: The editor will {subjoin} a brief note to clarify the date.
e.zh: 编辑会附加一则简短说明来澄清日期。

e.en: Her {subjoinder} softened the force of the accusation.
e.zh: 她的补充陈述缓和了指控的力度。

e.en: The contract included a legal {subjoinder} about late payment.
e.zh: 合同中包含一条关于逾期付款的法律附加说明。

e.en: The {subjoined} table lists the missing documents.
e.zh: 附加的表格列出了缺失的文件。

e.en: He read the {subjoined} remarks after the main speech.
e.zh: 他在主旨演讲后读了补充说明。

e.en: The clerk was {subjoining} a certificate to the application.
e.zh: 办事员正在把一份证明附加到申请材料上。

e.en: By {subjoining} one phrase, she changed the whole meaning.
e.zh: 她通过补充一个短语改变了整句话的意思。

e.en: The author {subjoins} a warning in the final paragraph.
e.zh: 作者在最后一段附加了一条警告。

e.en: The rule {subjoins} an exception for medical emergencies.
e.zh: 这条规则补充规定了医疗紧急情况的例外。

e.en: The surgeon examined the small {subjoint} near the damaged tendon.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了受损肌腱附近的小次级关节。

e.en: The diagram labels each {subjoint} structure in the mechanism.
e.zh: 图表标出了该机械装置中的每个附属关节结构。

e.en: The empire viewed the province as easily {subjugable}.
e.zh: 帝国认为这个省份很容易被征服。

e.en: She rejected the idea that any culture was naturally {subjugable}.
e.zh: 她反对任何文化天生可被制服的观念。

subjugationist.t: 主张征服者；压迫主义者

e.en: The pamphlet attacked the senator as a {subjugationist}.
e.zh: 这本小册子攻击那位参议员是压迫主义者。

e.en: A {subjugationist} policy cannot produce lasting peace.
e.zh: 主张征服的政策不可能带来持久和平。

e.en: History remembered him as a ruthless {subjugator}.
e.zh: 历史把他记作一名残酷的征服者。

e.en: The poem gives the {subjugator} no heroic dignity.
e.zh: 这首诗没有赋予压迫者任何英雄般的尊严。

e.en: The grammar book explains {subjunction} with several Latin examples.
e.zh: 这本语法书用几个拉丁语例子解释从属连接。

e.en: The lawyer used {subjunction} to add a condition to the clause.
e.zh: 律师通过附加方式给该条款加入了一个条件。

e.en: The organism was assigned to a different {subkingdom}.
e.zh: 这种生物被归入了另一个亚界。

e.en: Students compared each {subkingdom} in the old classification system.
e.zh: 学生们比较了旧分类体系中的每个生物亚界。

e.en: The dentist noted a small {sublabial} swelling.
e.zh: 牙医注意到下唇下方有一处小肿胀。

e.en: The fossil showed a distinct {sublabial} ridge.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出明显的唇下部脊状结构。

e.en: The team mapped a {sublacustrine} channel beneath the lake.
e.zh: 团队绘制了湖底一条水道的地图。

e.en: Volcanic gases may collect in {sublacustrine} sediments.
e.zh: 火山气体可能积聚在湖底沉积物中。

e.en: The geologist described a {sublamine} deposit under the clay layer.
e.zh: 地质学家描述了黏土层下方的薄层下沉积物。

e.en: The microscope revealed {sublamine} fibers in the sample.
e.zh: 显微镜显示样本中有层板下纤维。

e.en: Formal logic uses restricted {sublanguages} for precise proofs.
e.zh: 形式逻辑使用受限的子语言来进行精确证明。

e.en: The community developed several {sublanguages} for different trades.
e.zh: 这个社群为不同职业发展出几种分支语言。

e.en: The theologian defended a {sublapsarian} reading of election.
e.zh: 这位神学家为堕落后预定论式的拣选解释辩护。

e.en: His {sublapsarian} position differed from stricter Calvinist views.
e.zh: 他的堕落后预定论立场不同于更严格的加尔文主义观点。

e.en: The seminar compared {sublapsarianism} with supralapsarianism.
e.zh: 研讨课比较了堕落后预定论和堕落前预定论。

e.en: Few lay readers understand {sublapsarianism} without historical context.
e.zh: 没有历史背景，很少有普通读者能理解堕落后预定论。

e.en: Hegel used the term to {sublate} contradiction within a higher unity.
e.zh: 黑格尔用这个术语表示在更高统一中扬弃矛盾。

e.en: The new policy tried to {sublate} older customs rather than erase them.
e.zh: 新政策试图扬弃旧习俗，而不是把它们彻底抹去。

e.en: Hegel says each stage {sublates} the one before it.
e.zh: 黑格尔认为每个阶段都会扬弃前一个阶段。

e.en: The new policy {sublates} older rules instead of simply deleting them.
e.zh: 新政策不是简单删除旧规则，而是将其消解并保留下来。

e.en: The essay explains {sublation} in Hegelian philosophy.
e.zh: 这篇文章解释了黑格尔哲学中的扬弃。

e.en: Her theory treats conflict as a process of {sublation}.
e.zh: 她的理论把冲突视为一种消解并保留的过程。

e.en: The engineer inspected the concrete {sublayer} before paving.
e.zh: 工程师在铺路前检查了混凝土下层。

e.en: This neural network has an attention {sublayer} inside each block.
e.zh: 这个神经网络的每个模块里都有一个注意力子层。

e.en: The {sublessee} paid rent directly to the original tenant.
e.zh: 转租承租人直接向原承租人支付租金。

e.en: A {sublessee} must follow the building's safety rules.
e.zh: 转租承租人必须遵守大楼的安全规定。

e.en: The {sublessor} remained responsible for the main lease.
e.zh: 转租出租人仍需对主租约负责。

e.en: She became a {sublessor} when she rented out one room.

e.zh: 诗人试图把悲伤升华为艺术。

e.zh: 加热可以使这种物质不先熔化而直接升华。

e.zh: 编辑决定在每段可疑文字下面划线。
