e.zh: 尘土样本中含有许多更小的颗粒碎片。

e.en: The lawyer received a {subpena} for the records.
e.zh: 律师收到了一张索取记录的传票。

e.en: They can {subpena} witnesses to appear in court.
e.zh: 他们可以用传唤令要求证人出庭。

e.en: The court issued three {subpenas} yesterday.
e.zh: 法院昨天发出了三张传票。

e.en: The committee {subpenas} documents from several companies.
e.zh: 委员会传唤了几家公司提交文件。

subphyla.t: 亚门；生物分类亚门复数

e.en: The textbook compares several animal {subphyla}.
e.zh: 这本教材比较了几个动物亚门。

e.en: These {subphyla} share a common body plan.
e.zh: 这些亚门具有共同的身体结构。

e.en: Crustaceans belong to a major arthropod {subphylum}.
e.zh: 甲壳类属于节肢动物的一个主要亚门。

e.en: The species was placed in a different {subphylum}.
e.zh: 这个物种被归入了另一个亚门。

subpicosecond.t: 亚皮秒的；小于一皮秒的

e.en: The laser produced {subpicosecond} pulses.
e.zh: 这台激光器产生了亚皮秒脉冲。

e.en: Researchers measured a {subpicosecond} delay in the signal.
e.zh: 研究人员测得信号有小于一皮秒的延迟。

e.en: Neurons in the {subplate} guide early brain wiring.
e.zh: 皮质下板层中的神经元引导早期脑连接形成。

e.en: The engineer added a steel {subplate} for support.
e.zh: 工程师加了一块钢制下板来提供支撑。

e.en: The CT scan showed {subpleural} nodules.
e.zh: CT扫描显示有胸膜下结节。

e.en: Doctors watched the {subpleural} shadow closely.
e.zh: 医生密切观察那片近胸膜阴影。

e.en: The statue rests on a narrow {subplinth}.
e.zh: 这座雕像立在一层狭窄的副台基上。

e.en: Builders repaired the cracked stone {subplinth}.
e.zh: 建筑工人修补了开裂的石质底座下层。

e.en: Her second {subpoint} supported the main argument.
e.zh: 她的第二个分论点支撑了主论点。

e.en: Add each {subpoint} under the correct heading.
e.zh: 把每个次要点放在正确的小标题下面。

e.en: The island has a cold {subpolar} climate.
e.zh: 这座岛属于寒冷的亚极地气候。

e.en: Some {subpolar} waters remain rich in nutrients.
e.zh: 一些近极地水域仍富含养分。

e.en: She accepted a {subpost} in the regional office.
e.zh: 她接受了地区办公室的一个副职位。

e.en: Please reply in the relevant {subpost}.
e.zh: 请在相关的子帖子里回复。

e.en: Tests revealed {subpotency} in the vaccine batch.
e.zh: 检测发现这批疫苗效力不足。

e.en: Storage errors can cause drug {subpotency}.
e.zh: 储存失误可能导致药物效力偏低。

e.en: Inspectors found a {subpotent} medicine on the shelf.
e.zh: 检查人员在货架上发现了一种效力不足的药品。

e.en: A {subpotent} dose may fail to protect patients.
e.zh: 低效价剂量可能无法保护患者。

subprefect.t: 副地方长官；副级行政官

e.en: The {subprefect} visited the rural district.
e.zh: 副地方长官视察了这个乡村地区。

e.en: A school {subprefect} helped supervise the younger students.
e.zh: 学校的一名副级学生干部协助管理低年级学生。

e.en: The road connects villages across the {subprefecture}.
e.zh: 这条路连接了该支厅辖区内的多个村庄。

e.en: Officials moved the office to another {subprefecture}.
e.zh: 官员们把办公室迁到了另一个副省级辖区。

e.en: The factory installed a small {subpress} beside the main press.
e.zh: 工厂在主压机旁安装了一台小型副压机。

e.en: The journal was printed by a university {subpress}.
e.zh: 这本期刊由一所大学的辅助出版社印刷。

sublunate.t: 略呈新月形的；半月下的

e.en: The fossil showed a {sublunate} mark near the edge.
e.zh: 化石边缘附近有一道略呈新月形的痕迹。

e.en: A {sublunate} shadow lay beneath the small ridge.
e.zh: 小脊下方有一片半月状的阴影。

e.en: The fall may {subluxate} the shoulder joint.
e.zh: 这次跌倒可能会使肩关节半脱位。

e.en: Loose ligaments can {subluxate} the kneecap during exercise.
e.zh: 韧带松弛会在运动时使髌骨半脱位。

e.en: The guard carried a {submachinegun} at the gate.
e.zh: 守卫在门口携带一支冲锋枪。

e.en: The museum displayed an old {submachinegun} from the war.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一支战争时期的旧冲锋枪。

e.en: The soldiers were issued {submachineguns} for close combat.
e.zh: 士兵们配发了冲锋枪用于近距离作战。

e.en: Several antique {submachineguns} were locked in the display case.
e.zh: 几支古董冲锋枪被锁在展示柜里。

e.en: Water reached the houses through a {submain} under the street.
e.zh: 水通过街道下方的一条次主管道进入各户。

e.en: The engineer inspected the {submain} before opening the valve.
e.zh: 工程师在打开阀门前检查了次干线。

e.en: The essay rejected the racist idea of a {subman}.
e.zh: 这篇文章驳斥了把人视为低等人的种族主义观念。

e.en: Propaganda tried to portray the enemy as a {subman}.
e.zh: 宣传试图把敌人描绘成低等人。

e.en: The curve is a one-dimensional {submanifold} of the plane.
e.zh: 这条曲线是平面中的一维子流形。

e.en: They studied how the {submanifold} sits inside the larger space.
e.zh: 他们研究这个子流形如何嵌在更大的空间中。

e.en: The leaf has small {submarginal} spots near its rim.
e.zh: 这片叶子靠近边缘处有一些边缘下斑点。

e.en: The project survived despite {submarginal} profits.
e.zh: 尽管利润低于边际水平，这个项目仍然维持了下来。

e.en: Early {submarinism} changed naval strategy dramatically.
e.zh: 早期潜艇作战极大改变了海军战略。

e.en: The book traces the risks of {submarinism} in wartime.
e.zh: 这本书追溯了战时潜艇活动的风险。

e.en: The report divides buyers into several {submarkets}.
e.zh: 报告把买家划分为几个细分市场。

e.en: Luxury rentals and student housing are separate {submarkets}.
e.zh: 豪华租赁和学生住房属于不同的子市场。

e.en: The studio kept a {submaster} for regional copies.
e.zh: 录音室保留了一份子母版用于区域复制。

e.en: A {submaster} switch controls the lights in this section.
e.zh: 一个副主控开关控制这一区域的灯光。

e.en: The doctor noted swelling in the {submaxilary} area.
e.zh: 医生注意到下颌下区域有肿胀。

e.en: A {submaxilary} gland can become painful when infected.
e.zh: 下颌下腺感染时可能会疼痛。

e.en: The specimen had a damaged {submaxilla}.
e.zh: 这个标本的下颌骨受损。

e.en: Researchers compared the {submaxilla} with nearby jaw bones.
e.zh: 研究人员把下颌骨与附近的颌骨进行比较。

e.en: The infection affected the {submaxillary} gland.
e.zh: 感染影响了下颌下腺。

e.en: She felt a tender {submaxillary} lymph node.
e.zh: 她摸到一个有压痛的下颌下淋巴结。

e.en: A small {submeander} formed inside the larger river bend.
e.zh: 较大的河湾内部形成了一个小曲流。

e.en: The map shows each {submeander} along the old channel.
e.zh: 地图标出了旧河道上的每个次级弯曲。

e.en: The insect wing has a clear {submedian} vein.
e.zh: 这种昆虫翅膀上有一条清晰的近中线脉。

e.en: The surgeon made a {submedian} incision below the navel.
e.zh: 外科医生在肚脐下方做了一个近中线切口。

e.en: In C major, A is the {submediant}.
e.zh: 在C大调中，A是下中音。

e.en: The song moves briefly to the {submediant} chord.
e.zh: 这首歌短暂转到六级和弦。

e.en: Each committee has one {submember} from the finance team.
e.zh: 每个委员会都有一名来自财务团队的下属成员。

e.en: The data model stores every {submember} under its parent group.
e.zh: 数据模型把每个子成员存放在其父组之下。

e.en: The patient had a swollen {submental} lymph node.
e.zh: 病人有一个肿大的颏下淋巴结。

e.en: A {submental} incision can hide beneath the chin.
e.zh: 颏下切口可以隐藏在下巴下面。

e.en: The pump is fully {submergeible} in clean water.
e.zh: 这台泵可以完全浸没在清水中。

e.en: They tested a {submergeible} camera housing in the pool.
e.zh: 他们在泳池里测试了一个可潜水的相机外壳。

e.en: The device is {submergible} to a depth of ten meters.
e.zh: 这个装置可潜入十米深的水下。

e.en: Use a {submergible} light for the aquarium.
e.zh: 水族箱应使用可浸没的灯。

e.en: Workers {submerse} the baskets in boiling water.
e.zh: 工人把篮子浸入沸水中。

e.en: Some aquatic plants {submerse} their leaves completely.
e.zh: 一些水生植物会让叶片完全浸没在水中。

e.en: The machine {submerses} each part before rinsing it.
e.zh: 机器先把每个零件浸没，然后再冲洗。

e.en: This plant {submerses} its stems during the rainy season.
e.zh: 这种植物在雨季会让茎部浸入水中。

e.en: They cleaned the tools by {submersing} them in alcohol.
e.zh: 他们把工具浸在酒精中来清洁。

e.en: The diver was {submersing} slowly beneath the waves.
e.zh: 潜水员正慢慢沉入浪下。

e.en: The insurer {subrogates} to the client's claim after payment.
e.zh: 保险公司赔付后代位取得客户的索赔权。

e.en: Equity sometimes {subrogates} one creditor to another's rights.
e.zh: 衡平法有时会让一个债权人取代另一个人的权利。

e.en: The company is {subrogating} the claim to recover its losses.
e.zh: 公司正在通过代位求偿追回损失。

e.en: The court discussed {subrogating} the lender to the buyer's rights.
e.zh: 法院讨论了让贷款人代位取得买方权利的问题。

e.en: The policy includes a clause on {subrogation} after compensation.
e.zh: 这份保单包含赔偿后的代位求偿条款。

e.en: Lawyers argued that {subrogation} protected the second lender.
e.zh: 律师主张权利代位保护了第二个贷款人。

e.en: The negotiations continued {subrosa} for several weeks.
e.zh: 谈判秘密进行了好几个星期。

e.en: They made a {subrosa} agreement before the public meeting.
e.zh: 他们在公开会议前私下达成了一项协议。

e.en: The geologist described the pebbles as {subround} and smooth.
e.zh: 地质学家把这些卵石描述为近圆且光滑。

e.en: A {subround} leaf shape helps identify the plant.
e.zh: 近圆形的叶片形状有助于识别这种植物。

e.en: The fish can survive in {subsaline} water near the coast.
e.zh: 这种鱼能在沿海低盐度水域生存。

e.en: Researchers measured a {subsaline} layer below the surface.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了表层下面的微咸水层。

e.en: The company drilled a {subsalt} well in deep water.
e.zh: 公司在深水区钻了一口盐层下油井。

e.en: Seismic images revealed a complex {subsalt} structure.
e.zh: 地震图像显示出复杂的盐下构造。

e.en: The mission proposed a small {subsatellite} for local measurements.
e.zh: 这次任务提出使用一颗小型子卫星进行局部测量。

e.en: The storm passed near the {subsatellite} point at noon.
e.zh: 中午风暴经过了卫星下方点附近。

e.en: The solution remained {subsaturated} after cooling.
e.zh: 溶液冷却后仍未达到饱和。

e.en: Cloud droplets may evaporate in {subsaturated} air.
e.zh: 云滴在低于饱和的空气中可能会蒸发。

e.en: The doctor checked tenderness in the {subscapular} area.
e.zh: 医生检查了肩胛下区域是否有压痛。

e.en: A {subscapular} muscle helps rotate the shoulder inward.
e.zh: 肩胛下肌有助于让肩部向内旋转。

e.en: The newsletter became {subscribable} through the website.
e.zh: 这份通讯现在可以通过网站订阅。

e.en: Only registered investors can buy the {subscribable} shares.
e.zh: 只有注册投资者才能购买这些可认购股份。

e.en: Please {subscrible} your name beneath the statement.
e.zh: 请在声明下方签署你的姓名。

e.en: Old legal forms asked witnesses to {subscrible} their marks.
e.zh: 旧式法律表格要求见证人在下方签名画押。

e.en: The lawyer reviewed the {subscriptive} clause carefully.
e.zh: 律师仔细审查了这项签署条款。

e.en: The journal tested a {subscriptive} model for online access.
e.zh: 这家期刊试行了在线访问的订阅模式。

e.en: The report was {subseguently} corrected by the editor.
e.zh: 这份报告后来由编辑作了更正。

e.en: He resigned and was {subseguently} replaced by his deputy.
e.zh: 他辞职后随后由副手接任。

e.en: The ruins still show stone {subsellia} along the wall.
e.zh: 遗址中仍可看到沿墙排列的石质低座。

e.en: Visitors rested on the {subsellia} inside the old hall.
e.zh: 游客在旧大厅里的长凳上休息。

e.en: A carved {subsellium} stood beside the doorway.
e.zh: 门旁放着一张雕刻过的低座。

e.en: The priest sat on a wooden {subsellium} during the service.
e.zh: 礼拜时神父坐在一张木制长凳上。

subsensible.t: 感觉不到的；低于感知阈值

e.en: The instrument detected a {subsensible} vibration in the floor.
e.zh: 仪器检测到地板中人感觉不到的振动。

e.en: The drug may cause {subsensible} changes before symptoms appear.
e.zh: 这种药可能在症状出现前引起低于感知阈值的变化。

e.en: The fungus has {subseptate} spores under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下这种真菌的孢子略有隔膜。

e.en: A {subseptate} chamber separates the two cavities only partly.
e.zh: 半分隔的腔室只把两个空腔部分隔开。

e.en: Find the longest {subsequence} shared by both strings.
e.zh: 找出两个字符串共有的最长子序列。

e.en: The {subsequence} of events made the cause clearer.
e.zh: 随后发生的一连串事件让原因更清楚了。

e.en: The team analyzed the {subsequential} changes in policy.
e.zh: 团队分析了政策随后出现的变化。

e.en: The proof relies on a {subsequential} limit of the series.
e.zh: 这个证明依赖于该数列的一个子序列极限。

e.en: A burned forest may begin a new {subsere} within months.
e.zh: 被烧毁的森林可能在数月内开始新的次生演替系列。

e.en: Ecologists mapped each {subsere} after the flood.
e.zh: 生态学家绘制了洪水后每个次生演替系列。

e.en: The publisher released a {subseries} for younger readers.
e.zh: 出版社推出了面向年轻读者的子系列。

e.en: This proof studies a convergent {subseries} of the sequence.
e.zh: 这个证明研究该序列中的一个收敛子系列。

e.en: The scan showed a {subserosal} fibroid on the uterus.
e.zh: 扫描显示子宫上有一个浆膜下肌瘤。

e.en: Surgeons removed the {subserosal} mass without opening the cavity.
e.zh: 外科医生未打开腔体就切除了浆膜下肿块。

e.en: The report described a small {subserous} tumor.
e.zh: 报告描述了一个小的浆膜下肿瘤。

e.en: A {subserous} lesion may grow outward from the organ wall.
e.zh: 浆膜下病灶可能从器官壁向外生长。

e.en: The theory was criticized for {substantializing} social categories.
e.zh: 这个理论因把社会类别实体化而受到批评。

e.en: She avoided {substantializing} abstract fears in her report.
e.zh: 她在报告中避免把抽象恐惧具体化。

e.en: The committee asked for {substantiative} evidence before acting.
e.zh: 委员会要求先有证实性证据再采取行动。

e.en: His reply was brief but {substantiative}.
e.zh: 他的答复很简短，但有实质内容。

e.en: The witness became the main {substantiator} of the claim.
e.zh: 这名证人成了该说法的主要证实者。

e.en: In the report, the survey served as a {substantiator}.
e.zh: 在报告中，这项调查起到了证明依据的作用。

e.en: Some languages can {substantify} adjectives very freely.
e.zh: 有些语言可以很自由地把形容词名词化。

e.en: The philosopher tried to {substantify} the idea of justice.
e.zh: 这位哲学家试图把正义这一观念实体化。

e.en: The adjective has a {substantival} use in this sentence.
e.zh: 这个形容词在这个句子里作名词用。

e.en: Students often miss the {substantival} function of the phrase.
e.zh: 学生常常忽略这个短语的名词功能。

e.en: The adjective is used {substantivally} in the inscription.
e.zh: 碑文中这个形容词是以名词方式使用的。

e.en: In Latin, participles may function {substantivally}.
e.zh: 在拉丁语中，分词可以作名词使用。

e.en: The debate turned on the {substantivity} of moral values.
e.zh: 这场辩论围绕道德价值的实体性展开。

e.en: Critics questioned the {substantivity} of the proposed reform.
e.zh: 批评者质疑这项改革方案是否有实质内容。

e.en: German can {substantivize} many adjectives with ease.
e.zh: 德语可以轻易把许多形容词名词化。

e.en: The editor chose to {substantivize} the phrase for clarity.
e.zh: 编辑为求清楚，选择把这个短语转作名词。

e.en: The model enters a different {substate} after calibration.
e.zh: 模型校准后会进入一个不同的子状态。

e.en: Each region was treated as a political {substate}.
e.zh: 每个地区都被视为一种从属政治状态。

e.en: Brown dwarfs occupy the {substellar} mass range.
e.zh: 褐矮星处在亚恒星质量范围内。

e.en: The {substellar} point receives the planet's strongest sunlight.
e.zh: 恒星下点接收到这颗行星最强的阳光。

e.en: She reported a sharp {substernal} pain after exercise.
e.zh: 她说运动后胸骨下方有一阵刺痛。

e.en: The doctor noted {substernal} tenderness during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查时记录到胸骨下压痛。

e.en: In this formula, x is the {substituendum}.
e.zh: 在这个公式中，x 是被替换项。

e.en: The translator marked the phrase as the {substituendum}.
e.zh: 译者把这个短语标为待替换内容。

e.en: The chemist changed one {substituent} on the ring.
e.zh: 化学家改变了环上的一个取代基。

e.en: A shorter phrase can serve as the {substituent}.
e.zh: 一个较短的短语可以作为替代项。

e.en: The alloy contains {substitutional} atoms in its lattice.
e.zh: 这种合金的晶格中含有置换原子。

e.en: They proposed a {substitutional} method for the proof.
e.zh: 他们为这个证明提出了一种替代方法。

e.en: The atoms are arranged {substitutionally} in the crystal.
e.zh: 这些原子在晶体中以置换方式排列。

e.en: The term is used {substitutionally} throughout the paper.
e.zh: 这个术语在整篇论文中都以替代方式使用。

e.en: The program acts as a {substitutor} for missing symbols.
e.zh: 这个程序充当缺失符号的替换器。

e.en: In the experiment, water was the {substitutor} for oil.
e.zh: 在实验中，水被用作油的替代物。

e.en: The reaction used a {substoichiometric} amount of catalyst.
e.zh: 该反应使用了低于化学计量的催化剂用量。

e.en: A {substoichiometric} oxygen level changed the product yield.
e.zh: 低于化学计量的氧含量改变了产物收率。

substoichiometry.t: 亚化学计量；低计量关系

e.en: The paper discusses {substoichiometry} in metal oxides.
e.zh: 这篇论文讨论金属氧化物中的亚化学计量现象。

e.en: Careful weighing revealed slight {substoichiometry} in the sample.
e.zh: 精确称量显示样品中存在轻微的低计量关系。

e.en: The cache writes data to a local {substore}.
e.zh: 缓存把数据写入本地子存储区。

e.en: The mall opened a small {substore} for returns.
e.zh: 商场开设了一个小型分店处理退货。

e.en: A geomagnetic {substorm} brightened the aurora overnight.
e.zh: 一次地磁亚暴让夜间的极光变得更明亮。

e.en: The forecast warned of a brief {substorm} near the coast.
e.zh: 预报提醒海岸附近会有短暂的小型风暴。

e.en: Older texts sometimes use {substract} where modern English uses subtract.
e.zh: 较早的文本有时用 substract 表示现代英语中的 subtract。

e.en: The clerk tried to {substract} the fee from the total.
e.zh: 职员试图从总额中扣除这笔费用。

e.en: The circuit includes a simple {substractor} module.
e.zh: 这个电路包含一个简单的减法器模块。

e.en: The old manual calls the device a {substractor}.
e.zh: 那本旧手册把这个装置称为减法器。

e.en: The lab isolated a new {substrain} of the bacterium.
e.zh: 实验室分离出这种细菌的一个新亚菌株。

e.en: Each mouse {substrain} showed a different immune response.
e.zh: 每个小鼠子品系都表现出不同的免疫反应。

e.en: The enzyme binds to one {substrand} of the DNA complex.
e.zh: 这种酶会结合到 DNA 复合体的一条子链上。

e.en: A damaged {substrand} can affect the whole fiber.
e.zh: 受损的副股可能影响整根纤维。

e.en: His {subserviency} annoyed the whole committee.
e.zh: 他的卑顺态度让整个委员会都很反感。

e.en: The essay criticizes political {subserviency} to wealthy donors.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评了对富有捐助者的政治屈从。

e.en: The chemist measured a {subsextuple} portion of the sample.
e.zh: 化学家量取了样品的六分之一份。

e.en: A {subsextuple} ratio appears in the old musical theory.
e.zh: 这种六分之一的比例出现在古老的音乐理论中。

e.en: Miners used a narrow {subshaft} to reach the lower seam.
e.zh: 矿工们通过一条狭窄的副井到达下层矿脉。

e.en: The engineer inspected the damaged {subshaft} before reopening the tunnel.
e.zh: 工程师在重新开放隧道前检查了受损的次要竖井。

e.en: Each partner received a {subshare} of the royalties.
e.zh: 每位合伙人都分得了一小份版税。

e.en: The agreement created a separate {subshare} for local investors.
e.zh: 协议为本地投资者设立了单独的次级份额。

e.en: Electrons in the same {subshell} share similar energy.
e.zh: 同一亚壳层中的电子具有相近的能量。

e.en: The script opens a {subshell} to run the command safely.
e.zh: 脚本会打开一个子外壳来安全运行该命令。

e.en: Different {subshells} can hold different numbers of electrons.
e.zh: 不同亚壳层能容纳的电子数量不同。

e.en: The program launched several {subshells} during testing.
e.zh: 程序在测试期间启动了几个子外壳。

e.en: Lavender is often grown as a woody {subshrub}.
e.zh: 薰衣草常作为木质半灌木栽培。

e.en: The dry hillside was covered with low {subshrub} vegetation.
e.zh: 干燥的山坡上覆盖着低矮的半灌木植被。

e.en: The court considered the argument {subsidiarily}.
e.zh: 法院以附带方式考虑了这一论点。

e.en: The fund supports schools, and {subsidiarily} local clinics.
e.zh: 该基金资助学校，并辅助支持当地诊所。

e.en: The mineral was identified as a rare {subsilicate}.
e.zh: 这种矿物被鉴定为一种罕见的碱式硅酸盐。

e.en: A {subsilicate} coating formed on the heated surface.
e.zh: 受热表面形成了一层碱式硅酸盐涂层。

e.en: The philosopher described the soul as {subsistent}.
e.zh: 这位哲学家把灵魂描述为自存的。

e.en: Only a few {subsistent} rights survived the reform.
e.zh: 改革后只保留下少数仍然存在的权利。

subsocial.t: 亚社会性的；低度群居的

e.en: Some insects show {subsocial} care for their young.
e.zh: 有些昆虫表现出对幼虫的亚社会性照料。

e.en: The species lives in small {subsocial} groups under bark.
e.zh: 这个物种在树皮下以小型低度群居群体生活。

subsolar.t: 太阳正下方的；近赤道的

e.en: The satellite crossed the {subsolar} point at noon.
e.zh: 卫星在正午经过太阳正下方点。

e.en: Explorers suffered in the intense {subsolar} heat.
e.zh: 探险者在近赤道的酷热中备受煎熬。

e.en: The rocks changed during {subsolidus} cooling.
e.zh: 这些岩石在低于固相线的冷却过程中发生了变化。

e.en: Researchers modeled {subsolidus} reactions in the crystal.
e.zh: 研究人员模拟了晶体中的低于固相线反应。

e.en: The granite formed under {subsolvus} conditions.
e.zh: 这种花岗岩是在低于溶解度线的条件下形成的。

e.en: A {subsolvus} texture appeared in the cooled sample.
e.zh: 冷却样品中出现了低于溶解度线形成的结构。

e.en: The drone flew {subsonically} over the valley.
e.zh: 无人机以亚音速飞过山谷。

e.en: Air moved {subsonically} through the test chamber.
e.zh: 空气以亚音速通过测试舱。

e.en: The bridge design divided the arch into each {subspan}.
e.zh: 桥梁设计把拱结构划分为各个子跨度。

e.en: Engineers measured the {subspan} between two supports.
e.zh: 工程师测量了两个支点之间的局部跨度。

e.en: Isolation on islands can lead to {subspeciation}.
e.zh: 岛屿隔离可能导致亚种形成。

e.en: The study traces {subspeciation} within the mountain population.
e.zh: 这项研究追踪了山地种群内部的亚种分化。

e.en: The disease has a {substage} that is hard to detect.
e.zh: 这种疾病有一个难以发现的子阶段。

e.en: Geologists named the {substage} after a local rock layer.
e.zh: 地质学家用当地岩层为这一分期命名。

e.en: The draft used {substaintial} where substantial was intended.
e.zh: 草稿中把本该写作substantial的词误写成了substaintial。

e.en: The editor marked {substaintial} as a spelling error.
e.zh: 编辑把substaintial标为拼写错误。

e.en: The phrase {substantia} nigra refers to a brain region.
e.zh: substantia nigra这个短语指的是大脑中的一个区域。

e.en: Medieval writers used {substantia} to discuss essence.
e.zh: 中世纪作者用substantia来讨论本质。

e.en: The novelist tried to {substantialise} memory through vivid scenes.
e.zh: 小说家试图通过生动场景把记忆具体化。

e.en: British critics say the policy must {substantialise} its promises.
e.zh: 英国评论者说这项政策必须让承诺落到实处。

e.en: The lecture contrasted process philosophy with {substantialism}.
e.zh: 讲座把过程哲学与实体论作了对比。

e.en: His theology retained a strong form of {substantialism}.
e.zh: 他的神学保留了很强的实体主义色彩。

e.en: A {substantialist} view treats identity as fixed.
e.zh: 实体主义观点把身份看作固定不变。

e.en: She criticized the {substantialist} for ignoring relations.
e.zh: 她批评那位实体论者忽视关系。

e.en: The proposal would {substantialize} vague rights in law.
e.zh: 这项提案会把含糊的权利在法律中具体化。

e.en: Artists often {substantialize} grief through physical objects.
e.zh: 艺术家常通过实物把悲伤实体化。

substantialized.t: 已实体化的；已具体化的

e.en: The idea was {substantialized} in a working prototype.
e.zh: 这个想法在一个可运行原型中得到了具体化。

e.en: Fear became {substantialized} as a monster on stage.
e.zh: 恐惧在舞台上被实体化为一个怪物。

substrata.t: 底层；下层基础材料或文化层

e.en: Several cultural {substrata} shaped the region's dialect.
e.zh: 几种文化底层塑造了该地区的方言。

e.en: The engineer examined the road's gravel {substrata}.
e.zh: 工程师检查了道路下方的砾石基层。

e.en: The linguist studied {substratal} influence in local speech.
e.zh: 语言学家研究当地话语中的底层影响。

e.en: Water collected in the {substratal} layer beneath the field.
e.zh: 水积在田地下方的基础层里。

e.en: The essay imagines a hidden {substratosphere} below public culture.
e.zh: 这篇文章设想公共文化之下有一个隐藏的底层圈。

e.en: Geologists sometimes describe such zones as a {substratosphere}.
e.zh: 地质学家有时把这类区域称为基础层圈。

e.en: The ancient wall's {substruction} survived underground.
e.zh: 古墙的下部结构在地下保存了下来。

e.en: Engineers reinforced the bridge {substruction} before winter.
e.zh: 工程师在冬季前加固了桥梁基础构造。

substructural.t: 下部结构的；基础结构的

e.en: The survey found {substructural} cracks under the platform.
e.zh: 勘测发现平台下方有基础结构裂缝。

e.en: Her theory focuses on {substructural} forces in society.
e.zh: 她的理论关注社会中的深层结构力量。

e.en: The sample contained a rare copper {subsulphate}.
e.zh: 样品中含有一种罕见的铜碱式硫酸盐。

e.en: Older chemistry texts list {subsulphate} under basic salts.
e.zh: 较早的化学教材把碱式硫酸盐列在碱式盐下。

e.en: The patient showed a {subsultive} movement of the hand.
e.zh: 病人的手出现了抽搐性的跳动。

e.en: A {subsultive} rhythm disturbed the otherwise calm music.
e.zh: 一种跳动的节奏打破了原本平静的音乐。

e.en: His {subsultory} notes were hard to follow.
e.zh: 他那些跳跃不连贯的笔记很难看懂。

e.en: A {subsultory} twitch crossed her face.
e.zh: 她脸上掠过一阵抽搐似的跳动。

e.en: The doctor recorded {subsultus} during the fever.
e.zh: 医生记录到发烧期间出现了肌肉抽搐。

e.en: A brief {subsultus} shook his shoulder.
e.zh: 他的肩膀突然短促地抽动了一下。

e.en: These cases are {subsumable} under the same rule.
e.zh: 这些案件可以归入同一条规则之下。

e.en: The expense was {subsumable} within the broader budget.
e.zh: 这笔开支可纳入更大的预算范围。

e.en: The judge used {subsumptive} reasoning to apply the law.
e.zh: 法官用包摄性推理来适用法律。

e.en: A {subsumptive} category can include many smaller ideas.
e.zh: 一个涵盖性类别可以包括许多较小的概念。

e.en: The motor developed a {subsynchronous} vibration at low speed.
e.zh: 电机在低速时产生了次同步振动。

e.en: Their {subsynchronous} signals arrived slightly out of phase.
e.zh: 它们的近同步信号到达时相位略有偏差。

e.en: The student calculated the curve's {subtangent} carefully.
e.zh: 学生仔细计算了曲线的副切线长度。

e.en: In old geometry, the {subtangent} helped describe a slope.
e.zh: 在旧式几何中，副切线有助于描述斜率。

e.en: The game is designed for {subteen} players.
e.zh: 这款游戏是为未满十三岁的儿童设计的。

e.en: A {subteen} audience may miss the joke.
e.zh: 未满十三岁的观众可能听不懂这个笑话。

e.en: The book follows a curious {subteenager} in summer.
e.zh: 这本书讲述一个好奇的未满十三岁孩子的夏天。

e.en: Every {subteenager} must attend with an adult.
e.zh: 每个未满十三岁的孩子都必须由成人陪同参加。

e.en: The plant grows best in a {subtemperate} climate.
e.zh: 这种植物最适合在亚温带气候中生长。

e.en: They mapped the island's {subtemperate} coastal zone.
e.zh: 他们绘制了该岛近温带海岸区的地图。

e.en: The contract forbids any {subtenancy} without consent.
e.zh: 合同禁止未经同意建立任何转租关系。

e.en: Her {subtenancy} ended when the main lease expired.
e.zh: 主租约到期时，她的分租租赁权也终止了。

e.en: The {subtenant} paid rent to the original tenant.
e.zh: 分租客把租金付给原承租人。

e.en: A new {subtenant} moved into the spare office.
e.zh: 一名新的转租承租人搬进了空办公室。

e.en: The chord forms the {subtense} of the angle.
e.zh: 这条弦构成了该角所对的线段。

e.en: Surveyors measured the {subtense} from a fixed point.
e.zh: 测量员从一个固定点测量了张角所对线段。

e.en: The estate was held under a complex {subtenure}.
e.zh: 这片地产处于复杂的次级保有权之下。

e.en: Medieval records mention {subtenure} by local farmers.
e.zh: 中世纪记录提到当地农民的次级土地保有。

subterconscious.t: 潜意识下的；低于意识的

e.en: He described a {subterconscious} fear of failure.
e.zh: 他描述了一种潜意识下的失败恐惧。

e.en: The poem hints at {subterconscious} memories.
e.zh: 这首诗暗示了低于意识层面的记忆。

e.en: The novel portrays a {subterhuman} creature underground.
e.zh: 小说描写了一个生活在地下的低于人类的生物。

e.en: Such language treats opponents as {subterhuman}.
e.zh: 这种语言把对手贬成次人般的存在。

e.en: A {subterminal} band marks the insect's wing.
e.zh: 昆虫翅膀上有一道近末端的条纹。

e.en: The catheter tip lay in a {subterminal} position.
e.zh: 导管尖端位于接近末端的位置。

e.en: The philosopher rejected a {subternatural} explanation of mind.
e.zh: 这位哲学家拒绝用低于自然的方式解释心灵。

e.en: The tale gives the cave a {subternatural} gloom.
e.zh: 这个故事让洞穴带有一种次自然的阴郁感。

e.en: The diagram shows the {subterposition} of one layer below another.
e.zh: 图示显示了一层置于另一层下方的位置。

e.en: Classical grammar notes the {subterposition} of certain words.
e.zh: 古典语法提到某些词的后下置位置。

subterrane.t: 地下的；地下空间的地下层

e.en: The miners mapped the {subterrane} before digging deeper.
e.zh: 矿工们在继续深挖前绘制了地下层的图。

e.en: Water moved slowly through the {subterrane} rock.
e.zh: 水在地下岩层中缓慢流动。

e.en: A {subterraneous} passage linked the two old houses.
e.zh: 一条地下通道连接着两座老房子。

e.en: The novel hints at a {subterraneous} anger beneath his politeness.
e.zh: 小说暗示他的礼貌背后藏着隐秘的怒气。

e.en: The stream flows {subterraneously} beneath the village.
e.zh: 这条溪流在村庄下方的地下流过。

e.en: The movement grew {subterraneously} for many years.
e.zh: 这场运动多年来一直隐秘地发展。

e.en: Engineers tested a {subterrene} vehicle for drilling tunnels.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一种用于钻隧道的穿地机器。

e.en: The poem imagines a {subterrene} world of roots and stone.
e.zh: 这首诗想象了一个由根须和石头构成的地下世界。

e.en: The cave sheltered many {subterrestrial} insects.
e.zh: 洞穴庇护着许多地下昆虫。

e.en: Sensors recorded heat from a {subterrestrial} source.
e.zh: 传感器记录到来自地表以下热源的热量。

subtersurface.t: 表层以下的；地下浅层的

e.en: The survey found {subtersurface} cracks in the concrete.
e.zh: 检测发现混凝土表层以下有裂缝。

e.en: Roots spread through the {subtersurface} soil layer.
e.zh: 根系在地下浅层土壤中扩展。

subtetanic.t: 亚强直性的；未达强直痉挛的

e.en: The muscle showed {subtetanic} contractions during the test.
e.zh: 测试中这块肌肉出现了亚强直性收缩。

e.en: Researchers applied a {subtetanic} stimulus to avoid fatigue.
e.zh: 研究人员施加未达强直痉挛的刺激以避免疲劳。

e.en: The actor emphasized the scene's {subtextual} tension.
e.zh: 演员突出了这一场景中的潜台词张力。

e.en: Her smile carried a {subtextual} warning.
e.zh: 她的微笑带着含蓄的警告意味。

e.en: The surgeon discussed {subthalamotomy} as a treatment option.
e.zh: 外科医生把丘脑底核切开术作为一种治疗选择来讨论。

e.en: After {subthalamotomy}, the patient's tremor became less severe.
e.zh: 接受丘脑底核切开术后，患者的震颤减轻了。

e.en: The patient received a {subtherapeutic} dose by mistake.
e.zh: 患者误服了低于治疗剂量的药量。

e.en: Overuse of {subtherapeutic} antibiotics can encourage resistance.
e.zh: 滥用低于治疗剂量的抗生素可能促使耐药性产生。

subthreshold.t: 低于阈值的；未达诊断标准的

e.en: The device ignored {subthreshold} electrical signals.
e.zh: 设备忽略了低于阈值的电信号。

e.en: She reported {subthreshold} symptoms of depression.
e.zh: 她报告了未达到诊断标准的抑郁症状。

e.en: The jeweler admired the {subtil} workmanship.
e.zh: 珠宝匠赞赏这精细的工艺。

e.en: His argument turned on a {subtil} distinction.
e.zh: 他的论证取决于一个微妙的区别。

e.en: The manuscript preserves a {subtile} shade of meaning.
e.zh: 这份手稿保留了一层精细的含义。

e.en: She answered with a {subtile} smile.
e.zh: 她带着狡黠微妙的笑容回答。

e.en: The colors changed {subtilely} in the evening light.
e.zh: 色彩在傍晚的光线中微妙地变化。

e.en: He {subtilely} shifted the focus of the debate.
e.zh: 他巧妙而微妙地转移了辩论焦点。

e.en: The lab measured {subtilin} activity against several bacteria.
e.zh: 实验室测量了枯草菌素对几种细菌的活性。

e.en: Scientists purified {subtilin} from a bacterial culture.
e.zh: 科学家从细菌培养物中纯化出枯草菌素。

e.en: The critic tried to {subtilise} the difference between irony and satire.
e.zh: 评论家试图细分反讽与讽刺之间的区别。

e.en: Academic jargon can {subtilise} a simple idea too much.
e.zh: 学术行话可能把一个简单想法过度精细化。

e.en: Detergents often use {subtilisin} to break down protein stains.
e.zh: 洗涤剂常用枯草杆菌蛋白酶分解蛋白质污渍。

e.en: The enzyme {subtilisin} remains active in alkaline conditions.
e.zh: 枯草杆菌蛋白酶在碱性条件下仍保持活性。

e.en: The essay's {subtility} impressed the professor.
e.zh: 这篇论文的精细微妙给教授留下了印象。

e.en: He used legal {subtility} to avoid a direct answer.
e.zh: 他用法律上的机巧避开了直接回答。

e.en: Philosophers sometimes {subtilize} ordinary language.
e.zh: 哲学家有时会把日常语言精细化分析。

e.en: Do not {subtilize} the rule until no one understands it.
e.zh: 不要把这条规则细辨到没人能理解。

e.en: The theory was {subtilized} by later commentators.
e.zh: 这一理论被后来的评论者进一步精细化。

e.en: His {subtilized} explanation lost the audience.
e.zh: 他过分细辨的解释让听众听不懂了。

e.en: The editor was a patient {subtilizer} of style.
e.zh: 这位编辑是个有耐心的文风精细化者。

e.en: As a legal {subtilizer}, he loved narrow distinctions.
e.zh: 作为法律上的细辨者，他喜欢狭窄的区分。

e.en: The author {subtilizes} every emotional shift.
e.zh: 作者细致刻画每一次情绪变化。

e.en: He {subtilizes} the issue until it seems obscure.
e.zh: 他把问题过分细辨到显得晦涩。

e.en: Her {subtilizing} analysis clarified the poem's tone.
e.zh: 她精细化的分析阐明了诗歌的语调。

e.en: The lawyer kept {subtilizing} the contract language.
e.zh: 律师不断细辨合同措辞。

e.en: The old spelling {subtilty} appears in the archive.
e.zh: 旧拼法subtilty出现在档案中。

e.en: Medieval writers praised rhetorical {subtilty}.
e.zh: 中世纪作家赞赏修辞上的精细微妙。

e.en: The paper compared {subtilysin} with other proteases.
e.zh: 论文将枯草杆菌蛋白酶与其他蛋白酶作了比较。

e.en: Engineered {subtilysin} can tolerate higher temperatures.
e.zh: 经过工程改造的枯草杆菌蛋白酶能耐受更高温度。

subtlest.t: 最微妙的；最难察觉的招数或含义

e.en: She noticed the {subtlest} change in his voice.
e.zh: 她察觉到他声音中最细微的变化。

e.en: The {subtlest} humor in the novel is easy to miss.
e.zh: 小说里最含蓄的幽默很容易被忽略。

e.en: The melody rests briefly on the {subtonic}.
e.zh: 旋律短暂地停在下主音上。

e.en: In this mode, the {subtonic} gives the phrase a folk quality.
e.zh: 在这个调式中，下主音让乐句带有民间音乐的味道。

subtopia.t: 郊区化丑陋景观；杂乱郊区

e.en: The old village was swallowed by {subtopia}.
e.zh: 那座老村庄被杂乱的郊区景观吞没了。

e.en: Critics used {subtopia} to describe the spread of bland roadsides.
e.zh: 评论者用“郊区化丑陋景观”来形容单调路边建筑的蔓延。

e.en: The island has a {subtorrid} climate.
e.zh: 这座岛屿属于近热带气候。

e.en: Several {subtorrid} plants survived the mild winter.
e.zh: 几种近热带植物挺过了这个温和的冬天。

e.en: In 9 minus 4, 4 is the {subtrahend}.
e.zh: 在9减4中，4是减数。

e.en: The teacher asked students to identify the {subtrahend}.
e.zh: 老师要求学生找出算式中的减数。

e.en: The circuit showed a {subtranient} fluctuation after startup.
e.zh: 电路启动后出现了近瞬态波动。

e.en: Researchers modeled the {subtranient} response separately.
e.zh: 研究人员单独模拟了亚瞬态响应。

e.en: Engineers measured the {subtransient} current in the generator.
e.zh: 工程师测量了发电机中的亚瞬态电流。

e.en: The {subtransient} phase ended within milliseconds.
e.zh: 这个亚瞬态阶段在毫秒内结束了。

e.en: The city upgraded its {subtransmission} lines.
e.zh: 这座城市升级了分输电线路。

e.en: Losses in {subtransmission} can affect local voltage.
e.zh: 次级传输中的损耗会影响本地电压。

e.en: A {subtransparent} layer covered the specimen.
e.zh: 标本表面覆盖着一层半透明薄层。

e.en: The wings looked {subtransparent} in the morning light.
e.zh: 晨光中，那些翅膀显得稍微透明。

e.en: The club elected a new {subtreasurer}.
e.zh: 俱乐部选出了一位新的副财务主管。

e.en: As {subtreasurer}, he reviewed minor expenses.
e.zh: 作为副司库，他审核小额开支。

e.en: Several {subtreasuries} handled payments outside the capital.
e.zh: 几个地方金库负责处理首都以外的付款。

e.en: The old {subtreasuries} were merged into one department.
e.zh: 旧的分财政机构被合并成一个部门。

e.en: The receipts were stored in the {subtreasury}.
e.zh: 收据被存放在地方金库里。

e.en: A {subtreasury} office served the western districts.
e.zh: 一个分财政署为西部各区服务。

e.en: The botanist assigned the genus to a new {subtribe}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这个属归入一个新的亚族。

e.en: One {subtribe} moved north after the drought.
e.zh: 干旱之后，一个部族分支向北迁移。

e.en: The clerk filed the {subtriplicate} copy separately.
e.zh: 办事员把第三副本单独归档。

e.en: A {subtriplicate} record was kept for audit purposes.
e.zh: 为审计需要，保留了一份副三份本记录。

e.en: The {subtropic} coast is warm all year.
e.zh: 这片亚热带海岸全年温暖。

e.en: Many citrus fruits grow well in the {subtropic}.
e.zh: 许多柑橘类水果在亚热带地区长势很好。

e.en: The plant has narrow, {subulate} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物有狭长的钻状叶。

e.en: A {subulate} spine projects from the shell.
e.zh: 一个锥形尖刺从外壳上伸出。

e.en: The insect's antennae are finely {subulated}.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的触角呈细长锥尖状。

e.en: Each {subulated} leaf tapers to a hard point.
e.zh: 每片钻形叶都逐渐收成坚硬的尖端。

subuliferous.t: 有锥形尖刺的；生钻状体的

e.en: The {subuliferous} stem deterred grazing animals.
e.zh: 长有锥形尖刺的茎阻止了食草动物啃食。

e.en: A {subuliferous} surface distinguishes this species.
e.zh: 带钻状突起的表面使这个物种容易辨认。

e.en: The fossil shows a {subuliform} projection.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出一个锥尖形突起。

e.en: Its {subuliform} leaves help reduce water loss.
e.zh: 它的钻状叶有助于减少水分流失。

e.en: The jellyfish's {subumbrella} contracted rhythmically.
e.zh: 水母的伞下部有节奏地收缩。

e.en: Tiny structures lined the {subumbrella} surface.
e.zh: 细小结构排列在水母伞内面。

e.en: The vet examined the {subunguis} for infection.
e.zh: 兽医检查爪下部是否感染。

e.en: Damage near the {subunguis} made walking painful.
e.zh: 甲下部位附近的损伤让行走变得疼痛。

e.en: The fossil was described as {subungulate}.
e.zh: 这块化石被描述为近有蹄类。

e.en: Its {subungulate} feet suggested an unusual ancestry.
e.zh: 它似蹄的足部暗示了不寻常的祖源。

e.en: Developers hoped to {suburbanise} the farmland.
e.zh: 开发商希望把这片农田郊区化。

e.en: The region began to {suburbanise} after the new railway opened.
e.zh: 新铁路开通后，该地区开始向郊区扩展。

e.en: The novel captures the quiet {suburbanity} of the town.
e.zh: 这部小说捕捉到了小镇安静的郊区生活气息。

e.en: He disliked the neat {suburbanity} of identical lawns.
e.zh: 他不喜欢一片片相同草坪所呈现的整齐郊区气。

e.en: The highway helped {suburbanize} the valley.
e.zh: 这条公路推动了山谷地区的郊区化。

e.en: Families began to {suburbanize} as city rents rose.
e.zh: 随着城市租金上涨，许多家庭开始迁往郊区。

e.en: The once-rural county became heavily {suburbanized} after the highway opened.
e.zh: 高速公路开通后，这个曾经的乡村县大幅郊区化。

e.en: They studied how {suburbanized} communities changed local voting patterns.
e.zh: 他们研究了郊区化社区如何改变当地投票格局。

e.en: New rail service often {suburbanizes} farmland near the city.
e.zh: 新的铁路服务常会使城市附近的农田郊区化。

e.en: As the region {suburbanizes}, small shops replace barns and fields.
e.zh: 随着该地区变成郊区，小商店取代了谷仓和田地。

e.en: The council debated the effects of {suburbanizing} the valley.
e.zh: 委员会讨论了把山谷郊区化所带来的影响。

e.en: A {suburbanizing} landscape can still keep pockets of farmland.
e.zh: 正在郊区化的景观中仍可能保留一些农田。

e.en: The bishop held a {suburbicarian} see near Rome.
e.zh: 那位主教掌管罗马附近的一个近郊教区。

e.en: Historians use {suburbicarian} to describe certain dioceses around Rome.
e.zh: 历史学家用suburbicarian来描述罗马周边的某些教区。

e.en: Developers hoped to {suburbize} the farmland within ten years.
e.zh: 开发商希望在十年内把这片农田郊区化。

e.en: The town began to {suburbize} as commuters moved in.
e.zh: 随着通勤者迁入，这座小镇开始郊区化。

e.en: This dialect is a {subvariety} of a larger regional speech form.
e.zh: 这种方言是一个更大区域语言形式的亚变体。

e.en: The botanist identified a new {subvariety} of the cultivated rose.
e.zh: 植物学家鉴定出栽培玫瑰的一个新亚变种。

e.en: The charity agreed to {subvene} the clinic's emergency costs.
e.zh: 慈善机构同意资助诊所的紧急开支。

e.en: Local funds may {subvene} services that the state no longer supports.
e.zh: 地方资金可以援助州政府不再支持的服务。

e.en: The museum was {subvened} by a small annual grant.
e.zh: 这家博物馆由一笔小额年度补助资助。

e.en: Several rural schools were {subvened} after the storm damaged their roofs.
e.zh: 暴风雨损坏屋顶后，几所乡村学校获得了援助。

e.en: The agency is {subvening} the project until private donors arrive.
e.zh: 在私人捐助者到来之前，该机构正在资助这个项目。

e.en: Their role in {subvening} public libraries was rarely acknowledged.
e.zh: 他们援助公共图书馆的作用很少得到承认。

e.en: The board approved a {subventionary} payment for the theater.
e.zh: 董事会批准了一笔给剧院的补助性款项。

e.en: A {subventionary} policy kept the ferry service affordable.
e.zh: 一项资助性政策使渡轮服务保持可负担。

e.en: The ministry decided to {subventionize} small newspapers in remote areas.
e.zh: 该部决定补助偏远地区的小型报纸。

e.en: Critics argued that the plan would {subventionize} inefficient companies.
e.zh: 批评者认为该计划会资助效率低下的公司。

e.en: The pamphlet carried a {subversal} message against the regime.
e.zh: 这本小册子带有反对该政权的颠覆性信息。

e.en: Officials treated the play as {subversal} rather than merely satirical.
e.zh: 官员把这出戏视为颠覆性的，而不只是讽刺作品。

e.en: The government accused the group of {subversionary} activity.
e.zh: 政府指控该组织从事颠覆性活动。

e.en: Her novel was read as a {subversionary} attack on social convention.
e.zh: 她的小说被解读为对社会习俗的颠覆性攻击。

e.en: Any password system is {subvertible} if users share their credentials.
e.zh: 如果用户共享凭据，任何密码系统都可能被破坏。

e.en: The dictator feared that even loyal institutions were {subvertible}.
e.zh: 独裁者担心即使忠诚的机构也可能被颠覆。

e.en: The climbers faced a {subvertical} wall of wet limestone.
e.zh: 攀登者面对一面近乎垂直的湿石灰岩壁。

e.en: A {subvertical} fracture ran through the exposed rock face.
e.zh: 一道近乎垂直的裂缝贯穿裸露的岩面。

e.en: Prions are often discussed as {subviral} infectious agents.
e.zh: 朊病毒常被作为亚病毒性传染因子来讨论。

e.en: The lab studied {subviral} particles found in infected cells.
e.zh: 实验室研究了受感染细胞中发现的亚病毒颗粒。

subvisible.t: 肉眼难见的；近乎不可见的

e.en: The solution contained {subvisible} particles that required special testing.
e.zh: 溶液中含有肉眼难见的颗粒，需要专门检测。

e.en: A {subvisible} crack later caused the glass to fail.
e.zh: 一道近乎不可见的裂纹后来导致玻璃破裂。

e.en: The doctor suspected {subvitaminosis} rather than severe malnutrition.
e.zh: 医生怀疑是轻度维生素缺乏症，而不是严重营养不良。

e.en: Long winters increased the risk of {subvitaminosis} in the village.
e.zh: 漫长的冬季增加了村里发生轻度维生素缺乏症的风险。

e.en: The mineral showed a {subvitreous} sheen under the lamp.
e.zh: 这种矿物在灯下呈现近玻璃光泽。

e.en: Collectors value the stone's {subvitreous} surface and pale color.
e.zh: 收藏者看重这种石头近玻璃光泽的表面和浅淡颜色。

e.en: Readers often make {subvocal} movements while scanning difficult text.
e.zh: 读者浏览难懂文本时常会有默读发声的动作。

e.en: The therapist noticed a {subvocal} murmur during the exercise.
e.zh: 治疗师注意到练习过程中有很低的发声。

e.en: Some people {subvocalise} every word when they read silently.
e.zh: 有些人默读时会在心里念出每一个词。

e.en: The coach taught her not to {subvocalise} during speed reading.
e.zh: 教练教她速读时不要默读发声。

e.en: Speed-reading courses often try to reduce {subvocalization}.
e.zh: 速读课程常试图减少默读发声。

e.en: Researchers measured {subvocalization} with sensors near the throat.
e.zh: 研究人员用喉咙附近的传感器测量默读发声。

e.en: I tend to {subvocalize} technical terms when studying.
e.zh: 学习时我往往会在心里念出技术术语。

e.en: Children may {subvocalize} as they learn to read silently.
e.zh: 儿童学习默读时可能会默默发声。

subvocalized.t: 已默读发声的；心中默念的

e.en: The phrase was {subvocalized} before he answered aloud.
e.zh: 他大声回答前，先在心里默念了那句话。

e.en: Her {subvocalized} rehearsal helped her remember the speech.
e.zh: 她心中默念式的排练帮助她记住了演讲。

e.en: Geologists mapped a {subvolcanic} intrusion beneath the old crater.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了旧火山口下方的次火山侵入体。

e.en: The ore formed in a {subvolcanic} environment near rising magma.
e.zh: 这种矿石形成于上升岩浆附近的浅成火山环境。

subworker.t: 下级工人；辅助工人；分包工

e.en: The contractor hired a {subworker} to finish the wiring.
e.zh: 承包商雇了一名分包工来完成布线。

e.en: Each {subworker} reported progress to the site supervisor.
e.zh: 每名下级工人都向现场主管汇报进度。

e.en: The climbers faced {subzero} temperatures overnight.
e.zh: 登山者夜里遭遇了零度以下的低温。

e.en: This freezer keeps samples at {subzero} levels.
e.zh: 这台冷冻柜把样品保持在零度以下。

subzonate.t: 有不明显环带的；亚带状的

e.en: The shell showed a {subzonate} pattern under magnification.
e.zh: 放大观察时，贝壳呈现出不明显的环带花纹。

e.en: A {subzonate} marking can be hard to see in dim light.
e.zh: 光线昏暗时，亚带状斑纹可能很难看清。

e.en: The map divides the reserve into each ecological {subzone}.
e.zh: 这张地图把保护区划分为各个生态分区。

e.en: Parking rules vary by {subzone} within the city center.
e.zh: 市中心不同分区的停车规定各不相同。

e.en: The old recipe calls for chopped {succade}.
e.zh: 这份老食谱需要切碎的糖渍柑橘皮。

e.en: She folded {succade} into the holiday cake batter.
e.zh: 她把蜜饯果皮拌进节日蛋糕面糊里。

e.en: The baker displayed jars of colorful {succades}.
e.zh: 面包师摆出了几罐色彩鲜艳的蜜饯果皮。

e.en: These {succades} add a sharp sweetness to the pudding.
e.zh: 这些糖渍果皮给布丁增添了清亮的甜味。

e.en: The herbalist described the plant as a mild {succagogue}.
e.zh: 草药师说这种植物是一种温和的促分泌药。

e.en: A {succagogue} was once used to stimulate bodily fluids.
e.zh: 过去曾用促汁液分泌的药物来刺激体液分泌。

e.en: The family decorated the {succah} with fruit and branches.
e.zh: 这家人用水果和树枝装饰住棚节棚屋。

e.en: Rain leaked through the roof of the small {succah}.
e.zh: 雨水从小棚屋的屋顶漏了进来。

e.en: The cake was topped with {succate} orange peel.
e.zh: 蛋糕上撒着糖渍橙皮。

e.en: He preferred {succate} fruit in rich winter desserts.
e.zh: 他喜欢在浓郁的冬季甜点里加入蜜饯水果。

e.en: The cheap mixture served as a {succedane} for coffee.
e.zh: 这种廉价混合物被当作咖啡的替代品。

e.en: No legal {succedane} could replace the signed document.
e.zh: 没有任何法律上的替代物能取代那份签署文件。

e.en: The museum displayed several wartime {succedanea} for scarce materials.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几种战时稀缺材料的代用品。

e.en: Such {succedanea} often worked poorly but were widely used.
e.zh: 这类替代品往往效果不佳，却曾被广泛使用。

e.en: The dentist fitted a {succedaneous} tooth after the injury.
e.zh: 受伤后，牙医给他装了一颗替代牙。

e.en: A {succedaneous} method was adopted when supplies ran out.
e.zh: 物资耗尽后，人们采用了一种替代方法。

e.en: Barley was used as a {succedaneum} for coffee.
e.zh: 大麦曾被用作咖啡的代用品。

e.en: The committee rejected the proposal as a poor {succedaneum}.
e.zh: 委员会认为该方案只是拙劣的替代品，因此予以否决。

e.en: The {succedent} clause explains the consequence of the condition.
e.zh: 后续从句说明该条件带来的结果。

e.en: In astrology, a {succedent} house follows an angular house.
e.zh: 在占星术中，续宫位于角宫之后。

e.en: The {succentor} led the choir when the precentor was absent.
e.zh: 领唱缺席时，副领唱带领唱诗班。

e.en: A young {succentor} rehearsed the psalm with the boys.
e.zh: 一位年轻的助理唱诗班长带男孩们排练圣歌。

e.en: She wrote {succesfully} in her draft by mistake.
e.zh: 她在草稿里误把 successfully 写成了 succesfully。

e.en: The form accepted the misspelled word {succesfully}.
e.zh: 表单竟然接受了这个拼错的词 succesfully。

e.en: The essay examines the {successivity} of historical events.
e.zh: 这篇文章考察历史事件的相继发生。

e.en: Memory often depends on the {successivity} of impressions.
e.zh: 记忆常常依赖印象之间的连续性。

e.en: After several {successless} attempts, they changed strategy.
e.zh: 几次不成功的尝试之后，他们改变了策略。

e.en: His {successless} search lasted until midnight.
e.zh: 他徒劳的搜寻一直持续到午夜。

e.en: The chemist purified {succimide} before the next reaction.
e.zh: 化学家在下一步反应前提纯了琥珀酰亚胺。

e.en: A small amount of {succimide} remained in the sample.
e.zh: 样品中还残留少量琥珀酰亚胺。

e.en: The reaction produced {succinaldehyde} as an intermediate.
e.zh: 该反应生成琥珀醛作为中间体。

e.en: Researchers measured {succinaldehyde} in the prepared solution.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了配制溶液中的丁二醛。

e.en: The lab synthesized a new {succinamate} derivative.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一种新的琥珀酰胺酸衍生物。

e.en: This {succinamate} salt dissolves readily in water.
e.zh: 这种琥珀酰胺酸盐很容易溶于水。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {succinamide}.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量琥珀酰胺。

e.en: Heating {succinamide} changed the reaction rate.
e.zh: 加热琥珀酰胺改变了反应速率。

e.en: Cells convert {succinate} during the citric acid cycle.
e.zh: 细胞在柠檬酸循环中转化琥珀酸盐。

e.en: The doctor prescribed iron {succinate} for anemia.
e.zh: 医生为贫血开了琥珀酸亚铁。

e.en: The necklace was made from polished {succinite}.
e.zh: 这条项链由抛光的琥珀制成。

e.en: Geologists identified the resin as Baltic {succinite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这种树脂鉴定为波罗的海琥珀。

e.en: Elevated {succinoadenosine} can indicate a metabolic disorder.
e.zh: 琥珀酰腺苷升高可能提示代谢紊乱。

e.en: The assay detects {succinoadenosine} in dried blood spots.
e.zh: 该检测可在干血斑中检出琥珀酰腺苷。

e.en: She said Mr. {Such-and-such} had called earlier.
e.zh: 她说某某先生早些时候打过电话。

e.en: The form asks for your address, phone number, and {such-and-such}.
e.zh: 表格要填地址、电话号码以及诸如此类的信息。

e.en: Old records mention a Mr. {Suchandsuch} from the village.
e.zh: 旧记录提到村里有位某某先生。

e.en: He explained the plan as {suchandsuch}, but nobody understood.
e.zh: 他把计划说成如此这般，可没人听懂。

e.en: The vent can {suck-in} dust from the floor.
e.zh: 这个通风口会把地上的灰尘吸进去。

e.en: Don't let that offer {suck-in} your savings.
e.zh: 别让那个报价把你的积蓄骗进去。

e.en: Everyone knew he was a {suck-up} to the manager.
e.zh: 大家都知道他是经理面前的马屁精。

e.en: She refused to {suck-up} just to get promoted.
e.zh: 她不愿为了升职去巴结别人。

e.en: A {suckerfish} clung to the shark's side.
e.zh: 一条吸盘鱼贴在鲨鱼身侧。

e.en: The aquarium keeps a {suckerfish} to clean algae.
e.zh: 水族箱里养了一条吸盘鱼来清理藻类。

e.en: The old sailor called the remora a {suckfish}.
e.zh: 老水手把䲟鱼叫作吸盘鱼。

e.en: A {suckfish} uses its head disc to attach itself.
e.zh: 吸盘鱼用头部的吸盘附着在别的动物身上。

e.en: The pump will {suckout} the dirty water quickly.
e.zh: 水泵会很快把脏水抽出去。

e.en: He hit a lucky card for a {suckout} on the river.
e.zh: 他在最后一张牌摸到好运牌，侥幸逆转。

e.en: The intestine uses {sucrase} to break down sucrose.
e.zh: 肠道利用蔗糖酶分解蔗糖。

e.en: A lack of {sucrase} can cause digestive discomfort.
e.zh: 缺乏蔗糖酶可能引起消化不适。

e.en: The chemist prepared a calcium {sucrate} solution.
e.zh: 化学家配制了一种钙蔗糖盐溶液。

e.en: This {sucrate} forms when sugar reacts with the base.
e.zh: 糖与碱反应时会形成这种蔗糖盐。

e.en: The old formula listed {sucrol} as a sweetening agent.
e.zh: 旧配方把蔗糖衍生甜味剂列为甜味成分。

e.en: Researchers compared {sucrol} with ordinary table sugar.
e.zh: 研究人员把这种蔗糖衍生甜味剂与普通食糖作了比较。

e.en: The lab measured the {sucrosic} content of the syrup.
e.zh: 实验室测定了糖浆中的蔗糖含量。

e.en: A {sucrosic} solution was added to the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员向样本中加入了含蔗糖的溶液。

e.en: The device failed when its {suctional} force weakened.
e.zh: 设备的吸力减弱后就失效了。

e.en: Engineers tested the {suctional} effect in the tube.
e.zh: 工程师测试了管内的抽吸效应。

e.en: The parasite has {suctorial} mouthparts for feeding.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫有适于吸食的口器。

e.en: A remora's disk is a {suctorial} organ.
e.zh: 䲟鱼的吸盘是一种吸附器官。

e.en: The microscope revealed a tiny {suctorian} on the slide.
e.zh: 显微镜下可见载玻片上有一只微小的吸管虫。

e.en: A {suctorian} protozoan feeds through delicate tentacles.
e.zh: 吸管虫类原生动物通过细小触手取食。

e.en: The insect's {suctorious} mouth is adapted for nectar.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的吸食性口器适合吸取花蜜。

e.en: Biologists described the larva as {suctorious} in habit.
e.zh: 生物学家把这种幼虫的习性描述为吸食性的。

e.en: The fever left small {sudamina} across his chest.
e.zh: 发烧后他胸口出现了细小汗疹。

e.en: Doctors noted {sudamina} during the humid summer outbreak.
e.zh: 医生在潮湿夏季的病例中记录到汗疹。

e.en: The museum displayed ancient {sudaria} from the tomb.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了墓中出土的古代裹尸布。

e.en: Monks carried white {sudaria} during the ceremony.
e.zh: 修士们在仪式中携带白色汗巾。

e.en: The relic was described as a sacred {sudarium}.
e.zh: 这件圣物被描述为神圣的裹尸布。

e.en: He wiped his face with a linen {sudarium}.
e.zh: 他用一块亚麻汗巾擦了擦脸。

e.en: The chronicler mentioned a silk {sudary} in the chapel.
e.zh: 编年史作者提到礼拜堂里有一块丝质汗巾。

e.en: A {sudary} was placed over the dead man's face.
e.zh: 一块裹尸布盖在死者脸上。

e.en: Heavy {sudation} followed the long run.
e.zh: 长跑之后出现了大量出汗。

e.en: The treatment encouraged {sudation} in a warm room.
e.zh: 这种疗法让人在温暖房间里发汗。

e.en: Roman bathhouses often included heated {sudatories}.
e.zh: 罗马浴场常设有加热的发汗室。

e.en: The spa restored its old stone {sudatories}.
e.zh: 这家水疗馆修复了旧石砌蒸汽浴室。

e.en: Visitors relaxed in the warm {sudatorium} after bathing.
e.zh: 游客洗浴后在温暖的发汗室里放松。

e.en: The ancient {sudatorium} was heated from below.
e.zh: 古代蒸汽浴室从下方加热。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {sudatory} treatment for chills.
e.zh: 医生为寒战开了发汗疗法。

e.en: They sat quietly in the {sudatory} before bathing.
e.zh: 他们洗浴前静静坐在发汗室里。

succinonitrite.t: 琥珀酸腈类化合物或盐类的旧称或专称

e.en: The chemist noted {succinonitrite} in the old reagent catalogue.
e.zh: 化学家在旧试剂目录中注意到琥珀酸腈类化合物。

e.en: Few modern papers mention {succinonitrite} by that name.
e.zh: 现代论文很少再用这个名称提到琥珀酸腈类物质。

e.en: The assay measured {succinoxidase} activity in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 这项检测测量了组织样本中的琥珀酸氧化酶活性。

e.en: Researchers once used {succinoxidase} as a marker of respiration.
e.zh: 研究人员曾把琥珀酸氧化酶作为呼吸作用的标志。

e.en: The apothecary labeled the resin {succinum}.
e.zh: 药剂师把这种树脂标作琥珀。

e.en: Old medical texts sometimes prescribe {succinum} for its scent.
e.zh: 旧医学文献有时因其香气而开出琥珀香脂。

e.en: The molecule contains a reactive {succinyl} group.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个活泼的琥珀酰基。

e.en: They attached a {succinyl} chain to improve solubility.
e.zh: 他们接上琥珀酰链以提高溶解度。

e.en: The physician prescribed {succinylsulfathiazole} for an intestinal infection.
e.zh: 医生开了琥珀酰磺胺噻唑来治疗肠道感染。

e.en: Older formularies list {succinylsulfathiazole} among sulfa drugs.
e.zh: 旧药典把琥珀酰磺胺噻唑列在磺胺类药物中。

succinylsulphathiazole.t: 琥珀酰磺胺噻唑的英式拼法

e.en: The British label spelled the drug {succinylsulphathiazole}.
e.zh: 英国标签把这种药拼作琥珀酰磺胺噻唑。

e.en: A wartime manual recommended {succinylsulphathiazole} for certain bowel infections.
e.zh: 一本战时手册建议用琥珀酰磺胺噻唑治疗某些肠道感染。

e.en: The botanist described the leaf base as {succise}.
e.zh: 植物学家把叶基描述为骤然截断状。

e.en: A {succise} edge made the specimen easy to identify.
e.zh: 截断状边缘使这个标本容易辨认。

e.en: The wounded traveler was still {succorable} when help arrived.
e.zh: 救援到达时，受伤的旅人仍然可以获救。

e.en: She believed every lonely child was {succorable}.
e.zh: 她相信每个孤独的孩子都可以得到帮助。

e.en: The village depended on {succorance} from nearby towns.
e.zh: 这个村庄依靠附近城镇的援助。

e.en: His letter begged for {succorance} in a formal tone.
e.zh: 他的信以正式语气请求救助。

e.en: The herbalist dried {succory} roots for a bitter drink.
e.zh: 草药师晒干菊苣根，用来泡苦味饮品。

e.en: Wild {succory} grew along the dusty road.
e.zh: 野生菊苣长在尘土飞扬的路边。

e.en: The fruit remained {succose} even after storage.
e.zh: 这种水果即使储存后仍然多汁。

e.en: A {succose} stem can survive long dry spells.
e.zh: 含汁液的茎能熬过很长的干旱期。

e.en: The plant has thick, {succous} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物有厚而多汁的叶子。

e.en: He preferred the {succous} flesh of ripe peaches.
e.zh: 他更喜欢熟桃那种汁液丰富的果肉。

e.en: The medieval tale describes a {succuba} visiting sleepers at night.
e.zh: 这个中世纪故事描写女梦魔夜里造访睡梦中的人。

e.en: In the poem, the {succuba} symbolizes dangerous desire.
e.zh: 在这首诗里，女魅魔象征危险的欲望。

e.en: The manuscript warns of {succubae} in the margins.
e.zh: 手稿页边警告人们提防多个女梦魔。

e.en: Artists painted {succubae} as seductive spirits.
e.zh: 画家把女梦魔们画成诱人的灵体。

e.en: Legends say {succubi} torment sleepers with visions.
e.zh: 传说女梦魔会用幻象折磨睡梦中的人。

e.en: The fantasy novel includes {succubi} as minor villains.
e.zh: 这部奇幻小说把女魅魔写成次要反派。

e.en: Slow roasting preserved the meat's {succulency}.
e.zh: 慢烤保留了肉的鲜嫩多汁。

e.en: The cactus stores water through its natural {succulency}.
e.zh: 仙人掌凭借天然的多汁性储存水分。

e.en: The bishop opened a {succursal} chapel outside the city.
e.zh: 主教在城外开设了一座附属小教堂。

e.en: A {succursal} office handled requests from distant villages.
e.zh: 一个分支办事处处理偏远村庄的请求。

succus.t: 汁液；植物或体液的旧称

e.en: The physician examined the bitter {succus} of the herb.
e.zh: 医生检查了这种草药的苦味汁液。

e.en: Ancient writers used {succus} for many bodily fluids.
e.zh: 古代作者用succus指多种体液。

e.en: The technician had to {succuss} the vial before testing it.
e.zh: 技术员在检测前必须剧烈摇动小瓶。

e.en: Doctors may {succuss} the chest to listen for fluid.
e.zh: 医生可能会震荡胸部以听是否有积液声。

e.en: The lab used a {succussatory} motion to mix the sample.
e.zh: 实验室用震荡动作混合样本。

e.en: A {succussatory} test helped reveal fluid in the cavity.
e.zh: 一项震荡性检查帮助发现腔内积液。

succussed.t: 被剧烈摇动的；已震荡的

e.en: The nurse {succussed} the bottle ten times.
e.zh: 护士把瓶子剧烈摇动了十次。

e.en: The {succussed} mixture was then left to settle.
e.zh: 震荡后的混合物随后被静置沉淀。

succusses.t: 剧烈摇动；震荡的第三人称形式

e.en: She {succusses} each vial before recording the result.
e.zh: 她在记录结果前都会剧烈摇动每个小瓶。

e.en: The examiner {succusses} the abdomen during the demonstration.
e.zh: 检查者在演示中震荡腹部。

e.en: He was {succussing} the flask when the timer rang.
e.zh: 计时器响起时，他正在剧烈摇动烧瓶。

e.en: The doctor demonstrated {succussing} as part of the exam.
e.zh: 医生演示了把震荡作为检查的一部分。

e.en: Homeopathic preparations often involve repeated {succussion}.
e.zh: 顺势疗法制剂常涉及反复震荡。

e.en: The clinician used {succussion} to detect fluid in the stomach.
e.zh: 临床医生用震荡法检查胃内是否有液体。

e.en: The machine produced a strong {succussive} force.
e.zh: 这台机器产生了强烈的震荡力。

e.en: A {succussive} movement can mix the solution quickly.
e.zh: 震荡动作可以很快混合溶液。

sudburite.t: 萨德伯里岩；陨击角砾岩类矿物岩石

e.en: The geologist identified {sudburite} in the old impact crater.
e.zh: 地质学家在那个古老撞击坑里认出了萨德伯里岩。

e.en: A thin vein of {sudburite} cut across the darker rock.
e.zh: 一条薄薄的萨德伯里岩脉穿过较暗的岩石。

e.en: Boats moved slowly through the thick {sudd}.
e.zh: 船只缓慢穿过厚厚的漂浮植物堵塞河段。

e.en: The river became blocked by {sudd} after the floods.
e.zh: 洪水过后，河道被漂浮植物形成的障碍堵住了。

sudo.t: 用管理员权限执行命令

e.en: You need to run the installer with {sudo}.
e.zh: 你需要用管理员权限运行这个安装程序。

e.en: The command failed because {sudo} was not allowed.
e.zh: 这条命令失败了，因为不允许使用管理员权限。

e.en: She solves a {sudoku} puzzle every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都会解一道数独题。

e.en: This {sudoku} is harder than it looks.
e.zh: 这道数独比看起来要难。

e.en: The doctor tested his {sudomotor} nerve function.
e.zh: 医生检测了他支配汗腺的神经功能。

e.en: Diabetes can damage {sudomotor} responses in the feet.
e.zh: 糖尿病可能损害足部的汗腺神经反应。

e.en: The fever left {sudor} on his forehead.
e.zh: 发烧让他的额头上满是汗液。

e.en: Ancient physicians studied {sudor} as a sign of illness.
e.zh: 古代医师把汗液作为疾病征象来研究。

e.en: The nurse noted a strong {sudoral} reaction after the injection.
e.zh: 护士注意到注射后出现了明显的出汗反应。

e.en: The paper described {sudoral} symptoms during withdrawal.
e.zh: 论文描述了戒断期间与出汗有关的症状。

e.en: Skin contains many {sudoriferous} glands.
e.zh: 皮肤中有许多分泌汗液的腺体。

e.en: The diagram showed the {sudoriferous} ducts clearly.
e.zh: 图示清楚地显示了汗腺导管。

e.en: The herb was used as a {sudorific} remedy.
e.zh: 这种草药曾被用作发汗疗法。

e.en: A hot bath can have a {sudorific} effect.
e.zh: 热水澡可能产生发汗作用。

e.en: The textbook discussed {sudoriparous} glands in mammals.
e.zh: 教材讨论了哺乳动物产生汗液的腺体。

e.en: Damage to {sudoriparous} tissue reduced sweating.
e.zh: 产生汗液的组织受损后，出汗减少了。

e.en: He dressed like a {suedehead} in the old photograph.
e.zh: 在那张旧照片里，他穿得像短发青年亚文化成员。

e.en: The novel follows a young {suedehead} in London.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述伦敦一个短发青年亚文化成员的生活。

e.en: The jacket was made from soft {suedette}.
e.zh: 这件夹克是用柔软的仿麂皮织物做的。

e.en: She chose {suedette} curtains for the bedroom.
e.zh: 她为卧室选择了仿麂皮窗帘。

e.en: The {suer} demanded compensation for the injury.
e.zh: 起诉者要求为这次伤害获得赔偿。

e.en: A persistent {suer} can keep a case alive for years.
e.zh: 执着的原告可能让案件持续多年。

e.en: The pudding had a heavy, {suety} taste.
e.zh: 这道布丁有一种厚重而油腻的味道。

e.en: A {suety} smell filled the small kitchen.
e.zh: 小厨房里弥漫着一股像板油一样的气味。

e.en: The crater wall exposed layers of {suevite}.
e.zh: 撞击坑壁露出了几层陨击熔融角砾岩。

e.en: Samples of {suevite} helped date the impact event.
e.zh: 陨击熔融角砾岩样本帮助确定了撞击事件的年代。

e.en: A little bread will {suff} for the journey.
e.zh: 一点面包就足够这趟旅程用了。

e.en: Such excuses did not {suff} to calm the crowd.
e.zh: 这样的借口不足以安抚人群。

e.en: The heat was barely {sufferable} after noon.
e.zh: 中午过后，炎热几乎让人难以忍受。

e.en: His manners were {sufferable}, though hardly charming.
e.zh: 他的举止尚可，虽然谈不上讨人喜欢。

sufferably.t: 可忍受地；还算过得去地

e.en: The room was {sufferably} warm by evening.
e.zh: 到了晚上，房间暖得还算可以忍受。

e.en: She sang {sufferably}, but without much feeling.
e.zh: 她唱得还过得去，但没什么感情。

e.en: English has many {suffixal} patterns for adjectives.
e.zh: 英语有许多构成形容词的后缀模式。

e.en: The linguist analyzed {suffixal} changes in the dialect.
e.zh: 语言学家分析了这种方言中的后缀变化。

e.en: The word is formed by {suffixation}.
e.zh: 这个词是通过加后缀构成的。

e.en: Children learn {suffixation} before many spelling rules.
e.zh: 儿童在掌握许多拼写规则之前就会学习加后缀构词。

e.en: The grammar book calls this process {suffixion}.
e.zh: 这本语法书把这个过程称为后缀附加。

e.en: Old dictionaries sometimes use {suffixion} instead of suffixation.
e.zh: 旧词典有时用suffixion来表示加后缀。

e.en: The editor marked the {suffixment} as unnecessary.
e.zh: 编辑把这个后缀添加标为不必要。

e.en: Old grammars sometimes discuss {suffixment} in word formation.
e.zh: 旧语法书有时会讨论构词中的后缀添加。

e.en: The old physician tried to {sufflate} air into the tube.
e.zh: 那位老医生试着把空气吹入管中。

e.en: They would {sufflate} the powder over the wound.
e.zh: 他们会把粉末吹撒到伤口上。

e.en: The manual described {sufflation} through a narrow pipe.
e.zh: 手册描述了通过细管吹入空气的过程。

e.en: Gentle {sufflation} helped spread the medicine evenly.
e.zh: 轻柔的吹入有助于让药物均匀散开。

e.en: A {suffocative} heat filled the crowded room.
e.zh: 拥挤的房间里充满令人窒息的热气。

e.en: Her anxiety felt almost {suffocative} that night.
e.zh: 那晚她的焦虑几乎让人喘不过气。

e.en: The sinkhole formed after years of {suffosion}.
e.zh: 多年地下侵蚀后形成了这个塌陷坑。

e.en: Engineers studied {suffosion} beneath the old dam.
e.zh: 工程师研究了旧水坝下方的潜蚀现象。

e.en: Her lecture traced the rise of {suffragettism} in Britain.
e.zh: 她的讲座梳理了英国妇女参政运动理念的兴起。

e.en: Critics mocked {suffragettism} in the early newspapers.
e.zh: 早期报纸上的批评者嘲弄妇女参政运动。

suffragism.t: 选举权主义；妇女参政论

e.en: The pamphlet defended {suffragism} as a democratic principle.
e.zh: 这本小册子把选举权主义捍卫为民主原则。

e.en: American {suffragism} drew support from many reform groups.
e.zh: 美国的妇女参政论得到了许多改革团体的支持。

suffrutescent.t: 半灌木状的；基部木质的

e.en: The botanist identified a {suffrutescent} plant near the path.
e.zh: 植物学家在小路旁认出一种半灌木状植物。

e.en: Its {suffrutescent} stems survive after the flowers fade.
e.zh: 花谢之后，它基部木质的茎仍能存活。

e.en: Lavender can grow as a small {suffrutex}.
e.zh: 薰衣草可以长成一株小型半灌木。

e.en: The dry hillside was covered with hardy {suffrutex} plants.
e.zh: 干燥的山坡上覆盖着耐旱的亚灌木植物。

e.en: The herb becomes {suffruticose} as it matures.
e.zh: 这种草本植物成熟后会变得半灌木状。

e.en: A {suffruticose} base helps the plant endure winter.
e.zh: 略木质的基部帮助这种植物熬过冬天。

e.en: They used herbs to {suffumigate} the sickroom.
e.zh: 他们用草药熏蒸病房。

e.en: The ritual required priests to {suffumigate} the altar.
e.zh: 仪式要求祭司用烟熏祭坛。

e.en: The chamber was {suffumigated} with aromatic smoke.
e.zh: 房间已用芳香烟雾熏蒸过。

e.en: A {suffumigated} cloak carried the scent of incense.
e.zh: 一件被烟熏过的斗篷带着焚香气味。

e.en: The monks were {suffumigating} the hall before dawn.
e.zh: 僧侣们在黎明前正给大厅熏香。

e.en: A {suffumigating} brazier stood beside the doorway.
e.zh: 门旁放着一个用于熏烟的火盆。

e.en: A pink {suffusion} spread across the evening sky.
e.zh: 一片粉红色渐渐弥漫在傍晚的天空。

e.en: The doctor noticed a red {suffusion} in her eyes.
e.zh: 医生注意到她眼中有一片泛红。

e.en: The sunset cast a {suffusive} glow over the lake.
e.zh: 夕阳在湖面上洒下一片弥漫的光辉。

e.en: He spoke with a {suffusive} sadness that quieted everyone.
e.zh: 他说话时带着弥漫的悲伤，让所有人安静下来。

e.en: The {Sufi} poet wrote about divine love.
e.zh: 这位苏菲派诗人书写神圣之爱。

e.en: She attended a {Sufi} music gathering in Istanbul.
e.zh: 她在伊斯坦布尔参加了一场苏菲音乐聚会。

e.en: Many {Sufis} value music and poetry in worship.
e.zh: 许多苏菲派信徒在礼拜中重视音乐和诗歌。

e.en: The book describes {Sufis} traveling across medieval Persia.
e.zh: 这本书描写了苏菲派信徒在中世纪波斯各地游历。

e.en: She spread {sufu} on a bowl of rice.
e.zh: 她把腐乳抹在一碗米饭上。

e.en: The sauce tastes salty because it contains {sufu}.
e.zh: 这种酱因为含有豆腐乳而味道偏咸。

e.en: She boiled maize in a large {sufuria}.
e.zh: 她用一个大东非金属炊锅煮玉米。

e.en: The cook scrubbed the {sufuria} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后厨师把那只金属炊锅刷干净。

e.en: The company was fined for using {sug} to sell insurance.
e.zh: 这家公司因用冒充调查的推销方式卖保险而被罚款。

e.en: Good researchers avoid {sug} because it damages trust.
e.zh: 好的研究人员会避免冒充调查推销，因为这会破坏信任。

e.en: The old chair had a woven {sugan} seat.
e.zh: 那把旧椅子的座面是用草绳编成的。

e.en: Farmers tied the bundle with {sugan}.
e.zh: 农民用稻草绳把那捆东西扎起来。

e.en: The factory will {sugar-coat} the tablets before packaging.
e.zh: 工厂会在包装前给药片裹上糖衣。

e.en: Do not {sugar-coat} the problem for the client.
e.zh: 不要向客户粉饰这个问题。

e.en: The children liked the {sugar-coated} almonds.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢那些裹了糖衣的杏仁。

e.en: His {sugar-coated} apology avoided the real issue.
e.zh: 他那番粉饰过的道歉回避了真正的问题。

e.en: The pill has a thin {sugar-coating}.
e.zh: 这颗药丸有一层薄薄的糖衣。

e.en: After the layoffs, nobody wanted corporate {sugar-coating}.
e.zh: 裁员之后，没人想听公司的粉饰说法。

e.en: The hospital invited a {suicidologist} to train its staff.
e.zh: 医院邀请了一位自杀学研究者来培训员工。

e.en: As a {suicidologist}, she studies patterns of self-harm prevention.
e.zh: 作为自杀学研究者，她研究预防自伤的规律。

e.en: He wrote his thesis on {suicidology} and public health.
e.zh: 他的论文研究自杀学与公共卫生。

e.en: Modern {suicidology} examines social, medical, and psychological risks.
e.zh: 现代自杀学考察社会、医学和心理风险。

e.en: The vet noted several {suine} features in the skull.
e.zh: 兽医注意到这块头骨有几处猪类特征。

e.en: His rude, {suine} manners offended everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 他粗鲁得像猪一样的举止冒犯了晚餐上的所有人。

e.en: Raw wool contains {suint}, grease, and bits of dirt.
e.zh: 原羊毛含有羊毛脂汗垢、油脂和少量污物。

e.en: The old process washed {suint} from the fleece before spinning.
e.zh: 旧工艺在纺纱前会把羊毛上的汗垢洗掉。

e.en: She wore a navy {suit-dress} to the interview.
e.zh: 她穿了一件海军蓝西装式连衣裙去面试。

e.en: The designer updated the classic {suit-dress} with softer fabric.
e.zh: 设计师用更柔软的面料改良了经典西装式连衣裙。

e.en: My {suitemate} left a note on the kitchen table.
e.zh: 我的套房室友在厨房桌上留了张字条。

e.en: She met her college {suitemate} again after ten years.
e.zh: 十年后她又见到了大学时的套房室友。

e.en: We ordered {sukiyaki} for dinner at the Japanese restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在那家日本餐馆点了寿喜烧当晚餐。

e.en: Her homemade {sukiyaki} had thin beef and sweet soy broth.
e.zh: 她自制的寿喜烧有薄牛肉片和甜酱油汤底。

e.en: The family decorated the {sukkah} with fruit and paper chains.
e.zh: 那家人用水果和纸链装饰住棚节棚屋。

e.en: During Sukkot, meals are often eaten in a {sukkah}.
e.zh: 住棚节期间，人们常在棚屋里用餐。

e.en: The botanist described the seed as {sulcate} under magnification.
e.zh: 植物学家在放大观察下称这粒种子有沟纹。

e.en: A {sulcate} surface helped channel water away from the stone.
e.zh: 带沟槽的表面有助于把水从石头上引走。

e.en: The shell was deeply {sulcated} along one side.
e.zh: 贝壳一侧有很深的沟槽。

e.en: They found a {sulcated} tool handle in the excavation.
e.zh: 他们在发掘中发现了一个刻有沟槽的工具柄。

e.en: The report noted abnormal {sulcation} in the brain scan.
e.zh: 报告指出脑部扫描中有异常沟状结构。

e.en: Weathering produced fine {sulcation} across the limestone surface.
e.zh: 风化在石灰岩表面形成了细密的沟纹。

e.en: The fossil showed a narrow {sulciform} mark near its edge.
e.zh: 化石边缘附近有一道狭窄的沟状痕迹。

e.en: A {sulciform} depression ran down the center of the leaf.
e.zh: 叶片中央有一条沟状凹陷。

e.en: The chef served {sugar-cured} ham with pears.
e.zh: 厨师把糖腌火腿配梨一起端上来。

e.en: She packed {sugar-cured} fruit for the winter.
e.zh: 她把糖渍水果储存起来过冬。

sugar-daddy.t: 包养年轻情人的有钱男人

e.en: Her friends joked about her rich {sugar-daddy}.
e.zh: 她的朋友拿她那位有钱的金主开玩笑。

e.en: The article criticized the {sugar-daddy} arrangement.
e.zh: 那篇文章批评了这种金钱包养关系。

e.en: The old shop displayed a hard {sugar-loaf}.
e.zh: 那家老店陈列着一块坚硬的圆锥糖。

e.en: He broke pieces from the {sugar-loaf} carefully.
e.zh: 他小心地从糖锥上敲下几块。

e.en: The {sugar-mill} closed after the harvest.
e.zh: 收割季结束后，那家糖厂停工了。

e.en: Smoke rose from the old {sugar-mill}.
e.zh: 烟从那座旧甘蔗制糖厂升起。

e.en: The child saved one {sugar-plum} for later.
e.zh: 孩子留了一颗糖果蜜饯以后吃。

e.en: Visions of a {sugar-plum} future filled her mind.
e.zh: 她脑中满是甜美未来的幻想。

e.en: The {sugar-refinery} processes raw cane sugar.
e.zh: 这家炼糖厂加工粗甘蔗糖。

e.en: Workers repaired the {sugar-refinery} boilers overnight.
e.zh: 工人们连夜修理精糖厂的锅炉。

e.en: A {sugarberry} shaded the edge of the field.
e.zh: 一棵糖浆果树给田边投下阴凉。

e.en: Birds gathered in the old {sugarberry}.
e.zh: 鸟儿聚在那棵老朴树上。

e.en: They tapped maples in the {sugarbush} each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天他们都在糖枫林里采枫树汁。

e.en: The family owns a small {sugarbush} in Vermont.
e.zh: 这家人在佛蒙特有一小片采糖枫林。

e.en: Do not {sugarcoat} the problem for me.
e.zh: 别把这个问题对我粉饰淡化。

e.en: Factories {sugarcoat} the pills to hide bitterness.
e.zh: 工厂给药片裹糖衣来遮住苦味。

e.en: She handed him a {sugarcoated} tablet.
e.zh: 她递给他一片裹着糖衣的药片。

e.en: His report gave a {sugarcoated} version of events.
e.zh: 他的报告把事情说得经过粉饰。

e.en: The medicine has a thin {sugarcoating}.
e.zh: 这种药外面有一层薄薄的糖衣。

e.en: We need honesty, not {sugarcoating}.
e.zh: 我们需要诚实，而不是粉饰太平。

e.en: The company {sugarcoats} bad news in cheerful emails.
e.zh: 公司在欢快的邮件里粉饰坏消息。

e.en: This process {sugarcoats} each nut evenly.
e.zh: 这个工序会把每颗坚果均匀裹上糖衣。

e.en: Steam poured from the {sugarhouse} roof.
e.zh: 蒸汽从枫糖小屋的屋顶冒出来。

e.en: They boiled sap in the {sugarhouse}.
e.zh: 他们在制糖房里熬煮树汁。

e.en: Several {sugarhouses} opened for visitors in March.
e.zh: 三月有几间枫糖小屋向游客开放。

e.en: Old {sugarhouses} still stand along the road.
e.zh: 路边仍立着几座旧制糖房。

e.en: The cake's {sugariness} overwhelmed the coffee.
e.zh: 蛋糕的甜腻味盖过了咖啡的味道。

e.en: Her song avoided excessive {sugariness}.
e.zh: 她的歌没有过分甜腻。

e.en: A traditional {sugarloaf} sat on the counter.
e.zh: 柜台上放着一个传统糖锥。

e.en: The hill rose like a {sugarloaf}.
e.zh: 那座山像圆锥一样隆起。

e.en: The syrup left a {sugarry} film on the spoon.
e.zh: 糖浆在勺子上留下了一层甜黏的薄膜。

e.en: She disliked the drink's {sugarry} smell.
e.zh: 她不喜欢那饮料甜腻的气味。

e.en: The village {sugarworks} employed thirty people.
e.zh: 村里的制糖厂雇了三十个人。

e.en: Tourists visited the historic {sugarworks}.
e.zh: 游客参观了那座历史悠久的糖品作坊。

e.en: His lecture on {suggestology} sounded more mystical than scientific.
e.zh: 他关于暗示学的讲座听起来更像玄学而不是科学。

e.en: The book treats {suggestology} as a method of persuasion.
e.zh: 这本书把暗示学视为一种说服方法。

suggestopedia.t: 暗示教学法；放松学习法

e.en: The school experimented with {suggestopedia} in language classes.
e.zh: 学校在语言课上试用了暗示教学法。

e.en: Fans of {suggestopedia} emphasize music and relaxation.
e.zh: 暗示教学法的支持者强调音乐和放松。

e.en: A deep {sugh} came from the chimney.
e.zh: 烟囱里传来一阵低沉的呼啸声。

e.en: She answered with a tired {sugh}.
e.zh: 她疲惫地叹了一口气作为回答。

sulfanilamido.t: 磺胺酰氨基的；含磺胺酰氨基

e.en: The chemist identified a {sulfanilamido} group in the compound.
e.zh: 化学家在该化合物中识别出一个磺胺酰氨基。

e.en: Several {sulfanilamido} derivatives were tested for activity.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了几种磺胺酰氨基衍生物的活性。

sulfanilate.t: 对氨基苯磺酸盐；磺胺酸盐

e.en: The sample contained sodium {sulfanilate}.
e.zh: 样品中含有对氨基苯磺酸钠。

e.en: A {sulfanilate} solution was added slowly.
e.zh: 实验中缓慢加入了磺胺酸盐溶液。

e.en: Doctors once used {sulfanilylguanidine} for intestinal infections.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用磺胺胍治疗肠道感染。

e.en: The old label listed {sulfanilylguanidine} as the active ingredient.
e.zh: 旧标签上把磺胺胍列为有效成分。

sulfanilylurea.t: 磺胺脲；磺胺酰脲类化合物

e.en: The paper described a new {sulfanilylurea} compound.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种新的磺胺脲化合物。

e.en: They compared {sulfanilylurea} derivatives in the assay.
e.zh: 他们在测定中比较了多种磺胺酰脲衍生物。

e.en: The interaction study used {sulfaphenazole} as an inhibitor.
e.zh: 相互作用研究中使用磺胺苯唑作为抑制剂。

e.en: Few pharmacies still stock {sulfaphenazole}.
e.zh: 如今很少有药房仍备有磺胺苯唑。

sulfapyrazine.t: 磺胺吡嗪；磺胺类抗菌药

e.en: The veterinarian prescribed {sulfapyrazine} for the flock.
e.zh: 兽医给这群家禽开了磺胺吡嗪。

e.en: Residues of {sulfapyrazine} were measured in the feed.
e.zh: 研究人员检测了饲料中的磺胺吡嗪残留。

e.en: The archive spelled the drug as {sulfapyridin}.
e.zh: 档案中把这种药拼作磺胺吡啶的旧式写法。

e.en: Older textbooks sometimes mention {sulfapyridin}.
e.zh: 较早的教科书有时会提到sulfapyridin这种旧拼法。

e.en: {Sulfapyridine} was widely used before newer antibiotics appeared.
e.zh: 在更新的抗生素出现之前，磺胺吡啶曾被广泛使用。

e.en: The patient developed a rash after taking {sulfapyridine}.
e.zh: 患者服用磺胺吡啶后出现了皮疹。

e.en: The laboratory synthesized a {sulfapyrimidine} derivative.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一种磺胺嘧啶类衍生物。

e.en: A {sulfapyrimidine} drug was chosen for the trial.
e.zh: 试验选用了一种磺胺嘧啶类药物。

sulfaquinoxaline.t: 磺胺喹恶啉；兽用磺胺药

e.en: Farmers used {sulfaquinoxaline} to control coccidiosis.
e.zh: 农场主曾用磺胺喹恶啉控制球虫病。

e.en: The report found {sulfaquinoxaline} residues in poultry tissue.
e.zh: 报告在家禽组织中发现了磺胺喹恶啉残留。

sulfarsenide.t: 硫砷化物；含硫砷的化合物

e.en: The mineral was classified as a {sulfarsenide}.
e.zh: 这种矿物被归类为硫砷化物。

e.en: A rare {sulfarsenide} formed in the ore vein.
e.zh: 矿脉中形成了一种罕见的硫砷化物。

sulfarsphenamine.t: 硫胂凡纳明；旧抗梅毒药

e.en: {Sulfarsphenamine} was once used to treat syphilis.
e.zh: 硫胂凡纳明曾被用于治疗梅毒。

e.en: The museum displayed a vial of {sulfarsphenamine}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一小瓶硫胂凡纳明。

sulfasuxidine.t: 磺胺琥珀啶；肠道用磺胺药

e.en: {Sulfasuxidine} acted mainly within the intestine.
e.zh: 磺胺琥珀啶主要在肠道内发挥作用。

e.en: An old formulary listed {sulfasuxidine} for dysentery.
e.zh: 一本旧处方集中列有用于痢疾的磺胺琥珀啶。

sulfatase.t: 硫酸酯酶；水解硫酸酯的酶

e.en: The test measured {sulfatase} activity in the cells.
e.zh: 该检测测量了细胞中的硫酸酯酶活性。

e.en: A missing {sulfatase} can disrupt normal metabolism.
e.zh: 缺少一种硫酸酯酶可能会扰乱正常代谢。

sulfathiazole.t: 磺胺噻唑；磺胺类抗菌药

e.en: {Sulfathiazole} was common in early antibiotic therapy.
e.zh: 磺胺噻唑在早期抗菌治疗中很常见。

e.en: The ointment contained {sulfathiazole} for skin infections.
e.zh: 这种软膏含有用于皮肤感染的磺胺噻唑。

sulfathiazoline.t: 磺胺噻唑啉；磺胺类化合物

e.en: The researchers prepared {sulfathiazoline} in the laboratory.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验室制备了磺胺噻唑啉。

e.en: {Sulfathiazoline} appeared in the patent as a related compound.
e.zh: 磺胺噻唑啉作为相关化合物出现在专利中。

sulfathiourea.t: 磺胺硫脲；含硫脲的磺胺化合物

e.en: The compound was named {sulfathiourea} in the catalog.
e.zh: 目录中把该化合物命名为磺胺硫脲。

e.en: They studied {sulfathiourea} for possible antimicrobial effects.
e.zh: 他们研究了磺胺硫脲可能具有的抗菌作用。

e.en: A lack of {sulfatidase} damages nerve tissue.
e.zh: 缺乏硫脂酶会损伤神经组织。

e.en: The assay detected {sulfatidase} in the sample.
e.zh: 该测定在样品中检测到了硫脂酶。

e.en: {Sulfatide} accumulates in certain inherited disorders.
e.zh: 硫脂会在某些遗传性疾病中积聚。

e.en: The membrane contains a small amount of {sulfatide}.
e.zh: 这种膜含有少量硫脂。

e.en: Drug metabolism often involves {sulfation}.
e.zh: 药物代谢常常涉及硫酸化。

e.en: Excessive battery {sulfation} reduces performance.
e.zh: 电池过度硫酸盐化会降低性能。

sulfatize.t: 使硫酸盐化；转化为硫酸盐

e.en: The process can {sulfatize} metal surfaces.
e.zh: 这一过程会使金属表面硫酸盐化。

e.en: Engineers tried to {sulfatize} the ore before leaching.
e.zh: 工程师试图在浸出前使矿石硫酸盐化。

e.en: The molecule includes a reactive {sulfatyl} group.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个活泼的硫酸酰基。

e.en: They compared several {sulfatyl} derivatives.
e.zh: 他们比较了几种硫酸酰基衍生物。

sulfazide.t: 磺胺叠氮化物；磺酰叠氮化合物

e.zh: 每名相扑选手都在黎明前训练数小时。

e.zh: 只有傻瓜才会无视那个警告。

e.zh: 丢了钥匙后，他骂自己是个笨人。

e.zh: 猎人带着一支吹箭筒穿过森林。

e.zh: 传统吹箭筒可以发射毒镖。

e.zh: 编辑删掉了手稿中那个顽固沿用的错误说法。

e.en: He was a {sumpsimus} about every outdated rule.
e.zh: 他对每条过时规则都固执守旧。

e.en: A {sumpter-horse} carried the tents uphill.
e.zh: 一匹驮马把帐篷运上山。

e.en: The caravan relied on one steady {sumpter-horse}.
e.zh: 商队依靠一匹稳健的载货马。

e.en: The {sumpter-mule} followed the narrow trail.
e.zh: 那头驮骡沿着狭窄小路前行。

e.zh: 他们把面粉装到一头温顺的载货骡身上。

e.en: She came back from Spain with a deep {sun-tan}.
e.zh: 她从西班牙回来时晒成了深古铜色。

e.en: A light {sun-tan} covered his arms.
e.zh: 他的手臂晒出了一层浅浅的棕色。

sun-tanned.t: 晒黑的；被太阳晒成褐色的

e.en: His {sun-tanned} face looked healthy and relaxed.
e.zh: 他晒黑的脸看起来健康又放松。

e.en: The workers had {sun-tanned} arms from weeks outdoors.
e.zh: 工人们在户外待了几周，手臂都晒黑了。

e.en: We started walking at {sun-up}.
e.zh: 我们在日出时开始步行。

e.en: By {sun-up}, the camp was already quiet.
e.zh: 到天亮时，营地已经安静下来。

e.en: Ancient {sun-worship} shaped many local rituals.
e.zh: 古代的太阳崇拜影响了许多当地仪式。

e.en: Her holiday routine was mostly swimming and {sun-worship}.
e.zh: 她的假期基本就是游泳和尽情晒太阳。

sun-worshipper.t: 太阳崇拜者；爱晒太阳的人

e.en: The old temple was built by a {sun-worshipper}.
e.zh: 这座古庙是一位太阳崇拜者建造的。

e.en: Every beach has at least one devoted {sun-worshipper}.
e.zh: 每个海滩上至少都有一个特别爱晒太阳的人。

e.en: She wore a yellow {sunback} to the pool.
e.zh: 她穿着一件黄色露背泳装去泳池。

e.en: The shop sold cotton {sunback} dresses for summer.
e.zh: 那家店出售适合夏天穿的棉质露背裙。

e.en: They planned to {sunbake} on the quiet beach.
e.zh: 他们打算在安静的海滩上晒太阳。

e.en: Australians often {sunbake} during long summer holidays.
e.zh: 澳大利亚人常在漫长暑假里做日光浴。

e.en: The road crossed a {sunbaked} plain.
e.zh: 这条路穿过一片被烈日晒干的平原。

e.en: They rested beside a {sunbaked} brick wall.
e.zh: 他们在一堵被太阳晒热的砖墙旁休息。

e.en: She took a short {sunbath} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后她短暂地晒了会儿太阳。

e.en: A daily {sunbath} can burn fair skin quickly.
e.zh: 每天做日光浴可能很快晒伤白皙皮肤。

e.en: He {sunbaths} on the balcony every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上都在阳台上晒太阳。

e.en: The hotel offers private terraces for {sunbaths}.
e.zh: 酒店提供私人露台供客人做日光浴。

e.zh: 他们在中午前穿过了烈日曝晒的沙漠。

e.zh: 被太阳暴晒的油漆已经褪成了白色。

e.zh: 她打开笔记本电脑前先放下了遮阳帘。

e.zh: 一块条纹遮阳篷给咖啡馆的桌子挡住了阳光。

e.en: The child wore a blue {sunbonnet} in the garden.
e.zh: 那个孩子在花园里戴着一顶蓝色遮阳帽。

e.en: Her grandmother kept an old {sunbonnet} by the door.
e.zh: 她祖母把一顶旧遮阳女帽放在门边。

e.en: The girls tied their {sunbonnets} under their chins.
e.zh: 女孩们把遮阳帽的带子系在下巴下面。

e.en: The museum displayed cotton {sunbonnets} from the 1800s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了十九世纪的棉质遮阳女帽。

e.zh: 云旁出现了一道淡淡的日虹。

sunbright.t: 阳光明亮的；灿烂如日的

e.zh: 向导因常在户外工作，双臂晒成了古铜色。

e.zh: 孩子们回来时脸颊都被太阳晒黑了。

e.zh: 她晒黑的双手带着花园泥土的气味。

e.zh: 我们在乡村市场买了晒制的橄榄。

e.zh: 连下几周雨后，这终于是难得的晴天。

e.zh: 旧日历用红圈标出每个太阳日。

e.zh: 他用聚光镜点起了小火。

e.zh: 这座神庙是为太阳神而建的。

e.zh: 在故事里，太阳神驾车穿过天空。

sun-kissed.t: 阳光亲吻般的；晒出健康色的

e.zh: 她回来时皮肤晒出健康色，眼睛也很明亮。

e.zh: 宣传册展示了阳光明媚的海滩和湛蓝的海水。

e.zh: 搬进屋前请先把这把沙滩躺椅折起来。

e.zh: 工作人员把沙滩躺椅整齐地排成几行。

e.zh: 农场使用一台太阳能驱动的水泵。

e.zh: 他们在赛道上测试了一辆太阳能汽车。

e.en: A {sun-pump} draws water for the greenhouse.
e.zh: 一台太阳能泵为温室抽水。

e.en: The engineer repaired the old {sun-pump} before summer.
e.zh: 工程师在夏天前修好了那台旧日光泵。

e.en: A single {sun-ray} entered through the curtain.
e.zh: 一道太阳光线透过窗帘照了进来。

e.zh: 镜子映到一束日光，亮亮地闪了一下。

e.zh: 他们每天早上在阳光房里喝茶。

e.zh: 日光室让植物在冬天保持温暖。

e.en: Put on {sun-screen} before you go swimming.
e.zh: 去游泳前先涂防晒霜。

e.zh: 车窗上有一个可折叠的遮阳屏。

e.en: The {sun-shot} clouds turned gold at evening.
e.zh: 傍晚，被阳光照射的云变成了金色。

e.en: Her painting shows a {sun-shot} road after rain.
e.zh: 她的画描绘了雨后一条洒着阳光的道路。

e.en: Astronomers observed a large {sun-spot} today.
e.zh: 天文学家今天观测到一个巨大的太阳黑子。

e.en: A dark {sun-spot} appeared on his cheek.
e.zh: 他的脸颊上出现了一块深色晒斑。

e.en: A bright {sundog} appeared beside the winter sun.
e.zh: 冬日太阳旁出现了一块明亮的幻日。

e.en: The photographer waited for the {sundog} to sharpen.
e.zh: 摄影师等着那片幻日变得更清晰。

e.zh: 我们在洒满阳光的露台上吃午饭。

e.en: The film opens with a {sundrenched} coastal road.
e.zh: 电影开场是一条阳光普照的海滨公路。

e.zh: 市场用小篮子卖日晒风干的鱼。

e.zh: 那个杂货商把针和肥皂放在柜台后面。

e.zh: 一位老杂货商每周五去各个农场兜售。

sundrily.t: 以各种方式；杂七杂八地

e.zh: 客人们穿得各不相同，来参加这场非正式晚餐。

e.en: His tools lay {sundrily} across the workshop floor.
e.zh: 他的工具杂七杂八地散在工坊地板上。

e.en: The painter dotted {sundrops} across the sea.

e.en: A young {sungar} hid among the reeds.
e.zh: 一条幼小的长吻雀鳝躲在芦苇间。

sunglow.t: 日光辉映；阳光般的光泽

e.en: Her hair had a warm {sunglow} in the photo.

e.en: The reserve protects the tiny {suni}.
e.zh: 保护区保护这种体型很小的桑尼羚。

e.zh: 她把每件零星杂物都装进木箱。

e.en: The drawer was full of {sunket} from old trips.
e.zh: 抽屉里满是旧旅行留下的小琐物。

sunkissed.t: 被阳光晒暖的；晒成金色的

e.en: She returned with {sunkissed} cheeks and bright eyes.
e.zh: 她回来时脸颊晒成金色，眼睛明亮。

e.zh: 一只紫色海星在岩石上慢慢移动。

e.en: Her ring was set with a pale {sunstone}.
e.zh: 她的戒指镶着一颗浅色日长石。

e.en: Some legends say sailors used {sunstone} to find the sun.
e.zh: 有些传说说水手曾用太阳石寻找太阳的位置。

e.en: The {sunstruck} hiker needed water and shade.
e.zh: 那个中暑的徒步者需要水和阴凉处。

e.en: We found him dazed and {sunstruck} after the parade.
e.zh: 游行结束后，我们发现他被太阳晒得昏昏沉沉。

e.en: The baby wore a striped {sunsuit}.
e.zh: 宝宝穿着一件条纹儿童夏装。

e.en: She packed a cotton {sunsuit} for the holiday.
e.zh: 她为假期打包了一件棉质日光浴服。

e.en: The little courtyard is a perfect {suntrap}.
e.zh: 这个小院子是个很理想的避风向阳处。

e.en: Their balcony becomes a {suntrap} in the afternoon.
e.zh: 他们的阳台下午会变成一块聚热的阳地。

e.en: These sheltered patios are real {suntraps}.
e.zh: 这些有遮挡的露台是真正的避风向阳处。

e.en: Urban courtyards can become dangerous {suntraps} in summer.
e.zh: 城市庭院在夏天可能变成危险的聚热阳地。

sunwise.t: 顺太阳方向的；顺时针的

e.en: They walked {sunwise} around the old stone circle.
e.zh: 他们顺着太阳方向绕着古老的石圈行走。

e.en: Turn the wheel {sunwise} to tighten the rope.
e.zh: 顺时针转动轮子，把绳子拉紧。

e.en: He worked as a {supe} in old theater productions.
e.zh: 他曾在老剧场演出中当临时演员。

e.en: The film {supe} checked the crowd before shooting.
e.zh: 电影现场主管在拍摄前检查了群众演员。

e.en: The lab bought a new {super-computer} for climate models.
e.zh: 实验室买了一台新的超级计算机来做气候模型。

e.en: A {super-computer} can process huge amounts of data quickly.
e.zh: 超级计算机能快速处理海量数据。

e.en: The experiment showed {super-cooling} in pure water.
e.zh: 实验显示纯水出现了过冷却现象。

e.en: {Super-cooling} can keep a liquid below its freezing point.
e.zh: 过冷却能让液体保持在冰点以下。

e.en: Their strict {super-egos} made every small desire feel guilty.
e.zh: 他们严厉的超我让每个小小欲望都带着罪恶感。

e.en: The analyst compared the patients' {super-egos} in therapy.
e.zh: 分析师在治疗中比较了患者的超我。

e.en: The old receiver used a {super-emitron} for image pickup.
e.zh: 那台旧接收设备用超发射电子管来拾取图像。

e.en: Engineers replaced the damaged {super-emitron} before the broadcast.
e.zh: 工程师在播出前更换了损坏的超发射电子管。

e.en: She fixed the broken handle with {super-glue}.
e.zh: 她用强力胶修好了断掉的把手。

e.en: Do not get {super-glue} on your fingers.
e.zh: 不要把瞬间胶弄到手指上。

e.en: The treaty changed relations between each {super-power}.
e.zh: 这项条约改变了各超级大国之间的关系。

e.en: In the story, invisibility is her secret {super-power}.
e.zh: 在故事里，隐身是她的秘密超能力。

e.en: The chemist tried to {super-saturate} the solution with salt.
e.zh: 化学家试图让溶液中的盐达到过度饱和。

e.en: Streaming services can {super-saturate} viewers with similar shows.
e.zh: 流媒体服务可能用相似节目让观众过度饱和。

e.en: Crystals formed after {super-saturation} of the liquid.
e.zh: 液体过饱和后形成了晶体。

e.en: The market showed signs of {super-saturation} with delivery apps.
e.zh: 配送应用市场出现了过度充斥的迹象。

e.en: Critics feared the union would become a {super-state}.
e.zh: 批评者担心这个联盟会变成一个超国家。

e.en: The novel imagines a future {super-state} ruling the continent.
e.zh: 这部小说设想了一个统治大陆的未来超级国家。

e.en: A new {super-store} opened beside the highway.
e.zh: 高速公路旁开了一家新的大型超市。

e.en: The {super-store} sells furniture, food, and electronics.
e.zh: 这家巨型商店出售家具、食品和电子产品。

e.en: This cleaner is a {super-strength} formula for grease.
e.zh: 这种清洁剂是去油污的超强配方。

e.en: The hero's {super-strength} let him lift the truck.
e.zh: 英雄的超常力量让他举起了卡车。

e.en: Marxist theory examines economic bases and {super-structures}.
e.zh: 马克思主义理论研究经济基础和上层结构。

e.en: The shipyard builds steel {super-structures} for offshore platforms.
e.zh: 船厂为海上平台建造钢制大型结构。

e.en: A {super-tanker} waited outside the busy port.
e.zh: 一艘超级油轮在繁忙港口外等待。

e.en: The spill came from a damaged {super-tanker}.
e.zh: 泄漏来自一艘受损的超级油轮。

e.en: The obstacle seemed difficult but {superable}.
e.zh: 这个障碍看似困难，但可以克服。

e.en: For her, the record was {superable} with better training.
e.zh: 对她来说，只要训练更好，这项纪录是可以超越的。

e.en: The plan depends on the {superableness} of these barriers.
e.zh: 这个计划取决于这些障碍的可克服性。

e.en: Coaches debated the {superableness} of the old record.
e.zh: 教练们讨论那项旧纪录的可超越性。

e.en: The problem was framed {superably} by the consultant.
e.zh: 顾问把这个问题表述成可以克服的样子。

e.en: He described the crisis {superably}, not as a final defeat.
e.zh: 他把危机描述为可以克服，而不是最终失败。

e.en: Wildflowers {superabound} in the valley after spring rain.
e.zh: 春雨过后，山谷里的野花极其繁盛。

e.en: Warnings {superabound} in the report's final pages.
e.zh: 报告最后几页充满了大量警告。

e.en: The diaper contains a {superabsorbent} polymer layer.
e.zh: 这种尿布含有一层超强吸收性的聚合物。

e.en: Researchers tested a {superabsorbent} material for flood barriers.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了一种用于防洪屏障的超强吸收材料。

e.en: The island has {superabundant} sunlight and fresh water.
e.zh: 这座岛拥有极其丰富的阳光和淡水。

e.en: His speech was weakened by {superabundant} detail.
e.zh: 他的演讲因细节过多而变得乏力。

e.en: Fruit grew {superabundantly} in the warm valley.
e.zh: 水果在温暖的山谷里长得极其丰盛。

e.en: The claim was {superabundantly} supported by evidence.
e.zh: 这个说法得到了极其充分的证据支持。

e.en: The molecule acts as a {superacceptor} in the reaction.
e.zh: 该分子在反应中充当超强受体。

e.en: Chemists designed a {superacceptor} to improve charge transfer.
e.zh: 化学家设计了一种强电子受体来改善电荷转移。

e.en: A {superacid} can protonate very weak bases.
e.zh: 超强酸能够使很弱的碱质子化。

e.en: The lab stored the {superacid} under strict controls.
e.zh: 实验室在严格管控下储存这种超强酸。

e.en: A {superactinide} would belong beyond the known actinide series.
e.zh: 超锕系元素会位于已知锕系元素之后。

e.en: The paper modeled the electron shells of a {superactinide}.
e.zh: 论文模拟了一种超锕系元素的电子层。

e.en: Scientists predict unusual chemistry for {superactinides}.
e.zh: 科学家预测超锕系元素类会有异常的化学性质。

e.en: The lecture compared actinides with hypothetical {superactinides}.
e.zh: 讲座把锕系元素与假想的超锕系元素类作了比较。

e.en: The editor chose to {superadd} a moral lesson.
e.zh: 编辑选择额外添加一层道德教训。

e.en: Do not {superadd} new duties without extra pay.
e.zh: 不要在没有额外报酬的情况下再加新职责。

e.en: The medicine caused pain with a {superadded} fever.
e.zh: 这种药引起疼痛，并伴有额外出现的发热。

e.en: A {superadded} clause changed the contract's meaning.
e.zh: 一条附加条款改变了合同的含义。

e.en: The editor kept {superadding} notes to the old manuscript.
e.zh: 编辑不断给那份旧手稿附加注释。

e.en: By {superadding} heat, the chemist changed the reaction rate.
e.zh: 通过额外加热，化学家改变了反应速度。

e.en: The final clause was a late {superaddition} to the contract.
e.zh: 最后那项条款是后来才附加到合同里的。

e.en: A {superaddition} of sugar made the sauce too sweet.
e.zh: 额外加糖让酱汁变得太甜了。

e.en: The study found {superadditivity} when the two treatments were combined.
e.zh: 研究发现两种疗法结合时会产生协同增益。

e.en: In economics, {superadditivity} can make cooperation more valuable than separate action.
e.zh: 在经济学中，超加性会让合作比各自行动更有价值。

e.en: The prototype relies on {superaerodynamics} at extreme flight speeds.
e.zh: 这架原型机在极高速飞行时依赖超空气动力学。

e.en: Only specialists discussed {superaerodynamics} during the technical session.
e.zh: 技术会议上只有专家讨论了超空气动力学。

superagency.t: 超级代理机构；超强行动力

e.en: The new regulator acted like a {superagency} over several departments.
e.zh: 这个新监管机构像一个凌驾多个部门的超级机构。

e.en: The novel imagines human {superagency} in a world of machines.
e.zh: 这部小说想象了机器世界中人的超强行动力。

e.en: Doctors rejected {superalimentation} as unnecessary for the patient.
e.zh: 医生认为对这名病人进行强制喂养没有必要。

e.en: The report linked {superalimentation} with several metabolic problems.
e.zh: 报告把过度营养与几种代谢问题联系起来。

e.en: The lab synthesized a reactive {superalkali} for the experiment.
e.zh: 实验室为这项实验合成了一种活泼的超强碱。

e.en: A {superalkali} can donate electrons more easily than ordinary alkali metals.
e.zh: 超强碱比普通碱金属更容易给出电子。

e.en: A small {superaltar} stood above the main stone altar.
e.zh: 主石祭坛上方放着一座小祭坛。

e.en: The chapel's {superaltar} was decorated for the feast day.
e.zh: 小礼拜堂的附加祭坛为节日做了装饰。

e.en: In traditional logic, a universal statement is {superaltern} to a particular one.
e.zh: 在传统逻辑中，全称命题是特称命题的上位命题。

e.en: The officer held a {superaltern} position in the old hierarchy.
e.zh: 这名军官在旧等级体系中处于上级职位。

e.en: The {superannealed} wire became too soft for the device.
e.zh: 这根过度退火的金属丝对设备来说太软了。

e.en: Engineers tested the {superannealed} glass under rapid cooling.
e.zh: 工程师在快速冷却条件下测试了过度退火的玻璃。

e.en: Only permanent staff held {superannuable} posts at the university.
e.zh: 只有正式员工在大学里拥有可计退休金的职位。

e.en: Her contract made the position {superannuable} after two years.
e.zh: 她的合同规定两年后该职位可纳入退休金。

e.en: The company decided to {superannuate} several senior managers.
e.zh: 公司决定让几名资深经理退休。

e.en: New software may {superannuate} the old filing system.
e.zh: 新软件可能会淘汰旧的归档系统。

e.en: The policy {superannuates} employees at a fixed age.
e.zh: 这项政策按固定年龄让员工退休。

e.en: Each new model {superannuates} the previous design quickly.
